name: Vana Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM dyUtajitAH pArthAH kopitAshcha durAtmabhiH |
dhArtarAShTraiH sahAmAtyairnikRRityA dvijasattama
shlokas.2:
shrAvitAH paruShA vAchaH sRRijadbhirvairamuttamam |
kimakurvanta kauravyA mama pUrvapitAmahAH
shlokas.3:
kathaM chaishvaryavibhraShTAH sahasA duHkhameyuShaH |
vane vijahrire pArthAH shakrapratimatejasaH
shlokas.4:
ke chainAnanvavartanta prAptAnvyasanamuttamam |
kimAhArAH kimAchArAH kva cha vAso mahAtmanAm
shlokas.5:
kathaM dvAdasha varShANi vane teShAM mahAtmanAm |
vyatIyurbrAhmaNashreShTha shUrANAmarighAtinAm
shlokas.6:
kathaM cha rAjaputrI sA pravarA sarvayoShitAm |
pativratA mahAbhAgA satataM satyavAdinI
vanavAsamaduHkhArhA dAruNaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.7:
etadAchakShva me sarvaM vistareNa tapodhana |
shrotumichChAmi charitaM bhUridraviNatejasAm
kathyamAnaM tvayA vipra paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM dyUtajitAH pArthAH kopitAshcha durAtmabhiH |
dhArtarAShTraiH sahAmAtyairniryayurgajasAhvayAt
shlokas.9:
vardhamAnapuradvAreNAbhiniShkramya te tadA |
uda~NmukhAH shastrabhRRitaH prayayuH saha kRRiShNayA
shlokas.10:
indrasenAdayashchainAnbhRRityAH parichaturdasha |
rathairanuyayuH shIghraiH striya AdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
vrajatastAnviditvA tu paurAH shokAbhipIDitAH |
garhayanto.asakRRidbhIShmaviduradroNagautamAn
UchurvigatasantrAsAH samAgamya parasparam
shlokas.12:
nedamasti kulaM sarvaM na vayaM na cha no gRRihAH |
yatra duryodhanaH pApaH saubaleyena pAlitaH
karNaduHshAsanAbhyAM cha rAjyametachchikIrShati
shlokas.13:
no chetkulaM na chAchAro na dharmo.arthaH kutaH sukham |
yatra pApasahAyo.ayaM pApo rAjyaM bubhUShate
shlokas.14:
duryodhano gurudveShI tyaktAchArasuhRRijjanaH |
arthalubdho.abhimAnI cha nIchaH prakRRitinirghRRiNaH
shlokas.15:
neyamasti mahI kRRitsnA yatra duryodhano nRRipaH |
sAdhu gachChAmahe sarve yatra gachChanti pANDavAH
shlokas.16:
sAnukroshA mahAtmAno vijitendriyashatravaH |
hrImantaH kIrtimantashcha dharmAchAraparAyaNAH
shlokas.17:
evamuktvAnujagmustAnpANDavA.nste sametya cha |
UchuH prA~njalayaH sarve tAnkuntImAdrinandanAn
shlokas.18:
kva gamiShyatha bhadraM vastyaktvAsmAnduHkhabhAginaH |
vayamapyanuyAsyAmo yatra yUyaM gamiShyatha
shlokas.19:
adharmeNa jitA~nshrutvA yuShmA.nstyaktaghRRiNaiH paraiH |
udvignAH sma bhRRishaM sarve nAsmAnhAtumihArhatha
shlokas.20:
bhaktAnuraktAH suhRRidaH sadA priyahite ratAn |
kurAjAdhiShThite rAjye na vinashyema sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
shrUyatAM chAbhidhAsyAmo guNadoShAnnararShabhAH |
shubhAshubhAdhivAsena sa.nsargaM kurute yathA
shlokas.22:
vastramApastilAnbhUmiM gandho vAsayate yathA |
puShpANAmadhivAsena tathA sa.nsargajA guNAH
shlokas.23:
mohajAlasya yonirhi mUDhaireva samAgamaH |
ahanyahani dharmasya yoniH sAdhusamAgamaH
shlokas.24:
tasmAtprAj~naishcha vRRiddhaishcha susvabhAvaistapasvibhiH |
sadbhishcha saha sa.nsargaH kAryaH shamaparAyaNaiH
shlokas.25:
yeShAM trINyavadAtAni yonirvidyA cha karma cha |
tAnsevettaiH samAsyA hi shAstrebhyo.api garIyasI
shlokas.26:
nirArambhA hyapi vayaM puNyashIleShu sAdhuShu |
puNyamevApnuyAmeha pApaM pApopasevanAt
shlokas.27:
asatAM darshanAtsparshAtsa~njalpanasahAsanAt |
dharmAchArAH prahIyante na cha sidhyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.28:
buddhishcha hIyate pu.nsAM nIchaiH saha samAgamAt |
madhyamairmadhyatAM yAti shreShThatAM yAti chottamaiH
shlokas.29:
ye guNAH kIrtitA loke dharmakAmArthasambhavAH |
lokAchArAtmasambhUtA vedoktAH shiShTasaMmatAH
shlokas.30:
te yuShmAsu samastAshcha vyastAshchaiveha sadguNAH |
ichChAmo guNavanmadhye vastuM shreyo.abhikA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhanyA vayaM yadasmAkaM snehakAruNyayantritAH |
asato.api guNAnAhurbrAhmaNapramukhAH prajAH
shlokas.32:
tadahaM bhrAtRRisahitaH sarvAnvij~nApayAmi vaH |
nAnyathA taddhi kartavyamasmatsnehAnukampayA
shlokas.33:
bhIShmaH pitAmaho rAjA viduro jananI cha me |
suhRRijjanashcha prAyo me nagare nAgasAhvaye
shlokas.34:
te tvasmaddhitakAmArthaM pAlanIyAH prayatnataH |
yuShmAbhiH sahitaiH sarvaiH shokasantApavihvalAH
shlokas.35:
nivartatAgatA dUraM samAgamanashApitAH |
svajane nyAsabhUte me kAryA snehAnvitA matiH
shlokas.36:
etaddhi mama kAryANAM paramaM hRRidi sa.nsthitam |
sukRRitAnena me tuShTiH satkArashcha bhaviShyati
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathAnumantritAstena dharmarAjena tAH prajAH |
chakrurArtasvaraM ghoraM hA rAjanniti duHkhitAH
shlokas.38:
guNAnpArthasya sa.nsmRRitya duHkhArtAH paramAturAH |
akAmAH saMnyavartanta samAgamyAtha pANDavAn
shlokas.39:
nivRRitteShu tu paureShu rathAnAsthAya pANDavAH |
prajagmurjAhnavItIre pramANAkhyaM mahAvaTam
shlokas.40:
taM te divasasheSheNa vaTaM gatvA tu pANDavAH |
UShustAM rajanIM vIrAH sa.nspRRishya salilaM shuchi
udakenaiva tAM rAtrimUShuste duHkhakarshitAH
shlokas.41:
anujagmushcha tatraitAnsnehAtkechiddvijAtayaH |
sAgnayo.anagnayashchaiva sashiShyagaNabAndhavAH
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA shushubhe brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.42:
teShAM prAduShkRRitAgnInAM muhUrte ramyadAruNe |
brahmaghoShapuraskAraH sa~njalpaH samajAyata
shlokas.43:
rAjAnaM tu kurushreShThaM te ha.nsamadhurasvarAH |
AshvAsayanto viprAgryAH kShapAM sarvAM vyanodayan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
vanaM yiyAsatAM viprAstasthurbhikShAbhujo.agrataH
tAnuvAcha tato rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
vayaM hi hRRitasarvasvA hRRitarAjyA hRRitashriyaH |
phalamUlAmiShAhArA vanaM yAsyAma duHkhitAH
shlokas.3:
vanaM cha doShabahulaM bahuvyAlasarIsRRipam |
parikleshashcha vo manye dhruvaM tatra bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNAnAM pariklesho daivatAnyapi sAdayet |
kiM punarmAmito viprA nivartadhvaM yatheShTataH
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
gatiryA bhavatAM rAja.nstAM vayaM gantumudyatAH |
nArhathAsmAnparityaktuM bhaktAnsaddharmadarshinaH
shlokas.6:
anukampAM hi bhakteShu daivatAnyapi kurvate |
visheShato brAhmaNeShu sadAchArAvalambiShu
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mamApi paramA bhaktirbrAhmaNeShu sadA dvijAH |
sahAyaviparibhra.nshastvayaM sAdayatIva mAm
shlokas.8:
Ahareyurhi me ye.api phalamUlamRRigA.nstathA |
ta ime shokajairduHkhairbhrAtaro me vimohitAH
shlokas.9:
draupadyA viprakarSheNa rAjyApaharaNena cha |
duHkhAnvitAnimAnkleshairnAhaM yoktumihotsahe
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
asmatpoShaNajA chintA mA bhUtte hRRidi pArthiva |
svayamAhRRitya vanyAni anuyAsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.11:
anudhyAnena japyena vidhAsyAmaH shivaM tava |
kathAbhishchAnukUlAbhiH saha ra.nsyAmahe vane
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametanna sa.ndeho rameyaM brAhmaNaiH saha |
nyUnabhAvAttu pashyAmi pratyAdeshamivAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
kathaM drakShyAmi vaH sarvAnsvayamAhRRitabhojanAn |
madbhaktyA klishyato.anarhAndhikpApAndhRRitarAShTrajAn
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA sa nRRipaH shochanniShasAda mahItale |
tamadhyAtmaratirvidvA~nshaunako nAma vai dvijaH
yoge sA~Nkhye cha kushalo rAjAnamidamabravIt
shlokas.15:
shokasthAnasahasrANi bhayasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.16:
na hi j~nAnaviruddheShu bahudoSheShu karmasu |
shreyoghAtiShu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhAH
shlokas.17:
aShTA~NgAM buddhimAhuryAM sarvAshreyovighAtinIm |
shrutismRRitisamAyuktAM sA rAja.nstvayyavasthitA
shlokas.18:
arthakRRichChreShu durgeShu vyApatsu svajanasya cha |
shArIramAnasairduHkhairna sIdanti bhavadvidhAH
shlokas.19:
shrUyatAM chAbhidhAsyAmi janakena yathA purA |
AtmavyavasthAnakarA gItAH shlokA mahAtmanA
shlokas.20:
manodehasamutthAbhyAM duHkhAbhyAmarditaM jagat |
tayorvyAsasamAsAbhyAM shamopAyamimaM shRRiNu
shlokas.21:
vyAdheraniShTasa.nsparshAchChramAdiShTavivarjanAt |
duHkhaM chaturbhiH shArIraM kAraNaiH sampravartate
shlokas.22:
tadAshupratikArAchcha satataM chAvichintanAt |
AdhivyAdhiprashamanaM kriyAyogadvayena tu
shlokas.23:
matimanto hyato vaidyAH shamaM prAgeva kurvate |
mAnasasya priyAkhyAnaiH sambhogopanayairnRRiNAm
shlokas.24:
mAnasena hi duHkhena sharIramupatapyate |
ayaHpiNDena taptena kumbhasa.nsthamivodakam
shlokas.25:
mAnasaM shamayettasmAjj~nAnenAgnimivAmbunA |
prashAnte mAnase duHkhe shArIramupashAmyati
shlokas.26:
manaso duHkhamUlaM tu sneha ityupalabhyate |
snehAttu sajjate janturduHkhayogamupaiti cha
shlokas.27:
snehamUlAni duHkhAni snehajAni bhayAni cha |
shokaharShau tathAyAsaH sarvaM snehAtpravartate
shlokas.28:
snehAtkaraNarAgashcha prajaj~ne vaiShayastathA |
ashreyaskAvubhAvetau pUrvastatra guruH smRRitaH
shlokas.29:
koTarAgniryathAsheShaM samUlaM pAdapaM dahet |
dharmArthinaM tathAlpo.api rAgadoSho vinAshayet
shlokas.30:
viprayoge na tu tyAgI doShadarshI samAgamAt |
virAgaM bhajate janturnirvairo niShparigrahaH
shlokas.31:
tasmAtsnehaM svapakShebhyo mitrebhyo dhanasa~nchayAt |
svasharIrasamutthaM tu j~nAnena vinivartayet
shlokas.32:
j~nAnAnviteShu mukhyeShu shAstraj~neShu kRRitAtmasu |
na teShu sajjate snehaH padmapatreShvivodakam
shlokas.33:
rAgAbhibhUtaH puruShaH kAmena parikRRiShyate |
ichChA sa~njAyate tasya tatastRRiShNA pravartate
shlokas.34:
tRRiShNA hi sarvapApiShThA nityodvegakarI nRRiNAm |
adharmabahulA chaiva ghorA pApAnubandhinI
shlokas.35:
yA dustyajA durmatibhiryA na jIryati jIryataH |
yo.asau prANAntiko rogastAM tRRiShNAM tyajataH sukham
shlokas.36:
anAdyantA tu sA tRRiShNA antardehagatA nRRiNAm |
vinAshayati sambhUtA ayonija ivAnalaH
shlokas.37:
yathaidhaH svasamutthena vahninA nAshamRRichChati |
tathAkRRitAtmA lobhena sahajena vinashyati
shlokas.38:
rAjataH salilAdagneshchorataH svajanAdapi |
bhayamarthavatAM nityaM mRRityoH prANabhRRitAmiva
shlokas.39:
yathA hyAmiShamAkAshe pakShibhiH shvApadairbhuvi |
bhakShyate salile matsyaistathA sarveNa vittavAn
shlokas.40:
artha eva hi keShA~nchidanartho bhavitA nRRiNAm |
arthashreyasi chAsakto na shreyo vindate naraH
tasmAdarthAgamAH sarve manomohavivardhanAH
shlokas.41:
kArpaNyaM darpamAnau cha bhayamudvega eva cha |
arthajAni viduH prAj~nA duHkhAnyetAni dehinAm
shlokas.42:
arthasyopArjane duHkhaM pAlane cha kShaye tathA |
nAshe duHkhaM vyaye duHkhaM ghnanti chaivArthakAraNAt
shlokas.43:
arthA duHkhaM parityaktuM pAlitAshchApi te.asukhAH |
duHkhena chAdhigamyante teShAM nAshaM na chintayet
shlokas.44:
asantoShaparA mUDhAH santoShaM yAnti paNDitAH |
anto nAsti pipAsAyAH santoShaH paramaM sukham
shlokas.45:
tasmAtsantoShameveha dhanaM pashyanti paNDitAH |
anityaM yauvanaM rUpaM jIvitaM dravyasa~nchayaH
aishvaryaM priyasa.nvAso gRRidhyedeShu na paNDitaH
shlokas.46:
tyajeta sa~nchayA.nstasmAttajjaM kleshaM saheta kaH |
na hi sa~nchayavAnkashchiddRRishyate nirupadravaH
shlokas.47:
atashcha dharmibhiH pumbhiranIhArthaH prashasyate |
prakShAlanAddhi pa~Nkasya dUrAdasparshanaM varam
shlokas.48:
yudhiShThiraivamartheShu na spRRihAM kartumarhasi |
dharmeNa yadi te kAryaM vimuktechCho bhavArthataH
shlokas.49:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nArthopabhogalipsArthamiyamarthepsutA mama |
bharaNArthaM tu viprANAM brahmankA~NkShe na lobhataH
shlokas.50:
kathaM hyasmadvidho brahmanvartamAno gRRihAshrame |
bharaNaM pAlanaM chApi na kuryAdanuyAyinAm
shlokas.51:
sa.nvibhAgo hi bhUtAnAM sarveShAmeva shiShyate |
tathaivApachamAnebhyaH pradeyaM gRRihamedhinA
shlokas.52:
tRRiNAni bhUmirudakaM vAkchaturthI cha sUnRRitA |
satAmetAni geheShu nochChidyante kadAchana
shlokas.53:
deyamArtasya shayanaM sthitashrAntasya chAsanam |
tRRiShitasya cha pAnIyaM kShudhitasya cha bhojanam
shlokas.54:
chakShurdadyAnmano dadyAdvAchaM dadyAchcha sUnRRitAm |
pratyudgamyAbhigamanaM kuryAnnyAyena chArchanam
shlokas.55:
aghihotramanaDvA.nshcha j~nAtayo.atithibAndhavAH |
putradArabhRRitAshchaiva nirdaheyurapUjitAH
shlokas.56:
nAtmArthaM pAchayedannaM na vRRithA ghAtayetpashUn |
na cha tatsvayamashnIyAdvidhivadyanna nirvapet
shlokas.57:
shvabhyashcha shvapachebhyashcha vayobhyashchAvapedbhuvi |
vaishvadevaM hi nAmaitatsAyamprAtarvidhIyate
shlokas.58:
vighasAshI bhavettasmAnnityaM chAmRRitabhojanaH |
vighasaM bhRRityasheShaM tu yaj~nasheShaM tathAmRRitam
shlokas.59:
etAM yo vartate vRRittiM vartamAno gRRihAshrame |
tasya dharmaM paraM prAhuH kathaM vA vipra manyase
shlokas.60:
shaunaka uvAcha||
aho bata mahatkaShTaM viparItamidaM jagat |
yenApatrapate sAdhurasAdhustena tuShyati
shlokas.61:
shishnodarakRRite.aprAj~naH karoti vighasaM bahu |
moharAgasamAkrAnta indriyArthavashAnugaH
shlokas.62:
hriyate budhyamAno.api naro hAribhirindriyaiH |
vimUDhasa~nj~no duShTAshvairudbhrAntairiva sArathiH
shlokas.63:
ShaDindriyANi viShayaM samAgachChanti vai yadA |
tadA prAdurbhavatyeShAM pUrvasa~NkalpajaM manaH
shlokas.64:
mano yasyendriyagrAmaviShayaM prati choditam |
tasyautsukyaM sambhavati pravRRittishchopajAyate
shlokas.65:
tataH sa~NkalpavIryeNa kAmena viShayeShubhiH |
viddhaH patati lobhAgnau jyotirlobhAtpata~Ngavat
shlokas.66:
tato vihArairAhArairmohitashcha vishAM pate |
mahAmohamukhe magno nAtmAnamavabudhyate
shlokas.67:
evaM patati sa.nsAre tAsu tAsviha yoniShu |
avidyAkarmatRRiShNAbhirbhrAmyamANo.atha chakravat
shlokas.68:
brahmAdiShu tRRiNAnteShu hUteShu parivartate |
jale bhuvi tathAkAshe jAyamAnaH punaH punaH
shlokas.69:
abudhAnAM gatistveShA budhAnAmapi me shRRiNu |
ye dharme shreyasi ratA vimokSharatayo janAH
shlokas.70:
yadidaM vedavachanaM kuru karma tyajeti cha |
tasmAddharmAnimAnsarvAnnAbhimAnAtsamAcharet
shlokas.71:
ijyAdhyayanadAnAni tapaH satyaM kShamA damaH |
alobha iti mArgo.ayaM dharmasyAShTavidhaH smRRitaH
shlokas.72:
tatra pUrvashchaturvargaH pitRRiyAnapathe sthitaH |
kartavyamiti yatkAryaM nAbhimAnAtsamAcharet
shlokas.73:
uttaro devayAnastu sadbhirAcharitaH sadA |
aShTA~Ngenaiva mArgeNa vishuddhAtmA samAcharet
shlokas.75:
samyagAhArayogAchcha samyakchAdhyayanAgamAt |
samyakkarmopasaMnyAsAtsamyakchittanirodhanAt
evaM karmANi kurvanti sa.nsAravijigIShavaH
shlokas.76:
rAgadveShavinirmuktA aishvaryaM devatA gatAH |
rudrAH sAdhyAstathAdityA vasavo.athAshvinAvapi
yogaishvaryeNa sa.nyuktA dhArayanti prajA imAH
shlokas.77:
tathA tvamapi kaunteya shamamAsthAya puShkalam |
tapasA siddhimanvichCha yogasiddhiM cha bhArata
shlokas.78:
pitRRimAtRRimayI siddhiH prAptA karmamayI cha te |
tapasA siddhimanvichCha dvijAnAM bharaNAya vai
shlokas.79:
siddhA hi yadyadichChanti kurvate tadanugrahAt |
tasmAttapaH samAsthAya kuruShvAtmamanoratham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shaunakenaivamuktastu kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
purohitamupAgamya bhrAtRRimadhye.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
prasthitaM mAnuyAntIme brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
na chAsmi pAlane shakto bahuduHkhasamanvitaH
shlokas.3:
parityaktuM na shaknomi dAnashaktishcha nAsti me |
kathamatra mayA kAryaM bhagavA.nstadbravItu me
shlokas.4:
muhUrtamiva sa dhyAtvA dharmeNAnviShya tAM gatim |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM dhaumyo dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.5:
purA sRRiShTAni bhUtAni pIDyante kShudhayA bhRRisham |
tato.anukampayA teShAM savitA svapitA iva
shlokas.6:
gatvottarAyaNaM tejorasAnuddhRRitya rashmibhiH |
dakShiNAyanamAvRRitto mahIM nivishate raviH
shlokas.7:
kShetrabhUte tatastasminnoShadhIroShadhIpatiH |
divastejaH samuddhRRitya janayAmAsa vAriNA
shlokas.8:
niShiktashchandratejobhiH sUyate bhUgato raviH |
oShadhyaH ShaDrasA medhyAstadannaM prANinAM bhuvi
shlokas.9:
evaM bhAnumayaM hyannaM bhUtAnAM prANadhAraNam |
pitaiSha sarvabhUtAnAM tasmAttaM sharaNaM vraja
shlokas.10:
rAjAno hi mahAtmAno yonikarmavishodhitAH |
uddharanti prajAH sarvAstapa AsthAya puShkalam
shlokas.11:
bhImena kArtavIryeNa vainyena nahuSheNa cha |
tapoyogasamAdhisthairuddhRRitA hyApadaH prajAH
shlokas.12:
tathA tvamapi dharmAtmankarmaNA cha vishodhitaH |
tapa AsthAya dharmeNa dvijAtInbhara bhArata
shlokas.13:
evamuktastu dhaumyena tatkAlasadRRishaM vachaH |
dharmarAjo vishuddhAtmA tapa AtiShThaduttamam
shlokas.14:
puShpopahArairbalibhirarchayitvA divAkaram |
yogamAsthAya dharmAtmA vAyubhakSho jitendriyaH
gA~NgeyaM vAryupaspRRiShya prANAyAmena tasthivAn
shlokas.15:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM kurUNAmRRiShabhaH sa tu rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
viprArthamArAdhitavAnsUryamadbhutavikramam
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAja~nshuchirbhUtvA samAhitaH |
kShaNaM cha kuru rAjendra sarvaM vakShyAmyasheShataH
shlokas.17:
dhaumyena tu yatha proktaM pArthAya sumahAtmane |
nAmnAmaShTashataM puNyaM tachChRRiNuShva mahAmate
shlokas.18:
sUryo.aryamA bhagastvaShTA pUShArkaH savitA raviH |
gabhastimAnajaH kAlo mRRityurdhAtA prabhAkaraH
shlokas.19:
pRRithivyApashcha tejashcha khaM vAyushcha parAyaNam |
somo bRRihaspatiH shukro budho.a~NgAraka eva cha
shlokas.20:
indro vivasvAndIptA.nshuH shuchiH shauriH shanaishcharaH |
brahmA viShNushcha rudrashcha skando vaishravaNo yamaH
shlokas.21:
vaidyuto jATharashchAgniraindhanastejasAM patiH |
dharmadhvajo vedakartA vedA~Ngo vedavAhanaH
shlokas.22:
kRRitaM tretA dvAparashcha kaliH sarvAmarAshrayaH |
kalA kAShThA muhUrtAshcha pakShA mAsA RRitustathA
shlokas.23:
sa.nvatsarakaro.ashvatthaH kAlachakro vibhAvasuH |
puruShaH shAshvato yogI vyaktAvyaktaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.24:
lokAdhyakShaH prajAdhyakSho vishvakarmA tamonudaH |
varuNaH sAgaroM.ashushcha jImUto jIvano.arihA
shlokas.25:
bhUtAshrayo bhUtapatiH sarvabhUtaniShevitaH |
maNiH suvarNo bhUtAdiH kAmadaH sarvatomukhaH
shlokas.26:
jayo vishAlo varadaH shIghragaH prANadhAraNaH |
dhanvantarirdhUmaketurAdidevo.aditeH sutaH
shlokas.27:
dvAdashAtmAravindAkShaH pitA mAtA pitAmahaH |
svargadvAraM prajAdvAraM mokShadvAraM triviShTapam
shlokas.28:
dehakartA prashAntAtmA vishvAtmA vishvatomukhaH |
charAcharAtmA sUkShmAtmA maitreNa vapuShAnvitaH
shlokas.29:
etadvai kIrtanIyasya sUryasyaiva mahAtmanaH |
nAmnAmaShTashataM puNyaM shakreNoktaM mahAtmanA
shlokas.30:
shakrAchcha nAradaH prApto dhaumyashcha tadanantaram |
dhaumyAdyudhiShThiraH prApya sarvAnkAmAnavAptavAn
shlokas.31:
surapitRRigaNayakShasevitaM; hyasuranishAcharasiddhavanditam |
varakanakahutAshanaprabhaM; tvamapi manasyabhidhehi bhAskaram
shlokas.32:
sUryodaye yastu samAhitaH paThe;tsa putralAbhaM dhanaratnasa~nchayAn |
labheta jAtismaratAM sadA naraH; smRRitiM cha medhAM cha sa vindate parAm
shlokas.33:
imaM stavaM devavarasya yo naraH; prakIrtayechChuchisumanAH samAhitaH |
sa muchyate shokadavAgnisAgarA;llabheta kAmAnmanasA yathepsitAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato divAkaraH prIto darshayAmAsa pANDavam |
dIpyamAnaH svavapuShA jvalanniva hutAshanaH
shlokas.2:
yatte.abhilaShitaM rAjansarvametadavApsyasi |
ahamannaM pradAsyAmi sapta pa~ncha cha te samAH
shlokas.3:
phalamUlAmiShaM shAkaM sa.nskRRitaM yanmahAnase |
chaturvidhaM tadannAdyamakShayyaM te bhaviShyati
dhanaM cha vividhaM tubhyamityuktvAntaradhIyata
shlokas.4:
labdhvA varaM tu kaunteyo jalAduttIrya dharmavit |
jagrAha pAdau dhaumyasya bhrAtR^I.nshchAsvajatAchyutaH
shlokas.5:
draupadyA saha sa~Ngamya pashyamAno.abhyayAtprabhuH |
mahAnase tadAnnaM tu sAdhayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.6:
sa.nskRRitaM prasavaM yAti vanyamannaM chaturvidham |
akShayyaM vardhate chAnnaM tena bhojayate dvijAn
shlokas.7:
bhuktavatsu cha vipreShu bhojayitvAnujAnapi |
sheShaM vighasasa~nj~naM tu pashchAdbhu~Nkte yudhiShThiraH
yudhiShThiraM bhojayitvA sheShamashnAti pArShatI
shlokas.8:
evaM divAkarAtprApya divAkarasamadyutiH |
kAmAnmano.abhilaShitAnbrAhmaNebhyo dadau prabhuH
shlokas.9:
purohitapurogAshcha tithinakShatraparvasu |
yaj~niyArthAH pravartante vidhimantrapramANataH
shlokas.10:
tataH kRRitasvastyayanA dhaumyena saha pANDavAH |
dvijasa~NghaiH parivRRitAH prayayuH kAmyakaM vanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vanaM praviShTeShvatha pANDaveShu; praj~nAchakShustapyamAno.ambikeyaH |
dharmAtmAnaM viduramagAdhabuddhiM; sukhAsIno vAkyamuvAcha rAjA
shlokas.2:
praj~nA cha te bhArgavasyeva shuddhA; dharmaM cha tvaM paramaM vettha sUkShmam |
samashcha tvaM saMmataH kauravANAM; pathyaM chaiShAM mama chaiva bravIhi
shlokas.3:
evaM gate vidura yadadya kAryaM; paurAshcheme kathamasmAnbhajeran |
te chApyasmAnnoddhareyuH samUlA;nna kAmaye tA.nshcha vinashyamAnAn
shlokas.4:
vidura uvAcha||
trivargo.ayaM dharmamUlo narendra; rAjyaM chedaM dharmamUlaM vadanti |
dharme rAjanvartamAnaH svashaktyA; putrAnsarvAnpAhi kuntIsutA.nshcha
shlokas.5:
sa vai dharmo vipraluptaH sabhAyAM; pApAtmabhiH saubaleyapradhAnaiH |
AhUya kuntIsutamakShavatyAM; parAjaiShItsatyasandhaM sutaste
shlokas.6:
etasya te duShpraNItasya rAja;~nsheShasyAhaM paripashyAmyupAyam |
yathA putrastava kauravya pApA;nmukto loke pratitiShTheta sAdhu
shlokas.7:
tadvai sarvaM pANDuputrA labhantAM; yattadrAjannatisRRiShTaM tvayAsIt |
eSha dharmaH paramo yatsvakena; rAjA tuShyenna parasveShu gRRidhyet
shlokas.8:
etatkAryaM tava sarvapradhAnaM; teShAM tuShTiH shakuneshchAvamAnaH |
evaM sheShaM yadi putreShu te syA;detadrAja.nstvaramANaH kuruShva
shlokas.9:
athaitadevaM na karoShi rAja;ndhruvaM kurUNAM bhavitA vinAshaH |
na hi kruddho bhImaseno.arjuno vA; sheShaM kuryAchChAtravANAmanIke
shlokas.10:
yeShAM yoddhA savyasAchI kRRitAstro; dhanuryeShAM gANDivaM lokasAram |
yeShAM bhImo bAhushAlI cha yoddhA; teShAM loke kiM nu na prApyamasti
shlokas.11:
uktaM pUrvaM jAtamAtre sute te; mayA yatte hitamAsIttadAnIm |
putraM tyajemamahitaM kulasye;tyetadrAjanna cha tattvaM chakartha
idAnIM te hitamuktaM na chettvaM; kartAsi rAjanparitaptAsi pashchAt
shlokas.12:
yadyetadevamanumantA sutaste; samprIyamANaH pANDavairekarAjyam |
tApo na te vai bhavitA prItiyogA;ttvaM chenna gRRihNAsi sutaM sahAyaiH
athAparo bhavati hi taM nigRRihya; pANDoH putraM prakuruShvAdhipatye
shlokas.13:
ajAtashatrurhi vimuktarAgo; dharmeNemAM pRRithivIM shAstu rAjan |
tato rAjanpArthivAH sarva eva; vaishyA ivAsmAnupatiShThantu sadyaH
shlokas.14:
duryodhanaH shakuniH sUtaputraH; prItyA rAjanpANDuputrAnbhajantAm |
duHshAsano yAchatu bhImasenaM; sabhAmadhye drupadasyAtmajAM cha
shlokas.15:
yudhiShThiraM tvaM parisAntvayasva; rAjye chainaM sthApayasvAbhipUjya |
tvayA pRRiShTaH kimahamanyadvadeya;metatkRRitvA kRRitakRRityo.asi rAjan
shlokas.16:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
etadvAkyaM vidura yatte sabhAyA;miha proktaM pANDavAnprApya mAM cha |
hitaM teShAmahitaM mAmakAnA;metatsarvaM mama nopaiti chetaH
shlokas.17:
idaM tvidAnIM kuta eva nishchitaM; teShAmarthe pANDavAnAM yadAttha |
tenAdya manye nAsi hito mameti; kathaM hi putraM pANDavArthe tyajeyam
shlokas.18:
asa.nshayaM te.api mamaiva putrA; duryodhanastu mama dehAtprasUtaH |
svaM vai dehaM parahetostyajeti; ko nu brUyAtsamatAmanvavekShan
shlokas.19:
sa mA jihmaM vidura sarvaM bravIShi; mAnaM cha te.ahamadhikaM dhArayAmi |
yathechChakaM gachCha vA tiShTha vA tvaM; susAntvyamAnApyasatI strI jahAti
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA dhRRitarAShTro.anvapadya;dantarveshma sahasotthAya rAjan |
nedamastItyatha viduro bhAShamANaH; samprAdravadyatra pArthA babhUvuH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pANDavAstu vane vAsamuddishya bharatarShabhAH |
prayayurjAhnavIkUlAtkurukShetraM sahAnugAH
shlokas.2:
sarasvatIdRRiShadvatyau yamunAM cha niShevya te |
yayurvanenaiva vanaM satataM pashchimAM disham
shlokas.3:
tataH sarasvatIkUle sameShu marudhanvasu |
kAmyakaM nAma dadRRishurvanaM munijanapriyam
shlokas.4:
tatra te nyavasanvIrA vane bahumRRigadvije |
anvAsyamAnA munibhiH sAntvyamAnAshcha bhArata
shlokas.5:
vidurastvapi pANDUnAM tadA darshanalAlasaH |
jagAmaikarathenaiva kAmyakaM vanamRRiddhimat
shlokas.6:
tato yAtvA viduraH kAnanaM ta;chChIghrairashvairvAhinA syandanena |
dadarshAsInaM dharmarAjaM vivikte; sArdhaM draupadyA bhrAtRRibhirbrAhmaNaishcha
shlokas.7:
tato.apashyadviduraM tUrNamArA;dabhyAyAntaM satyasandhaH sa rAjA |
athAbravIdbhrAtaraM bhImasenaM; kiM nu kShattA vakShyati naH sametya
shlokas.8:
kachchinnAyaM vachanAtsaubalasya; samAhvAtA devanAyopayAti |
kachchitkShudraH shakunirnAyudhAni; jeShyatyasmAnpunarevAkShavatyAm
shlokas.9:
samAhUtaH kenachidAdraveti; nAhaM shakto bhImasenApayAtum |
gANDIve vA sa.nshayite kathaM chi;drAjyaprAptiH sa.nshayitA bhavennaH
shlokas.10:
tata utthAya viduraM pANDaveyAH; pratyagRRihNannRRipate sarva eva |
taiH satkRRitaH sa cha tAnAjamIDho; yathochitaM pANDuputrAnsameyAt
shlokas.11:
samAshvastaM viduraM te nararShabhA;stato.apRRichChannAgamanAya hetum |
sa chApi tebhyo vistarataH shasha.nsa; yathAvRRitto dhRRitarAShTro.a.ambikeyaH
shlokas.12:
vidura uvAcha||
avochanmAM dhRRitarAShTro.anugupta;majAtashatro parigRRihyAbhipUjya |
evaM gate samatAmabhyupetya; pathyaM teShAM mama chaiva bravIhi
shlokas.13:
mayApyuktaM yatkShamaM kauravANAM; hitaM pathyaM dhRRitarAShTrasya chaiva |
tadvai pathyaM tanmano nAbhyupaiti; tatashchAhaM kShamamanyanna manye
shlokas.14:
paraM shreyaH pANDaveyA mayoktaM; na me tachcha shrutavAnAmbikeyaH |
yathAturasyeva hi pathyamannaM; na rochate smAsya taduchyamAnam
shlokas.15:
na shreyase nIyate.ajAtashatro; strI shrotriyasyeva gRRihe praduShTA |
bruvanna ruchyai bharatarShabhasya; patiH kumAryA iva ShaShTivarShaH
shlokas.16:
dhruvaM vinAsho nRRipa kauravANAM; na vai shreyo dhRRitarAShTraH paraiti |
yathA parNe puShkarasyeva siktaM; jalaM na tiShThetpathyamuktaM tathAsmin
shlokas.17:
tataH kruddho dhRRitarAShTro.abravInmAM; yatra shraddhA bhArata tatra yAhi |
nAhaM bhUyaH kAmaye tvAM sahAyaM; mahImimAM pAlayituM puraM vA
shlokas.18:
so.ahaM tyakto dhRRitarAShTreNa rAjaM;stvAM shAsitumupayAtastvarAvAn |
tadvai sarvaM yanmayoktaM sabhAyAM; taddhAryatAM yatpravakShyAmi bhUyaH
shlokas.19:
kleshaistIvrairyujyamAnaH sapatnaiH; kShamAM kurvankAlamupAsate yaH |
saM vardhayanstokamivAgnimAtmavA;nsa vai bhu~Nkte pRRithivImeka eva
shlokas.20:
yasyAvibhaktaM vasu rAjansahAyai;stasya duHkhe.apya.nshabhAjaH sahAyAH |
sahAyAnAmeSha sa~NgrahaNe.abhyupAyaH; sahAyAptau pRRithivIprAptimAhuH
shlokas.21:
satyaM shreShThaM pANDava niShpralApaM; tulyaM chAnnaM saha bhojyaM sahAyaiH |
AtmA chaiShAmagrato nAtivarte;deva.nvRRittirvardhate bhUmipAlaH
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evaM kariShyAmi yathA bravIShi; parAM buddhimupagamyApramattaH |
yachchApyanyaddeshakAlopapannaM; tadvai vAchyaM tatkariShyAmi kRRitsnam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gate tu vidure rAjannAshramaM pANDavAnprati |
dhRRitarAShTro mahAprAj~naH paryatapyata bhArata
shlokas.2:
sa sabhAdvAramAgamya vidurasmAramohitaH |
samakShaM pArthivendrANAM papAtAviShTachetanaH
shlokas.3:
sa tu labdhvA punaH sa~nj~nAM samutthAya mahItalAt |
samIpopasthitaM rAjA sa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.4:
bhrAtA mama suhRRichchaiva sAkShAddharma ivAparaH |
tasya smRRitvAdya subhRRishaM hRRidayaM dIryatIva me
shlokas.5:
tamAnayasva dharmaj~naM mama bhrAtaramAshu vai |
iti bruvansa nRRipatiH karuNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.6:
pashchAttApAbhisantapto vidurasmArakarshitaH |
bhrAtRRisnehAdidaM rAjansa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.7:
gachCha sa~njaya jAnIhi bhrAtaraM viduraM mama |
yadi jIvati roSheNa mayA pApena nirdhutaH
shlokas.8:
na hi tena mama bhrAtrA susUkShmamapi ki~nchana |
vyalIkaM kRRitapUrvaM me prAj~nenAmitabuddhinA
shlokas.9:
sa vyalIkaM kathaM prApto mattaH paramabuddhimAn |
na jahyAjjIvitaM prAj~nastaM gachChAnaya sa~njaya
shlokas.10:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA rAj~nastamanumAnya cha |
sa~njayo bADhamityuktvA prAdravatkAmyakaM vanam
shlokas.11:
so.achireNa samAsAdya tadvanaM yatra pANDavAH |
rauravAjinasa.nvItaM dadarshAtha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.12:
vidureNa sahAsInaM brAhmaNaishcha sahasrashaH |
bhrAtRRibhishchAbhisa~NguptaM devairiva shatakratum
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThiramathAbhyetya pUjayAmAsa sa~njayaH |
bhImArjunayamA.nshchApi tadarhaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.14:
rAj~nA pRRiShTaH sa kushalaM sukhAsInashcha sa~njayaH |
shasha.nsAgamane hetumidaM chaivAbravIdvachaH
shlokas.15:
rAjA smarati te kShattardhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
taM pashya gatvA tvaM kShipraM sa~njIvaya cha pArthivam
shlokas.16:
so.anumAnya narashreShThAnpANDavAnkurunandanAn |
niyogAdrAjasiMhasya gantumarhasi mAnada
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu viduro dhImAnsvajanavatsalaH |
yudhiShThirasyAnumate punarAyAdgajAhvayam
shlokas.18:
tamabravInmahAprAj~naM dhRRitarAShTraH pratApavAn |
diShTyA prApto.asi dharmaj~na diShTyA smarasi me.anagha
shlokas.19:
adya rAtrau divA chAhaM tvatkRRite bharatarShabha |
prajAgare papashyAmi vichitraM dehamAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
so.a~NkamAdAya viduraM mUrdhnyupAghrAya chaiva ha |
kShamyatAmiti chovAcha yadukto.asi mayA ruShA
shlokas.21:
vidura uvAcha||
kShAntameva mayA rAjangururnaH paramo bhavAn |
tathA hyasmyAgataH kShipraM tvaddarshanaparAyaNaH
shlokas.22:
bhavanti hi naravyAghra puruShA dharmachetasaH |
dInAbhipAtino rAjannAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.23:
pANDoH sutA yAdRRishA me tAdRRishA me sutAstava |
dInA iti hi me buddhirabhipannAdya tAnprati
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anyonyamanunIyaivaM bhrAtarau tau mahAdyutI |
viduro dhRRitarAShTrashcha lebhAte paramAM mudam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA cha viduraM prAptaM rAj~nA cha parisAntvitam |
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajo rAjA paryatapyata durmatiH
shlokas.2:
sa saubalaM samAnAyya karNaduHshAsanAvapi |
abravIdvachanaM rAjA pravishyAbuddhijaM tamaH
shlokas.3:
eSha pratyAgato mantrI dhRRitarAShTrasya saMmataH |
viduraH pANDuputrANAM suhRRidvidvAnhite rataH
shlokas.4:
yAvadasya punarbuddhiM viduro nApakarShati |
pANDavAnayane tAvanmantrayadhvaM hitaM mama
shlokas.5:
atha pashyAmyahaM pArthAnprAptAniha katha~nchana |
punaH shoShaM gamiShyAmi nirAsurniravagrahaH
shlokas.6:
viShamudbandhanaM vApi shastramagnipraveshanam |
kariShye na hi tAnRRiddhAnpunardraShTumihotsahe
shlokas.7:
shakuniruvAcha||
kiM bAliShAM matiM rAjannAsthito.asi vishAM pate |
gatAste samayaM kRRitvA naitadevaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
satyavAkye sthitAH sarve pANDavA bharatarShabha |
pituste vachanaM tAta na grahIShyanti karhichit
shlokas.9:
atha vA te grahIShyanti punareShyanti vA puram |
nirasya samayaM bhUyaH paNo.asmAkaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.10:
sarve bhavAmo madhyasthA rAj~nashChandAnuvartinaH |
ChidraM bahu prapashyantaH pANDavAnAM susa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.11:
duHshAsana uvAcha||
evametanmahAprAj~na yathA vadasi mAtula |
nityaM hi me kathayatastava buddhirhi rochate
shlokas.12:
karNa uvAcha||
kAmamIkShAmahe sarve duryodhana tavepsitam |
aikamatyaM hi no rAjansarveShAmeva lakShyate
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu karNena rAjA duryodhanastadA |
nAtihRRiShTamanAH kShipramabhavatsa parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.14:
upalabhya tataH karNo vivRRitya nayane shubhe |
roShAdduHshAsanaM chaiva saubaleyaM cha tAvubhau
shlokas.15:
uvAcha paramakruddha udyamyAtmAnamAtmanA |
aho mama mataM yattannibodhata narAdhipAH
shlokas.16:
priyaM sarve chikIrShAmo rAj~naH ki~NkarapANayaH |
na chAsya shaknumaH sarve priye sthAtumatandritAH
shlokas.17:
vayaM tu shastrANyAdAya rathAnAsthAya da.nshitAH |
gachChAmaH sahitA hantuM pANDavAnvanagocharAn
shlokas.18:
teShu sarveShu shAnteShu gateShvaviditAM gatim |
nirvivAdA bhaviShyanti dhArtarAShTrAstathA vayam
shlokas.19:
yAvadeva paridyUnA yAvachChokaparAyaNAH |
yAvanmitravihInAshcha tAvachChakyA mataM mama
shlokas.20:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA pUjayantaH punaH punaH |
bADhamityeva te sarve pratyUchuH sUtajaM tadA
shlokas.21:
evamuktvA tu sa~NkruddhA rathaiH sarve pRRithakpRRithak |
niryayuH pANDavAnhantuM sa~NghashaH kRRitanishchayAH
shlokas.22:
tAnprasthitAnparij~nAya kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA dRRiShTvA divyena chakShuShA
shlokas.23:
pratiShidhyAtha tAnsarvAnbhagavA.NllokapUjitaH |
praj~nAchakShuShamAsInamuvAchAbhyetya satvaraH

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTra mahAprAj~na nibodha vachanaM mama |
vakShyAmi tvA kauravANAM sarveShAM hitamuttamam
shlokas.2:
na me priyaM mahAbAho yadgatAH pANDavA vanam |
nikRRityA nirjitAshchaiva duryodhanavashAnugaiH
shlokas.3:
te smarantaH parikleshAnvarShe pUrNe trayodashe |
vimokShyanti viShaM kruddhAH karaveyeShu bhArata
shlokas.4:
tadayaM kiM nu pApAtmA tava putraH sumandadhIH |
pANDavAnnityasa~Nkruddho rAjyahetorjighA.nsati
shlokas.5:
vAryatAM sAdhvayaM mUDhaH shamaM gachChatu te sutaH |
vanasthA.nstAnayaM hantumichChanprANairvimokShyate
shlokas.6:
yathAha viduraH prAj~no yathA bhIShmo yathA vayam |
yathA kRRipashcha droNashcha tathA sAdhu vidhIyatAm
shlokas.7:
vigraho hi mahAprAj~na svajanena vigarhitaH |
adharmyamayashasyaM cha mA rAjanpratipadyathAH
shlokas.8:
samIkShA yAdRRishI hyasya pANDavAnprati bhArata |
upekShyamANA sA rAjanmahAntamanayaM spRRishet
shlokas.9:
atha vAyaM sumandAtmA vanaM gachChatu te sutaH |
pANDavaiH sahito rAjanneka evAsahAyavAn
shlokas.10:
tataH sa.nsargajaH snehaH putrasya tava pANDavaiH |
yadi syAtkRRitakAryo.adya bhavestvaM manujeshvara
shlokas.11:
atha vA jAyamAnasya yachChIlamanujAyate |
shrUyate tanmahArAja nAmRRitasyApasarpati
shlokas.12:
kathaM vA manyate bhIShmo droNo vA viduro.api vA |
bhavAnvAtra kShamaM kAryaM purA chArtho.ativartate

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhagavannAhamapyetadrochaye dyUtasa.nstavam |
manye tadvidhinAkramya kArito.asmIti vai mune
shlokas.2:
naitadrochayate bhIShmo na droNo viduro na cha |
gAndhArI nechChati dyUtaM tachcha mohAtpravartitam
shlokas.3:
parityaktuM na shaknomi duryodhanamachetanam |
putrasnehena bhagava~njAnannapi yatavrata
shlokas.4:
vyAsa uvAcha||
vaichitravIrya nRRipate satyamAha yathA bhavAn |
dRRiDhaM vedmi paraM putraM paraM putrAnna vidyate
shlokas.5:
indro.apyashrunipAtena surabhyA pratibodhitaH |
anyaiH samRRiddhairapyarthairna sutAdvidyate param
shlokas.6:
atra te vartayiShyAmi mahadAkhyAnamuttamam |
surabhyAshchaiva sa.nvAdamindrasya cha vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
triviShTapagatA rAjansurabhiH prArudatkila |
gavAM mAta purA tAta tAmindro.anvakRRipAyata
shlokas.8:
indra uvAcha||
kimidaM rodiShi shubhe kachchitkShemaM divaukasAm |
mAnuSheShvatha vA goShu naitadalpaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
surabhiruvAcha||
vinipAto na vaH kashchiddRRishyate tridashAdhipa |
ahaM tu putraM shochAmi tena rodimi kaushika
shlokas.10:
pashyainaM karShakaM raudraM durbalaM mama putrakam |
pratodenAbhinighnantaM lA~Ngalena nipIDitam
shlokas.11:
etaM dRRiShTvA bhRRishaM shrantaM vadhyamAnaM surAdhipa |
kRRipAviShTAsmi devendra manashchodvijate mama
shlokas.12:
ekastatra balopeto dhuramudvahate.adhikAm |
aparo.alpabalaprANaH kRRisho dhamanisantataH
kRRichChrAdudvahate bhAraM taM vai shochAmi vAsava
shlokas.13:
vadhyamAnaH pratodena tudyamAnaH punaH punaH |
naiva shaknoti taM bhAramudvoDhuM pashya vAsava
shlokas.14:
tato.ahaM tasya duHkhArtA viraumi bhRRishaduHkhitA |
ashrUNyAvartayantI cha netrAbhyAM karuNAyatI
shlokas.15:
indra uvAcha||
tava putrasahasreShu pIDyamAneShu shobhane |
kiM kRRipAyitamastyatra putra eko.atra pIDyate
shlokas.16:
surabhiruvAcha||
yadi putrasahasraM me sarvatra samameva me |
dInasya tu sataH shakra putrasyAbhyadhikA kRRipA
shlokas.17:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tadindraH surabhIvAkyaM nishamya bhRRishavismitaH |
jIvitenApi kauravya mene.abhyadhikamAtmajam
shlokas.18:
pravavarSha cha tatraiva sahasA toyamulbaNam |
karShakasyAcharanvighnaM bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH
shlokas.19:
tadyathA surabhiH prAha samamevAstu te tathA |
suteShu rAjansarveShu dIneShvabhyadhikA kRRipA
shlokas.20:
yAdRRisho me sutaH paNDustAdRRisho me.asi putraka |
vidurashcha mahAprAj~naH snehAdetadbravImyaham
shlokas.21:
chirAya tava putrANAM shatamekashcha pArthiva |
pANDoH pa~nchaiva lakShyante te.api mandAH suduHkhitAH
shlokas.22:
kathaM jIveyuratyantaM kathaM vardheyurityapi |
iti dIneShu pArtheShu mano me paritapyate
shlokas.23:
yadi pArthiva kauravyA~njIvamAnAnihechChasi |
duryodhanastava sutaH shamaM gachChatu pANDavaiH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evametanmahAprAj~na yathA vadasi no mune |
ahaM chaiva vijAnAmi sarve cheme narAdhipAH
shlokas.2:
bhavA.nstu manyate sAdhu yatkurUNAM sukhodayam |
tadeva viduro.apyAha bhIShmo droNashcha mAM mune
shlokas.3:
yadi tvahamanugrAhyaH kauraveShu dayA yadi |
anushAdhi durAtmAnaM putraM duryodhanaM mama
shlokas.4:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ayamAyAti vai rAjanmaitreyo bhagavAnRRiShiH |
anvIya pANDavAnbhrAtR^InihaivAsmaddidRRikShayA
shlokas.5:
eSha duryodhanaM putraM tava rAjanmahAnRRiShiH |
anushAstA yathAnyAyaM shamAyAsya kulasya te
shlokas.6:
brUyAdyadeSha rAjendra tatkAryamavisha~NkayA |
akriyAyAM hi kAryasya putraM te shapsyate ruShA
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA yayau vyAso maitreyaH pratyadRRishyata |
pUjayA pratijagrAha saputrastaM narAdhipaH
shlokas.8:
dattvArghyAdyAH kriyAH sarvA vishrAntaM munipu~Ngavam |
prashrayeNAbravIdrAjA dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH
shlokas.9:
sukhenAgamanaM kachchidbhagavankurujA~Ngale |
kachchitkushalino vIrA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH
shlokas.10:
samaye sthAtumichChanti kachchichcha puruSharShabhAH |
kachchitkurUNAM saubhrAtramavyuchChinnaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
maitreya uvAcha||
tIrthayAtrAmanukrAmanprApto.asmi kurujA~Ngalam |
yadRRichChayA dharmarAjaM dRRiShTavAnkAmyake vane
shlokas.12:
taM jaTAjinasa.nvItaM tapovananivAsinam |
samAjagmurmahAtmAnaM draShTuM munigaNAH prabho
shlokas.13:
tatrAshrauShaM mahArAja putrANAM tava vibhramam |
anayaM dyUtarUpeNa mahApAyamupasthitam
shlokas.14:
tato.ahaM tvAmanuprAptaH kauravANAmavekShayA |
sadA hyabhyadhikaH snehaH prItishcha tvayi me prabho
shlokas.15:
naitadaupayikaM rAja.nstvayi bhIShme cha jIvati |
yadanyonyena te putrA virudhyante narAdhipa
shlokas.16:
meDhIbhUtaH svayaM rAjannigrahe pragrahe bhavAn |
kimarthamanayaM ghoramutpatantamupekShase
shlokas.17:
dasyUnAmiva yadvRRittaM sabhAyAM kurunandana |
tena na bhrAjase rAja.nstApasAnAM samAgame
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vyAvRRitya rAjAnaM duryodhanamamarShaNam |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA maitreyo bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.19:
duryodhana mahAbAho nibodha vadatAM vara |
vachanaM me mahAprAj~na bruvato yaddhitaM tava
shlokas.20:
mA druhaH pANDavAnrAjankuruShva hitamAtmanaH |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha lokasya cha nararShabha
shlokas.21:
te hi sarve naravyAghrAH shUrA vikrAntayodhinaH |
sarve nAgAyutaprANA vajrasaMhananA dRRiDhAH
shlokas.22:
satyavrataparAH sarve sarve puruShamAninaH |
hantAro devashatrUNAM rakShasAM kAmarUpiNAm
hiDimbabakamukhyAnAM kirmIrasya cha rakShasaH
shlokas.23:
itaH prachyavatAM rAtrau yaH sa teShAM mahAtmanAm |
AvRRitya mArgaM raudrAtmA tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.24:
taM bhImaH samarashlAghI balena balinAM varaH |
jaghAna pashumAreNa vyAghraH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.25:
pashya digvijaye rAjanyathA bhImena pAtitaH |
jarAsandho maheShvAso nAgAyutabalo yudhi
shlokas.26:
sambandhI vAsudevashcha yeShAM shyAlashcha pArShataH |
kastAnyudhi samAsIta jarAmaraNavAnnaraH
shlokas.27:
tasya te shama evAstu pANDavairbharatarShabha |
kuru me vachanaM rAjanmA mRRityuvashamanvagAH
shlokas.28:
evaM tu bruvatastasya maitreyasya vishAM pate |
UruM gajakarAkAraM kareNAbhijaghAna saH
shlokas.29:
duryodhanaH smitaM kRRitvA charaNenAlikhanmahIm |
na ki~nchiduktvA durmedhAstasthau ki~nchidavA~NmukhaH
shlokas.30:
tamashushrUShamANaM tu vilikhantaM vasundharAm |
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM rAjanmaitreyaM kopa Avishat
shlokas.31:
sa kopavashamApanno maitreyo munisattamaH |
vidhinA samprayuktashcha shApAyAsya mano dadhe
shlokas.32:
tataH sa vAryupaspRRishya kopasa.nraktalochanaH |
maitreyo dhArtarAShTraM tamashapadduShTachetasam
shlokas.33:
yasmAttvaM mAmanAdRRitya nemAM vAchaM chikIrShasi |
tasmAdasyAbhimAnasya sadyaH phalamavApnuhi
shlokas.34:
tvadabhidrohasa.nyuktaM yuddhamutpatsyate mahat |
yatra bhImo gadApAtaistavoruM bhetsyate balI
shlokas.35:
ityevamukte vachane dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
prasAdayAmAsa muniM naitadevaM bhavediti
shlokas.36:
maitreya uvAcha||
shamaM yAsyati chetputrastava rAjanyathA tathA |
shApo na bhavitA tAta viparIte bhaviShyati
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa vilakShastu rAjendra duryodhanapitA tadA |
maitreyaM prAha kirmIraH kathaM bhImena pAtitaH
shlokas.38:
maitreya uvAcha||
nAhaM vakShyAmyasUyA te na te shushrUShate sutaH |
eSha te viduraH sarvamAkhyAsyati gate mayi
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityevamuktvA maitreyaH prAtiShThata yathAgatam |
kirmIravadhasa.nvigno bahirduryodhano.agamat

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kirmIrasya vadhaM kShattaH shrotumichChAmi kathyatAm |
rakShasA bhImasenasya kathamAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
shRRiNu bhImasya karmedamatimAnuShakarmaNaH |
shrutapUrvaM mayA teShAM kathAnteShu punaH punaH
shlokas.3:
itaH prayAtA rAjendra pANDavA dyUtanirjitAH |
jagmustribhirahorAtraiH kAmyakaM nAma tadvanam
shlokas.4:
rAtrau nishIthe svAbhIle gate.ardhasamaye nRRipa |
prachAre puruShAdAnAM rakShasAM bhImakarmaNAm
shlokas.5:
tadvanaM tApasA nityaM sheShAshcha vanachAriNaH |
dUrAtpariharanti sma puruShAdabhayAtkila
shlokas.6:
teShAM pravishatAM tatra mArgamAvRRitya bhArata |
dIptAkShaM bhIShaNaM rakShaH solmukaM pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.7:
bAhU mahAntau kRRitvA tu tathAsyaM cha bhayAnakam |
sthitamAvRRitya panthAnaM yena yAnti kurUdvahAH
shlokas.8:
daShToShThadaMShTraM tAmrAkShaM pradIptordhvashiroruham |
sArkarashmitaDichchakraM sabalAkamivAmbudam
shlokas.9:
sRRijantaM rAkShasIM mAyAM mahArAvavirAviNam |
mu~nchantaM vipulaM nAdaM satoyamiva toyadam
shlokas.10:
tasya nAdena santrastAH pakShiNaH sarvatodisham |
vimuktanAdAH sampetuH sthalajA jalajaiH saha
shlokas.11:
sampradrutamRRigadvIpimahiSharkShasamAkulam |
tadvanaM tasya nAdena samprasthitamivAbhavat
shlokas.12:
tasyoruvAtAbhihatA tAmrapallavabAhavaH |
vidUrajAtAshcha latAH samAshliShyanta pAdapAn
shlokas.13:
tasminkShaNe.atha pravavau mAruto bhRRishadAruNaH |
rajasA sa.nvRRitaM tena naShTarShkamabhavannabhaH
shlokas.14:
pa~nchAnAM pANDuputrANAmavij~nAto mahAripuH |
pa~nchAnAmindriyANAM tu shokavega ivAtulaH
shlokas.15:
sa dRRiShTvA pANDavAndUrAtkRRiShNAjinasamAvRRitAn |
AvRRiNottadvanadvAraM mainAka iva parvataH
shlokas.16:
taM samAsAdya vitrastA kRRiShNA kamalalochanA |
adRRiShTapUrvaM santrAsAnnyamIlayata lochane
shlokas.17:
duHshAsanakarotsRRiShTaviprakIrNashiroruhA |
pa~nchaparvatamadhyasthA nadIvAkulatAM gatA
shlokas.18:
momuhyamAnAM tAM tatra jagRRihuH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
indriyANi prasaktAni viShayeShu yathA ratim
shlokas.19:
atha tAM rAkShasIM mAyAmutthitAM ghoradarshanAm |
rakShoghnairvividhairmantrairdhaumyaH samyakprayojitaiH
pashyatAM pANDuputrANAM nAshayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.20:
sa naShTamAyo.atibalaH krodhavisphAritekShaNaH |
kAmamUrtidharaH kShudraH kAlakalpo vyadRRishyata
shlokas.21:
tamuvAcha tato rAjA dIrghapraj~no yudhiShThiraH |
ko bhavAnkasya vA kiM te kriyatAM kAryamuchyatAm
shlokas.22:
pratyuvAchAtha tadrakSho dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
ahaM bakasya vai bhrAtA kirmIra iti vishrutaH
shlokas.23:
vane.asminkAmyake shUnye nivasAmi gatajvaraH |
yudhi nirjitya puruShAnAhAraM nityamAcharan
shlokas.24:
ke yUyamiha samprAptA bhakShyabhUtA mamAntikam |
yudhi nirjitya vaH sarvAnbhakShayiShye gatajvaraH
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThirastu tachChrutvA vachastasya durAtmanaH |
AchachakShe tataH sarvaM gotranAmAdi bhArata
shlokas.26:
pANDavo dharmarAjo.ahaM yadi te shrotramAgataH |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvairbhImasenArjunAdibhiH
shlokas.27:
hRRitarAjyo vane vAsaM vastuM kRRitamatistataH |
vanamabhyAgato ghoramidaM tava parigraham
shlokas.28:
kirmIrastvabravIdenaM diShTyA devairidaM mama |
upapAditamadyeha chirakAlAnmanogatam
shlokas.29:
bhImasenavadhArthaM hi nityamabhyudyatAyudhaH |
charAmi pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM nainamAsAdayAmyaham
shlokas.30:
so.ayamAsAdito diShTyA bhrAtRRihA kA~NkShitashchiram |
anena hi mama bhrAtA bako vinihataH priyaH
shlokas.31:
vetrakIyagRRihe rAjanbrAhmaNachChadmarUpiNA |
vidyAbalamupAshritya na hyastyasyaurasaM balam
shlokas.32:
hiDimbashcha sakhA mahyaM dayito vanagocharaH |
hato durAtmanAnena svasA chAsya hRRitA purA
shlokas.33:
so.ayamabhyAgato mUDho mamedaM gahanaM vanam |
prachArasamaye.asmAkamardharAtre samAsthite
shlokas.34:
adyAsya yAtayiShyAmi tadvairaM chirasambhRRitam |
tarpayiShyAmi cha bakaM rudhireNAsya bhUriNA
shlokas.35:
adyAhamanRRiNo bhUtvA bhrAtuH sakhyustathaiva cha |
shAntiM labdhAsmi paramAM hatva rAkShasakaNTakam
shlokas.36:
yadi tena purA mukto bhImaseno bakena vai |
adyainaM bhakShayiShyAmi pashyataste yudhiShThira
shlokas.37:
enaM hi vipulaprANamadya hatvA vRRikodaram |
sambhakShya jarayiShyAmi yathAgastyo mahAsuram
shlokas.38:
evamuktastu dharmAtmA satyasandho yudhiShThiraH |
naitadastIti sakrodho bhartsayAmAsa rAkShasam
shlokas.39:
tato bhImo mahAbAhurArujya tarasA druma |
dashavyAmamivodviddhaM niShpatramakarottadA
shlokas.40:
chakAra sajyaM gANDIvaM vajraniShpeShagauravam |
nimeShAntaramAtreNa tathaiva vijayo.arjunaH
shlokas.41:
nivArya bhImo jiShNuM tu tadrakSho ghoradarshanam |
abhidrutyAbravIdvAkyaM tiShTha tiShTheti bhArata
shlokas.42:
ityuktvainamabhikruddhaH kakShyAmutpIDya pANDavaH |
niShpiShya pANinA pANiM sa.ndaShToShThapuTo balI
tamabhyadhAvadvegena bhImo vRRikShAyudhastadA
shlokas.43:
yamadaNDapratIkAshaM tatastaM tasya mUrdhani |
pAtayAmAsa vegena kulishaM maghavAniva
shlokas.44:
asambhrAntaM tu tadrakShaH samare pratyadRRishyata |
chikShepa cholmukaM dIptamashaniM jvalitAmiva
shlokas.45:
tadudastamalAtaM tu bhImaH praharatAM varaH |
padA savyena chikShepa tadrakShaH punarAvrajat
shlokas.46:
kirmIrashchApi sahasA vRRikShamutpATya pANDavam |
daNDapANiriva kruddhaH samare pratyayudhyata
shlokas.47:
tadvRRikShayuddhamabhavanmahIruhavinAshanam |
vAlisugrIvayorbhrAtroryathA shrIkA~NkShiNoH purA
shlokas.48:
shIrShayoH patitA vRRikShA bibhidurnaikadhA tayoH |
yathaivotpalapadmAni mattayordvipayostathA
shlokas.49:
mu~njavajjarjarIbhUtA bahavastatra pAdapAH |
chIrANIva vyudastAni rejustatra mahAvane
shlokas.50:
tadvRRikShayuddhamabhavatsumuhUrtaM vishAM pate |
rAkShasAnAM cha mukhyasya narANAmuttamasya cha
shlokas.51:
tataH shilAM samutkShipya bhImasya yudhi tiShThataH |
prAhiNodrAkShasaH kruddho bhImasenashchachAla ha
shlokas.52:
taM shilAtADanajaDaM paryadhAvatsa rAkShasaH |
bAhuvikShiptakiraNaH svarbhAnuriva bhAskaram
shlokas.53:
tAvanyonyaM samAshliShya prakarShantau parasparam |
ubhAvapi chakAshete prayuddhau vRRiShabhAviva
shlokas.54:
tayorAsItsutumulaH samprahAraH sudAruNaH |
nakhadaMShTrAyudhavatorvyAghrayoriva dRRiptayoH
shlokas.55:
duryodhananikArAchcha bAhuvIryAchcha darpitaH |
kRRiShNAnayanadRRiShTashcha vyavardhata vRRikodaraH
shlokas.56:
abhipatyAtha bAhubhyAM pratyagRRihNAdamarShitaH |
mAta~Nga iva mAta~NgaM prabhinnakaraTAmukhaH
shlokas.57:
taM chApyAtha tato rakShaH pratijagrAha vIryavAn |
tamAkShipadbhImaseno balena balinAM varaH
shlokas.58:
tayorbhujaviniShpeShAdubhayorbalinostadA |
shabdaH samabhavadghoro veNusphoTasamo yudhi
shlokas.59:
athainamAkShipya balAdgRRihya madhye vRRikodaraH |
dhUnayAmAsa vegena vAyushchaNDa iva drumam
shlokas.60:
sa bhImena parAmRRiShTo durbalo balinA raNe |
vyaspandata yathAprANaM vichakarSha cha pANDavam
shlokas.61:
tata enaM parishrAntamupalabhya vRRikodaraH |
yoktrayAmAsa bAhubhyAM pashuM rashanayA yathA
shlokas.62:
vinadantaM mahAnAdaM bhinnabherIsamasvanam |
bhrAmayAmAsa suchiraM visphurantamachetasam
shlokas.63:
taM viShIdantamAj~nAya rAkShasaM pANDunandanaH |
pragRRihya tarasA dorbhyAM pashumAramamArayat
shlokas.64:
Akramya sa kaTIdeshe jAnunA rAkShasAdhamam |
apIDayata bAhubhyAM kaNThaM tasya vRRikodaraH
shlokas.65:
atha taM jaDasarvA~NgaM vyAvRRittanayanolbaNam |
bhUtale pAtayAmAsa vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.66:
hiDimbabakayoH pApa na tvamashrupramArjanam |
kariShyasi gatashchAsi yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.67:
ityevamuktvA puruShapravIra;staM rAkShasaM krodhavivRRittanetraH |
prasrastavastrAbharaNaM sphuranta;mudbhrAntachittaM vyasumutsasarja
shlokas.68:
tasminhate toyadatulyarUpe; kRRiShNAM puraskRRitya narendraputrAH |
bhImaM prashasyAtha guNairanekai;rhRRiShTAstato dvaitavanAya jagmuH
shlokas.69:
evaM vinihataH sa~Nkhye kirmIro manujAdhipa |
bhImena vachanAttasya dharmarAjasya kaurava
shlokas.70:
tato niShkaNTakaM kRRitvA vanaM tadaparAjitaH |
draupadyA saha dharmaj~no vasatiM tAmuvAsa ha
shlokas.71:
samAshvAsya cha te sarve draupadIM bharatarShabhAH |
prahRRiShTamanasaH prItyA prashasha.nsurvRRikodaram
shlokas.72:
bhImabAhubalotpiShTe vinaShTe rAkShase tataH |
vivishustadvanaM vIrAH kShemaM nihatakaNTakam
shlokas.73:
sa mayA gachChatA mArge vinikIrNo bhayAvahaH |
vane mahati duShTAtmA dRRiShTo bhImabalAddhataH
shlokas.74:
tatrAshrauShamahaM chaitatkarma bhImasya bhArata |
brAhmaNAnAM kathayatAM ye tatrAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.75:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM vinihataM sa~Nkhye kirmIraM rAkShasottamam |
shrutvA dhyAnaparo rAjA nishashvAsArtavattadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhojAH pravrajitA~nshrutvA vRRiShNayashchAndhakaiH saha |
pANDavAnduHkhasantaptAnsamAjagmurmahAvane
shlokas.2:
pA~nchAlasya cha dAyAdA dhRRiShTaketushcha chedipaH |
kekayAshcha mahAvIryA bhrAtaro lokavishrutAH
shlokas.3:
vane te.abhiyayuH pArthAnkrodhAmarshasamanvitAH |
garhayanto dhArtarAShTrAnkiM kurma iti chAbruvan
shlokas.4:
vAsudevaM puraskRRitya sarve te kShatriyarShabhAH |
parivAryopavivishurdharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.5:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneshcha durAtmanaH |
duHshAsanachaturthAnAM bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.6:
tataH sarve.abhiShi~nchAmo dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
nikRRityopacharanvadhya eSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pArthAnAmabhiSha~NgeNa tathA kruddhaM janArdanam |
arjunaH shamayAmAsA didhakShantamiva prajAH
shlokas.8:
sa~NkruddhaM keshavaM dRRiShTvA pUrvadeheShu phalgunaH |
kIrtayAmAsa karmANi satyakIrtermahAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
puruShasyAprameyasya satyasyAmitatejasaH |
prajApatipaterviShNorlokanAthasya dhImataH
shlokas.10:
arjuna uvAcha||
dasha varShasahasrANi yatrasAya~NgRRiho muniH |
vyacharastvaM purA kRRiShNa parvate gandhamAdane
shlokas.11:
dasha varShasahasrANi dasha varShashatAni cha |
puShkareShvavasaH kRRiShNa tvamapo bhakShayanpurA
shlokas.12:
UrdhvabAhurvishAlAyAM badaryAM madhusUdana |
atiShTha ekapAdena vAyubhakShaH shataM samAH
shlokas.13:
apakRRiShTottarAsa~NgaH kRRisho dhamanisantataH |
AsIH kRRiShNa sarasvatyAM satre dvAdashavArShike
shlokas.14:
prabhAsaM chApyathAsAdya tIrthaM puNyajanochitam |
tathA kRRiShNa mahAtejA divyaM varShasahasrakam
AtiShThastapa ekena pAdena niyame sthitaH
shlokas.15:
kShetraj~naH sarvabhUtAnAmAdirantashcha keshava |
nidhAnaM tapasAM kRRiShNa yaj~nastvaM cha sanAtanaH
shlokas.16:
nihatya narakaM bhaumamAhRRitya maNikuNDale |
prathamotpAditaM kRRiShNa medhyamashvamavAsRRijaH
shlokas.17:
kRRitvA tatkarma lokAnAmRRiShabhaH sarvalokajit |
avadhIstvaM raNe sarvAnsametAndaityadAnavAn
shlokas.18:
tataH sarveshvaratvaM cha sampradAya shachIpateH |
mAnuSheShu mahAbAho prAdurbhUto.asi keshava
shlokas.19:
sa tvaM nArAyaNo bhUtvA harirAsIH parantapa |
brahmA somashcha sUryashcha dharmo dhAtA yamo.analaH
shlokas.20:
vAyurvaishravaNo rudraH kAlaH khaM pRRithivI dishaH |
ajashcharAcharaguruH sraShTA tvaM puruShottama
shlokas.21:
turAyaNAdibhirdeva kratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH |
ayajo bhUritejA vai kRRiShNa chaitrarathe vane
shlokas.22:
shataM shatasahasrANi suvarNasya janArdana |
ekaikasmi.nstadA yaj~ne paripUrNAni bhAgashaH
shlokas.23:
aditerapi putratvametya yAdavanandana |
tvaM viShNuriti vikhyAta indrAdavarajo bhuvi
shlokas.24:
shishurbhUtvA divaM khaM cha pRRithivIM cha parantapa |
tribhirvikramaNaiH kRRiShNa krAntavAnasi tejasA
shlokas.25:
samprApya divamAkAshamAdityasadane sthitaH |
atyarochashcha bhUtAtmanbhAskaraM svena tejasA
shlokas.26:
sAditA mauravAH pAshA nisundanarakau hatau |
kRRitaH kShemaH punaH panthAH puraM prAgjyotiShaM prati
shlokas.27:
jArUthyAmAhutiH krAthaH shishupAlo janaiH saha |
bhImasenashcha shaibyashcha shatadhanvA cha nirjitaH
shlokas.28:
tathA parjanyaghoSheNa rathenAdityavarchasA |
avAkShIrmahiShIM bhojyAM raNe nirjitya rukmiNam
shlokas.29:
indradyumno hataH kopAdyavanashcha kasherumAn |
hataH saubhapatiH shAlvastvayA saubhaM cha pAtitam
shlokas.30:
irAvatyAM tathA bhojaH kArtavIryasamo yudhi |
gopatistAlaketushcha tvayA vinihatAvubhau
shlokas.31:
tAM cha bhogavatIM puNyAmRRiShikAntAM janArdana |
dvArakAmAtmasAtkRRitvA samudraM gamayiShyasi
shlokas.32:
na krodho na cha mAtsaryaM nAnRRitaM madhusUdana |
tvayi tiShThati dAshArha na nRRisha.nsyaM kuto.anRRiju
shlokas.33:
AsInaM chittamadhye tvAM dIpyamAnaM svatejasA |
Agamya RRiShayaH sarve.ayAchantAbhayamachyuta
shlokas.34:
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni sa~NkShipya madhusUdana |
AtmanyevAtmasAtkRRitvA jagadAsse parantapa
shlokas.35:
naivaM pUrve nApare vA kariShyanti kRRitAni te |
karmANi yAni deva tvaM bAla eva mahAdyute
shlokas.36:
kRRitavAnpuNDarIkAkSha baladevasahAyavAn |
vairAjabhavane chApi brahmaNA nyavasaH saha
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tadAtmAnamAtmA kRRiShNasya pANDavaH |
tUShNImAsIttataH pArthamityuvAcha janArdanaH
shlokas.38:
mamaiva tvaM tavaivAhaM ye madIyAstavaiva te |
yastvAM dveShTi sa mAM dveShTi yastvAmanu sa mAmanu
shlokas.39:
narastvamasi durdharSha harirnArAyaNo hyaham |
lokAllokamimaM prAptau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.40:
ananyaH pArtha mattastvamahaM tvattashcha bhArata |
nAvayorantaraM shakyaM vedituM bharatarShabha
shlokas.41:
tasminvIrasamAvAye sa.nrabdheShvatha rAjasu |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhairvIrairbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritA
shlokas.42:
pA~nchAlI puNDarIkAkShamAsInaM yAdavaiH saha |
abhigamyAbravItkRRiShNA sharaNyaM sharaNaiShiNI
shlokas.43:
pUrve prajAnisarge tvAmAhurekaM prajApatim |
sraShTAraM sarvabhUtAnAmasito devalo.abravIt
shlokas.44:
viShNustvamasi durdharSha tvaM yaj~no madhusUdana |
yaShTA tvamasi yaShTavyo jAmadagnyo yathAbravIt
shlokas.45:
RRiShayastvAM kShamAmAhuH satyaM cha puruShottama |
satyAdyaj~no.asi sambhUtaH kashyapastvAM yathAbravIt
shlokas.46:
sAdhyAnAmapi devAnAM vasUnAmIshvareshvaraH |
lokabhAvana lokesha yathA tvAM nArado.abravIt
shlokas.47:
divaM te shirasA vyAptaM padbhyAM cha pRRithivI vibho |
jaTharaM te ime lokAH puruSho.asi sanAtanaH
shlokas.48:
vidyAtapo.abhitaptAnAM tapasA bhAvitAtmanAm |
AtmadarshanasiddhAnAmRRiShINAmRRiShisattama
shlokas.49:
rAjarShINAM puNyakRRitAmAhaveShvanivartinAm |
sarvadharmopapannAnAM tvaM gatiH puruShottama
shlokas.50:
tvaM prabhustvaM vibhustvaM bhUrAtmabhUstvaM sanAtanaH |
lokapAlAshcha lokAshcha nakShatrANi disho dasha
nabhashchandrashcha sUryashcha tvayi sarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.51:
martyatA chaiva bhUtAnAmamaratvaM divaukasAm |
tvayi sarvaM mahAbAho lokakAryaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.52:
sA te.ahaM duHkhamAkhyAsye praNayAnmadhusUdana |
IshastvaM sarvabhUtAnAM ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH
shlokas.53:
kathaM nu bhAryA pArthAnAM tava kRRiShNa sakhI vibho |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhaginI sabhAM kRRiShyeta mAdRRishI
shlokas.54:
strIdharmiNI vepamAnA rudhireNa samukShitA |
ekavastrA vikRRiShTAsmi duHkhitA kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.55:
rAjamadhye sabhAyAM tu rajasAbhisamIritAm |
dRRiShTvA cha mAM dhArtarAShTrAH prAhasanpApachetasaH
shlokas.56:
dAsIbhAvena bhoktuM mAmIShuste madhusUdana |
jIvatsu pANDuputreShu pA~nchAleShvatha vRRiShNiShu
shlokas.57:
nanvahaM kRRiShNa bhIShmasya dhRRitarAShTrasya chobhayoH |
snuShA bhavAmi dharmeNa sAhaM dAsIkRRitA balAt
shlokas.58:
garhaye pANDavA.nstveva yudhi shreShThAnmahAbalAn |
ye klishyamAnAM prekShante dharmapatnIM yashasvinIm
shlokas.59:
dhigbalaM bhImasenasya dhikpArthasya dhanuShmatAm |
yau mAM viprakRRitAM kShudrairmarShayetAM janArdana
shlokas.60:
shAshvato.ayaM dharmapathaH sadbhirAcharitaH sadA |
yadbhAryAM parirakShanti bhartAro.alpabalA api
shlokas.61:
bhAryAyAM rakShyamANAyAM prajA bhavati rakShitA |
prajAyAM rakShyamANAyAmAtmA bhavati rakShitaH
shlokas.62:
AtmA hi jAyate tasyAM tasmAjjAyA bhavatyuta |
bhartA cha bhAryayA rakShyaH kathaM jAyAnmamodare
shlokas.63:
nanvime sharaNaM prAptAnna tyajanti kadAchana |
te mAM sharaNamApannAM nAnvapadyanta pANDavAH
shlokas.64:
pa~ncheme pa~nchabhirjAtAH kumArAshchAmitaujasaH |
eteShAmapyavekShArthaM trAtavyAsmi janArdana
shlokas.65:
prativindhyo yudhiShThirAtsutasomo vRRikodarAt |
arjunAchChrutakIrtistu shatAnIkastu nAkuliH
shlokas.66:
kaniShThAchChrutakarmA tu sarve satyaparAkramAH |
pradyumno yAdRRishaH kRRiShNa tAdRRishAste mahArathAH
shlokas.67:
nanvime dhanuShi shreShThA ajeyA yudhi shAtravaiH |
kimarthaM dhArtarAShTrANAM sahante durbalIyasAm
shlokas.68:
adharmeNa hRRitaM rAjyaM sarve dAsAH kRRitAstathA |
sabhAyAM parikRRiShTAhamekavastrA rajasvalA
shlokas.69:
nAdhijyamapi yachChakyaM kartumanyena gANDivam |
anyatrArjunabhImAbhyAM tvayA vA madhusUdana
shlokas.70:
dhigbhImasenasya balaM dhikpArthasya cha gANDivam |
yatra duryodhanaH kRRiShNa muhUrtamapi jIvati
shlokas.72:
bhojane bhImasenasya pApaH prAkShepayadviSham |
kAlakUTaM navaM tIkShNaM sambhRRitaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.73:
tajjIrNamavikAreNa sahAnnena janArdana |
sasheShatvAnmahAbAho bhImasya puruShottama
shlokas.74:
pramANakoTyAM vishvastaM tathA suptaM vRRikodaram |
baddhvainaM kRRiShNa ga~NgAyAM prakShipya punarAvrajat
shlokas.75:
yadA vibuddhaH kaunteyastadA sa~nChidya bandhanam |
udatiShThanmahAbAhurbhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.76:
AshIviShaiH kRRiShNasarpaiH suptaM chainamada.nshayat |
sarveShvevA~NgadesheShu na mamAra cha shatruhA
shlokas.77:
pratibuddhastu kaunteyaH sarvAnsarpAnapothayat |
sArathiM chAsya dayitamapahastena jaghnivAn
shlokas.78:
punaH suptAnupAdhAkShIdbAlakAnvAraNAvate |
shayAnAnAryayA sArdhaM ko nu tatkartumarhati
shlokas.79:
yatrAryA rudatI bhItA pANDavAnidamabravIt |
mahadvyasanamApannA shikhinA parivAritA
shlokas.80:
hA hatAsmi kuto nvadya bhavechChAntirihAnalAt |
anAthA vinashiShyAmi bAlakaiH putrakaiH saha
shlokas.81:
tatra bhImo mahAbAhurvAyuvegaparAkramaH |
AryAmAshvAsayAmAsa bhrAtR^I.nshchApi vRRikodaraH
shlokas.82:
vainateyo yathA pakShI garuDaH patatAM varaH |
tathaivAbhipatiShyAmi bhayaM vo neha vidyate
shlokas.83:
AryAma~Nkena vAmena rAjAnaM dakShiNena cha |
a.nsayoshcha yamau kRRitvA pRRiShThe bIbhatsumeva cha
shlokas.84:
sahasotpatya vegena sarvAnAdAya vIryavAn |
bhrAtR^InAryAM cha balavAnmokShayAmAsa pAvakAt
shlokas.85:
te rAtrau prasthitAH sarve mAtrA saha yashasvinaH |
abhyagachChanmahAraNyaM hiDimbavanamantikAt
shlokas.86:
shrAntAH prasuptAstatreme mAtrA saha suduHkhitAH |
suptA.nshchainAnabhyagachChaddhiDimbA nAma rAkShasI
shlokas.87:
bhImasya pAdau kRRitvA tu sva utsa~Nge tato balAt |
paryamardata saMhRRiShTA kalyANI mRRidupANinA
shlokas.88:
tAmabudhyadameyAtmA balavAnsatyavikramaH |
paryapRRichChachcha tAM bhImaH kimihechChasyanindite
shlokas.89:
tayoH shrutvA tu kathitamAgachChadrAkShasAdhamaH |
bhImarUpo mahAnAdAnvisRRijanbhImadarshanaH
shlokas.90:
kena sArdhaM kathayasi AnayainaM mamAntikam |
hiDimbe bhakShayiShyAvo na chiraM kartumarhasi
shlokas.92:
sa nAdAnvinadanghorAnrAkShasaH puruShAdakaH |
abhyadravata vegena bhImasenaM tadA kila
shlokas.93:
tamabhidrutya sa~Nkruddho vegena mahatA balI |
agRRihNAtpANinA pANiM bhImasenasya rAkShasaH
shlokas.94:
indrAshanisamasparshaM vajrasaMhananaM dRRiDham |
saMhatya bhImasenAya vyAkShipatsahasA karam
shlokas.95:
gRRihItaM pANinA pANiM bhImaseno.atha rakShasA |
nAmRRiShyata mahAbAhustatrAkrudhyadvRRikodaraH
shlokas.97:
hatvA hiDimbaM bhImo.atha prasthito bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
hiDimbAmagrataH kRRitvA yasyAM jAto ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.98:
tatashcha prAdravansarve saha mAtrA yashasvinaH |
ekachakrAmabhimukhAH sa.nvRRitA brAhmaNavrajaiH
shlokas.99:
prasthAne vyAsa eShAM cha mantrI priyahito.abhavat |
tato.agachChannekachakrAM pANDavAH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.100:
tatrApyAsAdayAmAsurbakaM nAma mahAbalam |
puruShAdaM pratibhayaM hiDimbenaiva saMmitam
shlokas.101:
taM chApi vinihatyograM bhImaH praharatAM varaH |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvairdrupadasya puraM yayau
shlokas.102:
labdhAhamapi tatraiva vasatA savyasAchinA |
yathA tvayA jitA kRRiShNa rukmiNI bhIShmakAtmajA
shlokas.103:
evaM suyuddhe pArthena jitAhaM madhusUdana |
svaya.nvare mahatkarma kRRitvA nasukaraM paraiH
shlokas.104:
evaM kleshaiH subahubhiH klishyamAnAH suduHkhitAH |
nivasAmAryayA hInAH kRRiShNa dhaumyapuraHsarAH
shlokas.105:
ta ime siMhavikrAntA vIryeNAbhyadhikAH paraiH |
vihInaiH pariklishyantIM samupekShanta mAM katham
shlokas.106:
etAdRRishAni duHkhAni sahante durbalIyasAm |
dIrghakAlaM pradIptAni pApAnAM kShudrakarmaNAm
shlokas.107:
kule mahati jAtAsmi divyena vidhinA kila |
pANDavAnAM priyA bhAryA snuShA pANDormahAtmanaH
shlokas.108:
kachagrahamanuprAptA sAsmi kRRiShNa varA satI |
pa~nchAnAmindrakalpAnAM prekShatAM madhusUdana
shlokas.109:
ityuktvA prArudatkRRiShNA mukhaM prachChAdya pANinA |
padmakoshaprakAshena mRRidunA mRRidubhAShiNI
shlokas.110:
stanAvapatitau pInau sujAtau shubhalakShaNau |
abhyavarShata pA~nchAlI duHkhajairashrubindubhiH
shlokas.111:
chakShuShI parimArjantI niHshvasantI punaH punaH |
bAShpapUrNena kaNThena kruddhA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.112:
naiva me patayaH santi na putrA madhusUdana |
na bhrAtaro na cha pitA naiva tvaM na cha bAndhavAH
shlokas.113:
ye mAM viprakRRitAM kShudrairupekShadhvaM vishokavat |
na hi me shAmyate duHkhaM karNo yatprAhasattadA
shlokas.114:
athainAmabravItkRRiShNastasminvIrasamAgame |
rodiShyanti striyo hyevaM yeShAM kruddhAsi bhAmini
shlokas.116:
yatsamarthaM pANDavAnAM tatkariShyAmi mA shuchaH |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi rAj~nAM rAj~nI bhaviShyasi
shlokas.117:
pateddyaurhimavA~nshIryetpRRithivI shakalIbhavet |
shuShyettoyanidhiH kRRiShNe na me moghaM vacho bhavet
shlokas.118:
dhRRiShTadyumna uvAcha||
ahaM droNaM haniShyAmi shikhaNDI tu pitAmaham |
duryodhanaM bhImasenaH karNaM hantA dhana~njayaH
shlokas.119:
rAmakRRiShNau vyapAshritya ajeyAH sma shuchismite |
api vRRitrahaNA yuddhe kiM punardhRRitarAShTrajaiH
shlokas.120:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityukte.abhimukhA vIrA vAsudevamupasthitA |
teShAM madhye mahAbAhuH keshavo vAkyamabravIt

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
nedaM kRRichChramanuprApto bhavAnsyAdvasudhAdhipa |
yadyahaM dvArakAyAM syAM rAjansaMnihitaH purA
shlokas.2:
AgachCheyamahaM dyUtamanAhUto.api kauravaiH |
Ambikeyena durdharSha rAj~nA duryodhanena cha
shlokas.3:
vArayeyamahaM dyUtaM bahUndoShAnpradarshayan |
bhIShmadroNau samAnAyya kRRipaM bAhlIkameva cha
shlokas.4:
vaichitravIryaM rAjAnamalaM dyUtena kaurava |
putrANAM tava rAjendra tvannimittamiti prabho
shlokas.5:
tatra vakShyAmyahaM doShAnyairbhavAnavaropitaH |
vIrasenasuto yaishcha rAjyAtprabhra.nshitaH purA
shlokas.6:
abhakShitavinAshaM cha devanena vishAM pate |
sAtatyaM cha prasa~Ngasya varNayeyaM yathAtatham
shlokas.7:
striyo.akShA mRRigayA pAnametatkAmasamutthitam |
vyasanaM chatuShTayaM proktaM yai rAjanbhrashyate shriyaH
shlokas.8:
tatra sarvatra vaktavyaM manyante shAstrakovidAH |
visheShatashcha vaktavyaM dyUte pashyanti tadvidaH
shlokas.9:
ekAhnA dravyanAsho.atra dhruvaM vyasanameva cha |
abhuktanAshashchArthAnAM vAkpAruShyaM cha kevalam
shlokas.10:
etachchAnyachcha kauravya prasa~Ngi kaTukodayam |
dyUte brUyAM mahAbAho samAsAdyAmbikAsutam
shlokas.11:
evamukto yadi mayA gRRihNIyAdvachanaM mama |
anAmayaM syAddharmasya kurUNAM kurunandana
shlokas.12:
na chetsa mama rAjendra gRRihNIyAnmadhuraM vachaH |
pathyaM cha bharatashreShTha nigRRihNIyAM balena tam
shlokas.13:
athainAnabhinIyaivaM suhRRido nAma durhRRidaH |
sabhAsadashcha tAnsarvAnbhedayeyaM durodarAn
shlokas.14:
asAMnidhyaM tu kauravya mamAnarteShvabhUttadA |
yenedaM vyasanaM prAptA bhavanto dyUtakAritam
shlokas.15:
so.ahametya kurushreShTha dvArakAM pANDunandana |
ashrauShaM tvAM vyasaninaM yuyudhAnAdyathAtatham
shlokas.16:
shrutvaiva chAhaM rAjendra paramodvignamAnasaH |
tUrNamabhyAgato.asmi tvAM draShTukAmo vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
aho kRRichChramanuprAptAH sarve sma bharatarShabha |
ye vayaM tvAM vyasaninaM pashyAmaH saha sodaraiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asAMnidhyaM kathaM kRRiShNa tavAsIdvRRiShNinandana |
kva chAsIdvipravAsaste kiM vAkArShIH pravAsakaH
shlokas.2:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
shAlvasya nagaraM saubhaM gato.ahaM bharatarShabha |
vinihantuM narashreShTha tatra me shRRiNu kAraNam
shlokas.3:
mahAtejA mahAbAhuryaH sa rAjA mahAyashAH |
damaghoShAtmajo vIraH shishupAlo mayA hataH
shlokas.4:
yaj~ne te bharatashreShTha rAjasUye.arhaNAM prati |
sa roShavashasamprApto nAmRRiShyata durAtmavAn
shlokas.5:
shrutvA taM nihataM shAlvastIvraroShasamanvitaH |
upAyAddvArakAM shUnyAmihasthe mayi bhArata
shlokas.6:
sa tatra yodhito rAjanbAlakairvRRiShNipu~NgavaiH |
AgataH kAmagaM saubhamAruhyaiva nRRisha.nsakRRit
shlokas.7:
tato vRRiShNipravIrA.nstAnbAlAnhatvA bahU.nstadA |
purodyAnAni sarvANi bhedayAmAsa durmatiH
shlokas.8:
uktavA.nshcha mahAbAho kvAsau vRRiShNikulAdhamaH |
vAsudevaH sumandAtmA vasudevasuto gataH
shlokas.9:
tasya yuddhArthino darpaM yuddhe nAshayitAsmyaham |
AnartAH satyamAkhyAta tatra gantAsmi yatra saH
shlokas.10:
taM hatvA vinivartiShye ka.nsakeshiniShUdanam |
ahatvA na nivartiShye satyenAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.11:
kvAsau kvAsAviti punastatra tatra vidhAvati |
mayA kila raNe yuddhaM kA~NkShamANaH sa saubharAT
shlokas.12:
adya taM pApakarmANaM kShudraM vishvAsaghAtinam |
shishupAlavadhAmarShAdgamayiShye yamakShayam
shlokas.13:
mama pApasvabhAvena bhrAtA yena nipAtitaH |
shishupAlo mahIpAlastaM vadhiShye mahItale
shlokas.14:
bhrAtA bAlashcha rAjA cha na cha sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
pramattashcha hato vIrastaM haniShye janArdanam
shlokas.15:
evamAdi mahArAja vilapya divamAsthitaH |
kAmagena sa saubhena kShiptvA mAM kurunandana
shlokas.16:
tamashrauShamahaM gatvA yathA vRRittaH sudurmatiH |
mayi kauravya duShTAtmA mArttikAvatako nRRipaH
shlokas.17:
tato.ahamapi kauravya roShavyAkulalochanaH |
nishchitya manasA rAjanvadhAyAsya mano dadhe
shlokas.18:
AnarteShu vimardaM cha kShepaM chAtmani kaurava |
pravRRiddhamavalepaM cha tasya duShkRRitakarmaNaH
shlokas.19:
tataH saubhavadhAyAhaM pratasthe pRRithivIpate |
sa mayA sAgarAvarte dRRiShTa AsItparIpsatA
shlokas.20:
tataH pradhmApya jalajaM pA~nchajanyamahaM nRRipa |
AhUya shAlvaM samare yuddhAya samavasthitaH
shlokas.21:
sumuhUrtamabhUdyuddhaM tatra me dAnavaiH saha |
vashIbhUtAshcha me sarve bhUtale cha nipAtitAH
shlokas.22:
etatkAryaM mahAbAho yenAhaM nAgamaM tadA |
shrutvaiva hAstinapuraM dyUtaM chAvinayotthitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vAsudeva mahAbAho vistareNa mahAmate |
saubhasya vadhamAchakShva na hi tRRipyAmi kathyataH
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
hataM shrutvA mahAbAho mayA shrautashravaM nRRipam |
upAyAdbharatashreShTha shAlvo dvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.3:
arundhattAM suduShTAtmA sarvataH pANDunandana |
shAlvo vaihAyasaM chApi tatpuraM vyUhya viShThitaH
shlokas.4:
tatrastho.atha mahIpAlo yodhayAmAsa tAM purIm |
abhisAreNa sarveNa tatra yuddhamavartata
shlokas.5:
purI samantAdvihitA sapatAkA satoraNA |
sachakrA sahuDA chaiva sayantrakhanakA tathA
shlokas.6:
sopatalpapratolIkA sATTATTAlakagopurA |
sakachagrahaNI chaiva solkAlAtAvapothikA
shlokas.7:
soShTrikA bharatashreShTha sabherIpaNavAnakA |
samittRRiNakushA rAjansashataghnIkalA~NgalA
shlokas.8:
sabhushuNDyashmalaguDA sAyudhA saparashvadhA |
lohacharmavatI chApi sAgniH sahuDashRRi~NgikA
shlokas.9:
shAstradRRiShTena vidhinA sa.nyuktA bharatarShabha |
dravyairanekairvividhairgadasAmboddhavAdibhiH
shlokas.10:
puruShaiH kurushArdUla samarthaiH pratibAdhane |
abhikhyAtakulairvIrairdRRiShTavIryaishcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.11:
madhyamena cha gulmena rakShitA sArasa~nj~nitA |
utkShiptagulmaishcha tathA hayaishchaiva padAtibhiH
shlokas.12:
AghoShitaM cha nagare na pAtavyA sureti ha |
pramAdaM parirakShadbhirugrasenoddhavAdibhiH
shlokas.13:
pramatteShvabhighAtaM hi kuryAchChAlvo narAdhipaH |
iti kRRitvApramattAste sarve vRRiShNyandhakAH sthitAH
shlokas.14:
AnartAshcha tathA sarve naTanartakagAyanAH |
bahirvivAsitAH sarve rakShadbhirvittasa~nchayAn
shlokas.15:
sa~NkramA bheditAH sarve nAvashcha pratiShedhitAH |
parikhAshchApi kauravya kIlaiH sunichitAH kRRitAH
shlokas.16:
udapAnAH kurushreShTha tathaivApyambarIShakAH |
samantAtkroshamAtraM cha kAritA viShamA cha bhUH
shlokas.17:
prakRRityA viShamaM durgaM prakRRityA cha surakShitam |
prakRRityA chAyudhopetaM visheSheNa tadAnagha
shlokas.18:
surakShitaM suguptaM cha sarvAyudhasamanvitam |
tatpuraM bharatashreShTha yathendrabhavanaM tathA
shlokas.19:
na chAmudro.abhiniryAti na chAmudraH praveshyate |
vRRiShNyandhakapure rAja.nstadA saubhasamAgame
shlokas.20:
anu rathyAsu sarvAsu chatvareShu cha kaurava |
balaM babhUva rAjendra prabhUtagajavAjimat
shlokas.21:
dattavetanabhaktaM cha dattAyudhaparichChadam |
kRRitApadAnaM cha tadA balamAsInmahAbhuja
shlokas.22:
na kupyavetanI kashchinna chAtikrAntavetanI |
nAnugrahabhRRitaH kashchinna chAdRRiShTaparAkramaH
shlokas.23:
evaM suvihitA rAjandvArakA bhUridakShiNaiH |
Ahukena suguptA cha rAj~nA rAjIvalochana

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tAM tUpayAtvA rAjendra shAlvaH saubhapatistadA |
prabhUtanaranAgena balenopavivesha ha
shlokas.2:
same niviShTA sA senA prabhUtasalilAshaye |
chatura~NgabalopetA shAlvarAjAbhipAlitA
shlokas.3:
varjayitvA shmashAnAni devatAyatanAni cha |
valmIkA.nshchaiva chaityA.nshcha tanniviShTamabhUdbalam
shlokas.4:
anIkAnAM vibhAgena panthAnaH ShaTkRRitAbhavan |
pravaNA nava chaivAsa~nshAlvasya shibire nRRipa
shlokas.5:
sarvAyudhasamopetaM sarvashastravishAradam |
rathanAgAshvakalilaM padAtidhvajasa~Nkulam
shlokas.6:
tuShTapuShTajanopetaM vIralakShaNalakShitam |
vichitradhvajasaMnAhaM vichitrarathakArmukam
shlokas.7:
saMniveshya cha kauravya dvArakAyAM nararShabha |
abhisArayAmAsa tadA vegena patagendravat
shlokas.8:
tadApatantaM sa.ndRRishya balaM shAlvapatestadA |
niryAya yodhayAmAsuH kumArA vRRiShNinandanAH
shlokas.9:
asahanto.abhiyAnaM tachChAlvarAjasya kaurava |
chArudeShNashcha sAmbashcha pradyumnashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.10:
te rathairda.nshitAH sarve vichitrAbharaNadhvajAH |
sa.nsaktAH shAlvarAjasya bahubhiryodhapu~NgavaiH
shlokas.11:
gRRihItvA tu dhanuH sAmbaH shAlvasya sachivaM raNe |
yodhayAmAsa saMhRRiShTaH kShemavRRiddhiM chamUpatim
shlokas.12:
tasya bANamayaM varShaM jAmbavatyAH suto mahat |
mumocha bharatashreShTha yathA varShaM sahasradRRik
shlokas.13:
tadbANavarShaM tumulaM viShehe sa chamUpatiH |
kShemavRRiddhirmahArAja himavAniva nishchalaH
shlokas.14:
tataH sAmbAya rAjendra kShemavRRiddhirapi sma ha |
mumocha mAyAvihitaM sharajAlaM mahattaram
shlokas.15:
tato mAyAmayaM jAlaM mAyayaiva vidArya saH |
sAmbaH sharasahasreNa rathamasyAbhyavarShata
shlokas.16:
tataH sa viddhaH sAmbena kShemavRRiddhishchamUpatiH |
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH sAmbabANaprapIDitaH
shlokas.17:
tasminvipradrute krUre shAlvasyAtha chamUpatau |
vegavAnnAma daiteyaH sutaM me.abhyadravadbalI
shlokas.18:
abhipannastu rAjendra sAmbo vRRiShNikulodvahaH |
vegaM vegavato rAja.nstasthau vIro vidhArayan
shlokas.19:
sa vegavati kaunteya sAmbo vegavatIM gadAm |
chikShepa tarasA vIro vyAvidhya satyavikramaH
shlokas.20:
tayA tvabhihato rAjanvegavAnapatadbhuvi |
vAtarugNa iva kShuNNo jIrNamUlo vanaspatiH
shlokas.21:
tasminnipatite vIre gadAnunne mahAsure |
pravishya mahatIM senAM yodhayAmAsa me sutaH
shlokas.22:
chArudeShNena sa.nsakto vivindhyo nAma dAnavaH |
mahArathaH samAj~nAto mahArAja mahAdhanuH
shlokas.23:
tataH sutumulaM yuddhaM chArudeShNavivindhyayoH |
vRRitravAsavayo rAjanyathA pUrvaM tathAbhavat
shlokas.24:
anyonyasyAbhisa~NkruddhAvanyonyaM jaghnatuH sharaiH |
vinadantau mahArAja siMhAviva mahAbalau
shlokas.25:
raukmiNeyastato bANamagnyarkopamavarchasam |
abhimantrya mahAstreNa sa.ndadhe shatrunAshanam
shlokas.26:
sa vivindhyAya sakrodhaH samAhUya mahArathaH |
chikShepa me suto rAjansa gatAsurathApatat
shlokas.27:
vivindhyaM nihataM dRRiShTvA tAM cha vikShobhitAM chamUm |
kAmagena sa saubhena shAlvaH punarupAgamat
shlokas.28:
tato vyAkulitaM sarvaM dvArakAvAsi tadbalam |
dRRiShTvA shAlvaM mahAbAho saubhasthaM pRRithivIgatam
shlokas.29:
tato niryAya kaunteya vyavasthApya cha tadbalam |
AnartAnAM mahArAja pradyumno vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.30:
sarve bhavantastiShThantu sarve pashyantu mAM yudhi |
nivArayantaM sa~NgrAme balAtsaubhaM sarAjakam
shlokas.31:
ahaM saubhapateH senAmAyasairbhujagairiva |
dhanurbhujavinirmuktairnAshayAmyadya yAdavAH
shlokas.32:
AshvasadhvaM na bhIH kAryA saubharADadya nashyati |
mayAbhipanno duShTAtmA sasaubho vinashiShyati
shlokas.33:
evaM bruvati saMhRRiShTe pradyumne pANDunandana |
viShThitaM tadbalaM vIra yuyudhe cha yathAsukham

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evamuktvA raukmiNeyo yAdavAnbharatarShabha |
da.nshitairharibhiryuktaM rathamAsthAya kA~nchanam
shlokas.2:
uchChritya makaraM ketuM vyAttAnanamala~NkRRitam |
utpatadbhirivAkAshaM tairhayairanvayAtparAn
shlokas.3:
vikShipannAdaya.nshchApi dhanuHshreShThaM mahAbalaH |
tUNakhaDgadharaH shUro baddhagodhA~NgulitravAn
shlokas.4:
sa vidyuchchalitaM chApaM viharanvai talAttalam |
mohayAmAsa daiteyAnsarvAnsaubhanivAsinaH
shlokas.5:
nAsya vikShipatashchApaM sa.ndadhAnasya chAsakRRit |
antaraM dadRRishe kashchinnighnataH shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.6:
mukhasya varNo na vikalpate.asya; chelushcha gAtrANi na chApi tasya |
siMhonnataM chApyabhigarjato.asya; shushrAva loko.adbhutarUpamagryam
shlokas.7:
jalecharaH kA~nchanayaShTisa.nstho; vyAttAnanaH sarvatimipramAthI |
vitrAsayanrAjati vAhamukhye; shAlvasya senApramukhe dhvajAgryaH
shlokas.8:
tataH sa tUrNaM niShpatya pradyumnaH shatrukarshanaH |
shAlvamevAbhidudrAva vidhAsyankalahaM nRRipa
shlokas.9:
abhiyAnaM tu vIreNa pradyumnena mahAhave |
nAmarShayata sa~NkruddhaH shAlvaH kurukulodvaha
shlokas.10:
sa roShamadamatto vai kAmagAdavaruhya cha |
pradyumnaM yodhayAmAsa shAlvaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.11:
tayoH sutumulaM yuddhaM shAlvavRRiShNipravIrayoH |
sametA dadRRishurlokA balivAsavayoriva
shlokas.12:
tasya mAyAmayo vIra ratho hemapariShkRRitaH |
sadhvajaH sapatAkashcha sAnukarShaH satUNavAn
shlokas.13:
sa taM rathavaraM shrImAnsamAruhya kila prabho |
mumocha bANAnkauravya pradyumnAya mahAbalaH
shlokas.14:
tato bANamayaM varShaM vyasRRijattarasA raNe |
pradyumno bhujavegena shAlvaM saMmohayanniva
shlokas.15:
sa tairabhihataH sa~Nkhye nAmarShayata saubharAT |
sharAndIptAgnisa~NkAshAnmumocha tanaye mama
shlokas.16:
sa shAlvabANai rAjendra viddho rukmiNinandanaH |
mumocha bANaM tvarito marmabhedinamAhave
shlokas.17:
tasya varma vibhidyAshu sa bANo matsuteritaH |
bibheda hRRidayaM patrI sa papAta mumoha cha
shlokas.18:
tasminnipatite vIre shAlvarAje vichetasi |
samprAdravandAnavendrA dArayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.19:
hAhAkRRitamabhUtsainyaM shAlvasya pRRithivIpate |
naShTasa~nj~ne nipatite tadA saubhapatau nRRipa
shlokas.20:
tata utthAya kauravya pratilabhya cha chetanAm |
mumocha bANaM tarasA pradyumnAya mahAbalaH
shlokas.21:
tena viddho mahAbAhuH pradyumnaH samare sthitaH |
jatrudeshe bhRRishaM vIro vyavAsIdadrathe tadA
shlokas.22:
taM sa viddhvA mahArAja shAlvo rukmiNinandanam |
nanAda siMhanAdaM vai nAdenApUrayanmahIm
shlokas.23:
tato mohaM samApanne tanaye mama bhArata |
mumocha bANA.nstvaritaH punaranyAndurAsadAn
shlokas.24:
sa tairabhihato bANairbahubhistena mohitaH |
nishcheShTaH kauravashreShTha pradyumno.abhUdraNAjire

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shAlvabANArdite tasminpradyumne balinAM vare |
vRRiShNayo bhagnasa~NkalpA vivyathuH pRRitanAgatAH
shlokas.2:
hAhAkRRitamabhUtsArvaM vRRiShNyandhakabalaM tadA |
pradyumne patite rAjanpare cha muditAbhavan
shlokas.3:
taM tathA mohitaM dRRiShTvA sArathirjavanairhayaiH |
raNAdapAharattUrNaM shikShito dArukistataH
shlokas.4:
nAtidUrApayAte tu rathe rathavarapraNut |
dhanurgRRihItvA yantAraM labdhasa~nj~no.abravIdidam
shlokas.5:
saute kiM te vyavasitaM kasmAdyAsi parA~NmukhaH |
naiSha vRRiShNipravIrANAmAhave dharma uchyate
shlokas.6:
kachchitsaute na te mohaH shAlvaM dRRiShTvA mahAhave |
viShAdo vA raNaM dRRiShTvA brUhi me tvaM yathAtatham
shlokas.7:
sUta uvAcha||
jAnArdane na me moho nApi me bhayamAvishat |
atibhAraM tu te manye shAlvaM keshavanandana
shlokas.8:
so.apayAmi shanairvIra balavAneSha pApakRRit |
mohitashcha raNe shUro rakShyaH sArathinA rathI
shlokas.9:
AyuShma.nstvaM mayA nityaM rakShitavyastvayApyaham |
rakShitavyo rathI nityamiti kRRitvApayAmyaham
shlokas.10:
ekashchAsi mahAbAho bahavashchApi dAnavAH |
nasamaM raukmiNeyAhaM raNaM matvApayAmyaham
shlokas.11:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evaM bruvati sUte tu tadA makaraketumAn |
uvAcha sUtaM kauravya nivartaya rathaM punaH
shlokas.12:
dArukAtmaja maivaM tvaM punaH kArShIH katha~nchana |
vyapayAnaM raNAtsaute jIvato mama karhichit
shlokas.13:
na sa vRRiShNikule jAto yo vai tyajati sa~Ngaram |
yo vA nipatitaM hanti tavAsmIti cha vAdinam
shlokas.14:
tathA striyaM vai yo hanti vRRiddhaM bAlaM tathaiva cha |
virathaM viprakIrNaM cha bhagnashastrAyudhaM tathA
shlokas.15:
tvaM cha sUtakule jAto vinItaH sUtakarmaNi |
dharmaj~nashchAsi vRRiShNInAmAhaveShvapi dAruke
shlokas.16:
sa jAna.nshcharitaM kRRitsnaM vRRiShNInAM pRRitanAmukhe |
apayAnaM punaH saute maivaM kArShIH katha~nchana
shlokas.17:
apayAtaM hataM pRRiShThe bhItaM raNapalAyinam |
gadAgrajo durAdharShaH kiM mAM vakShyati mAdhavaH
shlokas.18:
keshavasyAgrajo vApi nIlavAsA madotkaTaH |
kiM vakShyati mahAbAhurbaladevaH samAgataH
shlokas.19:
kiM vakShyati shinernaptA narasiMho mahAdhanuH |
apayAtaM raNAtsaute sAmbashcha samiti~njayaH
shlokas.20:
chArudeShNashcha durdharShastathaiva gadasAraNau |
akrUrashcha mahAbAhuH kiM mAM vakShyati sArathe
shlokas.21:
shUraM sambhAvitaM santaM nityaM puruShamAninam |
striyashcha vRRiShNIvIrANAM kiM mAM vakShyanti sa~NgatAH
shlokas.22:
pradyumno.ayamupAyAti bhItastyaktvA mahAhavam |
dhigenamiti vakShyanti na tu vakShyanti sAdhviti
shlokas.23:
dhigvAchA parihAso.api mama vA madvidhasya vA |
mRRityunAbhyadhikaH saute sa tvaM mA vyapayAH punaH
shlokas.24:
bhAraM hi mayi saMnyasya yAto madhunihA hariH |
yaj~naM bharatasiMhasya pArthasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.25:
kRRitavarmA mayA vIro niryAsyanneva vAritaH |
shAlvaM nivArayiShye.ahaM tiShTha tvamiti sUtaja
shlokas.26:
sa cha sambhAvayanmAM vai nivRRitto hRRidikAtmajaH |
taM sametya raNaM tyaktvA kiM vakShyAmi mahAratham
shlokas.27:
upayAtaM durAdharShaM sha~NkhachakragadAdharam |
puruShaM puNDarIkAkShaM kiM vakShyAmi mahAbhujam
shlokas.28:
sAtyakiM baladevaM cha ye chAnye.andhakavRRiShNayaH |
mayA spardhanti satataM kiM nu vakShyAmi tAnaham
shlokas.29:
tyaktvA raNamimaM saute pRRiShThato.abhyAhataH sharaiH |
tvayApanIto vivasho na jIveyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.30:
sa nivarta rathenAshu punardArukanandana |
na chaitadevaM kartavyamathApatsu katha~nchana
shlokas.31:
na jIvitamahaM saute bahu manye kadAchana |
apayAto raNAdbhItaH pRRiShThato.abhyAhataH sharaiH
shlokas.32:
kadA vA sUtaputra tvaM jAnIShe mAM bhayArditam |
apayAtaM raNaM hitvA yathA kApuruShaM tathA
shlokas.33:
na yuktaM bhavatA tyaktuM sa~NgrAmaM dArukAtmaja |
mayi yuddhArthini bhRRishaM sa tvaM yAhi yato raNam

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evamuktastu kaunteya sUtaputrastadA mRRidhe |
pradyumnamabravIchChlakShNaM madhuraM vAkyama~njasA
shlokas.2:
na me bhayaM raukmiNeya sa~NgrAme yachChato hayAn |
yuddhaj~nashchAsmi vRRiShNInAM nAtra ki~nchidato.anyathA
shlokas.3:
AyuShmannupadeshastu sArathye vartatAM smRRitaH |
sarvArtheShu rathI rakShyastvaM chApi bhRRishapIDitaH
shlokas.4:
tvaM hi shAlvaprayuktena patriNAbhihato bhRRisham |
kashmalAbhihato vIra tato.ahamapayAtavAn
shlokas.5:
sa tvaM sAtvatamukhyAdya labdhasa~nj~no yadRRichChayA |
pashya me hayasa.nyAne shikShAM keshavanandana
shlokas.6:
dArukeNAhamutpanno yathAvachchaiva shikShitaH |
vItabhIH pravishAmyetAM shAlvasya mahatIM chamUm
shlokas.7:
evamuktvA tato vIra hayAnsa~nchodya sa~Ngare |
rashmibhishcha samudyamya javenAbhyapatattadA
shlokas.8:
maNDalAni vichitrANi yamakAnItarANi cha |
savyAni cha vichitrANi dakShiNAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
pratodenAhatA rAjanrashmibhishcha samudyatAH |
utpatanta ivAkAshaM vibabhuste hayottamAH
shlokas.10:
te hastalAghavopetaM vij~nAya nRRipa dArukim |
dahyamAnA iva tadA paspRRishushcharaNairmahIm
shlokas.11:
so.apasavyAM chamUM tasya shAlvasya bharatarShabha |
chakAra nAtiyatnena tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.12:
amRRiShyamANo.apasavyaM pradyumnena sa saubharAT |
yantAramasya sahasA tribhirbANaiH samarpayat
shlokas.13:
dArukasya sutastaM tu bANavegamachintayan |
bhUya eva mahAbAho prayayau hayasaMmataH
shlokas.14:
tato bANAnbahuvidhAnpunareva sa saubharAT |
mumocha tanaye vIre mama rukmiNinandane
shlokas.15:
tAnaprAptA~nshitairbANaishchichCheda paravIrahA |
raukmiNeyaH smitaM kRRitvA darshayanhastalAghavam
shlokas.16:
ChinnAndRRiShTvA tu tAnbANAnpradyumnena sa saubharAT |
AsurIM dAruNIM mAyAmAsthAya vyasRRijachCharAn
shlokas.17:
prayujyamAnamAj~nAya daiteyAstraM mahAbalaH |
brahmAstreNAntarA ChittvA mumochAnyAnpatatriNaH
shlokas.18:
te tadastraM vidhUyAshu vivyadhU rudhirAshanAH |
shirasyurasi vaktre cha sa mumoha papAta cha
shlokas.19:
tasminnipatite kShudre shAlve bANaprapIDite |
raukmiNeyo.aparaM bANaM sa.ndadhe shatrunAshanam
shlokas.20:
tamarchitaM sarvadAshArhapUgai;rAshIrbhirarkajvalanaprakAsham |
dRRiShTvA sharaM jyAmabhinIyamAnaM; babhUva hAhAkRRitamantarikSham
shlokas.21:
tato devagaNAH sarve sendrAH saha dhaneshvarAH |
nAradaM preShayAmAsuH shvasanaM cha mahAbalam
shlokas.22:
tau raukmiNeyamAgamya vacho.abrUtAM divaukasAm |
naiSha vadhyastvayA vIra shAlvarAjaH katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
saMharasva punarbANamavadhyo.ayaM tvayA raNe |
etasya hi sharasyAjau nAvadhyo.asti pumAnkvachit
shlokas.24:
mRRityurasya mahAbAho raNe devakinandanaH |
kRRiShNaH sa~Nkalpito dhAtrA tanna mithyA bhavediti
shlokas.25:
tataH paramasaMhRRiShTaH pradyumnaH sharamuttamam |
sa~njahAra dhanuHshreShThAttUNe chaiva nyaveshayat
shlokas.26:
tata utthAya rAjendra shAlvaH paramadurmanAH |
vyapAyAtsabalastUrNaM pradyumnasharapIDitaH
shlokas.27:
sa dvArakAM parityajya krUro vRRiShNibhirarditaH |
saubhamAsthAya rAjendra divamAchakrame tadA

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
AnartanagaraM muktaM tato.ahamagamaM tadA |
mahAkratau rAjasUye nivRRitte nRRipate tava
shlokas.2:
apashyaM dvArakAM chAhaM mahArAja hatatviSham |
niHsvAdhyAyavaShaTkArAM nirbhUShaNavarastriyam
shlokas.3:
anabhij~neyarUpANi dvArakopavanAni cha |
dRRiShTvA sha~Nkopapanno.ahamapRRichChaM hRRidikAtmajam
shlokas.4:
asvasthanaranArIkamidaM vRRiShNipuraM bhRRiSham |
kimidaM narashArdUla shrotumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu sa mayA vistareNedamabravIt |
rodhaM mokShaM cha shAlvena hArdikyo rAjasattama
shlokas.6:
tato.ahaM kauravashreShTha shrutvA sarvamasheShataH |
vinAshe shAlvarAjasya tadaivAkaravaM matim
shlokas.7:
