tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha samAshvAsya pure janam |
rAjAnamAhukaM chaiva tathaivAnakadundubhim
sarvavRRiShNipravIrA.nshcha harShayannabruvaM tadA
shlokas.8:
apramAdaH sadA kAryo nagare yAdavarShabhAH |
shAlvarAjavinAshAya prayAtaM mAM nibodhata
shlokas.9:
nAhatvA taM nivartiShye purIM dvAravatIM prati |
sashAlvaM saubhanagaraM hatvA draShTAsmi vaH punaH
trisAmA hanyatAmeShA dundubhiH shatrubhIShaNI
shlokas.10:
te mayAshvAsitA vIrA yathAvadbharatarShabha |
sarve mAmabruvanhRRiShTAH prayAhi jahi shAtravAn
shlokas.11:
taiH prahRRiShTAtmabhirvIrairAshIrbhirabhinanditaH |
vAchayitvA dvijashreShThAnpraNamya shirasAhukam
shlokas.12:
sainyasugrIvayuktena rathenAnAdayandishaH |
pradhmApya sha~NkhapravaraM pA~nchajanyamahaM nRRipa
shlokas.13:
prayAto.asmi naravyAghra balena mahatA vRRitaH |
kL^iptena chatura~NgeNa balena jitakAshinA
shlokas.14:
samatItya bahUndeshAngirI.nshcha bahupAdapAn |
sarA.nsi saritashchaiva mArttikAvatamAsadam
shlokas.15:
tatrAshrauShaM naravyAghra shAlvaM nagaramantikAt |
prayAtaM saubhamAsthAya tamahaM pRRiShThato.anvayAm
shlokas.16:
tataH sAgaramAsAdya kukShau tasya mahormiNaH |
samudranAbhyAM shAlvo.abhUtsaubhamAsthAya shatruhan
shlokas.17:
sa samAlokya dUrAnmAM smayanniva yudhiShThira |
AhvayAmAsa duShTAtmA yuddhAyaiva muhurmuhuH
shlokas.18:
tasya shAr~NgavinirmuktairbahubhirmarmabhedibhiH |
puraM nAsAdyata sharaistato mAM roSha Avishat
shlokas.19:
sa chApi pApaprakRRitirdaiteyApasado nRRipa |
mayyavarShata durdharShaH sharadhArAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
sainikAnmama sUtaM cha hayA.nshcha samavAkirat |
achintayantastu sharAnvayaM yudhyAma bhArata
shlokas.21:
tataH shatasahasrANi sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
chikShipuH samare vIrA mayi shAlvapadAnugAH
shlokas.22:
te hayAnme rathaM chaiva tadA dArukameva cha |
ChAdayAmAsurasurA bANairmarmavibhedibhiH
shlokas.23:
na hayA na ratho vIra na yantA mama dArukaH |
adRRishyanta sharaishChannAstathAhaM sainikAshcha me
shlokas.24:
tato.ahamapi kauravya sharANAmayutAnbahUn |
abhimantritAnAM dhanuShA divyena vidhinAkShipam
shlokas.25:
na tatra viShayastvAsInmama sainyasya bhArata |
khe viShaktaM hi tatsaubhaM kroshamAtra ivAbhavat
shlokas.26:
tataste prekShakAH sarve ra~NgavATa iva sthitAH |
harShayAmAsuruchchairmAM siMhanAdatalasvanaiH
shlokas.27:
matkArmukavinirmuktA dAnavAnAM mahAraNe |
a~NgeShu rudhirAktAste vivishuH shalabhA iva
shlokas.28:
tato halahalAshabdaH saubhamadhye vyavardhata |
vadhyatAM vishikhaistIkShNaiH patatAM cha mahArNave
shlokas.29:
te nikRRittabhujaskandhAH kabandhAkRRitidarshanAH |
nadanto bhairavAnnAdannipatanti sma dAnavAH
shlokas.30:
tato gokShIrakundendumRRiNAlarajataprabham |
jalajaM pA~nchajanyaM vai prANenAhamapUrayam
shlokas.31:
tAndRRiShTvA patitA.nstatra shAlvaH saubhapatistadA |
mAyAyuddhena mahatA yodhayAmAsa mAM yudhi
shlokas.32:
tato huDahuDAH prAsAH shaktishUlaparashvadhAH |
paTTishAshcha bhushuNDyashcha prApatannanishaM mayi
shlokas.33:
tAnahaM mAyayaivAshu pratigRRihya vyanAshayam |
tasyAM hatAyAM mAyAyAM girishRRi~Ngairayodhayat
shlokas.34:
tato.abhavattama iva prabhAtamiva chAbhavat |
durdinaM sudinaM chaiva shItamuShNaM cha bhArata
shlokas.35:
evaM mAyAM vikurvANo yodhayAmAsa mAM ripuH |
vij~nAya tadahaM sarvaM mAyayaiva vyanAshayam
yathAkAlaM tu yuddhena vyadhamaM sarvataH sharaiH
shlokas.36:
tato vyoma mahArAja shatasUryamivAbhavat |
shatachandraM cha kaunteya sahasrAyutatArakam
shlokas.37:
tato nAj~nAyata tadA divArAtraM tathA dishaH |
tato.ahaM mohamApannaH praj~nAstraM samayojayam
tatastadastramastreNa vidhUtaM sharatUlavat
shlokas.38:
tathA tadabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
labdhAlokashcha rAjendra punaH shatrumayodhayam

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evaM sa puruShavyAghra shAlvo rAj~nAM mahAripuH |
yudhyamAno mayA sa~Nkhye viyadabhyAgamatpunaH
shlokas.2:
tataH shataghnIshcha mahAgadAshcha; dIptA.nshcha shUlAnmusalAnasI.nshcha |
chikShepa roShAnmayi mandabuddhiH; shAlvo mahArAja jayAbhikA~NkShI
shlokas.3:
tAnAshugairApatato.ahamAshu; nivArya tUrNaM khagamAnkha eva |
dvidhA tridhA chAchChinamAshu muktai;stato.antarikShe ninado babhUva
shlokas.4:
tataH shatasahasreNa sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
dArukaM vAjinashchaiva rathaM cha samavAkirat
shlokas.5:
tato mAmabravIdvIra dAruko vihvalanniva |
sthAtavyamiti tiShThAmi shAlvabANaprapIDitaH
shlokas.6:
iti tasya nishamyAhaM sAratheH karuNaM vachaH |
avekShamANo yantAramapashyaM sharapIDitam
shlokas.7:
na tasyorasi no mUrdhni na kAye na bhujadvaye |
antaraM pANDavashreShTha pashyAmi nahataM sharaiH
shlokas.8:
sa tu bANavarotpIDAdvisravatyasRRigulbaNam |
abhivRRiShTo yathA meghairgirirgairikadhAtumAn
shlokas.9:
abhIShuhastaM taM dRRiShTvA sIdantaM sArathiM raNe |
astambhayaM mahAbAho shAlvabANaprapIDitam
shlokas.10:
atha mAM puruShaH kashchiddvArakAnilayo.abravIt |
tvarito rathamabhyetya sauhRRidAdiva bhArata
shlokas.11:
Ahukasya vacho vIra tasyaiva parichArakaH |
viShaNNaH sannakaNTho vai tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.12:
dvArakAdhipatirvIra Aha tvAmAhuko vachaH |
keshaveha vijAnIShva yattvAM pitRRisakho.abravIt
shlokas.13:
upayAtvAdya shAlvena dvArakAM vRRiShNinandana |
viShakte tvayi durdharSha hataH shUrasuto balAt
shlokas.14:
tadalaM sAdhu yuddhena nivartasva janArdana |
dvArakAmeva rakShasva kAryametanmahattava
shlokas.15:
ityahaM tasya vachanaM shrutvA paramadurmanAH |
nishchayaM nAdhigachChAmi kartavyasyetarasya vA
shlokas.16:
sAtyakiM baladevaM cha pradyumnaM cha mahAratham |
jagarhe manasA vIra tachChrutvA vipriyaM vachaH
shlokas.17:
ahaM hi dvArakAyAshcha pitushcha kurunandana |
teShu rakShAM samAdhAya prayAtaH saubhapAtane
shlokas.18:
baladevo mahAbAhuH kachchijjIvati shatruhA |
sAtyakI raukmiNeyashcha chArudeShNashcha vIryavAn
sAmbaprabhRRitayashchaivetyahamAsaM sudurmanAH
shlokas.19:
eteShu hi naravyAghra jIvatsu na katha~nchana |
shakyaH shUrasuto hantumapi vajrabhRRitA svayam
shlokas.20:
hataH shUrasuto vyaktaM vyaktaM te cha parAsavaH |
baladevamukhAH sarve iti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.21:
so.ahaM sarvavinAshaM taM chintayAno muhurmuhuH |
suvihvalo mahArAja punaH shAlvamayodhayam
shlokas.22:
tato.apashyaM mahArAja prapatantamahaM tadA |
saubhAchChUrasutaM vIra tato mAM moha Avishat
shlokas.23:
tasya rUpaM prapatataH piturmama narAdhipa |
yayAteH kShINapuNyasya svargAdiva mahItalam
shlokas.24:
vishIrNagalitoShNIShaH prakIrNAmbaramUrdhajaH |
prapatandRRishyate ha sma kShINapuNya iva grahaH
shlokas.25:
tataH shAr~NgaM dhanuHshreShThaM karAtprapatitaM mama |
mohAtsannashcha kaunteya rathopastha upAvisham
shlokas.26:
tato hAhAkRRitaM sarvaM sainyaM me gatachetanam |
mAM dRRiShTvA rathanIDasthaM gatAsumiva bhArata
shlokas.27:
prasArya bAhU patataH prasArya charaNAvapi |
rUpaM piturapashyaM tachChakuneH patato yathA
shlokas.28:
taM patantaM mahAbAho shUlapaTTishapANayaH |
abhighnanto bhRRishaM vIrA mama cheto vyakampayan
shlokas.29:
tato muhUrtAtpratilabhya sa~nj~nA;mahaM tadA vIra mahAvimarde |
na tatra saubhaM na ripuM na shAlvaM; pashyAmi vRRiddhaM pitaraM na chApi
shlokas.30:
tato mamAsInmanasi mAyeyamiti nishchitam |
prabuddho.asmi tato bhUyaH shatasho vikira~nsharAn

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha pragRRihya ruchiraM dhanuH |
sharairapAtayaM saubhAchChirA.nsi vibudhadviShAm
shlokas.2:
sharA.nshchAshIviShAkArAnUrdhvagA.nstigmatejasaH |
apraiShaM shAlvarAjAya shAr~NgamuktAnsuvAsasaH
shlokas.3:
tato nAdRRishyata tadA saubhaM kurukulodvaha |
antarhitaM mAyayAbhUttato.ahaM vismito.abhavam
shlokas.4:
atha dAnavasa~NghAste vikRRitAnanamUrdhajAH |
udakroshanmahArAja viShThite mayi bhArata
shlokas.5:
tato.astraM shabdasAhaM vai tvaramANo mahAhave |
ayojayaM tadvadhAya tataH shabda upAramat
shlokas.6:
hatAste dAnavAH sarve yaiH sa shabda udIritaH |
sharairAdityasa~NkAshairjvalitaiH shabdasAdhanaiH
shlokas.7:
tasminnuparate shabde punarevAnyato.abhavat |
shabdo.aparo mahArAja tatrApi prAharaM sharAn
shlokas.8:
evaM dasha dishaH sarvAstiryagUrdhvaM cha bhArata |
nAdayAmAsurasurAste chApi nihatA mayA
shlokas.9:
tataH prAgjyotiShaM gatvA punareva vyadRRishyata |
saubhaM kAmagamaM vIra mohayanmama chakShuShI
shlokas.10:
tato lokAntakaraNo dAnavo vAnarAkRRitiH |
shilAvarSheNa sahasA mahatA mAM samAvRRiNot
shlokas.11:
so.ahaM parvatavarSheNa vadhyamAnaH samantataH |
valmIka iva rAjendra parvatopachito.abhavam
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM parvatachitaH sahayaH sahasArathiH |
aprakhyAtimiyAM rAjansadhvajaH parvataishchitaH
shlokas.13:
tato vRRiShNipravIrA ye mamAsansainikAstadA |
te bhayArtA dishaH sarvAH sahasA vipradudruvuH
shlokas.14:
tato hAhAkRRitaM sarvamabhUtkila vishAM pate |
dyaushcha bhUmishcha khaM chaivAdRRishyamAne tathA mayi
shlokas.15:
tato viShaNNamanaso mama rAjansuhRRijjanAH |
rurudushchukrushushchaiva duHkhashokasamanvitAH
shlokas.16:
dviShatAM cha praharSho.abhUdArtishchAdviShatAmapi |
evaM vijitavAnvIra pashchAdashrauShamachyuta
shlokas.17:
tato.ahamastraM dayitaM sarvapAShANabhedanam |
vajramudyamya tAnsarvAnparvatAnsamashAtayam
shlokas.18:
tataH parvatabhArArtA mandaprANavicheShTitAH |
hayA mama mahArAja vepamAnA ivAbhavan
shlokas.19:
meghajAlamivAkAshe vidAryAbhyuditaM ravim |
dRRiShTvA mAM bAndhavAH sarve harShamAhArayanpunaH
shlokas.20:
tato mAmabravItsUtaH prA~njaliH praNato nRRipa |
sAdhu sampashya vArShNeya shAlvaM saubhapatiM sthitam
shlokas.21:
alaM kRRiShNAvamanyainaM sAdhu yatnaM samAchara |
mArdavaM sakhitAM chaiva shAlvAdadya vyapAhara
shlokas.22:
jahi shAlvaM mahAbAho mainaM jIvaya keshava |
sarvaiH parAkramairvIra vadhyaH shatruramitrahan
shlokas.23:
na shatruravamantavyo durbalo.api balIyasA |
yo.api syAtpIThagaH kashchitkiM punaH samare sthitaH
shlokas.24:
sa tvaM puruShashArdUla sarvayatnairimaM prabho |
jahi vRRiShNikulashreShTha mA tvAM kAlo.atyagAtpunaH
shlokas.25:
naiSha mArdavasAdhyo vai mato nApi sakhA tava |
yena tvaM yodhito vIra dvArakA chAvamarditA
shlokas.26:
evamAdi tu kaunteya shrutvAhaM sArathervachaH |
tattvametaditi j~nAtvA yuddhe matimadhArayam
shlokas.27:
vadhAya shAlvarAjasya saubhasya cha nipAtane |
dArukaM chAbruvaM vIra muhUrtaM sthIyatAmiti
shlokas.28:
tato.apratihataM divyamabhedyamativIryavat |
AgneyamastraM dayitaM sarvasAhaM mahAprabham
shlokas.29:
yakShANAM rAkShasAnAM cha dAnavAnAM cha sa.nyuge |
rAj~nAM cha pratilomAnAM bhasmAntakaraNaM mahat
shlokas.30:
kShurAntamamalaM chakraM kAlAntakayamopamam |
abhimantryAhamatulaM dviShatAM cha nibarhaNam
shlokas.31:
jahi saubhaM svavIryeNa ye chAtra ripavo mama |
ityuktvA bhujavIryeNa tasmai prAhiNavaM ruShA
shlokas.32:
rUpaM sudarshanasyAsIdAkAshe patatastadA |
dvitIyasyeva sUryasya yugAnte pariviShyataH
shlokas.33:
tatsamAsAdya nagaraM saubhaM vyapagatatviSham |
madhyena pATayAmAsa krakacho dArvivochChritam
shlokas.34:
dvidhA kRRitaM tataH saubhaM sudarshanabalAddhatam |
maheshvarasharoddhUtaM papAta tripuraM yathA
shlokas.35:
tasminnipatite saubhe chakramAgAtkaraM mama |
punashchoddhUya vegena shAlvAyetyahamabruvam
shlokas.36:
tataH shAlvaM gadAM gurvImAvidhyantaM mahAhave |
dvidhA chakAra sahasA prajajvAla cha tejasA
shlokas.37:
tasminnipatite vIre dAnavAstrastachetasaH |
hAhAbhUtA disho jagmurarditA mama sAyakaiH
shlokas.38:
tato.ahaM samavasthApya rathaM saubhasamIpataH |
sha~NkhaM pradhmApya harSheNa suhRRidaH paryaharShayam
shlokas.39:
tanmerushikharAkAraM vidhvastATTAlagopuram |
dahyamAnamabhiprekShya striyastAH sampradudruvuH
shlokas.40:
evaM nihatya samare shAlvaM saubhaM nipAtya cha |
AnartAnpunarAgamya suhRRidAM prItimAvaham
shlokas.41:
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjannAgamaM nAgasAhvayam |
yadyagAM paravIraghna na hi jIvetsuyodhanaH
shlokas.42:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahAbAhuH kauravaM puruShottamaH |
Amantrya prayayau dhImAnpANDavAnmadhusUdanaH
shlokas.43:
abhivAdya mahAbAhurdharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
rAj~nA mUrdhanyupAghrAto bhImena cha mahAbhujaH
shlokas.44:
subhadrAmabhimanyuM cha rathamAropya kA~nchanam |
Aruroha rathaM kRRiShNaH pANDavairabhipUjitaH
shlokas.45:
sainyasugrIvayuktena rathenAdityavarchasA |
dvArakAM prayayau kRRiShNaH samAshvAsya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.46:
tataH prayAte dAshArhe dhRRiShTadyumno.api pArShataH |
draupadeyAnupAdAya prayayau svapuraM tadA
shlokas.47:
dhRRiShTaketuH svasAraM cha samAdAyAtha chedirAT |
jagAma pANDavAndRRiShTvA ramyAM shuktimatIM purIm
shlokas.48:
kekayAshchApyanuj~nAtAH kaunteyenAmitaujasA |
Amantrya pANDavAnsarvAnprayayuste.api bhArata
shlokas.49:
brAhmaNAshcha vishashchaiva tathA viShayavAsinaH |
visRRijyamAnAH subhRRishaM na tyajanti sma pANDavAn
shlokas.50:
samavAyaH sa rAjendra sumahAdbhutadarshanaH |
AsInmahAtmanAM teShAM kAmyake bharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
yudhiShThirastu viprA.nstAnanumAnya mahAmanAH |
shashAsa puruShAnkAle rathAnyojayateti ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasmindashArhAdhipatau prayAte; yudhiShThiro bhImasenArjunau cha |
yamau cha kRRiShNA cha purohitashcha; rathAnmahArhAnparamAshvayuktAn
shlokas.2:
AsthAya vIrAH sahitA vanAya; pratasthire bhUtapatiprakAshAH |
hiraNyaniShkAnvasanAni gAshcha; pradAya shikShAkSharamantravidbhyaH
shlokas.3:
preShyAH puro vi.nshatirAttashastrA; dhanUMShi varmANi sharA.nshcha pItAn |
maurvIshcha yantrANi cha sAyakA.nshcha; sarve samAdAya jaghanyamIyuH
shlokas.4:
tatastu vAsA.nsi cha rAjaputryA; dhAtryashcha dAsyashcha vibhUShaNaM cha |
tadindrasenastvaritaM pragRRihya; jaghanyamevopayayau rathena
shlokas.5:
tataH kurushreShThamupetya paurAH; pradakShiNaM chakruradInasattvAH |
taM brAhmaNAshchAbhyavadanprasannA; mukhyAshcha sarve kurujA~NgalAnAm
shlokas.6:
sa chApi tAnabhyavadatprasannaH; sahaiva tairbhrAtRRibhirdharmarAjaH |
tasthau cha tatrAdhipatirmahAtmA; dRRiShTvA janaughaM kurujA~NgalAnAm
shlokas.7:
piteva putreShu sa teShu bhAvaM; chakre kurUNAmRRiShabho mahAtmA |
te chApi tasminbharataprabarhe; tadA babhUvuH pitarIva putrAH
shlokas.8:
tataH samAsAdya mahAjanaughAH; kurupravIraM parivArya tasthuH |
hA nAtha hA dharma iti bruvanto; hriyA cha sarve.ashrumukhA babhUvuH
shlokas.9:
varaH kurUNAmadhipaH prajAnAM; piteva putrAnapahAya chAsmAn |
paurAnimA~njAnapadA.nshcha sarvA;nhitvA prayAtaH kva nu dharmarAjaH
shlokas.10:
dhigdhArtarAShTraM sunRRisha.nsabuddhiM; sasaubalaM pApamatiM cha karNam |
anarthamichChanti narendra pApA; ye dharmanityasya satastavogrAH
shlokas.11:
svayaM niveshyApratimaM mahAtmA; puraM mahaddevapuraprakAsham |
shatakratuprasthamamoghakarmA; hitvA prayAtaH kva nu dharmarAjaH
shlokas.12:
chakAra yAmapratimAM mahAtmA; sabhAM mayo devasabhAprakAshAm |
tAM devaguptAmiva devamAyAM; hitvA prayAtaH kva nu dharmarAjaH
shlokas.13:
tAndharmakAmArthaviduttamaujA; bIbhatsuruchchaiH sahitAnuvAcha |
AdAsyate vAsamimaM niruShya; vaneShu rAjA dviShatAM yashA.nsi
shlokas.14:
dvijAtimukhyAH sahitAH pRRithakcha; bhavadbhirAsAdya tapasvinashcha |
prasAdya dharmArthavidashcha vAchyA; yathArthasiddhiH paramA bhavennaH
shlokas.15:
ityevamukte vachane.arjunena; te brAhmaNAH sarvavarNAshcha rAjan |
mudAbhyanandansahitAshcha chakruH; pradakShiNaM dharmabhRRitAM variShTham
shlokas.16:
Amantrya pArthaM cha vRRikodaraM cha; dhana~njayaM yAj~nasenIM yamau cha |
pratasthire rAShTramapetaharShA; yudhiShThireNAnumatA yathAsvam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatasteShu prayAteShu kaunteyaH satyasa~NgaraH |
abhyabhAShata dharmAtmA bhrAtR^InsarvAnyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
dvAdashemAH samAsmAbhirvastavyaM nirjane vane |
samIkShadhvaM mahAraNye deshaM bahumRRigadvijam
shlokas.3:
bahupuShpaphalaM ramyaM shivaM puNyajanochitam |
yatremAH sharadaH sarvAH sukhaM prativasemahi
shlokas.4:
evamukte pratyuvAcha dharmarAjaM dhana~njayaH |
guruvanmAnavaguruM mAnayitvA manasvinam
shlokas.5:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhavAneva maharShINAM vRRiddhAnAM paryupAsitA |
aj~nAtaM mAnuShe loke bhavato nAsti ki~nchana
shlokas.6:
tvayA hyupAsitA nityaM brAhmaNA bharatarShabha |
dvaipAyanaprabhRRitayo nAradashcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.7:
yaH sarvalokadvArANi nityaM sa~ncharate vashI |
devalokAdbrahmalokaM gandharvApsarasAmapi
shlokas.8:
sarvA gatIrvijAnAsi brAhmaNAnAM na sa.nshayaH |
prabhAvA.nshchaiva vettha tvaM sarveShAmeva pArthiva
shlokas.9:
tvameva rAja~njAnAsi shreyaHkAraNameva cha |
yatrechChasi mahArAja nivAsaM tatra kurmahe
shlokas.10:
idaM dvaitavanaM nAma saraH puNyajanochitam |
bahupuShpaphalaM ramyaM nAnAdvijaniShevitam
shlokas.11:
atremA dvAdasha samA viharemeti rochaye |
yadi te.anumataM rAjankiM vAnyanmanyate bhavAn
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mamApyetanmataM pArtha tvayA yatsamudAhRRitam |
gachChAma puNyaM vikhyAtaM mahaddvaitavanaM saraH
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste prayayuH sarve pANDavA dharmachAriNaH |
brAhmaNairbahubhiH sArdhaM puNyaM dvaitavanaM saraH
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNAH sAgnihotrAshcha tathaiva cha niragnayaH |
svAdhyAyino bhikShavashcha sajapA vanavAsinaH
shlokas.15:
bahavo brAhmaNAstatra parivavruryudhiShThiram |
tapasvinaH satyashIlAH shatashaH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.16:
te yAtvA pANDavAstatra bahubhirbrAhmaNaiH saha |
puNyaM dvaitavanaM ramyaM vivishurbharatarShabhAH
shlokas.17:
tachChAlatAlAmramadhUkanIpa; kadambasarjArjunakarNikAraiH |
tapAtyaye puShpadharairupetaM; mahAvanaM rAShTrapatirdadarsha
shlokas.18:
mahAdrumANAM shikhareShu tasthu;rmanoramAM vAchamudIrayantaH |
mayUradAtyUhachakorasa~NghA;stasminvane kAnanakokilAshcha
shlokas.19:
kareNuyUthaiH saha yUthapAnAM; madotkaTAnAmachalaprabhANAm |
mahAnti yUthAni mahAdvipAnAM; tasminvane rAShTrapatirdadarsha
shlokas.20:
manoramAM bhogavatImupetya; dhRRitAtmanAM chIrajaTAdharANAm |
tasminvane dharmabhRRitAM nivAse; dadarsha siddharShigaNAnanekAn
shlokas.21:
tataH sa yAnAdavaruhya rAjA; sabhrAtRRikaH sajanaH kAnanaM tat |
vivesha dharmAtmavatAM variShTha;striviShTapaM shakra ivAmitaujAH
shlokas.22:
taM satyasandhaM sahitAbhipetu;rdidRRikShavashchAraNasiddhasa~NghAH |
vanaukasashchApi narendrasiMhaM; manasvinaM samparivArya tasthuH
shlokas.23:
sa tatra siddhAnabhivAdya sarvA;npratyarchito rAjavaddevavachcha |
vivesha sarvaiH sahito dvijAgryaiH; kRRitA~njalirdharmabhRRitAM variShThaH
shlokas.24:
sa puNyashIlaH pitRRivanmahAtmA; tapasvibhirdharmaparairupetya |
pratyarchitaH puShpadharasya mUle; mahAdrumasyopavivesha rAjA
shlokas.25:
bhImashcha kRRiShNA cha dhana~njayashcha; yamau cha te chAnucharA narendram |
vimuchya vAhAnavaruhya sarve; tatropatasthurbharataprabarhAH
shlokas.26:
latAvatAnAvanataH sa pANDavai;rmahAdrumaH pa~nchabhirugradhanvibhiH |
babhau nivAsopagatairmahAtmabhi;rmahAgirirvAraNayUthapairiva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatkAnanaM prApya narendraputrAH; sukhochitA vAsamupetya kRRichChram |
vijahrurindrapratimAH shiveShu; sarasvatIshAlavaneShu teShu
shlokas.2:
yatI.nshcha sarvAnsa munI.nshcha rAjA; tasminvane mUlaphalairudagraiH |
dvijAtimukhyAnRRiShabhaH kurUNAM; santarpayAmAsa mahAnubhAvaH
shlokas.3:
iShTIshcha pitryANi tathAgriyANi; mahAvane vasatAM pANDavAnAm |
purohitaH sarvasamRRiddhatejA;shchakAra dhaumyaH pitRRivatkurUNAm
shlokas.4:
apetya rAShTrAdvasatAM tu teShA;mRRiShiH purANo.atithirAjagAma |
tamAshramaM tIvrasamRRiddhatejA; mArkaNDeyaH shrImatAM pANDavAnAm
shlokas.5:
sa sarvaviddraupadIM prekShya kRRiShNAM; yudhiShThiraM bhImasenArjunau cha |
sa.nsmRRitya rAmaM manasA mahAtmA; tapasvimadhye.asmayatAmitaujAH
shlokas.6:
taM dharmarAjo vimanA ivAbravI;tsarve hriyA santi tapasvino.amI |
bhavAnidaM kiM smayatIva hRRiShTa;stapasvinAM pashyatAM mAmudIkShya
shlokas.7:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
na tAta hRRiShyAmi na cha smayAmi; praharShajo mAM bhajate na darpaH |
tavApadaM tvadya samIkShya rAmaM; satyavrataM dAsharathiM smarAmi
shlokas.8:
sa chApi rAjA saha lakShmaNena; vane nivAsaM pitureva shAsanAt |
dhanvI charanpArtha purA mayaiva; dRRiShTo girerRRiShyamUkasya sAnau
shlokas.9:
sahasranetrapratimo mahAtmA; mayasya jeta namucheshcha hantA |
piturnideshAdanaghaH svadharmaM; vane vAsaM dAsharathishchakAra
shlokas.10:
sa chApi shakrasya samaprabhAvo; mahAnubhAvaH samareShvajeyaH |
vihAya bhogAnacharadvaneShu; neshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.11:
nRRipAshcha nAbhAgabhagIrathAdayo; mahImimAM sAgarAntAM vijitya |
satyena te.apyajaya.nstAta lokA;nneshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.12:
alarkamAhurnaravarya santaM; satyavrataM kAshikarUSharAjam |
vihAya rAShTrANi vasUni chaiva; neshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.13:
dhAtrA vidhiryo vihitaH purANa;staM pUjayanto naravarya santaH |
saptarShayaH pArtha divi prabhAnti; neshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.14:
mahAbalAnparvatakUTamAtrA;nviShANinaH pashya gajAnnarendra |
sthitAnnideshe naravarya dhAtu;rneshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.15:
sarvANi bhUtAni narendra pashya; yathA yathAvadvihitaM vidhAtrA |
svayonitastatkurute prabhAvA;nneshe balasyeti charedadharmam
shlokas.16:
satyena dharmeNa yathArhavRRittyA; hriyA tathA sarvabhUtAnyatItya |
yashashcha tejashcha tavApi dIptaM; vibhAvasorbhAskarasyeva pArtha
shlokas.17:
yathApratij~naM cha mahAnubhAva; kRRichChraM vane vAsamimaM niruShya |
tataH shriyaM tejasA svena dIptA;mAdAsyase pArthiva kauravebhyaH
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamevamuktvA vachanaM maharShi;stapasvimadhye sahitaM suhRRidbhiH |
Amantrya dhaumyaM sahitA.nshcha pArthAM;stataH pratasthe dishamuttarAM saH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vasatsvatha dvaitavane pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
anukIrNaM mahAraNyaM brAhmaNaiH samapadyata
shlokas.2:
IryamANena satataM brahmaghoSheNa sarvataH |
brahmalokasamaM puNyamAsIddvaitavanaM saraH
shlokas.3:
yajuShAmRRichAM cha sAmnAM cha gadyAnAM chaiva sarvashaH |
AsIduchchAryamANAnAM nisvano hRRidaya~NgamaH
shlokas.4:
jyAghoShaH pANDaveyAnAM brahmaghoShashcha dhImatAm |
sa.nsRRiShTaM brahmaNA kShatraM bhUya eva vyarochata
shlokas.5:
athAbravIdbako dAlbhyo dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
sandhyAM kaunteyamAsInamRRiShibhiH parivAritam
shlokas.6:
pashya dvaitavane pArtha brAhmaNAnAM tapasvinAm |
homavelAM kurushreShTha samprajvalitapAvakAm
shlokas.7:
charanti dharmaM puNye.asmi.nstvayA guptA dhRRitavratAH |
bhRRigavo.a~Ngirasashchaiva vAsiShThAH kAshyapaiH saha
shlokas.8:
AgastyAshcha mahAbhAgA AtreyAshchottamavratAH |
sarvasya jagataH shreShThA brAhmaNAH sa~NgatAstvayA
shlokas.9:
idaM tu vachanaM pArtha shRRiNvekAgramanA mama |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaunteya yattvAM vakShyAmi kaurava
shlokas.10:
brahma kShatreNa sa.nsRRiShTaM kShatraM cha brahmaNA saha |
udIrNau dahataH shatrUnvanAnIvAgnimArutau
shlokas.11:
nAbrAhmaNastAta chiraM bubhUShe;dichChannimaM lokamamuM cha jetum |
vinItadharmArthamapetamohaM; labdhvA dvijaM nudati nRRipaH sapatnAn
shlokas.12:
charannaiHshreyasaM dharmaM prajApAlanakAritam |
nAdhyagachChadbalirloke tIrthamanyatra vai dvijAt
shlokas.13:
anUnamAsIdasurasya kAmai;rvairochaneH shrIrapi chAkShayAsIt |
labdhvA mahIM brAhmaNasamprayogA;tteShvAcharanduShTamato vyanashyat
shlokas.14:
nAbrAhmaNaM bhUmiriyaM sabhUti;rvarNaM dvitIyaM bhajate chirAya |
samudranemirnamate tu tasmai; yaM brAhmaNaH shAsti nayairvinItaH
shlokas.15:
ku~njarasyeva sa~NgrAme.aparigRRihyA~Nkushagraham |
brAhmaNairviprahINasya kShatrasya kShIyate balam
shlokas.16:
brahmaNyanupamA dRRiShTiH kShAtramapratimaM balam |
tau yadA charataH sArdhamatha lokaH prasIdati
shlokas.17:
yathA hi sumahAnagniH kakShaM dahati sAnilaH |
tathA dahati rAjanyo brAhmaNena samaM ripUn
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNebhyo.atha medhAvI buddhiparyeShaNaM charet |
alabdhasya cha lAbhAya labdhasya cha vivRRiddhaye
shlokas.19:
alabdhalAbhAya cha labdhavRRiddhaye; yathArhatIrthapratipAdanAya |
yashasvinaM vedavidaM vipashchitaM; bahushrutaM brAhmaNameva vAsaya
shlokas.20:
brAhmaNeShUttamA vRRittistava nityaM yudhiShThira |
tena te sarvalokeShu dIpyate prathitaM yashaH
shlokas.21:
tataste brAhmaNAH sarve bakaM dAlbhyamapUjayan |
yudhiShThire stUyamAne bhUyaH sumanaso.abhavan
shlokas.22:
dvaipAyano nAradashcha jAmadagnyaH pRRithushravAH |
indradyumno bhAlukishcha kRRitachetAH sahasrapAt
shlokas.23:
karNashravAshcha mu~njashcha lavaNAshvashcha kAshyapaH |
hArItaH sthUNakarNashcha agniveshyo.atha shaunakaH
shlokas.24:
RRitavAkcha suvAkchaiva bRRihadashva RRitAvasuH |
UrdhvaretA vRRiShAmitraH suhotro hotravAhanaH
shlokas.25:
ete chAnye cha bahavo brAhmaNAH sa.nshitavratAH |
ajAtashatrumAnarchuH pura.ndaramivarShayaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vanagatAH pArthAH sAyAhne saha kRRiShNayA |
upaviShTAH kathAshchakrurduHkhashokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.2:
priyA cha darshanIyA cha paNDitA cha pativratA |
tataH kRRiShNA dharmarAjamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
na nUnaM tasya pApasya duHkhamasmAsu ki~nchana |
vidyate dhArtarAShTrasya nRRisha.nsasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
yastvAM rAjanmayA sArdhamajinaiH prativAsitam |
bhrAtRRibhishcha tathA sarvairnAbhyabhAShata ki~nchana
vanaM prasthApya duShTAtmA nAnvatapyata durmatiH
shlokas.5:
AyasaM hRRidayaM nUnaM tasya duShkRRitakarmaNaH |
yastvAM dharmaparaM shreShThaM rUkShANyashrAvayattadA
shlokas.6:
sukhochitamaduHkhArhaM durAtmA sasuhRRidgaNaH |
IdRRishaM duHkhamAnIya modate pApapUruShaH
shlokas.7:
chaturNAmeva pApAnAmashru vai nApatattadA |
tvayi bhArata niShkrAnte vanAyAjinavAsasi
shlokas.8:
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneshcha durAtmanaH |
durbhrAtustasya chograsya tathA duHshAsanasya cha
shlokas.9:
itareShAM tu sarveShAM kurUNAM kurusattama |
duHkhenAbhiparItAnAM netrebhyaH prApatajjalam
shlokas.10:
idaM cha shayanaM dRRiShTvA yachchAsItte purAtanam |
shochAmi tvAM mahArAja duHkhAnarhaM sukhochitam
shlokas.11:
dAntaM yachcha sabhAmadhye AsanaM ratnabhUShitam |
dRRiShTvA kushabRRisIM chemAM shoko mAM rundhayatyayam
shlokas.12:
yadapashyaM sabhAyAM tvAM rAjabhiH parivAritam |
tachcha rAjannapashyantyAH kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.13:
yA tvAhaM chandanAdigdhamapashyaM sUryavarchasam |
sA tvA pa~NkamalAdigdhaM dRRiShTvA muhyAmi bhArata
shlokas.14:
yA vai tvA kaushikairvastraiH shubhrairbahudhanaiH purA |
dRRiShTavatyasmi rAjendra sA tvAM pashyAmi chIriNam
shlokas.15:
yachcha tadrukmapAtrIbhirbrAhmaNebhyaH sahasrashaH |
hriyate te gRRihAdannaM sa.nskRRitaM sArvakAmikam
shlokas.16:
yatInAmagRRihANAM te tathaiva gRRihamedhinAm |
dIyate bhojanaM rAjannatIva guNavatprabho
tachcha rAjannapashyantyAH kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.17:
yA.nste bhrAtR^InmahArAja yuvAno mRRiShTakuNDalAH |
abhojayanta mRRiShTAnnaiH sUdAH paramasa.nskRRitaiH
shlokas.18:
sarvA.nstAnadya pashyAmi vane vanyena jIvataH |
aduHkhArhAnmanuShyendra nopashAmyati me manaH
shlokas.19:
bhImasenamimaM chApi duHkhitaM vanavAsinam |
dhyAyantaM kiM na manyuste prApte kAle vivardhate
shlokas.20:
bhImasenaM hi karmANi svayaM kurvANamachyuta |
sukhArhaM duHkhitaM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.21:
satkRRitaM vividhairyAnairvastrairuchchAvachaistathA |
taM te vanagataM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.22:
kurUnapi hi yaH sarvAnhantumutsahate prabhuH |
tvatprasAdaM pratIkSha.nstu sahate.ayaM vRRikodaraH
shlokas.23:
yo.arjunenArjunastulyo dvibAhurbahubAhunA |
sharAtisarge shIghratvAtkAlAntakayamopamaH
shlokas.24:
yasya shastrapratApena praNatAH sarvapArthivAH |
yaj~ne tava mahArAja brAhmaNAnupatasthire
shlokas.25:
tamimaM puruShavyAghraM pUjitaM devadAnavaiH |
dhyAyantamarjunaM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.26:
dRRiShTvA vanagataM pArthamaduHkhArhaM sukhochitam |
na cha te vardhate manyustena muhyAmi bhArata
shlokas.27:
yo devA.nshcha manuShyA.nshcha sarpA.nshchaikaratho.ajayat |
taM te vanagataM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.28:
yo yAnairadbhutAkArairhayairnAgaishcha sa.nvRRitaH |
prasahya vittAnyAdatta pArthivebhyaH parantapaH
shlokas.29:
kShipatyekena vegena pa~ncha bANashatAni yaH |
taM te vanagataM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.30:
shyAmaM bRRihantaM taruNaM charmiNAmuttamaM raNe |
nakulaM te vane dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.31:
darshanIyaM cha shUraM cha mAdrIputraM yudhiShThira |
sahadevaM vane dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.32:
drupadasya kule jAtAM snuShAM pANDormahAtmanaH |
mAM te vanagatAM dRRiShTvA kasmAnmanyurna vardhate
shlokas.33:
nUnaM cha tava naivAsti manyurbharatasattama |
yatte bhrAtR^I.nshcha mAM chaiva dRRiShTvA na vyathate manaH
shlokas.34:
na nirmanyuH kShatriyo.asti loke nirvachanaM smRRitam |
tadadya tvayi pashyAmi kShatriye viparItavat
shlokas.35:
yo na darshayate tejaH kShatriyaH kAla Agate |
sarvabhUtAni taM pArtha sadA paribhavantyuta
shlokas.36:
tattvayA na kShamA kAryA shatrUnprati katha~nchana |
tejasaiva hi te shakyA nihantuM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.37:
tathaiva yaH kShamAkAle kShatriyo nopashAmyati |
apriyaH sarvabhUtAnAM so.amutreha cha nashyati

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prahlAdasya cha sa.nvAdaM balervairochanasya cha
shlokas.2:
asurendraM mahAprAj~naM dharmANAmAgatAgamam |
baliH paprachCha daityendraM prahlAdaM pitaraM pituH
shlokas.3:
kShamA svichChreyasI tAta utAho teja ityuta |
etanme sa.nshayaM tAta yathAvadbrUhi pRRichChate
shlokas.4:
shreyo yadatra dharmaj~na brUhi me tadasa.nshayam |
kariShyAmi hi tatsarvaM yathAvadanushAsanam
shlokas.5:
tasmai provAcha tatsarvamevaM pRRiShTaH pitAmahaH |
sarvanishchayavitprAj~naH sa.nshayaM paripRRichChate
shlokas.6:
prahlAda uvAcha||
na shreyaH satataM tejo na nityaM shreyasI kShamA |
iti tAta vijAnIhi dvayametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.7:
yo nityaM kShamate tAta bahUndoShAnsa vindati |
bhRRityAH paribhavantyenamudAsInAstathaiva cha
shlokas.8:
sarvabhUtAni chApyasya na namante kadAchana |
tasmAnnityaM kShamA tAta paNDitairapavAditA
shlokas.9:
avaj~nAya hi taM bhRRityA bhajante bahudoShatAm |
AdAtuM chAsya vittAni prArthayante.alpachetasaH
shlokas.10:
yAnaM vastrANyala~NkArA~nshayanAnyAsanAni cha |
bhojanAnyatha pAnAni sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.11:
AdadIrannadhikRRitA yathAkAmamachetasaH |
pradiShTAni cha deyAni na dadyurbhartRRishAsanAt
shlokas.12:
na chainaM bhartRRipUjAbhiH pUjayanti kadAchana |
avaj~nAnaM hi loke.asminmaraNAdapi garhitam
shlokas.13:
kShamiNaM tAdRRishaM tAta bruvanti kaTukAnyapi |
preShyAH putrAshcha bhRRityAshcha tathodAsInavRRittayaH
shlokas.14:
apyasya dArAnichChanti paribhUya kShamAvataH |
dArAshchAsya pravartante yathAkAmamachetasaH
shlokas.15:
tathA cha nityamuditA yadi svalpamapIshvarAt |
daNDamarhanti duShyanti duShTAshchApyapakurvate
shlokas.16:
ete chAnye cha bahavo nityaM doShAH kShamAvatAm |
atha vairochane doShAnimAnviddhyakShamAvatAm
shlokas.17:
asthAne yadi vA sthAne satataM rajasAvRRitaH |
kruddho daNDAnpraNayati vividhAnsvena tejasA
shlokas.18:
mitraiH saha virodhaM cha prApnute tejasAvRRitaH |
prApnoti dveShyatAM chaiva lokAtsvajanatastathA
shlokas.19:
so.avamAnAdarthahAnimupAlambhamanAdaram |
santApadveShalobhA.nshcha shatrU.nshcha labhate naraH
shlokas.20:
krodhAddaNDAnmanuShyeShu vividhAnpuruSho nayan |
bhrashyate shIghramaishvaryAtprANebhyaH svajanAdapi
shlokas.21:
yo.apakartR^I.nshcha kartR^I.nshcha tejasaivopagachChati |
tasmAdudvijate lokaH sarpAdveshmagatAdiva
shlokas.22:
yasmAdudvijate lokaH kathaM tasya bhavo bhavet |
antaraM hyasya dRRiShTvaiva loko vikurute dhruvam
tasmAnnAtyutsRRijettejo na cha nityaM mRRidurbhavet
shlokas.23:
kAle mRRiduryo bhavati kAle bhavati dAruNaH |
sa vai sukhamavApnoti loke.amuShminnihaiva cha
shlokas.24:
kShamAkAlA.nstu vakShyAmi shRRiNu me vistareNa tAn |
ye te nityamasantyAjyA yathA prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.25:
pUrvopakArI yastu syAdaparAdhe.agarIyasi |
upakAreNa tattasya kShantavyamaparAdhinaH
shlokas.26:
abuddhimAshritAnAM cha kShantavyamaparAdhinAm |
na hi sarvatra pANDityaM sulabhaM puruSheNa vai
shlokas.27:
atha chedbuddhijaM kRRitvA brUyuste tadabuddhijam |
pApAnsvalpe.api tAnhanyAdaparAdhe tathAnRRijUn
shlokas.28:
sarvasyaiko.aparAdhaste kShantavyaH prANino bhavet |
dvitIye sati vadhyastu svalpe.apyapakRRite bhavet
shlokas.29:
ajAnatA bhavetkashchidaparAdhaH kRRito yadi |
kShantavyameva tasyAhuH suparIkShya parIkShayA
shlokas.30:
mRRidunA mArdavaM hanti mRRidunA hanti dAruNam |
nAsAdhyaM mRRidunA ki~nchittasmAttIkShNataro mRRiduH
shlokas.31:
deshakAlau tu samprekShya balAbalamathAtmanaH |
nAdeshakAle ki~nchitsyAddeshaH kAlaH pratIkShyate
tathA lokabhayAchchaiva kShantavyamaparAdhinaH
shlokas.32:
eta eva.nvidhAH kAlAH kShamAyAH parikIrtitAH |
ato.anyathAnuvartatsu tejasaH kAla uchyate
shlokas.33:
draupadyuvAcha||
tadahaM tejasaH kAlaM tava manye narAdhipa |
dhArtarAShTreShu lubdheShu satataM chApakAriShu
shlokas.34:
na hi kashchitkShamAkAlo vidyate.adya kurUnprati |
tejasashchAgate kAle teja utsraShTumarhasi
shlokas.35:
mRRidurbhavatyavaj~nAtastIkShNAdudvijate janaH |
kAle prApte dvayaM hyetadyo veda sa mahIpatiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
krodho hantA manuShyANAM krodho bhAvayitA punaH |
iti viddhi mahAprAj~ne krodhamUlau bhavAbhavau
shlokas.2:
yo hi saMharate krodhaM bhAvastasya sushobhane |
yaH punaH puruShaH krodhaM nityaM na sahate shubhe
tasyAbhAvAya bhavati krodhaH paramadAruNaH
shlokas.3:
krodhamUlo vinAsho hi prajAnAmiha dRRishyate |
tatkathaM mAdRRishaH krodhamutsRRijellokanAshanam
shlokas.4:
kruddhaH pApaM naraH kuryAtkruddho hanyAdgurUnapi |
kruddhaH paruShayA vAchA shreyaso.apyavamanyate
shlokas.5:
vAchyAvAchye hi kupito na prajAnAti karhichit |
nAkAryamasti kruddhasya nAvAchyaM vidyate tathA
shlokas.6:
hi.nsyAtkrodhAdavadhyA.nshcha vadhyAnsampUjayedapi |
AtmAnamapi cha kruddhaH preShayedyamasAdanam
shlokas.7:
etAndoShAnprapashyadbhirjitaH krodho manIShibhiH |
ichChadbhiH paramaM shreya iha chAmutra chottamam
shlokas.8:
taM krodhaM varjitaM dhIraiH kathamasmadvidhashcharet |
etaddraupadi sandhAya na me manyuH pravardhate
shlokas.9:
AtmAnaM cha paraM chaiva trAyate mahato bhayAt |
krudhyantamapratikrudhyandvayoreSha chikitsakaH
shlokas.10:
mUDho yadi klishyamAnaH krudhyate.ashaktimAnnaraH |
balIyasAM manuShyANAM tyajatyAtmAnamantataH
shlokas.11:
tasyAtmAnaM santyajato lokA nashyantyanAtmanaH |
tasmAddraupadyashaktasya manyorniyamanaM smRRitam
shlokas.12:
vidvA.nstathaiva yaH shaktaH klishyamAno na kupyati |
sa nAshayitvA kleShTAraM paraloke cha nandati
shlokas.13:
tasmAdbalavatA chaiva durbalena cha nityadA |
kShantavyaM puruSheNAhurApatsvapi vijAnatA
shlokas.14:
manyorhi vijayaM kRRiShNe prasha.nsantIha sAdhavaH |
kShamAvato jayo nityaM sAdhoriha satAM matam
shlokas.15:
satyaM chAnRRitataH shreyo nRRisha.nsAchchAnRRisha.nsatA |
tamevaM bahudoShaM tu krodhaM sAdhuvivarjitam
mAdRRishaH prasRRijetkasmAtsuyodhanavadhAdapi
shlokas.16:
tejasvIti yamAhurvai paNDitA dIrghadarshinaH |
na krodho.abhyantarastasya bhavatIti vinishchitam
shlokas.17:
yastu krodhaM samutpannaM praj~nayA pratibAdhate |
tejasvinaM taM vidvA.nso manyante tattvadarshinaH
shlokas.18:
kruddho hi kAryaM sushroNi na yathAvatprapashyati |
na kAryaM na cha maryAdAM naraH kruddho.anupashyati
shlokas.19:
hantyavadhyAnapi kruddho gurUnrUkShaistudatyapi |
tasmAttejasi kartavye krodho dUrAtpratiShThitaH
shlokas.20:
dAkShyaM hyamarShaH shauryaM cha shIghratvamiti tejasaH |
guNAH krodhAbhibhUtena na shakyAH prAptuma~njasA
shlokas.21:
krodhaM tyaktvA tu puruShaH samyaktejo.abhipadyate |
kAlayuktaM mahAprAj~ne kruddhaistejaH suduHsaham
shlokas.22:
krodhastvapaNDitaiH shashvatteja ityabhidhIyate |
rajastallokanAshAya vihitaM mAnuShAnprati
shlokas.23:
tasmAchChashvattyajetkrodhaM puruShaH samyagAcharan |
shreyAnsvadharmAnapago na kruddha iti nishchitam
shlokas.24:
yadi sarvamabuddhInAmatikrAntamamedhasAm |
atikramo madvidhasya kathaM svitsyAdanindite
shlokas.25:
yadi na syurmanuShyeShu kShamiNaH pRRithivIsamAH |
na syAtsandhirmanuShyANAM krodhamUlo hi vigrahaH
shlokas.26:
abhiShakto hyabhiShajedAhanyAdguruNA hataH |
evaM vinAsho bhUtAnAmadharmaH prathito bhavet
shlokas.27:
AkruShTaH puruShaH sarvaH pratyAkroshedanantaram |
pratihanyAddhatashchaiva tathA hi.nsyAchcha hi.nsitaH
shlokas.28:
hanyurhi pitaraH putrAnputrAshchApi tathA pitR^In |
hanyushcha patayo bhAryAH patInbhAryAstathaiva cha
shlokas.29:
evaM sa~Nkupite loke janma kRRiShNe na vidyate |
prajAnAM sandhimUlaM hi janma viddhi shubhAnane
shlokas.30:
tAH kShIyeranprajAH sarvAH kShipraM draupadi tAdRRishe |
tasmAnmanyurvinAshAya prajAnAmabhavAya cha
shlokas.31:
yasmAttu loke dRRishyante kShamiNaH pRRithivIsamAH |
tasmAjjanma cha bhUtAnAM bhavashcha pratipadyate
shlokas.32:
kShantavyaM puruSheNeha sarvAsvApatsu shobhane |
kShamA bhavo hi bhUtAnAM janma chaiva prakIrtitam
shlokas.33:
AkruShTastADitaH kruddhaH kShamate yo balIyasA |
yashcha nityaM jitakrodho vidvAnuttamapUruShaH
shlokas.34:
prabhAvavAnapi narastasya lokAH sanAtanAH |
krodhanastvalpavij~nAnaH pretya cheha cha nashyati
shlokas.35:
atrApyudAharantImA gAthA nityaM kShamAvatAm |
gItAH kShamAvatA kRRiShNe kAshyapena mahAtmanA
shlokas.36:
kShamA dharmaH kShamA yaj~naH kShamA vedAH kShamA shrutam |
yastAmevaM vijAnAti sa sarvaM kShantumarhati
shlokas.37:
kShamA brahma kShamA satyaM kShamA bhUtaM cha bhAvi cha |
kShamA tapaH kShamA shauchaM kShamayA choddhRRitaM jagat
shlokas.38:
ati brahmavidAM lokAnati chApi tapasvinAm |
ati yaj~navidAM chaiva kShamiNaH prApnuvanti tAn
shlokas.39:
kShamA tejasvinAM tejaH kShamA brahma tapasvinAm |
kShamA satyaM satyavatAM kShamA dAnaM kShamA yashaH
shlokas.40:
tAM kShamAmIdRRishIM kRRiShNe kathamasmadvidhastyajet |
yasyAM brahma cha satyaM cha yaj~nA lokAshcha viShThitAH
bhujyante yajvanAM lokAH kShamiNAmapare tathA
shlokas.41:
kShantavyameva satataM puruSheNa vijAnatA |
yadA hi kShamate sarvaM brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.42:
kShamAvatAmayaM lokaH parashchaiva kShamAvatAm |
iha saMmAnamRRichChanti paratra cha shubhAM gatim
shlokas.43:
yeShAM manyurmanuShyANAM kShamayA nihataH sadA |
teShAM paratare lokAstasmAtkShAntiH parA matA
shlokas.44:
iti gItAH kAshyapena gAthA nityaM kShamAvatAm |
shrutvA gAthAH kShamAyAstvaM tuShya draupadi mA krudhaH
shlokas.45:
pitAmahaH shAntanavaH shamaM sampUjayiShyati |
AchAryo viduraH kShattA shamameva vadiShyataH
kRRipashcha sa~njayashchaiva shamameva vadiShyataH
shlokas.46:
somadatto yuyutsushcha droNaputrastathaiva cha |
pitAmahashcha no vyAsaH shamaM vadati nityashaH
shlokas.47:
etairhi rAjA niyataM chodyamAnaH shamaM prati |
rAjyaM dAteti me buddhirna chellobhAnnashiShyati
shlokas.48:
kAlo.ayaM dAruNaH prApto bharatAnAmabhUtaye |
nishchitaM me sadaivaitatpurastAdapi bhAmini
shlokas.49:
suyodhano nArhatIti kShamAmevaM na vindati |
arhastasyAhamityeva tasmAnmAM vindate kShamA
shlokas.50:
etadAtmavatAM vRRittameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
kShamA chaivAnRRisha.nsyaM cha tatkartAsmyahama~njasA

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
namo dhAtre vidhAtre cha yau mohaM chakratustava |
pitRRipaitAmahe vRRitte voDhavye te.anyathA matiH
shlokas.2:
neha dharmAnRRisha.nsyAbhyAM na kShAntyA nArjavena cha |
puruShaH shriyamApnoti na ghRRiNitvena karhichit
shlokas.3:
tvAM chedvyasanamabhyAgAdidaM bhArata duHsaham |
yattvaM nArhasi nApIme bhrAtaraste mahaujasaH
shlokas.4:
na hi te.adhyagamajjAtu tadAnIM nAdya bhArata |
dharmAtpriyataraM ki~nchidapi chejjIvitAdiha
shlokas.5:
dharmArthameva te rAjyaM dharmArthaM jIvitaM cha te |
brAhmaNA guravashchaiva jAnantyapi cha devatAH
shlokas.6:
bhImasenArjunau chaiva mAdreyau cha mayA saha |
tyajestvamiti me buddhirna tu dharmaM parityajeH
shlokas.7:
rAjAnaM dharmagoptAraM dharmo rakShati rakShitaH |
iti me shrutamAryANAM tvAM tu manye na rakShati
shlokas.8:
ananyA hi naravyAghra nityadA dharmameva te |
buddhiH satatamanveti ChAyeva puruShaM nijA
shlokas.9:
nAvama.nsthA hi sadRRishAnnAvarA~nshreyasaH kutaH |
avApya pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM na te shRRi~Ngamavardhata
shlokas.10:
svAhAkAraiH svadhAbhishcha pUjAbhirapi cha dvijAn |
daivatAni pitR^I.nshchaiva satataM pArtha sevase
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNAH sarvakAmaiste satataM pArtha tarpitAH |
yatayo mokShiNashchaiva gRRihasthAshchaiva bhArata
shlokas.12:
AraNyakebhyo lauhAni bhAjanAni prayachChasi |
nAdeyaM brAhmaNebhyaste gRRihe ki~nchana vidyate
shlokas.13:
yadidaM vaishvadevAnte sAyamprAtaH pradIyate |
taddattvAtithibhRRityebhyo rAja~nsheSheNa jIvasi
shlokas.14:
iShTayaH pashubandhAshcha kAmyanaimittikAshcha ye |
vartante pAkayaj~nAshcha yaj~nakarma cha nityadA
shlokas.15:
asminnapi mahAraNye vijane dasyusevite |
rAShTrAdapetya vasato dhArmaste nAvasIdati
shlokas.16:
ashvamedho rAjasUyaH puNDarIko.atha gosavaH |
etairapi mahAyaj~nairiShTaM te bhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.17:
rAjanparItayA buddhyA viShame.akShaparAjaye |
rAjyaM vasUnyAyudhAni bhrAtR^InmAM chAsi nirjitaH
shlokas.18:
RRijormRRidorvadAnyasya hrImataH satyavAdinaH |
kathamakShavyasanajA buddhirApatitA tava
shlokas.19:
atIva mohamAyAti manashcha paridUyate |
nishAmya te duHkhamidamimAM chApadamIdRRishIm
shlokas.20:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
Ishvarasya vashe lokastiShThate nAtmano yathA
shlokas.21:
dhAtaiva khalu bhUtAnAM sukhaduHkhe priyApriye |
dadhAti sarvamIshAnaH purastAchChukramuchcharan
shlokas.22:
yathA dArumayI yoShA naravIra samAhitA |
Irayatya~Ngama~NgAni tathA rAjannimAH prajAH
shlokas.23:
AkAsha iva bhUtAni vyApya sarvANi bhArata |
Ishvaro vidadhAtIha kalyANaM yachcha pApakam
shlokas.24:
shakunistantubaddho vA niyato.ayamanIshvaraH |
Ishvarasya vashe tiShThannAnyeShAM nAtmanaH prabhuH
shlokas.25:
maNiH sUtra iva proto nasyota iva govRRiShaH |
dhAturAdeshamanveti tanmayo hi tadarpaNaH
shlokas.26:
nAtmAdhIno manuShyo.ayaM kAlaM bhavati ka~nchana |
srotaso madhyamApannaH kUlAdvRRikSha iva chyutaH
shlokas.27:
aj~no janturanIsho.ayamAtmanaH sukhaduHkhayoH |
Ishvaraprerito gachChetsvargaM narakameva cha
shlokas.28:
yathA vAyostRRiNAgrANi vashaM yAnti balIyasaH |
dhAturevaM vashaM yAnti sarvabhUtAni bhArata
shlokas.29:
AryakarmaNi yu~njAnaH pApe vA punarIshvaraH |
vyApya bhUtAni charate na chAyamiti lakShyate
shlokas.30:
hetumAtramidaM dhAtuH sharIraM kShetrasa~nj~nitam |
yena kArayate karma shubhAshubhaphalaM vibhuH
shlokas.31:
pashya mAyAprabhAvo.ayamIshvareNa yathA kRRitaH |
yo hanti bhUtairbhUtAni mohayitvAtmamAyayA
shlokas.32:
anyathA paridRRiShTAni munibhirvedadarshibhiH |
anyathA parivartante vegA iva nabhasvataH
shlokas.33:
anyathaiva hi manyante puruShAstAni tAni cha |
anyathaiva prabhustAni karoti vikaroti cha
shlokas.34:
yathA kAShThena vA kAShThamashmAnaM chAshmanA punaH |
ayasA chApyayashChindyAnnirvicheShTamachetanam
shlokas.35:
evaM sa bhagavAndevaH svayambhUH prapitAmahaH |
hinasti bhUtairbhUtAni Chadma kRRitvA yudhiShThira
shlokas.36:
samprayojya viyojyAyaM kAmakArakaraH prabhuH |
krIDate bhagavanbhUtairbAlaH krIDanakairiva
shlokas.37:
na mAtRRipitRRivadrAjandhAtA bhUteShu vartate |
roShAdiva pravRRitto.ayaM yathAyamitaro janaH
shlokas.38:
AryA~nshIlavato dRRiShTvA hrImato vRRittikarshitAn |
anAryAnsukhinashchaiva vihvalAmIva chintayA
shlokas.39:
tavemAmApadaM dRRiShTvA samRRiddhiM cha suyodhane |
dhAtAraM garhaye pArtha viShamaM yo.anupashyati
shlokas.40:
AryashAstrAtige krUre lubdhe dharmApachAyini |
dhArtarAShTre shriyaM dattvA dhAtA kiM phalamashnute
shlokas.41:
karma chetkRRitamanveti kartAraM nAnyamRRichChati |
karmaNA tena pApena lipyate nUnamIshvaraH
shlokas.42:
atha karma kRRitaM pApaM na chetkartAramRRichChati |
kAraNaM balameveha janA~nshochAmi durbalAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
valgu chitrapadaM shlakShNaM yAj~naseni tvayA vachaH |
uktaM tachChrutamasmAbhirnAstikyaM tu prabhAShase
shlokas.2:
nAhaM dharmaphalAnveShI rAjaputri charAmyuta |
dadAmi deyamityeva yaje yaShTavyamityuta
shlokas.3:
astu vAtra phalaM mA vA kartavyaM puruSheNa yat |
gRRihAnAvasatA kRRiShNe yathAshakti karomi tat
shlokas.4:
dharmaM charAmi sushroNi na dharmaphalakAraNAt |
AgamAnanatikramya satAM vRRittamavekShya cha
dharma eva manaH kRRiShNe svabhAvAchchaiva me dhRRitam
shlokas.5:
na dharmaphalamApnoti yo dharmaM dogdhumichChati |
yashchainaM sha~Nkate kRRitvA nAstikyAtpApachetanaH
shlokas.6:
ativAdAnmadAchchaiva mA dharmamatisha~NkithAH |
dharmAtisha~NkI puruShastiryaggatiparAyaNaH
shlokas.7:
dharmo yasyAtisha~NkyaH syAdArShaM vA durbalAtmanaH |
vedAchChUdra ivApeyAtsa lokAdajarAmarAt
shlokas.8:
vedAdhyAyI dharmaparaH kule jAto yashasvini |
sthavireShu sa yoktavyo rAjabhirdharmachAribhiH
shlokas.9:
pApIyAnhi sa shUdrebhyastaskarebhyo visheShataH |
shAstrAtigo mandabuddhiryo dharmamatisha~Nkate
shlokas.10:
pratyakShaM hi tvayA dRRiShTa RRiShirgachChanmahAtapAH |
mArkaNDeyo.aprameyAtmA dharmeNa chirajIvitAm
shlokas.11:
vyAso vasiShTho maitreyo nArado lomashaH shukaH |
anye cha RRiShayaH siddhA dharmeNaiva suchetasaH
shlokas.12:
pratyakShaM pashyasi hyetAndivyayogasamanvitAn |
shApAnugrahaNe shaktAndevairapi garIyasaH
shlokas.13:
ete hi dharmamevAdau varNayanti sadA mama |
kartavyamamaraprakhyAH pratyakShAgamabuddhayaH
shlokas.14:
ato nArhasi kalyANi dhAtAraM dharmameva cha |
rajomUDhena manasA kSheptuM sha~Nkitumeva cha
shlokas.15:
dharmAtisha~NkI nAnyasminpramANamadhigachChati |
AtmapramANa unnaddhaH shreyaso hyavamanyakaH
shlokas.16:
indriyaprItisambaddhaM yadidaM lokasAkShikam |
etAvAnmanyate bAlo mohamanyatra gachChati
shlokas.17:
prAyashchittaM na tasyAsti yo dharmamatisha~Nkate |
dhyAyansa kRRipaNaH pApo na lokAnpratipadyate
shlokas.18:
pramANAnyativRRitto hi vedashAstrArthanindakaH |
kAmalobhAnugo mUDho narakaM pratipadyate
shlokas.19:
yastu nityaM kRRitamatirdharmamevAbhipadyate |
asha~NkamAnaH kalyANi so.amutrAnantyamashnute
shlokas.20:
ArShaM pramANamutkramya dharmAnaparipAlayan |
sarvashAstrAtigo mUDhaH shaM janmasu na vindati
shlokas.21:
shiShTairAcharitaM dharmaM kRRiShNe mA smAtisha~NkithAH |
purANamRRiShibhiH proktaM sarvaj~naiH sarvadarshibhiH
shlokas.22:
dharma eva plavo nAnyaH svargaM draupadi gachChatAm |
saiva nauH sAgarasyeva vaNijaH pAramRRichChataH
shlokas.23:
aphAlo yadi dharmaH syAchcharito dharmachAribhiH |
apratiShThe tamasyetajjaganmajjedanindite
shlokas.24:
nirvANaM nAdhigachCheyurjIveyuH pashujIvikAm |
vighAtenaiva yujyeyurna chArthaM ki~nchidApnuyuH
shlokas.25:
tapashcha brahmacharyaM cha yaj~naH svAdhyAya eva cha |
dAnamArjavametAni yadi syuraphalAni vai
shlokas.26:
nAchariShyanpare dharmaM pare paratare cha ye |
vipralambho.ayamatyantaM yadi syuraphalAH kriyAH
shlokas.27:
RRiShayashchaiva devAshcha gandharvAsurarAkShasAH |
IshvarAH kasya hetoste chareyurdharmamAdRRitAH
shlokas.28:
phaladaM tviha vij~nAya dhAtAraM shreyasi dhruve |
dharmaM te hyAcharankRRiShNe taddhi dharmasanAtanam
shlokas.29:
sa chAyaM saphalo dharmo na dharmo.aphala uchyate |
dRRishyante.api hi vidyAnAM phalAni tapasAM tathA
shlokas.30:
tvayyetadvai vijAnIhi janma kRRiShNe yathA shrutam |
vettha chApi yathA jAto dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn
shlokas.31:
etAvadeva paryAptamupamAnaM shuchismite |
karmaNAM phalamastIti dhIro.alpenApi tuShyati
shlokas.32:
bahunApi hyavidvA.nso naiva tuShyantyabuddhayaH |
teShAM na dharmajaM ki~nchitpretya sharmAsti karma vA
shlokas.33:
karmaNAmuta puNyAnAM pApAnAM cha phalodayaH |
prabhavashchApyayashchaiva devaguhyAni bhAmini
shlokas.34:
naitAni veda yaH kashchinmuhyantyatra prajA imAH |
rakShyANyetAni devAnAM gUDhamAyA hi devatAH
shlokas.35:
kRRishA~NgAH suvratAshchaiva tapasA dagdhakilbiShAH |
prasannairmAnasairyuktAH pashyantyetAni vai dvijAH
shlokas.36:
na phalAdarshanAddharmaH sha~Nkitavyo na devatAH |
yaShTavyaM chApramattena dAtavyaM chAnasUyatA
shlokas.37:
karmaNAM phalamastIti tathaitaddharma shAshvatam |
brahmA provAcha putrANAM yadRRiShirveda kashyapaH
shlokas.38:
tasmAtte sa.nshayaH kRRiShNe nIhAra iva nashyatu |
vyavasya sarvamastIti nAstikyaM bhAvamutsRRija
shlokas.39:
IshvaraM chApi bhUtAnAM dhAtAraM mA vichikShipaH |
shikShasvainaM namasvainaM mA te bhUdbuddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.40:
yasya prasAdAttadbhakto martyo gachChatyamartyatAm |
uttamaM daivataM kRRiShNe mAtivochaH katha~nchana

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
nAvamanye na garhe cha dharmaM pArtha katha~nchana |
IshvaraM kuta evAhamavama.nsye prajApatim
shlokas.2:
ArtAhaM pralapAmIdamiti mAM viddhi bhArata |
bhUyashcha vilapiShyAmi sumanAstannibodha me
shlokas.3:
karma khalviha kartavyaM jAtenAmitrakarshana |
akarmANo hi jIvanti sthAvarA netare janAH
shlokas.4:
A mAtRRistanapAnAchcha yAvachChayyopasarpaNam |
ja~NgamAH karmaNA vRRittimApnuvanti yudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
ja~NgameShu visheSheNa manuShyA bharatarShabha |
ichChanti karmaNA vRRittimavAptuM pretya cheha cha
shlokas.6:
utthAnamabhijAnanti sarvabhUtAni bhArata |
pratyakShaM phalamashnanti karmaNAM lokasAkShikam
shlokas.7:
pashyAmi svaM samutthAnamupajIvanti jantavaH |
api dhAtA vidhAtA cha yathAyamudake bakaH
shlokas.8:
svakarma kuru mA glAsIH karmaNA bhava da.nshitaH |
kRRityaM hi yo.abhijAnAti sahasre nAsti so.asti vA
shlokas.9:
tasya chApi bhavetkAryaM vivRRiddhau rakShaNe tathA |
bhakShyamANo hyanAvApaH kShIyate himavAnapi
shlokas.10:
utsIderanprajAH sarvA na kuryuH karma chedyadi |
api chApyaphalaM karma pashyAmaH kurvato janAn
nAnyathA hyabhijAnanti vRRittiM loke katha~nchana
shlokas.11:
yashcha diShTaparo loke yashchAyaM haThavAdakaH |
ubhAvapasadAvetau karmabuddhiH prashasyate
shlokas.12:
yo hi diShTamupAsIno nirvicheShTaH sukhaM svapet |
avasIdetsudurbuddhirAmo ghaTa ivAmbhasi
shlokas.13:
tathaiva haThabuddhiryaH shaktaH karmaNyakarmakRRit |
AsIta na chiraM jIvedanAtha iva durbalaH
shlokas.14:
akasmAdapi yaH kashchidarthaM prApnoti pUruShaH |
taM haTheneti manyante sa hi yatno na kasyachit
shlokas.15:
yachchApi ki~nchitpuruSho diShTaM nAma labhatyuta |
daivena vidhinA pArtha taddaivamiti nishchitam
shlokas.16:
yatsvayaM karmaNA ki~nchitphalamApnoti pUruShaH |
pratyakShaM chakShuShA dRRiShTaM tatpauruShamiti smRRitam
shlokas.17:
svabhAvataH pravRRitto.anyaH prApnotyarthAnakAraNAt |
tatsvabhAvAtmakaM viddhi phalaM puruShasattama
shlokas.18:
evaM haThAchcha daivAchcha svabhAvAtkarmaNastathA |
yAni prApnoti puruShastatphalaM pUrvakarmaNaH
shlokas.19:
dhAtApi hi svakarmaiva taistairhetubhirIshvaraH |
vidadhAti vibhajyeha phalaM pUrvakRRitaM nRRiNAm
shlokas.20:
yaddhyayaM puruShaH ki~nchitkurute vai shubhAshubham |
taddhAtRRivihitaM viddhi pUrvakarmaphalodayam
shlokas.21:
kAraNaM tasya deho.ayaM dhAtuH karmaNi karmaNi |
sa yathA prerayatyenaM tathAyaM kurute.avashaH
shlokas.22:
teShu teShu hi kRRityeShu viniyoktA maheshvaraH |
sarvabhUtAni kaunteya kArayatyavashAnyapi
shlokas.23:
manasArthAnvinishchitya pashchAtprApnoti karmaNA |
buddhipUrvaM svayaM dhIraH puruShastatra kAraNam
shlokas.24:
sa~NkhyAtuM naiva shakyAni karmANi puruSharShabha |
agAranagarANAM hi siddhiH puruShahaitukI
shlokas.25:
tile tailaM gavi kShIraM kAShThe pAvakamantataH |
dhiyA dhIro vijAnIyAdupAyaM chAsya siddhaye
shlokas.26:
tataH pravartate pashchAtkaraNeShvasya siddhaye |
tAM siddhimupajIvanti karmaNAmiha jantavaH
shlokas.27:
kushalena kRRitaM karma kartrA sAdhu vinishchitam |
idaM tvakushaleneti visheShAdupalabhyate
shlokas.28:
iShTApUrtaphalaM na syAnna shiShyo na gururbhavet |
puruShaH karmasAdhyeShu syAchchedayamakAraNam
shlokas.29:
kartRRitvAdeva puruShaH karmasiddhau prashasyate |
asiddhau nindyate chApi karmanAshaH kathaM tviha
shlokas.30:
sarvameva haThenaike diShTenaike vadantyuta |
puruShaprayatnajaM kechittraidhametanniruchyate
shlokas.31:
na chaivaitAvatA kAryaM manyanta iti chApare |
asti sarvamadRRishyaM tu diShTaM chaiva tathA haThaH
dRRishyate hi haThAchchaiva diShTAchchArthasya santatiH
shlokas.32:
ki~nchiddaivAddhaThAtki~nchitki~nchideva svakarmataH |
puruShaH phalamApnoti chaturthaM nAtra kAraNam
kushalAH pratijAnanti ye tattvaviduSho janAH
shlokas.33:
tathaiva dhAtA bhUtAnAmiShTAniShTaphalapradaH |
yadi na syAnna bhUtAnAM kRRipaNo nAma kashchana
shlokas.34:
yaM yamarthamabhiprepsuH kurute karma pUruShaH |
tattatsaphalameva syAdyadi na syAtpurAkRRitam
shlokas.35:
tridvArAmarthasiddhiM tu nAnupashyanti ye narAH |
tathaivAnarthasiddhiM cha yathA lokAstathaiva te
shlokas.36:
kartavyaM tveva karmeti manoreSha vinishchayaH |
ekAntena hyanIho.ayaM parAbhavati pUruShaH
shlokas.37:
kurvato hi bhavatyeva prAyeNeha yudhiShThira |
ekAntaphalasiddhiM tu na vindatyalasaH kvachit
shlokas.38:
asambhave tvasya hetuH prAyashchittaM tu lakShyate |
kRRite karmaNi rAjendra tathAnRRiNyamavApyate
shlokas.39:
alakShmIrAvishatyenaM shayAnamalasaM naram |
niHsa.nshayaM phalaM labdhvA dakSho bhUtimupAshnute
shlokas.40:
anarthaM sa.nshayAvasthaM vRRiNvate muktasa.nshayAH |
dhIrA narAH karmaratA na tu niHsa.nshayaM kvachit
shlokas.41:
ekAntena hyanartho.ayaM vartate.asmAsu sAmpratam |
na tu niHsa.nshayaM na syAttvayi karmaNyavasthite
shlokas.42:
atha vA siddhireva syAnmahimA tu tathaiva te |
vRRikodarasya bIbhatsorbhrAtroshcha yamayorapi
shlokas.43:
anyeShAM karma saphalamasmAkamapi vA punaH |
viprakarSheNa budhyeta kRRitakarmA yathA phalam
shlokas.44:
pRRithivIM lA~Ngalenaiva bhittvA bIjaM vapatyuta |
Aste.atha karShakastUShNIM parjanyastatra kAraNam
shlokas.45:
vRRiShTishchennAnugRRihNIyAdanenAstatra karShakaH |
yadanyaH puruShaH kuryAtkRRitaM tatsakalaM mayA
shlokas.46:
tachchedaphalamasmAkaM nAparAdho.asti naH kvachit |
iti dhIro.anvavekShyaiva nAtmAnaM tatra garhayet
shlokas.47:
kurvato nArthasiddhirme bhavatIti ha bhArata |
nirvedo nAtra gantavyo dvAvetau hyasya karmaNaH
siddhirvApyatha vAsiddhirapravRRittirato.anyathA
shlokas.48:
bahUnAM samavAye hi bhAvAnAM karma sidhyati |
guNAbhAve phalaM nyUnaM bhavatyaphalameva vA
anArambhe tu na phalaM na guNo dRRishyate.achyuta
shlokas.49:
deshakAlAvupAyA.nshcha ma~NgalaM svasti vRRiddhaye |
yunakti medhayA dhIro yathAshakti yathAbalam
shlokas.50:
apramattena tatkAryamupadeShTA parAkramaH |
bhUyiShThaM karmayogeShu sarva eva parAkramaH
shlokas.51:
yaM tu dhIro.anvavekSheta shreyA.nsaM bahubhirguNaiH |
sAmnaivArthaM tato lipsetkarma chAsmai prayojayet
shlokas.52:
vyasanaM vAsya kA~NkSheta vinAshaM vA yudhiShThira |
api sindhorgirervApi kiM punarmartyadharmiNaH
shlokas.53:
utthAnayuktaH satataM pareShAmantaraiShaNe |
AnRRiNyamApnoti naraH parasyAtmana eva cha
shlokas.54:
na chaivAtmAvamantavyaH puruSheNa kadAchana |
na hyAtmaparibhUtasya bhUtirbhavati bhArata
shlokas.55:
evaM sa.nsthitikA siddhiriyaM lokasya bhArata |
chitrA siddhigatiH proktA kAlAvasthAvibhAgataH
shlokas.56:
brAhmaNaM me pitA pUrvaM vAsayAmAsa paNDitam |
so.asmA arthamimaM prAha pitre me bharatarShabha
shlokas.57:
nItiM bRRihaspatiproktAM bhrAtR^Inme.agrAhayatpurA |
teShAM sA~NkathyamashrauShamahametattadA gRRihe
shlokas.58:
sa mAM rAjankarmavatImAgatAmAha sAntvayan |
shushrUShamANAmAsInAM pitura~Nke yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yAj~nasenyA vachaH shrutvA bhImaseno.atyamarShaNaH |
niHshvasannupasa~Ngamya kruddho rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.2:
rAjyasya padavIM dharmyAM vraja satpuruShochitAm |
dharmakAmArthahInAnAM kiM no vastuM tapovane
shlokas.3:
naiva dharmeNa tadrAjyaM nArjavena na chaujasA |
akShakUTamadhiShThAya hRRitaM duryodhanena naH
shlokas.4:
gomAyuneva siMhAnAM durbalena balIyasAm |
AmiShaM vighasAshena tadvadrAjyaM hi no hRRitam
shlokas.5:
dharmaleshapratichChannaH prabhavaM dharmakAmayoH |
arthamutsRRijya kiM rAjandurgeShu paritapyase
shlokas.6:
bhavato.anuvidhAnena rAjyaM naH pashyatAM hRRitam |
ahAryamapi shakreNa guptaM gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.7:
kuNInAmiva bilvAni pa~NgUnAmiva dhenavaH |
hRRitamaishvaryamasmAkaM jIvatAM bhavataH kRRite
shlokas.8:
bhavataH priyamityevaM mahadvyasanamIdRRisham |
dharmakAme pratItasya pratipannAH sma bhArata
shlokas.9:
karshayAmaH svamitrANi nandayAmashcha shAtravAn |
AtmAnaM bhavataH shAstre niyamya bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
yadvayaM na tadaivaitAndhArtarAShTrAnnihanmahi |
bhavataH shAstramAdAya tannastapati duShkRRitam
shlokas.11:
athainAmanvavekShasva mRRigacharyAmivAtmanaH |
avIrAcharitAM rAjanna balasthairniShevitAm
shlokas.12:
yAM na kRRiShNo na bIbhatsurnAbhimanyurna sRRi~njayaH |
na chAhamabhinandAmi na cha mAdrIsutAvubhau
shlokas.13:
bhavAndharmo dharma iti satataM vratakarshitaH |
kachchidrAjanna nirvedAdApannaH klIbajIvikAm
shlokas.14:
durmanuShyA hi nirvedamaphalaM sarvaghAtinam |
ashaktAH shriyamAhartumAtmanaH kurvate priyam
shlokas.15:
sa bhavAndRRiShTimA~nshaktaH pashyannAtmani pauruSham |
AnRRisha.nsyaparo rAjannAnarthamavabudhyase
shlokas.16:
asmAnamI dhArtarAShTrAH kShamamANAnalaM sataH |
ashaktAneva manyante tadduHkhaM nAhave vadhaH
shlokas.17:
tatra chedyudhyamAnAnAmajihmamanivartinAm |
sarvasho hi vadhaH shreyAnpretya lokA.Nllabhemahi
shlokas.18:
atha vA vayamevaitAnnihatya bharatarShabha |
AdadImahi gAM sarvAM tathApi shreya eva naH
shlokas.19:
sarvathA kAryametannaH svadharmamanutiShThatAm |
kA~NkShatAM vipulAM kIrtiM vairaM pratichikIrShatAm
shlokas.20:
AtmArthaM yudhyamAnAnAM vidite kRRityalakShaNe |
anyairapahRRite rAjye prasha.nsaiva na garhaNA
shlokas.21:
karshanArtho hi yo dharmo mitrANAmAtmanastathA |
vyasanaM nAma tadrAjanna sa dharmaH kudharma tat
shlokas.22:
sarvathA dharmanityaM tu puruShaM dharmadurbalam |
jahatastAta dharmArthau pretaM duHkhasukhe yathA
shlokas.23:
yasya dharmo hi dharmArthaM kleshabhA~Nna sa paNDitaH |
na sa dharmasya vedArthaM sUryasyAndhaH prabhAmiva
shlokas.24:
yasya chArthArthamevArthaH sa cha nArthasya kovidaH |
rakShate bhRRitako.araNyaM yathA syAttAdRRigeva saH
shlokas.25:
ativelaM hi yo.arthArthI netarAvanutiShThati |
sa vadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM brahmaheva jugupsitaH
shlokas.26:
satataM yashcha kAmArthI netarAvanutiShThati |
mitrANi tasya nashyanti dharmArthAbhyAM cha hIyate
shlokas.27:
tasya dharmArthahInasya kAmAnte nidhanaM dhruvam |
kAmato ramamANasya mInasyevAmbhasaH kShaye
shlokas.28:
tasmAddharmArthayornityaM na pramAdyanti paNDitAH |
prakRRitiH sA hi kAmasya pAvakasyAraNiryathA
shlokas.29:
sarvathA dharmamUlo.artho dharmashchArthaparigrahaH |
itaretarayonI tau viddhi meghodadhI yathA
shlokas.30:
dravyArthasparshasa.nyoge yA prItirupajAyate |
sa kAmashchittasa~NkalpaH sharIraM nAsya vidyate
shlokas.31:
arthArthI puruSho rAjanbRRihantaM dharmamRRichChati |
arthamRRichChati kAmArthI na kAmAdanyamRRichChatI
shlokas.32:
na hi kAmena kAmo.anyaH sAdhyate phalameva tat |
upayogAtphalasyeva kAShThAdbhasmeva paNDitaH
shlokas.33:
imA~nshakunikAnrAjanhanti vaita.nsiko yathA |
etadrUpamadharmasya bhUteShu cha vihi.nsatAm
shlokas.34:
kAmAllobhAchcha dharmasya pravRRittiM yo na pashyati |
sa vadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM pretya cheha cha durmatiH
shlokas.35:
vyaktaM te vidito rAjannartho dravyaparigrahaH |
prakRRitiM chApi vetthAsya vikRRitiM chApi bhUyasIm
shlokas.36:
tasya nAshaM vinAshaM vA jarayA maraNena vA |
anarthamiti manyante so.ayamasmAsu vartate
shlokas.37:
indriyANAM cha pa~nchAnAM manaso hRRidayasya cha |
viShaye vartamAnAnAM yA prItirupajAyate
sa kAma iti me buddhiH karmaNAM phalamuttamam
shlokas.38:
evameva pRRithagdRRiShTvA dharmArthau kAmameva cha |
na dharmapara eva syAnna chArthaparamo naraH
na kAmaparamo vA syAtsarvAnseveta sarvadA
shlokas.39:
dharmaM pUrvaM dhanaM madhye jaghanye kAmamAcharet |
ahanyanucharedevameSha shAstrakRRito vidhiH
shlokas.40:
kAmaM pUrvaM dhanaM madhye jaghanye dharmamAcharet |
vayasyanucharedevameSha shAstrakRRito vidhiH
shlokas.41:
dharmaM chArthaM cha kAmaM cha yathAvadvadatAM vara |
vibhajya kAle kAlaj~naH sarvAnseveta paNDitaH
shlokas.42:
mokSho vA paramaM shreya eSha rAjansukhArthinAm |
prAptirvA buddhimAsthAya sopAyaM kurunandana
shlokas.43:
tadvAshu kriyatAM rAjanprAptirvApyadhigamyatAm |
jIvitaM hyAturasyeva duHkhamantaravartinaH
shlokas.44:
viditashchaiva te dharmaH satataM charitashcha te |
jAnate tvayi sha.nsanti suhRRidaH karmachodanAm
shlokas.45:
dAnaM yaj~naH satAM pUjA vedadhAraNamArjavam |
eSha dharmaH paro rAjanphalavAnpretya cheha cha
shlokas.46:
eSha nArthavihInena shakyo rAjanniShevitum |
akhilAH puruShavyAghra guNAH syuryadyapItare
shlokas.47:
dharmamUlaM jagadrAjannAnyaddharmAdvishiShyate |
dharmashchArthena mahatA shakyo rAjanniShevitum
shlokas.48:
na chArtho bhaikShacharyeNa nApi klaibyena karhichit |
vettuM shakyaH sadA rAjankevalaM dharmabuddhinA
shlokas.49:
pratiShiddhA hi te yAch~nA yayA sidhyati vai dvijaH |
tejasaivArthalipsAyAM yatasva puruSharShabha
shlokas.50:
bhaikShacharyA na vihitA na cha viTshUdrajIvikA |
kShatriyasya visheSheNa dharmastu balamaurasam
shlokas.51:
udArameva vidvA.nso dharmaM prAhurmanIShiNaH |
udAraM pratipadyasva nAvare sthAtumarhasi
shlokas.52:
anubudhyasva rAjendra vettha dharmAnsanAtanAn |
krUrakarmAbhijAto.asi yasmAdudvijate janaH
shlokas.53:
prajApAlanasambhUtaM phalaM tava na garhitam |
eSha te vihito rAjandhAtrA dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.54:
tasmAdvichalitaH pArtha loke hAsyaM gamiShyasi |
svadharmAddhi manuShyANAM chalanaM na prashasyate
shlokas.55:
sa kShAtraM hRRidayaM kRRitvA tyaktvedaM shithilaM manaH |
vIryamAsthAya kaunteya dhuramudvaha dhuryavat
shlokas.56:
na hi kevaladharmAtmA pRRithivIM jAtu kashchana |
pArthivo vyajayadrAjanna bhUtiM na punaH shriyam
shlokas.57:
jihvAM dattvA bahUnAM hi kShudrANAM lubdhachetasAm |
nikRRityA labhate rAjyamAhAramiva shalyakaH
shlokas.58:
bhrAtaraH pUrvajAtAshcha susamRRiddhAshcha sarvashaH |
nikRRityA nirjitA devairasurAH pANDavarShabha
shlokas.59:
evaM balavataH sarvamiti buddhvA mahIpate |
jahi shatrUnmahAbAho parAM nikRRitimAsthitaH
shlokas.60:
na hyarjunasamaH kashchidyudhi yoddhA dhanurdharaH |
bhavitA vA pumAnkashchinmatsamo vA gadAdharaH
shlokas.61:
sattvena kurute yuddhaM rAjansubalavAnapi |
na pramANena notsAhAtsattvastho bhava pANDava
shlokas.62:
sattvaM hi mUlamarthasya vitathaM yadato.anyathA |
na tu prasaktaM bhavati vRRikShachChAyeva haimanI
shlokas.63:
arthatyAgo hi kAryaH syAdarthaM shreyA.nsamichChatA |
bIjaupamyena kaunteya mA te bhUdatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.64:
arthena tu samo.anartho yatra labhyeta nodayaH |
na tatra vipaNaH kAryaH kharakaNDUyitaM hi tat
shlokas.65:
evameva manuShyendra dharmaM tyaktvAlpakaM naraH |
bRRihantaM dharmamApnoti sa buddha iti nishchitaH
shlokas.66:
amitraM mitrasampannaM mitrairbhindanti paNDitAH |
bhinnairmitraiH parityaktaM durbalaM kurute vashe
shlokas.67:
sattvena kurute yuddhaM rAjansubalavAnapi |
nodyamena na hotrAbhiH sarvAH svIkurute prajAH
shlokas.68:
sarvathA saMhataireva durbalairbalavAnapi |
amitraH shakyate hantuM madhuhA bhramarairiva
shlokas.69:
yathA rAjanprajAH sarvAH sUryaH pAti gabhastibhiH |
atti chaiva tathaiva tvaM savituH sadRRisho bhava
shlokas.70:
etaddhyapi tapo rAjanpurANamiti naH shrutam |
vidhinA pAlanaM bhUmeryatkRRitaM naH pitAmahaiH
shlokas.71:
apeyAtkila bhAH sUryAllakShmIshchandramasastathA |
iti loko vyavasito dRRiShTvemAM bhavato vyathAm
shlokas.72:
bhavatashcha prasha.nsAbhirnindAbhiritarasya cha |
kathAyuktAH pariShadaH pRRithagrAjansamAgatAH
shlokas.73:
idamabhyadhikaM rAjanbrAhmaNA guravashcha te |
sametAH kathayantIha muditAH satyasandhatAm
shlokas.74:
yanna mohAnna kArpaNyAnna lobhAnna bhayAdapi |
anRRitaM ki~nchiduktaM te na kAmAnnArthakAraNAt
shlokas.75:
yadenaH kurute ki~nchidrAjA bhUmimavApnuvan |
sarvaM tannudate pashchAdyaj~nairvipuladakShiNaiH
shlokas.76:
brAhmaNebhyo dadadgrAmAngAshcha rAjansahasrashaH |
muchyate sarvapApebhyastamobhya iva chandramAH
shlokas.77:
paurajAnapadAH sarve prAyashaH kurunandana |
savRRiddhabAlAH sahitAH sha.nsanti tvAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.78:
shvadRRitau kShIramAsaktaM brahma vA vRRiShale yathA |
satyaM stene balaM nAryAM rAjyaM duryodhane tathA
shlokas.79:
iti nirvachanaM loke chiraM charati bhArata |
api chaitatstriyo bAlAH svAdhyAyamiva kurvate
shlokas.81:
vAchayitvA dvijashreShThAnadyaiva gajasAhvayam |
astravidbhiH parivRRito bhrAtRRibhirdRRiDhadhanvibhiH
AshIviShasamairvIrairmarudbhiriva vRRitrahA
shlokas.82:
amitrA.nstejasA mRRidnannasurebhya ivArihA |
shriyamAdatsva kaunteya dhArtarAShTrAnmahAbala
shlokas.83:
na hi gANDIvamuktAnAM sharANAM gArdhravAsasAm |
sparshamAshIviShAbhAnAM martyaH kashchana sa.nsahet
shlokas.84:
na sa vIro na mAta~Ngo na sadashvo.asti bhArata |
yaH saheta gadAvegaM mama kruddhasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.85:
sRRi~njayaiH saha kaikeyairvRRiShNInAmRRiShabheNa cha |
kathaM svidyudhi kaunteya rAjyaM na prApnuyAmahe

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM bhArata satyameta;dyanmA tudanvAkyashalyaiH kShiNoShi |
na tvA vigarhe pratikUlameta;nmamAnayAddhi vyasanaM va AgAt
shlokas.2:
ahaM hyakShAnanvapadyaM jihIrSha;nrAjyaM sarAShTraM dhRRitarAShTrasya putrAt |
tanmA shaThaH kitavaH pratyadevI;tsuyodhanArthaM subalasya putraH
shlokas.3:
mahAmAyaH shakuniH pArvatIyaH; sadA sabhAyAM pravapannakShapUgAn |
amAyinaM mAyayA pratyadevI;ttato.apashyaM vRRijinaM bhImasena
shlokas.4:
akShAnhi dRRiShTvA shakuneryathAva;tkAmAnulomAnayujo yujashcha |
shakyaM niyantumabhaviShyadAtmA; manyustu hanti puruShasya dhairyam
shlokas.5:
yantuM nAtmA shakyate pauruSheNa; mAnena vIryeNa cha tAta naddhaH |
na te vAchaM bhImasenAbhyasUye; manye tathA tadbhavitavyamAsIt
shlokas.6:
sa no rAjA dhRRitarAShTrasya putro; nyapAtayadvyasane rAjyamichChan |
dAsyaM cha no.agamayadbhImasena; yatrAbhavachCharaNaM draupadI naH
shlokas.7:
tvaM chApi tadvettha dhana~njayashcha; punardyUtAyAgatAnAM sabhAM naH |
yanmAbravIddhRRitarAShTrasya putra; ekaglahArthaM bharatAnAM samakSham
shlokas.8:
vane samA dvAdasha rAjaputra; yathAkAmaM viditamajAtashatro |
athAparaM chAviditaM charethAH; sarvaiH saha bhrAtRRibhishChadmagUDhaH
shlokas.9:
tvAM chechChrutvA tAta tathA charanta;mavabhotsyante bhAratAnAM charAH sma |
anyA.nshcharethAstAvato.abdA.nstatastvaM; nishchitya tatpratijAnIhi pArtha
shlokas.10:
charaishchenno.aviditaH kAlametaM; yukto rAjanmohayitvA madIyAn |
bravImi satyaM kurusa.nsadIha; tavaiva tA bhArata pa~ncha nadyaH
shlokas.11:
vayaM chaivaM bhrAtaraH sarva eva; tvayA jitAH kAlamapAsya bhogAn |
vasema ityAha purA sa rAjA; madhye kurUNAM sa mayoktastatheti
shlokas.12:
tatra dyUtamabhavanno jaghanyaM; tasmi~njitAH pravrajitAshcha sarve |
itthaM cha deshAnanusa~ncharAmo; vanAni kRRichChrANi cha kRRichChrarUpAH
shlokas.13:
suyodhanashchApi na shAntimichCha;nbhUyaH sa manyorvashamanvagachChat |
udyojayAmAsa kurU.nshcha sarvA;nye chAsya kechidvashamanvagachChan
shlokas.14:
taM sandhimAsthAya satAM sakAshe; ko nAma jahyAdiha rAjyahetoH |
Aryasya manye maraNAdgarIyo; yaddharmamutkramya mahIM prashiShyAt
shlokas.15:
tadaiva chedvIrakarmAkariShyo; yadA dyUte parighaM paryamRRikShaH |
bAhU didhakShanvAritaH phalgunena; kiM duShkRRitaM bhIma tadAbhaviShyat
shlokas.16:
prAgeva chaivaM samayakriyAyAH; kiM nAbravIH pauruShamAvidAnaH |
prAptaM tu kAlaM tvabhipadya pashchA;tkiM mAmidAnImativelamAttha
shlokas.17:
bhUyo.api duHkhaM mama bhImasena; dUye viShasyeva rasaM viditvA |
yadyAj~nasenIM parikRRiShyamANAM; sa.ndRRishya tatkShAntamiti sma bhIma
shlokas.18:
na tvadya shakyaM bharatapravIra; kRRitvA yaduktaM kuruvIramadhye |
kAlaM pratIkShasva sukhodayasya; paktiM phalAnAmiva bIjavApaH
shlokas.19:
yadA hi pUrvaM nikRRito nikRRityA; vairaM sapuShpaM saphalaM viditvA |
mahAguNaM harati hi pauruSheNa; tadA vIro jIvati jIvaloke
shlokas.20:
shriyaM cha loke labhate samagrAM; manye chAsmai shatravaH saMnamante |
mitrANi chainamatirAgAdbhajante; devA ivendramanujIvanti chainam
shlokas.21:
mama pratij~nAM cha nibodha satyAM; vRRiNe dharmamamRRitAjjIvitAchcha |
rAjyaM cha putrAshcha yasho dhanaM cha; sarvaM na satyasya kalAmupaiti

shlokas.1:
bhImasena uvAcha||
sandhiM kRRitvaiva kAlena antakena patatriNA |
anantenAprameyena srotasA sarvahAriNA
shlokas.2:
pratyakShaM manyase kAlaM martyaH sankAlabandhanaH |
phenadharmA mahArAja phaladharmA tathaiva cha
shlokas.3:
nimeShAdapi kaunteya yasyAyurapachIyate |
sUchyevA~njanachUrNasya kimiti pratipAlayet
shlokas.4:
yo nUnamamitAyuH syAdatha vApi pramANavit |
sa kAlaM vai pratIkSheta sarvapratyakShadarshivAn
shlokas.5:
pratIkShamANAnkAlo naH samA rAja.nstrayodasha |
AyuSho.apachayaM kRRitvA maraNAyopaneShyati
shlokas.6:
sharIriNAM hi maraNaM sharIre nityamAshritam |
prAgeva maraNAttasmAdrAjyAyaiva ghaTAmahe
shlokas.7:
yo na yAti prasa~NkhyAnamaspaShTo bhUmivardhanaH |
ayAtayitvA vairANi so.avasIdati gauriva
shlokas.8:
yo na yAtayate vairamalpasattvodyamaH pumAn |
aphalaM tasya janmAhaM manye durjAtajAyinaH
shlokas.9:
hairaNyau bhavato bAhU shrutirbhavati pArthiva |
hatvA dviShantaM sa~NgrAme bhuktvA bAhvarjitaM vasu
shlokas.10:
hatvA chetpuruSho rAjannikartAramari.ndama |
ahnAya narakaM gachChetsvargeNAsya sa saMmitaH
shlokas.11:
amarShajo hi santApaH pAvakAddIptimattaraH |
yenAhamabhisantapto na naktaM na divA shaye
shlokas.12:
ayaM cha pArtho bIbhatsurvariShTho jyAvikarShaNe |
Aste paramasantapto nUnaM siMha ivAshaye
shlokas.13:
yo.ayameko.abhimanute sarvA.Nlloke dhanurbhRRitaH |
so.ayamAtmajamUShmANaM mahAhastIva yachChati
shlokas.14:
nakulaH sahadevashcha vRRiddhA mAtA cha vIrasUH |
tavaiva priyamichChanta Asate jaDamUkavat
shlokas.15:
sarve te priyamichChanti bAndhavAH saha sRRi~njayaiH |
ahameko.abhisantapto mAtA cha prativindhyataH
shlokas.16:
priyameva tu sarveShAM yadbravImyuta ki~nchana |
sarve hI vyasanaM prAptAH sarve yuddhAbhinandinaH
shlokas.17:
netaH pApIyasI kAchidApadrAjanbhaviShyati |
yanno nIchairalpabalai rAjyamAchChidya bhujyate
shlokas.18:
shIladoShAdghRRiNAviShTa AnRRisha.nsyAtparantapa |
kleshA.nstitikShase rAjannAnyaH kashchitprasha.nsati
shlokas.19:
ghRRiNI brAhmaNarUpo.asi kathaM kShatre ajAyathAH |
asyAM hi yonau jAyante prAyashaH krUrabuddhayaH
shlokas.20:
ashrauShIstvaM rAjadharmAnyathA vai manurabravIt |
krUrAnnikRRitisa.nyuktAnvihitAnashamAtmakAn
shlokas.21:
kartavye puruShavyAghra kimAsse pIThasarpavat |
buddhyA vIryeNa sa.nyuktaH shrutenAbhijanena cha
shlokas.22:
tRRiNAnAM muShTinaikena himavantaM tu parvatam |
ChannamichChasi kaunteya yo.asmAnsa.nvartumichChasi
shlokas.23:
aj~nAtacharyA gUDhena pRRithivyAM vishrutena cha |
divIva pArtha sUryeNa na shakyA charituM tvayA
shlokas.24:
bRRihachChAla ivAnUpe shAkhApuShpapalAshavAn |
hastI shveta ivAj~nAtaH kathaM jiShNushchariShyati
shlokas.25:
imau cha siMhasa~NkAshau bhrAtarau sahitau shishU |
nakulaH sahadevashcha kathaM pArtha chariShyataH
shlokas.26:
puNyakIrtI rAjaputrI draupadI vIrasUriyam |
vishrutA kathamaj~nAtA kRRiShNA pArtha chariShyati
shlokas.27:
mAM chApi rAja~njAnanti AkumAramimAH prajAH |
aj~nAtacharyAM pashyAmi meroriva nigUhanam
shlokas.28:
tathaiva bahavo.asmAbhI rAShTrebhyo vipravAsitAH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha dhRRitarAShTramanuvratAH
shlokas.29:
na hi te.apyupashAmyanti nikRRitAnAM nirAkRRitAH |
avashyaM tairnikartavyamasmAkaM tatpriyaiShibhiH
shlokas.30:
te.apyasmAsu prayu~njIranprachChannAnsubahU~njanAn |
AchakShIra.nshcha no j~nAtvA tannaH syAtsumahadbhayam
shlokas.31:
asmAbhiruShitAH samyagvane mAsAstrayodasha |
parimANena tAnpashya tAvataH parivatsarAn
shlokas.32:
asti mAsaH pratinidhiryathA prAhurmanIShiNaH |
pUtikAniva somasya tathedaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.33:
atha vAnaDuhe rAjansAdhave sAdhuvAhine |
sauhityadAnAdekasmAdenasaH pratimuchyate
shlokas.34:
tasmAchChatruvadhe rAjankriyatAM nishchayastvayA |
kShatriyasya tu sarvasya nAnyo dharmo.asti sa.nyugAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhImasenavachaH shrutvA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
niHshvasya puruShavyAghraH sampradadhyau parantapaH
shlokas.2:
sa muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA vinishchityetikRRityatAm |
bhImasenamidaM vAkyamapadAntaramabravIt
shlokas.3:
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
idamanyatsamAdhatsva vAkyaM me vAkyakovida
shlokas.4:
mahApApAni karmANi yAni kevalasAhasAt |
Arabhyante bhImasena vyathante tAni bhArata
shlokas.5:
sumantrite suvikrAnte sukRRite suvichArite |
sidhyantyarthA mahAbAho daivaM chAtra pradakShiNam
shlokas.6:
tvaM tu kevalachApalyAdbaladarpochChritaH svayam |
ArabdhavyamidaM karma manyase shRRiNu tatra me
shlokas.7:
bhUrishravAH shalashchaiva jalasandhashcha vIryavAn |
bhIShmo droNashcha karNashcha droNaputrashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.8:
dhArtarAShTrA durAdharShA duryodhanapurogamAH |
sarva eva kRRitAstrAshcha satataM chAtatAyinaH
shlokas.9:
rAjAnaH pArthivAshchaiva ye.asmAbhirupatApitAH |
sa.nshritAH kauravaM pakShaM jAtasnehAshcha sAmpratam
shlokas.10:
duryodhanahite yuktA na tathAsmAsu bhArata |
pUrNakoshA balopetAH prayatiShyanti rakShaNe
shlokas.11:
sarve kauravasainyasya saputrAmAtyasainikAH |
sa.nvibhaktA hi mAtrAbhirbhogairapi cha sarvashaH
shlokas.12:
duryodhanena te vIrA mAnitAshcha visheShataH |
prANA.nstyakShyanti sa~NgrAme iti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.13:
samA yadyapi bhIShmasya vRRittirasmAsu teShu cha |
droNasya cha mahAbAho kRRipasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
avashyaM rAjapiNDastairnirveshya iti me matiH |
tasmAttyakShyanti sa~NgrAme prANAnapi sudustyajAn
shlokas.15:
sarve divyAstravidvA.nsaH sarve dharmaparAyaNAH |
ajeyAshcheti me buddhirapi devaiH savAsavaiH
shlokas.16:
amarShI nityasaMhRRiShTastatra karNo mahArathaH |
sarvAstravidanAdhRRiShya abhedyakavachAvRRitaH
shlokas.17:
anirjitya raNe sarvAnetAnpuruShasattamAn |
ashakyo hyasahAyena hantuM duryodhanastvayA
shlokas.18:
na nidrAmadhigachChAmi chintayAno vRRikodara |
ati sarvAndhanurgrAhAnsUtaputrasya lAghavam
shlokas.19:
etadvachanamAj~nAya bhImaseno.atyamarShaNaH |
babhUva vimanAstrasto na chaivovAcha ki~nchana
shlokas.20:
tayoH sa.nvadatorevaM tadA pANDavayordvayoH |
AjagAma mahAyogI vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH
shlokas.21:
so.abhigamya yathAnyAyaM pANDavaiH pratipUjitaH |
yudhiShThiramidaM vAkyamuvAcha vadatAM varaH
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho vedmi te hRRidi mAnasam |
manIShayA tataH kShipramAgato.asmi nararShabha
shlokas.23:
bhIShmAddroNAtkRRipAtkarNAddroNaputrAchcha bhArata |
yatte bhayamamitraghna hRRidi samparivartate
shlokas.24:
tatte.ahaM nAshayiShyAmi vidhidRRiShTena hetunA |
tachChrutvA dhRRitimAsthAya karmaNA pratipAdaya
shlokas.25:
tata ekAntamunnIya pArAsharyo yudhiShThiram |
abravIdupapannArthamidaM vAkyavishAradaH
shlokas.26:
shreyasaste paraH kAlaH prApto bharatasattama |
yenAbhibhavitA shatrUnraNe pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.27:
gRRihANemAM mayA proktAM siddhiM mUrtimatImiva |
vidyAM pratismRRitiM nAma prapannAya bravImi te
yAmavApya mahAbAhurarjunaH sAdhayiShyati
shlokas.28:
astrahetormahendraM cha rudraM chaivAbhigachChatu |
varuNaM cha dhaneshaM cha dharmarAjaM cha pANDava
shakto hyeSha surAndraShTuM tapasA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.29:
RRiShireSha mahAtejA nArAyaNasahAyavAn |
purANaH shAshvato devo viShNora.nshaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.30:
astrANIndrAchcha rudrAchcha lokapAlebhya eva cha |
samAdAya mahAbAhurmahatkarma kariShyati
shlokas.31:
vanAdasmAchcha kaunteya vanamanyadvichintyatAm |
nivAsArthAya yadyuktaM bhavedvaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.32:
ekatra chiravAso hi na prItijanano bhavet |
tApasAnAM cha shAntAnAM bhavedudvegakArakaH
shlokas.33:
mRRigANAmupayogashcha vIrudoShadhisa~NkShayaH |
bibharShi hi bahUnviprAnvedavedA~NgapAragAn
shlokas.34:
evamuktvA prapannAya shuchaye bhagavAnprabhuH |
provAcha yogatattvaj~no yogavidyAmanuttamAm
shlokas.35:
dharmarAj~ne tadA dhImAnvyAsaH satyavatIsutaH |
anuj~nAya cha kaunteyaM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.36:
yudhiShThirastu dharmAtmA tadbrahma manasA yataH |
dhArayAmAsa medhAvI kAle kAle samabhyasan
shlokas.37:
sa vyAsavAkyamudito vanAddvaitavanAttataH |
yayau sarasvatItIre kAmyakaM nAma kAnanam
shlokas.38:
tamanvayurmahArAja shikShAkSharavidastathA |
brAhmaNAstapasA yuktA devendramRRiShayo yathA
shlokas.39:
tataH kAmyakamAsAdya punaste bharatarShabhAH |
nyavishanta mahAtmAnaH sAmAtyAH sapadAnugAH
shlokas.40:
tatra te nyavasanrAjanka~nchitkAlaM manasvinaH |
dhanurvedaparA vIrAH shRRiNvAnA vedamuttamam
shlokas.41:
charanto mRRigayAM nityaM shuddhairbANairmRRigArthinaH |
pitRRidaivataviprebhyo nirvapanto yathAvidhi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kasyachittvatha kAlasya dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
sa.nsmRRitya munisa.ndeshamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
vivikte viditapraj~namarjunaM bharatarShabham |
sAntvapUrvaM smitaM kRRitvA pANinA parisa.nspRRishan
shlokas.3:
sa muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA vanavAsamari.ndamaH |
dhana~njayaM dharmarAjo rahasIdamuvAcha ha
shlokas.4:
bhIShme droNe kRRipe karNe droNaputre cha bhArata |
dhanurvedashchatuShpAda eteShvadya pratiShThitaH
shlokas.5:
brAhmaM daivamAsuraM cha saprayogachikitsitam |
sarvAstrANAM prayogaM cha te.abhijAnanti kRRitsnashaH
shlokas.6:
te sarve dhRRitarAShTrasya putreNa parisAntvitAH |
sa.nvibhaktAshcha tuShTAshcha guruvatteShu vartate
shlokas.7:
sarvayodheShu chaivAsya sadA vRRittiranuttamA |
shaktiM na hApayiShyanti te kAle pratipUjitAH
shlokas.8:
adya cheyaM mahI kRRitsnA duryodhanavashAnugA |
tvayi vyapAshrayo.asmAkaM tvayi bhAraH samAhitaH
tatra kRRityaM prapashyAmi prAptakAlamari.ndama
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAttAta gRRihItopaniShanmayA |
tayA prayuktayA samyagjagatsarvaM prakAshate
tena tvaM brahmaNA tAta sa.nyuktaH susamAhitaH
shlokas.10:
devatAnAM yathAkAlaM prasAdaM pratipAlaya |
tapasA yojayAtmAnamugreNa bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
dhanuShmAnkavachI khaDgI muniH sArasamanvitaH |
na kasyachiddadanmArgaM gachCha tAtottarAM disham
indre hyastrANi divyAni samastAni dhana~njaya
shlokas.12:
vRRitrAdbhItaistadA devairbalamindre samarpitam |
tAnyekasthAni sarvANi tatastvaM pratipatsyase
shlokas.13:
shakrameva prapadyasva sa te.astrANi pradAsyati |
dIkShito.adyaiva gachCha tvaM draShTuM devaM pura.ndaram
shlokas.14:
evamuktvA dharmarAjastamadhyApayata prabhuH |
dIkShitaM vidhinA tena yatavAkkAyamAnasam
anujaj~ne tato vIraM bhrAtA bhrAtaramagrajaH
shlokas.15:
nideshAddharmarAjasya draShTuM devaM pura.ndaram |
dhanurgANDIvamAdAya tathAkShayyau maheShudhI
shlokas.16:
kavachI satalatrANo baddhagodhA~NgulitravAn |
hutvAgniM brAhmaNAnniShkaiH svasti vAchya mahAbhujaH
shlokas.17:
prAtiShThata mahAbAhuH pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
vadhAya dhArtarAShTrANAM niHshvasyordhvamudIkShya cha
shlokas.18:
taM dRRiShTvA tatra kaunteyaM pragRRihItasharAsanam |
abruvanbrAhmaNAH siddhA bhUtAnyantarhitAni cha
kShipraM prApnuhi kaunteya manasA yadyadichChasi
shlokas.19:
taM siMhamiva gachChantaM shAlaskandhorumarjunam |
manA.nsyAdAya sarveShAM kRRiShNA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.20:
yatte kuntI mahAbAho jAtasyaichChaddhana~njaya |
tatte.astu sarvaM kaunteya yathA cha svayamichChasi
shlokas.21:
mAsmAkaM kShatriyakule janma kashchidavApnuyAt |
brAhmaNebhyo namo nityaM yeShAM yuddhe na jIvikA
shlokas.22:
nUnaM te bhrAtaraH sarve tvatkathAbhiH prajAgare |
ra.nsyante vIrakarmANi kIrtayantaH punaH punaH
shlokas.23:
naiva naH pArtha bhogeShu na dhane nota jIvite |
tuShTirbuddhirbhavitrI vA tvayi dIrghapravAsini
shlokas.24:
tvayi naH pArtha sarveShAM sukhaduHkhe samAhite |
jIvitaM maraNaM chaiva rAjyamaishvaryameva cha
ApRRiShTo me.asi kaunteya svasti prApnuhi pANDava
shlokas.25:
namo dhAtre vidhAtre cha svasti gachCha hyanAmayam |
svasti te.astvAntarikShebhyaH pArthivebhyashcha bhArata
divyebhyashchaiva bhUtebhyo ye chAnye paripanthinaH
shlokas.26:
tataH pradakShiNaM kRRitvA bhrAtR^IndhaumyaM cha pANDavaH |
prAtiShThata mahAbAhuH pragRRihya ruchiraM dhanuH
shlokas.27:
tasya mArgAdapAkrAmansarvabhUtAni gachChataH |
yuktasyaindreNa yogena parAkrAntasya shuShmiNaH
shlokas.28:
so.agachChatparvataM puNyamekAhnaiva mahAmanAH |
manojavagatirbhUtvA yogayukto yathAnilaH
shlokas.29:
himavantamatikramya gandhamAdanameva cha |
atyakrAmatsa durgANi divArAtramatandritaH
shlokas.30:
indrakIlaM samAsAdya tato.atiShThaddhana~njayaH |
antarikShe hi shushrAva tiShTheti sa vachastadA
shlokas.31:
tato.apashyatsavyasAchI vRRikShamUle tapasvinam |
brAhmyA shriyA dIpyamAnaM pi~NgalaM jaTilaM kRRisham
shlokas.32:
so.abravIdarjunaM tatra sthitaM dRRiShTvA mahAtapAH |
kastvaM tAteha samprApto dhanuShmAnkavachI sharI
nibaddhAsitalatrANaH kShatradharmamanuvrataH
shlokas.33:
neha shastreNa kartavyaM shAntAnAmayamAlayaH |
vinItakrodhaharShANAM brAhmaNAnAM tapasvinAm
shlokas.34:
nehAsti dhanuShA kAryaM na sa~NgrAmeNa karhichit |
nikShipaitaddhanustAta prApto.asi paramAM gatim
shlokas.35:
ityanantaujasaM vIraM yathA chAnyaM pRRithagjanam |
tathA vAchamathAbhIkShNaM brAhmaNo.arjunamabravIt
na chainaM chAlayAmAsa dhairyAtsudRRiDhanishchayam
shlokas.36:
tamuvAcha tataH prItaH sa dvijaH prahasanniva |
varaM vRRiNIShva bhadraM te shakro.ahamarisUdana
shlokas.37:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha sahasrAkShaM dhana~njayaH |
prA~njaliH praNato bhUtvA shUraH kurukulodvahaH
shlokas.38:
Ipsito hyeSha me kAmo varaM chainaM prayachCha me |
tvatto.adya bhagavannastraM kRRitsnamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.39:
pratyuvAcha mahendrastaM prItAtmA prahasanniva |
iha prAptasya kiM kAryamastraistava dhana~njaya
kAmAnvRRiNIShva lokA.nshcha prApto.asi paramAM gatim
shlokas.40:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha sahasrAkShaM dhana~njayaH |
na lokAnna punaH kAmAnna devatvaM kutaH sukham
shlokas.41:
na cha sarvAmaraishvaryaM kAmaye tridashAdhipa |
bhrAtR^I.nstAnvipine tyaktvA vairamapratiyAtya cha
akIrtiM sarvalokeShu gachCheyaM shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.42:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha vRRitrahA pANDunandanam |
sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA vAchA sarvalokanamaskRRitaH
shlokas.43:
yadA drakShyasi bhUteshaM tryakShaM shUladharaM shivam |
tadA dAtAsmi te tAta divyAnyastrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.44:
kriyatAM darshane yatno devasya parameShThinaH |
darshanAttasya kaunteya sa.nsiddhaH svargameShyasi
shlokas.45:
ityuktvA phalgunaM shakro jagAmAdarshanaM tataH |
arjuno.apyatha tatraiva tasthau yogasamanvitaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bhagava~nshrotumichChAmi pArthasyAkliShTakarmaNaH |
vistareNa kathAmetAM yathAstrANyupalabdhavAn
shlokas.2:
kathaM sa puruShavyAghro dIrghabAhurdhana~njayaH |
vanaM praviShTastejasvI nirmanuShyamabhItavat
shlokas.3:
kiM cha tena kRRitaM tatra vasatA brahmavittama |
kathaM cha bhagavAnsthANurdevarAjashcha toShitaH
shlokas.4:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tvatprasAdAddvijottama |
tvaM hi sarvaj~na divyaM cha mAnuShaM chaiva vettha ha
shlokas.5:
atyadbhutaM mahAprAj~na romaharShaNamarjunaH |
bhavena saha sa~NgrAmaM chakArApratimaM kila
purA praharatAM shreShThaH sa~NgrAmeShvaparAjitaH
shlokas.6:
yachChrutvA narasiMhAnAM dainyaharShAtivismayAt |
shUrANAmapi pArthAnAM hRRidayAni chakampire
shlokas.7:
yadyachcha kRRitavAnanyatpArthastadakhilaM vada |
na hyasya ninditaM jiShNoH susUkShmamapi lakShaye
charitaM tasya shUrasya tanme sarvaM prakIrtaya
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kathayiShyAmi te tAta kathAmetAM mahAtmanaH |
divyAM kauravashArdUla mahatImadbhutopamAm
shlokas.9:
