gAtrasa.nsparshasambandhaM tryambakeNa sahAnagha |
pArthasya devadevena shRRiNu samyaksamAgamam
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThiraniyogAtsa jagAmAmitavikramaH |
shakraM sureshvaraM draShTuM devadevaM cha sha~Nkaram
shlokas.11:
divyaM taddhanurAdAya khaDgaM cha puruSharShabhaH |
mahAbalo mahAbAhurarjunaH kAryasiddhaye
dishaM hyudIchIM kauravyo himavachChikharaM prati
shlokas.12:
aindriH sthiramanA rAjansarvalokamahArathaH |
tvarayA parayA yuktastapase dhRRitanishchayaH
vanaM kaNTakitaM ghorameka evAnvapadyata
shlokas.13:
nAnApuShpaphalopetaM nAnApakShiniShevitam |
nAnAmRRigagaNAkIrNaM siddhachAraNasevitam
shlokas.14:
tataH prayAte kaunteye vanaM mAnuShavarjitam |
sha~NkhAnAM paTahAnAM cha shabdaH samabhavaddivi
shlokas.15:
puShpavarShaM cha sumahannipapAta mahItale |
meghajAlaM cha vitataM ChAdayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.16:
atItya vanadurgANi saMnikarShe mahAgireH |
shushubhe himavatpRRiShThe vasamAno.arjunastadA
shlokas.17:
tatrApashyaddrumAnphullAnvihagairvalgu nAditAn |
nadIshcha bahulAvartA nIlavaiDUryasaMnibhAH
shlokas.18:
ha.nsakAraNDavodgItAH sArasAbhirutAstathA |
pu.nskokilarutAshchaiva krau~nchabarhiNanAditAH
shlokas.19:
manoharavanopetAstasminnatiratho.arjunaH |
puNyashItAmalajalAH pashyanprItamanAbhavat
shlokas.20:
ramaNIye vanoddeshe ramamANo.arjunastadA |
tapasyugre vartamAna ugratejA mahAmanAH
shlokas.21:
darbhachIraM nivasyAtha daNDAjinavibhUShitaH |
pUrNe pUrNe trirAtre tu mAsamekaM phalAshanaH
dviguNenaiva kAlena dvitIyaM mAsamatyagAt
shlokas.22:
tRRitIyamapi mAsaM sa pakSheNAhAramAcharan |
shIrNaM cha patitaM bhUmau parNaM samupayuktavAn
shlokas.23:
chaturthe tvatha samprApte mAsi pUrNe tataH param |
vAyubhakSho mahAbAhurabhavatpANDunandanaH
UrdhvabAhurnirAlambaH pAdA~NguShThAgraviShThitaH
shlokas.24:
sadopasparshanAchchAsya babhUvuramitaujasaH |
vidyudambhoruhanibhA jaTAstasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
tato maharShayaH sarve jagmurdevaM pinAkinam |
shitikaNThaM mahAbhAgaM praNipatya prasAdya cha
sarve nivedayAmAsuH karma tatphalgunasya ha
shlokas.26:
eSha pArtho mahAtejA himavatpRRiShThamAshritaH |
ugre tapasi duShpAre sthito dhUmAyayandishaH
shlokas.27:
tasya devesha na vayaM vidmaH sarve chikIrShitam |
santApayati naH sarvAnasau sAdhu nivAryatAm
shlokas.28:
maheshvara uvAcha||
shIghraM gachChata saMhRRiShTA yathAgatamatandritAH |
ahamasya vijAnAmi sa~NkalpaM manasi sthitam
shlokas.29:
nAsya svargaspRRihA kAchinnaishvaryasya na chAyuShaH |
yattvasya kA~NkShitaM sarvaM tatkariShye.ahamadya vai
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te shrutva sharvavachanamRRiShayaH satyavAdinaH |
prahRRiShTamanaso jagmuryathAsvaM punarAshramAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gateShu teShu sarveShu tapasviShu mahAtmasu |
pinAkapANirbhagavAnsarvapApaharo haraH
shlokas.2:
kairAtaM veShamAsthAya kA~nchanadrumasaMnibham |
vibhrAjamAno vapuShA girirmerurivAparaH
shlokas.3:
shrImaddhanurupAdAya sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn |
niShpapAta mahArchiShmAndahankakShamivAnalaH
shlokas.4:
devyA sahomayA shrImAnsamAnavrataveShayA |
nAnAveShadharairhRRiShTairbhUtairanugatastadA
shlokas.5:
kirAtaveShaprachChannaH strIbhishchAnu sahasrashaH |
ashobhata tadA rAjansa devo.atIva bhArata
shlokas.6:
kShaNena tadvanaM sarvaM niHshabdamabhavattadA |
nAdaH prasravaNAnAM cha pakShiNAM chApyupAramat
shlokas.7:
sa saMnikarShamAgamya pArthasyAkliShTakarmaNaH |
mUkaM nAma diteH putraM dadarshAdbhutadarshanam
shlokas.8:
vArAhaM rUpamAsthAya tarkayantamivArjunam |
hantuM paramaduShTAtmA tamuvAchAtha phalgunaH
shlokas.9:
gANDIvaM dhanurAdAya sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn |
sajyaM dhanurvaraM kRRitvA jyAghoSheNa ninAdayan
shlokas.10:
yanmAM prArthayase hantumanAgasamihAgatam |
tasmAttvAM pUrvamevAhaM neShyAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.11:
taM dRRiShTvA prahariShyantaM phalgunaM dRRiDhadhanvinam |
kirAtarUpI sahasA vArayAmAsa sha~NkaraH
shlokas.12:
mayaiSha prArthitaH pUrvaM nIlameghasamaprabhaH |
anAdRRityaiva tadvAkyaM prajahArAtha phalgunaH
shlokas.13:
kirAtashcha samaM tasminnekalakShye mahAdyutiH |
pramumochAshaniprakhyaM sharamagnishikhopamam
shlokas.14:
tau muktau sAyakau tAbhyAM samaM tatra nipetatuH |
mUkasya gAtre vistIrNe shailasaMhanane tadA
shlokas.15:
yathAshaniviniShpeSho vajrasyeva cha parvate |
tathA tayoH saMnipAtaH sharayorabhavattadA
shlokas.16:
sa viddho bahubhirbANairdIptAsyaiH pannagairiva |
mamAra rAkShasaM rUpaM bhUyaH kRRitvA vibhIShaNam
shlokas.17:
dadarshAtha tato jiShNuH puruShaM kA~nchanaprabham |
kirAtaveShaprachChannaM strIsahAyamamitrahA
tamabravItprItamanAH kaunteyaH prahasanniva
shlokas.18:
ko bhavAnaTate shUnye vane strIgaNasa.nvRRitaH |
na tvamasminvane ghore bibheShi kanakaprabha
shlokas.19:
kimarthaM cha tvayA viddho mRRigo.ayaM matparigrahaH |
mayAbhipannaH pUrvaM hi rAkShaso.ayamihAgataH
shlokas.20:
kAmAtparibhavAdvApi na me jIvanvimokShyase |
na hyeSha mRRigayAdharmo yastvayAdya kRRito mayi
tena tvAM bhra.nshayiShyAmi jIvitAtparvatAshraya
shlokas.21:
ityuktaH pANDaveyena kirAtaH prahasanniva |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA pANDavaM savyasAchinam
shlokas.22:
mamaivAyaM lakShyabhUtaH pUrvameva parigrahaH |
mamaiva cha prahAreNa jIvitAdvyavaropitaH
shlokas.23:
doShAnsvAnnArhase.anyasmai vaktuM svabaladarpitaH |
abhiShakto.asmi mandAtmanna me jIvanvimokShyase
shlokas.24:
sthiro bhavasva mokShyAmi sAyakAnashanIniva |
ghaTasva parayA shaktyA mu~ncha tvamapi sAyakAn
shlokas.25:
tatastau tatra sa.nrabdhau garjamAnau muhurmuhuH |
sharairAshIviShAkAraistatakShAte parasparam
shlokas.26:
tato.arjunaH sharavarShaM kirAte samavAsRRijat |
tatprasannena manasA pratijagrAha sha~NkaraH
shlokas.27:
muhUrtaM sharavarShaM tatpratigRRihya pinAkadhRRik |
akShatena sharIreNa tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.28:
sa dRRiShTvA bANavarShaM tanmoghIbhUtaM dhana~njayaH |
paramaM vismayaM chakre sAdhu sAdhviti chAbravIt
shlokas.29:
aho.ayaM sukumArA~Ngo himavachChikharAlayaH |
gANDIvamuktAnnArAchAnpratigRRihNAtyavihvalaH
shlokas.30:
ko.ayaM devo bhavetsAkShAdrudro yakShaH sureshvaraH |
vidyate hi girishreShThe tridashAnAM samAgamaH
shlokas.31:
na hi madbANajAlAnAmutsRRiShTAnAM sahasrashaH |
shakto.anyaH sahituM vegamRRite devaM pinAkinam
shlokas.32:
devo vA yadi vA yakSho rudrAdanyo vyavasthitaH |
ahamenaM sharaistIkShNairnayAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.33:
tato hRRiShTamanA jiShNurnArAchAnmarmabhedinaH |
vyasRRijachChatadhA rAjanmayUkhAniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.34:
tAnprasannena manasA bhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH |
shUlapANiH pratyagRRihNAchChilAvarShamivAchalaH
shlokas.35:
kShaNena kShINabANo.atha sa.nvRRittaH phalgunastadA |
vitrAsaM cha jagAmAtha taM dRRiShTvA sharasa~NkShayam
shlokas.36:
chintayAmAsa jiShNustu bhagavantaM hutAshanam |
purastAdakShayau dattau tUNau yenAsya khANDave
shlokas.37:
kiM nu mokShyAmi dhanuShA yanme bANAH kShayaM gatAH |
ayaM cha puruShaH ko.api bANAngrasati sarvashaH
shlokas.38:
ahamenaM dhanuShkoTyA shUlAgreNeva ku~njaram |
nayAmi daNDadhArasya yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.39:
samprAyudhyaddhanuShkoTyA kaunteyaH paravIrahA |
tadapyasya dhanurdivyaM jagrAsa girigocharaH
shlokas.40:
tato.arjuno grastadhanuH khaDgapANiratiShThata |
yuddhasyAntamabhIpsanvai vegenAbhijagAma tam
shlokas.41:
tasya mUrdhni shitaM khaDgamasaktaM parvateShvapi |
mumocha bhujavIryeNa vikramya kurunandanaH
tasya mUrdhAnamAsAdya paphAlAsivaro hi saH
shlokas.42:
tato vRRikShaiH shilAbhishcha yodhayAmAsa phalgunaH |
yathA vRRikShAnmahAkAyaH pratyagRRihNAdatho shilAH
shlokas.43:
kirAtarUpI bhagavA.nstataH pArtho mahAbalaH |
muShTibhirvajrasa.nsparshairdhUmamutpAdayanmukhe
prajahAra durAdharShe kirAtasamarUpiNi
shlokas.44:
tataH shakrAshanisamairmuShTibhirbhRRishadAruNaiH |
kirAtarUpI bhagavAnardayAmAsa phalgunam
shlokas.45:
tatashchaTachaTAshabdaH sughoraH samajAyata |
pANDavasya cha muShTInAM kirAtasya cha yudhyataH
shlokas.46:
sumuhUrtaM mahadyuddhamAsIttallomaharShaNam |
bhujaprahArasa.nyuktaM vRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.47:
jahArAtha tato jiShNuH kirAtamurasA balI |
pANDavaM cha vicheShTantaM kirAto.apyahanadbalAt
shlokas.48:
tayorbhujaviniShpeShAtsa~NgharSheNorasostathA |
samajAyata gAtreShu pAvako.a~NgAradhUmavAn
shlokas.49:
tata enaM mahAdevaH pIDya gAtraiH supIDitam |
tejasA vyAkramadroShAchchetastasya vimohayan
shlokas.50:
tato nipIDitairgAtraiH piNDIkRRita ivAbabhau |
phalguno gAtrasa.nruddho devadevena bhArata
shlokas.51:
niruchChvAso.abhavachchaiva saMniruddho mahAtmanA |
tataH papAta saMmUDhastataH prIto.abhavadbhavaH
shlokas.52:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
bho bho phalguna tuShTo.asmi karmaNApratimena te |
shauryeNAnena dhRRityA cha kShatriyo nAsti te samaH
shlokas.53:
samaM tejashcha vIryaM cha mamAdya tava chAnagha |
prItaste.ahaM mahAbAho pashya mAM puruSharShabha
shlokas.54:
dadAni te vishAlAkSha chakShuH pUrvaRRiShirbhavAn |
vijeShyasi raNe shatrUnapi sarvAndivaukasaH
shlokas.55:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato devaM mahAdevaM girishaM shUlapANinam |
dadarsha phalgunastatra saha devyA mahAdyutim
shlokas.56:
sa jAnubhyAM mahIM gatvA shirasA praNipatya cha |
prasAdayAmAsa haraM pArthaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.57:
arjuna uvAcha||
kapardinsarvabhUtesha bhaganetranipAtana |
vyatikramaM me bhagavankShantumarhasi sha~Nkara
shlokas.58:
bhavagaddarshanAkA~NkShI prApto.asmImaM mahAgirim |
dayitaM tava devesha tApasAlayamuttamam
shlokas.59:
prasAdaye tvAM bhagavansarvabhUtanamaskRRita |
na me syAdaparAdho.ayaM mahAdevAtisAhasAt
shlokas.60:
kRRito mayA yadaj~nAnAdvimardo.ayaM tvayA saha |
sharaNaM samprapannAya tatkShamasvAdya sha~Nkara
shlokas.61:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamuvAcha mahAtejAH prahasya vRRiShabhadhvajaH |
pragRRihya ruchiraM bAhuM kShAntamityeva phalgunam

shlokas.1:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
narastvaM pUrvadehe vai nArAyaNasahAyavAn |
badaryAM taptavAnugraM tapo varShAyutAnbahUn
shlokas.2:
tvayi vA paramaM tejo viShNau vA puruShottame |
yuvAbhyAM puruShAgryAbhyAM tejasA dhAryate jagat
shlokas.3:
shakrAbhiSheke sumahaddhanurjaladanisvanam |
pragRRihya dAnavAH shastAstvayA kRRiShNena cha prabho
shlokas.4:
etattadeva gANDIvaM tava pArtha karochitam |
mAyAmAsthAya yadgrastaM mayA puruShasattama
tUNau chApyakShayau bhUyastava pArtha yathochitau
shlokas.5:
prItimAnasmi vai pArtha tava satyaparAkrama |
gRRihANa varamasmattaH kA~NkShitaM yannararShabha
shlokas.6:
na tvayA sadRRishaH kashchitpumAnmartyeShu mAnada |
divi vA vidyate kShatraM tvatpradhAnamari.ndama
shlokas.7:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhagavandadAsi chenmahyaM kAmaM prItyA vRRiShadhvaja |
kAmaye divyamastraM tadghoraM pAshupataM prabho
shlokas.8:
yattadbrahmashiro nAma raudraM bhImaparAkramam |
yugAnte dAruNe prApte kRRitsnaM saMharate jagat
shlokas.9:
daheyaM yena sa~NgrAme dAnavAnrAkShasA.nstathA |
bhUtAni cha pishAchA.nshcha gandharvAnatha pannagAn
shlokas.10:
yataH shUlasahasrANi gadAshchograpradarshanAH |
sharAshchAshIviShAkArAH sambhavantyanumantritAH
shlokas.11:
yudhyeyaM yena bhIShmeNa droNena cha kRRipeNa cha |
sUtaputreNa cha raNe nityaM kaTukabhAShiNA
shlokas.12:
eSha me prathamaH kAmo bhagavanbhaganetrahan |
tvatprasAdAdvinirvRRittaH samarthaH syAmahaM yathA
shlokas.13:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
dadAni te.astraM dayitamahaM pAshupataM mahat |
samartho dhAraNe mokShe saMhAre chApi pANDava
shlokas.14:
naitadveda mahendro.api na yamo na cha yakSharAT |
varuNo vAtha vA vAyuH kuto vetsyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.15:
na tvetatsahasA pArtha moktavyaM puruShe kvachit |
jagadvinirdahetsarvamalpatejasi pAtitam
shlokas.16:
avadhyo nAma nAstyasya trailokye sacharAchare |
manasA chakShuShA vAchA dhanuShA cha nipAtyate
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA tvaritaH pArthaH shuchirbhUtvA samAhitaH |
upasa~NgRRihya vishveshamadhIShveti cha so.abravIt
shlokas.18:
tatastvadhyApayAmAsa sarahasya nivartanam |
tadastraM pANDavashreShThaM mUrtimantamivAntakam
shlokas.19:
upatasthe mahAtmAnaM yathA tryakShamumApatim |
pratijagrAha tachchApi prItimAnarjunastadA
shlokas.20:
tatashchachAla pRRithivI saparvatavanadrumA |
sasAgaravanoddeshA sagrAmanagarAkarA
shlokas.21:
sha~NkhadundubhighoShAshcha bherINAM cha sahasrashaH |
tasminmuhUrte samprApte nirghAtashcha mahAnabhUt
shlokas.22:
athAstraM jAjvaladghoraM pANDavasyAmitaujasaH |
mUrtimadviShThitaM pArshve dadRRishurdevadAnavAH
shlokas.23:
spRRiShTasya cha tryambakena phalgunasyAmitaujasaH |
yatki~nchidashubhaM dehe tatsarvaM nAshameyivat
shlokas.24:
svargaM gachChetyanuj~nAtastryambakena tadArjunaH |
praNamya shirasA pArthaH prA~njalirdevamaikShata
shlokas.25:
tataH prabhustridivanivAsinAM vashI; mahAmatirgirisha umApatiH shivaH |
dhanurmahadditijapishAchasUdanaM; dadau bhavaH puruShavarAya gANDivam
shlokas.26:
tataH shubhaM girivaramIshvarastadA; sahomayA sitataTasAnukandaram |
vihAya taM patagamaharShisevitaM; jagAma khaM puruShavarasya pashyataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya sampashyatastveva pinAkI vRRiShabhadhvajaH |
jagAmAdarshanaM bhAnurlokasyevAstameyivAn
shlokas.2:
tato.arjunaH paraM chakre vismayaM paravIrahA |
mayA sAkShAnmahAdevo dRRiShTa ityeva bhArata
shlokas.3:
dhanyo.asmyanugRRihIto.asmi yanmayA tryambako haraH |
pinAkI varado rUpI dRRiShTaH spRRiShTashcha pANinA
shlokas.4:
kRRitArthaM chAvagachChAmi paramAtmAnamAtmanA |
shatrU.nshcha vijitAnsarvAnnirvRRittaM cha prayojanam
shlokas.5:
tato vaiDUryavarNAbho bhAsayansarvato dishaH |
yAdogaNavRRitaH shrImAnAjagAma jaleshvaraH
shlokas.6:
nAgairnadairnadIbhishcha daityaiH sAdhyaishcha daivataiH |
varuNo yAdasAM bhartA vashI taM deshamAgamat
shlokas.7:
atha jAmbUnadavapurvimAnena mahArchiShA |
kuberaH samanuprApto yakShairanugataH prabhuH
shlokas.8:
vidyotayannivAkAshamadbhutopamadarshanaH |
dhanAnAmIshvaraH shrImAnarjunaM draShTumAgataH
shlokas.9:
tathA lokAntakRRichChrImAnyamaH sAkShAtpratApavAn |
mUrtyamUrtidharaiH sArdhaM pitRRibhirlokabhAvanaiH
shlokas.10:
daNDapANirachintyAtmA sarvabhUtavinAshakRRit |
vaivasvato dharmarAjo vimAnenAvabhAsayan
shlokas.11:
trI.NllokAnguhyakA.nshchaiva gandharvA.nshcha sapannagAn |
dvitIya iva mArtaNDo yugAnte samupasthite
shlokas.12:
bhAnumanti vichitrANi shikharANi mahAgireH |
samAsthAyArjunaM tatra dadRRishustapasAnvitam
shlokas.13:
tato muhUrtAdbhagavAnairAvatashirogataH |
AjagAma sahendrANyA shakraH suragaNairvRRitaH
shlokas.14:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
shushubhe tArakArAjaH sitamabhramivAsthitaH
shlokas.15:
sa.nstUyamAno gandharvairRRiShibhishcha tapodhanaiH |
shRRi~NgaM gireH samAsAdya tasthau sUrya ivoditaH
shlokas.16:
atha meghasvano dhImAnvyAjahAra shubhAM giram |
yamaH paramadharmaj~no dakShiNAM dishamAsthitaH
shlokas.17:
arjunArjuna pashyAsmA.NllokapAlAnsamAgatAn |
dRRiShTiM te vitarAmo.adya bhavAnarho hi darshanam
shlokas.18:
pUrvarShiramitAtmA tvaM naro nAma mahAbalaH |
niyogAdbrahmaNastAta martyatAM samupAgataH
tvaM vAsavasamudbhUto mahAvIryaparAkramaH
shlokas.19:
kShatraM chAgnisamasparshaM bhAradvAjena rakShitam |
dAnavAshcha mahAvIryA ye manuShyatvamAgatAH
nivAtakavachAshchaiva sa.nsAdhyAH kurunandana
shlokas.20:
piturmamA.nsho devasya sarvalokapratApinaH |
karNaH sa sumahAvIryastvayA vadhyo dhana~njaya
shlokas.21:
a.nshAshcha kShitisamprAptA devagandharvarakShasAm |
tayA nipAtitA yuddhe svakarmaphalanirjitAm
gatiM prApsyanti kaunteya yathAsvamarikarshana
shlokas.22:
akShayA tava kIrtishcha loke sthAsyati phalguna |
tvayA sAkShAnmahAdevastoShito hi mahAmRRidhe
laghvI vasumatI chApi kartavyA viShNunA saha
shlokas.23:
gRRihANAstraM mahAbAho daNDamaprativAraNam |
anenAstreNa sumahattvaM hi karma kariShyasi
shlokas.24:
pratijagrAha tatpArtho vidhivatkurunandanaH |
samantraM sopachAraM cha samokShaM sanivartanam
shlokas.25:
tato jaladharashyAmo varuNo yAdasAM patiH |
pashchimAM dishamAsthAya giramuchchArayanprabhuH
shlokas.26:
pArtha kShatriyamukhyastvaM kShatradharme vyavasthitaH |
pashya mAM pRRithutAmrAkSha varuNo.asmi jaleshvaraH
shlokas.27:
mayA samudyatAnpAshAnvAruNAnanivAraNAn |
pratigRRihNIShva kaunteya sarahasyanivartanAn
shlokas.28:
ebhistadA mayA vIra sa~NgrAme tArakAmaye |
daiteyAnAM sahasrANi sa.nyatAni mahAtmanAm
shlokas.29:
tasmAdimAnmahAsattva matprasAdAtsamutthitAn |
gRRihANa na hi te muchyedantako.apyAtatAyinaH
shlokas.30:
anena tvaM yadAstreNa sa~NgrAme vichariShyasi |
tadA niHkShatriyA bhUmirbhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.31:
tataH kailAsanilayo dhanAdhyakSho.abhyabhAShata |
datteShvastreShu divyeShu varuNena yamena cha
shlokas.32:
savyasAchinmahAbAho pUrvadeva sanAtana |
sahAsmAbhirbhavA~nshrAntaH purAkalpeShu nityashaH
shlokas.33:
matto.api tvaM gRRihANAstramantardhAnaM priyaM mama |
ojastejodyutiharaM prasvApanamarAtihan
shlokas.34:
tato.arjuno mahAbAhurvidhivatkurunandanaH |
kauberamapi jagrAha divyamastraM mahAbalaH
shlokas.35:
tato.abravIddevarAjaH pArthamakliShTakAriNam |
sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA vAchA meghadundubhinisvanaH
shlokas.36:
kuntImAtarmahAbAho tvamIshAnaH purAtanaH |
parAM siddhimanuprAptaH sAkShAddevagatiM gataH
shlokas.37:
devakAryaM hi sumahattvayA kAryamari.ndama |
AroDhavyastvayA svargaH sajjIbhava mahAdyute
shlokas.38:
ratho mAtalisa.nyukta AgantA tvatkRRite mahIm |
tatra te.ahaM pradAsyAmi divyAnyastrANi kaurava
shlokas.39:
tAndRRiShTvA lokapAlA.nstu sametAngirimUrdhani |
jagAma vismayaM dhImAnkuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.40:
tato.arjuno mahAtejA lokapAlAnsamAgatAn |
pUjayAmAsa vidhivadvAgbhiradbhiH phalairapi
shlokas.41:
tataH pratiyayurdevAH pratipUjya dhana~njayam |
yathAgatena vibudhAH sarve kAmamanojavAH
shlokas.42:
tato.arjuno mudaM lebhe labdhAstraH puruSharShabhaH |
kRRitArthamiva chAtmAnaM sa mene pUrNamAnasaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gateShu lokapAleShu pArthaH shatrunibarhaNaH |
chintayAmAsa rAjendra devarAjarathAgamam
shlokas.2:
tatashchintayamAnasya guDAkeshasya dhImataH |
ratho mAtalisa.nyukta AjagAma mahAprabhaH
shlokas.3:
nabho vitimiraM kurva~njaladAnpATayanniva |
dishaH sampUrayannAdairmahAmegharavopamaiH
shlokas.4:
asayaH shaktayo bhImA gadAshchograpradarshanAH |
divyaprabhAvAH prAsAshcha vidyutashcha mahAprabhAH
shlokas.5:
tathaivAshanayastatra chakrayuktA huDAguDAH |
vAyusphoTAH sanirghAtA barhimeghanibhasvanAH
shlokas.6:
tatra nAgA mahAkAyA jvalitAsyAH sudAruNAH |
sitAbhrakUTapratimAH saMhatAshcha yathopalAH
shlokas.7:
dasha vAjisahasrANi harINAM vAtaraMhasAm |
vahanti yaM netramuShaM divyaM mAyAmayaM ratham
shlokas.8:
tatrApashyanmahAnIlaM vaijayantaM mahAprabham |
dhvajamindIvarashyAmaM va.nshaM kanakabhUShaNam
shlokas.9:
tasminrathe sthitaM sUtaM taptahemavibhUShitam |
dRRiShTvA pArtho mahAbAhurdevamevAnvatarkayat
shlokas.10:
tathA tarkayatastasya phalgunasyAtha mAtaliH |
saMnataH prashrito bhUtvA vAkyamarjunamabravIt
shlokas.11:
bho bho shakrAtmaja shrImA~nshakrastvAM draShTumichChati |
Arohatu bhavA~nshIghraM rathamindrasya saMmatam
shlokas.12:
Aha mAmamarashreShThaH pitA tava shatakratuH |
kuntIsutamiha prAptaM pashyantu tridashAlayAH
shlokas.13:
eSha shakraH parivRRito devairRRiShigaNaistathA |
gandharvairapsarobhishcha tvAM didRRikShuH pratIkShate
shlokas.14:
asmAllokAddevalokaM pAkashAsanashAsanAt |
Aroha tvaM mayA sArdhaM labdhAstraH punareShyasi
shlokas.15:
arjuna uvAcha||
mAtale gachCha shIghraM tvamArohasva rathottamam |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAnAM shatairapi sudurlabham
shlokas.16:
pArthivaiH sumahAbhAgairyajvabhirbhUridakShiNaiH |
daivatairvA samAroDhuM dAnavairvA rathottamam
shlokas.17:
nAtaptatapasA shakya eSha divyo mahArathaH |
draShTuM vApyatha vA spraShTumAroDhuM kuta eva tu
shlokas.18:
tvayi pratiShThite sAdho rathasthe sthiravAjini |
pashchAdahamathArokShye sukRRitI satpathaM yathA
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA mAtaliH shakrasArathiH |
Aruroha rathaM shIghraM hayAnyeme cha rashmibhiH
shlokas.20:
tato.arjuno hRRiShTamanA ga~NgAyAmAplutaH shuchiH |
jajApa japyaM kaunteyo vidhivatkurunandanaH
shlokas.21:
tataH pitR^InyathAnyAyaM tarpayitvA yathAvidhi |
mandaraM shailarAjaM tamApraShTumupachakrame
shlokas.22:
sAdhUnAM dharmashIlAnAM munInAM puNyakarmaNAm |
tvaM sadA sa.nshrayaH shaila svargamArgAbhikA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.23:
tvatprasAdAtsadA shaila brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vishaH |
svargaM prAptAshcharanti sma devaiH saha gatavyathAH
shlokas.24:
adrirAja mahAshaila munisa.nshraya tIrthavan |
gachChAmyAmantrayAmi tvAM sukhamasmyuShitastvayi
shlokas.25:
tava sAnUni ku~njAshcha nadyaH prasravaNAni cha |
tIrthAni cha supuNyAni mayA dRRiShTAnyanekashaH
shlokas.26:
evamuktvArjunaH shailamAmantrya paravIrahA |
Aruroha rathaM divyaM dyotayanniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.27:
sa tenAdityarUpeNa divyenAdbhutakarmaNA |
UrdhvamAchakrame dhImAnprahRRiShTaH kurunandanaH
shlokas.28:
so.adarshanapathaM yAtvA martyAnAM bhUmichAriNAm |
dadarshAdbhutarUpANi vimAnAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.29:
na tatra sUryaH somo vA dyotate na cha pAvakaH |
svayaiva prabhayA tatra dyotante puNyalabdhayA
shlokas.30:
tArArUpANi yAnIha dRRishyante dyutimanti vai |
dIpavadviprakRRiShTatvAdaNUni sumahAntyapi
shlokas.31:
tAni tatra prabhAsvanti rUpavanti cha pANDavaH |
dadarsha sveShu dhiShNyeShu dIptimanti svayArchiShA
shlokas.32:
tatra rAjarShayaH siddhA vIrAshcha nihatA yudhi |
tapasA cha jitasvargAH sampetuH shatasa~NghashaH
shlokas.33:
gandharvANAM sahasrANi sUryajvalanatejasAm |
guhyakAnAmRRiShINAM cha tathaivApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.34:
lokAnAtmaprabhAnpashyanphalguno vismayAnvitaH |
paprachCha mAtaliM prItyA sa chApyenamuvAcha ha
shlokas.35:
ete sukRRitinaH pArtha sveShu dhiShNyeShvavasthitAH |
yAndRRiShTavAnasi vibho tArArUpANi bhUtale
shlokas.36:
tato.apashyatsthitaM dvAri sitaM vaijayinaM gajam |
airAvataM chaturdantaM kailAsamiva shRRi~NgiNam
shlokas.37:
sa siddhamArgamAkramya kurupANDavasattamaH |
vyarochata yathA pUrvaM mAndhAtA pArthivottamaH
shlokas.38:
atichakrAma lokAnsa rAj~nAM rAjIvalochanaH |
tato dadarsha shakrasya purIM tAmamarAvatIm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa dadarsha purIM ramyAM siddhachAraNasevitAm |
sarvartukusumaiH puNyaiH pAdapairupashobhitAm
shlokas.2:
tatra saugandhikAnAM sa drumANAM puNyagandhinAm |
upavIjyamAno mishreNa vAyunA puNyagandhinA
shlokas.3:
nandanaM cha vanaM divyamapsarogaNasevitam |
dadarsha divyakusumairAhvayadbhiriva drumaiH
shlokas.4:
nAtaptatapasA shakyo draShTuM nAnAhitAgninA |
sa lokaH puNyakartR^INAM nApi yuddhaparA~NmukhaiH
shlokas.5:
nAyajvabhirnAnRRitakairna vedashrutivarjitaiH |
nAnAplutA~NgaistIrtheShu yaj~nadAnabahiShkRRitaiH
shlokas.6:
nApi yaj~nahanaiH kShudrairdraShTuM shakyaH katha~nchana |
pAnapairgurutalpaishcha mA.nsAdairvA durAtmabhiH
shlokas.7:
sa taddivyaM vanaM pashyandivyagItaninAditam |
pravivesha mahAbAhuH shakrasya dayitAM purIm
shlokas.8:
tatra devavimAnAni kAmagAni sahasrashaH |
sa.nsthitAnyabhiyAtAni dadarshAyutashastadA
shlokas.9:
sa.nstUyamAno gandharvairapsarobhishcha pANDavaH |
puShpagandhavahaiH puNyairvAyubhishchAnuvIjitaH
shlokas.10:
tato devAH sagandharvAH siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
hRRiShTAH sampUjayAmAsuH pArthamakliShTakAriNam
shlokas.11:
AshIrvAdaiH stUyamAno divyavAditranisvanaiH |
pratipede mahAbAhuH sha~NkhadundubhinAditam
shlokas.12:
nakShatramArgaM vipulaM suravIthIti vishrutam |
indrAj~nayA yayau pArthaH stUyamAnaH samantataH
shlokas.13:
tatra sAdhyAstathA vishve maruto.athAshvinAvapi |
AdityA vasavo rudrAstathA brahmarShayo.amalAH
shlokas.14:
rAjarShayashcha bahavo dilIpapramukhA nRRipAH |
tumbururnAradashchaiva gandharvau cha hahAhuhU
shlokas.15:
tAnsarvAnsa samAgamya vidhivatkurunandanaH |
tato.apashyaddevarAjaM shatakratumari.ndamam
shlokas.16:
tataH pArtho mahAbAhuravatIrya rathottamAt |
dadarsha sAkShAddevendraM pitaraM pAkashAsanam
shlokas.17:
pANDureNAtapatreNa hemadaNDena chAruNA |
divyagandhAdhivAsena vyajanena vidhUyatA
shlokas.18:
vishvAvasuprabhRRitibhirgandharvaiH stutivandanaiH |
stUyamAnaM dvijAgryaishcha RRigyajuHsAmasa.nstavaiH
shlokas.19:
tato.abhigamya kaunteyaH shirasAbhyanamadbalI |
sa chainamanuvRRittAbhyAM bhujAbhyAM pratyagRRihNata
shlokas.20:
tataH shakrAsane puNye devarAjarShipUjite |
shakraH pANau gRRihItvainamupAveshayadantike
shlokas.21:
mUrdhni chainamupAghrAya devendraH paravIrahA |
a~NkamAropayAmAsa prashrayAvanataM tadA
shlokas.22:
sahasrAkShaniyogAtsa pArthaH shakrAsanaM tadA |
adhyakrAmadameyAtmA dvitIya iva vAsavaH
shlokas.23:
tataH premNA vRRitrashatrurarjunasya shubhaM mukham |
pasparsha puNyagandhena kareNa parisAntvayan
shlokas.24:
parimArjamAnaH shanakairbAhU chAsyAyatau shubhau |
jyAsharakShepakaThinau stambhAviva hiraNmayau
shlokas.25:
vajragrahaNachihnena kareNa balasUdanaH |
muhurmuhurvajradharo bAhU sa.nsphAlaya~nshanaiH
shlokas.26:
smayanniva guDAkeshaM prekShamANaH sahasradRRik |
harSheNotphullanayano na chAtRRipyata vRRitrahA
shlokas.27:
ekAsanopaviShTau tau shobhayAM chakratuH sabhAm |
sUryAchandramasau vyomni chaturdashyAmivoditau
shlokas.28:
tatra sma gAthA gAyanti sAmnA paramavalgunA |
gandharvAstumburushreShThAH kushalA gItasAmasu
shlokas.29:
ghRRitAchI menakA rambhA pUrvachittiH svayamprabhA |
urvashI mishrakeshI cha DuNDurgaurI varUthinI
shlokas.30:
gopAlI sahajanyA cha kumbhayoniH prajAgarA |
chitrasenA chitralekhA sahA cha madhurasvarA
shlokas.31:
etAshchAnyAshcha nanRRitustatra tatra varA~NganAH |
chittapramathane yuktAH siddhAnAM padmalochanAH
shlokas.32:
mahAkaTitaTashroNyaH kampamAnaiH payodharaiH |
kaTAkShahAvamAdhuryaishchetobuddhimanoharAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato devAH sagandharvAH samAdAyArghyamuttamam |
shakrasya matamAj~nAya pArthamAnarchura~njasA
shlokas.2:
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha pratigrAhya nRRipAtmajam |
praveshayAmAsuratho pura.ndaraniveshanam
shlokas.3:
evaM sampUjito jiShNuruvAsa bhavane pituH |
upashikShanmahAstrANi sasaMhArANi pANDavaH
shlokas.4:
shakrasya hastAddayitaM vajramastraM durutsaham |
ashanIshcha mahAnAdA meghabarhiNalakShaNAH
shlokas.5:
gRRihItAstrastu kaunteyo bhrAtR^InsasmAra pANDavaH |
pura.ndaraniyogAchcha pa~nchAbdamavasatsukhI
shlokas.6:
tataH shakro.abravItpArthaM kRRitAstraM kAla Agate |
nRRittaM gItaM cha kaunteya chitrasenAdavApnuhi
shlokas.7:
vAditraM devavihitaM nRRiloke yanna vidyate |
tadarjayasva kaunteya shreyo vai te bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
sakhAyaM pradadau chAsya chitrasenaM pura.ndaraH |
sa tena saha sa~Ngamya reme pArtho nirAmayaH
shlokas.9:
kadAchidaTamAnastu maharShiruta lomashaH |
jagAma shakrabhavanaM pura.ndaradidRRikShayA
shlokas.10:
sa sametya namaskRRitya devarAjaM mahAmuniH |
dadarshArdhAsanagataM pANDavaM vAsavasya ha
shlokas.11:
tataH shakrAbhyanuj~nAta Asane viShTarottare |
niShasAda dvijashreShThaH pUjyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.12:
tasya dRRiShTvAbhavadbuddhiH pArthamindrAsane sthitam |
kathaM nu kShatriyaH pArthaH shakrAsanamavAptavAn
shlokas.13:
kiM tvasya sukRRitaM karma lokA vA ke vinirjitAH |
ya evamupasamprAptaH sthAnaM devanamaskRRitam
shlokas.14:
tasya vij~nAya sa~NkalpaM shakro vRRitraniShUdanaH |
lomashaM prahasanvAkyamidamAha shachIpatiH
shlokas.15:
brahmarShe shrUyatAM yatte manasaitadvivakShitam |
nAyaM kevalamartyo vai kShatriyatvamupAgataH
shlokas.16:
maharShe mama putro.ayaM kuntyAM jAto mahAbhujaH |
astrahetoriha prAptaH kasmAchchitkAraNAntarAt
shlokas.17:
aho nainaM bhavAnvetti purANamRRiShisattamam |
shRRiNu me vadato brahmanyo.ayaM yachchAsya kAraNam
shlokas.18:
naranArAyaNau yau tau purANAvRRiShisattamau |
tAvimAvabhijAnIhi hRRiShIkeshadhana~njayau
shlokas.19:
yanna shakyaM surairdraShTumRRiShibhirvA mahAtmabhiH |
tadAshramapadaM puNyaM badarI nAma vishrutam
shlokas.20:
sa nivAso.abhavadvipra viShNorjiShNostathaiva cha |
yataH pravavRRite ga~NgA siddhachAraNasevitA
shlokas.21:
tau manniyogAdbrahmarShe kShitau jAtau mahAdyutI |
bhUmerbhArAvataraNaM mahAvIryau kariShyataH
shlokas.22:
udvRRittA hyasurAH kechinnivAtakavachA iti |
vipriyeShu sthitAsmAkaM varadAnena mohitAH
shlokas.23:
tarkayante surAnhantuM baladarpasamanvitAH |
devAnna gaNayante cha tathA dattavarA hi te
shlokas.24:
pAtAlavAsino raudrA danoH putrA mahAbalAH |
sarve devanikAyA hi nAlaM yodhayituM sma tAn
shlokas.25:
yo.asau bhUmigataH shrImAnviShNurmadhuniShUdanaH |
kapilo nAma devo.asau bhagavAnajito hariH
shlokas.26:
yena pUrvaM mahAtmAnaH khanamAnA rasAtalam |
darshanAdeva nihatAH sagarasyAtmajA vibho
shlokas.27:
tena kAryaM mahatkAryamasmAkaM dvijasattama |
pArthena cha mahAyuddhe sametAbhyAmasa.nshayam
shlokas.28:
ayaM teShAM samastAnAM shaktaH pratisamAsane |
tAnnihatya raNe shUraH punaryAsyati mAnuShAn
shlokas.29:
bhavA.nshchAsmanniyogena yAtu tAvanmahItalam |
kAmyake drakShyase vIraM nivasantaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.30:
sa vAchyo mama sa.ndeshAddharmAtmA satyasa~NgaraH |
notkaNThA phalgune kAryA kRRitAstraH shIghrameShyati
shlokas.31:
nAshuddhabAhuvIryeNa nAkRRitAstreNa vA raNe |
bhIShmadroNAdayo yuddhe shakyAH pratisamAsitum
shlokas.32:
gRRihItAstro guDAkesho mahAbAhurmahAmanAH |
nRRittavAditragItAnAM divyAnAM pArameyivAn
shlokas.33:
bhavAnapi viviktAni tIrthAni manujeshvara |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvairdraShTumarhatyari.ndama
shlokas.34:
tIrtheShvAplutya puNyeShu vipApmA vigatajvaraH |
rAjyaM bhokShyasi rAjendra sukhI vigatakalmaShaH
shlokas.35:
bhavA.nshchainaM dvijashreShTha paryaTantaM mahItale |
trAtumarhati viprAgrya tapobalasamanvitaH
shlokas.36:
giridurgeShu hi sadA desheShu viShameShu cha |
vasanti rAkShasA raudrAstebhyo rakShetsadA bhavAn
shlokas.37:
sa tatheti pratij~nAya lomashaH sumahAtapAH |
kAmyakaM vanamuddishya samupAyAnmahItalam
shlokas.38:
dadarsha tatra kaunteyaM dharmarAjamari.ndamam |
tApasairbhrAtRRibhishchaiva sarvataH parivAritam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
atyadbhutamidaM karma pArthasyAmitatejasaH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahAtejAH shrutvA vipra kimabravIt
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shakralokagataM pArthaM shrutvA rAjAmbikAsutaH |
dvaipAyanAdRRiShishreShThAtsa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
shrutaM me sUta kArtsnyena karma pArthasya dhImataH |
kachchittavApi viditaM yathAtathyena sArathe
shlokas.4:
pramatto grAmyadharmeShu mandAtmA pApanishchayaH |
mama putraH sudurbuddhiH pRRithivIM ghAtayiShyati
shlokas.5:
yasya nityamRRitA vAchaH svaireShvapi mahAtmanaH |
trailokyamapi tasya syAdyoddhA yasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.6:
asyataH karNinArAchA.nstIkShNAgrA.nshcha shilAshitAn |
ko.arjunasyAgratastiShThedapi mRRityurjarAtigaH
shlokas.7:
mama putrA durAtmAnaH sarve mRRityuvashaM gatAH |
yeShAM yuddhaM durAdharShaiH pANDavaiH pratyupasthitam
shlokas.8:
tasyaiva cha na pashyAmi yudhi gANDIvadhanvanaH |
anishaM chintayAno.api ya enamudiyAdrathI
shlokas.9:
droNakarNau pratIyAtAM yadi bhIShmo.api vA raNe |
mahAnsyAtsa.nshayo loke na tu pashyAmi no jayam
shlokas.10:
ghRRiNI karNaH pramAdI cha AchAryaH sthaviro guruH |
amarShI balavAnpArthaH sa.nrambhI dRRiDhavikramaH
shlokas.11:
bhavetsutumulaM yuddhaM sarvasho.apyaparAjitam |
sarve hyastravidaH shUrAH sarve prAptA mahadyashaH
shlokas.12:
api sarveshvaratvaM hi na vA~nCheranparAjitAH |
vadhe nUnaM bhavechChAntisteShAM vA phalgunasya vA
shlokas.13:
na tu hantArjunasyAsti jetA vAsya na vidyate |
manyustasya kathaM shAmyenmandAnprati samutthitaH
shlokas.14:
tridasheshasamo vIraH khANDave.agnimatarpayat |
jigAya pArthivAnsarvAnrAjasUye mahAkratau
shlokas.15:
sheShaM kuryAdgirervajraM nipatanmUrdhni sa~njaya |
na tu kuryuH sharAH sheShamastAstAta kirITinA
shlokas.16:
yathA hi kiraNA bhAnostapantIha charAcharam |
tathA pArthabhujotsRRiShTAH sharAstapsyanti me sutAn
shlokas.17:
api vA rathaghoSheNa bhayArtA savyasAchinaH |
pratibhAti vidIrNeva sarvato bhAratI chamUH
shlokas.18:
yadudvapanpravapa.nshchaiva bANA;nsthAtAtatAyI samare kirITI |
sRRiShTo.antakaH sarvaharo vidhAtrA; bhavedyathA tadvadapAraNIyaH
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yadetatkathitaM rAja.nstvayA duryodhanaM prati |
sarvametadyathAttha tvaM naitanmithyA mahIpate
shlokas.20:
manyunA hi samAviShTAH pANDavAste.amitaujasaH |
dRRiShTvA kRRiShNAM sabhAM nItAM dharmapatnIM yashasvinIm
shlokas.21:
duHshAsanasya tA vAchaH shrutvA te dAruNodayAH |
karNasya cha mahArAja na svapsyantIti me matiH
shlokas.22:
shrutaM hi te mahArAja yathA pArthena sa.nyuge |
ekAdashatanuH sthANurdhanuShA paritoShitaH
shlokas.23:
kairAtaM veShamAsthAya yodhayAmAsa phalgunam |
jij~nAsuH sarvadeveshaH kapardI bhagavAnsvayam
shlokas.24:
tatrainaM lokapAlAste darshayAmAsurarjunam |
astrahetoH parAkrAntaM tapasA kauravarShabham
shlokas.25:
naitadutsahate.anyo hi labdhumanyatra phalgunAt |
sAkShAddarshanameteShAmIshvarANAM naro bhuvi
shlokas.26:
maheshvareNa yo rAjanna jIrNo grastamUrtimAn |
kastamutsahate vIraM yuddhe jarayituM pumAn
shlokas.27:
AsAditamidaM ghoraM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
draupadIM parikarShadbhiH kopayadbhishcha pANDavAn
shlokas.28:
yatra visphuramANoShTho bhImaH prAha vacho mahat |
dRRiShTvA duryodhanenorU draupadyA darshitAvubhau
shlokas.29:
UrU bhetsyAmi te pApa gadayA vajrakalpayA |
trayodashAnAM varShANAmante durdyUtadevinaH
shlokas.30:
sarve praharatAM shreShThAH sarve chAmitatejasaH |
sarve sarvAstravidvA.nso devairapi sudurjayAH
shlokas.31:
manye manyusamuddhUtAH putrANAM tava sa.nyuge |
antaM pArthAH kariShyanti vIryAmarShasamanvitAH
shlokas.32:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kiM kRRitaM sUta karNena vadatA paruShaM vachaH |
paryAptaM vairametAvadyatkRRiShNA sA sabhAM gatA
shlokas.33:
apIdAnIM mama sutAstiShTheranmandachetasaH |
yeShAM bhrAtA gururjyeShTho vinaye nAvatiShThate
shlokas.34:
mamApi vachanaM sUta na shushrUShati mandabhAk |
dRRiShTvA mAM chakShuShA hInaM nirvicheShTamachetanam
shlokas.35:
ye chAsya sachivA mandAH karNasaubalakAdayaH |
te.apyasya bhUyaso doShAnvardhayanti vichetasaH
shlokas.36:
svairamuktA api sharAH pArthenAmitatejasA |
nirdaheyurmama sutAnkiM punarmanyuneritAH
shlokas.37:
pArthabAhubalotsRRiShTA mahAchApaviniHsRRitAH |
divyAstramantramuditAH sAdayeyuH surAnapi
shlokas.38:
yasya mantrI cha goptA cha suhRRichchaiva janArdanaH |
haristrailokyanAthaH sa kiM nu tasya na nirjitam
shlokas.39:
idaM cha sumahachchitramarjunasyeha sa~njaya |
mahAdevena bAhubhyAM yatsameta iti shrutiH
shlokas.40:
pratyakShaM sarvalokasya khANDave yatkRRitaM purA |
phalgunena sahAyArthe vahnerdAmodareNa cha
shlokas.41:
sarvathA nAsti me putraH sAmAtyaH sahabAndhavaH |
kruddhe pArthe cha bhIme cha vAsudeve cha sAtvate

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yadidaM shochitaM rAj~nA dhRRitarAShTreNa vai mune |
pravrAjya pANDavAnvIrAnsarvametannirarthakam
shlokas.2:
kathaM hi rAjA putraM svamupekShetAlpachetasam |
duryodhanaM pANDuputrAnkopayAnaM mahArathAn
shlokas.3:
kimAsItpANDuputrANAM vane bhojanamuchyatAm |
vAneyamatha vA kRRiShTametadAkhyAtu me bhavAn
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vAneyaM cha mRRigA.nshchaiva shuddhairbANairnipAtitAn |
brAhmaNAnAM nivedyAgramabhu~njanpuruSharShabhAH
shlokas.5:
tA.nstu shUrAnmaheShvAsA.nstadA nivasato vane |
anvayurbrAhmaNA rAjansAgnayo.anagnayastathA
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNAnAM sahasrANi snAtakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
dasha mokShavidAM tadvadyAnbibharti yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.7:
rurUnkRRiShNamRRigA.nshchaiva medhyA.nshchAnyAnvanecharAn |
bANairunmathya vidhivadbrAhmaNebhyo nyavedayat
shlokas.8:
na tatra kashchiddurvarNo vyAdhito vApyadRRishyata |
kRRisho vA durbalo vApi dIno bhIto.api vA naraH
shlokas.9:
putrAniva priyA~nj~nAtInbhrAtR^Iniva sahodarAn |
pupoSha kauravashreShTho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
patI.nshcha draupadI sarvAndvijA.nshchaiva yashasvinI |
mAteva bhojayitvAgre shiShTamAhArayattadA
shlokas.11:
prAchIM rAjA dakShiNAM bhImaseno; yamau pratIchImatha vApyudIchIm |
dhanurdharA mA.nsahetormRRigANAM; kShayaM chakrurnityamevopagamya
shlokas.12:
tathA teShAM vasatAM kAmyake vai; vihInAnAmarjunenotsukAnAm |
pa~nchaiva varShANi tadA vyatIyu;radhIyatAM japatAM juhvatAM cha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sudIrghamuShNaM niHshvasya dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
abravItsa~njayaM sUtamAmantrya bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
devaputrau mahAbhAgau devarAjasamadyutI |
nakulaH sahadevashcha pANDavau yuddhadurmadau
shlokas.3:
dRRiDhAyudhau dUrapAtau yuddhe cha kRRitanishchayau |
shIghrahastau dRRiDhakrodhau nityayuktau tarasvinau
shlokas.4:
bhImArjunau purodhAya yadA tau raNamUrdhani |
sthAsyete siMhavikrAntAvashvinAviva duHsahau
na sheShamiha pashyAmi tadA sainyasya sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
tau hyapratirathau yuddhe devaputrau mahArathau |
draupadyAstaM parikleshaM na kSha.nsyete tvamarShiNau
shlokas.6:
vRRiShNayo vA maheShvAsA pA~nchAlA vA mahaujasaH |
yudhi satyAbhisandhena vAsudevena rakShitAH
pradhakShyanti raNe pArthAH putrANAM mama vAhinIm
shlokas.7:
rAmakRRiShNapraNItAnAM vRRiShNInAM sUtanandana |
na shakyaH sahituM vegaH parvatairapi sa.nyuge
shlokas.8:
teShAM madhye maheShvAso bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
shaikyayA vIraghAtinyA gadayA vichariShyati
shlokas.9:
tathA gANDIvanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
gadAvegaM cha bhImasya nAlaM soDhuM narAdhipAH
shlokas.10:
tato.ahaM suhRRidAM vAcho duryodhanavashAnugaH |
smaraNIyAH smariShyAmi mayA yA na kRRitAH purA
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyatikramo.ayaM sumahA.nstvayA rAjannupekShitaH |
samarthenApi yanmohAtputraste na nivAritaH
shlokas.12:
shrutvA hi nirjitAndyUte pANDavAnmadhusUdanaH |
tvaritaH kAmyake pArthAnsamabhAvayadachyutaH
shlokas.13:
drupadasya tathA putrA dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
virATo dhRRiShTaketushcha kekayAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.14:
taishcha yatkathitaM tatra dRRiShTvA pArthAnparAjitAn |
chAreNa viditaM sarvaM tanmayA veditaM cha te
shlokas.15:
samAgamya vRRitastatra pANDavairmadhusUdanaH |
sArathye phalgunasyAjau tathetyAha cha tAnhariH
shlokas.16:
amarShito hi kRRiShNo.api dRRiShTvA pArthA.nstathAgatAn |
kRRiShNAjinottarAsa~NgAnabravIchcha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.17:
yA sA samRRiddhiH pArthAnAmindraprasthe babhUva ha |
rAjasUye mayA dRRiShTA nRRipairanyaiH sudurlabhA
shlokas.18:
yatra sarvAnmahIpAlA~nshastratejobhayArditAn |
sava~NgA~NgAnsapauNDroDrAnsacholadraviDAndhakAn
shlokas.19:
sAgarAnUpagA.nshchaiva ye cha pattanavAsinaH |
siMhalAnbarbarAnmlechChAnye cha jA~NgalavAsinaH
shlokas.20:
pashchimAni cha rAjyAni shatashaH sAgarAntikAn |
pahlavAndaradAnsarvAnkirAtAnyavanA~nshakAn
shlokas.21:
hArahUNA.nshcha chInA.nshcha tukhArAnsaindhavA.nstathA |
jAguDAnramaThAnmuNDAnstrIrAjyAnatha ta~NgaNAn
shlokas.22:
ete chAnye cha bahavo ye cha te bharatarShabha |
AgatAnahamadrAkShaM yaj~ne te pariveShakAn
shlokas.23:
sA te samRRiddhiryairAttA chapalA pratisAriNI |
AdAya jIvitaM teShAmAhariShyAmi tAmaham
shlokas.24:
rAmeNa saha kauravya bhImArjunayamaistathA |
akrUragadasAmbaishcha pradyumnenAhukena cha
dhRRiShTadyumnena vIreNa shishupAlAtmajena cha
shlokas.25:
duryodhanaM raNe hatvA sadyaH karNaM cha bhArata |
duHshAsanaM saubaleyaM yashchAnyaH pratiyotsyate
shlokas.26:
tatastvaM hAstinapure bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vasan |
dhArtarAShTrIM shriyaM prApya prashAdhi pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.27:
athainamabravIdrAjA tasminvIrasamAgame |
shRRiNvatsu teShu sarveShu dhRRiShTadyumnamukheShu cha
shlokas.28:
pratigRRihNAmi te vAchaM satyAmetAM janArdana |
amitrAnme mahAbAho sAnubandhAnhaniShyasi
shlokas.29:
varShAttrayodashAdUrdhvaM satyaM mAM kuru keshava |
pratij~nAto vane vAso rAjamadhye mayA hyayam
shlokas.30:
taddharmarAjavachanaM pratishrutya sabhAsadaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnapurogAste shamayAmAsura~njasA
keshavaM madhurairvAkyaiH kAlayuktairamarShitam
shlokas.31:
pA~nchAlIM chAhurakliShTAM vAsudevasya shRRiNvataH |
duryodhanastava krodhAddevi tyakShyati jIvitam
pratijAnIma te satyaM mA shucho varavarNini
shlokas.32:
ye sma te kupitAM kRRiShNe dRRiShTvA tvAM prAhasa.nstadA |
mA.nsAni teShAM khAdanto hasiShyanti mRRigadvijAH
shlokas.33:
pAsyanti rudhiraM teShAM gRRidhrA gomAyavastathA |
uttamA~NgAni karShanto yaistvaM kRRiShTA sabhAtale
shlokas.34:
teShAM drakShyasi pA~nchAli gAtrANi pRRithivItale |
kravyAdaiH kRRiShyamANAni bhakShyamANAni chAsakRRit
shlokas.35:
parikliShTAsi yaistatra yaishchApi samupekShitA |
teShAmutkRRittashirasAM bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.36:
evaM bahuvidhA vAchastadochuH puruSharShabhAH |
sarve tejasvinaH shUrAH sarve chAhatalakShaNAH
shlokas.37:
te dharmarAjena vRRitA varShAdUrdhvaM trayodashAt |
puraskRRityopayAsyanti vAsudevaM mahArathAH
shlokas.38:
rAmashcha kRRiShNashcha dhana~njayashcha; pradyumnasAmbau yuyudhAnabhImau |
mAdrIsutau kekayarAjaputrAH; pA~nchAlaputrAH saha dharmarAj~nA
shlokas.39:
etAnsarvA.NllokavIrAnajeyA;nmahAtmanaH sAnubandhAnsasainyAn |
ko jIvitArthI samare pratyudIyA;tkruddhAnsiMhAnkesariNo yathaiva
shlokas.40:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yanmAbravIdviduro dyUtakAle; tvaM pANDavA~njeShyasi chennarendra |
dhruvaM kurUNAmayamantakAlo; mahAbhayo bhavitA shoNitaughaH
shlokas.41:
manye tathA tadbhaviteti sUta; yathA kShattA prAha vachaH purA mAm |
asa.nshayaM bhavitA yuddhameta;dgate kAle pANDavAnAM yathoktam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
astrahetorgate pArthe shakralokaM mahAtmani |
yudhiShThiraprabhRRitayaH kimakurvanta pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
astrahetorgate pArthe shakralokaM mahAtmani |
nyavasankRRiShNayA sArdhaM kAmyake puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.3:
tataH kadAchidekAnte vivikta iva shAdvale |
duHkhArtA bharatashreShThA niSheduH saha kRRiShNayA
dhana~njayaM shochamAnAH sAshrukaNThAH suduHkhitAH
shlokas.4:
tadviyogAddhi tAnsarvA~nshokaH samabhipupluve |
dhana~njayaviyogAchcha rAjyanAshAchcha duHkhitAH
shlokas.5:
atha bhImo mahAbAhuryudhiShThiramabhAShata |
nideshAtte mahArAja gato.asau puruSharShabhaH
arjunaH pANDuputrANAM yasminprANAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.6:
yasminvinaShTe pA~nchAlAH saha putraistathA vayam |
sAtyakirvAsudevashcha vinashyeyurasa.nshayam
shlokas.7:
yo.asau gachChati tejasvI bahUnkleshAnachintayan |
bhavanniyogAdbIbhatsustato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.8:
yasya bAhU samAshritya vayaM sarve mahAtmanaH |
manyAmahe jitAnAjau parAnprAptAM cha medinIm
shlokas.9:
yasya prabhAvAnna mayA sabhAmadhye dhanuShmataH |
nItA lokamamuM sarve dhArtarAShTrAH sasaubalAH
shlokas.10:
te vayaM bAhubalinaH krodhamutthitamAtmanaH |
sahAmahe bhavanmUlaM vAsudevena pAlitAH
shlokas.11:
vayaM hi saha kRRiShNena hatvA karNamukhAnparAn |
svabAhuvijitAM kRRitsnAM prashAsema vasundharAm
shlokas.12:
bhavato dyUtadoSheNa sarve vayamupaplutAH |
ahInapauruShA rAjanbalibhirbalavattamAH
shlokas.13:
kShAtraM dharmaM mahArAja samavekShitumarhasi |
na hi dharmo mahArAja kShatriyasya vanAshrayaH
rAjyameva paraM dharmaM kShatriyasya vidurbudhAH
shlokas.14:
sa kShatradharmavidrAjanmA dharmyAnnInashaH pathaH |
prAgdvAdasha samA rAjandhArtarAShTrAnnihanmahi
shlokas.15:
nivartya cha vanAtpArthamAnAyya cha janArdanam |
vyUDhAnIkAnmahArAja javenaiva mahAhave
dhArtarAShTrAnamuM lokaM gamayAmi vishAM pate
shlokas.16:
sarvAnahaM haniShyAmi dhArtarAShTrAnsasaubalAn |
duryodhanaM cha karNaM cha yo vAnyaH pratiyotsyate
shlokas.17:
mayA prashamite pashchAttvameShyasi vanAtpunaH |
evaM kRRite na te doSho bhaviShyati vishAM pate
shlokas.18:
yaj~naishcha vividhaistAta kRRitaM pApamari.ndama |
avadhUya mahArAja gachChema svargamuttamam
shlokas.19:
evametadbhavedrAjanyadi rAjA na bAlishaH |
asmAkaM dIrghasUtraH syAdbhavAndharmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.20:
nikRRityA nikRRitipraj~nA hantavyA iti nishchayaH |
na hi naikRRitikaM hatvA nikRRityA pApamuchyate
shlokas.21:
tathA bhArata dharmeShu dharmaj~nairiha dRRishyate |
ahorAtraM mahArAja tulyaM sa.nvatsareNa hi
shlokas.22:
tathaiva vedavachanaM shrUyate nityadA vibho |
sa.nvatsaro mahArAja pUrNo bhavati kRRichChrataH
shlokas.23:
yadi vedAH pramANaM te divasAdUrdhvamachyuta |
trayodasha samAH kAlo j~nAyatAM pariniShThitaH
shlokas.24:
kAlo duryodhanaM hantuM sAnubandhamari.ndama |
ekAgrAM pRRithivIM sarvAM purA rAjankaroti saH
shlokas.25:
evaM bruvANaM bhImaM tu dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha sAntvayanrAjA mUrdhnyupAghrAya pANDavam
shlokas.26:
asa.nshayaM mahAbAho haniShyasi suyodhanam |
varShAttrayodashAdUrdhvaM saha gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.27:
yachcha mA bhAShase pArtha prAptaH kAla iti prabho |
anRRitaM notsahe vaktuM na hyetanmayi vidyate
shlokas.28:
antareNApi kaunteya nikRRitiM pApanishchayam |
hantA tvamasi durdharSha sAnubandhaM suyodhanam
shlokas.29:
evaM bruvati bhImaM tu dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
AjagAma mahAbhAgo bRRihadashvo mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.30:
tamabhiprekShya dharmAtmA samprAptaM dharmachAriNam |
shAstravanmadhuparkeNa pUjayAmAsa dharmarAT
shlokas.31:
AshvastaM chainamAsInamupAsIno yudhiShThiraH |
abhiprekShya mahAbAhuH kRRipaNaM bahvabhAShata
shlokas.32:
akShadyUtena bhagavandhanaM rAjyaM cha me hRRitam |
AhUya nikRRitipraj~naiH kitavairakShakovidaiH
shlokas.33:
anakShaj~nasya hi sato nikRRityA pApanishchayaiH |
bhAryA cha me sabhAM nItA prANebhyo.api garIyasI
shlokas.34:
asti rAjA mayA kashchidalpabhAgyataro bhuvi |
bhavatA dRRiShTapUrvo vA shrutapUrvo.api vA bhavet
na matto duHkhitataraH pumAnastIti me matiH
shlokas.35:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
yadbravIShi mahArAja na matto vidyate kvachit |
alpabhAgyataraH kashchitpumAnastIti pANDava
shlokas.36:
atra te kathayiShyAmi yadi shushrUShase.anagha |
yastvatto duHkhitataro rAjAsItpRRithivIpate
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athainamabravIdrAjA bravItu bhagavAniti |
imAmavasthAM samprAptaM shrotumichChAmi pArthivam
shlokas.38:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahitaH saha bhrAtRRibhirachyuta |
yastvatto duHkhitataro rAjAsItpRRithivIpate
shlokas.39:
niShadheShu mahIpAlo vIrasena iti sma ha |
tasya putro.abhavannAmnA nalo dharmArthadarshivAn
shlokas.40:
sa nikRRityA jito rAjA puShkareNeti naH shrutam |
vanavAsamaduHkhArho bhAryayA nyavasatsaha
shlokas.41:
na tasyAshvo na cha ratho na bhrAtA na cha bAndhavAH |
vane nivasato rAja~nshiShyante sma kadAchana
shlokas.42:
bhavAnhi sa.nvRRito vIrairbhrAtRRibhirdevasaMmitaiH |
brahmakalpairdvijAgryaishcha tasmAnnArhasi shochitum
shlokas.43:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vistareNAhamichChAmi nalasya sumahAtmanaH |
charitaM vadatAM shreShTha tanmamAkhyAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
AsIdrAjA nalo nAma vIrasenasuto balI |
upapanno guNairiShTai rUpavAnashvakovidaH
shlokas.2:
atiShThanmanujendrANAM mUrdhni devapatiryathA |
uparyupari sarveShAmAditya iva tejasA
shlokas.3:
brahmaNyo vedavichChUro niShadheShu mahIpatiH |
akShapriyaH satyavAdI mahAnakShauhiNIpatiH
shlokas.4:
Ipsito varanArINAmudAraH sa.nyatendriyaH |
rakShitA dhanvinAM shreShThaH sAkShAdiva manuH svayam
shlokas.5:
tathaivAsIdvidarbheShu bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
shUraH sarvaguNairyuktaH prajAkAmaH sa chAprajaH
shlokas.6:
sa prajArthe paraM yatnamakarotsusamAhitaH |
tamabhyagachChadbrahmarShirdamano nAma bhArata
shlokas.7:
taM sa bhImaH prajAkAmastoShayAmAsa dharmavit |
mahiShyA saha rAjendra satkAreNa suvarchasam
shlokas.8:
tasmai prasanno damanaH sabhAryAya varaM dadau |
kanyAratnaM kumArA.nshcha trInudArAnmahAyashAH
shlokas.9:
damayantIM damaM dAntaM damanaM cha suvarchasam |
upapannAnguNaiH sarvairbhImAnbhImaparAkramAn
shlokas.10:
damayantI tu rUpeNa tejasA yashasA shriyA |
saubhAgyena cha lokeShu yashaH prApa sumadhyamA
shlokas.11:
atha tAM vayasi prApte dAsInAM samala~NkRRitam |
shataM sakhInAM cha tathA paryupAste shachImiva
shlokas.12:
tatra sma bhrAjate bhaimI sarvAbharaNabhUShitA |
sakhImadhye.anavadyA~NgI vidyutsaudAminI yathA
atIva rUpasampannA shrIrivAyatalochanA
shlokas.13:
na deveShu na yakSheShu tAdRRigrUpavatI kvachit |
mAnuSheShvapi chAnyeShu dRRiShTapUrvA na cha shrutA
chittapramAthinI bAlA devAnAmapi sundarI
shlokas.14:
nalashcha narashArdUlo rUpeNApratimo bhuvi |
kandarpa iva rUpeNa mUrtimAnabhavatsvayam
shlokas.15:
tasyAH samIpe tu nalaM prashasha.nsuH kutUhalAt |
naiShadhasya samIpe tu damayantIM punaH punaH
shlokas.16:
tayoradRRiShTakAmo.abhUchChRRiNvatoH satataM guNAn |
anyonyaM prati kaunteya sa vyavardhata hRRichChayaH
shlokas.17:
ashaknuvannalaH kAmaM tadA dhArayituM hRRidA |
antaHpurasamIpasthe vana Aste rahogataH
shlokas.18:
sa dadarsha tadA ha.nsA~njAtarUpaparichChadAn |
vane vicharatAM teShAmekaM jagrAha pakShiNam
shlokas.19:
tato.antarikShago vAchaM vyAjahAra tadA nalam |
na hantavyo.asmi te rAjankariShyAmi hi te priyam
shlokas.20:
damayantIsakAshe tvAM kathayiShyAmi naiShadha |
yathA tvadanyaM puruShaM na sA ma.nsyati karhichit
shlokas.21:
evamuktastato ha.nsamutsasarja mahIpatiH |
te tu ha.nsAH samutpatya vidarbhAnagama.nstataH
shlokas.22:
vidarbhanagarIM gatvA damayantyAstadAntike |
nipetuste garutmantaH sA dadarshAtha tAnkhagAn
shlokas.23:
sA tAnadbhutarUpAnvai dRRiShTvA sakhigaNAvRRitA |
hRRiShTA grahItuM khagamA.nstvaramANopachakrame
shlokas.24:
atha ha.nsA visasRRipuH sarvataH pramadAvane |
ekaikashastataH kanyAstAnha.nsAnsamupAdravan
shlokas.25:
damayantI tu yaM ha.nsaM samupAdhAvadantike |
sa mAnuShIM giraM kRRitvA damayantImathAbravIt
shlokas.26:
damayanti nalo nAma niShadheShu mahIpatiH |
ashvinoH sadRRisho rUpe na samAstasya mAnuShAH
shlokas.27:
tasya vai yadi bhAryA tvaM bhavethA varavarNini |
saphalaM te bhavejjanma rUpaM chedaM sumadhyame
shlokas.28:
vayaM hi devagandharvamanuShyoragarAkShasAn |
dRRiShTavanto na chAsmAbhirdRRiShTapUrvastathAvidhaH
shlokas.29:
tvaM chApi ratnaM nArINAM nareShu cha nalo varaH |
vishiShTAyA vishiShTena sa~Ngamo guNavAnbhavet
shlokas.30:
evamuktA tu ha.nsena damayantI vishAM pate |
abravIttatra taM ha.nsaM tamapyevaM nalaM vada
shlokas.31:
tathetyuktvANDajaH kanyAM vaidarbhasya vishAM pate |
punarAgamya niShadhAnnale sarvaM nyavedayat

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
damayantI tu tachChrutvA vacho ha.nsasya bhArata |
tadA prabhRRiti nasvasthA nalaM prati babhUva sA
shlokas.2:
tatashchintAparA dInA vivarNavadanA kRRishA |
babhUva damayantI tu niHshvAsaparamA tadA
shlokas.3:
UrdhvadRRiShTirdhyAnaparA babhUvonmattadarshanA |
na shayyAsanabhogeShu ratiM vindati karhichit
shlokas.4:
na naktaM na divA shete hA heti vadatI muhuH |
tAmasvasthAM tadAkArAM sakhyastA jaj~nuri~NgitaiH
shlokas.5:
tato vidarbhapataye damayantyAH sakhIgaNaH |
nyavedayata nasvasthAM damayantIM nareshvara
shlokas.6:
tachChrutvA nRRipatirbhImo damayantIsakhIgaNAt |
chintayAmAsa tatkAryaM sumahatsvAM sutAM prati
shlokas.7:
sa samIkShya mahIpAlaH svAM sutAM prAptayauvanAm |
apashyadAtmanaH kAryaM damayantyAH svaya.nvaram
shlokas.8:
sa saMnipAtayAmAsa mahIpAlAnvishAM pate |
anubhUyatAmayaM vIrAH svaya.nvara iti prabho
shlokas.9:
shrutvA tu pArthivAH sarve damayantyAH svaya.nvaram |
abhijagmustadA bhImaM rAjAno bhImashAsanAt
shlokas.10:
hastyashvarathaghoSheNa nAdayanto vasundharAm |
vichitramAlyAbharaNairbalairdRRishyaiH svala~NkRRitaiH
shlokas.11:
etasminneva kAle tu purANAvRRiShisattamau |
aTamAnau mahAtmAnAvindralokamito gatau
shlokas.12:
nAradaH parvatashchaiva mahAtmAnau mahAvratau |
devarAjasya bhavanaM vivishAte supUjitau
shlokas.13:
tAvarchitvA sahasrAkShastataH kushalamavyayam |
paprachChAnAmayaM chApi tayoH sarvagataM vibhuH
shlokas.14:
nArada uvAcha||
AvayoH kushalaM deva sarvatragatamIshvara |
loke cha maghavankRRitsne nRRipAH kushalino vibho
shlokas.15:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA paprachCha balavRRitrahA |
dharmaj~nAH pRRithivIpAlAstyaktajIvitayodhinaH
shlokas.16:
shastreNa nidhanaM kAle ye gachChantyaparA~NmukhAH |
ayaM loko.akShayasteShAM yathaiva mama kAmadhuk
shlokas.17:
kva nu te kShatriyAH shUrA na hi pashyAmi tAnaham |
AgachChato mahIpAlAnatithIndayitAnmama
shlokas.18:
evamuktastu shakreNa nAradaH pratyabhAShata |
shRRiNu me bhagavanyena na dRRishyante mahIkShitaH
shlokas.19:
vidarbharAjaduhitA damayantIti vishrutA |
rUpeNa samatikrAntA pRRithivyAM sarvayoShitaH
shlokas.20:
tasyAH svaya.nvaraH shakra bhavitA nachirAdiva |
tatra gachChanti rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
tAM ratnabhUtAM lokasya prArthayanto mahIkShitaH |
kA~NkShanti sma visheSheNa balavRRitraniShUdana
shlokas.22:
etasminkathyamAne tu lokapAlAshcha sAgnikAH |
AjagmurdevarAjasya samIpamamarottamAH
shlokas.23:
tatastachChushruvuH sarve nAradasya vacho mahat |
shrutvA chaivAbruvanhRRiShTA gachChAmo vayamapyuta
shlokas.24:
tataH sarve mahArAja sagaNAH sahavAhanAH |
vidarbhAnabhito jagmuryatra sarve mahIkShitaH
shlokas.25:
nalo.api rAjA kaunteya shrutvA rAj~nAM samAgamam |
abhyagachChadadInAtmA damayantImanuvrataH
shlokas.26:
atha devAH pathi nalaM dadRRishurbhUtale sthitam |
sAkShAdiva sthitaM mUrtyA manmathaM rUpasampadA
shlokas.27:
taM dRRiShTvA lokapAlAste bhrAjamAnaM yathA ravim |
tasthurvigatasa~NkalpA vismitA rUpasampadA
shlokas.28:
tato.antarikShe viShTabhya vimAnAni divaukasaH |
abruvannaiShadhaM rAjannavatIrya nabhastalAt
shlokas.29:
bho bho naiShadha rAjendra nala satyavrato bhavAn |
asmAkaM kuru sAhAyyaM dUto bhava narottama

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tebhyaH pratij~nAya nalaH kariShya iti bhArata |
athainAnparipaprachCha kRRitA~njaliravasthitaH
shlokas.2:
ke vai bhavantaH kashchAsau yasyAhaM dUta IpsitaH |
kiM cha tatra mayA kAryaM kathayadhvaM yathAtatham
shlokas.3:
evamukte naiShadhena maghavAnpratyabhAShata |
amarAnvai nibodhAsmAndamayantyarthamAgatAn
shlokas.4:
ahamindro.ayamagnishcha tathaivAyamapAmpatiH |
sharIrAntakaro nR^INAM yamo.ayamapi pArthiva
shlokas.5:
sa vai tvamAgatAnasmAndamayantyai nivedaya |
lokapAlAH sahendrAstvAM samAyAnti didRRikShavaH
shlokas.6:
prAptumichChanti devAstvAM shakro.agnirvaruNo yamaH |
teShAmanyatamaM devaM patitve varayasva ha
shlokas.7:
evamuktaH sa shakreNa nalaH prA~njalirabravIt |
ekArthasamavetaM mAM na preShayitumarhatha
shlokas.8:
devA UchuH||
kariShya iti sa.nshrutya pUrvamasmAsu naiShadha |
na kariShyasi kasmAttvaM vraja naiShadha mAchiram
shlokas.9:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa devaistairnaiShadhaH punarabravIt |
surakShitAni veshmAni praveShTuM kathamutsahe
shlokas.10:
pravekShyasIti taM shakraH punarevAbhyabhAShata |
jagAma sa tathetyuktvA damayantyA niveshanam
shlokas.11:
dadarsha tatra vaidarbhIM sakhIgaNasamAvRRitAm |
dedIpyamAnAM vapuShA shriyA cha varavarNinIm
shlokas.12:
atIva sukumArA~NgIM tanumadhyAM sulochanAm |
AkShipantImiva cha bhAH shashinaH svena tejasA
shlokas.13:
tasya dRRiShTvaiva vavRRidhe kAmastAM chAruhAsinIm |
satyaM chikIrShamANastu dhArayAmAsa hRRichChayam
shlokas.14:
tatastA naiShadhaM dRRiShTvA sambhrAntAH paramA~NganAH |
AsanebhyaH samutpetustejasA tasya dharShitAH
shlokas.15:
prashasha.nsushcha suprItA nalaM tA vismayAnvitAH |
na chainamabhyabhAShanta manobhistvabhyachintayan
shlokas.16:
aho rUpamaho kAntiraho dhairyaM mahAtmanaH |
ko.ayaM devo nu yakSho nu gandharvo nu bhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
na tvenaM shaknuvanti sma vyAhartumapi ki~nchana |
tejasA dharShitAH sarvA lajjAvatyo varA~NganAH
shlokas.18:
athainaM smayamAneva smitapUrvAbhibhAShiNI |
damayantI nalaM vIramabhyabhAShata vismitA
shlokas.19:
kastvaM sarvAnavadyA~Nga mama hRRichChayavardhana |
prApto.asyamaravadvIra j~nAtumichChAmi te.anagha
shlokas.20:
kathamAgamanaM cheha kathaM chAsi na lakShitaH |
surakShitaM hi me veshma rAjA chaivograshAsanaH
shlokas.21:
evamuktastu vaidarbhyA nalastAM pratyuvAcha ha |
nalaM mAM viddhi kalyANi devadUtamihAgatam
shlokas.22:
devAstvAM prAptumichChanti shakro.agnirvaruNo yamaH |
teShAmanyatamaM devaM patiM varaya shobhane
shlokas.23:
teShAmeva prabhAvena praviShTo.ahamalakShitaH |
pravishantaM hi mAM kashchinnApashyannApyavArayat
shlokas.24:
etadarthamahaM bhadre preShitaH surasattamaiH |
etachChrutvA shubhe buddhiM prakuruShva yathechChasi

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sA namaskRRitya devebhyaH prahasya nalamabravIt |
praNayasva yathAshraddhaM rAjankiM karavANi te
shlokas.2:
ahaM chaiva hi yachchAnyanmamAsti vasu ki~nchana |
sarvaM tattava vishrabdhaM kuru praNayamIshvara
shlokas.3:
ha.nsAnAM vachanaM yattattanmAM dahati pArthiva |
tvatkRRite hi mayA vIra rAjAnaH saMnipAtitAH
shlokas.4:
yadi chedbhajamAnAM mAM pratyAkhyAsyasi mAnada |
viShamagniM jalaM rajjumAsthAsye tava kAraNAt
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu vaidarbhyA nalastAM pratyuvAcha ha |
tiShThatsu lokapAleShu kathaM mAnuShamichChasi
shlokas.6:
yeShAmahaM lokakRRitAmIshvarANAM mahAtmanAm |
na pAdarajasA tulyo manaste teShu vartatAm
shlokas.7:
vipriyaM hyAcharanmartyo devAnAM mRRityumRRichChati |
trAhi mAmanavadyA~Ngi varayasva surottamAn
shlokas.8:
tato bAShpakalAM vAchaM damayantI shuchismitA |
pravyAharantI shanakairnalaM rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.9:
astyupAyo mayA dRRiShTo nirapAyo nareshvara |
yena doSho na bhavitA tava rAjankatha~nchana
shlokas.10:
tvaM chaiva hi narashreShTha devAshchAgnipurogamAH |
AyAntu sahitAH sarve mama yatra svaya.nvaraH
shlokas.11:
tato.ahaM lokapAlAnAM saMnidhau tvAM nareshvara |
varayiShye naravyAghra naivaM doSho bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
evamuktastu vaidarbhyA nalo rAjA vishAM pate |
AjagAma punastatra yatra devAH samAgatAH
shlokas.13:
tamapashya.nstathAyAntaM lokapAlAH saheshvarAH |
dRRiShTvA chainaM tato.apRRichChanvRRittAntaM sarvameva tat
shlokas.14:
devA UchuH||
kachchiddRRiShTA tvayA rAjandamayantI shuchismitA |
kimabravIchcha naH sarvAnvada bhUmipate.anagha
shlokas.15:
nala uvAcha||
bhavadbhirahamAdiShTo damayantyA niveshanam |
praviShTaH sumahAkakShyaM daNDibhiH sthavirairvRRitam
shlokas.16:
pravishantaM cha mAM tatra na kashchiddRRiShTavAnnaraH |
RRite tAM pArthivasutAM bhavatAmeva tejasA
shlokas.17:
sakhyashchAsyA mayA dRRiShTAstAbhishchApyupalakShitaH |
vismitAshchAbhavandRRiShTvA sarvA mAM vibudheshvarAH
shlokas.18:
varNyamAneShu cha mayA bhavatsu ruchirAnanA |
mAmeva gatasa~NkalpA vRRiNIte surasattamAH
shlokas.19:
abravIchchaiva mAM bAlA AyAntu sahitAH surAH |
tvayA saha narashreShTha mama yatra svaya.nvaraH
shlokas.20:
teShAmahaM saMnidhau tvAM varayiShye narottama |
evaM tava mahAbAho doSho na bhaviteti ha
shlokas.21:
etAvadeva vibudhA yathAvRRittamudAhRRitam |
mayAsheShaM pramANaM tu bhavantastridasheshvarAH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
atha kAle shubhe prApte tithau puNye kShaNe tathA |
AjuhAva mahIpAlAnbhImo rAjA svaya.nvare
shlokas.2:
tachChrutvA pRRithivIpAlAH sarve hRRichChayapIDitAH |
tvaritAH samupAjagmurdamayantImabhIpsavaH
shlokas.3:
kanakastambharuchiraM toraNena virAjitam |
vivishuste mahAra~NgaM nRRipAH siMhA ivAchalam
shlokas.4:
tatrAsaneShu vividheShvAsInAH pRRithivIkShitaH |
surabhisragdharAH sarve sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH
shlokas.5:
tAM rAjasamitiM pUrNAM nAgairbhogavatImiva |
sampUrNAM puruShavyAghrairvyAghrairgiriguhAmiva
shlokas.6:
tatra sma pInA dRRishyante bAhavaH parighopamAH |
AkAravantaH sushlakShNAH pa~nchashIrShA ivoragAH
shlokas.7:
sukeshAntAni chArUNi sunAsAni shubhAni cha |
mukhAni rAj~nAM shobhante nakShatrANi yathA divi
shlokas.8:
damayantI tato ra~NgaM pravivesha shubhAnanA |
muShNantI prabhayA rAj~nAM chakShUMShi cha manA.nsi cha
shlokas.9:
tasyA gAtreShu patitA teShAM dRRiShTirmahAtmanAm |
tatra tatraiva saktAbhUnna chachAla cha pashyatAm
shlokas.10:
tataH sa~NkIrtyamAneShu rAj~nAM nAmasu bhArata |
dadarsha bhaimI puruShAnpa~ncha tulyAkRRitIniva
shlokas.11:
tAnsamIkShya tataH sarvAnnirvisheShAkRRitInsthitAn |
sa.ndehAdatha vaidarbhI nAbhyajAnAnnalaM nRRipam
yaM yaM hi dadRRishe teShAM taM taM mene nalaM nRRipam
shlokas.12:
sA chintayantI buddhyAtha tarkayAmAsa bhAminI |
kathaM nu devA~njAnIyAM kathaM vidyAM nalaM nRRipam
shlokas.13:
evaM sa~nchintayantI sA vaidarbhI bhRRishaduHkhitA |
shrutAni devali~NgAni chintayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.14:
devAnAM yAni li~NgAni sthavirebhyaH shrutAni me |
tAnIha tiShThatAM bhUmAvekasyApi na lakShaye
shlokas.15:
sA vinishchitya bahudhA vichArya cha punaH punaH |
sharaNaM prati devAnAM prAptakAlamamanyata
shlokas.16:
vAchA cha manasA chaiva namaskAraM prayujya sA |
devebhyaH prA~njalirbhUtvA vepamAnedamabravIt
shlokas.17:
ha.nsAnAM vachanaM shrutvA yathA me naiShadho vRRitaH |
patitve tena satyena devAstaM pradishantu me
shlokas.18:
vAchA cha manasA chaiva yathA nAbhicharAmyaham |
tena satyena vibudhAstameva pradishantu me
shlokas.19:
yathA devaiH sa me bhartA vihito niShadhAdhipaH |
tena satyena me devAstameva pradishantu me
shlokas.20:
svaM chaiva rUpaM puShyantu lokapAlAH saheshvarAH |
yathAhamabhijAnIyAM puNyashlokaM narAdhipam
shlokas.21:
nishamya damayantyAstatkaruNaM paridevitam |
nishchayaM paramaM tathyamanurAgaM cha naiShadhe
shlokas.22:
manovishuddhiM buddhiM cha bhaktiM rAgaM cha bhArata |
yathoktaM chakrire devAH sAmarthyaM li~NgadhAraNe
shlokas.23:
sApashyadvibudhAnsarvAnasvedAnstabdhalochanAn |
hRRiShitasragrajohInAnsthitAnaspRRishataH kShitim
shlokas.24:
ChAyAdvitIyo mlAnasragrajaHsvedasamanvitaH |
bhUmiShTho naiShadhashchaiva nimeSheNa cha sUchitaH
shlokas.25:
sA samIkShya tato devAnpuNyashlokaM cha bhArata |
naiShadhaM varayAmAsa bhaimI dharmeNa bhArata
shlokas.26:
vilajjamAnA vastrAnte jagrAhAyatalochanA |
skandhadeshe.asRRijachchAsya srajaM paramashobhanAm
varayAmAsa chaivainaM patitve varavarNinI
shlokas.27:
tato hA heti sahasA shabdo mukto narAdhipaiH |
devairmaharShibhishchaiva sAdhu sAdhviti bhArata
vismitairIritaH shabdaH prasha.nsadbhirnalaM nRRipam
shlokas.28:
vRRite tu naiShadhe bhaimyA lokapAlA mahaujasaH |
prahRRiShTamanasaH sarve nalAyAShTau varAndaduH
shlokas.29:
pratyakShadarshanaM yaj~ne gatiM chAnuttamAM shubhAm |
naiShadhAya dadau shakraH prIyamANaH shachIpatiH
shlokas.30:
agnirAtmabhavaM prAdAdyatra vA~nChati naiShadhaH |
lokAnAtmaprabhA.nshchaiva dadau tasmai hutAshanaH
shlokas.31:
yamastvannarasaM prAdAddharme cha paramAM sthitim |
apAmpatirapAM bhAvaM yatra vA~nChati naiShadhaH
shlokas.32:
srajaM chottamagandhADhyAM sarve cha mithunaM daduH |
varAnevaM pradAyAsya devAste tridivaM gatAH
shlokas.33:
pArthivAshchAnubhUyAsyA vivAhaM vismayAnvitAH |
damayantyAH pramuditAH pratijagmuryathAgatam
shlokas.34:
avApya nArIratnaM tatpuNyashloko.api pArthivaH |
reme saha tayA rAjA shachyeva balavRRitrahA
shlokas.35:
atIva mudito rAjA bhrAjamAnoM.ashumAniva |
ara~njayatprajA vIro dharmeNa paripAlayan
shlokas.36:
Ije chApyashvamedhena yayAtiriva nAhuShaH |
anyaishcha kratubhirdhImAnbahubhishchAptadakShiNaiH
shlokas.37:
punashcha ramaNIyeShu vaneShUpavaneShu cha |
damayantyA saha nalo vijahArAmaropamaH
shlokas.38:
evaM sa yajamAnashcha vihara.nshcha narAdhipaH |
rarakSha vasusampUrNAM vasudhAM vasudhAdhipaH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
vRRite tu naiShadhe bhaimyA lokapAlA mahaujasaH |
yAnto dadRRishurAyAntaM dvAparaM kalinA saha
shlokas.2:
athAbravItkaliM shakraH samprekShya balavRRitrahA |
dvApareNa sahAyena kale brUhi kva yAsyasi
shlokas.3:
tato.abravItkaliH shakraM damayantyAH svaya.nvaram |
gatvAhaM varayiShye tAM mano hi mama tadgatam
shlokas.4:
tamabravItprahasyendro nirvRRittaH sa svaya.nvaraH |
vRRitastayA nalo rAjA patirasmatsamIpataH
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu shakreNa kaliH kopasamanvitaH |
devAnAmantrya tAnsarvAnuvAchedaM vachastadA
shlokas.6:
devAnAM mAnuShaM madhye yatsA patimavindata |
nanu tasyA bhavennyAyyaM vipulaM daNDadhAraNam
shlokas.7:
evamukte tu kalinA pratyUchuste divaukasaH |
asmAbhiH samanuj~nAto damayantyA nalo vRRitaH
shlokas.8:
kashcha sarvaguNopetaM nAshrayeta nalaM nRRipam |
yo veda dharmAnakhilAnyathAvachcharitavrataH
shlokas.9:
yasminsatyaM dhRRitirdAnaM tapaH shauchaM damaH shamaH |
dhruvANi puruShavyAghre lokapAlasame nRRipe
shlokas.10:
AtmAnaM sa shapenmUDho hanyAchchAtmAnamAtmanA |
eva~NguNaM nalaM yo vai kAmayechChapituM kale
shlokas.11:
kRRichChre sa narake majjedagAdhe vipule.aplave |
evamuktvA kaliM devA dvAparaM cha divaM yayuH
shlokas.12:
tato gateShu deveShu kalirdvAparamabravIt |
saMhartuM notsahe kopaM nale vatsyAmi dvApara
shlokas.13:
bhra.nshayiShyAmi taM rAjyAnna bhaimyA saha ra.nsyate |
tvamapyakShAnsamAvishya kartuM sAhAyyamarhasi

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evaM sa samayaM kRRitvA dvApareNa kaliH saha |
AjagAma tatastatra yatra rAjA sa naiShadhaH
shlokas.2:
sa nityamantaraprekShI niShadheShvavasachchiram |
athAsya dvAdashe varShe dadarsha kalirantaram
shlokas.3:
kRRitvA mUtramupaspRRishya sandhyAmAste sma naiShadhaH |
akRRitvA pAdayoH shauchaM tatrainaM kalirAvishat
shlokas.4:
sa samAvishya tu nalaM samIpaM puShkarasya ha |
gatvA puShkaramAhedamehi dIvya nalena vai
shlokas.5:
akShadyUte nalaM jetA bhavAnhi sahito mayA |
niShadhAnpratipadyasva jitvA rAjannalaM nRRipam
shlokas.6:
evamuktastu kalinA puShkaro nalamabhyayAt |
kalishchaiva vRRiSho bhUtvA gavAM puShkaramabhyayAt
shlokas.7:
AsAdya tu nalaM vIraM puShkaraH paravIrahA |
dIvyAvetyabravIdbhrAtA vRRiSheNeti muhurmuhuH
shlokas.8:
na chakShame tato rAjA samAhvAnaM mahAmanAH |
vaidarbhyAH prekShamANAyAH paNakAlamamanyata
shlokas.9:
hiraNyasya suvarNasya yAnayugyasya vAsasAm |
AviShTaH kalinA dyUte jIyate sma nalastadA
shlokas.10:
tamakShamadasaMmattaM suhRRidAM na tu kashchana |
nivAraNe.abhavachChakto dIvyamAnamachetasam
shlokas.11:
tataH paurajanaH sarvo mantribhiH saha bhArata |
rAjAnaM draShTumAgachChannivArayitumAturam
shlokas.12:
tataH sUta upAgamya damayantyai nyavedayat |
eSha paurajanaH sarvo dvAri tiShThati kAryavAn
shlokas.13:
nivedyatAM naiShadhAya sarvAH prakRRitayaH sthitAH |
amRRiShyamANA vyasanaM rAj~no dharmArthadarshinaH
shlokas.14:
tataH sA bAShpakalayA vAchA duHkhena karshitA |
uvAcha naiShadhaM bhaimI shokopahatachetanA
shlokas.15:
rAjanpaurajano dvAri tvAM didRRikShuravasthitaH |
mantribhiH sahitaH sarvai rAjabhaktipuraskRRitaH
taM draShTumarhasItyevaM punaH punarabhAShata
shlokas.16:
tAM tathA ruchirApA~NgIM vilapantIM sumadhyamAm |
AviShTaH kalinA rAjA nAbhyabhAShata ki~nchana
shlokas.17:
tataste mantriNaH sarve te chaiva puravAsinaH |
nAyamastIti duHkhArtA vrIDitA jagmurAlayAn
shlokas.18:
tathA tadabhavaddyUtaM puShkarasya nalasya cha |
yudhiShThira bahUnmAsAnpuNyashlokastvajIyata

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
damayantI tato dRRiShTvA puNyashlokaM narAdhipam |
unmattavadanunmattA devane gatachetasam
shlokas.2:
bhayashokasamAviShTA rAjanbhImasutA tataH |
chintayAmAsa tatkAryaM sumahatpArthivaM prati
shlokas.3:
sA sha~NkamAnA tatpApaM chikIrShantI cha tatpriyam |
nalaM cha hRRitasarvasvamupalabhyedamabravIt
shlokas.4:
bRRihatsene vrajAmAtyAnAnAyya nalashAsanAt |
AchakShva yaddhRRitaM dravyamavashiShTaM cha yadvasu
shlokas.5:
tataste mantriNaH sarve vij~nAya nalashAsanam |
api no bhAgadheyaM syAdityuktvA punarAvrajan
shlokas.6:
tAstu sarvAH prakRRitayo dvitIyaM samupasthitAH |
nyavedayadbhImasutA na cha tatpratyanandata
shlokas.7:
vAkyamapratinandantaM bhartAramabhivIkShya sA |
damayantI punarveshma vrIDitA pravivesha ha
shlokas.8:
nishamya satataM chAkShAnpuNyashlokaparA~NmukhAn |
nalaM cha hRRitasarvasvaM dhAtrIM punaruvAcha ha
shlokas.9:
bRRihatsene punargachCha vArShNeyaM nalashAsanAt |
sUtamAnaya kalyANi mahatkAryamupasthitam
shlokas.10:
bRRihatsenA tu tachChrutvA damayantyAH prabhAShitam |
vArShNeyamAnayAmAsa puruShairAptakAribhiH
shlokas.11:
vArShNeyaM tu tato bhaimI sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA girA |
uvAcha deshakAlaj~nA prAptakAlamaninditA
shlokas.12:
jAnIShe tvaM yathA rAjA samyagvRRittaH sadA tvayi |
tasya tvaM viShamasthasya sAhAyyaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.13:
yathA yathA hi nRRipatiH puShkareNeha jIyate |
tathA tathAsya dyUte vai rAgo bhUyo.abhivardhate
shlokas.14:
yathA cha puShkarasyAkShA vartante vashavartinaH |
tathA viparyayashchApi nalasyAkSheShu dRRishyate
shlokas.15:
suhRRitsvajanavAkyAni yathAvanna shRRiNoti cha |
nUnaM manye na sheSho.asti naiShadhasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.16:
yatra me vachanaM rAjA nAbhinandati mohitaH |
sharaNaM tvAM prapannAsmi sArathe kuru madvachaH
na hi me shudhyate bhAvaH kadAchidvinashediti
shlokas.17:
nalasya dayitAnashvAnyojayitvA mahAjavAn |
idamAropya mithunaM kuNDinaM yAtumarhasi
shlokas.18:
mama j~nAtiShu nikShipya dArakau syandanaM tathA |
ashvA.nshchaitAnyathAkAmaM vasa vAnyatra gachCha vA
shlokas.19:
damayantyAstu tadvAkyaM vArShNeyo nalasArathiH |
nyavedayadasheSheNa nalAmAtyeShu mukhyashaH
shlokas.20:
taiH sametya vinishchitya so.anuj~nAto mahIpate |
yayau mithunamAropya vidarbhA.nstena vAhinA
shlokas.21:
hayA.nstatra vinikShipya sUto rathavaraM cha tam |
indrasenAM cha tAM kanyAmindrasenaM cha bAlakam
shlokas.22:
Amantrya bhImaM rAjAnamArtaH shochannalaM nRRipam |
aTamAnastato.ayodhyAM jagAma nagarIM tadA
shlokas.23:
RRituparNaM sa rAjAnamupatasthe suduHkhitaH |
bhRRitiM chopayayau tasya sArathyena mahIpate

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tatastu yAte vArShNeye puNyashlokasya dIvyataH |
puShkareNa hRRitaM rAjyaM yachchAnyadvasu ki~nchana
shlokas.2:
hRRitarAjyaM nalaM rAjanprahasanpuShkaro.abravIt |
dyUtaM pravartatAM bhUyaH pratipANo.asti kastava
shlokas.3:
shiShTA te damayantyekA sarvamanyaddhRRitaM mayA |
damayantyAH paNaH sAdhu vartatAM yadi manyase
shlokas.4:
puShkareNaivamuktasya puNyashlokasya manyunA |
vyadIryateva hRRidayaM na chainaM ki~nchidabravIt
shlokas.5:
tataH puShkaramAlokya nalaH paramamanyumAn |
utsRRijya sarvagAtrebhyo bhUShaNAni mahAyashAH
shlokas.6:
ekavAsA asa.nvItaH suhRRichChokavivardhanaH |
nishchakrAma tadA rAjA tyaktvA suvipulAM shriyam
shlokas.7:
damayantyekavastrA taM gachChantaM pRRiShThato.anviyAt |
sa tayA bAhyataH sArdhaM trirAtraM naiShadho.avasat
shlokas.8:
puShkarastu mahArAja ghoShayAmAsa vai pure |
nale yaH samyagAtiShThetsa gachChedvadhyatAM mama
shlokas.9:
puShkarasya tu vAkyena tasya vidveShaNena cha |
paurA na tasminsatkAraM kRRitavanto yudhiShThira
shlokas.10:
sa tathA nagarAbhyAshe satkArArho na satkRRitaH |
trirAtramuShito rAjA jalamAtreNa vartayan
shlokas.11:
kShudhA sampIDyamAnastu nalo bahutithe.ahani |
apashyachChakunAnkA.nshchiddhiraNyasadRRishachChadAn
shlokas.12:
sa chintayAmAsa tadA niShadhAdhipatirbalI |
asti bhakSho mamAdyAyaM vasu chedaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
tatastAnantarIyeNa vAsasA samavAstRRiNot |
tasyAntarIyamAdAya jagmuH sarve vihAyasA
shlokas.14:
utpatantaH khagAste tu vAkyamAhustadA nalam |
dRRiShTvA digvAsasaM bhUmau sthitaM dInamadhomukham
shlokas.15:
vayamakShAH sudurbuddhe tava vAso jihIrShavaH |
AgatA na hi naH prItiH savAsasi gate tvayi
shlokas.16:
tAnsamIkShya gatAnakShAnAtmAnaM cha vivAsasam |
puNyashlokastato rAjA damayantImathAbravIt
shlokas.17:
yeShAM prakopAdaishvaryAtprachyuto.ahamanindite |
prANayAtrAM na vinde cha duHkhitaH kShudhayArditaH
shlokas.18:
yeShAM kRRite na satkAramakurvanmayi naiShadhAH |
ta ime shakunA bhUtvA vAso.apyapaharanti me
shlokas.19:
vaiShamyaM paramaM prApto duHkhito gatachetanaH |
bhartA te.ahaM nibodhedaM vachanaM hitamAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
ete gachChanti bahavaH panthAno dakShiNApatham |
avantImRRikShavantaM cha samatikramya parvatam
shlokas.21:
eSha vindhyo mahAshailaH payoShNI cha samudragA |
AshramAshcha maharShINAmamI puShpaphalAnvitAH
shlokas.22:
eSha panthA vidarbhANAmayaM gachChati kosalAn |
ataH paraM cha desho.ayaM dakShiNe dakShiNApathaH
shlokas.23:
tataH sA bAShpakalayA vAchA duHkhena karshitA |
uvAcha damayantI taM naiShadhaM karuNaM vachaH
shlokas.24:
udvepate me hRRidayaM sIdantya~NgAni sarvashaH |
tava pArthiva sa~NkalpaM chintayantyAH punaH punaH
shlokas.25:
hRRitarAjyaM hRRitadhanaM vivastraM kShuchChramAnvitam |
kathamutsRRijya gachCheyamahaM tvAM vijane vane
shlokas.26:
shrAntasya te kShudhArtasya chintayAnasya tatsukham |
vane ghore mahArAja nAshayiShyAmi te klamam
shlokas.27:
na cha bhAryAsamaM ki~nchidvidyate bhiShajAM matam |
auShadhaM sarvaduHkheShu satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.28:
nala uvAcha||
evametadyathAttha tvaM damayanti sumadhyame |
nAsti bhAryAsamaM mitraM narasyArtasya bheShajam
shlokas.29:
na chAhaM tyaktukAmastvAM kimarthaM bhIru sha~Nkase |
tyajeyamahamAtmAnaM na tveva tvAmanindite
shlokas.30:
damayantyuvAcha||
yadi mAM tvaM mahArAja na vihAtumihechChasi |
tatkimarthaM vidarbhANAM panthAH samupadishyate
shlokas.31:
avaimi chAhaM nRRipate na tvaM mAM tyaktumarhasi |
chetasA tvapakRRiShTena mAM tyajethA mahApate
shlokas.32:
panthAnaM hi mamAbhIkShNamAkhyAsi narasattama |
atonimittaM shokaM me vardhayasyamaraprabha
shlokas.33:
yadi chAyamabhiprAyastava rAjanvrajediti |
sahitAveva gachChAvo vidarbhAnyadi manyase
shlokas.34:
vidarbharAjastatra tvAM pUjayiShyati mAnada |
tena tvaM pUjito rAjansukhaM vatsyasi no gRRihe

shlokas.1:
nala uvAcha||
yathA rAjyaM pituste tattathA mama na sa.nshayaH |
na tu tatra gamiShyAmi viShamasthaH katha~nchana
shlokas.2:
kathaM samRRiddho gatvAhaM tava harShavivardhanaH |
paridyUno gamiShyAmi tava shokavivardhanaH
shlokas.3:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
iti bruvannalo rAjA damayantIM punaH punaH |
sAntvayAmAsa kalyANIM vAsaso.ardhena sa.nvRRitAm
shlokas.4:
tAvekavastrasa.nvItAvaTamAnAvitastataH |
kShutpipAsAparishrAntau sabhAM kA~nchidupeyatuH
shlokas.5:
tAM sabhAmupasamprApya tadA sa niShadhAdhipaH |
vaidarbhyA sahito rAjA niShasAda mahItale
shlokas.6:
sa vai vivastro malino vikachaH pA.nsuguNThitaH |
damayantyA saha shrAntaH suShvApa dharaNItale
shlokas.7:
damayantyapi kalyANI nidrayApahRRitA tataH |
sahasA duHkhamAsAdya sukumArI tapasvinI
shlokas.8:
suptAyAM damayantyAM tu nalo rAjA vishAM pate |
shokonmathitachittAtmA na sma shete yathA purA
shlokas.9:
sa tadrAjyApaharaNaM suhRRittyAgaM cha sarvashaH |
vane cha taM paridhva.nsaM prekShya chintAmupeyivAn
shlokas.10:
kiM nu me syAdidaM kRRitvA kiM nu me syAdakurvataH |
kiM nu me maraNaM shreyaH parityAgo janasya vA
shlokas.11:
mAmiyaM hyanuraktedaM duHkhamApnoti matkRRite |
madvihInA tviyaM gachChetkadAchitsvajanaM prati
shlokas.12:
mayA niHsa.nshayaM duHkhamiyaM prApsyatyanuttamA |
utsarge sa.nshayaH syAttu vindetApi sukhaM kvachit
shlokas.13:
sa vinishchitya bahudhA vichArya cha punaH punaH |
utsarge.amanyata shreyo damayantyA narAdhipaH
shlokas.14:
so.avastratAmAtmanashcha tasyAshchApyekavastratAm |
chintayitvAdhyagAdrAjA vastrArdhasyAvakartanam
shlokas.15:
kathaM vAso vikarteyaM na cha budhyeta me priyA |
chintyaivaM naiShadho rAjA sabhAM paryacharattadA
shlokas.16:
paridhAvannatha nala itashchetashcha bhArata |
AsasAda sabhoddeshe vikoshaM khaDgamuttamam
shlokas.17:
tenArdhaM vAsasashChittvA nivasya cha parantapaH |
suptAmutsRRijya vaidarbhIM prAdravadgatachetanaH
shlokas.18:
tato nibaddhahRRidayaH punarAgamya tAM sabhAm |
damayantIM tathA dRRiShTvA ruroda niShadhAdhipaH
shlokas.19:
yAM na vAyurna chAdityaH purA pashyati me priyAm |
seyamadya sabhAmadhye shete bhUmAvanAthavat
shlokas.20:
iyaM vastrAvakartena sa.nvItA chAruhAsinI |
unmatteva varArohA kathaM buddhvA bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
kathamekA satI bhaimI mayA virahitA shubhA |
chariShyati vane ghore mRRigavyAlaniShevite
shlokas.22:
gatvA gatvA nalo rAjA punareti sabhAM muhuH |
AkRRiShyamANaH kalinA sauhRRidenApakRRiShyate
shlokas.23:
dvidheva hRRidayaM tasya duHkhitasyAbhavattadA |
doleva muhurAyAti yAti chaiva sabhAM muhuH
shlokas.24:
so.apakRRiShTastu kalinA mohitaH prAdravannalaH |
suptAmutsRRijya tAM bhAryAM vilapya karuNaM bahu
shlokas.25:
naShTAtmA kalinA spRRiShTastattadvigaNayannRRipaH |
jagAmaiva vane shUnye bhAryAmutsRRijya duHkhitaH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
apakrAnte nale rAjandamayantI gataklamA |
abudhyata varArohA santrastA vijane vane
shlokas.2:
sApashyamAnA bhartAraM duHkhashokasamanvitA |
prAkroshaduchchaiH santrastA mahArAjeti naiShadham
shlokas.3:
hA nAtha hA mahArAja hA svAminkiM jahAsi mAm |
hA hatAsmi vinaShTAsmi bhItAsmi vijane vane
shlokas.4:
nanu nAma mahArAja dharmaj~naH satyavAgasi |
kathamuktvA tathAsatyaM suptAmutsRRijya mAM gataH
shlokas.5:
kathamutsRRijya gantAsi vashyAM bhAryAmanuvratAm |
visheShato.anapakRRite pareNApakRRite sati
shlokas.6:
shakShyase tA giraH satyAH kartuM mayi nareshvara |
yAstvayA lokapAlAnAM saMnidhau kathitAH purA
shlokas.7:
paryAptaH parihAso.ayametAvAnpuruSharShabha |
bhItAhamasmi durdharSha darshayAtmAnamIshvara
shlokas.8:
dRRishyase dRRishyase rAjanneSha tiShThasi naiShadha |
AvArya gulmairAtmAnaM kiM mAM na pratibhAShase
shlokas.9:
nRRisha.nsaM bata rAjendra yanmAmeva~NgatAmiha |
vilapantIM samAli~Ngya nAshvAsayasi pArthiva
shlokas.10:
na shochAmyahamAtmAnaM na chAnyadapi ki~nchana |
kathaM nu bhavitAsyeka iti tvAM nRRipa shochimi
shlokas.11:
kathaM nu rAja.nstRRiShitaH kShudhitaH shramakarshitaH |
sAyAhne vRRikShamUleShu mAmapashyanbhaviShyasi
shlokas.12:
tataH sA tIvrashokArtA pradIpteva cha manyunA |
itashchetashcha rudatI paryadhAvata duHkhitA
shlokas.13:
muhurutpatate bAlA muhuH patati vihvalA |
muhurAlIyate bhItA muhuH kroshati roditi
shlokas.14:
sA tIvrashokasantaptA muhurniHshvasya vihvalA |
uvAcha bhaimI niShkramya rodamAnA pativratA
shlokas.15:
yasyAbhishApAdduHkhArto duHkhaM vindati naiShadhaH |
tasya bhUtasya tadduHkhAdduHkhamabhyadhikaM bhavet
shlokas.16:
apApachetasaM pApo ya evaM kRRitavAnnalam |
tasmAdduHkhataraM prApya jIvatvasukhajIvikAm
shlokas.17:
evaM tu vilapantI sA rAj~no bhAryA mahAtmanaH |
anveShati sma bhartAraM vane shvApadasevite
shlokas.18:
unmattavadbhImasutA vilapantI tatastataH |
hA hA rAjanniti muhuritashchetashcha dhAvati
shlokas.19:
tAM shuShyamANAmatyarthaM kurarImiva vAshatIm |
karuNaM bahu shochantIM vilapantIM muhurmuhuH
shlokas.20:
sahasAbhyAgatAM bhaimImabhyAshaparivartinIm |
jagrAhAjagaro grAho mahAkAyaH kShudhAnvitaH
shlokas.21:
sA grasyamAnA grAheNa shokena cha parAjitA |
nAtmAnaM shochati tathA yathA shochati naiShadham
shlokas.22:
hA nAtha mAmiha vane grasyamAnAmanAthavat |
grAheNAnena vipine kimarthaM nAbhidhAvasi
shlokas.23:
kathaM bhaviShyasi punarmAmanusmRRitya naiShadha |
pApAnmuktaH punarlabdhvA buddhiM cheto dhanAni cha
shlokas.24:
shrAntasya te kShudhArtasya pariglAnasya naiShadha |
kaH shramaM rAjashArdUla nAshayiShyati mAnada
shlokas.25:
tAmakasmAnmRRigavyAdho vicharangahane vane |
AkrandatImupashrutya javenAbhisasAra ha
shlokas.26:
tAM sa dRRiShTvA tathA grastAmurageNAyatekShaNAm |
tvaramANo mRRigavyAdhaH samabhikramya vegitaH
shlokas.27:
mukhataH pAtayAmAsa shastreNa nishitena ha |
nirvicheShTaM bhuja~NgaM taM vishasya mRRigajIvanaH
shlokas.28:
mokShayitvA cha tAM vyAdhaH prakShAlya salilena cha |
samAshvAsya kRRitAhArAmatha paprachCha bhArata
shlokas.29:
kasya tvaM mRRigashAvAkShi kathaM chAbhyAgatA vanam |
kathaM chedaM mahatkRRichChraM prAptavatyasi bhAmini
shlokas.30:
damayantI tathA tena pRRichChyamAnA vishAM pate |
sarvametadyathAvRRittamAchachakShe.asya bhArata
shlokas.31:
tAmardhavastrasa.nvItAM pInashroNipayodharAm |
sukumArAnavadyA~NgIM pUrNachandranibhAnanAm
shlokas.32:
arAlapakShmanayanAM tathA madhurabhAShiNIm |
lakShayitvA mRRigavyAdhaH kAmasya vashameyivAn
shlokas.33:
tAmatha shlakShNayA vAchA lubdhako mRRidupurvayA |
sAntvayAmAsa kAmArtastadabudhyata bhAminI
shlokas.34:
damayantI tu taM duShTamupalabhya pativratA |
tIvraroShasamAviShTA prajajvAleva manyunA
shlokas.35:
sa tu pApamatiH kShudraH pradharShayitumAturaH |
durdharShAM tarkayAmAsa dIptAmagnishikhAmiva
shlokas.36:
damayantI tu duHkhArtA patirAjyavinAkRRitA |
atItavAkpathe kAle shashApainaM ruShA kila
shlokas.37:
yathAhaM naiShadhAdanyaM manasApi na chintaye |
tathAyaM patatAM kShudraH parAsurmRRigajIvanaH
shlokas.38:
uktamAtre tu vachane tayA sa mRRigajIvanaH |
vyasuH papAta medinyAmagnidagdha iva drumaH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sA nihatya mRRigavyAdhaM pratasthe kamalekShaNA |
vanaM pratibhayaM shUnyaM jhillikAgaNanAditam
shlokas.2:
siMhavyAghravarAharkSharurudvIpiniShevitam |
nAnApakShigaNAkIrNaM mlechChataskarasevitam
shlokas.3:
shAlaveNudhavAshvatthatinduke~Ngudaki.nshukaiH |
arjunAriShTasa~nChannaM chandanaishcha sashAlmalaiH
shlokas.4:
jambvAmralodhrakhadirashAkavetrasamAkulam |
kAshmaryAmalakaplakShakadambodumbarAvRRitam
shlokas.5:
badarIbilvasa~nChannaM nyagrodhaishcha samAkulam |
priyAlatAlakharjUraharItakabibhItakaiH
shlokas.6:
nAnAdhAtushatairnaddhAnvividhAnapi chAchalAn |
niku~njAnpakShisa~NghuShTAndarIshchAdbhutadarshanAH
nadIH sarA.nsi vApIshcha vividhA.nshcha mRRigadvijAn
shlokas.7:
sA bahUnbhImarUpA.nshcha pishAchoragarAkShasAn |
palvalAni taDAgAni girikUTAni sarvashaH
saritaH sAgarA.nshchaiva dadarshAdbhutadarshanAn
shlokas.8:
yUthasho dadRRishe chAtra vidarbhAdhipanandinI |
mahiShAnvarAhAngomAyUnRRikShavAnarapannagAn
shlokas.9:
tejasA yashasA sthityA shriyA cha parayA yutA |
vaidarbhI vicharatyekA nalamanveShatI tadA
shlokas.10:
nAbibhyatsA nRRipasutA bhaimI tatrAtha kasyachit |
dAruNAmaTavIM prApya bhartRRivyasanakarshitA
shlokas.11:
vidarbhatanayA rAjanvilalApa suduHkhitA |
bhartRRishokaparItA~NgI shilAtalasamAshritA
shlokas.12:
damayantyuvAcha||
siMhoraska mahAbAho niShadhAnAM janAdhipa |
kva nu rAjangato.asIha tyaktvA mAM nirjane vane
shlokas.13:
ashvamedhAdibhirvIra kratubhiH svAptadakShiNaiH |
kathamiShTvA naravyAghra mayi mithyA pravartase
shlokas.14:
yattvayoktaM naravyAghra matsamakShaM mahAdyute |
kartumarhasi kalyANa tadRRitaM pArthivarShabha
shlokas.15:
yathoktaM vihagairha.nsaiH samIpe tava bhUmipa |
matsakAshe cha tairuktaM tadavekShitumarhasi
shlokas.16:
chatvAra ekato vedAH sA~NgopA~NgAH savistarAH |
svadhItA mAnavashreShTha satyamekaM kilaikataH
shlokas.17:
tasmAdarhasi shatrughna satyaM kartuM nareshvara |
uktavAnasi yadvIra matsakAshe purA vachaH
shlokas.18:
hA vIra nanu nAmAhamiShTA kila tavAnagha |
asyAmaTavyAM ghorAyAM kiM mAM na pratibhAShase
shlokas.19:
bhartsayatyeSha mAM raudro vyAttAsyo dAruNAkRRitiH |
araNyarATkShudhAviShTaH kiM mAM na trAtumarhasi
shlokas.20:
na me tvadanyA subhage priyA ityabravIstadA |
tAmRRitAM kuru kalyANa puroktAM bhAratIM nRRipa
shlokas.21:
unmattAM vilapantIM mAM bhAryAmiShTAM narAdhipa |
IpsitAmIpsito nAtha kiM mAM na pratibhAShase
shlokas.22:
kRRishAM dInAM vivarNAM cha malinAM vasudhAdhipa |
vastrArdhaprAvRRitAmekAM vilapantImanAthavat
shlokas.23:
yUthabhraShTAmivaikAM mAM hariNIM pRRithulochana |
na mAnayasi mAnArha rudatImarikarshana
shlokas.24:
mahArAja mahAraNye mAmihaikAkinIM satIm |
AbhAShamANAM svAM patnIM kiM mAM na pratibhAShase
shlokas.25:
kulashIlopasampannaM chArusarvA~Ngashobhanam |
nAdya tvAmanupashyAmi girAvasminnarottama
vane chAsminmahAghore siMhavyAghraniShevite
shlokas.26:
shayAnamupaviShTaM vA sthitaM vA niShadhAdhipa |
prasthitaM vA narashreShTha mama shokavivardhana
shlokas.27:
kaM nu pRRichChAmi duHkhArtA tvadarthe shokakarshitA |
kachchiddRRiShTastvayAraNye sa~Ngatyeha nalo nRRipaH
shlokas.28:
ko nu me kathayedadya vane.asminviShThitaM nalam |
abhirUpaM mahAtmAnaM paravyUhavinAshanam
shlokas.29:
yamanveShasi rAjAnaM nalaM padmanibhekShaNam |
ayaM sa iti kasyAdya shroShyAmi madhurAM giram
shlokas.30:
araNyarADayaM shrImA.nshchaturdaMShTro mahAhanuH |
shArdUlo.abhimukhaH praiti pRRichChAmyenamasha~NkitA
