shlokas.31:
bhavAnmRRigANAmadhipastvamasminkAnane prabhuH |
vidarbharAjatanayAM damayantIti viddhi mAm
shlokas.32:
niShadhAdhipaterbhAryAM nalasyAmitraghAtinaH |
patimanveShatImekAM kRRipaNAM shokakarshitAm
AshvAsaya mRRigendreha yadi dRRiShTastvayA nalaH
shlokas.33:
atha vAraNyanRRipate nalaM yadi na sha.nsasi |
mAmadasva mRRigashreShTha vishokAM kuru duHkhitAm
shlokas.34:
shrutvAraNye vilapitaM mamaiSha mRRigarATsvayam |
yAtyetAM mRRiShTasalilAmApagAM sAgara~NgamAm
shlokas.35:
imaM shilochchayaM puNyaM shRRi~NgairbahubhiruchChritaiH |
virAjadbhirdivaspRRigbhirnaikavarNairmanoramaiH
shlokas.36:
nAnAdhAtusamAkIrNaM vividhopalabhUShitam |
asyAraNyasya mahataH ketubhUtamivochChritam
shlokas.37:
siMhashArdUlamAta~NgavarAharkShamRRigAyutam |
patatribhirbahuvidhaiH samantAdanunAditam
shlokas.38:
ki.nshukAshokabakulapuMnAgairupashobhitam |
saridbhiH saviha~NgAbhiH shikharaishchopashobhitam
girirAjamimaM tAvatpRRichChAmi nRRipatiM prati
shlokas.39:
bhagavannachalashreShTha divyadarshana vishruta |
sharaNya bahukalyANa namaste.astu mahIdhara
shlokas.40:
praName tvAbhigamyAhaM rAjaputrIM nibodha mAm |
rAj~naH snuShAM rAjabhAryAM damayantIti vishrutAm
shlokas.41:
rAjA vidarbhAdhipatiH pitA mama mahArathaH |
bhImo nAma kShitipatishchAturvarNyasya rakShitA
shlokas.42:
rAjasUyAshvamedhAnAM kratUnAM dakShiNAvatAm |
AhartA pArthivashreShThaH pRRithuchArva~nchitekShaNaH
shlokas.43:
brahmaNyaH sAdhuvRRittashcha satyavAganasUyakaH |
shIlavAnsusamAchAraH pRRithushrIrdharmavichChuchiH
shlokas.44:
samyaggoptA vidarbhANAM nirjitArigaNaH prabhuH |
tasya mAM viddhi tanayAM bhagava.nstvAmupasthitAm
shlokas.45:
niShadheShu mahAshaila shvashuro me nRRipottamaH |
sugRRihItanAmA vikhyAto vIrasena iti sma ha
shlokas.46:
tasya rAj~naH suto vIraH shrImAnsatyaparAkramaH |
kramaprAptaM pituH svaM yo rAjyaM samanushAsti ha
shlokas.47:
nalo nAmAridamanaH puNyashloka iti shrutaH |
brahmaNyo vedavidvAgmI puNyakRRitsomapo.agnichit
shlokas.48:
yaShTA dAtA cha yoddhA cha samyakchaiva prashAsitA |
tasya mAmachalashreShTha viddhi bhAryAmihAgatAm
shlokas.49:
tyaktashriyaM bhartRRihInAmanAthAM vyasanAnvitAm |
anveShamANAM bhartAraM taM vai naravarottamam
shlokas.50:
khamullikhadbhiretairhi tvayA shRRi~NgashatairnRRipaH |
kachchiddRRiShTo.achalashreShTha vane.asmindAruNe nalaH
shlokas.51:
gajendravikramo dhImAndIrghabAhuramarShaNaH |
vikrAntaH satyavAgdhIro bhartA mama mahAyashAH
niShadhAnAmadhipatiH kachchiddRRiShTastvayA nalaH
shlokas.52:
kiM mAM vilapatImekAM parvatashreShTha duHkhitAm |
girA nAshvAsayasyadya svAM sutAmiva duHkhitAm
shlokas.53:
vIra vikrAnta dharmaj~na satyasandha mahIpate |
yadyasyasminvane rAjandarshayAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.54:
kadA nu snigdhagambhIrAM jImUtasvanasaMnibhAm |
shroShyAmi naiShadhasyAhaM vAchaM tAmamRRitopamAm
shlokas.55:
vaidarbhItyeva kathitAM shubhAM rAj~no mahAtmanaH |
AmnAyasAriNImRRiddhAM mama shokanibarhiNIm
shlokas.56:
iti sA taM girishreShThamuktvA pArthivanandinI |
damayantI tato bhUyo jagAma dishamuttarAm
shlokas.57:
sA gatvA trInahorAtrAndadarsha paramA~NganA |
tApasAraNyamatulaM divyakAnanadarshanam
shlokas.58:
vasiShThabhRRigvatrisamaistApasairupashobhitam |
niyataiH sa.nyatAhArairdamashauchasamanvitaiH
shlokas.59:
abbhakShairvAyubhakShaishcha patrAhAraistathaiva cha |
jitendriyairmahAbhAgaiH svargamArgadidRRikShubhiH
shlokas.60:
valkalAjinasa.nvItairmunibhiH sa.nyatendriyaiH |
tApasAdhyuShitaM ramyaM dadarshAshramamaNDalam
shlokas.61:
sA dRRiShTvaivAshramapadaM nAnAmRRiganiShevitam |
shAkhAmRRigagaNaishchaiva tApasaishcha samanvitam
shlokas.62:
subhrUH sukeshI sushroNI sukuchA sudvijAnanA |
varchasvinI supratiShThA sva~nchitodyatagAminI
shlokas.63:
sA viveshAshramapadaM vIrasenasutapriyA |
yoShidratnaM mahAbhAgA damayantI manasvinI
shlokas.64:
sAbhivAdya tapovRRiddhAnvinayAvanatA sthitA |
svAgataM ta iti proktA taiH sarvaistApasaishcha sA
shlokas.65:
pUjAM chAsyA yathAnyAyaM kRRitvA tatra tapodhanAH |
AsyatAmityathochuste brUhi kiM karavAmahe
shlokas.66:
tAnuvAcha varArohA kachchidbhagavatAmiha |
tapasyagniShu dharmeShu mRRigapakShiShu chAnaghAH
kushalaM vo mahAbhAgAH svadharmacharaNeShu cha
shlokas.67:
tairuktA kushalaM bhadre sarvatreti yashasvinI |
brUhi sarvAnavadyA~Ngi kA tvaM kiM cha chikIrShasi
shlokas.68:
dRRiShTvaiva te paraM rUpaM dyutiM cha paramAmiha |
vismayo naH samutpannaH samAshvasihi mA shuchaH
shlokas.69:
asyAraNyasya mahatI devatA vA mahIbhRRitaH |
asyA nu nadyAH kalyANi vada satyamanindite
shlokas.70:
sAbravIttAnRRiShInnAhamaraNyasyAsya devatA |
na chApyasya girerviprA na nadyA devatApyaham
shlokas.71:
mAnuShIM mAM vijAnIta yUyaM sarve tapodhanAH |
vistareNAbhidhAsyAmi tanme shRRiNuta sarvashaH
shlokas.72:
vidarbheShu mahIpAlo bhImo nAma mahAdyutiH |
tasya mAM tanayAM sarve jAnIta dvijasattamAH
shlokas.73:
niShadhAdhipatirdhImAnnalo nAma mahAyashAH |
vIraH sa~NgrAmajidvidvAnmama bhartA vishAM patiH
shlokas.74:
devatAbhyarchanaparo dvijAtijanavatsalaH |
goptA niShadhava.nshasya mahAbhAgo mahAdyutiH
shlokas.76:
nalo nAma nRRipashreShTho devarAjasamadyutiH |
mama bhartA vishAlAkShaH pUrNenduvadano.arihA
shlokas.77:
AhartA kratumukhyAnAM vedavedA~NgapAragaH |
sapatnAnAM mRRidhe hantA ravisomasamaprabhaH
shlokas.78:
sa kaishchinnikRRitipraj~nairakalyANairnarAdhamaiH |
AhUya pRRithivIpAlaH satyadharmaparAyaNaH
devane kushalairjihmairjito rAjyaM vasUni cha
shlokas.79:
tasya mAmavagachChadhvaM bhAryAM rAjarShabhasya vai |
damayantIti vikhyAtAM bhartRRidarshanalAlasAm
shlokas.80:
sA vanAni girI.nshchaiva sarA.nsi saritastathA |
palvalAni cha ramyANi tathAraNyAni sarvashaH
shlokas.81:
anveShamANA bhartAraM nalaM raNavishAradam |
mahAtmAnaM kRRitAstraM cha vicharAmIha duHkhitA
shlokas.82:
kachchidbhagavatAM puNyaM tapovanamidaM nRRipaH |
bhavetprApto nalo nAma niShadhAnAM janAdhipaH
shlokas.83:
yatkRRite.ahamidaM viprAH prapannA bhRRishadAruNam |
vanaM pratibhayaM ghoraM shArdUlamRRigasevitam
shlokas.84:
yadi kaishchidahorAtrairna drakShyAmi nalaM nRRipam |
AtmAnaM shreyasA yokShye dehasyAsya vimochanAt
shlokas.85:
ko nu me jIvitenArthastamRRite puruSharShabham |
kathaM bhaviShyAmyadyAhaM bhartRRishokAbhipIDitA
shlokas.86:
evaM vilapatImekAmaraNye bhImanandinIm |
damayantImathochuste tApasAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.87:
udarkastava kalyANi kalyANo bhavitA shubhe |
vayaM pashyAma tapasA kShipraM drakShyasi naiShadham
shlokas.88:
niShadhAnAmadhipatiM nalaM ripunighAtinam |
bhaimi dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaM drakShyase vigatajvaram
shlokas.89:
vimuktaM sarvapApebhyaH sarvaratnasamanvitam |
tadeva nagarashreShThaM prashAsantamari.ndamam
shlokas.90:
dviShatAM bhayakartAraM suhRRidAM shokanAshanam |
patiM drakShyasi kalyANi kalyANAbhijanaM nRRipam
shlokas.91:
evamuktvA nalasyeShTAM mahiShIM pArthivAtmajAm |
antarhitAstApasAste sAgnihotrAshramAstadA
shlokas.92:
sA dRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM vismitA abhavattadA |
damayantyanavadyA~NgI vIrasenanRRipasnuShA
shlokas.93:
kiM nu svapno mayA dRRiShTaH ko.ayaM vidhirihAbhavat |
kva nu te tApasAH sarve kva tadAshramamaNDalam
shlokas.94:
kva sA puNyajalA ramyA nAnAdvijaniShevitA |
nadI te cha nagA hRRidyAH phalapuShpopashobhitAH
shlokas.95:
dhyAtvA chiraM bhImasutA damayantI shuchismitA |
bhartRRishokaparA dInA vivarNavadanAbhavat
shlokas.96:
sA gatvAthAparAM bhUmiM bAShpasa.ndigdhayA girA |
vilalApAshrupUrNAkShI dRRiShTvAshokataruM tataH
shlokas.97:
upagamya tarushreShThamashokaM puShpitaM tadA |
pallavApIDitaM hRRidyaM viha~NgairanunAditam
shlokas.99:
vishokAM kuru mAM kShipramashoka priyadarshana |
vItashokabhayAbAdhaM kachchittvaM dRRiShTavAnnRRipam
shlokas.100:
nalaM nAmAridamanaM damayantyAH priyaM patim |
niShadhAnAmadhipatiM dRRiShTavAnasi me priyam
shlokas.102:
yathA vishokA gachCheyamashokanaga tatkuru |
satyanAmA bhavAshoka mama shokavinAshanAt
shlokas.103:
evaM sAshokavRRikShaM tamArtA triH parigamya ha |
jagAma dAruNataraM deshaM bhaimI varA~NganA
shlokas.104:
sA dadarsha nagAnnaikAnnaikAshcha saritastathA |
naikA.nshcha parvatAnramyAnnaikA.nshcha mRRigapakShiNaH
shlokas.105:
kandarA.nshcha nitambA.nshcha nadA.nshchAdbhutadarshanAn |
dadarsha sA bhImasutA patimanveShatI tadA
shlokas.106:
gatvA prakRRiShTamadhvAnaM damayantI shuchismitA |
dadarshAtha mahAsArthaM hastyashvarathasa~Nkulam
shlokas.107:
uttarantaM nadIM ramyAM prasannasalilAM shubhAm |
sushItatoyAM vistIrNAM hradinIM vetasairvRRitAm
shlokas.109:
sA dRRiShTvaiva mahAsArthaM nalapatnI yashasvinI |
upasarpya varArohA janamadhyaM vivesha ha
shlokas.110:
unmattarUpA shokArtA tathA vastrArdhasa.nvRRitA |
kRRishA vivarNA malinA pA.nsudhvastashiroruhA
shlokas.111:
tAM dRRiShTvA tatra manujAH kechidbhItAH pradudruvuH |
kechichchintAparAstasthuH kechittatra vichukrushuH
shlokas.112:
prahasanti sma tAM kechidabhyasUyanta chApare |
chakrustasyAM dayAM kechitpaprachChushchApi bhArata
shlokas.113:
kAsi kasyAsi kalyANi kiM vA mRRigayase vane |
tvAM dRRiShTvA vyathitAH smeha kachchittvamasi mAnuShI
shlokas.114:
vada satyaM vanasyAsya parvatasyAtha vA dishaH |
devatA tvaM hi kalyANi tvAM vayaM sharaNaM gatAH
shlokas.115:
yakShI vA rAkShasI vA tvamutAho.asi varA~NganA |
sarvathA kuru naH svasti rakShasvAsmAnanindite
shlokas.116:
yathAyaM sarvathA sArthaH kShemI shIghramito vrajet |
tathA vidhatsva kalyANi tvAM vayaM sharaNaM gatAH
shlokas.117:
tathoktA tena sArthena damayantI nRRipAtmajA |
pratyuvAcha tataH sAdhvI bhartRRivyasanaduHkhitA
sArthavAhaM cha sArthaM cha janA ye chAtra kechana
shlokas.118:
yUnaH sthavirabAlAshcha sArthasya cha purogamAH |
mAnuShIM mAM vijAnIta manujAdhipateH sutAm
nRRipasnuShAM rAjabhAryAM bhartRRidarshanalAlasAm
shlokas.119:
vidarbharANmama pitA bhartA rAjA cha naiShadhaH |
nalo nAma mahAbhAgastaM mArgAmyaparAjitam
shlokas.120:
yadi jAnIta nRRipatiM kShipraM sha.nsata me priyam |
nalaM pArthivashArdUlamamitragaNasUdanam
shlokas.121:
tAmuvAchAnavadyA~NgIM sArthasya mahataH prabhuH |
sArthavAhaH shuchirnAma shRRiNu kalyANi madvachaH
shlokas.122:
ahaM sArthasya netA vai sArthavAhaH shuchismite |
manuShyaM nalanAmAnaM na pashyAmi yashasvini
shlokas.123:
ku~njaradvIpimahiShashArdUlarkShamRRigAnapi |
pashyAmyasminvane kaShTe amanuShyaniShevite
tathA no yakSharADadya maNibhadraH prasIdatu
shlokas.124:
sAbravIdvaNijaH sarvAnsArthavAhaM cha taM tataH |
kva nu yAsyasi sArtho.ayametadAkhyAtumarhatha
shlokas.125:
sArthavAha uvAcha||
sArtho.ayaM chedirAjasya subAhoH satyavAdinaH |
kShipraM janapadaM gantA lAbhAya manujAtmaje

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sA tachChrutvAnavadyA~NgI sArthavAhavachastadA |
agachChattena vai sArdhaM bhartRRidarshanalAlasA
shlokas.2:
atha kAle bahutithe vane mahati dAruNe |
taDAgaM sarvatobhadraM padmasaugandhikaM mahat
shlokas.3:
dadRRishurvaNijo ramyaM prabhUtayavasendhanam |
bahumUlaphalopetaM nAnApakShigaNairvRRitam
shlokas.4:
taM dRRiShTvA mRRiShTasalilaM manoharasukhAvaham |
suparishrAntavAhAste niveshAya mano dadhuH
shlokas.5:
saMmate sArthavAhasya vivishurvanamuttamam |
uvAsa sArthaH sumahAnvelAmAsAdya pashchimAm
shlokas.6:
athArdharAtrasamaye niHshabdastimite tadA |
supte sArthe parishrAnte hastiyUthamupAgamat
pAnIyArthaM girinadIM madaprasravaNAvilAm
shlokas.7:
mArgaM sa.nrudhya sa.nsuptaM padminyAH sArthamuttamam |
suptaM mamarda sahasA cheShTamAnaM mahItale
shlokas.8:
hAhAravaM pramu~nchantaH sArthikAH sharaNArthinaH |
vanagulmA.nshcha dhAvanto nidrAndhA mahato bhayAt
kechiddantaiH karaiH kechitkechitpadbhyAM hatA narAH
shlokas.9:
gokharoShTrAshvabahulaM padAtijanasa~Nkulam |
bhayArtaM dhAvamAnaM tatparasparahataM tadA
shlokas.10:
ghorAnnAdAnvimu~nchanto nipeturdharaNItale |
vRRikSheShvAsajya sambhagnAH patitA viShameShu cha
tathA tannihataM sarvaM samRRiddhaM sArthamaNDalam
shlokas.11:
athAparedyuH samprApte hatashiShTA janAstadA |
vanagulmAdviniShkramya shochanto vaishasaM kRRitam
bhrAtaraM pitaraM putraM sakhAyaM cha janAdhipa
shlokas.12:
ashochattatra vaidarbhI kiM nu me duShkRRitaM kRRitam |
yo.api me nirjane.araNye samprApto.ayaM janArNavaH
hato.ayaM hastiyUthena mandabhAgyAnmamaiva tu
shlokas.13:
prAptavyaM suchiraM duHkhaM mayA nUnamasa.nshayam |
nAprAptakAlo mriyate shrutaM vRRiddhAnushAsanam
shlokas.14:
yannAhamadya mRRiditA hastiyUthena duHkhitA |
na hyadaivakRRitaM ki~nchinnarANAmiha vidyate
shlokas.15:
na cha me bAlabhAve.api ki~nchidvyapakRRitaM kRRitam |
karmaNA manasA vAchA yadidaM duHkhamAgatam
shlokas.16:
manye svaya.nvarakRRite lokapAlAH samAgatAH |
pratyAkhyAtA mayA tatra nalasyArthAya devatAH
nUnaM teShAM prabhAvena viyogaM prAptavatyaham
shlokas.17:
evamAdIni duHkhAni sA vilapya varA~NganA |
hatashiShTaiH saha tadA brAhmaNairvedapAragaiH
agachChadrAjashArdUla duHkhashokaparAyaNA
shlokas.18:
gachChantI sA chirAtkAlAtpuramAsAdayanmahat |
sAyAhne chedirAjasya subAhoH satyavAdinaH
vastrArdhakartasa.nvItA pravivesha purottamam
shlokas.19:
tAM vivarNAM kRRishAM dInAM muktakeshImamArjanAm |
unmattAmiva gachChantIM dadRRishuH puravAsinaH
shlokas.20:
pravishantIM tu tAM dRRiShTvA chedirAjapurIM tadA |
anujagmustato bAlA grAmiputrAH kutUhalAt
shlokas.21:
sA taiH parivRRitAgachChatsamIpaM rAjaveshmanaH |
tAM prAsAdagatApashyadrAjamAtA janairvRRitAm
shlokas.22:
sA janaM vArayitvA taM prAsAdatalamuttamam |
Aropya vismitA rAjandamayantImapRRichChata
shlokas.23:
evamapyasukhAviShTA bibharShi paramaM vapuH |
bhAsi vidyudivAbhreShu sha.nsa me kAsi kasya vA
shlokas.24:
na hi te mAnuShaM rUpaM bhUShaNairapi varjitam |
asahAyA narebhyashcha nodvijasyamaraprabhe
shlokas.25:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasyA bhaimI vachanamabravIt |
mAnuShIM mAM vijAnIhi bhartAraM samanuvratAm
shlokas.26:
sairandhrIM jAtisampannAM bhujiShyAM kAmavAsinIm |
phalamUlAshanAmekAM yatrasAyampratishrayAm
shlokas.27:
asa~NkhyeyaguNo bhartA mAM cha nityamanuvrataH |
bhartAramapi taM vIraM ChAyevAnapagA sadA
shlokas.28:
tasya daivAtprasa~Ngo.abhUdatimAtraM sma devane |
dyUte sa nirjitashchaiva vanameko.abhyupeyivAn
shlokas.29:
tamekavasanaM vIramunmattamiva vihvalam |
AshvAsayantI bhartAramahamanvagamaM vanam
shlokas.30:
sa kadAchidvane vIraH kasmi.nshchitkAraNAntare |
kShutparItaH suvimanAstadapyekaM vyasarjayat
shlokas.31:
tamekavasanaM nagnamunmattaM gatachetasam |
anuvrajantI bahulA na svapAmi nishAH sadA
shlokas.32:
tato bahutithe kAle suptAmutsRRijya mAM kvachit |
vAsaso.ardhaM parichChidya tyaktavAnmAmanAgasam
shlokas.33:
taM mArgamANA bhartAraM dahyamAnA dinakShapAH |
na vindAmyamaraprakhyaM priyaM prANadhaneshvaram
shlokas.34:
tAmashruparipUrNAkShIM vilapantIM tathA bahu |
rAjamAtAbravIdArtAM bhaimImArtatarA svayam
shlokas.35:
vasasva mayi kalyANi prItirme tvayi vartate |
mRRigayiShyanti te bhadre bhartAraM puruShA mama
shlokas.36:
atha vA svayamAgachChetparidhAvannitastataH |
ihaiva vasatI bhadre bhartAramupalapsyase
shlokas.37:
rAjamAturvachaH shrutvA damayantI vacho.abravIt |
samayenotsahe vastuM tvayi vIraprajAyini
shlokas.38:
uchChiShTaM naiva bhu~njIyAM na kuryAM pAdadhAvanam |
na chAhaM puruShAnanyAnsambhASheyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.39:
prArthayedyadi mAM kashchiddaNDyaste sa pumAnbhavet |
bharturanveShaNArthaM tu pashyeyaM brAhmaNAnaham
shlokas.40:
yadyevamiha kartavyaM vasAmyahamasa.nshayam |
ato.anyathA na me vAso vartate hRRidaye kvachit
shlokas.41:
tAM prahRRiShTena manasA rAjamAtedamabravIt |
sarvametatkariShyAmi diShTyA te vratamIdRRisham
shlokas.42:
evamuktvA tato bhaimIM rAjamAtA vishAM pate |
uvAchedaM duhitaraM sunandAM nAma bhArata
shlokas.43:
sairandhrImabhijAnIShva sunande devarUpiNIm |
etayA saha modasva nirudvignamanAH svayam

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
utsRRijya damayantIM tu nalo rAjA vishAM pate |
dadarsha dAvaM dahyantaM mahAntaM gahane vane
shlokas.2:
tatra shushrAva madhye.agnau shabdaM bhUtasya kasyachit |
abhidhAva naletyuchchaiH puNyashloketi chAsakRRit
shlokas.3:
mA bhairiti nalashchoktvA madhyamagneH pravishya tam |
dadarsha nAgarAjAnaM shayAnaM kuNDalIkRRitam
shlokas.4:
sa nAgaH prA~njalirbhUtvA vepamAno nalaM tadA |
uvAcha viddhi mAM rAjannAgaM karkoTakaM nRRipa
shlokas.5:
mayA pralabdho brahmarShiranAgAH sumahAtapAH |
tena manyuparItena shapto.asmi manujAdhipa
shlokas.6:
tasya shApAnna shaknomi padAdvichalituM padam |
upadekShyAmi te shreyastrAtumarhati mAM bhavAn
shlokas.7:
sakhA cha te bhaviShyAmi matsamo nAsti pannagaH |
laghushcha te bhaviShyAmi shIghramAdAya gachCha mAm
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA sa nAgendro babhUvA~NguShThamAtrakaH |
taM gRRihItvA nalaH prAyAduddeshaM dAvavarjitam
shlokas.9:
AkAshadeshamAsAdya vimuktaM kRRiShNavartmanA |
utsraShTukAmaM taM nAgaH punaH karkoTako.abravIt
shlokas.10:
padAni gaNayangachCha svAni naiShadha kAnichit |
tatra te.ahaM mahArAja shreyo dhAsyAmi yatparam
shlokas.11:
tataH sa~NkhyAtumArabdhamadashaddashame pade |
tasya daShTasya tadrUpaM kShipramantaradhIyata
shlokas.12:
sa dRRiShTvA vismitastasthAvAtmAnaM vikRRitaM nalaH |
svarUpadhAriNaM nAgaM dadarsha cha mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
tataH karkoTako nAgaH sAntvayannalamabravIt |
mayA te.antarhitaM rUpaM na tvA vidyurjanA iti
shlokas.14:
yatkRRite chAsi vikRRito duHkhena mahatA nala |
viSheNa sa madIyena tvayi duHkhaM nivatsyati
shlokas.15:
viSheNa sa.nvRRitairgAtrairyAvattvAM na vimokShyati |
tAvattvayi mahArAja duHkhaM vai sa nivatsyati
shlokas.16:
anAgA yena nikRRitastvamanarho janAdhipa |
krodhAdasUyayitvA taM rakShA me bhavataH kRRitA
shlokas.17:
na te bhayaM naravyAghra daMShTribhyaH shatruto.api vA |
brahmavidbhyashcha bhavitA matprasAdAnnarAdhipa
shlokas.18:
rAjanviShanimittA cha na te pIDA bhaviShyati |
sa~NgrAmeShu cha rAjendra shashvajjayamavApsyasi
shlokas.19:
gachCha rAjannitaH sUto bAhuko.ahamiti bruvan |
samIpamRRituparNasya sa hi vedAkShanaipuNam
ayodhyAM nagarIM ramyAmadyaiva niShadheshvara
shlokas.20:
sa te.akShahRRidayaM dAtA rAjAshvahRRidayena vai |
ikShvAkukulajaH shrImAnmitraM chaiva bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
bhaviShyasi yadAkShaj~naH shreyasA yokShyase tadA |
sameShyasi cha dAraistvaM mA sma shoke manaH kRRithAH
rAjyena tanayAbhyAM cha satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.22:
svarUpaM cha yadA draShTumichChethAstvaM narAdhipa |
sa.nsmartavyastadA te.ahaM vAsashchedaM nivAsayeH
shlokas.23:
anena vAsasAchChannaH svarUpaM pratipatsyase |
ityuktvA pradadAvasmai divyaM vAsoyugaM tadA
shlokas.24:
evaM nalaM samAdishya vAso dattvA cha kaurava |
nAgarAjastato rAja.nstatraivAntaradhIyata

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tasminnantarhite nAge prayayau naiShadho nalaH |
RRituparNasya nagaraM prAvishaddashame.ahani
shlokas.2:
sa rAjAnamupAtiShThadbAhuko.ahamiti bruvan |
ashvAnAM vAhane yuktaH pRRithivyAM nAsti matsamaH
shlokas.3:
arthakRRichChreShu chaivAhaM praShTavyo naipuNeShu cha |
annasa.nskAramapi cha jAnAmyanyairvisheShataH
shlokas.4:
yAni shilpAni loke.asminyachchApyanyatsuduShkaram |
sarvaM yatiShye tatkartumRRituparNa bharasva mAm
shlokas.5:
RRituparNa uvAcha||
vasa bAhuka bhadraM te sarvametatkariShyasi |
shIghrayAne sadA buddhirdhIyate me visheShataH
shlokas.6:
sa tvamAtiShTha yogaM taM yena shIghrA hayA mama |
bhaveyurashvAdhyakSho.asi vetanaM te shataM shatAH
shlokas.7:
tvAmupasthAsyatashchemau nityaM vArShNeyajIvalau |
etAbhyAM ra.nsyase sArdhaM vasa vai mayi bAhuka
shlokas.8:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evamukto nalastena nyavasattatra pUjitaH |
RRituparNasya nagare sahavArShNeyajIvalaH
shlokas.9:
sa tatra nivasanrAjA vaidarbhImanuchintayan |
sAyaM sAyaM sadA chemaM shlokamekaM jagAda ha
shlokas.10:
kva nu sA kShutpipAsArtA shrAntA shete tapasvinI |
smarantI tasya mandasya kaM vA sAdyopatiShThati
shlokas.11:
evaM bruvantaM rAjAnaM nishAyAM jIvalo.abravIt |
kAmenAM shochase nityaM shrotumichChAmi bAhuka
shlokas.12:
tamuvAcha nalo rAjA mandapraj~nasya kasyachit |
AsIdbahumatA nArI tasyA dRRiDhataraM cha saH
shlokas.13:
sa vai kenachidarthena tayA mando vyayujyata |
viprayuktashcha mandAtmA bhramatyasukhapIDitaH
shlokas.14:
dahyamAnaH sa shokena divArAtramatandritaH |
nishAkAle smara.nstasyAH shlokamekaM sma gAyati
shlokas.15:
sa vai bhramanmahIM sarvAM kvachidAsAdya ki~nchana |
vasatyanarhastadduHkhaM bhUya evAnusa.nsmaran
shlokas.16:
sA tu taM puruShaM nArI kRRichChre.apyanugatA vane |
tyaktA tenAlpapuNyena duShkaraM yadi jIvati
shlokas.17:
ekA bAlAnabhij~nA cha mArgANAmatathochitA |
kShutpipAsAparItA cha duShkaraM yadi jIvati
shlokas.18:
shvApadAcharite nityaM vane mahati dAruNe |
tyaktA tenAlpapuNyena mandapraj~nena mAriSha
shlokas.19:
ityevaM naiShadho rAjA damayantImanusmaran |
aj~nAtavAsamavasadrAj~nastasya niveshane

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
hRRitarAjye nale bhImaH sabhArye preShyatAM gate |
dvijAnprasthApayAmAsa naladarshanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.2:
sa.ndidesha cha tAnbhImo vasu dattvA cha puShkalam |
mRRigayadhvaM nalaM chaiva damayantIM cha me sutAm
shlokas.3:
asminkarmaNi niShpanne vij~nAte niShadhAdhipe |
gavAM sahasraM dAsyAmi yo vastAvAnayiShyati
agrahAraM cha dAsyAmi grAmaM nagarasaMmitam
shlokas.4:
na chechChakyAvihAnetuM damayantI nalo.api vA |
j~nAtamAtre.api dAsyAmi gavAM dashashataM dhanam
shlokas.5:
ityuktAste yayurhRRiShTA brAhmaNAH sarvatodisham |
purarAShTrANi chinvanto naiShadhaM saha bhAryayA
shlokas.6:
tatashchedipurIM ramyAM sudevo nAma vai dvijaH |
vichinvAno.atha vaidarbhImapashyadrAjaveshmani
puNyAhavAchane rAj~naH sunandAsahitAM sthitAm
shlokas.7:
mandaprakhyAyamAnena rUpeNApratimena tAm |
pinaddhAM dhUmajAlena prabhAmiva vibhAvasoH
shlokas.8:
tAM samIkShya vishAlAkShImadhikaM malinAM kRRishAm |
tarkayAmAsa bhaimIti kAraNairupapAdayan
shlokas.9:
sudeva uvAcha||
yatheyaM me purA dRRiShTA tathArUpeyama~NganA |
kRRitArtho.asmyadya dRRiShTvemAM lokakAntAmiva shriyam
shlokas.10:
pUrNachandrAnanAM shyAmAM chAruvRRittapayodharAm |
kurvantIM prabhayA devIM sarvA vitimirA dishaH
shlokas.11:
chArupadmapalAshAkShIM manmathasya ratImiva |
iShTAM sarvasya jagataH pUrNachandraprabhAmiva
shlokas.12:
vidarbhasarasastasmAddaivadoShAdivoddhRRitAm |
malapa~NkAnuliptA~NgIM mRRiNAlImiva tAM bhRRisham
shlokas.13:
paurNamAsImiva nishAM rAhugrastanishAkarAm |
patishokAkulAM dInAM shuShkasrotAM nadImiva
shlokas.14:
vidhvastaparNakamalAM vitrAsitaviha~NgamAm |
hastihastaparikliShTAM vyAkulAmiva padminIm
shlokas.15:
sukumArIM sujAtA~NgIM ratnagarbhagRRihochitAm |
dahyamAnAmivoShNena mRRiNAlImachiroddhRRitAm
shlokas.16:
rUpaudAryaguNopetAM maNDanArhAmamaNDitAm |
chandralekhAmiva navAM vyomni nIlAbhrasa.nvRRitAm
shlokas.17:
kAmabhogaiH priyairhInAM hInAM bandhujanena cha |
dehaM dhArayatIM dInAM bhartRRidarshanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.18:
bhartA nAma paraM nAryA bhUShaNaM bhUShaNairvinA |
eShA virahitA tena shobhanApi na shobhate
shlokas.19:
duShkaraM kurute.atyarthaM hIno yadanayA nalaH |
dhArayatyAtmano dehaM na shokenAvasIdati
shlokas.20:
imAmasitakeshAntAM shatapatrAyatekShaNAm |
sukhArhAM duHkhitAM dRRiShTvA mamApi vyathate manaH
shlokas.21:
kadA nu khalu duHkhasya pAraM yAsyati vai shubhA |
bhartuH samAgamAtsAdhvI rohiNI shashino yathA
shlokas.22:
asyA nUnaM punarlAbhAnnaiShadhaH prItimeShyati |
rAjA rAjyaparibhraShTaH punarlabdhveva medinIm
shlokas.23:
tulyashIlavayoyuktAM tulyAbhijanasa.nyutAm |
naiShadho.arhati vaidarbhIM taM cheyamasitekShaNA
shlokas.24:
yuktaM tasyAprameyasya vIryasattvavato mayA |
samAshvAsayituM bhAryAM patidarshanalAlasAm
shlokas.25:
ayamAshvAsayAmyenAM pUrNachandranibhAnanAm |
adRRiShTapUrvAM duHkhasya duHkhArtAM dhyAnatatparAm
shlokas.26:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evaM vimRRishya vividhaiH kAraNairlakShaNaishcha tAm |
upagamya tato bhaimIM sudevo brAhmaNo.abravIt
shlokas.27:
ahaM sudevo vaidarbhi bhrAtuste dayitaH sakhA |
bhImasya vachanAdrAj~nastvAmanveShTumihAgataH
shlokas.28:
kushalI te pitA rAj~ni janitrI bhrAtarashcha te |
AyuShmantau kushalinau tatrasthau dArakau cha te
tvatkRRite bandhuvargAshcha gatasattvA ivAsate
shlokas.29:
abhij~nAya sudevaM tu damayantI yudhiShThira |
paryapRRichChattataH sarvAnkrameNa suhRRidaH svakAn
shlokas.30:
ruroda cha bhRRishaM rAjanvaidarbhI shokakarshitA |
dRRiShTvA sudevaM sahasA bhrAturiShTaM dvijottamam
shlokas.31:
tato rudantIM tAM dRRiShTvA sunandA shokakarshitAm |
sudevena sahaikAnte kathayantIM cha bhArata
shlokas.32:
janitryai preShayAmAsa sairandhrI rudate bhRRisham |
brAhmaNena samAgamya tAM veda yadi manyase
shlokas.33:
atha chedipatermAtA rAj~nashchAntaHpurAttadA |
jagAma yatra sA bAlA brAhmaNena sahAbhavat
shlokas.34:
tataH sudevamAnAyya rAjamAtA vishAM pate |
paprachCha bhAryA kasyeyaM sutA vA kasya bhAminI
shlokas.35:
kathaM cha naShTA j~nAtibhyo bharturvA vAmalochanA |
tvayA cha viditA vipra kathameva~NgatA satI
shlokas.36:
etadichChAmyahaM tvatto j~nAtuM sarvamasheShataH |
tattvena hi mamAchakShva pRRichChantyA devarUpiNIm
shlokas.37:
evamuktastayA rAjansudevo dvijasattamaH |
sukhopaviShTa AchaShTa damayantyA yathAtatham

shlokas.1:
sudeva uvAcha||
vidarbharAjo dharmAtmA bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
suteyaM tasya kalyANI damayantIti vishrutA
shlokas.2:
rAjA tu naiShadho nAma vIrasenasuto nalaH |
bhAryeyaM tasya kalyANI puNyashlokasya dhImataH
shlokas.3:
sa vai dyUte jito bhrAtrA hRRitarAjyo mahIpatiH |
damayantyA gataH sArdhaM na praj~nAyata karhichit
shlokas.4:
te vayaM damayantyarthe charAmaH pRRithivImimAm |
seyamAsAditA bAlA tava putraniveshane
shlokas.5:
asyA rUpeNa sadRRishI mAnuShI neha vidyate |
asyAshchaiva bhruvormadhye sahajaH pipluruttamaH
shyAmAyAH padmasa~NkAsho lakShito.antarhito mayA
shlokas.6:
malena sa.nvRRito hyasyAstanvabhreNeva chandramAH |
chihnabhUto vibhUtyarthamayaM dhAtrA vinirmitaH
shlokas.7:
pratipatkaluShevendorlekhA nAti virAjate |
na chAsyA nashyate rUpaM vapurmalasamAchitam
asa.nskRRitamapi vyaktaM bhAti kA~nchanasaMnibham
shlokas.8:
anena vapuShA bAlA piplunAnena chaiva ha |
lakShiteyaM mayA devI pihito.agnirivoShmaNA
shlokas.9:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya sudevasya vishAM pate |
sunandA shodhayAmAsa pipluprachChAdanaM malam
shlokas.10:
sa malenApakRRiShTena piplustasyA vyarochata |
damayantyAstadA vyabhre nabhasIva nishAkaraH
shlokas.11:
pipluM dRRiShTvA sunandA cha rAjamAtA cha bhArata |
rudantyau tAM pariShvajya muhUrtamiva tasthatuH
utsRRijya bAShpaM shanakai rAjamAtedamabravIt
shlokas.12:
bhaginyA duhitA me.asi piplunAnena sUchitA |
ahaM cha tava mAtA cha rAjanyasya mahAtmanaH
sute dashArNAdhipateH sudAmnashchArudarshane
shlokas.13:
bhImasya rAj~naH sA dattA vIrabAhorahaM punaH |
tvaM tu jAtA mayA dRRiShTA dashArNeShu piturgRRihe
shlokas.14:
yathaiva te piturgehaM tathedamapi bhAmini |
yathaiva hi mamaishvaryaM damayanti tathA tava
shlokas.15:
tAM prahRRiShTena manasA damayantI vishAM pate |
abhivAdya mAturbhaginImidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.16:
aj~nAyamAnApi satI sukhamasmyuShiteha vai |
sarvakAmaiH suvihitA rakShyamANA sadA tvayA
shlokas.17:
sukhAtsukhataro vAso bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH |
chiraviproShitAM mAtarmAmanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.18:
dArakau cha hi me nItau vasatastatra bAlakau |
pitrA vihInau shokArtau mayA chaiva kathaM nu tau
shlokas.19:
yadi chApi priyaM ki~nchinmayi kartumihechChasi |
vidarbhAnyAtumichChAmi shIghraM me yAnamAdisha
shlokas.20:
bADhamityeva tAmuktvA hRRiShTA mAtRRiShvasA nRRipa |
guptAM balena mahatA putrasyAnumate tataH
shlokas.21:
prasthApayadrAjamAtA shrImatA naravAhinA |
yAnena bharatashreShTha svannapAnaparichChadAm
shlokas.22:
tataH sA nachirAdeva vidarbhAnagamachChubhA |
tAM tu bandhujanaH sarvaH prahRRiShTaH pratyapUjayat
shlokas.23:
sarvAnkushalino dRRiShTvA bAndhavAndArakau cha tau |
mAtaraM pitaraM chaiva sarvaM chaiva sakhIjanam
shlokas.24:
devatAH pUjayAmAsa brAhmaNA.nshcha yashasvinI |
vidhinA pareNa kalyANI damayantI vishAM pate
shlokas.25:
atarpayatsudevaM cha gosahasreNa pArthivaH |
prIto dRRiShTvaiva tanayAM grAmeNa draviNena cha
shlokas.26:
sA vyuShTA rajanIM tatra piturveshmani bhAminI |
vishrAntA mAtaraM rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
damayantyuvAcha||
mAM chedichChasi jIvantIM mAtaH satyaM bravImi te |
naravIrasya vai tasya nalasyAnayane yata
shlokas.2:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
damayantyA tathoktA tu sA devI bhRRishaduHkhitA |
bAShpeNa pihitA rAjannottaraM ki~nchidabravIt
shlokas.3:
tadavasthAM tu tAM dRRiShTvA sarvamantaHpuraM tadA |
hAhAbhUtamatIvAsIdbhRRishaM cha praruroda ha
shlokas.4:
tato bhImaM mahArAja bhAryA vachanamabravIt |
damayantI tava sutA bhartAramanushochati
shlokas.5:
apakRRiShya cha lajjAM mAM svayamuktavatI nRRipa |
prayatantu tava preShyAH puNyashlokasya darshane
shlokas.6:
tayA prachodito rAjA brAhmaNAnvashavartinaH |
prAsthApayaddishaH sarvA yatadhvaM naladarshane
shlokas.7:
tato vidarbhAdhipaterniyogAdbrAhmaNarShabhAH |
damayantImatho dRRiShTvA prasthitAH smetyathAbruvan
shlokas.8:
atha tAnabravIdbhaimI sarvarAShTreShvidaM vachaH |
bruvadhvaM janasa.nsatsu tatra tatra punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
kva nu tvaM kitava ChittvA vastrArdhaM prasthito mama |
utsRRijya vipine suptAmanuraktAM priyAM priya
shlokas.10:
sA vai yathA samAdiShTA tatrAste tvatpratIkShiNI |
dahyamAnA bhRRishaM bAlA vastrArdhenAbhisa.nvRRitA
shlokas.11:
tasyA rudantyAH satataM tena shokena pArthiva |
prasAdaM kuru vai vIra prativAkyaM dadasva cha
shlokas.12:
etadanyachcha vaktavyaM kRRipAM kuryAdyathA mayi |
vAyunA dhUyamAno hi vanaM dahati pAvakaH
shlokas.13:
bhartavyA rakShaNIyA cha patnI hi patinA sadA |
tannaShTamubhayaM kasmAddharmaj~nasya satastava
shlokas.14:
khyAtaH prAj~naH kulInashcha sAnukroshashcha tvaM sadA |
sa.nvRRitto niranukroshaH sha~Nke madbhAgyasa~NkShayAt
shlokas.15:
sa kuruShva maheShvAsa dayAM mayi nararShabha |
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmastvatta eva hi me shrutam
shlokas.16:
evaM bruvANAnyadi vaH pratibrUyAddhi kashchana |
sa naraH sarvathA j~neyaH kashchAsau kva cha vartate
shlokas.17:
yachcha vo vachanaM shrutvA brUyAtprativacho naraH |
tadAdAya vachaH kShipraM mamAvedyaM dvijottamAH
shlokas.18:
yathA cha vo na jAnIyAchcharato bhImashAsanAt |
punarAgamanaM chaiva tathA kAryamatandritaiH
shlokas.19:
yadi vAsau samRRiddhaH syAdyadi vApyadhano bhavet |
yadi vApyarthakAmaH syAjj~neyamasya chikIrShitam
shlokas.20:
evamuktAstvagachCha.nste brAhmaNAH sarvatodisham |
nalaM mRRigayituM rAja.nstathA vyasaninaM tadA
shlokas.21:
te purANi sarAShTrANi grAmAnghoShA.nstathAshramAn |
anveShanto nalaM rAjannAdhijagmurdvijAtayaH
shlokas.22:
tachcha vAkyaM tathA sarve tatra tatra vishAM pate |
shrAvayAM chakrire viprA damayantyA yatheritam

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
atha dIrghasya kAlasya parNAdo nAma vai dvijaH |
pratyetya nagaraM bhaimImidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
naiShadhaM mRRigayAnena damayanti divAnisham |
ayodhyAM nagarIM gatvA bhA~NgasvarirupasthitaH
shlokas.3:
shrAvitashcha mayA vAkyaM tvadIyaM sa mahAjane |
RRituparNo mahAbhAgo yathoktaM varavarNini
shlokas.4:
tachChrutvA nAbravItki~nchidRRituparNo narAdhipaH |
na cha pAriShadaH kashchidbhAShyamANo mayAsakRRit
shlokas.5:
anuj~nAtaM tu mAM rAj~nA vijane kashchidabravIt |
RRituparNasya puruSho bAhuko nAma nAmataH
shlokas.6:
sUtastasya narendrasya virUpo hrasvabAhukaH |
shIghrayAne sukushalo mRRiShTakartA cha bhojane
shlokas.7:
sa viniHshvasya bahusho ruditvA cha muhurmuhuH |
kushalaM chaiva mAM pRRiShTvA pashchAdidamabhAShata
shlokas.8:
vaiShamyamapi samprAptA gopAyanti kulastriyaH |
AtmAnamAtmanA satyo jitasvargA na sa.nshayaH
rahitA bhartRRibhishchaiva na krudhyanti kadAchana
shlokas.9:
viShamasthena mUDhena paribhraShTasukhena cha |
yatsA tena parityaktA tatra na kroddhumarhati
shlokas.10:
prANayAtrAM pariprepsoH shakunairhRRitavAsasaH |
AdhibhirdahyamAnasya shyAmA na kroddhumarhati
shlokas.11:
satkRRitAsatkRRitA vApi patiM dRRiShTvA tathAgatam |
bhraShTarAjyaM shriyA hInaM shyAmA na kroddhumarhati
shlokas.12:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA tvarito.ahamihAgataH |
shrutvA pramANaM bhavatI rAj~nashchaiva nivedaya
shlokas.13:
etachChrutvAshrupUrNAkShI parNAdasya vishAM pate |
damayantI raho.abhyetya mAtaraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.14:
ayamartho na sa.nvedyo bhIme mAtaH katha~nchana |
tvatsaMnidhau samAdekShye sudevaM dvijasattamam
shlokas.15:
yathA na nRRipatirbhImaH pratipadyeta me matam |
tathA tvayA prayattavyaM mama chetpriyamichChasi
shlokas.16:
yathA chAhaM samAnItA sudevenAshu bAndhavAn |
tenaiva ma~NgalenAshu sudevo yAtu mAchiram
samAnetuM nalaM mAtarayodhyAM nagarImitaH
shlokas.17:
vishrAntaM cha tataH pashchAtparNAdaM dvijasattamam |
archayAmAsa vaidarbhI dhanenAtIva bhAminI
shlokas.18:
nale chehAgate vipra bhUyo dAsyAmi te vasu |
tvayA hi me bahu kRRitaM yathA nAnyaH kariShyati
yadbhartrAhaM sameShyAmi shIghrameva dvijottama
shlokas.19:
evamukto.archayitvA tAmAshIrvAdaiH suma~NgalaiH |
gRRihAnupayayau chApi kRRitArthaH sa mahAmanAH
shlokas.20:
tatashchAnAyya taM vipraM damayantI yudhiShThira |
abravItsaMnidhau mAturduHkhashokasamanvitA
shlokas.21:
gatvA sudeva nagarImayodhyAvAsinaM nRRipam |
RRituparNaM vacho brUhi patimanyaM chikIrShatI
AsthAsyati punarbhaimI damayantI svaya.nvaram
shlokas.22:
tatra gachChanti rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha sarvashaH |
yathA cha gaNitaH kAlaH shvobhUte sa bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
yadi sambhAvanIyaM te gachCha shIghramari.ndama |
sUryodaye dvitIyaM sA bhartAraM varayiShyati
na hi sa j~nAyate vIro nalo jIvanmRRito.api vA
shlokas.24:
evaM tayA yathoktaM vai gatvA rAjAnamabravIt |
RRituparNaM mahArAja sudevo brAhmaNastadA

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
shrutvA vachaH sudevasya RRituparNo narAdhipaH |
sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA vAchA bAhukaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
vidarbhAnyAtumichChAmi damadantyAH svaya.nvaram |
ekAhnA hayatattvaj~na manyase yadi bAhuka
shlokas.3:
evamuktasya kaunteya tena rAj~nA nalasya ha |
vyadIryata mano duHkhAtpradadhyau cha mahAmanAH
shlokas.4:
damayantI bhavedetatkuryAdduHkhena mohitA |
asmadarthe bhavedvAyamupAyashchintito mahAn
shlokas.5:
nRRisha.nsaM bata vaidarbhI kartukAmA tapasvinI |
mayA kShudreNa nikRRitA pApenAkRRitabuddhinA
shlokas.6:
strIsvabhAvashchalo loke mama doShashcha dAruNaH |
syAdevamapi kuryAtsA vivashA gatasauhRRidA
mama shokena sa.nvignA nairAshyAttanumadhyamA
shlokas.7:
na chaivaM karhichitkuryAtsApatyA cha visheShataH |
yadatra tathyaM pathyaM cha gatvA vetsyAmi nishchayam
RRituparNasya vai kAmamAtmArthaM cha karomyaham
shlokas.8:
iti nishchitya manasA bAhuko dInamAnasaH |
kRRitA~njaliruvAchedamRRituparNaM narAdhipam
shlokas.9:
pratijAnAmi te satyaM gamiShyasi narAdhipa |
ekAhnA puruShavyAghra vidarbhanagarIM nRRipa
shlokas.10:
tataH parIkShAmashvAnAM chakre rAjansa bAhukaH |
ashvashAlAmupAgamya bhA~NgasvarinRRipAj~nayA
shlokas.11:
sa tvaryamANo bahusha RRituparNena bAhukaH |
adhyagachChatkRRishAnashvAnsamarthAnadhvani kShamAn
shlokas.12:
tejobalasamAyuktAnkulashIlasamanvitAn |
varjitA.NllakShaNairhInaiH pRRithuprothAnmahAhanUn
shuddhAndashabhirAvartaiH sindhujAnvAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA tAnabravIdrAjA ki~nchitkopasamanvitaH |
kimidaM prArthitaM kartuM pralabdhavyA hi te vayam
shlokas.14:
kathamalpabalaprANA vakShyantIme hayA mama |
mahAnadhvA cha turagairgantavyaH kathamIdRRishaiH
shlokas.15:
bAhuka uvAcha||
ete hayA gamiShyanti vidarbhAnnAtra sa.nshayaH |
athAnyAnmanyase rAjanbrUhi kAnyojayAmi te
shlokas.16:
RRituparNa uvAcha||
tvameva hayatattvaj~naH kushalashchAsi bAhuka |
yAnmanyase samarthA.nstvaM kShipraM tAneva yojaya
shlokas.17:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tataH sadashvA.nshchaturaH kulashIlasamanvitAn |
yojayAmAsa kushalo javayuktAnrathe naraH
shlokas.18:
tato yuktaM rathaM rAjA samArohattvarAnvitaH |
atha paryapatanbhUmau jAnubhiste hayottamAH
shlokas.19:
tato naravaraH shrImAnnalo rAjA vishAM pate |
sAntvayAmAsa tAnashvA.nstejobalasamanvitAn
shlokas.20:
rashmibhishcha samudyamya nalo yAtumiyeSha saH |
sUtamAropya vArShNeyaM javamAsthAya vai param
shlokas.21:
te chodyamAnA vidhinA bAhukena hayottamAH |
samutpeturivAkAshaM rathinaM mohayanniva
shlokas.22:
tathA tu dRRiShTvA tAnashvAnvahato vAtaraMhasaH |
ayodhyAdhipatirdhImAnvismayaM paramaM yayau
shlokas.23:
rathaghoShaM tu taM shrutvA hayasa~NgrahaNaM cha tat |
vArShNeyashchintayAmAsa bAhukasya hayaj~natAm
shlokas.24:
kiM nu syAnmAtalirayaM devarAjasya sArathiH |
tathA hi lakShaNaM vIre bAhuke dRRishyate mahat
shlokas.25:
shAlihotro.atha kiM nu syAddhayAnAM kulatattvavit |
mAnuShaM samanuprApto vapuH paramashobhanam
shlokas.26:
utAho svidbhavedrAjA nalaH parapura~njayaH |
so.ayaM nRRipatirAyAta ityevaM samachintayat
shlokas.27:
atha vA yAM nalo veda vidyAM tAmeva bAhukaH |
tulyaM hi lakShaye j~nAnaM bAhukasya nalasya cha
shlokas.28:
api chedaM vayastulyamasya manye nalasya cha |
nAyaM nalo mahAvIryastadvidyastu bhaviShyati
shlokas.29:
prachChannA hi mahAtmAnashcharanti pRRithivImimAm |
daivena vidhinA yuktAH shAstroktaishcha virUpaNaiH
shlokas.30:
bhavettu matibhedo me gAtravairUpyatAM prati |
pramANAtparihInastu bhavediti hi me matiH
shlokas.31:
vayaHpramANaM tattulyaM rUpeNa tu viparyayaH |
nalaM sarvaguNairyuktaM manye bAhukamantataH
shlokas.32:
evaM vichArya bahusho vArShNeyaH paryachintayat |
hRRidayena mahArAja puNyashlokasya sArathiH
shlokas.33:
RRituparNastu rAjendra bAhukasya hayaj~natAm |
chintayanmumude rAjA sahavArShNeyasArathiH
shlokas.34:
balaM vIryaM tathotsAhaM hayasa~NgrahaNaM cha tat |
paraM yatnaM cha samprekShya parAM mudamavApa ha

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sa nadIH parvatA.nshchaiva vanAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
achireNAtichakrAma khecharaH khe charanniva
shlokas.2:
tathA prayAte tu rathe tadA bhA~NgasvarirnRRipaH |
uttarIyamathApashyadbhraShTaM parapura~njayaH
shlokas.3:
tataH sa tvaramANastu paTe nipatite tadA |
grahIShyAmIti taM rAjA nalamAha mahAmanAH
shlokas.4:
nigRRihNIShva mahAbuddhe hayAnetAnmahAjavAn |
vArShNeyo yAvadetaM me paTamAnayatAmiti
shlokas.5:
nalastaM pratyuvAchAtha dUre bhraShTaH paTastava |
yojanaM samatikrAnto na sa shakyastvayA punaH
shlokas.6:
evamukte nalenAtha tadA bhA~NgasvarirnRRipaH |
AsasAda vane rAjanphalavantaM bibhItakam
shlokas.7:
taM dRRiShTvA bAhukaM rAjA tvaramANo.abhyabhAShata |
mamApi sUta pashya tvaM sa~NkhyAne paramaM balam
shlokas.8:
sarvaH sarvaM na jAnAti sarvaj~no nAsti kashchana |
naikatra pariniShThAsti j~nAnasya puruShe kvachit
shlokas.9:
vRRikShe.asminyAni parNAni phalAnyapi cha bAhuka |
patitAni cha yAnyatra tatraikamadhikaM shatam
ekapatrAdhikaM patraM phalamekaM cha bAhuka
shlokas.10:
pa~ncha koTyo.atha patrANAM dvayorapi cha shAkhayoH |
prachinuhyasya shAkhe dve yAshchApyanyAH prashAkhikAH
AbhyAM phalasahasre dve pa~nchonaM shatameva cha
shlokas.11:
tato rathAdavaplutya rAjAnaM bAhuko.abravIt |
parokShamiva me rAjankatthase shatrukarshana
shlokas.12:
atha te gaNite rAjanvidyate na parokShatA |
pratyakShaM te mahArAja gaNayiShye bibhItakam
shlokas.13:
ahaM hi nAbhijAnAmi bhavedevaM na veti cha |
sa~NkhyAsyAmi phalAnyasya pashyataste janAdhipa
muhUrtamiva vArShNeyo rashmInyachChatu vAjinAm
shlokas.14:
tamabravInnRRipaH sUtaM nAyaM kAlo vilambitum |
bAhukastvabravIdenaM paraM yatnaM samAsthitaH
shlokas.15:
pratIkShasva muhUrtaM tvamatha vA tvarate bhavAn |
eSha yAti shivaH panthA yAhi vArShNeyasArathiH
shlokas.16:
abravIdRRituparNastaM sAntvayankurunandana |
tvameva yantA nAnyo.asti pRRithivyAmapi bAhuka
shlokas.17:
tvatkRRite yAtumichChAmi vidarbhAnhayakovida |
sharaNaM tvAM prapanno.asmi na vighnaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.18:
kAmaM cha te kariShyAmi yanmAM vakShyasi bAhuka |
vidarbhAnyadi yAtvAdya sUryaM darshayitAsi me
shlokas.19:
athAbravIdbAhukastaM sa~NkhyAyemaM bibhItakam |
tato vidarbhAnyAsyAmi kuruShvedaM vacho mama
shlokas.20:
akAma iva taM rAjA gaNayasvetyuvAcha ha |
so.avatIrya rathAttUrNaM shAtayAmAsa taM drumam
shlokas.21:
tataH sa vismayAviShTo rAjAnamidamabravIt |
gaNayitvA yathoktAni tAvantyeva phalAni cha
shlokas.22:
atyadbhutamidaM rAjandRRiShTavAnasmi te balam |
shrotumichChAmi tAM vidyAM yathaitajj~nAyate nRRipa
shlokas.23:
tamuvAcha tato rAjA tvarito gamane tadA |
viddhyakShahRRidayaj~naM mAM sa~NkhyAne cha vishAradam
shlokas.24:
bAhukastamuvAchAtha dehi vidyAmimAM mama |
matto.api chAshvahRRidayaM gRRihANa puruSharShabha
shlokas.25:
RRituparNastato rAjA bAhukaM kAryagauravAt |
hayaj~nAnasya lobhAchcha tathetyevAbravIdvachaH
shlokas.26:
yatheShTaM tvaM gRRihANedamakShANAM hRRidayaM param |
nikShepo me.ashvahRRidayaM tvayi tiShThatu bAhuka
evamuktvA dadau vidyAmRRituparNo nalAya vai
shlokas.27:
tasyAkShahRRidayaj~nasya sharIrAnniHsRRitaH kaliH |
karkoTakaviShaM tIkShNaM mukhAtsatatamudvaman
shlokas.28:
kalestasya tadArtasya shApAgniH sa viniHsRRitaH |
sa tena karshito rAjA dIrghakAlamanAtmavAn
shlokas.29:
tato viShavimuktAtmA svarUpamakarotkaliH |
taM shaptumaichChatkupito niShadhAdhipatirnalaH
shlokas.30:
tamuvAcha kalirbhIto vepamAnaH kRRitA~njaliH |
kopaM sa.nyachCha nRRipate kIrtiM dAsyAmi te parAm
shlokas.31:
indrasenasya jananI kupitA mAshapatpurA |
yadA tvayA parityaktA tato.ahaM bhRRishapIDitaH
shlokas.32:
avasaM tvayi rAjendra suduHkhamaparAjita |
viSheNa nAgarAjasya dahyamAno divAnisham
shlokas.33:
ye cha tvAM manujA loke kIrtayiShyantyatandritAH |
matprasUtaM bhayaM teShAM na kadAchidbhaviShyati
shlokas.34:
evamukto nalo rAjA nyayachChatkopamAtmanaH |
tato bhItaH kaliH kShipraM pravivesha bibhItakam
kalistvanyena nAdRRishyatkathayannaiShadhena vai
shlokas.35:
tato gatajvaro rAjA naiShadhaH paravIrahA |
sampranaShTe kalau rAjansa~NkhyAyAtha phalAnyuta
shlokas.36:
mudA paramayA yuktastejasA cha pareNa ha |
rathamAruhya tejasvI prayayau javanairhayaiH
bibhItakashchAprashastaH sa.nvRRittaH kalisa.nshrayAt
shlokas.37:
hayottamAnutpatato dvijAniva punaH punaH |
nalaH sa~nchodayAmAsa prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.38:
vidarbhAbhimukho rAjA prayayau sa mahAmanAH |
nale tu samatikrAnte kalirapyagamadgRRihAn
shlokas.39:
tato gatajvaro rAjA nalo.abhUtpRRithivIpate |
vimuktaH kalinA rAjanrUpamAtraviyojitaH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
tato vidarbhAnsamprAptaM sAyAhne satyavikramam |
RRituparNaM janA rAj~ne bhImAya pratyavedayan
shlokas.2:
sa bhImavachanAdrAjA kuNDinaM prAvishatpuram |
nAdayanrathaghoSheNa sarvAH sopadisho dasha
shlokas.3:
tatastaM rathanirghoShaM nalAshvAstatra shushruvuH |
shrutvA cha samahRRiShyanta pureva nalasaMnidhau
shlokas.4:
damayantI cha shushrAva rathaghoShaM nalasya tam |
yathA meghasya nadato gambhIraM jaladAgame
shlokas.5:
nalena sa~NgRRihIteShu pureva nalavAjiShu |
sadRRishaM rathanirghoShaM mene bhaimI tathA hayAH
shlokas.6:
prAsAdasthAshcha shikhinaH shAlAsthAshchaiva vAraNAH |
hayAshcha shushruvustatra rathaghoShaM mahIpateH
shlokas.7:
te shrutvA rathanirghoShaM vAraNAH shikhinastathA |
praNedurunmukhA rAjanmeghodayamivekShya ha
shlokas.8:
damayantyuvAcha||
yathAsau rathanirghoShaH pUrayanniva medinIm |
mama hlAdayate cheto nala eSha mahIpatiH
shlokas.9:
adya chandrAbhavaktraM taM na pashyAmi nalaM yadi |
asa~NkhyeyaguNaM vIraM vinashiShyAmyasa.nshayam
shlokas.10:
yadi vai tasya vIrasya bAhvornAdyAhamantaram |
pravishAmi sukhasparshaM vinashiShyAmyasa.nshayam
shlokas.11:
yadi mAM meghanirghoSho nopagachChati naiShadhaH |
adya chAmIkaraprakhyo vinashiShyAmyasa.nshayam
shlokas.12:
yadi mAM siMhavikrAnto mattavAraNavAraNaH |
nAbhigachChati rAjendro vinashiShyAmyasa.nshayam
shlokas.13:
na smarAmyanRRitaM ki~nchinna smarAmyanupAkRRitam |
na cha paryuShitaM vAkyaM svaireShvapi mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
prabhuH kShamAvAnvIrashcha mRRidurdAnto jitendriyaH |
raho.anIchAnuvartI cha klIbavanmama naiShadhaH
shlokas.15:
guNA.nstasya smarantyA me tatparAyA divAnisham |
hRRidayaM dIryata idaM shokAtpriyavinAkRRitam
shlokas.16:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evaM vilapamAnA sA naShTasa~nj~neva bhArata |
Aruroha mahadveshma puNyashlokadidRRikShayA
shlokas.17:
tato madhyamakakShAyAM dadarsha rathamAsthitam |
RRituparNaM mahIpAlaM sahavArShNeyabAhukam
shlokas.18:
tato.avatIrya vArShNeyo bAhukashcha rathottamAt |
hayA.nstAnavamuchyAtha sthApayAmAsatU ratham
shlokas.19:
so.avatIrya rathopasthAdRRituparNo narAdhipaH |
upatasthe mahArAja bhImaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.20:
taM bhImaH pratijagrAha pUjayA parayA tataH |
akasmAtsahasA prAptaM strImantraM na sma vindati
shlokas.21:
kiM kAryaM svAgataM te.astu rAj~nA pRRiShTashcha bhArata |
nAbhijaj~ne sa nRRipatirduhitrarthe samAgatam
shlokas.22:
RRituparNo.api rAjA sa dhImAnsatyaparAkramaH |
rAjAnaM rAjaputraM vA na sma pashyati ka~nchana
naiva svaya.nvarakathAM na cha viprasamAgamam
shlokas.23:
tato vigaNayanrAjA manasA kosalAdhipaH |
Agato.asmItyuvAchainaM bhavantamabhivAdakaH
shlokas.24:
rAjApi cha smayanbhImo manasAbhivichintayat |
adhikaM yojanashataM tasyAgamanakAraNam
shlokas.25:
grAmAnbahUnatikramya nAdhyagachChadyathAtatham |
alpakAryaM vinirdiShTaM tasyAgamanakAraNam
shlokas.26:
naitadevaM sa nRRipatistaM satkRRitya vyasarjayat |
vishrAmyatAmiti vadanklAnto.asIti punaH punaH
shlokas.27:
sa satkRRitaH prahRRiShTAtmA prItaH prItena pArthivaH |
rAjapreShyairanugato diShTaM veshma samAvishat
shlokas.28:
RRituparNe gate rAjanvArShNeyasahite nRRipe |
bAhuko rathamAsthAya rathashAlAmupAgamat
shlokas.29:
sa mochayitvA tAnashvAnparichArya cha shAstrataH |
svayaM chaitAnsamAshvAsya rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.30:
damayantI tu shokArtA dRRiShTvA bhA~NgasvariM nRRipam |
sUtaputraM cha vArShNeyaM bAhukaM cha tathAvidham
shlokas.31:
chintayAmAsa vaidarbhI kasyaiSha rathanisvanaH |
nalasyeva mahAnAsInna cha pashyAmi naiShadham
shlokas.32:
vArShNeyena bhavennUnaM vidyA saivopashikShitA |
tenAsya rathanirghoSho nalasyeva mahAnabhUt
shlokas.33:
Aho svidRRituparNo.api yathA rAjA nalastathA |
tato.ayaM rathanirghoSho naiShadhasyeva lakShyate
shlokas.34:
evaM vitarkayitvA tu damayantI vishAM pate |
dUtIM prasthApayAmAsa naiShadhAnveShaNe nRRipa

shlokas.1:
damayantyuvAcha||
gachCha keshini jAnIhi ka eSha rathavAhakaH |
upaviShTo rathopasthe vikRRito hrasvabAhukaH
shlokas.2:
abhyetya kushalaM bhadre mRRidupUrvaM samAhitA |
pRRichChethAH puruShaM hyenaM yathAtattvamanindite
shlokas.3:
atra me mahatI sha~NkA bhavedeSha nalo nRRipaH |
tathA cha me manastuShTirhRRidayasya cha nirvRRitiH
shlokas.4:
brUyAshchainaM kathAnte tvaM parNAdavachanaM yathA |
prativAkyaM cha sushroNi budhyethAstvamanindite
shlokas.5:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evaM samAhitA gatvA dUtI bAhukamabravIt |
damayantyapi kalyANI prAsAdasthAnvavaikShata
shlokas.6:
keshinyuvAcha||
svAgataM te manuShyendra kushalaM te bravImyaham |
damayantyA vachaH sAdhu nibodha puruSharShabha
shlokas.7:
kadA vai prasthitA yUyaM kimarthamiha chAgatAH |
tattvaM brUhi yathAnyAyaM vaidarbhI shrotumichChati
shlokas.8:
bAhuka uvAcha||
shrutaH svaya.nvaro rAj~nA kausalyena yashasvinA |
dvitIyo damayantyA vai shvobhUta iti bhAmini
shlokas.9:
shrutvA taM prasthito rAjA shatayojanayAyibhiH |
hayairvAtajavairmukhyairahamasya cha sArathiH
shlokas.10:
keshinyuvAcha||
atha yo.asau tRRitIyo vaH sa kutaH kasya vA punaH |
tvaM cha kasya kathaM chedaM tvayi karma samAhitam
shlokas.11:
bAhuka uvAcha||
puNyashlokasya vai sUto vArShNeya iti vishrutaH |
sa nale vidrute bhadre bhA~NgasvarimupasthitaH
shlokas.12:
ahamapyashvakushalaH sUdatve cha suniShThitaH |
RRituparNena sArathye bhojane cha vRRitaH svayam
shlokas.13:
keshinyuvAcha||
atha jAnAti vArShNeyaH kva nu rAjA nalo gataH |
katha~nchittvayi vaitena kathitaM syAttu bAhuka
shlokas.14:
bAhuka uvAcha||
ihaiva putrau nikShipya nalasyAshubhakarmaNaH |
gatastato yathAkAmaM naiSha jAnAti naiShadham
shlokas.15:
na chAnyaH puruShaH kashchinnalaM vetti yashasvini |
gUDhashcharati loke.asminnaShTarUpo mahIpatiH
shlokas.16:
Atmaiva hi nalaM vetti yA chAsya tadanantarA |
na hi vai tAni li~NgAni nalaM sha.nsanti karhichit
shlokas.17:
keshinyuvAcha||
yo.asAvayodhyAM prathamaM gatavAnbrAhmaNastadA |
imAni nArIvAkyAni kathayAnaH punaH punaH
shlokas.18:
kva nu tvaM kitava ChittvA vastrArdhaM prasthito mama |
utsRRijya vipine suptAmanuraktAM priyAM priya
shlokas.19:
sA vai yathA samAdiShTA tatrAste tvatpratIkShiNI |
dahyamAnA divArAtraM vastrArdhenAbhisa.nvRRitA
shlokas.20:
tasyA rudantyAH satataM tena duHkhena pArthiva |
prasAdaM kuru vai vIra prativAkyaM prayachCha cha
shlokas.21:
tasyAstatpriyamAkhyAnaM prabravIhi mahAmate |
tadeva vAkyaM vaidarbhI shrotumichChatyaninditA
shlokas.22:
etachChrutvA prativachastasya dattaM tvayA kila |
yatpurA tatpunastvatto vaidarbhI shrotumichChati
shlokas.23:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evamuktasya keshinyA nalasya kurunandana |
hRRidayaM vyathitaM chAsIdashrupUrNe cha lochane
shlokas.24:
sa nigRRihyAtmano duHkhaM dahyamAno mahIpatiH |
bAShpasa.ndigdhayA vAchA punarevedamabravIt
shlokas.25:
vaiShamyamapi samprAptA gopAyanti kulastriyaH |
AtmAnamAtmanA satyo jitasvargA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
rahitA bhartRRibhishchaiva na krudhyanti kadAchana |
prANA.nshchAritrakavachA dhArayantIha satstriyaH
shlokas.27:
prANayAtrAM pariprepsoH shakunairhRRitavAsasaH |
AdhibhirdahyamAnasya shyAmA na kroddhumarhati
shlokas.28:
satkRRitAsatkRRitA vApi patiM dRRiShTvA tathAgatam |
bhraShTarAjyaM shriyA hInaM kShudhitaM vyasanAplutam
shlokas.29:
evaM bruvANastadvAkyaM nalaH paramaduHkhitaH |
na bAShpamashakatsoDhuM praruroda cha bhArata
shlokas.30:
tataH sA keshinI gatvA damayantyai nyavedayat |
tatsarvaM kathitaM chaiva vikAraM chaiva tasya tam

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
damayantI tu tachChrutvA bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNA |
sha~NkamAnA nalaM taM vai keshinImidamabravIt
shlokas.2:
gachCha keshini bhUyastvaM parIkShAM kuru bAhuke |
AbruvANA samIpasthA charitAnyasya lakShaya
shlokas.3:
yadA cha ki~nchitkuryAtsa kAraNaM tatra bhAmini |
tatra sa~ncheShTamAnasya sa.nlakShyaM te vicheShTitam
shlokas.4:
na chAsya pratibandhena deyo.agnirapi bhAmini |
yAchate na jalaM deyaM samyagatvaramANayA
shlokas.5:
etatsarvaM samIkShya tvaM charitaM me nivedaya |
yachchAnyadapi pashyethAstachchAkhyeyaM tvayA mama
shlokas.6:
damayantyaivamuktA sA jagAmAthAshu keshinI |
nishAmya cha hayaj~nasya li~NgAni punarAgamat
shlokas.7:
sA tatsarvaM yathAvRRittaM damayantyai nyavedayat |
nimittaM yattadA dRRiShTaM bAhuke divyamAnuSham
shlokas.8:
keshinyuvAcha||
dRRiDhaM shuchyupachAro.asau na mayA mAnuShaH kvachit |
dRRiShTapUrvaH shruto vApi damayanti tathAvidhaH
shlokas.9:
hrasvamAsAdya sa~nchAraM nAsau vinamate kvachit |
taM tu dRRiShTvA yathAsa~Ngamutsarpati yathAsukham
sa~NkaTe.apyasya sumahadvivaraM jAyate.adhikam
shlokas.10:
RRituparNasya chArthAya bhojanIyamanekashaH |
preShitaM tatra rAj~nA cha mA.nsaM subahu pAshavam
shlokas.11:
tasya prakShAlanArthAya kumbhastatropakalpitaH |
sa tenAvekShitaH kumbhaH pUrNa evAbhavattadA
shlokas.12:
tataH prakShAlanaM kRRitvA samadhishritya bAhukaH |
tRRiNamuShTiM samAdAya AvidhyainaM samAdadhat
shlokas.13:
atha prajvalitastatra sahasA havyavAhanaH |
tadadbhutatamaM dRRiShTvA vismitAhamihAgatA
shlokas.14:
anyachcha tasminsumahadAshcharyaM lakShitaM mayA |
yadagnimapi sa.nspRRishya naiva dahyatyasau shubhe
shlokas.15:
Chandena chodakaM tasya vahatyAvarjitaM drutam |
atIva chAnyatsumahadAshcharyaM dRRiShTavatyaham
shlokas.16:
yatsa puShpANyupAdAya hastAbhyAM mamRRide shanaiH |
mRRidyamAnAni pANibhyAM tena puShpANi tAnyatha
shlokas.17:
bhUya eva sugandhIni hRRiShitAni bhavanti cha |
etAnyadbhutakalpAni dRRiShTvAhaM drutamAgatA
shlokas.18:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
damayantI tu tachChrutvA puNyashlokasya cheShTitam |
amanyata nalaM prAptaM karmacheShTAbhisUchitam
shlokas.19:
sA sha~NkamAnA bhartAraM nalaM bAhukarUpiNam |
keshinIM shlakShNayA vAchA rudatI punarabravIt
shlokas.20:
punargachCha pramattasya bAhukasyopasa.nskRRitam |
mahAnasAchChRRitaM mA.nsaM samAdAyaihi bhAmini
shlokas.21:
sA gatvA bAhuke vyagre tanmA.nsamapakRRiShya cha |
atyuShNameva tvaritA tatkShaNaM priyakAriNI
damayantyai tataH prAdAtkeshinI kurunandana
shlokas.22:
sochitA nalasiddhasya mA.nsasya bahushaH purA |
prAshya matvA nalaM sUdaM prAkroshadbhRRishaduHkhitA
shlokas.23:
vaiklavyaM cha paraM gatvA prakShAlya cha mukhaM tataH |
mithunaM preShayAmAsa keshinyA saha bhArata
shlokas.24:
indrasenAM saha bhrAtrA samabhij~nAya bAhukaH |
abhidrutya tato rAjA pariShvajyA~NkamAnayat
shlokas.25:
bAhukastu samAsAdya sutau surasutopamau |
bhRRishaM duHkhaparItAtmA sasvaraM prarudoda ha
shlokas.26:
naiShadho darshayitvA tu vikAramasakRRittadA |
utsRRijya sahasA putrau keshinImidamabravIt
shlokas.27:
idaM susadRRishaM bhadre mithunaM mama putrayoH |
tato dRRiShTvaiva sahasA bAShpamutsRRiShTavAnaham
shlokas.28:
bahushaH sampatantIM tvAM janaH sha~Nketa doShataH |
vayaM cha deshAtithayo gachCha bhadre namo.astu te

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sarvaM vikAraM dRRiShTvA tu puNyashlokasya dhImataH |
Agatya keshinI kShipraM damayantyai nyavedayat
shlokas.2:
damayantI tato bhUyaH preShayAmAsa keshinIm |
mAtuH sakAshaM duHkhArtA nalasha~NkAsamutsukA
shlokas.3:
parIkShito me bahusho bAhuko nalasha~NkayA |
rUpe me sa.nshayastvekaH svayamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.4:
sa vA praveshyatAM mAtarmAM vAnuj~nAtumarhasi |
viditaM vAtha vAj~nAtaM piturme sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.5:
evamuktA tu vaidarbhyA sA devI bhImamabravIt |
duhitustamabhiprAyamanvajAnAchcha pArthivaH
shlokas.6:
sA vai pitrAbhyanuj~nAtA mAtrA cha bharatarShabha |
nalaM praveshayAmAsa yatra tasyAH pratishrayaH
shlokas.7:
taM tu dRRiShTvA tathAyuktaM damayantI nalaM tadA |
tIvrashokasamAviShTA babhUva varavarNinI
shlokas.8:
tataH kAShAyavasanA jaTilA malapa~NkinI |
damayantI mahArAja bAhukaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTapUrvastvayA kashchiddharmaj~no nAma bAhuka |
suptAmutsRRijya vipine gato yaH puruShaH striyam
shlokas.10:
anAgasaM priyAM bhAryAM vijane shramamohitAm |
apahAya tu ko gachChetpuNyashlokamRRite nalam
shlokas.11:
kiM nu tasya mayA kAryamaparAddhaM mahIpateH |
yo mAmutsRRijya vipine gatavAnnidrayA hRRitAm
shlokas.12:
sAkShAddevAnapAhAya vRRito yaH sa mayA purA |
anuvratAM sAbhikAmAM putriNIM tyaktavAnkatham
shlokas.13:
agnau pANigRRihItAM cha ha.nsAnAM vachane sthitAm |
bhariShyAmIti satyaM cha pratishrutya kva tadgatam
shlokas.14:
damayantyA bruvantyAstu sarvametadari.ndama |
shokajaM vAri netrAbhyAmasukhaM prAsravadbahu
shlokas.15:
atIva kRRiShNatArAbhyAM raktAntAbhyAM jalaM tu tat |
parisravannalo dRRiShTvA shokArta idamabravIt
shlokas.16:
mama rAjyaM pranaShTaM yannAhaM tatkRRitavAnsvayam |
kalinA tatkRRitaM bhIru yachcha tvAmahamatyajam
shlokas.17:
tvayA tu dharmabhRRichChreShThe shApenAbhihataH purA |
vanasthayA duHkhitayA shochantyA mAM vivAsasam
shlokas.18:
sa machCharIre tvachChApAddahyamAno.avasatkaliH |
tvachChApadagdhaH satataM so.agnAviva samAhitaH
shlokas.19:
mama cha vyavasAyena tapasA chaiva nirjitaH |
duHkhasyAntena chAnena bhavitavyaM hi nau shubhe
shlokas.20:
vimuchya mAM gataH pApaH sa tato.ahamihAgataH |
tvadarthaM vipulashroNi na hi me.anyatprayojanam
shlokas.21:
kathaM nu nArI bhartAramanuraktamanuvratam |
utsRRijya varayedanyaM yathA tvaM bhIru karhichit
shlokas.22:
dUtAshcharanti pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM nRRipatishAsanAt |
bhaimI kila sma bhartAraM dvitIyaM varayiShyati
shlokas.23:
svairavRRittA yathAkAmamanurUpamivAtmanaH |
shrutvaiva chaivaM tvarito bhA~NgasvarirupasthitaH
shlokas.24:
damayantI tu tachChrutvA nalasya paridevitam |
prA~njalirvepamAnA cha bhItA vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
damayantyuvAcha||
na mAmarhasi kalyANa pApena parisha~Nkitum |
mayA hi devAnutsRRijya vRRitastvaM niShadhAdhipa
shlokas.2:
tavAbhigamanArthaM tu sarvato brAhmaNA gatAH |
vAkyAni mama gAthAbhirgAyamAnA disho dasha
shlokas.3:
tatastvAM brAhmaNo vidvAnparNAdo nAma pArthiva |
abhyagachChatkosalAyAmRRituparNaniveshane
shlokas.4:
tena vAkye hRRite samyakprativAkye tathAhRRite |
upAyo.ayaM mayA dRRiShTo naiShadhAnayane tava
shlokas.5:
tvAmRRite na hi loke.anya ekAhnA pRRithivIpate |
samartho yojanashataM gantumashvairnarAdhipa
shlokas.6:
tathA chemau mahIpAla bhaje.ahaM charaNau tava |
yathA nAsatkRRitaM ki~nchinmanasApi charAmyaham
shlokas.7:
ayaM charati loke.asminbhUtasAkShI sadAgatiH |
eSha mu~nchatu me prANAnyadi pApaM charAmyaham
shlokas.8:
tathA charati tigmA.nshuH pareNa bhuvanaM sadA |
sa vimu~nchatu me prANAnyadi pApaM charAmyaham
shlokas.9:
chandramAH sarvabhUtAnAmantashcharati sAkShivat |
sa vimu~nchatu me prANAnyadi pApaM charAmyaham
shlokas.10:
ete devAstrayaH kRRitsnaM trailokyaM dhArayanti vai |
vibruvantu yathAsatyamete vAdya tyajantu mAm
shlokas.11:
evamukte tato vAyurantarikShAdabhAShata |
naiShA kRRitavatI pApaM nala satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.12:
rAja~nshIlanidhiH sphIto damayantyA surakShitaH |
sAkShiNo rakShiNashchAsyA vayaM trInparivatsarAn
shlokas.13:
upAyo vihitashchAyaM tvadarthamatulo.anayA |
na hyekAhnA shataM gantA tvadRRite.anyaH pumAniha
shlokas.14:
upapannA tvayA bhaimI tvaM cha bhaimyA mahIpate |
nAtra sha~NkA tvayA kAryA sa~NgachCha saha bhAryayA
shlokas.15:
tathA bruvati vAyau tu puShpavRRiShTiH papAta ha |
devadundubhayo nedurvavau cha pavanaH shivaH
shlokas.16:
tadadbhutatamaM dRRiShTvA nalo rAjAtha bhArata |
damayantyAM visha~NkAM tAM vyapAkarShadari.ndamaH
shlokas.17:
tatastadvastramarajaH prAvRRiNodvasudhAdhipaH |
sa.nsmRRitya nAgarAjAnaM tato lebhe vapuH svakam
shlokas.18:
svarUpiNaM tu bhartAraM dRRiShTvA bhImasutA tadA |
prAkroshaduchchairAli~Ngya puNyashlokamaninditA
shlokas.19:
bhaimImapi nalo rAjA bhrAjamAno yathA purA |
sasvaje svasutau chApi yathAvatpratyanandata
shlokas.20:
tataH svorasi vinyasya vaktraM tasya shubhAnanA |
parItA tena duHkhena nishashvAsAyatekShaNA
shlokas.21:
tathaiva maladigdhA~NgI pariShvajya shuchismitA |
suchiraM puruShavyAghraM tasthau sAshrupariplutA
shlokas.22:
tataH sarvaM yathAvRRittaM damayantyA nalasya cha |
bhImAyAkathayatprItyA vaidarbhyA jananI nRRipa
shlokas.23:
tato.abravInmahArAjaH kRRitashauchamahaM nalam |
damayantyA sahopetaM kAlyaM draShTA sukhoShitam
shlokas.24:
tatastau sahitau rAtriM kathayantau purAtanam |
vane vicharitaM sarvamUShaturmuditau nRRipa
shlokas.25:
sa chaturthe tato varShe sa~Ngamya saha bhAryayA |
sarvakAmaiH susiddhArtho labdhavAnparamAM mudam
shlokas.26:
damayantyapi bhartAramavApyApyAyitA bhRRisham |
ardhasa~njAtasasyeva toyaM prApya vasundharA
shlokas.27:
saivaM sametya vyapanItatandrI; shAntajvarA harShavivRRiddhasattvA |
rarAja bhaimI samavAptakAmA; shItA.nshunA rAtririvoditena

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
atha tAM vyuShito rAtriM nalo rAjA svala~NkRRitaH |
vaidarbhyA sahitaH kAlyaM dadarsha vasudhAdhipam
shlokas.2:
tato.abhivAdayAmAsa prayataH shvashuraM nalaH |
tasyAnu damayantI cha vavande pitaraM shubhA
shlokas.3:
taM bhImaH pratijagrAha putravatparayA mudA |
yathArhaM pUjayitvA tu samAshvAsayata prabhuH
nalena sahitAM tatra damayantIM pativratAm
shlokas.4:
tAmarhaNAM nalo rAjA pratigRRihya yathAvidhi |
paricharyAM svakAM tasmai yathAvatpratyavedayat
shlokas.5:
tato babhUva nagare sumahAnharShanisvanaH |
janasya samprahRRiShTasya nalaM dRRiShTvA tathAgatam
shlokas.6:
ashobhayachcha nagaraM patAkAdhvajamAlinam |
siktasaMmRRiShTapuShpADhyA rAjamArgAH kRRitAstadA
shlokas.7:
dvAri dvAri cha paurANAM puShpabha~NgaH prakalpitaH |
architAni cha sarvANi devatAyatanAni cha
shlokas.8:
RRituparNo.api shushrAva bAhukachChadminaM nalam |
damayantyA samAyuktaM jahRRiShe cha narAdhipaH
shlokas.9:
tamAnAyya nalo rAjA kShamayAmAsa pArthivam |
sa cha taM kShamayAmAsa hetubhirbuddhisaMmataH
shlokas.10:
sa satkRRito mahIpAlo naiShadhaM vismayAnvitaH |
diShTyA sameto dAraiH svairbhavAnityabhyanandata
shlokas.11:
kachchittu nAparAdhaM te kRRitavAnasmi naiShadha |
aj~nAtavAsaM vasato madgRRihe niShadhAdhipa
shlokas.12:
yadi vA buddhipUrvANi yadyabuddhAni kAnichit |
mayA kRRitAnyakAryANi tAni me kShantumarhasi
shlokas.13:
nala uvAcha||
na me.aparAdhaM kRRitavA.nstvaM svalpamapi pArthiva |
kRRite.api cha na me kopaH kShantavyaM hi mayA tava
shlokas.14:
pUrvaM hyasi sakhA me.asi sambandhI cha narAdhipa |
ata UrdhvaM tu bhUyastvaM prItimAhartumarhasi
shlokas.15:
sarvakAmaiH suvihitaH sukhamasmyuShitastvayi |
na tathA svagRRihe rAjanyathA tava gRRihe sadA
shlokas.16:
idaM chaiva hayaj~nAnaM tvadIyaM mayi tiShThati |
tadupAkartumichChAmi manyase yadi pArthiva
shlokas.17:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
evamuktvA dadau vidyAmRRituparNAya naiShadhaH |
sa cha tAM pratijagrAha vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.18:
tato gRRihyAshvahRRidayaM tadA bhA~NgasvarirnRRipaH |
sUtamanyamupAdAya yayau svapurameva hi
shlokas.19:
RRituparNe pratigate nalo rAjA vishAM pate |
nagare kuNDine kAlaM nAtidIrghamivAvasat

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
sa mAsamuShya kaunteya bhImamAmantrya naiShadhaH |
purAdalpaparIvAro jagAma niShadhAnprati
shlokas.2:
rathenaikena shubhreNa dantibhiH pariShoDashaiH |
pa~nchAshadbhirhayaishchaiva ShaTshataishcha padAtibhiH
shlokas.3:
sa kampayanniva mahIM tvaramANo mahIpatiH |
praviveshAtisa.nrabdhastarasaiva mahAmanAH
shlokas.4:
tataH puShkaramAsAdya vIrasenasuto nalaH |
uvAcha dIvyAva punarbahu vittaM mayArjitam
shlokas.5:
damayantI cha yachchAnyanmayA vasu samarjitam |
eSha vai mama saMnyAsastava rAjyaM tu puShkara
shlokas.6:
punaH pravartatAM dyUtamiti me nishchitA matiH |
ekapANena bhadraM te prANayoshcha paNAvahe
shlokas.7:
jitvA parasvamAhRRitya rAjyaM vA yadi vA vasu |
pratipANaH pradAtavyaH paraM hi dhanamuchyate
shlokas.8:
na chedvA~nChasi taddyUtaM yuddhadyUtaM pravartatAm |
dvairathenAstu vai shAntistava vA mama vA nRRipa
shlokas.9:
va.nshabhojyamidaM rAjyaM mArgitavyaM yathA tathA |
yena tenApyupAyena vRRiddhAnAmiti shAsanam
shlokas.10:
dvayorekatare buddhiH kriyatAmadya puShkara |
kaitavenAkShavatyAM vA yuddhe vA namyatAM dhanuH
shlokas.11:
naiShadhenaivamuktastu puShkaraH prahasanniva |
dhruvamAtmajayaM matvA pratyAha pRRithivIpatim
shlokas.12:
diShTyA tvayArjitaM vittaM pratipANAya naiShadha |
diShTyA cha duShkRRitaM karma damayantyAH kShayaM gatam
diShTyA cha dhriyase rAjansadAro.arinibarhaNa
shlokas.13:
dhanenAnena vaidarbhI jitena samala~NkRRitA |
mAmupasthAsyati vyaktaM divi shakramivApsarAH
shlokas.14:
nityasho hi smarAmi tvAM pratIkShAmi cha naiShadha |
devane cha mama prItirna bhavatyasuhRRidgaNaiH
shlokas.15:
jitvA tvadya varArohAM damayantImaninditAm |
kRRitakRRityo bhaviShyAmi sA hi me nityasho hRRidi
shlokas.16:
shrutvA tu tasya tA vAcho bahvabaddhapralApinaH |
iyeSha sa shirashChettuM khaDgena kupito nalaH
shlokas.17:
smaya.nstu roShatAmrAkShastamuvAcha tato nRRipaH |
paNAvaH kiM vyAharase jitvA vai vyAhariShyasi
shlokas.18:
tataH prAvartata dyUtaM puShkarasya nalasya cha |
ekapANena bhadraM te nalena sa parAjitaH
saratnakoshanichayaH prANena paNito.api cha
shlokas.19:
jitvA cha puShkaraM rAjA prahasannidamabravIt |
mama sarvamidaM rAjyamavyagraM hatakaNTakam
shlokas.20:
vaidarbhI na tvayA shakyA rAjApasada vIkShitum |
tasyAstvaM saparIvAro mUDha dAsatvamAgataH
shlokas.21:
na tattvayA kRRitaM karma yenAhaM nirjitaH purA |
kalinA tatkRRitaM karma tvaM tu mUDha na budhyase
nAhaM parakRRitaM doShaM tvayyAdhAsye katha~nchana
shlokas.22:
yathAsukhaM tvaM jIvasva prANAnabhyutsRRijAmi te |
tathaiva cha mama prItistvayi vIra na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
saubhrAtraM chaiva me tvatto na kadAchitprahAsyati |
puShkara tvaM hi me bhrAtA sa~njIvasva shataM samAH
shlokas.24:
evaM nalaH sAntvayitvA bhrAtaraM satyavikramaH |
svapuraM preShayAmAsa pariShvajya punaH punaH
shlokas.25:
sAntvito naiShadhenaivaM puShkaraH pratyuvAcha tam |
puNyashlokaM tadA rAjannabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.26:
kIrtirastu tavAkShayyA jIva varShAyutaM sukhI |
yo me vitarasi prANAnadhiShThAnaM cha pArthiva
shlokas.27:
sa tathA satkRRito rAj~nA mAsamuShya tadA nRRipaH |
prayayau svapuraM hRRiShTaH puShkaraH svajanAvRRitaH
shlokas.28:
mahatyA senayA rAjanvinItaiH parichArakaiH |
bhrAjamAna ivAdityo vapuShA puruSharShabha
shlokas.29:
prasthApya puShkaraM rAjA vittavantamanAmayam |
pravivesha puraM shrImAnatyarthamupashobhitam
pravishya sAntvayAmAsa paurA.nshcha niShadhAdhipaH

shlokas.1:
bRRihadashva uvAcha||
prashAnte tu pure hRRiShTe sampravRRitte mahotsave |
mahatyA senayA rAjA damayantImupAnayat
shlokas.2:
damayantImapi pitA satkRRitya paravIrahA |
prasthApayadameyAtmA bhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.3:
AgatAyAM tu vaidarbhyAM saputrAyAM nalo nRRipaH |
vartayAmAsa mudito devarADiva nandane
shlokas.4:
tathA prakAshatAM yAto jambUdvIpe.atha rAjasu |
punaH sve chAvasadrAjye pratyAhRRitya mahAyashAH
shlokas.5:
Ije cha vividhairyaj~nairvidhivatsvAptadakShiNaiH |
tathA tvamapi rAjendra sasuhRRidvakShyase.achirAt
shlokas.6:
duHkhametAdRRishaM prApto nalaH parapura~njayaH |
devanena narashreShTha sabhAryo bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
ekAkinaiva sumahannalena pRRithivIpate |
duHkhamAsAditaM ghoraM prAptashchAbhyudayaH punaH
shlokas.8:
tvaM punarbhrAtRRisahitaH kRRiShNayA chaiva pANDava |
ramase.asminmahAraNye dharmamevAnuchintayan
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNaishcha mahAbhAgairvedavedA~NgapAragaiH |
nityamanvAsyase rAja.nstatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.10:
itihAsamimaM chApi kalinAshanamuchyate |
shakyamAshvAsituM shrutvA tvadvidhena vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
asthiratvaM cha sa~nchintya puruShArthasya nityadA |
tasyAye cha vyaye chaiva samAshvasihi mA shuchaH
shlokas.12:
ye chedaM kathayiShyanti nalasya charitaM mahat |
shroShyanti chApyabhIkShNaM vai nAlakShmIstAnbhajiShyati
arthAstasyopapatsyante dhanyatAM cha gamiShyati
shlokas.13:
itihAsamimaM shrutvA purANaM shashvaduttamam |
putrAnpautrAnpashU.nshchaiva vetsyate nRRiShu chAgryatAm
arogaH prItimA.nshchaiva bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
bhayaM pashyasi yachcha tvamAhvayiShyati mAM punaH |
akShaj~na iti tatte.ahaM nAshayiShyAmi pArthiva
shlokas.15:
vedAkShahRRidayaM kRRitsnamahaM satyaparAkrama |
upapadyasva kaunteya prasanno.ahaM bravImi te
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato hRRiShTamanA rAjA bRRihadashvamuvAcha ha |
bhagavannakShahRRidayaM j~nAtumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.17:
tato.akShahRRidayaM prAdAtpANDavAya mahAtmane |
dattvA chAshvashiro.agachChadupaspraShTuM mahAtapAH
shlokas.18:
bRRihadashve gate pArthamashrauShItsavyasAchinam |
vartamAnaM tapasyugre vAyubhakShaM manIShiNam
shlokas.19:
brAhmaNebhyastapasvibhyaH sampatadbhyastatastataH |
tIrthashailavarebhyashcha sametebhyo dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.20:
iti pArtho mahAbAhurdurApaM tapa AsthitaH |
na tathA dRRiShTapUrvo.anyaH kashchidugratapA iti
shlokas.21:
yathA dhana~njayaH pArthastapasvI niyatavrataH |
munirekacharaH shrImAndharmo vigrahavAniva
shlokas.22:
taM shrutvA pANDavo rAja.nstapyamAnaM mahAvane |
anvashochata kaunteyaH priyaM vai bhrAtaraM jayam
shlokas.23:
dahyamAnena tu hRRidA sharaNArthI mahAvane |
brAhmaNAnvividhaj~nAnAnparyapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bhagavankAmyakAtpArthe gate me prapitAmahe |
pANDavAH kimakurvanta tamRRite savyasAchinam
shlokas.2:
sa hi teShAM maheShvAso gatirAsIdanIkajit |
AdityAnAM yathA viShNustathaiva pratibhAti me
shlokas.3:
tenendrasamavIryeNa sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinA |
vinAbhUtA vane vIrAH kathamAsanpitAmahAH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gate tu kAmyakAttAta pANDave savyasAchini |
babhUvuH kauraveyAste duHkhashokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.5:
AkShiptasUtrA maNayashChinnapakShA iva dvijAH |
aprItamanasaH sarve babhUvuratha pANDavAH
shlokas.6:
vanaM cha tadabhUttena hInamakliShTakarmaNA |
kubereNa yathA hInaM vanaM chaitrarathaM tathA
shlokas.7:
tamRRite puruShavyAghraM pANDavA janamejaya |
mudamaprApnuvanto vai kAmyake nyavasa.nstadA
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNArthe parAkrAntAH shuddhairbANairmahArathAH |
nighnanto bharatashreShTha medhyAnbahuvidhAnmRRigAn
shlokas.9:
nityaM hi puruShavyAghrA vanyAhAramari.ndamAH |
viprasRRitya samAhRRitya brAhmaNebhyo nyavedayan
shlokas.10:
evaM te nyavasa.nstatra sotkaNThAH puruSharShabhAH |
ahRRiShTamanasaH sarve gate rAjandhana~njaye
shlokas.11:
atha viproShitaM vIraM pA~nchAlI madhyamaM patim |
smarantI pANDavashreShThamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
yo.arjunenArjunastulyo dvibAhurbahubAhunA |
tamRRite pANDavashreShThaM vanaM na pratibhAti me
shUnyAmiva cha pashyAmi tatra tatra mahImimAm
shlokas.13:
bahvAshcharyamidaM chApi vanaM kusumitadrumam |
na tathA ramaNIyaM me tamRRite savyasAchinam
shlokas.14:
nIlAmbudasamaprakhyaM mattamAta~Ngavikramam |
tamRRite puNDarIkAkShaM kAmyakaM nAtibhAti me
shlokas.15:
yasya sma dhanuSho ghoShaH shrUyate.ashaninisvanaH |
na labhe sharma taM rAjansmarantI savyasAchinam
shlokas.16:
tathA lAlapyamAnAM tAM nishamya paravIrahA |
bhImaseno mahArAja draupadImidamabravIt
shlokas.17:
manaHprItikaraM bhadre yadbravIShi sumadhyame |
tanme prINAti hRRidayamamRRitaprAshanopamam
shlokas.18:
yasya dIrghau samau pInau bhujau parighasaMnibhau |
maurvIkRRitakiNau vRRittau khaDgAyudhagadAdharau
shlokas.19:
niShkA~NgadakRRitApIDau pa~nchashIrShAvivoragau |
tamRRite puruShavyAghraM naShTasUryamidaM vanam
shlokas.20:
yamAshritya mahAbAhuM pA~nchAlAH kuravastathA |
surANAmapi yattAnAM pRRitanAsu na bibhyati
shlokas.21:
yasya bAhU samAshritya vayaM sarve mahAtmanaH |
manyAmahe jitAnAjau parAnprAptAM cha medinIm
shlokas.22:
tamRRite phalgunaM vIraM na labhe kAmyake dhRRitim |
shUnyAmiva cha pashyAmi tatra tatra mahImimAm
shlokas.23:
nakula uvAcha||
ya udIchIM dishaM gatvA jitvA yudhi mahAbalAn |
gandharvamukhyA~nshatasho hayA.Nllebhe sa vAsaviH
shlokas.24:
rAja.nstittirikalmAShA~nshrImAnanilaraMhasaH |
prAdAdbhrAtre priyaH premNA rAjasUye mahAkratau
shlokas.25:
tamRRite bhImadhanvAnaM bhImAdavarajaM vane |
kAmaye kAmyake vAsaM nedAnImamaropamam
shlokas.26:
sahadeva uvAcha||
yo dhanAni cha kanyAshcha yudhi jitvA mahArathAn |
AjahAra purA rAj~ne rAjasUye mahAkratau
shlokas.27:
yaH sametAnmRRidhe jitvA yAdavAnamitadyutiH |
subhadrAmAjahAraiko vAsudevasya saMmate
shlokas.28:
tasya jiShNorbRRisIM dRRiShTvA shUnyAmupaniveshane |
hRRidayaM me mahArAja na shAmyati kadAchana
shlokas.29:
vanAdasmAdvivAsaM tu rochaye.ahamari.ndama |
na hi nastamRRite vIraM ramaNIyamidaM vanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhana~njayotsukAste tu vane tasminmahArathAH |
nyavasanta mahAbhAgA draupadyA saha pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
athApashyanmahAtmAnaM devarShiM tatra nAradam |
dIpyamAnaM shriyA brAhmyA dIptAgnisamatejasam
shlokas.3:
sa taiH parivRRitaH shrImAnbhrAtRRibhiH kurusattamaH |
vibabhAvatidIptaujA devairiva shatakratuH
shlokas.4:
yathA cha vedAnsAvitrI yAj~nasenI tathA satI |
na jahau dharmataH pArthAnmerumarkaprabhA yathA
shlokas.5:
pratigRRihya tu tAM pUjAM nArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
AshvAsayaddharmasutaM yuktarUpamivAnagha
shlokas.6:
uvAcha cha mahAtmAnaM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
brUhi dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha kenArthaH kiM dadAmi te
shlokas.7:
atha dharmasuto rAjA praNamya bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
uvAcha prA~njalirvAkyaM nAradaM devasaMmitam
shlokas.8:
tvayi tuShTe mahAbhAga sarvalokAbhipUjite |
kRRitamityeva manye.ahaM prasAdAttava suvrata
shlokas.9:
yadi tvahamanugrAhyo bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anagha |
sa.ndehaM me munishreShTha hRRidisthaM Chettumarhasi
shlokas.10:
pradakShiNaM yaH kurute pRRithivIM tIrthatatparaH |
kiM phalaM tasya kArtsnyena tadbrahmanvaktumarhasi
shlokas.11:
nArada uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahito yathA bhIShmeNa bhArata |
pulastyasya sakAshAdvai sarvametadupashrutam
shlokas.12:
purA bhAgIrathItIre bhIShmo dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
pitryaM vrataM samAsthAya nyavasanmunivattadA
shlokas.13:
shubhe deshe mahArAja puNye devarShisevite |
ga~NgAdvAre mahAtejA devagandharvasevite
shlokas.14:
sa pitR^I.nstarpayAmAsa devA.nshcha paramadyutiH |
RRiShI.nshcha toShayAmAsa vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.15:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya japanneva mahAtapAH |
dadarshAdbhutasa~NkAshaM pulastyamRRiShisattamam
shlokas.16:
sa taM dRRiShTvogratapasaM dIpyamAnamiva shriyA |
praharShamatulaM lebhe vismayaM cha paraM yayau
shlokas.17:
upasthitaM mahArAja pUjayAmAsa bhArata |
bhIShmo dharmabhRRitAM shreShTho vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.18:
shirasA chArghyamAdAya shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
nAma sa~NkIrtayAmAsa tasminbrahmarShisattame
shlokas.19:
bhIShmo.ahamasmi bhadraM te dAso.asmi tava suvrata |
tava sa.ndarshanAdeva mukto.ahaM sarvakilbiShaiH
shlokas.20:
evamuktvA mahArAja bhIShmo dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
vAgyataH prA~njalirbhUtvA tUShNImAsIdyudhiShThira
shlokas.21:
taM dRRiShTvA niyamenAtha svAdhyAyAmnAyakarshitam |
bhIShmaM kurukulashreShThaM muniH prItamanAbhavat
shlokas.22:
pulastya uvAcha||
anena tava dharmaj~na prashrayeNa damena cha |
satyena cha mahAbhAga tuShTo.asmi tava sarvashaH
shlokas.23:
yasyedRRishaste dharmo.ayaM pitRRibhaktyAshrito.anagha |
tena pashyasi mAM putra prItishchApi mama tvayi
shlokas.24:
amoghadarshI bhIShmAhaM brUhi kiM karavANi te |
yadvakShyasi kurushreShTha tasya dAtAsmi te.anagha
shlokas.25:
bhIShma uvAcha||
prIte tvayi mahAbhAga sarvalokAbhipUjite |
kRRitamityeva manye.ahaM yadahaM dRRiShTavAnprabhum
shlokas.26:
yadi tvahamanugrAhyastava dharmabhRRitAM vara |
vakShyAmi hRRitsthaM sa.ndehaM tanme tvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.27:
asti me bhagavankashchittIrthebhyo dharmasa.nshayaH |
tamahaM shrotumichChAmi pRRithaksa~NkIrtitaM tvayA
shlokas.28:
pradakShiNaM yaH pRRithivIM karotyamitavikrama |
kiM phalaM tasya viprarShe tanme brUhi tapodhana
shlokas.29:
pulastya uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM pravakShyAmi yadRRiShINAM parAyaNam |
tadekAgramanAstAta shRRiNu tIrtheShu yatphalam
shlokas.30:
yasya hastau cha pAdau cha manashchaiva susa.nyatam |
vidyA tapashcha kIrtishcha sa tIrthaphalamashnute
shlokas.31:
pratigrahAdupAvRRittaH santuShTo niyataH shuchiH |
aha~NkAranivRRittashcha sa tIrthaphalamashnute
shlokas.32:
akalkako nirArambho laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
vimuktaH sarvadoShairyaH sa tIrthaphalamashnute
shlokas.33:
akrodhanashcha rAjendra satyashIlo dRRiDhavrataH |
Atmopamashcha bhUteShu sa tIrthaphalamashnute
shlokas.34:
RRiShibhiH kratavaH proktA vedeShviha yathAkramam |
phalaM chaiva yathAtattvaM pretya cheha cha sarvashaH
shlokas.35:
na te shakyA daridreNa yaj~nAH prAptuM mahIpate |
bahUpakaraNA yaj~nA nAnAsambhAravistarAH
shlokas.36:
prApyante pArthivairete samRRiddhairvA naraiH kvachit |
nArthanyUnopakaraNairekAtmabhirasaMhataiH
shlokas.37:
yo daridrairapi vidhiH shakyaH prAptuM nareshvara |
tulyo yaj~naphalaiH puNyaistaM nibodha yudhAM vara
shlokas.38:
RRiShINAM paramaM guhyamidaM bharatasattama |
tIrthAbhigamanaM puNyaM yaj~nairapi vishiShyate
shlokas.39:
anupoShya trirAtrANi tIrthAnyanabhigamya cha |
adattvA kA~nchanaM gAshcha daridro nAma jAyate
shlokas.40:
agniShTomAdibhiryaj~nairiShTvA vipuladakShiNaiH |
na tatphalamavApnoti tIrthAbhigamanena yat
shlokas.41:
nRRiloke devadevasya tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
puShkaraM nAma vikhyAtaM mahAbhAgaH samAvishet
shlokas.42:
dasha koTisahasrANi tIrthAnAM vai mahIpate |
sAMnidhyaM puShkare yeShAM trisandhyaM kurunandana
shlokas.43:
AdityA vasavo rudrAH sAdhyAshcha samarudgaNAH |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva nityaM saMnihitA vibho
shlokas.44:
yatra devAstapastaptvA daityA brahmarShayastathA |
divyayogA mahArAja puNyena mahatAnvitAH
shlokas.45:
manasApyabhikAmasya puShkarANi manasvinaH |
pUyante sarvapApAni nAkapRRiShThe cha pUjyate
shlokas.46:
tasmi.nstIrthe mahAbhAga nityameva pitAmahaH |
uvAsa paramaprIto devadAnavasaMmataH
shlokas.47:
puShkareShu mahAbhAga devAH sarShipurogamAH |
siddhiM samabhisamprAptAH puNyena mahatAnvitAH
shlokas.48:
tatrAbhiShekaM yaH kuryAtpitRRidevArchane rataH |
ashvamedhaM dashaguNaM pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.49:
apyekaM bhojayedvipraM puShkarAraNyamAshritaH |
tenAsau karmaNA bhIShma pretya cheha cha modate
shlokas.50:
shAkamUlaphalairvApi yena vartayate svayam |
tadvai dadyAdbrAhmaNAya shraddhAvAnanasUyakaH
tenaiva prApnuyAtprAj~no hayamedhaphalaM naraH
shlokas.51:
brAhmaNaH kShatriyo vaishyaH shUdro vA rAjasattama |
na viyoniM vrajantyete snAtAstIrthe mahAtmanaH
shlokas.52:
kArttikyAM tu visheSheNa yo.abhigachCheta puShkaram |
phalaM tatrAkShayaM tasya vardhate bharatarShabha
shlokas.53:
sAyaM prAtaH smaredyastu puShkarANi kRRitA~njaliH |
upaspRRiShTaM bhavettena sarvatIrtheShu bhArata
prApnuyAchcha naro lokAnbrahmaNaH sadane.akShayAn
shlokas.54:
janmaprabhRRiti yatpApaM striyo vA puruShasya vA |
puShkare snAtamAtrasya sarvameva praNashyati
shlokas.55:
yathA surANAM sarveShAmAdistu madhusUdanaH |
tathaiva puShkaraM rAja.nstIrthAnAmAdiruchyate
shlokas.56:
uShya dvAdasha varShANi puShkare niyataH shuchiH |
kratUnsarvAnavApnoti brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.57:
yastu varShashataM pUrNamagnihotramupAsate |
kArttikIM vA vasedekAM puShkare samameva tat
shlokas.58:
duShkaraM puShkaraM gantuM duShkaraM puShkare tapaH |
duShkaraM puShkare dAnaM vastuM chaiva suduShkaram
shlokas.59:
uShya dvAdasharAtraM tu niyato niyatAshanaH |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitto jambUmArgaM samAvishet
shlokas.60:
jambUmArgaM samAvishya devarShipitRRisevitam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti viShNulokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.61:
tatroShya rajanIH pa~ncha ShaShThakAlakShamI naraH |
na durgatimavApnoti siddhiM prApnoti chottamAm
shlokas.62:
jambUmArgAdupAvRRitto gachChettaNDulikAshramam |
na durgatimavApnoti svargaloke cha pUjyate
shlokas.63:
agastyasara AsAdya pitRRidevArchane rataH |
trirAtropoShito rAjannagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.64:
shAkavRRittiH phalairvApi kaumAraM vindate padam |
kaNvAshramaM samAsAdya shrIjuShTaM lokapUjitam
shlokas.65:
dharmAraNyaM hi tatpuNyamAdyaM cha bharatarShabha |
yatra praviShTamAtro vai pApebhyo vipramuchyate
shlokas.66:
archayitvA pitR^IndevAnniyato niyatAshanaH |
sarvakAmasamRRiddhasya yaj~nasya phalamashnute
shlokas.67:
pradakShiNaM tataH kRRitvA yayAtipatanaM vrajet |
hayamedhasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti tatra vai
shlokas.68:
mahAkAlaM tato gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
koTitIrthamupaspRRishya hayamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.69:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na puNyasthAnamumApateH |
nAmnA bhadravaTaM nAma triShu lokeShu vishrutam
shlokas.70:
tatrAbhigamya cheshAnaM gosahasraphalaM labhet |
mahAdevaprasAdAchcha gANapatyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.71:
narmadAmatha chAsAdya nadIM trailokyavishrutAm |
tarpayitvA pitR^IndevAnagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.72:
dakShiNaM sindhumAsAdya brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
agniShTomamavApnoti vimAnaM chAdhirohati
shlokas.73:
charmaNvatIM samAsAdya niyato niyatAshanaH |
rantidevAbhyanuj~nAto agniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.74:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na himavatsutamarbudam |
pRRithivyAM yatra vai ChidraM pUrvamAsIdyudhiShThira
shlokas.75:
tatrAshramo vasiShThasya triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
tatroShya rajanImekAM gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.76:
pi~NgAtIrthamupaspRRishya brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
kapilAnAM naravyAghra shatasya phalamashnute
shlokas.77:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na prabhAsaM lokavishrutam |
yatra saMnihito nityaM svayameva hutAshanaH
devatAnAM mukhaM vIra analo.anilasArathiH
shlokas.78:
tasmi.nstIrthavare snAtvA shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
agniShTomAtirAtrAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.79:
tato gatvA sarasvatyAH sAgarasya cha sa~Ngame |
gosahasraphalaM prApya svargaloke mahIyate
dIpyamAno.agnivannityaM prabhayA bharatarShabha
shlokas.80:
trirAtramuShitastatra tarpayetpitRRidevatAH |
prabhAsate yathA somo ashvamedhaM cha vindati
shlokas.81:
varadAnaM tato gachChettIrthaM bharatasattama |
viShNordurvAsasA yatra varo datto yudhiShThira
shlokas.82:
varadAne naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
tato dvAravatIM gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH
piNDArake naraH snAtvA labhedbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.83:
tasmi.nstIrthe mahAbhAga padmalakShaNalakShitAH |
adyApi mudrA dRRishyante tadadbhutamari.ndama
shlokas.84:
trishUlA~NkAni padmAni dRRishyante kurunandana |
mahAdevasya sAMnidhyaM tatraiva bharatarShabha
shlokas.85:
sAgarasya cha sindhoshcha sa~NgamaM prApya bhArata |
tIrthe salilarAjasya snAtvA prayatamAnasaH
shlokas.86:
tarpayitvA pitR^IndevAnRRiShI.nshcha bharatarShabha |
prApnoti vAruNaM lokaM dIpyamAnaH svatejasA
shlokas.87:
sha~NkukarNeshvaraM devamarchayitvA yudhiShThira |
ashvamedhaM dashaguNaM pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.88:
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya gachCheta bharatarShabha |
tIrthaM kuruvarashreShTha triShu lokeShu vishrutam
dRRimIti nAmnA vikhyAtaM sarvapApapramochanam
shlokas.89:
yatra brahmAdayo devA upAsante maheshvaram |
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha rudraM devagaNairvRRitam
janmaprabhRRiti pApAni kRRitAni nudate naraH
shlokas.90:
dRRimI chAtra narashreShTha sarvadevairabhiShTutA |
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra hayamedhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.91:
jitvA yatra mahAprAj~na viShNunA prabhaviShNunA |
purA shauchaM kRRitaM rAjanhatvA daivatakaNTakAn
shlokas.92:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na vasordhArAmabhiShTutAm |
gamanAdeva tasyAM hi hayamedhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.93:
snAtvA kuruvarashreShTha prayatAtmA tu mAnavaH |
tarpya devAnpitR^I.nshchaiva viShNuloke mahIyate
shlokas.94:
tIrthaM chAtra paraM puNyaM vasUnAM bharatarShabha |
tatra snAtvA cha pItvA cha vasUnAM saMmato bhavet
shlokas.95:
sindhUttamamiti khyAtaM sarvapApapraNAshanam |
tatra snAtvA narashreShTha labhedbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.96:
brahmatu~NgaM samAsAdya shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
brahmalokamavApnoti sukRRitI virajA naraH
shlokas.97:
kumArikANAM shakrasya tIrthaM siddhaniShevitam |
tatra snAtvA naraH kShipraM shakralokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.98:
reNukAyAshcha tatraiva tIrthaM devaniShevitam |
tatra snAtvA bhavedvipro vimalashchandramA yathA
shlokas.99:
atha pa~nchanadaM gatvA niyato niyatAshanaH |
pa~ncha yaj~nAnavApnoti kramasho ye.anukIrtitAH
shlokas.100:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na bhImAyAH sthAnamuttamam |
tatra snAtvA tu yonyAM vai naro bharatasattama
shlokas.101:
devyAH putro bhavedrAja.nstaptakuNDalavigrahaH |
gavAM shatasahasrasya phalaM chaivApnuyAnmahat
shlokas.102:
girimu~njaM samAsAdya triShu lokeShu vishrutam |
pitAmahaM namaskRRitya gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.103:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na vimalaM tIrthamuttamam |
adyApi yatra dRRishyante matsyAH sauvarNarAjatAH
shlokas.104:
tatra snAtvA narashreShTha vAjapeyamavApnuyAt |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA gachChechcha paramAM gatim
shlokas.105:
tato gachCheta maladAM triShu lokeShu vishrutAm |
pashchimAyAM tu sandhyAyAmupaspRRishya yathAvidhi
shlokas.106:
charuM narendra saptArcheryathAshakti nivedayet |
pitR^INAmakShayaM dAnaM pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.107:
gavAM shatasahasreNa rAjasUyashatena cha |
ashvamedhasahasreNa shreyAnsaptArchiShashcharuH
shlokas.108:
tato nivRRitto rAjendra vastrApadamathAvishet |
abhigamya mahAdevamashvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.109:
