maNimantaM samAsAdya brahmachArI samAhitaH |
ekarAtroShito rAjannagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.110:
atha gachCheta rAjendra devikAM lokavishrutAm |
prasUtiryatra viprANAM shrUyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.111:
trishUlapANeH sthAnaM cha triShu lokeShu vishrutam |
devikAyAM naraH snAtvA samabhyarchya maheshvaram
shlokas.112:
yathAshakti charuM tatra nivedya bharatarShabha |
sarvakAmasamRRiddhasya yaj~nasya labhate phalam
shlokas.113:
kAmAkhyaM tatra rudrasya tIrthaM devarShisevitam |
tatra snAtvA naraH kShipraM siddhimApnoti bhArata
shlokas.114:
yajanaM yAjanaM gatvA tathaiva brahmavAlukAm |
puShpanyAsa upaspRRishya na shochenmaraNaM tataH
shlokas.116:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na dIrghasatraM yathAkramam |
yatra brahmAdayo devAH siddhAshcha paramarShayaH
dIrghasatramupAsante dakShiNAbhiryatavratAH
shlokas.117:
gamanAdeva rAjendra dIrghasatramari.ndama |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.118:
tato vinashanaM gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
gachChatyantarhitA yatra marupRRiShThe sarasvatI
chamase cha shivodbhede nAgodbhede cha dRRishyate
shlokas.119:
snAtvA cha chamasodbhede agniShTomaphalaM labhet |
shivodbhede naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.120:
nAgodbhede naraH snAtvA nAgalokamavApnuyAt |
shashayAnaM cha rAjendra tIrthamAsAdya durlabham
shasharUpapratichChannAH puShkarA yatra bhArata
shlokas.121:
sarasvatyAM mahArAja anu sa.nvatsaraM hi te |
snAyante bharatashreShTha vRRittAM vai kArttikIM sadA
shlokas.122:
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra dyotate shashivatsadA |
gosahasraphalaM chaiva prApnuyAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.123:
kumArakoTimAsAdya niyataH kurunandana |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta pitRRidevArchane rataH
gavAmayamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.124:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na rudrakoTiM samAhitaH |
purA yatra mahArAja RRiShikoTiH samAhitA
praharSheNa cha sa.nviShTA devadarshanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.125:
ahaM pUrvamahaM pUrvaM drakShyAmi vRRiShabhadhvajam |
evaM samprasthitA rAjannRRiShayaH kila bhArata
shlokas.126:
tato yogeShvareNApi yogamAsthAya bhUpate |
teShAM manyupraNAshArthamRRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.127:
sRRiShTA koTistu rudrANAmRRiShINAmagrataH sthitA |
mayA pUrvataraM dRRiShTa iti te menire pRRithak
shlokas.128:
teShAM tuShTo mahAdeva RRiShINAmugratejasAm |
bhaktyA paramayA rAjanvaraM teShAM pradiShTavAn
adya prabhRRiti yuShmAkaM dharmavRRiddhirbhaviShyati
shlokas.129:
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra rudrakoTyAM naraH shuchiH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.130:
tato gachCheta rAjendra sa~NgamaM lokavishrutam |
sarasvatyA mahApuNyamupAsante janArdanam
shlokas.131:
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayaH siddhachAraNAH |
abhigachChanti rAjendra chaitrashuklachaturdashIm
shlokas.132:
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra vindedbahu suvarNakam |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.133:
RRiShINAM yatra satrANi samAptAni narAdhipa |
satrAvasAnamAsAdya gosahasraphalaM labhet

shlokas.1:
pulastya uvAcha||
tato gachCheta rAjendra kurukShetramabhiShTutam |
pApebhyo vipramuchyante tadgatAH sarvajantavaH
shlokas.2:
kurukShetraM gamiShyAmi kurukShetre vasAmyaham |
ya evaM satataM brUyAtso.api pApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.3:
tatra mAsaM vasedvIra sarasvatyAM yudhiShThira |
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayaH siddhachAraNAH
shlokas.4:
gandharvApsaraso yakShAH pannagAshcha mahIpate |
brahmakShetraM mahApuNyamabhigachChanti bhArata
shlokas.5:
manasApyabhikAmasya kurukShetraM yudhiShThira |
pApAni vipraNashyanti brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.6:
gatvA hi shraddhayA yuktaH kurukShetraM kurUdvaha |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.7:
tato machakrukaM rAjandvArapAlaM mahAbalam |
yakShaM samabhivAdyaiva gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.8:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na viShNoH sthAnamanuttamam |
satataM nAma rAjendra yatra saMnihito hariH
shlokas.9:
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha trilokaprabhavaM harim |
ashvamedhamavApnoti viShNulokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.10:
tataH pAriplavaM gachChettIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
agniShTomAtirAtrAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.11:
pRRithivyAstIrthamAsAdya gosahasraphalaM labhet |
tataH shAlUkinIM gatvA tIrthasevI narAdhipa
dashAshvamedhike snAtvA tadeva labhate phalam
shlokas.12:
sarpadarvIM samAsAdya nAgAnAM tIrthamuttamam |
agniShTomamavApnoti nAgalokaM cha vindati
shlokas.13:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na dvArapAlaM tarantukam |
tatroShya rajanImekAM gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.14:
tataH pa~nchanadaM gatvA niyato niyatAshanaH |
koTitIrthamupaspRRishya hayamedhaphalaM labhet
ashvinostIrthamAsAdya rUpavAnabhijAyate
shlokas.15:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na vArAhaM tIrthamuttamam |
viShNurvArAharUpeNa pUrvaM yatra sthito.abhavat
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra agniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.16:
tato jayantyA rAjendra somatIrthaM samAvishet |
snAtvA phalamavApnoti rAjasUyasya mAnavaH
shlokas.17:
ekaha.nse naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
kRRitashauchaM samAsAdya tIrthasevI kurUdvaha
puNDarIkamavApnoti kRRitashaucho bhavennaraH
shlokas.18:
tato mu~njavaTaM nAma mahAdevasya dhImataH |
tatroShya rajanImekAM gANapatyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.19:
tatraiva cha mahArAja yakShI lokaparishrutA |
tAM chAbhigamya rAjendra puNyA.NllokAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.20:
kurukShetrasya taddvAraM vishrutaM bharatarShabha |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya tIrthasevI samAhitaH
shlokas.21:
saMmite puShkarANAM cha snAtvArchya pitRRidevatAH |
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa AhRRite vai mahAtmanA
kRRitakRRityo bhavedrAjannashvamedhaM cha vindati
shlokas.22:
tato rAmahradAngachChettIrthasevI narAdhipa |
yatra rAmeNa rAjendra tarasA dIptatejasA
kShatramutsAdya vIryeNa hradAH pa~ncha niveshitAH
shlokas.23:
pUrayitvA naravyAghra rudhireNeti naH shrutam |
pitarastarpitAH sarve tathaiva cha pitAmahAH
tataste pitaraH prItA rAmamUchurmahIpate
shlokas.24:
rAma rAma mahAbhAga prItAH sma tava bhArgava |
anayA pitRRibhaktyA cha vikrameNa cha te vibho
varaM vRRiNIShva bhadraM te kimichChasi mahAdyute
shlokas.25:
evamuktaH sa rAjendra rAmaH praharatAM varaH |
abravItprA~njalirvAkyaM pitR^Insa gagane sthitAn
shlokas.26:
bhavanto yadi me prItA yadyanugrAhyatA mayi |
pitRRiprasAdAdichCheyaM tapasApyAyanaM punaH
shlokas.27:
yachcha roShAbhibhUtena kShatramutsAditaM mayA |
tatashcha pApAnmuchyeyaM yuShmAkaM tejasA hyaham
hradAshcha tIrthabhUtA me bhaveyurbhuvi vishrutAH
shlokas.28:
etachChrutvA shubhaM vAkyaM rAmasya pitarastadA |
pratyUchuH paramaprItA rAmaM harShasamanvitAH
shlokas.29:
tapaste vardhatAM bhUyaH pitRRibhaktyA visheShataH |
yachcha roShAbhibhUtena kShatramutsAditaM tvayA
shlokas.30:
tatashcha pApAnmuktastvaM karmabhiste cha pAtitAH |
hradAshcha tava tIrthatvaM gamiShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.31:
hradeShveteShu yaH snAtvA pitR^InsantarpayiShyati |
pitarastasya vai prItA dAsyanti bhuvi durlabham
IpsitaM manasaH kAmaM svargalokaM cha shAshvatam
shlokas.32:
evaM dattvA varAnrAjanrAmasya pitarastadA |
Amantrya bhArgavaM prItAstatraivAntardadhustadA
shlokas.33:
evaM rAmahradAH puNyA bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH |
snAtvA hradeShu rAmasya brahmachArI shubhavrataH
rAmamabhyarchya rAjendra labhedbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.34:
va.nshamUlakamAsAdya tIrthasevI kurUdvaha |
svava.nshamuddharedrAjansnAtvA vai va.nshamUlake
shlokas.35:
kAyashodhanamAsAdya tIrthaM bharatasattama |
sharIrashuddhiH snAtasya tasmi.nstIrthe na sa.nshayaH
shuddhadehashcha sa.nyAti shubhA.NllokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.36:
tato gachCheta rAjendra tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
lokA yatroddhRRitAH pUrvaM viShNunA prabhaviShNunA
shlokas.37:
lokoddhAraM samAsAdya tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
snAtvA tIrthavare rAja.NllokAnuddharate svakAn
shrItIrthaM cha samAsAdya vindate shriyamuttamAm
shlokas.38:
kapilAtIrthamAsAdya brahmachArI samAhitaH |
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha daivatAni pitR^I.nstathA
kapilAnAM sahasrasya phalaM vindati mAnavaH
shlokas.39:
sUryatIrthaM samAsAdya snAtvA niyatamAnasaH |
archayitvA pitR^IndevAnupavAsaparAyaNaH
agniShTomamavApnoti sUryalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.40:
gavAmbhavanamAsAdya tIrthasevI yathAkramam |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANo gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.41:
sha~NkhinIM tatra AsAdya tIrthasevI kurUdvaha |
devyAstIrthe naraH snAtvA labhate rUpamuttamam
shlokas.42:
tato gachCheta rAjendra dvArapAlamarantukam |
tasya tIrthaM sarasvatyAM yakShendrasya mahAtmanaH
tatra snAtvA naro rAjannagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.43:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na brahmAvartaM narAdhipa |
brahmAvarte naraH snAtvA brahmalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.44:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na sutIrthakamanuttamam |
yatra saMnihitA nityaM pitaro daivataiH saha
shlokas.45:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta pitRRidevArchane rataH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti pitRRilokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.46:
tato.ambuvashyaM dharmaj~na samAsAdya yathAkramam |
kosheshvarasya tIrtheShu snAtvA bharatasattama
sarvavyAdhivinirmukto brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.47:
mAtRRitIrthaM cha tatraiva yatra snAtasya bhArata |
prajA vivardhate rAjannanantAM chAshnute shriyam
shlokas.48:
tataH shItavanaM gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
tIrthaM tatra mahArAja mahadanyatra durlabham
shlokas.49:
punAti darshanAdeva daNDenaikaM narAdhipa |
keshAnabhyukShya vai tasminpUto bhavati bhArata
shlokas.50:
tIrthaM tatra mahArAja shvAnalomApahaM smRRitam |
yatra viprA naravyAghra vidvA.nsastIrthatatparAH
shlokas.51:
shvAnalomApanayane tIrthe bharatasattama |
prANAyAmairnirharanti shvalomAni dvijottamAH
shlokas.52:
pUtAtmAnashcha rAjendra prayAnti paramAM gatim |
dashAshvamedhikaM chaiva tasmi.nstIrthe mahIpate
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra gachCheta paramAM gatim
shlokas.53:
tato gachCheta rAjendra mAnuShaM lokavishrutam |
yatra kRRiShNamRRigA rAjanvyAdhena paripIDitAH
avagAhya tasminsarasi mAnuShatvamupAgatAH
shlokas.54:
tasmi.nstIrthe naraH snAtvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.55:
mAnuShasya tu pUrveNa kroshamAtre mahIpate |
ApagA nAma vikhyAtA nadI siddhaniShevitA
shlokas.56:
shyAmAkabhojanaM tatra yaH prayachChati mAnavaH |
devAnpitR^I.nshcha uddishya tasya dharmaphalaM mahat
ekasminbhojite vipre koTirbhavati bhojitA
shlokas.57:
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha daivatAni pitR^I.nstathA |
uShitvA rajanImekAmagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.58:
tato gachCheta rAjendra brahmaNaH sthAnamuttamam |
brahmodumbaramityeva prakAshaM bhuvi bhArata
shlokas.59:
tatra saptarShikuNDeShu snAtasya kurupu~Ngava |
kedAre chaiva rAjendra kapiShThalamahAtmanaH
shlokas.60:
brahmANamabhigamyAtha shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA brahmalokaM prapadyate
shlokas.61:
kapiShThalasya kedAraM samAsAdya sudurlabham |
antardhAnamavApnoti tapasA dagdhakilbiShaH
shlokas.62:
tato gachCheta rAjendra sarakaM lokavishrutam |
kRRiShNapakShe chaturdashyAmabhigamya vRRiShadhvajam
labhate sarvakAmAnhi svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.63:
tisraH koTyastu tIrthAnAM sarake kurunandana |
rudrakoTistathA kUpe hradeShu cha mahIpate
ilAspadaM cha tatraiva tIrthaM bharatasattama
shlokas.64:
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha pitR^IndevA.nshcha bhArata |
na durgatimavApnoti vAjapeyaM cha vindati
shlokas.65:
ki.ndAne cha naraH snAtvA ki~njapye cha mahIpate |
aprameyamavApnoti dAnaM japyaM cha bhArata
shlokas.66:
kalashyAM chApyupaspRRishya shraddadhAno jitendriyaH |
agniShTomasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.67:
sarakasya tu pUrveNa nAradasya mahAtmanaH |
tIrthaM kuruvarashreShTha anAjanmeti vishrutam
shlokas.68:
tatra tIrthe naraH snAtvA prANA.nshchotsRRijya bhArata |
nAradenAbhyanuj~nAto lokAnprApnoti durlabhAn
shlokas.69:
shuklapakShe dashamyAM tu puNDarIkaM samAvishet |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjanpuNDarIkaphalaM labhet
shlokas.70:
tatastriviShTapaM gachChettriShu lokeShu vishrutam |
tatra vaitaraNI puNyA nadI pApapramochanI
shlokas.71:
tatra snAtvArchayitvA cha shUlapANiM vRRiShadhvajam |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA gachCheta paramAM gatim
shlokas.72:
tato gachCheta rAjendra phalakIvanamuttamam |
yatra devAH sadA rAjanphalakIvanamAshritAH
tapashcharanti vipulaM bahuvarShasahasrakam
shlokas.73:
dRRiShadvatyAM naraH snAtvA tarpayitvA cha devatAH |
agniShTomAtirAtrAbhyAM phalaM vindati bhArata
shlokas.74:
tIrthe cha sarvadevAnAM snAtvA bharatasattama |
gosahasrasya rAjendra phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.75:
pANikhAte naraH snAtvA tarpayitvA cha devatAH |
rAjasUyamavApnoti RRiShilokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.76:
tato gachCheta rAjendra mishrakaM tIrthamuttamam |
tatra tIrthAni rAjendra mishritAni mahAtmanA
shlokas.77:
vyAsena nRRipashArdUla dvijArthamiti naH shrutam |
sarvatIrtheShu sa snAti mishrake snAti yo naraH
shlokas.78:
tato vyAsavanaM gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
manojave naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.79:
gatvA madhuvaTIM chApi devyAstIrthaM naraH shuchiH |
tatra snAtvArchayeddevAnpitR^I.nshcha prayataH shuchiH
sa devyA samanuj~nAto gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.80:
kaushikyAH sa~Ngame yastu dRRiShadvatyAshcha bhArata |
snAti vai niyatAhAraH sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.81:
tato vyAsasthalI nAma yatra vyAsena dhImatA |
putrashokAbhitaptena dehatyAgArthanishchayaH
shlokas.82:
kRRito devaishcha rAjendra punarutthApitastadA |
abhigamya sthalIM tasya gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.83:
ki.ndattaM kUpamAsAdya tilaprasthaM pradAya cha |
gachCheta paramAM siddhimRRiNairmuktaH kurUdvaha
shlokas.84:
ahashcha sudinaM chaiva dve tIrthe cha sudurlabhe |
tayoH snAtvA naravyAghra sUryalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.85:
mRRigadhUmaM tato gachChettriShu lokeShu vishrutam |
tatra ga~NgAhrade snAtvA samabhyarchya cha mAnavaH
shUlapANiM mahAdevamashvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.86:
devatIrthe naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
atha vAmanakaM gachChettriShu lokeShu vishrutam
shlokas.87:
tatra viShNupade snAtvA archayitvA cha vAmanam |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA viShNulokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.88:
kulampune naraH snAtvA punAti svakulaM naraH |
pavanasya hradaM gatvA marutAM tIrthamuttamam
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra vAyuloke mahIyate
shlokas.89:
amarANAM hrade snAtvA amareShu narAdhipa |
amarANAM prabhAvena svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.90:
shAlihotrasya rAjendra shAlishUrpe yathAvidhi |
snAtvA naravarashreShTha gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.91:
shrIku~njaM cha sarasvatyAM tIrthaM bharatasattama |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjannagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.92:
tato naimiShaku~njaM cha samAsAdya kurUdvaha |
RRiShayaH kila rAjendra naimiSheyAstapodhanAH
tIrthayAtrAM puraskRRitya kurukShetraM gatAH purA
shlokas.93:
tataH ku~njaH sarasvatyAM kRRito bharatasattama |
RRiShINAmavakAshaH syAdyathA tuShTikaro mahAn
shlokas.94:
tasminku~nje naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
kanyAtIrthe naraH snAtvA agniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.95:
tato gachChennaravyAghra brahmaNaH sthAnamuttamam |
tatra varNAvaraH snAtvA brAhmaNyaM labhate naraH
brAhmaNashcha vishuddhAtmA gachCheta paramAM gatim
shlokas.96:
tato gachChennarashreShTha somatIrthamanuttamam |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjansomalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.97:
saptasArasvataM tIrthaM tato gachChennarAdhipa |
yatra ma~NkaNakaH siddho maharShirlokavishrutaH
shlokas.98:
purA ma~NkaNako rAjankushAgreNeti naH shrutam |
kShataH kila kare rAja.nstasya shAkaraso.asravat
shlokas.99:
sa vai shAkarasaM dRRiShTvA harShAviShTo mahAtapAH |
pranRRittaH kila viprarShirvismayotphullalochanaH
shlokas.100:
tatastasminpranRRitte vai sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM cha yat |
pranRRittamubhayaM vIra tejasA tasya mohitam
shlokas.101:
brahmAdibhiH surai rAjannRRiShibhishcha tapodhanaiH |
vij~napto vai mahAdeva RRiSherarthe narAdhipa
nAyaM nRRityedyathA deva tathA tvaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.102:
tataH pranRRittamAsAdya harShAviShTena chetasA |
surANAM hitakAmArthamRRiShiM devo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.103:
aho maharShe dharmaj~na kimarthaM nRRityate bhavAn |
harShasthAnaM kimarthaM vA tavAdya munipu~Ngava
shlokas.104:
RRiShiruvAcha||
kiM na pashyasi me deva karAchChAkarasaM srutam |
yaM dRRiShTvAhaM pranRRitto vai harSheNa mahatAnvitaH
shlokas.105:
pulastya uvAcha||
taM prahasyAbravIddevo muniM rAgeNa mohitam |
ahaM vai vismayaM vipra na gachChAmIti pashya mAm
shlokas.106:
evamuktvA narashreShTha mahAdevena dhImatA |
a~NgulyagreNa rAjendra svA~NguShThastADito.anagha
shlokas.107:
tato bhasma kShatAdrAjannirgataM himasaMnibham |
taddRRiShTvA vrIDito rAjansa muniH pAdayorgataH
shlokas.108:
nAnyaM devamahaM manye rudrAtparataraM mahat |
surAsurasya jagato gatistvamasi shUladhRRik
shlokas.109:
tvayA sRRiShTamidaM vishvaM trailokyaM sacharAcharam |
tvAmeva bhagavansarve pravishanti yugakShaye
shlokas.110:
devairapi na shakyastvaM parij~nAtuM kuto mayA |
tvayi sarve cha dRRishyante surA brahmAdayo.anagha
shlokas.111:
sarvastvamasi lokAnAM kartA kArayitA cha ha |
tvatprasAdAtsurAH sarve modantIhAkutobhayAH
evaM stutvA mahAdevaM sa RRiShiH praNato.abhavat
shlokas.113:
RRiShiruvAcha||
tvatprasAdAnmahAdeva tapo me na kShareta vai |
pulastya uvAcha||
tato devaH prahRRiShTAtmA brahmarShimidamabravIt |
tapaste vardhatAM vipra matprasAdAtsahasradhA
shlokas.114:
Ashrame cheha vatsyAmi tvayA sArdhaM mahAmune |
saptasArasvate snAtvA archayiShyanti ye tu mAm
shlokas.115:
na teShAM durlabhaM ki~nchidiha loke paratra cha |
sArasvataM cha te lokaM gamiShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.116:
tatastvaushanasaM gachChettriShu lokeShu vishrutam |
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH
shlokas.117:
kArttikeyashcha bhagavA.nstrisandhyaM kila bhArata |
sAMnidhyamakarottatra bhArgavapriyakAmyayA
shlokas.118:
kapAlamochanaM tIrthaM sarvapApapramochanam |
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.119:
agnitIrthaM tato gachChettatra snAtvA nararShabha |
agnilokamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.120:
vishvAmitrasya tatraiva tIrthaM bharatasattama |
tatra snAtvA mahArAja brAhmaNyamabhijAyate
shlokas.121:
brahmayoniM samAsAdya shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra brahmalokaM prapadyate
punAtyAsaptamaM chaiva kulaM nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.122:
tato gachCheta rAjendra tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
pRRithUdakamiti khyAtaM kArttikeyasya vai nRRipa
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta pitRRidevArchane rataH
shlokas.123:
aj~nAnAjj~nAnato vApi striyA vA puruSheNa vA |
yatki~nchidashubhaM karma kRRitaM mAnuShabuddhinA
shlokas.124:
tatsarvaM nashyate tasya snAtamAtrasya bhArata |
ashvamedhaphalaM chApi svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.125:
puNyamAhuH kurukShetraM kurukShetrAtsarasvatIm |
sarasvatyAshcha tIrthAni tIrthebhyashcha pRRithUdakam
shlokas.126:
uttame sarvatIrthAnAM yastyajedAtmanastanum |
pRRithUdake japyaparo nainaM shvomaraNaM tapet
shlokas.127:
gItaM sanatkumAreNa vyAsena cha mahAtmanA |
vede cha niyataM rAjanabhigachChetpRRithUdakam
shlokas.128:
pRRithUdakAtpuNyatamaM nAnyattIrthaM narottama |
etanmedhyaM pavitraM cha pAvanaM cha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.129:
tatra snAtvA divaM yAnti api pApakRRito janAH |
pRRithUdake narashreShTha prAhurevaM manIShiNaH
shlokas.130:
madhusravaM cha tatraiva tIrthaM bharatasattama |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjangosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.131:
tato gachChennarashreShTha tIrthaM devyA yathAkramam |
sarasvatyAruNAyAshcha sa~NgamaM lokavishrutam
shlokas.132:
trirAtropoShitaH snAtvA muchyate brahmahatyayA |
agniShTomAtirAtrAbhyAM phalaM vindati mAnavaH
shlokas.133:
AsaptamaM kulaM chaiva punAti bharatarShabha |
avatIrNaM cha tatraiva tIrthaM kurukulodvaha
viprANAmanukampArthaM darbhiNA nirmitaM purA
shlokas.134:
vratopanayanAbhyAM vA upavAsena vA dvijaH |
kriyAmantraishcha sa.nyukto brAhmaNaH syAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.135:
kriyAmantravihIno.api tatra snAtvA nararShabha |
chIrNavrato bhavedvipro dRRiShTametatpurAtane
shlokas.136:
samudrAshchApi chatvAraH samAnItAshcha darbhiNA |
yeShu snAto naravyAghra na durgatimavApnuyAt
phalAni gosahasrANAM chaturNAM vindate cha saH
shlokas.137:
tato gachCheta rAjendra tIrthaM shatasahasrakam |
sAhasrakaM cha tatraiva dve tIrthe lokavishrute
shlokas.138:
ubhayorhi naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
dAnaM vApyupavAso vA sahasraguNitaM bhavet
shlokas.139:
tato gachCheta rAjendra reNukAtIrthamuttamam |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta pitRRidevArchane rataH
sravapApavishuddhAtmA agniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.140:
vimochanamupaspRRishya jitamanyurjitendriyaH |
pratigrahakRRitairdoShaiH sarvaiH sa parimuchyate
shlokas.141:
tataH pa~nchavaTaM gatvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
puNyena mahatA yuktaH satAM loke mahIyate
shlokas.142:
yatra yogeshvaraH sthANuH svayameva vRRiShadhvajaH |
tamarchayitvA deveshaM gamanAdeva sidhyati
shlokas.143:
aujasaM varuNaM tIrthaM dIpyate svena tejasA |
yatra brahmAdibhirdevairRRiShibhishcha tapodhanaiH
senApatyena devAnAmabhiShikto guhastadA
shlokas.144:
aujasasya tu pUrveNa kurutIrthaM kurUdvaha |
kurutIrthe naraH snAtvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA kurulokaM prapadyate
shlokas.145:
svargadvAraM tato gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
svargalokamavApnoti brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.146:
tato gachChedanarakaM tIrthasevI narAdhipa |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjanna durgatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.147:
tatra brahmA svayaM nityaM devaiH saha mahIpate |
anvAsyate narashreShTha nArAyaNapurogamaiH
shlokas.148:
sAMnidhyaM chaiva rAjendra rudrapatnyAH kurUdvaha |
abhigamya cha tAM devIM na durgatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.149:
tatraiva cha mahArAja vishveshvaramumApatim |
abhigamya mahAdevaM muchyate sarvakilbiShaiH
shlokas.150:
nArAyaNaM chAbhigamya padmanAbhamari.ndamam |
shobhamAno mahArAja viShNulokaM prapadyate
shlokas.151:
tIrthe tu sarvadevAnAM snAtaH sa puruSharShabha |
sarvaduHkhaiH parityakto dyotate shashivatsadA
shlokas.152:
tataH svastipuraM gachChettIrthasevI narAdhipa |
pAvanaM tIrthamAsAdya tarpayetpitRRidevatAH
agniShTomasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.153:
ga~NgAhradashcha tatraiva kUpashcha bharatarShabha |
tisraH koTyastu tIrthAnAM tasminkUpe mahIpate
tatra snAtvA naro rAjansvargalokaM prapadyate
shlokas.154:
ApagAyAM naraH snAtvA archayitvA maheshvaram |
gANapatyamavApnoti kulaM choddharate svakam
shlokas.155:
tataH sthANuvaTaM gachChettriShu lokeShu vishrutam |
tatra snAtvA sthito rAtriM rudralokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.156:
badarIpAchanaM gachChedvasiShThasyAshramaM tataH |
badaraM bhakShayettatra trirAtropoShito naraH
shlokas.157:
samyagdvAdasha varShANi badarAnbhakShayettu yaH |
trirAtropoShitashchaiva bhavettulyo narAdhipa
shlokas.158:
indramArgaM samAsAdya tIrthasevI narAdhipa |
ahorAtropavAsena shakraloke mahIyate
shlokas.159:
ekarAtraM samAsAdya ekarAtroShito naraH |
niyataH satyavAdI cha brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.160:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
AdityasyAshramo yatra tejorAshermahAtmanaH
shlokas.161:
tasmi.nstIrthe naraH snAtvA pUjayitvA vibhAvasum |
AdityalokaM vrajati kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.162:
somatIrthe naraH snAtvA tIrthasevI kurUdvaha |
somalokamavApnoti naro nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.163:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na dadhIchasya mahAtmanaH |
tIrthaM puNyatamaM rAjanpAvanaM lokavishrutam
shlokas.164:
yatra sArasvato rAjanso.a~NgirAstapaso nidhiH |
tasmi.nstIrthe naraH snAtvA vAjapeyaphalaM labhet
sArasvatIM gatiM chaiva labhate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.165:
tataH kanyAshramaM gachChenniyato brahmacharyavAn |
trirAtropoShito rAjannupavAsaparAyaNaH
labhetkanyAshataM divyaM brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.166:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na tIrthaM saMnihitImapi |
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH
mAsi mAsi samAyAnti puNyena mahatAnvitAH
shlokas.167:
saMnihityAmupaspRRishya rAhugraste divAkare |
ashvamedhashataM tena iShTaM bhavati shAshvatam
shlokas.168:
pRRithivyAM yAni tIrthAni antarikShacharANi cha |
nadyo nadAstaDAgAshcha sarvaprasravaNAni cha
shlokas.169:
udapAnAshcha vaprAshcha puNyAnyAyatanAni cha |
mAsi mAsi samAyAnti saMnihityAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.170:
yatki~nchidduShkRRitaM karma striyA vA puruShasya vA |
snAtamAtrasya tatsarvaM nashyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
padmavarNena yAnena brahmalokaM sa gachChati
shlokas.171:
abhivAdya tato yakShaM dvArapAlamarantukam |
koTirUpamupaspRRishya labhedbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.172:
ga~NgAhradashcha tatraiva tIrthaM bharatasattama |
tatra snAtastu dharmaj~na brahmachArI samAhitaH
rAjasUyAshvamedhAbhyAM phalaM vindati shAshvatam
shlokas.173:
pRRithivyAM naimiShaM puNyamantarikShe cha puShkaram |
trayANAmapi lokAnAM kurukShetraM vishiShyate
shlokas.174:
pA.nsavo.api kurukShetre vAyunA samudIritAH |
api duShkRRitakarmANaM nayanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.175:
dakShiNena sarasvatyA uttareNa dRRiShadvatIm |
ye vasanti kurukShetre te vasanti triviShTape
shlokas.176:
kurukShetraM gamiShyAmi kurukShetre vasAmyaham |
apyekAM vAchamutsRRijya sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.177:
brahmavedI kurukShetraM puNyaM brahmarShisevitam |
tadAvasanti ye rAjanna te shochyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.178:
tarantukArantukayoryadantaraM; rAmahradAnAM cha machakrukasya |
etatkurukShetrasamantapa~nchakaM; pitAmahasyottaravediruchyate

shlokas.1:
pulastya uvAcha||
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na dharmatIrthaM purAtanam |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjandharmashIlaH samAhitaH
AsaptamaM kulaM rAjanpunIte nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.2:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na kArApatanamuttamam |
agniShTomamavApnoti munilokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.3:
saugandhikaM vanaM rAja.nstato gachCheta mAnavaH |
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH
shlokas.4:
siddhachAraNagandharvAH kiMnarAH samahoragAH |
tadvanaM pravishanneva sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.5:
tato hi sA sarichChreShThA nadInAmuttamA nadI |
plakShAddevI srutA rAjanmahApuNyA sarasvatI
shlokas.6:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta valmIkAnniHsRRite jale |
archayitvA pitR^IndevAnashvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.7:
IshAnAdhyuShitaM nAma tatra tIrthaM sudurlabham |
ShaTsu shamyAnipAteShu valmIkAditi nishchayaH
shlokas.8:
kapilAnAM sahasraM cha vAjimedhaM cha vindati |
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra dRRiShTametatpurAtane
shlokas.9:
sugandhAM shatakumbhAM cha pa~nchayaj~nAM cha bhArata |
abhigamya narashreShTha svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.10:
trishUlakhAtaM tatraiva tIrthamAsAdya bhArata |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta pitRRidevArchane rataH
gANapatyaM sa labhate dehaM tyaktvA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
tato gachCheta rAjendra devyAH sthAnaM sudurlabham |
shAkambharIti vikhyAtA triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.12:
divyaM varShasahasraM hi shAkena kila suvrata |
AhAraM sA kRRitavatI mAsi mAsi narAdhipa
shlokas.13:
RRiShayo.abhyAgatAstatra devyA bhaktyA tapodhanAH |
AtithyaM cha kRRitaM teShAM shAkena kila bhArata
tataH shAkambharItyeva nAma tasyAH pratiShThitam
shlokas.14:
shAkambharIM samAsAdya brahmachArI samAhitaH |
trirAtramuShitaH shAkaM bhakShayenniyataH shuchiH
shlokas.15:
shAkAhArasya yatsamyagvarShairdvAdashabhiH phalam |
tatphalaM tasya bhavati devyAshChandena bhArata
shlokas.16:
tato gachChetsuvarNAkShaM triShu lokeShu vishrutam |
yatra viShNuH prasAdArthaM rudramArAdhayatpurA
shlokas.17:
varA.nshcha subahU.Nllebhe daivateShu sudurlabhAn |
uktashcha tripuraghnena parituShTena bhArata
shlokas.18:
api chAsmatpriyataro loke kRRiShNa bhaviShyasi |
tvanmukhaM cha jagatkRRitsnaM bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
tatrAbhigamya rAjendra pUjayitvA vRRiShadhvajam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti gANapatyaM cha vindati
shlokas.20:
dhUmAvatIM tato gachChettriratropoShito naraH |
manasA prArthitAnkAmA.Nllabhate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.21:
devyAstu dakShiNArdhena rathAvarto narAdhipa |
tatrAroheta dharmaj~na shraddadhAno jitendriyaH
mahAdevaprasAdAddhi gachCheta paramAM gatim
shlokas.22:
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya gachCheta bharatarShabha |
dhArAM nAma mahAprAj~na sarvapApapraNAshinIm
tatra snAtvA naravyAghra na shochati narAdhipa
shlokas.23:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na namaskRRitya mahAgirim |
svargadvAreNa yattulyaM ga~NgAdvAraM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta koTitIrthe samAhitaH |
puNDarIkamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.25:
saptaga~Nge triga~Nge cha shakrAvarte cha tarpayan |
devAnpitR^I.nshcha vidhivatpuNyaloke mahIyate
shlokas.26:
tataH kanakhale snAtvA trirAtropoShito naraH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.27:
kapilAvaTaM cha gachCheta tIrthasevI narAdhipa |
uShyaikAM rajanIM tatra gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.28:
nAgarAjasya rAjendra kapilasya mahAtmanAH |
tIrthaM kuruvarashreShTha sarvalokeShu vishrutam
shlokas.29:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta nAgatIrthe narAdhipa |
kapilAnAM sahasrasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.30:
tato lalitikAM gachChechChantanostIrthamuttamam |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjanna durgatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.31:
ga~NgAsa~Ngamayoshchaiva snAti yaH sa~Ngame naraH |
dashAshvamedhAnApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.32:
tato gachCheta rAjendra sugandhAM lokavishrutAm |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.33:
rudrAvartaM tato gachChettIrthasevI narAdhipa |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjansvargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.34:
ga~NgAyAshcha narashreShTha sarasvatyAshcha sa~Ngame |
snAto.ashvamedhamApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.35:
bhadrakarNeshvaraM gatvA devamarchya yathAvidhi |
na durgatimavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.36:
tataH kubjAmrakaM gachChettIrthasevI yathAkramam |
gosahasramavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.37:
arundhatIvaTaM gachChettIrthasevI narAdhipa |
sAmudrakamupaspRRishya trirAtropoShito naraH
gosahasraphalaM vindetkulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.38:
brahmAvartaM tato gachChedbrahmachArI samAhitaH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.39:
yamunAprabhavaM gatvA upaspRRishya cha yAmune |
ashvamedhaphalaM labdhvA svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.40:
darvIsa~NkramaNaM prApya tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.41:
sindhoshcha prabhavaM gatvA siddhagandharvasevitam |
tatroShya rajanIH pa~ncha vindyAdbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.42:
atha vedIM samAsAdya naraH paramadurgamAm |
ashvamedhamavApnoti gachChechchaushanasIM gatim
shlokas.43:
RRiShikulyAM samAsAdya vAsiShThaM chaiva bhArata |
vAsiShThaM samatikramya sarve varNA dvijAtayaH
shlokas.44:
RRiShikulyAM naraH snAtvA RRiShilokaM prapadyate |
yadi tatra vasenmAsaM shAkAhAro narAdhipa
shlokas.45:
bhRRigutu~NgaM samAsAdya vAjimedhaphalaM labhet |
gatvA vIrapramokShaM cha sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.46:
kRRittikAmaghayoshchaiva tIrthamAsAdya bhArata |
agniShTomAtirAtrAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti puNyakRRit
shlokas.47:
tataH sandhyAM samAsAdya vidyAtIrthamanuttamam |
upaspRRishya cha vidyAnAM sarvAsAM pArago bhavet
shlokas.48:
mahAshrame vasedrAtriM sarvapApapramochane |
ekakAlaM nirAhAro lokAnAvasate shubhAn
shlokas.49:
ShaShThakAlopavAsena mAsamuShya mahAlaye |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA vindyAdbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.50:
atha vetasikAM gatvA pitAmahaniShevitAm |
ashvamedhamavApnoti gachChechchaushanasIM gatim
shlokas.51:
atha sundarikAtIrthaM prApya siddhaniShevitam |
rUpasya bhAgI bhavati dRRiShTametatpurAtane
shlokas.52:
tato vai brAhmaNIM gatvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
padmavarNena yAnena brahmalokaM prapadyate
shlokas.53:
tatashcha naimiShaM gachChetpuNyaM siddhaniShevitam |
tatra nityaM nivasati brahmA devagaNairvRRitaH
shlokas.54:
naimiShaM prArthayAnasya pApasyArdhaM praNashyati |
praviShTamAtrastu naraH sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.55:
tatra mAsaM vaseddhIro naimiShe tIrthatatparaH |
pRRithivyAM yAni tIrthAni naimiShe tAni bhArata
shlokas.56:
abhiShekakRRitastatra niyato niyatAshanaH |
gavAmayasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti bhArata
punAtyAsaptamaM chaiva kulaM bharatasattama
shlokas.57:
yastyajennaimiShe prANAnupavAsaparAyaNaH |
sa modetsvargalokastha evamAhurmanIShiNaH
nityaM puNyaM cha medhyaM cha naimiShaM nRRipasattama
shlokas.58:
ga~NgodbhedaM samAsAdya trirAtropoShito naraH |
vAjapeyamavApnoti brahmabhUtashcha jAyate
shlokas.59:
sarasvatIM samAsAdya tarpayetpitRRidevatAH |
sArasvateShu lokeShu modate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.60:
tatashcha bAhudAM gachChedbrahmachArI samAhitaH |
devasatrasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.61:
tatashchIravatIM gachChetpuNyAM puNyatamairvRRitAm |
pitRRidevArchanarato vAjapeyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.62:
vimalAshokamAsAdya virAjati yathA shashI |
tatroShya rajanImekAM svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.63:
gopratAraM tato gachChetsarayvAstIrthamuttamam |
yatra rAmo gataH svargaM sabhRRityabalavAhanaH
shlokas.64:
dehaM tyaktvA divaM yAtastasya tIrthasya tejasA |
rAmasya cha prasAdena vyavasAyAchcha bhArata
shlokas.65:
tasmi.nstIrthe naraH snAtvA gopratAre narAdhipa |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.66:
rAmatIrthe naraH snAtvA gomatyAM kurunandana |
ashvamedhamavApnoti punAti cha kulaM naraH
shlokas.67:
shatasAhasrikaM tatra tIrthaM bharatasattama |
tatropasparshanaM kRRitvA niyato niyatAshanaH
gosahasraphalaM puNyaM prApnoti bharatarShabha
shlokas.68:
tato gachCheta rAjendra bhartRRisthAnamanuttamam |
koTitIrthe naraH snAtvA archayitvA guhaM nRRipa
gosahasraphalaM vindettejasvI cha bhavennaraH
shlokas.69:
tato vArANasIM gatvA archayitvA vRRiShadhvajam |
kapilAhrade naraH snAtvA rAjasUyaphalaM labhet
shlokas.70:
mArkaNDeyasya rAjendra tIrthamAsAdya durlabham |
gomatIga~Ngayoshchaiva sa~Ngame lokavishrute
agniShTomamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.71:
tato gayAM samAsAdya brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti gamanAdeva bhArata
shlokas.72:
tatrAkShayavaTo nAma triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
pitR^INAM tatra vai dattamakShayaM bhavati prabho
shlokas.74:
tato brahmasaro gachCheddharmAraNyopashobhitam |
pauNDarIkamavApnoti prabhAtAmeva sharvarIm
shlokas.75:
tasminsarasi rAjendra brahmaNo yUpa uchChritaH |
yUpaM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA vAjapeyaphalaM labhet
shlokas.76:
tato gachCheta rAjendra dhenukAM lokavishrutAm |
ekarAtroShito rAjanprayachChettiladhenukAm
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA somalokaM vrajeddhruvam
shlokas.77:
tatra chihnaM mahArAja adyApi hi na sa.nshayaH |
kapilA saha vatsena parvate vicharatyuta
savatsAyAH padAni sma dRRishyante.adyApi bhArata
shlokas.78:
teShUpaspRRishya rAjendra padeShu nRRipasattama |
yatki~nchidashubhaM karma tatpraNashyati bhArata
shlokas.79:
tato gRRidhravaTaM gachChetsthAnaM devasya dhImataH |
snAyIta bhasmanA tatra abhigamya vRRiShadhvajam
shlokas.80:
brAhmaNena bhavechchIrNaM vrataM dvAdashavArShikam |
itareShAM tu varNAnAM sarvapApaM praNashyati
shlokas.81:
gachCheta tata udyantaM parvataM gItanAditam |
sAvitraM tu padaM tatra dRRishyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.82:
tatra sandhyAmupAsIta brAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH |
upAstA cha bhavetsandhyA tena dvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.83:
yonidvAraM cha tatraiva vishrutaM bharatarShabha |
tatrAbhigamya muchyeta puruSho yonisa~NkarAt
shlokas.84:
kRRiShNashuklAvubhau pakShau gayAyAM yo vasennaraH |
punAtyAsaptamaM rAjankulaM nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.85:
eShTavyA bahavaH putrA yadyeko.api gayAM vrajet |
yajeta vAshvamedhena nIlaM vA vRRiShamutsRRijet
shlokas.86:
tataH phalguM vrajedrAja.nstIrthasevI narAdhipa |
ashvamedhamavApnoti siddhiM cha mahatIM vrajet
shlokas.87:
tato gachCheta rAjendra dharmapRRiShThaM samAhitaH |
yatra dharmo mahArAja nityamAste yudhiShThira
abhigamya tatastatra vAjimedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.88:
tato gachCheta rAjendra brahmaNastIrthamuttamam |
tatrArchayitvA rAjendra brahmANamamitaujasam
rAjasUyAshvamedhAbhyAM phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.89:
tato rAjagRRihaM gachChettIrthasevI narAdhipa |
upaspRRishya tapodeShu kAkShIvAniva modate
shlokas.90:
yakShiNyA naityakaM tatra prAshnIta puruShaH shuchiH |
yakShiNyAstu prasAdena muchyate bhrUNahatyayA
shlokas.91:
maNinAgaM tato gatvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
naityakaM bhu~njate yastu maNinAgasya mAnavaH
shlokas.92:
daShTasyAshIviSheNApi na tasya kramate viSham |
tatroShya rajanImekAM sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.93:
tato gachCheta brahmarShergautamasya vanaM nRRipa |
ahalyAyA hrade snAtvA vrajeta paramAM gatim
abhigamya shriyaM rAjanvindate shriyamuttamAm
shlokas.94:
tatrodapAno dharmaj~na triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
tatrAbhiShekaM kRRitvA tu vAjimedhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.95:
janakasya tu rAjarSheH kUpastridashapUjitaH |
tatrAbhiShekaM kRRitvA tu viShNulokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.96:
tato vinashanaM gachChetsarvapApapramochanam |
vAjapeyamavApnoti somalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.97:
gaNDakIM tu samAsAdya sarvatIrthajalodbhavAm |
vAjapeyamavApnoti sUryalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.98:
tato.adhiva.nshyaM dharmaj~na samAvishya tapovanam |
guhyakeShu mahArAja modate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.99:
kampanAM tu samAsAdya nadIM siddhaniShevitAm |
puNDarIkamavApnoti sUryalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.100:
tato vishAlAmAsAdya nadIM trailokyavishrutAm |
agniShTomamavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.101:
atha mAheshvarIM dhArAM samAsAdya narAdhipa |
ashvamedhamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.102:
divaukasAM puShkariNIM samAsAdya naraH shuchiH |
na durgatimavApnoti vAjapeyaM cha vindati
shlokas.103:
maheshvarapadaM gachChedbrahmachArI samAhitaH |
maheshvarapade snAtvA vAjimedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.104:
tatra koTistu tIrthAnAM vishrutA bharatarShabha |
kUrmarUpeNa rAjendra asureNa durAtmanA
hriyamANAhRRitA rAjanviShNunA prabhaviShNunA
shlokas.105:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANastIrthakoTyAM yudhiShThira |
puNDarIkamavApnoti viShNulokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.106:
tato gachCheta rAjendra sthAnaM nArAyaNasya tu |
sadA saMnihito yatra harirvasati bhArata
shAlagrAma iti khyAto viShNoradbhutakarmaNaH
shlokas.107:
abhigamya trilokeshaM varadaM viShNumavyayam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti viShNulokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.108:
tatrodapAno dharmaj~na sarvapApapramochanaH |
samudrAstatra chatvAraH kUpe saMnihitAH sadA
tatropaspRRishya rAjendra na durgatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.109:
abhigamya mahAdevaM varadaM viShNumavyayam |
virAjati yathA soma RRiNairmukto yudhiShThira
shlokas.110:
jAtismara upaspRRishya shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
jAtismaratvaM prApnoti snAtvA tatra na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.111:
vaTeshvarapuraM gatvA archayitvA tu keshavam |
IpsitA.Nllabhate kAmAnupavAsAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.112:
tatastu vAmanaM gatvA sarvapApapramochanam |
abhivAdya hariM devaM na durgatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.113:
bharatasyAshramaM gatvA sarvapApapramochanam |
kaushikIM tatra seveta mahApAtakanAshinIm
rAjasUyasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.114:
tato gachCheta dharmaj~na champakAraNyamuttamam |
tatroShya rajanImekAM gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.115:
atha jyeShThilamAsAdya tIrthaM paramasaMmatam |
upoShya rajanImekAmagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.116:
tatra vishveshvaraM dRRiShTvA devyA saha mahAdyutim |
mitrAvaruNayorlokAnApnoti puruSharShabha
shlokas.117:
kanyAsa.nvedyamAsAdya niyato niyatAshanaH |
manoH prajApaterlokAnApnoti bharatarShabha
shlokas.118:
kanyAyAM ye prayachChanti pAnamannaM cha bhArata |
tadakShayamiti prAhurRRiShayaH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.119:
nishchIrAM cha samAsAdya triShu lokeShu vishrutAm |
ashvamedhamavApnoti viShNulokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.120:
ye tu dAnaM prayachChanti nishchIrAsa~Ngame narAH |
te yAnti narashArdUla brahmalokaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.121:
tatrAshramo vasiShThasya triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANo vAjapeyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.122:
devakUTaM samAsAdya brahmarShigaNasevitam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti kulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.123:
tato gachCheta rAjendra kaushikasya munerhradam |
yatra siddhiM parAM prApto vishvAmitro.atha kaushikaH
shlokas.124:
tatra mAsaM vasedvIra kaushikyAM bharatarShabha |
ashvamedhasya yatpuNyaM tanmAsenAdhigachChati
shlokas.125:
sarvatIrthavare chaiva yo vaseta mahAhrade |
na durgatimavApnoti vindedbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.126:
kumAramabhigatvA cha vIrAshramanivAsinam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti naro nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.127:
agnidhArAM samAsAdya triShu lokeShu vishrutAm |
agniShTomamavApnoti na cha svargAnnivartate
shlokas.128:
pitAmahasaro gatvA shailarAjapratiShThitam |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANo agniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.129:
pitAmahasya sarasaH prasrutA lokapAvanI |
kumAradhArA tatraiva triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.130:
yatra snAtvA kRRitArtho.asmItyAtmAnamavagachChati |
ShaShThakAlopavAsena muchyate brahmahatyayA
shlokas.131:
shikharaM vai mahAdevyA gauryAstrailokyavishrutam |
samAruhya naraH shrAddhaH stanakuNDeShu sa.nvishet
shlokas.132:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANaH pitRRidevArchane rataH |
hayamedhamavApnoti shakralokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.133:
tAmrAruNaM samAsAdya brahmachArI samAhitaH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti shakralokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.134:
nandinyAM cha samAsAdya kUpaM tridashasevitam |
naramedhasya yatpuNyaM tatprApnoti kurUdvaha
shlokas.135:
kAlikAsa~Ngame snAtvA kaushikyAruNayoryataH |
trirAtropoShito vidvAnsarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.136:
urvashItIrthamAsAdya tataH somAshramaM budhaH |
kumbhakarNAshrame snAtvA pUjyate bhuvi mAnavaH
shlokas.137:
snAtvA kokAmukhe puNye brahmachArI yatavrataH |
jAtismaratvaM prApnoti dRRiShTametatpurAtane
shlokas.138:
sakRRinnandAM samAsAdya kRRitAtmA bhavati dvijaH |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA shakralokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.139:
RRiShabhadvIpamAsAdya sevyaM krau~nchaniShUdanam |
sarasvatyAmupaspRRishya vimAnastho virAjate
shlokas.140:
auddAlakaM mahArAja tIrthaM muniniShevitam |
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvIta sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.141:
dharmatIrthaM samAsAdya puNyaM brahmarShisevitam |
vAjapeyamavApnoti naro nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.142:
tathA champAM samAsAdya bhAgIrathyAM kRRitodakaH |
daNDArkamabhigamyaiva gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.143:
laveDikAM tato gachChetpuNyAM puNyopasevitAm |
vAjapeyamavApnoti vimAnasthashcha pUjyate

shlokas.1:
pulastya uvAcha||
atha sandhyAM samAsAdya sa.nvedyaM tIrthamuttamam |
upaspRRishya naro vidvAnbhavennAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.2:
rAmasya cha prasAdena tIrthaM rAjankRRitaM purA |
tallohityaM samAsAdya vindyAdbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.3:
karatoyAM samAsAdya trirAtropoShito naraH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti kRRite paitAmahe vidhau
shlokas.4:
ga~NgAyAstvatha rAjendra sAgarasya cha sa~Ngame |
ashvamedhaM dashaguNaM pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.5:
ga~NgAyAstvaparaM dvIpaM prApya yaH snAti bhArata |
trirAtropoShito rAjansarvakAmAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.6:
tato vaitaraNIM gatvA nadIM pApapramochanIm |
virajaM tIrthamAsAdya virAjati yathA shashI
shlokas.7:
prabhavechcha kule puNye sarvapApaM vyapohati |
gosahasraphalaM labdhvA punAti cha kulaM naraH
shlokas.8:
shoNasya jyotirathyAshcha sa~Ngame nivasa~nshuchiH |
tarpayitvA pitR^IndevAnagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.9:
shoNasya narmadAyAshcha prabhave kurunandana |
va.nshagulma upaspRRishya vAjimedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.10:
RRiShabhaM tIrthamAsAdya koshalAyAM narAdhipa |
vAjapeyamavApnoti trirAtropoShito naraH
shlokas.11:
koshalAyAM samAsAdya kAlatIrtha upaspRRishet |
vRRishabhaikAdashaphalaM labhate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
puShpavatyAmupaspRRishya trirAtropoShito naraH |
gosahasraphalaM vindyAtkulaM chaiva samuddharet
shlokas.13:
tato badarikAtIrthe snAtvA prayatamAnasaH |
dIrghamAyuravApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.14:
tato mahendramAsAdya jAmadagnyaniShevitam |
rAmatIrthe naraH snAtvA vAjimedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.15:
mata~Ngasya tu kedArastatraiva kurunandana |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjangosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.16:
shrIparvataM samAsAdya nadItIra upaspRRishet |
ashvamedhamavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.17:
shrIparvate mahAdevo devyA saha mahAdyutiH |
nyavasatparamaprIto brahmA cha tridashairvRRitaH
shlokas.18:
tatra devahrade snAtvA shuchiH prayatamAnasaH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti parAM siddhiM cha gachChati
shlokas.19:
RRiShabhaM parvataM gatvA pANDyeShu surapUjitam |
vAjapeyamavApnoti nAkapRRiShThe cha modate
shlokas.20:
tato gachCheta kAverIM vRRitAmapsarasAM gaNaiH |
tatra snAtvA naro rAjangosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.21:
tatastIre samudrasya kanyAtIrtha upaspRRishet |
tatropaspRRishya rAjendra sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.22:
atha gokarNamAsAdya triShu lokeShu vishrutam |
samudramadhye rAjendra sarvalokanamaskRRitam
shlokas.23:
yatra brahmAdayo devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH |
bhUtayakShapishAchAshcha kiMnarAH samahoragAH
shlokas.24:
siddhachAraNagandharvA mAnuShAH pannagAstathA |
saritaH sAgarAH shailA upAsanta umApatim
shlokas.25:
tatreshAnaM samabhyarchya trirAtropoShito naraH |
dashAshvamedhamApnoti gANapatyaM cha vindati
uShya dvAdasharAtraM tu kRRitAtmA bhavate naraH
shlokas.26:
tata eva tu gAyatryAH sthAnaM trailokyavishrutam |
trirAtramuShitastatra gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.27:
nidarshanaM cha pratyakShaM brAhmaNAnAM narAdhipa |
gAyatrIM paThate yastu yonisa~NkarajastathA
gAthA vA gItikA vApi tasya sampadyate nRRipa
shlokas.28:
sa.nvartasya tu viprarShervApImAsAdya durlabhAm |
rUpasya bhAgI bhavati subhagashchaiva jAyate
shlokas.29:
tato veNNAM samAsAdya tarpayetpitRRidevatAH |
mayUraha.nsasa.nyuktaM vimAnaM labhate naraH
shlokas.30:
tato godAvarIM prApya nityaM siddhaniShevitAm |
gavAmayamavApnoti vAsukerlokamApnuyAt
shlokas.31:
veNNAyAH sa~Ngame snAtvA vAjapeyaphalaM labhet |
varadAsa~Ngame snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.32:
brahmasthAnaM samAsAdya trirAtramuShito naraH |
gosahasraphalaM vindetsvargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.33:
kushaplavanamAsAdya brahmachArI samAhitaH |
trirAtramuShitaH snAtvA ashvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.34:
tato devahrade ramye kRRiShNaveNNAjalodbhave |
jAtimAtrahrade chaiva tathA kanyAshrame nRRipa
shlokas.35:
yatra kratushatairiShTvA devarAjo divaM gataH |
agniShTomashataM vindedgamanAdeva bhArata
shlokas.36:
sarvadevahrade snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet |
jAtimAtrahrade snAtvA bhavejjAtismaro naraH
shlokas.37:
tato.avApya mahApuNyAM payoShNIM saritAM varAm |
pitRRidevArchanarato gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.38:
daNDakAraNyamAsAdya mahArAja upaspRRishet |
gosahasraphalaM tatra snAtamAtrasya bhArata
shlokas.39:
sharabha~NgAshramaM gatvA shukasya cha mahAtmanaH |
na durgatimavApnoti punAti cha kulaM naraH
shlokas.40:
tataH shUrpArakaM gachChejjAmadagnyaniShevitam |
rAmatIrthe naraH snAtvA vindyAdbahu suvarNakam
shlokas.41:
saptagodAvare snAtvA niyato niyatAshanaH |
mahatpuNyamavApnoti devalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.42:
tato devapathaM gachChenniyato niyatAshanaH |
devasatrasya yatpuNyaM tadavApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.43:
tu~NgakAraNyamAsAdya brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
vedAnadhyApayattatra RRiShiH sArasvataH purA
shlokas.44:
tatra vedAnpranaShTA.nstu munera~NgirasaH sutaH |
upaviShTo maharShINAmuttarIyeShu bhArata
shlokas.45:
o~NkAreNa yathAnyAyaM samyaguchchAritena cha |
yena yatpUrvamabhyastaM tattasya samupasthitam
shlokas.46:
RRiShayastatra devAshcha varuNo.agniH prajApatiH |
harirnArAyaNo devo mahAdevastathaiva cha
shlokas.47:
pitAmahashcha bhagavAndevaiH saha mahAdyutiH |
bhRRiguM niyojayAmAsa yAjanArthe mahAdyutim
shlokas.48:
tataH sa chakre bhagavAnRRiShINAM vidhivattadA |
sarveShAM punarAdhAnaM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.49:
AjyabhAgena vai tatra tarpitAstu yathAvidhi |
devAstribhuvaNaM yAtA RRiShayashcha yathAsukham
shlokas.50:
tadaraNyaM praviShTasya tu~NgakaM rAjasattama |
pApaM praNashyate sarvaM striyo vA puruShasya vA
shlokas.51:
tatra mAsaM vaseddhIro niyato niyatAshanaH |
brahmalokaM vrajedrAjanpunIte cha kulaM naraH
shlokas.52:
medhAvikaM samAsAdya pitR^IndevA.nshcha tarpayet |
agniShTomamavApnoti smRRitiM medhAM cha vindati
shlokas.53:
tataH kAla~njaraM gatvA parvataM lokavishrutam |
tatra devahrade snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.54:
AtmAnaM sAdhayettatra girau kAla~njare nRRipa |
svargaloke mahIyeta naro nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.55:
tato girivarashreShThe chitrakUTe vishAM pate |
mandAkinIM samAsAdya nadIM pApapramochanIm
shlokas.56:
tatrAbhiShekaM kurvANaH pitRRidevArchane rataH |
ashvamedhamavApnoti gatiM cha paramAM vrajet
shlokas.57:
tato gachCheta rAjendra bhartRRisthAnamanuttamam |
yatra devo mahAseno nityaM saMnihito nRRipaH
shlokas.58:
pumA.nstatra narashreShTha gamanAdeva sidhyati |
koTitIrthe naraH snAtvA gosahasraphalaM labhet
shlokas.59:
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya jyeShThasthAnaM vrajennaraH |
abhigamya mahAdevaM virAjati yathA shashI
shlokas.60:
tatra kUpo mahArAja vishruto bharatarShabha |
samudrAstatra chatvAro nivasanti yudhiShThira
shlokas.61:
tatropaspRRishya rAjendra kRRitvA chApi pradakShiNam |
niyatAtmA naraH pUto gachCheta paramAM gatim
shlokas.62:
tato gachChetkurushreShTha shRRi~NgaverapuraM mahat |
yatra tIrNo mahArAja rAmo dAsharathiH purA
shlokas.63:
ga~NgAyAM tu naraH snAtvA brahmachArI samAhitaH |
vidhUtapApmA bhavati vAjapeyaM cha vindati
shlokas.64:
abhigamya mahAdevamabhyarchya cha narAdhipa |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya gANapatyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.65:
tato gachCheta rAjendra prayAgamRRiShisa.nstutam |
yatra brahmAdayo devA dishashcha sadigIshvarAH
shlokas.66:
lokapAlAshcha sAdhyAshcha nairRRitAH pitarastathA |
sanatkumArapramukhAstathaiva paramarShayaH
shlokas.67:
a~NgiraHpramukhAshchaiva tathA brahmarShayo.apare |
tathA nAgAH suparNAshcha siddhAshchakracharAstathA
shlokas.68:
saritaH sAgarAshchaiva gandharvApsarasastathA |
harishcha bhagavAnAste prajApatipuraskRRitaH
shlokas.69:
tatra trINyagnikuNDAni yeShAM madhye cha jAhnavI |
prayAgAdabhiniShkrAntA sarvatIrthapuraskRRitA
shlokas.70:
tapanasya sutA tatra triShu lokeShu vishrutA |
yamunA ga~NgayA sArdhaM sa~NgatA lokapAvanI
shlokas.71:
ga~NgAyamunayormadhyaM pRRithivyA jaghanaM smRRitam |
prayAgaM jaghanasyAntamupasthamRRiShayo viduH
shlokas.72:
prayAgaM sapratiShThAnaM kambalAshvatarau tathA |
tIrthaM bhogavatI chaiva vedI proktA prajApateH
shlokas.73:
tatra vedAshcha yaj~nAshcha mUrtimanto yudhiShThira |
prajApatimupAsante RRiShayashcha mahAvratAH
yajante kratubhirdevAstathA chakracharA nRRipa
shlokas.74:
tataH puNyatamaM nAsti triShu lokeShu bhArata |
prayAgaH sarvatIrthebhyaH prabhavatyadhikaM vibho
shlokas.75:
shravaNAttasya tIrthasya nAmasa~NkIrtanAdapi |
mRRittikAlambhanAdvApi naraH pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.76:
tatrAbhiShekaM yaH kuryAtsa~Ngame sa.nshitavrataH |
puNyaM sa phalamApnoti rAjasUyAshvamedhayoH
shlokas.77:
eShA yajanabhUmirhi devAnAmapi satkRRitA |
tatra dattaM sUkShmamapi mahadbhavati bhArata
shlokas.78:
na vedavachanAttAta na lokavachanAdapi |
matirutkramaNIyA te prayAgamaraNaM prati
shlokas.79:
dasha tIrthasahasrANi ShaShTikoTtyastathAparAH |
yeShAM sAMnidhyamatraiva kIrtitaM kurunandana
shlokas.80:
chAturvede cha yatpuNyaM satyavAdiShu chaiva yat |
snAta eva tadApnoti ga~NgAyamunasa~Ngame
shlokas.81:
tatra bhogavatI nAma vAsukestIrthamuttamam |
tatrAbhiShekaM yaH kuryAtso.ashvamedhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.82:
tatra ha.nsaprapatanaM tIrthaM trailokyavishrutam |
dashAshvamedhikaM chaiva ga~NgAyAM kurunandana
shlokas.83:
yatra ga~NgA mahArAja sa deshastattapovanam |
siddhakShetraM tu tajj~neyaM ga~NgAtIrasamAshritam
shlokas.84:
idaM satyaM dvijAtInAM sAdhUnAmAtmajasya cha |
suhRRidAM cha japetkarNe shiShyasyAnugatasya cha
shlokas.85:
idaM dharmyamidaM puNyamidaM medhyamidaM sukham |
idaM svargyamidaM ramyamidaM pAvanamuttamam
shlokas.86:
maharShINAmidaM guhyaM sarvapApapramochanam |
adhItya dvijamadhye cha nirmalatvamavApnuyAt
shlokas.87:
yashchedaM shRRiNuyAnnityaM tIrthapuNyaM sadA shuchiH |
jAtIH sa smarate bahvIrnAkapRRiShThe cha modate
shlokas.88:
gamyAnyapi cha tIrthAni kIrtitAnyagamAni cha |
manasA tAni gachCheta sarvatIrthasamIkShayA
shlokas.89:
etAni vasubhiH sAdhyairAdityairmarudashvibhiH |
RRiShibhirdevakalpaishcha shritAni sukRRitaiShibhiH
shlokas.90:
evaM tvamapi kauravya vidhinAnena suvrata |
vraja tIrthAni niyataH puNyaM puNyena vardhate
shlokas.91:
bhAvitaiH kAraNaiH pUrvamAstikyAchChrutidarshanAt |
prApyante tAni tIrthAni sadbhiH shiShTAnudarshibhiH
shlokas.92:
nAvrato nAkRRitAtmA cha nAshuchirna cha taskaraH |
snAti tIrtheShu kauravya na cha vakramatirnaraH
shlokas.93:
tvayA tu samyagvRRittena nityaM dharmArthadarshinA |
pitarastAritAstAta sarve cha prapitAmahAH
shlokas.94:
pitAmahapurogAshcha devAH sarShigaNA nRRipa |
tava dharmeNa dharmaj~na nityamevAbhitoShitAH
shlokas.95:
avApsyasi cha lokAnvai vasUnAM vAsavopama |
kIrtiM cha mahatIM bhIShma prApsyase bhuvi shAshvatIm
shlokas.96:
nArada uvAcha||
evamuktvAbhyanuj~nApya pulastyo bhagavAnRRiShiH |
prItaH prItena manasA tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.98:
anena vidhinA yastu pRRithivIM sa~nchariShyati |
ashvamedhashatasyAgryaM phalaM pretya sa bhokShyate
shlokas.99:
atashchAShTaguNaM pArtha prApsyase dharmamuttamam |
netA cha tvamRRiShInyasmAttena te.aShTaguNaM phalam
shlokas.100:
rakShogaNAvakIrNAni tIrthAnyetAni bhArata |
na gatirvidyate.anyasya tvAmRRite kurunandana
shlokas.101:
idaM devarShicharitaM sarvatIrthArthasa.nshritam |
yaH paThetkalyamutthAya sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.102:
RRiShimukhyAH sadA yatra vAlmIkistvatha kAshyapaH |
Atreyastvatha kauNDinyo vishvAmitro.atha gautamaH
shlokas.103:
asito devalashchaiva mArkaNDeyo.atha gAlavaH |
bharadvAjo vasiShThashcha muniruddAlakastathA
shlokas.104:
shaunakaH saha putreNa vyAsashcha japatAM varaH |
durvAsAshcha munishreShTho gAlavashcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.105:
ete RRiShivarAH sarve tvatpratIkShAstapodhanAH |
ebhiH saha mahArAja tIrthAnyetAnyanuvraja
shlokas.106:
eSha vai lomasho nAma devarShiramitadyutiH |
sameShyati tvayA chaiva tena sArdhamanuvraja
shlokas.107:
mayA cha saha dharmaj~na tIrthAnyetAnyanuvraja |
prApsyase mahatIM kIrtiM yathA rAjA mahAbhiShaH
shlokas.108:
yathA yayAtirdharmAtmA yathA rAjA purUravAH |
tathA tvaM kurushArdUla svena dharmeNa shobhase
shlokas.109:
yathA bhagIratho rAjA yathA rAmashcha vishrutaH |
tathA tvaM sarvarAjabhyo bhrAjase rashmivAniva
shlokas.110:
yathA manuryathekShvAkuryathA pUrurmahAyashAH |
yathA vainyo mahAtejAstathA tvamapi vishrutaH
shlokas.111:
yathA cha vRRitrahA sarvAnsapatnAnnirdahatpurA |
tathA shatrukShayaM kRRitvA prajAstvaM pAlayiShyasi
shlokas.112:
svadharmavijitAmurvIM prApya rAjIvalochana |
khyAtiM yAsyasi dharmeNa kArtavIryArjuno yathA
shlokas.113:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAshvAsya rAjAnaM nArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
anuj~nApya mahAtmAnaM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.114:
yudhiShThiro.api dharmAtmA tamevArthaM vichintayan |
tIrthayAtrAshrayaM puNyamRRiShINAM pratyavedayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhrAtR^INAM matamAj~nAya nAradasya cha dhImataH |
pitAmahasamaM dhaumyaM prAha rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
mayA sa puruShavyAghro jiShNuH satyaparAkramaH |
astrahetormahAbAhuramitAtmA vivAsitaH
shlokas.3:
sa hi vIro.anuraktashcha samarthashcha tapodhana |
kRRitI cha bhRRishamapyastre vAsudeva iva prabhuH
shlokas.4:
ahaM hyetAvubhau brahmankRRiShNAvarinighAtinau |
abhijAnAmi vikrAntau tathA vyAsaH pratApavAn
triyugau puNDarIkAkShau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.5:
nArado.api tathA veda so.apyasha.nsatsadA mama |
tathAhamapi jAnAmi naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.6:
shakto.ayamityato matvA mayA sampreShito.arjunaH |
indrAdanavaraH shaktaH surasUnuH surAdhipam
draShTumastrANi chAdAtumindrAditi vivAsitaH
shlokas.7:
bhIShmadroNAvatirathau kRRipo drauNishcha durjayaH |
dhRRitarAShTrasya putreNa vRRitA yudhi mahAbalAH
sarve vedavidaH shUrAH sarve.astrakushalAstathA
shlokas.8:
yoddhukAmashcha pArthena satataM yo mahAbalaH |
sa cha divyAstravitkarNaH sUtaputro mahArathaH
shlokas.9:
so.ashvavegAnilabalaH sharArchistalanisvanaH |
rajodhUmo.astrasantApo dhArtarAShTrAniloddhataH
shlokas.10:
nisRRiShTa iva kAlena yugAntajvalano yathA |
mama sainyamayaM kakShaM pradhakShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
taM sa kRRiShNAniloddhUto divyAstrajalado mahAn |
shvetavAjibalAkAbhRRidgANDIvendrAyudhojjvalaH
shlokas.12:
satataM sharadhArAbhiH pradIptaM karNapAvakam |
udIrNo.arjunamegho.ayaM shamayiShyati sa.nyuge
shlokas.13:
sa sAkShAdeva sarvANi shakrAtparapura~njayaH |
divyAnyastrANi bIbhatsustattvataH pratipatsyate
shlokas.14:
alaM sa teShAM sarveShAmiti me dhIyate matiH |
nAsti tvatikriyA tasya raNe.arINAM pratikriyA
shlokas.15:
taM vayaM pANDavaM sarve gRRihItAstraM dhana~njayam |
draShTAro na hi bIbhatsurbhAramudyamya sIdati
shlokas.16:
vayaM tu tamRRite vIraM vane.asmindvipadAM vara |
avadhAnaM na gachChAmaH kAmyake saha kRRiShNayA
shlokas.17:
bhavAnanyadvanaM sAdhu bahvannaM phalavachChuchi |
AkhyAtu ramaNIyaM cha sevitaM puNyakarmabhiH
shlokas.18:
yatra ka~nchidvayaM kAlaM vasantaH satyavikramam |
pratIkShAmo.arjunaM vIraM varShakAmA ivAmbudam
shlokas.19:
vividhAnAshramAnkA.nshchiddvijAtibhyaH parishrutAn |
sarA.nsi saritashchaiva ramaNIyA.nshcha parvatAn
shlokas.20:
AchakShva na hi no brahmanrochate tamRRite.arjunam |
vane.asminkAmyake vAso gachChAmo.anyAM dishaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAnsarvAnutsukAndRRiShTvA pANDavAndInachetasaH |
AshvAsaya.nstadA dhaumyo bRRihaspatisamo.abravIt
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNAnumatAnpuNyAnAshramAnbharatarShabha |
dishastIrthAni shailA.nshcha shRRiNu me gadato nRRipa
shlokas.3:
pUrvaM prAchIM dishaM rAjanrAjarShigaNasevitAm |
ramyAM te kIrtayiShyAmi yudhiShThira yathAsmRRiti
shlokas.4:
tasyAM devarShijuShTAyAM naimiShaM nAma bhArata |
yatra tIrthAni devAnAM supuNyAni pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.5:
yatra sA gomatI puNyA ramyA devarShisevitA |
yaj~nabhUmishcha devAnAM shAmitraM cha vivasvataH
shlokas.6:
tasyAM girivaraH puNyo gayo rAjarShisatkRRitaH |
shivaM brahmasaro yatra sevitaM tridasharShibhiH
shlokas.7:
yadarthaM puruShavyAghra kIrtayanti purAtanAH |
eShTavyA bahavaH putrA yadyeko.api gayAM vrajet
shlokas.8:
mahAnadI cha tatraiva tathA gayashiro.anagha |
yatrAsau kIrtyate viprairakShayyakaraNo vaTaH
yatra dattaM pitRRibhyo.annamakShayyaM bhavati prabho
shlokas.9:
sA cha puNyajalA yatra phalgunAmA mahAnadI |
bahumUlaphalA chApi kaushikI bharatarShabha
vishvAmitro.abhyagAdyatra brAhmaNatvaM tapodhanaH
shlokas.10:
ga~NgA yatra nadI puNyA yasyAstIre bhagIrathaH |
ayajattAta bahubhiH kratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.11:
pA~nchAleShu cha kauravya kathayantyutpalAvatam |
vishvAmitro.ayajadyatra shakreNa saha kaushikaH
yatrAnuva.nshaM bhagavA~njAmadagnyastathA jagau
shlokas.12:
vishvAmitrasya tAM dRRiShTvA vibhUtimatimAnuShIm |
kanyakubje.apibatsomamindreNa saha kaushikaH
tataH kShatrAdapAkrAmadbrAhmaNo.asmIti chAbravIt
shlokas.13:
pavitramRRiShibhirjuShTaM puNyaM pAvanamuttamam |
ga~NgAyamunayorvIra sa~NgamaM lokavishrutam
shlokas.14:
yatrAyajata bhUtAtmA pUrvameva pitAmahaH |
prayAgamiti vikhyAtaM tasmAdbharatasattama
shlokas.15:
agastyasya cha rAjendra tatrAshramavaro mahAn |
hiraNyabinduH kathito girau kAla~njare nRRipa
shlokas.16:
atyanyAnparvatAnrAjanpuNyo girivaraH shivaH |
mahendro nAma kauravya bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
ayajadyatra kaunteya pUrvameva pitAmahaH |
yatra bhAgIrathI puNyA sadasyAsIdyudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
yatrAsau brahmashAleti puNyA khyAtA vishAM pate |
dhUtapApmabhirAkIrNA puNyaM tasyAshcha darshanam
shlokas.19:
pavitro ma~NgalIyashcha khyAto loke sanAtanaH |
kedArashcha mata~Ngasya mahAnAshrama uttamaH
shlokas.20:
kuNDodaH parvato ramyo bahumUlaphalodakaH |
naiShadhastRRiShito yatra jalaM sharma cha labdhavAn
shlokas.21:
yatra devavanaM ramyaM tApasairupashobhitam |
bAhudA cha nadI yatra nandA cha girimUrdhani
shlokas.22:
tIrthAni saritaH shailAH puNyAnyAyatanAni cha |
prAchyAM dishi mahArAja kIrtitAni mayA tava
shlokas.23:
tisRRiShvanyAsu puNyAni dikShu tIrthAni me shRRiNu |
saritaH parvatA.nshchaiva puNyAnyAyatanAni cha

shlokas.1:
dhaumya uvAcha||
dakShiNasyAM tu puNyAni shRRiNu tIrthAni bhArata |
vistareNa yathAbuddhi kIrtyamAnAni bhArata
shlokas.2:
yasyAmAkhyAyate puNyA dishi godAvarI nadI |
bahvArAmA bahujalA tApasAcharitA shubhA
shlokas.3:
veNNA bhImarathI chobhe nadyau pApabhayApahe |
mRRigadvijasamAkIrNe tApasAlayabhUShite
shlokas.4:
rAjarShestatra cha sarinnRRigasya bharatarShabha |
ramyatIrthA bahujalA payoShNI dvijasevitA
shlokas.5:
api chAtra mahAyogI mArkaNDeyo mahAtapAH |
anuvaMShyAM jagau gAthAM nRRigasya dharaNIpateH
shlokas.6:
nRRigasya yajamAnasya pratyakShamiti naH shrutam |
amAdyadindraH somena dakShiNAbhirdvijAtayaH
shlokas.7:
mATharasya vanaM puNyaM bahumUlaphalaM shivam |
yUpashcha bharatashreShTha varuNasrotase girau
shlokas.8:
praveNyuttarapArshve tu puNye kaNvAshrame tathA |
tApasAnAmaraNyAni kIrtitAni yathAshruti
shlokas.9:
vedI shUrpArake tAta jamadagnermahAtmanaH |
ramyA pAShANatIrthA cha purashchandrA cha bhArata
shlokas.10:
ashokatIrthaM martyeShu kaunteya bahulAshramam |
agastyatIrthaM pANDyeShu vAruNaM cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.11:
kumAryaH kathitAH puNyAH pANDyeShveva nararShabha |
tAmraparNIM tu kaunteya kIrtayiShyAmi tAM shRRiNu
shlokas.12:
yatra devaistapastaptaM mahadichChadbhirAshrame |
gokarNamiti vikhyAtaM triShu lokeShu bhArata
shlokas.13:
shItatoyo bahujalaH puNyastAta shivashcha saH |
hradaH paramaduShprApo mAnuShairakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.14:
tatraiva tRRiNasomAgneH sampannaphalamUlavAn |
Ashramo.agastyashiShyasya puNyo devasabhe girau
shlokas.15:
vaiDUryaparvatastatra shrImAnmaNimayaH shivaH |
agastyasyAshramashchaiva bahumUlaphalodakaH
shlokas.16:
surAShTreShvapi vakShyAmi puNyAnyAyatanAni cha |
AshramAnsaritaH shailAnsarA.nsi cha narAdhipa
shlokas.17:
chamasonmajjanaM viprAstatrApi kathayantyuta |
prabhAsaM chodadhau tIrthaM tridashAnAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
tatra piNDArakaM nAma tApasAcharitaM shubham |
ujjayantashcha shikharI kShipraM siddhikaro mahAn
shlokas.19:
tatra devarShivaryeNa nAradenAnukIrtitaH |
purANaH shrUyate shlokastaM nibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
puNye girau surAShTreShu mRRigapakShiniShevite |
ujjayante sma taptA~Ngo nAkapRRiShThe mahIyate
shlokas.21:
puNyA dvAravatI tatra yatrAste madhusUdanaH |
sAkShAddevaH purANo.asau sa hi dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.22:
ye cha vedavido viprA ye chAdhyAtmavido janAH |
te vadanti mahAtmAnaM kRRiShNaM dharmaM sanAtanam
shlokas.23:
pavitrANAM hi govindaH pavitraM paramuchyate |
puNyAnAmapi puNyo.asau ma~NgalAnAM cha ma~Ngalam
shlokas.24:
trailokyaM puNDarIkAkSho devadevaH sanAtanaH |
Aste harirachintyAtmA tatraiva madhusUdanaH

shlokas.1:
dhaumya uvAcha||
avantiShu pratIchyAM vai kIrtayiShyAmi te dishi |
yAni tatra pavitrANi puNyAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.2:
priya~NgvAmravanopetA vAnIravanamAlinI |
pratyaksrotA nadI puNyA narmadA tatra bhArata
shlokas.3:
niketaH khyAyate puNyo yatra vishravaso muneH |
jaj~ne dhanapatiryatra kubero naravAhanaH
shlokas.4:
vaiDUryashikharo nAma puNyo girivaraH shubhaH |
divyapuShpaphalAstatra pAdapA haritachChadAH
shlokas.5:
tasya shailasya shikhare sarastatra cha dhImataH |
praphullanalinaM rAjandevagandharvasevitam
shlokas.6:
bahvAshcharyaM mahArAja dRRishyate tatra parvate |
puNye svargopame divye nityaM devarShisevite
shlokas.7:
hradinI puNyatIrthA cha rAjarShestatra vai sarit |
vishvAmitranadI pArA puNyA parapura~njaya
shlokas.8:
yasyAstIre satAM madhye yayAtirnahuShAtmajaH |
papAta sa punarlokA.Nllebhe dharmAnsanAtanAn
shlokas.9:
tatra puNyahradastAta mainAkashchaiva parvataH |
bahumUlaphalo vIra asito nAma parvataH
shlokas.10:
AshramaH kakShasenasya puNyastatra yudhiShThira |
chyavanasyAshramashchaiva khyAtaH sarvatra pANDava
tatrAlpenaiva sidhyanti mAnavAstapasA vibho
shlokas.11:
jambUmArgo mahArAja RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
AshramaH shAmyatAM shreShTha mRRigadvijagaNAyutaH
shlokas.12:
tataH puNyatamA rAjansatataM tApasAyutA |
ketumAlA cha medhyA cha ga~NgAraNyaM cha bhUmipa
khyAtaM cha saindhavAraNyaM puNyaM dvijaniShevitam
shlokas.13:
pitAmahasaraH puNyaM puShkaraM nAma bhArata |
vaikhAnasAnAM siddhAnAmRRiShINAmAshramaH priyaH
shlokas.14:
apyatra sa.nstavArthAya prajApatiratho jagau |
puShkareShu kurushreShTha gAthAM sukRRitinAM vara
shlokas.15:
manasApyabhikAmasya puShkarANi manasvinaH |
pApANi vipraNashyanti nAkapRRiShThe cha modate

shlokas.1:
dhaumya uvAcha||
udIchyAM rAjashArdUla dishi puNyAni yAni vai |
tAni te kIrtayiShyAmi puNyAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.2:
sarasvatI puNyavahA hradinI vanamAlinI |
samudragA mahAvegA yamunA yatra pANDava
shlokas.3:
tatra puNyatamaM tIrthaM plakShAvataraNaM shivam |
yatra sArasvatairiShTvA gachChantyavabhRRithaM dvijAH
shlokas.4:
puNyaM chAkhyAyate divyaM shivamagnishiro.anagha |
sahadevo.ayajadyatra shamyAkShepeNa bhArata
shlokas.5:
etasminneva chArtheyamindragItA yudhiShThira |
gAthA charati loke.asmingIyamAnA dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.6:
agnayaH sahadevena ye chitA yamunAmanu |
shataM shatasahasrANi sahasrashatadakShiNAH
shlokas.7:
tatraiva bharato rAjA chakravartI mahAyashAH |
vi.nshatiM sapta chAShTau cha hayamedhAnupAharat
shlokas.8:
kAmakRRidyo dvijAtInAM shrutastAta mayA purA |
atyantamAshramaH puNyaH sarakastasya vishrutaH
shlokas.9:
sarasvatI nadI sadbhiH satataM pArtha pUjitA |
vAlakhilyairmahArAja yatreShTamRRiShibhiH purA
shlokas.10:
dRRiShadvatI puNyatamA tatra khyAtA yudhiShThira |
tatra vaivarNyavarNau cha supuNyau manujAdhipa
shlokas.11:
vedaj~nau vedaviditau vidyAvedavidAvubhau |
yajantau kratubhirnityaM puNyairbharatasattama
shlokas.12:
sametya bahusho devAH sendrAH savaruNAH purA |
vishAkhayUpe.atapyanta tasmAtpuNyatamaH sa vai
shlokas.13:
RRiShirmahAnmahAbhAgo jamadagnirmahAyashAH |
palAshakeShu puNyeShu ramyeShvayajatAbhibhUH
shlokas.14:
yatra sarvAH sarichChreShThAH sAkShAttamRRiShisattamam |
svaM svaM toyamupAdAya parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.15:
api chAtra mahArAja svayaM vishvAvasurjagau |
imaM shlokaM tadA vIra prekShya vIryaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.16:
yajamAnasya vai devA~njamadagnermahAtmanaH |
Agamya saritaH sarvA madhunA samatarpayan
shlokas.17:
gandharvayakSharakShobhirapsarobhishcha shobhitam |
kirAtakiMnarAvAsaM shailaM shikhariNAM varam
shlokas.18:
bibheda tarasA ga~NgA ga~NgAdvAre yudhiShThira |
puNyaM tatkhyAyate rAjanbrahmarShigaNasevitam
shlokas.19:
sanatkumAraH kauravya puNyaM kanakhalaM tathA |
parvatashcha pururnAma yatra jAtaH purUravAH
shlokas.20:
bhRRiguryatra tapastepe maharShigaNasevitaH |
sa rAjannAshramaH khyAto bhRRigutu~Ngo mahAgiriH
shlokas.21:
yachcha bhUtaM bhaviShyachcha bhavachcha puruSharShabha |
nArAyaNaH prabhurviShNuH shAshvataH puruShottamaH
shlokas.22:
tasyAtiyashasaH puNyAM vishAlAM badarImanu |
AshramaH khyAyate puNyastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH
shlokas.23:
uShNatoyavahA ga~Nga shItatoyavahAparA |
suvarNasikatA rAjanvishAlAM badarImanu
shlokas.24:
RRiShayo yatra devAshcha mahAbhAgA mahaujasaH |
prApya nityaM namasyanti devaM nArAyaNaM vibhum
shlokas.25:
yatra nArAyaNo devaH paramAtmA sanAtanaH |
tatra kRRitsnaM jagatpArtha tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.26:
tatpuNyaM tatparaM brahma tattIrthaM tattapovanam |
tatra devarShayaH siddhAH sarve chaiva tapodhanAH
shlokas.27:
Adidevo mahAyogI yatrAste madhusUdanaH |
puNyAnAmapi tatpuNyaM tatra te sa.nshayo.astu mA
shlokas.28:
etAni rAjanpuNyAni pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpate |
kIrtitAni narashreShTha tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.29:
etAni vasubhiH sAdhyairAdityairmarudashvibhiH |
RRiShibhirbrahmakalpaishcha sevitAni mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.30:
charanetAni kaunteya sahito brAhmaNarShabhaiH |
bhrAtRRibhishcha mahAbhAgairutkaNThAM vijahiShyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sambhAShamANe tu dhaumye kauravanandana |
lomashaH sumahAtejA RRiShistatrAjagAma ha
shlokas.2:
taM pANDavAgrajo rAjA sagaNo brAhmaNAshcha te |
udatiShThanmahAbhAgaM divi shakramivAmarAH
shlokas.3:
tamabhyarchya yathAnyAyaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
paprachChAgamane hetumaTane cha prayojanam
shlokas.4:
sa pRRiShTaH pANDuputreNa prIyamANo mahAmanAH |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA harShayanniva pANDavAn
shlokas.5:
sa~ncharannasmi kaunteya sarvalokAnyadRRichChayA |
gataH shakrasya sadanaM tatrApashyaM sureshvaram
shlokas.6:
tava cha bhrAtaraM vIramapashyaM savyasAchinam |
shakrasyArdhAsanagataM tatra me vismayo mahAn
AsItpuruShashArdUla dRRiShTvA pArthaM tathAgatam
shlokas.7:
Aha mAM tatra devesho gachCha pANDusutAniti |
so.ahamabhyAgataH kShipraM didRRikShustvAM sahAnujam
shlokas.8:
vachanAtpuruhUtasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH |
AkhyAsye te priyaM tAta mahatpANDavanandana
shlokas.9:
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito rAjankRRiShNayA chaiva tachChRRiNu |
yattvayokto mahAbAhurastrArthaM pANDavarShabha
shlokas.10:
tadastramAptaM pArthena rudrAdapratimaM mahat |
yattadbrahmashiro nAma tapasA rudramAgatam
shlokas.11:
amRRitAdutthitaM raudraM tallabdhaM savyasAchinA |
tatsamantraM sasaMhAraM saprAyashchittama~Ngalam
shlokas.12:
vajraM chAnyAni chAstrANi daNDAdIni yudhiShThira |
yamAtkuberAdvaruNAdindrAchcha kurunandana
astrANyadhItavAnpArtho divyAnyamitavikramaH
shlokas.13:
vishvAvasoshcha tanayAdgItaM nRRittaM cha sAma cha |
vAditraM cha yathAnyAyaM pratyavindadyathAvidhi
shlokas.14:
evaM kRRitAstraH kaunteyo gAndharvaM vedamAptavAn |
sukhaM vasati bIbhatsuranujasyAnujastava
shlokas.15:
yadarthaM mAM surashreShTha idaM vachanamabravIt |
tachcha te kathayiShyAmi yudhiShThira nibodha me
shlokas.16:
bhavAnmanuShyalokAya gamiShyati na sa.nshayaH |
brUyAdyudhiShThiraM tatra vachanAnme dvijottama
shlokas.17:
AgamiShyati te bhrAtA kRRitAstraH kShipramarjunaH |
surakAryaM mahatkRRitvA yadAshakyaM divaukasaiH
shlokas.18:
tapasA tu tvamAtmAnaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha yojaya |
tapaso hi paraM nAsti tapasA vindate mahat
shlokas.19:
ahaM cha karNaM jAnAmi yathAvadbharatarShabha |
na sa pArthasya sa~NgrAme kalAmarhati ShoDashIm
shlokas.20:
yachchApi te bhayaM tasmAnmanasisthamari.ndama |
tachchApyapahariShyAmi savyasAchAvihAgate
shlokas.21:
yachcha te mAnasaM vIra tIrthayAtrAmimAM prati |
tachcha te lomashaH sarvaM kathayiShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.22:
yachcha ki~nchittapoyuktaM phalaM tIrtheShu bhArata |
maharShireSha yadbrUyAttachChraddheyamananyathA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
dhana~njayena chApyuktaM yattachChRRiNu yudhiShThira |
yudhiShThiraM bhrAtaraM me yojayerdharmyayA shriyA
shlokas.2:
tvaM hi dharmAnparAnvettha tapA.nsi cha tapodhana |
shrImatAM chApi jAnAsi rAj~nAM dharmaM sanAtanam
shlokas.3:
sa bhavAnyatparaM veda pAvanaM puruShAnprati |
tena sa.nyojayethAstvaM tIrthapuNyena pANDavam
shlokas.4:
yathA tIrthAni gachCheta gAshcha dadyAtsa pArthivaH |
tathA sarvAtmanA kAryamiti mAM vijayo.abravIt
shlokas.5:
bhavatA chAnugupto.asau charettIrthAni sarvashaH |
rakShobhyo rakShitavyashcha durgeShu viShameShu cha
shlokas.6:
dadhIcha iva devendraM yathA chApya~NgirA ravim |
tathA rakShasva kaunteyaM rAkShasebhyo dvijottama
shlokas.7:
yAtudhAnA hi bahavo rAkShasAH parvatopamAH |
tvayAbhiguptAnkaunteyAnnAtivarteyurantikAt
shlokas.8:
so.ahamindrasya vachanAnniyogAdarjunasya cha |
rakShamANo bhayebhyastvAM chariShyAmi tvayA saha
shlokas.9:
dvistIrthAni mayA pUrvaM dRRiShTAni kurunandana |
idaM tRRitIyaM drakShyAmi tAnyeva bhavatA saha
shlokas.10:
iyaM rAjarShibhiryAtA puNyakRRidbhiryudhiShThira |
manvAdibhirmahArAja tIrthayAtrA bhayApahA
shlokas.11:
nAnRRijurnAkRRitAtmA cha nAvaidyo na cha pApakRRit |
snAti tIrtheShu kauravya na cha vakramatirnaraH
shlokas.12:
tvaM tu dharmamatirnityaM dharmaj~naH satyasa~NgaraH |
vimuktaH sarvapApebhyo bhUya eva bhaviShyasi
shlokas.13:
yathA bhagIratho rAjA rAjAnashcha gayAdayaH |
yathA yayAtiH kaunteya tathA tvamapi pANDava
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na harShAtsamprapashyAmi vAkyasyAsyottaraM kvachit |
smareddhi devarAjo yaM kiM nAmAbhyadhikaM tataH
shlokas.15:
bhavatA sa~Ngamo yasya bhrAtA yasya dhana~njayaH |
vAsavaH smarate yasya ko nAmAbhyadhikastataH
shlokas.16:
yachcha mAM bhagavAnAha tIrthAnAM darshanaM prati |
dhaumyasya vachanAdeShA buddhiH pUrvaM kRRitaiva me
shlokas.17:
tadyadA manyase brahmangamanaM tIrthadarshane |
tadaiva gantAsmi dRRiDhameSha me nishchayaH paraH
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gamane kRRitabuddhiM taM pANDavaM lomasho.abravIt |
laghurbhava mahArAja laghuH svairaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bikShAbhujo nivartantAM brAhmaNA yatayashcha ye |
ye chApyanugatAH paurA rAjabhaktipuraskRRitAH
shlokas.20:
dhRRitarAShTraM mahArAjamabhigachChantu chaiva te |
sa dAsyati yathAkAlamuchitA yasya yA bhRRitiH
shlokas.21:
sa chedyathochitAM vRRittiM na dadyAnmanujeshvaraH |
asmatpriyahitArthAya pA~nchAlyo vaH pradAsyati
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato bhUyiShThashaH paurA gurubhArasamAhitAH |
viprAshcha yatayo yuktA jagmurnAgapuraM prati
shlokas.23:
tAnsarvAndharmarAjasya premNA rAjAmbikAsutaH |
pratijagrAha vidhivaddhanaishcha samatarpayat
shlokas.24:
tataH kuntIsuto rAjA laghubhirbrAhmaNaiH saha |
lomashena cha suprItastrirAtraM kAmyake.avasat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prayAntaM kaunteyaM brAhmaNA vanavAsinaH |
abhigamya tadA rAjannidaM vachanamabruvan
shlokas.2:
rAja.nstIrthAni gantAsi puNyAni bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
devarShiNA cha sahito lomashena mahAtmanA
shlokas.3:
asmAnapi mahArAja netumarhasi pANDava |
asmAbhirhi na shakyAni tvadRRite tAni kaurava
shlokas.4:
shvApadairupasRRiShTAni durgANi viShamANi cha |
agamyAni narairalpaistIrthAni manujeshvara
shlokas.5:
bhavanto bhrAtaraH shUrA dhanurdharavarAH sadA |
bhavadbhiH pAlitAH shUrairgachChema vayamapyuta
shlokas.6:
bhavatprasAdAddhi vayaM prApnuyAma phalaM shubham |
tIrthAnAM pRRithivIpAla vratAnAM cha vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
tava vIryaparitrAtAH shuddhAstIrthapariplutAH |
bhavema dhUtapApmAnastIrthasa.ndarshanAnnRRipa
shlokas.8:
bhavAnapi narendrasya kArtavIryasya bhArata |
aShTakasya cha rAjarSherlomapAdasya chaiva ha
shlokas.9:
bharatasya cha vIrasya sArvabhaumasya pArthiva |
dhruvaM prApsyasi duShprApA.NllokA.nstIrthapariplutaH
shlokas.10:
prabhAsAdIni tIrthAni mahendrAdI.nshcha parvatAn |
ga~NgAdyAH saritashchaiva plakShAdI.nshcha vanaspatIn
tvayA saha mahIpAla draShTumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.11:
yadi te brAhmaNeShvasti kAchitprItirjanAdhipa |
kuru kShipraM vacho.asmAkaM tataH shreyo.abhipatsyase
shlokas.12:
tIrthAni hi mahAbAho tapovighnakaraiH sadA |
anukIrNAni rakShobhistebhyo nastrAtumarhasi
shlokas.13:
tIrthAnyuktAni dhaumyena nAradena cha dhImatA |
yAnyuvAcha cha devarShirlomashaH sumahAtapAH
shlokas.14:
vidhivattAni sarvANi paryaTasva narAdhipa |
dhUtapApmA sahAsmAbhirlomashena cha pAlitaH
shlokas.15:
sa tathA pUjyamAnastairharShAdashrupariplutaH |
bhImasenAdibhirvIrairbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
bADhamityabravItsarvA.nstAnRRiShInpANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.16:
lomashaM samanuj~nApya dhaumyaM chaiva purohitam |
tataH sa pANDavashreShTho bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vashI
draupadyA chAnavadyA~NgyA gamanAya mano dadhe
shlokas.17:
atha vyAso mahAbhAgastathA nAradaparvatau |
kAmyake pANDavaM draShTuM samAjagmurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.18:
teShAM yudhiShThiro rAjA pUjAM chakre yathAvidhi |
satkRRitAste mahAbhAgA yudhiShThiramathAbruvan
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira yamau bhIma manasA kurutArjavam |
manasA kRRitashauchA vai shuddhAstIrthAni gachChata
shlokas.20:
sharIraniyamaM hyAhurbrAhmaNA mAnuShaM vratam |
manovishuddhAM buddhiM cha daivamAhurvrataM dvijAH
shlokas.21:
mano hyaduShTaM shUrANAM paryAptaM vai narAdhipa |
maitrIM buddhiM samAsthAya shuddhAstIrthAni gachChata
shlokas.22:
te yUyaM mAnasaiH shuddhAH sharIraniyamavrataiH |
daivaM vrataM samAsthAya yathoktaM phalamApsyatha
shlokas.23:
te tatheti pratij~nAya kRRiShNayA saha pANDavAH |
kRRitasvastyayanAH sarve munibhirdivyamAnuShaiH
shlokas.24:
lomashasyopasa~NgRRihya pAdau dvaipAyanasya cha |
nAradasya cha rAjendra devarSheH parvatasya cha
shlokas.25:
dhaumyena sahitA vIrAstathAnyairvanavAsibhiH |
mArgashIrShyAmatItAyAM puShyeNa prayayustataH
shlokas.26:
kaThinAni samAdAya chIrAjinajaTAdharAH |
abhedyaiH kavachairyuktAstIrthAnyanvachara.nstadA
shlokas.27:
indrasenAdibhirbhRRityai rathaiH parichaturdashaiH |
mahAnasavyApRRitaishcha tathAnyaiH parichArakaiH
shlokas.28:
sAyudhA baddhaniShTri.nshAstUNavantaH samArgaNAH |
prA~NmukhAH prayayurvIrAH pANDavA janamejaya

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na vai nirguNamAtmAnaM manye devarShisattama |
tathAsmi duHkhasantapto yathA nAnyo mahIpatiH
shlokas.2:
parA.nshcha nirguNAnmanye na cha dharmaratAnapi |
te cha lomasha loke.asminnRRidhyante kena ketunA
shlokas.3:
lomasha uvAcha||
nAtra duHkhaM tvayA rAjankAryaM pArtha katha~nchana |
yadadharmeNa vardherannadharmaruchayo janAH
shlokas.4:
vardhatyadharmeNa narastato bhadrANi pashyati |
tataH sapatnA~njayati samUlastu vinashyati
shlokas.5:
mayA hi dRRiShTA daiteyA dAnavAshcha mahIpate |
vardhamAnA hyadharmeNa kShayaM chopagatAH punaH
shlokas.6:
purA devayuge chaiva dRRiShTaM sarvaM mayA vibho |
arochayansurA dharmaM dharmaM tatyajire.asurAH
shlokas.7:
tIrthAni devA vivishurnAvishanbhAratAsurAH |
tAnadharmakRRito darpaH pUrvameva samAvishat
shlokas.8:
darpAnmAnaH samabhavanmAnAtkrodho vyajAyata |
krodhAdahrIstato.alajjA vRRittaM teShAM tato.anashat
shlokas.9:
tAnalajjAngatahrIkAnhInavRRittAnvRRithAvratAn |
kShamA lakShmIshcha dharmashcha nachirAtprajahustataH
lakShmIstu devAnagamadalakShmIrasurAnnRRipa
shlokas.10:
tAnalakShmIsamAviShTAndarpopahatachetasaH |
daiteyAndAnavA.nshchaiva kalirapyAvishattataH
shlokas.11:
tAnalakShmIsamAviShTAndAnavAnkalinA tathA |
darpAbhibhUtAnkaunteya kriyAhInAnachetasaH
shlokas.12:
mAnAbhibhUtAnachirAdvinAshaH pratyapadyata |
niryashasyAstato daityAH kRRitsnasho vilayaM gatAH
shlokas.13:
devAstu sAgarA.nshchaiva saritashcha sarA.nsi cha |
abhyagachChandharmashIlAH puNyAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.14:
tapobhiH kratubhirdAnairAshIrvAdaishcha pANDava |
prajahuH sarvapApAni shreyashcha pratipedire
shlokas.15:
evaM hi dAnavantashcha kriyAvantashcha sarvashaH |
tIrthAnyagachChanvibudhAstenApurbhUtimuttamAm
shlokas.16:
tathA tvamapi rAjendra snAtvA tIrtheShu sAnujaH |
punarvetsyasi tAM lakShmImeSha panthAH sanAtanaH
shlokas.17:
yathaiva hi nRRigo rAjA shibiraushInaro yathA |
bhagIratho vasumanA gayaH pUruH purUravAH
shlokas.18:
charamANAstapo nityaM sparshanAdambhasashcha te |
tIrthAbhigamanAtpUtA darshanAchcha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.19:
alabhanta yashaH puNyaM dhanAni cha vishAM pate |
tathA tvamapi rAjendra labdhAsi vipulAM shriyam
shlokas.20:
yathA chekShvAkuracharatsaputrajanabAndhavaH |
muchukundo.atha mAndhAtA maruttashcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.21:
kIrtiM puNyAmavindanta yathA devAstapobalAt |
devarShayashcha kArtsnyena tathA tvamapi vetsyase
shlokas.22:
dhArtarAShTrAstu darpeNa mohena cha vashIkRRitAH |
nachirAdvinashiShyanti daityA iva na sa.nshayaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te tathA sahitA vIrA vasantastatra tatra ha |
krameNa pRRithivIpAla naimiShAraNyamAgatAH
shlokas.2:
tatastIrtheShu puNyeShu gomatyAH pANDavA nRRipa |
kRRitAbhiShekAH pradadurgAshcha vittaM cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
tatra devAnpitR^InviprA.nstarpayitvA punaH punaH |
kanyAtIrthe.ashvatIrthe cha gavAM tIrthe cha kauravAH
shlokas.4:
vAlakoTyAM vRRiShaprasthe girAvuShya cha pANDavAH |
bAhudAyAM mahIpAla chakruH sarve.abhiShechanam
shlokas.5:
prayAge devayajane devAnAM pRRithivIpate |
UShurAplutya gAtrANi tapashchAtasthuruttamam
shlokas.6:
ga~NgAyamunayoshchaiva sa~Ngame satyasa~NgarAH |
vipApmAno mahAtmAno viprebhyaH pradadurvasu
shlokas.7:
tapasvijanajuShTAM cha tato vedIM prajApateH |
jagmuH pANDusutA rAjanbrAhmaNaiH saha bhArata
shlokas.8:
tatra te nyavasanvIrAstapashchAtasthuruttamam |
santarpayantaH satataM vanyena haviShA dvijAn
shlokas.9:
tato mahIdharaM jagmurdharmaj~nenAbhisatkRRitam |
rAjarShiNA puNyakRRitA gayenAnupamadyute
shlokas.10:
saro gayashiro yatra puNyA chaiva mahAnadI |
RRiShijuShTaM supuNyaM tattIrthaM brahmasarottamam
shlokas.11:
agastyo bhagavAnyatra gato vaivasvataM prati |
uvAsa cha svayaM yatra dharmo rAjansanAtanaH
shlokas.12:
sarvAsAM saritAM chaiva samudbhedo vishAM pate |
yatra saMnihito nityaM mahAdevaH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.13:
tatra te pANDavA vIrAshchAturmAsyaistadejire |
RRiShiyaj~nena mahatA yatrAkShayavaTo mahAn
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNAstatra shatashaH samAjagmustapodhanAH |
chAturmAsyenAyajanta ArSheNa vidhinA tadA
shlokas.15:
tatra vidyAtaponityA brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
kathAH prachakrire puNyAH sadasisthA mahAtmanAm
shlokas.16:
tatra vidyAvratasnAtaH kaumAraM vratamAsthitaH |
shamaTho.akathayadrAjannAmUrtarayasaM gayam
shlokas.17:
amUrtarayasaH putro gayo rAjarShisattamaH |
puNyAni yasya karmANi tAni me shRRiNu bhArata
shlokas.18:
yasya yaj~no babhUveha bahvanno bahudakShiNaH |
yatrAnnaparvatA rAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
ghRRitakulyAshcha dadhnashcha nadyo bahushatAstathA |
vya~njanAnAM pravAhAshcha mahArhANAM sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
ahanyahani chApyetadyAchatAM sampradIyate |
anyattu brAhmaNA rAjanbhu~njate.annaM susa.nskRRitam
shlokas.21:
tatra vai dakShiNAkAle brahmaghoSho divaM gataH |
na sma praj~nAyate ki~nchidbrahmashabdena bhArata
shlokas.22:
puNyena charatA rAjanbhUrdishaH khaM nabhastathA |
ApUrNamAsIchChabdena tadapyAsInmahAdbhutam
shlokas.23:
tatra sma gAthA gAyanti manuShyA bharatarShabha |
annapAnaiH shubhaistRRiptA deshe deshe suvarchasaH
shlokas.24:
gayasya yaj~ne ke tvadya prANino bhoktumIpsavaH |
yatra bhojanashiShTasya parvatAH pa~nchavi.nshatiH
shlokas.25:
na sma pUrve janAshchakrurna kariShyanti chApare |
gayo yadakarodyaj~ne rAjarShiramitadyutiH
shlokas.26:
kathaM nu devA haviShA gayena paritarpitAH |
punaH shakShyantyupAdAtumanyairdattAni kAnichit
shlokas.27:
eva.nvidhAH subahavastasya yaj~ne mahAtmanaH |
babhUvurasya sarasaH samIpe kurunandana

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH samprasthito rAjA kaunteyo bhUridakShiNaH |
agastyAshramamAsAdya durjayAyAmuvAsa ha
shlokas.2:
tatra vai lomashaM rAjA paprachCha vadatAM varaH |
agastyeneha vAtApiH kimarthamupashAmitaH
shlokas.3:
AsIdvA kimprabhAvashcha sa daityo mAnavAntakaH |
kimarthaM chodgato manyuragastyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
lomasha uvAcha||
ilvalo nAma daiteya AsItkauravanandana |
maNimatyAM puri purA vAtApistasya chAnujaH
shlokas.5:
sa brAhmaNaM tapoyuktamuvAcha ditinandanaH |
putraM me bhagavAnekamindratulyaM prayachChatu
shlokas.6:
tasmai sa brAhmaNo nAdAtputraM vAsavasaMmitam |
chukrodha so.asurastasya brAhmaNasya tato bhRRisham
shlokas.7:
samAhvayati yaM vAchA gataM vaivasvatakShayam |
sa punardehamAsthAya jIvansma pratidRRishyate
shlokas.8:
tato vAtApimasuraM ChAgaM kRRitvA susa.nskRRitam |
taM brAhmaNaM bhojayitvA punareva samAhvayat
shlokas.9:
tasya pArshvaM vinirbhidya brAhmaNasya mahAsuraH |
vAtApiH prahasanrAjannishchakrAma vishAM pate
shlokas.10:
evaM sa brAhmaNAnrAjanbhojayitvA punaH punaH |
hi.nsayAmAsa daiteya ilvalo duShTachetanaH
shlokas.11:
agastyashchApi bhagavAnetasminkAla eva tu |
pitR^Indadarsha garte vai lambamAnAnadhomukhAn
shlokas.12:
so.apRRichChallambamAnA.nstAnbhavanta iha kimparAH |
