santAnahetoriti te tamUchurbrahmavAdinaH
shlokas.13:
te tasmai kathayAmAsurvayaM te pitaraH svakAH |
gartametamanuprAptA lambAmaH prasavArthinaH
shlokas.14:
yadi no janayethAstvamagastyApatyamuttamam |
syAnno.asmAnnirayAnmokShastvaM cha putrApnuyA gatim
shlokas.15:
sa tAnuvAcha tejasvI satyadharmaparAyaNaH |
kariShye pitaraH kAmaM vyetu vo mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.16:
tataH prasavasantAnaM chintayanbhagavAnRRiShiH |
AtmanaH prasavasyArthe nApashyatsadRRishIM striyam
shlokas.17:
sa tasya tasya sattvasya tattada~Ngamanuttamam |
sambhRRitya tatsamaira~Ngairnirmame striyamuttamAm
shlokas.18:
sa tAM vidarbharAjAya putrakAmAya tAmyate |
nirmitAmAtmano.arthAya muniH prAdAnmahAtapAH
shlokas.19:
sA tatra jaj~ne subhagA vidyutsaudAminI yathA |
vibhrAjamAnA vapusA vyavardhata shubhAnanA
shlokas.20:
jAtamAtrAM cha tAM dRRiShTvA vaidarbhaH pRRithivIpatiH |
praharSheNa dvijAtibhyo nyavedayata bhArata
shlokas.21:
abhyanandanta tAM sarve brAhmaNA vasudhAdhipa |
lopAmudreti tasyAshcha chakrire nAma te dvijAH
shlokas.22:
vavRRidhe sA mahArAja bibhratI rUpamuttamam |
apsvivotpalinI shIghramagneriva shikhA shubhA
shlokas.23:
tAM yauvanasthAM rAjendra shataM kanyAH svala~NkRRitAH |
dAshIshataM cha kalyANImupatasthurvashAnugAH
shlokas.24:
sA sma dAsIshatavRRitA madhye kanyAshatasya cha |
Aste tejasvinI kanyA rohiNIva divi prabho
shlokas.25:
yauvanasthAmapi cha tAM shIlAchArasamanvitAm |
na vavre puruShaH kashchidbhayAttasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.26:
sA tu satyavatI kanyA rUpeNApsaraso.apyati |
toShayAmAsa pitaraM shIlena svajanaM tathA
shlokas.27:
vaidarbhIM tu tathAyuktAM yuvatIM prekShya vai pitA |
manasA chintayAmAsa kasmai dadyAM sutAmiti

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
yadA tvamanyatAgastyo gArhasthye tAM kShamAmiti |
tadAbhigamya provAcha vaidarbhaM pRRithivIpatim
shlokas.2:
rAjanniveshe buddhirme vartate putrakAraNAt |
varaye tvAM mahIpAla lopAmudrAM prayachCha me
shlokas.3:
evamuktaH sa muninA mahIpAlo vichetanaH |
pratyAkhyAnAya chAshaktaH pradAtumapi naichChata
shlokas.4:
tataH sa bhAryAmabhyetya provAcha pRRithivIpatiH |
maharShirvIryavAneSha kruddhaH shApAgninA dahet
shlokas.5:
taM tathA duHkhitaM dRRiShTvA sabhAryaM pRRithivIpatim |
lopAmudrAbhigamyedaM kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
na matkRRite mahIpAla pIDAmabhyetumarhasi |
prayachCha mAmagastyAya trAhyAtmAnaM mayA pitaH
shlokas.7:
duhiturvachanAdrAjA so.agastyAya mahAtmane |
lopAmudrAM tataH prAdAdvidhipUrvaM vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
prApya bhAryAmagastyastu lopAmudrAmabhAShata |
mahArhANyutsRRijaitAni vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.9:
tataH sA darshanIyAni mahArhANi tanUni cha |
samutsasarja rambhorUrvasanAnyAyatekShaNA
shlokas.10:
tatashchIrANi jagrAha valkalAnyajinAni cha |
samAnavratacharyA cha babhUvAyatalochanA
shlokas.11:
ga~NgAdvAramathAgamya bhagavAnRRiShisattamaH |
ugramAtiShThata tapaH saha patnyAnukUlayA
shlokas.12:
sA prItyA bahumAnAchcha patiM paryacharattadA |
agastyashcha parAM prItiM bhAryAyAmakarotprabhuH
shlokas.13:
tato bahutithe kAle lopAmudrAM vishAM pate |
tapasA dyotitAM snAtAM dadarsha bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.14:
sa tasyAH parichAreNa shauchena cha damena cha |
shriyA rUpeNa cha prIto maithunAyAjuhAva tAm
shlokas.15:
tataH sA prA~njalirbhUtvA lajjamAneva bhAminI |
tadA sapraNayaM vAkyaM bhagavantamathAbravIt
shlokas.16:
asa.nshayaM prajAhetorbhAryAM patiravindata |
yA tu tvayi mama prItistAmRRiShe kartumarhasi
shlokas.17:
yathA piturgRRihe vipra prAsAde shayanaM mama |
tathAvidhe tvaM shayane mAmupaitumihArhasi
shlokas.18:
ichChAmi tvAM sragviNaM cha bhUShaNaishcha vibhUShitam |
upasartuM yathAkAmaM divyAbharaNabhUShitA
shlokas.19:
agastya uvAcha||
na vai dhanAni vidyante lopAmudre tathA mama |
yathAvidhAni kalyANi pitustava sumadhyame
shlokas.20:
lopAmudrovAcha||
Isho.asi tapasA sarvaM samAhartumiheshvara |
kShaNena jIvaloke yadvasu ki~nchana vidyate
shlokas.21:
agastya uvAcha||
evametadyathAttha tvaM tapovyayakaraM tu me |
yathA tu me na nashyeta tapastanmAM prachodaya
shlokas.22:
lopAmudrovAcha||
alpAvashiShTaH kAlo.ayamRRitau mama tapodhana |
na chAnyathAhamichChAmi tvAmupaituM katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
na chApi dharmamichChAmi viloptuM te tapodhana |
etattu me yathAkAmaM sampAdayitumarhasi
shlokas.24:
agastya uvAcha||
yadyeSha kAmaH subhage tava buddhyA vinishchitaH |
hanta gachChAmyahaM bhadre chara kAmamiha sthitA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
tato jagAma kauravya so.agastyo bhikShituM vasu |
shrutarvANaM mahIpAlaM yaM vedAbhyadhikaM nRRipaiH
shlokas.2:
sa viditvA tu nRRipatiH kumbhayonimupAgamat |
viShayAnte sahAmAtyaH pratyagRRihNAtsusatkRRitam
shlokas.3:
tasmai chArghyaM yathAnyAyamAnIya pRRithivIpatiH |
prA~njaliH prayato bhUtvA paprachChAgamane.arthitAm
shlokas.4:
agastya uvAcha||
vittArthinamanuprAptaM viddhi mAM pRRithivIpate |
yathAshaktyavihi.nsyAnyAnsa.nvibhAgaM prayachCha me
shlokas.5:
lomasha uvAcha||
tata Ayavyayau pUrNau tasmai rAjA nyavedayat |
ato vidvannupAdatsva yadatra vasu manyase
shlokas.6:
tata Ayavyayau dRRiShTvA samau samamatirdvijaH |
sarvathA prANinAM pIDAmupAdAnAdamanyata
shlokas.7:
sa shrutarvANamAdAya vadhryashvamagamattataH |
sa cha tau viShayasyAnte pratyagRRihNAdyathAvidhi
shlokas.8:
tayorarghyaM cha pAdyaM cha vadhryashvaH pratyavedayat |
anuj~nApya cha paprachCha prayojanamupakrame
shlokas.9:
agastya uvAcha||
vittakAmAviha prAptau viddhyAvAM pRRithivIpate |
yathAshaktyavihi.nsyAnyAnsa.nvibhAgaM prayachCha nau
shlokas.10:
lomasha uvAcha||
tata Ayavyayau pUrNau tAbhyAM rAjA nyavedayat |
tato j~nAtvA samAdattAM yadatra vyatirichyate
shlokas.11:
tata Ayavyayau dRRiShTvA samau samamatirdvijaH |
sarvathA prANinAM pIDAmupAdAnAdamanyata
shlokas.12:
paurukutsaM tato jagmustrasadasyuM mahAdhanam |
agastyashcha shrutarvA cha vadhryashvashcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
trasadasyushcha tAnsarvAnpratyagRRihNAdyathAvidhi |
abhigamya mahArAja viShayAnte savAhanaH
shlokas.14:
archayitvA yathAnyAyamikShvAkU rAjasattamaH |
samAshvastA.nstato.apRRichChatprayojanamupakrame
shlokas.15:
agastya uvAcha||
vittakAmAniha prAptAnviddhi naH pRRithivIpate |
yathAshaktyavihi.nsyAnyAnsa.nvibhAgaM prayachCha naH
shlokas.16:
lomasha uvAcha||
tata Ayavyayau pUrNau teShAM rAjA nyavedayat |
ato j~nAtvA samAdaddhvaM yadatra vyatirichyate
shlokas.17:
tata Ayavyayau dRRiShTvA samau samamatirdvijaH |
sarvathA prANinAM pIDAmupAdAnAdamanyata
shlokas.18:
tataH sarve sametyAtha te nRRipAstaM mahAmunim |
idamUchurmahArAja samavekShya parasparam
shlokas.19:
ayaM vai dAnavo brahmannilvalo vasumAnbhuvi |
tamabhikramya sarve.adya vayaM yAchAmahe vasu
shlokas.20:
teShAM tadAsIdruchitamilvalasyopabhikShaNam |
tataste sahitA rAjannilvalaM samupAdravan

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
ilvalastAnviditvA tu maharShisahitAnnRRipAn |
upasthitAnsahAmAtyo viShayAnte.abhyapUjayat
shlokas.2:
teShAM tato.asurashreShTha AtithyamakarottadA |
sa sa.nskRRitena kauravya bhrAtrA vAtApinA kila
shlokas.3:
tato rAjarShayaH sarve viShaNNA gatachetasaH |
vAtApiM sa.nskRRitaM dRRiShTvA meShabhUtaM mahAsuram
shlokas.4:
athAbravIdagastyastAnrAjarShInRRiShisattamaH |
viShAdo vo na kartavyo ahaM bhokShye mahAsuram
shlokas.5:
dhuryAsanamathAsAdya niShasAda mahAmuniH |
taM paryaveShaddaityendra ilvalaH prahasanniva
shlokas.6:
agastya eva kRRitsnaM tu vAtApiM bubhuje tataH |
bhuktavatyasuro.a.ahvAnamakarottasya ilvalaH
shlokas.7:
tato vAyuH prAdurabhUdagastyasya mahAtmanaH |
ilvalashcha viShaNNo.abhUddRRiShTvA jIrNaM mahAsuram
shlokas.8:
prA~njalishcha sahAmAtyairidaM vachanamabravIt |
kimarthamupayAtAH stha brUta kiM karavANi vaH
shlokas.9:
pratyuvAcha tato.agastyaH prahasannilvalaM tadA |
IshaM hyasura vidmastvAM vayaM sarve dhaneshvaram
shlokas.10:
ime cha nAtidhanino dhanArthashcha mahAnmama |
yathAshaktyavihi.nsyAnyAnsa.nvibhAgaM prayachCha naH
shlokas.11:
tato.abhivAdya tamRRiShimilvalo vAkyamabravIt |
ditsitaM yadi vetsi tvaM tato dAsyAmi te vasu
shlokas.12:
agastya uvAcha||
gavAM dasha sahasrANi rAj~nAmekaikasho.asura |
tAvadeva suvarNasya ditsitaM te mahAsura
shlokas.13:
mahyaM tato vai dviguNaM rathashchaiva hiraNmayaH |
manojavau vAjinau cha ditsitaM te mahAsura
jij~nAsyatAM rathaH sadyo vyaktameSha hiraNmayaH
shlokas.14:
lomasha uvAcha||
jij~nAsyamAnaH sa rathaH kaunteyAsIddhiraNmayaH |
tataH pravyathito daityo dadAvabhyadhikaM vasu
shlokas.15:
vivAjashcha suvAjashcha tasminyuktau rathe hayau |
Uhatustau vasUnyAshu tAnyagastyAshramaM prati
sarvAnrAj~naH sahAgastyAnnimeShAdiva bhArata
shlokas.16:
agastyenAbhyanuj~nAtA jagmU rAjarShayastadA |
kRRitavA.nshcha muniH sarvaM lopAmudrAchikIrShitam
shlokas.17:
lopAmudrovAcha||
kRRitavAnasi tatsarvaM bhagavanmama kA~NkShitam |
utpAdaya sakRRinmahyamapatyaM vIryavattaram
shlokas.18:
agastya uvAcha||
tuShTo.ahamasmi kalyANi tava vRRittena shobhane |
vichAraNAmapatye tu tava vakShyAmi tAM shRRiNu
shlokas.19:
sahasraM te.astu putrANAM shataM vA dashasaMmitam |
dasha vA shatatulyAH syureko vApi sahasravat
shlokas.20:
lopAmudrovAcha||
sahasrasaMmitaH putra eko me.astu tapodhana |
eko hi bahubhiH shreyAnvidvAnsAdhurasAdhubhiH
shlokas.21:
lomasha uvAcha||
sa tatheti pratij~nAya tayA samabhavanmuniH |
samaye samashIlinyA shraddhAvA~nshraddadhAnayA
shlokas.22:
tata AdhAya garbhaM tamagamadvanameva saH |
tasminvanagate garbho vavRRidhe sapta shAradAn
shlokas.23:
saptame.abde gate chApi prAchyavatsa mahAkaviH |
jvalanniva prabhAvena dRRiDhasyurnAma bhArata
sA~NgopaniShadAnvedA~njapanneva mahAyashAH
shlokas.24:
tasya putro.abhavadRRiSheH sa tejasvI mahAnRRiShiH |
sa bAla eva tejasvI pitustasya niveshane
idhmAnAM bhAramAjahre idhmavAhastato.abhavat
shlokas.25:
tathAyuktaM cha taM dRRiShTvA mumude sa munistadA |
lebhire pitarashchAsya lokAnrAjanyathepsitAn
shlokas.26:
agastyasyAshramaH khyAtaH sarvartukusumAnvitaH |
prAhrAdirevaM vAtApiragastyena vinAshitaH
shlokas.27:
tasyAyamAshramo rAjanramaNIyo guNairyutaH |
eShA bhAgIrathI puNyA yatheShTamavagAhyatAm

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhUya evAhamichChAmi maharShestasya dhImataH |
karmaNAM vistaraM shrotumagastyasya dvijottama
shlokas.2:
lomasha uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjankathAM divyAmadbhutAmatimAnuShIm |
agastyasya mahArAja prabhAvamamitAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
AsankRRitayuge ghorA dAnavA yuddhadurmadAH |
kAleyA iti vikhyAtA gaNAH paramadAruNAH
shlokas.4:
te tu vRRitraM samAshritya nAnApraharaNodyatAH |
samantAtparyadhAvanta mahendrapramukhAnsurAn
shlokas.5:
tato vRRitravadhe yatnamakurva.nstridashAH purA |
pura.ndaraM puraskRRitya brahmANamupatasthire
shlokas.6:
kRRitA~njalI.nstu tAnsarvAnparameShThI uvAcha ha |
viditaM me surAH sarvaM yadvaH kAryaM chikIrShitam
shlokas.7:
tamupAyaM pravakShyAmi yathA vRRitraM vadhiShyatha |
dadhIcha iti vikhyAto mahAnRRiShirudAradhIH
shlokas.8:
taM gatvA sahitAH sarve varaM vai samprayAchata |
sa vo dAsyati dharmAtmA suprItenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.9:
sa vAchyaH sahitaiH sarvairbhavadbhirjayakA~NkShibhiH |
svAnyasthIni prayachCheti trailokyasya hitAya vai
sa sharIraM samutsRRijya svAnyasthIni pradAsyati
shlokas.10:
tasyAsthibhirmahAghoraM vajraM sambhriyatAM dRRiDham |
mahachChatruhaNaM tIkShNaM ShaDashraM bhImanisvanam
shlokas.11:
tena vajreNa vai vRRitraM vadhiShyati shatakratuH |
etadvaH sarvamAkhyAtaM tasmAchChIghraM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.12:
evamuktAstato devA anuj~nApya pitAmaham |
nArAyaNaM puraskRRitya dadhIchasyAshramaM yayuH
shlokas.13:
sarasvatyAH pare pAre nAnAdrumalatAvRRitam |
ShaTpadodgItaninadairvighuShTaM sAmagairiva
pu.nskokilaravonmishraM jIva~njIvakanAditam
shlokas.14:
mahiShaishcha varAhaishcha sRRimaraishchamarairapi |
tatra tatrAnucharitaM shArdUlabhayavarjitaiH
shlokas.15:
kareNubhirvAraNaishcha prabhinnakaraTAmukhaiH |
saro.avagADhaiH krIDadbhiH samantAdanunAditam
shlokas.16:
siMhavyAghrairmahAnAdAnnadadbhiranunAditam |
aparaishchApi sa.nlInairguhAkandaravAsibhiH
shlokas.17:
teShu teShvavakAsheShu shobhitaM sumanoramam |
triviShTapasamaprakhyaM dadhIchAshramamAgaman
shlokas.18:
tatrApashyandadhIchaM te divAkarasamadyutim |
jAjvalyamAnaM vapuShA yathA lakShmyA pitAmaham
shlokas.19:
tasya pAdau surA rAjannabhivAdya praNamya cha |
ayAchanta varaM sarve yathoktaM parameShThinA
shlokas.20:
tato dadhIchaH paramapratItaH; surottamA.nstAnidamabhyuvAcha |
karomi yadvo hitamadya devAH; svaM chApi dehaM tvahamutsRRijAmi
shlokas.21:
sa evamuktvA dvipadAM variShThaH; prANAnvashI svAnsahasotsasarja |
tataH surAste jagRRihuH parAso;rasthIni tasyAtha yathopadesham
shlokas.22:
prahRRiShTarUpAshcha jayAya devA;stvaShTAramAgamya tamarthamUchuH |
tvaShTA tu teShAM vachanaM nishamya; prahRRiShTarUpaH prayataH prayatnAt
shlokas.23:
chakAra vajraM bhRRishamugrarUpaM; kRRitvA cha shakraM sa uvAcha hRRiShTaH |
anena vajrapravareNa deva; bhasmIkuruShvAdya surArimugram
shlokas.24:
tato hatAriH sagaNaH sukhaM vai; prashAdhi kRRitsnaM tridivaM diviShThaH |
tvaShTrA tathoktaH sa pura.ndarastu; vajraM prahRRiShTaH prayato.abhyagRRihNAt

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
tataH sa vajrI balibhirdaivatairabhirakShitaH |
AsasAda tato vRRitraM sthitamAvRRitya rodasI
shlokas.2:
kAlakeyairmahAkAyaiH samantAdabhirakShitam |
samudyatapraharaNaiH sashRRi~Ngairiva parvataiH
shlokas.3:
tato yuddhaM samabhavaddevAnAM saha dAnavaiH |
muhUrtaM bharatashreShTha lokatrAsakaraM mahat
shlokas.4:
udyatapratipiShTAnAM khaDgAnAM vIrabAhubhiH |
AsItsutumulaH shabdaH sharIreShvabhipAtyatAm
shlokas.5:
shirobhiH prapatadbhishcha antarikShAnmahItalam |
tAlairiva mahIpAla vRRintAdbhraShTairadRRishyata
shlokas.6:
te hemakavachA bhUtvA kAleyAH parighAyudhAH |
tridashAnabhyavartanta dAvadagdhA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.7:
teShAM vegavatAM vegaM sahitAnAM pradhAvatAm |
na shekustridashAH soDhuM te bhagnAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.8:
tAndRRiShTvA dravato bhItAnsahasrAkShaH pura.ndaraH |
vRRitre vivardhamAne cha kashmalaM mahadAvishat
shlokas.9:
taM shakraM kashmalAviShTaM dRRiShTvA viShNuH sanAtanaH |
svatejo vyadadhAchChakre balamasya vivardhayan
shlokas.10:
viShNunApyAyitaM shakraM dRRiShTvA devagaNAstataH |
svaM svaM tejaH samAdadhyustathA brahmarShayo.amalAH
shlokas.11:
sa samApyAyitaH shakro viShNunA daivataiH saha |
RRiShibhishcha mahAbhAgairbalavAnsamapadyata
shlokas.12:
j~nAtvA balasthaM tridashAdhipaM tu; nanAda vRRitro mahato ninAdAn |
tasya praNAdena dharA dishashcha; khaM dyaurnagAshchApi chachAla sarvam
shlokas.13:
tato mahendraH paramAbhitaptaH; shrutvA ravaM ghorarUpaM mahAntam |
bhaye nimagnastvaritaM mumocha; vajraM mahattasya vadhAya rAjan
shlokas.14:
sa shakravajrAbhihataH papAta; mahAsuraH kA~nchanamAlyadhArI |
yathA mahA~nshailavaraH purastA;tsa mandaro viShNukarAtpramuktaH
shlokas.15:
tasminhate daityavare bhayArtaH; shakraH padudrAva saraH praveShTum |
vajraM na mene svakarAtpramuktaM; vRRitraM hataM chApi bhayAnna mene
shlokas.16:
sarve cha devA muditAH prahRRiShTA; maharShayashchendramabhiShTuvantaH |
sarvA.nshcha daityA.nstvaritAH sametya; jaghnuH surA vRRitravadhAbhitaptAn
shlokas.17:
te vadhyamAnAstridashaistadAnIM; samudramevAvivishurbhayArtAH |
pravishya chaivodadhimaprameyaM; jhaShAkulaM ratnasamAkulaM cha
shlokas.18:
tadA sma mantraM sahitAH prachakru;strailokyanAshArthamabhismayantaH |
tatra sma kechinmatinishchayaj~nA;stA.nstAnupAyAnanuvarNayanti
shlokas.19:
teShAM tu tatra kramakAlayogA;dghorA matishchintayatAM babhUva |
ye santi vidyAtapasopapannA;steShAM vinAshaH prathamaM tu kAryaH
shlokas.20:
lokA hi sarve tapasA dhriyante; tasmAttvaradhvaM tapasaH kShayAya |
ye santi kechiddhi vasundharAyAM; tapasvino dharmavidashcha tajj~nAH
teShAM vadhaH kriyatAM kShiprameva; teShu pranaShTeShu jagatpranaShTam
shlokas.21:
evaM hi sarve gatabuddhibhAvA; jagadvinAshe paramaprahRRiShTAH |
durgaM samAshritya mahormimantaM; ratnAkaraM varuNasyAlayaM sma

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
samudraM te samAshritya vAruNaM nidhimambhasAm |
kAleyAH sampravartanta trailokyasya vinAshane
shlokas.2:
te rAtrau samabhikruddhA bhakShayanti sadA munIn |
AshrameShu cha ye santi punyeShvAyataneShu cha
shlokas.3:
vasiShThasyAshrame viprA bhakShitAstairdurAtmabhiH |
ashItishatamaShTau cha nava chAnye tapasvinaH
shlokas.4:
chyavanasyAshramaM gatvA puNyaM dvijaniShevitam |
phalamUlAshanAnAM hi munInAM bhakShitaM shatam
shlokas.5:
evaM rAtrau sma kurvanti vivishushchArNavaM divA |
bharadvAjAshrame chaiva niyatA brahmachAriNaH
vAyvAhArAmbubhakShAshcha vi.nshatiH saMnipAtitAH
shlokas.6:
evaM krameNa sarvA.nstAnAshramAndAnavAstadA |
nishAyAM paridhAvanti mattA bhujabalAshrayAt
kAlopasRRiShTAH kAleyA ghnanto dvijagaNAnbahUn
shlokas.7:
na chainAnanvabudhyanta manujA manujottama |
evaM pravRRittAndaityA.nstA.nstApaseShu tapasviShu
shlokas.8:
prabhAte samadRRishyanta niyatAhArakarshitAH |
mahItalasthA munayaH sharIrairgatajIvitaiH
shlokas.9:
kShINamA.nsairvirudhirairvimajjAntrairvisandhibhiH |
AkIrNairAchitA bhUmiH sha~NkhAnAmiva rAshibhiH
shlokas.10:
kalashairvipraviddhaishcha sruvairbhagnaistathaiva cha |
vikIrNairagnihotraishcha bhUrbabhUva samAvRRitA
shlokas.11:
niHsvAdhyAyavaShaTkAraM naShTayaj~notsavakriyam |
jagadAsInnirutsAhaM kAleyabhayapIDitam
shlokas.12:
evaM prakShIyamANAshcha mAnavA manujeshvara |
AtmatrANaparA bhItAH prAdravanta disho bhayAt
shlokas.13:
kechidguhAH pravivishurnirjharA.nshchApare shritAH |
apare maraNodvignA bhayAtprAnAnsamutsRRijan
shlokas.14:
kechidatra maheShvAsAH shUrAH paramadarpitAH |
mArgamANAH paraM yatnaM dAnavAnAM prachakrire
shlokas.15:
na chaitAnadhijagmuste samudraM samupAshritAn |
shramaM jagmushcha paramamAjagmuH kShayameva cha
shlokas.16:
jagatyupashamaM yAte naShTayaj~notsavakriye |
AjagmuH paramAmArtiM tridashA manujeshvara
shlokas.17:
sametya samahendrAshcha bhayAnmantraM prachakrire |
nArAyaNaM puraskRRitya vaikuNThamaparAjitam
shlokas.18:
tato devAH sametAste tadochurmadhusUdanam |
tvaM naH sraShTA cha pAtA cha bhartA cha jagataH prabho
tvayA sRRiShTamidaM sarvaM yachche~NgaM yachcha ne~Ngati
shlokas.19:
tvayA bhUmiH purA naShTA samudrAtpuShkarekShaNa |
vArAhaM rUpamAsthAya jagadarthe samuddhRRitA
shlokas.20:
Adidaityo mahAvIryo hiraNyakashipustvayA |
nArasiMhaM vapuH kRRitvA sUditaH puruShottama
shlokas.21:
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM balishchApi mahAsuraH |
vAmanaM vapurAshritya trailokyAdbhra.nshitastvayA
shlokas.22:
asurashcha maheShvAso jambha ityabhivishrutaH |
yaj~nakShobhakaraH krUrastvayaiva vinipAtitaH
shlokas.23:
evamAdIni karmANi yeShAM sa~NkhyA na vidyate |
asmAkaM bhayabhItAnAM tvaM gatirmadhusUdana
shlokas.24:
tasmAttvAM deva devesha lokArthaM j~nApayAmahe |
rakSha lokA.nshcha devA.nshcha shakraM cha mahato bhayAt

shlokas.1:
devA UchuH||
itaH pradAnAdvartante prajAH sarvAshchaturvidhAH |
tA bhAvitA bhAvayanti havyakavyairdivaukasaH
shlokas.2:
lokA hyevaM vartayanti anyonyaM samupAshritAH |
tvatprasAdAnnirudvignAstvayaiva parirakShitAH
shlokas.3:
idaM cha samanuprAptaM lokAnAM bhayamuttamam |
na cha jAnIma keneme rAtrau vadhyanti brAhmaNAH
shlokas.4:
kShINeShu cha brAhmaNeShu pRRithivI kShayameShyati |
tataH pRRithivyAM kShINAyAM tridivaM kShayameShyati
shlokas.5:
tvatprasAdAnmahAbAho lokAH sarve jagatpate |
vinAshaM nAdhigachCheyustvayA vai parirakShitAH
shlokas.6:
viShNuruvAcha||
viditaM me surAH sarvaM prajAnAM kShayakAraNam |
bhavatAM chApi vakShyAmi shRRiNudhvaM vigatajvarAH
shlokas.7:
kAleya iti vikhyAto gaNaH paramadAruNaH |
taishcha vRRitraM samAshritya jagatsarvaM prabAdhitam
shlokas.8:
te vRRitraM nihataM dRRiShTvA sahasrAkSheNa dhImatA |
jIvitaM parirakShantaH praviShTA varuNAlayam
shlokas.9:
te pravishyodadhiM ghoraM nakragrAhasamAkulam |
utsAdanArthaM lokAnAM rAtrau ghnanti munIniha
shlokas.10:
na tu shakyAH kShayaM netuM samudrAshrayagA hi te |
samudrasya kShaye buddhirbhavadbhiH sampradhAryatAm
agastyena vinA ko hi shakto.anyo.arNavashoShaNe
shlokas.11:
etachChrutvA vacho devA viShNunA samudAhRRitam |
parameShThinamAj~nApya agastyasyAshramaM yayuH
shlokas.12:
tatrApashyanmahAtmAnaM vAruNiM dIptatejasam |
upAsyamAnamRRiShibhirdevairiva pitAmaham
shlokas.13:
te.abhigamya mahAtmAnaM maitrAvaruNimachyutam |
AshramasthaM taporAshiM karmabhiH svairabhiShTuvan
shlokas.14:
devA UchuH||
nahuSheNAbhitaptAnAM tvaM lokAnAM gatiH purA |
bhra.nshitashcha suraishvaryAllokArthaM lokakaNTakaH
shlokas.15:
krodhAtpravRRiddhaH sahasA bhAskarasya nagottamaH |
vachastavAnatikrAmanvindhyaH shailo na vardhate
shlokas.16:
tamasA chAvRRite loke mRRityunAbhyarditAH prajAH |
tvAmeva nAthamAsAdya nirvRRitiM paramAM gatAH
shlokas.17:
asmAkaM bhayabhItAnAM nityasho bhagavAngatiH |
tatastvArtAH prayAchAmastvAM varaM varado hyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimarthaM sahasA vindhyaH pravRRiddhaH krodhamUrChitaH |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa mahAmune
shlokas.2:
lomasha uvAcha||
adrirAjaM mahAshailaM maruM kanakaparvatam |
udayAstamaye bhAnuH pradakShiNamavartata
shlokas.3:
taM tu dRRiShTvA tathA vindhyaH shailaH sUryamathAbravIt |
yathA hi merurbhavatA nityashaH parigamyate
pradakShiNaM cha kriyate mAmevaM kuru bhAskara
shlokas.4:
evamuktastataH sUryaH shailendraM pratyabhAShata |
nAhamAtmechChayA shaila karomyenaM pradakShiNam
eSha mArgaH pradiShTo me yenedaM nirmitaM jagat
shlokas.5:
evamuktastataH krodhAtpravRRiddhaH sahasAchalaH |
sUryAchandramasormArgaM roddhumichChanparantapa
shlokas.6:
tato devAH sahitAH sarva eva; sendrAH samAgamya mahAdrirAjam |
nivArayAmAsurupAyatastaM; na cha sma teShAM vachanaM chakAra
shlokas.7:
athAbhijagmurmunimAshramasthaM; tapasvinaM dharmabhRRitAM variShTham |
agastyamatyadbhutavIryadIptaM; taM chArthamUchuH sahitAH surAste
shlokas.8:
devA UchuH||
sUryAchandramasormArgaM nakShatrANAM gatiM tathA |
shailarAjo vRRiNotyeSha vindhyaH krodhavashAnugaH
shlokas.9:
taM nivArayituM shakto nAnyaH kashchiddvijottama |
RRite tvAM hi mahAbhAga tasmAdenaM nivAraya
shlokas.10:
lomasha uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vachanaM vipraH surANAM shailamabhyagAt |
so.abhigamyAbravIdvindhyaM sadAraH samupasthitaH
shlokas.11:
mArgamichChAmyahaM dattaM bhavatA parvatottama |
dakShiNAmabhigantAsmi dishaM kAryeNa kenachit
shlokas.12:
yAvadAgamanaM mahyaM tAvattvaM pratipAlaya |
nivRRitte mayi shailendra tato vardhasva kAmataH
shlokas.13:
evaM sa samayaM kRRitvA vindhyenAmitrakarshana |
adyApi dakShiNAddeshAdvAruNirna nivartate
shlokas.14:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathA vindhyo na vardhate |
agastyasya prabhAvena yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.15:
kAleyAstu yathA rAjansuraiH sarvairniShUditAH |
agastyAdvaramAsAdya tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.16:
tridashAnAM vachaH shrutvA maitrAvaruNirabravIt |
kimarthamabhiyAtAH stha varaM mattaH kimichChatha
evamuktAstatastena devAstaM munimabruvan
shlokas.17:
evaM tvayechChAma kRRitaM maharShe; mahArNavaM pIyamAnaM mahAtman |
tato vadhiShyAma sahAnubandhA;nkAleyasa~nj~nAnsuravidviShastAn
shlokas.18:
tridashAnAM vachaH shrutvA tatheti munirabravIt |
kariShye bhavatAM kAmaM lokAnAM cha mahatsukham
shlokas.19:
evamuktvA tato.agachChatsamudraM saritAM patim |
RRiShibhishcha tapaHsiddhaiH sArdhaM devaishcha suvrataH
shlokas.20:
manuShyoragagandharvayakShakimpuruShAstathA |
anujagmurmahAtmAnaM draShTukAmAstadadbhutam
shlokas.21:
tato.abhyagachChansahitAH samudraM bhImanisvanam |
nRRityantamiva chormIbhirvalgantamiva vAyunA
shlokas.22:
hasantamiva phenaughaiH skhalantaM kandareShu cha |
nAnAgrAhasamAkIrNaM nAnAdvijagaNAyutam
shlokas.23:
agastyasahitA devAH sagandharvamahoragAH |
RRiShayashcha mahAbhAgAH samAsedurmahodadhim

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
samudraM sa samAsAdya vAruNirbhagavAnRRiShiH |
uvAcha sahitAndevAnRRiShI.nshchaiva samAgatAn
shlokas.2:
eSha lokahitArthaM vai pibAmi varuNAlayam |
bhavadbhiryadanuShTheyaM tachChIghraM sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.3:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM maitrAvaruNirachyutaH |
samudramapibatkruddhaH sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.4:
pIyamAnaM samudraM tu dRRiShTvA devAH savAsavAH |
vismayaM paramaM jagmuH stutibhishchApyapUjayan
shlokas.5:
tvaM nastrAtA vidhAtA cha lokAnAM lokabhAvanaH |
tvatprasAdAtsamuchChedaM na gachChetsAmaraM jagat
shlokas.6:
sampUjyamAnastridashairmahAtmA; gandharvatUryeShu nadatsu sarvashaH |
divyaishcha puShpairavakIryamANo; mahArNavaM niHsalilaM chakAra
shlokas.7:
dRRiShTvA kRRitaM niHsalilaM mahArNavaM; surAH samastAH paramaprahRRiShTAH |
pragRRihya divyAni varAyudhAni; tAndAnavA~njaghnuradInasattvAH
shlokas.8:
te vadhyamAnAstridashairmahAtmabhi;rmahAbalairvegibhirunnadadbhiH |
na sehire vegavatAM mahAtmanAM; vegaM tadA dhArayituM divaukasAm
shlokas.9:
te vadhyamAnAstridashairdAnavA bhImanisvanAH |
chakruH sutumulaM yuddhaM muhUrtamiva bhArata
shlokas.10:
te pUrvaM tapasA dagdhA munibhirbhAvitAtmabhiH |
yatamAnAH paraM shaktyA tridashairviniShUditAH
shlokas.11:
te hemaniShkAbharaNAH kuNDalA~NgadadhAriNaH |
nihatya bahvashobhanta puShpitA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.12:
hatasheShAstataH kechitkAleyA manujottama |
vidArya vasudhAM devIM pAtAlatalamAshritAH
shlokas.13:
nihatAndAnavAndRRiShTvA tridashA munipu~Ngavam |
tuShTuvurvividhairvAkyairidaM chaivAbruvanvachaH
shlokas.14:
tvatprasAdAnmahAbhAga lokaiH prAptaM mahatsukham |
tvattejasA cha nihatAH kAleyAH krUravikramAH
shlokas.15:
pUrayasva mahAbAho samudraM lokabhAvana |
yattvayA salilaM pItaM tadasminpunarutsRRija
shlokas.16:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha bhagavAnmunipu~NgavaH |
jIrNaM taddhi mayA toyamupAyo.anyaH prachintyatAm
pUraNArthaM samudrasya bhavadbhiryatnamAsthitaiH
shlokas.17:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
vismitAshcha viShaNNAshcha babhUvuH sahitAH surAH
shlokas.18:
parasparamanuj~nApya praNamya munipu~Ngavam |
prajAH sarvA mahArAja viprajagmuryathAgatam
shlokas.19:
tridashA viShNunA sArdhamupajagmuH pitAmaham |
pUraNArthaM samudrasya mantrayitvA punaH punaH
UchuH prA~njalayaH sarve sAgarasyAbhipUraNam

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
tAnuvAcha sametA.nstu brahmA lokapitAmahaH |
gachChadhvaM vibudhAH sarve yathAkAmaM yathepsitam
shlokas.2:
mahatA kAlayogena prakRRitiM yAsyate.arNavaH |
j~nAtInvai kAraNaM kRRitvA mahArAj~no bhagIrathAt
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM vai j~nAtayo brahmankAraNaM chAtra kiM mune |
kathaM samudraH pUrNashcha bhagIrathaparishramAt
shlokas.4:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa tapodhana |
kathyamAnaM tvayA vipra rAj~nAM charitamuttamam
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu viprendro dharmarAj~nA mahAtmanA |
kathayAmAsa mAhAtmyaM sagarasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
lomasha uvAcha||
ikShvAkUNAM kule jAtaH sagaro nAma pArthivaH |
rUpasattvabalopetaH sa chAputraH pratApavAn
shlokas.7:
sa haihayAnsamutsAdya tAlaja~NghA.nshcha bhArata |
vashe cha kRRitvA rAj~no.anyAnsvarAjyamanvashAsata
shlokas.8:
tasya bhArye tvabhavatAM rUpayauvanadarpite |
vaidarbhI bharatashreShTha shaibyA cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
sa putrakAmo nRRipatistatApa sumahattapaH |
patnIbhyAM saha rAjendra kailAsaM girimAshritaH
shlokas.10:
sa tapyamAnaH sumahattapo yogasamanvitaH |
AsasAda mahAtmAnaM tryakShaM tripuramardanam
shlokas.11:
sha~NkaraM bhavamIshAnaM shUlapAniM pinAkinam |
tryambakaM shivamugreshaM bahurUpamumApatim
shlokas.12:
sa taM dRRiShTvaiva varadaM patnIbhyAM sahito nRRipaH |
praNipatya mahAbAhuH putrArthaM samayAchata
shlokas.13:
taM prItimAnharaH prAha sabhAryaM nRRipasattamam |
yasminvRRito muhUrte.ahaM tvayeha nRRipate varam
shlokas.14:
ShaShTiH putrasahasrANi shUrAH samaradarpitAH |
ekasyAM sambhaviShyanti patnyAM tava narottama
shlokas.15:
te chaiva sarve sahitAH kShayaM yAsyanti pArthiva |
eko va.nshadharaH shUra ekasyAM sambhaviShyati
evamuktvA tu taM rudrastatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.16:
sa chApi sagaro rAjA jagAma svaM niveshanam |
patnIbhyAM sahitastAta so.atihRRiShTamanAstadA
shlokas.17:
tasyAtha manujashreShTha te bhArye kamalekShaNe |
vaidarbhI chaiva shaibyA cha garbhiNyau sambabhUvatuH
shlokas.18:
tataH kAlena vaidarbhI garbhAlAbuM vyajAyata |
shaibyA cha suShuve putraM kumAraM devarUpiNam
shlokas.19:
tadAlAbuM samutsraShTuM manashchakre sa pArthivaH |
athAntarikShAchChushrAva vAchaM gambhIranisvanAm
shlokas.20:
rAjanmA sAhasaM kArShIH putrAnna tyaktumarhasi |
alAbumadhyAnniShkRRiShya bIjaM yatnena gopyatAm
shlokas.21:
sopasvedeShu pAtreShu ghRRitapUrNeShu bhAgashaH |
tataH putrasahasrANi ShaShTiM prApsyasi pArthiva
shlokas.22:
mahAdevena diShTaM te putrajanma narAdhipa |
anena kramayogena mA te buddhirato.anyathA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
etachChrutvAntarikShAchcha sa rAjA rAjasattama |
yathoktaM tachchakArAtha shraddadhadbharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
ShaShTiH putrasahasrANi tasyApratimatejasaH |
rudraprasAdAdrAjarSheH samajAyanta pArthiva
shlokas.3:
te ghorAH krUrakarmANa AkAshaparisarpiNaH |
bahutvAchchAvajAnantaH sarvA.NllokAnsahAmarAn
shlokas.4:
tridashA.nshchApyabAdhanta tathA gandharvarAkShasAn |
sarvANi chaiva bhUtAni shUrAH samarashAlinaH
shlokas.5:
vadhyamAnAstato lokAH sAgarairmandabuddhibhiH |
brahmANaM sharaNaM jagmuH sahitAH sarvadaivataiH
shlokas.6:
tAnuvAcha mahAbhAgaH sarvalokapitAmahaH |
gachChadhvaM tridashAH sarve lokaiH sArdhaM yathAgatam
shlokas.7:
nAtidIrgheNa kAlena sAgarANAM kShayo mahAn |
bhaviShyati mahAghoraH svakRRitaiH karmabhiH surAH
shlokas.8:
evamuktAstato devA lokAshcha manujeshvara |
pitAmahamanuj~nApya viprajagmuryathAgatam
shlokas.9:
tataH kAle bahutithe vyatIte bharatarShabha |
dIkShitaH sagaro rAjA hayamedhena vIryavAn
tasyAshvo vyacharadbhUmiM putraiH suparirakShitaH
shlokas.10:
samudraM sa samAsAdya nistoyaM bhImadarshanam |
rakShyamANaH prayatnena tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.11:
tataste sAgarAstAta hRRitaM matvA hayottamam |
Agamya piturAchakhyuradRRishyaM turagaM hRRitam
tenoktA dikShu sarvAsu sarve mArgata vAjinam
shlokas.12:
tataste piturAj~nAya dikShu sarvAsu taM hayam |
amArganta mahArAja sarvaM cha pRRithivItalam
shlokas.13:
tataste sAgarAH sarve samupetya parasparam |
nAdhyagachChanta turagamashvahartArameva cha
shlokas.14:
Agamya pitaraM chochustataH prA~njalayo.agrataH |
sasamudravanadvIpA sanadInadakandarA
saparvatavanoddeshA nikhilena mahI nRRipa
shlokas.15:
asmAbhirvichitA rAja~nshAsanAttava pArthiva |
na chAshvamadhigachChAmo nAshvahartArameva cha
shlokas.16:
shrutvA tu vachanaM teShAM sa rAjA krodhamUrChitaH |
uvAcha vachanaM sarvA.nstadA daivavashAnnRRipa
shlokas.17:
anAgamAya gachChadhvaM bhUyo mArgata vAjinam |
yaj~niyaM taM vinA hyashvaM nAgantavyaM hi putrakAH
shlokas.18:
pratigRRihya tu sa.ndeshaM tataste sagarAtmajAH |
bhUya eva mahIM kRRitsnAM vichetumupachakramuH
shlokas.19:
athApashyanta te vIrAH pRRithivImavadAritAm |
samAsAdya bilaM tachcha khanantaH sagarAtmajAH
kuddAlairhreShukaishchaiva samudramakhana.nstadA
shlokas.20:
sa khanyamAnaH sahitaiH sAgarairvaruNAlayaH |
agachChatparamAmArtiM dAryamANaH samantataH
shlokas.21:
asuroragarakShA.nsi sattvAni vividhAni cha |
ArtanAdamakurvanta vadhyamAnAni sAgaraiH
shlokas.22:
ChinnashIrShA videhAshcha bhinnajAnvasthimastakAH |
prANinaH samadRRishyanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.23:
evaM hi khanatAM teShAM samudraM makarAlayam |
vyatItaH sumahAnkAlo na chAshvaH samadRRishyata
shlokas.24:
tataH pUrvottare deshe samudrasya mahIpate |
vidArya pAtAlamatha sa~NkruddhAH sagarAtmajAH
apashyanta hayaM tatra vicharantaM mahItale
shlokas.25:
kapilaM cha mahAtmAnaM tejorAshimanuttamam |
tapasA dIpyamAnaM taM jvAlAbhiriva pAvakam

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
te taM dRRiShTvA hayaM rAjansamprahRRiShTatanUruhAH |
anAdRRitya mahAtmAnaM kapilaM kAlachoditAH
sa~NkruddhAH samadhAvanta ashvagrahaNakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.2:
tataH kruddho mahArAja kapilo munisattamaH |
vAsudeveti yaM prAhuH kapilaM munisattamam
shlokas.3:
sa chakShurvivRRitaM kRRitvA tejasteShu samutsRRijan |
dadAha sumahAtejA mandabuddhInsa sAgarAn
shlokas.4:
tAndRRiShTvA bhasmasAdbhUtAnnAradaH sumahAtapAH |
sagarAntikamAgachChattachcha tasmai nyavedayat
shlokas.5:
sa tachChrutvA vacho ghoraM rAjA munimukhodgatam |
muhUrtaM vimanA bhUtvA sthANorvAkyamachintayat
AtmAnamAtmanAshvAsya hayamevAnvachintayat
shlokas.6:
a.nshumantaM samAhUya asamaj~naHsutaM tadA |
pautraM bharatashArdUla idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
ShaShTistAni sahasrANi putrANAmamitaujasAm |
kApilaM teja AsAdya matkRRite nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.8:
tava chApi pitA tAta parityakto mayAnagha |
dharmaM sa.nrakShamANena paurANAM hitamichChatA
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimarthaM rAjashArdUlaH sagaraH putramAtmajam |
tyaktavAndustyajaM vIraM tanme brUhi tapodhana
shlokas.10:
lomasha uvAcha||
asama~njA iti khyAtaH sagarasya suto hyabhUt |
yaM shaibyA janayAmAsa paurANAM sa hi dArakAn
khureShu kroshato gRRihya nadyAM chikShepa durbalAn
shlokas.11:
tataH paurAH samAjagmurbhayashokapariplutAH |
sagaraM chAbhyayAchanta sarve prA~njalayaH sthitAH
shlokas.12:
tvaM nastrAtA mahArAja parachakrAdibhirbhayaiH |
asama~njobhayAdghorAttato nastrAtumarhasi
shlokas.13:
paurANAM vachanaM shrutvA ghoraM nRRipatisattamaH |
muhUrtaM vimanA bhUtvA sachivAnidamabravIt
shlokas.14:
asama~njAH purAdadya suto me vipravAsyatAm |
yadi vo matpriyaM kAryametachChIghraM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.15:
evamuktA narendreNa sachivAste narAdhipa |
yathoktaM tvaritAshchakruryathAj~nApitavAnnRRipaH
shlokas.16:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathA putro mahAtmanA |
paurANAM hitakAmena sagareNa vivAsitaH
shlokas.17:
a.nshumA.nstu maheShvAso yaduktaH sagareNa ha |
tatte sarvaM pravakShyAmi kIrtyamAnaM nibodha me
shlokas.18:
sagara uvAcha||
pitushcha te.ahaM tyAgena putrANAM nidhanena cha |
alAbhena tathAshvasya paritapyAmi putraka
shlokas.19:
tasmAdduHkhAbhisantaptaM yaj~navighnAchcha mohitam |
hayasyAnayanAtpautra narakAnmAM samuddhara
shlokas.20:
lomasha uvAcha||
a.nshumAnevamuktastu sagareNa mahAtmanA |
jagAma duHkhAttaM deshaM yatra vai dAritA mahI
shlokas.21:
sa tu tenaiva mArgeNa samudraM pravivesha ha |
apashyachcha mahAtmAnaM kapilaM turagaM cha tam
shlokas.22:
sa dRRiShTvA tejaso rAshiM purANamRRiShisattamam |
praNamya shirasA bhUmau kAryamasmai nyavedayat
shlokas.23:
tataH prIto mahAtejAH kalipoM.ashumato.abhavat |
uvAcha chainaM dharmAtmA varado.asmIti bhArata
shlokas.24:
sa vavre turagaM tatra prathamaM yaj~nakAraNAt |
dvitIyamudakaM vavre pitR^INAM pAvanepsayA
shlokas.25:
tamuvAcha mahAtejAH kapilo munipu~NgavaH |
dadAni tava bhadraM te yadyatprArthayase.anagha
shlokas.26:
tvayi kShamA cha dharmashcha satyaM chApi pratiShThitam |
tvayA kRRitArthaH sagaraH putravA.nshcha tvayA pitA
shlokas.27:
tava chaiva prabhAvena svargaM yAsyanti sAgarAH |
pautrashcha te tripathagAM tridivAdAnayiShyati
pAvanArthaM sAgarANAM toShayitvA maheshvaram
shlokas.28:
hayaM nayasva bhadraM te yaj~niyaM narapu~Ngava |
yaj~naH samApyatAM tAta sagarasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
a.nshumAnevamuktastu kapilena mahAtmanA |
AjagAma hayaM gRRihya yaj~navATaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.30:
so.abhivAdya tataH pAdau sagarasya mahAtmanaH |
mUrdhni tenApyupAghrAtastasmai sarvaM nyavedayat
shlokas.31:
yathA dRRiShTaM shrutaM chApi sAgarANAM kShayaM tathA |
taM chAsmai hayamAchaShTa yaj~navATamupAgatam
shlokas.32:
tachChrutvA sagaro rAjA putrajaM duHkhamatyajat |
a.nshumantaM cha sampUjya samApayata taM kratum
shlokas.33:
samAptayaj~naH sagaro devaiH sarvaiH sabhAjitaH |
putratve kalpayAmAsa samudraM varuNAlayam
shlokas.34:
prashAsya suchiraM kAlaM rAjyaM rAjIvalochanaH |
pautre bhAraM samAveshya jagAma tridivaM tadA
shlokas.35:
a.nshumAnapi dharmAtmA mahIM sAgaramekhalAm |
prashashAsa mahArAja yathaivAsya pitAmahaH
shlokas.36:
tasya putraH samabhavaddilIpo nAma dharmavit |
tasmai rAjyaM samAdhAya a.nshumAnapi sa.nsthitaH
shlokas.37:
dilIpastu tataH shrutvA pitR^INAM nidhanaM mahat |
paryatapyata duHkhena teShAM gatimachintayat
shlokas.38:
ga~NgAvataraNe yatnaM sumahachchAkaronnRRipaH |
na chAvatArayAmAsa cheShTamAno yathAbalam
shlokas.39:
tasya putraH samabhavachChrImAndharmaparAyaNaH |
bhagIratha iti khyAtaH satyavAganasUyakaH
shlokas.40:
abhiShichya tu taM rAjye dilIpo vanamAshritaH |
tapaHsiddhisamAyogAtsa rAjA bharatarShabha
vanAjjagAma tridivaM kAlayogena bhArata

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
sa tu rAjA maheShvAsashchakravartI mahArathaH |
babhUva sarvalokasya manonayananandanaH
shlokas.2:
sa shushrAva mahAbAhuH kapilena mahAtmanA |
pitR^INAM nidhanaM ghoramaprAptiM tridivasya cha
shlokas.3:
sa rAjyaM sachive nyasya hRRidayena vidUyatA |
jagAma himavatpArshvaM tapastaptuM nareshvaraH
shlokas.4:
ArirAdhayiShurga~NgAM tapasA dagdhakilbiShaH |
so.apashyata narashreShTha himavantaM nagottamam
shlokas.5:
shRRi~NgairbahuvidhAkArairdhAtumadbhirala~NkRRitam |
pavanAlambibhirmeghaiH pariShvaktaM samantataH
shlokas.6:
nadIku~njanitambaishcha sodakairupashobhitam |
guhAkandarasa.nlInaiH siMhavyAghrairniShevitam
shlokas.7:
shakunaishcha vichitrA~NgaiH kUjadbhirvividhA giraH |
bhRRi~NgarAjaistathA ha.nsairdAtyUhairjalakukkuTaiH
shlokas.8:
mayUraiH shatapatraishcha kokilairjIvajIvakaiH |
chakorairasitApA~NgaistathA putrapriyairapi
shlokas.9:
jalasthAneShu ramyeShu padminIbhishcha sa~Nkulam |
sArasAnAM cha madhurairvyAhRRitaiH samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.10:
kiMnarairapsarobhishcha niShevitashilAtalam |
dishAgajaviShANAgraiH samantAdghRRiShTapAdapam
shlokas.11:
vidyAdharAnucharitaM nAnAratnasamAkulam |
viSholbaNairbhuja~Ngaishcha dIptajihvairniShevitam
shlokas.12:
kvachitkanakasa~NkAshaM kvachidrajatasaMnibham |
kvachida~njanapu~njAbhaM himavantamupAgamat
shlokas.13:
sa tu tatra narashreShThastapo ghoraM samAshritaH |
phalamUlAmbubhakSho.abhUtsahasraM parivatsarAn
shlokas.14:
sa.nvatsarasahasre tu gate divye mahAnadI |
darshayAmAsa taM ga~NgA tadA mUrtimatI svayam
shlokas.15:
ga~NgovAcha||
kimichChasi mahArAja mattaH kiM cha dadAni te |
tadbravIhi narashreShTha kariShyAmi vachastava
shlokas.16:
lomasha uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha rAjA haimavatIM tadA |
pitAmahA me varade kapilena mahAnadi
anveShamANAsturagaM nItA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.17:
ShaShTistAni sahasrANi sAgarANAM mahAtmanAm |
kApilaM teja AsAdya kShaNena nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.18:
teShAmevaM vinaShTAnAM svarge vAso na vidyate |
yAvattAni sharIrANi tvaM jalairnAbhiShi~nchasi
shlokas.19:
svargaM naya mahAbhAge matpitR^InsagarAtmajAn |
teShAmarthe.abhiyAchAmi tvAmahaM vai mahAnadi
shlokas.20:
etachChrutvA vacho rAj~no ga~NgA lokanamaskRRitA |
bhagIrathamidaM vAkyaM suprItA samabhAShata
shlokas.21:
kariShyAmi mahArAja vachaste nAtra sa.nshayaH |
vegaM tu mama durdhAryaM patantyA gaganAchchyutam
shlokas.22:
na shaktastriShu lokeShu kashchiddhArayituM nRRipa |
anyatra vibudhashreShThAnnIlakaNThAnmaheshvarAt
shlokas.23:
taM toShaya mahAbAho tapasA varadaM haram |
sa tu mAM prachyutAM devaH shirasA dhArayiShyati
kariShyati cha te kAmaM pitR^INAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.24:
etachChrutvA vacho rAjanmahArAjo bhagIrathaH |
kailAsaM parvataM gatvA toShayAmAsa sha~Nkaram
shlokas.25:
tatastena samAgamya kAlayogena kenachit |
agRRihNAchcha varaM tasmAdga~NgAyA dhAraNaM nRRipa
svargavAsaM samuddishya pitR^INAM sa narottamaH

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
bhagIrathavachaH shrutvA priyArthaM cha divaukasAm |
evamastviti rAjAnaM bhagavAnpratyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
dhArayiShye mahAbAho gaganAtprachyutAM shivAm |
divyAM devanadIM puNyAM tvatkRRite nRRipasattama
shlokas.3:
evamuktvA mahAbAho himavantamupAgamat |
sa.nvRRitaH pArShadairghorairnAnApraharaNodyataiH
shlokas.4:
tataH sthitvA narashreShThaM bhagIrathamuvAcha ha |
prayAchasva mahAbAho shailarAjasutAM nadIm
patamAnAM sarichChreShThAM dhArayiShye triviShTapAt
shlokas.5:
etachChrutvA vacho rAjA sharveNa samudAhRRitam |
prayataH praNato bhUtvA ga~NgAM samanuchintayat
shlokas.6:
tataH puNyajalA ramyA rAj~nA samanuchintitA |
IshAnaM cha sthitaM dRRiShTvA gaganAtsahasA chyutA
shlokas.7:
tAM prachyutAM tato dRRiShTvA devAH sArdhaM maharShibhiH |
gandharvoragarakShA.nsi samAjagmurdidRRikShayA
shlokas.8:
tataH papAta gaganAdga~NgA himavataH sutA |
samudbhrAntamahAvartA mInagrAhasamAkulA
shlokas.9:
tAM dadhAra haro rAjanga~NgAM gaganamekhalAm |
lalATadeshe patitAM mAlAM muktAmayImiva
shlokas.10:
sA babhUva visarpantI tridhA rAjansamudragA |
phenapu~njAkulajalA ha.nsAnAmiva pa~NktayaH
shlokas.11:
kvachidAbhogakuTilA praskhalantI kvachitkvachit |
svaphenapaTasa.nvItA matteva pramadAvrajat
kvachitsA toyaninadairnadantI nAdamuttamam
shlokas.12:
evaM prakArAnsubahUnkurvantI gaganAchchyutA |
pRRithivItalamAsAdya bhagIrathamathAbravIt
shlokas.13:
darshayasva mahArAja mArgaM kena vrajAmyaham |
tvadarthamavatIrNAsmi pRRithivIM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.14:
etachChrutvA vacho rAjA prAtiShThata bhagIrathaH |
yatra tAni sharIrANi sAgarANAM mahAtmanAm
pAvanArthaM narashreShTha puNyena salilena ha
shlokas.15:
ga~NgAyA dhAraNaM kRRitvA haro lokanamaskRRitaH |
kailAsaM parvatashreShThaM jagAma tridashaiH saha
shlokas.16:
samudraM cha samAsAdya ga~NgayA sahito nRRipaH |
pUrayAmAsa vegena samudraM varuNAlayam
shlokas.17:
duhitRRitve cha nRRipatirga~NgAM samanukalpayat |
pitR^INAM chodakaM tatra dadau pUrNamanorathaH
shlokas.18:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM ga~NgA tripathagA yathA |
pUraNArthaM samudrasya pRRithivImavatAritA
shlokas.19:
samudrashcha yathA pItaH kAraNArthe mahAtmanA |
vAtApishcha yathA nItaH kShayaM sa brahmahA prabho
agastyena mahArAja yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prayAtaH kaunteyaH krameNa bharatarShabha |
nandAmaparanandAM cha nadyau pApabhayApahe
shlokas.2:
sa parvataM samAsAdya hemakUTamanAmayam |
achintyAnadbhutAnbhAvAndadarsha subahUnnRRipaH
shlokas.3:
vAcho yatrAbhavanmeghA upalAshcha sahasrashaH |
nAshaknuva.nstamAroDhuM viShaNNamanaso janAH
shlokas.4:
vAyurnityaM vavau yatra nityaM devashcha varShati |
sAyaM prAtashcha bhagavAndRRishyate havyavAhanaH
shlokas.5:
evaM bahuvidhAnbhAvAnadbhutAnvIkShya pANDavaH |
lomashaM punareva sma paryapRRichChattadadbhutam
shlokas.6:
lomasha uvAcha||
yathAshrutamidaM pUrvamasmAbhirarikarshana |
tadekAgramanA rAjannibodha gadato mama
shlokas.7:
asminnRRiShabhakUTe.abhUdRRiShabho nAma tApasaH |
anekashatavarShAyustapasvI kopano bhRRisham
shlokas.8:
sa vai sambhAShyamANo.anyaiH kopAdgirimuvAcha ha |
ya iha vyAharetkashchidupalAnutsRRijestadA
shlokas.9:
vAtaM chAhUya mA shabdamityuvAcha sa tApasaH |
vyAhara.nshchaiva puruSho meghena vinivAryate
shlokas.10:
evametAni karmANi rAja.nstena maharShiNA |
kRRitAni kAnichitkopAtpratiShiddhAni kAnichit
shlokas.11:
nandAmabhigatAndevAnpurA rAjanniti shrutiH |
anvapadyanta sahasA puruShA devadarshinaH
shlokas.12:
te darshanamanichChanto devAH shakrapurogamAH |
durgaM chakrurimaM deshaM giripratyUharUpakam
shlokas.13:
tadA prabhRRiti kaunteya narA girimimaM sadA |
nAshaknuvanabhidraShTuM kuta evAdhirohitum
shlokas.14:
nAtaptatapasA shakyo draShTumeSha mahAgiriH |
AroDhuM vApi kaunteya tasmAnniyatavAgbhava
shlokas.15:
iha devAH sadA sarve yaj~nAnAjahruruttamAn |
teShAmetAni li~NgAni dRRishyante.adyApi bhArata
shlokas.16:
kushAkAreva dUrveyaM sa.nstIrNeva cha bhUriyam |
yUpaprakArA bahavo vRRikShAshcheme vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
devAshcha RRiShayashchaiva vasantyadyApi bhArata |
teShAM sAyaM tathA prAtardRRishyate havyavAhanaH
shlokas.18:
ihAplutAnAM kaunteya sadyaH pApmA vihanyate |
kurushreShThAbhiShekaM vai tasmAtkuru sahAnujaH
shlokas.19:
tato nandAplutA~NgastvaM kaushikImabhiyAsyasi |
vishvAmitreNa yatrograM tapastaptamanuttamam
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastatra samAplutya gAtrANi sagaNo nRRipaH |
jagAma kaushikIM puNyAM ramyAM shivajalAM nadIm

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
eShA devanadI puNyA kaushikI bharatarShabha |
vishvAmitrAshramo ramya eSha chAtra prakAshate
shlokas.2:
Ashramashchaiva puNyAkhyaH kAshyapasya mahAtmanaH |
RRishyashRRi~NgaH suto yasya tapasvI sa.nyatendriyaH
shlokas.3:
tapaso yaH prabhAvena varShayAmAsa vAsavam |
anAvRRiShTyAM bhayAdyasya vavarSha balavRRitrahA
shlokas.4:
mRRigyAM jAtaH sa tejasvI kAshyapasya sutaH prabhuH |
viShaye lomapAdasya yashchakArAdbhutaM mahat
shlokas.5:
nivartiteShu sasyeShu yasmai shAntAM dadau nRRipaH |
lomapAdo duhitaraM sAvitrIM savitA yathA
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
RRishyashRRi~NgaH kathaM mRRigyAmutpannaH kAshyapAtmajaH |
viruddhe yonisa.nsarge kathaM cha tapasA yutaH
shlokas.7:
kimarthaM cha bhayAchChakrastasya bAlasya dhImataH |
anAvRRiShTyAM pravRRittAyAM vavarSha balavRRitrahA
shlokas.8:
katha.nrUpA cha shAntAbhUdrAjaputrI yatavratA |
lobhayAmAsa yA cheto mRRigabhUtasya tasya vai
shlokas.9:
lomapAdashcha rAjarShiryadAshrUyata dhArmikaH |
kathaM vai viShaye tasya nAvarShatpAkashAsanaH
shlokas.10:
etanme bhagavansarvaM vistareNa yathAtatham |
vaktumarhasi shushrUShorRRiShyashRRi~Ngasya cheShTitam
shlokas.11:
lomasha uvAcha||
vibhANDakasya brahmarShestapasA bhAvitAtmanaH |
amoghavIryasya sataH prajApatisamadyuteH
shlokas.12:
shRRiNu putro yathA jAta RRishyashRRi~NgaH pratApavAn |
mahAhrade mahAtejA bAlaH sthavirasaMmataH
shlokas.13:
mahAhradaM samAsAdya kAshyapastapasi sthitaH |
dIrghakAlaM parishrAnta RRiShirdevarShisaMmataH
shlokas.14:
tasya retaH prachaskanda dRRiShTvApsarasamurvashIm |
apsUpaspRRishato rAjanmRRigI tachchApibattadA
shlokas.15:
saha toyena tRRiShitA sA garbhiNyabhavannRRipa |
amoghatvAdvidheshchaiva bhAvitvAddaivanirmitAt
shlokas.16:
tasyAM mRRigyAM samabhavattasya putro mahAnRRiShiH |
RRishyashRRi~Ngastaponityo vana eva vyavardhata
shlokas.17:
tasyarshyashRRi~NgaM shirasi rAjannAsInmahAtmanaH |
tenarshyashRRi~Nga ityevaM tadA sa prathito.abhavat
shlokas.18:
na tena dRRiShTapUrvo.anyaH pituranyatra mAnuShaH |
tasmAttasya mano nityaM brahmacharye.abhavannRRipa
shlokas.19:
etasminneva kAle tu sakhA dasharathasya vai |
lomapAda iti khyAto a~NgAnAmIshvaro.abhavat
shlokas.20:
tena kAmaH kRRito mithyA brAhmaNebhya iti shrutiH |
sa brAhmaNaiH parityaktastadA vai jagatIpatiH
shlokas.21:
purohitApachArAchcha tasya rAj~no yadRRichChayA |
na vavarSha sahasrAkShastato.apIDyanta vai prajAH
shlokas.22:
sa brAhmaNAnparyapRRichChattapoyuktAnmanIShiNaH |
pravarShaNe surendrasya samarthAnpRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.23:
kathaM pravarShetparjanya upAyaH paridRRishyatAm |
tamUchushchoditAstena svamatAni manIShiNaH
shlokas.24:
tatra tveko munivarastaM rAjAnamuvAcha ha |
kupitAstava rAjendra brAhmaNA niskRRitiM chara
shlokas.25:
RRishyashRRi~NgaM munisutamAnayasva cha pArthiva |
vAneyamanabhij~naM cha nArINAmArjave ratam
shlokas.26:
sa chedavataredrAjanviShayaM te mahAtapAH |
sadyaH pravarShetparjanya iti me nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
etachChrutvA vacho rAjankRRitvA niskRRitimAtmanaH |
sa gatvA punarAgachChatprasanneShu dvijAtiShu
rAjAnamAgataM dRRiShTvA pratisa~njagRRihuH prajAH
shlokas.28:
tato.a~NgapatirAhUya sachivAnmantrakovidAn |
RRishyashRRi~NgAgame yatnamakaronmantranishchaye
shlokas.29:
so.adhyagachChadupAyaM tu tairamAtyaiH sahAchyutaH |
shAstraj~nairalamarthaj~nairnItyAM cha pariniShThitaiH
shlokas.30:
tata AnAyayAmAsa vAramukhyA mahIpatiH |
veshyAH sarvatra niShNAtAstA uvAcha sa pArthivaH
shlokas.31:
RRishyashRRi~NgamRRiSheH putramAnayadhvamupAyataH |
lobhayitvAbhivishvAsya viShayaM mama shobhanAH
shlokas.32:
tA rAjabhayabhItAshcha shApabhItAshcha yoShitaH |
ashakyamUchustatkAryaM vivarNA gatachetasaH
shlokas.33:
tatra tvekA jaradyoShA rAjAnamidamabravIt |
prayatiShye mahArAja tamAnetuM tapodhanam
shlokas.34:
abhipretA.nstu me kAmAnsamanuj~nAtumarhasi |
tataH shakShye lobhayitumRRishyashRRi~NgamRRiSheH sutam
shlokas.35:
tasyAH sarvamabhiprAyamanvajAnAtsa pArthivaH |
dhanaM cha pradadau bhUri ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.36:
tato rUpeNa sampannA vayasA cha mahIpate |
striya AdAya kAshchitsA jagAma vanama~njasA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
sA tu nAvyAshramaM chakre rAjakAryArthasiddhaye |
sa.ndeshAchchaiva nRRipateH svabuddhyA chaiva bhArata
shlokas.2:
nAnApuShpaphalairvRRikShaiH kRRitrimairupashobhitam |
nAnAgulmalatopetaiH svAdukAmaphalapradaiH
shlokas.3:
atIva ramaNIyaM tadatIva cha manoharam |
chakre nAvyAshramaM ramyamadbhutopamadarshanam
shlokas.4:
tato nibadhya tAM nAvamadUre kAshyapAshramAt |
chArayAmAsa puruShairvihAraM tasya vai muneH
shlokas.5:
tato duhitaraM veshyA samAdhAyetikRRityatAm |
dRRiShTvAntaraM kAshyapasya prAhiNodbuddhisaMmatAm
shlokas.6:
sA tatra gatvA kushalA taponityasya saMnidhau |
AshramaM taM samAsAdya dadarsha tamRRiSheH sutam
shlokas.7:
veshyovAcha||
kachchinmune kushalaM tApasAnAM; kachchichcha vo mUlaphalaM prabhUtam |
kachchidbhavAnramate chAshrame.asmiM;stvAM vai draShTuM sAmpratamAgato.asmi
shlokas.8:
kachchittapo vardhate tApasAnAM; pitA cha te kachchidahInatejAH |
kachchittvayA prIyate chaiva vipra; kachchitsvAdhyAyaH kriyate RRishyashRRi~Nga
shlokas.9:
RRishyashRRi~Nga uvAcha||
RRiddho bhavA~njyotiriva prakAshate; manye chAhaM tvAmabhivAdanIyam |
pAdyaM vai te sampradAsyAmi kAmA;dyathAdharmaM phalamUlAni chaiva
shlokas.10:
kaushyAM bRRisyAmAssva yathopajoShaM; kRRiShNAjinenAvRRitAyAM sukhAyAm |
kva chAshramastava kiM nAma chedaM; vrataM brahma.nshcharasi hi devavattvam
shlokas.11:
veshyovAcha||
mamAshramaH kAshyapaputra ramya;striyojanaM shailamimaM pareNa |
tatra svadharmo.anabhivAdanaM no; na chodakaM pAdyamupaspRRishAmaH
shlokas.12:
RRishyashRRi~Nga uvAcha||
phalAni pakvAni dadAni te.ahaM; bhallAtakAnyAmalakAni chaiva |
parUShakAnI~NgudadhanvanAni; priyAlAnAM kAmakAraM kuruShva
shlokas.13:
lomasha uvAcha||
sA tAni sarvANi visarjayitvA; bhakShAnmahArhAnpradadau tato.asmai |
tAnyRRishyashRRi~Ngasya mahArasAni; bhRRishaM surUpANi ruchiM dadurhi
shlokas.14:
dadau cha mAlyAni sugandhavanti; chitrANi vAsA.nsi cha bhAnumanti |
pAnAni chAgryANi tato mumoda; chikrIDa chaiva prajahAsa chaiva
shlokas.15:
sA kandukenAramatAsya mUle; vibhajyamAnA phalitA lateva |
gAtraishcha gAtrANi niShevamANA; samAshliShachchAsakRRidRRishyashRRi~Ngam
shlokas.16:
sarjAnashokA.nstilakA.nshcha vRRikShA;nprapuShpitAnavanAmyAvabhajya |
vilajjamAneva madAbhibhUtA; pralobhayAmAsa sutaM maharSheH
shlokas.17:
atharshyashRRi~NgaM vikRRitaM samIkShya; punaH punaH pIDya cha kAyamasya |
avekShamANA shanakairjagAma; kRRitvAgnihotrasya tadApadesham
shlokas.18:
tasyAM gatAyAM madanena matto; vichetanashchAbhavadRRishyashRRi~NgaH |
tAmeva bhAvena gatena shUnyo; viniHshvasannArtarUpo babhUva
shlokas.19:
tato muhUrtAddharipi~NgalAkShaH; praveShTito romabhirA nakhAgrAt |
svAdhyAyavAnvRRittasamAdhiyukto; vibhANDakaH kAshyapaH prAdurAsIt
shlokas.20:
so.apashyadAsInamupetya putraM; dhyAyantamekaM viparItachittam |
viniHshvasantaM muhurUrdhvadRRiShTiM; vibhANDakaH putramuvAcha dInam
shlokas.21:
na kalpyante samidhaH kiM nu tAta; kachchiddhutaM chAgnihotraM tvayAdya |
sunirNiktaM sruksruvaM homadhenuH; kachchitsavatsA cha kRRitA tvayAdya
shlokas.22:
na vai yathApUrvamivAsi putra; chintAparashchAsi vichetanashcha |
dIno.atimAtraM tvamihAdya kiM nu; pRRichChAmi tvAM ka ihAdyAgato.abhUt

shlokas.1:
RRishyashRRi~Nga uvAcha||
ihAgato jaTilo brahmachArI; na vai hrasvo nAtidIrgho manasvI |
suvarNavarNaH kamalAyatAkShaH; sutaH surANAmiva shobhamAnaH
shlokas.2:
samRRiddharUpaH saviteva dIptaH; sushuklakRRiShNAkShatarashchakoraiH |
nIlAH prasannAshcha jaTAH sugandhA; hiraNyarajjugrathitAH sudIrghAH
shlokas.3:
AdhArarUpA punarasya kaNThe; vibhrAjate vidyudivAntarikShe |
dvau chAsya piNDAvadhareNa kaNTha;majAtaromau sumanoharau cha
shlokas.4:
vilagnamadhyashcha sa nAbhideshe; kaTishcha tasyAtikRRitapramANA |
tathAsya chIrAntaritA prabhAti; hiraNmayI mekhalA me yatheyam
shlokas.5:
anyachcha tasyAdbhutadarshanIyaM; vikUjitaM pAdayoH samprabhAti |
pANyoshcha tadvatsvanavannibaddhau; kalApakAvakShamAlA yatheyam
shlokas.6:
vicheShTamAnasya cha tasya tAni; kUjanti ha.nsA sarasIva mattAH |
chIrANi tasyAdbhutadarshanAni; nemAni tadvanmama rUpavanti
shlokas.7:
vaktraM cha tasyAdbhutadarshanIyaM; pravyAhRRitaM hlAdayatIva chetaH |
pu.nskokilasyeva cha tasya vANI; tAM shRRiNvato me vyathito.antarAtmA
shlokas.8:
yathA vanaM mAdhavamAsi madhye; samIritaM shvasanenAbhivAti |
tathA sa vAtyuttamapuNyagandhI; niShevyamANaH pavanena tAta
shlokas.9:
susa.nyatAshchApi jaTA vibhaktA; dvaidhIkRRitA bhAnti samA lalATe |
karNau cha chitrairiva chakravAlaiH; samAvRRitau tasya surUpavadbhiH
shlokas.10:
tathA phalaM vRRittamatho vichitraM; samAhanatpANinA dakShiNena |
tadbhUmimAsAdya punaH punashcha; samutpatatyadbhutarUpamuchchaiH
shlokas.11:
tachchApi hatvA parivartate.asau; vAterito vRRikSha ivAvaghUrNaH |
taM prekShya me putramivAmarANAM; prItiH parA tAta ratishcha jAtA
shlokas.12:
sa me samAshliShya punaH sharIraM; jaTAsu gRRihyAbhyavanAmya vaktram |
vaktreNa vaktraM praNidhAya shabdaM; chakAra tanme.ajanayatpraharSham
shlokas.13:
na chApi pAdyaM bahu manyate.asau; phalAni chemAni mayAhRRitAni |
eva.nvrato.asmIti cha mAmavocha;tphalAni chAnyAni navAnyadAnme
shlokas.14:
mayopayuktAni phalAni tAni; nemAni tulyAni rasena teShAm |
na chApi teShAM tvagiyaM yathaiShAM; sArANi naiShAmiva santi teShAm
shlokas.15:
toyAni chaivAtirasAni mahyaM; prAdAtsa vai pAtumudArarUpaH |
pItvaiva yAnyabhyadhikaH praharSho; mamAbhavadbhUshchaliteva chAsIt
shlokas.16:
imAni chitrANi cha gandhavanti; mAlyAni tasyodgrathitAni paTTaiH |
yAni prakIryeha gataH svameva; sa AshramaM tapasA dyotamAnaH
shlokas.17:
gatena tenAsmi kRRito vichetA; gAtraM cha me samparitapyatIva |
ichChAmi tasyAntikamAshu gantuM; taM cheha nityaM parivartamAnam
shlokas.18:
gachChAmi tasyAntikameva tAta; kA nAma sA vratacharyA cha tasya |
ichChAmyahaM charituM tena sArdhaM; yathA tapaH sa charatyugrakarmA

shlokas.1:
vibhANDaka uvAcha||
rakShA.nsi chaitAni charanti putra; rUpeNa tenAdbhutadarshanena |
atulyarUpANyatighoravanti; vighnaM sadA tapasashchintayanti
shlokas.2:
surUparUpANi cha tAni tAta; pralobhayante vividhairupAyaiH |
sukhAchcha lokAchcha nipAtayanti; tAnyugrakarmANi munInvaneShu
shlokas.3:
na tAni seveta muniryatAtmA; satAM lokAnprArthayAnaH katha~nchit |
kRRitvA vighnaM tApasAnAM ramante; pApAchArAstapasastAnyapApa
shlokas.4:
asajjanenAcharitAni putra; pApAnyapeyAni madhUni tAni |
mAlyAni chaitAni na vai munInAM; smRRitAni chitrojjvalagandhavanti
shlokas.5:
lomasha uvAcha||
rakShA.nsi tAnIti nivArya putraM; vibhANDakastAM mRRigayAM babhUva |
nAsAdayAmAsa yadA tryaheNa; tadA sa paryAvavRRite.a.ashramAya
shlokas.6:
yadA punaH kAshyapo vai jagAma; phalAnyAhartuM vidhinA shrAmaNena |
tadA punarlobhayituM jagAma; sA veshayoShA munimRRishyashRRi~Ngam
shlokas.7:
dRRiShTvaiva tAmRRishyashRRi~NgaH prahRRiShTaH; sambhrAntarUpo.abhyapatattadAnIm |
provAcha chainAM bhavato.a.ashramAya; gachChAva yAvanna pitA mamaiti
shlokas.8:
tato rAjankAshyapasyaikaputraM; praveshya yogena vimuchya nAvam |
pralobhayantyo vividhairupAyai;rAjagmura~NgAdhipateH samIpam
shlokas.9:
sa.nsthApya tAmAshramadarshane tu; santAritAM nAvamatIva shubhrAm |
tIrAdupAdAya tathaiva chakre; rAjAshramaM nAma vanaM vichitram
shlokas.10:
antaHpure taM tu niveshya rAjA; vibhANDakasyAtmajamekaputram |
dadarsha devaM sahasA pravRRiShTa;mApUryamANaM cha jagajjalena
shlokas.11:
sa lomapAdaH paripUrNakAmaH; sutAM dadAvRRishyashRRi~NgAya shAntAm |
krodhapratIkArakaraM cha chakre; gobhishcha mArgeShvabhikarShaNaM cha
shlokas.12:
vibhANDakasyAvrajataH sa rAjA; pashUnprabhUtAnpashupA.nshcha vIrAn |
samAdishatputragRRiddhI maharShi;rvibhANDakaH paripRRichChedyadA vaH
shlokas.13:
sa vaktavyaH prA~njalibhirbhavadbhiH; putrasya te pashavaH karShaNaM cha |
kiM te priyaM vai kriyatAM maharShe; dAsAH sma sarve tava vAchi baddhAH
shlokas.14:
athopAyAtsa munishchaNDakopaH; svamAshramaM mUlaphalAni gRRihya |
anveShamANashcha na tatra putraM; dadarsha chukrodha tato bhRRishaM saH
shlokas.15:
tataH sa kopena vidIryamANa; Asha~NkamAno nRRipatervidhAnam |
jagAma champAM pradidhakShamANa;stama~NgarAjaM viShayaM cha tasya
shlokas.16:
sa vai shrAntaH kShudhitaH kAshyapastA;nghoShAnsamAsAditavAnsamRRiddhAn |
gopaishcha tairvidhivatpUjyamAno; rAjeva tAM rAtrimuvAsa tatra
shlokas.17:
samprApya satkAramatIva tebhyaH; provAcha kasya prathitAH stha saumyAH |
Uchustataste.abhyupagamya sarve; dhanaM tavedaM vihitaM sutasya
shlokas.18:
deshe tu deshe tu sa pUjyamAna;stA.nshchaiva shRRiNvanmadhurAnpralApAn |
prashAntabhUyiShTharajAH prahRRiShTaH; samAsasAdA~NgapatiM purastham
shlokas.19:
sampUjitastena nararShabheNa; dadarsha putraM divi devaM yathendram |
shAntAM snuShAM chaiva dadarsha tatra; saudAminImuchcharantIM yathaiva
shlokas.20:
grAmA.nshcha ghoShA.nshcha sutaM cha dRRiShTvA; shAntAM cha shAnto.asya paraH sa kopaH |
chakAra tasmai paramaM prasAdaM; vibhANDako bhUmipaternarendra
shlokas.21:
sa tatra nikShipya sutaM maharShi;ruvAcha sUryAgnisamaprabhAvam |
jAte putre vanamevAvrajethA; rAj~naH priyANyasya sarvANi kRRitvA
shlokas.22:
sa tadvachaH kRRitavAnRRishyashRRi~Ngo; yayau cha yatrAsya pitA babhUva |
shAntA chainaM paryacharadyathAva;tkhe rohiNI somamivAnukUlA
shlokas.23:
arundhatI vA subhagA vasiShThaM; lopAmudrA vApi yathA hyagastyam |
nalasya vA damayantI yathAbhU;dyathA shachI vajradharasya chaiva
shlokas.24:
nADAyanI chendrasenA yathaiva; vashyA nityaM mudgalasyAjamIDha |
tathA shAntA RRishyashRRi~NgaM vanasthaM; prItyA yuktA paryacharannarendra
shlokas.25:
tasyAshramaH puNya eSho vibhAti; mahAhradaM shobhayanpuNyakIrteH |
atra snAtaH kRRitakRRityo vishuddha;stIrthAnyanyAnyanusa.nyAhi rAjan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prayAtaH kaushikyAH pANDavo janamejaya |
AnupUrvyeNa sarvANi jagAmAyatanAnyuta
shlokas.2:
sa sAgaraM samAsAdya ga~NgAyAH sa~Ngame nRRipa |
nadIshatAnAM pa~nchAnAM madhye chakre samAplavam
shlokas.3:
tataH samudratIreNa jagAma vasudhAdhipaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vIraH kali~NgAnprati bhArata
shlokas.4:
lomasha uvAcha||
ete kali~NgAH kaunteya yatra vaitaraNI nadI |
yatrAyajata dharmo.api devA~nsharaNametya vai
shlokas.5:
RRiShibhiH samupAyuktaM yaj~niyaM girishobhitam |
uttaraM tIrametaddhi satataM dvijasevitam
shlokas.6:
samena devayAnena pathA svargamupeyuShaH |
atra vai RRiShayo.anye.api purA kratubhirIjire
shlokas.7:
atraiva rudro rAjendra pashumAdattavAnmakhe |
rudraH pashuM mAnavendra bhAgo.ayamiti chAbravIt
shlokas.8:
hRRite pashau tadA devAstamUchurbharatarShabha |
mA parasvamabhidrogdhA mA dharmAnsakalAnnashIH
shlokas.9:
tataH kalyANarUpAbhirvAgbhiste rudramastuvan |
iShTyA chainaM tarpayitvA mAnayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.10:
tataH sa pashumutsRRijya devayAnena jagmivAn |
atrAnuva.nsho rudrasya taM nibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.11:
ayAtayAmaM sarvebhyo bhAgebhyo bhAgamuttamam |
devAH sa~NkalpayAmAsurbhayAdrudrasya shAshvatam
shlokas.12:
imAM gAthAmatra gAyannapaH spRRishati yo naraH |
devayAnastasya panthAshchakShushchaiva prakAshate
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vaitaraNIM sarve pANDavA draupadI tathA |
avatIrya mahAbhAgA tarpayAM chakrire pitR^In
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
upaspRRishyaiva bhagavannasyAM nadyAM tapodhana |
mAnuShAdasmi viShayAdapetaH pashya lomasha
shlokas.15:
sarvA.NllokAnprapashyAmi prasAdAttava suvrata |
vaikhAnasAnAM japatAmeSha shabdo mahAtmanAm
shlokas.16:
lomasha uvAcha||
trishataM vai sahasrANi yojanAnAM yudhiShThira |
yatra dhvaniM shRRiNoShyenaM tUShNImAssva vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
etatsvayambhuvo rAjanvanaM ramyaM prakAshate |
yatrAyajata kaunteya vishvakarmA pratApavAn
shlokas.18:
yasminyaj~ne hi bhUrdattA kashyapAya mahAtmane |
saparvatavanoddeshA dakShiNA vai svayambhuvA
shlokas.19:
avAsIdachcha kaunteya dattamAtrA mahI tadA |
uvAcha chApi kupitA lokeshvaramidaM prabhum
shlokas.20:
na mAM martyAya bhagavankasmaichiddAtumarhasi |
pradAnaM moghametatte yAsyAmyeShA rasAtalam
shlokas.21:
viShIdantIM tu tAM dRRiShTvA kashyapo bhagavAnRRiShiH |
prasAdayAM babhUvAtha tato bhUmiM vishAM pate
shlokas.22:
tataH prasannA pRRithivI tapasA tasya pANDava |
punarunmajjya salilAdvedIrUpA sthitA babhau
shlokas.23:
saiShA prakAshate rAjanvedI sa.nsthAnalakShaNA |
AruhyAtra mahArAja vIryavAnvai bhaviShyasi
shlokas.24:
ahaM cha te svastyayanaM prayokShye; yathA tvamenAmadhirokShyase.adya |
spRRiShTA hi martyena tataH samudra;meShA vedI pravishatyAjamIDha
shlokas.25:
agnirmitro yonirApo.atha devyo; viShNo retastvamamRRitasya nAbhiH |
evaM bruvanpANDava satyavAkyaM; vedImimAM tvaM tarasAdhiroha
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kRRitasvastyayano mahAtmA; yudhiShThiraH sAgaragAmagachChat |
kRRitvA cha tachChAsanamasya sarvaM; mahendramAsAdya nishAmuvAsa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tatra tAmuShitvaikAM rajanIM pRRithivIpatiH |
tApasAnAM paraM chakre satkAraM bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.2:
lomashashchAsya tAnsarvAnAchakhyau tatra tApasAn |
bhRRigUna~Ngirasashchaiva vAsiShThAnatha kAshyapAn
shlokas.3:
tAnsametya sa rAjarShirabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
rAmasyAnucharaM vIramapRRichChadakRRitavraNam
shlokas.4:
kadA nu rAmo bhagavA.nstApasAndarshayiShyati |
tenaivAhaM prasa~Ngena draShTumichChAmi bhArgavam
shlokas.5:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
AyAnevAsi vidito rAmasya viditAtmanaH |
prItistvayi cha rAmasya kShipraM tvAM darshayiShyati
shlokas.6:
chaturdashImaShTamIM cha rAmaM pashyanti tApasAH |
asyAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAM bhavitrI cha chaturdashI
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhavAnanugato vIraM jAmadagnyaM mahAbalam |
pratyakShadarshI sarvasya pUrvavRRittasya karmaNaH
shlokas.8:
sa bhavAnkathayatvetadyathA rAmeNa nirjitAH |
Ahave kShatriyAH sarve kathaM kena cha hetunA
shlokas.9:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
kanyakubje mahAnAsItpArthivaH sumahAbalaH |
gAdhIti vishruto loke vanavAsaM jagAma saH
shlokas.10:
vane tu tasya vasataH kanyA jaj~ne.apsaraHsamA |
RRichIko bhArgavastAM cha varayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.11:
tamuvAcha tato rAjA brAhmaNaM sa.nshitavratam |
uchitaM naH kule ki~nchitpUrvairyatsampravartitam
shlokas.12:
ekataH shyAmakarNAnAM pANDurANAM tarasvinAm |
sahasraM vAjinAM shulkamiti viddhi dvijottama
shlokas.13:
na chApi bhagavAnvAchyo dIyatAmiti bhArgava |
deyA me duhitA cheyaM tvadvidhAya mahAtmane
shlokas.14:
RRichIka uvAcha||
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM pANDurANAM tarasvinAm |
dAsyAmyashvasahasraM te mama bhAryA sutAstu te
shlokas.15:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
sa tatheti pratij~nAya rAjanvaruNamabravIt |
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM pANDurANAM tarasvinAm
sahasraM vAjinAmekaM shulkArthaM me pradIyatAm
shlokas.16:
tasmai prAdAtsahasraM vai vAjinAM varuNastadA |
tadashvatIrthaM vikhyAtamutthitA yatra te hayAH
shlokas.17:
ga~NgAyAM kanyakubje vai dadau satyavatIM tadA |
tato gAdhiH sutAM tasmai janyAshchAsansurAstadA
labdhvA hayasahasraM tu tA.nshcha dRRiShTvA divaukasaH
shlokas.18:
dharmeNa labdhvA tAM bhAryAmRRichIko dvijasattamaH |
yathAkAmaM yathAjoShaM tayA reme sumadhyayA
shlokas.19:
taM vivAhe kRRite rAjansabhAryamavalokakaH |
AjagAma bhRRigushreShThaH putraM dRRiShTvA nananda cha
shlokas.20:
bhAryApatI tamAsInaM guruM suragaNArchitam |
architvA paryupAsInau prA~njalI tasthatustadA
shlokas.21:
tataH snuShAM sa bhagavAnprahRRiShTo bhRRigurabravIt |
varaM vRRiNIShva subhage dAtA hyasmi tavepsitam
shlokas.22:
sA vai prasAdayAmAsa taM guruM putrakAraNAt |
Atmanashchaiva mAtushcha prasAdaM cha chakAra saH
shlokas.23:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
RRitau tvaM chaiva mAtA cha snAte pu.nsavanAya vai |
Ali~NgetAM pRRithagvRRikShau sAshvatthaM tvamudumbaram
shlokas.24:
Ali~Ngane tu te rAja.nshchakratuH sma viparyayam |
kadAchidbhRRigurAgachChattaM cha veda viparyayam
shlokas.25:
athovAcha mahAtejA bhRRiguH satyavatIM snuShAm |
brAhmaNaH kShatravRRittirvai tava putro bhaviShyati
shlokas.26:
kShatriyo brAhmaNAchAro mAtustava suto mahAn |
bhaviShyati mahAvIryaH sAdhUnAM mArgamAsthitaH
shlokas.27:
tataH prasAdayAmAsa shvashuraM sA punaH punaH |
na me putro bhavedIdRRikkAmaM pautro bhavediti
shlokas.28:
evamastviti sA tena pANDava pratinanditA |
jamadagniM tataH putraM sA jaj~ne kAla Agate
tejasA varchasA chaiva yuktaM bhArgavanandanam
shlokas.29:
sa vardhamAnastejasvI vedasyAdhyayanena vai |
bahUnRRiShInmahAtejAH pANDaveyAtyavartata
shlokas.30:
taM tu kRRitsno dhanurvedaH pratyabhAdbharatarShabha |
chaturvidhAni chAstrANi bhAskaropamavarchasam

shlokas.1:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
sa vedAdhyayane yukto jamadagnirmahAtapAH |
tapastepe tato devAnniyamAdvashamAnayat
shlokas.2:
sa prasenajitaM rAjannadhigamya narAdhipam |
reNukAM varayAmAsa sa cha tasmai dadau nRRipaH
shlokas.3:
reNukAM tvatha samprApya bhAryAM bhArgavanandanaH |
AshramasthastayA sArdhaM tapastepe.anukUlayA
shlokas.4:
tasyAH kumArAshchatvAro jaj~nire rAmapa~nchamAH |
sarveShAmajaghanyastu rAma AsIjjaghanyajaH
shlokas.5:
phalAhAreShu sarveShu gateShvatha suteShu vai |
reNukA snAtumagamatkadAchinniyatavratA
shlokas.6:
sA tu chitrarathaM nAma mArttikAvatakaM nRRipam |
dadarsha reNukA rAjannAgachChantI yadRRichChayA
shlokas.7:
krIDantaM salile dRRiShTvA sabhAryaM padmamAlinam |
RRiddhimantaM tatastasya spRRihayAmAsa reNukA
shlokas.8:
vyabhichArAttu sA tasmAtklinnAmbhasi vichetanA |
praviveshAshramaM trastA tAM vai bhartAnvabudhyata
shlokas.9:
sa tAM dRRiShTvA chyutAM dhairyAdbrAhmyA lakShmyA vivarjitAm |
dhikShabdena mahAtejA garhayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.10:
tato jyeShTho jAmadagnyo rumaNvAnnAma nAmataH |
AjagAma suSheNashcha vasurvishvAvasustathA
shlokas.11:
tAnAnupUrvyAdbhagavAnvadhe mAturachodayat |
na cha te jAtasaMmohAH ki~nchidUchurvichetasaH
shlokas.12:
tataH shashApa tAnkopAtte shaptAshchetanAM jahuH |
mRRigapakShisadharmANaH kShipramAsa~njaDopamAH
shlokas.13:
tato rAmo.abhyagAtpashchAdAshramaM paravIrahA |
tamuvAcha mahAmanyurjamadagnirmahAtapAH
shlokas.14:
jahImAM mAtaraM pApAM mA cha putra vyathAM kRRithAH |
tata AdAya parashuM rAmo mAtuH shiro.aharat
shlokas.15:
tatastasya mahArAja jamadagnermahAtmanaH |
kopo agachChatsahasA prasannashchAbravIdidam
shlokas.16:
mamedaM vachanAttAta kRRitaM te karma duShkaram |
vRRiNIShva kAmAndharmaj~na yAvato vA~nChase hRRidA
shlokas.17:
sa vavre mAturutthAnamasmRRitiM cha vadhasya vai |
pApena tena chAsparshaM bhrAtR^INAM prakRRitiM tathA
shlokas.18:
apratidvandvatAM yuddhe dIrghamAyushcha bhArata |
dadau cha sarvAnkAmA.nstA~njamadagnirmahAtapAH
shlokas.19:
kadAchittu tathaivAsya viniShkrAntAH sutAH prabho |
athAnUpapatirvIraH kArtavIryo.abhyavartata
shlokas.20:
tamAshramapadaM prAptamRRiSherbhAryA samarchayat |
sa yuddhamadasaMmatto nAbhyanandattathArchanam
shlokas.21:
pramathya chAshramAttasmAddhomadhenvAstadA balAt |
jahAra vatsaM kroshantyA babha~nja cha mahAdrumAn
shlokas.22:
AgatAya cha rAmAya tadAchaShTa pitA svayam |
gAM cha rorUyatIM dRRiShTvA kopo rAmaM samAvishat
shlokas.23:
sa manyuvashamApannaH kArtavIryamupAdravat |
tasyAtha yudhi vikramya bhArgavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.24:
chichCheda nishitairbhallairbAhUnparighasaMnibhAn |
sahasrasaMmitAnrAjanpragRRihya ruchiraM dhanuH
shlokas.25:
arjunasyAtha dAyAdA rAmeNa kRRitamanyavaH |
AshramasthaM vinA rAmaM jamadagnimupAdravan
shlokas.26:
te taM jaghnurmahAvIryamayudhyantaM tapasvinam |
asakRRidrAma rAmeti vikroshantamanAthavat
shlokas.27:
kArtavIryasya putrAstu jamadagniM yudhiShThira |
ghAtayitvA sharairjagmuryathAgatamari.ndamAH
shlokas.28:
apakrAnteShu chaiteShu jamadagnau tathAgate |
samitpANirupAgachChadAshramaM bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.29:
sa dRRiShTvA pitaraM vIrastathA mRRityuvashaM gatam |
anarhantaM tathAbhUtaM vilalApa suduHkhitaH

shlokas.1:
rAma uvAcha||
mamAparAdhAttaiH kShudrairhatastvaM tAta bAlishaiH |
kArtavIryasya dAyAdairvane mRRiga iveShubhiH
shlokas.2:
dharmaj~nasya kathaM tAta vartamAnasya satpathe |
mRRityureva.nvidho yuktaH sarvabhUteShvanAgasaH
shlokas.3:
kiM nu tairna kRRitaM pApaM yairbhavA.nstapasi sthitaH |
ayudhyamAno vRRiddhaH sanhataH sharashataiH shitaiH
shlokas.4:
kiM nu te tatra vakShyanti sachiveShu suhRRitsu cha |
ayudhyamAnaM dharmaj~namekaM hatvAnapatrapAH
shlokas.5:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
vilapyaivaM sa karuNaM bahu nAnAvidhaM nRRipa |
pretakAryANi sarvANi pitushchakre mahAtapAH
shlokas.6:
dadAha pitaraM chAgnau rAmaH parapura~njayaH |
pratijaj~ne vadhaM chApi sarvakShatrasya bhArata
shlokas.7:
sa~Nkruddho.atibalaH shUraH shastramAdAya vIryavAn |
jaghnivAnkArtavIryasya sutAneko.antakopamaH
shlokas.8:
teShAM chAnugatA ye cha kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha |
tA.nshcha sarvAnavAmRRidnAdrAmaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivIM kRRitvA niHkShatriyAM prabhuH |
samantapa~nchake pa~ncha chakAra rudhirahradAn
shlokas.10:
sa teShu tarpayAmAsa pitR^InbhRRigukulodvahaH |
sAkShAddadarsha charchIkaM sa cha rAmaM nyavArayat
shlokas.11:
tato yaj~nena mahatA jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
tarpayAmAsa devendramRRitvigbhyashcha mahIM dadau
shlokas.12:
vedIM chApyadadaddhaimIM kashyapAya mahAtmane |
dashavyAmAyatAM kRRitvA navotsedhAM vishAM pate
shlokas.13:
tAM kashyapasyAnumate brAhmaNAH khaNDashastadA |
vyabhaja.nstena te rAjanprakhyAtAH khANDavAyanAH
shlokas.14:
sa pradAya mahIM tasmai kashyapAya mahAtmane |
asminmahendre shailendre vasatyamitavikramaH
shlokas.15:
evaM vairamabhUttasya kShatriyairlokavAsibhiH |
pRRithivI chApi vijitA rAmeNAmitatejasA
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatashchaturdashIM rAmaH samayena mahAmanAH |
darshayAmAsa tAnviprAndharmarAjaM cha sAnujam
shlokas.17:
sa tamAnarcha rAjendro bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH prabhuH |
dvijAnAM cha parAM pUjAM chakre nRRipatisattamaH
shlokas.18:
archayitvA jAmadagnyaM pUjitastena chAbhibhUH |
mahendra uShya tAM rAtriM prayayau dakShiNAmukhaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gachChansa tIrthAni mahAnubhAvaH; puNyAni ramyANi dadarsha rAjA |
sarvANi viprairupashobhitAni; kvachitkvachidbhArata sAgarasya
shlokas.2:
sa vRRittavA.nsteShu kRRitAbhiShekaH; sahAnujaH pArthivaputrapautraH |
samudragAM puNyatamAM prashastAM; jagAma pArikShita pANDuputraH
shlokas.3:
tatrApi chAplutya mahAnubhAvaH; santarpayAmAsa pitR^InsurA.nshcha |
dvijAtimukhyeShu dhanaM visRRijya; godAvariM sAgaragAmagachChat
shlokas.4:
tato vipApmA draviDeShu rAja;nsamudramAsAdya cha lokapuNyam |
agastyatIrthaM cha pavitrapuNyaM; nArItIrthAnyatha vIro dadarsha
shlokas.5:
tatrArjunasyAgryadhanurdharasya; nishamya tatkarma parairasahyam |
sampUjyamAnaH paramarShisa~NghaiH; parAM mudaM pANDusutaH sa lebhe
shlokas.6:
sa teShu tIrtheShvabhiShiktagAtraH; kRRiShNAsahAyaH sahito.anujaishcha |
sampUjayanvikramamarjunasya; reme mahIpAlapatiH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.7:
tataH sahasrANi gavAM pradAya; tIrtheShu teShvambudharottamasya |
hRRiShTaH saha bhrAtRRibhirarjunasya; sa~NkIrtayAmAsa gavAM pradAnam
shlokas.8:
sa tAni tIrthAni cha sAgarasya; puNyAni chAnyAni bahUni rAjan |
krameNa gachChanparipUrNakAmaH; shUrpArakaM puNyatamaM dadarsha
shlokas.9:
tatrodadheH ka~nchidatItya deshaM; khyAtaM pRRithivyAM vanamAsasAda |
taptaM surairyatra tapaH purastA;diShTaM tathA puNyatamairnarendraiH
shlokas.10:
sa tatra tAmagryadhanurdharasya; vedIM dadarshAyatapInabAhuH |
RRichIkaputrasya tapasvisa~NghaiH; samAvRRitAM puNyakRRidarchanIyAm
shlokas.11:
tato vasUnAM vasudhAdhipaH sa; marudgaNAnAM cha tathAshvinoshcha |
vaivasvatAdityadhaneshvarANA;mindrasya viShNoH saviturvibhoshcha
shlokas.12:
bhagasya chandrasya divAkarasya; paterapAM sAdhyagaNasya chaiva |
dhAtuH pitR^INAM cha tathA mahAtmA; rudrasya rAjansagaNasya chaiva
shlokas.13:
sarasvatyAH siddhagaNasya chaiva; pUShNashcha ye chApyamarAstathAnye |
puNyAni chApyAyatanAni teShAM; dadarsha rAjA sumanoharANi
shlokas.14:
teShUpavAsAnvividhAnupoShya; dattvA cha ratnAni mahAdhanAni |
tIrtheShu sarveShu pariplutA~NgaH; punaH sa shUrpArakamAjagAma
shlokas.15:
sa tena tIrthena tu sAgarasya; punaH prayAtaH saha sodarIyaiH |
dvijaiH pRRithivyAM prathitaM mahadbhi;stIrthaM prabhAsaM samupAjagAma
shlokas.16:
tatrAbhiShiktaH pRRithulohitAkShaH; sahAnujairdevagaNAnpitR^I.nshcha |
santarpayAmAsa tathaiva kRRiShNA; te chApi viprAH saha lomashena
shlokas.17:
sa dvAdashAhaM jalavAyubhakShaH; kurvankShapAhaHsu tadAbhiShekam |
samantato.agnInupadIpayitvA; tepe tapo dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH
shlokas.18:
tamugramAsthAya tapashcharantaM; shushrAva rAmashcha janArdanashcha |
tau sarvavRRiShNipravarau sasainyau; yudhiShThiraM jagmaturAjamIDham
shlokas.19:
te vRRiShNayaH pANDusutAnsamIkShya; bhUmau shayAnAnmaladigdhagAtrAn |
anarhatIM draupadIM chApi dRRiShTvA; suduHkhitAshchukrushurArtanAdam
shlokas.20:
tataH sa rAmaM cha janArdanaM cha; kArShNiM cha sAmbaM cha shineshcha pautram |
anyA.nshcha vRRiShNInupagamya pUjAM; chakre yathAdharmamadInasattvaH
shlokas.21:
te chApi sarvAnpratipUjya pArthAM;staiH satkRRitAH pANDusutaistathaiva |
yudhiShThiraM samparivArya rAja;nnupAvishandevagaNA yathendram
shlokas.22:
teShAM sa sarvaM charitaM pareShAM; vane cha vAsaM paramapratItaH |
astrArthamindrasya gataM cha pArthaM; kRRiShNe shasha.nsAmararAjaputram
shlokas.23:
shrutvA tu te tasya vachaH pratItA;stA.nshchApi dRRiShTvA sukRRishAnatIva |
netrodbhavaM saMmumuchurdashArhA; duHkhArtijaM vAri mahAnubhAvAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
prabhAsatIrthaM samprApya vRRiShNayaH pANDavAstathA |
kimakurvankathAshchaiShAM kAstatrAsa.nstapodhana
shlokas.2:
te hi sarve mahAtmAnaH sarvashAstravishAradAH |
vRRiShNayaH pANDavAshchaiva suhRRidashcha parasparam
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prabhAsatIrthaM samprApya puNyaM tIrthaM mahodadheH |
vRRiShNayaH pANDavAnvIrAnparivAryopatasthire
shlokas.4:
tato gokShIrakundendumRRiNAlarajataprabhaH |
vanamAlI halI rAmo babhAShe puShkarekShaNam
shlokas.5:
na kRRiShNa dharmashcharito bhavAya; jantoradharmashcha parAbhavAya |
yudhiShThiro yatra jaTI mahAtmA; vanAshrayaH klishyati chIravAsAH
shlokas.6:
duryodhanashchApi mahIM prashAsti; na chAsya bhUmirvivaraM dadAti |
dharmAdadharmashcharito garIyA;nitIva manyeta naro.alpabuddhiH
shlokas.7:
duryodhane chApi vivardhamAne; yudhiShThire chAsukha AttarAjye |
kiM nvadya kartavyamiti prajAbhiH; sha~NkA mithaH sa~njanitA narANAm
shlokas.8:
ayaM hi dharmaprabhavo narendro; dharme rataH satyadhRRitiH pradAtA |
chaleddhi rAjyAchcha sukhAchcha pArtho; dharmAdapetashcha kathaM vivardhet
shlokas.9:
kathaM nu bhIShmashcha kRRipashcha vipro; droNashcha rAjA cha kulasya vRRiddhaH |
pravrAjya pArthAnsukhamApnuvanti; dhikpApabuddhInbharatapradhAnAn
shlokas.10:
kiM nAma vakShyatyavanipradhAnaH; pitR^InsamAgamya paratra pApaH |
putreShu samyakcharitaM mayeti; putrAnapApAnavaropya rAjyAt
shlokas.11:
nAsau dhiyA sampratipashyati sma; kiM nAma kRRitvAhamachakShurevam |
jAtaH pRRithivyAmiti pArthiveShu; pravrAjya kaunteyamathApi rAjyAt
shlokas.12:
nUnaM samRRiddhAnpitRRilokabhUmau; chAmIkarAbhAnkShitijAnpraphullAn |
vichitravIryasya sutaH saputraH; kRRitvA nRRisha.nsaM bata pashyati sma
shlokas.13:
vyUDhottarA.nsAnpRRithulohitAkShA;nnemAnsma pRRichChansa shRRiNoti nUnam |
prasthApayadyatsa vanaM hyasha~Nko; yudhiShThiraM sAnujamAttashastram
shlokas.14:
yo.ayaM pareShAM pRRitanAM samRRiddhAM; nirAyudho dIrghabhujo nihanyAt |
shrutvaiva shabdaM hi vRRikodarasya; mu~nchanti sainyAni shakRRitsamUtram
shlokas.15:
sa kShutpipAsAdhvakRRishastarasvI; sametya nAnAyudhabANapANiH |
vane smaranvAsamimaM sughoraM; sheShaM na kuryAditi nishchitaM me
shlokas.16:
na hyasya vIryeNa balena kashchi;tsamaH pRRithivyAM bhavitA nareShu |
shItoShNavAtAtapakarshitA~Ngo; na sheShamAjAvasuhRRitsu kuryAt
shlokas.17:
prAchyAM nRRipAnekarathena jitvA; vRRikodaraH sAnucharAnraNeShu |
svastyAgamadyo.atirathastarasvI; so.ayaM vane klishyati chIravAsAH
shlokas.18:
yo dantakUre vyajayannRRidevA;nsamAgatAndAkShiNAtyAnmahIpAn |
taM pashyatemaM sahadevamadya; tapasvinaM tApasaveSharUpam
shlokas.19:
yaH pArthivAnekarathena vIro; dishaM pratIchIM prati yuddhashauNDaH |
so.ayaM vane mUlaphalena jIva;~njaTI charatyadya malAchitA~NgaH
shlokas.20:
satre samRRiddhe.ati rathasya rAj~no; vedItalAdutpatitA sutA yA |
seyaM vane vAsamimaM suduHkhaM; kathaM sahatyadya satI sukhArhA
shlokas.21:
trivargamukhyasya samIraNasya; deveshvarasyApyatha vAshvinoshcha |
eShAM surANAM tanayAH kathaM nu; vane charantyalpasukhAH sukhArhAH
shlokas.22:
jite hi dharmasya sute sabhArye; sabhrAtRRike sAnuchare niraste |
duryodhane chApi vivardhamAne; kathaM na sIdatyavaniH sashailA

shlokas.1:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
na rAma kAlaH paridevanAya; yaduttaraM tatra tadeva sarve |
samAcharAmo hyanatItakAlaM; yudhiShThiro yadyapi nAha ki~nchit
shlokas.2:
ye nAthavanto hi bhavanti loke; te nAtmanA karma samArabhante |
teShAM tu kAryeShu bhavanti nAthAH; shaibyAdayo rAma yathA yayAteH
shlokas.3:
yeShAM tathA rAma samArabhante; kAryANi nAthAH svamatena loke |
te nAthavantaH puruShapravIrA; nAnAthavatkRRichChramavApnuvanti
shlokas.4:
kasmAdayaM rAmajanArdanau cha; pradyumnasAmbau cha mayA sametau |
vasatyaraNye saha sodarIyai;strailokyanAthAnadhigamya nAthAn
shlokas.5:
niryAtu sAdhvadya dashArhasenA; prabhUtanAnAyudhachitravarmA |
yamakShayaM gachChatu dhArtarAShTraH; sabAndhavo vRRiShNibalAbhibhUtaH
shlokas.6:
tvaM hyeva kopAtpRRithivImapImAM; sa.nveShTayestiShThatu shAr~NgadhanvA |
sa dhArtarAShTraM jahi sAnubandhaM; vRRitraM yathA devapatirmahendraH
shlokas.7:
bhrAtA cha me yashcha sakhA gurushcha; janArdanasyAtmasamashcha pArthaH |
yadarthamabhyudyatamuttamaM ta;tkaroti karmAgryamapAraNIyam
shlokas.8:
tasyAstravarShANyahamuttamAstrai;rvihatya sarvANi raNe.abhibhUya |
kAyAchChiraH sarpaviShAgnikalpaiH; sharottamairunmathitAsmi rAma
shlokas.9:
khaDgena chAhaM nishitena sa~Nkhye; kAyAchChirastasya balAtpramathya |
tato.asya sarvAnanugAnhaniShye; duryodhanaM chApi kurU.nshcha sarvAn
shlokas.10:
AttAyudhaM mAmiha rauhiNeya; pashyantu bhaumA yudhi jAtaharShAH |
nighnantamekaM kuruyodhamukhyA;nkAle mahAkakShamivAntakAgniH
shlokas.11:
pradyumnamuktAnnishitAnna shaktAH; soDhuM kRRipadroNavikarNakarNAH |
jAnAmi vIryaM cha tavAtmajasya; kArShNirbhavatyeSha yathA raNasthaH
shlokas.12:
sAmbaH sasUtaM sarathaM bhujAbhyAM; duHshAsanaM shAstu balAtpramathya |
na vidyate jAmbavatIsutasya; raNe.aviShahyaM hi raNotkaTasya
shlokas.13:
etena bAlena hi shambarasya; daityasya sainyaM sahasA praNunnam |
vRRittoruratyAyatapInabAhu;retena sa~Nkhye nihato.ashvachakraH
ko nAma sAmbasya raNe manuShyo; gatvAntaraM vai bhujayordhareta
shlokas.14:
yathA pravishyAntaramantakasya; kAle manuShyo na viniShkrameta |
tathA pravishyAntaramasya sa~Nkhye; ko nAma jIvanpunarAvrajeta
shlokas.15:
droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha mahArathau tau; sutairvRRitaM chApyatha somadattam |
sarvANi sainyAni cha vAsudevaH; pradhakShyate sAyakavahnijAlaiH
shlokas.16:
kiM nAma lokeShvaviShahyamasti; kRRiShNasya sarveShu sadaivateShu |
AttAyudhasyottamabANapANe;shchakrAyudhasyApratimasya yuddhe
shlokas.17:
tato.aniruddho.apyasicharmapANi;rmahImimAM dhArtarAShTrairvisa~nj~naiH |
hRRitottamA~NgairnihataiH karotu; kIrNAM kushairvedimivAdhvareShu
shlokas.18:
gadolmukau bAhukabhAnunIthAH; shUrashcha sa~Nkhye nishaThaH kumAraH |
raNotkaTau sAraNachArudeShNau; kulochitaM viprathayantu karma
shlokas.19:
savRRiShNibhojAndhakayodhamukhyA; samAgatA kShatriyashUrasenA |
hatvA raNe tAndhRRitarAShTraputrA.N;lloke yashaH sphItamupAkarotu
shlokas.20:
tato.abhimanyuH pRRithivIM prashAstu; yAvadvrataM dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH |
yudhiShThiraH pArayate mahAtmA; dyUte yathoktaM kurusattamena
shlokas.21:
asmatpramuktairvishikhairjitAri;stato mahIM bhokShyati dharmarAjaH |
nirdhArtarAShTrAM hatasUtaputrA;metaddhi naH kRRityatamaM yashashyam
shlokas.22:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM mAdhava satyameta;dgRRihNIma te vAkyamadInasattva |
svAbhyAM bhujAbhyAmajitAM tu bhUmiM; nechChetkurUNAmRRiShabhaH katha~nchit
shlokas.23:
na hyeSha kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhA;dyudhiShThiro jAtu jahyAtsvadharmam |
bhImArjunau chAtirathau yamau vA; tathaiva kRRiShNA drupadAtmajeyam
shlokas.24:
ubhau hi yuddhe.apratimau pRRithivyAM; vRRikodarashchaiva dhana~njayashcha |
kasmAnna kRRitsnAM pRRithivIM prashAse;nmAdrIsutAbhyAM cha puraskRRito.ayam
shlokas.25:
yadA tu pA~nchAlapatirmahAtmA; sakekayashchedipatirvayaM cha |
yotsyAma vikramya parA.nstadA vai; suyodhanastyakShyati jIvalokam
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
naitachchitraM mAdhava yadbravIShi; satyaM tu me rakShyatamaM na rAjyam |
kRRiShNastu mAM veda yathAvadekaH; kRRiShNaM cha vedAhamatho yathAvat
shlokas.27:
yadaiva kAlaM puruShapravIro; vetsyatyayaM mAdhava vikramasya |
tadA raNe tvaM cha shinipravIra; suyodhanaM jeShyasi keshavashcha
shlokas.28:
pratiprayAntvadya dashArhavIrA; dRRiDho.asmi nAthairnaralokanAthaiH |
dharme.apramAdaM kurutAprameyA; draShTAsmi bhUyaH sukhinaH sametAn
shlokas.29:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te.anyonyamAmantrya tathAbhivAdya; vRRiddhAnparisvajya shishU.nshcha sarvAn |
yadupravIrAH svagRRihANi jagmU; rAjApi tIrthAnyanusa~nchachAra
shlokas.30:
visRRijya kRRiShNaM tvatha dharmarAjo; vidarbharAjopachitAM sutIrthAm |
sutena somena vimishritodAM; tataH payoShNIM prati sa hyuvAsa

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
nRRigeNa yajamAnena someneha pura.ndaraH |
tarpitaH shrUyate rAjansa tRRipto madamabhyagAt
shlokas.2:
iha devaiH sahendrairhi prajApatibhireva cha |
iShTaM bahuvidhairyaj~nairmahadbhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.3:
AmUrtarayasashcheha rAjA vajradharaM prabhum |
tarpayAmAsa somena hayamedheShu saptasu
shlokas.4:
tasya saptasu yaj~neShu sarvamAsIddhiraNmayam |
vAnaspatyaM cha bhaumaM cha yaddravyaM niyataM makhe
shlokas.5:
teShveva chAsya yaj~neShu prayogAH sapta vishrutAH |
saptaikaikasya yUpasya chaShAlAshchopari sthitAH
shlokas.6:
tasya sma yUpAnyaj~neShu bhrAjamAnAnhiraNmayAn |
svayamutthApayAmAsurdevAH sendrA yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
teShu tasya makhAgryeShu gayasya pRRithivIpateH |
amAdyadindraH somena dakShiNAbhirdvijAtayaH
shlokas.8:
sikatA vA yathA loke yathA vA divi tArakAH |
yathA vA varShato dhArA asa~NkhyeyAshcha kenachit
shlokas.9:
tathaiva tadasa~NkhyeyaM dhanaM yatpradadau gayaH |
sadasyebhyo mahArAja teShu yaj~neShu saptasu
shlokas.10:
bhavetsa~Nkhyeyametadvai yadetatparikIrtitam |
na sA shakyA tu sa~NkhyAtuM dakShiNA dakShiNAvataH
shlokas.11:
hiraNmayIbhirgobhishcha kRRitAbhirvishvakarmaNA |
brAhmaNA.nstarpayAmAsa nAnAdigbhyaH samAgatAn
shlokas.12:
alpAvasheShA pRRithivI chaityairAsInmahAtmanaH |
gayasya yajamAnasya tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.13:
sa lokAnprAptavAnaindrAnkarmaNA tena bhArata |
salokatAM tasya gachChetpayoShNyAM ya upaspRRishet
shlokas.14:
tasmAttvamatra rAjendra bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anagha |
upaspRRishya mahIpAla dhUtapApmA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa payoShNyAM narashreShThaH snAtvA vai bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
vaiDUryaparvataM chaiva narmadAM cha mahAnadIm
samAjagAma tejasvI bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anaghaH
