shlokas.16:
tato.asya sarvANyAchakhyau lomasho bhagavAnRRiShiH |
tIrthAni ramaNIyAni tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
yathAyogaM yathAprIti prayayau bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
dadamAno.asakRRidvittaM brAhmaNebhyaH sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
lomasha uvAcha||
devAnAmeti kaunteya tathA rAj~nAM salokatAm |
vaiDUryaparvataM dRRiShTvA narmadAmavatIrya cha
shlokas.19:
sandhireSha narashreShTha tretAyA dvAparasya cha |
etamAsAdya kaunteya sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.20:
eSha sharyAtiyaj~nasya deshastAta prakAshate |
sAkShAdyatrApibatsomamashvibhyAM saha kaushikaH
shlokas.21:
chukopa bhArgavashchApi mahendrasya mahAtapAH |
sa.nstambhayAmAsa cha taM vAsavaM chyavanaH prabhuH
sukanyAM chApi bhAryAM sa rAjaputrImivAptavAn
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM viShTambhitastena bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
kimarthaM bhArgavashchApi kopaM chakre mahAtapAH
shlokas.23:
nAsatyau cha kathaM brahmankRRitavAnsomapIthinau |
etatsarvaM yathAvRRittamAkhyAtu bhagavAnmama

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
bhRRigormaharSheH putro.abhUchchyavano nAma bhArgavaH |
samIpe sarasaH so.asya tapastepe mahAdyutiH
shlokas.2:
sthANubhUto mahAtejA vIrasthAnena pANDava |
atiShThatsubahUnkAlAnekadeshe vishAM pate
shlokas.3:
sa valmIko.abhavadRRiShirlatAbhirabhisa.nvRRitaH |
kAlena mahatA rAjansamAkIrNaH pipIlikaiH
shlokas.4:
tathA sa sa.nvRRito dhImAnmRRitpiNDa iva sarvashaH |
tapyati sma tapo rAjanvalmIkena samAvRRitaH
shlokas.5:
atha dIrghasya kAlasya sharyAtirnAma pArthivaH |
AjagAma saro ramyaM vihartumidamuttamam
shlokas.6:
tasya strINAM sahasrANi chatvAryAsanparigrahaH |
ekaiva cha sutA shubhrA sukanyA nAma bhArata
shlokas.7:
sA sakhIbhiH parivRRitA sarvAbharaNabhUShitA |
cha~NkramyamANA valmIkaM bhArgavasya samAsadat
shlokas.8:
sA chaiva sudatI tatra pashyamAnA manoramAn |
vanaspatInvichinvantI vijahAra sakhIvRRitA
shlokas.9:
rUpeNa vayasA chaiva madanena madena cha |
babha~nja vanavRRikShANAM shAkhAH paramapuShpitAH
shlokas.10:
tAM sakhIrahitAmekAmekavastrAmala~NkRRitAm |
dadarsha bhArgavo dhImA.nshcharantImiva vidyutam
shlokas.11:
tAM pashyamAno vijane sa reme paramadyutiH |
kShAmakaNThashcha brahmarShistapobalasamanvitaH
tAmAbabhAShe kalyANIM sA chAsya na shRRiNoti vai
shlokas.12:
tataH sukanyA valmIke dRRiShTvA bhArgavachakShuShI |
kautUhalAtkaNTakena buddhimohabalAtkRRitA
shlokas.13:
kiM nu khalvidamityuktvA nirbibhedAsya lochane |
akrudhyatsa tayA viddhe netre paramamanyumAn
tataH sharyAtisainyasya shakRRinmUtraM samAvRRiNot
shlokas.14:
tato ruddhe shakRRinmUtre sainyamAnAhaduHkhitam |
tathAgatamabhiprekShya paryapRRichChatsa pArthivaH
shlokas.15:
taponityasya vRRiddhasya roShaNasya visheShataH |
kenApakRRitamadyeha bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH
j~nAtaM vA yadi vAj~nAtaM tadRRitaM brUta mAchiram
shlokas.16:
tamUchuH sainikAH sarve na vidmo.apakRRitaM vayam |
sarvopAyairyathAkAmaM bhavA.nstadadhigachChatu
shlokas.17:
tataH sa pRRithivIpAlaH sAmnA chogreNa cha svayam |
paryapRRichChatsuhRRidvargaM pratyajAnanna chaiva te
shlokas.18:
AnAhArtaM tato dRRiShTvA tatsainyamasukhArditam |
pitaraM duHkhitaM chApi sukanyedamathAbravIt
shlokas.19:
mayATantyeha valmIke dRRiShTaM sattvamabhijvalat |
khadyotavadabhij~nAtaM tanmayA viddhamantikAt
shlokas.20:
etachChrutvA tu sharyAtirvalmIkaM tUrNamAdravat |
tatrApashyattapovRRiddhaM vayovRRiddhaM cha bhArgavam
shlokas.21:
ayAchadatha sainyArthaM prA~njaliH pRRithivIpatiH |
aj~nAnAdbAlayA yatte kRRitaM tatkShantumarhasi
shlokas.22:
tato.abravInmahIpAlaM chyavano bhArgavastadA |
rUpaudAryasamAyuktAM lobhamohabalAtkRRitAm
shlokas.23:
tAmeva pratigRRihyAhaM rAjanduhitaraM tava |
kShamiShyAmi mahIpAla satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.24:
RRiShervachanamAj~nAya sharyAtiravichArayan |
dadau duhitaraM tasmai chyavanAya mahAtmane
shlokas.25:
pratigRRihya cha tAM kanyAM chyavanaH prasasAda ha |
prAptaprasAdo rAjA sa sasainyaH punarAvrajat
shlokas.26:
sukanyApi patiM labdhvA tapasvinamaninditA |
nityaM paryacharatprItyA tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.27:
agnInAmatithInAM cha shushrUShuranasUyikA |
samArAdhayata kShipraM chyavanaM sA shubhAnanA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
kasyachittvatha kAlasya surANAmashvinau nRRipa |
kRRitAbhiShekAM vivRRitAM sukanyAM tAmapashyatAm
shlokas.2:
tAM dRRiShTvA darshanIyA~NgIM devarAjasutAmiva |
UchatuH samabhidrutya nAsatyAvashvinAvidam
shlokas.3:
kasya tvamasi vAmoru kiM vane vai karoShi cha |
ichChAva bhadre j~nAtuM tvAM tattvamAkhyAhi shobhane
shlokas.4:
tataH sukanyA sa.nvItA tAvuvAcha surottamau |
sharyAtitanayAM vittaM bhAryAM cha chyavanasya mAm
shlokas.5:
athAshvinau prahasyaitAmabrUtAM punareva tu |
kathaM tvamasi kalyANi pitrA dattA gatAdhvane
shlokas.6:
bhrAjase vanamadhye tvaM vidyutsaudAminI yathA |
na deveShvapi tulyAM hi tvayA pashyAva bhAmini
shlokas.7:
sarvAbharaNasampannA paramAmbaradhAriNI |
shobhethAstvanavadyA~Ngi na tvevaM malapa~NkinI
shlokas.8:
kasmAdeva.nvidhA bhUtvA jarAjarjaritaM patim |
tvamupAsse ha kalyANi kAmabhogabahiShkRRitam
shlokas.9:
asamarthaM paritrANe poShaNe cha shuchismite |
sAdhu chyavanamutsRRijya varayasvaikamAvayoH
patyarthaM devagarbhAbhe mA vRRithA yauvanaM kRRithAH
shlokas.10:
evamuktA sukanyA tu surau tAvidamabravIt |
ratAhaM chyavane patyau maivaM mA paryasha~NkithAH
shlokas.11:
tAvabrUtAM punastvenAmAvAM devabhiShagvarau |
yuvAnaM rUpasampannaM kariShyAvaH patiM tava
shlokas.12:
tatastasyAvayoshchaiva patimekatamaM vRRiNu |
etena samayenainamAmantraya varAnane
shlokas.13:
sA tayorvachanAdrAjannupasa~Ngamya bhArgavam |
uvAcha vAkyaM yattAbhyAmuktaM bhRRigusutaM prati
shlokas.14:
tachChrutvA chyavano bhAryAmuvAcha kriyatAmiti |
bhartrA sA samanuj~nAtA kriyatAmityathAbravIt
shlokas.15:
shrutvA tadashvinau vAkyaM tattasyAH kriyatAmiti |
UchatU rAjaputrIM tAM patistava vishatvapaH
shlokas.16:
tato.ambhashchyavanaH shIghraM rUpArthI pravivesha ha |
ashvinAvapi tadrAjansaraH pravishatAM prabho
shlokas.17:
tato muhUrtAduttIrNAH sarve te sarasastataH |
divyarUpadharAH sarve yuvAno mRRiShTakuNDalAH
tulyarUpadharAshchaiva manasaH prItivardhanAH
shlokas.18:
te.abruvansahitAH sarve vRRiNIShvAnyatamaM shubhe |
asmAkamIpsitaM bhadre patitve varavarNini
yatra vApyabhikAmAsi taM vRRiNIShva sushobhane
shlokas.19:
sA samIkShya tu tAnsarvA.nstulyarUpadharAnsthitAn |
nishchitya manasA buddhyA devI vavre svakaM patim
shlokas.20:
labdhvA tu chyavano bhAryAM vayorUpaM cha vA~nChitam |
hRRiShTo.abravInmahAtejAstau nAsatyAvidaM vachaH
shlokas.21:
yathAhaM rUpasampanno vayasA cha samanvitaH |
kRRito bhavadbhyAM vRRiddhaH sanbhAryAM cha prAptavAnimAm
shlokas.22:
tasmAdyuvAM kariShyAmi prItyAhaM somapIthinau |
miShato devarAjasya satyametadbravImi vAm
shlokas.23:
tachChrutvA hRRiShTamanasau divaM tau pratijagmatuH |
chyavano.api sukanyA cha surAviva vijahratuH

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
tataH shrutvA tu sharyAtirvayaHsthaM chyavanaM kRRitam |
saMhRRiShTaH senayA sArdhamupAyAdbhArgavAshramam
shlokas.2:
chyavanaM cha sukanyAM cha dRRiShTvA devasutAviva |
reme mahIpaH sharyAtiH kRRitsnAM prApya mahImiva
shlokas.3:
RRiShiNA satkRRitastena sabhAryaH pRRithivIpatiH |
upopaviShTaH kalyANIH kathAshchakre mahAmanAH
shlokas.4:
athainaM bhArgavo rAjannuvAcha parisAntvayan |
yAjayiShyAmi rAja.nstvAM sambhArAnupakalpaya
shlokas.5:
tataH paramasaMhRRiShTaH sharyAtiH pRRithivIpatiH |
chyavanasya mahArAja tadvAkyaM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.6:
prashaste.ahani yaj~nIye sarvakAmasamRRiddhimat |
kArayAmAsa sharyAtiryaj~nAyatanamuttamam
shlokas.7:
tatrainaM chyavano rAjanyAjayAmAsa bhArgavaH |
adbhutAni cha tatrAsanyAni tAni nibodha me
shlokas.8:
agRRihNAchchyavanaH somamashvinordevayostadA |
tamindro vArayAmAsa gRRihyamANaM tayorgraham
shlokas.9:
indra uvAcha||
ubhAvetau na somArhau nAsatyAviti me matiH |
bhiShajau devaputrANAM karmaNA naivamarhataH
shlokas.10:
chyavana uvAcha||
mAvama.nsthA mahAtmAnau rUpadraviNavattarau |
yau chakraturmAM maghavanvRRindArakamivAjaram
shlokas.11:
RRite tvAM vibudhA.nshchAnyAnkathaM vai nArhataH savam |
ashvinAvapi devendra devau viddhi pura.ndara
shlokas.12:
indra uvAcha||
chikitsakau karmakarau kAmarUpasamanvitau |
loke charantau martyAnAM kathaM somamihArhataH
shlokas.13:
lomasha uvAcha||
etadeva yadA vAkyamAmreDayati vAsavaH |
anAdRRitya tataH shakraM grahaM jagrAha bhArgavaH
shlokas.14:
grahIShyantaM tu taM somamashvinoruttamaM tadA |
samIkShya balabhiddeva idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
AbhyAmarthAya somaM tvaM grahIShyasi yadi svayam |
vajraM te prahariShyAmi ghorarUpamanuttamam
shlokas.16:
evamuktaH smayannindramabhivIkShya sa bhArgavaH |
jagrAha vidhivatsomamashvibhyAmuttamaM graham
shlokas.17:
tato.asmai prAharadvajraM ghorarUpaM shachIpatiH |
tasya praharato bAhuM stambhayAmAsa bhArgavaH
shlokas.18:
sa.nstambhayitvA chyavano juhuve mantrato.analam |
kRRityArthI sumahAtejA devaM hi.nsitumudyataH
shlokas.19:
tataH kRRityA samabhavadRRiShestasya tapobalAt |
mado nAma mahAvIryo bRRihatkAyo mahAsuraH
sharIraM yasya nirdeShTumashakyaM tu surAsuraiH
shlokas.20:
tasyAsyamabhavadghoraM tIkShNAgradashanaM mahat |
hanurekA sthitA tasya bhUmAvekA divaM gatA
shlokas.21:
chatasra AyatA daMShTrA yojanAnAM shataM shatam |
itare tvasya dashanA babhUvurdashayojanAH
prAkArasadRRishAkArAH shUlAgrasamadarshanAH
shlokas.22:
bAhU parvatasa~NkAshAvAyatAvayutaM samau |
netre ravishashiprakhye vaktramantakasaMnibham
shlokas.23:
leliha~njihvayA vaktraM vidyuchchapalalolayA |
vyAttAnano ghoradRRiShTirgrasanniva jagadbalAt
shlokas.24:
sa bhakShayiShyansa~NkruddhaH shatakratumupAdravat |
mahatA ghorarUpeNa lokA~nshabdena nAdayan

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
taM dRRiShTvA ghoravadanaM madaM devaH shatakratuH |
AyAntaM bhakShayiShyantaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam
shlokas.2:
bhayAtsa.nstambhitabhujaH sRRikkiNI lelihanmuhuH |
tato.abravIddevarAjashchyavanaM bhayapIDitaH
shlokas.3:
somArhAvashvinAvetAvadya prabhRRiti bhArgava |
bhaviShyataH satyametadvacho brahmanbravImi te
shlokas.4:
na te mithyA samArambho bhavatveSha paro vidhiH |
jAnAmi chAhaM viprarShe na mithyA tvaM kariShyasi
shlokas.5:
somArhAvashvinAvetau yathaivAdya kRRitau tvayA |
bhUya eva tu te vIryaM prakAshediti bhArgava
shlokas.6:
sukanyAyAH pitushchAsya loke kIrtiH prathediti |
ato mayaitadvihitaM tava vIryaprakAshanam
tasmAtprasAdaM kuru me bhavatvetadyathechChasi
shlokas.7:
evamuktasya shakreNa chyavanasya mahAtmanaH |
sa manyurvyagamachChIghraM mumocha cha pura.ndaram
shlokas.8:
madaM cha vyabhajadrAjanpAne strIShu cha vIryavAn |
akSheShu mRRigayAyAM cha pUrvasRRiShTaM punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
tathA madaM viniShkShipya shakraM santarpya chendunA |
ashvibhyAM sahitAndevAnyAjayitvA cha taM nRRipam
shlokas.10:
vikhyApya vIryaM sarveShu lokeShu vadatAM varaH |
sukanyayA sahAraNye vijahArAnuraktayA
shlokas.11:
tasyaitaddvijasa~NghuShTaM saro rAjanprakAshate |
atra tvaM saha sodaryaiH pitR^IndevA.nshcha tarpaya
shlokas.12:
etaddRRiShTvA mahIpAla sikatAkShaM cha bhArata |
saindhavAraNyamAsAdya kulyAnAM kuru darshanam
puShkareShu mahArAja sarveShu cha jalaM spRRisha
shlokas.13:
ArchIkaparvatashchaiva nivAso vai manIShiNAm |
sadAphalaH sadAsroto marutAM sthAnamuttamam
chaityAshchaite bahushatAstridashAnAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
etachchandramasastIrthamRRiShayaH paryupAsate |
vaikhAnasAshcha RRiShayo vAlakhilyAstathaiva cha
shlokas.15:
shRRi~NgANi trINi puNyANi trINi prasravaNAni cha |
sarvANyanuparikramya yathAkAmamupaspRRisha
shlokas.16:
shantanushchAtra kaunteya shunakashcha narAdhipa |
naranArAyaNau chobhau sthAnaM prAptAH sanAtanam
shlokas.17:
iha nityashayA devAH pitarashcha maharShibhiH |
ArchIkaparvate tepustAnyajasva yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
iha te vai charUnprAshnannRRiShayashcha vishAM pate |
yamunA chAkShayasrotAH kRRiShNashcheha taporataH
shlokas.19:
yamau cha bhImasenashcha kRRiShNA chAmitrakarshana |
sarve chAtra gamiShyAmaH sukRRishAH sutapasvinaH
shlokas.20:
etatprasravaNaM puNyamindrasya manujAdhipa |
yatra dhAtA vidhAtA cha varuNashchordhvamAgatAH
shlokas.21:
iha te nyavasanrAjankShAntAH paramadharmiNaH |
maitrANAmRRijubuddhInAmayaM girivaraH shubhaH
shlokas.22:
eShA sA yamunA rAjanrAjarShigaNasevitA |
nAnAyaj~nachitA rAjanpuNyA pApabhayApahA
shlokas.23:
atra rAjA maheShvAso mAndhAtAyajata svayam |
sahadevashcha kaunteya somako dadatAM varaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mAndhAtA rAjashArdUlastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
kathaM jAto mahAbrahmanyauvanAshvo nRRipottamaH
kathaM chaitAM parAM kAShThAM prAptavAnamitadyutiH
shlokas.2:
yasya lokAstrayo vashyA viShNoriva mahAtmanaH |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM charitaM tasya dhImataH
shlokas.3:
yathA mAndhAtRRishabdashcha tasya shakrasamadyuteH |
janma chAprativIryasya kushalo hyasi bhAShitum
shlokas.4:
lomasha uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAjanrAj~nastasya mahAtmanaH |
yathA mAndhAtRRishabdo vai lokeShu parigIyate
shlokas.5:
ikShvAkuva.nshaprabhavo yuvanAshvo mahIpatiH |
so.ayajatpRRithivIpAla kratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.6:
ashvamedhasahasraM cha prApya dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
anyaishcha kratubhirmukhyairvividhairAptadakShiNaiH
shlokas.7:
anapatyastu rAjarShiH sa mahAtmA dRRiDhavrataH |
mantriShvAdhAya tadrAjyaM vananityo babhUva ha
shlokas.8:
shAstradRRiShTena vidhinA sa.nyojyAtmAnamAtmanA |
pipAsAshuShkahRRidayaH praviveshAshramaM bhRRigoH
shlokas.9:
tAmeva rAtriM rAjendra mahAtmA bhRRigunandanaH |
iShTiM chakAra saudyumnermaharShiH putrakAraNAt
shlokas.10:
sambhRRito mantrapUtena vAriNA kalasho mahAn |
tatrAtiShThata rAjendra pUrvameva samAhitaH
yatprAshya prasavettasya patnI shakrasamaM sutam
shlokas.11:
taM nyasya vedyAM kalashaM suShupuste maharShayaH |
rAtrijAgaraNashrAntAH saudyumniH samatItya tAn
shlokas.12:
shuShkakaNThaH pipAsArtaH pANIyArthI bhRRishaM nRRipaH |
taM pravishyAshramaM shrAntaH pANIyaM so.abhyayAchata
shlokas.13:
tasya shrAntasya shuShkeNa kaNThena kroshatastadA |
nAshrauShItkashchana tadA shakuneriva vAshitam
shlokas.14:
tatastaM kalashaM dRRiShTvA jalapUrNaM sa pArthivaH |
abhyadravata vegena pItvA chAmbho vyavAsRRijat
shlokas.15:
sa pItvA shItalaM toyaM pipAsArto mahIpatiH |
nirvANamagamaddhImAnsusukhI chAbhavattadA
shlokas.16:
tataste pratyabudhyanta RRiShayaH sanarAdhipAH |
nistoyaM taM cha kalashaM dadRRishuH sarva eva te
shlokas.17:
kasya karmedamiti cha paryapRRichChansamAgatAH |
yuvanAshvo mayetyeva satyaM samabhipadyata
shlokas.18:
na yuktamiti taM prAha bhagavAnbhArgavastadA |
sutArthaM sthApitA hyApastapasA chaiva sambhRRitAH
shlokas.19:
mayA hyatrAhitaM brahma tapa AsthAya dAruNam |
putrArthaM tava rAjarShe mahAbalaparAkrama
shlokas.20:
mahAbalo mahAvIryastapobalasamanvitaH |
yaH shakramapi vIryeNa gamayedyamasAdanam
shlokas.21:
anena vidhinA rAjanmayaitadupapAditam |
abbhakShaNaM tvayA rAjannayuktaM kRRitamadya vai
shlokas.22:
na tvadya shakyamasmAbhiretatkartumato.anyathA |
nUnaM daivakRRitaM hyetadyadevaM kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.23:
pipAsitena yAH pItA vidhimantrapuraskRRitAH |
ApastvayA mahArAja mattapovIryasambhRRitAH
tAbhyastvamAtmanA putrameva.nvIryaM janiShyasi
shlokas.24:
vidhAsyAmo vayaM tatra taveShTiM paramAdbhutAm |
yathA shakrasamaM putraM janayiShyasi vIryavAn
shlokas.25:
tato varShashate pUrNe tasya rAj~no mahAtmanaH |
vAmaM pArshvaM vinirbhidya sutaH sUrya ivAparaH
shlokas.26:
nishchakrAma mahAtejA na cha taM mRRityurAvishat |
yuvanAshvaM narapatiM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.27:
tataH shakro mahAtejAstaM didRRikShurupAgamat |
pradeshinIM tato.asyAsye shakraH samabhisa.ndadhe
shlokas.28:
mAmayaM dhAsyatItyevaM paribhAShTaH sa vajriNA |
mAndhAteti cha nAmAsya chakruH sendrA divaukasaH
shlokas.29:
pradeshinIM shakradattAmAsvAdya sa shishustadA |
avardhata mahIpAla kiShkUNAM cha trayodasha
shlokas.30:
vedAstaM sadhanurvedA divyAnyastrANi cheshvaram |
upatasthurmahArAja dhyAtamAtrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.31:
dhanurAjagavaM nAma sharAH shRRi~NgodbhavAshcha ye |
abhedyaM kavachaM chaiva sadyastamupasa.nshrayan
shlokas.32:
so.abhiShikto maghavatA svayaM shakreNa bhArata |
dharmeNa vyajayallokA.nstrInviShNuriva vikramaiH
shlokas.33:
tasyApratihataM chakraM prAvartata mahAtmanaH |
ratnAni chaiva rAjarShiM svayamevopatasthire
shlokas.34:
tasyeyaM vasusampUrNA vasudhA vasudhAdhipa |
teneShTaM vividhairyaj~nairbahubhiH svAptadakShiNaiH
shlokas.35:
chitachaityo mahAtejA dharmaM prApya cha puShkalam |
shakrasyArdhAsanaM rAja.NllabdhavAnamitadyutiH
shlokas.36:
ekAhnA pRRithivI tena dharmanityena dhImatA |
nirjitA shAsanAdeva saratnAkarapattanA
shlokas.37:
tasya chityairmahArAja kratUnAM dakShiNAvatAm |
chaturantA mahI vyAptA nAsItki~nchidanAvRRitam
shlokas.38:
tena padmasahasrANi gavAM dasha mahAtmanA |
brAhmaNebhyo mahArAja dattAnIti prachakShate
shlokas.39:
tena dvAdashavArShikyAmanAvRRiShTyAM mahAtmanA |
vRRiShTaM sasyavivRRiddhyarthaM miShato vajrapANinaH
shlokas.40:
tena somakulotpanno gAndhArAdhipatirmahAn |
garjanniva mahAmeghaH pramathya nihataH sharaiH
shlokas.41:
prajAshchaturvidhAstena jitA rAjanmahAtmanA |
tenAtmatapasA lokAH sthApitAshchApi tejasA
shlokas.42:
tasyaitaddevayajanaM sthAnamAdityavarchasaH |
pashya puNyatame deshe kurukShetrasya madhyataH
shlokas.43:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM mAndhAtushcharitaM mahat |
janma chAgryaM mahIpAla yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
katha.nvIryaH sa rAjAbhUtsomako vadatAM vara |
karmANyasya prabhAvaM cha shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.2:
lomasha uvAcha||
yudhiShThirAsInnRRipatiH somako nAma dhArmikaH |
tasya bhAryAshataM rAjansadRRishInAmabhUttadA
shlokas.3:
sa vai yatnena mahatA tAsu putraM mahIpatiH |
ka~nchinnAsAdayAmAsa kAlena mahatA api
shlokas.4:
kadAchittasya vRRiddhasya yatamAnasya yatnataH |
janturnAma sutastasminstrIshate samajAyata
shlokas.5:
taM jAtaM mAtaraH sarvAH parivArya samAsate |
satataM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA kAmabhogAnvishAM pate
shlokas.6:
tataH pipIlikA jantuM kadAchidadashatsphiji |
sa daShTo vyanadadrAja.nstena duHkhena bAlakaH
shlokas.7:
tatastA mAtaraH sarvAH prAkroshanbhRRishaduHkhitAH |
parivArya jantuM sahitAH sa shabdastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.8:
tamArtanAdaM sahasA shushrAva sa mahIpatiH |
amAtyapariShanmadhye upaviShTaH sahartvijaiH
shlokas.9:
tataH prasthApayAmAsa kimetaditi pArthivaH |
tasmai kShattA yathAvRRittamAchachakShe sutaM prati
shlokas.10:
tvaramANaH sa chotthAya somakaH saha mantribhiH |
pravishyAntaHpuraM putramAshvAsayadari.ndamaH
shlokas.11:
sAntvayitvA tu taM putraM niShkramyAntaHpurAnnRRipaH |
RRitvijaiH sahito rAjansahAmAtya upAvishat
shlokas.12:
somaka uvAcha||
dhigastvihaikaputratvamaputratvaM varaM bhavet |
nityAturatvAdbhUtAnAM shoka evaikaputratA
shlokas.13:
idaM bhAryAshataM brahmanparIkShyopachitaM prabho |
putrArthinA mayA voDhaM na chAsAM vidyate prajA
shlokas.14:
ekaH katha~nchidutpannaH putro janturayaM mama |
yatamAnasya sarvAsu kiM nu duHkhamataH param
shlokas.15:
vayashcha samatItaM me sabhAryasya dvijottama |
AsAM prANAH samAyattA mama chAtraikaputrake
shlokas.16:
syAnnu karma tathA yuktaM yena putrashataM bhavet |
mahatA laghunA vApi karmaNA duShkareNa vA
shlokas.17:
RRitviguvAcha||
asti vai tAdRRishaM karma yena putrashataM bhavet |
yadi shaknoShi tatkartumatha vakShyAmi somaka
shlokas.18:
somaka uvAcha||
kAryaM vA yadi vAkAryaM yena putrashataM bhavet |
kRRitameva hi tadviddhi bhagavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.19:
RRitviguvAcha||
yajasva jantunA rAja.nstvaM mayA vitate kratau |
tataH putrashataM shrImadbhaviShyatyachireNa te
shlokas.20:
vapAyAM hUyamAnAyAM dhUmamAghrAya mAtaraH |
tatastAH sumahAvIryA~njanayiShyanti te sutAn
shlokas.21:
tasyAmeva tu te janturbhavitA punarAtmajaH |
uttare chAsya sauvarNaM lakShma pArshve bhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
somaka uvAcha||
brahmanyadyadyathA kAryaM tattatkuru tathA tathA |
putrakAmatayA sarvaM kariShyAmi vachastava
shlokas.2:
lomasha uvAcha||
tataH sa yAjayAmAsa somakaM tena jantunA |
mAtarastu balAtputramapAkarShuH kRRipAnvitAH
shlokas.3:
hA hatAH smeti vAshantyastIvrashokasamanvitAH |
taM mAtaraH pratyakarShangRRihItvA dakShiNe kare
savye pANau gRRihItvA tu yAjako.api sma karShati
shlokas.4:
kurarINAmivArtAnAmapAkRRiShya tu taM sutam |
vishasya chainaM vidhinA vapAmasya juhAva saH
shlokas.5:
vapAyAM hUyamAnAyAM gandhamAghrAya mAtaraH |
ArtA nipetuH sahasA pRRithivyAM kurunandana
sarvAshcha garbhAnalabha.nstatastAH pArthivA~NganAH
shlokas.6:
tato dashasu mAseShu somakasya vishAM pate |
jaj~ne putrashataM pUrNaM tAsu sarvAsu bhArata
shlokas.7:
janturjyeShThaH samabhavajjanitryAmeva bhArata |
sa tAsAmiShTa evAsInna tathAnye nijAH sutAH
shlokas.8:
tachcha lakShaNamasyAsItsauvarNaM pArshva uttare |
tasminputrashate chAgryaH sa babhUva guNairyutaH
shlokas.9:
tataH sa lokamagamatsomakasya guruH param |
atha kAle vyatIte tu somako.apyagamatparam
shlokas.10:
atha taM narake ghore pachyamAnaM dadarsha saH |
tamapRRichChatkimarthaM tvaM narake pachyase dvija
shlokas.11:
tamabravIdguruH so.atha pachyamAno.agninA bhRRisham |
tvaM mayA yAjito rAja.nstasyedaM karmaNaH phalam
shlokas.12:
etachChrutvA sa rAjarShirdharmarAjAnamabravIt |
ahamatra pravekShyAmi muchyatAM mama yAjakaH
matkRRite hi mahAbhAgaH pachyate narakAgninA
shlokas.13:
dharma uvAcha||
nAnyaH kartuH phalaM rAjannupabhu~Nkte kadAchana |
imAni tava dRRishyante phalAni dadatAM vara
shlokas.14:
somaka uvAcha||
puNyAnna kAmaye lokAnRRite.ahaM brahmavAdinam |
ichChAmyahamanenaiva saha vastuM surAlaye
shlokas.15:
narake vA dharmarAja karmaNAsya samo hyaham |
puNyApuNyaphalaM deva samamastvAvayoridam
shlokas.16:
dharma uvAcha||
yadyevamIpsitaM rAjanbhu~NkShvAsya sahitaH phalam |
tulyakAlaM sahAnena pashchAtprApsyasi sadgatim
shlokas.17:
lomasha uvAcha||
sa chakAra tathA sarvaM rAjA rAjIvalochanaH |
punashcha lebhe lokAnsvAnkarmaNA nirjitA~nshubhAn
saha tenaiva vipreNa guruNA sa gurupriyaH
shlokas.18:
eSha tasyAshramaH puNyo ya eSho.agre virAjate |
kShAnta uShyAtra ShaDrAtraM prApnoti sugatiM naraH
shlokas.19:
etasminnapi rAjendra vatsyAmo vigatajvarAH |
ShaDrAtraM niyatAtmAnaH sajjIbhava kurUdvaha

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
asminkila svayaM rAjanniShTavAnvai prajApatiH |
satramiShTIkRRitaM nAma purA varShasahasrikam
shlokas.2:
ambarIShashcha nAbhAga iShTavAnyamunAmanu |
yaj~naishcha tapasA chaiva parAM siddhimavApa saH
shlokas.3:
desho nAhuShayaj~nAnAmayaM puNyatamo nRRipa |
yatreShTvA dasha padmAni sadasyebhyo nisRRiShTavAn
shlokas.4:
sArvabhaumasya kaunteya yayAteramitaujasaH |
spardhamAnasya shakreNa pashyedaM yaj~navAstviha
shlokas.5:
pashya nAnAvidhAkArairagnibhirnichitAM mahIm |
majjantImiva chAkrAntAM yayAteryaj~nakarmabhiH
shlokas.6:
eShA shamyekapatrA sA sharakaM chaitaduttamam |
pashya rAmahradAnetAnpashya nArAyaNAshramam
shlokas.7:
etadArchIkaputrasya yogairvicharato mahIm |
apasarpaNaM mahIpAla raupyAyAmamitaujasaH
shlokas.8:
atrAnuva.nshaM paThataH shRRiNu me kurunandana |
ulUkhalairAbharaNaiH pishAchI yadabhAShata
shlokas.9:
yugandhare dadhi prAshya uShitvA chAchyutasthale |
tadvadbhUtilaye snAtvA saputrA vastumichChasi
shlokas.10:
ekarAtramuShitveha dvitIyaM yadi vatsyasi |
etadvai te divA vRRittaM rAtrau vRRittamato.anyathA
shlokas.11:
atrAdyAho nivatsyAmaH kShapAM bharatasattama |
dvArametaddhi kaunteya kurukShetrasya bhArata
shlokas.12:
atraiva nAhuSho rAjA rAjankratubhiriShTavAn |
yayAtirbahuratnADhyairyatrendro mudamabhyagAt
shlokas.13:
etatplakShAvataraNaM yamunAtIrthamuchyate |
etadvai nAkapRRiShThasya dvAramAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.14:
atra sArasvatairyaj~nairIjAnAH paramarShayaH |
yUpolUkhalinastAta gachChantyavabhRRithAplavam
shlokas.15:
atraiva bharato rAjA medhyamashvamavAsRRijat |
asakRRitkRRiShNasAra~NgaM dharmeNAvApya medinIm
shlokas.16:
atraiva puruShavyAghra maruttaH satramuttamam |
Aste devarShimukhyena sa.nvartenAbhipAlitaH
shlokas.17:
atropaspRRishya rAjendra sarvA.NllokAnprapashyati |
pUyate duShkRRitAchchaiva samupaspRRishya bhArata
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatra sabhrAtRRikaH snAtvA stUyamAno maharShibhiH |
lomashaM pANDavashreShTha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.19:
sarvA.NllokAnprapashyAmi tapasA satyavikrama |
ihasthaH pANDavashreShThaM pashyAmi shvetavAhanam
shlokas.20:
lomasha uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho pashyanti paramarShayaH |
sarasvatImimAM puNyAM pashyaikasharaNAvRRitAm
shlokas.21:
yatra snAtvA narashreShTha dhUtapApmA bhaviShyati |
iha sArasvatairyaj~nairiShTavantaH surarShayaH
RRiShayashchaiva kaunteya tathA rAjarShayo.api cha
shlokas.22:
vedI prajApatereShA samantAtpa~nchayojanA |
kurorvai yaj~nashIlasya kShetrametanmahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
iha martyAstapastaptvA svargaM gachChanti bhArata |
martukAmA narA rAjannihAyAnti sahasrashaH
shlokas.2:
evamAshIH prayuktA hi dakSheNa yajatA purA |
iha ye vai mariShyanti te vai svargajito narAH
shlokas.3:
eShA sarasvatI puNyA divyA choghavatI nadI |
etadvinashanaM nAma sarasvatyA vishAM pate
shlokas.4:
dvAraM niShAdarAShTrasya yeShAM dveShAtsarasvatI |
praviShTA pRRithivIM vIra mA niShAdA hi mAM viduH
shlokas.5:
eSha vai chamasodbhedo yatra dRRishyA sarasvatI |
yatrainAmabhyavartanta divyAH puNyAH samudragAH
shlokas.6:
etatsindhormahattIrthaM yatrAgastyamari.ndama |
lopAmudrA samAgamya bhartAramavRRiNIta vai
shlokas.7:
etatprabhAsate tIrthaM prabhAsaM bhAskaradyute |
indrasya dayitaM puNyaM pavitraM pApanAshanam
shlokas.8:
etadviShNupadaM nAma dRRishyate tIrthamuttamam |
eShA ramyA vipAshA cha nadI paramapAvanI
shlokas.9:
atraiva putrashokena vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH |
baddhvAtmAnaM nipatito vipAshaH punarutthitaH
shlokas.10:
kAshmIramaNDalaM chaitatsarvapuNyamari.ndama |
maharShibhishchAdhyuShitaM pashyedaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.11:
atrottarANAM sarveShAmRRiShINAM nAhuShasya cha |
agneshchAtraiva sa.nvAdaH kAshyapasya cha bhArata
shlokas.12:
etaddvAraM mahArAja mAnasasya prakAshate |
varShamasya girermadhye rAmeNa shrImatA kRRitam
shlokas.13:
eSha vAtikaShaNDo vai prakhyAtaH satyavikramaH |
nAbhyavartata yaddvAraM videhAnuttaraM cha yaH
shlokas.14:
eSha ujjAnako nAma yavakrIryatra shAntavAn |
arundhatIsahAyashcha vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.15:
hradashcha kushavAneSha yatra padmaM kusheshayam |
Ashramashchaiva rukmiNyA yatrAshAmyadakopanA
shlokas.16:
samAdhInAM samAsastu pANDaveya shrutastvayA |
taM drakShyasi mahArAja bhRRigutu~NgaM mahAgirim
shlokas.17:
jalAM chopajalAM chaiva yamunAmabhito nadIm |
ushInaro vai yatreShTvA vAsavAdatyarichyata
shlokas.18:
tAM devasamitiM tasya vAsavashcha vishAM pate |
abhyagachChata rAjAnaM j~nAtumagnishcha bhArata
shlokas.19:
jij~nAsamAnau varadau mahAtmAnamushInaram |
indraH shyenaH kapoto.agnirbhUtvA yaj~ne.abhijagmatuH
shlokas.20:
UruM rAj~naH samAsAdya kapotaH shyenajAdbhayAt |
sharaNArthI tadA rAjannililye bhayapIDitaH

shlokas.1:
shyena uvAcha||
dharmAtmAnaM tvAhurekaM sarve rAjanmahIkShitaH |
sa vai dharmaviruddhaM tvaM kasmAtkarma chikIrShasi
shlokas.2:
vihitaM bhakShaNaM rAjanpIDyamAnasya me kShudhA |
mA bhA~NkShIrdharmalobhena dharmamutsRRiShTavAnasi
shlokas.3:
rAjovAcha||
santrastarUpastrANArthI tvatto bhIto mahAdvija |
matsakAshamanuprAptaH prANagRRidhnurayaM dvijaH
shlokas.4:
evamabhyAgatasyeha kapotasyAbhayArthinaH |
apradAne paro.adharmaH kiM tvaM shyena prapashyasi
shlokas.5:
praspandamAnaH sambhrAntaH kapotaH shyena lakShyate |
matsakAshaM jIvitArthI tasya tyAgo vigarhitaH
shlokas.6:
shyena uvAcha||
AhArAtsarvabhUtAni sambhavanti mahIpate |
AhAreNa vivardhante tena jIvanti jantavaH
shlokas.7:
shakyate dustyaje.apyarthe chirarAtrAya jIvitum |
na tu bhojanamutsRRijya shakyaM vartayituM chiram
shlokas.8:
bhakShyAdvilopitasyAdya mama prANA vishAM pate |
visRRijya kAyameShyanti panthAnamapunarbhavam
shlokas.9:
pramRRite mayi dharmAtmanputradAraM nashiShyati |
rakShamANaH kapotaM tvaM bahUnprANAnnashiShyasi
shlokas.10:
dharmaM yo bAdhate dharmo na sa dharmaH kudharma tat |
avirodhI tu yo dharmaH sa dharmaH satyavikrama
shlokas.11:
virodhiShu mahIpAla nishchitya gurulAghavam |
na bAdhA vidyate yatra taM dharmaM samudAcharet
shlokas.12:
gurulAghavamAj~nAya dharmAdharmavinishchaye |
yato bhUyA.nstato rAjankuru dharmavinishchayam
shlokas.13:
rAjovAcha||
bahukalyANasa.nyuktaM bhAShase vihagottama |
suparNaH pakShirATkiM tvaM dharmaj~nashchAsyasa.nshayam
tathA hi dharmasa.nyuktaM bahu chitraM prabhAShase
shlokas.14:
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchiditi tvA lakShayAmyaham |
sharaNaiShiNaH parityAgaM kathaM sAdhviti manyase
shlokas.15:
AhArArthaM samArambhastava chAyaM viha~Ngama |
shakyashchApyanyathA kartumAhAro.apyadhikastvayA
shlokas.16:
govRRiSho vA varAho vA mRRigo vA mahiSho.api vA |
tvadarthamadya kriyatAM yadvAnyadabhikA~NkShase
shlokas.17:
shyena uvAcha||
na varAhaM na chokShANaM na mRRigAnvividhA.nstathA |
bhakShayAmi mahArAja kimannAdyena tena me
shlokas.18:
yastu me daivavihito bhakShaH kShatriyapu~Ngava |
tamutsRRija mahIpAla kapotamimameva me
shlokas.19:
shyenAH kapotAnkhAdanti sthitireShA sanAtanI |
mA rAjanmArgamAj~nAya kadalIskandhamAruha
shlokas.20:
rAjovAcha||
rAjyaM shibInAmRRiddhaM vai shAdhi pakShigaNArchita |
yadvA kAmayase ki~nchichChyena sarvaM dadAni te
vinemaM pakShiNaM shyena sharaNArthinamAgatam
shlokas.21:
yenemaM varjayethAstvaM karmaNA pakShisattama |
tadAchakShva kariShyAmi na hi dAsye kapotakam
shlokas.22:
shyena uvAcha||
ushInara kapote te yadi sneho narAdhipa |
Atmano mA.nsamutkRRitya kapotatulayA dhRRitam
shlokas.23:
yadA samaM kapotena tava mA.nsaM bhavennRRipa |
tadA pradeyaM tanmahyaM sA me tuShTirbhaviShyati
shlokas.24:
rAjovAcha||
anugrahamimaM manye shyena yanmAbhiyAchase |
tasmAtte.adya pradAsyAmi svamA.nsaM tulayA dhRRitam
shlokas.25:
lomasha uvAcha||
athotkRRitya svamA.nsaM tu rAjA paramadharmavit |
tulayAmAsa kaunteya kapotena sahAbhibho
shlokas.26:
dhriyamANastu tulayA kapoto vyatirichyate |
punashchotkRRitya mA.nsAni rAjA prAdAdushInaraH
shlokas.27:
na vidyate yadA mA.nsaM kapotena samaM dhRRitam |
tata utkRRittamA.nso.asAvAruroha svayaM tulAm
shlokas.28:
shyena uvAcha||
indro.ahamasmi dharmaj~na kapoto havyavADayam |
jij~nAsamAnau dharme tvAM yaj~navATamupAgatau
shlokas.29:
yatte mA.nsAni gAtrebhya utkRRittAni vishAM pate |
eShA te bhAsvarI kIrtirlokAnabhibhaviShyati
shlokas.30:
yAvalloke manuShyAstvAM kathayiShyanti pArthiva |
tAvatkIrtishcha lokAshcha sthAsyanti tava shAshvatAH
shlokas.31:
lomasha uvAcha||
tatpANDaveya sadanaM rAj~nastasya mahAtmanaH |
pashyasvaitanmayA sArdhaM puNyaM pApapramochanam
shlokas.32:
atra vai satataM devA munayashcha sanAtanAH |
dRRishyante brAhmaNai rAjanpuNyavadbhirmahAtmabhiH

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
yaH kathyate mantravidagryabuddhi;rauddAlakiH shvetaketuH pRRithivyAm |
tasyAshramaM pashya narendra puNyaM; sadAphalairupapannaM mahIjaiH
shlokas.2:
sAkShAdatra shvetaketurdadarsha; sarasvatIM mAnuShadeharUpAm |
vetsyAmi vANImiti sampravRRittAM; sarasvatIM shvetaketurbabhAShe
shlokas.3:
tasminkAle brahmavidAM variShThA;vAstAM tadA mAtulabhAgineyau |
aShTAvakrashchaiva kahoDasUnu;rauddAlakiH shvetaketushcha rAjan
shlokas.4:
videharAjasya mahIpatestau; viprAvubhau mAtulabhAgineyau |
pravishya yaj~nAyatanaM vivAde; bandiM nijagrAhaturaprameyam
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathamprabhAvaH sa babhUva vipra;stathAyuktaM yo nijagrAha bandim |
aShTAvakraH kena chAsau babhUva; tatsarvaM me lomasha sha.nsa tattvam
shlokas.6:
lomasha uvAcha||
uddAlakasya niyataH shiShya eko; nAmnA kahoDeti babhUva rAjan |
shushrUShurAchAryavashAnuvartI; dIrghaM kAlaM so.adhyayanaM chakAra
shlokas.7:
taM vai viprAH paryabhava.nshcha shiShyA;staM cha j~nAtvA viprakAraM guruH saH |
tasmai prAdAtsadya eva shrutaM cha; bhAryAM cha vai duhitaraM svAM sujAtAm
shlokas.8:
tasyA garbhaH samabhavadagnikalpaH; so.adhIyAnaM pitaramathAbhyuvAcha |
sarvAM rAtrimadhyayanaM karoShi; nedaM pitaH samyagivopavartate
shlokas.9:
upAlabdhaH shiShyamadhye maharShiH; sa taM kopAdudarasthaM shashApa |
yasmAtkukShau vartamAno bravIShi; tasmAdvakro bhavitAsyaShTakRRitvaH
shlokas.10:
sa vai tathA vakra evAbhyajAya;daShTAvakraH prathito vai maharShiH |
tasyAsIdvai mAtulaH shvetaketuH; sa tena tulyo vayasA babhUva
shlokas.11:
sampIDyamAnA tu tadA sujAtA; vivardhamAnena sutena kukShau |
uvAcha bhartAramidaM rahogatA; prasAdya hInaM vasunA dhanArthinI
shlokas.12:
kathaM kariShyAmyadhanA maharShe; mAsashchAyaM dashamo vartate me |
na chAsti te vasu ki~nchitprajAtA; yenAhametAmApadaM nistareyam
shlokas.13:
uktastvevaM bhAryayA vai kahoDo; vittasyArthe janakamathAbhyagachChat |
sa vai tadA vAdavidA nigRRihya; nimajjito bandinehApsu vipraH
shlokas.14:
uddAlakastaM tu tadA nishamya; sUtena vAde.apsu tathA nimajjitam |
uvAcha tAM tatra tataH sujAtA;maShTAvakre gUhitavyo.ayamarthaH
shlokas.15:
rarakSha sA chApyati taM sumantraM; jAto.apyevaM na sa shushrAva vipraH |
uddAlakaM pitRRivachchApi mene; aShTAvakro bhrAtRRivachChvetaketum
shlokas.16:
tato varShe dvAdashe shvetaketu;raShTAvakraM pitura~Nke nisannam |
apAkarShadgRRihya pANau rudantaM; nAyaM tavA~NkaH piturityuktavA.nshcha
shlokas.17:
yattenoktaM duruktaM tattadAnIM; hRRidi sthitaM tasya suduHkhamAsIt |
gRRihaM gatvA mAtaraM rodamAnaH; paprachChedaM kva nu tAto mameti
shlokas.18:
tataH sujAtA paramArtarUpA; shApAdbhItA sarvamevAchachakShe |
tadvai tattvaM sarvamAj~nAya mAtu;rityabravIchChvetaketuM sa vipraH
shlokas.19:
gachChAva yaj~naM janakasya rAj~no; bahvAshcharyaH shrUyate tasya yaj~naH |
shroShyAvo.atra brAhmaNAnAM vivAda;mannaM chAgryaM tatra bhokShyAvahe cha
vichakShaNatvaM cha bhaviShyate nau; shivashcha saumyashcha hi brahmaghoShaH
shlokas.20:
tau jagmaturmAtulabhAgineyau; yaj~naM samRRiddhaM janakasya rAj~naH |
aShTAvakraH pathi rAj~nA sametya; utsAryamANo vAkyamidaM jagAda

shlokas.1:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
andhasya panthA badhirasya panthAH; striyaH panthA vaivadhikasya panthAH |
rAj~naH panthA brAhmaNenAsametya; sametya tu brAhmaNasyaiva panthAH
shlokas.2:
rAjovAcha||
panthA ayaM te.adya mayA nisRRiShTo; yenechChase tena kAmaM vrajasva |
na pAvako vidyate vai laghIyA;nindro.api nityaM namate brAhmaNAnAm
shlokas.3:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
yaj~naM draShTuM prAptavantau sva tAta; kautUhalaM nau balavadvai vivRRiddham |
AvAM prAptAvatithI sampraveshaM; kA~NkShAvahe dvArapate tavAj~nAm
shlokas.4:
aindradyumneryaj~nadRRishAvihAvAM; vivakShU vai janakendraM didRRikShU |
na vai krodhAdvyAdhinaivottamena; sa.nyojaya dvArapAla kShaNena
shlokas.5:
dvArapAla uvAcha||
bandeH samAdeshakarA vayaM sma; nibodha vAkyaM cha mayeryamANam |
na vai bAlAH pravishantyatra viprA; vRRiddhA vidvA.nsaH pravishanti dvijAgryAH
shlokas.6:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
yadyatra vRRiddheShu kRRitaH pravesho; yuktaM mama dvArapAla praveShTum |
vayaM hi vRRiddhAshcharitavratAshcha; vedaprabhAvena praveshanArhAH
shlokas.7:
shushrUShavashchApi jitendriyAshcha; j~nAnAgame chApi gatAH sma niShThAm |
na bAla ityavamantavyamAhu;rbAlo.apyagnirdahati spRRishyamAnaH
shlokas.8:
dvArapAla uvAcha||
sarasvatImIraya vedajuShTA;mekAkSharAM bahurUpAM virAjam |
a~NgAtmAnaM samavekShasva bAlaM; kiM shlAghase durlabhA vAdasiddhiH
shlokas.9:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
na j~nAyate kAyavRRiddhyA vivRRiddhi;ryathAShThIlA shAlmaleH sampravRRiddhA |
hrasvo.alpakAyaH phalito vivRRiddho; yashchAphalastasya na vRRiddhabhAvaH
shlokas.10:
dvArapAla uvAcha||
vRRiddhebhya eveha matiM sma bAlA; gRRihNanti kAlena bhavanti vRRiddhAH |
na hi j~nAnamalpakAlena shakyaM; kasmAdbAlo vRRiddha ivAvabhAShase
shlokas.11:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
na tena sthaviro bhavati yenAsya palitaM shiraH |
bAlo.api yaH prajAnAti taM devAH sthaviraM viduH
shlokas.12:
na hAyanairna palitairna vittena na bandhubhiH |
RRiShayashchakrire dharmaM yo.anUchAnaH sa no mahAn
shlokas.13:
didRRikShurasmi samprApto bandinaM rAjasa.nsadi |
nivedayasva mAM dvAHstha rAj~ne puShkaramAline
shlokas.14:
draShTAsyadya vadato dvArapAla; manIShibhiH saha vAde vivRRiddhe |
utAho vApyuchchatAM nIchatAM vA; tUShNIM bhUteShvatha sarveShu chAdya
shlokas.15:
dvArapAla uvAcha||
kathaM yaj~naM dashavarSho vishestvaM; vinItAnAM viduShAM sampraveshyam |
upAyataH prayatiShye tavAhaM; praveshane kuru yatnaM yathAvat
shlokas.16:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
bho bho rAja~njanakAnAM variShTha; sabhAjyastvaM tvayi sarvaM samRRiddham |
tvaM vA kartA karmaNAM yaj~niyAnAM; yayAtireko nRRipatirvA purastAt
shlokas.17:
vidvAnbandI vedavido nigRRihya; vAde bhagnAnapratisha~NkamAnaH |
tvayA nisRRiShTaiH puruShairAptakRRidbhi;rjale sarvAnmajjayatIti naH shrutam
shlokas.18:
sa tachChrutvA brAhmaNAnAM sakAshA;dbrahmodyaM vai kathayitumAgato.asmi |
kvAsau bandI yAvadenaM sametya; nakShatrANIva savitA nAshayAmi
shlokas.19:
rAjovAcha||
Asha.nsase bandinaM tvaM vijetu;mavij~nAtvA vAkyabalaM parasya |
vij~nAtavIryaiH shakyamevaM pravaktuM; dRRiShTashchAsau brAhmaNairvAdashIlaiH
shlokas.20:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
vivAdito.asau na hi mAdRRishairhi; siMhIkRRitastena vadatyabhItaH |
sametya mAM nihataH sheShyate.adya; mArge bhagnaM shakaTamivAbalAkSham
shlokas.21:
rAjovAcha||
ShaNNAbherdvAdashAkShasya chaturvi.nshatiparvaNaH |
yastriShaShTishatArasya vedArthaM sa paraH kaviH
shlokas.22:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
chaturvi.nshatiparva tvAM ShaNNAbhi dvAdashapradhi |
tattriShaShTishatAraM vai chakraM pAtu sadAgati
shlokas.23:
rAjovAcha||
vaDave iva sa.nyukte shyenapAte divaukasAm |
kastayorgarbhamAdhatte garbhaM suShuvatushcha kam
shlokas.24:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
mA sma te te gRRihe rAja~nshAtravANAmapi dhruvam |
vAtasArathirAdhatte garbhaM suShuvatushcha tam
shlokas.25:
rAjovAcha||
kiM svitsuptaM na nimiShati kiM svijjAtaM na chopati |
kasya sviddhRRidayaM nAsti kiM svidvegena vardhate
shlokas.26:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
matsyaH supto na nimiShatyaNDaM jAtaM na chopati |
ashmano hRRidayaM nAsti nadI vegena vardhate
shlokas.27:
rAjovAcha||
na tvA manye mAnuShaM devasattvaM; na tvaM bAlaH sthavirastvaM mato me |
na te tulyo vidyate vAkpralApe; tasmAddvAraM vitarAmyeSha bandI

shlokas.1:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
atrograsenasamiteShu rAja;nsamAgateShvapratimeShu rAjasu |
na vai vivitsAntaramasti vAdinAM; mahAjale ha.nsaninAdinAmiva
shlokas.2:
na me.adya vakShyasyativAdimAni;nglahaM prapannaH saritAmivAgamaH |
hutAshanasyeva samiddhatejasaH; sthiro bhavasveha mamAdya bandin
shlokas.3:
bandyuvAcha||
vyAghraM shayAnaM prati mA prabodhaya; AshIviShaM sRRikkiNI lelihAnam |
padAhatasyeva shiro.abhihatya; nAdaShTo vai mokShyase tannibodha
shlokas.4:
yo vai darpAtsaMhananopapannaH; sudurbalaH parvatamAvihanti |
tasyaiva pANiH sanakho vishIryate; na chaiva shailasya hi dRRishyate vraNaH
shlokas.5:
sarve rAj~no maithilasya mainAkasyeva parvatAH |
nikRRiShTabhUtA rAjAno vatsA anaduho yathA
shlokas.6:
lomasha uvAcha||
aShTAvakraH samitau garjamAno; jAtakrodho bandinamAha rAjan |
ukte vAkye chottaraM me bravIhi; vAkyasya chApyuttaraM te bravImi
shlokas.7:
bandyuvAcha||
eka evAgnirbahudhA samidhyate; ekaH sUryaH sarvamidaM prabhAsate |
eko vIro devarAjo nihantA; yamaH pitR^INAmIshvarashchaika eva
shlokas.8:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
dvAvindrAgnI charato vai sakhAyau; dvau devarShI nAradaH parvatashcha |
dvAvashvinau dve cha rathasya chakre; bhAryApatI dvau vihitau vidhAtrA
shlokas.9:
bandyuvAcha||
triH sUyate karmaNA vai prajeyaM; trayo yuktA vAjapeyaM vahanti |
adhvaryavastriShavaNAni tanvate; trayo lokAstrINi jyotIMShi chAhuH
shlokas.10:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
chatuShTayaM brAhmaNAnAM niketaM; chatvAro yuktA yaj~namimaM vahanti |
dishashchatasrashchaturashcha varNA;shchatuShpadA gaurapi shashvaduktA
shlokas.11:
bandyuvAcha||
pa~nchAgnayaH pa~nchapadA cha pa~Nkti;ryaj~nAH pa~nchaivApyatha pa~nchendriyANi |
dRRiShTA vede pa~nchachUDAshcha pa~ncha; loke khyAtaM pa~nchanadaM cha puNyam
shlokas.12:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
ShaDAdhAne dakShiNAmAhureke; ShaDeveme RRitavaH kAlachakram |
ShaDindriyANyuta ShaTkRRittikAshcha; ShaTsAdyaskAH sarvavedeShu dRRiShTAH
shlokas.13:
bandyuvAcha||
sapta grAmyAH pashavaH sapta vanyAH; sapta ChandA.nsi kratumekaM vahanti |
saptarShayaH sapta chApyarhaNAni; saptatantrI prathitA chaiva vINA
shlokas.14:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
aShTau shANAH shatamAnaM vahanti; tathAShTapAdaH sharabhaH siMhaghAtI |
aShTau vasU~nshushruma devatAsu; yUpashchAShTAsrirvihitaH sarvayaj~naH
shlokas.15:
bandyuvAcha||
navaivoktAH sAmidhenyaH pitR^INAM; tathA prAhurnavayogaM viShargam |
navAkSharA bRRihatI sampradiShTA; navayogo gaNanAmeti shashvat
shlokas.16:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
dashA dashoktAH puruShasya loke; sahasramAhurdasha pUrNaM shatAni |
dashaiva mAsAnbibhrati garbhavatyo; dasherakA dasha dAshA dashArNAH
shlokas.17:
bandyuvAcha||
ekAdashaikAdashinaH pashUnA;mekAdashaivAtra bhavanti yUpAH |
ekAdasha prANabhRRitAM vikArA; ekAdashoktA divi deveShu rudrAH
shlokas.18:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
sa.nvatsaraM dvAdasha mAsamAhu;rjagatyAH pAdo dvAdashaivAkSharANi |
dvAdashAhaH prAkRRito yaj~na ukto; dvAdashAdityAnkathayantIha viprAH
shlokas.20:
bandyuvAcha||
trayodashI tithiruktA mahogrA; trayodashadvIpavatI mahI cha |
lomasha uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA virarAma bandI; shlokasyArdhaM vyAjahArAShTavakraH |
trayodashAhAni sasAra keshI; trayodashAdInyatichChandA.nsi chAhuH
shlokas.21:
tato mahAnudatiShThanninAda;stUShNImbhUtaM sUtaputraM nishamya |
adhomukhaM dhyAnaparaM tadAnI;maShTAvakraM chApyudIryantameva
shlokas.22:
tasmi.nstathA sa~Nkule vartamAne; sphIte yaj~ne janakasyAtha rAj~naH |
aShTAvakraM pUjayanto.abhyupeyu;rviprAH sarve prA~njalayaH pratItAH
shlokas.23:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
anena vai brAhmaNAH shushruvA.nso; vAde jitvA salile majjitAH kila |
tAneva dharmAnayamadya bandI; prApnotu gRRihyApsu nimajjayainam
shlokas.24:
bandyuvAcha||
ahaM putro varuNasyota rAj~na;statrAsa satraM dvAdashavArShikaM vai |
satreNa te janaka tulyakAlaM; tadarthaM te prahitA me dvijAgryAH
shlokas.25:
ete sarve varuNasyota yaj~naM; draShTuM gatA iha AyAnti bhUyaH |
aShTAvakraM pUjaye pUjanIyaM; yasya hetorjanitAraM sameShye
shlokas.26:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
viprAH samudrAmbhasi majjitAste; vAchA jitA medhayA AvidAnAH |
tAM medhayA vAchamathojjahAra; yathA vAchamavachinvanti santaH
shlokas.27:
agnirdaha~njAtavedAH satAM gRRihA;nvisarjaya.nstejasA na sma dhAkShIt |
bAleShu putreShu kRRipaNaM vadatsu; tathA vAchamavachinvanti santaH
shlokas.28:
shleShmAtakI kShINavarchAH shRRiNoShi; utAho tvAM stutayo mAdayanti |
hastIva tvaM janaka vitudyamAno; na mAmikAM vAchamimAM shRRiNoShi
shlokas.29:
janaka uvAcha||
shRRiNomi vAchaM tava divyarUpA;mamAnuShIM divyarUpo.asi sAkShAt |
ajaiShIryadbandinaM tvaM vivAde; nisRRiShTa eSha tava kAmo.adya bandI
shlokas.30:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
nAnena jIvatA kashchidartho me bandinA nRRipa |
pitA yadyasya varuNo majjayainaM jalAshaye
shlokas.31:
bandyuvAcha||
ahaM putro varuNasyota rAj~no; na me bhayaM salile majjitasya |
imaM muhUrtaM pitaraM drakShyate.aya;maShTAvakrashchiranaShTaM kahoDam
shlokas.32:
lomasha uvAcha||
tataste pUjitA viprA varuNena mahAtmanA |
udatiShThanta te sarve janakasya samIpataH
shlokas.33:
kahoDa uvAcha||
ityarthamichChanti sutA~njanA janaka karmaNA |
yadahaM nAshakaM kartuM tatputraH kRRitavAnmama
shlokas.34:
utAbalasya balavAnuta bAlasya paNDitaH |
uta vAviduSho vidvAnputro janaka jAyate
shlokas.35:
bandyuvAcha||
shitena te parashunA svayamevAntako nRRipa |
shirA.nsyapAharatvAjau ripUNAM bhadramastu te
shlokas.36:
mahadukthyaM gIyate sAma chAgryaM; samyaksomaH pIyate chAtra satre |
shuchInbhAgAnpratijagRRihushcha hRRiShTAH; sAkShAddevA janakasyeha yaj~ne
shlokas.37:
lomasha uvAcha||
samutthiteShvatha sarveShu rAja;nvipreShu teShvadhikaM suprabheShu |
anuj~nAto janakenAtha rAj~nA; vivesha toyaM sAgarasyota bandI
shlokas.38:
aShTAvakraH pitaraM pUjayitvA; sampUjito brAhmaNaistairyathAvat |
pratyAjagAmAshramameva chAgryaM; jitvA bandiM sahito mAtulena
shlokas.39:
atra kaunteya sahito bhrAtRRibhistvaM; sukhoShitaH saha vipraiH pratItaH |
puNyAnyanyAni shuchikarmaikabhakti;rmayA sArdhaM charitAsyAjamIDha

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
eShA madhuvilA rAjansama~NgA samprakAshate |
etatkardamilaM nAma bharatasyAbhiShechanam
shlokas.2:
alakShmyA kila sa.nyukto vRRitraM hatvA shachIpatiH |
AplutaH sarvapApebhyaH sama~NgAyAM vyamuchyata
shlokas.3:
etadvinashanaM kukShau mainAkasya nararShabha |
aditiryatra putrArthaM tadannamapachatpurA
shlokas.4:
enaM parvatarAjAnamAruhya puruSharShabha |
ayashasyAmasa.nshabdyAmalakShmIM vyapanotsyatha
shlokas.5:
ete kanakhalA rAjanRRiShINAM dayitA nagAH |
eShA prakAshate ga~NgA yudhiShThira mahAnadI
shlokas.6:
sanatkumAro bhagavAnatra siddhimagAtparAm |
AjamIDhAvagAhyainAM sarvapApaiH pramokShyase
shlokas.7:
apAM hradaM cha puNyAkhyaM bhRRigutu~NgaM cha parvatam |
tUShNIM ga~NgAM cha kaunteya sAmAtyaH samupaspRRisha
shlokas.8:
AshramaH sthUlashiraso ramaNIyaH prakAshate |
atra mAnaM cha kaunteya krodhaM chaiva vivarjaya
shlokas.9:
eSha raibhyAshramaH shrImAnpANDaveya prakAshate |
bhAradvAjo yatra kaviryavakrIto vyanashyata
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
katha.nyukto.abhavadRRiShirbharadvAjaH pratApavAn |
kimarthaM cha yavakrIta RRiShiputro vyanashyata
shlokas.11:
etatsarvaM yathAvRRittaM shrotumichChAmi lomasha |
karmabhirdevakalpAnAM kIrtyamAnairbhRRishaM rame
shlokas.12:
lomasha uvAcha||
bharadvAjashcha raibhyashcha sakhAyau sambabhUvatuH |
tAvUShaturihAtyantaM prIyamANau vanAntare
shlokas.13:
raibhyasya tu sutAvAstAmarvAvasuparAvasU |
AsIdyavakrIH putrastu bharadvAjasya bhArata
shlokas.14:
raibhyo vidvAnsahApatyastapasvI chetaro.abhavat |
tayoshchApyatulA prItirbAlyAtprabhRRiti bhArata
shlokas.15:
yavakrIH pitaraM dRRiShTvA tapasvinamasatkRRitam |
dRRiShTvA cha satkRRitaM viprai raibhyaM putraiH sahAnagha
shlokas.16:
paryatapyata tejasvI manyunAbhipariplutaH |
tapastepe tato ghoraM vedaj~nAnAya pANDava
shlokas.17:
susamiddhe mahatyagnau sharIramupatApayan |
janayAmAsa santApamindrasya sumahAtapAH
shlokas.18:
tata indro yavakrItamupagamya yudhiShThira |
abravItkasya hetostvamAsthitastapa uttamam
shlokas.19:
yavakrIruvAcha||
dvijAnAmanadhItA vai vedAH suragaNArchita |
pratibhAntviti tapye.ahamidaM paramakaM tapaH
shlokas.20:
svAdhyAyArthe samArambho mamAyaM pAkashAsana |
tapasA j~nAtumichChAmi sarvaj~nAnAni kaushika
shlokas.21:
kAlena mahatA vedAH shakyA gurumukhAdvibho |
prAptuM tasmAdayaM yatnaH paramo me samAsthitaH
shlokas.22:
indra uvAcha||
amArga eSha viprarShe yena tvaM yAtumichChasi |
kiM vighAtena te vipra gachChAdhIhi gurormukhAt
shlokas.23:
lomasha uvAcha||
evamuktvA gataH shakro yavakrIrapi bhArata |
bhUya evAkarodyatnaM tapasyamitavikrama
shlokas.24:
ghoreNa tapasA rAja.nstapyamAno mahAtapAH |
santApayAmAsa bhRRishaM devendramiti naH shrutam
shlokas.25:
taM tathA tapyamAnaM tu tapastIvraM mahAmunim |
upetya balabhiddevo vArayAmAsa vai punaH
shlokas.26:
ashakyo.arthaH samArabdho naitadbuddhikRRitaM tava |
pratibhAsyanti vai vedAstava chaiva pitushcha te
shlokas.27:
yavakrIruvAcha||
na chaitadevaM kriyate devarAja mamepsitam |
mahatA niyamenAhaM tapsye ghorataraM tapaH
shlokas.28:
samiddhe.agnAvupakRRityA~Ngama~NgaM; hoShyAmi vA maghava.nstannibodha |
yadyetadevaM na karoShi kAmaM; mamepsitaM devarAjeha sarvam
shlokas.29:
lomasha uvAcha||
nishchayaM tamabhij~nAya munestasya mahAtmanaH |
prativAraNahetvarthaM buddhyA sa~nchintya buddhimAn
shlokas.30:
tata indro.akarodrUpaM brAhmaNasya tapasvinaH |
anekashatavarShasya durbalasya sayakShmaNaH
shlokas.31:
yavakrItasya yattIrthamuchitaM shauchakarmaNi |
bhAgIrathyAM tatra setuM vAlukAbhishchakAra saH
shlokas.32:
yadAsya vadato vAkyaM na sa chakre dvijottamaH |
vAlukAbhistataH shakro ga~NgAM samabhipUrayan
shlokas.33:
vAlukAmuShTimanishaM bhAgIrathyAM vyasarjayat |
setumabhyArabhachChakro yavakrItaM nidarshayan
shlokas.34:
taM dadarsha yavakrIstu yatnavantaM nibandhane |
prahasa.nshchAbravIdvAkyamidaM sa munipu~NgavaH
shlokas.35:
kimidaM vartate brahmankiM cha te ha chikIrShitam |
atIva hi mahAnyatnaH kriyate.ayaM nirarthakaH
shlokas.36:
indra uvAcha||
bandhiShye setunA ga~NgAM sukhaH panthA bhaviShyati |
klishyate hi janastAta taramANaH punaH punaH
shlokas.37:
yavakrIruvAcha||
nAyaM shakyastvayA baddhuM mahAnoghaH katha~nchana |
ashakyAdvinivartasva shakyamarthaM samArabha
shlokas.38:
indra uvAcha||
yathaiva bhavatA chedaM tapo vedArthamudyatam |
ashakyaM tadvadasmAbhirayaM bhAraH samudyataH
shlokas.39:
yavakrIruvAcha||
yathA tava nirartho.ayamArambhastridasheshvara |
tathA yadi mamApIdaM manyase pAkashAsana
shlokas.40:
kriyatAM yadbhavechChakyaM mayA suragaNeshvara |
varA.nshcha me prayachChAnyAnyairanyAnbhavitAsmyati
shlokas.41:
lomasha uvAcha||
tasmai prAdAdvarAnindra uktavAnyAnmahAtapAH |
pratibhAsyanti te vedAH pitrA saha yathepsitAH
shlokas.42:
yachchAnyatkA~NkShase kAmaM yavakrIrgamyatAmiti |
sa labdhakAmaH pitaramupetyAtha tato.abravIt

shlokas.1:
yavakrIruvAcha||
pratibhAsyanti vai vedA mama tAtasya chobhayoH |
ati chAnyAnbhaviShyAvo varA labdhAstathA mayA
shlokas.2:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
darpaste bhavitA tAta varA.NllabdhvA yathepsitAn |
sa darpapUrNaH kRRipaNaH kShiprameva vinashyasi
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImA gAthA devairudAhRRitAH |
RRiShirAsItpurA putra bAladhirnAma vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
sa putrashokAdudvignastapastepe sudushcharam |
bhavenmama suto.amartya iti taM labdhavA.nshcha saH
shlokas.5:
tasya prasAdo devaishcha kRRito na tvamaraiH samaH |
nAmartyo vidyate martyo nimittAyurbhaviShyati
shlokas.6:
bAladhiruvAcha||
yatheme parvatAH shashvattiShThanti surasattamAH |
akShayAstannimittaM me sutasyAyurbhavediti
shlokas.7:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
tasya putrastadA jaj~ne medhAvI krodhanaH sadA |
sa tachChrutvAkaroddarpamRRiShI.nshchaivAvamanyata
shlokas.8:
vikurvANo munInAM tu charamANo mahImimAm |
AsasAda mahAvIryaM dhanuShAkShaM manIShiNam
shlokas.9:
tasyApachakre medhAvI taM shashApa sa vIryavAn |
bhava bhasmeti choktaH sa na bhasma samapadyata
shlokas.10:
dhanuShAkShastu taM dRRiShTvA medhAvinamanAmayam |
nimittamasya mahiShairbhedayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.11:
sa nimitte vinaShTe tu mamAra sahasA shishuH |
taM mRRitaM putramAdAya vilalApa tataH pitA
shlokas.12:
lAlapyamAnaM taM dRRiShTvA munayaH punarArtavat |
UchurvedoktayA pUrvaM gAthayA tannibodha me
shlokas.13:
na diShTamarthamatyetumIsho martyaH katha~nchana |
mahiShairbhedayAmAsa dhanuShAkSho mahIdharAn
shlokas.14:
evaM labdhvA varAnbAlA darpapUrNAstarasvinaH |
kShiprameva vinashyanti yathA na syAttathA bhavAn
shlokas.15:
eSha raibhyo mahAvIryaH putrau chAsya tathAvidhau |
taM yathA putra nAbhyeShi tathA kuryAstvatandritaH
shlokas.16:
sa hi kruddhaH samarthastvAM putra pIDayituM ruShA |
vaidyashchApi tapasvI cha kopanashcha mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.17:
yavakrIruvAcha||
evaM kariShye mA tApaM tAta kArShIH katha~nchana |
yathA hi me bhavAnmAnyastathA raibhyaH pitA mama
shlokas.18:
lomasha uvAcha||
uktvA sa pitaraM shlakShNaM yavakrIrakutobhayaH |
viprakurvannRRiShInanyAnatuShyatparayA mudA

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
cha~NkramyamANaH sa tadA yavakrIrakutobhayaH |
jagAma mAdhave mAsi raibhyAshramapadaM prati
shlokas.2:
sa dadarshAshrame puNye puShpitadrumabhUShite |
vicharantIM snuShAM tasya kiMnarImiva bhArata
shlokas.3:
yavakrIstAmuvAchedamupatiShThasva mAmiti |
nirlajjo lajjayA yuktAM kAmena hRRitachetanaH
shlokas.4:
sA tasya shIlamAj~nAya tasmAchChApAchcha bibhyatI |
tejasvitAM cha raibhyasya tathetyuktvA jagAma sA
shlokas.5:
tata ekAntamunnIya majjayAmAsa bhArata |
AjagAma tadA raibhyaH svamAshramamari.ndama
shlokas.6:
rudantIM cha snuShAM dRRiShTvA bhAryAmArtAM parAvasoH |
sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA vAchA paryapRRichChadyudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
sA tasmai sarvamAchaShTa yavakrIbhAShitaM shubhA |
pratyuktaM cha yavakrItaM prekShApUrvaM tadAtmanA
shlokas.8:
shRRiNvAnasyaiva raibhyasya yavakrItavicheShTitam |
dahanniva tadA chetaH krodhaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.9:
sa tadA manyunAviShTastapasvI bhRRishakopanaH |
avalupya jaTAmekAM juhAvAgnau susa.nskRRite
shlokas.10:
tataH samabhavannArI tasyA rUpeNa saMmitA |
avalupyAparAM chAtha juhAvAgnau jaTAM punaH
shlokas.11:
tataH samabhavadrakSho ghorAkShaM bhImadarshanam |
abrUtAM tau tadA raibhyaM kiM kAryaM karavAmahe
shlokas.12:
tAvabravIdRRiShiH kruddho yavakrIrvadhyatAmiti |
jagmatustau tathetyuktvA yavakrItajighA.nsayA
shlokas.13:
tatastaM samupAsthAya kRRityA sRRiShTA mahAtmanA |
kamaNDaluM jahArAsya mohayitvA tu bhArata
shlokas.14:
uchchiShTaM tu yavakrItamapakRRiShTakamaNDalum |
tata udyatashUlaH sa rAkShasaH samupAdravat
shlokas.15:
tamApatantaM samprekShya shUlahastaM jighA.nsayA |
yavakrIH sahasotthAya prAdravadyena vai saraH
shlokas.16:
jalahInaM saro dRRiShTvA yavakrIstvaritaH punaH |
jagAma saritaH sarvAstAshchApyAsanvishoShitAH
shlokas.17:
sa kAlyamAno ghoreNa shUlahastena rakShasA |
agnihotraM piturbhItaH sahasA samupAdravat
shlokas.18:
sa vai pravishamAnastu shUdreNAndhena rakShiNA |
nigRRihIto balAddvAri so.avAtiShThata pArthiva
shlokas.19:
nigRRihItaM tu shUdreNa yavakrItaM sa rAkShasaH |
tADayAmAsa shUlena sa bhinnahRRidayo.apatat
shlokas.20:
yavakrItaM sa hatvA tu rAkShaso raibhyamAgamat |
anuj~nAtastu raibhyeNa tayA nAryA sahAcharat

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
bharadvAjastu kaunteya kRRitvA svAdhyAyamAhnikam |
samitkalApamAdAya pravivesha svamAshramam
shlokas.2:
taM sma dRRiShTvA purA sarve pratyuttiShThanti pAvakAH |
na tvenamupatiShThanti hataputraM tadAgnayaH
shlokas.3:
vaikRRitaM tvagnihotre sa lakShayitvA mahAtapAH |
tamandhaM shUdramAsInaM gRRihapAlamathAbravIt
shlokas.4:
kiM nu me nAgnayaH shUdra pratinandanti darshanam |
tvaM chApi na yathApUrvaM kachchitkShemamihAshrame
shlokas.5:
kachchinna raibhyaM putro me gatavAnalpachetanaH |
etadAchakShva me shIghraM na hi me shudhyate manaH
shlokas.6:
shUdra uvAcha||
raibhyaM gato nUnamasau sutaste mandachetanaH |
tathA hi nihataH shete rAkShasena balIyasA
shlokas.7:
prakAlyamAnastenAyaM shUlahastena rakShasA |
agnyAgAraM prati dvAri mayA dorbhyAM nivAritaH
shlokas.8:
tataH sa nihato hyatra jalakAmo.ashuchirdhruvam |
sambhAvito hi tUrNena shUlahastena rakShasA
shlokas.9:
lomasha uvAcha||
bharadvAjastu shUdrasya tachChrutvA vipriyaM vachaH |
gatAsuM putramAdAya vilalApa suduHkhitaH
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNAnAM kilArthAya nanu tvaM taptavA.nstapaH |
dvijAnAmanadhItA vai vedAH sampratibhAntviti
shlokas.11:
tathA kalyANashIlastvaM brAhmaNeShu mahAtmasu |
anAgAH sarvabhUteShu karkashatvamupeyivAn
shlokas.12:
pratiShiddho mayA tAta raibhyAvasathadarshanAt |
gatavAneva taM kShudraM kAlAntakayamopamam
shlokas.13:
yaH sa jAnanmahAtejA vRRiddhasyaikaM mamAtmajam |
gatavAneva kopasya vashaM paramadurmatiH
shlokas.14:
putrashokamanuprApya eSha raibhyasya karmaNA |
tyakShyAmi tvAmRRite putra prANAniShTatamAnbhuvi
shlokas.15:
yathAhaM putrashokena dehaM tyakShyAmi kilbiShI |
tathA jyeShThaH suto raibhyaM hi.nsyAchChIghramanAgasam
shlokas.16:
sukhino vai narA yeShAM jAtyA putro na vidyate |
te putrashokamaprApya vicharanti yathAsukham
shlokas.17:
ye tu putrakRRitAchChokAdbhRRishaM vyAkulachetasaH |
shapantIShTAnsakhInArtAstebhyaH pApataro nu kaH
shlokas.18:
parAsushcha suto dRRiShTaH shaptashcheShTaH sakhA mayA |
IdRRishImApadaM ko nu dvitIyo.anubhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
vilapyaivaM bahuvidhaM bharadvAjo.adahatsutam |
susamiddhaM tataH pashchAtpravivesha hutAshanam

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu bRRihaddyumno mahIpatiH |
satramAste mahAbhAgo raibhyayAjyaH pratApavAn
shlokas.2:
tena raibhyasya vai putrAvarvAvasuparAvasU |
vRRitau sahAyau satrArthe bRRihaddyumnena dhImatA
shlokas.3:
tatra tau samanuj~nAtau pitrA kaunteya jagmatuH |
Ashrame tvabhavadraibhyo bhAryA chaiva parAvasoH
shlokas.4:
athAvalokako.agachChadgRRihAnekaH parAvasuH |
kRRiShNAjinena sa.nvItaM dadarsha pitaraM vane
shlokas.5:
jaghanyarAtre nidrAndhaH sAvasheShe tamasyapi |
charantaM gahane.araNye mene sa pitaraM mRRigam
shlokas.6:
mRRigaM tu manyamAnena pitA vai tena hi.nsitaH |
akAmayAnena tadA sharIratrANamichChatA
shlokas.7:
sa tasya pretakAryANi kRRitvA sarvANi bhArata |
punarAgamya tatsatramabravIdbhrAtaraM vachaH
shlokas.8:
idaM karma na shaktastvaM voDhumekaH katha~nchana |
mayA tu hi.nsitastAto manyamAnena taM mRRigam
shlokas.9:
so.asmadarthe vrataM sAdhu chara tvaM brahmahi.nsanam |
samartho hyahamekAkI karma kartumidaM mune
shlokas.10:
arvAvasuruvAcha||
karotu vai bhavAnsatraM bRRihaddyumnasya dhImataH |
brahmahatyAM chariShye.ahaM tvadarthaM niyatendriyaH
shlokas.11:
lomasha uvAcha||
sa tasyA brahmahatyAyAH pAraM gatvA yudhiShThira |
arvAvasustadA satramAjagAma punarmuniH
shlokas.12:
tataH parAvasurdRRiShTvA bhrAtaraM samupasthitam |
bRRihaddyumnamuvAchedaM vachanaM pariShadgatam
shlokas.13:
eSha te brahmahA yaj~naM mA draShTuM pravishediti |
brahmahA prekShitenApi pIDayettvAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
preShyairutsAryamANastu rAjannarvAvasustadA |
na mayA brahmahatyeyaM kRRitetyAha punaH punaH
shlokas.15:
uchyamAno.asakRRitpreShyairbrahmahanniti bhArata |
naiva sa pratijAnAti brahmahatyAM svayaM kRRitAm
mama bhrAtrA kRRitamidaM mayA tu parirakShitam
shlokas.16:
prItAstasyAbhavandevAH karmaNArvAvasornRRipa |
taM te pravarayAmAsurnirAsushcha parAvasum
shlokas.17:
tato devA varaM tasmai daduragnipurogamAH |
sa chApi varayAmAsa piturutthAnamAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
anAgastvaM tathA bhrAtuH pitushchAsmaraNaM vadhe |
bharadvAjasya chotthAnaM yavakrItasya chobhayoH
shlokas.19:
tataH prAdurbabhUvuste sarva eva yudhiShThira |
athAbravIdyavakrIto devAnagnipurogamAn
shlokas.20:
samadhItaM mayA brahma vratAni charitAni cha |
kathaM nu raibhyaH shakto mAmadhIyAnaM tapasvinam
tathAyuktena vidhinA nihantumamarottamAH
shlokas.21:
devA UchuH||
maivaM kRRithA yavakrIta yathA vadasi vai mune |
RRite gurumadhItA hi sukhaM vedAstvayA purA
shlokas.22:
anena tu gurUnduHkhAttoShayitvA svakarmaNA |
kAlena mahatA kleshAdbrahmAdhigatamuttamam
shlokas.23:
lomasha uvAcha||
yavakrItamathoktvaivaM devAH sAgnipurogamAH |
sa~njIvayitvA tAnsarvAnpunarjagmustriviShTapam
shlokas.24:
Ashramastasya puNyo.ayaM sadApuShpaphaladrumaH |
atroShya rAjashArdUla sarvapApaiH pramokShyase

shlokas.1:
lomasha uvAcha||
ushIrabIjaM mainAkaM giriM shvetaM cha bhArata |
samatIto.asi kaunteya kAlashailaM cha pArthiva
shlokas.2:
eShA ga~NgA saptavidhA rAjate bharatarShabha |
sthAnaM virajasaM ramyaM yatrAgnirnityamidhyate
shlokas.3:
etadvai mAnuSheNAdya na shakyaM draShTumapyuta |
samAdhiM kurutAvyagrAstIrthAnyetAni drakShyatha
shlokas.4:
shvetaM giriM pravekShyAmo mandaraM chaiva parvatam |
yatra mANicharo yakShaH kuberashchApi yakSharAT
shlokas.5:
aShTAshItisahasrANi gandharvAH shIghrachAriNaH |
tathA kimpuruShA rAjanyakShAshchaiva chaturguNAH
shlokas.6:
anekarUpasa.nsthAnA nAnApraharaNAshcha te |
yakShendraM manujashreShTha mANibhadramupAsate
shlokas.7:
teShAmRRiddhiratIvAgryA gatau vAyusamAshcha te |
sthAnAtprachyAvayeyurye devarAjamapi dhruvam
shlokas.8:
taistAta balibhirguptA yAtudhAnaishcha rakShitAH |
durgamAH parvatAH pArtha samAdhiM paramaM kuru
shlokas.9:
kuberasachivAshchAnye raudrA maitrAshcha rAkShasAH |
taiH sameShyAma kaunteya yatto vikramaNe bhava
shlokas.10:
kailAsaH parvato rAjanShaDyojanashatAnyuta |
yatra devAH samAyAnti vishAlA yatra bhArata
shlokas.11:
asa~NkhyeyAstu kaunteya yakSharAkShasakiMnarAH |
nAgAH suparNA gandharvAH kuberasadanaM prati
shlokas.12:
tAnvigAhasva pArthAdya tapasA cha damena cha |
rakShyamANo mayA rAjanbhImasenabalena cha
shlokas.13:
svasti te varuNo rAjA yamashcha samiti~njayaH |
ga~NgA cha yamunA chaiva parvatashcha dadhAtu te
shlokas.14:
indrasya jAmbUnadaparvatAgre; shRRiNomi ghoShaM tava devi ga~Nge |
gopAyayemaM subhage giribhyaH; sarvAjamIDhApachitaM narendram
bhavasva sharma pravivikShato.asya; shailAnimA~nshailasute nRRipasya
shlokas.15:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
apUrvo.ayaM sambhramo lomashasya; kRRiShNAM sarve rakShata mA pramAdam |
desho hyayaM durgatamo mato.asya; tasmAtparaM shauchamihAcharadhvam
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abravIdbhImamudAravIryaM; kRRiShNAM yattaH pAlaya bhImasena |
shUnye.arjune.asaMnihite cha tAta; tvameva kRRiShNAM bhajase.asukheShu
shlokas.17:
tato mahAtmA yamajau sametya; mUrdhanyupAghrAya vimRRijya gAtre |
uvAcha tau bAShpakalaM sa rAjA; mA bhaiShTamAgachChatamapramattau

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
antarhitAni bhUtAni rakShA.nsi balavanti cha |
agninA tapasA chaiva shakyaM gantuM vRRikodara
shlokas.2:
saMnivartaya kaunteya kShutpipAse balAnvayAt |
tato balaM cha dAkShyaM cha sa.nshrayasva kurUdvaha
shlokas.3:
RRiShestvayA shrutaM vAkyaM kailAsaM parvataM prati |
buddhyA prapashya kaunteya kathaM kRRiShNA gamiShyati
shlokas.4:
atha vA sahadevena dhaumyena cha sahAbhibho |
sUdaiH paurogavaishchaiva sarvaishcha parichArakaiH
shlokas.5:
rathairashvaishcha ye chAnye viprAH kleshAsahAH pathi |
sarvaistvaM sahito bhIma nivartasvAyatekShaNa
shlokas.6:
trayo vayaM gamiShyAmo laghvAhArA yatavratAH |
ahaM cha nakulashchaiva lomashashcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.7:
mamAgamanamAkA~NkShanga~NgAdvAre samAhitaH |
vaseha draupadIM rakShanyAvadAgamanaM mama
shlokas.8:
bhIma uvAcha||
rAjaputrI shrameNArtA duHkhArtA chaiva bhArata |
vrajatyeva hi kalyANI shvetavAhadidRRikShayA
shlokas.9:
tava chApyaratistIvrA vardhate tamapashyataH |
kiM punaH sahadevaM cha mAM cha kRRiShNAM cha bhArata
shlokas.10:
rathAH kAmaM nivartantAM sarve cha parichArakAH |
sUdAH paurogavAshchaiva manyate yatra no bhavAn
shlokas.11:
na hyahaM hAtumichChAmi bhavantamiha karhichit |
shaile.asminrAkShasAkIrNe durgeShu viShameShu cha
shlokas.12:
iyaM chApi mahAbhAgA rAjaputrI yatavratA |
tvAmRRite puruShavyAghra notsahedvinivartitum
shlokas.13:
tathaiva sahadevo.ayaM satataM tvAmanuvrataH |
na jAtu vinivarteta mataj~no hyahamasya vai
shlokas.14:
api chAtra mahArAja savyasAchididRRikShayA |
sarve lAlasabhUtAH sma tasmAdyAsyAmahe saha
shlokas.15:
yadyashakyo rathairgantuM shailo.ayaM bahukandaraH |
padbhireva gamiShyAmo mA rAjanvimanA bhava
shlokas.16:
ahaM vahiShye pA~nchAlIM yatra yatra na shakShyati |
iti me vartate buddhirmA rAjanvimanA bhava
shlokas.17:
sukumArau tathA vIrau mAdrInandikarAvubhau |
durge santArayiShyAmi yadyashaktau bhaviShyataH
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evaM te bhAShamANasya balaM bhImAbhivardhatAm |
yastvamutsahase voDhuM draupadIM vipule.adhvani
shlokas.19:
yamajau chApi bhadraM te naitadanyatra vidyate |
balaM cha te yashashchaiva dharmaH kIrtishcha vardhatAm
shlokas.20:
yastvamutsahase netuM bhrAtarau saha kRRiShNayA |
mA te glAnirmahAbAho mA cha te.astu parAbhavaH
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kRRiShNAbravIdvAkyaM prahasantI manoramA |
gamiShyAmi na santApaH kAryo mAM prati bhArata
shlokas.22:
lomasha uvAcha||
tapasA shakyate gantuM parvato gandhamAdanaH |
tapasA chaiva kaunteya sarve yokShyAmahe vayam
shlokas.23:
nakulaH sahadevashcha bhImasenashcha pArthiva |
ahaM cha tvaM cha kaunteya drakShyAmaH shvetavAhanam
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sambhAShamANAste subAhorviShayaM mahat |
dadRRishurmuditA rAjanprabhUtagajavAjimat
shlokas.25:
kirAtata~NgaNAkIrNaM kuNindashatasa~Nkulam |
himavatyamarairjuShTaM bahvAshcharyasamAkulam
shlokas.26:
subAhushchApi tAndRRiShTvA pUjayA pratyagRRihNata |
viShayAnte kuNindAnAmIshvaraH prItipUrvakam
shlokas.27:
tatra te pUjitAstena sarva eva sukhoShitAH |
pratasthurvimale sUrye himavantaM giriM prati
shlokas.28:
indrasenamukhA.nshchaiva bhRRityAnpaurogavA.nstathA |
sUdA.nshcha paribarhaM cha draupadyAH sarvasho nRRipa
shlokas.29:
rAj~naH kuNindAdhipateH paridAya mahArathAH |
padbhireva mahAvIryA yayuH kauravanandanAH
shlokas.30:
te shanaiH prAdravansarve kRRiShNayA saha pANDavAH |
tasmAddeshAtsusaMhRRiShTA draShTukAmA dhana~njayam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhImasena yamau chobhau pA~nchAli cha nibodhata |
nAsti bhUtasya nAsho vai pashyatAsmAnvanecharAn
shlokas.2:
durbalAH kleshitAH smeti yadbravIthetaretaram |
ashakye.api vrajAmeti dhana~njayadidRRikShayA
shlokas.3:
tanme dahati gAtrANi tUlarAshimivAnalaH |
yachcha vIraM na pashyAmi dhana~njayamupAntike
shlokas.4:
tasya darshanatRRiShNaM mAM sAnujaM vanamAsthitam |
yAj~nasenyAH parAmarshaH sa cha vIra dahatyuta
shlokas.5:
nakulAtpUrvajaM pArthaM na pashyAmyamitaujasam |
ajeyamugradhanvAnaM tena tapye vRRikodara
shlokas.6:
tIrthAni chaiva ramyANi vanAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
charAmi saha yuShmAbhistasya darshanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.7:
pa~ncha varShANyahaM vIraM satyasandhaM dhana~njayam |
yanna pashyAmi bIbhatsuM tena tapye vRRikodara
shlokas.8:
taM vai shyAmaM guDAkeshaM siMhavikrAntagAminam |
na pashyAmi mahAbAhuM tena tapye vRRikodara
shlokas.9:
kRRitAstraM nipuNaM yuddhe pratimAnaM dhanuShmatAm |
na pashyAmi narashreShThaM tena tapye vRRikodara
shlokas.10:
charantamarisa~NgheShu kAlaM kruddhamivAntakam |
prabhinnamiva mAta~NgaM siMhaskandhaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.11:
yaH sa shakrAdanavaro vIryeNa draviNena cha |
yamayoH pUrvajaH pArthaH shvetAshvo.amitavikramaH
shlokas.12:
duHkhena mahatAviShTaH svakRRitenAnivartinA |
ajeyamugradhanvAnaM taM na pashyAmi phalgunam
shlokas.13:
satataM yaH kShamAshIlaH kShipyamANo.apyaNIyasA |
RRijumArgaprapannasya sharmadAtAbhayasya cha
shlokas.14:
sa tu jihmapravRRittasya mAyayAbhijighA.nsataH |
api vajradharasyApi bhavetkAlaviShopamaH
shlokas.15:
shatrorapi prapannasya so.anRRisha.nsaH pratApavAn |
dAtAbhayasya bIbhatsuramitAtmA mahAbalaH
shlokas.16:
sarveShAmAshrayo.asmAkaM raNe.arINAM pramarditA |
AhartA sarvaratnAnAM sarveShAM naH sukhAvahaH
shlokas.17:
ratnAni yasya vIryeNa divyAnyAsanpurA mama |
bahUni bahujAtAni yAni prAptaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.18:
yasya bAhubalAdvIra sabhA chAsItpurA mama |
sarvaratnamayI khyAtA triShu lokeShu pANDava
shlokas.19:
vAsudevasamaM vIrye kArtavIryasamaM yudhi |
ajeyamajitaM yuddhe taM na pashyAmi phalgunam
shlokas.20:
sa~NkarShaNaM mahAvIryaM tvAM cha bhImAparAjitam |
anujAtaH sa vIryeNa vAsudevaM cha shatruhA
shlokas.21:
yasya bAhubale tulyaH prabhAve cha pura.ndaraH |
jave vAyurmukhe somaH krodhe mRRityuH sanAtanaH
shlokas.22:
te vayaM taM naravyAghraM sarve vIra didRRikShavaH |
pravekShyAmo mahAbAho parvataM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.23:
vishAlA badarI yatra naranArAyaNAshramaH |
taM sadAdhyuShitaM yakShairdrakShyAmo girimuttamam
shlokas.24:
kuberanalinIM ramyAM rAkShasairabhirakShitAm |
padbhireva gamiShyAmastapyamAnA mahattapaH
shlokas.25:
nAtaptatapasA shakyo desho gantuM vRRikodara |
na nRRisha.nsena lubdhena nAprashAntena bhArata
shlokas.26:
tatra sarve gamiShyAmo bhImArjunapadaiShiNaH |
sAyudhA baddhanistri.nshAH saha viprairmahAvrataiH
shlokas.27:
makShikAnmashakAnda.nshAnvyAghrAnsiMhAnsarIsRRipAn |
prApnotyaniyataH pArtha niyatastAnna pashyati
shlokas.28:
te vayaM niyatAtmAnaH parvataM gandhamAdanam |
pravekShyAmo mitAhArA dhana~njayadidRRikShavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te shUrAstatadhanvAnastUNavantaH samArgaNAH |
baddhagodhA~NgulitrANAH khadgavanto.amitaujasaH
shlokas.2:
parigRRihya dvijashreShThA~nshreShThAH sarvadhanuShmatAm |
pA~nchAlIsahitA rAjanprayayurgandhamAdanam
shlokas.3:
sarA.nsi saritashchaiva parvatA.nshcha vanAni cha |
vRRikShA.nshcha bahulachChAyAndadRRishurgirimUrdhani
nityapuShpaphalAndeshAndevarShigaNasevitAn
shlokas.4:
AtmanyAtmAnamAdhAya vIrA mUlaphalAshanAH |
cheruruchchAvachAkArAndeshAnviShamasa~NkaTAn
pashyanto mRRigajAtAni bahUni vividhAni cha
shlokas.5:
RRiShisiddhAmarayutaM gandharvApsarasAM priyam |
vivishuste mahAtmAnaH kiMnarAcharitaM girim
shlokas.6:
pravishatsvatha vIreShu parvataM gandhamAdanam |
chaNDavAtaM mahadvarShaM prAdurAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.7:
tato reNuH samudbhUtaH sapatrabahulo mahAn |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha dyAM chaiva tamasAvRRiNot
shlokas.8:
na sma praj~nAyate ki~nchidAvRRite vyomni reNunA |
na chApi shekuste kartumanyonyasyAbhibhAShaNam
shlokas.9:
na chApashyanta te.anyonyaM tamasA hatachakShuShaH |
AkRRiShyamANA vAtena sAshmachUrNena bhArata
shlokas.10:
drumANAM vAtabhagnAnAM patatAM bhUtale bhRRisham |
anyeShAM cha mahIjAnAM shabdaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.11:
dyauH svitpatati kiM bhUmau dIryante parvatA nu kim |
iti te menire sarve pavanena vimohitAH
shlokas.12:
te yathAnantarAnvRRikShAnvalmIkAnviShamANi cha |
pANibhiH parimArganto bhItA vAyornililyire
shlokas.13:
tataH kArmukamudyamya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
kRRiShNAmAdAya sa~NgatyA tasthAvAshritya pAdapam
shlokas.14:
dharmarAjashcha dhaumyashcha nililyAte mahAvane |
agnihotrANyupAdAya sahadevastu parvate
shlokas.15:
nakulo brAhmaNAshchAnye lomashashcha mahAtapAH |
vRRikShAnAsAdya santrastAstatra tatra nililyire
shlokas.16:
mandIbhUte cha pavane tasminrajasi shAmyati |
mahadbhiH pRRiShataistUrNaM varShamabhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.17:
tato.ashmasahitA dhArAH sa.nvRRiNvantyaH samantataH |
prapeturanishaM tatra shIghravAtasamIritAH
shlokas.18:
tataH sAgaragA ApaH kIryamANAH samantataH |
prAdurAsansakalusAH phenavatyo vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
vahantyo vAri bahulaM phenoDupapariplutam |
parisasrurmahAshabdAH prakarShantyo mahIruhAn
shlokas.20:
tasminnuparate varShe vAte cha samatAM gate |
gate hyambhasi nimnAni prAdurbhUte divAkare
shlokas.21:
nirjagmuste shanaiH sarve samAjagmushcha bhArata |
pratasthushcha punarvIrAH parvataM gandhamAdanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prayAtamAtreShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
padbhyAmanuchitA gantuM draupadI samupAvishat
shlokas.2:
shrAntA duHkhaparItA cha vAtavarSheNa tena cha |
saukumAryAchcha pA~nchAlI saMmumoha yashasvinI
shlokas.3:
sA pAtyamAnA mohena bAhubhyAmasitekShaNA |
vRRittAbhyAmanurUpAbhyAmUrU samavalambata
shlokas.4:
AlambamAnA sahitAvUrU gajakaropamau |
papAta sahasA bhUmau vepantI kadalI yathA
shlokas.5:
tAM patantIM varArohAM sajjamAnAM latAmiva |
nakulaH samabhidrutya parijagrAha vIryavAn
shlokas.6:
nakula uvAcha||
rAjanpA~nchAlarAjasya suteyamasitekShaNA |
shrAntA nipatitA bhUmau tAmavekShasva bhArata
shlokas.7:
aduHkhArhA paraM duHkhaM prApteyaM mRRidugAminI |
AshvAsaya mahArAja tAmimAM shramakarshitAm
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAjA tu vachanAttasya bhRRishaM duHkhasamanvitaH |
bhImashcha sahadevashcha sahasA samupAdravan
shlokas.9:
tAmavekShya tu kaunteyo vivarNavadanAM kRRishAm |
a~NkamAnIya dharmAtmA paryadevayadAturaH
shlokas.10:
kathaM veshmasu gupteShu svAstIrNashayanochitA |
shete nipatitA bhUmau sukhArhA varavarNinI
shlokas.11:
sukumArau kathaM pAdau mukhaM cha kamalaprabham |
matkRRite.adya varArhAyAH shyAmatAM samupAgatam
shlokas.12:
kimidaM dyUtakAmena mayA kRRitamabuddhinA |
AdAya kRRiShNAM charatA vane mRRigagaNAyute
shlokas.13:
sukhaM prApsyati pA~nchAlI pANDavAnprApya vai patIn |
iti drupadarAjena pitrA dattAyatekShaNA
shlokas.14:
tatsarvamanavApyaiva shramashokAddhi karshitA |
shete nipatitA bhUmau pApasya mama karmabhiH
shlokas.15:
tathA lAlapyamAne tu dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
dhaumyaprabhRRitayaH sarve tatrAjagmurdvijottamAH
shlokas.16:
te samAshvAsayAmAsurAshIrbhishchApyapUjayan |
rakShoghnA.nshcha tathA mantrA~njepushchakrushcha te kriyAH
shlokas.17:
paThyamAneShu mantreShu shAntyarthaM paramarShibhiH |
spRRishyamAnA karaiH shItaiH pANDavaishcha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.18:
sevyamAnA cha shItena jalamishreNa vAyunA |
pA~nchAlI sukhamAsAdya lebhe chetaH shanaiH shanaiH
shlokas.19:
parigRRihya cha tAM dInAM kRRiShNAmajinasa.nstare |
tadA vishrAmayAmAsurlabdhasa~nj~nAM tapasvinIm
shlokas.20:
tasyA yamau raktatalau pAdau pUjitalakShaNau |
karAbhyAM kiNajAtAbhyAM shanakaiH sa.nvavAhatuH
shlokas.21:
paryAshvAsayadapyenAM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha cha kurushreShTho bhImasenamidaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
bahavaH parvatA bhIma viShamA himadurgamAH |
teShu kRRiShNA mahAbAho kathaM nu vichariShyati
shlokas.23:
bhImasena uvAcha||
tvAM rAjanrAjaputrIM cha yamau cha puruSharShabhau |
svayaM neShyAmi rAjendra mA viShAde manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.24:
atha vAsau mayA jAto vihago madbalopamaH |
vahedanagha sarvAnno vachanAtte ghatotkachaH
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anuj~nAto dharmarAj~nA putraM sasmAra rAkShasam |
ghaTotkachashcha dharmAtmA smRRitamAtraH pitustadA
kRRitA~njalirupAtiShThadabhivAdyAtha pANDavAn
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNA.nshcha mahAbAhuH sa cha tairabhinanditaH |
uvAcha bhImasenaM sa pitaraM satyavikramaH
shlokas.27:
smRRito.asmi bhavatA shIghraM shushrUShurahamAgataH |
Aj~nApaya mahAbAho sarvaM kartAsmyasa.nshayam
tachChrutvA bhImasenastu rAkShasaM pariShasvaje

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dharmaj~no balavA~nshUraH sadyo rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
bhakto.asmAnaurasaH putro bhIma gRRihNAtu mAtaram
shlokas.2:
tava bhIma balenAhamatibhImaparAkrama |
akShataH saha pA~nchAlyA gachCheyaM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhrAturvachanamAj~nAya bhImaseno ghaTotkacham |
Adidesha naravyAghrastanayaM shatrukarshanam
shlokas.4:
haiDimbeya parishrAntA tava mAtAparAjitA |
tvaM cha kAmagamastAta balavAnvaha tAM khaga
shlokas.5:
skandhamAropya bhadraM te madhye.asmAkaM vihAyasA |
gachCha nIchikayA gatyA yathA chainAM na pIDayeH
shlokas.6:
ghaTotkacha uvAcha||
dharmarAjaM cha dhaumyaM cha rAjaputrIM yamau tathA |
eko.apyahamalaM voDhuM kimutAdya sahAyavAn
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tataH kRRiShNAmuvAha sa ghaTotkachaH |
pANDUnAM madhyago vIraH pANDavAnapi chApare
shlokas.8:
lomashaH siddhamArgeNa jagAmAnupamadyutiH |
svenaivAtmaprabhAvena dvitIya iva bhAskaraH
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNA.nshchApi tAnsarvAnsamupAdAya rAkShasAH |
niyogAdrAkShasendrasya jagmurbhImaparAkramAH
shlokas.10:
evaM suramaNIyAni vanAnyupavanAni cha |
Alokayantaste jagmurvishAlAM badarIM prati
shlokas.11:
te tvAshugatibhirvIrA rAkShasaistairmahAbalaiH |
uhyamAnA yayuH shIghraM mahadadhvAnamalpavat
shlokas.12:
deshAnmlechChagaNAkIrNAnnAnAratnAkarAyutAn |
dadRRishurgiripAdA.nshcha nAnAdhAtusamAchitAn
shlokas.13:
vidyAdharagaNAkIrNAnyutAnvAnarakiMnaraiH |
tathA kimpuruShaishchaiva gandharvaishcha samantataH
shlokas.14:
nadIjAlasamAkIrNAnnAnApakShirutAkulAn |
nAnAvidhairmRRigairjuShTAnvAnaraishchopashobhitAn
shlokas.15:
te vyatItya bahUndeshAnuttarA.nshcha kurUnapi |
dadRRishurvividhAshcharyaM kailAsaM parvatottamam
shlokas.16:
tasyAbhyAshe tu dadRRishurnaranArAyaNAshramam |
upetaM pAdapairdivyaiH sadApuShpaphalopagaiH
shlokas.17:
dadRRishustAM cha badarIM vRRittaskandhAM manoramAm |
snigdhAmaviralachChAyAM shriyA paramayA yutAm
shlokas.18:
patraiH snigdhairaviralairupetAM mRRidubhiH shubhAm |
vishAlashAkhAM vistIrNAmatidyutisamanvitAm
shlokas.19:
phalairupachitairdivyairAchitAM svAdubhirbhRRisham |
madhusravaiH sadA divyAM maharShigaNasevitAm
madapramuditairnityaM nAnAdvijagaNairyutAm
shlokas.20:
ada.nshamashake deshe bahumUlaphalodake |
nIlashAdvalasa~nChanne devagandharvasevite
shlokas.21:
susamIkRRitabhUbhAge svabhAvavihite shubhe |
jAtAM himamRRidusparshe deshe.apahatakaNTake
shlokas.22:
tAmupetya mahAtmAnaH saha tairbrAhmaNarShabhaiH |
avaterustataH sarve rAkShasaskandhataH shanaiH
shlokas.23:
tatastamAshramaM puNyaM naranArAyaNAshritam |
dadRRishuH pANDavA rAjansahitA dvijapu~NgavaiH
shlokas.24:
tamasA rahitaM puNyamanAmRRiShTaM raveH karaiH |
kShuttRRiTshItoShNadoShaishcha varjitaM shokanAshanam
shlokas.25:
maharShigaNasambAdhaM brAhmyA lakShmyA samanvitam |
duShpraveshaM mahArAja narairdharmabahiShkRRitaiH
shlokas.26:
balihomArchitaM divyaM susaMmRRiShTAnulepanam |
divyapuShpopahAraishcha sarvato.abhivirAjitam
shlokas.27:
vishAlairagnisharaNaiH srugbhANDairAchitaM shubhaiH |
mahadbhistoyakalashaiH kaThinaishchopashobhitam
sharaNyaM sarvabhUtAnAM brahmaghoShaninAditam
shlokas.28:
divyamAshrayaNIyaM tamAshramaM shramanAshanam |
shriyA yutamanirdeshyaM devacharyopashobhitam
shlokas.29:
phalamUlAshanairdAntaishchIrakRRiShNAjinAmbaraiH |
sUryavaishvAnarasamaistapasA bhAvitAtmabhiH
shlokas.30:
maharShibhirmokShaparairyatibhirniyatendriyaiH |
brahmabhUtairmahAbhAgairupetaM brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.31:
so.abhyagachChanmahAtejAstAnRRiShInniyataH shuchiH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito dhImAndharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.32:
divyaj~nAnopapannAste dRRiShTvA prAptaM yudhiShThiram |
abhyagachChanta suprItAH sarva eva maharShayaH
AshIrvAdAnprayu~njAnAH svAdhyAyaniratA bhRRisham
shlokas.33:
prItAste tasya satkAraM vidhinA pAvakopamAH |
upAjahrushcha salilaM puShpamUlaphalaM shuchi
shlokas.34:
sa taiH prItyAtha satkAramupanItaM maharShibhiH |
prayataH pratigRRihyAtha dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
taM shakrasadanaprakhyaM divyagandhaM manoramam |
prItaH svargopamaM puNyaM pANDavaH saha kRRiShNayA
shlokas.36:
vivesha shobhayA yuktaM bhrAtRRibhishcha sahAnagha |
brAhmaNairvedavedA~NgapAragaishcha sahAchyutaH
shlokas.37:
tatrApashyatsa dharmAtmA devadevarShipUjitam |
naranArAyaNasthAnaM bhAgIrathyopashobhitam
shlokas.38:
madhusravaphalAM divyAM maharShigaNasevitAm |
tAmupetya mahAtmAnaste.avasanbrAhmaNaiH saha
shlokas.39:
Alokayanto mainAkaM nAnAdvijagaNAyutam |
hiraNyashikharaM chaiva tachcha bindusaraH shivam
shlokas.40:
bhAgIrathIM sutIrthAM cha shItAmalajalAM shivAm |
maNipravAlaprastArAM pAdapairupashobhitAm
shlokas.41:
divyapuShpasamAkIrNAM manasaH prItivardhanIm |
vIkShamANA mahAtmAno vijahrustatra pANDavAH
shlokas.42:
tatra devAnpitR^I.nshchaiva tarpayantaH punaH punaH |
brAhmaNaiH sahitA vIrA nyavasanpuruSharShabhAH
shlokas.43:
kRRiShNAyAstatra pashyantaH krIDitAnyamaraprabhAH |
vichitrANi naravyAghrA remire tatra pANDavAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatra te puruShavyAghrAH paramaM shauchamAsthitAH |
ShaDrAtramavasanvIrA dhana~njayadidRRikShayA
tasminviharamANAshcha ramamANAshcha pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
manoj~ne kAnanavare sarvabhUtamanorame |
pAdapaiH puShpavikachaiH phalabhArAvanAmitaiH
shlokas.3:
shobhitaM sarvatoramyaiH pu.nskokilakulAkulaiH |
snigdhapatrairaviralaiH shItachChAyairmanoramaiH
shlokas.4:
sarA.nsi cha vichitrANi prasannasalilAni cha |
kamalaiH sotpalaistatra bhrAjamAnAni sarvashaH
pashyantashchArurUpANi remire tatra pANDavAH
shlokas.5:
puNyagandhaH sukhasparsho vavau tatra samIraNaH |
hlAdayanpANDavAnsarvAnsakRRiShNAnsadvijarShabhAn
shlokas.6:
tataH pUrvottaro vAyuH pavamAno yadRRichChayA |
sahasrapatramarkAbhaM divyaM padmamudAvahat
shlokas.7:
tadapashyata pA~nchAlI divyagandhaM manoramam |
anilenAhRRitaM bhUmau patitaM jalajaM shuchi
shlokas.8:
tachChubhA shubhamAsAdya saugandhikamanuttamam |
atIva muditA rAjanbhImasenamathAbravIt
shlokas.9:
pashya divyaM suruchiraM bhIma puShpamanuttamam |
gandhasa.nsthAnasampannaM manaso mama nandanam
shlokas.10:
etattu dharmarAjAya pradAsyAmi parantapa |
hareridaM me kAmAya kAmyake punarAshrame
shlokas.11:
yadi te.ahaM priyA pArtha bahUnImAnyupAhara |
tAnyahaM netumichChAmi kAmyakaM punarAshramam
shlokas.12:
evamuktvA tu pA~nchAlI bhImasenamaninditA |
jagAma dharmarAjAya puShpamAdAya tattadA
shlokas.13:
abhiprAyaM tu vij~nAya mahiShyAH puruSharShabhaH |
priyAyAH priyakAmaH sa bhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.14:
vAtaM tamevAbhimukho yatastatpuShpamAgatam |
AjihIrShurjagAmAshu sa puShpANyaparANyapi
shlokas.15:
rukmapRRiShThaM dhanurgRRihya sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn |
mRRigarADiva sa~NkruddhaH prabhinna iva ku~njaraH
shlokas.16:
draupadyAH priyamanvichChansvabAhubalamAshritaH |
vyapetabhayasaMmohaH shailamabhyapatadbalI
shlokas.17:
sa taM drumalatAgulmachChannaM nIlashilAtalam |
giriM chachArAriharaH kiMnarAcharitaM shubham
shlokas.18:
nAnAvarNadharaishchitraM dhAtudrumamRRigANDajaiH |
sarvabhUShaNasampUrNaM bhUmerbhujamivochChritam
shlokas.19:
sarvarturamaNIyeShu gandhamAdanasAnuShu |
saktachakShurabhiprAyaM hRRidayenAnuchintayan
shlokas.20:
pu.nskokilaninAdeShu ShaTpadAbhiruteShu cha |
baddhashrotramanashchakShurjagAmAmitavikramaH
shlokas.21:
jighramANo mahAtejAH sarvartukusumodbhavam |
gandhamuddAmamuddAmo vane matta iva dvipaH
shlokas.22:
hriyamANashramaH pitrA samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
pituH sa.nsparshashItena gandhamAdanavAyunA
shlokas.23:
sa yakShagandharvasurabrahmarShigaNasevitam |
viloDayAmAsa tadA puShpahetorari.ndamaH
shlokas.24:
viShamachChedarachitairanuliptamivA~NgulaiH |
vimalairdhAtuvichChedaiH kA~nchanA~njanarAjataiH
shlokas.25:
sapakShamiva nRRityantaM pArshvalagnaiH payodharaiH |
muktAhArairiva chitaM chyutaiH prasravaNodakaiH
shlokas.26:
abhirAmanadIku~njanirjharodarakandaram |
apsaronUpuraravaiH pranRRittabahubarhiNam
shlokas.27:
digvAraNaviShANAgrairghRRiShTopalashilAtalam |
srastA.nshukamivAkShobhyairnimnagAniHsRRitairjalaiH
shlokas.28:
sashaShpakavalaiH svasthairadUraparivartibhiH |
bhayasyAj~naishcha hariNaiH kautUhalanirIkShitaH
shlokas.29:
chAlayannUruvegena latAjAlAnyanekashaH |
AkrIDamAnaH kaunteyaH shrImAnvAyusuto yayau
shlokas.30:
priyAmanorathaM kartumudyatashchArulochanaH |
prA.nshuH kanakatAlAbhaH siMhasaMhanano yuvA
shlokas.31:
mattavAraNavikrAnto mattavAraNavegavAn |
mattavAraNatAmrAkSho mattavAraNavAraNaH
shlokas.32:
priyapArshvopaviShTAbhirvyAvRRittAbhirvicheShTitaiH |
yakShagandharvayoShAbhiradRRishyAbhirnirIkShitaH
shlokas.33:
navAvatAraM rUpasya vikrINanniva pANDavaH |
chachAra ramaNIyeShu gandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.34:
sa.nsmaranvividhAnkleshAnduryodhanakRRitAnbahUn |
draupadyA vanavAsinyAH priyaM kartuM samudyataH
shlokas.35:
so.achintayadgate svargamarjune mayi chAgate |
puShpahetoH kathaM nvAryaH kariShyati yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.36:
snehAnnaravaro nUnamavishvAsAdvanasya cha |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha na mokShyati yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.37:
kathaM nu kusumAvAptiH syAchChIghramiti chintayan |
pratasthe narashArdUlaH pakShirADiva vegitaH
shlokas.38:
kampayanmedinIM padbhyAM nirghAta iva parvasu |
trAsayangajayUthAni vAtaraMhA vRRikodaraH
shlokas.39:
siMhavyAghragaNA.nshchaiva mardamAno mahAbalaH |
unmUlayanmahAvRRikShAnpothaya.nshchorasA balI
shlokas.40:
latAvallIshcha vegena vikarShanpANDunandanaH |
uparyupari shailAgramArurukShuriva dvipaH
vinardamAno.atibhRRishaM savidyudiva toyadaH
shlokas.41:
tasya shabdena ghoreNa dhanurghoSheNa chAbhibho |
trastAni mRRigayUthAni samantAdvipradudruvuH
shlokas.42:
athApashyanmahAbAhurgandhamAdanasAnuShu |
suramyaM kadalIShaNDaM bahuyojanavistRRitam
shlokas.43:
tamabhyagachChadvegena kShobhayiShyanmahAbalaH |
mahAgaja ivAsrAvI prabha~njanvividhAndrumAn
shlokas.44:
utpATya kadalIskandhAnbahutAlasamuchChrayAn |
chikShepa tarasA bhImaH samantAdbalinAM varaH
shlokas.45:
tataH sattvAnyupAkrAmanbahUni cha mahAnti cha |
ruruvAraNasa~NghAshcha mahiShAshcha jalAshrayAH
shlokas.46:
