siMhavyAghrAshcha sa~NkruddhA bhImasenamabhidravan |
vyAditAsyA mahAraudrA vinadanto.atibhIShaNAH
shlokas.47:
tato vAyusutaH krodhAtsvabAhubalamAshritaH |
gajenAghnangajaM bhImaH siMhaM siMhena chAbhibhUH
talaprahArairanyA.nshcha vyahanatpANDavo balI
shlokas.48:
te hanyamAnA bhImena siMhavyAghratarakShavaH |
bhayAdvisasRRipuH sarve shakRRinmUtraM cha susruvuH
shlokas.49:
pravivesha tataH kShipraM tAnapAsya mahAbalaH |
vanaM pANDusutaH shrImA~nshabdenApUrayandishaH
shlokas.50:
tena shabdena chogreNa bhImasenaraveNa cha |
vanAntaragatAH sarve vitresurmRRigapakShiNaH
shlokas.51:
taM shabdaM sahasA shrutvA mRRigapakShisamIritam |
jalArdrapakShA vihagAH samutpetuH sahasrashaH
shlokas.52:
tAnaudakAnpakShigaNAnnirIkShya bharatarShabhaH |
tAnevAnusaranramyaM dadarsha sumahatsaraH
shlokas.53:
kA~nchanaiH kadalIShaNDairmandamArutakampitaiH |
vIjyamAnamivAkShobhyaM tIrAntaravisarpibhiH
shlokas.54:
tatsaro.athAvatIryAshu prabhUtakamalotpalam |
mahAgaja ivoddAmashchikrIDa balavadbalI
vikrIDya tasminsuchiramuttatArAmitadyutiH
shlokas.55:
tato.avagAhya vegena tadvanaM bahupAdapam |
dadhmau cha sha~NkhaM svanavatsarvaprANena pANDavaH
shlokas.56:
tasya sha~Nkhasya shabdena bhImasenaraveNa cha |
bAhushabdena chogreNa nardantIva girerguhAH
shlokas.57:
taM vajraniShpeShasamamAsphoTitaravaM bhRRisham |
shrutvA shailaguhAsuptaiH siMhairmukto mahAsvanaH
shlokas.58:
siMhanAdabhayatrastaiH ku~njarairapi bhArata |
mukto virAvaH sumahAnparvato yena pUritaH
shlokas.59:
taM tu nAdaM tataH shrutvA supto vAnarapu~NgavaH |
prAjRRimbhata mahAkAyo hanUmAnnAma vAnaraH
shlokas.60:
kadalIShaNDamadhyastho nidrAvashagatastadA |
jRRimbhamANaH suvipulaM shakradhvajamivochChritam
AsphoTayata lA~NgUlamindrAshanisamasvanam
shlokas.61:
tasya lA~NgUlaninadaM parvataH sa guhAmukhaiH |
udgAramiva gaurnardamutsasarja samantataH
shlokas.62:
sa lA~NgUlaravastasya mattavAraNanisvanam |
antardhAya vichitreShu chachAra girisAnuShu
shlokas.63:
sa bhImasenastaM shrutvA samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
shabdaprabhavamanvichCha.nshchachAra kadalIvanam
shlokas.64:
kadalIvanamadhyasthamatha pIne shilAtale |
sa dadarsha mahAbAhurvAnarAdhipatiM sthitam
shlokas.65:
vidyutsa~NghAtaduShprekShyaM vidyutsa~NghAtapi~Ngalam |
vidyutsa~NghAtasadRRishaM vidyutsa~NghAtacha~nchalam
shlokas.66:
bAhusvastikavinyastapInahrasvashirodharam |
skandhabhUyiShThakAyatvAttanumadhyakaTItaTam
shlokas.67:
ki~nchichchAbhugnashIrSheNa dIrgharomA~nchitena cha |
lA~NgUlenordhvagatinA dhvajeneva virAjitam
shlokas.68:
raktoShThaM tAmrajihvAsyaM raktakarNaM chaladbhruvam |
vadanaM vRRittadaMShTrAgraM rashmivantamivoDupam
shlokas.69:
vadanAbhyantaragataiH shuklabhAsairala~NkRRitam |
kesarotkarasaMmishramashokAnAmivotkaram
shlokas.70:
hiraNmayInAM madhyasthaM kadalInAM mahAdyutim |
dIpyamAnaM svavapuShA archiShmantamivAnalam
shlokas.71:
nirIkShantamavitrastaM lochanairmadhupi~NgalaiH |
taM vAnaravaraM vIramatikAyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.72:
athopasRRitya tarasA bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
siMhanAdaM samakarodbodhayiShyankapiM tadA
shlokas.73:
tena shabdena bhImasya vitresurmRRigapakShiNaH |
hanUmA.nshcha mahAsattva IShadunmIlya lochane
avaikShadatha sAvaj~naM lochanairmadhupi~NgalaiH
shlokas.74:
smitenAbhAShya kaunteyaM vAnaro naramabravIt |
kimarthaM sarujaste.ahaM sukhasuptaH prabodhitaH
shlokas.75:
nanu nAma tvayA kAryA dayA bhUteShu jAnatA |
vayaM dharmaM na jAnImastiryagyoniM samAshritAH
shlokas.76:
manuShyA buddhisampannA dayAM kurvanti jantuShu |
krUreShu karmasu kathaM dehavAkchittadUShiShu
dharmaghAtiShu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhAH
shlokas.77:
na tvaM dharmaM vijAnAsi vRRiddhA nopAsitAstvayA |
alpabuddhitayA vanyAnutsAdayasi yanmRRigAn
shlokas.78:
brUhi kastvaM kimarthaM vA vanaM tvamidamAgataH |
varjitaM mAnuShairbhAvaistathaiva puruShairapi
shlokas.79:
ataH paramagamyo.ayaM parvataH sudurAruhaH |
vinA siddhagatiM vIra gatiratra na vidyate
shlokas.80:
kAruNyAtsauhRRidAchchaiva vAraye tvAM mahAbala |
nAtaH paraM tvayA shakyaM gantumAshvasihi prabho
shlokas.81:
imAnyamRRitakalpAni mUlAni cha phalAni cha |
bhakShayitvA nivartasva grAhyaM yadi vacho mama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vachastasya vAnarendrasya dhImataH |
bhImasenastadA vIraH provAchAmitrakarshanaH
shlokas.2:
ko bhavAnkiMnimittaM vA vAnaraM vapurAshritaH |
brAhmaNAnantaro varNaH kShatriyastvAnupRRichChati
shlokas.3:
kauravaH somava.nshIyaH kuntyA garbheNa dhAritaH |
pANDavo vAyutanayo bhImasena iti shrutaH
shlokas.4:
sa vAkyaM bhImasenasya smitena pratigRRihya tat |
hanUmAnvAyutanayo vAyuputramabhAShata
shlokas.5:
vAnaro.ahaM na te mArgaM pradAsyAmi yathepsitam |
sAdhu gachCha nivartasva mA tvaM prApsyasi vaishasam
shlokas.6:
bhIma uvAcha||
vaishasaM vAstu yadvAnyanna tvA pRRichChAmi vAnara |
prayachChottiShTha mArgaM me mA tvaM prApsyasi vaishasam
shlokas.7:
hanUmAnuvAcha||
nAsti shaktirmamotthAtuM vyAdhinA kleshito hyaham |
yadyavashyaM prayAtavyaM la~NghayitvA prayAhi mAm
shlokas.8:
bhIma uvAcha||
nirguNaH paramAtmeti dehaM te vyApya tiShThati |
tamahaM j~nAnavij~neyaM nAvamanye na la~Nghaye
shlokas.9:
yadyAgamairna vindeyaM tamahaM bhUtabhAvanam |
krameyaM tvAM giriM chemaM hanUmAniva sAgaram
shlokas.10:
hanUmAnuvAcha||
ka eSha hanumAnnAma sAgaro yena la~NghitaH |
pRRichChAmi tvA kurushreShTha kathyatAM yadi shakyate
shlokas.11:
bhIma uvAcha||
bhrAtA mama guNashlAghyo buddhisattvabalAnvitaH |
rAmAyaNe.ativikhyAtaH shUro vAnarapu~NgavaH
shlokas.12:
rAmapatnIkRRite yena shatayojanamAyataH |
sAgaraH plavagendreNa krameNaikena la~NghitaH
shlokas.13:
sa me bhrAtA mahAvIryastulyo.ahaM tasya tejasA |
bale parAkrame yuddhe shakto.ahaM tava nigrahe
shlokas.14:
uttiShTha dehi me mArgaM pashya vA me.adya pauruSham |
machChAsanamakurvANaM mA tvA neShye yamakShayam
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vij~nAya taM balonmattaM bAhuvIryeNa garvitam |
hRRidayenAvahasyainaM hanUmAnvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.16:
prasIda nAsti me shaktirutthAtuM jarayAnagha |
mamAnukampayA tvetatpuchChamutsArya gamyatAm
shlokas.17:
sAvaj~namatha vAmena smaya~njagrAha pANinA |
na chAshakachchAlayituM bhImaH puchChaM mahAkapeH
shlokas.18:
uchchikShepa punardorbhyAmindrAyudhamivochChritam |
noddhartumashakadbhImo dorbhyAmapi mahAbalaH
shlokas.19:
utkShiptabhrUrvivRRittAkShaH saMhatabhrukuTImukhaH |
svinnagAtro.abhavadbhImo na choddhartuM shashAka ha
shlokas.20:
yatnavAnapi tu shrImA.NllA~NgUloddharaNoddhutaH |
kapeH pArshvagato bhImastasthau vrIDAdadhomukhaH
shlokas.21:
praNipatya cha kaunteyaH prA~njalirvAkyamabravIt |
prasIda kapishArdUla duruktaM kShamyatAM mama
shlokas.22:
siddho vA yadi vA devo gandharvo vAtha guhyakaH |
pRRiShTaH sankAmayA brUhi kastvaM vAnararUpadhRRik
shlokas.23:
hanUmAnuvAcha||
yatte mama parij~nAne kautUhalamari.ndama |
tatsarvamakhilena tvaM shRRiNu pANDavanandana
shlokas.24:
ahaM kesariNaH kShetre vAyunA jagadAyuShA |
jAtaH kamalapatrAkSha hanUmAnnAma vAnaraH
shlokas.25:
sUryaputraM cha sugrIvaM shakraputraM cha vAlinam |
sarvavAnararAjAnau sarvavAnarayUthapAH
shlokas.26:
upatasthurmahAvIryA mama chAmitrakarshana |
sugrIveNAbhavatprItiranilasyAgninA yathA
shlokas.27:
nikRRitaH sa tato bhrAtrA kasmi.nshchitkAraNAntare |
RRishyamUke mayA sArdhaM sugrIvo nyavasachchiram
shlokas.28:
atha dAsharathirvIro rAmo nAma mahAbalaH |
viShNurmAnuSharUpeNa chachAra vasudhAmimAm
shlokas.29:
sa pituH priyamanvichChansahabhAryaH sahAnujaH |
sadhanurdhanvinAM shreShTho daNDakAraNyamAshritaH
shlokas.30:
tasya bhAryA janasthAnAdrAvaNena hRRitA balAt |
va~nchayitvA mahAbuddhiM mRRigarUpeNa rAghavam
shlokas.31:
hRRitadAraH saha bhrAtrA patnIM mArgansa rAghavaH |
dRRiShTavA~nshailashikhare sugrIvaM vAnararShabham
shlokas.32:
tena tasyAbhavatsakhyaM rAghavasya mahAtmanaH |
sa hatvA vAlinaM rAjye sugrIvaM pratyapAdayat
sa harInpreShayAmAsa sItAyAH parimArgaNe
shlokas.33:
tato vAnarakoTIbhiryAM vayaM prasthitA disham |
tatra pravRRittiH sItAyA gRRidhreNa pratipAditA
shlokas.34:
tato.ahaM kAryasiddhyarthaM rAmasyAkliShTakarmaNaH |
shatayojanavistIrNamarNavaM sahasAplutaH
shlokas.35:
dRRiShTA sA cha mayA devI rAvaNasya niveshane |
pratyAgatashchApi punarnAma tatra prakAshya vai
shlokas.36:
tato rAmeNa vIreNa hatvA tAnsarvarAkShasAn |
punaH pratyAhRRitA bhAryA naShTA vedashrutiryathA
shlokas.37:
tataH pratiShThite rAme vIro.ayaM yAchito mayA |
yAvadrAmakathA vIra bhavellokeShu shatruhan
tAvajjIveyamityevaM tathAstviti cha so.abravIt
shlokas.38:
dasha varShasahasrANi dasha varShashatAni cha |
rAjyaM kAritavAnrAmastatastu tridivaM gataH
shlokas.39:
tadihApsarasastAta gandharvAshcha sadAnagha |
tasya vIrasya charitaM gAyantyo ramayanti mAm
shlokas.40:
ayaM cha mArgo martyAnAmagamyaH kurunandana |
tato.ahaM ruddhavAnmArgaM tavemaM devasevitam
dharShayedvA shapedvApi mA kashchiditi bhArata
shlokas.41:
divyo devapatho hyeSha nAtra gachChanti mAnuShAH |
yadarthamAgatashchAsi tatsaro.abhyarNa eva hi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto mahAbAhurbhImasenaH pratApavAn |
praNipatya tataH prItyA bhrAtaraM hRRiShTamAnasaH
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA hanUmantaM kapIshvaram
shlokas.2:
mayA dhanyataro nAsti yadAryaM dRRiShTavAnaham |
anugraho me sumahA.nstRRiptishcha tava darshanAt
shlokas.3:
evaM tu kRRitamichChAmi tvayAryAdya priyaM mama |
yatte tadAsItplavataH sAgaraM makarAlayam
rUpamapratimaM vIra tadichChAmi nirIkShitum
shlokas.4:
evaM tuShTo bhaviShyAmi shraddhAsyAmi cha te vachaH |
evamuktaH sa tejasvI prahasya harirabravIt
shlokas.5:
na tachChakyaM tvayA draShTuM rUpaM nAnyena kenachit |
kAlAvasthA tadA hyanyA vartate sA na sAmpratam
shlokas.6:
anyaH kRRitayuge kAlastretAyAM dvApare.aparaH |
ayaM pradhva.nsanaH kAlo nAdya tadrUpamasti me
shlokas.7:
bhUmirnadyo nagAH shailAH siddhA devA maharShayaH |
kAlaM samanuvartante yathA bhAvA yuge yuge
balavarShmaprabhAvA hi prahIyantyudbhavanti cha
shlokas.8:
tadalaM tava tadrUpaM draShTuM kurukulodvaha |
yugaM samanuvartAmi kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.9:
bhIma uvAcha||
yugasa~NkhyAM samAchakShva AchAraM cha yuge yuge |
dharmakAmArthabhAvA.nshcha varShma vIryaM bhavAbhavau
shlokas.10:
hanUmAnuvAcha||
kRRitaM nAma yugaM tAta yatra dharmaH sanAtanaH |
kRRitameva na kartavyaM tasminkAle yugottame
shlokas.11:
na tatra dharmAH sIdanti na kShIyante cha vai prajAH |
tataH kRRitayugaM nAma kAlena guNatAM gatam
shlokas.12:
devadAnavagandharvayakSharAkShasapannagAH |
nAsankRRitayuge tAta tadA na krayavikrayAH
shlokas.13:
na sAmayajuRRigvarNAH kriyA nAsIchcha mAnavI |
abhidhyAya phalaM tatra dharmaH saMnyAsa eva cha
shlokas.14:
na tasminyugasa.nsarge vyAdhayo nendriyakShayaH |
nAsUyA nApi ruditaM na darpo nApi paishunam
shlokas.15:
na vigrahaH kutastandrI na dveSho nApi vaikRRitam |
na bhayaM na cha santApo na cherShyA na cha matsaraH
shlokas.16:
tataH paramakaM brahma yA gatiryoginAM parA |
AtmA cha sarvabhUtAnAM shuklo nArAyaNastadA
shlokas.17:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrAshcha kRRitalakShaNAH |
kRRite yuge samabhavansvakarmaniratAH prajAH
shlokas.18:
samAshramaM samAchAraM samaj~nAnamatIbalam |
tadA hi samakarmANo varNA dharmAnavApnuvan
shlokas.19:
ekavedasamAyuktA ekamantravidhikriyAH |
pRRithagdharmAstvekavedA dharmamekamanuvratAH
shlokas.20:
chAturAshramyayuktena karmaNA kAlayoginA |
akAmaphalasa.nyogAtprApnuvanti parAM gatim
shlokas.21:
AtmayogasamAyukto dharmo.ayaM kRRitalakShaNaH |
kRRite yuge chatuShpAdashchAturvarNyasya shAshvataH
shlokas.22:
etatkRRitayugaM nAma traiguNyaparivarjitam |
tretAmapi nibodha tvaM yasminsatraM pravartate
shlokas.23:
pAdena hrasate dharmo raktatAM yAti chAchyutaH |
satyapravRRittAshcha narAH kriyAdharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.24:
tato yaj~nAH pravartante dharmAshcha vividhAH kriyAH |
tretAyAM bhAvasa~NkalpAH kriyAdAnaphalodayAH
shlokas.25:
prachalanti na vai dharmAttapodAnaparAyaNAH |
svadharmasthAH kriyAvanto janAstretAyuge.abhavan
shlokas.26:
dvApare.api yuge dharmo dvibhAgonaH pravartate |
viShNurvai pItatAM yAti chaturdhA veda eva cha
shlokas.27:
tato.anye cha chaturvedAstrivedAshcha tathApare |
dvivedAshchaikavedAshchApyanRRichashcha tathApare
shlokas.28:
evaM shAstreShu bhinneShu bahudhA nIyate kriyA |
tapodAnapravRRittA cha rAjasI bhavati prajA
shlokas.29:
ekavedasya chAj~nAnAdvedAste bahavaH kRRitAH |
satyasya cheha vibhra.nshAtsatye kashchidavasthitaH
shlokas.30:
satyAtprachyavamAnAnAM vyAdhayo bahavo.abhavan |
kAmAshchopadravAshchaiva tadA daivatakAritAH
shlokas.31:
yairardyamAnAH subhRRishaM tapastapyanti mAnavAH |
kAmakAmAH svargakAmA yaj~nA.nstanvanti chApare
shlokas.32:
evaM dvAparamAsAdya prajAH kShIyantyadharmataH |
pAdenaikena kaunteya dharmaH kaliyuge sthitaH
shlokas.33:
tAmasaM yugamAsAdya kRRiShNo bhavati keshavaH |
vedAchArAH prashAmyanti dharmayaj~nakriyAstathA
shlokas.34:
Itayo vyAdhayastandrI doShAH krodhAdayastathA |
upadravAshcha vartante Adhayo vyAdhayastathA
shlokas.35:
yugeShvAvartamAneShu dharmo vyAvartate punaH |
dharme vyAvartamAne tu loko vyAvartate punaH
shlokas.36:
loke kShINe kShayaM yAnti bhAvA lokapravartakAH |
yugakShayakRRitA dharmAH prArthanAni vikurvate
shlokas.37:
etatkaliyugaM nAma achirAdyatpravartate |
yugAnuvartanaM tvetatkurvanti chirajIvinaH
shlokas.38:
yachcha te matparij~nAne kautUhalamari.ndama |
anarthakeShu ko bhAvaH puruShasya vijAnataH
shlokas.39:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
yugasa~NkhyAM mahAbAho svasti prApnuhi gamyatAm

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
pUrvarUpamadRRiShTvA te na yAsyAmi katha~nchana |
yadi te.ahamanugrAhyo darshayAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu bhImena smitaM kRRitvA plava~NgamaH |
tadrUpaM darshayAmAsa yadvai sAgarala~Nghane
shlokas.3:
bhrAtuH priyamabhIpsanvai chakAra sumahadvapuH |
dehastasya tato.atIva vardhatyAyAmavistaraiH
shlokas.4:
tadrUpaM kadalIShaNDaM ChAdayannamitadyutiH |
gireshchochChrayamAgamya tasthau tatra sa vAnaraH
shlokas.5:
samuchChritamahAkAyo dvitIya iva parvataH |
tAmrekShaNastIkShNadaMShTro bhRRikuTIkRRitalochanaH
dIrghalA~NgUlamAvidhya disho vyApya sthitaH kapiH
shlokas.6:
tadrUpaM mahadAlakShya bhrAtuH kauravanandanaH |
visismiye tadA bhImo jahRRiShe cha punaH punaH
shlokas.7:
tamarkamiva tejobhiH sauvarNamiva parvatam |
pradIptamiva chAkAshaM dRRiShTvA bhImo nyamIlayat
shlokas.8:
AbabhAShe cha hanumAnbhImasenaM smayanniva |
etAvadiha shaktastvaM rUpaM draShTuM mamAnagha
shlokas.9:
vardhe.ahaM chApyato bhUyo yAvanme manasepsitam |
bhIma shatruShu chAtyarthaM vardhate mUrtirojasA
shlokas.10:
tadadbhutaM mahAraudraM vindhyamandarasaMnibham |
dRRiShTvA hanUmato varShma sambhrAntaH pavanAtmajaH
shlokas.11:
pratyuvAcha tato bhImaH samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
kRRitA~njaliradInAtmA hanUmantamavasthitam
shlokas.12:
dRRiShTaM pramANaM vipulaM sharIrasyAsya te vibho |
saMharasva mahAvIrya svayamAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.13:
na hi shaknomi tvAM draShTuM divAkaramivoditam |
aprameyamanAdhRRiShyaM mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.14:
vismayashchaiva me vIra sumahAnmanaso.adya vai |
yadrAmastvayi pArshvasthe svayaM rAvaNamabhyagAt
shlokas.15:
tvameva shaktastAM la~NkAM sayodhAM sahavAhanAm |
svabAhubalamAshritya vinAshayitumojasA
shlokas.16:
na hi te ki~nchidaprApyaM mArutAtmaja vidyate |
tava naikasya paryApto rAvaNaH sagaNo yudhi
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu bhImena hanUmAnplavagarShabhaH |
pratyuvAcha tato vAkyaM snigdhagambhIrayA girA
shlokas.18:
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
bhImasena na paryApto mamAsau rAkShasAdhamaH
shlokas.19:
mayA tu tasminnihate rAvaNe lokakaNTake |
kIrtirnashyedrAghavasya tata etadupekShitam
shlokas.20:
tena vIreNa hatvA tu sagaNaM rAkShasAdhipam |
AnItA svapuraM sItA loke kIrtishcha sthApitA
shlokas.21:
tadgachCha vipulapraj~na bhrAtuH priyahite rataH |
ariShTaM kShemamadhvAnaM vAyunA parirakShitaH
shlokas.22:
eSha panthAH kurushreShTha saugandhikavanAya te |
drakShyase dhanadodyAnaM rakShitaM yakSharAkShasaiH
shlokas.23:
na cha te tarasA kAryaH kusumAvachayaH svayam |
daivatAni hi mAnyAni puruSheNa visheShataH
shlokas.24:
balihomanamaskArairmantraishcha bharatarShabha |
daivatAni prasAdaM hi bhaktyA kurvanti bhArata
shlokas.25:
mA tAta sAhasaM kArShIH svadharmamanupAlaya |
svadharmasthaH paraM dharmaM budhyasvAgamayasva cha
shlokas.26:
na hi dharmamavij~nAya vRRiddhAnanupasevya cha |
dharmo vai vedituM shakyo bRRihaspatisamairapi
shlokas.27:
adharmo yatra dharmAkhyo dharmashchAdharmasa~nj~nitaH |
vij~nAtavyo vibhAgena yatra muhyantyabuddhayaH
shlokas.28:
AchArasambhavo dharmo dharmAdvedAH samutthitAH |
vedairyaj~nAH samutpannA yaj~nairdevAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.29:
vedAchAravidhAnoktairyaj~nairdhAryanti devatAH |
bRRihaspatyushanoktaishcha nayairdhAryanti mAnavAH
shlokas.30:
paNyAkaravaNijyAbhiH kRRiShyAtho yonipoShaNaiH |
vArtayA dhAryate sarvaM dharmairetairdvijAtibhiH
shlokas.31:
trayI vArtA daNDanItistisro vidyA vijAnatAm |
tAbhiH samyakprayuktAbhirlokayAtrA vidhIyate
shlokas.32:
sA cheddharmakriyA na syAttrayIdharmamRRite bhuvi |
daNDanItimRRite chApi nirmaryAdamidaM bhavet
shlokas.33:
vArtAdharme hyavartantyo vinashyeyurimAH prajAH |
supravRRittaistribhirhyetairdharmaiH sUyanti vai prajAH
shlokas.34:
dvijAnAmamRRitaM dharmo hyekashchaivaikavarNikaH |
yaj~nAdhyayanadAnAni trayaH sAdhAraNAH smRRitAH
shlokas.35:
yAjanAdhyApane chobhe brAhmaNAnAM pratigrahaH |
pAlanaM kShatriyANAM vai vaishyadharmashcha poShaNam
shlokas.36:
shushrUShA tu dvijAtInAM shUdrANAM dharma uchyate |
bhaikShahomavratairhInAstathaiva guruvAsinAm
shlokas.37:
kShatradharmo.atra kaunteya tava dharmAbhirakShaNam |
svadharmaM pratipadyasva vinIto niyatendriyaH
shlokas.38:
vRRiddhaiH saMmantrya sadbhishcha buddhimadbhiH shrutAnvitaiH |
susthitaH shAsti daNDena vyasanI paribhUyate
shlokas.39:
nigrahAnugrahaiH samyagyadA rAjA pravartate |
tadA bhavati lokasya maryAdA suvyavasthitA
shlokas.40:
tasmAddeshe cha durge cha shatrumitrabaleShu cha |
nityaM chAreNa boddhavyaM sthAnaM vRRiddhiH kShayastathA
shlokas.41:
rAj~nAmupAyAshchatvAro buddhimantraH parAkramaH |
nigrahAnugrahau chaiva dAkShyaM tatkAryasAdhanam
shlokas.42:
sAmnA dAnena bhedena daNDenopekShaNena cha |
sAdhanIyAni kAryANi samAsavyAsayogataH
shlokas.43:
mantramUlA nayAH sarve chArAshcha bharatarShabha |
sumantritairnayaiH siddhistadvidaiH saha mantrayet
shlokas.44:
striyA mUDhena lubdhena bAlena laghunA tathA |
na mantrayeta guhyAni yeShu chonmAdalakShaNam
shlokas.45:
mantrayetsaha vidvadbhiH shaktaiH karmANi kArayet |
snigdhaishcha nItivinyAsAnmUrkhAnsarvatra varjayet
shlokas.46:
dhArmikAndharmakAryeShu arthakAryeShu paNDitAn |
strIShu klIbAnniyu~njIta krUrAnkrUreShu karmasu
shlokas.47:
svebhyashchaiva parebhyashcha kAryAkAryasamudbhavA |
buddhiH karmasu vij~neyA ripUNAM cha balAbalam
shlokas.48:
buddhyA supratipanneShu kuryAtsAdhuparigraham |
nigrahaM chApyashiShTeShu nirmaryAdeShu kArayet
shlokas.49:
nigrahe pragrahe samyagyadA rAjA pravartate |
tadA bhavati lokasya maryAdA suvyavasthitA
shlokas.50:
eSha te vihitaH pArtha ghoro dharmo duranvayaH |
taM svadharmavibhAgena vinayastho.anupAlaya
shlokas.51:
tapodharmadamejyAbhirviprA yAnti yathA divam |
dAnAtithyakriyAdharmairyAnti vaishyAshcha sadgatim
shlokas.52:
kShatraM yAti tathA svargaM bhuvi nigrahapAlanaiH |
samyakpraNIya daNDaM hi kAmadveShavivarjitAH
alubdhA vigatakrodhAH satAM yAnti salokatAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH saMhRRitya vipulaM tadvapuH kAmavardhitam |
bhImasenaM punardorbhyAM paryaShvajata vAnaraH
shlokas.2:
pariShvaktasya tasyAshu bhrAtrA bhImasya bhArata |
shramo nAshamupAgachChatsarvaM chAsItpradakShiNam
shlokas.3:
tataH punarathovAcha paryashrunayano hariH |
bhImamAbhAShya sauhArdAdbAShpagadgadayA girA
shlokas.4:
gachCha vIra svamAvAsaM smartavyo.asmi kathAntare |
ihasthashcha kurushreShTha na nivedyo.asmi kasyachit
shlokas.5:
dhanadasyAlayAchchApi visRRiShTAnAM mahAbala |
deshakAla ihAyAtuM devagandharvayoShitAm
shlokas.6:
mamApi saphalaM chakShuH smAritashchAsmi rAghavam |
mAnuShaM gAtrasa.nsparshaM gatvA bhIma tvayA saha
shlokas.7:
tadasmaddarshanaM vIra kaunteyAmoghamastu te |
bhrAtRRitvaM tvaM puraskRRitya varaM varaya bhArata
shlokas.8:
yadi tAvanmayA kShudrA gatvA vAraNasAhvayam |
dhArtarAShTrA nihantavyA yAvadetatkaromyaham
shlokas.9:
shilayA nagaraM vA tanmarditavyaM mayA yadi |
yAvadadya karomyetatkAmaM tava mahAbala
shlokas.10:
bhImasenastu tadvAkyaM shrutvA tasya mahAtmanaH |
pratyuvAcha hanUmantaM prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.11:
kRRitameva tvayA sarvaM mama vAnarapu~Ngava |
svasti te.astu mahAbAho kShAmaye tvAM prasIda me
shlokas.12:
sanAthAH pANDavAH sarve tvayA nAthena vIryavan |
tavaiva tejasA sarvAnvijeShyAmo vayaM ripUn
shlokas.13:
evamuktastu hanumAnbhImasenamabhAShata |
bhrAtRRitvAtsauhRRidAchchApi kariShyAmi tava priyam
shlokas.14:
chamUM vigAhya shatrUNAM sharashaktisamAkulAm |
yadA siMharavaM vIra kariShyasi mahAbala
tadAhaM bRRiMhayiShyAmi svaraveNa ravaM tava
shlokas.15:
vijayasya dhvajasthashcha nAdAnmokShyAmi dAruNAn |
shatrUNAM te prANaharAnityuktvAntaradhIyata
shlokas.16:
gate tasminharivare bhImo.api balinAM varaH |
tena mArgeNa vipulaM vyacharadgandhamAdanam
shlokas.17:
anusmaranvapustasya shriyaM chApratimAM bhuvi |
mAhAtmyamanubhAvaM cha smarandAsharatheryayau
shlokas.18:
sa tAni ramaNIyAni vanAnyupavanAni cha |
viloDayAmAsa tadA saugandhikavanepsayA
shlokas.19:
phullapadmavichitrANi puShpitAni vanAni cha |
mattavAraNayUthAni pa~NkaklinnAni bhArata
varShatAmiva meghAnAM vRRindAni dadRRishe tadA
shlokas.20:
hariNaishcha~nchalApA~NgairhariNIsahitairvane |
sashaShpakavalaiH shrImAnpathi dRRiShTo drutaM yayau
shlokas.21:
mahiShaishcha varAhaishcha shArdUlaishcha niShevitam |
vyapetabhIrgiriM shauryAdbhImaseno vyagAhata
shlokas.22:
kusumAnatashAkhaishcha tAmprapallavakomalaiH |
yAchyamAna ivAraNye drumairmArutakampitaiH
shlokas.23:
kRRitapadmA~njalipuTA mattaShaTpadasevitAH |
priyatIrthavanA mArge padminIH samatikraman
shlokas.24:
sajjamAnamanodRRiShTiH phulleShu girisAnuShu |
draupadIvAkyapAtheyo bhImaH shIghrataraM yayau
shlokas.25:
parivRRitte.ahani tataH prakIrNahariNe vane |
kA~nchanairvimalaiH padmairdadarsha vipulAM nadIm
shlokas.26:
mattakAraNDavayutAM chakravAkopashobhitAm |
rachitAmiva tasyAdrermAlAM vimalapa~NkajAm
shlokas.27:
tasyAM nadyAM mahAsattvaH saugandhikavanaM mahat |
apashyatprItijananaM bAlArkasadRRishadyuti
shlokas.28:
taddRRiShTvA labdhakAmaH sa manasA pANDunandanaH |
vanavAsaparikliShTAM jagAma manasA priyAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa gatvA nalinIM ramyAM rAkShasairabhirakShitAm |
kailAsashikhare ramye dadarsha shubhakAnane
shlokas.2:
kuberabhavanAbhyAshe jAtAM parvatanirjhare |
suramyAM vipulachChAyAM nAnAdrumalatAvRRitAm
shlokas.3:
haritAmbujasa~nChannAM divyAM kanakapuShkarAm |
pavitrabhUtAM lokasya shubhAmadbhutadarshanAm
shlokas.4:
tatrAmRRitarasaM shItaM laghu kuntIsutaH shubham |
dadarsha vimalaM toyaM shivaM bahu cha pANDavaH
shlokas.5:
tAM tu puShkariNIM ramyAM padmasaugandhikAyutAm |
jAtarUpamayaiH padmaishChannAM paramagandhibhiH
shlokas.6:
vaiDUryavaranAlaishcha bahuchitrairmanoharaiH |
ha.nsakAraNDavoddhUtaiH sRRijadbhiramalaM rajaH
shlokas.7:
AkrIDaM yakSharAjasya kuberasya mahAtmanaH |
gandharvairapsarobhishcha devaishcha paramArchitAm
shlokas.8:
sevitAmRRiShibhirdivyAM yakShaiH kimpuruShaistathA |
rAkShasaiH kiMnaraishchaiva guptAM vaishravaNena cha
shlokas.9:
tAM cha dRRiShTvaiva kaunteyo bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
babhUva paramaprIto divyaM samprekShya tatsaraH
shlokas.10:
tachcha krodhavashA nAma rAkShasA rAjashAsanAt |
rakShanti shatasAhasrAshchitrAyudhaparichChadAH
shlokas.11:
te tu dRRiShTvaiva kaunteyamajinaiH parivAritam |
rukmA~NgadadharaM vIraM bhImaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.12:
sAyudhaM baddhanistri.nshamasha~Nkitamari.ndamam |
puShkarepsumupAyAntamanyonyamabhichukrushuH
shlokas.13:
ayaM puruShashArdUlaH sAyudho.ajinasa.nvRRitaH |
yachchikIrShuriha prAptastatsampraShTumihArhatha
shlokas.14:
tataH sarve mahAbAhuM samAsAdya vRRikodaram |
tejoyuktamapRRichChanta kastvamAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.15:
muniveShadharashchAsi chIravAsAshcha lakShyase |
yadarthamasi samprAptastadAchakShva mahAdyute

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
pANDavo bhImaseno.ahaM dharmaputrAdanantaraH |
vishAlAM badarIM prApto bhrAtRRibhiH saha rAkShasAH
shlokas.2:
apashyattatra pa~nchAlI saugandhikamanuttamam |
aniloDhamito nUnaM sA bahUni parIpsati
shlokas.3:
tasyA mAmanavadyA~NgyA dharmapatnyAH priye sthitam |
puShpAhAramiha prAptaM nibodhata nishAcharAH
shlokas.4:
rAkShasA UchuH||
AkrIDo.ayaM kuberasya dayitaH puruSharShabha |
neha shakyaM manuShyeNa vihartuM martyadharmiNA
shlokas.5:
devarShayastathA yakShA devAshchAtra vRRikodara |
Amantrya yakShapravaraM pibanti viharanti cha
gandharvApsarasashchaiva viharantyatra pANDava
shlokas.6:
anyAyeneha yaH kashchidavamanya dhaneshvaram |
vihartumichCheddurvRRittaH sa vinashyedasa.nshayam
shlokas.7:
tamanAdRRitya padmAni jihIrShasi balAditaH |
dharmarAjasya chAtmAnaM bravIShi bhrAtaraM katham
shlokas.8:
bhIma uvAcha||
rAkShasAstaM na pashyAmi dhaneshvaramihAntike |
dRRiShTvApi cha mahArAjaM nAhaM yAchitumutsahe
shlokas.9:
na hi yAchanti rAjAna eSha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
na chAhaM hAtumichChAmi kShAtradharmaM katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
iyaM cha nalinI ramyA jAtA parvatanirjhare |
neyaM bhavanamAsAdya kuberasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
tulyA hi sarvabhUtAnAmiyaM vaishravaNasya cha |
eva~NgateShu dravyeShu kaH kaM yAchitumarhati
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA rAkShasAnsarvAnbhImaseno vyagAhata |
tataH sa rAkShasairvAchA pratiShiddhaH pratApavAn
mA maivamiti sakrodhairbhartsayadbhiH samantataH
shlokas.13:
kadarthIkRRitya tu sa tAnrAkShasAnbhImavikramaH |
vyagAhata mahAtejAste taM sarve nyavArayan
shlokas.14:
gRRihNIta badhnIta nikRRintatemaM; pachAma khAdAma cha bhImasenam |
kruddhA bruvanto.anuyayurdrutaM te; shastrANi chodyamya vivRRittanetrAH
shlokas.15:
tataH sa gurvIM yamadaNDakalpAM; mahAgadAM kA~nchanapaTTanaddhAm |
pragRRihya tAnabhyapatattarasvI; tato.abravIttiShThata tiShThateti
shlokas.16:
te taM tadA tomarapaTTishAdyai;rvyAvidhya shastraiH sahasAbhipetuH |
jighA.nsavaH krodhavashAH subhImA; bhImaM samantAtparivavrurugrAH
shlokas.17:
vAtena kuntyAM balavAnsa jAtaH; shUrastarasvI dviShatAM nihantA |
satye cha dharme cha rataH sadaiva; parAkrame shatrubhirapradhRRiShyaH
shlokas.18:
teShAM sa mArgAnvividhAnmahAtmA; nihatya shastrANi cha shAtravANAm |
yathApravIrAnnijaghAna vIraH; paraHshatAnpuShkariNIsamIpe
shlokas.19:
te tasya vIryaM cha balaM cha dRRiShTvA; vidyAbalaM bAhubalaM tathaiva |
ashaknuvantaH sahitAH samantA;ddhatapravIrAH sahasA nivRRittAH
shlokas.20:
vidIryamANAstata eva tUrNa;mAkAshamAsthAya vimUDhasa~nj~nAH |
kailAsashRRi~NgANyabhidudruvuste; bhImArditAH krodhavashAH prabhagnAH
shlokas.21:
sa shakravaddAnavadaityasa~NghA;nvikramya jitvA cha raNe.arisa~NghAn |
vigAhya tAM puShkariNIM jitAriH; kAmAya jagrAha tato.ambujAni
shlokas.22:
tataH sa pItvAmRRitakalpamambho; bhUyo babhUvottamavIryatejAH |
utpATya jagrAha tato.ambujAni; saugandhikAnyuttamagandhavanti
shlokas.23:
tatastu te krodhavashAH sametya; dhaneshvaraM bhImabalapraNunnAH |
bhImasya vIryaM cha balaM cha sa~Nkhye; yathAvadAchakhyuratIva dInAH
shlokas.24:
teShAM vachastattu nishamya devaH; prahasya rakShA.nshi tato.abhyuvAcha |
gRRihNAtu bhImo jalajAni kAmaM; kRRiShNAnimittaM viditaM mamaitat
shlokas.25:
tato.abhyanuj~nAya dhaneshvaraM te; jagmuH kurUNAM pravaraM viroShAH |
bhImaM cha tasyAM dadRRishurnalinyAM; yathopajoShaM viharantamekam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastAni mahArhANi divyAni bharatarShabha |
bahUni bahurUpANi virajA.nsi samAdade
shlokas.2:
tato vAyurmahA~nshIghro nIchaiH sharkarakarShaNaH |
prAdurAsItkharasparshaH sa~NgrAmamabhichodayan
shlokas.3:
papAta mahatI cholkA sanirghAtA mahAprabhA |
niShprabhashchAbhavatsUryashChannarashmistamovRRitaH
shlokas.4:
nirghAtashchAbhavadbhImo bhIme vikramamAsthite |
chachAla pRRithivI chApi pA.nsuvarShaM papAta cha
shlokas.5:
salohitA dishashchAsankharavAcho mRRigadvijAH |
tamovRRitamabhUtsarvaM na praj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.6:
tadadbhutamabhiprekShya dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha vadatAM shreShThaH ko.asmAnabhibhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
sajjIbhavata bhadraM vaH pANDavA yuddhadurmadAH |
yathArUpANi pashyAmi svabhyagro naH parAkramaH
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA tato rAjA vIkShAM chakre samantataH |
apashyamAno bhImaM cha dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.9:
tatra kRRiShNAM yamau chaiva samIpasthAnari.ndamaH |
paprachCha bhrAtaraM bhImaM bhImakarmANamAhave
shlokas.10:
kachchinna bhImaH pA~nchAli ki~nchitkRRityaM chikIrShati |
kRRitavAnapi vA vIraH sAhasaM sAhasapriyaH
shlokas.11:
ime hyakasmAdutpAtA mahAsamaradarshinaH |
darshayanto bhayaM tIvraM prAdurbhUtAH samantataH
shlokas.12:
taM tathA vAdinaM kRRiShNA pratyuvAcha manasvinI |
priyA priyaM chikIrShantI mahiShI chAruhAsinI
shlokas.13:
yattatsaugandhikaM rAjannAhRRitaM mAtarishvanA |
tanmayA bhImasenasya prItayAdyopapAditam
shlokas.14:
api chokto mayA vIro yadi pashyedbahUnyapi |
tAni sarvANyupAdAya shIghramAgamyatAmiti
shlokas.15:
sa tu nUnaM mahAbAhuH priyArthaM mama pANDavaH |
prAgudIchIM dishaM rAja.nstAnyAhartumito gataH
shlokas.16:
uktastvevaM tayA rAjA yamAvidamathAbravIt |
gachChAma sahitAstUrNaM yena yAto vRRikodaraH
shlokas.17:
vahantu rAkShasA viprAnyathAshrAntAnyathAkRRishAn |
tvamapyamarasa~NkAsha vaha kRRiShNAM ghaTotkacha
shlokas.18:
vyaktaM dUramito bhImaH praviShTa iti me matiH |
chiraM cha tasya kAlo.ayaM sa cha vAyusamo jave
shlokas.19:
tarasvI vainateyasya sadRRisho bhuvi la~Nghane |
utpatedapi chAkAshaM nipatechcha yathechChakam
shlokas.20:
tamanviyAma bhavatAM prabhAvAdrajanIcharAH |
purA sa nAparAdhnoti siddhAnAM brahmavAdinAm
shlokas.21:
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve haiDimbapramukhAstadA |
uddeshaj~nAH kuberasya nalinyA bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
AdAya pANDavA.nshchaiva tA.nshcha viprAnanekashaH |
lomashenaiva sahitAH prayayuH prItamAnasAH
shlokas.23:
te gatvA sahitAH sarve dadRRishustatra kAnane |
praphullapa~NkajavatIM nalinIM sumanoharAm
shlokas.24:
taM cha bhImaM mahAtmAnaM tasyAstIre vyavasthitam |
dadRRishurnihatA.nshchaiva yakShAnsuvipulekShaNAn
shlokas.25:
udyamya cha gadAM dorbhyAM nadItIre vyavasthitam |
prajAsa~NkShepasamaye daNDahastamivAntakam
shlokas.26:
taM dRRiShTvA dharmarAjastu pariShvajya punaH punaH |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA kaunteya kimidaM kRRitam
shlokas.27:
sAhasaM bata bhadraM te devAnAmapi chApriyam |
punarevaM na kartavyaM mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.28:
anushAsya cha kaunteyaM padmAni pratigRRihya cha |
tasyAmeva nalinyAM te vijahruramaropamAH
shlokas.29:
etasminneva kAle tu pragRRihItashilAyudhAH |
prAdurAsanmahAkAyAstasyodyAnasya rakShiNaH
shlokas.30:
te dRRiShTvA dharmarAjAnaM devarShiM chApi lomasham |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha tathAnyAnbrAhmaNarShabhAn
vinayenAnatAH sarve praNipetushcha bhArata
shlokas.31:
sAntvitA dharmarAjena praseduH kShaNadAcharAH |
viditAshcha kuberasya tataste narapu~NgavAH
UShurnAtichiraM kAlaM ramamANAH kurUdvahAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastAnparivishvastAnvasatastatra pANDavAn |
gateShu teShu rakShaHsu bhImasenAtmaje.api cha
shlokas.2:
rahitAnbhImasenena kadAchittAnyadRRichChayA |
jahAra dharmarAjAnaM yamau kRRiShNAM cha rAkShasaH
shlokas.3:
brAhmaNo mantrakushalaH sarvAstreShvastravittamaH |
iti bruvanpANDaveyAnparyupAste sma nityadA
shlokas.4:
parIkShamANaH pArthAnAM kalApAni dhanUMShi cha |
antaraM samabhiprepsurnAmnA khyAto jaTAsuraH
shlokas.5:
sa bhImasene niShkrAnte mRRigayArthamari.ndame |
anyadrUpaM samAsthAya vikRRitaM bhairavaM mahat
shlokas.6:
gRRihItvA sarvashastrANi draupadIM parigRRihya cha |
prAtiShThata sa duShTAtmA trIngRRihItvA cha pANDavAn
shlokas.7:
sahadevastu yatnena tato.apakramya pANDavaH |
AkrandadbhImasenaM vai yena yAto mahAbalaH
shlokas.8:
tamabravIddharmarAjo hriyamANo yudhiShThiraH |
dharmaste hIyate mUDha na chainaM samavekShase
shlokas.9:
ye.anye kechinmanuShyeShu tiryagyonigatA api |
gandharvayakSharakShA.nsi vayA.nsi pashavastathA
manuShyAnupajIvanti tatastvamupajIvasi
shlokas.10:
samRRiddhyA hyasya lokasya loko yuShmAkamRRidhyate |
imaM cha lokaM shochantamanushochanti devatAH
pUjyamAnAshcha vardhante havyakavyairyathAvidhi
shlokas.11:
vayaM rAShTrasya goptAro rakShitArashcha rAkShasa |
rAShTrasyArakShyamANasya kuto bhUtiH kutaH sukham
shlokas.12:
na cha rAjAvamantavyo rakShasA jAtvanAgasi |
aNurapyapachArashcha nAstyasmAkaM narAshana
shlokas.13:
drogdhavyaM na cha mitreShu na vishvasteShu karhichit |
yeShAM chAnnAni bhu~njIta yatra cha syAtpratishrayaH
shlokas.14:
sa tvaM pratishraye.asmAkaM pUjyamAnaH sukhoShitaH |
bhuktvA chAnnAni duShpraj~na kathamasmA~njihIrShasi
shlokas.15:
evameva vRRithAchAro vRRithAvRRiddho vRRithAmatiH |
vRRithAmaraNamarhastvaM vRRithAdya na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.16:
atha chedduShTabuddhistvaM sarvairdharmairvivarjitaH |
pradAya shastrANyasmAkaM yuddhena draupadIM hara
shlokas.17:
atha chettvamavij~nAya idaM karma kariShyasi |
adharmaM chApyakIrtiM cha loke prApsyasi kevalam
shlokas.18:
etAmadya parAmRRishya striyaM rAkShasa mAnuShIm |
viShametatsamAloDya kumbhena prAshitaM tvayA
shlokas.19:
tato yudhiShThirastasya bhArikaH samapadyata |
sa tu bhArAbhibhUtAtmA na tathA shIghrago.abhavat
shlokas.20:
athAbravIddraupadIM cha nakulaM cha yudhiShThiraH |
mA bhaiShTa rAkShasAnmUDhAdgatirasya mayA hRRitA
shlokas.21:
nAtidUre mahAbAhurbhavitA pavanAtmajaH |
asminmuhUrte samprApte na bhaviShyati rAkShasaH
shlokas.22:
sahadevastu taM dRRiShTvA rAkShasaM mUDhachetasam |
uvAcha vachanaM rAjankuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.23:
rAjankiM nAma tatkRRityaM kShatriyasyAstyato.adhikam |
yadyuddhe.abhimukhaH prANA.nstyajechChatrU~njayeta vA
shlokas.24:
eSha chAsmAnvayaM chainaM yudhyamAnAH parantapa |
sUdayema mahAbAho deshakAlo hyayaM nRRipa
shlokas.25:
kShatradharmasya samprAptaH kAlaH satyaparAkrama |
jayantaH pAtyamAnA vA prAptumarhAma sadgatim
shlokas.26:
rAkShase jIvamAne.adya ravirastamiyAdyadi |
nAhaM brUyAM punarjAtu kShatriyo.asmIti bhArata
shlokas.27:
bho bho rAkShasa tiShThasva sahadevo.asmi pANDavaH |
hatvA vA mAM nayasvainAnhato vAdyeha svapsyasi
shlokas.28:
tathaiva tasminbruvati bhImaseno yadRRichChayA |
prAdRRishyata mahAbAhuH savajra iva vAsavaH
shlokas.29:
so.apashyadbhrAtarau tatra draupadIM cha yashasvinIm |
kShitisthaM sahadevaM cha kShipantaM rAkShasaM tadA
shlokas.30:
mArgAchcha rAkShasaM mUDhaM kAlopahatachetasam |
bhramantaM tatra tatraiva daivena vinivAritam
shlokas.31:
bhrAtR^I.nstAnhriyato dRRiShTvA draupadIM cha mahAbalaH |
krodhamAhArayadbhImo rAkShasaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.32:
vij~nAto.asi mayA pUrvaM cheShTa~nshastraparIkShaNe |
AsthA tu tvayi me nAsti yato.asi na hatastadA
brahmarUpapratichChanno na no vadasi chApriyam
shlokas.33:
priyeShu charamANaM tvAM na chaivApriyakAriNam |
atithiM brahmarUpaM cha kathaM hanyAmanAgasam
rAkShasaM manyamAno.api yo hanyAnnarakaM vrajet
shlokas.34:
apakvasya cha kAlena vadhastava na vidyate |
nUnamadyAsi sampakvo yathA te matirIdRRishI
dattA kRRiShNApaharaNe kAlenAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.35:
baDisho.ayaM tvayA grastaH kAlasUtreNa lambitaH |
matsyo.ambhasIva syUtAsyaH kathaM me.adya gamiShyasi
shlokas.36:
yaM chAsi prasthito deshaM manaH pUrvaM gataM cha te |
na taM gantAsi gantAsi mArgaM bakahiDimbayoH
shlokas.37:
evamuktastu bhImena rAkShasaH kAlachoditaH |
bhIta utsRRijya tAnsarvAnyuddhAya samupasthitaH
shlokas.38:
abravIchcha punarbhImaM roShAtprasphuritAdharaH |
na me mUDhA dishaH pApa tvadarthaM me vilambanam
shlokas.39:
shrutA me rAkShasA ye ye tvayA vinihatA raNe |
teShAmadya kariShyAmi tavAsreNodakakriyAm
shlokas.40:
evamuktastato bhImaH sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan |
smayamAna iva krodhAtsAkShAtkAlAntakopamaH
bAhusa.nrambhamevechChannabhidudrAva rAkShasam
shlokas.41:
rAkShaso.api tadA bhImaM yuddhArthinamavasthitam |
abhidudrAva sa.nrabdho balo vajradharaM yathA
shlokas.42:
vartamAne tadA tAbhyAM bAhuyuddhe sudAruNe |
mAdrIputrAvabhikruddhAvubhAvapyabhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.43:
nyavArayattau prahasankuntIputro vRRikodaraH |
shakto.ahaM rAkShasasyeti prekShadhvamiti chAbravIt
shlokas.44:
AtmanA bhrAtRRibhishchAhaM dharmeNa sukRRitena cha |
iShTena cha shape rAjansUdayiShyAmi rAkShasam
shlokas.45:
ityevamuktvA tau vIrau spardhamAnau parasparam |
bAhubhiH samasajjetAmubhau rakShovRRikodarau
shlokas.46:
tayorAsItsamprahAraH kruddhayorbhImarakShasoH |
amRRiShyamANayoH sa~Nkhye devadAnavayoriva
shlokas.47:
ArujyArujya tau vRRikShAnanyonyamabhijaghnatuH |
jImUtAviva gharmAnte vinadantau mahAbalau
shlokas.48:
babha~njaturmahAvRRikShAnUrubhirbalinAM varau |
anyonyenAbhisa.nrabdhau parasparajayaiShiNau
shlokas.49:
tadvRRikShayuddhamabhavanmahIruhavinAshanam |
vAlisugrIvayorbhrAtroH pureva kapisiMhayoH
shlokas.50:
AvidhyAvidhya tau vRRikShAnmuhUrtamitaretaram |
tADayAmAsaturubhau vinadantau muhurmuhuH
shlokas.51:
tasmindeshe yadA vRRikShAH sarva eva nipAtitAH |
pu~njIkRRitAshcha shatashaH parasparavadhepsayA
shlokas.52:
tadA shilAH samAdAya muhUrtamiva bhArata |
mahAbhrairiva shailendrau yuyudhAte mahAbalau
shlokas.53:
ugrAbhirugrarUpAbhirbRRihatIbhiH parasparam |
vajrairiva mahAvegairAjaghnaturamarShaNau
shlokas.54:
abhihatya cha bhUyastAvanyonyaM baladarpitau |
bhujAbhyAM parigRRihyAtha chakarShAte gajAviva
shlokas.55:
muShTibhishcha mahAghorairanyonyamabhipetatuH |
tayoshchaTachaTAshabdo babhUva sumahAtmanoH
shlokas.56:
tataH saMhRRitya muShTiM tu pa~nchashIrShamivoragam |
vegenAbhyahanadbhImo rAkShasasya shirodharAm
shlokas.57:
tataH shrAntaM tu tadrakSho bhImasenabhujAhatam |
suparishrAntamAlakShya bhImaseno.abhyavartata
shlokas.58:
tata enaM mahAbAhurbAhubhyAmamaropamaH |
samutkShipya balAdbhImo niShpipeSha mahItale
shlokas.59:
tasya gAtrANi sarvANi chUrNayAmAsa pANDavaH |
aratninA chAbhihatya shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.60:
sa.ndaShToShThaM vivRRittAkShaM phalaM vRRintAdiva chyutam |
jaTAsurasya tu shiro bhImasenabalAddhRRitam
papAta rudhirAdigdhaM sa.ndaShTadashanachChadam
shlokas.61:
taM nihatya maheShvAso yudhiShThiramupAgamat |
stUyamAno dvijAgryaistairmarudbhiriva vAsavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nihate rAkShase tasminpunarnArAyaNAshramam |
abhyetya rAjA kaunteyo nivAsamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.2:
sa samAnIya tAnsarvAnbhrAtR^InityabravIdvachaH |
draupadyA sahitAnkAle sa.nsmaranbhrAtaraM jayam
shlokas.3:
samAshchatasro.abhigatAH shivena charatAM vane |
kRRitoddeshashcha bIbhatsuH pa~nchamImabhitaH samAm
shlokas.4:
prApya parvatarAjAnaM shvetaM shikhariNAM varam |
tatrApi cha kRRitoddeshaH samAgamadidRRikShubhiH
shlokas.5:
kRRitashcha samayastena pArthenAmitatejasA |
pa~ncha varShANi vatsyAmi vidyArthIti purA mayi
shlokas.6:
tatra gANDIvadhanvAnamavAptAstramari.ndamam |
devalokAdimaM lokaM drakShyAmaH punarAgatam
shlokas.7:
ityuktvA brAhmaNAnsarvAnAmantrayata pANDavaH |
kAraNaM chaiva tatteShAmAchachakShe tapasvinAm
shlokas.8:
tamugratapasaH prItAH kRRitvA pArthaM pradakShiNam |
brAhmaNAste.anvamodanta shivena kushalena cha
shlokas.9:
sukhodarkamimaM kleshamachirAdbharatarShabha |
kShatradharmeNa dharmaj~na tIrtvA gAM pAlayiShyasi
shlokas.10:
tattu rAjA vachasteShAM pratigRRihya tapasvinAm |
pratasthe saha vipraistairbhrAtRRibhishcha parantapaH
shlokas.11:
draupadyA sahitaH shrImAnhaiDimbeyAdibhistathA |
rAkShasairanuyAtashcha lomashenAbhirakShitaH
shlokas.12:
kvachijjagAma padbhyAM tu rAkShasairuhyate kvachit |
tatra tatra mahAtejA bhrAtRRibhiH saha suvrataH
shlokas.13:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bahUnkleshAnvichintayan |
siMhavyAghragajAkIrNAmudIchIM prayayau disham
shlokas.14:
avekShamANaH kailAsaM mainAkaM chaiva parvatam |
gandhamAdanapAdA.nshcha meruM chApi shilochchayam
shlokas.15:
uparyupari shailasya bahvIshcha saritaH shivAH |
prasthaM himavataH puNyaM yayau saptadashe.ahani
shlokas.16:
dadRRishuH pANDavA rAjangandhamAdanamantikAt |
pRRiShThe himavataH puNye nAnAdrumalatAyute
shlokas.17:
salilAvartasa~njAtaiH puShpitaishcha mahIruhaiH |
samAvRRitaM puNyatamamAshramaM vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.18:
tamupakramya rAjarShiM dharmAtmAnamari.ndamAH |
pANDavA vRRiShaparvANamavandanta gataklamAH
shlokas.19:
abhyanandatsa rAjarShiH putravadbharatarShabhAn |
pUjitAshchAvasa.nstatra saptarAtramari.ndamAH
shlokas.20:
aShTame.ahani samprApte tamRRiShiM lokavishrutam |
Amantrya vRRiShaparvANaM prasthAnaM samarochayan
shlokas.21:
ekaikashashcha tAnviprAnnivedya vRRiShaparvaNe |
nyAsabhUtAnyathAkAlaM bandhUniva susatkRRitAn
shlokas.22:
tataste varavastrANi shubhAnyAbharaNAni cha |
nyadadhuH pANDavAstasminnAshrame vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.23:
atItAnAgate vidvAnkushalaH sarvadharmavit |
anvashAsatsa dharmaj~naH putravadbharatarShabhAn
shlokas.24:
te.anuj~nAtA mahAtmAnaH prayayurdishamuttarAm |
kRRiShNayA sahitA vIrA brAhmaNaishcha mahAtmabhiH
tAnprasthitAnanvagachChadvRRiShaparvA mahIpatiH
shlokas.25:
upanyasya mahAtejA viprebhyaH pANDavA.nstadA |
anusa.nsAdhya kaunteyAnAshIrbhirabhinandya cha
vRRiShaparvA nivavRRite panthAnamupadishya cha
shlokas.26:
nAnAmRRigagaNairjuShTaM kaunteyaH satyavikramaH |
padAtirbhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM prAtiShThata yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.27:
nAnAdrumanirodheShu vasantaH shailasAnuShu |
parvataM vivishuH shvetaM chaturthe.ahani pANDavAH
shlokas.28:
mahAbhraghanasa~NkAshaM salilopahitaM shubham |
maNikA~nchanaramyaM cha shailaM nAnAsamuchChrayam
shlokas.29:
te samAsAdya panthAnaM yathoktaM vRRiShaparvaNA |
anusasruryathoddeshaM pashyanto vividhAnnagAn
shlokas.30:
uparyupari shailasya guhAH paramadurgamAH |
sudurgamA.nste subahUnsukhenaivAbhichakramuH
shlokas.31:
dhaumyaH kRRiShNA cha pArthAshcha lomashashcha mahAnRRiShiH |
agamansahitAstatra na kashchidavahIyate
shlokas.32:
te mRRigadvijasa~NghuShTaM nAnAdvijasamAkulam |
shAkhAmRRigagaNaishchaiva sevitaM sumanoharam
shlokas.33:
puNyaM padmasaropetaM sapalvalamahAvanam |
upatasthurmahAvIryA mAlyavantaM mahAgirim
shlokas.34:
tataH kimpuruShAvAsaM siddhachAraNasevitam |
dadRRishurhRRiShTaromANaH parvataM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.35:
vidyAdharAnucharitaM kiMnarIbhistathaiva cha |
gajasiMhasamAkIrNamudIrNasharabhAyutam
shlokas.36:
upetamanyaishcha tadA mRRigairmRRiduninAdibhiH |
te gandhamAdanavanaM tannandanavanopamam
shlokas.37:
muditAH pANDutanayA manohRRidayanandanam |
vivishuH kramasho vIrA araNyaM shubhakAnanam
shlokas.38:
draupadIsahitA vIrAstaishcha viprairmahAtmabhiH |
shRRiNvantaH prItijananAnvalgUnmadakalA~nshubhAn
shrotraramyAnsumadhurA~nshabdAnkhagamukheritAn
shlokas.39:
sarvartuphalabhArADhyAnsarvartukusumojjvalAn |
pashyantaH pAdapA.nshchApi phalabhArAvanAmitAn
shlokas.40:
AmrAnAmrAtakAnphullAnnArikelAnsatindukAn |
ajAtakA.nstathA jIrAndADimAnbIjapUrakAn
shlokas.41:
panasA.NllikuchAnmochAnkharjUrAnAmravetasAn |
pArAvatA.nstathA kShaudrAnnIpA.nshchApi manoramAn
shlokas.42:
bilvAnkapitthA~njambU.nshcha kAshmarIrbadarIstathA |
plakShAnudumbaravaTAnashvatthAnkShIriNastathA
bhallAtakAnAmalakAnharItakabibhItakAn
shlokas.43:
i~NgudAnkaravIrA.nshcha tindukA.nshcha mahAphalAn |
etAnanyA.nshcha vividhAngandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.44:
phalairamRRitakalpaistAnAchitAnsvAdubhistarUn |
tathaiva champakAshokAnketakAnbakulA.nstathA
shlokas.45:
puMnAgAnsaptaparNA.nshcha karNikArAnsaketakAn |
pATalAnkuTajAnramyAnmandArendIvarA.nstathA
shlokas.46:
pArijAtAnkovidArAndevadArutarU.nstathA |
shAlA.nstAlA.nstamAlA.nshcha priyAlAnbakulA.nstathA
shAlmalIH ki.nshukAshokA~nshi.nshapA.nstaralA.nstathA
shlokas.47:
chakoraiH shatapatraishcha bhRRi~NgarAjaistathA shukaiH |
kokilaiH kalavi~Nkaishcha hArItairjIvajIvakaiH
shlokas.48:
priyavrataishchAtakaishcha tathAnyairvividhaiH khagaiH |
shrotraramyaM sumadhuraM kUjadbhishchApyadhiShThitAn
shlokas.49:
sarA.nsi cha vichitrANi prasannasalilAni cha |
kumudaiH puNDarIkaishcha tathA kokanadotpalaiH
kahlAraiH kamalaishchaiva AchitAni samantataH
shlokas.50:
kadambaishchakravAkaishcha kurarairjalakukkuTaiH |
kAraNDavaiH plavairha.nsairbakairmadgubhireva cha
etaishchAnyaishcha kIrNAni samantAjjalachAribhiH
shlokas.51:
hRRiShTaistathA tAmarasarasAsavamadAlasaiH |
padmodarachyutarajaHki~njalkAruNara~njitaiH
shlokas.52:
madhurasvarairmadhukarairvirutAnkamalAkarAn |
pashyantaste manoramyAngandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.53:
tathaiva padmaShaNDaishcha maNDiteShu samantataH |
shikhaNDinIbhiH sahitA.NllatAmaNDapakeShu cha
meghatUryaravoddAmamadanAkulitAnbhRRisham
shlokas.54:
kRRitvaiva kekAmadhuraM sa~NgItamadhurasvaram |
chitrAnkalApAnvistIrya savilAsAnmadAlasAn
mayUrAndadRRishushchitrAnnRRityato vanalAsakAn
shlokas.55:
kAntAbhiH sahitAnanyAnapashyanramataH sukham |
vallIlatAsa~NkaTeShu kaTakeShu sthitA.nstathA
shlokas.56:
kA.nshchichChakunajAtA.nshcha viTapeShUtkaTAnapi |
kalAparachitATopAnvichitramukuTAniva
vivareShu tarUNAM cha muditAndadRRishushcha te
shlokas.57:
sindhuvArAnathoddAmAnmanmathasyeva tomarAn |
suvarNakusumAkIrNAngirINAM shikhareShu cha
shlokas.58:
karNikArAnvirachitAnkarNapUrAnivottamAn |
athApashyankurabakAnvanarAjiShu puShpitAn
kAmavashyotsukakarAnkAmasyeva sharotkarAn
shlokas.59:
tathaiva vanarAjInAmudArAnrachitAniva |
virAjamAnA.nste.apashya.nstilakA.nstilakAniva
shlokas.60:
tathAna~NgasharAkArAnsahakArAnmanoramAn |
apashyanbhramarArAvAnma~njarIbhirvirAjitAn
shlokas.61:
hiraNyasadRRishaiH puShpairdAvAgnisadRRishairapi |
lohitaira~njanAbhaishcha vaiDUryasadRRishairapi
shlokas.62:
tathA shAlA.nstamAlA.nshcha pATalyo bakulAni cha |
mAlA iva samAsaktAH shailAnAM shikhareShu cha
shlokas.63:
evaM krameNa te vIrA vIkShamANAH samantataH |
gajasa~NghasamAbAdhaM siMhavyAghrasamAyutam
shlokas.64:
sharabhonnAdasa~NghuShTaM nAnArAvaninAditam |
sarvartuphalapuShpADhyaM gandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.65:
pItA bhAsvaravarNAbhA babhUvurvanarAjayaH |
nAtra kaNTakinaH kechinnAtra kechidapuShpitAH
snigdhapatraphalA vRRikShA gandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.66:
vimalasphaTikAbhAni pANDurachChadanairdvijaiH |
rAjaha.nsairupetAni sArasAbhirutAni cha
sarA.nsi saritaH pArthAH pashyantaH shailasAnuShu
shlokas.67:
padmotpalavichitrANi sukhasparshajalAni cha |
gandhavanti cha mAlyAni rasavanti phalAni cha
atIva vRRikShA rAjante puShpitAH shailasAnuShu
shlokas.68:
ete chAnye cha bahavastatra kAnanajA drumAH |
latAshcha vividhAkArAH patrapuShpaphalochchayAH
shlokas.69:
yudhiShThirastu tAnvRRikShAnpashyamAno nagottame |
bhImasenamidaM vAkyamabravInmadhurAkSharam
shlokas.70:
pashya bhIma shubhAndeshAndevAkrIDAnsamantataH |
amAnuShagatiM prAptAH sa.nsiddhAH sma vRRikodara
shlokas.71:
latAbhishchaiva bahvIbhiH puShpitAH pAdapottamAH |
sa.nshliShTAH pArtha shobhante gandhamAdanasAnuShu
shlokas.72:
shikhaNDinIbhishcharatAM sahitAnAM shikhaNDinAm |
nardatAM shRRiNu nirghoShaM bhIma parvatasAnuShu
shlokas.73:
chakorAH shatapatrAshcha mattakokilashArikAH |
patriNaH puShpitAnetAnsa.nshliShyanti mahAdrumAn
shlokas.74:
raktapItAruNAH pArtha pAdapAgragatA dvijAH |
parasparamudIkShante bahavo jIvajIvakAH
shlokas.75:
haritAruNavarNAnAM shAdvalAnAM samantataH |
sArasAH pratidRRishyante shailaprasravaNeShvapi
shlokas.76:
vadanti madhurA vAchaH sarvabhUtamanonugAH |
bhRRi~NgarAjopachakrAshcha lohapRRiShThAshcha patriNaH
shlokas.77:
chaturviShANAH padmAbhAH ku~njarAH sakareNavaH |
ete vaiDUryavarNAbhaM kShobhayanti mahatsaraH
shlokas.79:
bhAskarAbhaprabhA bhIma shAradAbhraghanopamAH |
shobhayanti mahAshailaM nAnArajatadhAtavaH
shlokas.80:
kvachida~njanavarNAbhAH kvachitkA~nchanasaMnibhAH |
dhAtavo haritAlasya kvachiddhi~Ngulakasya cha
shlokas.82:
sitAsitAbhrapratimA bAlasUryasamaprabhAH |
ete bahuvidhAH shailaM shobhayanti mahAprabhAH
shlokas.83:
gandharvAH saha kAntAbhiryathoktaM vRRiShaparvaNA |
dRRishyante shailashRRi~NgeShu pArtha kimpuruShaiH saha
shlokas.84:
gItAnAM talatAlAnAM yathA sAmnAM cha nisvanaH |
shrUyate bahudhA bhIma sarvabhUtamanoharaH
shlokas.86:
dhAtubhishcha saridbhishcha kiMnarairmRRigapakShibhiH |
gandharvairapsarobhishcha kAnanaishcha manoramaiH
shlokas.87:
vyAlaishcha vividhAkAraiH shatashIrShaiH samantataH |
upetaM pashya kaunteya shailarAjamari.ndama
shlokas.88:
te prItamanasaH shUrAH prAptA gatimanuttamAm |
nAtRRipyanparvatendrasya darshanena parantapAH
shlokas.89:
upetamatha mAlyaishcha phalavadbhishcha pAdapaiH |
ArShTiSheNasya rAjarSherAshramaM dadRRishustadA
shlokas.90:
tatastaM tIvratapasaM kRRishaM dhamanisantatam |
pAragaM sarvadharmANAmArShTiSheNamupAgaman

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirastamAsAdya tapasA dagdhakilbiSham |
abhyavAdayata prItaH shirasA nAma kIrtayan
shlokas.2:
tataH kRRiShNA cha bhImashcha yamau chApi yashasvinau |
shirobhiH prApya rAjarShiM parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.3:
tathaiva dhaumyo dharmaj~naH pANDavAnAM purohitaH |
yathAnyAyamupAkrAntastamRRiShiM sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.4:
anvajAnAtsa dharmaj~no munirdivyena chakShuShA |
pANDoH putrAnkurushreShThAnAsyatAmiti chAbravIt
shlokas.5:
kurUNAmRRiShabhaM prAj~naM pUjayitvA mahAtapAH |
saha bhrAtRRibhirAsInaM paryapRRichChadanAmayam
shlokas.6:
nAnRRite kuruShe bhAvaM kachchiddharme cha vartase |
matApitroshcha te vRRittiH kachchitpArtha na sIdati
shlokas.7:
kachchitte guravaH sarve vRRiddhA vaidyAshcha pUjitAH |
kachchinna kuruShe bhAvaM pArtha pApeShu karmasu
shlokas.8:
sukRRitaM pratikartuM cha kachchiddhAtuM cha duShkRRitam |
yathAnyAyaM kurushreShTha jAnAsi na cha katthase
shlokas.9:
yathArhaM mAnitAH kachchittvayA nandanti sAdhavaH |
vaneShvapi vasankachchiddharmamevAnuvartase
shlokas.10:
kachchiddhaumyastvadAchArairna pArtha paritapyate |
dAnadharmatapaHshauchairArjavena titikShayA
shlokas.11:
pitRRipaitAmahaM vRRittaM kachchitpArthAnuvartase |
kachchidrAjarShiyAtena pathA gachChasi pANDava
shlokas.12:
sve sve kila kule jAte putre naptari vA punaH |
pitaraH pitRRilokasthAH shochanti cha hasanti cha
shlokas.13:
kiM nvasya duShkRRite.asmAbhiH samprAptavyaM bhaviShyati |
kiM chAsya sukRRite.asmAbhiH prAptavyamiti shobhanam
shlokas.14:
pitA mAtA tathaivAgnirgururAtmA cha pa~nchamaH |
yasyaite pUjitAH pArtha tasya lokAvubhau jitau
shlokas.15:
abbhakShA vAyubhakShAshcha plavamAnA vihAyasA |
juShante parvatashreShThamRRiShayaH parvasandhiShu
shlokas.16:
kAminaH saha kAntAbhiH parasparamanuvratAH |
dRRishyante shailashRRi~NgasthAstathA kimpuruShA nRRipa
shlokas.17:
arajA.nsi cha vAsA.nsi vasAnAH kaushikAni cha |
dRRishyante bahavaH pArtha gandharvApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.18:
vidyAdharagaNAshchaiva sragviNaH priyadarshanAH |
mahoragagaNAshchaiva suparNAshchoragAdayaH
shlokas.19:
asya chopari shailasya shrUyate parvasandhiShu |
bherIpaNavasha~NkhAnAM mRRida~NgAnAM cha nisvanaH
shlokas.20:
ihasthaireva tatsarvaM shrotavyaM bharatarShabhAH |
na kAryA vaH katha~nchitsyAttatrAbhisaraNe matiH
shlokas.21:
na chApyataH paraM shakyaM gantuM bharatasattamAH |
vihAro hyatra devAnAmamAnuShagatistu sA
shlokas.22:
IShachchapalakarmANaM manuShyamiha bhArata |
dviShanti sarvabhUtAni tADayanti cha rAkShasAH
shlokas.23:
abhyatikramya shikharaM shailasyAsya yudhiShThira |
gatiH paramasiddhAnAM devarShINAM prakAshate
shlokas.24:
chApalAdiha gachChantaM pArtha yAnamataH param |
ayaHshUlAdibhirghnanti rAkShasAH shatrusUdana
shlokas.25:
apsarobhiH parivRRitaH samRRiddhyA naravAhanaH |
iha vaishravaNastAta parvasandhiShu dRRishyate
shlokas.26:
shikhare taM samAsInamadhipaM sarvarakShasAm |
prekShante sarvabhUtAni bhAnumantamivoditam
shlokas.27:
devadAnavasiddhAnAM tathA vaishravaNasya cha |
gireH shikharamudyAnamidaM bharatasattama
shlokas.28:
upAsInasya dhanadaM tumburoH parvasandhiShu |
gItasAmasvanastAta shrUyate gandhamAdane
shlokas.29:
etadeva.nvidhaM chitramiha tAta yudhiShThira |
prekShante sarvabhUtAni bahushaH parvasandhiShu
shlokas.30:
bhu~njAnAH sarvabhojyAni rasavanti phalAni cha |
vasadhvaM pANDavashreShThA yAvadarjunadarshanam
shlokas.31:
na tAta chapalairbhAvyamiha prAptaiH katha~nchana |
uShitveha yathAkAmaM yathAshraddhaM vihRRitya cha
tataH shastrabhRRitAM shreShTha pRRithivIM pAlayiShyasi

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
pANDoH putrA mahAtmAnaH sarve divyaparAkramAH |
kiyantaM kAlamavasanparvate gandhamAdane
shlokas.2:
kAni chAbhyavahAryANi tatra teShAM mahAtmanAm |
vasatAM lokavIrANAmAsa.nstadbrUhi sattama
shlokas.3:
vistareNa cha me sha.nsa bhImasenaparAkramam |
yadyachchakre mahAbAhustasminhaimavate girau
na khalvAsItpunaryuddhaM tasya yakShairdvijottama
shlokas.4:
kachchitsamAgamasteShAmAsIdvaishravaNena cha |
tatra hyAyAti dhanada ArShTiSheNo yathAbravIt
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa tapodhana |
na hi me shRRiNvatastRRiptirasti teShAM vicheShTitam
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etadAtmahitaM shrutvA tasyApratimatejasaH |
shAsanaM satataM chakrustathaiva bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.7:
bhu~njAnA munibhojyAni rasavanti phalAni cha |
shuddhabANahatAnAM cha mRRigANAM pishitAnyapi
shlokas.8:
medhyAni himavatpRRiShThe madhUni vividhAni cha |
evaM te nyavasa.nstatra pANDavA bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.9:
tathA nivasatAM teShAM pa~nchamaM varShamabhyagAt |
shRRiNvatAM lomashoktAni vAkyAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.10:
kRRityakAla upasthAsya iti choktvA ghaTotkachaH |
rAkShasaiH sahitaH sarvaiH pUrvameva gataH prabho
shlokas.11:
ArShTiSheNAshrame teShAM vasatAM vai mahAtmanAm |
agachChanbahavo mAsAH pashyatAM mahadadbhutam
shlokas.12:
taistatra ramamANaishcha viharadbhishcha pANDavaiH |
prItimanto mahAbhAgA munayashchAraNAstathA
shlokas.13:
AjagmuH pANDavAndraShTuM siddhAtmAno yatavratAH |
taistaiH saha kathAshchakrurdivyA bharatasattamAH
shlokas.14:
tataH katipayAhasya mahAhradanivAsinam |
RRiddhimantaM mahAnAgaM suparNaH sahasAharat
shlokas.15:
prAkampata mahAshailaH prAmRRidyanta mahAdrumAH |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni pANDavAshcha tadadbhutam
shlokas.16:
tataH shailottamasyAgrAtpANDavAnprati mArutaH |
avahatsarvamAlyAni gandhavanti shubhAni cha
shlokas.17:
tatra puShpANi divyAni suhRRidbhiH saha pANDavAH |
dadRRishuH pa~ncha varNAni draupadI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.18:
bhImasenaM tataH kRRiShNA kAle vachanamabravIt |
vivikte parvatoddeshe sukhAsInaM mahAbhujam
shlokas.19:
suparNAnilavegena shvasanena mahAbalAt |
pa~nchavarNAni pAtyante puShpANi bharatarShabha
pratyakShaM sarvabhUtAnAM nadImashvarathAM prati
shlokas.20:
khANDave satyasandhena bhrAtrA tava nareshvara |
gandharvoragarakShA.nsi vAsavashcha nivAritaH
hatA mAyAvinashchogrA dhanuH prAptaM cha gANDivam
shlokas.21:
tavApi sumahattejo mahadbAhubalaM cha te |
aviShahyamanAdhRRiShyaM shatakratubalopamam
shlokas.22:
tvadbAhubalavegena trAsitAH sarvarAkShasAH |
hitvA shailaM prapadyantAM bhImasena disho dasha
shlokas.23:
tataH shailottamasyAgraM chitramAlyadharaM shivam |
vyapetabhayasaMmohAH pashyantu suhRRidastava
shlokas.24:
evaM praNihitaM bhIma chirAtprabhRRiti me manaH |
draShTumichChAmi shailAgraM tvadbAhubalamAshritA
shlokas.25:
tataH kShiptamivAtmAnaM draupadyA sa parantapaH |
nAmRRiShyata mahAbAhuH prahAramiva sadgavaH
shlokas.26:
siMharShabhagatiH shrImAnudAraH kanakaprabhaH |
manasvI balavAndRRipto mAnI shUrashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.27:
lohitAkShaH pRRithuvya.nso mattavAraNavikramaH |
siMhadaMShTro bRRihatskandhaH shAlapota ivodgataH
shlokas.28:
mahAtmA chArusarvA~NgaH kambugrIvo mahAbhujaH |
rukmapRRiShThaM dhanuH khaDgaM tUNA.nshchApi parAmRRishat
shlokas.29:
kesarIva yathotsiktaH prabhinna iva vAraNaH |
vyapetabhayasaMmohaH shailamabhyapatadbalI
shlokas.30:
taM mRRigendramivAyAntaM prabhinnamiva vAraNam |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni bANakhaDgadhanurdharam
shlokas.31:
draupadyA vardhayanharShaM gadAmAdAya pANDavaH |
vyapetabhayasaMmohaH shailarAjaM samAvishat
shlokas.32:
na glAnirna cha kAtaryaM na vaiklavyaM na matsaraH |
kadAchijjuShate pArthamAtmajaM mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.33:
tadekAyanamAsAdya viShamaM bhImadarshanam |
bahutAlochChrayaM shRRi~NgamAruroha mahAbalaH
shlokas.34:
sa kiMnaramahAnAgamunigandharvarAkShasAn |
harShayanparvatasyAgramAsasAda mahAbalaH
shlokas.35:
tatra vaishravaNAvAsaM dadarsha bharatarShabhaH |
kA~nchanaiH sphATikAkArairveshmabhiH samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.36:
modayansarvabhUtAni gandhamAdanasambhavaH |
sarvagandhavahastatra mArutaH susukho vavau
shlokas.37:
chitrA vividhavarNAbhAshchitrama~njaridhAriNaH |
achintyA vividhAstatra drumAH paramashobhanAH
shlokas.38:
ratnajAlaparikShiptaM chitramAlyadharaM shivam |
rAkShasAdhipateH sthAnaM dadarsha bharatarShabhaH
shlokas.39:
gadAkhaDgadhanuShpANiH samabhityaktajIvitaH |
bhImaseno mahAbAhustasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.40:
tataH sha~NkhamupAdhmAsIddviShatAM lomaharShaNam |
jyAghoShatalaghoShaM cha kRRitvA bhUtAnyamohayat
shlokas.41:
tataH saMhRRiShTaromANaH shabdaM tamabhidudruvuH |
yakSharAkShasagandharvAH pANDavasya samIpataH
shlokas.42:
gadAparighanistri.nshashaktishUlaparashvadhAH |
pragRRihItA vyarochanta yakSharAkShasabAhubhiH
shlokas.43:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM teShAM tasya cha bhArata |
taiH prayuktAnmahAkAyaiH shaktishUlaparashvadhAn
bhallairbhImaH prachichCheda bhImavegataraistataH
shlokas.44:
antarikShacharANAM cha bhUmiShThAnAM cha garjatAm |
sharairvivyAdha gAtrANi rAkShasAnAM mahAbalaH
shlokas.45:
sA lohitamahAvRRiShTirabhyavarShanmahAbalam |
kAyebhyaH prachyutA dhArA rAkShasAnAM samantataH
shlokas.46:
bhImabAhubalotsRRiShTairbahudhA yakSharakShasAm |
vinikRRittAnyadRRishyanta sharIrANi shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.47:
prachChAdyamAnaM rakShobhiH pANDavaM priyadarshanam |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni sUryamabhragaNairiva
shlokas.48:
sa rashmibhirivAdityaH sharairarinighAtibhiH |
sarvAnArChanmahAbAhurbalavAnsatyavikramaH
shlokas.49:
abhitarjayamAnAshcha ruvantashcha mahAravAn |
na mohaM bhImasenasya dadRRishuH sarvarAkShasAH
shlokas.50:
te sharaiH kShatasarvA~NgA bhImasenabhayArditAH |
bhImamArtasvaraM chakrurviprakIrNamahAyudhAH
shlokas.51:
utsRRijya te gadAshUlAnasishaktiparashvadhAn |
dakShiNAM dishamAjagmustrAsitA dRRiDhadhanvanA
shlokas.52:
tatra shUlagadApANirvyUDhorasko mahAbhujaH |
sakhA vaishravaNasyAsInmaNimAnnAma rAkShasaH
shlokas.53:
adarshayadadhIkAraM pauruShaM cha mahAbalaH |
sa tAndRRiShTvA parAvRRittAnsmayamAna ivAbravIt
shlokas.54:
ekena bahavaH sa~Nkhye mAnuSheNa parAjitAH |
prApya vaishravaNAvAsaM kiM vakShyatha dhaneshvaram
shlokas.55:
evamAbhAShya tAnsarvAnnyavartata sa rAkShasaH |
shaktishUlagadApANirabhyadhAvachcha pANDavam
shlokas.56:
tamApatantaM vegena prabhinnamiva vAraNam |
vatsadantaistribhiH pArshve bhImasenaH samarpayat
shlokas.57:
maNimAnapi sa~NkruddhaH pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
prAhiNodbhImasenAya parikShipya mahAbalaH
shlokas.58:
vidyudrUpAM mahAghorAmAkAshe mahatIM gadAm |
sharairbahubhirabhyarChadbhImasenaH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.59:
pratyahanyanta te sarve gadAmAsAdya sAyakAH |
na vegaM dhArayAmAsurgadAvegasya vegitAH
shlokas.60:
gadAyuddhasamAchAraM budhyamAnaH sa vIryavAn |
vya.nsayAmAsa taM tasya prahAraM bhImavikramaH
shlokas.61:
tataH shaktiM mahAghorAM rukmadaNDAmayasmayIm |
tasminnevAntare dhImAnprajahArAtha rAkShasaH
shlokas.62:
sA bhujaM bhImanirhrAdA bhittvA bhImasya dakShiNam |
sAgnijvAlA mahAraudrA papAta sahasA bhuvi
shlokas.63:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH shaktyAmitaparAkramaH |
gadAM jagrAha kauravyo gadAyuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.64:
tAM pragRRihyonnadanbhImaH sarvashaikyAyasIM gadAm |
tarasA so.abhidudrAva maNimantaM mahAbalam
shlokas.65:
dIpyamAnaM mahAshUlaM pragRRihya maNimAnapi |
prAhiNodbhImasenAya vegena mahatA nadan
shlokas.66:
bha~NktvA shUlaM gadAgreNa gadAyuddhavishAradaH |
abhidudrAva taM tUrNaM garutmAniva pannagam
shlokas.67:
so.antarikShamabhiplutya vidhUya sahasA gadAm |
prachikShepa mahAbAhurvinadya raNamUrdhani
shlokas.68:
sendrAshanirivendreNa visRRiShTA vAtaraMhasA |
hatvA rakShaH kShitiM prApya kRRityeva nipapAta ha
shlokas.69:
taM rAkShasaM bhImabalaM bhImasenena pAtitam |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni siMheneva gavAM patim
shlokas.70:
taM prekShya nihataM bhUmau hatasheShA nishAcharAH |
bhImamArtasvaraM kRRitvA jagmuH prAchIM dishaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA bahuvidhaiH shabdairnAdyamAnA girerguhAH |
ajAtashatruH kaunteyo mAdrIputrAvubhAvapi
shlokas.2:
dhaumyaH kRRiShNA cha viprAshcha sarve cha suhRRidastathA |
bhImasenamapashyantaH sarve vimanaso.abhavan
shlokas.3:
draupadImArShTiSheNAya pradAya tu mahArathAH |
sahitAH sAyudhAH shUrAH shailamAruruhustadA
shlokas.4:
tataH samprApya shailAgraM vIkShamANA mahArathAH |
dadRRishuste maheShvAsA bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.5:
sphuratashcha mahAkAyAngatasattvA.nshcha rAkShasAn |
mahAbalAnmahAghorAnbhImasenena pAtitAn
shlokas.6:
shushubhe sa mahAbAhurgadAkhaDgadhanurdharaH |
nihatya samare sarvAndAnavAnmaghavAniva
shlokas.7:
tataste samatikramya pariShvajya vRRikodaram |
tatropavivishuH pArthAH prAptA gatimanuttamAm
shlokas.8:
taishchaturbhirmaheShvAsairgirishRRi~Ngamashobhata |
lokapAlairmahAbhAgairdivaM devavarairiva
shlokas.9:
kuberasadanaM dRRiShTvA rAkShasA.nshcha nipAtitAn |
bhrAtA bhrAtaramAsInamabhyabhAShata pANDavam
shlokas.10:
sAhasAdyadi vA mohAdbhIma pApamidaM kRRitam |
naitatte sadRRishaM vIra muneriva mRRiShAvachaH
shlokas.11:
rAjadviShTaM na kartavyamiti dharmavido viduH |
tridashAnAmidaM dviShTaM bhImasena tvayA kRRitam
shlokas.12:
arthadharmAvanAdRRitya yaH pApe kurute manaH |
karmaNAM pArtha pApAnAM sa phalaM vindate dhruvam
punarevaM na kartavyaM mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.13:
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA bhrAtA bhrAtaramachyutam |
arthatattvavibhAgaj~naH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
virarAma mahAtejAstamevArthaM vichintayan
shlokas.14:
tatastu hatashiShTA ye bhImasenena rAkShasAH |
sahitAH pratyapadyanta kuberasadanaM prati
shlokas.15:
te javena mahAvegAH prApya vaishravaNAlayam |
bhImamArtasvaraM chakrurbhImasenabhayArditAH
shlokas.16:
nyastashastrAyudhAH shrAntAH shoNitAktaparichChadAH |
prakIrNamUrdhajA rAjanyakShAdhipatimabruvan
shlokas.17:
gadAparighanistri.nshatomaraprAsayodhinaH |
rAkShasA nihatAH sarve tava deva puraHsarAH
shlokas.18:
pramRRidya tarasA shailaM mAnuSheNa dhaneshvara |
ekena sahitAH sa~Nkhye hatAH krodhavashA gaNAH
shlokas.19:
pravarA rakShasendrANAM yakShANAM cha dhanAdhipa |
sherate nihatA deva gatasattvAH parAsavaH
shlokas.20:
labdhaH shailo vayaM muktA maNimA.nste sakhA hataH |
mAnuSheNa kRRitaM karma vidhatsva yadanantaram
shlokas.21:
sa tachChrutvA tu sa~NkruddhaH sarvayakShagaNAdhipaH |
kopasa.nraktanayanaH kathamityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.22:
dvitIyamaparAdhyantaM bhImaM shrutvA dhaneshvaraH |
chukrodha yakShAdhipatiryujyatAmiti chAbravIt
shlokas.23:
athAbhraghanasa~NkAshaM girikUTamivochChritam |
hayaiH sa.nyojayAmAsurgAndharvairuttamaM ratham
shlokas.24:
tasya sarvaguNopetA vimalAkShA hayottamAH |
tejobalajavopetA nAnAratnavibhUShitAH
shlokas.25:
shobhamAnA rathe yuktAstariShyanta ivAshugAH |
harShayAmAsuranyonyami~NgitairvijayAvahaiH
shlokas.26:
sa tamAsthAya bhagavAnrAjarAjo mahAratham |
prayayau devagandharvaiH stUyamAno mahAdyutiH
shlokas.27:
taM prayAntaM mahAtmAnaM sarvayakShadhanAdhipam |
raktAkShA hemasa~NkAshA mahAkAyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.28:
sAyudhA baddhanistri.nshA yakShA dashashatAyutAH |
javena mahatA vIrAH parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.29:
taM mahAntamupAyAntaM dhaneshvaramupAntike |
dadRRishurhRRiShTaromANaH pANDavAH priyadarshanam
shlokas.30:
kuberastu mahAsattvAnpANDoH putrAnmahArathAn |
AttakArmukanistri.nshAndRRiShTvA prIto.abhavattadA
shlokas.31:
te pakShiNa ivotpatya gireH shRRi~NgaM mahAjavAH |
tasthusteShAM samabhyAshe dhaneshvarapuraHsarAH
shlokas.32:
tatastaM hRRiShTamanasaM pANDavAnprati bhArata |
samIkShya yakShagandharvA nirvikArA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.33:
pANDavAshcha mahAtmAnaH praNamya dhanadaM prabhum |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dharmaputrashcha dharmavit
shlokas.34:
aparAddhamivAtmAnaM manyamAnA mahArathAH |
tasthuH prA~njalayaH sarve parivArya dhaneshvaram
shlokas.35:
shayyAsanavaraM shrImatpuShpakaM vishvakarmaNA |
vihitaM chitraparyantamAtiShThata dhanAdhipaH
shlokas.36:
tamAsInaM mahAkAyAH sha~NkukarNA mahAjavAH |
upopavivishuryakShA rAkShasAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.37:
shatashashchApi gandharvAstathaivApsarasAM gaNAH |
parivAryopatiShThanta yathA devAH shatakratum
shlokas.38:
kA~nchanIM shirasA bibhradbhImasenaH srajaM shubhAm |
bANakhaDgadhanuShpANirudaikShata dhanAdhipam
shlokas.39:
na bhIrbhImasya na glAnirvikShatasyApi rAkShasaiH |
AsIttasyAmavasthAyAM kuberamapi pashyataH
shlokas.40:
AdadAnaM shitAnbANAnyoddhukAmamavasthitam |
dRRiShTvA bhImaM dharmasutamabravInnaravAhanaH
shlokas.41:
vidustvAM sarvabhUtAni pArtha bhUtahite ratam |
nirbhayashchApi shailAgre vasa tvaM saha bandhubhiH
shlokas.42:
na cha manyustvayA kAryo bhImasenasya pANDava |
kAlenaite hatAH pUrvaM nimittamanujastava
shlokas.43:
vrIDA chAtra na kartavyA sAhasaM yadidaM kRRitam |
dRRiShTashchApi suraiH pUrvaM vinAsho yakSharakShasAm
shlokas.44:
na bhImasene kopo me prIto.asmi bharatarShabha |
karmaNAnena bhImasya mama tuShTirabhUtpurA
shlokas.45:
evamuktvA tu rAjAnaM bhImasenamabhAShata |
naitanmanasi me tAta vartate kurusattama
yadidaM sAhasaM bhIma kRRiShNArthe kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.46:
mAmanAdRRitya devA.nshcha vinAshaM yakSharakShasAm |
svabAhubalamAshritya tenAhaM prItimA.nstvayi
shApAdasmi vinirmukto ghorAdadya vRRikodara
shlokas.47:
ahaM pUrvamagastyena kruddhena paramarShiNA |
shapto.aparAdhe kasmi.nshchittasyaiShA niShkRRitiH kRRitA
shlokas.48:
dRRiShTo hi mama sa~NkleshaH purA pANDavanandana |
na tavAtrAparAdho.asti katha~nchidapi shatruhan
shlokas.49:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM shapto.asi bhagavannagastyena mahAtmanA |
shrotumichChAmyahaM deva tavaitachChApakAraNam
shlokas.50:
idaM chAshcharyabhUtaM me yatkrodhAttasya dhImataH |
tadaiva tvaM na nirdagdhaH sabalaH sapadAnugaH
shlokas.51:
vaishravaNa uvAcha||
devatAnAmabhUnmantraH kushavatyAM nareshvara |
vRRitastatrAhamagamaM mahApadmashataistribhiH
yakShANAM ghorarUpANAM vividhAyudhadhAriNAm
shlokas.52:
adhvanyahamathApashyamagastyamRRiShisattamam |
ugraM tapastapasyantaM yamunAtIramAshritam
nAnApakShigaNAkIrNaM puShpitadrumashobhitam
shlokas.53:
tamUrdhvabAhuM dRRiShTvA tu sUryasyAbhimukhaM sthitam |
tejorAshiM dIpyamAnaM hutAshanamivaidhitam
shlokas.54:
rAkShasAdhipatiH shrImAnmaNimAnnAma me sakhA |
maurkhyAdaj~nAnabhAvAchcha darpAnmohAchcha bhArata
nyaShThIvadAkAshagato maharShestasya mUrdhani
shlokas.55:
sa kopAnmAmuvAchedaM dishaH sarvA dahanniva |
mAmavaj~nAya duShTAtmA yasmAdeSha sakhA tava
shlokas.56:
dharShaNAM kRRitavAnetAM pashyataste dhaneshvara |
tasmAtsahaibhiH sainyaiste vadhaM prApsyati mAnuShAt
shlokas.57:
tvaM chApyebhirhataiH sainyaiH kleshaM prApsyasi durmate |
tameva mAnuShaM dRRiShTvA kilbiShAdvipramokShyase
shlokas.58:
sainyAnAM tu tavaiteShAM putrapautrabalAnvitam |
na shApaM prApsyate ghoraM gachCha te.a.aj~nAM kariShyati
shlokas.59:
eSha shApo mayA prAptaH prAktasmAdRRiShisattamAt |
sa bhImena mahArAja bhrAtrA tava vimokShitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishravaNa uvAcha||
yudhiShThira dhRRitirdAkShyaM deshakAlau parAkramaH |
lokatantravidhAnAnAmeSha pa~nchavidho vidhiH
shlokas.2:
dhRRitimantashcha dakShAshcha sve sve karmaNi bhArata |
parAkramavidhAnaj~nA narAH kRRitayuge.abhavan
shlokas.3:
dhRRitimAndeshakAlaj~naH sarvadharmavidhAnavit |
kShatriyaH kShatriyashreShTha pRRithivImanushAsti vai
shlokas.4:
ya evaM vartate pArtha puruShaH sarvakarmasu |
sa loke labhate vIra yashaH pretya cha sadgatim
shlokas.5:
deshakAlAntaraprepsuH kRRitvA shakraH parAkramam |
samprAptastridive rAjyaM vRRitrahA vasubhiH saha
shlokas.6:
pApAtmA pApabuddhiryaH pApamevAnuvartate |
karmaNAmavibhAgaj~naH pretya cheha cha nashyati
shlokas.7:
akAlaj~naH sudurmedhAH kAryANAmavisheShavit |
vRRithAchArasamArambhaH pretya cheha cha nashyati
shlokas.8:
sAhase vartamAnAnAM nikRRitInAM durAtmanAm |
sarvasAmarthyalipsUnAM pApo bhavati nishchayaH
shlokas.9:
adharmaj~no.avaliptashcha bAlabuddhiramarShaNaH |
nirbhayo bhImaseno.ayaM taM shAdhi puruSharShabha
shlokas.10:
ArShTiSheNasya rAjarSheH prApya bhUyastvamAshramam |
tAmisraM prathamaM pakShaM vItashokabhayo vasa
shlokas.11:
alakAH saha gandharvairyakShaishcha saha rAkShasaiH |
manniyuktA manuShyendra sarve cha girivAsinaH
rakShantu tvA mahAbAho sahitaM dvijasattamaiH
shlokas.12:
sAhaseShu cha santiShThanniha shaile vRRikodaraH |
vAryatAM sAdhvayaM rAja.nstvayA dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.13:
itaH paraM cha rAjendra drakShyanti vanagocharAH |
upasthAsyanti cha sadA rakShiShyanti cha sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
tathaiva chAnnapAnAni svAdUni cha bahUni cha |
upasthAsyanti vo gRRihya matpreShyAH puruSharShabha
shlokas.15:
yathA jiShNurmahendrasya yathA vAyorvRRikodaraH |
dharmasya tvaM yathA tAta yogotpanno nijaH sutaH
shlokas.16:
AtmajAvAtmasampannau yamau chobhau yathAshvinoH |
rakShyAstadvanmamApIha yUyaM sarve yudhiShThira
shlokas.17:
arthatattvavibhAgaj~naH sarvadharmavisheShavit |
bhImasenAdavarajaH phalgunaH kushalI divi
shlokas.18:
yAH kAshchana matA lokeShvagryAH paramasampadaH |
janmaprabhRRiti tAH sarvAH sthitAstAta dhana~njaye
shlokas.19:
damo dAnaM balaM buddhirhrIrdhRRitisteja uttamam |
etAnyapi mahAsattve sthitAnyamitatejasi
shlokas.20:
na mohAtkurute jiShNuH karma pANDava garhitam |
na pArthasya mRRiShoktAni kathayanti narA nRRiShu
shlokas.21:
sa devapitRRigandharvaiH kurUNAM kIrtivardhanaH |
mAnitaH kurute.astrANi shakrasadmani bhArata
shlokas.22:
yo.asau sarvAnmahIpAlAndharmeNa vashamAnayat |
sa shantanurmahAtejAH pitustava pitAmahaH
prIyate pArtha pArthena divi gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.23:
samyakchAsau mahAvIryaH kuladhurya iva sthitaH |
pitR^IndevA.nstathA viprAnpUjayitvA mahAyashAH
sapta mukhyAnmahAmedhAnAharadyamunAM prati
shlokas.24:
adhirAjaH sa rAja.nstvAM shantanuH prapitAmahaH |
svargajichChakralokasthaH kushalaM paripRRichChati
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shaktiM gadAM khaDgaM dhanushcha bharatarShabha |
prAdhvaM kRRitvA namashchakre kuberAya vRRikodaraH
shlokas.26:
tato.abravIddhanAdhyakShaH sharaNyaH sharaNAgatam |
mAnahA bhava shatrUNAM suhRRidAM nandivardhanaH
shlokas.27:
sveShu veshmasu ramyeShu vasatAmitratApanAH |
kAmAnupahariShyanti yakShA vo bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.28:
shIghrameva guDAkeshaH kRRitAstraH puruSharShabhaH |
sAkShAnmaghavatA sRRiShTaH samprApsyati dhana~njayaH
shlokas.29:
evamuttamakarmANamanushiShya yudhiShThiram |
astaM girivarashreShThaM prayayau guhyakAdhipaH
shlokas.30:
taM paristomasa~NkIrNairnAnAratnavibhUShitaiH |
yAnairanuyayuryakShA rAkShasAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.31:
pakShiNAmiva nirghoShaH kuberasadanaM prati |
babhUva paramAshvAnAmairAvatapathe yatAm
shlokas.32:
te jagmustUrNamAkAshaM dhanAdhipativAjinaH |
prakarShanta ivAbhrANi pibanta iva mArutam
shlokas.33:
tatastAni sharIrANi gatasattvAni rakShasAm |
apAkRRiShyanta shailAgrAddhanAdhipatishAsanAt
shlokas.34:
teShAM hi shApakAlo.asau kRRito.agastyena dhImatA |
samare nihatAstasmAtsarve maNimatA saha
shlokas.35:
pANDavAstu mahAtmAnasteShu veshmasu tAM kShapAm |
sukhamUShurgatodvegAH pUjitAH sarvarAkShasaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sUryodaye dhaumyaH kRRitvAhnikamari.ndama |
ArShTiSheNena sahitaH pANDavAnabhyavartata
shlokas.2:
te.abhivAdyArShTiSheNasya pAdau dhaumyasya chaiva ha |
tataH prA~njalayaH sarve brAhmaNA.nstAnapUjayan
shlokas.3:
tato yudhiShThiraM dhaumyo gRRihItvA dakShiNe kare |
prAchIM dishamabhiprekShya maharShiridamabravIt
shlokas.4:
asau sAgaraparyantAM bhUmimAvRRitya tiShThati |
shailarAjo mahArAja mandaro.abhivirAjate
shlokas.5:
indravaishravaNAvetAM dishaM pANDava rakShataH |
parvataishcha vanAntaishcha kAnanaishchopashobhitAm
shlokas.6:
etadAhurmahendrasya rAj~no vaishravaNasya cha |
RRiShayaH sarvadharmaj~nAH sadma tAta manIShiNaH
shlokas.7:
atashchodyantamAdityamupatiShThanti vai prajAH |
RRiShayashchApi dharmaj~nAH siddhAH sAdhyAshcha devatAH
shlokas.8:
yamastu rAjA dharmAtmA sarvaprANabhRRitAM prabhuH |
pretasattvagatImetAM dakShiNAmAshrito disham
shlokas.9:
etatsa.nyamanaM puNyamatIvAdbhutadarshanam |
pretarAjasya bhavanamRRiddhyA paramayA yutam
shlokas.10:
yaM prApya savitA rAjansatyena pratitiShThati |
astaM parvatarAjAnametamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.11:
etaM parvatarAjAnaM samudraM cha mahodadhim |
AvasanvaruNo rAjA bhUtAni parirakShati
shlokas.12:
udIchIM dIpayanneSha dishaM tiShThati kIrtimAn |
mahAmerurmahAbhAga shivo brahmavidAM gatiH
shlokas.13:
yasminbrahmasadashchaiva tiShThate cha prajApatiH |
bhUtAtmA visRRijansarvaM yatki~nchijja~NgamAgamam
shlokas.14:
yAnAhurbrahmaNaH putrAnmAnasAndakShasaptamAn |
teShAmapi mahAmeruH sthAnaM shivamanAmayam
shlokas.15:
atraiva pratitiShThanti punaratrodayanti cha |
sapta devarShayastAta vasiShThapramukhAH sadA
shlokas.16:
deshaM virajasaM pashya meroH shikharamuttamam |
yatrAtmatRRiptairadhyAste devaiH saha pitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
yamAhuH sarvabhUtAnAM prakRRiteH prakRRitiM dhruvam |
anAdinidhanaM devaM prabhuM nArAyaNaM param
shlokas.18:
brahmaNaH sadanAttasya paraM sthAnaM prakAshate |
devAshcha yatnAtpashyanti divyaM tejomayaM shivam
shlokas.19:
atyarkAnaladIptaM tatsthAnaM viShNormahAtmanaH |
svayaiva prabhayA rAjanduShprekShyaM devadAnavaiH
shlokas.20:
tadvai jyotIMShi sarvANi prApya bhAsanti no.api cha |
svayaM vibhuradInAtmA tatra hyabhivirAjate
shlokas.21:
yatayastatra gachChanti bhaktyA nArAyaNaM harim |
pareNa tapasA yuktA bhAvitAH karmabhiH shubhaiH
shlokas.22:
yogasiddhA mahAtmAnastamomohavivarjitAH |
tatra gatvA punarnemaM lokamAyAnti bhArata
shlokas.23:
sthAnametanmahAbhAga dhruvamakShayamavyayam |
Ishvarasya sadA hyetatpraNamAtra yudhiShThira
shlokas.24:
etaM jyotIMShi sarvANi prakarShanbhagavAnapi |
kurute vitamaskarmA Adityo.abhipradakShiNam
shlokas.25:
astaM prApya tataH sandhyAmatikramya divAkaraH |
udIchIM bhajate kAShThAM dishameSha vibhAvasuH
shlokas.26:
sa merumanuvRRittaH sanpunargachChati pANDava |
prA~NmukhaH savitA devaH sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.27:
sa mAsaM vibhajankAlaM bahudhA parvasandhiShu |
tathaiva bhagavAnsomo nakShatraiH saha gachChati
shlokas.28:
evameSha parikramya mahAmerumatandritaH |
bhAvayansarvabhUtAni punargachChati mandaram
shlokas.29:
tathA tamisrahA devo mayUkhairbhAvaya~njagat |
mArgametadasambAdhamAdityaH parivartate
shlokas.30:
sisRRikShuH shishirANyeSha dakShiNAM bhajate disham |
tataH sarvANi bhUtAni kAlaH shishiramRRichChati
shlokas.31:
sthAvarANAM cha bhUtAnAM ja~NgamAnAM cha tejasA |
tejA.nsi samupAdatte nivRRittaH sanvibhAvasuH
shlokas.32:
tataH svedaH klamastandrI glAnishcha bhajate narAn |
prANibhiH satataM svapno hyabhIkShNaM cha niShevyate
shlokas.33:
evametadanirdeshyaM mArgamAvRRitya bhAnumAn |
punaH sRRijati varShANi bhagavAnbhAvayanprajAH
shlokas.34:
vRRiShTimArutasantApaiH sukhaiH sthAvaraja~NgamAn |
vardhayansumahAtejAH punaH pratinivartate
shlokas.35:
evameSha charanpArtha kAlachakramatandritaH |
prakarShansarvabhUtAni savitA parivartate
shlokas.36:
santatA gatiretasya naiSha tiShThati pANDava |
AdAyaiva tu bhUtAnAM tejo visRRijate punaH
shlokas.37:
vibhajansarvabhUtAnAmAyuH karma cha bhArata |
ahorAtrAnkalAH kAShThAH sRRijatyeSha sadA vibhuH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminnagendre vasatAM tu teShAM; mahAtmanAM sadvratamAsthitAnAm |
ratiH pramodashcha babhUva teShA;mAkA~NkShatAM darshanamarjunasya
shlokas.2:
tAnvIryayuktAnsuvishuddhasattvAM;stejasvinaH satyadhRRitipradhAnAn |
samprIyamANA bahavo.abhijagmu;rgandharvasa~NghAshcha maharShayashcha
shlokas.3:
taM pAdapaiH puShpadharairupetaM; nagottamaM prApya mahArathAnAm |
manaHprasAdaH paramo babhUva; yathA divaM prApya marudgaNAnAm
shlokas.4:
mayUraha.nsasvananAditAni; puShpopakIrNAni mahAchalasya |
shRRi~NgANi sAnUni cha pashyamAnA; gireH paraM harShamavApya tasthuH
shlokas.5:
sAkShAtkubereNa kRRitAshcha tasmi;nnagottame sa.nvRRitakUlarodhasaH |
kAdambakAraNDavaha.nsajuShTAH; padmAkulAH puShkariNIrapashyan
shlokas.6:
krIDApradeshA.nshcha samRRiddharUpA;nsuchitramAlyAvRRitajAtashobhAn |
maNipravekAnsumanoharA.nshcha; yathA bhaveyurdhanadasya rAj~naH
shlokas.7:
anekavarNaishcha sugandhibhishcha; mahAdrumaiH santatamabhramAlibhiH |
tapaHpradhAnAH satataM charantaH; shRRi~NgaM gireshchintayituM na shekuH
shlokas.8:
svatejasA tasya nagottamasya; mahauShadhInAM cha tathA prabhAvAt |
vibhaktabhAvo na babhUva kashchi;daharnishAnAM puruShapravIra
shlokas.9:
yamAsthitaH sthAvaraja~NgamAni; vibhAvasurbhAvayate.amitaujAH |
tasyodayaM chAstamayaM cha vIrA;statra sthitAste dadRRishurnRRisiMhAH
shlokas.10:
ravestamisrAgamanirgamA.nste; tathodayaM chAstamayaM cha vIrAH |
samAvRRitAH prekShya tamonudasya; gabhastijAlaiH pradisho dishashcha
shlokas.11:
svAdhyAyavantaH satatakriyAshcha; dharmapradhAnAshcha shuchivratAshcha |
satye sthitAstasya mahArathasya; satyavratasyAgamanapratIkShAH
shlokas.12:
ihaiva harSho.astu samAgatAnAM; kShipraM kRRitAstreNa dhana~njayena |
iti bruvantaH paramAshiShaste; pArthAstapoyogaparA babhUvuH
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA vichitrANi girau vanAni; kirITinaM chintayatAmabhIkShNam |
babhUva rAtrirdivasashcha teShAM; sa.nvatsareNaiva samAnarUpaH
shlokas.14:
yadaiva dhaumyAnumate mahAtmA; kRRitvA jaTAH pravrajitaH sa jiShNuH |
tadaiva teShAM na babhUva harShaH; kuto ratistadgatamAnasAnAm
shlokas.15:
bhrAturniyogAttu yudhiShThirasya; vanAdasau vAraNamattagAmI |
yatkAmyakAtpravrajitaH sa jiShNu;stadaiva te shokahatA babhUvuH
shlokas.16:
tathA tu taM chintayatAM sitAshva;mastrArthinaM vAsavamabhyupetam |
mAso.atha kRRichChreNa tadA vyatIta;stasminnage bhArata bhAratAnAm
shlokas.17:
tataH kadAchiddharisamprayuktaM; mahendravAhaM sahasopayAtam |
vidyutprabhaM prekShya mahArathAnAM; harSho.arjunaM chintayatAM babhUva
shlokas.18:
sa dIpyamAnaH sahasAntarikShaM; prakAshayanmAtalisa~NgRRihItaH |
babhau maholkeva ghanAntarasthA; shikheva chAgnerjvalitA vidhUmA
shlokas.19:
tamAsthitaH sa.ndadRRishe kirITI; sragvI varANyAbharaNAni bibhrat |
dhana~njayo vajradharaprabhAvaH; shriyA jvalanparvatamAjagAma
shlokas.20:
sa shailamAsAdya kirITamAlI; mahendravAhAdavaruhya tasmAt |
dhaumyasya pAdAvabhivAdya pUrva;majAtashatrostadanantaraM cha
shlokas.21:
vRRikodarasyApi vavanda pAdau; mAdrIsutAbhyAmabhivAditashcha |
sametya kRRiShNAM parisAntvya chainAM; prahvo.abhavadbhrAturupahvare saH
shlokas.22:
babhUva teShAM paramaH praharSha;stenAprameyeNa samAgatAnAm |
sa chApi tAnprekShya kirITamAlI; nananda rAjAnamabhiprasha.nsan
shlokas.23:
yamAsthitaH sapta jaghAna pUgA;nditeH sutAnAM namuchernihantA |
tamindravAhaM samupetya pArthAH; pradakShiNaM chakruradInasattvAH
shlokas.24:
te mAtaleshchakruratIva hRRiShTAH; satkAramagryaM surarAjatulyam |
sarvaM yathAvachcha divaukasastA;npaprachChurenaM kururAjaputrAH
shlokas.25:
tAnapyasau mAtalirabhyananda;tpiteva putrAnanushiShya chainAn |
yayau rathenApratimaprabheNa; punaH sakAshaM tridiveshvarasya
shlokas.26:
gate tu tasminvaradevavAhe; shakrAtmajaH sarvaripupramAthI |
shakreNa dattAni dadau mahAtmA; mahAdhanAnyuttamarUpavanti
divAkarAbhANi vibhUShaNAni; prItaH priyAyai sutasomamAtre
shlokas.27:
tataH sa teShAM kurupu~NgavAnAM; teShAM cha sUryAgnisamaprabhANAm |
viprarShabhANAmupavishya madhye; sarvaM yathAvatkathayAM babhUva
shlokas.28:
evaM mayAstrANyupashikShitAni; shakrAchcha vAtAchcha shivAchcha sAkShAt |
tathaiva shIlena samAdhinA cha; prItAH surA me sahitAH sahendrAH
shlokas.29:
sa~NkShepato vai sa vishuddhakarmA; tebhyaH samAkhyAya divi pravesham |
mAdrIsutAbhyAM sahitaH kirITI; suShvApa tAmAvasatiM pratItaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu sarvavAditranisvanaH |
babhUva tumulaH shabdastvantarikShe divaukasAm
shlokas.2:
rathanemisvanashchaiva ghaNTAshabdashcha bhArata |
pRRithagvyAlamRRigANAM cha pakShiNAM chaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
taM samantAdanuyayurgandharvApsarasastathA |
vimAnaiH sUryasa~NkAshairdevarAjamari.ndamam
shlokas.4:
tataH sa haribhiryuktaM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitam |
meghanAdinamAruhya shriyA paramayA jvalan
shlokas.5:
pArthAnabhyAjagAmAshu devarAjaH pura.ndaraH |
Agatya cha sahasrAkSho rathAdavaruroha vai
shlokas.6:
taM dRRiShTvaiva mahAtmAnaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH shrImAndevarAjamupAgamat
shlokas.7:
pUjayAmAsa chaivAtha vidhivadbhUridakShiNaH |
yathArhamamitAtmAnaM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.8:
dhana~njayashcha tejasvI praNipatya pura.ndaram |
bhRRityavatpraNatastasthau devarAjasamIpataH
shlokas.9:
ApyAyata mahAtejAH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
dhana~njayamabhiprekShya vinItaM sthitamantike
shlokas.10:
jaTilaM devarAjasya tapoyuktamakalmaSham |
harSheNa mahatAviShTaH phalgunasyAtha darshanAt
shlokas.11:
taM tathAdInamanasaM rAjAnaM harShasamplutam |
uvAcha vachanaM dhImAndevarAjaH pura.ndaraH
shlokas.12:
tvamimAM pRRithivIM rAjanprashAsiShyasi pANDava |
svasti prApnuhi kaunteya kAmyakaM punarAshramam
shlokas.13:
astrANi labdhAni cha pANDavena; sarvANi mattaH prayatena rAjan |
kRRitapriyashchAsmi dhana~njayena; jetuM na shakyastribhireSha lokaiH
shlokas.14:
evamuktvA sahasrAkShaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
jagAma tridivaM hRRiShTaH stUyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.15:
dhaneshvaragRRihasthAnAM pANDavAnAM samAgamam |
shakreNa ya imaM vidvAnadhIyIta samAhitaH
shlokas.16:
sa.nvatsaraM brahmachArI niyataH sa.nshitavrataH |
sa jIveta nirAbAdhaH susukhI sharadAM shatam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yathAgataM gate shakre bhrAtRRibhiH saha sa~NgataH |
kRRiShNayA chaiva bIbhatsurdharmaputramapUjayat
shlokas.2:
abhivAdayamAnaM tu mUrdhnyupAghrAya pANDavam |
harShagadgadayA vAchA prahRRiShTo.arjunamabravIt
shlokas.3:
kathamarjuna kAlo.ayaM svarge vyatigatastava |
kathaM chAstrANyavAptAni devarAjashcha toShitaH
shlokas.4:
samyagvA te gRRihItAni kachchidastrANi bhArata |
kachchitsurAdhipaH prIto rudrashchAstrANyadAttava
shlokas.5:
yathA dRRiShTashcha te shakro bhagavAnvA pinAkadhRRik |
yathA chAstrANyavAptAni yathA chArAdhitashcha te
shlokas.6:
yathoktavA.nstvAM bhagavA~nshatakraturari.ndama |
kRRitapriyastvayAsmIti tachcha te kiM priyaM kRRitam
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa mahAdyute
shlokas.7:
yathA tuShTo mahAdevo devarAjashcha te.anagha |
yachchApi vajrapANeste priyaM kRRitamari.ndama
etadAkhyAhi me sarvamakhilena dhana~njaya
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
shRRiNu hanta mahArAja vidhinA yena dRRiShTavAn |
shatakratumahaM devaM bhagavantaM cha sha~Nkaram
shlokas.9:
