vidyAmadhItya tAM rAja.nstvayoktAmarimardana |
bhavatA cha samAdiShTastapase prasthito vanam
shlokas.10:
bhRRigutu~Ngamatho gatvA kAmyakAdAsthitastapaH |
ekarAtroShitaH ka~nchidapashyaM brAhmaNaM pathi
shlokas.11:
sa mAmapRRichChatkaunteya kvAsi gantA bravIhi me |
tasmA avitathaM sarvamabruvaM kurunandana
shlokas.12:
sa tathyaM mama tachChrutvA brAhmaNo rAjasattama |
apUjayata mAM rAjanprItimA.nshchAbhavanmayi
shlokas.13:
tato mAmabravItprItastapa AtiShTha bhArata |
tapasvI nachireNa tvaM drakShyase vibudhAdhipam
shlokas.14:
tato.ahaM vachanAttasya girimAruhya shaishiram |
tapo.atapyaM mahArAja mAsaM mUlaphalAshanaH
shlokas.15:
dvitIyashchApi me mAso jalaM bhakShayato gataH |
nirAhArastRRitIye.atha mAse pANDavanandana
shlokas.16:
UrdhvabAhushchaturthaM tu mAsamasmi sthitastadA |
na cha me hIyate prANastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.17:
chaturthe samabhikrAnte prathame divase gate |
varAhasa.nsthitaM bhUtaM matsamIpamupAgamat
shlokas.18:
nighnanprothena pRRithivIM vilikha.nshcharaNairapi |
saMmArja~njaThareNorvIM vivarta.nshcha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.19:
anu tasyAparaM bhUtaM mahatkairAtasa.nsthitam |
dhanurbANAsimatprAptaM strIgaNAnugataM tadA
shlokas.20:
tato.ahaM dhanurAdAya tathAkShayyau maheShudhI |
atADayaM shareNAtha tadbhUtaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.21:
yugapattatkirAtashcha vikRRiShya balavaddhanuH |
abhyAjaghne dRRiDhataraM kampayanniva me manaH
shlokas.22:
sa tu mAmabravIdrAjanmama pUrvaparigrahaH |
mRRigayAdharmamutsRRijya kimarthaM tADitastvayA
shlokas.23:
eSha te nishitairbANairdarpaM hanmi sthiro bhava |
sa varShmavAnmahAkAyastato mAmabhyadhAvata
shlokas.24:
tato girimivAtyarthamAvRRiNonmAM mahAsharaiH |
taM chAhaM sharavarSheNa mahatA samavAkiram
shlokas.25:
tataH sharairdIptamukhaiH patritairanumantritaiH |
pratyavidhyamahaM taM tu vajrairiva shilochchayam
shlokas.26:
tasya tachChatadhA rUpamabhavachcha sahasradhA |
tAni chAsya sharIrANi sharairahamatADayam
shlokas.27:
punastAni sharIrANi ekIbhUtAni bhArata |
adRRishyanta mahArAja tAnyahaM vyadhamaM punaH
shlokas.28:
aNurbRRihachChirA bhUtvA bRRihachchANushirAH punaH |
ekIbhUtastadA rAjanso.abhyavartata mAM yudhi
shlokas.29:
yadAbhibhavituM bANairnaiva shaknomi taM raNe |
tato.ahamastramAtiShThaM vAyavyaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.30:
na chainamashakaM hantuM tadadbhutamivAbhavat |
tasminpratihate chAstre vismayo me mahAnabhUt
shlokas.31:
bhUyashchaiva mahArAja savisheShamahaM tataH |
astrapUgena mahatA raNe bhUtamavAkiram
shlokas.32:
sthUNAkarNamayojAlaM sharavarShaM sharolbaNam |
shailAstramashmavarShaM cha samAsthAyAhamabhyayAm
jagrAsa prahasa.nstAni sarvANyastrANi me.anagha
shlokas.33:
teShu sarveShu shAnteShu brahmAstramahamAdisham |
tataH prajvalitairbANaiH sarvataH sopachIyata
upachIyamAnashcha mayA mahAstreNa vyavardhata
shlokas.34:
tataH santApito loko matprasUtena tejasA |
kShaNena hi dishaH khaM cha sarvato.abhividIpitam
shlokas.35:
tadapyastraM mahAtejAH kShaNenaiva vyashAtayat |
brahmAstre tu hate rAjanbhayaM mAM mahadAvishat
shlokas.36:
tato.ahaM dhanurAdAya tathAkShayyau maheShudhI |
sahasAbhyahanaM bhUtaM tAnyapyastrANyabhakShayat
shlokas.37:
hateShvastreShu sarveShu bhakShiteShvAyudheShu cha |
mama tasya cha bhUtasya bAhuyuddhamavartata
shlokas.38:
vyAyAmaM muShTibhiH kRRitvA talairapi samAhatau |
apAtayachcha tadbhUtaM nishcheShTo hyagamaM mahIm
shlokas.39:
tataH prahasya tadbhUtaM tatraivAntaradhIyata |
saha strIbhirmahArAja pashyato me.adbhutopamam
shlokas.40:
evaM kRRitvA sa bhagavA.nstato.anyadrUpamAtmanaH |
divyameva mahArAja vasAno.adbhutamambaram
shlokas.41:
hitvA kirAtarUpaM cha bhagavA.nstridasheshvaraH |
svarUpaM divyamAsthAya tasthau tatra maheshvaraH
shlokas.42:
adRRishyata tataH sAkShAdbhagavAngovRRiShadhvajaH |
umAsahAyo haridRRigbahurUpaH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.43:
sa mAmabhyetya samare tathaivAbhimukhaM sthitam |
shUlapANirathovAcha tuShTo.asmIti parantapa
shlokas.44:
tatastaddhanurAdAya tUNau chAkShayyasAyakau |
prAdAnmamaiva bhagavAnvarayasveti chAbravIt
shlokas.45:
tuShTo.asmi tava kaunteya brUhi kiM karavANi te |
yatte manogataM vIra tadbrUhi vitarAmyaham
amaratvamapAhAya brUhi yatte manogatam
shlokas.46:
tataH prA~njalirevAhamastreShu gatamAnasaH |
praNamya shirasA sharvaM tato vachanamAdade
shlokas.47:
bhagavAnme prasannashchedIpsito.ayaM varo mama |
astrANIchChAmyahaM j~nAtuM yAni deveShu kAnichit
dadAnItyeva bhagavAnabravIttryambakashcha mAm
shlokas.48:
raudramastraM madIyaM tvAmupasthAsyati pANDava |
pradadau cha mama prItaH so.astraM pAshupataM prabhuH
shlokas.49:
uvAcha cha mahAdevo dattvA me.astraM sanAtanam |
na prayojyaM bhavedetanmAnuSheShu katha~nchana
shlokas.50:
pIDyamAnena balavatprayojyaM te dhana~njaya |
astrANAM pratighAte cha sarvathaiva prayojayeH
shlokas.51:
tadapratihataM divyaM sarvAstrapratiShedhanam |
mUrtimanme sthitaM pArshve prasanne govRRiShadhvaje
shlokas.52:
utsAdanamamitrANAM parasenAnikartanam |
durAsadaM duShprahasaM suradAnavarAkShasaiH
shlokas.53:
anuj~nAtastvahaM tena tatraiva samupAvisham |
prekShatashchaiva me devastatraivAntaradhIyata

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tatastAmavasaM prIto rajanIM tatra bhArata |
prasAdAddevadevasya tryambakasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
vyuShito rajanIM chAhaM kRRitvA pUrvAhNikakriyAm |
apashyaM taM dvijashreShThaM dRRiShTavAnasmi yaM purA
shlokas.3:
tasmai chAhaM yathAvRRittaM sarvameva nyavedayam |
bhagavantaM mahAdevaM sameto.asmIti bhArata
shlokas.4:
sa mAmuvAcha rAjendra prIyamANo dvijottamaH |
dRRiShTastvayA mahAdevo yathA nAnyena kenachit
shlokas.5:
sametya lokapAlaistu sarvairvaivasvatAdibhiH |
draShTAsyanagha devendraM sa cha te.astrANi dAsyati
shlokas.6:
evamuktvA sa mAM rAjannAshliShya cha punaH punaH |
agachChatsa yathAkAmaM brAhmaNaH sUryasaMnibhaH
shlokas.7:
athAparAhNe tasyAhnaH prAvAtpuNyaH samIraNaH |
punarnavamimaM lokaM kurvanniva sapatnahan
shlokas.8:
divyAni chaiva mAlyAni sugandhIni navAni cha |
shaishirasya gireH pAde prAdurAsansamIpataH
shlokas.9:
vAditrANi cha divyAni sughoShANi samantataH |
stutayashchendrasa.nyuktA ashrUyanta manoharAH
shlokas.10:
gaNAshchApsarasAM tatra gandharvANAM tathaiva cha |
purastAddevadevasya jagurgItAni sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
marutAM cha gaNAstatra devayAnairupAgaman |
mahendrAnucharA ye cha devasadmanivAsinaH
shlokas.12:
tato marutvAnharibhiryuktairvAhaiH svala~NkRRitaiH |
shachIsahAyastatrAyAtsaha sarvaistadAmaraiH
shlokas.13:
etasminneva kAle tu kubero naravAhanaH |
darshayAmAsa mAM rAja.NllakShmyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.14:
dakShiNasyAM dishi yamaM pratyapashyaM vyavasthitam |
varuNaM devarAjaM cha yathAsthAnamavasthitam
shlokas.15:
te mAmUchurmahArAja sAntvayitvA surarShabhAH |
savyasAchinsamIkShasva lokapAlAnavasthitAn
shlokas.16:
surakAryArthasiddhyarthaM dRRiShTavAnasi sha~Nkaram |
asmatto.api gRRihANa tvamastrANIti samantataH
shlokas.17:
tato.ahaM prayato bhUtvA praNipatya surarShabhAn |
pratyagRRihNaM tadAstrANi mahAnti vidhivatprabho
shlokas.18:
gRRihItAstrastato devairanuj~nAto.asmi bhArata |
atha devA yayuH sarve yathAgatamari.ndama
shlokas.19:
maghavAnapi devesho rathamAruhya suprabham |
uvAcha bhagavAnvAkyaM smayanniva surArihA
shlokas.20:
puraivAgamanAdasmAdvedAhaM tvAM dhana~njaya |
ataH paraM tvahaM vai tvAM darshaye bharatarShabha
shlokas.21:
tvayA hi tIrtheShu purA samAplAvaH kRRito.asakRRit |
tapashchedaM purA taptaM svargaM gantAsi pANDava
shlokas.22:
bhUyashchaiva tu taptavyaM tapaH paramadAruNam |
uvAcha bhagavAnsarvaM tapasashchopapAdanam
shlokas.23:
mAtalirmanniyogAttvAM tridivaM prApayiShyati |
viditastvaM hi devAnAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.24:
tato.ahamabruvaM shakraM prasIda bhagavanmama |
AchAryaM varaye tvAhamastrArthaM tridasheshvara
shlokas.25:
indra uvAcha||
krUraM karmAstravittAta kariShyasi parantapa |
yadarthamastrANIpsustvaM taM kAmaM pANDavApnuhi
shlokas.26:
arjuna uvAcha||
tato.ahamabruvaM nAhaM divyAnyastrANi shatruhan |
mAnuSheShu prayokShyAmi vinAstrapratighAtanam
shlokas.27:
tAni divyAni me.astrANi prayachCha vibudhAdhipa |
lokA.nshchAstrajitAnpashchAllabheyaM surapu~Ngava
shlokas.28:
indra uvAcha||
parIkShArthaM mayaitatte vAkyamuktaM dhana~njaya |
mamAtmajasya vachanaM sUpapannamidaM tava
shlokas.29:
shikSha me bhavanaM gatvA sarvANyastrANi bhArata |
vAyoragnervasubhyo.atha varuNAtsamarudgaNAt
shlokas.30:
sAdhyaM paitAmahaM chaiva gandharvoragarakShasAm |
vaiShNavAni cha sarvANi nairRRitAni tathaiva cha
madgatAni cha yAnIha sarvAstrANi kurUdvaha
shlokas.31:
arjuna uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu mAM shakrastatraivAntaradhIyata |
athApashyaM hariyujaM rathamaindramupasthitam
divyaM mAyAmayaM puNyaM yattaM mAtalinA nRRipa
shlokas.32:
lokapAleShu yAteShu mAmuvAchAtha mAtaliH |
draShTumichChati shakrastvAM devarAjo mahAdyute
shlokas.33:
sa.nsiddhastvaM mahAbAho kuru kAryamanuttamam |
pashya puNyakRRitAM lokAnsasharIro divaM vraja
shlokas.34:
ityukto.ahaM mAtalinA girimAmantrya shaishiram |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya samArohaM rathottamam
shlokas.35:
chodayAmAsa sa hayAnmanomArutaraMhasaH |
mAtalirhayashAstraj~no yathAvadbhUridakShiNaH
shlokas.36:
avaikShata cha me vaktraM sthitasyAtha sa sArathiH |
tathA bhrAnte rathe rAjanvismitashchedamabravIt
shlokas.37:
atyadbhutamidaM me.adya vichitraM pratibhAti mAm |
yadAsthito rathaM divyaM padA na chalito bhavAn
shlokas.38:
devarAjo.api hi mayA nityamatropalakShitaH |
vichalanprathamotpAte hayAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.39:
tvaM punaH sthita evAtra rathe bhrAnte kurUdvaha |
atishakramidaM sattvaM taveti pratibhAti me
shlokas.40:
ityuktvAkAshamAvishya mAtalirvibudhAlayAn |
darshayAmAsa me rAjanvimAnAni cha bhArata
shlokas.41:
nandanAdIni devAnAM vanAni bahulAnyuta |
darshayAmAsa me prItyA mAtaliH shakrasArathiH
shlokas.42:
tataH shakrasya bhavanamapashyamamarAvatIm |
divyaiH kAmaphalairvRRikShai ratnaishcha samala~NkRRitAm
shlokas.43:
na tAM bhAsayate sUryo na shItoShNe na cha klamaH |
rajaH pa~Nko na cha tamastatrAsti na jarA nRRipa
shlokas.44:
na tatra shoko dainyaM vA vaivarNyaM chopalakShyate |
divaukasAM mahArAja na cha glAnirari.ndama
shlokas.45:
na krodhalobhau tatrAstAmashubhaM cha vishAM pate |
nityatuShTAshcha hRRiShTAshcha prANinaH suraveshmani
shlokas.46:
nityapuShpaphalAstatra pAdapA haritachChadAH |
puShkariNyashcha vividhAH padmasaugandhikAyutAH
shlokas.47:
shItastatra vavau vAyuH sugandho jIvanaH shuchiH |
sarvaratnavichitrA cha bhUmiH puShpavibhUShitA
shlokas.48:
mRRigadvijAshcha bahavo ruchirA madhurasvarAH |
vimAnayAyinashchAtra dRRishyante bahavo.amarAH
shlokas.49:
tato.apashyaM vasUnrudrAnsAdhyA.nshcha samarudgaNAn |
AdityAnashvinau chaiva tAnsarvAnpratyapUjayam
shlokas.50:
te mAM vIryeNa yashasA tejasA cha balena cha |
astraishchApyanvajAnanta sa~NgrAmavijayena cha
shlokas.51:
pravishya tAM purIM ramyAM devagandharvasevitAm |
devarAjaM sahasrAkShamupAtiShThaM kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.52:
dadAvardhAsanaM prItaH shakro me dadatAM varaH |
bahumAnAchcha gAtrANi pasparsha mama vAsavaH
shlokas.53:
tatrAhaM devagandharvaiH sahito bhuridakShiNa |
astrArthamavasaM svarge kurvANo.astrANi bhArata
shlokas.54:
vishvAvasoshcha me putrashchitraseno.abhavatsakhA |
sa cha gAndharvamakhilaM grAhayAmAsa mAM nRRipa
shlokas.55:
tato.ahamavasaM rAjangRRihItAstraH supUjitaH |
sukhaM shakrasya bhavane sarvakAmasamanvitaH
shlokas.56:
shRRiNvanvai gItashabdaM cha tUryashabdaM cha puShkalam |
pashya.nshchApsarasaH shreShThA nRRityamAnAH parantapa
shlokas.57:
tatsarvamanavaj~nAya tathyaM vijj~nAya bhArata |
atyarthaM pratigRRihyAhamastreShveva vyavasthitaH
shlokas.58:
tato.atuShyatsahasrAkShastena kAmena me vibhuH |
evaM me vasato rAjanneSha kAlo.atyagAddivi

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kRRitAstramabhivishvastamatha mAM harivAhanaH |
sa.nspRRishya mUrdhni pANibhyAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
na tvamadya yudhA jetuM shakyaH suragaNairapi |
kiM punarmAnuShe loke mAnuShairakRRitAtmabhiH
aprameyo.apradhRRiShyashcha yuddheShvapratimastathA
shlokas.3:
athAbravItpunardevaH samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
astrayuddhe samo vIra na te kashchidbhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
apramattaH sadA dakShaH satyavAdI jitendriyaH |
brahmaNyashchAstravichchAsi shUrashchAsi kurUdvaha
shlokas.5:
astrANi samavAptAni tvayA dasha cha pa~ncha cha |
pa~nchabhirvidhibhiH pArtha na tvayA vidyate samaH
shlokas.6:
prayogamupasaMhAramAvRRittiM cha dhana~njaya |
prAyashchittaM cha vettha tvaM pratighAtaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
tava gurvarthakAlo.ayamupapannaH parantapa |
pratijAnIShva taM kartumato vetsyAmyahaM param
shlokas.8:
tato.ahamabruvaM rAjandevarAjamidaM vachaH |
viShahyaM chenmayA kartuM kRRitameva nibodha tat
shlokas.9:
tato mAmabravIdrAjanprahasya balavRRitrahA |
nAviShahyaM tavAdyAsti triShu lokeShu ki~nchana
shlokas.10:
nivAtakavachA nAma dAnavA mama shatravaH |
samudrakukShimAshritya durge prativasantyuta
shlokas.11:
tisraH koTyaH samAkhyAtAstulyarUpabalaprabhAH |
tA.nstatra jahi kaunteya gurvarthaste bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
tato mAtalisa.nyuktaM mayUrasamaromabhiH |
hayairupetaM prAdAnme rathaM divyaM mahAprabham
shlokas.13:
babandha chaiva me mUrdhni kirITamidamuttamam |
svarUpasadRRishaM chaiva prAdAda~NgavibhUShaNam
shlokas.14:
abhedyaM kavachaM chedaM sparsharUpavaduttamam |
ajarAM jyAmimAM chApi gANDIve samayojayat
shlokas.15:
tataH prAyAmahaM tena syandanena virAjatA |
yenAjayaddevapatirbaliM vairochaniM purA
shlokas.16:
tato devAH sarva eva tena ghoSheNa bodhitaH |
manvAnA devarAjaM mAM samAjagmurvishAM pate
dRRiShTvA cha mAmapRRichChanta kiM kariShyasi phalguna
shlokas.17:
tAnabruvaM yathAbhUtamidaM kartAsmi sa.nyuge |
nivAtakavachAnAM tu prasthitaM mAM vadhaiShiNam
nibodhata mahAbhAgAH shivaM chAshAsta me.anaghAH
shlokas.18:
tuShTuvurmAM prasannAste yathA devaM pura.ndaram |
rathenAnena maghavA jitavA~nshambaraM yudhi
namuchiM balavRRitrau cha prahlAdanarakAvapi
shlokas.19:
bahUni cha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
rathenAnena daityAnAM jitavAnmaghavAnyudhi
shlokas.20:
tvamapyetena kaunteya nivAtakavachAnraNe |
vijetA yudhi vikramya pureva maghavAnvashI
shlokas.21:
ayaM cha sha~Nkhapravaro yena jetAsi dAnavAn |
anena vijitA lokAH shakreNApi mahAtmanA
shlokas.22:
pradIyamAnaM devaistu devadattaM jalodbhavam |
pratyagRRihNaM jayAyainaM stUyamAnastadAmaraiH
shlokas.23:
sa sha~NkhI kavachI bANI pragRRihItasharAsanaH |
dAnavAlayamatyugraM prayAto.asmi yuyutsayA

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tato.ahaM stUyamAnastu tatra tatra maharShibhiH |
apashyamudadhiM bhImamapAmpatimathAvyayam
shlokas.2:
phenavatyaH prakIrNAshcha saMhatAshcha samuchChritAH |
UrmayashchAtra dRRishyante chalanta iva parvatAH
nAvaH sahasrashastatra ratnapUrNAH samantataH
shlokas.3:
timi~NgilAH kachChapAshcha tathA timitimi~NgilAH |
makarAshchAtra dRRishyante jale magnA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.4:
sha~NkhAnAM cha sahasrANi magnAnyapsu samantataH |
dRRishyante sma yathA rAtrau tArAstanvabhrasa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.5:
tathA sahasrashastatra ratnasa~NghAH plavantyuta |
vAyushcha ghUrNate bhImastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.6:
tamatItya mahAvegaM sarvAmbhonidhimuttamam |
apashyaM dAnavAkIrNaM taddaityapuramantikAt
shlokas.7:
tatraiva mAtalistUrNaM nipatya pRRithivItale |
nAdayanrathaghoSheNa tatpuraM samupAdravat
shlokas.8:
rathaghoShaM tu taM shrutvA stanayitnorivAmbare |
manvAnA devarAjaM mAM sa.nvignA dAnavAbhavan
shlokas.9:
sarve sambhrAntamanasaH sharachApadharAH sthitAH |
tathA shUlAsiparashugadAmusalapANayaH
shlokas.10:
tato dvArANi pidadhurdAnavAstrastachetasaH |
sa.nvidhAya pure rakShAM na sma kashchana dRRishyate
shlokas.11:
tataH sha~NkhamupAdAya devadattaM mahAsvanam |
puramAsuramAshliShya prAdhamaM taM shanairaham
shlokas.12:
sa tu shabdo divaM stabdhvA pratishabdamajIjanat |
vitresushcha nililyushcha bhUtAni sumahAntyapi
shlokas.13:
tato nivAtakavachAH sarva eva samantataH |
da.nshitA vividhaistrANairvividhAyudhapANayaH
shlokas.14:
Ayasaishcha mahAshUlairgadAbhirmusalairapi |
paTTishaiH karavAlaishcha rathachakraishcha bhArata
shlokas.15:
shataghnIbhirbhushuNDIbhiH khaDgaishchitraiH svala~NkRRitaiH |
pragRRihItairditeH putrAH prAdurAsansahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
tato vichArya bahudhA rathamArgeShu tAnhayAn |
prAchodayatsame deshe mAtalirbharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
tena teShAM praNunnAnAmAshutvAchChIghragAminAm |
nAnvapashyaM tadA ki~nchittanme.adbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.18:
tataste dAnavAstatra yodhavrAtAnyanekashaH |
vikRRitasvararUpANi bhRRishaM sarvANyachodayan
shlokas.19:
tena shabdena mahatA samudre parvatopamAH |
Aplavanta gataiH sattvairmatsyAH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
tato vegena mahatA dAnavA mAmupAdravan |
vimu~nchantaH shitAnbANA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.21:
sa samprahArastumulasteShAM mama cha bhArata |
avartata mahAghoro nivAtakavachAntakaH
shlokas.22:
tato devarShayashchaiva dAnavarShigaNAshcha ye |
brahmarShayashcha siddhAshcha samAjagmurmahAmRRidhe
shlokas.23:
te vai mAmanurUpAbhirmadhurAbhirjayaiShiNaH |
astuvanmunayo vAgbhiryathendraM tArakAmaye

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tato nivAtakavachAH sarve vegena bhArata |
abhyadravanmAM sahitAH pragRRihItAyudhA raNe
shlokas.2:
AchChidya rathapanthAnamutkroshanto mahArathAH |
AvRRitya sarvataste mAM sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.3:
tato.apare mahAvIryAH shUlapaTTishapANayaH |
shUlAni cha bhushuNDIshcha mumuchurdAnavA mayi
shlokas.4:
tachChUlavarShaM sumahadgadAshaktisamAkulam |
anishaM sRRijyamAnaM tairapatanmadrathopari
shlokas.5:
anye mAmabhyadhAvanta nivAtakavachA yudhi |
shitashastrAyudhA raudrAH kAlarUpAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.6:
tAnahaM vividhairbANairvegavadbhirajihmagaiH |
gANDIvamuktairabhyaghnamekaikaM dashabhirmRRidhe
te kRRitA vimukhAH sarve matprayuktaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.7:
tato mAtalinA tUrNaM hayAste samprachoditAH |
rathamArgAdbahU.nstatra vicherurvAtaraMhasaH
susa.nyatA mAtalinA prAmathnanta diteH sutAn
shlokas.8:
shataM shatAste harayastasminyuktA mahArathe |
tadA mAtalinA yattA vyacharannalpakA iva
shlokas.9:
teShAM charaNapAtena rathanemisvanena cha |
mama bANanipAtaishcha hatAste shatasho.asurAH
shlokas.10:
gatAsavastathA chAnye pragRRihItasharAsanAH |
hatasArathayastatra vyakRRiShyanta tura~NgamaiH
shlokas.11:
te disho vidishaH sarvAH pratirudhya prahAriNaH |
nighnanti vividhaiH shastraistato me vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM mAtalervIryamapashyaM paramAdbhutam |
ashvA.nstathA vegavato yadayatnAdadhArayat
shlokas.13:
tato.ahaM laghubhishchitrairastraistAnasurAnraNe |
sAyudhAnachChinaM rAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.14:
evaM me charatastatra sarvayatnena shatruhan |
prItimAnabhavadvIro mAtaliH shakrasArathiH
shlokas.15:
vadhyamAnAstataste tu hayaistena rathena cha |
agamanprakShayaM kechinnyavartanta tathApare
shlokas.16:
spardhamAnA ivAsmAbhirnivAtakavachA raNe |
sharavarShairmahadbhirmAM samantAtpratyavArayan
shlokas.17:
tato.ahaM laghubhishchitrairbrahmAstraparimantritaiH |
vyadhamaM sAyakairAshu shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
tataH sampIDyamAnAste krodhAviShTA mahAsurAH |
apIDayanmAM sahitAH sharashUlAsivRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.19:
tato.ahamastramAtiShThaM paramaM tigmatejasam |
dayitaM devarAjasya mAdhavaM nAma bhArata
shlokas.20:
tataH khaDgA.nstrishUlA.nshcha tomarA.nshcha sahasrashaH |
astravIryeNa shatadhA tairmuktAnahamachChinam
shlokas.21:
ChittvA praharaNAnyeShAM tatastAnapi sarvashaH |
pratyavidhyamahaM roShAddashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.22:
gANDIvAddhi tadA sa~Nkhye yathA bhramarapa~NktayaH |
niShpatanti tathA bANAstanmAtalirapUjayat
shlokas.23:
teShAmapi tu bANAste bahutvAchChalabhA iva |
avAkiranmAM balavattAnahaM vyadhamaM sharaiH
shlokas.24:
vadhyamAnAstataste tu nivAtakavachAH punaH |
sharavarShairmahadbhirmAM samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.25:
sharavegAnnihatyAhamastraiH sharavighAtibhiH |
jvaladbhiH paramaiH shIghraistAnavidhyaM sahasrashaH
shlokas.26:
teShAM ChinnAni gAtrANi visRRijanti sma shoNitam |
prAvRRiShIvAtivRRiShTAni shRRi~NgANIva dharAbhRRitAm
shlokas.27:
indrAshanisamasparshairvegavadbhirajihmagaiH |
madbANairvadhyamAnAste samudvignAH sma dAnavAH
shlokas.28:
shatadhA bhinnadehAntrAH kShINapraharaNaujasaH |
tato nivAtakavachA mAmayudhyanta mAyayA

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tato.ashmavarShaM sumahatprAdurAsItsamantataH |
nagamAtrairmahAghoraistanmAM dRRiDhamapIDayat
shlokas.2:
tadahaM vajrasa~NkAshaiH sharairindrAstrachoditaiH |
achUrNayaM vegavadbhiH shatadhaikaikamAhave
shlokas.3:
chUrNyamAne.ashmavarShe tu pAvakaH samajAyata |
tatrAshmachUrNamapatatpAvakaprakarA iva
shlokas.4:
tato.ashmavarShe nihate jalavarShaM mahattaram |
dhArAbhirakShamAtrAbhiH prAdurAsInmamAntike
shlokas.5:
nabhasaH prachyutA dhArAstigmavIryAH sahasrashaH |
AvRRiNvansarvato vyoma dishashchopadishastathA
shlokas.6:
dhArANAM cha nipAtena vAyorvisphUrjitena cha |
garjitena cha daityAnAM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.7:
dhArA divi cha sambaddhA vasudhAyAM cha sarvashaH |
vyAmohayanta mAM tatra nipatantyo.anishaM bhuvi
shlokas.8:
tatropadiShTamindreNa divyamastraM vishoShaNam |
dIptaM prAhiNavaM ghoramashuShyattena tajjalam
shlokas.9:
hate.ashmavarShe tu mayA jalavarShe cha shoShite |
mumuchurdAnavA mAyAmagniM vAyuM cha mAnada
shlokas.10:
tato.ahamagniM vyadhamaM salilAstreNa sarvashaH |
shailena cha mahAstreNa vAyorvegamadhArayam
shlokas.11:
tasyAM pratihatAyAM tu dAnavA yuddhadurmadAH |
prAkurvanvividhA mAyA yaugapadyena bhArata
shlokas.12:
tato varShaM prAdurabhUtsumahallomaharShaNam |
astrANAM ghorarUpANAmagnervAyostathAshmanAm
shlokas.13:
sA tu mAyAmayI vRRiShTiH pIDayAmAsa mAM yudhi |
atha ghoraM tamastIvraM prAdurAsItsamantataH
shlokas.14:
tamasA sa.nvRRite loke ghoreNa paruSheNa cha |
turagA vimukhAshchAsanprAskhalachchApi mAtaliH
shlokas.15:
hastAddhiraNmayashchAsya pratodaH prApatadbhuvi |
asakRRichchAha mAM bhItaH kvAsIti bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
mAM cha bhIrAvishattIvrA tasminvigatachetasi |
sa cha mAM vigataj~nAnaH santrasta idamabravIt
shlokas.17:
surANAmasurANAM cha sa~NgrAmaH sumahAnabhUt |
amRRitArthe purA pArtha sa cha dRRiShTo mayAnagha
shlokas.18:
shambarasya vadhe chApi sa~NgrAmaH sumahAnabhUt |
sArathyaM devarAjasya tatrApi kRRitavAnaham
shlokas.19:
tathaiva vRRitrasya vadhe sa~NgRRihItA hayA mayA |
vairochanermayA yuddhaM dRRiShTaM chApi sudAruNam
shlokas.20:
ete mayA mahAghorAH sa~NgrAmAH paryupAsitAH |
na chApi vigataj~nAno bhUtapUrvo.asmi pANDava
shlokas.21:
pitAmahena saMhAraH prajAnAM vihito dhruvam |
na hi yuddhamidaM yuktamanyatra jagataH kShayAt
shlokas.22:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sa.nstabhyAtmAnamAtmanA |
mohayiShyandAnavAnAmahaM mAyAmayaM balam
shlokas.23:
abruvaM mAtaliM bhItaM pashya me bhujayorbalam |
astrANAM cha prabhAvaM me dhanuSho gANDivasya cha
shlokas.24:
adyAstramAyayaiteShAM mAyAmetAM sudAruNAm |
vinihanmi tamashchograM mA bhaiH sUta sthiro bhava
shlokas.25:
evamuktvAhamasRRijamastramAyAM narAdhipa |
mohanIM sarvashatrUNAM hitAya tridivaukasAm
shlokas.26:
pIDyamAnAsu mAyAsu tAsu tAsvasureshvarAH |
punarbahuvidhA mAyAH prAkurvannamitaujasaH
shlokas.27:
punaH prakAshamabhavattamasA grasyate punaH |
vrajatyadarshanaM lokaH punarapsu nimajjati
shlokas.28:
susa~NgRRihItairharibhiH prakAshe sati mAtaliH |
vyacharatsyandanAgryeNa sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe
shlokas.29:
tataH paryapatannugrA nivAtakavachA mayi |
tAnahaM vivaraM dRRiShTvA prAhiNvaM yamasAdanam
shlokas.30:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe nivAtakavachAntake |
nApashyaM sahasA sarvAndAnavAnmAyayAvRRitAn

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
adRRishyamAnAste daityA yodhayanti sma mAyayA |
adRRishyAnastravIryeNa tAnapyahamayodhayam
shlokas.2:
gANDIvamuktA vishikhAH samyagastraprachoditAH |
achChindannuttamA~NgAni yatra yatra sma te.abhavan
shlokas.3:
tato nivAtakavachA vadhyamAnA mayA yudhi |
saMhRRitya mAyAM sahasA prAvishanpuramAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
vyapayAteShu daityeShu prAdurbhUte cha darshane |
apashyaM dAnavA.nstatra hatA~nshatasahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
viniShpiShTAni tatraiShAM shastrANyAbharaNAni cha |
kUTashaH sma pradRRishyante gAtrANi kavachAni cha
shlokas.6:
hayAnAM nAntaraM hyAsItpadAdvichalituM padam |
utpatya sahasA tasthurantarikShagamAstataH
shlokas.7:
tato nivAtakavachA vyoma sa~nChAdya kevalam |
adRRishyA hyabhyavartanta visRRijantaH shilochchayAn
shlokas.8:
antarbhUmigatAshchAnye hayAnAM charaNAnyatha |
nyagRRihNandAnavA ghorA rathachakre cha bhArata
shlokas.9:
vinigRRihya harInashvAnrathaM cha mama yudhyataH |
sarvato mAmachinvanta sarathaM dharaNIdharaiH
shlokas.10:
parvatairupachIyadbhiH patamAnaistathAparaiH |
sa desho yatra vartAma guheva samapadyata
shlokas.11:
parvataishChAdyamAno.ahaM nigRRihItaishcha vAjibhiH |
agachChaM paramAmArtiM mAtalistadalakShayat
shlokas.12:
lakShayitvA tu mAM bhItamidaM vachanamabravIt |
arjunArjuna mA bhaistvaM vajramastramudIraya
shlokas.13:
tato.ahaM tasya tadvAkyaM shrutvA vajramudIrayam |
devarAjasya dayitaM vajramastraM narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
achalaM sthAnamAsAdya gANDIvamanumantrya cha |
amu~nchaM vajrasa.nsparshAnAyasAnnishitA~nsharAn
shlokas.15:
tato mAyAshcha tAH sarvA nivAtakavachA.nshcha tAn |
te vajrachoditA bANA vajrabhUtAH samAvishan
shlokas.16:
te vajravegAbhihatA dAnavAH parvatopamAH |
itaretaramAshliShya nyapatanpRRithivItale
shlokas.17:
antarbhUmau tu ye.agRRihNandAnavA rathavAjinaH |
anupravishya tAnbANAH prAhiNvanyamasAdanam
shlokas.18:
hatairnivAtakavachairnirastaiH parvatopamaiH |
samAchChAdyata deshaH sa vikIrNairiva parvataiH
shlokas.19:
na hayAnAM kShatiH kAchinna rathasya na mAtaleH |
mama chAdRRishyata tadA tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.20:
tato mAM prahasanrAjanmAtaliH pratyabhAShata |
naitadarjuna deveShu tvayi vIryaM yadIkShyate
shlokas.21:
hateShvasurasa~NgheShu dArAsteShAM tu sarvashaH |
prAkroshannagare tasminyathA sharadi lakShmaNAH
shlokas.22:
tato mAtalinA sArdhamahaM tatpuramabhyayAm |
trAsayanrathaghoSheNa nivAtakavachastriyaH
shlokas.23:
tAndRRiShTvA dashasAhasrAnmayUrasadRRishAnhayAn |
rathaM cha ravisa~NkAshaM prAdravangaNashaH striyaH
shlokas.24:
tAbhirAbharaNaiH shabdastrAsitAbhiH samIritaH |
shilAnAmiva shaileShu patantInAmabhUttadA
shlokas.25:
vitrastA daityanAryastAH svAni veshmAnyathAvishan |
bahuratnavichitrANi shAtakumbhamayAni cha
shlokas.26:
tadadbhutAkAramahaM dRRiShTvA nagaramuttamam |
vishiShTaM devanagarAdapRRichChaM mAtaliM tataH
shlokas.27:
idameva.nvidhaM kasmAddevatA nAvishantyuta |
pura.ndarapurAddhIdaM vishiShTamiti lakShaye
shlokas.28:
mAtaliruvAcha||
AsIdidaM purA pArtha devarAjasya naH puram |
tato nivAtakavachairitaH prachyAvitAH surAH
shlokas.29:
tapastaptvA mahattIvraM prasAdya cha pitAmaham |
idaM vRRitaM nivAsAya devebhyashchAbhayaM yudhi
shlokas.30:
tataH shakreNa bhagavAnsvayambhUrabhichoditaH |
vidhattAM bhagavAnatretyAtmano hitakAmyayA
shlokas.31:
tata ukto bhagavatA diShTamatreti vAsavaH |
bhavitAntastvamevaiShAM dehenAnyena vRRitrahan
shlokas.32:
tata eShAM vadhArthAya shakro.astrANi dadau tava |
na hi shakyAH surairhantuM ya ete nihatAstvayA
shlokas.33:
kAlasya pariNAmena tatastvamiha bhArata |
eShAmantakaraH prAptastattvayA cha kRRitaM tathA
shlokas.34:
dAnavAnAM vinAshArthaM mahAstrANAM mahadbalam |
grAhitastvaM mahendreNa puruShendra taduttamam
shlokas.35:
arjuna uvAcha||
tataH pravishya nagaraM dAnavA.nshcha nihatya tAn |
punarmAtalinA sArdhamagachChaM devasadma tat

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
nivartamAnena mayA mahaddRRiShTaM tato.aparam |
puraM kAmacharaM divyaM pAvakArkasamaprabham
shlokas.2:
drumai ratnamayaishchaitrairbhAsvaraishcha patatribhiH |
paulomaiH kAlakeyaishcha nityahRRiShTairadhiShThitam
shlokas.3:
gopurATTAlakopetaM chaturdvAraM durAsadam |
sarvaratnamayaM divyamadbhutopamadarshanam
drumaiH puShpaphalopetairdivyaratnamayairvRRitam
shlokas.4:
tathA patatribhirdivyairupetaM sumanoharaiH |
asurairnityamuditaiH shUlarShTimusalAyudhaiH
chApamudgarahastaishcha sragvibhiH sarvato vRRitam
shlokas.5:
tadahaM prekShya daityAnAM puramadbhutadarshanam |
apRRichChaM mAtaliM rAjankimidaM dRRishyateti vai
shlokas.6:
mAtaliruvAcha||
pulomA nAma daiteyI kAlakA cha mahAsurI |
divyaM varShasahasraM te cheratuH paramaM tapaH
tapaso.ante tatastAbhyAM svayambhUradadAdvaram
shlokas.7:
agRRihNItAM varaM te tu sutAnAmalpaduHkhatAm |
avadhyatAM cha rAjendra surarAkShasapannagaiH
shlokas.8:
ramaNIyaM puraM chedaM khacharaM sukRRitaprabham |
sarvaratnaiH samuditaM durdharShamamarairapi
sayakShagandharvagaNaiH pannagAsurarAkShasaiH
shlokas.9:
sarvakAmaguNopetaM vItashokamanAmayam |
brahmaNA bharatashreShTha kAlakeyakRRite kRRitam
shlokas.10:
tadetatkhacharaM divyaM charatyamaravarjitam |
paulomAdhyuShitaM vIra kAlakeyaishcha dAnavaiH
shlokas.11:
hiraNyapuramityetatkhyAyate nagaraM mahat |
rakShitaM kAlakeyaishcha paulomaishcha mahAsuraiH
shlokas.12:
ta ete muditA nityamavadhyAH sarvadaivataiH |
nivasantyatra rAjendra gatodvegA nirutsukAH
mAnuSho mRRityureteShAM nirdiShTo brahmaNA purA
shlokas.13:
arjuna uvAcha||
surAsurairavadhyA.nstAnahaM j~nAtvA tataH prabho |
abruvaM mAtaliM hRRiShTo yAhyetatpurama~njasA
shlokas.14:
tridasheshadviSho yAvatkShayamastrairnayAmyaham |
na katha~nchiddhi me pApA na vadhyA ye suradviShaH
shlokas.15:
uvAha mAM tataH shIghraM hiraNyapuramantikAt |
rathena tena divyena hariyuktena mAtaliH
shlokas.16:
te mAmAlakShya daiteyA vichitrAbharaNAmbarAH |
samutpeturmahAvegA rathAnAsthAya da.nshitAH
shlokas.17:
tato nAlIkanArAchairbhallashaktyRRiShTitomaraiH |
abhyaghnandAnavendrA mAM kruddhAstIvraparAkramAH
shlokas.18:
tadahaM chAstravarSheNa mahatA pratyavArayam |
shastravarShaM mahadrAjanvidyAbalamupAshritaH
shlokas.19:
vyAmohayaM cha tAnsarvAnrathamArgaishcharanraNe |
te.anyonyamabhisaMmUDhAH pAtayanti sma dAnavAH
shlokas.20:
teShAmahaM vimUDhAnAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm |
shirA.nsi vishikhairdIptairvyaharaM shatasa~NghashaH
shlokas.21:
te vadhyamAnA daiteyAH puramAsthAya tatpunaH |
khamutpetuH sanagarA mAyAmAsthAya dAnavIm
shlokas.22:
tato.ahaM sharavarSheNa mahatA pratyavArayam |
mArgamAvRRitya daityAnAM gatiM chaiShAmavArayam
shlokas.23:
tatpuraM khacharaM divyaM kAmagaM divyavarchasam |
daiteyairvaradAnena dhAryate sma yathAsukham
shlokas.24:
antarbhUmau nipatitaM punarUrdhvaM pratiShThate |
punastiryakprayAtyAshu punarapsu nimajjati
shlokas.25:
amarAvatisa~NkAshaM puraM kAmagamaM tu tat |
ahamastrairbahuvidhaiH pratyagRRihNaM narAdhipa
shlokas.26:
tato.ahaM sharajAlena divyAstramuditena cha |
nyagRRihNaM saha daiteyaistatpuraM bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
vikShataM chAyasairbANairmatprayuktairajihmagaiH |
mahImabhyapatadrAjanprabhagnaM puramAsuram
shlokas.28:
te vadhyamAnA madbANairvajravegairayasmayaiH |
paryabhramanta vai rAjannasurAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.29:
tato mAtalirapyAshu purastAnnipatanniva |
mahImavAtaratkShipraM rathenAdityavarchasA
shlokas.30:
tato rathasahasrANi ShaShTisteShAmamarShiNAm |
yuyutsUnAM mayA sArdhaM paryavartanta bhArata
shlokas.31:
tAnahaM nishitairbANairvyadhamaM gArdhravAjitaiH |
te yuddhe saMnyavartanta samudrasya yathormayaH
shlokas.32:
neme shakyA mAnuSheNa yuddheneti prachintya vai |
tato.ahamAnupUrvyeNa sarvANyastrANyayojayam
shlokas.33:
tatastAni sahasrANi rathAnAM chitrayodhinAm |
astrANi mama divyAni pratyaghna~nshanakairiva
shlokas.34:
rathamArgAnvichitrA.nste vicharanto mahArathAH |
pratyadRRishyanta sa~NgrAme shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.35:
vichitramukuTApIDA vichitrakavachadhvajAH |
vichitrAbharaNAshchaiva nandayantIva me manaH
shlokas.36:
ahaM tu sharavarShaistAnastrapramuditai raNe |
nAshaknuvaM pIDayituM te tu mAM paryapIDayan
shlokas.37:
taiH pIDyamAno bahubhiH kRRitAstraiH kushalairyudhi |
vyathito.asmi mahAyuddhe bhayaM chAgAnmahanmama
shlokas.38:
tato.ahaM devadevAya rudrAya praNato raNe |
svasti bhUtebhya ityuktvA mahAstraM samayojayam
yattadraudramiti khyAtaM sarvAmitravinAshanam
shlokas.39:
tato.apashyaM trishirasaM puruShaM navalochanam |
trimukhaM ShaDbhujaM dIptamarkajvalanamUrdhajam
lelihAnairmahAnAgaiH kRRitashIrShamamitrahan
shlokas.40:
vibhIstatastadastraM tu ghoraM raudraM sanAtanam |
dRRiShTvA gANDIvasa.nyogamAnIya bharatarShabha
shlokas.41:
namaskRRitvA trinetrAya sharvAyAmitatejase |
muktavAndAnavendrANAM parAbhAvAya bhArata
shlokas.42:
muktamAtre tatastasminrUpANyAsansahasrashaH |
mRRigANAmatha siMhAnAM vyAghrANAM cha vishAM pate
RRikShANAM mahiShANAM cha pannagAnAM tathA gavAm
shlokas.43:
gajAnAM sRRimarANAM cha sharabhANAM cha sarvashaH |
RRiShabhANAM varAhANAM mArjArANAM tathaiva cha
shAlAvRRikANAM pretAnAM bhuruNDAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.44:
gRRidhrANAM garuDAnAM cha makarANAM tathaiva cha |
pishAchAnAM sayakShANAM tathaiva cha suradviShAm
shlokas.45:
guhyakAnAM cha sa~NgrAme nairRRitAnAM tathaiva cha |
jhaShANAM gajavaktrANAmulUkAnAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.46:
mInakUrmasamUhAnAM nAnAshastrAsipANinAm |
tathaiva yAtu dhAnAnAM gadAmudgaradhAriNAm
shlokas.47:
etaishchAnyaishcha bahubhirnAnArUpadharaistathA |
sarvamAsIjjagadvyAptaM tasminnastre visarjite
shlokas.48:
triShirobhishchaturdaMShTraishchaturAsyaishchaturbhujaiH |
anekarUpasa.nyuktairmA.nsamedovasAshibhiH
abhIkShNaM vadhyamAnAste dAnavA ye samAgatAH
shlokas.49:
arkajvalanatejobhirvajrAshanisamaprabhaiH |
adrisAramayaishchAnyairbANairarividAraNaiH
nyahanaM dAnavAnsarvAnmuhUrtenaiva bhArata
shlokas.50:
gANDIvAstrapraNunnA.nstAngatAsUnnabhasashchyutAn |
dRRiShTvAhaM prANamaM bhUyastripuraghnAya vedhase
shlokas.51:
tathA raudrAstraniShpiShTAndivyAbharaNabhUShitAn |
nishAmya paramaM harShamagamaddevasArathiH
shlokas.52:
tadasahyaM kRRitaM karma devairapi durAsadam |
dRRiShTvA mAM pUjayAmAsa mAtaliH shakrasArathiH
shlokas.53:
uvAcha chedaM vachanaM prIyamANaH kRRitA~njaliH |
surAsurairasahyaM hi karma yatsAdhitaM tvayA
na hyetatsa.nyuge kartumapi shaktaH sureshvaraH
shlokas.54:
surAsurairavadhyaM hi purametatkhagaM mahat |
tvayA vimathitaM vIra svavIryAstratapobalAt
shlokas.55:
vidhvaste.atha pure tasmindAnaveShu hateShu cha |
vinadantyaH striyaH sarvA niShpeturnagarAdbahiH
shlokas.56:
prakIrNakeshyo vyathitAH kurarya iva duHkhitAH |
petuH putrAnpitR^InbhrAtR^I~nshochamAnA mahItale
shlokas.57:
rudantyo dInakaNThyastA vinadantyo hateshvarAH |
urA.nsi pANibhirghnantyaH prasrastasragvibhUShaNAH
shlokas.58:
tachChokayuktamashrIkaM duHkhadainyasamAhatam |
na babhau dAnavapuraM hatatviTkaM hateshvaram
shlokas.59:
gandharvanagarAkAraM hatanAgamiva hradam |
shuShkavRRikShamivAraNyamadRRishyamabhavatpuram
shlokas.60:
mAM tu saMhRRiShTamanasaM kShipraM mAtalirAnayat |
devarAjasya bhavanaM kRRitakarmANamAhavAt
shlokas.61:
hiraNyapuramArujya nihatya cha mahAsurAn |
nivAtakavachA.nshchaiva tato.ahaM shakramAgamam
shlokas.62:
mama karma cha devendraM mAtalirvistareNa tat |
sarvaM vishrAvayAmAsa yathA bhUtaM mahAdyute
shlokas.63:
hiraNyapuraghAtaM cha mAyAnAM cha nivAraNam |
nivAtakavachAnAM cha vadhaM sa~Nkhye mahaujasAm
shlokas.64:
tachChrutvA bhagavAnprItaH sahasrAkShaH pura.ndaraH |
marudbhiH sahitaH shrImAnsAdhu sAdhvityathAbravIt
shlokas.65:
tato mAM devarAjo vai samAshvAsya punaH punaH |
abravIdvibudhaiH sArdhamidaM sumadhuraM vachaH
shlokas.66:
atidevAsuraM karma kRRitametattvayA raNe |
gurvarthashcha mahAnpArtha kRRitaH shatrUnghnatA mama
shlokas.67:
evameva sadA bhAvyaM sthireNAjau dhana~njaya |
asaMmUDhena chAstrANAM kartavyaM pratipAdanam
shlokas.68:
aviShahyo raNe hi tvaM devadAnavarAkShasaiH |
sayakShAsuragandharvaiH sapakShigaNapannagaiH
shlokas.69:
vasudhAM chApi kaunteya tvadbAhubalanirjitAm |
pAlayiShyati dharmAtmA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tato mAmabhivishvastaM sa.nrUDhasharavikShatam |
devarAjo.anugRRihyedaM kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
divyAnyastrANi sarvANi tvayi tiShThanti bhArata |
na tvAbhibhavituM shakto mAnuSho bhuvi kashchana
shlokas.3:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipaH karNaH shakuniH saha rAjabhiH |
sa~NgrAmasthasya te putra kalAM nArhanti ShoDashIm
shlokas.4:
idaM cha me tanutrANaM prAyachChanmaghavAnprabhuH |
abhedyaM kavachaM divyaM srajaM chaiva hiraNmayIm
shlokas.5:
devadattaM cha me sha~NkhaM devaH prAdAnmahAravam |
divyaM chedaM kirITaM me svayamindro yuyoja ha
shlokas.6:
tato divyAni vastrANi divyAnyAbharaNAni cha |
prAdAchChakro mamaitAni ruchirANi bRRihanti cha
shlokas.7:
evaM sampUjitastatra sukhamasmyuShito nRRipa |
indrasya bhavane puNye gandharvashishubhiH saha
shlokas.8:
tato mAmabravIchChakraH prItimAnamaraiH saha |
samayo.arjuna gantuM te bhrAtaro hi smaranti te
shlokas.9:
evamindrasya bhavane pa~ncha varShANi bhArata |
uShitAni mayA rAjansmaratA dyUtajaM kalim
shlokas.10:
tato bhavantamadrAkShaM bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritam |
gandhamAdanamAsAdya parvatasyAsya mUrdhani
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
diShTyA dhana~njayAstrANi tvayA prAptAni bhArata |
diShTyA chArAdhito rAjA devAnAmIshvaraH prabhuH
shlokas.12:
diShTyA cha bhagavAnsthANurdevyA saha parantapa |
sAkShAddRRiShTaH suyuddhena toShitashcha tvayAnagha
shlokas.13:
diShTyA cha lokapAlaistvaM sameto bharatarShabha |
diShTyA vardhAmahe sarve diShTyAsi punarAgataH
shlokas.14:
adya kRRitsnAmimAM devIM vijitAM puramAlinIm |
manye cha dhRRitarAShTrasya putrAnapi vashIkRRitAn
shlokas.15:
tAni tvichChAmi te draShTuM divyAnyastrANi bhArata |
yaistathA vIryavantaste nivAtakavachA hatA
shlokas.16:
arjuna uvAcha||
shvaH prabhAte bhavAndraShTA divyAnyastrANi sarvashaH |
nivAtakavachA ghorA yairmayA vinipAtitAH
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAgamanaM tatra kathayitvA dhana~njayaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvai rajanIM tAmuvAsa ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasyAM rajanyAM vyuShTAyAM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
utthAyAvashyakAryANi kRRitavAnbhratRRibhiH saha
shlokas.2:
tataH sa~nchodayAmAsa so.arjunaM bhrAtRRinandanam |
darshayAstrANi kaunteya yairjitA dAnavAstvayA
shlokas.3:
tato dhana~njayo rAjandevairdattAni pANDavaH |
astrANi tAni divyAni darshayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.4:
yathAnyAyaM mahAtejAH shauchaM paramamAsthitaH |
girikUbaraM pAdapA~NgaM shubhaveNu triveNukam
pArthivaM rathamAsthAya shobhamAno dhana~njayaH
shlokas.5:
tataH suda.nshitastena kavachena suvarchasA |
dhanurAdAya gANDIvaM devadattaM cha vArijam
shlokas.6:
shoshubhyamAnaH kaunteya AnupUrvyAnmahAbhujaH |
astrANi tAni divyAni darshanAyopachakrame
shlokas.7:
atha prayokShyamANena divyAnyastrANi tena vai |
samAkrAntA mahI padbhyAM samakampata sadrumA
shlokas.8:
kShubhitAH saritashchaiva tathaiva cha mahodadhiH |
shailAshchApi vyashIryanta na vavau cha samIraNaH
shlokas.9:
na babhAse sahasrA.nshurna jajvAla cha pAvakaH |
na vedAH pratibhAnti sma dvijAtInAM katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
antarbhUmigatA ye cha prANino janamejaya |
pIDyamAnAH samutthAya pANDavaM paryavArayan
shlokas.11:
vepamAnAH prA~njalayaste sarve pihitAnanAH |
dahyamAnAstadAstraistairyAchanti sma dhana~njayam
shlokas.12:
tato brahmarShayashchaiva siddhAshchaiva surarShayaH |
ja~NgamAni cha bhUtAni sarvANyevAvatasthire
shlokas.13:
rAjarShayashcha pravarAstathaiva cha divaukasaH |
yakSharAkShasagandharvAstathaiva cha patatriNaH
shlokas.14:
tataH pitAmahashchaiva lokapAlAshcha sarvashaH |
bhagavA.nshcha mahAdevaH sagaNo.abhyAyayau tadA
shlokas.15:
tato vAyurmahArAja divyairmAlyaiH sugandhibhiH |
abhitaH pANDavA.nshchitrairavachakre samantataH
shlokas.16:
jagushcha gAthA vividhA gandharvAH surachoditAH |
nanRRituH sa~Nghashashchaiva rAjannapsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.17:
tasmi.nstu tumule kAle nAradaH surachoditaH |
AgamyAha vachaH pArthaM shravaNIyamidaM nRRipa
shlokas.18:
arjunArjuna mA yu~NkShva divyAnyastrANi bhArata |
naitAni niradhiShThAne prayujyante kadAchana
shlokas.19:
adhiShThAne na vAnArtaH prayu~njIta kadAchana |
prayoge sumahAndoSho hyastrANAM kurunandana
shlokas.20:
etAni rakShyamANAni dhana~njaya yathAgamam |
balavanti sukhArhANi bhaviShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.21:
arakShyamANAnyetAni trailokyasyApi pANDava |
bhavanti sma vinAshAya maivaM bhUyaH kRRithAH kvachit
shlokas.22:
ajAtashatro tvaM chaiva drakShyase tAni sa.nyuge |
yojyamAnAni pArthena dviShatAmavamardane
shlokas.23:
nivAryAtha tataH pArthaM sarve devA yathAgatam |
jagmuranye cha ye tatra samAjagmurnararShabha
shlokas.24:
teShu sarveShu kauravya pratiyAteShu pANDavAH |
tasminneva vane hRRiShTAsta UShuH saha kRRiShNayA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
tasminkRRitAstre rathinAM pradhAne; pratyAgate bhavanAdvRRitrahantuH |
ataH paraM kimakurvanta pArthAH; sametya shUreNa dhana~njayena
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vaneShu teShveva tu te narendrAH; sahArjunenendrasamena vIrAH |
tasmi.nshcha shailapravare suramye; dhaneshvarAkrIDagatA vijahruH
shlokas.3:
veshmAni tAnyapratimAni pashya;nkrIDAshcha nAnAdrumasaMnikarShAH |
chachAra dhanvI bahudhA narendraH; so.astreShu yattaH satataM kirITI
shlokas.4:
avApya vAsaM naradevaputrAH; prasAdajaM vaishravaNasya rAj~naH |
na prANinAM te spRRihayanti rAja;~nshivashcha kAlaH sa babhUva teShAm
shlokas.5:
sametya pArthena yathaikarAtra;mUShuH samAstatra tadA chatasraH |
pUrvAshcha ShaTtA dasha pANDavAnAM; shivA babhUvurvasatAM vaneShu
shlokas.6:
tato.abravIdvAyusutastarasvI; jiShNushcha rAjAnamupopavishya |
yamau cha vIrau surarAjakalpA;vekAntamAsthAya hitaM priyaM cha
shlokas.7:
tava pratij~nAM kururAja satyAM; chikIrShamANAstvadanu priyaM cha |
tato.anugachChAma vanAnyapAsya; suyodhanaM sAnucharaM nihantum
shlokas.8:
ekAdashaM varShamidaM vasAmaH; suyodhanenAttasukhAH sukhArhAH |
taM va~nchayitvAdhamabuddhishIla;maj~nAtavAsaM sukhamApnuyAmaH
shlokas.9:
tavAj~nayA pArthiva nirvisha~NkA; vihAya mAnaM vicharanvanAni |
samIpavAsena vilobhitAste; j~nAsyanti nAsmAnapakRRiShTadeshAn
shlokas.10:
sa.nvatsaraM taM tu vihRRitya gUDhaM; narAdhamaM taM sukhamuddharema |
niryAtya vairaM saphalaM sapuShpaM; tasmai narendrAdhamapUruShAya
shlokas.11:
suyodhanAyAnucharairvRRitAya; tato mahImAhara dharmarAja |
svargopamaM shailamimaM charadbhiH; shakyo vihantuM naradeva shokaH
shlokas.12:
kIrtishcha te bhArata puNyagandhA; nashyeta lokeShu charAchareShu |
tatprApya rAjyaM kurupu~NgavAnAM; shakyaM mahatprAptamatha kriyAshcha
shlokas.13:
idaM tu shakyaM satataM narendra; prAptuM tvayA yallabhase kuberAt |
kuruShva buddhiM dviShatAM vadhAya; kRRitAgasAM bhArata nigrahe cha
shlokas.14:
tejastavograM na saheta rAja;nsametya sAkShAdapi vajrapANiH |
na hi vyathAM jAtu kariShyatastau; sametya devairapi dharmarAja
shlokas.15:
tvadarthasiddhyarthamabhipravRRittau; suparNaketushcha shineshcha naptA |
yathaiva kRRiShNo.apratimo balena; tathaiva rAjansa shinipravIraH
shlokas.16:
tavArthasiddhyarthamabhipravRRittau; yathaiva kRRiShNaH saha yAdavaistaiH |
tathaiva chAvAM naradevavarya; yamau cha vIrau kRRitinau prayoge
tvadarthayogaprabhavapradhAnAH; samaM kariShyAma parAnsametya
shlokas.17:
tatastadAj~nAya mataM mahAtmA; teShAM sa dharmasya suto variShThaH |
pradakShiNaM vaishravaNAdhivAsaM; chakAra dharmArthaviduttamaujaH
shlokas.18:
Amantrya veshmAni nadIH sarA.nsi; sarvANi rakShA.nsi cha dharmarAjaH |
yathAgataM mArgamavekShamANaH; punargiriM chaiva nirIkShamANaH
shlokas.19:
samAptakarmA sahitaH suhRRidbhi;rjitvA sapatnAnpratilabhya rAjyam |
shailendra bhUyastapase dhRRitAtmA; draShTA tavAsmIti matiM chakAra
shlokas.20:
vRRitaH sa sarvairanujairdvijaishcha; tenaiva mArgeNa patiH kurUNAm |
uvAha chainAnsagaNA.nstathaiva; ghaTotkachaH parvatanirjhareShu
shlokas.21:
tAnprasthitAnprItimanA maharShiH; piteva putrAnanushiShya sarvAn |
sa lomashaH prItamanA jagAma; divaukasAM puNyatamaM nivAsam
shlokas.22:
tenAnushiShTArShTiSheNena chaiva; tIrthAni ramyANi tapovanAni |
mahAnti chAnyAni sarA.nsi pArthAH; sampashyamAnAH prayayurnarAgryAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nagottamaM prasravaNairupetaM; dishAM gajaiH kiMnarapakShibhishcha |
sukhaM nivAsaM jahatAM hi teShAM; na prItirAsIdbharatarShabhANAm
shlokas.2:
tatastu teShAM punareva harShaH; kailAsamAlokya mahAnbabhUva |
kuberakAntaM bharatarShabhANAM; mahIdharaM vAridharaprakAsham
shlokas.3:
samuchChrayAnparvatasaMnirodhA;ngoShThAngirINAM girisetumAlAH |
bahUnprapAtA.nshcha samIkShya vIrAH; sthalAni nimnAni cha tatra tatra
shlokas.4:
tathaiva chAnyAni mahAvanAni; mRRigadvijAnekapasevitAni |
Alokayanto.abhiyayuH pratItA;ste dhanvinaH khaDgadharA narAgryAH
shlokas.5:
vanAni ramyANi sarA.nsi nadyo; guhA girINAM girigahvarANi |
ete nivAsAH satataM babhUvu;rnishAnishaM prApya nararShabhANAm
shlokas.6:
te durgavAsaM bahudhA niruShya; vyatItya kailAsamachintyarUpam |
AseduratyarthamanoramaM vai; tamAshramAgryaM vRRiShaparvaNaste
shlokas.7:
sametya rAj~nA vRRiShaparvaNaste; pratyarchitAstena cha vItamohAH |
shasha.nsire vistarashaH pravAsaM; shivaM yathAvadvRRiShaparvaNaste
shlokas.8:
sukhoShitAstatra ta ekarAtraM; puNyAshrame devamaharShijuShTe |
abhyAyayuste badarIM vishAlAM; sukhena vIrAH punareva vAsam
shlokas.9:
UShustatastatra mahAnubhAvA; nArAyaNasthAnagatA narAgryAH |
kuberakAntAM nalinIM vishokAH; sampashyamAnAH surasiddhajuShTAm
shlokas.10:
tAM chAtha dRRiShTvA nalinIM vishokAH; pANDoH sutAH sarvanarapravIrAH |
te remire nandanavAsametya; dvijarShayo vItabhayA yathaiva
shlokas.11:
tataH krameNopayayurnRRivIrA; yathAgatenaiva pathA samagrAH |
vihRRitya mAsaM sukhino badaryAM; kirAtarAj~no viShayaM subAhoH
shlokas.12:
chInA.nstukhArAndaradAnsadArvA;ndeshAnkuNindasya cha bhUriratnAn |
atItya durgaM himavatpradeshaM; puraM subAhordadRRishurnRRivIrAH
shlokas.13:
shrutvA cha tAnpArthivaputrapautrA;nprAptAnsubAhurviShaye samagrAn |
pratyudyayau prItiyutaH sa rAjA; taM chAbhyanandanvRRiShabhAH kurUNAm
shlokas.14:
sametya rAj~nA tu subAhunA te; sUtairvishokapramukhaishcha sarvaiH |
sahendrasenaiH parichArakaishcha; paurogavairye cha mahAnasasthAH
shlokas.15:
sukhoShitAstatra ta ekarAtraM; sUtAnupAdAya rathA.nshcha sarvAn |
ghaTotkachaM sAnucharaM visRRijya; tato.abhyayuryAmunamadrirAjam
shlokas.16:
tasmingirau prasravaNopapanne; himottarIyAruNapANDusAnau |
vishAkhayUpaM samupetya chakru;stadA nivAsaM puruShapravIrAH
shlokas.17:
varAhanAnAmRRigapakShijuShTaM; mahadvanaM chaitrarathaprakAsham |
shivena yAtvA mRRigayApradhAnAH; sa.nvatsaraM tatra vane vijahruH
shlokas.18:
tatrAsasAdAtibalaM bhuja~NgaM; kShudhArditaM mRRityumivograrUpam |
vRRikodaraH parvatakandarAyAM; viShAdamohavyathitAntarAtmA
shlokas.19:
dvIpo.abhavadyatra vRRikodarasya; yudhiShThiro dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH |
amokShayadyastamanantatejA; grAheNa sa.nveShTitasarvagAtram
shlokas.20:
te dvAdashaM varShamathopayAntaM; vane vihartuM kuravaH pratItAH |
tasmAdvanAchchaitrarathaprakAshA;chChriyA jvalantastapasA cha yuktAH
shlokas.21:
tatashcha yAtvA marudhanvapArshvaM; sadA dhanurvedaratipradhAnAH |
sarasvatImetya nivAsakAmAH; sarastato dvaitavanaM pratIyuH
shlokas.22:
samIkShya tAndvaitavane niviShTA;nnivAsinastatra tato.abhijagmuH |
tapodamAchArasamAdhiyuktA;stRRiNodapAtrAharaNAshmakuTTAH
shlokas.23:
plakShAkSharauhItakavetasAshcha; snuhA badaryaH khadirAH shirIShAH |
bilve~NgudAH pIlushamIkarIrAH; sarasvatItIraruhA babhUvuH
shlokas.24:
tAM yakShagandharvamaharShikAntA;mAyAgabhUtAmiva devatAnAm |
sarasvatIM prItiyutAshcharantaH; sukhaM vijahrurnaradevaputrAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM nAgAyutaprANo bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
bhayamAhArayattIvraM tasmAdajagarAnmune
shlokas.2:
paulastyaM yo.a.ahvayadyuddhe dhanadaM baladarpitaH |
nalinyAM kadanaM kRRitvA varANAM yakSharakShasAm
shlokas.3:
taM sha.nsasi bhayAviShTamApannamarikarShaNam |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bahvAshcharye vane teShAM vasatAmugradhanvinAm |
prAptAnAmAshramAdrAjanrAjarShervRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.5:
yadRRichChayA dhanuShpANirbaddhakhaDgo vRRikodaraH |
dadarsha tadvanaM ramyaM devagandharvasevitam
shlokas.6:
sa dadarsha shubhAndeshAngirerhimavatastadA |
devarShisiddhacharitAnapsarogaNasevitAn
shlokas.7:
chakoraishchakravAkaishcha pakShibhirjIvajIvakaiH |
kokilairbhRRi~NgarAjaishcha tatra tatra vinAditAn
shlokas.8:
nityapuShpaphalairvRRikShairhimasa.nsparshakomalaiH |
upetAnbahulachChAyairmanonayananandanaiH
shlokas.9:
sa sampashyangirinadIrvaiDUryamaNisaMnibhaiH |
salilairhimasa.nsparshairha.nsakAraNDavAyutaiH
shlokas.10:
vanAni devadArUNAM meghAnAmiva vAgurAH |
harichandanamishrANi tu~NgakAlIyakAnyapi
shlokas.11:
mRRigayAM paridhAvansa sameShu marudhanvasu |
vidhyanmRRigA~nsharaiH shuddhaishchachAra sumahAbalaH
shlokas.12:
sa dadarsha mahAkAyaM bhuja~NgaM lomaharShaNam |
giridurge samApannaM kAyenAvRRitya kandaram
shlokas.13:
parvatAbhogavarShmANaM bhogaishchandrArkamaNDalaiH |
chitrA~NgamajinaishchitrairharidrAsadRRishachChavim
shlokas.14:
guhAkAreNa vaktreNa chaturdaMShTreNa rAjatA |
dIptAkSheNAtitAmreNa lihantaM sRRikkiNI muhuH
shlokas.15:
trAsanaM sarvabhUtAnAM kAlAntakayamopamam |
niHshvAsakShveDanAdena bhartsayantamiva sthitam
shlokas.16:
sa bhImaM sahasAbhyetya pRRidAkuH kShudhito bhRRisham |
jagrAhAjagaro grAho bhujayorubhayorbalAt
shlokas.17:
tena sa.nspRRiShTamAtrasya bhimasenasya vai tadA |
sa~nj~nA mumoha sahasA varadAnena tasya ha
shlokas.18:
dasha nAgasahasrANi dhArayanti hi yadbalam |
tadbalaM bhImasenasya bhujayorasamaM paraiH
shlokas.19:
sa tejasvI tathA tena bhujagena vashIkRRitaH |
visphura~nshanakairbhImo na shashAka vicheShTitum
shlokas.20:
nAgAyutasamaprANaH siMhaskandho mahAbhujaH |
gRRihIto vyajahAtsattvaM varadAnena mohitaH
shlokas.21:
sa hi prayatnamakarottIvramAtmavimokShaNe |
na chainamashakadvIraH katha~nchitpratibAdhitum

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa bhImasenastejasvI tathA sarpavashaM gataH |
chintayAmAsa sarpasya vIryamatyadbhutaM mahat
shlokas.2:
uvAcha cha mahAsarpaM kAmayA brUhi pannaga |
kastvaM bho bhujagashreShTha kiM mayA cha kariShyasi
shlokas.3:
pANDavo bhimaseno.ahaM dharmarAjAdanantaraH |
nAgAyutasamaprANastvayA nItaH kathaM vasham
shlokas.4:
siMhAH kesariNo vyAghrA mahiShA vAraNAstathA |
samAgatAshcha bahusho nihatAshcha mayA mRRidhe
shlokas.5:
dAnavAshcha pishAchAshcha rAkShasAshcha mahAbalAH |
bhujavegamashaktA me soDhuM pannagasattama
shlokas.6:
kiM nu vidyAbalaM kiM vA varadAnamatho tava |
udyogamapi kurvANo vashago.asmi kRRitastvayA
shlokas.7:
asatyo vikramo nR^INAmiti me nishchitA matiH |
yathedaM me tvayA nAga balaM pratihataM mahat
shlokas.8:
ityeva.nvAdinaM vIraM bhImamakliShTakAriNam |
bhogena mahatA sarpaH samantAtparyaveShTayat
shlokas.9:
nigRRihya taM mahAbAhuM tataH sa bhujagastadA |
vimuchyAsya bhujau pInAvidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.10:
diShTyA tvaM kShudhitasyAdya devairbhakSho mahAbhuja |
diShTyA kAlasya mahataH priyAH prANA hi dehinAm
shlokas.11:
yathA tvidaM mayA prAptaM bhuja~Ngatvamari.ndama |
tadavashyaM mayA khyApyaM tavAdya shRRiNu sattama
shlokas.12:
imAmavasthAM samprApto hyahaM kopAnmanIShiNAm |
shApasyAntaM pariprepsuH sarpasya kathayAmi tat
shlokas.13:
nahuSho nAma rAjarShirvyaktaM te shrotramAgataH |
tavaiva pUrvaH pUrveShAmAyorva.nshakaraH sutaH
shlokas.14:
so.ahaM shApAdagastyasya brAhmaNAnavamanya cha |
imAmavasthAmApannaH pashya daivamidaM mama
shlokas.15:
tvAM chedavadhyamAyAntamatIva priyadarshanam |
ahamadyopayokShyAmi vidhAnaM pashya yAdRRisham
shlokas.16:
na hi me muchyate kashchitkatha~nchidgrahaNaM gataH |
gajo vA mahiSho vApi ShaShThe kAle narottama
shlokas.17:
nAsi kevalasarpeNa tiryagyoniShu vartatA |
gRRihItaH kauravashreShTha varadAnamidaM mama
shlokas.18:
patatA hi vimAnAgrAnmayA shakrAsanAddrutam |
kuru shApAntamityukto bhagavAnmunisattamaH
shlokas.19:
sa mAmuvAcha tejasvI kRRipayAbhipariplutaH |
mokShaste bhavitA rAjankasmAchchitkAlaparyayAt
shlokas.20:
tato.asmi patito bhUmau na cha mAmajahAtsmRRitiH |
smArtamasti purANaM me yathaivAdhigataM tathA
shlokas.21:
yastu te vyAhRRitAnprashnAnpratibrUyAdvisheShavit |
sa tvAM mokShayitA shApAditi mAmabravIdRRiShiH
shlokas.22:
gRRihItasya tvayA rAjanprANino.api balIyasaH |
sattvabhra.nsho.adhikasyApi sarvasyAshu bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
iti chApyahamashrauShaM vachasteShAM dayAvatAm |
mayi sa~njAtahArdAnAmatha te.antarhitA dvijAH
shlokas.24:
so.ahaM paramaduShkarmA vasAmi niraye.ashuchau |
sarpayonimimAM prApya kAlAkA~NkShI mahAdyute
shlokas.25:
tamuvAcha mahAbAhurbhImaseno bhuja~Ngamam |
na te kupye mahAsarpa na chAtmAnaM vigarhaye
shlokas.26:
yasmAdabhAvI bhAvI vA manuShyaH sukhaduHkhayoH |
Agame yadi vApAye na tatra glapayenmanaH
shlokas.27:
daivaM puruShakAreNa ko nivartitumarhati |
daivameva paraM manye puruShArtho nirarthakaH
shlokas.28:
pashya daivopaghAtAddhi bhujavIryavyapAshrayam |
imAmavasthAM samprAptamanimittamihAdya mAm
shlokas.29:
kiM tu nAdyAnushochAmi tathAtmAnaM vinAshitam |
yathA tu vipine nyastAnbhrAtR^InrAjyaparichyutAn
shlokas.30:
himavA.nshcha sudurgo.ayaM yakSharAkShasasa~NkulaH |
mAM cha te samudIkShantaH prapatiShyanti vihvalAH
shlokas.31:
vinaShTamatha vA shrutvA bhaviShyanti nirudyamAH |
dharmashIlA mayA te hi bAdhyante rAjyagRRiddhinA
shlokas.32:
atha vA nArjuno dhImAnviShAdamupayAsyati |
sarvAstravidanAdhRRiShyo devagandharvarAkShasaiH
shlokas.33:
samarthaH sa mahAbAhurekAhnA sumahAbalaH |
devarAjamapi sthAnAtprachyAvayitumojasA
shlokas.34:
kiM punardhRRitarAShTrasya putraM durdyUtadevinam |
vidviShTaM sarvalokasya dambhalobhaparAyaNam
shlokas.35:
mAtaraM chaiva shochAmi kRRipaNAM putragRRiddhinIm |
yAsmAkaM nityamAshAste mahattvamadhikaM paraiH
shlokas.36:
kathaM nu tasyAnAthAyA madvinAshAdbhuja~Ngama |
aphalAste bhaviShyanti mayi sarve manorathAH
shlokas.37:
nakulaH sahadevashcha yamajau guruvartinau |
madbAhubalasa.nstabdhau nityaM puruShamAninau
shlokas.38:
nirutsAhau bhaviShyete bhraShTavIryaparAkramau |
madvinAshAtparidyUnAviti me vartate matiH
shlokas.39:
eva.nvidhaM bahu tadA vilalApa vRRikodaraH |
bhuja~Ngabhogasa.nruddho nAshakachcha vicheShTitum
shlokas.40:
yudhiShThirastu kaunteya babhUvAsvasthachetanaH |
aniShTadarshanAnghorAnutpAtAnparichintayan
shlokas.41:
dAruNaM hyashivaM nAdaM shivA dakShiNataH sthitA |
dIptAyAM dishi vitrastA rauti tasyAshramasya ha
shlokas.42:
ekapakShAkShicharaNA vartikA ghoradarshanA |
rudhiraM vamantI dadRRishe pratyAdityamapasvarA
shlokas.43:
pravavAvanilo rUkShashchaNDaH sharkarakarShaNaH |
apasavyAni sarvANi mRRigapakShirutAni cha
shlokas.44:
pRRiShThato vAyasaH kRRiShNo yAhi yAhIti vAshati |
muhurmuhuH prasphurati dakShiNo.asya bhujastathA
shlokas.45:
hRRidayaM charaNashchApi vAmo.asya parivartate |
savyasyAkShNo vikArashchApyaniShTaH samapadyata
shlokas.46:
sa dharmarAjo medhAvI sha~NkamAno mahadbhayam |
draupadIM paripaprachCha kva bhIma iti bhArata
shlokas.47:
shasha.nsa tasmai pA~nchAlI chirayAtaM vRRikodaram |
sa pratasthe mahAbAhurdhaumyena sahito nRRipaH
shlokas.48:
draupadyA rakShaNaM kAryamityuvAcha dhana~njayam |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha vyAdidesha dvijAnprati
shlokas.49:
sa tasya padamunnIya tasmAdevAshramAtprabhuH |
dadarsha pRRithivIM chihnairbhImasya parichihnitAm
shlokas.50:
dhAvatastasya vIrasya mRRigArthe vAtaraMhasaH |
UruvAtavinirbhagnAndrumAnvyAvarjitAnpathi
shlokas.51:
sa gatvA taistadA chihnairdadarsha girigahvare |
gRRihItaM bhujagendreNa nishcheShTamanujaM tathA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirastamAsAdya sarpabhogAbhiveShTitam |
dayitaM bhrAtaraM vIramidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
kuntImAtaH kathamimAmApadaM tvamavAptavAn |
kashchAyaM parvatAbhogapratimaH pannagottamaH
shlokas.3:
sa dharmarAjamAlakShya bhrAtA bhrAtaramagrajam |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvaM grahaNAdi vicheShTitam
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
devo vA yadi vA daitya urago vA bhavAnyadi |
satyaM sarpa vacho brUhi pRRichChati tvAM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
kimAhRRitya viditvA vA prItiste syAdbhuja~Ngama |
kimAhAraM prayachChAmi kathaM mu~nchedbhavAnimam
shlokas.6:
sarpa uvAcha||
nahuSho nAma rAjAhamAsaM pUrvastavAnagha |
prathitaH pa~nchamaH somAdAyoH putro narAdhipa
shlokas.7:
kratubhistapasA chaiva svAdhyAyena damena cha |
trailokyaishvaryamavyagraM prApto vikramaNena cha
shlokas.8:
tadaishvaryaM samAsAdya darpo mAmagamattadA |
sahasraM hi dvijAtInAmuvAha shibikAM mama
shlokas.9:
aishvaryamadamatto.ahamavamanya tato dvijAn |
imAmagastyena dashAmAnItaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.10:
na tu mAmajahAtpraj~nA yAvadadyeti pANDava |
tasyaivAnugrahAdrAjannagastyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
ShaShThe kAle mamAhAraH prApto.ayamanujastava |
nAhamenaM vimokShyAmi na chAnyamabhikAmaye
shlokas.12:
prashnAnuchchAritA.nstu tvaM vyAhariShyasi chenmama |
atha pashchAdvimokShyAmi bhrAtaraM te vRRikodaram
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brUhi sarpa yathAkAmaM prativakShyAmi te vachaH |
api chechChaknuyAM prItimAhartuM te bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.14:
vedyaM yadbrAhmaNeneha tadbhavAnvetti kevalam |
sarparAja tataH shrutvA prativakShyAmi te vachaH
shlokas.15:
sarpa uvAcha||
brAhmaNaH ko bhavedrAjanvedyaM kiM cha yudhiShThira |
bravIhyatimatiM tvAM hi vAkyairanumimImahe
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
satyaM dAnaM kShamA shIlamAnRRisha.nsyaM damo ghRRiNA |
dRRishyante yatra nAgendra sa brAhmaNa iti smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
vedyaM sarpa paraM brahma nirduHkhamasukhaM cha yat |
yatra gatvA na shochanti bhavataH kiM vivakShitam
shlokas.18:
sarpa uvAcha||
chAturvarNyaM pramANaM cha satyaM cha brahma chaiva ha |
shUdreShvapi cha satyaM cha dAnamakrodha eva cha
AnRRisha.nsyamahi.nsA cha ghRRiNA chaiva yudhiShThira
shlokas.19:
vedyaM yachchAttha nirduHkhamasukhaM cha narAdhipa |
tAbhyAM hInaM padaM chAnyanna tadastIti lakShaye
shlokas.20:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shUdre chaitadbhavellakShyaM dvije tachcha na vidyate |
na vai shUdro bhavechChUdro brAhmaNo na cha brAhmaNaH
shlokas.21:
yatraitallakShyate sarpa vRRittaM sa brAhmaNaH smRRitaH |
yatraitanna bhavetsarpa taM shUdramiti nirdishet
shlokas.22:
yatpunarbhavatA proktaM na vedyaM vidyateti ha |
tAbhyAM hInamatItyAtra padaM nAstIti chedapi
shlokas.23:
evametanmataM sarpa tAbhyAM hInaM na vidyate |
yathA shItoShNayormadhye bhavennoShNaM na shItatA
shlokas.24:
evaM vai sukhaduHkhAbhyAM hInamasti padaM kvachit |
eShA mama matiH sarpa yathA vA manyate bhavAn
shlokas.25:
sarpa uvAcha||
yadi te vRRittato rAjanbrAhmaNaH prasamIkShitaH |
vyarthA jAtistadAyuShmankRRitiryAvanna dRRishyate
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
jAtiratra mahAsarpa manuShyatve mahAmate |
sa~NkarAtsarvavarNAnAM duShparIkShyeti me matiH
shlokas.27:
sarve sarvAsvapatyAni janayanti yadA narAH |
vA~Nmaithunamatho janma maraNaM cha samaM nRRiNAm
shlokas.28:
idamArShaM pramANaM cha ye yajAmaha ityapi |
tasmAchChIlaM pradhAneShTaM vidurye tattvadarshinaH
shlokas.29:
prA~NnAbhivardhanAtpu.nso jAtakarma vidhIyate |
tatrAsya mAtA sAvitrI pitA tvAchArya uchyate
shlokas.30:
vRRittyA shUdrasamo hyeSha yAvadvede na jAyate |
asminnevaM matidvaidhe manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt
shlokas.31:
kRRitakRRityAH punarvarNA yadi vRRittaM na vidyate |
sa~Nkarastatra nAgendra balavAnprasamIkShitaH
shlokas.32:
yatredAnIM mahAsarpa sa.nskRRitaM vRRittamiShyate |
taM brAhmaNamahaM pUrvamuktavAnbhujagottama
shlokas.33:
sarpa uvAcha||
shrutaM viditavedyasya tava vAkyaM yudhiShThira |
bhakShayeyamahaM kasmAdbhrAtaraM te vRRikodaram

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhavAnetAdRRisho loke vedavedA~NgapAragaH |
brUhi kiM kurvataH karma bhavedgatiranuttamA
shlokas.2:
sarpa uvAcha||
pAtre dattvA priyANyuktvA satyamuktvA cha bhArata |
ahi.nsAnirataH svargaM gachChediti matirmama
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dAnAdvA sarpa satyAdvA kimato guru dRRishyate |
ahi.nsApriyayoshchaiva gurulAghavamuchyatAm
shlokas.4:
sarpa uvAcha||
dAne ratatvaM satyaM cha ahi.nsA priyameva cha |
eShAM kAryagarIyastvAddRRishyate gurulAghavam
shlokas.5:
kasmAchchiddAnayogAddhi satyameva vishiShyate |
satyavAkyAchcha rAjendra ki~nchiddAnaM vishiShyate
shlokas.6:
evameva maheShvAsa priyavAkyAnmahIpate |
ahi.nsA dRRishyate gurvI tatashcha priyamiShyate
shlokas.7:
evametadbhavedrAjankAryApekShamanantaram |
yadabhipretamanyatte brUhi yAvadbravImyaham
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM svarge gatiH sarpa karmaNAM cha phalaM dhruvam |
asharIrasya dRRishyeta viShayA.nshcha bravIhi me
shlokas.9:
sarpa uvAcha||
tisro vai gatayo rAjanparidRRiShTAH svakarmabhiH |
mAnuShyaM svargavAsashcha tiryagyonishcha tattridhA
shlokas.10:
tatra vai mAnuShAllokAddAnAdibhiratandritaH |
ahi.nsArthasamAyuktaiH kAraNaiH svargamashnute
shlokas.11:
viparItaishcha rAjendra kAraNairmAnuSho bhavet |
tiryagyonistathA tAta visheShashchAtra vakShyate
shlokas.12:
kAmakrodhasamAyukto hi.nsAlobhasamanvitaH |
manuShyatvAtparibhraShTastiryagyonau prasUyate
shlokas.13:
tiryagyonyAM pRRithagbhAvo manuShyatve vidhIyate |
gavAdibhyastathAshvebhyo devatvamapi dRRishyate
shlokas.14:
so.ayametA gatIH sarvA jantushcharati kAryavAn |
nitye mahati chAtmAnamavasthApayate nRRipa
shlokas.15:
jAto jAtashcha balavAnbhu~Nkte chAtmA sa dehavAn |
phalArthastAta niShpRRiktaH prajAlakShaNabhAvanaH
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shabde sparshe cha rUpe cha tathaiva rasagandhayoH |
tasyAdhiShThAnamavyagraM brUhi sarpa yathAtatham
shlokas.17:
kiM na gRRihNAsi viShayAnyugapattvaM mahAmate |
etAvaduchyatAM choktaM sarvaM pannagasattama
shlokas.18:
sarpa uvAcha||
yadAtmadravyamAyuShmandehasa.nshrayaNAnvitam |
karaNAdhiShThitaM bhogAnupabhu~Nkte yathAvidhi
shlokas.19:
j~nAnaM chaivAtra buddhishcha manashcha bharatarShabha |
tasya bhogAdhikaraNe karaNAni nibodha me
shlokas.20:
manasA tAta paryeti kramasho viShayAnimAn |
viShayAyatanasthena bhUtAtmA kShetraniHsRRitaH
shlokas.21:
atra chApi naravyAghra mano jantorvidhIyate |
tasmAdyugapadasyAtra grahaNaM nopapadyate
shlokas.22:
sa AtmA puruShavyAghra bhruvorantaramAshritaH |
dravyeShu sRRijate buddhiM vividheShu parAvarAm
shlokas.23:
buddheruttarakAlaM cha vedanA dRRishyate budhaiH |
eSha vai rAjashArdUla vidhiH kShetraj~nabhAvanaH
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
manasashchApi buddheshcha brUhi me lakShaNaM param |
etadadhyAtmaviduShAM paraM kAryaM vidhIyate
shlokas.25:
sarpa uvAcha||
buddhirAtmAnugA tAta utpAtena vidhIyate |
tadAshritA hi sa~nj~naiShA vidhistasyaiShaNe bhavet
shlokas.26:
buddherguNavidhirnAsti manastu guNavadbhavet |
buddhirutpadyate kArye manastUtpannameva hi
shlokas.27:
etadvisheShaNaM tAta manobuddhyormayeritam |
tvamapyatrAbhisambuddhaH kathaM vA manyate bhavAn
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
aho buddhimatAM shreShTha shubhA buddhiriyaM tava |
viditaM veditavyaM te kasmAnmAmanupRRichChasi
shlokas.29:
sarvaj~naM tvAM kathaM moha AvishatsvargavAsinam |
evamadbhutakarmANamiti me sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.30:
sarpa uvAcha||
supraj~namapi chechChUramRRiddhirmohayate naram |
vartamAnaH sukhe sarvo nAvaitIti matirmama
shlokas.31:
so.ahamaishvaryamohena madAviShTo yudhiShThira |
patitaH pratisambuddhastvAM tu sambodhayAmyaham
shlokas.32:
kRRitaM kAryaM mahArAja tvayA mama parantapa |
kShINaH shApaH sukRRichChro me tvayA sambhAShya sAdhunA
shlokas.33:
ahaM hi divi divyena vimAnena charanpurA |
abhimAnena mattaH sanka~nchinnAnyamachintayam
shlokas.34:
brahmarShidevagandharvayakSharAkShasakiMnarAH |
karAnmama prayachChanti sarve trailokyavAsinaH
shlokas.35:
chakShuShA yaM prapashyAmi prANinaM pRRithivIpate |
tasya tejo harAmyAshu taddhi dRRiShTibalaM mama
shlokas.36:
brahmarShINAM sahasraM hi uvAha shibikAM mama |
sa mAmapanayo rAjanbhra.nshayAmAsa vai shriyaH
shlokas.37:
tatra hyagastyaH pAdena vahanspRRiShTo mayA muniH |
adRRiShTena tato.asmyukto dhva.nsa sarpeti vai ruShA
shlokas.38:
tatastasmAdvimAnAgrAtprachyutashchyutabhUShaNaH |
prapatanbubudhe.a.atmAnaM vyAlIbhUtamadhomukham
shlokas.39:
ayAchaM tamahaM vipraM shApasyAnto bhavediti |
aj~nAnAtsampravRRittasya bhagavankShantumarhasi
shlokas.40:
tataH sa mAmuvAchedaM prapatantaM kRRipAnvitaH |
yudhiShThiro dharmarAjaH shApAttvAM mokShayiShyati
shlokas.41:
abhimAnasya ghorasya balasya cha narAdhipa |
phale kShINe mahArAja phalaM puNyamavApsyasi
shlokas.42:
tato me vismayo jAtastaddRRiShTvA tapaso balam |
brahma cha brAhmaNatvaM cha yena tvAhamachUchudam
shlokas.43:
satyaM damastapo yogamahi.nsA dAnanityatA |
sAdhakAni sadA pu.nsAM na jAtirna kulaM nRRipa
shlokas.44:
ariShTa eSha te bhrAtA bhImo mukto mahAbhujaH |
svasti te.astu mahArAja gamiShyAmi divaM punaH
shlokas.45:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvAjagaraM dehaM tyaktvA sa nahuSho nRRipaH |
divyaM vapuH samAsthAya gatastridivameva ha
shlokas.46:
yudhiShThiro.api dharmAtmA bhrAtrA bhImena sa~NgataH |
dhaumyena sahitaH shrImAnAshramaM punarabhyagAt
shlokas.47:
tato dvijebhyaH sarvebhyaH sametebhyo yathAtatham |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.48:
tachChrutvA te dvijAH sarve bhrAtarashchAsya te trayaH |
AsansuvrIDitA rAjandraupadI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.49:
te tu sarve dvijashreShThAH pANDavAnAM hitepsayA |
maivamityabruvanbhImaM garhayanto.asya sAhasam
shlokas.50:
pANDavAstu bhayAnmuktaM prekShya bhImaM mahAbalam |
harShamAhArayAM chakrurvijahrushcha mudA yutAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nidAghAntakaraH kAlaH sarvabhUtasukhAvahaH |
tatraiva vasatAM teShAM prAvRRiTsamabhipadyata
shlokas.2:
ChAdayanto mahAghoShAH khaM dishashcha balAhakAH |
pravavarShurdivArAtramasitAH satataM tadA
shlokas.3:
tapAtyayaniketAshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
apetArkaprabhAjAlAH savidyudvimalaprabhAH
shlokas.4:
virUDhashaShpA pRRithivI mattada.nshasarIsRRipA |
babhUva payasA siktA shAntadhUmarajo.aruNA
shlokas.5:
na sma praj~nAyate ki~nchidambhasA samavastRRite |
samaM vA viShamaM vApi nadyo vA sthAvarANi vA
shlokas.6:
kShubdhatoyA mahAghoShAH shvasamAnA ivAshugAH |
sindhavaH shobhayAM chakruH kAnanAni tapAtyaye
shlokas.7:
nadatAM kAnanAnteShu shrUyante vividhAH svanAH |
vRRiShTibhistADyamAnAnAM varAhamRRigapakShiNAm
shlokas.8:
stokakAH shikhinashchaiva pu.nskokilagaNaiH saha |
mattAH paripatanti sma dardurAshchaiva darpitAH
shlokas.9:
tathA bahuvidhAkArA prAvRRiNmeghAnunAditA |
abhyatItA shivA teShAM charatAM marudhanvasu
shlokas.10:
krau~nchaha.nsagaNAkIrNA sharatpraNihitAbhavat |
rUDhakakShavanaprasthA prasannajalanimnagA
shlokas.11:
vimalAkAshanakShatrA sharatteShAM shivAbhavat |
mRRigadvijasamAkIrNA pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.12:
pashyantaH shAntarajasaH kShapA jaladashItalAH |
grahanakShatrasa~Nghaishcha somena cha virAjitAH
shlokas.13:
kumudaiH puNDarIkaishcha shItavAridharAH shivAH |
nadIH puShkariNIshchaiva dadRRishuH samala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.14:
AkAshanIkAshataTAM nIpanIvArasa~NkulAm |
babhUva charatAM harShaH puNyatIrthAM sarasvatIm
shlokas.15:
te vai mumudire vIrAH prasannasalilAM shivAm |
pashyanto dRRiDhadhanvAnaH paripUrNAM sarasvatIm
shlokas.16:
teShAM puNyatamA rAtriH parvasandhau sma shAradI |
tatraiva vasatAmAsItkArttikI janamejaya
shlokas.17:
puNyakRRidbhirmahAsattvaistApasaiH saha pANDavAH |
tatsarvaM bharatashreShThAH samUhuryogamuttamam
shlokas.18:
tamisrAbhyudaye tasmindhaumyena saha pANDavAH |
sUtaiH paurogavaishchaiva kAmyakaM prayayurvanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kAmyakaM prApya kaunteyA yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
kRRitAtithyA munigaNairniSheduH saha kRRiShNayA
shlokas.2:
tatastAnparivishvastAnvasataH pANDunandanAn |
brAhmaNA bahavastatra samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.3:
athAbravIddvijaH kashchidarjunasya priyaH sakhA |
eShyatIha mahAbAhurvashI shaurirudAradhIH
shlokas.4:
viditA hi hareryUyamihAyAtAH kurUdvahAH |
sadA hi darshanAkA~NkShI shreyo.anveShI cha vo hariH
shlokas.5:
bahuvatsarajIvI cha mArkaNDeyo mahAtapAH |
svAdhyAyatapasA yuktaH kShipraM yuShmAnsameShyati
shlokas.6:
tathaiva tasya bruvataH pratyadRRiShyata keshavaH |
sainyasugrIvayuktena rathena rathinAM varaH
shlokas.7:
maghavAniva paulomyA sahitaH satyabhAmayA |
upAyAddevakIputro didRRikShuH kurusattamAn
shlokas.8:
avatIrya rathAtkRRiShNo dharmarAjaM yathAvidhi |
vavande mudito dhImAnbhImaM cha balinAM varam
shlokas.9:
pUjayAmAsa dhaumyaM cha yamAbhyAmabhivAditaH |
pariShvajya guDAkeshaM draupadIM paryasAntvayat
shlokas.10:
sa dRRiShTvA phalgunaM vIraM chirasya priyamAgatam |
paryaShvajata dAshArhaH punaH punarari.ndamam
shlokas.11:
tathaiva satyabhAmApi draupadIM pariShasvaje |
pANDavAnAM priyAM bhAryAM kRRiShNasya mahiShI priyA
shlokas.12:
tataste pANDavAH sarve sabhAryAH sapurohitAH |
AnarchuH puNDarIkAkShaM parivavrushcha sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
kRRiShNastu pArthena sametya vidvA;ndhana~njayenAsuratarjanena |
babhau yathA bhUtapatirmahAtmA; sametya sAkShAdbhagavAnguhena
shlokas.14:
tataH samastAni kirITamAlI; vaneShu vRRittAni gadAgrajAya |
uktvA yathAvatpunaranvapRRichCha;tkathaM subhadrA cha tathAbhimanyuH
shlokas.15:
sa pUjayitvA madhuhA yathAva;tpArthA.nshcha kRRiShNAM cha purohitaM cha |
uvAcha rAjAnamabhiprasha.nsa;nyudhiShThiraM tatra sahopavishya
shlokas.16:
dharmaH paraH pANDava rAjyalAbhA;ttasyArthamAhustapa eva rAjan |
satyArjavAbhyAM charatA svadharmaM; jitastavAyaM cha parashcha lokaH
shlokas.17:
adhItamagre charatA vratAni; samyagdhanurvedamavApya kRRitsnam |
kShAtreNa dharmeNa vasUni labdhvA; sarve hyavAptAH kratavaH purANAH
shlokas.18:
na grAmyadharmeShu ratistavAsti; kAmAnna ki~nchitkuruShe narendra |
na chArthalobhAtprajahAsi dharmaM; tasmAtsvabhAvAdasi dharmarAjaH
shlokas.19:
dAnaM cha satyaM cha tapashcha rAja;~nshraddhA cha shAntishcha dhRRitiH kShamA cha |
avApya rAShTrANi vasUni bhogA;neShA parA pArtha sadA ratiste
shlokas.20:
yadA janaughaH kurujA~NgalAnAM; kRRiShNAM sabhAyAmavashAmapashyat |
apetadharmavyavahAravRRittaM; saheta tatpANDava kastvadanyaH
shlokas.21:
asa.nshayaM sarvasamRRiddhakAmaH; kShipraM prajAH pAlayitAsi samyak |
ime vayaM nigrahaNe kurUNAM; yadi pratij~nA bhavataH samAptA
shlokas.22:
dhaumyaM cha kRRiShNAM cha yudhiShThiraM cha; yamau cha bhImaM cha dashArhasiMhaH |
uvAcha diShTyA bhavatAM shivena; prAptaH kirITI muditaH kRRitAstraH
shlokas.23:
provAcha kRRiShNAmapi yAj~nasenIM; dashArhabhartA sahitaH suhRRidbhiH |
kRRiShNe dhanurvedaratipradhAnAH; satyavratAste shishavaH sushIlAH
sadbhiH sadaivAcharitaM samAdhiM; charanti putrAstava yAj~naseni
shlokas.24:
rAjyena rAShTraishcha nimantryamANAH; pitrA cha kRRiShNe tava sodaraishcha |
na yaj~nasenasya na mAtulAnAM; gRRiheShu bAlA ratimApnuvanti
shlokas.25:
AnartamevAbhimukhAH shivena; gatvA dhanurvedaratipradhAnAH |
tavAtmajA vRRiShNipuraM pravishya; na daivatebhyaH spRRihayanti kRRiShNe
shlokas.26:
yathA tvamevArhasi teShu vRRittiM; prayoktumAryA cha yathaiva kuntI |
teShvapramAdena sadA karoti; tathA cha bhUyashcha tathA subhadrA
shlokas.27:
yathAniruddhasya yathAbhimanyo;ryathA sunIthasya yathaiva bhAnoH |
tathA vinetA cha gatishcha kRRiShNe; tavAtmajAnAmapi raukmiNeyaH
shlokas.28:
gadAsicharmagrahaNeShu shUrA;nastreShu shikShAsu rathAshvayAne |
samyagvinetA vinayatyatandrI;stA.nshchAbhimanyuH satataM kumAraH
shlokas.29:
sa chApi samyakpraNidhAya shikShA;mastrANi chaiShAM guruvatpradAya |
tavAtmajAnAM cha tathAbhimanyoH; parAkramaistuShyati raukmiNeyaH
shlokas.30:
yadA vihAraM prasamIkShamANAH; prayAnti putrAstava yAj~naseni |
ekaikameShAmanuyAnti tatra; rathAshcha yAnAni cha dantinashcha
shlokas.31:
athAbravIddharmarAjaM tu kRRiShNo; dashArhayodhAH kukurAndhakAshcha |
ete nideshaM tava pAlayanti; tiShThanti yatrechChasi tatra rAjan
shlokas.32:
AvartatAM kArmukavegavAtA; halAyudhapragrahaNA madhUnAm |
senA tavArtheShu narendra yattA; sasAdipattyashvarathA sanAgA
shlokas.33:
prasthApyatAM pANDava dhArtarAShTraH; suyodhanaH pApakRRitAM variShThaH |
sa sAnubandhaH sasuhRRidgaNashcha; saubhasya saubhAdhipateshcha mArgam
shlokas.34:
kAmaM tathA tiShTha narendra tasmi;nyathA kRRitaste samayaH sabhAyAm |
dAshArhayodhaistu sasAdiyodhaM; pratIkShatAM nAgapuraM bhavantam
shlokas.35:
vyapetamanyurvyapanItapApmA; vihRRitya yatrechChasi tatra kAmam |
tataH samRRiddhaM prathamaM vishokaH; prapatsyase nAgapuraM sarAShTram
shlokas.36:
tatastadAj~nAya mataM mahAtmA; yathAvaduktaM puruShottamena |
prashasya viprekShya cha dharmarAjaH; kRRitA~njaliH keshavamityuvAcha
shlokas.37:
asa.nshayaM keshava pANDavAnAM; bhavAngatistvachCharaNA hi pArthAH |
kAlodaye tachcha tatashcha bhUyaH; kartA bhavAnkarma na sa.nshayo.asti
shlokas.38:
yathApratij~naM vihRRitashcha kAlaH; sarvAH samA dvAdasha nirjaneShu |
aj~nAtacharyAM vidhivatsamApya; bhavadgatAH keshava pANDaveyAH
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA vadati vArShNeye dharmarAje cha bhArata |
atha pashchAttapovRRiddho bahuvarShasahasradhRRik
pratyadRRiShyata dharmAtmA mArkaNDeyo mahAtapAH
shlokas.40:
tamAgatamRRiShiM vRRiddhaM bahuvarShasahasriNam |
AnarchurbrAhmaNAH sarve kRRiShNashcha saha pANDavaiH
shlokas.41:
tamarchitaM suviShvastamAsInamRRiShisattamam |
brAhmaNAnAM matenAha pANDavAnAM cha keshavaH
shlokas.42:
shushrUShavaH pANDavAste brAhmaNAshcha samAgatAH |
draupadI satyabhAmA cha tathAhaM paramaM vachaH
shlokas.43:
purAvRRittAH kathAH puNyAH sadAchArAH sanAtanAH |
rAj~nAM strINAmRRiShINAM cha mArkaNDeya vichakShva naH
shlokas.44:
teShu tatropaviShTeShu devarShirapi nAradaH |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA pANDavAnavalokakaH
shlokas.45:
tamapyatha mahAtmAnaM sarve tu puruSharShabhAH |
pAdyArghyAbhyAM yathAnyAyamupatasthurmanIShiNam
shlokas.46:
nAradastvatha devarShirj~nAtvA tA.nstu kRRitakShaNAn |
mArkaNDeyasya vadatastAM kathAmanvamodata
shlokas.47:
uvAcha chainaM kAlaj~naH smayanniva sa nAradaH |
brahmarShe kathyatAM yatte pANDaveShu vivakShitam
shlokas.48:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha mArkaNDeyo mahAtapAH |
kShaNaM kurudhvaM vipulamAkhyAtavyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.49:
evamuktAH kShaNaM chakruH pANDavAH saha tairdvijaiH |
madhya.ndine yathAdityaM prekShantastaM mahAmunim

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM vivakShantamAlakShya kururAjo mahAmunim |
kathAsa~njananArthAya chodayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.2:
bhavAndaivatadaityAnAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm |
rAjarShINAM cha sarveShAM charitaj~naH sanAtanaH
shlokas.3:
sevyashchopAsitavyashcha mato naH kA~NkShitashchiram |
ayaM cha devakIputraH prApto.asmAnavalokakaH
shlokas.4:
bhavatyeva hi me buddhirdRRiShTvAtmAnaM sukhAchchyutam |
dhArtarAShTrA.nshcha durvRRittAnRRidhyataH prekShya sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
karmaNaH puruShaH kartA shubhasyApyashubhasya cha |
svaphalaM tadupAshnAti kathaM kartA svidIshvaraH
shlokas.6:
atha vA sukhaduHkheShu nRRiNAM brahmavidAM vara |
iha vA kRRitamanveti paradehe.atha vA punaH
shlokas.7:
dehI cha dehaM santyajya mRRigyamANaH shubhAshubhaiH |
kathaM sa.nyujyate pretya iha vA dvijasattama
shlokas.8:
aihalaukikamevaitadutAho pAralaukikam |
kva cha karmANi tiShThanti jantoH pretasya bhArgava
shlokas.9:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tvadyukto.ayamanuprashno yathAvadvadatAM vara |
viditaM veditavyaM te sthityarthamanupRRichChasi
shlokas.10:
atra te vartayiShyAmi tadihaikamanAH shRRiNu |
yathehAmutra cha naraH sukhaduHkhamupAshnute
shlokas.11:
nirmalAni sharIrANi vishuddhAni sharIriNAm |
sasarja dharmatantrANi pUrvotpannaH prajApatiH
shlokas.12:
amoghabalasa~NkalpAH suvratAH satyavAdinaH |
brahmabhUtA narAH puNyAH purANAH kurunandana
shlokas.13:
sarve devaiH samAyAnti svachChandena nabhastalam |
tatashcha punarAyAnti sarve svachChandachAriNaH
shlokas.14:
svachChandamaraNAshchAsannarAH svachChandajIvinaH |
alpabAdhA nirAta~NkA siddhArthA nirupadravAH
shlokas.15:
draShTAro devasa~NghAnAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm |
pratyakShAH sarvadharmANAM dAntA vigatamatsarAH
shlokas.16:
AsanvarShasahasrANi tathA putrasahasriNaH |
tataH kAlAntare.anyasminpRRithivItalachAriNaH
shlokas.17:
kAmakrodhAbhibhUtAste mAyAvyAjopajIvinaH |
lobhamohAbhibhUtAshcha tyaktA devaistato narAH
shlokas.18:
ashubhaiH karmabhiH pApAstirya~NnarakagAminaH |
sa.nsAreShu vichitreShu pachyamAnAH punaH punaH
shlokas.19:
mogheShTA moghasa~NkalpA moghaj~nAnA vichetasaH |
sarvAtisha~Nkinashchaiva sa.nvRRittAH kleshabhAginaH
ashubhaiH karmabhishchApi prAyashaH parichihnitAH
shlokas.20:
dauShkulyA vyAdhibahulA durAtmAno.apratApinaH |
bhavantyalpAyuShaH pApA raudrakarmaphalodayAH
nAthantaH sarvakAmAnAM nAstikA bhinnasetavaH
shlokas.21:
jantoH pretasya kaunteya gatiH svairiha karmabhiH |
prAj~nasya hInabuddheshcha karmakoshaH kva tiShThati
shlokas.22:
kvasthastatsamupAshnAti sukRRitaM yadi vetarat |
iti te darshanaM yachcha tatrApyanunayaM shRRiNu
shlokas.23:
ayamAdisharIreNa devasRRiShTena mAnavaH |
shubhAnAmashubhAnAM cha kurute sa~nchayaM mahat
shlokas.24:
AyuSho.ante prahAyedaM kShINaprAyaM kalevaram |
sambhavatyeva yugapadyonau nAstyantarAbhavaH
shlokas.25:
tatrAsya svakRRitaM karma ChAyevAnugataM sadA |
phalatyatha sukhArho vA duHkhArho vApi jAyate
shlokas.26:
kRRitAntavidhisa.nyuktaH sa janturlakShaNaiH shubhaiH |
ashubhairvA nirAdAno lakShyate j~nAnadRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.27:
eShA tAvadabuddhInAM gatiruktA yudhiShThira |
ataH paraM j~nAnavatAM nibodha gatimuttamAm
shlokas.28:
manuShyAstaptatapasaH sarvAgamaparAyaNAH |
sthiravratAH satyaparA gurushushrUShaNe ratAH
shlokas.29:
sushIlAH shuklajAtIyAH kShAntA dAntAH sutejasaH |
shubhayonyantaragatAH prAyashaH shubhalakShaNAH
shlokas.30:
jitendriyatvAdvashinaH shuklatvAnmandarogiNaH |
alpabAdhaparitrAsAdbhavanti nirupadravAH
shlokas.31:
chyavantaM jAyamAnaM cha garbhasthaM chaiva sarvashaH |
svamAtmAnaM paraM chaiva budhyante j~nAnachakShuShaH
karmabhUmimimAM prApya punaryAnti surAlayam
shlokas.32:
ki~nchiddaivAddhaThAtki~nchitki~nchideva svakarmabhiH |
prApnuvanti narA rAjanmA te.astvanyA vichAraNA
shlokas.33:
imAmatropamAM chApi nibodha vadatAM vara |
manuShyaloke yachChreyaH paraM manye yudhiShThira
shlokas.34:
iha vaikasya nAmutra amutraikasya no iha |
iha chAmutra chaikasya nAmutraikasya no iha
shlokas.35:
dhanAni yeShAM vipulAni santi; nityaM ramante suvibhUShitA~NgAH |
teShAmayaM shatruvaraghna loko; nAsau sadA dehasukhe ratAnAm
shlokas.36:
ye yogayuktAstapasi prasaktAH; svAdhyAyashIlA jarayanti dehAn |
jitendriyA bhUtahite niviShTA;steShAmasau nAyamarighna lokaH
shlokas.37:
ye dharmameva prathamaM charanti; dharmeNa labdhvA cha dhanAni kAle |
dArAnavApya kratubhiryajante; teShAmayaM chaiva parashcha lokaH
shlokas.38:
ye naiva vidyAM na tapo na dAnaM; na chApi mUDhAH prajane yatante |
na chAdhigachChanti sukhAnyabhAgyA;steShAmayaM chaiva parashcha nAsti
shlokas.39:
sarve bhavantastvativIryasattvA; divyaujasaH saMhananopapannAH |
lokAdamuShmAdavaniM prapannAH; svadhItavidyAH surakAryahetoH
shlokas.40:
kRRitvaiva karmANi mahAnti shUrA;stapodamAchAravihArashIlAH |
devAnRRiShInpretagaNA.nshcha sarvA;nsantarpayitvA vidhinA pareNa
shlokas.41:
svargaM paraM puNyakRRitAM nivAsaM; krameNa samprApsyatha karmabhiH svaiH |
mA bhUdvisha~NkA tava kauravendra; dRRiShTvAtmanaH kleshamimaM sukhArha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mArkaNDeyaM mahAtmAnamUchuH pANDusutAstadA |
mAhAtmyaM dvijamukhyAnAM shrotumichChAma kathyatAm
shlokas.2:
evamuktaH sa bhagavAnmArkaNDeyo mahAtapAH |
uvAcha sumahAtejAH sarvashAstravishAradaH
shlokas.3:
haihayAnAM kulakaro rAjA parapura~njayaH |
kumAro rUpasampanno mRRigayAmacharadbalI
shlokas.4:
charamANastu so.araNye tRRiNavIrutsamAvRRite |
kRRiShNAjinottarAsa~NgaM dadarsha munimantike
sa tena nihato.araNye manyamAnena vai mRRigam
shlokas.5:
vyathitaH karma tatkRRitvA shokopahatachetanaH |
jagAma haihayAnAM vai sakAshaM prathitAtmanAm
shlokas.6:
rAj~nAM rAjIvanetrosau kumAraH pRRithivIpate |
teShAM cha tadyathAvRRittaM kathayAmAsa vai tadA
shlokas.7:
taM chApi hi.nsitaM tAta muniM mUlaphalAshinam |
shrutvA dRRiShTvA cha te tatra babhUvurdInamAnasAH
shlokas.8:
kasyAyamiti te sarve mArgamANAstatastataH |
jagmushchAriShTanemeste tArkShyasyAshramama~njasA
shlokas.9:
te.abhivAdya mahAtmAnaM taM muniM sa.nshitavratam |
tasthuH sarve sa tu munisteShAM pUjAmathAharat
shlokas.10:
te tamUchurmahAtmAnaM na vayaM satkriyAM mune |
tvatto.arhAH karmadoSheNa brAhmaNo hi.nsito hi naH
shlokas.11:
tAnabravItsa viprarShiH kathaM vo brAhmaNo hataH |
kva chAsau brUta sahitAH pashyadhvaM me tapobalam
shlokas.12:
te tu tatsarvamakhilamAkhyAyAsmai yathAtatham |
nApashya.nstamRRiShiM tatra gatAsuM te samAgatAH
anveShamANAH savrIDAH svapnavadgatamAnasAH
shlokas.13:
tAnabravIttatra munistArkShyaH parapura~njayaH |
syAdayaM brAhmaNaH so.atha yo yuShmAbhirvinAshitaH
putro hyayaM mama nRRipAstapobalasamanvitaH
shlokas.14:
te tu dRRiShTvaiva tamRRiShiM vismayaM paramaM gatAH |
mahadAshcharyamiti vai vibruvANA mahIpate
shlokas.15:
mRRito hyayamato dRRiShTaH kathaM jIvitamAptavAn |
kimetattapaso vIryaM yenAyaM jIvitaH punaH
shrotumichChAma viprarShe yadi shrotavyamityuta
shlokas.16:
sa tAnuvAcha nAsmAkaM mRRityuH prabhavate nRRipAH |
kAraNaM vaH pravakShyAmi hetuyogaM samAsataH
shlokas.17:
satyamevAbhijAnImo nAnRRite kurmahe manaH |
svadharmamanutiShThAmastasmAnmRRityubhayaM na naH
shlokas.18:
yadbrAhmaNAnAM kushalaM tadeShAM kathayAmahe |
naiShAM dushcharitaM brUmastasmAnmRRityubhayaM na naH
shlokas.19:
atithInannapAnena bhRRityAnatyashanena cha |
tejasvideshavAsAchcha tasmAnmRRityubhayaM na naH
shlokas.20:
etadvai leshamAtraM vaH samAkhyAtaM vimatsarAH |
gachChadhvaM sahitAH sarve na pApAdbhayamasti vaH
shlokas.21:
evamastviti te sarve pratipUjya mahAmunim |
svadeshamagamanhRRiShTA rAjAno bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
bhUya eva tu mAhAtmyaM brAhmaNAnAM nibodha me |
vainyo nAmeha rAjarShirashvamedhAya dIkShitaH
tamatrirgantumArebhe vittArthamiti naH shrutam
shlokas.2:
bhUyo.atha nAnurudhyatsa dharmavyaktinidarshanAt |
sa~nchintya sa mahAtejA vanamevAnvarochayat
dharmapatnIM samAhUya putrA.nshchedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.3:
prApsyAmaH phalamatyantaM bahulaM nirupadravam |
araNyagamanaM kShipraM rochatAM vo guNAdhikam
shlokas.4:
taM bhAryA pratyuvAchedaM dharmamevAnurudhyatI |
vainyaM gatvA mahAtmAnamarthayasva dhanaM bahu
sa te dAsyati rAjarShiryajamAno.arthine dhanam
shlokas.5:
tata AdAya viprarShe pratigRRihya dhanaM bahu |
bhRRityAnsutAnsa.nvibhajya tato vraja yathepsitam
eSha vai paramo dharmo dharmavidbhirudAhRRitaH
shlokas.6:
atriruvAcha||
kathito me mahAbhAge gautamena mahAtmanA |
vainyo dharmArthasa.nyuktaH satyavratasamanvitaH
shlokas.7:
kiM tvasti tatra dveShTAro nivasanti hi me dvijAH |
yathA me gautamaH prAha tato na vyavasAmyaham
shlokas.8:
tatra sma vAchaM kalyANIM dharmakAmArthasaMhitAm |
mayoktAmanyathA brUyustataste vai nirarthakAm
shlokas.9:
gamiShyAmi mahAprAj~ne rochate me vachastava |
gAshcha me dAsyate vainyaH prabhUtaM chArthasa~nchayam
shlokas.10:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA jagAmAshu vainyayaj~naM mahAtapAH |
gatvA cha yaj~nAyatanamatristuShTAva taM nRRipam
shlokas.11:
