rAjanvainya tvamIshashcha bhuvi tvaM prathamo nRRipaH |
stuvanti tvAM munigaNAstvadanyo nAsti dharmavit
shlokas.12:
tamabravIdRRiShistatra vachaH kruddho mahAtapAH |
maivamatre punarbrUyA na te praj~nA samAhitA
atra naH prathamaM sthAtA mahendro vai prajApatiH
shlokas.13:
athAtrirapi rAjendra gautamaM pratyabhAShata |
ayameva vidhAtA cha yathaivendraH prajApatiH
tvameva muhyase mohAnna praj~nAnaM tavAsti ha
shlokas.14:
gautama uvAcha||
jAnAmi nAhaM muhyAmi tvaM vivakShurvimuhyase |
stoShyase.abhyudayaprepsustasya darshanasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.15:
na vettha paramaM dharmaM na chAvaiShi prayojanam |
bAlastvamasi mUDhashcha vRRiddhaH kenApi hetunA
shlokas.16:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
vivadantau tathA tau tu munInAM darshane sthitau |
ye tasya yaj~ne sa.nvRRittAste.apRRichChanta kathaM tvimau
shlokas.17:
praveshaH kena datto.ayamanayorvainyasa.nsadi |
uchchaiH samabhibhAShantau kena kAryeNa viShThitau
shlokas.18:
tataH paramadharmAtmA kAshyapaH sarvadharmavit |
vivAdinAvanuprAptau tAvubhau pratyavedayat
shlokas.19:
athAbravItsadasyA.nstu gautamo munisattamAn |
AvayorvyAhRRitaM prashnaM shRRiNuta dvijapu~NgavAH
vainyo vidhAtetyAhAtriratra naH sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.20:
shrutvaiva tu mahAtmAno munayo.abhyadravandrutam |
sanatkumAraM dharmaj~naM sa.nshayachChedanAya vai
shlokas.21:
sa cha teShAM vachaH shrutvA yathAtattvaM mahAtapAH |
pratyuvAchAtha tAnevaM dharmArthasahitaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
sanatkumAra uvAcha||
brahma kShatreNa sahitaM kShatraM cha brahmaNA saha |
rAjA vai prathamo dharmaH prajAnAM patireva cha
sa eva shakraH shukrashcha sa dhAtA sa bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.23:
prajApatirvirATsamrATkShatriyo bhUpatirnRRipaH |
ya ebhiH stUyate shabdaiH kastaM nArchitumarhati
shlokas.24:
purAyoniryudhAjichcha abhiyA mudito bhavaH |
svarNetA sahajidbabhruriti rAjAbhidhIyate
shlokas.25:
satyamanyuryudhAjIvaH satyadharmapravartakaH |
adharmAdRRiShayo bhItA balaM kShatre samAdadhan
shlokas.26:
Adityo divi deveShu tamo nudati tejasA |
tathaiva nRRipatirbhUmAvadharmaM nudate bhRRisham
shlokas.27:
ato rAj~naH pradhAnatvaM shAstraprAmANyadarshanAt |
uttaraH sidhyate pakSho yena rAjeti bhAShitam
shlokas.28:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH sa rAjA saMhRRiShTaH siddhe pakShe mahAmanAH |
tamatrimabravItprItaH pUrvaM yenAbhisa.nstutaH
shlokas.29:
yasmAtsarvamanuShyeShu jyAyA.nsaM mAmihAbravIH |
sarvadevaishcha viprarShe saMmitaM shreShThameva cha
tasmAtte.ahaM pradAsyAmi vividhaM vasu bhUri cha
shlokas.30:
dAsIsahasraM shyAmAnAM suvastrANAmala~NkRRitam |
dasha koTyo hiraNyasya rukmabhArA.nstathA dasha
etaddadAni te vipra sarvaj~nastvaM hi me mataH
shlokas.31:
tadatrirnyAyataH sarvaM pratigRRihya mahAmanAH |
pratyAjagAma tejasvI gRRihAneva mahAtapAH
shlokas.32:
pradAya cha dhanaM prItaH putrebhyaH prayatAtmavAn |
tapaH samabhisandhAya vanamevAnvapadyata

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atraiva cha sarasvatyA gItaM parapura~njaya |
pRRiShTayA muninA vIra shRRiNu tArkShyeNa dhImatA
shlokas.2:
tArkShya uvAcha||
kiM nu shreyaH puruShasyeha bhadre; kathaM kurvanna chyavate svadharmAt |
AchakShva me chArusarvA~Ngi sarvaM; tvayAnushiShTo na chyaveyaM svadharmAt
shlokas.3:
kathaM chAgniM juhuyAM pUjaye vA; kasminkAle kena dharmo na nashyet |
etatsarvaM subhage prabravIhi; yathA lokAnvirajAH sa~nchareyam
shlokas.4:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evaM pRRiShTA prItiyuktena tena; shushrUShumIkShyottamabuddhiyuktam |
tArkShyaM vipraM dharmayuktaM hitaM cha; sarasvatI vAkyamidaM babhAShe
shlokas.5:
sarasvatyuvAcha||
yo brahma jAnAti yathApradeshaM; svAdhyAyanityaH shuchirapramattaH |
sa vai puro devapurasya gantA; sahAmaraiH prApnuyAtprItiyogam
shlokas.6:
tatra sma ramyA vipulA vishokAH; supuShpitAH puShkariNyaH supuNyAH |
akardamA mInavatyaH sutIrthA; hiraNmayairAvRRitAH puNDarIkaiH
shlokas.7:
tAsAM tIreShvAsate puNyakarmA; mahIyamAnaH pRRithagapsarobhiH |
supuNyagandhAbhirala~NkRRitAbhi;rhiraNyavarNAbhiratIva hRRiShTaH
shlokas.8:
paraM lokaM gopradAstvApnuvanti; dattvAnaDvAhaM sUryalokaM vrajanti |
vAso dattvA chandramasaH sa lokaM; dattvA hiraNyamamRRitatvameti
shlokas.9:
dhenuM dattvA suvratAM sAdhudohAM; kalyANavatsAmapalAyinIM cha |
yAvanti romANi bhavanti tasyA;stAvadvarShANyashnute svargalokam
shlokas.10:
anaDvAhaM suvrataM yo dadAti; halasya voDhAramanantavIryam |
dhurandharaM balavantaM yuvAnaM; prApnoti lokAndasha dhenudasya
shlokas.11:
yaH sapta varShANi juhoti tArkShya; havyaM tvagnau suvrataH sAdhushIlaH |
saptAvarAnsapta pUrvAnpunAti; pitAmahAnAtmanaH karmabhiH svaiH
shlokas.12:
tArkShya uvAcha||
kimagnihotrasya vrataM purANa;mAchakShva me pRRichChatashchArurUpe |
tvayAnushiShTo.ahamihAdya vidyAM; yadagnihotrasya vrataM purANam
shlokas.13:
sarasvatyuvAcha||
na chAshuchirnApyanirNiktapANi;rnAbrahmavijjuhuyAnnAvipashchit |
bubhukShavaH shuchikAmA hi devA; nAshraddadhAnAddhi havirjuShanti
shlokas.14:
nAshrotriyaM devahavye niyu~njyA;nmoghaM parA si~nchati tAdRRisho hi |
apUrNamashrotriyamAha tArkShya; na vai tAdRRigjuhuyAdagnihotram
shlokas.15:
kRRishAnuM ye juhvati shraddadhAnAH; satyavratA hutashiShTAshinashcha |
gavAM lokaM prApya te puNyagandhaM; pashyanti devaM paramaM chApi satyam
shlokas.16:
tArkShya uvAcha||
kShetraj~nabhUtAM paralokabhAve; karmodaye buddhimatipraviShTAm |
praj~nAM cha devIM subhage vimRRishya; pRRichChAmi tvAM kA hyasi chArurUpe
shlokas.17:
sarasvatyuvAcha||
agnihotrAdahamabhyAgatAsmi; viprarShabhANAM sa.nshayachChedanAya |
tvatsa.nyogAdahametadabruvaM; bhAve sthitA tathyamarthaM yathAvat
shlokas.18:
tArkShya uvAcha||
na hi tvayA sadRRishI kAchidasti; vibhrAjase hyatimAtraM yathA shrIH |
rUpaM cha te divyamatyantakAntaM; praj~nAM cha devIM subhage bibharShi
shlokas.19:
sarasvatyuvAcha||
shreShThAni yAni dvipadAM variShTha; yaj~neShu vidvannupapAdayanti |
tairevAhaM sampravRRiddhA bhavAmi; ApyAyitA rUpavatI cha vipra
shlokas.20:
yachchApi dravyamupayujyate ha; vAnaspatyamAyasaM pArthivaM vA |
divyena rUpeNa cha praj~nayA cha; tenaiva siddhiriti viddhi vidvan
shlokas.21:
tArkShya uvAcha||
idaM shreyaH paramaM manyamAnA; vyAyachChante munayaH sampratItAH |
AchakShva me taM paramaM vishokaM; mokShaM paraM yaM pravishanti dhIrAH
shlokas.22:
sarasvatyuvAcha||
taM vai paraM vedavidaH prapannAH; paraM parebhyaH prathitaM purANam |
svAdhyAyadAnavratapuNyayogai;stapodhanA vItashokA vimuktAH
shlokas.23:
tasyAtha madhye vetasaH puNyagandhaH; sahasrashAkho vimalo vibhAti |
tasya mUlAtsaritaH prasravanti; madhUdakaprasravaNA ramaNyaH
shlokas.24:
shAkhAM shAkhAM mahAnadyaH sa.nyAnti sikatAsamAH |
dhAnApUpA mA.nsashAkAH sadA pAyasakardamAH
shlokas.25:
yasminnagnimukhA devAH sendrAH saha marudgaNaiH |
Ijire kratubhiH shreShThaistatpadaM paramaM mune

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa pANDavo bhUyo mArkaNDeyamuvAcha ha |
kathayasveha charitaM manorvaivasvatasya me
shlokas.2:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
vivasvataH suto rAjanparamarShiH pratApavAn |
babhUva narashArdUla prajApatisamadyutiH
shlokas.3:
ojasA tejasA lakShmyA tapasA cha visheShataH |
atichakrAma pitaraM manuH svaM cha pitAmaham
shlokas.4:
UrdhvabAhurvishAlAyAM badaryAM sa narAdhipaH |
ekapAdasthitastIvraM chachAra sumahattapaH
shlokas.5:
avAkShirAstathA chApi netrairanimiShairdRRiDham |
so.atapyata tapo ghoraM varShANAmayutaM tadA
shlokas.6:
taM kadAchittapasyantamArdrachIrajaTAdharam |
vIriNItIramAgamya matsyo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
bhagavankShudramatsyo.asmi balavadbhyo bhayaM mama |
matsyebhyo hi tato mAM tvaM trAtumarhasi suvrata
shlokas.8:
durbalaM balavanto hi matsyaM matsyA visheShataH |
bhakShayanti yathA vRRittirvihitA naH sanAtanI
shlokas.9:
tasmAdbhayaughAnmahato majjantaM mAM visheShataH |
trAtumarhasi kartAsmi kRRite pratikRRitaM tava
shlokas.10:
sa matsyavachanaM shrutvA kRRipayAbhipariplutaH |
manurvaivasvato.agRRihNAttaM matsyaM pANinA svayam
shlokas.11:
udakAntamupAnIya matsyaM vaivasvato manuH |
ali~njare prAkShipatsa chandrA.nshusadRRishaprabham
shlokas.12:
sa tatra vavRRidhe rAjanmatsyaH paramasatkRRitaH |
putravachchAkarottasminmanurbhAvaM visheShataH
shlokas.13:
atha kAlena mahatA sa matsyaH sumahAnabhUt |
ali~njare jale chaiva nAsau samabhavatkila
shlokas.14:
atha matsyo manuM dRRiShTvA punarevAbhyabhAShata |
bhagavansAdhu me.adyAnyatsthAnaM sampratipAdaya
shlokas.15:
uddhRRityAli~njarAttasmAttataH sa bhagavAnmuniH |
taM matsyamanayadvApIM mahatIM sa manustadA
shlokas.16:
tatra taM prAkShipachchApi manuH parapura~njaya |
athAvardhata matsyaH sa punarvarShagaNAnbahUn
shlokas.17:
dviyojanAyatA vApI vistRRitA chApi yojanam |
tasyAM nAsau samabhavanmatsyo rAjIvalochana
vicheShTituM vA kaunteya matsyo vApyAM vishAM pate
shlokas.18:
manuM matsyastato dRRiShTvA punarevAbhyabhAShata |
naya mAM bhagavansAdho samudramahiShIM prabho
ga~NgAM tatra nivatsyAmi yathA vA tAta manyase
shlokas.19:
evamukto manurmatsyamanayadbhagavAnvashI |
nadIM ga~NgAM tatra chainaM svayaM prAkShipadachyutaH
shlokas.20:
sa tatra vavRRidhe matsyaH ki~nchitkAlamari.ndama |
tataH punarmanuM dRRiShTvA matsyo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.21:
ga~NgAyAM hi na shaknomi bRRihattvAchcheShTituM prabho |
samudraM naya mAmAshu prasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.22:
uddhRRitya ga~NgAsalilAttato matsyaM manuH svayam |
samudramanayatpArtha tatra chainamavAsRRijat
shlokas.23:
sumahAnapi matsyaH sansa manormanasastadA |
AsIdyatheShTahAryashcha sparshagandhasukhashcha vai
shlokas.24:
yadA samudre prakShiptaH sa matsyo manunA tadA |
tata enamidaM vAkyaM smayamAna ivAbravIt
shlokas.25:
bhagavankRRitA hi me rakShA tvayA sarvA visheShataH |
prAptakAlaM tu yatkAryaM tvayA tachChrUyatAM mama
shlokas.26:
achirAdbhagavanbhaumamidaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
sarvameva mahAbhAga pralayaM vai gamiShyati
shlokas.27:
samprakShAlanakAlo.ayaM lokAnAM samupasthitaH |
tasmAttvAM bodhayAmyadya yatte hitamanuttamam
shlokas.28:
trasAnAM sthAvarANAM cha yachche~NgaM yachcha ne~Ngati |
tasya sarvasya samprAptaH kAlaH paramadAruNaH
shlokas.29:
naushcha kArayitavyA te dRRiDhA yuktavaTAkarA |
tatra saptarShibhiH sArdhamAruhethA mahAmune
shlokas.30:
bIjAni chaiva sarvANi yathoktAni mayA purA |
tasyAmArohayernAvi susa~NguptAni bhAgashaH
shlokas.31:
nausthashcha mAM pratIkShethAstadA munijanapriya |
AgamiShyAmyahaM shRRi~NgI vij~neyastena tApasa
shlokas.32:
evametattvayA kAryamApRRiShTo.asi vrajAmyaham |
nAtisha~NkyamidaM chApi vachanaM te mamAbhibho
shlokas.33:
evaM kariShya iti taM sa matsyaM pratyabhAShata |
jagmatushcha yathAkAmamanuj~nApya parasparam
shlokas.34:
tato manurmahArAja yathoktaM matsyakena ha |
bIjAnyAdAya sarvANi sAgaraM pupluve tadA
nAvA tu shubhayA vIra mahormiNamari.ndama
shlokas.35:
chintayAmAsa cha manustaM matsyaM pRRithivIpate |
sa cha tachchintitaM j~nAtvA matsyaH parapura~njaya
shRRi~NgI tatrAjagAmAshu tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.36:
taM dRRiShTvA manujendrendra manurmatsyaM jalArNave |
shRRi~NgiNaM taM yathoktena rUpeNAdrimivochChritam
shlokas.37:
vaTAkaramayaM pAshamatha matsyasya mUrdhani |
manurmanujashArdUla tasmi~nshRRi~Nge nyaveshayat
shlokas.38:
sa.nyatastena pAshena matsyaH parapura~njaya |
vegena mahatA nAvaM prAkarShallavaNAmbhasi
shlokas.39:
sa tatAra tayA nAvA samudraM manujeshvara |
nRRityamAnamivormIbhirgarjamAnamivAmbhasA
shlokas.40:
kShobhyamANA mahAvAtaiH sA naustasminmahodadhau |
ghUrNate chapaleva strI mattA parapura~njaya
shlokas.41:
naiva bhUmirna cha dishaH pradisho vA chakAshire |
sarvamAmbhasamevAsItkhaM dyaushcha narapu~Ngava
shlokas.42:
evambhUte tadA loke sa~Nkule bharatarShabha |
adRRishyanta saptarShayo manurmatsyaH sahaiva ha
shlokas.43:
evaM bahUnvarShagaNA.nstAM nAvaM so.atha matsyakaH |
chakarShAtandrito rAja.nstasminsalilasa~nchaye
shlokas.44:
tato himavataH shRRi~NgaM yatparaM puruSharShabha |
tatrAkarShattato nAvaM sa matsyaH kurunandana
shlokas.45:
tato.abravIttadA matsyastAnRRiShInprahasa~nshanaiH |
asminhimavataH shRRi~Nge nAvaM badhnIta mAchiram
shlokas.46:
sA baddhA tatra taistUrNamRRiShibhirbharatarShabha |
naurmatsyasya vachaH shrutvA shRRi~Nge himavatastadA
shlokas.47:
tachcha naubandhanaM nAma shRRi~NgaM himavataH param |
khyAtamadyApi kaunteya tadviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.48:
athAbravIdanimiShastAnRRiShInsahitA.nstadA |
ahaM prajApatirbrahmA matparaM nAdhigamyate
matsyarUpeNa yUyaM cha mayAsmAnmokShitA bhayAt
shlokas.49:
manunA cha prajAH sarvAH sadevAsuramAnavAH |
sraShTavyAH sarvalokAshcha yachche~NgaM yachcha ne~Ngati
shlokas.50:
tapasA chAtitIvreNa pratibhAsya bhaviShyati |
matprasAdAtprajAsarge na cha mohaM gamiShyati
shlokas.51:
ityuktvA vachanaM matsyaH kShaNenAdarshanaM gataH |
sraShTukAmaH prajAshchApi manurvaivasvataH svayam
pramUDho.abhUtprajAsarge tapastepe mahattataH
shlokas.52:
tapasA mahatA yuktaH so.atha sraShTuM prachakrame |
sarvAH prajA manuH sAkShAdyathAvadbharatarShabha
shlokas.53:
ityetanmAtsyakaM nAma purANaM parikIrtitam |
AkhyAnamidamAkhyAtaM sarvapApaharaM mayA
shlokas.54:
ya idaM shRRiNuyAnnityaM manoshcharitamAditaH |
sa sukhI sarvasiddhArthaH svargalokamiyAnnaraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa punarevAtha mArkaNDeyaM yashasvinam |
paprachCha vinayopeto dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
naike yugasahasrAntAstvayA dRRiShTA mahAmune |
na chApIha samaH kashchidAyuShA tava vidyate
varjayitvA mahAtmAnaM brAhmaNaM parameShThinam
shlokas.3:
anantarikShe loke.asmindevadAnavavarjite |
tvameva pralaye vipra brahmANamupatiShThasi
shlokas.4:
pralaye chApi nirvRRitte prabuddhe cha pitAmahe |
tvameva sRRijyamAnAni bhUtAnIha prapashyasi
shlokas.5:
chaturvidhAni viprarShe yathAvatparameShThinA |
vAyubhUtA dishaH kRRitvA vikShipyApastatastataH
shlokas.6:
tvayA lokaguruH sAkShAtsarvalokapitAmahaH |
ArAdhito dvijashreShTha tatpareNa samAdhinA
shlokas.7:
tasmAtsarvAntako mRRityurjarA vA dehanAshinI |
na tvA vishati viprarShe prasAdAtparameShThinaH
shlokas.8:
yadA naiva ravirnAgnirna vAyurna cha chandramAH |
naivAntarikShaM naivorvI sheShaM bhavati ki~nchana
shlokas.9:
tasminnekArNave loke naShTe sthAvaraja~Ngame |
naShTe devAsuragaNe samutsannamahorage
shlokas.10:
shayAnamamitAtmAnaM padme padmaniketanam |
tvamekaH sarvabhUteshaM brahmANamupatiShThasi
shlokas.11:
etatpratyakShataH sarvaM pUrvavRRittaM dvijottama |
tasmAdichChAmahe shrotuM sarvahetvAtmikAM kathAm
shlokas.12:
anubhUtaM hi bahushastvayaikena dvijottama |
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchitsarvalokeShu nityadA
shlokas.13:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi namaskRRitvA svayambhuve |
puruShAya purANAya shAshvatAyAvyayAya cha
shlokas.14:
ya eSha pRRithudIrghAkShaH pItavAsA janArdanaH |
eSha kartA vikartA cha sarvabhAvanabhUtakRRit
shlokas.15:
achintyaM mahadAshcharyaM pavitramapi chottamam |
anAdinidhanaM bhUtaM vishvamakShayamavyayam
shlokas.16:
eSha kartA na kriyate kAraNaM chApi pauruShe |
yo hyenaM puruShaM vetti devA api na taM viduH
shlokas.17:
sarvamAshcharyamevaitannirvRRittaM rAjasattama |
Adito manujavyAghra kRRitsnasya jagataH kShaye
shlokas.18:
chatvAryAhuH sahasrANi varShANAM tatkRRitaM yugam |
tasya tAvachChatI sandhyA sandhyA.nshashcha tataH param
shlokas.19:
trINi varShasahasrANi tretAyugamihochyate |
tasya tAvachChatI sandhyA sandhyA.nshashcha tataH param
shlokas.20:
tathA varShasahasre dve dvAparaM parimANataH |
tasyApi dvishatI sandhyA sandhyA.nshashcha tataH param
shlokas.21:
sahasramekaM varShANAM tataH kaliyugaM smRRitam |
tasya varShashataM sandhyA sandhyA.nshashcha tataH param
sandhyAsandhyA.nshayostulyaM pramANamupadhAraya
shlokas.22:
kShINe kaliyuge chaiva pravartati kRRitaM yugam |
eShA dvAdashasAhasrI yugAkhyA parikIrtitA
shlokas.23:
etatsahasraparyantamaho brAhmamudAhRRitam |
vishvaM hi brahmabhavane sarvashaH parivartate
lokAnAM manujavyAghra pralayaM taM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.24:
alpAvashiShTe tu tadA yugAnte bharatarShabha |
sahasrAnte narAH sarve prAyasho.anRRitavAdinaH
shlokas.25:
yaj~napratinidhiH pArtha dAnapratinidhistathA |
vratapratinidhishchaiva tasminkAle pravartate
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNAH shUdrakarmANastathA shUdrA dhanArjakAH |
kShatradharmeNa vApyatra vartayanti gate yuge
shlokas.27:
nivRRittayaj~nasvAdhyAyAH piNDodakavivarjitAH |
brAhmaNAH sarvabhakShAshcha bhaviShyanti kalau yuge
shlokas.28:
ajapA brAhmaNAstAta shUdrA japaparAyaNAH |
viparIte tadA loke pUrvarUpaM kShayasya tat
shlokas.29:
bahavo mlechCharAjAnaH pRRithivyAM manujAdhipa |
mithyAnushAsinaH pApA mRRiShAvAdaparAyaNAH
shlokas.30:
AndhrAH shakAH pulindAshcha yavanAshcha narAdhipAH |
kAmbojA aurNikAH shUdrAstathAbhIrA narottama
shlokas.31:
na tadA brAhmaNaH kashchitsvadharmamupajIvati |
kShatriyA api vaishyAshcha vikarmasthA narAdhipa
shlokas.32:
alpAyuShaH svalpabalA alpatejaHparAkramAH |
alpadehAlpasArAshcha tathA satyAlpabhAShiNaH
shlokas.33:
bahushUnyA janapadA mRRigavyAlAvRRitA dishaH |
yugAnte samanuprApte vRRithA cha brahmachAriNaH
bhovAdinastathA shUdrA brAhmaNAshchAryavAdinaH
shlokas.34:
yugAnte manujavyAghra bhavanti bahujantavaH |
na tathA ghrANayuktAshcha sarvagandhA vishAM pate
rasAshcha manujavyAghra na tathA svAduyoginaH
shlokas.35:
bahuprajA hrasvadehAH shIlAchAravivarjitAH |
mukhebhagAH striyo rAjanbhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.36:
aTTashUlA janapadAH shivashUlAshchatuShpathAH |
keshashUlAH striyo rAjanbhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.37:
alpakShIrAstathA gAvo bhaviShyanti janAdhipa |
alpapuShpaphalAshchApi pAdapA bahuvAyasAH
shlokas.38:
brahmavadhyAvaliptAnAM tathA mithyAbhisha.nsinAm |
nRRipANAM pRRithivIpAla pratigRRihNanti vai dvijAH
shlokas.39:
lobhamohaparItAshcha mithyAdharmadhvajAvRRitAH |
bhikShArthaM pRRithivIpAla cha~nchUryante dvijairdishaH
shlokas.40:
karabhArabhayAtpu.nso gRRihasthAH parimoShakAH |
munichChadmAkRRitichChannA vANijyamupajIvate
shlokas.41:
mithyA cha nakharomANi dhArayanti narAstadA |
arthalobhAnnaravyAghra vRRithA cha brahmachAriNaH
shlokas.42:
AshrameShu vRRithAchArAH pAnapA gurutalpagAH |
aihalaukikamIhante mA.nsashoNitavardhanam
shlokas.43:
bahupAShaNDasa~NkIrNAH parAnnaguNavAdinaH |
AshramA manujavyAghra na bhavanti yugakShaye
shlokas.44:
yathartuvarShI bhagavAnna tathA pAkashAsanaH |
na tadA sarvabIjAni samyagrohanti bhArata
adharmaphalamatyarthaM tadA bhavati chAnagha
shlokas.45:
tathA cha pRRithivIpAla yo bhaveddharmasa.nyutaH |
alpAyuH sa hi mantavyo na hi dharmo.asti kashchana
shlokas.46:
bhUyiShThaM kUTamAnaishcha paNyaM vikrINate janAH |
vaNijashcha naravyAghra bahumAyA bhavantyuta
shlokas.47:
dharmiShThAH parihIyante pApIyAnvardhate janaH |
dharmasya balahAniH syAdadharmashcha balI tathA
shlokas.48:
alpAyuSho daridrAshcha dharmiShThA mAnavAstadA |
dIrghAyuShaH samRRiddhAshcha vidharmANo yugakShaye
shlokas.49:
adharmiShThairupAyaishcha prajA vyavaharantyuta |
sa~nchayenApi chAlpena bhavantyADhyA madAnvitAH
shlokas.50:
dhanaM vishvAsato nyastaM mitho bhUyiShThasho narAH |
hartuM vyavasitA rAjanmAyAchArasamanvitAH
shlokas.51:
puruShAdAni sattvAni pakShiNo.atha mRRigAstathA |
nagarANAM vihAreShu chaityeShvapi cha sherate
shlokas.52:
saptavarShAShTavarShAshcha striyo garbhadharA nRRipa |
dashadvAdashavarShANAM pu.nsAM putraH prajAyate
shlokas.53:
bhavanti ShoDashe varShe narAH palitinastathA |
AyuHkShayo manuShyANAM kShiprameva prapadyate
shlokas.54:
kShINe yuge mahArAja taruNA vRRiddhashIlinaH |
taruNAnAM cha yachChIlaM tadvRRiddheShu prajAyate
shlokas.55:
viparItAstadA nAryo va~nchayitvA rahaH patIn |
vyuchcharantyapi duHshIlA dAsaiH pashubhireva cha
shlokas.56:
tasminyugasahasrAnte samprApte chAyuShaH kShaye |
anAvRRiShTirmahArAja jAyate bahuvArShikI
shlokas.57:
tatastAnyalpasArANi sattvAni kShudhitAni cha |
pralayaM yAnti bhUyiShThaM pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.58:
tato dinakarairdIptaiH saptabhirmanujAdhipa |
pIyate salilaM sarvaM samudreShu saritsu cha
shlokas.59:
yachcha kAShThaM tRRiNaM chApi shuShkaM chArdraM cha bhArata |
sarvaM tadbhasmasAdbhUtaM dRRishyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.60:
tataH sa.nvartako vahnirvAyunA saha bhArata |
lokamAvishate pUrvamAdityairupashoShitam
shlokas.61:
tataH sa pRRithivIM bhittvA samAvishya rasAtalam |
devadAnavayakShANAM bhayaM janayate mahat
shlokas.62:
nirdahannAgalokaM cha yachcha ki~nchitkShitAviha |
adhastAtpRRithivIpAla sarvaM nAshayate kShaNAt
shlokas.63:
tato yojanavi.nshAnAM sahasrANi shatAni cha |
nirdahatyashivo vAyuH sa cha sa.nvartako.analaH
shlokas.64:
sadevAsuragandharvaM sayakShoragarAkShasam |
tato dahati dIptaH sa sarvameva jagadvibhuH
shlokas.65:
tato gajakulaprakhyAstaDinmAlAvibhUShitAH |
uttiShThanti mahAmeghA nabhasyadbhutadarshanAH
shlokas.66:
kechinnIlotpalashyAmAH kechitkumudasaMnibhAH |
kechitki~njalkasa~NkAshAH kechitpItAH payodharAH
shlokas.67:
kechiddhAridrasa~NkAshAH kAkANDakanibhAstathA |
kechitkamalapatrAbhAH kechiddhi~NgulakaprabhAH
shlokas.68:
kechitpuravarAkArAH kechidgajakulopamAH |
kechida~njanasa~NkAshAH kechinmakarasa.nsthitAH
vidyunmAlApinaddhA~NgAH samuttiShThanti vai ghanAH
shlokas.69:
ghorarUpA mahArAja ghorasvananinAditAH |
tato jaladharAH sarve vyApnuvanti nabhastalam
shlokas.70:
tairiyaM pRRithivI sarvA saparvatavanAkarA |
ApUryate mahArAja salilaughapariplutA
shlokas.71:
tataste jaladA ghorA rAviNaH puruSharShabha |
sarvataH plAvayantyAshu choditAH parameShThinA
shlokas.72:
varShamANA mahattoyaM pUrayanto vasundharAm |
sughoramashivaM raudraM nAshayanti cha pAvakam
shlokas.73:
tato dvAdasha varShANi payodAsta upaplave |
dhArAbhiH pUrayanto vai chodyamAnA mahAtmanA
shlokas.74:
tataH samudraH svAM velAmatikrAmati bhArata |
parvatAshcha vishIryante mahI chApi vishIryate
shlokas.75:
sarvataH sahasA bhrAntAste payodA nabhastalam |
sa.nveShTayitvA nashyanti vAyuvegaparAhatAH
shlokas.76:
tatastaM mArutaM ghoraM svayambhUrmanujAdhipa |
AdipadmAlayo devaH pItvA svapiti bhArata
shlokas.77:
tasminnekArNave ghore naShTe sthAvaraja~Ngame |
naShTe devAsuragaNe yakSharAkShasavarjite
shlokas.79:
ekArNave jale ghore vicharanpArthivottama |
apashyansarvabhUtAni vaiklavyamagamaM param
shlokas.80:
tataH sudIrghaM gatvA tu plavamAno narAdhipa |
shrAntaH kvachinna sharaNaM labhAmyahamatandritaH
shlokas.81:
tataH kadAchitpashyAmi tasminsalilasamplave |
nyagrodhaM sumahAntaM vai vishAlaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.82:
shAkhAyAM tasya vRRikShasya vistIrNAyAM narAdhipa |
parya~Nke pRRithivIpAla divyAstaraNasa.nstRRite
shlokas.83:
upaviShTaM mahArAja pUrNendusadRRishAnanam |
phullapadmavishAlAkShaM bAlaM pashyAmi bhArata
shlokas.84:
tato me pRRithivIpAla vismayaH sumahAnabhUt |
kathaM tvayaM shishuH shete loke nAshamupAgate
shlokas.85:
tapasA chintaya.nshchApi taM shishuM nopalakShaye |
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha jAnannapi narAdhipa
shlokas.86:
atasIpuShpavarNAbhaH shrIvatsakRRitalakShaNaH |
sAkShAllakShmyA ivAvAsaH sa tadA pratibhAti me
shlokas.87:
tato mAmabravIdbAlaH sa padmanibhalochanaH |
shrIvatsadhArI dyutimAnvAkyaM shrutisukhAvaham
shlokas.88:
jAnAmi tvA parishrAntaM tAta vishrAmakA~NkShiNam |
mArkaNDeya ihAssva tvaM yAvadichChasi bhArgava
shlokas.89:
abhyantaraM sharIraM me pravishya munisattama |
Assva bho vihito vAsaH prasAdaste kRRito mayA
shlokas.90:
tato bAlena tenaivamuktasyAsIttadA mama |
nirvedo jIvite dIrghe manuShyatve cha bhArata
shlokas.91:
tato bAlena tenAsyaM sahasA vivRRitaM kRRitam |
tasyAhamavasho vaktraM daivayogAtpraveshitaH
shlokas.92:
tataH praviShTastatkukShiM sahasA manujAdhipa |
sarAShTranagarAkIrNAM kRRitsnAM pashyAmi medinIm
shlokas.93:
ga~NgAM shatadruM sItAM cha yamunAmatha kaushikIm |
charmaNvatIM vetravatIM chandrabhAgAM sarasvatIm
shlokas.94:
sindhuM chaiva vipAshAM cha nadIM godAvarImapi |
vasvokasArAM nalinIM narmadAM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.95:
nadIM tAmrAM cha veNNAM cha puNyatoyAM shubhAvahAm |
suveNAM kRRiShNaveNAM cha irAmAM cha mahAnadIm
shoNaM cha puruShavyAghra vishalyAM kampunAmapi
shlokas.96:
etAshchAnyAshcha nadyo.ahaM pRRithivyAM yA narottama |
parikrAmanprapashyAmi tasya kukShau mahAtmanaH
shlokas.97:
tataH samudraM pashyAmi yAdogaNaniShevitam |
ratnAkaramamitraghna nidhAnaM payaso mahat
shlokas.98:
tataH pashyAmi gaganaM chandrasUryavirAjitam |
jAjvalyamAnaM tejobhiH pAvakArkasamaprabhaiH
pashyAmi cha mahIM rAjankAnanairupashobhitAm
shlokas.99:
yajante hi tadA rAjanbrAhmaNA bahubhiH savaiH |
kShatriyAshcha pravartante sarvavarNAnura~njane
shlokas.100:
vaishyAH kRRiShiM yathAnyAyaM kArayanti narAdhipa |
shushrUShAyAM cha niratA dvijAnAM vRRiShalAstathA
shlokas.101:
tataH paripatanrAja.nstasya kukShau mahAtmanaH |
himavantaM cha pashyAmi hemakUTaM cha parvatam
shlokas.102:
niShadhaM chApi pashyAmi shvetaM cha rajatAchitam |
pashyAmi cha mahIpAla parvataM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.103:
mandaraM manujavyAghra nIlaM chApi mahAgirim |
pashyAmi cha mahArAja meruM kanakaparvatam
shlokas.104:
mahendraM chaiva pashyAmi vindhyaM cha girimuttamam |
malayaM chApi pashyAmi pAriyAtraM cha parvatam
shlokas.105:
ete chAnye cha bahavo yAvantaH pRRithivIdharAH |
tasyodare mayA dRRiShTAH sarvaratnavibhUShitAH
shlokas.106:
siMhAnvyAghrAnvarAhA.nshcha nAgA.nshcha manujAdhipa |
pRRithivyAM yAni chAnyAni sattvAni jagatIpate
tAni sarvANyahaM tatra pashyanparyacharaM tadA
shlokas.107:
kukShau tasya naravyAghra praviShTaH sa~ncharandishaH |
shakrAdI.nshchApi pashyAmi kRRitsnAndevagaNA.nstathA
shlokas.108:
gandharvApsaraso yakShAnRRiShI.nshchaiva mahIpate |
daityadAnavasa~NghA.nshcha kAleyA.nshcha narAdhipa
siMhikAtanayA.nshchApi ye chAnye surashatravaH
shlokas.109:
yachcha ki~nchinmayA loke dRRiShTaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
tadapashyamahaM sarvaM tasya kukShau mahAtmanaH
phalAhAraH pravicharankRRitsnaM jagadidaM tadA
shlokas.110:
antaH sharIre tasyAhaM varShANAmadhikaM shatam |
na cha pashyAmi tasyAhamantaM dehasya kutrachit
shlokas.111:
satataM dhAvamAnashcha chintayAno vishAM pate |
AsAdayAmi naivAntaM tasya rAjanmahAtmanaH
shlokas.112:
tatastameva sharaNaM gato.asmi vidhivattadA |
vareNyaM varadaM devaM manasA karmaNaiva cha
shlokas.113:
tato.ahaM sahasA rAjanvAyuvegena niHsRRitaH |
mahAtmano mukhAttasya vivRRitAtpuruShottama
shlokas.114:
tatastasyaiva shAkhAyAM nyagrodhasya vishAM pate |
Aste manujashArdUla kRRitsnamAdAya vai jagat
shlokas.115:
tenaiva bAlaveSheNa shrIvatsakRRitalakShaNam |
AsInaM taM naravyAghra pashyAmyamitatejasam
shlokas.116:
tato mAmabravIdvIra sa bAlaH prahasanniva |
shrIvatsadhArI dyutimAnpItavAsA mahAdyutiH
shlokas.117:
apIdAnIM sharIre.asminmAmake munisattama |
uShitastvaM suvishrAnto mArkaNDeya bravIhi me
shlokas.118:
muhUrtAdatha me dRRiShTiH prAdurbhUtA punarnavA |
yayA nirmuktamAtmAnamapashyaM labdhachetasam
shlokas.119:
tasya tAmratalau tAta charaNau supratiShThitau |
sujAtau mRRiduraktAbhira~NgulIbhirala~NkRRitau
shlokas.120:
prayatena mayA mUrdhnA gRRihItvA hyabhivanditau |
dRRiShTvAparimitaM tasya prabhAvamamitaujasaH
shlokas.121:
vinayenA~njaliM kRRitvA prayatnenopagamya cha |
dRRiShTo mayA sa bhUtAtmA devaH kamalalochanaH
shlokas.122:
tamahaM prA~njalirbhUtvA namaskRRityedamabruvam |
j~nAtumichChAmi deva tvAM mAyAM chemAM tavottamAm
shlokas.124:
tava deva sharIrasthA devadAnavarAkShasAH |
yakShagandharvanAgAshcha jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.125:
tvatprasAdAchcha me deva smRRitirna parihIyate |
drutamantaH sharIre te satataM paridhAvataH
shlokas.126:
ichChAmi puNDarIkAkSha j~nAtuM tvAhamanindita |
iha bhUtvA shishuH sAkShAtkiM bhavAnavatiShThate
pItvA jagadidaM vishvametadAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.127:
kimarthaM cha jagatsarvaM sharIrasthaM tavAnagha |
kiyantaM cha tvayA kAlamiha stheyamari.ndama
shlokas.128:
etadichChAmi devesha shrotuM brAhmaNakAmyayA |
tvattaH kamalapatrAkSha vistareNa yathAtatham
mahaddhyetadachintyaM cha yadahaM dRRiShTavAnprabho
shlokas.129:
ityuktaH sa mayA shrImAndevadevo mahAdyutiH |
sAntvayanmAmidaM vAkyamuvAcha vadatAM varaH

shlokas.1:
deva uvAcha||
kAmaM devApi mAM vipra na vijAnanti tattvataH |
tvatprItyA tu pravakShyAmi yathedaM visRRijAmyaham
shlokas.2:
pitRRibhakto.asi viprarShe mAM chaiva sharaNaM gataH |
ato dRRiShTo.asmi te sAkShAdbrahmacharyaM cha te mahat
shlokas.3:
Apo nArA iti proktAH sa~nj~nAnAma kRRitaM mayA |
tena nArAyaNo.asmyukto mama taddhyayanaM sadA
shlokas.4:
ahaM nArAyaNo nAma prabhavaH shAshvato.avyayaH |
vidhAtA sarvabhUtAnAM saMhartA cha dvijottama
shlokas.5:
ahaM viShNurahaM brahmA shakrashchAhaM surAdhipaH |
ahaM vaishravaNo rAjA yamaH pretAdhipastathA
shlokas.6:
ahaM shivashcha somashcha kashyapashcha prajApatiH |
ahaM dhAtA vidhAtA cha yaj~nashchAhaM dvijottama
shlokas.7:
agnirAsyaM kShitiH pAdau chandrAdityau cha lochane |
sadishaM cha nabhaH kAyo vAyurmanasi me sthitaH
shlokas.8:
mayA kratushatairiShTaM bahubhiH svAptadakShiNaiH |
yajante vedaviduSho mAM devayajane sthitam
shlokas.9:
pRRithivyAM kShatriyendrAshcha pArthivAH svargakA~NkShiNaH |
yajante mAM tathA vaishyAH svargalokajigIShavaH
shlokas.10:
chatuHsamudraparyantAM merumandarabhUShaNAm |
sheSho bhUtvAhamevaitAM dhArayAmi vasundharAm
shlokas.11:
vArAhaM rUpamAsthAya mayeyaM jagatI purA |
majjamAnA jale vipra vIryeNAsItsamuddhRRitA
shlokas.12:
agnishcha vaDavAvaktro bhUtvAhaM dvijasattama |
pibAmyapaH samAviddhAstAshchaiva visRRijAmyaham
shlokas.13:
brahma vaktraM bhujau kShatramUrU me sa.nshritA vishaH |
pAdau shUdrA bhajante me vikrameNa krameNa cha
shlokas.14:
RRigvedaH sAmavedashcha yajurvedo.apyatharvaNaH |
mattaH prAdurbhavantyete mAmeva pravishanti cha
shlokas.15:
yatayaH shAntiparamA yatAtmAno mumukShavaH |
kAmakrodhadveShamuktA niHsa~NgA vItakalmaShAH
shlokas.16:
sattvasthA niraha~NkArA nityamadhyAtmakovidAH |
mAmeva satataM viprAshchintayanta upAsate
shlokas.17:
ahaM sa.nvartako jyotirahaM sarvartako yamaH |
ahaM sa.nvartakaH sUryo ahaM sa.nvartako.anilaH
shlokas.18:
tArArUpANi dRRishyante yAnyetAni nabhastale |
mama rUpANyathaitAni viddhi tvaM dvijasattama
shlokas.19:
ratnAkarAH samudrAshcha sarva eva chaturdisham |
vasanaM shayanaM chaiva nilayaM chaiva viddhi me
shlokas.20:
kAmaM krodhaM cha harShaM cha bhayaM mohaM tathaiva cha |
mamaiva viddhi rUpANi sarvANyetAni sattama
shlokas.21:
prApnuvanti narA vipra yatkRRitvA karmashobhanam |
satyaM dAnaM tapashchogramahi.nsA chaiva jantuShu
shlokas.22:
madvidhAnena vihitA mama dehavihAriNaH |
mayAbhibhUtavij~nAnA vicheShTante na kAmataH
shlokas.23:
samyagvedamadhIyAnA yajanto vividhairmakhaiH |
shAntAtmAno jitakrodhAH prApnuvanti dvijAtayaH
shlokas.24:
prAptuM na shakyo yo vidvannarairduShkRRitakarmabhiH |
lobhAbhibhUtaiH kRRipaNairanAryairakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.25:
taM mAM mahAphalaM viddhi padaM sukRRitakarmaNaH |
duShprApaM vipramUDhAnAM mArgaM yogairniShevitam
shlokas.26:
yadA yadA cha dharmasya glAnirbhavati sattama |
abhyutthAnamadharmasya tadAtmAnaM sRRijAmyaham
shlokas.27:
daityA hi.nsAnuraktAshcha avadhyAH surasattamaiH |
rAkShasAshchApi loke.asminyadotpatsyanti dAruNAH
shlokas.28:
tadAhaM samprasUyAmi gRRiheShu shubhakarmaNAm |
praviShTo mAnuShaM dehaM sarvaM prashamayAmyaham
shlokas.29:
sRRiShTvA devamanuShyA.nshcha gandharvoragarAkShasAn |
sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni saMharAmyAtmamAyayA
shlokas.30:
karmakAle punardehamanuchintya sRRijAmyaham |
pravishya mAnuShaM dehaM maryAdAbandhakAraNAt
shlokas.31:
shvetaH kRRitayuge varNaH pItastretAyuge mama |
rakto dvAparamAsAdya kRRiShNaH kaliyuge tathA
shlokas.32:
trayo bhAgA hyadharmasya tasminkAle bhavantyuta |
antakAle cha samprApte kAlo bhUtvAtidAruNaH
trailokyaM nAshayAmyekaH kRRitsnaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.33:
ahaM trivartmA sarvAtmA sarvalokasukhAvahaH |
abhibhUH sarvago.ananto hRRiShIkesha urukramaH
shlokas.34:
kAlachakraM nayAmyeko brahmannahamarUpi vai |
shamanaM sarvabhUtAnAM sarvalokakRRitodyamam
shlokas.35:
evaM praNihitaH samya~NmayAtmA munisattama |
sarvabhUteShu viprendra na cha mAM vetti kashchana
shlokas.36:
yachcha ki~nchittvayA prAptaM mayi kleShAtmakaM dvija |
sukhodayAya tatsarvaM shreyase cha tavAnagha
shlokas.37:
yachcha ki~nchittvayA loke dRRiShTaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
vihitaH sarvathaivAsau mamAtmA munisattama
shlokas.38:
ardhaM mama sharIrasya sarvalokapitAmahaH |
ahaM nArAyaNo nAma sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH
shlokas.39:
yAvadyugAnAM viprarShe sahasraparivartanam |
tAvatsvapimi vishvAtmA sarvalokapitAmahaH
shlokas.40:
evaM sarvamahaM kAlamihAse munisattama |
ashishuH shishurUpeNa yAvadbrahmA na budhyate
shlokas.41:
mayA cha vipra datto.ayaM varaste brahmarUpiNA |
asakRRitparituShTena viprarShigaNapUjita
shlokas.42:
sarvamekArNavaM dRRiShTvA naShTaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
viklavo.asi mayA j~nAtastataste darshitaM jagat
shlokas.43:
abhyantaraM sharIrasya praviShTo.asi yadA mama |
dRRiShTvA lokaM samastaM cha vismito nAvabudhyase
shlokas.44:
tato.asi vaktrAdviprarShe drutaM niHsArito mayA |
AkhyAtaste mayA chAtmA durj~neyo.api surAsuraiH
shlokas.45:
yAvatsa bhagavAnbrahmA na budhyati mahAtapAH |
tAvattvamiha viprarShe vishrabdhashchara vai sukham
shlokas.46:
tato vibuddhe tasmi.nstu sarvalokapitAmahe |
ekIbhUto hi srakShyAmi sharIrAddvijasattama
shlokas.47:
AkAshaM pRRithivIM jyotirvAyuM salilameva cha |
loke yachcha bhavechCheShamiha sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.48:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ityuktvAntarhitastAta sa devaH paramAdbhutaH |
prajAshchemAH prapashyAmi vichitrA bahudhAkRRitAH
shlokas.49:
etaddRRiShTaM mayA rAja.nstasminprApte yugakShaye |
AshcharyaM bharatashreShTha sarvadharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.50:
yaH sa devo mayA dRRiShTaH purA padmanibhekShaNaH |
sa eSha puruShavyAghra sambandhI te janArdanaH
shlokas.51:
asyaiva varadAnAddhi smRRitirna prajahAti mAm |
dIrghamAyushcha kaunteya svachChandamaraNaM tathA
shlokas.52:
sa eSha kRRiShNo vArShNeyaH purANapuruSho vibhuH |
Aste harirachintyAtmA krIDanniva mahAbhujaH
shlokas.53:
eSha dhAtA vidhAtA cha saMhartA chaiva sAtvataH |
shrIvatsavakShA govindaH prajApatipatiH prabhuH
shlokas.54:
dRRiShTvemaM vRRiShNishArdUlaM smRRitirmAmiyamAgatA |
AdidevamajaM viShNuM puruShaM pItavAsasam
shlokas.55:
sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAM pitA mAtA cha mAdhavaH |
gachChadhvamenaM sharaNaM sharaNyaM kauravarShabhAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktAstu te pArthA yamau cha puruSharShabhau |
draupadyA kRRiShNayA sArdhaM namashchakrurjanArdanam
shlokas.2:
sa chaitAnpuruShavyAghra sAmnA paramavalgunA |
sAntvayAmAsa mAnArhAnmanyamAno yathAvidhi
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThirastu kaunteyo mArkaNDeyaM mahAmunim |
punaH paprachCha sAmrAjye bhaviShyAM jagato gatim
shlokas.4:
AshcharyabhUtaM bhavataH shrutaM no vadatAM vara |
mune bhArgava yadvRRittaM yugAdau prabhavApyayau
shlokas.5:
asminkaliyuge.apyasti punaH kautUhalaM mama |
samAkuleShu dharmeShu kiM nu sheShaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.6:
ki.nvIryA mAnavAstatra kimAhAravihAriNaH |
kimAyuShaH ki.nvasanA bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.7:
kAM cha kAShThAM samAsAdya punaH sampatsyate kRRitam |
vistareNa mune brUhi vichitrANIha bhAShase
shlokas.8:
ityuktaH sa munishreShThaH punarevAbhyabhAShata |
ramayanvRRiShNishArdUlaM pANDavA.nshcha mahAmuniH
shlokas.9:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
bhaviShyaM sarvalokasya vRRittAntaM bharatarShabha |
kaluShaM kAlamAsAdya kathyamAnaM nibodha me
shlokas.10:
kRRite chatuShpAtsakalo nirvyAjopAdhivarjitaH |
vRRiShaH pratiShThito dharmo manuShyeShvabhavatpurA
shlokas.11:
adharmapAdaviddhastu tribhira.nshaiH pratiShThitaH |
tretAyAM dvApare.ardhena vyAmishro dharma uchyate
shlokas.12:
tribhira.nshairadharmastu lokAnAkramya tiShThati |
chaturthA.nshena dharmastu manuShyAnupatiShThati
shlokas.13:
AyurvIryamatho buddhirbalaM tejashcha pANDava |
manuShyANAmanuyugaM hrasatIti nibodha me
shlokas.14:
rAjAno brAhmaNA vaishyAH shUdrAshchaiva yudhiShThira |
vyAjairdharmaM chariShyanti dharmavaita.nsikA narAH
shlokas.15:
satyaM sa~NkShepsyate loke naraiH paNDitamAnibhiH |
satyahAnyA tatasteShAmAyuralpaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.16:
AyuShaH prakShayAdvidyAM na shakShyantyupashikShitum |
vidyAhInAnavij~nAnAllobho.apyabhibhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
lobhakrodhaparA mUDhAH kAmasaktAshcha mAnavAH |
vairabaddhA bhaviShyanti parasparavadhepsavaH
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH sa~NkIryantaH parasparam |
shUdratulyA bhaviShyanti tapaHsatyavivarjitAH
shlokas.19:
antyA madhyA bhaviShyanti madhyAshchAntAvasAyinaH |
IdRRisho bhavitA loko yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.20:
vastrANAM pravarA shANI dhAnyAnAM koradUShakAH |
bhAryAmitrAshcha puruShA bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.21:
matsyAmiSheNa jIvanto duhantashchApyajaiDakam |
goShu naShTAsu puruShA bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.22:
anyonyaM parimuShNanto hi.nsayantashcha mAnavAH |
ajapA nAstikAH stenA bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.23:
sarittIreShu kuddAlairvApayiShyanti chauShadhIH |
tAshchApyalpaphalAsteShAM bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.24:
shrAddhe daive cha puruShA ye cha nityaM dhRRitavratAH |
te.api lobhasamAyuktA bhokShyantIha parasparam
shlokas.25:
pitA putrasya bhoktA cha pituH putrastathaiva cha |
atikrAntAni bhojyAni bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.26:
na vratAni chariShyanti brAhmaNA vedanindakAH |
na yakShyanti na hoShyanti hetuvAdavilobhitAH
shlokas.27:
nimne kRRiShiM kariShyanti yokShyanti dhuri dhenukAH |
ekahAyanavatsA.nshcha vAhayiShyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.28:
putraH pitRRivadhaM kRRitvA pitA putravadhaM tathA |
nirudvego bRRihadvAdI na nindAmupalapsyate
shlokas.29:
mlechChabhUtaM jagatsarvaM nishkriyaM yaj~navarjitam |
bhaviShyati nirAnandamanutsavamatho tathA
shlokas.30:
prAyashaH kRRipaNAnAM hi tathA bandhumatAmapi |
vidhavAnAM cha vittAni hariShyantIha mAnavAH
shlokas.31:
alpavIryabalAH stabdhA lobhamohaparAyaNAH |
tatkathAdAnasantuShTA duShTAnAmapi mAnavAH
parigrahaM kariShyanti pApAchAraparigrahAH
shlokas.32:
sa~NghAtayantaH kaunteya rAjAnaH pApabuddhayaH |
parasparavadhodyuktA mUrkhAH paNDitamAninaH
bhaviShyanti yugasyAnte kShatriyA lokakaNTakAH
shlokas.33:
arakShitAro lubdhAshcha mAnAha~NkAradarpitAH |
kevalaM daNDaruchayo bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.34:
AkramyAkramya sAdhUnAM dArA.nshchaiva dhanAni cha |
bhokShyante niranukroshA rudatAmapi bhArata
shlokas.35:
na kanyAM yAchate kashchinnApi kanyA pradIyate |
svaya~NgrAhA bhaviShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.36:
rAjAnashchApyasantuShTAH parArthAnmUDhachetasaH |
sarvopAyairhariShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.37:
mlechChIbhUtaM jagatsarvaM bhaviShyati cha bhArata |
hasto hastaM parimuShedyugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.38:
satyaM sa~NkShipyate loke naraiH paNDitamAnibhiH |
sthavirA bAlamatayo bAlAH sthavirabuddhayaH
shlokas.39:
bhIravaH shUramAnInaH shUrA bhIruviShAdinaH |
na vishvasanti chAnyonyaM yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.40:
ekAhAryaM jagatsarvaM lobhamohavyavasthitam |
adharmo vardhati mahAnna cha dharmaH pravartate
shlokas.41:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyA na shiShyanti janAdhipa |
ekavarNastadA loko bhaviShyati yugakShaye
shlokas.42:
na kSha.nsyati pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM tathA |
bhAryA cha patishushrUShAM na kariShyati kAchana
shlokas.43:
ye yavAnnA janapadA godhUmAnnAstathaiva cha |
tAndeshAnsa.nshrayiShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.44:
svairAhArAshcha puruShA yoShitashcha vishAM pate |
anyonyaM na sahiShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.45:
mlechChabhUtaM jagatsarvaM bhaviShyati yudhiShThira |
na shrAddhairhi pitR^I.nshchApi tarpayiShyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.46:
na kashchitkasyachichChrotA na kashchitkasyachidguruH |
tamograstastadA loko bhaviShyati narAdhipa
shlokas.47:
paramAyushcha bhavitA tadA varShANi ShoDasha |
tataH prANAnvimokShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.48:
pa~nchame vAtha ShaShThe vA varShe kanyA prasUyate |
saptavarShAShTavarShAshcha prajAsyanti narAstadA
shlokas.49:
patyau strI tu tadA rAjanpuruSho vA striyaM prati |
yugAnte rAjashArdUla na toShamupayAsyati
shlokas.50:
alpadravyA vRRithAli~NgA hi.nsA cha prabhaviShyati |
na kashchitkasyachiddAtA bhaviShyati yugakShaye
shlokas.51:
aTTashUlA janapadAH shivashUlAshchatuShpathAH |
keshashUlAH striyashchApi bhaviShyanti yugakShaye
shlokas.52:
mlechChAH krUrAH sarvabhakShA dAruNAH sarvakarmasu |
bhAvinaH pashchime kAle manuShyA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.53:
krayavikrayakAle cha sarvaH sarvasya va~nchanam |
yugAnte bharatashreShTha vRRittilobhAtkariShyati
shlokas.54:
j~nAnAni chApyavij~nAya kariShyanti kriyAstathA |
AtmachChandena vartante yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.55:
svabhAvAtkrUrakarmANashchAnyonyamabhisha~NkinaH |
bhavitAro janAH sarve samprApte yugasa~NkShaye
shlokas.56:
ArAmA.nshchaiva vRRikShA.nshcha nAshayiShyanti nirvyathAH |
bhavitA sa~NkShayo loke jIvitasya cha dehinAm
shlokas.57:
tathA lobhAbhibhUtAshcha chariShyanti mahImimAm |
brAhmaNAshcha bhaviShyanti brahmasvAni cha bhu~njate
shlokas.58:
hAhAkRRitA dvijAshchaiva bhayArtA vRRiShalArditAH |
trAtAramalabhanto vai bhramiShyanti mahImimAm
shlokas.59:
jIvitAntakarA raudrAH krUrAH prANivihi.nsakAH |
yadA bhaviShyanti narAstadA sa~NkShepsyate yugam
shlokas.60:
AshrayiShyanti cha nadIH parvatAnviShamANi cha |
pradhAvamAnA vitrastA dvijAH kurukulodvaha
shlokas.61:
dasyuprapIDitA rAjankAkA iva dvijottamAH |
kurAjabhishcha satataM karabhAraprapIDitAH
shlokas.62:
dhairyaM tyaktvA mahIpAla dAruNe yugasa~NkShaye |
vikarmANi kariShyanti shUdrANAM parichArakAH
shlokas.63:
shUdrA dharmaM pravakShyanti brAhmaNAH paryupAsakAH |
shrotArashcha bhaviShyanti prAmANyena vyavasthitAH
shlokas.64:
viparItashcha loko.ayaM bhaviShyatyadharottaraH |
eDUkAnpUjayiShyanti varjayiShyanti devatAH
shUdrAH parichariShyanti na dvijAnyugasa~NkShaye
shlokas.65:
AshrameShu maharShINAM brAhmaNAvasatheShu cha |
devasthAneShu chaityeShu nAgAnAmAlayeShu cha
shlokas.66:
eDUkachihnA pRRithivI na devagRRihabhUShitA |
bhaviShyati yuge kShINe tadyugAntasya lakShaNam
shlokas.67:
yadA raudrA dharmahInA mA.nsAdAH pAnapAstathA |
bhaviShyanti narA nityaM tadA sa~NkShepsyate yugam
shlokas.68:
puShpe puShpaM yadA rAjanphale phalamupAshritam |
prajAsyati mahArAja tadA sa~NkShepsyate yugam
shlokas.69:
akAlavarShI parjanyo bhaviShyati gate yuge |
akrameNa manuShyANAM bhaviShyati tadA kriyA
virodhamatha yAsyanti vRRiShalA brAhmaNaiH saha
shlokas.70:
mahI mlechChasamAkIrNA bhaviShyati tato.achirAt |
karabhArabhayAdviprA bhajiShyanti disho dasha
shlokas.72:
evaM paryAkule loke maryAdA na bhaviShyati |
na sthAsyantyupadeshe cha shiShyA vipriyakAriNaH
shlokas.73:
AchAryopanidhishchaiva vatsyate tadanantaram |
arthayuktyA pravatsyanti mitrasambandhibAndhavAH
abhAvaH sarvabhUtAnAM yugAnte cha bhaviShyati
shlokas.74:
dishaH prajvalitAH sarvA nakShatrANi chalAni cha |
jyotIMShi pratikUlAni vAtAH paryAkulAstathA
ulkApAtAshcha bahavo mahAbhayanidarshakAH
shlokas.75:
ShaDbhiranyaishcha sahito bhAskaraH pratapiShyati |
tumulAshchApi nirhrAdA digdAhAshchApi sarvashaH
kabandhAntarhito bhAnurudayAstamaye tadA
shlokas.76:
akAlavarShI cha tadA bhaviShyati sahasradRRik |
sasyAni cha na rokShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.77:
abhIkShNaM krUravAdinyaH paruShA ruditapriyAH |
bhartR^INAM vachane chaiva na sthAsyanti tadA striyaH
shlokas.78:
putrAshcha mAtApitarau haniShyanti yugakShaye |
sUdayiShyanti cha patInstriyaH putrAnapAshritAH
shlokas.79:
aparvaNi mahArAja sUryaM rAhurupaiShyati |
yugAnte hutabhukchApi sarvataH prajvaliShyati
shlokas.80:
pAnIyaM bhojanaM chaiva yAchamAnAstadAdhvagAH |
na lapsyante nivAsaM cha nirastAH pathi sherate
shlokas.81:
nirghAtavAyasA nAgAH shakunAH samRRigadvijAH |
rUkShA vAcho vimokShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.82:
mitrasambandhinashchApi santyakShyanti narAstadA |
janaM parijanaM chApi yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.83:
atha deshAndishashchApi pattanAni purANi cha |
kramashaH sa.nshrayiShyanti yugAnte paryupasthite
shlokas.84:
hA tAta hA sutetyevaM tadA vAchaH sudAruNAH |
vikroshamAnashchAnyonyaM jano gAM paryaTiShyati
shlokas.85:
tatastumulasa~NghAte vartamAne yugakShaye |
dvijAtipUrvako lokaH krameNa prabhaviShyati
shlokas.87:
yadA chandrashcha sUryashcha tathA tiShyabRRihaspatI |
ekarAshau sameShyanti prapatsyati tadA kRRitam
shlokas.88:
kAlavarShI cha parjanyo nakShatrANi shubhAni cha |
pradakShiNA grahAshchApi bhaviShyantyanulomagAH
kShemaM subhikShamArogyaM bhaviShyati nirAmayam
shlokas.89:
kalkirviShNuyashA nAma dvijaH kAlaprachoditaH |
utpatsyate mahAvIryo mahAbuddhiparAkramaH
shlokas.90:
sambhUtaH sambhalagrAme brAhmaNAvasathe shubhe |
manasA tasya sarvANi vAhanAnyAyudhAni cha
upasthAsyanti yodhAshcha shastrANi kavachAni cha
shlokas.91:
sa dharmavijayI rAjA chakravartI bhaviShyati |
sa chemaM sa~NkulaM lokaM prasAdamupaneShyati
shlokas.92:
utthito brAhmaNo dIptaH kShayAntakRRidudAradhIH |
sa sa~NkShepo hi sarvasya yugasya parivartakaH
shlokas.93:
sa sarvatra gatAnkShudrAnbrAhmaNaiH parivAritaH |
utsAdayiShyati tadA sarvAnmlechChagaNAndvijaH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tatashchorakShayaM kRRitvA dvijebhyaH pRRithivImimAm |
vAjimedhe mahAyaj~ne vidhivatkalpayiShyati
shlokas.2:
sthApayitvA sa maryAdAH svayambhuvihitAH shubhAH |
vanaM puNyayashaHkarmA jarAvAnsa.nshrayiShyati
shlokas.3:
tachChIlamanuvartsyante manuShyA lokavAsinaH |
vipraishchorakShaye chaiva kRRite kShemaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNAjinAni shaktIshcha trishUlAnyAyudhAni cha |
sthApayanviprashArdUlo desheShu vijiteShu cha
shlokas.5:
sa.nstUyamAno viprendrairmAnayAno dvijottamAn |
kalkishchariShyati mahIM sadA dasyuvadhe rataH
shlokas.6:
hA tAta hA sutetyevaM tAstA vAchaH sudAruNAH |
vikroshamAnAnsubhRRishaM dasyUnneShyati sa~NkShayam
shlokas.7:
tato.adharmavinAsho vai dharmavRRiddhishcha bhArata |
bhaviShyati kRRite prApte kriyAvA.nshcha janastathA
shlokas.8:
ArAmAshchaiva chaityAshcha taTAkAnyavaTAstathA |
yaj~nakriyAshcha vividhA bhaviShyanti kRRite yuge
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNAH sAdhavashchaiva munayashcha tapasvinaH |
AshramAH sahapAShaNDAH sthitAH satye janAH prajAH
shlokas.10:
jAsyanti sarvabIjAni upyamAnAni chaiva ha |
sarveShvRRituShu rAjendra sarvaM sasyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
narA dAneShu niratA vrateShu niyameShu cha |
japayaj~naparA viprA dharmakAmA mudA yutAH
pAlayiShyanti rAjAno dharmeNemAM vasundharAm
shlokas.12:
vyavahAraratA vaishyA bhaviShyanti kRRite yuge |
ShaTkarmaniratA viprAH kShatriyA rakShaNe ratAH
shlokas.13:
shushrUShAyAM ratAH shUdrAstathA varNatrayasya cha |
eSha dharmaH kRRitayuge tretAyAM dvApare tathA
pashchime yugakAle cha yaH sa te samprakIrtitaH
shlokas.14:
sarvalokasya viditA yugasa~NkhyA cha pANDava |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtamatItAnAgataM mayA
vAyuproktamanusmRRitya purANamRRiShisa.nstutam
shlokas.15:
evaM sa.nsAramArgA me bahushashchirajIvinA |
dRRiShTAshchaivAnubhUtAshcha tA.nste kathitavAnaham
shlokas.16:
idaM chaivAparaM bhUyaH saha bhrAtRRibhirachyuta |
dharmasa.nshayamokShArthaM nibodha vachanaM mama
shlokas.17:
dharme tvayAtmA sa.nyojyo nityaM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
dharmAtmA hi sukhaM rAjA pretya cheha cha nandati
shlokas.18:
nibodha cha shubhAM vANIM yAM pravakShyAmi te.anagha |
na brAhmaNe paribhavaH kartavyaste kadAchana
brAhmaNo ruShito hanyAdapi lokAnpratij~nayA
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mArkaNDeyavachaH shrutvA kurUNAM pravaro nRRipaH |
uvAcha vachanaM dhImAnparamaM paramadyutiH
shlokas.20:
kasmindharme mayA stheyaM prajAH sa.nrakShatA mune |
kathaM cha vartamAno vai na chyaveyaM svadharmataH
shlokas.21:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
dayAvAnsarvabhUteShu hito rakto.anasUyakaH |
apatyAnAmiva sveShAM prajAnAM rakShaNe rataH
chara dharmaM tyajAdharmaM pitR^IndevA.nshcha pUjaya
shlokas.22:
pramAdAdyatkRRitaM te.abhUtsa.nyagdAnena tajjaya |
alaM te mAnamAshritya satataM paravAnbhava
shlokas.23:
vijitya pRRithivIM sarvAM modamAnaH sukhI bhava |
eSha bhUto bhaviShyashcha dharmaste samudIritaH
shlokas.24:
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchidatItAnAgataM bhuvi |
tasmAdimaM parikleshaM tvaM tAta hRRidi mA kRRithAH
shlokas.25:
eSha kAlo mahAbAho api sarvadivaukasAm |
muhyanti hi prajAstAta kAlenAbhiprachoditAH
shlokas.26:
mA cha te.atra vichAro bhUdyanmayoktaM tavAnagha |
atisha~Nkya vacho hyetaddharmalopo bhavettava
shlokas.27:
jAto.asi prathite va.nshe kurUNAM bharatarShabha |
karmaNA manasA vAchA sarvametatsamAchara
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yattvayoktaM dvijashreShTha vAkyaM shrutimanoharam |
tathA kariShye yatnena bhavataH shAsanaM vibho
shlokas.29:
na me lobho.asti viprendra na bhayaM na cha matsaraH |
kariShyAmi hi tatsarvamuktaM yatte mayi prabho
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tu vachanaM tasya pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
prahRRiShTAH pANDavA rAjansahitAH shAr~NgadhanvanA
shlokas.31:
tathA kathAM shubhAM shrutvA mArkaNDeyasya dhImataH |
vismitAH samapadyanta purANasya nivedanAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhUya eva brAhmaNamahAbhAgyaM vaktumarhasItyabravItpANDaveyo mArkaNDeyam
shlokas.2: athAchaShTa mArkaNDeyaH
shlokas.3: ayodhyAyAmikShvAkukulotpannaH pArthivaH parikShinnAma mRRigayAmagamat
shlokas.4: tamekAshvena mRRigamanusarantaM mRRigo dUramapAharat
shlokas.5:
athAdhvani jAtashramaH kShuttRRiShNAbhibhUtashcha kasmi.nshchiduddeshe nIlaM vanaShaNDamapashyat
tachcha vivesha
shlokas.6: tatastasya vanaShaNDasya madhye.atIva ramaNIyaM saro dRRiShTvA sAshva eva vyagAhata
shlokas.7: athAshvastaH sa bisamRRiNAlamashvasyAgre nikShipya puShkariNItIre samAvishat
shlokas.8: tataH shayAno madhuraM gItashabdamashRRiNot
shlokas.9:
sa shrutvAchintayat
neha manuShyagatiM pashyAmi
kasya khalvayaM gItashabda iti
shlokas.10: athApashyatkanyAM paramarUpadarshanIyAM puShpANyavachinvatIM gAyantIM cha
shlokas.11: atha sA rAj~naH samIpe paryakrAmat
shlokas.12:
tAmabravIdrAjA
kasyAsi subhage tvamiti
shlokas.13:
sA pratyuvAcha
kanyAsmIti
shlokas.14:
tAM rAjovAcha
arthI tvayAhamiti
shlokas.15:
athovAcha kanyA
samayenAhaM shakyA tvayA labdhum
nAnyatheti
shlokas.16: tAM rAjA samayamapRRichChat
shlokas.17:
tataH kanyedamuvAcha
udakaM me na darshayitavyamiti
shlokas.18: sa rAjA bADhamityuktvA tAM samAgamya tayA sahAste
shlokas.19:
tatraivAsIne rAjani senAnvagachChat
padenAnupadaM dRRiShTvA rAjAnaM parivAryAtiShThat
shlokas.20:
paryAshvastashcha rAjA tayaiva saha shibikayA prAyAdavighATitayA
svanagaramanuprApya rahasi tayA saha ramannAste
nAnyatki~nchanApashyat
shlokas.21:
atha pradhAnAmAtyastasyAbhyAshacharAH striyo.apRRichChat
kimatra prayojanaM vartata iti
shlokas.22:
athAbruva.nstAH striyaH
apUrvamiva pashyAma udakaM nAtra nIyateti
shlokas.23:
athAmAtyo.anudakaM vanaM kArayitvodAravRRikShaM bahumUlapuShpaphalaM rahasyupagamya rAjAnamabravIt
vanamidamudAramanudakam
sAdhvatra ramyatAmiti
shlokas.24:
sa tasya vachanAttayaiva saha devyA tadvanaM prAvishat
sa kadAchittasminvane ramye tayaiva saha vyavaharat
atha kShuttRRiShNArditaH shrAnto.atimAtramatimuktAgAramapashyat
shlokas.25: tatpravishya rAjA saha priyayA sudhAtalasukRRitAM vimalasalilapUrNAM vApImapashyat
shlokas.26: dRRiShTvaiva cha tAM tasyA eva tIre sahaiva tayA devyA vyatiShThat
shlokas.27:
atha tAM devIM sa rAjAbravIt
sAdhvavatara vApIsalilamiti
shlokas.28:
sA tadvachaH shrutvAvatIrya vApIM nyamajjat
na punarudamajjat
shlokas.29: tAM mRRigayamANo rAjA nApashyat
shlokas.30:
vApImapi niHsrAvya maNDUkaM shvabhramukhe dRRiShTvA kruddha Aj~nApayAmAsa
sarvamaNDUkavadhaH kriyatAmiti
yo mayArthI sa mRRitakairmaNDUkairupAyanairmAmupatiShThediti
shlokas.31:
atha maNDUkavadhe ghore kriyamANe dikShu sarvAsu maNDUkAnbhayamAvishat
te bhItA maNDUkarAj~ne yathAvRRittaM nyavedayan
shlokas.32: tato maNDUkarATtApasaveShadhArI rAjAnamabhyagachChat
shlokas.33:
upetya chainamuvAcha
mA rAjankrodhavashaM gamaH
prasAdaM kuru
nArhasi maNDUkAnAmanaparAdhinAM vadhaM kartumiti
shlokas.34:
shlokau chAtra bhavataH
mA maNDUkA~njighA.nsa tvaM kopaM sandhArayAchyuta |
prakShIyate dhanodreko janAnAmavijAnatAm
shlokas.35:
pratijAnIhi naitA.nstvaM prApya krodhaM vimokShyase |
alaM kRRitvA tavAdharmaM maNDUkaiH kiM hatairhi te
shlokas.36:
tameva.nvAdinamiShTajanashokaparItAtmA rAjA provAcha
na hi kShamyate tanmayA
haniShyAmyetAn
etairdurAtmabhiH priyA me bhakShitA
sarvathaiva me vadhyA maNDUkAH
nArhasi vidvanmAmuparoddhumiti
shlokas.37:
sa tadvAkyamupalabhya vyathitendriyamanAH provAcha
prasIda rAjan
ahamAyurnAma maNDUkarAjaH
mama sA duhitA sushobhanA nAma
tasyA dauHshIlyametat
bahavo hi rAjAnastayA vipralabdhapUrvA iti
shlokas.38:
tamabravIdrAjA
tayAsmyarthI
sA me dIyatAmiti
shlokas.39:
athainAM rAj~ne pitAdAt
abravIchchainAm
enaM rAjAnaM shushrUShasveti
shlokas.40:
sa uvAcha duhitaram
yasmAttvayA rAjAno vipralabdhAstasmAdabrahmaNyAni tavApatyAni bhaviShyantyanRRitakatvAttaveti
shlokas.41:
sa cha rAjA tAmupalabhya tasyAM surataguNanibaddhahRRidayo lokatrayaishvaryamivopalabhya harShabAShpakalayA vAchA praNipatyAbhipUjya maNDUkarAjAnamabravIt
anugRRihIto.asmIti
shlokas.42: sa cha maNDUkarAjo jAmAtaramanuj~nApya yathAgatamagachChat
shlokas.43:
atha kasyachitkAlasya tasyAM kumArAstrayastasya rAj~naH sambabhUvuH shalo dalo balashcheti
tatasteShAM jyeShThaM shalaM samaye pitA rAjye.abhiShichya tapasi dhRRitAtmA vanaM jagAma
shlokas.44:
atha kadAchichChalo mRRigayAmacharat
mRRigaM chAsAdya rathenAnvadhAvat
shlokas.45:
sUtaM chovAcha
shIghraM mAM vahasveti
shlokas.46:
sa tathoktaH sUto rAjAnamabravIt
mA kriyatAmanubandhaH
naiSha shakyastvayA mRRigo grahItuM yadyapi te rathe yuktau vAmyau syAtAmiti
shlokas.47:
tato.abravIdrAjA sUtam
AchakShva me vAmyau
hanmi vA tvAmiti
shlokas.48:
sa evamukto rAjabhayabhIto vAmadevashApabhItashcha sannAchakhyau rAj~ne
vAmadevasyAshvau vAmyau manojavAviti
shlokas.49:
athainamevaM bruvANamabravIdrAjA
vAmadevAshramaM yAhIti
shlokas.50:
sa gatvA vAmadevAshramaM tamRRiShimabravIt
bhagavanmRRigo mayA viddhaH palAyate
taM sambhAvayeyam
arhasi me vAmyau dAtumiti
shlokas.51:
tamabravIdRRiShiH
dadAni te vAmyau
kRRitakAryeNa bhavatA mamaiva niryAtyau kShipramiti
shlokas.52:
sa cha tAvashvau pratigRRihyAnuj~nApya charShiM prAyAdvAmyasa.nyuktena rathena mRRigaM prati
gachCha.nshchAbravItsUtam
ashvaratnAvimAvayogyau brAhmaNAnAm
naitau pratideyau vAmadevAyeti
shlokas.53: evamuktvA mRRigamavApya svanagarametyAshvAvantaHpure.asthApayat
shlokas.54:
atharShishchintayAmAsa
taruNo rAjaputraH kalyANaM patramAsAdya ramate
na me pratiniryAtayati
aho kaShTamiti
shlokas.55:
manasA nishchitya mAsi pUrNe shiShyamabravIt
gachChAtreya
rAjAnaM brUhi
yadi paryAptaM niryAtayopAdhyAyavAmyAviti
shlokas.56: sa gatvaivaM taM rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.57:
taM rAjA pratyuvAcha
rAj~nAmetadvAhanam
anarhA brAhmaNA ratnAnAmeva.nvidhAnAm
kiM cha brAhmaNAnAmashvaiH kAryam
sAdhu pratigamyatAmiti
shlokas.58: sa gatvaivamupAdhyAyAyAchaShTa
shlokas.59:
tachChrutvA vachanamapriyaM vAmadevaH krodhaparItAtmA svayameva rAjAnamabhigamyAshvArthamabhyachodayat
na chAdAdrAjA
shlokas.60:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
prayachCha vAmyau mama pArthiva tvaM; kRRitaM hi te kAryamanyairashakyam |
mA tvA vadhIdvaruNo ghorapAshai;rbrahmakShatrasyAntare vartamAnaH
shlokas.61:
rAjovAcha||
anaDvAhau suvratau sAdhu dAntA;vetadviprANAM vAhanaM vAmadeva |
tAbhyAM yAhi tvaM yatra kAmo maharShe; ChandA.nsi vai tvAdRRishaM sa.nvahanti
shlokas.62:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
ChandA.nsi vai mAdRRishaM sa.nvahanti; loke.amuShminpArthiva yAni santi |
asmi.nstu loke mama yAnameta;dasmadvidhAnAmapareShAM cha rAjan
shlokas.63:
rAjovAcha||
chatvAro vA gardabhAstvAM vahantu; shreShThAshvataryo harayo vA tura~NgAH |
taistvaM yAhi kShatriyasyaiSha vAho; mama vAmyau na tavaitau hi viddhi
shlokas.64:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
ghoraM vrataM brAhmaNasyaitadAhu;retadrAjanyadihAjIvamAnaH |
ayasmayA ghorarUpA mahAnto; vahantu tvAM shitashUlAshchaturdhA
shlokas.65:
rAjovAcha||
ye tvA vidurbrAhmaNaM vAmadeva; vAchA hantuM manasA karmaNA vA |
te tvAM sashiShyamiha pAtayantu; madvAkyanunnAH shitashUlAsihastAH
shlokas.66:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
nAnuyogA brAhmaNAnAM bhavanti; vAchA rAjanmanasA karmaNA vA |
yastvevaM brahma tapasAnveti vidvAM;stena shreShTho bhavati hi jIvamAnaH
shlokas.67:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamukte vAmadevena rAja;nsamuttasthU rAkShasA ghorarUpAH |
taiH shUlahastairvadhyamAnaH sa rAjA; provAchedaM vAkyamuchchaistadAnIm
shlokas.68:
ikShvAkavo yadi brahmandalo vA; vidheyA me yadi vAnye visho.api |
notsrakShye.ahaM vAmadevasya vAmyau; naiva.nvidhA dharmashIlA bhavanti
shlokas.69:
evaM bruvanneva sa yAtudhAnai;rhato jagAmAshu mahIM kShitIshaH |
tato viditvA nRRipatiM nipAtita;mikShvAkavo vai dalamabhyaShi~nchan
shlokas.70:
rAjye tadA tatra gatvA sa vipraH; provAchedaM vachanaM vAmadevaH |
dalaM rAjAnaM brAhmaNAnAM hi deya;mevaM rAjansarvadharmeShu dRRiShTam
shlokas.71:
bibheShi chettvamadharmAnnarendra; prayachCha me shIghramevAdya vAmyau |
etachChrutvA vAmadevasya vAkyaM; sa pArthivaH sUtamuvAcha roShAt
shlokas.72:
ekaM hi me sAyakaM chitrarUpaM; digdhaM viSheNAhara sa~NgRRihItam |
yena viddho vAmadevaH shayIta; sa.ndashyamAnaH shvabhirArtarUpaH
shlokas.73:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
jAnAmi putraM dashavarShaM tavAhaM; jAtaM mahiShyAM shyenajitaM narendra |
taM jahi tvaM madvachanAtpraNunna;stUrNaM priyaM sAyakairghorarUpaiH
shlokas.74:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamukto vAmadevena rAja;nnantaHpure rAjaputraM jaghAna |
sa sAyakastigmatejA visRRiShTaH; shrutvA dalastachcha vAkyaM babhAShe
shlokas.75:
ikShvAkavo hanta charAmi vaH priyaM; nihanmImaM vipramadya pramathya |
AnIyatAmaparastigmatejAH; pashyadhvaM me vIryamadya kShitIshAH
shlokas.76:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
yaM tvamenaM sAyakaM ghorarUpaM; viSheNa digdhaM mama sa.ndadhAsi |
na tvamenaM sharavaryaM vimoktuM; sandhAtuM vA shakShyasi mAnavendra
shlokas.77:
rAjovAcha||
ikShvAkavaH pashyata mAM gRRihItaM; na vai shaknomyeSha sharaM vimoktum |
na chAsya kartuM nAshamabhyutsahAmi; AyuShmAnvai jIvatu vAmadevaH
shlokas.79:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
sa.nspRRishainAM mahiShIM sAyakena; tatastasmAdenaso mokShyase tvam |
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tatastathA kRRitavAnpArthivastu; tato muniM rAjaputrI babhAShe |
yathA yuktaM vAmadevAhamenaM; dine dine sa.nvishantI vyasha.nsam
brAhmaNebhyo mRRigayantI sUnRRitAni; tathA brahmanpuNyalokaM labheyam
shlokas.80:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
tvayA trAtaM rAjakulaM shubhekShaNe; varaM vRRiNIShvApratimaM dadAni te |
prashAdhImaM svajanaM rAjaputri; ikShvAkurAjyaM sumahachchApyanindye
shlokas.81:
rAjaputryuvAcha||
varaM vRRiNe bhagavannekameva; vimuchyatAM kilbiShAdadya bhartA |
shivena chAdhyAhi saputrabAndhavaM; varo vRRito hyeSha mayA dvijAgrya
shlokas.82:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shrutvA vachaH sa munI rAjaputryA;stathAstviti prAha kurupravIra |
tataH sa rAjA mudito babhUva; vAmyau chAsmai sampradadau praNamya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mArkaNDeyamRRiShayaH pANDavAshcha paryapRRichChan
asti kashchidbhavatashchirajAtatara iti
shlokas.2:
sa tAnuvAcha
asti khalu rAjarShirindradyumno nAma kShINapuNyastridivAtprachyutaH
kIrtiste vyuchChinneti
sa mAmupAtiShThat
atha pratyabhijAnAti mAM bhavAniti
shlokas.3:
tamahamabruvam
na vayaM rAsAyanikAH sharIropatApenAtmanaH samArabhAmahe.arthAnAmanuShThAnam
shlokas.4:
asti khalu himavati prAkArakarNo nAmolUkaH
sa bhavantaM yadi jAnIyAt
prakRRiShTe chAdhvani himavAn
tatrAsau prativasatIti
shlokas.5: sa mAmashvo bhUtvA tatrAvahadyatra babhUvolUkaH
shlokas.6:
athainaM sa rAjarShiH paryapRRichChat
pratyabhijAnAti mAM bhavAniti
shlokas.7:
sa muhUrtaM dhyAtvAbravIdenam
nAbhijAne bhavantamiti
shlokas.8:
sa evamukto rAjarShirindradyumnaH punastamulUkamabravIt
asti kashchidbhavatashchirajAtatara iti
shlokas.9:
sa evamukto.abravIdenam
asti khalvindradyumnasaro nAma
tasminnADIja~Ngho nAma bakaH prativasati
so.asmattashchirajAtataraH
taM pRRichCheti
shlokas.10: tata indradyumno mAM cholUkaM chAdAya tatsaro.agachChadyatrAsau nADIja~Ngho nAma bako babhUva
shlokas.11:
so.asmAbhiH pRRiShTaH
bhavAnindradyumnaM rAjAnaM pratyabhijAnAtIti
shlokas.12:
sa evamukto.abravInmuhUrtaM dhyAtvA
nAbhijAnAmyahamindradyumnaM rAjAnamiti
shlokas.13:
tataH so.asmAbhiH pRRiShTaH
asti kashchidanyo bhavatashchirajAtatara iti
shlokas.14:
sa no.abravIdasti khalvihaiva sarasyakUpAro nAma kachChapaH prativasati
sa mattashchirajAtatara iti
sa yadi katha~nchidabhijAnIyAdimaM rAjAnaM tamakUpAraM pRRichChAma iti
shlokas.15:
tataH sa bakastamakUpAraM kachChapaM vij~nApayAmAsa
astyasmAkamabhipretaM bhavantaM ka~nchidarthamabhipraShTum
sAdhvAgamyatAM tAvaditi
shlokas.16: etachChrutvA sa kachChapastasmAtsarasa utthAyAbhyagachChadyatra tiShThAmo vayaM tasya sarasastIre
shlokas.17:
AgataM chainaM vayamapRRichChAma
bhavAnindradyumnaM rAjAnamabhijAnAtIti
shlokas.18:
sa muhUrtaM dhyAtvA bAShpapUrNanayana udvignahRRidayo vepamAno visa~nj~nakalpaH prA~njalirabravIt
kimahamenaM na pratyabhijAnAmi
ahaM hyanena sahasrakRRitvaH pUrvamagnichitiShUpahitapUrvaH
sarashchedamasya dakShiNAdattAbhirgobhiratikramamANAbhiH kRRitam
atra chAhaM prativasAmIti
shlokas.19: athaitatkachChapenodAhRRitaM shrutvA samanantaraM devalokAddevarathaH prAdurAsIt
shlokas.20:
vAchashchAshrUyantendradyumnaM prati
prastutaste svargaH
yathochitaM sthAnamabhipadyasva
kIrtimAnasi
avyagro yAhIti
shlokas.21:
divaM spRRishati bhUmiM cha shabdaH puNyasya karmaNaH |
yAvatsa shabdo bhavati tAvatpuruSha uchyate
shlokas.22:
akIrtiH kIrtyate yasya loke bhUtasya kasyachit |
patatyevAdhamA.NllokAnyAvachChabdaH sa kIrtyate
shlokas.23:
tasmAtkalyANavRRittaH syAdatyantAya naro bhuvi |
vihAya vRRittaM pApiShThaM dharmamevAbhisa.nshrayet
shlokas.24:
ityetachChrutvA sa rAjAbravIt
tiShTha tAvadyAvadidAnImimau vRRiddhau yathAsthAnaM pratipAdayAmIti
shlokas.25: sa mAM prAkArakarNaM cholUkaM yathochite sthAne pratipAdya tenaiva yAnena sa.nsiddho yathochitaM sthAnaM pratipannaH
shlokas.26: etanmayAnubhUtaM chirajIvinA dRRiShTamiti pANDavAnuvAcha mArkaNDeyaH
shlokas.27:
pANDavAshchochuH prItAH
sAdhu
shobhanaM kRRitaM bhavatA rAjAnamindradyumnaM svargalokAchchyutaM sve sthAne svarge punaH pratipAdayateti
shlokas.28:
athainAnabravIdasau
nanu devakIputreNApi kRRiShNena narake majjamAno rAjarShirnRRigastasmAtkRRichChrAtsamuddhRRitya punaH svargaM pratipAdita iti

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThiro dharmarAjaH paprachCha bharatarShabha |
mArkaNDeyaM tapovRRiddhaM dIrghAyuShamakalmaSham
shlokas.2:
viditAstava dharmaj~na devadAnavarAkShasAH |
rAjava.nshAshcha vividhA RRiShiva.nshAshcha shAshvatAH
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchidasmi.Nlloke dvijottama
shlokas.3:
kathAM vetsi mune divyAM manuShyoragarakShasAm |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tattvena kathitaM dvija
shlokas.4:
kuvalAshva iti khyAta ikShvAkuraparAjitaH |
kathaM nAma viparyAsAddhundhumAratvamAgataH
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmi tattvena j~nAtuM bhArgavasattama |
viparyastaM yathA nAma kuvalAshvasya dhImataH
shlokas.6:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi shRRiNu rAjanyudhiShThira |
dharmiShThamidamAkhyAnaM dhundhumArasya tachChRRiNu
shlokas.7:
yathA sa rAjA ikShvAkuH kuvalAshvo mahIpatiH |
dhundhumAratvamagamattachChRRiNuShva mahIpate
shlokas.8:
maharShirvishrutastAta utta~Nka iti bhArata |
marudhanvasu ramyeShu Ashramastasya kaurava
shlokas.9:
utta~Nkastu mahArAja tapo.atapyatsudushcharam |
ArirAdhayiShurviShNuM bahUnvarShagaNAnvibho
shlokas.10:
tasya prItaH sa bhagavAnsAkShAddarshanameyivAn |
dRRiShTvaiva charShiH prahvastaM tuShTAva vividhaiH stavaiH
shlokas.11:
tvayA deva prajAH sarvAH sadevAsuramAnavAH |
sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni ja~NgamAni tathaiva cha
brahma vedAshcha vedyaM cha tvayA sRRiShTaM mahAdyute
shlokas.12:
shiraste gaganaM deva netre shashidivAkarau |
niHshvAsaH pavanashchApi tejo.agnishcha tavAchyuta
bAhavaste dishaH sarvAH kukShishchApi mahArNavaH
shlokas.13:
UrU te parvatA deva khaM nAbhirmadhusUdana |
pAdau te pRRithivI devI romANyoShadhayastathA
shlokas.14:
indrasomAgnivaruNA devAsuramahoragAH |
prahvAstvAmupatiShThanti stuvanto vividhaiH stavaiH
shlokas.15:
tvayA vyAptAni sarvANi bhUtAni bhuvaneshvara |
yoginaH sumahAvIryAH stuvanti tvAM maharShayaH
shlokas.16:
tvayi tuShTe jagatsvasthaM tvayi kruddhe mahadbhayam |
bhayAnAmapanetAsi tvamekaH puruShottama
shlokas.17:
devAnAM mAnuShANAM cha sarvabhUtasukhAvahaH |
tribhirvikramaNairdeva trayo lokAstvayAhRRitAH
asurANAM samRRiddhAnAM vinAshashcha tvayA kRRitaH
shlokas.18:
tava vikramaNairdevA nirvANamagamanparam |
parAbhavaM cha daityendrAstvayi kruddhe mahAdyute
shlokas.19:
tvaM hi kartA vikartA cha bhUtAnAmiha sarvashaH |
ArAdhayitvA tvAM devAH sukhamedhanti sarvashaH
shlokas.20:
evaM stuto hRRiShIkesha utta~Nkena mahAtmanA |
utta~NkamabravIdviShNuH prItaste.ahaM varaM vRRiNu
shlokas.21:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
paryApto me varo hyeSha yadahaM dRRiShTavAnharim |
puruShaM shAshvataM divyaM sraShTAraM jagataH prabhum
shlokas.22:
viShNuruvAcha||
prItaste.ahamalaulyena bhaktyA cha dvijasattama |
avashyaM hi tvayA brahmanmatto grAhyo varo dvija
shlokas.23:
evaM sa~nChandyamAnastu vareNa hariNA tadA |
utta~NkaH prA~njalirvavre varaM bharatasattama
shlokas.24:
yadi me bhagavAnprItaH puNDarIkanibhekShaNaH |
dharme satye dame chaiva buddhirbhavatu me sadA
abhyAsashcha bhavedbhaktyA tvayi nityaM maheshvara
shlokas.25:
viShNuruvAcha||
sarvametaddhi bhavitA matprasAdAttava dvija |
pratibhAsyati yogashcha yena yukto divaukasAm
trayANAmapi lokAnAM mahatkAryaM kariShyasi
shlokas.26:
utsAdanArthaM lokAnAM dhundhurnAma mahAsuraH |
tapasyati tapo ghoraM shRRiNu yastaM haniShyati
shlokas.27:
bRRihadashva iti khyAto bhaviShyati mahIpatiH |
tasya putraH shuchirdAntaH kuvalAshva iti shrutaH
shlokas.28:
sa yogabalamAsthAya mAmakaM pArthivottamaH |
shAsanAttava viprarShe dhundhumAro bhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ikShvAkau sa.nsthite rAja~nshashAdaH pRRithivImimAm |
prAptaH paramadharmAtmA so.ayodhyAyAM nRRipo.abhavat
shlokas.2:
shashAdasya tu dAyAdaH kakutstho nAma vIryavAn |
anenAshchApi kAkutsthaH pRRithushchAnenasaH sutaH
shlokas.3:
viShvagashvaH pRRithoH putrastasmAdArdrastu jaj~nivAn |
Ardrasya yuvanAshvastu shrAvastastasya chAtmajaH
shlokas.4:
jaj~ne shrAvastako rAjA shrAvastI yena nirmitA |
shrAvastasya tu dAyAdo bRRihadashvo mahAbalaH
bRRihadashvasutashchApi kuvalAshva iti smRRitaH
shlokas.5:
kuvalAshvasya putrANAM sahasrANyekavi.nshatiH |
sarve vidyAsu niShNAtA balavanto durAsadAH
shlokas.6:
kuvalAshvastu pitRRito guNairabhyadhiko.abhavat |
samaye taM tato rAjye bRRihadashvo.abhyaShechayat
kuvalAshvaM mahArAja shUramuttamadhArmikam
shlokas.7:
putrasa~NkrAmitashrIstu bRRihadashvo mahIpatiH |
jagAma tapase dhImA.nstapovanamamitrahA
shlokas.8:
atha shushrAva rAjarShiM tamutta~Nko yudhiShThira |
vanaM samprasthitaM rAjanbRRihadashvaM dvijottamaH
shlokas.9:
tamutta~Nko mahAtejAH sarvAstraviduShAM varam |
nyavArayadameyAtmA samAsAdya narottamam
shlokas.10:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
bhavatA rakShaNaM kAryaM tattAvatkartumarhasi |
nirudvignA vayaM rAja.nstvatprasAdAdvasemahi
shlokas.11:
tvayA hi pRRithivI rAjanrakShyamANA mahAtmanA |
bhaviShyati nirudvignA nAraNyaM gantumarhasi
shlokas.12:
pAlane hi mahAndharmaH prajAnAmiha dRRishyate |
na tathA dRRishyate.araNye mA te bhUdbuddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.13:
IdRRisho na hi rAjendra dharmaH kvachana dRRishyate |
prajAnAM pAlane yo vai purA rAjarShibhiH kRRitaH
rakShitavyAH prajA rAj~nA tAstvaM rakShitumarhasi
shlokas.14:
nirudvignastapashchartuM na hi shaknomi pArthiva |
mamAshramasamIpe vai sameShu marudhanvasu
shlokas.15:
samudro vAlukApUrNa ujjAnaka iti smRRitaH |
bahuyojanavistIrNo bahuyojanamAyataH
shlokas.16:
tatra raudro dAnavendro mahAvIryaparAkramaH |
madhukaiTabhayoH putro dhundhurnAma sudAruNaH
shlokas.17:
antarbhUmigato rAjanvasatyamitavikramaH |
taM nihatya mahArAja vanaM tvaM gantumarhasi
shlokas.18:
shete lokavinAshAya tapa AsthAya dAruNam |
tridashAnAM vinAshAya lokAnAM chApi pArthiva
shlokas.19:
avadhyo devatAnAM sa daityAnAmatha rakShasAm |
nAgAnAmatha yakShANAM gandharvANAM cha sarvashaH
avApya sa varaM rAjansarvalokapitAmahAt
shlokas.20:
taM vinAshaya bhadraM te mA te buddhirato.anyathA |
prApsyase mahatIM kIrtiM shAshvatImavyayAM dhruvAm
shlokas.21:
krUrasya svapatastasya vAlukAntarhitasya vai |
sa.nvatsarasya paryante niHshvAsaH sampravartate
yadA tadA bhUshchalati sashailavanakAnanA
shlokas.22:
tasya niHshvAsavAtena raja uddhUyate mahat |
AdityapathamAvRRitya saptAhaM bhUmikampanam
savisphuli~NgaM sajvAlaM sadhUmaM hyatidAruNam
shlokas.23:
tena rAjanna shaknomi tasminsthAtuM sva Ashrame |
taM vinAshaya rAjendra lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
lokAH svasthA bhavantvadya tasminvinihate.asure
shlokas.24:
tvaM hi tasya vinAshAya paryApta iti me matiH |
tejasA tava tejashcha viShNurApyAyayiShyati
shlokas.25:
viShNunA cha varo datto mama pUrvaM tato vadhe |
yastaM mahAsuraM raudraM vadhiShyati mahIpatiH
tejastaM vaiShNavamiti pravekShyati durAsadam
shlokas.26:
tattejastvaM samAdhAya rAjendra bhuvi duHsaham |
taM niShUdaya sa.nduShTaM daityaM raudraparAkramam
shlokas.27:
na hi dhundhurmahAtejAstejasAlpena shakyate |
nirdagdhuM pRRithivIpAla sa hi varShashatairapi

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sa evamukto rAjarShirutta~NkenAparAjitaH |
utta~NkaM kauravashreShTha kRRitA~njalirathAbravIt
shlokas.2:
na te.abhigamanaM brahmanmoghametadbhaviShyati |
putro mamAyaM bhagavankuvalAshva iti smRRitaH
shlokas.3:
dhRRitimAnkShiprakArI cha vIryeNApratimo bhuvi |
priyaM vai sarvametatte kariShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
putraiH parivRRitaH sarvaiH shUraiH parighabAhubhiH |
visarjayasva mAM brahmannyastashastro.asmi sAmpratam
shlokas.5:
tathAstviti cha tenokto muninAmitatejasA |
sa tamAdishya tanayamutta~NkAya mahAtmane
kriyatAmiti rAjarShirjagAma vanamuttamam
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ka eSha bhagavandaityo mahAvIryastapodhana |
kasya putro.atha naptA vA etadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.7:
evaM mahAbalo daityo na shruto me tapodhana |
etadichChAmi bhagavanyAthAtathyena veditum
sarvameva mahAprAj~na vistareNa tapodhana
shlokas.8:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannidaM sarvaM yathAvRRittaM narAdhipa |
ekArNave tadA ghore naShTe sthAvaraja~Ngame
pranaShTeShu cha bhUteShu sarveShu bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
prabhavaH sarvabhUtAnAM shAshvataH puruSho.avyayaH |
suShvApa bhagavAnviShNurapshayyAmeka eva ha
nAgasya bhoge mahati sheShasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.10:
lokakartA mahAbhAga bhagavAnachyuto hariH |
nAgabhogena mahatA parirabhya mahImimAm
shlokas.11:
svapatastasya devasya padmaM sUryasamaprabham |
nAbhyAM viniHsRRitaM tatra yatrotpannaH pitAmahaH
sAkShAllokagururbrahmA padme sUryendusaprabhe
shlokas.12:
chaturvedashchaturmUrtistathaiva cha chaturmukhaH |
svaprabhAvAddurAdharSho mahAbalaparAkramaH
shlokas.13:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya dAnavau vIryavattarau |
madhushcha kaiTabhashchaiva dRRiShTavantau hariM prabhum
shlokas.14:
shayAnaM shayane divye nAgabhoge mahAdyutim |
bahuyojanavistIrNe bahuyojanamAyate
shlokas.15:
kirITakaustubhadharaM pItakausheyavAsasam |
dIpyamAnaM shriyA rAja.nstejasA vapuShA tathA
sahasrasUryapratimamadbhutopamadarshanam
shlokas.16:
vismayaH sumahAnAsInmadhukaiTabhayostadA |
dRRiShTvA pitAmahaM chaiva padme padmanibhekShaNam
shlokas.17:
vitrAsayetAmatha tau brahmANamamitaujasam |
vitrAsyamAno bahusho brahmA tAbhyAM mahAyashAH
akampayatpadmanAlaM tato.abudhyata keshavaH
shlokas.18:
athApashyata govindo dAnavau vIryavattarau |
dRRiShTvA tAvabravIddevaH svAgataM vAM mahAbalau
dadAni vAM varaM shreShThaM prItirhi mama jAyate
shlokas.19:
tau prahasya hRRiShIkeshaM mahAvIryau mahAsurau |
pratyabrUtAM mahArAja sahitau madhusUdanam
shlokas.20:
AvAM varaya deva tvaM varadau svaH surottama |
dAtArau svo varaM tubhyaM tadbravIhyavichArayan
shlokas.21:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
pratigRRihNe varaM vIrAvIpsitashcha varo mama |
yuvAM hi vIryasampannau na vAmasti samaH pumAn
shlokas.22:
vadhyatvamupagachChetAM mama satyaparAkramau |
etadichChAmyahaM kAmaM prAptuM lokahitAya vai
shlokas.23:
madhukaiTabhAvUchatuH||
anRRitaM noktapUrvaM nau svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA |
satye dharme cha niratau viddhyAvAM puruShottama
shlokas.24:
bale rUpe cha vIrye cha shame cha na samo.asti nau |
dharme tapasi dAne cha shIlasattvadameShu cha
shlokas.25:
upaplavo mahAnasmAnupAvartata keshava |
uktaM pratikuruShva tvaM kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.26:
AvAmichChAvahe deva kRRitamekaM tvayA vibho |
anAvRRite.asminnAkAshe vadhaM suravarottama
shlokas.27:
putratvamabhigachChAva tava chaiva sulochana |
vara eSha vRRito deva tadviddhi surasattama
shlokas.29:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
bADhamevaM kariShyAmi sarvametadbhaviShyati |
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
vichintya tvatha govindo nApashyadyadanAvRRitam |
avakAshaM pRRithivyAM vA divi vA madhusUdanaH
shlokas.30:
svakAvanAvRRitAvUrU dRRiShTvA devavarastadA |
madhukaiTabhayo rAja~nshirasI madhusUdanaH
chakreNa shitadhAreNa nyakRRintata mahAyashAH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
dhundhurnAma mahAtejAstayoH putro mahAdyutiH |
sa tapo.atapyata mahanmahAvIryaparAkramaH
shlokas.2:
atiShThadekapAdena kRRisho dhamanisantataH |
tasmai brahmA dadau prIto varaM vavre sa cha prabho
shlokas.3:
devadAnavayakShANAM sarpagandharvarakShasAm |
avadhyo.ahaM bhaveyaM vai vara eSha vRRito mayA
shlokas.4:
evaM bhavatu gachCheti tamuvAcha pitAmahaH |
sa evamuktastatpAdau mUrdhnA spRRishya jagAma ha
shlokas.5:
sa tu dhundhurvaraM labdhvA mahAvIryaparAkramaH |
anusmaranpitRRivadhaM tato viShNumupAdravat
shlokas.6:
sa tu devAnsagandharvA~njitvA dhundhuramarShaNaH |
babAdha sarvAnasakRRiddevAnviShNuM cha vai bhRRisham
shlokas.7:
samudro vAlukApUrNa ujjAnaka iti smRRitaH |
Agamya cha sa duShTAtmA taM deshaM bharatarShabha
bAdhate sma paraM shaktyA tamutta~NkAshramaM prabho
shlokas.8:
antarbhUmigatastatra vAlukAntarhitastadA |
madhukaiTabhayoH putro dhundhurbhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.9:
shete lokavinAshAya tapobalasamAshritaH |
utta~NkasyAshramAbhyAshe niHshvasanpAvakArchiShaH
shlokas.10:
etasminneva kAle tu sabhRRityabalavAhanaH |
kuvalAshvo narapatiranvito balashAlinAm
shlokas.11:
sahasrairekavi.nshatyA putrANAmarimardanaH |
prAyAdutta~Nkasahito dhundhostasya niveshanam
shlokas.12:
tamAvishattato viShNurbhagavA.nstejasA prabhuH |
utta~Nkasya niyogena lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.13:
tasminprayAte durdharShe divi shabdo mahAnabhUt |
eSha shrImAnnRRipasuto dhundhumAro bhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
divyaishcha puShpaistaM devAH samantAtparyavAkiran |
devadundubhayashchaiva neduH svayamudIritAH
shlokas.15:
shItashcha vAyuH pravavau prayANe tasya dhImataH |
vipA.nsulAM mahIM kurvanvavarSha cha sureshvaraH
shlokas.16:
antarikShe vimAnAni devatAnAM yudhiShThira |
tatraiva samadRRishyanta dhundhuryatra mahAsuraH
shlokas.17:
kuvalAshvasya dhundhoshcha yuddhakautUhalAnvitAH |
devagandharvasahitAH samavaikShanmaharShayaH
shlokas.18:
nArAyaNena kauravya tejasApyAyitastadA |
sa gato nRRipatiH kShipraM putraistaiH sarvatodisham
shlokas.19:
arNavaM khAnayAmAsa kuvalAshvo mahIpatiH |
kuvalAshvasya putraistu tasminvai vAlukArNave
shlokas.20:
saptabhirdivasaiH khAtvA dRRiShTo dhundhurmahAbalaH |
AsIdghoraM vapustasya vAlukAntarhitaM mahat
dIpyamAnaM yathA sUryastejasA bharatarShabha
shlokas.21:
tato dhundhurmahArAja dishamAshritya pashchimAm |
supto.abhUdrAjashArdUla kAlAnalasamadyutiH
shlokas.22:
kuvalAshvasya putraistu sarvataH parivAritaH |
abhidrutaH sharaistIkShNairgadAbhirmusalairapi
paTTishaiH parighaiH prAsaiH khaDgaishcha vimalaiH shitaiH
shlokas.23:
sa vadhyamAnaH sa~NkruddhaH samuttasthau mahAbalaH |
kruddhashchAbhakShayatteShAM shastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.24:
AsyAdvamanpAvakaM sa sa.nvartakasamaM tadA |
tAnsarvAnnRRipateH putrAnadahatsvena tejasA
shlokas.25:
mukhajenAgninA kruddho lokAnudvartayanniva |
kShaNena rAjashArdUla pureva kapilaH prabhuH
sagarasyAtmajAnkruddhastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.26:
teShu krodhAgnidagdheShu tadA bharatasattama |
taM prabuddhaM mahAtmAnaM kumbhakarNamivAparam
AsasAda mahAtejAH kuvalAshvo mahIpatiH
shlokas.27:
tasya vAri mahArAja susrAva bahu dehataH |
tadApIyata tattejo rAjA vArimayaM nRRipa
yogI yogena vahniM cha shamayAmAsa vAriNA
shlokas.28:
brahmAstreNa tadA rAjA daityaM krUraparAkramam |
dadAha bharatashreShTha sarvalokAbhayAya vai
shlokas.29:
so.astreNa dagdhvA rAjarShiH kuvalAshvo mahAsuram |
surashatrumamitraghnastrilokesha ivAparaH
dhundhumAra iti khyAto nAmnA samabhavattataH
shlokas.30:
prItaishcha tridashaiH sarvairmaharShisahitaistadA |
varaM vRRiNIShvetyuktaH sa prA~njaliH praNatastadA
atIva mudito rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.31:
dadyAM vittaM dvijAgryebhyaH shatrUNAM chApi durjayaH |
sakhyaM cha viShNunA me syAdbhUteShvadroha eva cha
dharme ratishcha satataM svarge vAsastathAkShayaH
shlokas.32:
tathAstviti tato devaiH prItairuktaH sa pArthivaH |
RRiShibhishcha sagandharvairutta~Nkena cha dhImatA
shlokas.33:
sabhAjya chainaM vividhairAshIrvAdaistato nRRipam |
devA maharShayashchaiva svAni sthAnAni bhejire
shlokas.34:
tasya putrAstrayaH shiShTA yudhiShThira tadAbhavan |
dRRiDhAshvaH kapilAshvashcha chandrAshvashchaiva bhArata
tebhyaH paramparA rAjannikShvAkUNAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.35:
evaM sa nihatastena kuvalAshvena sattama |
dhundhurdaityo mahAvIryo madhukaiTabhayoH sutaH
shlokas.36:
kuvalAshvastu nRRipatirdhundhumAra iti smRRitaH |
nAmnA cha guNasa.nyuktastadA prabhRRiti so.abhavat
shlokas.37:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
dhaundhumAramupAkhyAnaM prathitaM yasya karmaNA
shlokas.38:
idaM tu puNyamAkhyAnaM viShNoH samanukIrtanam |
shRRiNuyAdyaH sa dharmAtmA putravA.nshcha bhavennaraH
shlokas.39:
AyuShmAndhRRitimA.nshchaiva shrutvA bhavati parvasu |
na cha vyAdhibhayaM ki~nchitprApnoti vigatajvaraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA mArkaNDeyaM mahAdyutim |
paprachCha bharatashreShTho dharmaprashnaM sudurvacham
shlokas.2:
shrotumichChAmi bhagavanstrINAM mAhAtmyamuttamam |
kathyamAnaM tvayA vipra sUkShmaM dharmaM cha tattvataH
shlokas.3:
pratyakSheNa hi viprarShe devA dRRishyanti sattama |
sUryAchandramasau vAyuH pRRithivI vahnireva cha
shlokas.4:
pitA mAtA cha bhagavangAva eva cha sattama |
yachchAnyadeva vihitaM tachchApi bhRRigunandana
shlokas.5:
manye.ahaM guruvatsarvamekapatnyastathA striyaH |
pativratAnAM shushrUShA duShkarA pratibhAti me
shlokas.6:
pativratAnAM mAhAtmyaM vaktumarhasi naH prabho |
nirudhya chendriyagrAmaM manaH sa.nrudhya chAnagha
patiM daivatavachchApi chintayantyaH sthitA hi yAH
shlokas.7:
bhagavanduShkaraM hyetatpratibhAti mama prabho |
mAtApitRRiShu shushrUShA strINAM bhartRRiShu cha dvija
shlokas.8:
strINAM dharmAtsughorAddhi nAnyaM pashyAmi duShkaram |
sAdhvAchArAH striyo brahmanyatkurvanti sadAdRRitAH
duShkaraM bata kurvanti pitaro mAtarashcha vai
shlokas.9:
ekapatnyashcha yA nAryo yAshcha satyaM vadantyuta |
kukShiNA dasha mAsA.nshcha garbhaM sandhArayanti yAH
nAryaH kAlena sambhUya kimadbhutataraM tataH
shlokas.10:
sa.nshayaM paramaM prApya vedanAmatulAmapi |
prajAyante sutAnnAryo duHkhena mahatA vibho
puShNanti chApi mahatA snehena dvijasattama
shlokas.11:
ye cha krUreShu sarveShu vartamAnA jugupsitAH |
svakarma kurvanti sadA duShkaraM tachcha me matam
shlokas.12:
kShatradharmasamAchAraM tathyaM chAkhyAhi me dvija |
dharmaH sudurlabho vipra nRRisha.nsena durAtmanA
shlokas.13:
etadichChAmi bhagavanprashnaM prashnavidAM vara |
shrotuM bhRRigukulashreShTha shushrUShe tava suvrata
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
hanta te sarvamAkhyAsye prashnametaM sudurvacham |
tattvena bharatashreShTha gadatastannibodha me
shlokas.15:
mAtaraM sadRRishIM tAta pitR^Inanye cha manyate |
duShkaraM kurute mAtA vivardhayati yA prajAH
shlokas.16:
tapasA devatejyAbhirvandanena titikShayA |
abhichArairupAyaishcha Ihante pitaraH sutAn
shlokas.17:
evaM kRRichChreNa mahatA putraM prApya sudurlabham |
chintayanti sadA vIra kIdRRisho.ayaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
Asha.nsate cha putreShu pitA mAtA cha bhArata |
yashaH kIrtimathaishvaryaM prajA dharmaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.19:
tayorAshAM tu saphalAM yaH karoti sa dharmavit |
pitA mAtA cha rAjendra tuShyato yasya nityadA
iha pretya cha tasyAtha kIrtirdharmashcha shAshvataH
shlokas.20:
naiva yaj~naH striyaH kashchinna shrAddhaM nopavAsakam |
yA tu bhartari shushrUShA tayA svargamupAshnute
shlokas.21:
etatprakaraNaM rAjannadhikRRitya yudhiShThira |
prativratAnAM niyataM dharmaM chAvahitaH shRRiNu

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
kashchiddvijAtipravaro vedAdhyAyI tapodhanaH |
tapasvI dharmashIlashcha kaushiko nAma bhArata
shlokas.2:
sA~NgopaniShadAnvedAnadhIte dvijasattamaH |
sa vRRikShamUle kasmi.nshchidvedAnuchchArayansthitaH
shlokas.3:
upariShTAchcha vRRikShasya balAkA saMnyalIyata |
tayA purIShamutsRRiShTaM brAhmaNasya tadopari
shlokas.4:
tAmavekShya tataH kruddhaH samapadhyAyata dvijaH |
bhRRishaM krodhAbhibhUtena balAkA sA nirIkShitA
shlokas.5:
apadhyAtA cha vipreNa nyapatadvasudhAtale |
balAkAM patitAM dRRiShTvA gatasattvAmachetanAm
kAruNyAdabhisantaptaH paryashochata tAM dvijaH
shlokas.6:
akAryaM kRRitavAnasmi rAgadveShabalAtkRRitaH |
ityuktvA bahusho vidvAngrAmaM bhaikShAya sa.nshritaH
shlokas.7:
grAme shuchIni pracharankulAni bharatarShabha |
praviShTastatkulaM yatra pUrvaM charitavA.nstu saH
shlokas.8:
dehIti yAchamAno vai tiShThetyuktaH striyA tataH |
shauchaM tu yAvatkurute bhAjanasya kuTumbinI
shlokas.9:
etasminnantare rAjankShudhAsampIDito bhRRisham |
bhartA praviShTaH sahasA tasyA bharatasattama
shlokas.10:
sA tu dRRiShTvA patiM sAdhvI brAhmaNaM vyapahAya tam |
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha dadau bhartre tathAsanam
shlokas.11:
prahvA paryacharachchApi bhartAramasitekShaNA |
AhAreNAtha bhakShyaishcha vAkyaiH sumadhuraistathA
shlokas.12:
uchChiShTaM bhu~njate bhartuH sA tu nityaM yudhiShThira |
daivataM cha patiM mene bhartushchittAnusAriNI
shlokas.13:
na karmaNA na manasA nAtyashnAnnApi chApibat |
taM sarvabhAvopagatA patishushrUShaNe ratA
shlokas.14:
sAdhvAchArA shuchirdakShA kuTumbasya hitaiShiNI |
bhartushchApi hitaM yattatsatataM sAnuvartate
shlokas.15:
devatAtithibhRRityAnAM shvashrUshvashurayostathA |
shushrUShaNaparA nityaM satataM sa.nyatendriyA
shlokas.16:
sA brAhmaNaM tadA dRRiShTvA sa.nsthitaM bhaikShakA~NkShiNam |
kurvatI patishushrUShAM sasmArAtha shubhekShaNA
shlokas.17:
vrIDitA sAbhavatsAdhvI tadA bharatasattama |
bhikShAmAdAya viprAya nirjagAma yashasvinI
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kimidaM bhavati tvaM mAM tiShThetyuktvA varA~Ngane |
uparodhaM kRRitavatI na visarjitavatyasi
shlokas.19:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
brAhmaNaM krodhasantaptaM jvalantamiva tejasA |
dRRiShTvA sAdhvI manuShyendra sAntvapUrvaM vacho.abravIt
shlokas.20:
kShantumarhasi me vipra bhartA me daivataM mahat |
sa chApi kShudhitaH shrAntaH prAptaH shushrUShito mayA
shlokas.21:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
brAhmaNA na garIyA.nso garIyA.nste patiH kRRitaH |
