gRRihasthadharme vartantI brAhmaNAnavamanyase
shlokas.22:
indro.apyeShAM praNamate kiM punarmAnuShA bhuvi |
avalipte na jAnIShe vRRiddhAnAM na shrutaM tvayA
brAhmaNA hyagnisadRRishA daheyuH pRRithivImapi
shlokas.23:
stryuvAcha||
nAvajAnAmyahaM viprAndevaistulyAnmanasvinaH |
aparAdhamimaM vipra kShantumarhasi me.anagha
shlokas.24:
jAnAmi tejo viprANAM mahAbhAgyaM cha dhImatAm |
apeyaH sAgaraH krodhAtkRRito hi lavaNodakaH
shlokas.25:
tathaiva dIptatapasAM munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
yeShAM krodhAgniradyApi daNDake nopashAmyati
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNAnAM paribhavAdvAtApishcha durAtmavAn |
agastyamRRiShimAsAdya jIrNaH krUro mahAsuraH
shlokas.27:
prabhAvA bahavashchApi shrUyante brahmavAdinAm |
krodhaH suvipulo brahmanprasAdashcha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.28:
asmi.nstvatikrame brahmankShantumarhasi me.anagha |
patishushrUShayA dharmo yaH sa me rochate dvija
shlokas.29:
daivateShvapi sarveShu bhartA me daivataM param |
avisheSheNa tasyAhaM kuryAM dharmaM dvijottama
shlokas.30:
shushrUShAyAH phalaM pashya patyurbrAhmaNa yAdRRisham |
balAkA hi tvayA dagdhA roShAttadviditaM mama
shlokas.31:
krodhaH shatruH sharIrastho manuShyANAM dvijottama |
yaH krodhamohau tyajati taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.32:
yo vadediha satyAni guruM santoShayeta cha |
hi.nsitashcha na hi.nseta taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.33:
jitendriyo dharmaparaH svAdhyAyanirataH shuchiH |
kAmakrodhau vashe yasya taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.34:
yasya chAtmasamo loko dharmaj~nasya manasvinaH |
sarvadharmeShu cha ratastaM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.35:
yo.adhyApayedadhIyIta yajedvA yAjayIta vA |
dadyAdvApi yathAshakti taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.36:
brahmachArI cha vedAnyo adhIyIta dvijottamaH |
svAdhyAye chApramatto vai taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.37:
yadbrAhmaNAnAM kushalaM tadeShAM parikIrtayet |
satyaM tathA vyAharatAM nAnRRite ramate manaH
shlokas.38:
dhanaM tu brAhmaNasyAhuH svAdhyAyaM damamArjavam |
indriyANAM nigrahaM cha shAshvataM dvijasattama
satyArjave dharmamAhuH paraM dharmavido janAH
shlokas.39:
durj~neyaH shAshvato dharmaH sa tu satye pratiShThitaH |
shrutipramANo dharmaH syAditi vRRiddhAnushAsanam
shlokas.40:
bahudhA dRRishyate dharmaH sUkShma eva dvijottama |
bhavAnapi cha dharmaj~naH svAdhyAyanirataH shuchiH
na tu tattvena bhagavandharmAnvetsIti me matiH
shlokas.41:
mAtApitRRibhyAM shushrUShuH satyavAdI jitendriyaH |
mithilAyAM vasanvyAdhaH sa te dharmAnpravakShyati
tatra gachChasva bhadraM te yathAkAmaM dvijottama
shlokas.42:
atyuktamapi me sarvaM kShantumarhasyanindita |
striyo hyavadhyAH sarveShAM ye dharmaviduSho janAH
shlokas.43:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
prIto.asmi tava bhadraM te gataH krodhashcha shobhane |
upAlambhastvayA hyukto mama niHshreyasaM param
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi sAdhayiShyAmi shobhane
shlokas.44:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tayA visRRiShTo nirgamya svameva bhavanaM yayau |
vinindansa dvijo.a.atmAnaM kaushiko narasattama

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
chintayitvA tadAshcharyaM striyA proktamasheShataH |
vinindansa dvijo.a.atmAnamAgaskRRita ivAbabhau
shlokas.2:
chintayAnaH sa dharmasya sUkShmAM gatimathAbravIt |
shraddadhAnena bhAvyaM vai gachChAmi mithilAmaham
shlokas.3:
kRRitAtmA dharmavittasyAM vyAdho nivasate kila |
taM gachChAmyahamadyaiva dharmaM praShTuM tapodhanam
shlokas.4:
iti sa~nchintya manasA shraddadhAnaH striyA vachaH |
balAkApratyayenAsau dharmyaishcha vachanaiH shubhaiH
sampratasthe sa mithilAM kautUhalasamanvitaH
shlokas.5:
atikrAmannaraNyAni grAmA.nshcha nagarANi cha |
tato jagAma mithilAM janakena surakShitAm
shlokas.6:
dharmasetusamAkIrNAM yaj~notsavavatIM shubhAm |
gopurATTAlakavatIM gRRihaprAkArashobhitAm
shlokas.7:
pravishya sa purIM ramyAM vimAnairbahubhirvRRitAm |
paNyaishcha bahubhiryuktAM suvibhaktamahApathAm
shlokas.8:
ashvai rathaistathA nAgairyAnaishcha bahubhirvRRitAm |
hRRiShTapuShTajanAkIrNAM nityotsavasamAkulAm
shlokas.9:
so.apashyadbahuvRRittAntAM brAhmaNaH samatikraman |
dharmavyAdhamapRRichChachcha sa chAsya kathito dvijaiH
shlokas.10:
apashyattatra gatvA taM sUnAmadhye vyavasthitam |
mArgamAhiShamA.nsAni vikrINantaM tapasvinam
AkulatvAttu kretR^INAmekAnte sa.nsthito dvijaH
shlokas.11:
sa tu j~nAtvA dvijaM prAptaM sahasA sambhramotthitaH |
AjagAma yato vipraH sthita ekAnta Asane
shlokas.12:
vyAdha uvAcha||
abhivAdaye tvA bhagavansvAgataM te dvijottama |
ahaM vyAdhastu bhadraM te kiM karomi prashAdhi mAm
shlokas.13:
ekapatnyA yadukto.asi gachCha tvaM mithilAmiti |
jAnAmyetadahaM sarvaM yadarthaM tvamihAgataH
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shrutvA tu tasya tadvAkyaM sa vipro bhRRishaharShitaH |
dvitIyamidamAshcharyamityachintayata dvijaH
shlokas.15:
adeshasthaM hi te sthAnamiti vyAdho.abravIddvijam |
gRRihaM gachChAva bhagavanyadi rochayase.anagha
shlokas.16:
bADhamityeva saMhRRiShTo vipro vachanamabravIt |
agratastu dvijaM kRRitvA sa jagAma gRRihAnprati
shlokas.17:
pravishya cha gRRihaM ramyamAsanenAbhipUjitaH |
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha pratigRRihya dvijottamaH
shlokas.18:
tataH sukhopaviShTastaM vyAdhaM vachanamabravIt |
karmaitadvai na sadRRishaM bhavataH pratibhAti me
anutapye bhRRishaM tAta tava ghoreNa karmaNA
shlokas.19:
vyAdha uvAcha||
kulochitamidaM karma pitRRipaitAmahaM mama |
vartamAnasya me dharme sve manyuM mA kRRithA dvija
shlokas.20:
dhAtrA tu vihitaM pUrvaM karma svaM pAlayAmyaham |
prayatnAchcha gurU vRRiddhau shushrUShe.ahaM dvijottama
shlokas.21:
satyaM vade nAbhyasUye yathAshakti dadAmi cha |
devatAtithibhRRityAnAmavashiShTena vartaye
shlokas.22:
na kutsayAmyahaM ki~nchinna garhe balavattaram |
kRRitamanveti kartAraM purA karma dvijottama
shlokas.23:
kRRiShigorakShyavANijyamiha lokasya jIvanam |
daNDanItistrayI vidyA tena lokA bhavantyuta
shlokas.24:
karma shUdre kRRiShirvaishye sa~NgrAmaH kShatriye smRRitaH |
brahmacharyaM tapo mantrAH satyaM cha brAhmaNe sadA
shlokas.25:
rAjA prashAsti dharmeNa svakarmaniratAH prajAH |
vikarmANashcha ye kechittAnyunakti svakarmasu
shlokas.26:
bhetavyaM hi sadA rAj~nAM prajAnAmadhipA hi te |
mArayanti vikarmasthaM lubdhA mRRigamiveShubhiH
shlokas.27:
janakasyeha viprarShe vikarmastho na vidyate |
svakarmaniratA varNAshchatvAro.api dvijottama
shlokas.28:
sa eSha janako rAjA durvRRittamapi chetsutam |
daNDyaM daNDe nikShipati tathA na glAti dhArmikam
shlokas.29:
suyuktachAro nRRipatiH sarvaM dharmeNa pashyati |
shrIshcha rAjyaM cha daNDashcha kShatriyANAM dvijottama
shlokas.30:
rAjAno hi svadharmeNa shriyamichChanti bhUyasIm |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM trAtA rAjA bhavatyuta
shlokas.31:
pareNa hi hatAnbrahmanvarAhamahiShAnaham |
na svayaM hanmi viprarShe vikrINAmi sadA tvaham
shlokas.32:
na bhakShayAmi mA.nsAni RRitugAmI tathA hyaham |
sadopavAsI cha tathA naktabhojI tathA dvija
shlokas.33:
ashIlashchApi puruSho bhUtvA bhavati shIlavAn |
prANihi.nsAratashchApi bhavate dhArmikaH punaH
shlokas.34:
vyabhichArAnnarendrANAM dharmaH sa~NkIryate mahAn |
adharmo vardhate chApi sa~NkIryante tathA prajAH
shlokas.35:
uruNDA vAmanAH kubjAH sthUlashIrShAstathaiva cha |
klIbAshchAndhAshcha jAyante badhirA lambachUchukAH
pArthivAnAmadharmatvAtprajAnAmabhavaH sadA
shlokas.36:
sa eSha rAjA janakaH sarvaM dharmeNa pashyati |
anugRRihNanprajAH sarvAH svadharmaniratAH sadA
shlokas.37:
ye chaiva mAM prasha.nsanti ye cha nindanti mAnavAH |
sarvAnsupariNItena karmaNA toShayAmyaham
shlokas.38:
ye jIvanti svadharmeNa sambhu~njante cha pArthivAH |
na ki~nchidupajIvanti dakShA utthAnashIlinaH
shlokas.39:
shaktyAnnadAnaM satataM titikShA dharmanityatA |
yathArhaM pratipUjA cha sarvabhUteShu vai dayA
tyAgAnnAnyatra martyAnAM guNAstiShThanti pUruShe
shlokas.40:
mRRiShAvAdaM pariharetkuryAtpriyamayAchitaH |
na cha kAmAnna sa.nrambhAnna dveShAddharmamutsRRijet
shlokas.41:
priye nAtibhRRishaM hRRiShyedapriye na cha sa~njvaret |
na muhyedarthakRRichChreShu na cha dharmaM parityajet
shlokas.42:
karma chetki~nchidanyatsyAditaranna samAcharet |
yatkalyANamabhidhyAyettatrAtmAnaM niyojayet
shlokas.43:
na pApaM prati pApaH syAtsAdhureva sadA bhavet |
Atmanaiva hataH pApo yaH pApaM kartumichChati
shlokas.44:
karma chaitadasAdhUnAM vRRijinAnAmasAdhuvat |
na dharmo.astIti manvAnAH shuchInavahasanti ye
ashraddadhAnA dharmasya te nashyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.45:
mahAdRRitirivAdhmAtaH pApo bhavati nityadA |
mUDhAnAmavaliptAnAmasAraM bhAShitaM bhavet
darshayatyantarAtmAnaM divA rUpamivA.nshumAn
shlokas.46:
na loke rAjate mUrkhaH kevalAtmaprasha.nsayA |
api cheha mRRijA hInaH kRRitavidyaH prakAshate
shlokas.47:
abruvankasyachinnindAmAtmapUjAmavarNayan |
na kashchidguNasampannaH prakAsho bhuvi dRRishyate
shlokas.48:
vikarmaNA tapyamAnaH pApAdviparimuchyate |
naitatkuryAM punariti dvitIyAtparimuchyate
shlokas.49:
karmaNA yena teneha pApAddvijavarottama |
evaM shrutiriyaM brahmandharmeShu paridRRishyate
shlokas.50:
pApAnyabuddhveha purA kRRitAni; prAgdharmashIlo vinihanti pashchAt |
dharmo brahmannudate pUruShANAM; yatkurvate pApamiha pramAdAt
shlokas.51:
pApaM kRRitvA hi manyeta nAhamasmIti pUruShaH |
chikIrShedeva kalyANaM shraddadhAno.anasUyakaH
shlokas.52:
vasanasyeva ChidrANi sAdhUnAM vivRRiNoti yaH |
pApaM chetpuruShaH kRRitvA kalyANamabhipadyate
muchyate sarvapApebhyo mahAbhrairiva chandramAH
shlokas.53:
yathAdityaH samudyanvai tamaH sarvaM vyapohati |
evaM kalyANamAtiShThansarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.54:
pApAnAM viddhyadhiShThAnaM lobhameva dvijottama |
lubdhAH pApaM vyavasyanti narA nAtibahushrutAH
adharmA dharmarUpeNa tRRiNaiH kUpA ivAvRRitAH
shlokas.55:
teShAM damaH pavitrANi pralApA dharmasa.nshritAH |
sarvaM hi vidyate teShu shiShTAchAraH sudurlabhaH
shlokas.56:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sa tu vipro mahAprAj~no dharmavyAdhamapRRichChata |
shiShTAchAraM kathamahaM vidyAmiti narottama
etanmahAmate vyAdha prabravIhi yathAtatham
shlokas.57:
vyAdha uvAcha||
yaj~no dAnaM tapo vedAH satyaM cha dvijasattama |
pa~nchaitAni pavitrANi shiShTAchAreShu nityadA
shlokas.58:
kAmakrodhau vashe kRRitvA dambhaM lobhamanArjavam |
dharma ityeva santuShTAste shiShTAH shiShTasaMmatAH
shlokas.59:
na teShAM vidyate.avRRittaM yaj~nasvAdhyAyashIlinAm |
AchArapAlanaM chaiva dvitIyaM shiShTalakShaNam
shlokas.60:
gurushushrUShaNaM satyamakrodho dAnameva cha |
etachchatuShTayaM brahma~nshiShTAchAreShu nityadA
shlokas.61:
shiShTAchAre manaH kRRitvA pratiShThApya cha sarvashaH |
yAmayaM labhate tuShTiM sA na shakyA hyato.anyathA
shlokas.62:
vedasyopaniShatsatyaM satyasyopaniShaddamaH |
damasyopaniShattyAgaH shiShTAchAreShu nityadA
shlokas.63:
ye tu dharmamasUyante buddhimohAnvitA narAH |
apathA gachChatAM teShAmanuyAtApi pIDyate
shlokas.64:
ye tu shiShTAH suniyatAH shrutityAgaparAyaNAH |
dharmyaM panthAnamArUDhAH satyadharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.65:
niyachChanti parAM buddhiM shiShTAchArAnvitA narAH |
upAdhyAyamate yuktAH sthityA dharmArthadarshinaH
shlokas.66:
nAstikAnbhinnamaryAdAnkrUrAnpApamatau sthitAn |
tyaja tA~nj~nAnamAshritya dhArmikAnupasevya cha
shlokas.67:
kAmalobhagrahAkIrNAM pa~nchendriyajalAM nadIm |
nAvaM dhRRitimayIM kRRitvA janmadurgANi santara
shlokas.68:
krameNa sa~nchito dharmo buddhiyogamayo mahAn |
shiShTAchAre bhavetsAdhU rAgaH shukleva vAsasi
shlokas.69:
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM sarvabhUtahitaM param |
ahi.nsA paramo dharmaH sa cha satye pratiShThitaH
satye kRRitvA pratiShThAM tu pravartante pravRRittayaH
shlokas.70:
satyameva garIyastu shiShTAchAraniShevitam |
AchArashcha satAM dharmaH santashchAchAralakShaNAH
shlokas.71:
yo yathAprakRRitirjantuH svAM svAM prakRRitimashnute |
pApAtmA krodhakAmAdIndoShAnApnotyanAtmavAn
shlokas.72:
Arambho nyAyayukto yaH sa hi dharma iti smRRitaH |
anAchArastvadharmeti etachChiShTAnushAsanam
shlokas.73:
akrudhyanto.anasUyanto niraha~NkAramatsarAH |
RRijavaH shamasampannAH shiShTAchArA bhavanti te
shlokas.74:
traividyavRRiddhAH shuchayo vRRittavanto manasvinaH |
gurushushrUShavo dAntAH shiShTAchArA bhavantyuta
shlokas.75:
teShAmadInasattvAnAM duShkarAchArakarmaNAm |
svaiH karmabhiH satkRRitAnAM ghoratvaM sampraNashyati
shlokas.76:
taM sadAchAramAshcharyaM purANaM shAshvataM dhruvam |
dharmaM dharmeNa pashyantaH svargaM yAnti manIShiNaH
shlokas.77:
AstikA mAnahInAshcha dvijAtijanapUjakAH |
shrutavRRittopasampannAH te santaH svargagAminaH
shlokas.78:
vedoktaH paramo dharmo dharmashAstreShu chAparaH |
shiShTAchIrNashcha shiShTAnAM trividhaM dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.79:
pAraNaM chApi vidyAnAM tIrthAnAmavagAhanam |
kShamA satyArjavaM shauchaM shiShTAchAranidarshanam
shlokas.80:
sarvabhUtadayAvanto ahi.nsAniratAH sadA |
paruShaM na prabhAShante sadA santo dvijapriyAH
shlokas.81:
shubhAnAmashubhAnAM cha karmaNAM phalasa~nchaye |
vipAkamabhijAnanti te shiShTAH shiShTasaMmatAH
shlokas.82:
nyAyopetA guNopetAH sarvalokahitaiShiNaH |
santaH svargajitaH shuklAH saMniviShTAshcha satpathe
shlokas.83:
dAtAraH sa.nvibhaktAro dInAnugrahakAriNaH |
sarvabhUtadayAvantaste shiShTAH shiShTasaMmatAH
shlokas.84:
sarvapUjyAH shrutadhanAstathaiva cha tapasvinaH |
dAnanityAH sukhA.NllokAnApnuvantIha cha shriyam
shlokas.85:
pIDayA cha kalatrasya bhRRityAnAM cha samAhitAH |
atishaktyA prayachChanti santaH sadbhiH samAgatAH
shlokas.86:
lokayAtrAM cha pashyanto dharmamAtmahitAni cha |
evaM santo vartamAnA edhante shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.87:
ahi.nsA satyavachanamAnRRisha.nsyamathArjavam |
adroho nAtimAnashcha hrIstitikShA damaH shamaH
shlokas.88:
dhImanto dhRRitimantashcha bhUtAnAmanukampakAH |
akAmadveShasa.nyuktAste santo lokasatkRRitAH
shlokas.89:
trINyeva tu padAnyAhuH satAM vRRittamanuttamam |
na druhyechchaiva dadyAchcha satyaM chaiva sadA vadet
shlokas.90:
sarvatra cha dayAvantaH santaH karuNavedinaH |
gachChantIha susantuShTA dharmyaM panthAnamuttamam
shiShTAchArA mahAtmAno yeShAM dharmaH sunishchitaH
shlokas.91:
anasUyA kShamA shAntiH santoShaH priyavAditA |
kAmakrodhaparityAgaH shiShTAchAraniShevaNam
shlokas.92:
karmaNA shrutasampannaM satAM mArgamanuttamam |
shiShTAchAraM niShevante nityaM dharmeShvatandritAH
shlokas.93:
praj~nAprAsAdamAruhya muhyato mahato janAn |
prekShanto lokavRRittAni vividhAni dvijottama
atipuNyAni pApAni tAni dvijavarottama
shlokas.94:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathApraj~naM yathAshrutam |
shiShTAchAraguNAnbrahmanpuraskRRitya dvijarShabha

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sa tu vipramathovAcha dharmavyAdho yudhiShThira |
yadahaM hyAchare karma ghorametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.2:
vidhistu balavAnbrahmandustaraM hi purAkRRitam |
purAkRRitasya pApasya karmadoSho bhavatyayam
doShasyaitasya vai brahmanvighAte yatnavAnaham
shlokas.3:
vidhinA vihite pUrvaM nimittaM ghAtako bhavet |
nimittabhUtA hi vayaM karmaNo.asya dvijottama
shlokas.4:
yeShAM hatAnAM mA.nsAni vikrINAmo vayaM dvija |
teShAmapi bhaveddharma upabhogena bhakShaNAt
devatAtithibhRRityAnAM pitR^INAM pratipUjanAt
shlokas.5:
oShadhyo vIrudhashchApi pashavo mRRigapakShiNaH |
annAdyabhUtA lokasya ityapi shrUyate shrutiH
shlokas.6:
AtmamA.nsapradAnena shibiraushInaro nRRipaH |
svargaM sudurlabhaM prAptaH kShamAvAndvijasattama
shlokas.7:
rAj~no mahAnase pUrvaM rantidevasya vai dvija |
dve sahasre tu vadhyete pashUnAmanvahaM tadA
shlokas.8:
samA.nsaM dadato hyannaM rantidevasya nityashaH |
atulA kIrtirabhavannRRipasya dvijasattama
chAturmAsyeShu pashavo vadhyanta iti nityashaH
shlokas.9:
agnayo mA.nsakAmAshcha ityapi shrUyate shrutiH |
yaj~neShu pashavo brahmanvadhyante satataM dvijaiH
sa.nskRRitAH kila mantraishcha te.api svargamavApnuvan
shlokas.10:
yadi naivAgnayo brahmanmA.nsakAmAbhavanpurA |
bhakShyaM naiva bhavenmA.nsaM kasyachiddvijasattama
shlokas.11:
atrApi vidhiruktashcha munibhirmA.nsabhakShaNe |
devatAnAM pitR^INAM cha bhu~Nkte dattvA tu yaH sadA
yathAvidhi yathAshraddhaM na sa duShyati bhakShaNAt
shlokas.12:
amA.nsAshI bhavatyevamityapi shrUyate shrutiH |
bhAryAM gachChanbrahmachArI RRitau bhavati brAhmaNaH
shlokas.13:
satyAnRRite vinishchitya atrApi vidhiruchyate |
saudAsena purA rAj~nA mAnuShA bhakShitA dvija
shApAbhibhUtena bhRRishamatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.14:
svadharma iti kRRitvA tu na tyajAmi dvijottama |
purAkRRitamiti j~nAtvA jIvAmyetena karmaNA
shlokas.15:
svakarma tyajato brahmannadharma iha dRRishyate |
svakarmanirato yastu sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.16:
pUrvaM hi vihitaM karma dehinaM na vimu~nchati |
dhAtrA vidhirayaM dRRiShTo bahudhA karmanirNaye
shlokas.17:
draShTavyaM tu bhavetprAj~na krUre karmaNi vartatA |
kathaM karma shubhaM kuryAM kathaM muchye parAbhavAt
karmaNastasya ghorasya bahudhA nirNayo bhavet
shlokas.18:
dAne cha satyavAkye cha gurushushrUShaNe tathA |
dvijAtipUjane chAhaM dharme cha nirataH sadA
ativAdAtimAnAbhyAM nivRRitto.asmi dvijottama
shlokas.19:
kRRiShiM sAdhviti manyante tatra hi.nsA parA smRRitA |
karShanto lA~NgalaiH pu.nso ghnanti bhUmishayAnbahUn
jIvAnanyA.nshcha bahushastatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.20:
dhAnyabIjAni yAnyAhurvrIhyAdIni dvijottama |
sarvANyetAni jIvAni tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.21:
adhyAkramya pashU.nshchApi ghnanti vai bhakShayanti cha |
vRRikShAnathauShadhIshchaiva Chindanti puruShA dvija
shlokas.22:
jIvA hi bahavo brahmanvRRikSheShu cha phaleShu cha |
udake bahavashchApi tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.23:
sarvaM vyAptamidaM brahmanprANibhiH prANijIvanaiH |
matsyA grasante matsyA.nshcha tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.24:
sattvaiH sattvAni jIvanti bahudhA dvijasattama |
prANino.anyonyabhakShAshcha tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.25:
cha~NkramyamANA jIvA.nshcha dharaNIsa.nshritAnbahUn |
padbhyAM ghnanti narA vipra tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.26:
upaviShTAH shayAnAshcha ghnanti jIvAnanekashaH |
j~nAnavij~nAnavantashcha tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.27:
jIvairgrastamidaM sarvamAkAshaM pRRithivI tathA |
avij~nAnAchcha hi.nsanti tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.28:
ahi.nseti yaduktaM hi puruShairvismitaiH purA |
ke na hi.nsanti jIvanvai loke.asmindvijasattama
bahu sa~nchintya iha vai nAsti kashchidahi.nsakaH
shlokas.29:
ahi.nsAyAM tu niratA yatayo dvijasattama |
kurvantyeva hi hi.nsAM te yatnAdalpatarA bhavet
shlokas.30:
AlakShyAshchaiva puruShAH kule jAtA mahAguNAH |
mahAghorANi karmANi kRRitvA lajjanti vai na cha
shlokas.31:
suhRRidaH suhRRido.anyA.nshcha durhRRidashchApi durhRRidaH |
samyakpravRRittAnpuruShAnna samyaganupashyataH
shlokas.32:
samRRiddhaishcha na nandanti bAndhavA bAndhavairapi |
gurU.nshchaiva vinindanti mUDhAH paNDitamAninaH
shlokas.33:
bahu loke viparyastaM dRRishyate dvijasattama |
dharmayuktamadharmaM cha tatra kiM pratibhAti te
shlokas.34:
vaktuM bahuvidhaM shakyaM dharmAdharmeShu karmasu |
svakarmanirato yo hi sa yashaH prApnuyAnmahat

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
dharmavyAdhastu nipuNaM punareva yudhiShThira |
viprarShabhamuvAchedaM sarvadharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.2:
shrutipramANo dharmo hi vRRiddhAnAmiti bhAShitam |
sUkShmA gatirhi dharmasya bahushAkhA hyanantikA
shlokas.3:
prANAtyaye vivAhe cha vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet |
anRRitaM cha bhavetsatyaM satyaM chaivAnRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.4:
yadbhUtahitamatyantaM tatsatyamiti dhAraNA |
viparyayakRRito.adharmaH pashya dharmasya sUkShmatAm
shlokas.5:
yatkarotyashubhaM karma shubhaM vA dvijasattama |
avashyaM tatsamApnoti puruSho nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.6:
viShamAM cha dashAM prApya devAngarhati vai bhRRisham |
AtmanaH karmadoShANi na vijAnAtyapaNDitaH
shlokas.7:
mUDho naikRRitikashchApi chapalashcha dvijottama |
sukhaduHkhaviparyAso yadA samupapadyate
nainaM praj~nA sunItaM vA trAyate naiva pauruSham
shlokas.8:
yo yamichChedyathA kAmaM taM taM kAmaM samashnuyAt |
yadi syAdaparAdhInaM puruShasya kriyAphalam
shlokas.9:
sa.nyatAshchApi dakShAshcha matimantashcha mAnavAH |
dRRishyante niShphalAH santaH prahINAH sarvakarmabhiH
shlokas.10:
bhUtAnAmaparaH kashchiddhi.nsAyAM satatotthitaH |
va~nchanAyAM cha lokasya sa sukheneha jIvati
shlokas.11:
acheShTamAnamAsInaM shrIH ka~nchidupatiShThati |
kashchitkarmANi kurvanhi na prApyamadhigachChati
shlokas.12:
devAniShTvA tapastaptvA kRRipaNaiH putragRRiddhibhiH |
dashamAsadhRRitA garbhe jAyante kulapA.nsanAH
shlokas.13:
apare dhanadhAnyaishcha bhogaishcha pitRRisa~nchitaiH |
vipulairabhijAyante labdhAstaireva ma~NgalaiH
shlokas.14:
karmajA hi manuShyANAM rogA nAstyatra sa.nshayaH |
Adhibhishchaiva bAdhyante vyAdhaiH kShudramRRigA iva
shlokas.15:
te chApi kushalairvaidyairnipuNaiH sambhRRitauShadhaiH |
vyAdhayo vinivAryante mRRigA vyAdhairiva dvija
shlokas.16:
yeShAmasti cha bhoktavyaM grahaNIdoShapIDitAH |
na shaknuvanti te bhoktuM pashya dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.17:
apare bAhubalinaH klishyante bahavo janAH |
duHkhena chAdhigachChanti bhojanaM dvijasattama
shlokas.18:
iti lokamanAkrandaM mohashokapariplutam |
srotasAsakRRidAkShiptaM hriyamANaM balIyasA
shlokas.19:
na mriyeyurna jIryeyuH sarve syuH sArvakAmikAH |
nApriyaM pratipashyeyurvashitvaM yadi vai bhavet
shlokas.20:
uparyupari lokasya sarvo gantuM samIhate |
yatate cha yathAshakti na cha tadvartate tathA
shlokas.21:
bahavaH sampradRRishyante tulyanakShatrama~NgalAH |
mahachcha phalavaiShamyaM dRRishyate karmasandhiShu
shlokas.22:
na kashchidIshate brahmansvaya~NgrAhasya sattama |
karmaNAM prAkRRitAnAM vai iha siddhiH pradRRishyate
shlokas.23:
yathA shrutiriyaM brahma~njIvaH kila sanAtanaH |
sharIramadhruvaM loke sarveShAM prANinAmiha
shlokas.24:
vadhyamAne sharIre tu dehanAsho bhavatyuta |
jIvaH sa~Nkramate.anyatra karmabandhanibandhanaH
shlokas.25:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kathaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha jIvo bhavati shAshvataH |
etadichChAmyahaM j~nAtuM tattvena vadatAM vara
shlokas.26:
vyAdha uvAcha||
na jIvanAsho.asti hi dehabhede; mithyaitadAhurmriyateti mUDhAH |
jIvastu dehAntaritaH prayAti; dashArdhataivAsya sharIrabhedaH
shlokas.27:
anyo hi nAshnAti kRRitaM hi karma; sa eva kartA sukhaduHkhabhAgI |
yattena ki~nchiddhi kRRitaM hi karma; tadashnute nAsti kRRitasya nAshaH
shlokas.28:
apuNyashIlAshcha bhavanti puNyA; narottamAH pApakRRito bhavanti |
naro.anuyAtastviha karmabhiH svai;stataH samutpadyati bhAvitastaiH
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kathaM sambhavate yonau kathaM vA puNyapApayoH |
jAtIH puNyA hyapuNyAshcha kathaM gachChati sattama
shlokas.30:
vyAdha uvAcha||
garbhAdhAnasamAyuktaM karmedaM sampradRRishyate |
samAsena tu te kShipraM pravakShyAmi dvijottama
shlokas.31:
yathA sambhRRitasambhAraH punareva prajAyate |
shubhakRRichChubhayonIShu pApakRRitpApayoniShu
shlokas.32:
shubhaiH prayogairdevatvaM vyAmishrairmAnuSho bhavet |
mohanIyairviyonIShu tvadhogAmI cha kilbiShaiH
shlokas.33:
jAtimRRityujarAduHkhaiH satataM samabhidrutaH |
sa.nsAre pachyamAnashcha doShairAtmakRRitairnaraH
shlokas.34:
tiryagyonisahasrANi gatvA narakameva cha |
jIvAH samparivartante karmabandhanibandhanAH
shlokas.35:
jantustu karmabhistaistaiH svakRRitaiH pretya duHkhitaH |
tadduHkhapratighAtArthamapuNyAM yonimashnute
shlokas.36:
tataH karma samAdatte punaranyannavaM bahu |
pachyate tu punastena bhuktvApathyamivAturaH
shlokas.37:
ajasrameva duHkhArto.aduHkhitaH sukhasa~nj~nitaH |
tato.anivRRittabandhatvAtkarmaNAmudayAdapi
parikrAmati sa.nsAre chakravadbahuvedanaH
shlokas.38:
sa chennivRRittabandhastu vishuddhashchApi karmabhiH |
prApnoti sukRRitA.NllokAnyatra gatvA na shochati
shlokas.39:
pApaM kurvanpApavRRittaH pApasyAntaM na gachChati |
tasmAtpuNyaM yatetkartuM varjayeta cha pAtakam
shlokas.40:
anasUyuH kRRitaj~nashcha kalyANAnyeva sevate |
sukhAni dharmamarthaM cha svargaM cha labhate naraH
shlokas.41:
sa.nskRRitasya hi dAntasya niyatasya yatAtmanaH |
prAj~nasyAnantarA vRRittiriha loke paratra cha
shlokas.42:
satAM dharmeNa varteta kriyAM shiShTavadAcharet |
asa~Nkleshena lokasya vRRittiM lipseta vai dvija
shlokas.43:
santi hyAgatavij~nAnAH shiShTAH shAstravichakShaNAH |
svadharmeNa kriyA loke karmaNaH so.apyasa~NkaraH
shlokas.44:
prAj~no dharmeNa ramate dharmaM chaivopajIvati |
tasya dharmAdavApteShu dhaneShu dvijasattama
tasyaiva si~nchate mUlaM guNAnpashyati yatra vai
shlokas.45:
dharmAtmA bhavati hyevaM chittaM chAsya prasIdati |
sa maitrajanasantuShTa iha pretya cha nandati
shlokas.46:
shabdaM sparshaM tathA rUpaM gandhAniShTA.nshcha sattama |
prabhutvaM labhate chApi dharmasyaitatphalaM viduH
shlokas.47:
dharmasya cha phalaM labdhvA na tRRipyati mahAdvija |
atRRipyamANo nirvedamAdatte j~nAnachakShuShA
shlokas.48:
praj~nAchakShurnara iha doShaM naivAnurudhyate |
virajyati yathAkAmaM na cha dharmaM vimu~nchati
shlokas.49:
sarvatyAge cha yatate dRRiShTvA lokaM kShayAtmakam |
tato mokShe prayatate nAnupAyAdupAyataH
shlokas.50:
evaM nirvedamAdatte pApaM karma jahAti cha |
dhArmikashchApi bhavati mokShaM cha labhate param
shlokas.51:
tapo niHshreyasaM jantostasya mUlaM shamo damaH |
tena sarvAnavApnoti kAmAnyAnmanasechChati
shlokas.52:
indriyANAM nirodhena satyena cha damena cha |
brahmaNaH padamApnoti yatparaM dvijasattama
shlokas.53:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
indriyANi tu yAnyAhuH kAni tAni yatavrata |
nigrahashcha kathaM kAryo nigrahasya cha kiM phalam
shlokas.54:
kathaM cha phalamApnoti teShAM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
etadichChAmi tattvena dharmaM j~nAtuM sudhArmika

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktastu vipreNa dharmavyAdho yudhiShThira |
pratyuvAcha yathA vipraM tachChRRiNuShva narAdhipa
shlokas.2:
vyAdha uvAcha||
vij~nAnArthaM manuShyANAM manaH pUrvaM pravartate |
tatprApya kAmaM bhajate krodhaM cha dvijasattama
shlokas.3:
tatastadarthaM yatate karma chArabhate mahat |
iShTAnAM rUpagandhAnAmabhyAsaM cha niShevate
shlokas.4:
tato rAgaH prabhavati dveShashcha tadanantaram |
tato lobhaH prabhavati mohashcha tadanantaram
shlokas.5:
tasya lobhAbhibhUtasya rAgadveShahatasya cha |
na dharme jAyate buddhirvyAjAddharmaM karoti cha
shlokas.6:
vyAjena charate dharmamarthaM vyAjena rochate |
vyAjena sidhyamAneShu dhaneShu dvijasattama
tatraiva ramate buddhistataH pApaM chikIrShati
shlokas.7:
suhRRidbhirvAryamANashcha paNDitaishcha dvijottama |
uttaraM shrutisambaddhaM bravIti shrutiyojitam
shlokas.8:
adharmastrividhastasya vardhate rAgadoShataH |
pApaM chintayate chApi bravIti cha karoti cha
shlokas.9:
tasyAdharmapravRRittasya guNA nashyanti sAdhavaH |
ekashIlAshcha mitratvaM bhajante pApakarmiNaH
shlokas.10:
sa tenAsukhamApnoti paratra cha vihanyate |
pApAtmA bhavati hyevaM dharmalAbhaM tu me shRRiNu
shlokas.11:
yastvetAnpraj~nayA doShAnpUrvamevAnupashyati |
kushalaH sukhaduHkheShu sAdhU.nshchApyupasevate
tasya sAdhusamArambhAdbuddhirdharmeShu jAyate
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
bravIShi sUnRRitaM dharmaM yasya vaktA na vidyate |
divyaprabhAvaH sumahAnRRiShireva mato.asi me
shlokas.13:
vyAdha uvAcha||
brAhmaNA vai mahAbhAgAH pitaro.agrabhujaH sadA |
teShAM sarvAtmanA kAryaM priyaM loke manIShiNA
shlokas.14:
yatteShAM cha priyaM tatte vakShyAmi dvijasattama |
namaskRRitvA brAhmaNebhyo brAhmIM vidyAM nibodha me
shlokas.15:
idaM vishvaM jagatsarvamajayyaM chApi sarvashaH |
mahAbhUtAtmakaM brahmannAtaH parataraM bhavet
shlokas.16:
mahAbhUtAni khaM vAyuragnirApastathA cha bhUH |
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha tadguNAH
shlokas.17:
teShAmapi guNAH sarve guNavRRittiH parasparam |
pUrvapUrvaguNAH sarve kramasho guNiShu triShu
shlokas.18:
ShaShThastu chetanA nAma mana ityabhidhIyate |
saptamI tu bhavedbuddhiraha~NkArastataH param
shlokas.19:
indriyANi cha pa~nchaiva rajaH sattvaM tamastathA |
ityeSha saptadashako rAshiravyaktasa~nj~nakaH
shlokas.20:
sarvairihendriyArthaistu vyaktAvyaktaiH susa.nvRRitaH |
chaturvi.nshaka ityeSha vyaktAvyaktamayo guNaH
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyo shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa viprastu dharmavyAdhena bhArata |
kathAmakathayadbhUyo manasaH prItivardhanIm
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNa||
mahAbhUtAni yAnyAhuH pa~ncha dharmavidAM vara |
ekaikasya guNAnsamyakpa~nchAnAmapi me vada
shlokas.3:
vyAdha uvAcha||
bhUmirApastathA jyotirvAyurAkAshameva cha |
guNottarANi sarvANi teShAM vakShyAmi te guNAn
shlokas.4:
bhUmiH pa~nchaguNA brahmannudakaM cha chaturguNam |
guNAstrayastejasi cha trayashchAkAshavAtayoH
shlokas.5:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH |
ete guNAH pa~ncha bhUmeH sarvebhyo guNavattarAH
shlokas.6:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha rasashchApi dvijottama |
apAmete guNA brahmankIrtitAstava suvrata
shlokas.7:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha tejaso.atha guNAstrayaH |
shabdaH sparshashcha vAyau tu shabda AkAsha eva cha
shlokas.8:
ete pa~nchadasha brahmanguNA bhUteShu pa~nchasu |
vartante sarvabhUteShu yeShu lokAH pratiShThitAH
anyonyaM nAtivartante sampachcha bhavati dvija
shlokas.9:
yadA tu viShamIbhAvamAcharanti charAcharAH |
tadA dehI dehamanyaM vyatirohati kAlataH
shlokas.10:
AnupUrvyA vinashyanti jAyante chAnupUrvashaH |
tatra tatra hi dRRishyante dhAtavaH pA~nchabhautikAH
yairAvRRitamidaM sarvaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.11:
indriyaiH sRRijyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti smRRitam |
avyaktamiti vij~neyaM li~NgagrAhyamatIndriyam
shlokas.12:
yathAsvaM grAhakAnyeShAM shabdAdInAmimAni tu |
indriyANi yadA dehI dhArayanniha tapyate
shlokas.13:
loke vitatamAtmAnaM lokaM chAtmani pashyati |
parAvaraj~naH saktaH sansarvabhUtAni pashyati
shlokas.14:
pashyataH sarvabhUtAni sarvAvasthAsu sarvadA |
brahmabhUtasya sa.nyogo nAshubhenopapadyate
shlokas.15:
j~nAnamUlAtmakaM kleshamativRRittasya mohajam |
loko buddhiprakAshena j~neyamArgeNa dRRishyate
shlokas.16:
anAdinidhanaM jantumAtmayoniM sadAvyayam |
anaupamyamamUrtaM cha bhagavAnAha buddhimAn
tapomUlamidaM sarvaM yanmAM viprAnupRRichChasi
shlokas.17:
indriyANyeva tatsarvaM yatsvarganarakAvubhau |
nigRRihItavisRRiShTAni svargAya narakAya cha
shlokas.18:
eSha yogavidhiH kRRitsno yAvadindriyadhAraNam |
etanmUlaM hi tapasaH kRRitsnasya narakasya cha
shlokas.19:
indriyANAM prasa~Ngena doShamRRichChatyasa.nshayam |
saMniyamya tu tAnyeva tataH siddhimavApnute
shlokas.20:
ShaNNAmAtmani nityAnAmaishvaryaM yo.adhigachChati |
na sa pApaiH kuto.anarthairyujyate vijitendriyaH
shlokas.21:
rathaH sharIraM puruShasya dRRiShTa;mAtmA niyantendriyANyAhurashvAn |
tairapramattaH kushalI sadashvai;rdAntaiH sukhaM yAti rathIva dhIraH
shlokas.22:
ShaNNAmAtmani nityAnAmindriyANAM pramAthinAm |
yo dhIro dhArayedrashmInsa syAtparamasArathiH
shlokas.23:
indriyANAM prasRRiShTAnAM hayAnAmiva vartmasu |
dhRRitiM kurvIta sArathye dhRRityA tAni jayeddhruvam
shlokas.24:
indriyANAM hi charatAM yanmano.anuvidhIyate |
tadasya harate buddhiM nAvaM vAyurivAmbhasi
shlokas.25:
yeShu vipratipadyante ShaTsu mohAtphalAgame |
teShvadhyavasitAdhyAyI vindate dhyAnajaM phalam

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evaM tu sUkShme kathite dharmavyAdhena bhArata |
brAhmaNaH sa punaH sUkShmaM paprachCha susamAhitaH
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
sattvasya rajasashchaiva tamasashcha yathAtatham |
guNA.nstattvena me brUhi yathAvadiha pRRichChataH
shlokas.3:
vyAdha uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
eShAM guNAnpRRithaktvena nibodha gadato mama
shlokas.4:
mohAtmakaM tamasteShAM raja eShAM pravartakam |
prakAshabahulatvAchcha sattvaM jyAya ihochyate
shlokas.5:
avidyAbahulo mUDhaH svapnashIlo vichetanaH |
durdRRishIkastamodhvastaH sakrodhastAmaso.alasaH
shlokas.6:
pravRRittavAkyo mantrI cha yo.anurAgyabhyasUyakaH |
vivitsamAno viprarShe stabdho mAnI sa rAjasaH
shlokas.7:
prakAshabahulo dhIro nirvivitso.anasUyakaH |
akrodhano naro dhImAndAntashchaiva sa sAttvikaH
shlokas.8:
sAttvikastvatha sambuddho lokavRRittena klishyate |
yadA budhyati boddhavyaM lokavRRittaM jugupsate
shlokas.9:
vairAgyasya hi rUpaM tu pUrvameva pravartate |
mRRidurbhavatyaha~NkAraH prasIdatyArjavaM cha yat
shlokas.10:
tato.asya sarvadva.ndvAni prashAmyanti parasparam |
na chAsya sa.nyamo nAma kvachidbhavati kashchana
shlokas.11:
shUdrayonau hi jAtasya sadguNAnupatiShThataH |
vaishyatvaM bhavati brahmankShatriyatvaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.12:
Arjave vartamAnasya brAhmaNyamabhijAyate |
guNAste kIrtitAH sarve kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
pArthivaM dhAtumAsAdya shArIro.agniH kathaM bhavet |
avakAshavisheSheNa kathaM vartayate.anilaH
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
prashnametaM samuddiShTaM brAhmaNena yudhiShThira |
vyAdhaH sa kathayAmAsa brAhmaNAya mahAtmane
shlokas.15:
vyAdha uvAcha||
mUrdhAnamAshrito vahniH sharIraM paripAlayan |
prANo mUrdhani chAgnau cha vartamAno vicheShTate
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha sarvaM prANe pratiShThitam
shlokas.16:
shreShThaM tadeva bhUtAnAM brahmajyotirupAsmahe |
sa jantuH sarvabhUtAtmA puruShaH sa sanAtanaH
mano buddhiraha~NkAro bhUtAnAM viShayashcha saH
shlokas.17:
evaM tviha sa sarvatra prANena paripAlyate |
pRRiShThatastu samAnena svAM svAM gatimupAshritaH
shlokas.18:
bastimUle gude chaiva pAvakaH samupAshritaH |
vahanmUtraM purIShaM chApyapAnaH parivartate
shlokas.19:
prayatne karmaNi bale ya ekastriShu vartate |
udAna iti taM prAhuradhyAtmaviduSho janAH
shlokas.20:
sandhau sandhau saMniviShTaH sarveShvapi tathAnilaH |
sharIreShu manuShyANAM vyAna ityupadiShyate
shlokas.21:
dhAtuShvagnistu vitataH sa tu vAyusamIritaH |
rasAndhAtU.nshcha doShA.nshcha vartayanparidhAvati
shlokas.22:
prANAnAM saMnipAtAttu saMnipAtaH prajAyate |
UShmA chAgniriti j~neyo yo.annaM pachati dehinAm
shlokas.23:
apAnodAnayormadhye prANavyAnau samAhitau |
samanvitastvadhiShThAnaM samyakpachati pAvakaH
shlokas.24:
tasyApi pAyuparyantastathA syAdgudasa~nj~nitaH |
srotA.nsi tasmAjjAyante sarvaprANeShu dehinAm
shlokas.25:
agnivegavahaH prANo gudAnte pratihanyate |
sa UrdhvamAgamya punaH samutkShipati pAvakam
shlokas.26:
pakvAshayastvadho nAbhyA UrdhvamAmAshayaH sthitaH |
nAbhimadhye sharIrasya prANAH sarve pratiShThitAH
shlokas.27:
pravRRittA hRRidayAtsarvAstiryagUrdhvamadhastathA |
vahantyannarasAnnADyo dasha prANaprachoditAH
shlokas.28:
yoginAmeSha mArgastu yena gachChanti tatparam |
jitaklamAsanA dhIrA mUrdhanyAtmAnamAdadhuH
evaM sarveShu vitatau prANApAnau hi dehiShu
shlokas.29:
ekAdashavikArAtmA kalAsambhArasambhRRitaH |
mUrtimantaM hi taM viddhi nityaM karmajitAtmakam
shlokas.30:
tasminyaH sa.nsthito hyagnirnityaM sthAlyAmivAhitaH |
AtmAnaM taM vijAnIhi nityaM yogajitAtmakam
shlokas.31:
devo yaH sa.nsthitastasminnabbinduriva puShkare |
kShetraj~naM taM vijAnIhi nityaM tyAgajitAtmakam
shlokas.32:
jIvAtmakAni jAnIhi rajaH sattvaM tamastathA |
jIvamAtmaguNaM viddhi tathAtmAnaM parAtmakam
shlokas.33:
sachetanaM jIvaguNaM vadanti; sa cheShTate cheShTayate cha sarvam |
tataH paraM kShetravido vadanti; prAkalpayadyo bhuvanAni sapta
shlokas.34:
evaM sarveShu bhUteShu bhUtAtmA na prakAshate |
dRRishyate tvagryayA buddhyA sUkShmayA j~nAnavedibhiH
shlokas.35:
chittasya hi prasAdena hanti karma shubhAshubham |
prasannAtmAtmani sthitvA sukhamAnantyamashnute
shlokas.36:
lakShaNaM tu prasAdasya yathA tRRiptaH sukhaM svapet |
nivAte vA yathA dIpo dIpyetkushaladIpitaH
shlokas.37:
pUrvarAtre pare chaiva yu~njAnaH satataM manaH |
laghvAhAro vishuddhAtmA pashyannAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.38:
pradIpteneva dIpena manodIpena pashyati |
dRRiShTvAtmAnaM nirAtmAnaM tadA sa tu vimuchyate
shlokas.39:
sarvopAyaistu lobhasya krodhasya cha vinigrahaH |
etatpavitraM yaj~nAnAM tapo vai sa~Nkramo mataH
shlokas.40:
nityaM krodhAttapo rakShechChriyaM rakSheta matsarAt |
vidyAM mAnApamAnAbhyAmAtmAnaM tu pramAdataH
shlokas.41:
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmaH kShamA cha paramaM balam |
Atmaj~nAnaM paraM j~nAnaM paraM satyavrataM vratam
shlokas.42:
satyasya vachanaM shreyaH satyaM j~nAnaM hitaM bhavet |
yadbhUtahitamatyantaM tadvai satyaM paraM matam
shlokas.43:
yasya sarve samArambhAH nirAshIrbandhanAH sadA |
tyAge yasya hutaM sarvaM sa tyAgI sa cha buddhimAn
shlokas.44:
yato na gururapyenaM chyAvayedupapAdayan |
taM vidyAdbrahmaNo yogaM viyogaM yogasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.45:
na hi.nsyAtsarvabhUtAni maitrAyaNagatashcharet |
nedaM jIvitamAsAdya vairaM kurvIta kenachit
shlokas.46:
Aki~nchanyaM susantoSho nirAshitvamachApalam |
etadeva paraM j~nAnaM sadAtmaj~nAnamuttamam
shlokas.47:
parigrahaM parityajya bhava buddhyA yatavrataH |
ashokaM sthAnamAtiShThennishchalaM pretya cheha cha
shlokas.48:
taponityena dAntena muninA sa.nyatAtmanA |
ajitaM jetukAmena bhAvyaM sa~NgeShvasa~NginA
shlokas.49:
guNAguNamanAsa~NgamekakAryamanantaram |
etadbrAhmaNa te vRRittamAhurekapadaM sukham
shlokas.50:
parityajati yo duHkhaM sukhaM chApyubhayaM naraH |
brahma prApnoti so.atyantamasa~Ngena cha gachChati
shlokas.51:
yathAshrutamidaM sarvaM samAsena dvijottama |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evaM sa~Nkathite kRRitsne mokShadharme yudhiShThira |
dRRiDhaM prItamanA vipro dharmavyAdhamuvAcha ha
shlokas.2:
nyAyayuktamidaM sarvaM bhavatA parikIrtitam |
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchiddharmeShviha hi dRRishyate
shlokas.3:
vyAdha uvAcha||
pratyakShaM mama yo dharmastaM pashya dvijasattama |
yena siddhiriyaM prAptA mayA brAhmaNapu~Ngava
shlokas.4:
uttiShTha bhagavankShipraM pravishyAbhyantaraM gRRiham |
draShTumarhasi dharmaj~na mAtaraM pitaraM cha me
shlokas.5:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa pravishyAtha dadarsha paramArchitam |
saudhaM hRRidyaM chatuHshAlamatIva cha manoharam
shlokas.6:
devatAgRRihasa~NkAshaM daivataishcha supUjitam |
shayanAsanasambAdhaM gandhaishcha paramairyutam
shlokas.7:
tatra shuklAmbaradharau pitarAvasya pUjitau |
kRRitAhArau sutuShTau tAvupaviShTau varAsane
dharmavyAdhastu tau dRRiShTvA pAdeShu shirasApatat
shlokas.8:
vRRiddhAvUchatuH||
uttiShThottiShTha dharmaj~na dharmastvAmabhirakShatu |
prItau svastava shauchena dIrghamAyuravApnuhi
satputreNa tvayA putra nityakAlaM supUjitau
shlokas.9:
na te.anyaddaivataM ki~nchiddaivateShvapi vartate |
prayatatvAddvijAtInAM damenAsi samanvitaH
shlokas.10:
pituH pitAmahA ye cha tathaiva prapitAmahAH |
prItAste satataM putra damenAvAM cha pUjayA
shlokas.11:
manasA karmaNA vAchA shushrUShA naiva hIyate |
na chAnyA vitathA buddhirdRRishyate sAmprataM tava
shlokas.12:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa yathA vRRiddhau supUjitau |
tathA tvayA kRRitaM sarvaM tadvishiShTaM cha putraka
shlokas.13:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tatastaM brAhmaNaM tAbhyAM dharmavyAdho nyavedayat |
tau svAgatena taM vipramarchayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.14:
pratigRRihya cha tAM pUjAM dvijaH paprachCha tAvubhau |
saputrAbhyAM sabhRRityAbhyAM kachchidvAM kushalaM gRRihe
anAmayaM cha vAM kachchitsadaiveha sharIrayoH
shlokas.15:
vRRiddhAvUchatuH||
kushalaM no gRRihe vipra bhRRityavarge cha sarvashaH |
kachchittvamapyavighnena samprApto bhagavanniha
shlokas.16:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
bADhamityeva tau vipraH pratyuvAcha mudAnvitaH |
dharmavyAdhastu taM vipramarthavadvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.17:
pitA mAtA cha bhagavannetau me daivataM param |
yaddaivatebhyaH kartavyaM tadetAbhyAM karomyaham
shlokas.18:
trayastri.nshadyathA devAH sarve shakrapurogamAH |
sampUjyAH sarvalokasya tathA vRRiddhAvimau mama
shlokas.19:
upahArAnAharanto devatAnAM yathA dvijAH |
kurvate tadvadetAbhyAM karomyahamatandritaH
shlokas.20:
etau me paramaM brahmanpitA mAtA cha daivatam |
etau puShpaiH phalai ratnaistoShayAmi sadA dvija
shlokas.21:
etAvevAgnayo mahyaM yAnvadanti manIShiNaH |
yaj~nA vedAshcha chatvAraH sarvametau mama dvija
shlokas.22:
etadarthaM mama prANA bhAryA putrAH suhRRijjanAH |
saputradAraH shushrUShAM nityameva karomyaham
shlokas.23:
svayaM cha snApayAmyetau tathA pAdau pradhAvaye |
AhAraM samprayachChAmi svayaM cha dvijasattama
shlokas.24:
anukUlAH kathA vachmi vipriyaM parivarjayan |
adharmeNApi sa.nyuktaM priyamAbhyAM karomyaham
shlokas.25:
dharmameva guruM j~nAtvA karomi dvijasattama |
atandritaH sadA vipra shushrUShAM vai karomyaham
shlokas.26:
pa~nchaiva guravo brahmanpuruShasya bubhUShataH |
pitA mAtAgnirAtmA cha gurushcha dvijasattama
shlokas.27:
eteShu yastu varteta samyageva dvijottama |
bhaveyuragnayastasya parichIrNAstu nityashaH
gArhasthye vartamAnasya dharma eSha sanAtanaH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
gurU nivedya viprAya tau mAtApitarAvubhau |
punareva sa dharmAtmA vyAdho brAhmaNamabravIt
shlokas.2:
pravRRittachakShurjAto.asmi sampashya tapaso balam |
yadarthamukto.asi tayA gachChasva mithilAmiti
shlokas.3:
patishushrUShaparayA dAntayA satyashIlayA |
mithilAyAM vasanvyAdhaH sa te dharmAnpravakShyati
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
pativratAyAH satyAyAH shIlADhyAyA yatavrata |
sa.nsmRRitya vAkyaM dharmaj~na guNavAnasi me mataH
shlokas.5:
vyAdha uvAcha||
yattadA tvaM dvijashreShTha tayokto mAM prati prabho |
dRRiShTametattayA samyagekapatnyA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.6:
tvadanugrahabuddhyA tu vipraitaddarshitaM mayA |
vAkyaM cha shRRiNu me tAta yatte vakShye hitaM dvija
shlokas.7:
tvayA vinikRRitA mAtA pitA cha dvijasattama |
anisRRiShTo.asi niShkrAnto gRRihAttAbhyAmanindita
vedochchAraNakAryArthamayuktaM tattvayA kRRitam
shlokas.8:
tava shokena vRRiddhau tAvandhau jAtau tapasvinau |
tau prasAdayituM gachCha mA tvA dharmo.atyagAnmahAn
shlokas.9:
tapasvI tvaM mahAtmA cha dharme cha nirataH sadA |
sarvametadapArthaM te kShipraM tau samprasAdaya
shlokas.10:
shraddadhasva mama brahmannAnyathA kartumarhasi |
gamyatAmadya viprarShe shreyaste kathayAmyaham
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yadetaduktaM bhavatA sarvaM satyamasa.nshayam |
prIto.asmi tava dharmaj~na sAdhvAchAra guNAnvita
shlokas.12:
vyAdha uvAcha||
daivatapratimo hi tvaM yastvaM dharmamanuvrataH |
purANaM shAshvataM divyaM duShprApamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.13:
atandritaH kuru kShipraM mAtApitrorhi pUjanam |
ataH paramahaM dharmaM nAnyaM pashyAmi ka~nchana
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ihAhamAgato diShTyA diShTyA me sa~NgataM tvayA |
IdRRishA durlabhA loke narA dharmapradarshakAH
shlokas.15:
eko narasahasreShu dharmavidvidyate na vA |
prIto.asmi tava satyena bhadraM te puruShottama
shlokas.16:
patamAno hi narake bhavatAsmi samuddhRRitaH |
bhavitavyamathaivaM cha yaddRRiShTo.asi mayAnagha
shlokas.17:
rAjA yayAtirdauhitraiH patitastArito yathA |
sadbhiH puruShashArdUla tathAhaM bhavatA tviha
shlokas.18:
mAtApitRRibhyAM shushrUShAM kariShye vachanAttava |
nAkRRitAtmA vedayati dharmAdharmavinishchayam
shlokas.19:
durj~neyaH shAshvato dharmaH shUdrayonau hi vartatA |
na tvAM shUdramahaM manye bhavitavyaM hi kAraNam
yena karmavipAkena prApteyaM shUdratA tvayA
shlokas.20:
etadichChAmi vij~nAtuM tattvena hi mahAmate |
kAmayA brUhi me tathyaM sarvaM tvaM prayatAtmavAn
shlokas.21:
vyAdha uvAcha||
anatikramaNIyA hi brAhmaNA vai dvijottama |
shRRiNu sarvamidaM vRRittaM pUrvadehe mamAnagha
shlokas.22:
ahaM hi brAhmaNaH pUrvamAsaM dvijavarAtmaja |
vedAdhyAyI sukushalo vedA~NgAnAM cha pAragaH
AtmadoShakRRitairbrahmannavasthAM prAptavAnimAm
shlokas.23:
kashchidrAjA mama sakhA dhanurvedaparAyaNaH |
sa.nsargAddhanuShi shreShThastato.ahamabhavaM dvija
shlokas.24:
etasminneva kAle tu mRRigayAM nirgato nRRipaH |
sahito yodhamukhyaishcha mantribhishcha susa.nvRRitaH
tato.abhyahanmRRigA.nstatra subahUnAshramaM prati
shlokas.25:
atha kShiptaH sharo ghoro mayApi dvijasattama |
tADitashcha munistena shareNAnataparvaNA
shlokas.26:
bhUmau nipatito brahmannuvAcha pratinAdayan |
nAparAdhyAmyahaM ki~nchitkena pApamidaM kRRitam
shlokas.27:
manvAnastaM mRRigaM chAhaM samprAptaH sahasA munim |
apashyaM tamRRiShiM viddhaM shareNAnataparvaNA
tamugratapasaM vipraM niShTanantaM mahItale
shlokas.28:
akAryakaraNAchchApi bhRRishaM me vyathitaM manaH |
ajAnatA kRRitamidaM mayetyatha tamabruvam
kShantumarhasi me brahmanniti chokto mayA muniH
shlokas.29:
tataH pratyabravIdvAkyamRRiShirmAM krodhamUrChitaH |
vyAdhastvaM bhavitA krUra shUdrayonAviti dvija

shlokas.1:
vyAdha uvAcha||
evaM shapto.ahamRRiShiNA tadA dvijavarottama |
abhiprasAdayamRRiShiM girA vAkyavishAradam
shlokas.2:
ajAnatA mayAkAryamidamadya kRRitaM mune |
kShantumarhasi tatsarvaM prasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.3:
RRiShiruvAcha||
nAnyathA bhavitA shApa evametadasa.nshayam |
AnRRisha.nsyAdahaM ki~nchitkartAnugrahamadya te
shlokas.4:
shUdrayonau vartamAno dharmaj~no bhavitA hyasi |
mAtApitroshcha shushrUShAM kariShyasi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
tayA shushrUShayA siddhiM mahatIM samavApsyasi |
jAtismarashcha bhavitA svargaM chaiva gamiShyasi
shApakShayAnte nirvRRitte bhavitAsi punardvijaH
shlokas.6:
vyAdha uvAcha||
evaM shaptaH purA tena RRiShiNAsmyugratejasA |
prasAdashcha kRRitastena mamaivaM dvipadAM vara
shlokas.7:
sharaM choddhRRitavAnasmi tasya vai dvijasattama |
AshramaM cha mayA nIto na cha prANairvyayujyata
shlokas.8:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathA mama purAbhavat |
abhitashchApi gantavyaM mayA svargaM dvijottama
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
evametAni puruShA duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha |
prApnuvanti mahAbuddhe notkaNThAM kartumarhasi
duShkaraM hi kRRitaM tAta jAnatA jAtimAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
karmadoShashcha vai vidvannAtmajAtikRRitena vai |
ka~nchitkAlaM mRRiShyatAM vai tato.asi bhavitA dvijaH
sAmprataM cha mato me.asi brAhmaNo nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNaH patanIyeShu vartamAno vikarmasu |
dAmbhiko duShkRRitaprAyaH shUdreNa sadRRisho bhavet
shlokas.12:
yastu shUdro dame satye dharme cha satatotthitaH |
taM brAhmaNamahaM manye vRRittena hi bhaveddvijaH
shlokas.13:
karmadoSheNa viShamAM gatimApnoti dAruNAm |
kShINadoShamahaM manye chAbhitastvAM narottama
shlokas.14:
kartumarhasi notkaNThAM tvadvidhA hyaviShAdinaH |
lokavRRittAntavRRittaj~nA nityaM dharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.15:
vyAdha uvAcha||
praj~nayA mAnasaM duHkhaM hanyAchChArIramauShadhaiH |
etadvij~nAnasAmarthyaM na bAlaiH samatAM vrajet
shlokas.16:
aniShTasamprayogAchcha viprayogAtpriyasya cha |
mAnuShA mAnasairduHkhairyujyante alpabuddhayaH
shlokas.17:
guNairbhUtAni yujyante viyujyante tathaiva cha |
sarvANi naitadekasya shokasthAnaM hi vidyate
shlokas.18:
aniShTenAnvitaM pashya.nstathA kShipraM virajyate |
tatashcha pratikurvanti yadi pashyantyupakramam
shochato na bhavetki~nchitkevalaM paritapyate
shlokas.19:
parityajanti ye duHkhaM sukhaM vApyubhayaM narAH |
ta eva sukhamedhante j~nAnatRRiptA manIShiNaH
shlokas.20:
asantoShaparA mUDhAH santoShaM yAnti paNDitAH |
asantoShasya nAstyantastuShTistu paramaM sukham
na shochanti gatAdhvAnaH pashyantaH paramAM gatim
shlokas.21:
na viShAde manaH kAryaM viShAdo viShamuttamam |
mArayatyakRRitapraj~naM bAlaM kruddha ivoragaH
shlokas.22:
yaM viShAdo.abhibhavati viShame samupasthite |
tejasA tasya hInasya puruShArtho na vidyate
shlokas.23:
avashyaM kriyamANasya karmaNo dRRishyate phalam |
na hi nirvedamAgamya ki~nchitprApnoti shobhanam
shlokas.24:
athApyupAyaM pashyeta duHkhasya parimokShaNe |
ashochannArabhetaiva yuktashchAvyasanI bhavet
shlokas.25:
bhUteShvabhAvaM sa~nchintya ye tu buddheH paraM gatAH |
na shochanti kRRitapraj~nAH pashyantaH paramAM gatim
shlokas.26:
na shochAmi cha vai vidvankAlAkA~NkShI sthito.asmyaham |
etairnidarshanairbrahmannAvasIdAmi sattama
shlokas.27:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kRRitapraj~no.asi medhAvI buddhishcha vipulA tava |
nAhaM bhavantaM shochAmi j~nAnatRRipto.asi dharmavit
shlokas.28:
ApRRichChe tvAM svasti te.astu dharmastvA parirakShatu |
apramAdastu kartavyo dharme dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.29:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
bADhamityeva taM vyAdhaH kRRitA~njaliruvAcha ha |
pradakShiNamatho kRRitvA prasthito dvijasattamaH
shlokas.30:
sa tu gatvA dvijaH sarvAM shushrUShAM kRRitavA.nstadA |
mAtApitRRibhyAM vRRiddhAbhyAM yathAnyAyaM susa.nshitaH
shlokas.31:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM nikhilena yudhiShThira |
pRRiShTavAnasi yaM tAta dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.32:
pativratAyA mAhAtmyaM brAhmaNasya cha sattama |
mAtApitroshcha shushrUShA vyAdhe dharmashcha kIrtitaH
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atyadbhutamidaM brahmandharmAkhyAnamanuttamam |
sarvadharmabhRRitAM shreShTha kathitaM dvijasattama
shlokas.34:
sukhashravyatayA vidvanmuhUrtamiva me gatam |
na hi tRRipto.asmi bhagava~nshRRiNvAno dharmamuttamam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvemAM dharmasa.nyuktAM dharmarAjaH kathAM shubhAm |
punaH paprachCha tamRRiShiM mArkaNDeyaM tapasvinam
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathamagnirvanaM yAtaH kathaM chApya~NgirAH purA |
naShTe.agnau havyamavahadagnirbhUtvA mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.3:
agniryadA tveka eva bahutvaM chAsya karmasu |
dRRishyate bhagavansarvametadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.4:
kumArashcha yathotpanno yathA chAgneH suto.abhavat |
yathA rudrAchcha sambhUto ga~NgAyAM kRRittikAsu cha
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmyahaM tvattaH shrotuM bhArgavanandana |
kautUhalasamAviShTo yathAtathyaM mahAmune
shlokas.6:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA kruddho hutavahastapastaptuM vanaM gataH
shlokas.7:
yathA cha bhagavAnagniH svayamevA~NgirAbhavat |
santApayansvaprabhayA nAshaya.nstimirANi cha
shlokas.8:
Ashramastho mahAbhAgo havyavAhaM visheShayan |
tathA sa bhUtvA tu tadA jagatsarvaM prakAshayan
shlokas.9:
tapashchara.nshcha hutabhuksantaptastasya tejasA |
bhRRishaM glAnashcha tejasvI na sa ki~nchitprajaj~nivAn
shlokas.10:
atha sa~nchintayAmAsa bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
anyo.agniriha lokAnAM brahmaNA sampravartitaH
agnitvaM vipranaShTaM hi tapyamAnasya me tapaH
shlokas.11:
kathamagniH punarahaM bhaveyamiti chintya saH |
apashyadagnivallokA.nstApayantaM mahAmunim
shlokas.12:
sopAsarpachChanairbhItastamuvAcha tadA~NgirAH |
shIghrameva bhavasvAgnistvaM punarlokabhAvanaH
vij~nAtashchAsi lokeShu triShu sa.nsthAnachAriShu
shlokas.13:
tvamagne prathamaH sRRiShTo brahmaNA timirApahaH |
svasthAnaM pratipadyasva shIghrameva tamonuda
shlokas.14:
agniruvAcha||
naShTakIrtirahaM loke bhavA~njAto hutAshanaH |
bhavantameva j~nAsyanti pAvakaM na tu mAM janAH
shlokas.15:
nikShipAmyahamagnitvaM tvamagniH prathamo bhava |
bhaviShyAmi dvitIyo.ahaM prAjApatyaka eva cha
shlokas.16:
a~NgirA uvAcha||
kuru puNyaM prajAsvargyaM bhavAgnistimirApahaH |
mAM cha deva kuruShvAgne prathamaM putrama~njasA
shlokas.17:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tachChrutvA~Ngiraso vAkyaM jAtavedAstathAkarot |
rAjanbRRihaspatirnAma tasyApya~NgirasaH sutaH
shlokas.18:
j~nAtvA prathamajaM taM tu vahnerA~NgirasaM sutam |
upetya devAH paprachChuH kAraNaM tatra bhArata
shlokas.19:
sa tu pRRiShTastadA devaistataH kAraNamabravIt |
pratyagRRihNa.nstu devAshcha tadvacho.a~NgirasastadA
shlokas.20:
atra nAnAvidhAnagnInpravakShyAmi mahAprabhAn |
karmabhirbahubhiH khyAtAnnAnAtvaM brAhmaNeShviha

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
brahmaNo yastRRitIyastu putraH kurukulodvaha |
tasyApavasutA bhAryA prajAstasyApi me shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
bRRihajjyotirbRRihatkIrtirbRRihadbrahmA bRRihanmanAH |
bRRihanmantro bRRihadbhAsastathA rAjanbRRihaspatiH
shlokas.3:
prajAsu tAsu sarvAsu rUpeNApratimAbhavat |
devI bhAnumatI nAma prathamA~NgirasaH sutA
shlokas.4:
bhUtAnAmeva sarveShAM yasyAM rAgastadAbhavat |
rAgAdrAgeti yAmAhurdvitIyA~NgirasaH sutA
shlokas.5:
yAM kapardisutAmAhurdRRishyAdRRishyeti dehinaH |
tanutvAtsA sinIvAlI tRRitIyA~NgirasaH sutA
shlokas.6:
pashyatyarchiShmatI bhAbhirhavirbhishcha haviShmatI |
ShaShThIma~NgirasaH kanyAM puNyAmAhurhaviShmatIm
shlokas.7:
mahAmakheShvA~NgirasI dIptimatsu mahAmatI |
mahAmatIti vikhyAtA saptamI kathyate sutA
shlokas.8:
yAM tu dRRiShTvA bhagavatIM janaH kuhukuhAyate |
ekAna.nsheti yAmAhuH kuhUma~NgirasaH sutAm

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
bRRihaspateshchAndramasI bhAryAbhUdyA yashasvinI |
agnInsAjanayatpuNyAnShaDekAM chApi putrikAm
shlokas.2:
AhutiShveva yasyAgnerhaviShAjyaM vidhIyate |
so.agnirbRRihaspateH putraH sha.nyurnAma mahAprabhaH
shlokas.3:
chAturmAsyeShu yasyeShTyAmashvamedhe.agrajaH pashuH |
dIpto jvAlairanekAbhairagnireko.atha vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
sha.nyorapratimA bhAryA satyA satyA cha dharmajA |
agnistasya suto dIptastisraH kanyAshcha suvratAH
shlokas.5:
prathamenAjyabhAgena pUjyate yo.agniradhvare |
agnistasya bharadvAjaH prathamaH putra uchyate
shlokas.6:
paurNamAsyeShu sarveShu haviShAjyaM sruvodyatam |
bharato nAmataH so.agnirdvitIyaH sha.nyutaH sutaH
shlokas.7:
tisraH kanyA bhavantyanyA yAsAM sa bharataH patiH |
bharatastu sutastasya bharatyekA cha putrikA
shlokas.8:
bharato bharatasyAgneH pAvakastu prajApateH |
mahAnatyarthamahitastathA bharatasattama
shlokas.9:
bharadvAjasya bhAryA tu vIrA vIrashcha piNDadaH |
prAhurAjyena tasyejyAM somasyeva dvijAH shanaiH
shlokas.10:
haviShA yo dvitIyena somena saha yujyate |
rathaprabhU rathadhvAnaH kumbharetAH sa uchyate
shlokas.11:
sarayvAM janayatsiddhiM bhAnuM bhAbhiH samAvRRiNot |
AgneyamAnayannityamAhvAneShveSha kathyate
shlokas.12:
yastu na chyavate nityaM yashasA varchasA shriyA |
agnirnishchyavano nAma pRRithivIM stauti kevalam
shlokas.13:
vipApmA kaluShairmukto vishuddhashchArchiShA jvalan |
vipApo.agniH sutastasya satyaH samayakarmasu
shlokas.14:
AkroshatAM hi bhUtAnAM yaH karoti hi niShkRRitim |
agniH sa niShkRRitirnAma shobhayatyabhisevitaH
shlokas.15:
anukUjanti yeneha vedanArtAH svayaM janAH |
tasya putraH svano nAma pAvakaH sa rujaskaraH
shlokas.16:
yastu vishvasya jagato buddhimAkramya tiShThati |
taM prAhuradhyAtmavido vishvajinnAma pAvakam
shlokas.17:
antarAgniH shrito yo hi bhuktaM pachati dehinAm |
sa yaj~ne vishvabhu~NnAma sarvalokeShu bhArata
shlokas.18:
brahmachArI yatAtmA cha satataM vipulavrataH |
brAhmaNAH pUjayantyenaM pAkayaj~neShu pAvakam
shlokas.19:
prathito gopatirnAma nadI yasyAbhavatpriyA |
tasminsarvANi karmANi kriyante karmakartRRibhiH
shlokas.20:
vaDavAmukhaH pibatyambho yo.asau paramadAruNaH |
UrdhvabhAgUrdhvabhA~NnAma kaviH prANAshritastu saH
shlokas.21:
udagdvAraM haviryasya gRRihe nityaM pradIyate |
tataH sviShTaM bhavedAjyaM sviShTakRRitparamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.22:
yaH prashAnteShu bhUteShu manyurbhavati pAvakaH |
krodhasya tu raso jaj~ne manyatI chAtha putrikA
svAheti dAruNA krUrA sarvabhUteShu tiShThati
shlokas.23:
tridive yasya sadRRisho nAsti rUpeNa kashchana |
atulyatvAtkRRito devairnAmnA kAmastu pAvakaH
shlokas.24:
saMharShAddhArayankrodhaM dhanvI sragvI rathe sthitaH |
samare nAshayechChatrUnamogho nAma pAvakaH
shlokas.25:
uktho nAma mahAbhAga tribhirukthairabhiShTutaH |
mahAvAchaM tvajanayatsakAmAshvaM hi yaM viduH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
kAshyapo hyatha vAsiShThaH prANashcha prANaputrakaH |
agnirA~Ngirasashchaiva chyavanastriShuvarchakaH
shlokas.2:
acharanta tapastIvraM putrArthe bahuvArShikam |
putraM labhema dharmiShThaM yashasA brahmaNA samam
shlokas.3:
mahAvyAhRRitibhirdhyAtaH pa~nchabhistaistadA tvatha |
jaj~ne tejomayo.archiShmAnpa~nchavarNaH prabhAvanaH
shlokas.4:
samiddho.agniH shirastasya bAhU sUryanibhau tathA |
tva~Nnetre cha suvarNAbhe kRRiShNe ja~Nghe cha bhArata
shlokas.5:
pa~nchavarNaH sa tapasA kRRitastaiH pa~nchabhirjanaiH |
pA~nchajanyaH shruto vede pa~nchava.nshakarastu saH
shlokas.6:
dasha varShasahasrANi tapastaptvA mahAtapAH |
janayatpAvakaM ghoraM pitR^INAM sa prajAH sRRijan
shlokas.7:
bRRihadrathantaraM mUrdhno vaktrAchcha tarasAharau |
shivaM nAbhyAM balAdindraM vAyvagnI prANato.asRRijat
shlokas.8:
bAhubhyAmanudAttau cha vishve bhUtAni chaiva ha |
etAnsRRiShTvA tataH pa~ncha pitR^INAmasRRijatsutAn
shlokas.9:
bRRihadUrjasya praNidhiH kAshyapasya bRRihattaraH |
bhAnura~Ngiraso vIraH putro varchasya saubharaH
shlokas.10:
prANasya chAnudAttashcha vyAkhyAtAH pa~ncha va.nshajAH |
devAnyaj~namuShashchAnyAnsRRijanpa~nchadashottarAn
shlokas.11:
abhImamatibhImaM cha bhImaM bhImabalAbalam |
etAnyaj~namuShaH pa~ncha devAnabhyasRRijattapaH
shlokas.12:
sumitraM mitravantaM cha mitraj~naM mitravardhanam |
mitradharmANamityetAndevAnabhyasRRijattapaH
shlokas.13:
surapravIraM vIraM cha sukeshaM cha suvarchasam |
surANAmapi hantAraM pa~nchaitAnasRRijattapaH
shlokas.14:
trividhaM sa.nsthitA hyete pa~ncha pa~ncha pRRithakpRRithak |
muShNantyatra sthitA hyete svargato yaj~nayAjinaH
shlokas.15:
teShAmiShTaM harantyete nighnanti cha mahadbhuvi |
spardhayA havyavAhAnAM nighnantyete haranti cha
shlokas.16:
havirvedyAM tadAdAnaM kushalaiH sampravartitam |
tadete nopasarpanti yatra chAgniH sthito bhavet
shlokas.17:
chito.agnirudvahanyaj~naM pakShAbhyAM tAnprabAdhate |
mantraiH prashamitA hyete neShTaM muShNanti yaj~niyam
shlokas.18:
bRRihadukthatapasyaiva putro bhUmimupAshritaH |
agnihotre hUyamAne pRRithivyAM sadbhirijyate
shlokas.19:
rathantarashcha tapasaH putro.agniH paripaThyate |
mitravindAya vai tasya haviradhvaryavo viduH
mumude paramaprItaH saha putrairmahAyashAH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
gurubhirniyamairyukto bharato nAma pAvakaH |
agniH puShTimatirnAma tuShTaH puShTiM prayachChati
bharatyeSha prajAH sarvAstato bharata uchyate
shlokas.2:
agniryastu shivo nAma shaktipUjAparashcha saH |
duHkhArtAnAM sa sarveShAM shivakRRitsatataM shivaH
shlokas.3:
tapasastu phalaM dRRiShTvA sampravRRiddhaM tapo mahat |
uddhartukAmo matimAnputro jaj~ne pura.ndaraH
shlokas.4:
UShmA chaivoShmaNo jaj~ne so.agnirbhUteShu lakShyate |
agnishchApi manurnAma prAjApatyamakArayat
shlokas.5:
shambhumagnimatha prAhurbrAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
AvasathyaM dvijAH prAhurdIptamagniM mahAprabham
shlokas.6:
UrjaskarAnhavyavAhAnsuvarNasadRRishaprabhAn |
agnistapo hyajanayatpa~ncha yaj~nasutAniha
shlokas.7:
prashAnte.agnirmahAbhAga parishrAnto gavAmpatiH |
asurA~njanayanghorAnmartyA.nshchaiva pRRithagvidhAn
shlokas.8:
tapasashcha manuM putraM bhAnuM chApya~NgirAsRRijat |
bRRihadbhAnuM tu taM prAhurbrAhmaNA vedapAragAH
shlokas.9:
bhAnorbhAryA suprajA tu bRRihadbhAsA tu somajA |
asRRijetAM tu ShaTputrA~nshRRiNu tAsAM prajAvidhim
shlokas.10:
durbalAnAM tu bhUtAnAM tanuM yaH samprayachChati |
tamagniM baladaM prAhuH prathamaM bhAnutaH sutam
shlokas.11:
yaH prashAnteShu bhUteShu manyurbhavati dAruNaH |
agniH sa manyumAnnAma dvitIyo bhAnutaH sutaH
shlokas.12:
darshe cha paurNamAse cha yasyeha haviruchyate |
viShNurnAmeha yo.agnistu dhRRitimAnnAma so.a~NgirAH
shlokas.13:
indreNa sahitaM yasya havirAgrayaNaM smRRitam |
agnirAgrayaNo nAma bhAnorevAnvayastu saH
shlokas.14:
chAturmAsyeShu nityAnAM haviShAM yo niragrahaH |
chaturbhiH sahitaH putrairbhAnorevAnvayastu saH
shlokas.15:
nishAM tvajanayatkanyAmagnIShomAvubhau tathA |
manorevAbhavadbhAryA suShuve pa~ncha pAvakAn
shlokas.16:
pUjyate haviShAgryeNa chAturmAsyeShu pAvakaH |
parjanyasahitaH shrImAnagnirvaishvAnarastu saH
shlokas.17:
asya lokasya sarvasya yaH patiH paripaThyate |
so.agnirvishvapatirnAma dvitIyo vai manoH sutaH
tataH sviShTaM bhavedAjyaM sviShTakRRitparamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.18:
kanyA sA rohiNI nAma hiraNyakashipoH sutA |
karmaNAsau babhau bhAryA sa vahniH sa prajApatiH
shlokas.19:
prANamAshritya yo dehaM pravartayati dehinAm |
tasya saMnihito nAma shabdarUpasya sAdhanaH
shlokas.20:
shuklakRRiShNagatirdevo yo bibharti hutAshanam |
akalmaShaH kalmaShANAM kartA krodhAshritastu saH
shlokas.21:
kapilaM paramarShiM cha yaM prAhuryatayaH sadA |
agniH sa kapilo nAma sA~NkhyayogapravartakaH
shlokas.22:
agniryachChati bhUtAni yena bhUtAni nityadA |
karmasviha vichitreShu so.agraNIrvahniruchyate
shlokas.23:
imAnanyAnsamasRRijatpAvakAnprathitAnbhuvi |
agnihotrasya duShTasya prAyashchittArthamulbaNAn
shlokas.24:
sa.nspRRisheyuryadAnyonyaM katha~nchidvAyunAgnayaH |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA vai shuchaye.agnaye
shlokas.25:
dakShiNAgniryadA dvAbhyAM sa.nsRRijeta tadA kila |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA vai vItaye.agnaye
shlokas.26:
yadyagnayo hi spRRishyeyurniveshasthA davAgninA |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA tu shuchaye.agnaye
shlokas.27:
agniM rajasvalA chetstrI sa.nspRRishedagnihotrikam |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA dasyumate.agnaye
shlokas.28:
mRRitaH shrUyeta yo jIvanpareyuH pashavo yathA |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kartavyAbhimate.agnaye
shlokas.29:
Arto na juhuyAdagniM trirAtraM yastu brAhmaNaH |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA syAduttarAgnaye
shlokas.30:
darshaM cha paurNamAsaM cha yasya tiShThetpratiShThitam |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA pathikRRite.agnaye
shlokas.31:
sUtikAgniryadA chAgniM sa.nspRRishedagnihotrikam |
iShTiraShTAkapAlena kAryA chAgnimate.agnaye

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
Apasya muditA bhAryA sahasya paramA priyA |
bhUpatirbhuvabhartA cha janayatpAvakaM param
shlokas.2:
bhUtAnAM chApi sarveShAM yaM prAhuH pAvakaM patim |
AtmA bhuvanabharteti sAnvayeShu dvijAtiShu
shlokas.3:
mahatAM chaiva bhUtAnAM sarveShAmiha yaH patiH |
bhagavAnsa mahAtejA nityaM charati pAvakaH
shlokas.4:
agnirgRRihapatirnAma nityaM yaj~neShu pUjyate |
hutaM vahati yo havyamasya lokasya pAvakaH
shlokas.5:
apAM garbho mahAbhAgaH sahaputro mahAdbhutaH |
bhUpatirbhuvabhartA cha mahataH patiruchyate
shlokas.6:
dahanmRRitAni bhUtAni tasyAgnirbharato.abhavat |
agniShTome cha niyataH kratushreShTho bharasya tu
shlokas.7:
AyAntaM niyataM dRRiShTvA praviveshArNavaM bhayAt |
devAstaM nAdhigachChanti mArgamANA yathAdisham
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTvA tvagniratharvANaM tato vachanamabravIt |
devAnAM vaha havyaM tvamahaM vIra sudurbalaH
atharvangachCha madhvakShaM priyametatkuruShva me
shlokas.9:
preShya chAgniratharvANamanyaM deshaM tato.agamat |
matsyAstasya samAchakhyuH kruddhastAnagnirabravIt
shlokas.10:
bhakShyA vai vividhairbhAvairbhaviShyatha sharIriNAm |
atharvANaM tathA chApi havyavAho.abravIdvachaH
shlokas.11:
anunIyamAno.api bhRRishaM devavAkyAddhi tena saH |
naichChadvoDhuM haviH sarvaM sharIraM cha samatyajat
shlokas.12:
sa tachCharIraM santyajya pravivesha dharAM tadA |
bhUmiM spRRiShTvAsRRijaddhAtUnpRRithakpRRithagatIva hi
shlokas.13:
AsyAtsugandhi tejashcha asthibhyo devadAru cha |
shleShmaNaH sphaTikaM tasya pittAnmarakataM tathA
shlokas.14:
yakRRitkRRiShNAyasaM tasya tribhireva babhuH prajAH |
nakhAstasyAbhrapaTalaM shirAjAlAni vidrumam
sharIrAdvividhAshchAnye dhAtavo.asyAbhavannRRipa
shlokas.15:
evaM tyaktvA sharIraM tu parame tapasi sthitaH |
bhRRigva~NgirAdibhirbhUyastapasotthApitastadA
shlokas.16:
bhRRishaM jajvAla tejasvI tapasApyAyitaH shikhI |
dRRiShTvA RRiShInbhayAchchApi pravivesha mahArNavam
shlokas.17:
tasminnaShTe jagadbhItamatharvANamathAshritam |
archayAmAsurevainamatharvANaM surarShayaH
shlokas.18:
atharvA tvasRRijallokAnAtmanAlokya pAvakam |
miShatAM sarvabhUtAnAmunmamAtha mahArNavam
shlokas.19:
evamagnirbhagavatA naShTaH pUrvamatharvaNA |
AhUtaH sarvabhUtAnAM havyaM vahati sarvadA
shlokas.20:
evaM tvajanayaddhiShNyAnvedoktAnvibudhAnbahUn |
vicharanvividhAndeshAnbhramamANastu tatra vai
shlokas.21:
sindhuvarjaM pa~ncha nadyo devikAtha sarasvatI |
ga~NgA cha shatakumbhA cha sharayUrgaNDasAhvayA
shlokas.22:
charmaNvatI mahI chaiva medhyA medhAtithistathA |
tAmrAvatI vetravatI nadyastisro.atha kaushikI
shlokas.23:
tamasA narmadA chaiva nadI godAvarI tathA |
veNNA praveNI bhImA cha medrathA chaiva bhArata
shlokas.24:
bhAratI suprayogA cha kAverI murmurA tathA |
kRRiShNA cha kRRiShNaveNNA cha kapilA shoNa eva cha
etA nadyastu dhiShNyAnAM mAtaro yAH prakIrtitAH
shlokas.25:
adbhutasya priyA bhAryA tasyAH putro viDUrathaH |
yAvantaH pAvakAH proktAH somAstAvanta eva cha
shlokas.26:
atreshchApyanvaye jAtA brahmaNo mAnasAH prajAH |
atriH putrAnsraShTukAmastAnevAtmanyadhArayat
tasya tadbrahmaNaH kAyAnnirharanti hutAshanAH
shlokas.27:
evamete mahAtmAnaH kIrtitAste.agnayo mayA |
aprameyA yathotpannAH shrImantastimirApahAH
shlokas.28:
adbhutasya tu mAhAtmyaM yathA vedeShu kIrtitam |
tAdRRishaM viddhi sarveShAmeko hyeSha hutAshanaH
shlokas.29:
eka evaiSha bhagavAnvij~neyaH prathamo.a~NgirAH |
bahudhA niHsRRitaH kAyAjjyotiShTomaH kraturyathA
shlokas.30:
ityeSha va.nshaH sumahAnagnInAM kIrtito mayA |
pAvito vividhairmantrairhavyaM vahati dehinAm

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
agnInAM vividho va.nshaH kIrtitaste mayAnagha |
shRRiNu janma tu kauravya kArttikeyasya dhImataH
shlokas.2:
adbhutasyAdbhutaM putraM pravakShyAmyamitaujasam |
jAtaM saptarShibhAryAbhirbrahmaNyaM kIrtivardhanam
shlokas.3:
devAsurAH purA yattA vinighnantaH parasparam |
tatrAjayansadA devAndAnavA ghorarUpiNaH
shlokas.4:
vadhyamAnaM balaM dRRiShTvA bahushastaiH pura.ndaraH |
svasainyanAyakArthAya chintAmApa bhRRishaM tadA
shlokas.5:
devasenAM dAnavairyo bhagnAM dRRiShTvA mahAbalaH |
pAlayedvIryamAshritya sa j~neyaH puruSho mayA
shlokas.6:
sa shailaM mAnasaM gatvA dhyAyannarthamimaM bhRRisham |
shushrAvArtasvaraM ghoramatha muktaM striyA tadA
shlokas.7:
abhidhAvatu mA kashchitpuruShastrAtu chaiva ha |
patiM cha me pradishatu svayaM vA patirastu me
shlokas.8:
pura.ndarastu tAmAha mA bhairnAsti bhayaM tava |
evamuktvA tato.apashyatkeshinaM sthitamagrataH
shlokas.9:
kirITinaM gadApANiM dhAtumantamivAchalam |
haste gRRihItvA tAM kanyAmathainaM vAsavo.abravIt
shlokas.10:
anAryakarmankasmAttvamimAM kanyAM jihIrShasi |
vajriNaM mAM vijAnIhi viramAsyAH prabAdhanAt
shlokas.11:
keshyuvAcha||
visRRijasva tvamevainAM shakraiShA prArthitA mayA |
kShamaM te jIvato gantuM svapuraM pAkashAsana
shlokas.12:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA gadAM keshI chikShependravadhAya vai |
tAmApatantIM chichCheda madhye vajreNa vAsavaH
shlokas.13:
athAsya shailashikharaM keshI kruddho vyavAsRRijat |
tadApatantaM samprekShya shailashRRi~NgaM shatakratuH
bibheda rAjanvajreNa bhuvi tannipapAta ha
shlokas.14:
patatA tu tadA keshI tena shRRi~NgeNa tADitaH |
hitvA kanyAM mahAbhAgAM prAdravadbhRRishapIDitaH
shlokas.15:
apayAte.asure tasmi.nstAM kanyAM vAsavo.abravIt |
kAsi kasyAsi kiM cheha kuruShe tvaM shubhAnane
shlokas.16:
kanyovAcha||
ahaM prajApateH kanyA devaseneti vishrutA |
bhaginI daityasenA me sA pUrvaM keshinA hRRitA
shlokas.17:
sahaivAvAM bhaginyau tu sakhIbhiH saha mAnasam |
AgachChAveha ratyarthamanuj~nApya prajApatim
shlokas.18:
nityaM chAvAM prArthayate hartuM keshI mahAsuraH |
ichChatyenaM daityasenA na tvahaM pAkashAsana
shlokas.19:
sA hRRitA tena bhagavanmuktAhaM tvadbalena tu |
tvayA devendra nirdiShTaM patimichChAmi durjayam
shlokas.20:
indra uvAcha||
mama mAtRRiShvaseyA tvaM mAtA dAkShAyaNI mama |
AkhyAtaM tvahamichChAmi svayamAtmabalaM tvayA
shlokas.21:
kanyovAcha||
abalAhaM mahAbAho patistu balavAnmama |
varadAnAtpiturbhAvI surAsuranamaskRRitaH
shlokas.22:
indra uvAcha||
kIdRRishaM vai balaM devi patyustava bhaviShyati |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tava vAkyamanindite
shlokas.23:
kanyovAcha||
devadAnavayakShANAM kiMnaroragarakShasAm |
jetA sa dRRiShTo duShTAnAM mahAvIryo mahAbalaH
shlokas.24:
yastu sarvANi bhUtAni tvayA saha vijeShyati |
sa hi me bhavitA bhartA brahmaNyaH kIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.25:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
indrastasyA vachaH shrutvA duHkhito.achintayadbhRRisham |
asyA devyAH patirnAsti yAdRRishaM samprabhAShate
shlokas.26:
athApashyatsa udaye bhAskaraM bhAskaradyutiH |
somaM chaiva mahAbhAgaM vishamAnaM divAkaram
shlokas.27:
amAvAsyAM sampravRRittaM muhUrtaM raudrameva cha |
devAsuraM cha sa~NgrAmaM so.apashyadudaye girau
shlokas.28:
lohitaishcha ghanairyuktAM pUrvAM sandhyAM shatakratuH |
apashyallohitodaM cha bhagavAnvaruNAlayam
shlokas.29:
bhRRigubhishchA~Ngirobhishcha hutaM mantraiH pRRithagvidhaiH |
havyaM gRRihItvA vahniM cha pravishantaM divAkaram
shlokas.30:
parva chaiva chaturvi.nshaM tadA sUryamupasthitam |
tathA dharmagataM raudraM somaM sUryagataM cha tam
shlokas.31:
samAlokyaikatAmeva shashino bhAskarasya cha |
samavAyaM tu taM raudraM dRRiShTvA shakro vyachintayat
shlokas.32:
eSha raudrashcha sa~NghAto mahAnyuktashcha tejasA |
somasya vahnisUryAbhyAmadbhuto.ayaM samAgamaH
janayedyaM sutaM somaH so.asyA devyAH patirbhavet
shlokas.33:
agnishchaitairguNairyuktaH sarvairagnishcha devatA |
eSha chejjanayedgarbhaM so.asyA devyAH patirbhavet
shlokas.34:
evaM sa~nchintya bhagavAnbrahmalokaM tadA gataH |
gRRihItvA devasenAM tAmavandatsa pitAmaham
uvAcha chAsyA devyAstvaM sAdhu shUraM patiM disha
shlokas.35:
brahmovAcha||
yathaitachchintitaM kAryaM tvayA dAnavasUdana |
tathA sa bhavitA garbho balavAnuruvikramaH
shlokas.36:
sa bhaviShyati senAnIstvayA saha shatakrato |
asyA devyAH patishchaiva sa bhaviShyati vIryavAn
shlokas.37:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA namastasmai kRRitvAsau saha kanyayA |
tatrAbhyagachChaddevendro yatra devarShayo.abhavan
vasiShThapramukhA mukhyA viprendrAH sumahAvratAH
shlokas.38:
bhAgArthaM tapasopAttaM teShAM somaM tathAdhvare |
pipAsavo yayurdevAH shatakratupurogamAH
shlokas.39:
iShTiM kRRitvA yathAnyAyaM susamiddhe hutAshane |
juhuvuste mahAtmAno havyaM sarvadivaukasAm
shlokas.40:
samAhUto hutavahaH so.adbhutaH sUryamaNDalAt |
viniHsRRityAyayau vahnirvAgyato vidhivatprabhuH
AgamyAhavanIyaM vai tairdvijairmantrato hutam
shlokas.41:
sa tatra vividhaM havyaM pratigRRihya hutAshanaH |
RRiShibhyo bharatashreShTha prAyachChata divaukasAm
shlokas.42:
niShkrAma.nshchApyapashyatsa patnIsteShAM mahAtmanAm |
sveShvAshrameShUpaviShTAH snAyantIshcha yathAsukham
shlokas.43:
rukmavedinibhAstAstu chandralekhA ivAmalAH |
hutAshanArchipratimAH sarvAstArA ivAdbhutAH
shlokas.44:
sa tadgatena manasA babhUva kShubhitendriyaH |
patnIrdRRiShTvA dvijendrANAM vahniH kAmavashaM yayau
shlokas.45:
sa bhUyashchintayAmAsa na nyAyyaM kShubhito.asmi yat |
sAdhvIH patnIrdvijendrANAmakAmAH kAmayAmyaham
shlokas.46:
naitAH shakyA mayA draShTuM spraShTuM vApyanimittataH |
gArhapatyaM samAvishya tasmAtpashyAmyabhIkShNashaH
shlokas.47:
sa.nspRRishanniva sarvAstAH shikhAbhiH kA~nchanaprabhAH |
pashyamAnashcha mumude gArhapatyaM samAshritaH
shlokas.48:
niruShya tatra suchiramevaM vahnirvashaM gataH |
manastAsu vinikShipya kAmayAno varA~NganAH
shlokas.49:
kAmasantaptahRRidayo dehatyAge sunishchitaH |
alAbhe brAhmaNastrINAmagnirvanamupAgataH
shlokas.50:
svAhA taM dakShaduhitA prathamaM kAmayattadA |
sA tasya ChidramanvaichChachchirAtprabhRRiti bhAminI
apramattasya devasya na chApashyadaninditA
shlokas.51:
sA taM j~nAtvA yathAvattu vahniM vanamupAgatam |
tattvataH kAmasantaptaM chintayAmAsa bhAminI
shlokas.52:
ahaM saptarShipatnInAM kRRitvA rUpANi pAvakam |
kAmayiShyAmi kAmArtaM tAsAM rUpeNa mohitam
evaM kRRite prItirasya kAmAvAptishcha me bhavet

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shivA bhAryA tva~NgirasaH shIlarUpaguNAnvitA |
tasyAH sA prathamaM rUpaM kRRitvA devI janAdhipa
jagAma pAvakAbhyAshaM taM chovAcha varA~NganA
shlokas.2:
mAmagne kAmasantaptAM tvaM kAmayitumarhasi |
kariShyasi na chedevaM mRRitAM mAmupadhAraya
shlokas.3:
ahama~Ngiraso bhAryA shivA nAma hutAshana |
sakhIbhiH sahitA prAptA mantrayitvA vinishchayam
shlokas.4:
agniruvAcha||
kathaM mAM tvaM vijAnIShe kAmArtamitarAH katham |
yAstvayA kIrtitAH sarvAH saptarShINAM priyAH striyaH
shlokas.5:
shivovAcha||
asmAkaM tvaM priyo nityaM bibhImastu vayaM tava |
tvachchittami~Ngitairj~nAtvA preShitAsmi tavAntikam
shlokas.6:
maithunAyeha samprAptA kAmaM prAptaM drutaM chara |
mAtaro mAM pratIkShante gamiShyAmi hutAshana
shlokas.7:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato.agnirupayeme tAM shivAM prItimudAyutaH |
prItyA devI cha sa.nyuktA shukraM jagrAha pANinA
shlokas.8:
achintayanmamedaM ye rUpaM drakShyanti kAnane |
te brAhmaNInAmanRRitaM doShaM vakShyanti pAvake
shlokas.9:
tasmAdetadrakShyamANA garuDI sambhavAmyaham |
vanAnnirgamanaM chaiva sukhaM mama bhaviShyati
shlokas.10:
suparNI sA tadA bhUtvA nirjagAma mahAvanAt |
apashyatparvataM shvetaM sharastambaiH susa.nvRRitam
shlokas.11:
dRRiShTIviShaiH saptashIrShairguptaM bhogibhiradbhutaiH |
rakShobhishcha pishAchaishcha raudrairbhUtagaNaistathA
rAkShasIbhishcha sampUrNamanekaishcha mRRigadvijaiH
shlokas.12:
sA tatra sahasA gatvA shailapRRiShThaM sudurgamam |
prAkShipatkA~nchane kuNDe shukraM sA tvaritA satI
shlokas.13:
shiShTAnAmapi sA devI saptarShINAM mahAtmanAm |
patnIsarUpatAM kRRitvA kAmayAmAsa pAvakam
shlokas.14:
divyarUpamarundhatyAH kartuM na shakitaM tayA |
tasyAstapaHprabhAveNa bhartRRishushrUShaNena cha
shlokas.15:
ShaTkRRitvastattu nikShiptamagne retaH kurUttama |
tasminkuNDe pratipadi kAminyA svAhayA tadA
shlokas.16:
tatskannaM tejasA tatra sambhRRitaM janayatsutam |
RRiShibhiH pUjitaM skannamanayatskandatAM tataH
shlokas.17:
ShaTshirA dviguNashrotro dvAdashAkShibhujakramaH |
ekagrIvastvekakAyaH kumAraH samapadyata
shlokas.18:
dvitIyAyAmabhivyaktastRRitIyAyAM shishurbabhau |
a~Ngapratya~NgasambhUtashchaturthyAmabhavadguhaH
shlokas.19:
lohitAbhreNa mahatA sa.nvRRitaH saha vidyutA |
lohitAbhre sumahati bhAti sUrya ivoditaH
shlokas.20:
gRRihItaM tu dhanustena vipulaM lomaharShaNam |
nyastaM yattripuraghnena surArivinikRRintanam
shlokas.21:
tadgRRihItvA dhanuHshreShThaM nanAda balavA.nstadA |
saMmohayannivemAnsa trI.NllokAnsacharAcharAn
shlokas.22:
tasya taM ninadaM shrutvA mahAmeghaughanisvanam |
utpetaturmahAnAgau chitrashchairAvatashcha ha
shlokas.23:
tAvApatantau samprekShya sa bAlArkasamadyutiH |
dvAbhyAM gRRihItvA pANibhyAM shaktiM chAnyena pANinA
apareNAgnidAyAdastAmrachUDaM bhujena saH
shlokas.24:
mahAkAyamupashliShTaM kukkuTaM balinAM varam |
gRRihItvA vyanadadbhImaM chikrIDa cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.25:
dvAbhyAM bhujAbhyAM balavAngRRihItvA sha~Nkhamuttamam |
prAdhmApayata bhUtAnAM trAsanaM balinAmapi
shlokas.26:
dvAbhyAM bhujAbhyAmAkAshaM bahusho nijaghAna saH |
krIDanbhAti mahAsenastrI.NllokAnvadanaiH piban
parvatAgre.aprameyAtmA rashmimAnudaye yathA
shlokas.27:
sa tasya parvatasyAgre niShaNNo.adbhutavikramaH |
vyalokayadameyAtmA mukhairnAnAvidhairdishaH
sa pashyanvividhAnbhAvA.nshchakAra ninadaM punaH
shlokas.28:
tasya taM ninadaM shrutvA nyapatanbahudhA janAH |
bhItAshchodvignamanasastameva sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.29:
ye tu taM sa.nshritA devaM nAnAvarNAstadA janAH |
tAnapyAhuH pAriShadAnbrAhmaNAH sumahAbalAn
shlokas.30:
sa tUtthAya mahAbAhurupasAntvya cha tA~njanAn |
dhanurvikRRiShya vyasRRijadbANA~nshvete mahAgirau
shlokas.31:
bibheda sa sharaiH shailaM krau~nchaM himavataH sutam |
tena ha.nsAshcha gRRidhrAshcha meruM gachChanti parvatam
shlokas.32:
sa vishIrNo.apatachChailo bhRRishamArtasvarAnruvan |
tasminnipatite tvanye neduH shailA bhRRishaM bhayAt
shlokas.33:
sa taM nAdaM bhRRishArtAnAM shrutvApi balinAM varaH |
na prAvyathadameyAtmA shaktimudyamya chAnadat
shlokas.34:
sA tadA vipulA shaktiH kShiptA tena mahAtmanA |
bibheda shikharaM ghoraM shvetasya tarasA gireH
shlokas.35:
sa tenAbhihato dIno giriH shveto.achalaiH saha |
utpapAta mahIM tyaktvA bhItastasmAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.36:
tataH pravyathitA bhUmirvyashIryata samantataH |
ArtA skandaM samAsAdya punarbalavatI babhau
shlokas.37:
parvatAshcha namaskRRitya tameva pRRithivIM gatAH |
athAyamabhajallokaH skandaM shuklasya pa~nchamIm

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
RRiShayastu mahAghorAndRRiShTvotpAtAnpRRithagvidhAn |
akurva~nshAntimudvignA lokAnAM lokabhAvanAH
shlokas.2:
nivasanti vane ye tu tasmi.nshchaitrarathe janAH |
te.abruvanneSha no.anarthaH pAvakenAhRRito mahAn
sa~Ngamya ShaDbhiH patnIbhiH saptarShINAmiti sma ha
shlokas.3:
apare garuDImAhustvayAnartho.ayamAhRRitaH |
yairdRRiShTA sA tadA devI tasyA rUpeNa gachChatI
na tu tatsvAhayA karma kRRitaM jAnAti vai janaH
shlokas.4:
suparNI tu vachaH shrutvA mamAyaM tanayastviti |
upagamya shanaiH skandamAhAhaM jananI tava
shlokas.5:
atha saptarShayaH shrutvA jAtaM putraM mahaujasam |
tatyajuH ShaTtadA patnIrvinA devImarundhatIm
shlokas.6:
ShaDbhireva tadA jAtamAhustadvanavAsinaH |
saptarShInAha cha svAhA mama putro.ayamityuta
ahaM jAne naitadevamiti rAjanpunaH punaH
shlokas.7:
vishvAmitrastu kRRitveShTiM saptarShINAM mahAmuniH |
pAvakaM kAmasantaptamadRRiShTaH pRRiShThato.anvagAt
tattena nikhilaM sarvamavabuddhaM yathAtatham
shlokas.8:
vishvAmitrastu prathamaM kumAraM sharaNaM gataH |
stavaM divyaM samprachakre mahAsenasya chApi saH
shlokas.9:
ma~NgalAni cha sarvANi kaumArANi trayodasha |
jAtakarmAdikAstasya kriyAshchakre mahAmuniH
shlokas.10:
ShaDvaktrasya tu mAhAtmyaM kukkuTasya cha sAdhanam |
shaktyA devyAH sAdhanaM cha tathA pAriShadAmapi
shlokas.11:
vishvAmitrashchakAraitatkarma lokahitAya vai |
tasmAdRRiShiH kumArasya vishvAmitro.abhavatpriyaH
shlokas.12:
anvajAnAchcha svAhAyA rUpAnyatvaM mahAmuniH |
abravIchcha munInsarvAnnAparAdhyanti vai striyaH
shrutvA tu tattvatastasmAtte patnIH sarvato.atyajan
shlokas.13:
skandaM shrutvA tato devA vAsavaM sahitAbruvan |
aviShahyabalaM skandaM jahi shakrAshu mAchiram
shlokas.14:
yadi vA na niha.nsyenamadyendro.ayaM bhaviShyati |
trailokyaM saMnigRRihyAsmA.nstvAM cha shakra mahAbalaH
shlokas.15:
sa tAnuvAcha vyathito bAlo.ayaM sumahAbalaH |
sraShTAramapi lokAnAM yudhi vikramya nAshayet
shlokas.16:
sarvAstvadyAbhigachChantu skandaM lokasya mAtaraH |
kAmavIryA ghnantu chainaM tathetyuktvA cha tA yayuH
shlokas.17:
tamapratibalaM dRRiShTvA viShaNNavadanAstu tAH |
ashakyo.ayaM vichintyaivaM tameva sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.18:
UchushchApi tvamasmAkaM putro.asmAbhirdhRRitaM jagat |
abhinandasva naH sarvAH prasnutAH snehaviklavAH
shlokas.19:
tAH sampUjya mahAsenaH kAmA.nshchAsAM pradAya saH |
apashyadagnimAyAntaM pitaraM balinAM balI
shlokas.20:
sa tu sampUjitastena saha mAtRRigaNena ha |
parivArya mahAsenaM rakShamANaH sthitaH sthiram
shlokas.21:
sarvAsAM yA tu mAtR^INAM nArI krodhasamudbhavA |
dhAtrI sA putravatskandaM shUlahastAbhyarakShata
shlokas.22:
lohitasyodadheH kanyA krUrA lohitabhojanA |
pariShvajya mahAsenaM putravatparyarakShata
shlokas.23:
agnirbhUtvA naigameyashChAgavaktro bahuprajaH |
ramayAmAsa shailasthaM bAlaM krIDanakairiva

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
grahAH sopagrahAshchaiva RRiShayo mAtarastathA |
hutAshanamukhAshchApi dIptAH pAriShadAM gaNAH
shlokas.2:
ete chAnye cha bahavo ghorAstridivavAsinaH |
parivArya mahAsenaM sthitA mAtRRigaNaiH saha
shlokas.3:
sa.ndigdhaM vijayaM dRRiShTvA vijayepsuH sureshvaraH |
AruhyairAvataskandhaM prayayau daivataiH saha
vijighA.nsurmahAsenamindrastUrNataraM yayau
shlokas.4:
ugraM tachcha mahAvegaM devAnIkaM mahAprabham |
vichitradhvajasaMnAhaM nAnAvAhanakArmukam
pravarAmbarasa.nvItaM shriyA juShTamala~NkRRitam
shlokas.5:
vijighA.nsuM tadAyAntaM kumAraH shakramabhyayAt |
vinadanpathi shakrastu drutaM yAti mahAbalaH
saMharShayandevasenAM jighA.nsuH pAvakAtmajam
shlokas.6:
sampUjyamAnastridashaistathaiva paramarShibhiH |
samIpamupasamprAptaH kArttikeyasya vAsavaH
shlokas.7:
siMhanAdaM tatashchakre deveshaH sahitaH suraiH |
guho.api shabdaM taM shrutvA vyanadatsAgaro yathA
shlokas.8:
tasya shabdena mahatA samuddhUtodadhiprabham |
babhrAma tatra tatraiva devasainyamachetanam
shlokas.9:
jighA.nsUnupasamprAptAndevAndRRiShTvA sa pAvakiH |
visasarja mukhAtkruddhaH pravRRiddhAH pAvakArchiShaH
tA devasainyAnyadahanveShTamAnAni bhUtale
shlokas.10:
te pradIptashirodehAH pradIptAyudhavAhanAH |
prachyutAH sahasA bhAnti chitrAstArAgaNA iva
shlokas.11:
dahyamAnAH prapannAste sharaNaM pAvakAtmajam |
devA vajradharaM tyaktvA tataH shAntimupAgatAH
shlokas.12:
tyakto devaistataH skande vajraM shakro.abhyavAsRRijat |
tadvisRRiShTaM jaghAnAshu pArshvaM skandasya dakShiNam
bibheda cha mahArAja pArshvaM tasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
vajraprahArAtskandasya sa~njAtaH puruSho.aparaH |
yuvA kA~nchanasaMnAhaH shaktidhRRigdivyakuNDalaH
yadvajravishanAjjAto vishAkhastena so.abhavat
shlokas.14:
taM jAtamaparaM dRRiShTvA kAlAnalasamadyutim |
bhayAdindrastataH skandaM prA~njaliH sharaNaM gataH
shlokas.15:
tasyAbhayaM dadau skandaH sahasainyasya sattama |
tataH prahRRiShTAstridashA vAditrANyabhyavAdayan

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
skandasya pArShadAnghorA~nshRRiNuShvAdbhutadarshanAn |
vajraprahArAtskandasya jaj~nustatra kumArakAH
ye haranti shishU~njAtAngarbhasthA.nshchaiva dAruNAH
shlokas.2:
vajraprahArAtkanyAshcha jaj~nire.asya mahAbalAH |
kumArAshcha vishAkhaM taM pitRRitve samakalpayan
shlokas.3:
sa bhUtvA bhagavAnsa~Nkhye rakSha.nshChAgamukhastadA |
vRRitaH kanyAgaNaiH sarvairAtmanInaishcha putrakaiH
shlokas.4:
mAtR^INAM prekShatInAM cha bhadrashAkhashcha kaushalaH |
tataH kumArapitaraM skandamAhurjanA bhuvi
shlokas.5:
rudramagnimumAM svAhAM pradesheShu mahAbalAm |
yajanti putrakAmAshcha putriNashcha sadA janAH
shlokas.6:
yAstAstvajanayatkanyAstapo nAma hutAshanaH |
kiM karomIti tAH skandaM samprAptAH samabhAShata
shlokas.7:
mAtara UchuH||
bhavema sarvalokasya vayaM mAtara uttamAH |
prasAdAttava pUjyAshcha priyametatkuruShva naH
shlokas.8:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
so.abravIdbADhamityevaM bhaviShyadhvaM pRRithagvidhAH |
ashivAshcha shivAshchaiva punaH punarudAradhIH
shlokas.9:
tataH sa~Nkalpya putratve ska.ndaM mAtRRigaNo.agamat |
kAkI cha halimA chaiva rudrAtha bRRihalI tathA
AryA palAlA vai mitrA saptaitAH shishumAtaraH
shlokas.10:
etAsAM vIryasampannaH shishurnAmAtidAruNaH |
skandaprasAdajaH putro lohitAkSho bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.11:
eSha vIrAShTakaH proktaH skandamAtRRigaNodbhavaH |
ChAgavaktreNa sahito navakaH parikIrtyate
shlokas.12:
ShaShThaM ChAgamayaM vaktraM skandasyaiveti viddhi tat |
ShaTshiro.abhyantaraM rAjannityaM mAtRRigaNArchitam
shlokas.13:
ShaNNAM tu pravaraM tasya shIrShANAmiha shabdyate |
shaktiM yenAsRRijaddivyAM bhadrashAkha iti sma ha
shlokas.14:
ityetadvividhAkAraM vRRittaM shuklasya pa~nchamIm |
tatra yuddhaM mahAghoraM vRRittaM ShaShThyAM janAdhipa

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
upaviShTaM tataH skandaM hiraNyakavachasrajam |
hiraNyachUDamukuTaM hiraNyAkShaM mahAprabham
shlokas.2:
lohitAmbarasa.nvItaM tIkShNadaMShTraM manoramam |
sarvalakShaNasampannaM trailokyasyApi supriyam
shlokas.3:
tatastaM varadaM shUraM yuvAnaM mRRiShTakuNDalam |
abhajatpadmarUpA shrIH svayameva sharIriNI
shlokas.4:
shriyA juShTaH pRRithuyashAH sa kumAravarastadA |
niShaNNo dRRishyate bhUtaiH paurNamAsyAM yathA shashI
shlokas.5:
apUjayanmahAtmAno brAhmaNAstaM mahAbalam |
idamAhustadA chaiva skandaM tatra maharShayaH
shlokas.6:
hiraNyavarNa bhadraM te lokAnAM sha~Nkaro bhava |
tvayA ShaDrAtrajAtena sarve lokA vashIkRRitAH
shlokas.7:
abhayaM cha punardattaM tvayaivaiShAM surottama |
tasmAdindro bhavAnastu trailokyasyAbhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.8:
skanda uvAcha||
kimindraH sarvalokAnAM karotIha tapodhanAH |
kathaM devagaNA.nshchaiva pAti nityaM sureshvaraH
shlokas.9:
RRiShaya UchuH||
indro dishati bhUtAnAM balaM tejaH prajAH sukham |
tuShTaH prayachChati tathA sarvAndAyAnsureshvaraH
shlokas.10:
durvRRittAnAM saMharati vRRittasthAnAM prayachChati |
anushAsti cha bhUtAni kAryeShu balasUdanaH
shlokas.11:
asUrye cha bhavetsUryastathAchandre cha chandramAH |
bhavatyagnishcha vAyushcha pRRithivyApashcha kAraNaiH
shlokas.12:
etadindreNa kartavyamindre hi vipulaM balam |
tvaM cha vIra balashreShThastasmAdindro bhavasva naH
shlokas.13:
shakra uvAcha||
bhavasvendro mahAbAho sarveShAM naH sukhAvahaH |
abhiShichyasva chaivAdya prAptarUpo.asi sattama
shlokas.14:
skanda uvAcha||
shAdhi tvameva trailokyamavyagro vijaye rataH |
ahaM te ki~NkaraH shakra na mamendratvamIpsitam
shlokas.15:
shakra uvAcha||
