balaM tavAdbhutaM vIra tvaM devAnAmarI~njahi |
avaj~nAsyanti mAM lokA vIryeNa tava vismitAH
shlokas.16:
indratve.api sthitaM vIra balahInaM parAjitam |
Avayoshcha mitho bhede prayatiShyantyatandritAH
shlokas.17:
bhedite cha tvayi vibho loko dvaidhamupeShyati |
dvidhAbhUteShu lokeShu nishchiteShvAvayostathA
vigrahaH sampravarteta bhUtabhedAnmahAbala
shlokas.18:
tatra tvaM mAM raNe tAta yathAshraddhaM vijeShyasi |
tasmAdindro bhavAnadya bhavitA mA vichAraya
shlokas.19:
skanda uvAcha||
tvameva rAjA bhadraM te trailokyasya mamaiva cha |
karomi kiM cha te shakra shAsanaM tadbravIhi me
shlokas.20:
shakra uvAcha||
yadi satyamidaM vAkyaM nishchayAdbhAShitaM tvayA |
yadi vA shAsanaM skanda kartumichChasi me shRRiNu
shlokas.21:
abhiShichyasva devAnAM senApatye mahAbala |
ahamindro bhaviShyAmi tava vAkyAnmahAbala
shlokas.22:
skanda uvAcha||
dAnavAnAM vinAshAya devAnAmarthasiddhaye |
gobrAhmaNasya trANArthaM senApatye.abhiShi~ncha mAm
shlokas.23:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
so.abhiShikto maghavatA sarvairdevagaNaiH saha |
atIva shushubhe tatra pUjyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.24:
tasya tatkA~nchanaM ChatraM dhriyamANaM vyarochata |
yathaiva susamiddhasya pAvakasyAtmamaNDalam
shlokas.25:
vishvakarmakRRitA chAsya divyA mAlA hiraNmayI |
AbaddhA tripuraghnena svayameva yashasvinA
shlokas.26:
Agamya manujavyAghra saha devyA parantapa |
archayAmAsa suprIto bhagavAngovRRiShadhvajaH
shlokas.27:
rudramagniM dvijAH prAhU rudrasUnustatastu saH |
rudreNa shukramutsRRiShTaM tachChvetaH parvato.abhavat
pAvakasyendriyaM shvete kRRittikAbhiH kRRitaM nage
shlokas.28:
pUjyamAnaM tu rudreNa dRRiShTvA sarve divaukasaH |
rudrasUnuM tataH prAhurguhaM guNavatAM varam
shlokas.29:
anupravishya rudreNa vahniM jAto hyayaM shishuH |
tatra jAtastataH skando rudrasUnustato.abhavat
shlokas.30:
rudrasya vahneH svAhAyAH ShaNNAM strINAM cha tejasA |
jAtaH skandaH surashreShTho rudrasUnustato.abhavat
shlokas.31:
araje vAsasI rakte vasAnaH pAvakAtmajaH |
bhAti dIptavapuH shrImAnraktAbhrAbhyAmivA.nshumAn
shlokas.32:
kukkuTashchAgninA dattastasya keturala~NkRRitaH |
rathe samuchChrito bhAti kAlAgniriva lohitaH
shlokas.33:
vivesha kavachaM chAsya sharIraM sahajaM tataH |
yudhyamAnasya devasya prAdurbhavati tatsadA
shlokas.34:
shaktirvarma balaM tejaH kAntatvaM satyamakShatiH |
brahmaNyatvamasaMmoho bhaktAnAM parirakShaNam
shlokas.35:
nikRRintanaM cha shatrUNAM lokAnAM chAbhirakShaNam |
skandena saha jAtAni sarvANyeva janAdhipa
shlokas.36:
evaM devagaNaiH sarvaiH so.abhiShiktaH svala~NkRRitaH |
babhau pratItaH sumanAH paripUrNendudarshanaH
shlokas.37:
iShTaiH svAdhyAyaghoShaishcha devatUryaravairapi |
devagandharvagItaishcha sarvairapsarasAM gaNaiH
shlokas.38:
etaishchAnyaishcha vividhairhRRiShTatuShTairala~NkRRitaiH |
krIDanniva tadA devairabhiShiktaH sa pAvakiH
shlokas.39:
abhiShiktaM mahAsenamapashyanta divaukasaH |
vinihatya tamaH sUryaM yathehAbhyuditaM tathA
shlokas.40:
athainamabhyayuH sarvA devasenAH sahasrashaH |
asmAkaM tvaM patiriti bruvANAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.41:
tAH samAsAdya bhagavAnsarvabhUtagaNairvRRitaH |
architashcha stutashchaiva sAntvayAmAsa tA api
shlokas.42:
shatakratushchAbhiShichya skandaM senApatiM tadA |
sasmAra tAM devasenAM yA sA tena vimokShitA
shlokas.43:
ayaM tasyAH patirnUnaM vihito brahmaNA svayam |
iti chintyAnayAmAsa devasenAM svala~NkRRitAm
shlokas.44:
skandaM chovAcha balabhidiyaM kanyA surottama |
ajAte tvayi nirdiShTA tava patnI svayambhuvA
shlokas.45:
tasmAttvamasyA vidhivatpANiM mantrapuraskRRitam |
gRRihANa dakShiNaM devyAH pANinA padmavarchasam
shlokas.46:
evamuktaH sa jagrAha tasyAH pANiM yathAvidhi |
bRRihaspatirmantravidhiM jajApa cha juhAva cha
shlokas.47:
evaM skandasya mahiShIM devasenAM vidurbudhAH |
ShaShThIM yAM brAhmaNAH prAhurlakShmImAshAM sukhapradAm
sinIvAlIM kuhUM chaiva sadvRRittimaparAjitAm
shlokas.48:
yadA skandaH patirlabdhaH shAshvato devasenayA |
tadA tamAshrayallakShmIH svayaM devI sharIriNI
shlokas.49:
shrIjuShTaH pa~nchamIM skandastasmAchChrIpa~nchamI smRRitA |
ShaShThyAM kRRitArtho.abhUdyasmAttasmAtShaShThI mahAtithiH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shriyA juShTaM mahAsenaM devasenApatiM kRRitam |
saptarShipatnyaH ShaDdevyastatsakAshamathAgaman
shlokas.2:
RRiShibhiH samparityaktA dharmayuktA mahAvratAH |
drutamAgamya chochustA devasenApatiM prabhum
shlokas.3:
vayaM putra parityaktA bhartRRibhirdevasaMmitaiH |
akAraNAdruShA tAta puNyasthAnAtparichyutAH
shlokas.4:
asmAbhiH kila jAtastvamiti kenApyudAhRRitam |
asatyametatsa.nshrutya tasmAnnastrAtumarhasi
shlokas.5:
akShayashcha bhavetsvargastvatprasAdAddhi naH prabho |
tvAM putraM chApyabhIpsAmaH kRRitvaitadanRRiNo bhava
shlokas.6:
skanda uvAcha||
mAtaro hi bhavatyo me suto vo.ahamaninditAH |
yachchAbhIpsatha tatsarvaM sambhaviShyati vastathA
shlokas.7:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamukte tataH shakraM kiM kAryamiti so.abravIt |
uktaH skandena brUhIti so.abravIdvAsavastataH
shlokas.8:
abhijitspardhamAnA tu rohiNyA kanyasI svasA |
ichChantI jyeShThatAM devI tapastaptuM vanaM gatA
shlokas.9:
tatra mUDho.asmi bhadraM te nakShatraM gaganAchchyutam |
kAlaM tvimaM paraM skanda brahmaNA saha chintaya
shlokas.10:
dhaniShThAdistadA kAlo brahmaNA parinirmitaH |
rohiNyAdyo.abhavatpUrvamevaM sa~NkhyA samAbhavat
shlokas.11:
evamukte tu shakreNa tridivaM kRRittikA gatAH |
nakShatraM shakaTAkAraM bhAti tadvahnidaivatam
shlokas.12:
vinatA chAbravItskandaM mama tvaM piNDadaH sutaH |
ichChAmi nityamevAhaM tvayA putra sahAsitum
shlokas.13:
skanda uvAcha||
evamastu namaste.astu putrasnehAtprashAdhi mAm |
snuShayA pUjyamAnA vai devi vatsyasi nityadA
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atha mAtRRigaNaH sarvaH skandaM vachanamabravIt |
vayaM sarvasya lokasya mAtaraH kavibhiH stutAH
ichChAmo mAtarastubhyaM bhavituM pUjayasva naH
shlokas.15:
skanda uvAcha||
mAtarastu bhavatyo me bhavatInAmahaM sutaH |
uchyatAM yanmayA kAryaM bhavatInAmathepsitam
shlokas.16:
mAtara UchuH||
yAstu tA mAtaraH pUrvaM lokasyAsya prakalpitAH |
asmAkaM tadbhavetsthAnaM tAsAM chaiva na tadbhavet
shlokas.17:
bhavema pUjyA lokasya na tAH pUjyAH surarShabha |
prajAsmAkaM hRRitAstAbhistvatkRRite tAH prayachCha naH
shlokas.18:
skanda uvAcha||
dattAH prajA na tAH shakyA bhavatIbhirniShevitum |
anyAM vaH kAM prayachChAmi prajAM yAM manasechChatha
shlokas.19:
mAtara UchuH||
ichChAma tAsAM mAtR^INAM prajA bhoktuM prayachCha naH |
tvayA saha pRRithagbhUtA ye cha tAsAmatheshvarAH
shlokas.20:
skanda uvAcha||
prajA vo dadmi kaShTaM tu bhavatIbhirudAhRRitam |
parirakShata bhadraM vaH prajAH sAdhu namaskRRitAH
shlokas.21:
mAtara UchuH||
parirakShAma bhadraM te prajAH skanda yathechChasi |
tvayA no rochate skanda sahavAsashchiraM prabho
shlokas.22:
skanda uvAcha||
yAvatShoDasha varShANi bhavanti taruNAH prajAH |
prabAdhata manuShyANAM tAvadrUpaiH pRRithagvidhaiH
shlokas.23:
ahaM cha vaH pradAsyAmi raudramAtmAnamavyayam |
paramaM tena sahitA sukhaM vatsyatha pUjitAH
shlokas.24:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH sharIrAtskandasya puruShaH kA~nchanaprabhaH |
bhoktuM prajAH sa martyAnAM niShpapAta mahAbalaH
shlokas.25:
apatatsa tadA bhUmau visa~nj~no.atha kShudhAnvitaH |
skandena so.abhyanuj~nAto raudrarUpo.abhavadgrahaH
skandApasmAramityAhurgrahaM taM dvijasattamAH
shlokas.26:
vinatA tu mahAraudrA kathyate shakunigrahaH |
pUtanAM rAkShasIM prAhustaM vidyAtpUtanAgraham
shlokas.27:
kaShTA dAruNarUpeNa ghorarUpA nishAcharI |
pishAchI dAruNAkArA kathyate shItapUtanA
garbhAnsA mAnuShINAM tu harate ghoradarshanA
shlokas.28:
aditiM revatIM prAhurgrahastasyAstu raivataH |
so.api bAlA~nshishUnghoro bAdhate vai mahAgrahaH
shlokas.29:
daityAnAM yA ditirmAtA tAmAhurmukhamaNDikAm |
atyarthaM shishumA.nsena samprahRRiShTA durAsadA
shlokas.30:
kumArAshcha kumAryashcha ye proktAH skandasambhavAH |
te.api garbhabhujaH sarve kauravya sumahAgrahAH
shlokas.31:
tAsAmeva kumArINAM patayaste prakIrtitAH |
aj~nAyamAnA gRRihNanti bAlakAnraudrakarmiNaH
shlokas.32:
gavAM mAtA tu yA prAj~naiH kathyate surabhirnRRipa |
shakunistAmathAruhya saha bhu~Nkte shishUnbhuvi
shlokas.33:
saramA nAma yA mAtA shunAM devI janAdhipa |
sApi garbhAnsamAdatte mAnuShINAM sadaiva hi
shlokas.34:
pAdapAnAM cha yA mAtA kara~njanilayA hi sA |
kara~nje tAM namasyanti tasmAtputrArthino narAH
shlokas.35:
ime tvaShTAdashAnye vai grahA mA.nsamadhupriyAH |
dvipa~ncharAtraM tiShThanti satataM sUtikAgRRihe
shlokas.36:
kadrUH sUkShmavapurbhUtvA garbhiNIM pravishedyadA |
bhu~Nkte sA tatra taM garbhaM sA tu nAgaM prasUyate
shlokas.37:
gandharvANAM tu yA mAtA sA garbhaM gRRihya gachChati |
tato vilInagarbhA sA mAnuShI bhuvi dRRishyate
shlokas.38:
yA janitrI tvapsarasAM garbhamAste pragRRihya sA |
upaviShTaM tato garbhaM kathayanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.39:
lohitasyodadheH kanyA dhAtrI skandasya sA smRRitA |
lohitAyanirityevaM kadambe sA hi pUjyate
shlokas.40:
puruSheShu yathA rudrastathAryA pramadAsvapi |
AryA mAtA kumArasya pRRithakkAmArthamijyate
shlokas.41:
evamete kumArANAM mayA proktA mahAgrahAH |
yAvatShoDasha varShANi ashivAste shivAstataH
shlokas.42:
ye cha mAtRRigaNAH proktAH puruShAshchaiva ye grahAH |
sarve skandagrahA nAma j~neyA nityaM sharIribhiH
shlokas.43:
teShAM prashamanaM kAryaM snAnaM dhUpamathA~njanam |
balikarmopahArashcha skandasyejyA visheShataH
shlokas.44:
evamete.architAH sarve prayachChanti shubhaM nRRiNAm |
AyurvIryaM cha rAjendra samyakpUjAnamaskRRitAH
shlokas.45:
UrdhvaM tu ShoDashAdvarShAdye bhavanti grahA nRRiNAm |
tAnahaM sampravakShyAmi namaskRRitya maheshvaram
shlokas.46:
yaH pashyati naro devA~njAgradvA shayito.api vA |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM taM tu devagrahaM viduH
shlokas.47:
AsInashcha shayAnashcha yaH pashyati naraH pitR^In |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM sa j~neyastu pitRRigrahaH
shlokas.48:
avamanyati yaH siddhAnkruddhAshchApi shapanti yam |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM j~neyaH siddhagrahastu saH
shlokas.49:
upAghrAti cha yo gandhAnrasA.nshchApi pRRithagvidhAn |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM sa j~neyo rAkShaso grahaH
shlokas.50:
gandharvAshchApi yaM divyAH sa.nspRRishanti naraM bhuvi |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM graho gAndharva eva saH
shlokas.51:
Avishanti cha yaM yakShAH puruShaM kAlaparyaye |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM j~neyo yakShagrahastu saH
shlokas.52:
adhirohanti yaM nityaM pishAchAH puruShaM kvachit |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM paishAchaM taM grahaM viduH
shlokas.53:
yasya doShaiH prakupitaM chittaM muhyati dehinaH |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM sAdhanaM tasya shAstrataH
shlokas.54:
vaiklavyAchcha bhayAchchaiva ghorANAM chApi darshanAt |
unmAdyati sa tu kShipraM sattvaM tasya tu sAdhanam
shlokas.55:
kashchitkrIDitukAmo vai bhoktukAmastathAparaH |
abhikAmastathaivAnya ityeSha trividho grahaH
shlokas.56:
yAvatsaptativarShANi bhavantyete grahA nRRiNAm |
ataH paraM dehinAM tu grahatulyo bhavejjvaraH
shlokas.57:
aprakIrNendriyaM dAntaM shuchiM nityamatandritam |
AstikaM shraddadhAnaM cha varjayanti sadA grahAH
shlokas.58:
ityeSha te grahoddesho mAnuShANAM prakIrtitaH |
na spRRishanti grahA bhaktAnnarAndevaM maheshvaram

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
yadA skandena mAtR^INAmevametatpriyaM kRRitam |
athainamabravItsvAhA mama putrastvamaurasaH
shlokas.2:
ichChAmyahaM tvayA dattAM prItiM paramadurlabhAm |
tAmabravIttataH skandaH prItimichChasi kIdRRishIm
shlokas.3:
svAhovAcha||
dakShasyAhaM priyA kanyA svAhA nAma mahAbhuja |
bAlyAtprabhRRiti nityaM cha jAtakAmA hutAshane
shlokas.4:
na cha mAM kAminIM putra samyagjAnAti pAvakaH |
ichChAmi shAshvataM vAsaM vastuM putra sahAgninA
shlokas.5:
skanda uvAcha||
havyaM kavyaM cha yatki~nchiddvijA mantrapuraskRRitam |
hoShyantyagnau sadA devi svAhetyuktvA samudyatam
shlokas.6:
adya prabhRRiti dAsyanti suvRRittAH satpathe sthitAH |
evamagnistvayA sArdhaM sadA vatsyati shobhane
shlokas.7:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktA tataH svAhA tuShTA skandena pUjitA |
pAvakena samAyuktA bhartrA skandamapUjayat
shlokas.8:
tato brahmA mahAsenaM prajApatirathAbravIt |
abhigachCha mahAdevaM pitaraM tripurArdanam
shlokas.9:
rudreNAgniM samAvishya svAhAmAvishya chomayA |
hitArthaM sarvalokAnAM jAtastvamaparAjitaH
shlokas.10:
umAyonyAM cha rudreNa shukraM siktaM mahAtmanA |
Aste girau nipatitaM mi~njikAmi~njikaM yataH
shlokas.11:
sambhUtaM lohitode tu shukrasheShamavApatat |
sUryarashmiShu chApyanyadanyachchaivApatadbhuvi
AsaktamanyadvRRikSheShu tadevaM pa~nchadhApatat
shlokas.12:
ta ete vividhAkArA gaNA j~neyA manIShibhiH |
tava pAriShadA ghorA ya ete pishitAshanAH
shlokas.13:
evamastviti chApyuktvA mahAseno maheshvaram |
apUjayadameyAtmA pitaraM pitRRivatsalaH
shlokas.14:
arkapuShpaistu te pa~ncha gaNAH pUjyA dhanArthibhiH |
vyAdhiprashamanArthaM cha teShAM pUjAM samAcharet
shlokas.15:
mi~njikAmi~njikaM chaiva mithunaM rudrasambhavam |
namaskAryaM sadaiveha bAlAnAM hitamichChatA
shlokas.16:
striyo mAnuShamA.nsAdA vRRiddhikA nAma nAmataH |
vRRikSheShu jAtAstA devyo namaskAryAH prajArthibhiH
shlokas.17:
evamete pishAchAnAmasa~NkhyeyA gaNAH smRRitAH |
ghaNTAyAH sapatAkAyAH shRRiNu me sambhavaM nRRipa
shlokas.18:
airAvatasya ghaNTe dve vaijayantyAviti shrute |
guhasya te svayaM datte shakreNAnAyya dhImatA
shlokas.19:
ekA tatra vishAkhasya ghaNTA skandasya chAparA |
patAkA kArttikeyasya vishAkhasya cha lohitA
shlokas.20:
yAni krIDanakAnyasya devairdattAni vai tadA |
taireva ramate devo mahAseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.21:
sa sa.nvRRitaH pishAchAnAM gaNairdevagaNaistathA |
shushubhe kA~nchane shaile dIpyamAnaH shriyA vRRitaH
shlokas.22:
tena vIreNa shushubhe sa shailaH shubhakAnanaH |
AdityenevA.nshumatA mandarashchArukandaraH
shlokas.23:
santAnakavanaiH phullaiH karavIravanairapi |
pArijAtavanaishchaiva japAshokavanaistathA
shlokas.24:
kadambataruShaNDaishcha divyairmRRigagaNairapi |
divyaiH pakShigaNaishchaiva shushubhe shvetaparvataH
shlokas.25:
tatra devagaNAH sarve sarve chaiva maharShayaH |
meghatUryaravAshchaiva kShubdhodadhisamasvanAH
shlokas.26:
tatra divyAshcha gandharvA nRRityantyapsarasastathA |
hRRiShTAnAM tatra bhUtAnAM shrUyate ninado mahAn
shlokas.27:
evaM sendraM jagatsarvaM shvetaparvatasa.nsthitam |
prahRRiShTaM prekShate skandaM na cha glAyati darshanAt

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
yadAbhiShikto bhagavAnsenApatyena pAvakiH |
tadA samprasthitaH shrImAnhRRiShTo bhadravaTaM haraH
rathenAdityavarNena pArvatyA sahitaH prabhuH
shlokas.2:
sahasraM tasya siMhAnAM tasminyuktaM rathottame |
utpapAta divaM shubhraM kAlenAbhiprachoditaH
shlokas.3:
te pibanta ivAkAshaM trAsayantashcharAcharAn |
siMhA nabhasyagachChanta nadantashchArukesarAH
shlokas.4:
tasminrathe pashupatiH sthito bhAtyumayA saha |
vidyutA sahitaH sUryaH sendrachApe ghane yathA
shlokas.5:
agratastasya bhagavAndhanesho guhyakaiH saha |
AsthAya ruchiraM yAti puShpakaM naravAhanaH
shlokas.6:
airAvataM samAsthAya shakrashchApi suraiH saha |
pRRiShThato.anuyayau yAntaM varadaM vRRiShabhadhvajam
shlokas.7:
jambhakairyakSharakShobhiH sragvibhiH samala~NkRRitaH |
yAtyamogho mahAyakSho dakShiNaM pakShamAsthitaH
shlokas.8:
tasya dakShiNato devA marutashchitrayodhinaH |
gachChanti vasubhiH sArdhaM rudraishcha saha sa~NgatAH
shlokas.9:
yamashcha mRRityunA sArdhaM sarvataH parivAritaH |
ghorairvyAdhishatairyAti ghorarUpavapustathA
shlokas.10:
yamasya pRRiShThatashchaiva ghorastrishikharaH shitaH |
vijayo nAma rudrasya yAti shUlaH svala~NkRRitaH
shlokas.11:
tamugrapAsho varuNo bhagavAnsalileshvaraH |
parivArya shanairyAti yAdobhirvividhairvRRitaH
shlokas.12:
pRRiShThato vijayasyApi yAti rudrasya paTTishaH |
gadAmusalashaktyAdyairvRRitaH praharaNottamaiH
shlokas.13:
paTTishaM tvanvagAdrAja.nshChatraM raudraM mahAprabham |
kamaNDalushchApyanu taM maharShigaNasa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.14:
tasya dakShiNato bhAti daNDo gachCha~nshriyA vRRitaH |
bhRRigva~NgirobhiH sahito devaishchApyabhipUjitaH
shlokas.15:
eShAM tu pRRiShThato rudro vimale syandane sthitaH |
yAti saMharShayansarvA.nstejasA tridivaukasaH
shlokas.16:
RRiShayashchaiva devAshcha gandharvA bhujagAstathA |
nadyo nadA drumAshchaiva tathaivApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.17:
nakShatrANi grahAshchaiva devAnAM shishavashcha ye |
striyashcha vividhAkArA yAnti rudrasya pRRiShThataH
sRRijantyaH puShpavarShANi chArurUpA varA~NganAH
shlokas.18:
parjanyashchApyanuyayau namaskRRitya pinAkinam |
ChatraM tu pANDuraM somastasya mUrdhanyadhArayat
chAmare chApi vAyushcha gRRihItvAgnishcha viShThitau
shlokas.19:
shakrashcha pRRiShThatastasya yAti rAja~nshriyA vRRitaH |
saha rAjarShibhiH sarvaiH stuvAno vRRiShaketanam
shlokas.20:
gaurI vidyAtha gAndhArI keshinI mitrasAhvayA |
sAvitryA saha sarvAstAH pArvatyA yAnti pRRiShThataH
shlokas.21:
tatra vidyAgaNAH sarve ye kechitkavibhiH kRRitAH |
yasya kurvanti vachanaM sendrA devAshchamUmukhe
shlokas.22:
sa gRRihItvA patAkAM tu yAtyagre rAkShaso grahaH |
vyApRRitastu shmashAne yo nityaM rudrasya vai sakhA
pi~Ngalo nAma yakShendro lokasyAnandadAyakaH
shlokas.23:
ebhiH sa sahitastatra yayau devo yathAsukham |
agrataH pRRiShThatashchaiva na hi tasya gatirdhruvA
shlokas.24:
rudraM satkarmabhirmartyAH pUjayantIha daivatam |
shivamityeva yaM prAhurIshaM rudraM pinAkinam
bhAvaistu vividhAkAraiH pUjayanti maheshvaram
shlokas.25:
devasenApatistvevaM devasenAbhirAvRRitaH |
anugachChati deveshaM brahmaNyaH kRRittikAsutaH
shlokas.26:
athAbravInmahAsenaM mahAdevo bRRihadvachaH |
saptamaM mArutaskandhaM rakSha nityamatandritaH
shlokas.27:
skanda uvAcha||
saptamaM mArutaskandhaM pAlayiShyAmyahaM prabho |
yadanyadapi me kAryaM deva tadvada mAchiram
shlokas.28:
rudra uvAcha||
kAryeShvahaM tvayA putra sa.ndraShTavyaH sadaiva hi |
darshanAnmama bhaktyA cha shreyaH paramavApsyasi
shlokas.29:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ityuktvA visasarjainaM pariShvajya maheShvaraH |
visarjite tataH skande babhUvautpAtikaM mahat
sahasaiva mahArAja devAnsarvAnpramohayat
shlokas.30:
jajvAla khaM sanakShatraM pramUDhaM bhuvanaM bhRRisham |
chachAla vyanadachchorvI tamobhUtaM jagatprabho
shlokas.31:
tatastaddAruNaM dRRiShTvA kShubhitaH sha~NkarastadA |
umA chaiva mahAbhAgA devAshcha samaharShayaH
shlokas.32:
tatasteShu pramUDheShu parvatAmbudasaMnibham |
nAnApraharaNaM ghoramadRRishyata mahadbalam
shlokas.33:
taddhi ghoramasa~NkhyeyaM garjachcha vividhA giraH |
abhyadravadraNe devAnbhagavantaM cha sha~Nkaram
shlokas.34:
tairvisRRiShTAnyanIkeShu bANajAlAnyanekashaH |
parvatAshcha shataghnyashcha prAsAshcha parighA gadAH
shlokas.35:
nipatadbhishcha tairghorairdevAnIkaM mahAyudhaiH |
kShaNena vyadravatsarvaM vimukhaM chApyadRRishyata
shlokas.36:
nikRRittayodhanAgAshvaM kRRittAyudhamahAratham |
dAnavairarditaM sainyaM devAnAM vimukhaM babhau
shlokas.37:
asurairvadhyamAnaM tatpAvakairiva kAnanam |
apataddagdhabhUyiShThaM mahAdrumavanaM yathA
shlokas.38:
te vibhinnashirodehAH prachyavante divaukasaH |
na nAthamadhyagachChanta vadhyamAnA mahAraNe
shlokas.39:
atha tadvidrutaM sainyaM dRRiShTvA devaH pura.ndaraH |
AshvAsayannuvAchedaM balavaddAnavArditam
shlokas.40:
bhayaM tyajata bhadraM vaH shUrAH shastrANi gRRihNata |
kurudhvaM vikrame buddhiM mA vaH kAchidvyathA bhavet
shlokas.41:
jayatainAnsudurvRRittAndAnavAnghoradarshanAn |
abhidravata bhadraM vo mayA saha mahAsurAn
shlokas.42:
shakrasya vachanaM shrutvA samAshvastA divaukasaH |
dAnavAnpratyayudhyanta shakraM kRRitvA vyapAshrayam
shlokas.43:
tataste tridashAH sarve marutashcha mahAbalAH |
pratyudyayurmahAvegAH sAdhyAshcha vasubhiH saha
shlokas.44:
tairvisRRiShTAnyanIkeShu kruddhaiH shastrANi sa.nyuge |
sharAshcha daityakAyeShu pibanti smAsRRigulbaNam
shlokas.45:
teShAM dehAnvinirbhidya sharAste nishitAstadA |
niShpatanto adRRishyanta nagebhya iva pannagAH
shlokas.46:
tAni daityasharIrANi nirbhinnAni sma sAyakaiH |
apatanbhUtale rAja.nshChinnAbhrANIva sarvashaH
shlokas.47:
tatastaddAnavaM sainyaM sarvairdevagaNairyudhi |
trAsitaM vividhairbANaiH kRRitaM chaiva parA~Nmukham
shlokas.48:
athotkruShTaM tadA hRRiShTaiH sarvairdevairudAyudhaiH |
saMhatAni cha tUryANi tadA sarvANyanekashaH
shlokas.49:
evamanyonyasa.nyuktaM yuddhamAsItsudAruNam |
devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha mA.nsashoNitakardamam
shlokas.50:
anayo devalokasya sahasaiva vyadRRishyata |
tathA hi dAnavA ghorA vinighnanti divaukasaH
shlokas.51:
tatastUryapraNAdAshcha bherINAM cha mahAsvanAH |
babhUvurdAnavendrANAM siMhanAdAshcha dAruNAH
shlokas.52:
atha daityabalAdghorAnniShpapAta mahAbalaH |
dAnavo mahiSho nAma pragRRihya vipulaM girim
shlokas.53:
te taM ghanairivAdityaM dRRiShTvA samparivAritam |
samudyatagiriM rAjanvyadravanta divaukasaH
shlokas.54:
athAbhidrutya mahiSho devA.nshchikShepa taM girim |
patatA tena giriNA devasainyasya pArthiva
bhImarUpeNa nihatamayutaM prApatadbhuvi
shlokas.55:
atha tairdAnavaiH sArdhaM mahiShastrAsayansurAn |
abhyadravadraNe tUrNaM siMhaH kShudramRRigAniva
shlokas.56:
tamApatantaM mahiShaM dRRiShTvA sendrA divaukasaH |
vyadravanta raNe bhItA vishIrNAyudhaketanAH
shlokas.57:
tataH sa mahiShaH kruddhastUrNaM rudrarathaM yayau |
abhidrutya cha jagrAha rudrasya rathakUbaram
shlokas.58:
yadA rudrarathaM kruddho mahiShaH sahasA gataH |
resatU rodasI gADhaM mumuhushcha maharShayaH
shlokas.59:
vyanada.nshcha mahAkAyA daityA jaladharopamAH |
AsIchcha nishchitaM teShAM jitamasmAbhirityuta
shlokas.60:
tathAbhUte tu bhagavAnnAvadhInmahiShaM raNe |
sasmAra cha tadA skandaM mRRityuM tasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.61:
mahiSho.api rathaM dRRiShTvA raudraM rudrasya nAnadat |
devAnsantrAsaya.nshchApi daityA.nshchApi praharShayan
shlokas.62:
tatastasminbhaye ghore devAnAM samupasthite |
AjagAma mahAsenaH krodhAtsUrya iva jvalan
shlokas.63:
lohitAmbarasa.nvIto lohitasragvibhUShaNaH |
lohitAsyo mahAbAhurhiraNyakavachaH prabhuH
shlokas.64:
rathamAdityasa~NkAshamAsthitaH kanakaprabham |
taM dRRiShTvA daityasenA sA vyadravatsahasA raNe
shlokas.65:
sa chApi tAM prajvalitAM mahiShasya vidAriNIm |
mumocha shaktiM rAjendra mahAseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.66:
sA muktAbhyahanachChaktirmahiShasya shiro mahat |
papAta bhinne shirasi mahiShastyaktajIvitaH
shlokas.67:
kShiptAkShiptA tu sA shaktirhatvA shatrUnsahasrashaH |
skandahastamanuprAptA dRRishyate devadAnavaiH
shlokas.68:
prAyaH sharairvinihatA mahAsenena dhImatA |
sheShA daityagaNA ghorA bhItAstrastA durAsadaiH
skandasya pArShadairhatvA bhakShitAH shatasa~NghashaH
shlokas.69:
dAnavAnbhakShayantaste prapibantashcha shoNitam |
kShaNAnnirdAnavaM sarvamakArShurbhRRishaharShitAH
shlokas.70:
tamA.nsIva yathA sUryo vRRikShAnagnirghanAnkhagaH |
tathA skando.ajayachChatrUnsvena vIryeNa kIrtimAn
shlokas.72:
naShTashatruryadA skandaH prayAtashcha maheshvaram |
athAbravInmahAsenaM pariShvajya pura.ndaraH
shlokas.73:
brahmadattavaraH skanda tvayAyaM mahiSho hataH |
devAstRRiNamayA yasya babhUvurjayatAM vara
so.ayaM tvayA mahAbAho shamito devakaNTakaH
shlokas.74:
shataM mahiShatulyAnAM dAnavAnAM tvayA raNe |
nihataM devashatrUNAM yairvayaM pUrvatApitAH
shlokas.75:
tAvakairbhakShitAshchAnye dAnavAH shatasa~NghashaH |
ajeyastvaM raNe.arINAmumApatiriva prabhuH
shlokas.76:
etatte prathamaM deva khyAtaM karma bhaviShyati |
triShu lokeShu kIrtishcha tavAkShayyA bhaviShyati
vashagAshcha bhaviShyanti surAstava surAtmaja
shlokas.77:
mahAsenetyevamuktvA nivRRittaH saha daivataiH |
anuj~nAto bhagavatA tryambakena shachIpatiH
shlokas.78:
gato bhadravaTaM rudro nivRRittAshcha divaukasaH |
uktAshcha devA rudreNa skandaM pashyata mAmiva
shlokas.79:
sa hatvA dAnavagaNAnpUjyamAno maharShibhiH |
ekAhnaivAjayatsarvaM trailokyaM vahninandanaH
shlokas.80:
skandasya ya idaM janma paThate susamAhitaH |
sa puShTimiha samprApya skandasAlokyatAmiyAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
upAsIneShu vipreShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
draupadI satyabhAmA cha vivishAte tadA samam
jAhasyamAne suprIte sukhaM tatra niShIdatuH
shlokas.2:
chirasya dRRiShTvA rAjendra te.anyonyasya priya.nvade |
kathayAmAsatushchitrAH kathAH kuruyadukShitAm
shlokas.3:
athAbravItsatyabhAmA kRRiShNasya mahiShI priyA |
sAtrAjitI yAj~nasenIM rahasIdaM sumadhyamA
shlokas.4:
kena draupadi vRRittena pANDavAnupatiShThasi |
lokapAlopamAnvIrAnyUnaH paramasaMmatAn
kathaM cha vashagAstubhyaM na kupyanti cha te shubhe
shlokas.5:
tava vashyA hi satataM pANDavAH priyadarshane |
mukhaprekShAshcha te sarve tattvametadbravIhi me
shlokas.6:
vratacharyA tapo vApi snAnamantrauShadhAni vA |
vidyAvIryaM mUlavIryaM japahomastathAgadAH
shlokas.7:
mama AchakShva pA~nchAli yashasyaM bhagavedanam |
yena kRRiShNe bhavennityaM mama kRRiShNo vashAnugaH
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA satyabhAmA virarAma yashasvinI |
pativratA mahAbhAgA draupadI pratyuvAcha tAm
shlokas.9:
asatstrINAM samAchAraM satye mAmanupRRichChasi |
asadAcharite mArge kathaM syAdanukIrtanam
shlokas.10:
anuprashnaH sa.nshayo vA naitattvayyupapadyate |
tathA hyupetA buddhyA tvaM kRRiShNasya mahiShI priyA
shlokas.11:
yadaiva bhartA jAnIyAnmantramUlaparAM striyam |
udvijeta tadaivAsyAH sarpAdveshmagatAdiva
shlokas.12:
udvignasya kutaH shAntirashAntasya kutaH sukham |
na jAtu vashago bhartA striyAH syAnmantrakAraNAt
shlokas.13:
amitraprahitA.nshchApi gadAnparamadAruNAn |
mUlapravAdairhi viShaM prayachChanti jighA.nsavaH
shlokas.14:
jihvayA yAni puruShastvachA vApyupasevate |
tatra chUrNAni dattAni hanyuH kShipramasa.nshayam
shlokas.15:
jalodarasamAyuktAH shvitriNaH palitAstathA |
apumA.nsaH kRRitAH strIbhirjaDAndhabadhirAstathA
shlokas.16:
pApAnugAstu pApAstAH patInupasRRijantyuta |
na jAtu vipriyaM bhartuH striyA kAryaM katha~nchana
shlokas.17:
vartAmyahaM tu yAM vRRittiM pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
tAM sarvAM shRRiNu me satyAM satyabhAme yashasvini
shlokas.18:
aha~NkAraM vihAyAhaM kAmakrodhau cha sarvadA |
sadArAnpANDavAnnityaM prayatopacharAmyaham
shlokas.19:
praNayaM pratisa~NgRRihya nidhAyAtmAnamAtmani |
shushrUShurnirabhImAnA patInAM chittarakShiNI
shlokas.20:
durvyAhRRitAchCha~NkamAnA duHsthitAdduravekShitAt |
durAsitAddurvrajitAdi~NgitAdhyAsitAdapi
shlokas.21:
sUryavaishvAnaranibhAnsomakalpAnmahArathAn |
seve chakShurhaNaH pArthAnugratejaHpratApinaH
shlokas.22:
devo manuShyo gandharvo yuvA chApi svala~NkRRitaH |
dravyavAnabhirUpo vA na me.anyaH puruSho mataH
shlokas.23:
nAbhuktavati nAsnAte nAsa.nviShTe cha bhartari |
na sa.nvishAmi nAshnAmi sadA karmakareShvapi
shlokas.24:
kShetrAdvanAdvA grAmAdvA bhartAraM gRRihamAgatam |
pratyutthAyAbhinandAmi Asanenodakena cha
shlokas.25:
pramRRiShTabhANDA mRRiShTAnnA kAle bhojanadAyinI |
sa.nyatA guptadhAnyA cha susaMmRRiShTaniveshanA
shlokas.26:
atiraskRRitasambhAShA duHstriyo nAnusevatI |
anukUlavatI nityaM bhavAmyanalasA sadA
shlokas.27:
anarme chApi hasanaM dvAri sthAnamabhIkShNashaH |
avaskare chirasthAnaM niShkuTeShu cha varjaye
shlokas.28:
atihAsAtiroShau cha krodhasthAnaM cha varjaye |
niratAhaM sadA satye bhartR^INAmupasevane
sarvathA bhartRRirahitaM na mameShTaM katha~nchana
shlokas.29:
yadA pravasate bhartA kuTumbArthena kenachit |
sumanovarNakApetA bhavAmi vratachAriNI
shlokas.30:
yachcha bhartA na pibati yachcha bhartA na khAdati |
yachcha nAshnAti me bhartA sarvaM tadvarjayAmyaham
shlokas.31:
yathopadeshaM niyatA vartamAnA varA~Ngane |
svala~NkRRitA suprayatA bhartuH priyahite ratA
shlokas.32:
ye cha dharmAH kuTumbeShu shvashrvA me kathitAH purA |
bhikShAbalishrAddhamiti sthAlIpAkAshcha parvasu
mAnyAnAM mAnasatkArA ye chAnye viditA mayA
shlokas.33:
tAnsarvAnanuvartAmi divArAtramatandritA |
vinayAnniyamA.nshchApi sadA sarvAtmanA shritA
shlokas.34:
mRRidUnsataH satyashIlAnsatyadharmAnupAlinaH |
AshIviShAniva kruddhAnpatInparicharAmyaham
shlokas.35:
patyAshrayo hi me dharmo mataH strINAM sanAtanaH |
sa devaH sA gatirnAnyA tasya kA vipriyaM charet
shlokas.36:
ahaM patInnAtishaye nAtyashne nAtibhUShaye |
nApi parivade shvashrUM sarvadA pariyantritA
shlokas.37:
avadhAnena subhage nityotthAnatayaiva cha |
bhartAro vashagA mahyaM gurushushrUShaNena cha
shlokas.38:
nityamAryAmahaM kuntIM vIrasUM satyavAdinIm |
svayaM paricharAmyekA snAnAchChAdanabhojanaiH
shlokas.39:
naitAmatishaye jAtu vastrabhUShaNabhojanaiH |
nApi parivade chAhaM tAM pRRithAM pRRithivIsamAm
shlokas.40:
aShTAvagre brAhmaNAnAM sahasrANi sma nityadA |
bhu~njate rukmapAtrIShu yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.41:
aShTAshItisahasrANi snAtakA gRRihamedhinaH |
tri.nshaddAsIka ekaiko yAnbibharti yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.42:
dashAnyAni sahasrANi yeShAmannaM susa.nskRRitam |
hriyate rukmapAtrIbhiryatInAmUrdhvaretasAm
shlokas.43:
tAnsarvAnagrahAreNa brAhmaNAnbrahmavAdinaH |
yathArhaM pUjayAmi sma pAnAchChAdanabhojanaiH
shlokas.44:
shataM dAsIsahasrANi kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH |
kambukeyUradhAriNyo niShkakaNThyaH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.45:
mahArhamAlyAbharaNAH suvarNAshchandanokShitAH |
maNInhema cha bibhratyo nRRityagItavishAradAH
shlokas.46:
tAsAM nAma cha rUpaM cha bhojanAchChAdanAni cha |
sarvAsAmeva vedAhaM karma chaiva kRRitAkRRitam
shlokas.47:
shataM dAsIsahasrANi kuntIputrasya dhImataH |
pAtrIhastA divArAtramatithInbhojayantyuta
shlokas.48:
shatamashvasahasrANi dasha nAgAyutAni cha |
yudhiShThirasyAnuyAtramindraprasthanivAsinaH
shlokas.49:
etadAsIttadA rAj~no yanmahIM paryapAlayat |
yeShAM sa~NkhyAvidhiM chaiva pradishAmi shRRiNomi cha
shlokas.50:
antaHpurANAM sarveShAM bhRRityAnAM chaiva sarvashaH |
A gopAlAvipAlebhyaH sarvaM veda kRRitAkRRitam
shlokas.51:
sarvaM rAj~naH samudayamAyaM cha vyayameva cha |
ekAhaM vedmi kalyANi pANDavAnAM yashasvinAm
shlokas.52:
mayi sarvaM samAsajya kuTumbaM bharatarShabhAH |
upAsanaratAH sarve ghaTante sma shubhAnane
shlokas.53:
tamahaM bhAramAsaktamanAdhRRiShyaM durAtmabhiH |
sukhaM sarvaM parityajya rAtryahAni ghaTAmi vai
shlokas.54:
adhRRiShyaM varuNasyeva nidhipUrNamivodadhim |
ekAhaM vedmi koshaM vai patInAM dharmachAriNAm
shlokas.55:
anishAyAM nishAyAM cha sahAyAH kShutpipAsayoH |
ArAdhayantyAH kauravyA.nstulyA rAtrirahashcha me
shlokas.56:
prathamaM pratibudhyAmi charamaM sa.nvishAmi cha |
nityakAlamahaM satye etatsa.nvananaM mama
shlokas.57:
etajjAnAmyahaM kartuM bhartRRisa.nvananaM mahat |
asatstrINAM samAchAraM nAhaM kuryAM na kAmaye
shlokas.58:
tachChrutvA dharmasahitaM vyAhRRitaM kRRiShNayA tadA |
uvAcha satyA satkRRitya pA~nchAlIM dharmachAriNIm
shlokas.59:
abhipannAsmi pA~nchAli yAj~naseni kShamasva me |
kAmakAraH sakhInAM hi sopahAsaM prabhAShitum

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
imaM tu te mArgamapetadoShaM; vakShyAmi chittagrahaNAya bhartuH |
yasminyathAvatsakhi vartamAnA; bhartAramAchChetsyasi kAminIbhyaH
shlokas.2:
naitAdRRishaM daivatamasti satye; sarveShu lokeShu sadaivateShu |
yathA patistasya hi sarvakAmA; labhyAH prasAde kupitashcha hanyAt
shlokas.3:
tasmAdapatyaM vividhAshcha bhogAH; shayyAsanAnyadbhutadarshanAni |
vastrANi mAlyAni tathaiva gandhAH; svargashcha loko viShamA cha kIrtiH
shlokas.4:
sukhaM sukheneha na jAtu labhyaM; duHkhena sAdhvI labhate sukhAni |
sA kRRiShNamArAdhaya sauhRRidena; premNA cha nityaM pratikarmaNA cha
shlokas.5:
tathAshanaishchArubhiragryamAlyai;rdAkShiNyayogairvividhaishcha gandhaiH |
asyAH priyo.asmIti yathA viditvA; tvAmeva sa.nshliShyati sarvabhAvaiH
shlokas.6:
shrutvA svaraM dvAragatasya bhartuH; pratyutthitA tiShTha gRRihasya madhye |
dRRiShTvA praviShTaM tvaritAsanena; pAdyena chaiva pratipUjaya tvam
shlokas.7:
sampreShitAyAmatha chaiva dAsyA;mutthAya sarvaM svayameva kuryAH |
jAnAtu kRRiShNastava bhAvametaM; sarvAtmanA mAM bhajatIti satye
shlokas.8:
tvatsaMnidhau yatkathayetpatiste; yadyapyaguhyaM parirakShitavyam |
kAchitsapatnI tava vAsudevaM; pratyAdishettena bhavedvirAgaH
shlokas.9:
priyA.nshcha raktA.nshcha hitA.nshcha bhartu;stAnbhojayethA vividhairupAyaiH |
dveShyairapakShairahitaishcha tasya; bhidyasva nityaM kuhakoddhataishcha
shlokas.10:
madaM pramAdaM puruSheShu hitvA; sa.nyachCha bhAvaM pratigRRihya maunam |
pradyumnasAmbAvapi te kumArau; nopAsitavyau rahite kadAchit
shlokas.11:
mahAkulInAbhirapApikAbhiH; strIbhiH satIbhistava sakhyamastu |
chaNDAshcha shauNDAshcha mahAshanAshcha; chaurAshcha duShTAshchapalAshcha varjyAH
shlokas.12:
etadyashasyaM bhagavedanaM cha; svargyaM tathA shatrunibarhaNaM cha |
mahArhamAlyAbharaNA~NgarAgA; bhartAramArAdhaya puNyagandhA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mArkaNDeyAdibhirvipraiH pANDavaishcha mahAtmabhiH |
kathAbhiranukUlAbhiH sahAsitvA janArdanaH
shlokas.2:
tatastaiH sa.nvidaM kRRitvA yathAvanmadhusUdanaH |
ArurukShU rathaM satyAmAhvayAmAsa keshavaH
shlokas.3:
satyabhAmA tatastatra svajitvA drupadAtmajAm |
uvAcha vachanaM hRRidyaM yathAbhAvasamAhitam
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNe mA bhUttavotkaNThA mA vyathA mA prajAgaraH |
bhartRRibhirdevasa~NkAshairjitAM prApsyasi medinIm
shlokas.5:
na hyevaM shIlasampannA naivaM pUjitalakShaNAH |
prApnuvanti chiraM kleshaM yathA tvamasitekShaNe
shlokas.6:
avashyaM cha tvayA bhUmiriyaM nihatakaNTakA |
bhartRRibhiH saha bhoktavyA nirdva.ndveti shrutaM mayA
shlokas.7:
dhArtarAShTravadhaM kRRitvA vairANi pratiyAtya cha |
yudhiShThirasthAM pRRithivIM draShTAsi drupadAtmaje
shlokas.8:
yAstAH pravrAjamAnAM tvAM prAhasandarpamohitAH |
tAH kShipraM hatasa~NkalpA drakShyasi tvaM kurustriyaH
shlokas.9:
tava duHkhopapannAyA yairAcharitamapriyam |
viddhi samprasthitAnsarvA.nstAnkRRiShNe yamasAdanam
shlokas.10:
putraste prativindhyashcha sutasomastathA vibhuH |
shrutakarmArjunishchaiva shatAnIkashcha nAkuliH
sahadevAchcha yo jAtaH shrutasenastavAtmajaH
shlokas.11:
sarve kushalino vIrAH kRRitAstrAshcha sutAstava |
abhimanyuriva prItA dvAravatyAM ratA bhRRisham
shlokas.12:
tvamivaiShAM subhadrA cha prItyA sarvAtmanA sthitA |
prIyate bhAvanirdva.ndvA tebhyashcha vigatajvarA
shlokas.13:
bheje sarvAtmanA chaiva pradyumnajananI tathA |
bhAnuprabhRRitibhishchainAnvishinaShTi cha keshavaH
shlokas.14:
bhojanAchChAdane chaiShAM nityaM me shvashuraH sthitaH |
rAmaprabhRRitayaH sarve bhajantyandhakavRRiShNayaH
tulyo hi praNayasteShAM pradyumnasya cha bhAmini
shlokas.15:
evamAdi priyaM prItyA hRRidyamuktvA manonugam |
gamanAya manashchakre vAsudevarathaM prati
shlokas.16:
tAM kRRiShNAM kRRiShNamahiShI chakArAbhipradakShiNam |
Aruroha rathaM shaureH satyabhAmA cha bhAminI
shlokas.17:
smayitvA tu yadushreShTho draupadIM parisAntvya cha |
upAvartya tataH shIghrairhayaiH prAyAtparantapaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM vane vartamAnA narAgryAH; shItoShNavAtAtapakarshitA~NgAH |
sarastadAsAdya vanaM cha puNyaM; tataH paraM kimakurvanta pArthAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sarastadAsAdya tu pANDuputrA; janaM samutsRRijya vidhAya chaiShAm |
vanAni ramyANyatha parvatA.nshcha; nadIpradeshA.nshcha tadA vicheruH
shlokas.3:
tathA vane tAnvasataH pravIrA;nsvAdhyAyavantashcha tapodhanAshcha |
abhyAyayurvedavidaH purANA;stAnpUjayAmAsuratho narAgryAH
shlokas.4:
tataH kadAchitkushalaH kathAsu; vipro.abhyagachChadbhuvi kauraveyAn |
sa taiH sametyAtha yadRRichChayaiva; vaichitravIryaM nRRipamabhyagachChat
shlokas.5:
athopaviShTaH pratisatkRRitashcha; vRRiddhena rAj~nA kurusattamena |
prachoditaH sankathayAM babhUva; dharmAnilendraprabhavAnyamau cha
shlokas.6:
kRRishA.nshcha vAtAtapakarshitA~NgA;nduHkhasya chograsya mukhe prapannAn |
tAM chApyanAthAmiva vIranAthAM; kRRiShNAM parikleshaguNena yuktAm
shlokas.7:
tataH kathAM tasya nishamya rAjA; vaichitravIryaH kRRipayAbhitaptaH |
vane sthitAnpArthivaputrapautrA;~nshrutvA tadA duHkhanadIM prapannAn
shlokas.8:
provAcha dainyAbhihatAntarAtmA; niHshvAsabAShpopahataH sa pArthAn |
vAchaM katha~nchitsthiratAmupetya; tatsarvamAtmaprabhavaM vichintya
shlokas.9:
kathaM nu satyaH shuchirAryavRRitto; jyeShThaH sutAnAM mama dharmarAjaH |
ajAtashatruH pRRithivItalasthaH; shete purA rA~NkavakUTashAyI
shlokas.10:
prabodhyate mAgadhasUtapUgai;rnityaM stuvadbhiH svayamindrakalpaH |
patatrisa~NghaiH sa jaghanyarAtre; prabodhyate nUnamiDAtalasthaH
shlokas.11:
kathaM nu vAtAtapakarshitA~Ngo; vRRikodaraH kopapariplutA~NgaH |
shete pRRithivyAmatathochitA~NgaH; kRRiShNAsamakShaM vasudhAtalasthaH
shlokas.12:
tathArjunaH sukumAro manasvI; vashe sthito dharmasutasya rAj~naH |
vidUyamAnairiva sarvagAtrai;rdhruvaM na shete vasatIramarShAt
shlokas.13:
yamau cha kRRiShNAM cha yudhiShThiraM cha; bhImaM cha dRRiShTvA sukhaviprayuktAn |
viniHshvasansarpa ivogratejA; dhruvaM na shete vasatIramarShAt
shlokas.14:
tathA yamau chApyasukhau sukhArhau; samRRiddharUpAvamarau divIva |
prajAgarasthau dhruvamaprashAntau; dharmeNa satyena cha vAryamANau
shlokas.15:
samIraNenApi samo balena; samIraNasyaiva suto balIyAn |
sa dharmapAshena sitogratejA; dhruvaM viniHshvasya sahatyamarSham
shlokas.16:
sa chApi bhUmau parivartamAno; vadhaM sutAnAM mama kA~NkShamANaH |
satyena dharmeNa cha vAryamANaH; kAlaM pratIkShatyadhiko raNe.anyaiH
shlokas.17:
ajAtashatrau tu jite nikRRityA; duHshAsano yatparuShANyavochat |
tAni praviShTAni vRRikodarA~NgaM; dahanti marmAgnirivendhanAni
shlokas.18:
na pApakaM dhyAsyati dharmaputro; dhana~njayashchApyanuvartate tam |
araNyavAsena vivardhate tu; bhImasya kopo.agnirivAnilena
shlokas.19:
sa tena kopena vidIryamANaH; karaM kareNAbhinipIDya vIraH |
viniHshvasatyuShNamatIva ghoraM; dahannivemAnmama putrapautrAn
shlokas.20:
gANDIvadhanvA cha vRRikodarashcha; sa.nrambhiNAvantakakAlakalpau |
na sheShayetAM yudhi shatrusenAM; sharAnkirantAvashaniprakAshAn
shlokas.21:
duryodhanaH shakuniH sUtaputro; duHshAsanashchApi sumandachetAH |
madhu prapashyanti na tu prapAtaM; vRRikodaraM chaiva dhana~njayaM cha
shlokas.22:
shubhAshubhaM puruShaH karma kRRitvA; pratIkShate tasya phalaM sma kartA |
sa tena yujyatyavashaH phalena; mokShaH kathaM syAtpuruShasya tasmAt
shlokas.23:
kShetre sukRRiShTe hyupite cha bIje; deve cha varShatyRRitukAlayuktam |
na syAtphalaM tasya kutaH prasiddhi;ranyatra daivAditi chintayAmi
shlokas.24:
kRRitaM matAkSheNa yathA na sAdhu; sAdhupravRRittena cha pANDavena |
mayA cha duShputravashAnugena; yathA kurUNAmayamantakAlaH
shlokas.25:
dhruvaM pravAsyatyasamIrito.api; dhruvaM prajAsyatyuta garbhiNI yA |
dhruvaM dinAdau rajanIpraNAsha;stathA kShapAdau cha dinapraNAshaH
shlokas.26:
kriyeta kasmAnna pare cha kuryu;rvittaM na dadyuH puruShAH katha~nchit |
prApyArthakAlaM cha bhavedanarthaH; kathaM nu tatsyAditi tatkutaH syAt
shlokas.27:
kathaM na bhidyeta na cha sraveta; na cha prasichyediti rakShitavyam |
arakShyamANaH shatadhA vishIrye;ddhruvaM na nAsho.asti kRRitasya loke
shlokas.28:
gato hyaraNyAdapi shakralokaM; dhana~njayaH pashyata vIryamasya |
astrANi divyAni chaturvidhAni; j~nAtvA punarlokamimaM prapannaH
shlokas.29:
svargaM hi gatvA sasharIra eva; ko mAnuShaH punarAgantumichChet |
anyatra kAlopahatAnanekA;nsamIkShamANastu kurUnmumUrShUn
shlokas.30:
dhanurgrAhashchArjunaH savyasAchI; dhanushcha tadgANDivaM lokasAram |
astrANi divyAni cha tAni tasya; trayasya tejaH prasaheta ko nu
shlokas.31:
nishamya tadvachanaM pArthivasya; duryodhano rahite saubalashcha |
abodhayatkarNamupetya sarvaM; sa chApyahRRiShTo.abhavadalpachetAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrasya tadvAkyaM nishamya sahasaubalaH |
duryodhanamidaM kAle karNo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
pravrAjya pANDavAnvIrAnsvena vIryeNa bhArata |
bhu~NkShvemAM pRRithivImeko divaM shambarahA yathA
shlokas.3:
prAchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyAshcha pratIchyodIchyavAsinaH |
kRRitAH karapradAH sarve rAjAnaste narAdhipa
shlokas.4:
yA hi sA dIpyamAneva pANDavAnbhajate purA |
sAdya lakShmIstvayA rAjannavAptA bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.5:
indraprasthagate yAM tAM dIpyamAnAM yudhiShThire |
apashyAma shriyaM rAjannachiraM shokakarshitAH
shlokas.6:
sA tu buddhibaleneyaM rAj~nastasmAdyudhiShThirAt |
tvayAkShiptA mahAbAho dIpyamAneva dRRishyate
shlokas.7:
tathaiva tava rAjendra rAjAnaH paravIrahan |
shAsane.adhiShThitAH sarve kiM kurma iti vAdinaH
shlokas.8:
tavAdya pRRithivI rAjannikhilA sAgarAmbarA |
saparvatavanA devI sagrAmanagarAkarA
nAnAvanoddeshavatI pattanairupashobhitA
shlokas.9:
vandyamAno dvijai rAjanpUjyamAnashcha rAjabhiH |
pauruShAddivi deveShu bhrAjase rashmivAniva
shlokas.10:
rudrairiva yamo rAjA marudbhiriva vAsavaH |
kurubhistvaM vRRito rAjanbhAsi nakShatrarADiva
shlokas.11:
ye sma te nAdriyante.a.aj~nA nodvijante kadA cha na |
pashyAmastA~nshriyA hInAnpANDavAnvanavAsinaH
shlokas.12:
shrUyante hi mahArAja saro dvaitavanaM prati |
vasantaH pANDavAH sArdhaM brAhmaNairvanavAsibhiH
shlokas.13:
sa prayAhi mahArAja shriyA paramayA yutaH |
pratapanpANDuputrA.nstvaM rashmivAniva tejasA
shlokas.14:
sthito rAjye chyutAnrAjyAchChriyA hInA~nshriyA vRRitaH |
asamRRiddhAnsamRRiddhArthaH pashya pANDusutAnnRRipa
shlokas.15:
mahAbhijanasampannaM bhadre mahati sa.nsthitam |
pANDavAstvAbhivIkShantAM yayAtimiva nAhuSham
shlokas.16:
yAM shriyaM suhRRidashchaiva durhRRidashcha vishAM pate |
pashyanti puruShe dIptAM sA samarthA bhavatyuta
shlokas.17:
samastho viShamasthAnhi durhRRido yo.abhivIkShate |
jagatIsthAnivAdristhaH kiM tataH paramaM sukham
shlokas.18:
na putradhanalAbhena na rAjyenApi vindati |
prItiM nRRipatishArdUla yAmamitrAghadarshanAt
shlokas.19:
kiM nu tasya sukhaM na syAdAshrame yo dhana~njayam |
abhivIkSheta siddhArtho valkalAjinavAsasam
shlokas.20:
suvAsaso hi te bhAryA valkalAjinavAsasam |
pashyantvasukhitAM kRRiShNAM sA cha nirvidyatAM punaH
vinindatAM tathAtmAnaM jIvitaM cha dhanachyutA
shlokas.21:
na tathA hi sabhAmadhye tasyA bhavitumarhati |
vaimanasyaM yathA dRRiShTvA tava bhAryAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.22:
evamuktvA tu rAjAnaM karNaH shakuninA saha |
tUShNIM babhUvaturubhau vAkyAnte janamejaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
karNasya vachanaM shrutvA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
hRRiShTo bhUtvA punardIna idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
bravIShi yadidaM karNa sarvaM me manasi sthitam |
na tvabhyanuj~nAM lapsyAmi gamane yatra pANDavAH
shlokas.3:
paridevati tAnvIrAndhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
manyate.abhyadhikA.nshchApi tapoyogena pANDavAn
shlokas.4:
atha vApyanubudhyeta nRRipo.asmAkaM chikIrShitam |
evamapyAyatiM rakShannAbhyanuj~nAtumarhati
shlokas.5:
na hi dvaitavane ki~nchidvidyate.anyatprayojanam |
utsAdanamRRite teShAM vanasthAnAM mama dviShAm
shlokas.6:
jAnAsi hi yathA kShattA dyUtakAla upasthite |
abravIdyachcha mAM tvAM cha saubalaM cha vachastadA
shlokas.7:
tAni pUrvANi vAkyAni yachchAnyatparidevitam |
vichintya nAdhigachChAmi gamanAyetarAya vA
shlokas.8:
mamApi hi mahAnharSho yadahaM bhImaphalgunau |
kliShTAvaraNye pashyeyaM kRRiShNayA sahitAviti
shlokas.9:
na tathA prApnuyAM prItimavApya vasudhAmapi |
dRRiShTvA yathA pANDusutAnvalkalAjinavAsasaH
shlokas.10:
kiM nu syAdadhikaM tasmAdyadahaM drupadAtmajAm |
draupadIM karNa pashyeyaM kAShAyavasanAM vane
shlokas.11:
yadi mAM dharmarAjashcha bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
yuktaM paramayA lakShmyA pashyetAM jIvitaM bhavet
shlokas.12:
upAyaM na tu pashyAmi yena gachChema tadvanam |
yathA chAbhyanujAnIyAdgachChantaM mAM mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
sa saubalena sahitastathA duHshAsanena cha |
upAyaM pashya nipuNaM yena gachChema tadvanam
shlokas.14:
ahamapyadya nishchitya gamanAyetarAya vA |
kAlyameva gamiShyAmi samIpaM pArthivasya ha
shlokas.15:
mayi tatropaviShTe tu bhIShme cha kurusattame |
upAyo yo bhaveddRRiShTastaM brUyAH sahasaubalaH
shlokas.16:
tato bhIShmasya rAj~nashcha nishamya gamanaM prati |
vyavasAyaM kariShye.ahamanunIya pitAmaham
shlokas.17:
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve jagmurAvasathAnprati |
vyuShitAyAM rajanyAM tu karNo rAjAnamabhyayAt
shlokas.18:
tato duryodhanaM karNaH prahasannidamabravIt |
upAyaH paridRRiShTo.ayaM taM nibodha janeshvara
shlokas.19:
ghoShA dvaitavane sarve tvatpratIkShA narAdhipa |
ghoShayAtrApadeshena gamiShyAmo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
uchitaM hi sadA gantuM ghoShayAtrAM vishAM pate |
evaM cha tvAM pitA rAjansamanuj~nAtumarhati
shlokas.21:
tathA kathayamAnau tau ghoShayAtrAvinishchayam |
gAndhArarAjaH shakuniH pratyuvAcha hasanniva
shlokas.22:
upAyo.ayaM mayA dRRiShTo gamanAya nirAmayaH |
anuj~nAsyati no rAjA chodayiShyati chApyuta
shlokas.23:
ghoShA dvaitavane sarve tvatpratIkShA narAdhipa |
ghoShayAtrApadeshena gamiShyAmo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
tataH prahasitAH sarve te.anyonyasya talAndaduH |
tadeva cha vinishchitya dadRRishuH kurusattamam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTraM tataH sarve dadRRishurjanamejaya |
pRRiShTvA sukhamatho rAj~naH pRRiShTvA rAj~nA cha bhArata
shlokas.2:
tatastairvihitaH pUrvaM sama~Ngo nAma ballavaH |
samIpasthAstadA gAvo dhRRitarAShTre nyavedayat
shlokas.3:
anantaraM cha rAdheyaH shakunishcha vishAM pate |
AhatuH pArthivashreShThaM dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam
shlokas.4:
ramaNIyeShu desheShu ghoShAH samprati kaurava |
smAraNAsamayaH prApto vatsAnAmapi chA~Nkanam
shlokas.5:
mRRigayA chochitA rAjannasminkAle sutasya te |
duryodhanasya gamanaM tvamanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
mRRigayA shobhanA tAta gavAM cha samavekShaNam |
vishrambhastu na gantavyo ballavAnAmiti smare
shlokas.7:
te tu tatra naravyAghrAH samIpa iti naH shrutam |
ato nAbhyanujAnAmi gamanaM tatra vaH svayam
shlokas.8:
ChadmanA nirjitAste hi karshitAshcha mahAvane |
taponityAshcha rAdheya samarthAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.9:
dharmarAjo na sa~NkrudhyedbhImasenastvamarShaNaH |
yaj~nasenasya duhitA teja eva tu kevalam
shlokas.10:
yUyaM chApyaparAdhyeyurdarpamohasamanvitAH |
tato vinirdaheyuste tapasA hi samanvitAH
shlokas.11:
atha vA sAyudhA vIrA manyunAbhipariplutAH |
sahitA baddhanistri.nshA daheyuH shastratejasA
shlokas.12:
atha yUyaM bahutvAttAnArabhadhvaM katha~nchana |
anAryaM paramaM tatsyAdashakyaM tachcha me matam
shlokas.13:
uShito hi mahAbAhurindraloke dhana~njayaH |
divyAnyastrANyavApyAtha tataH pratyAgato vanam
shlokas.14:
akRRitAstreNa pRRithivI jitA bIbhatsunA purA |
kiM punaH sa kRRitAstro.adya na hanyAdvo mahArathaH
shlokas.15:
atha vA madvachaH shrutvA tatra yattA bhaviShyatha |
udvignavAso vishrambhAdduHkhaM tatra bhaviShyati
shlokas.16:
atha vA sainikAH kechidapakuryuryudhiShThire |
tadabuddhikRRitaM karma doShamutpAdayechcha vaH
shlokas.17:
tasmAdgachChantu puruShAH smAraNAyAptakAriNaH |
na svayaM tatra gamanaM rochaye tava bhArata
shlokas.18:
shakuniruvAcha||
dharmaj~naH pANDavo jyeShThaH pratij~nAtaM cha sa.nsadi |
tena dvAdasha varShANi vastavyAnIti bhArata
shlokas.19:
anuvRRittAshcha te sarve pANDavA dharmachAriNaH |
yudhiShThirashcha kaunteyo na naH kopaM kariShyati
shlokas.20:
mRRigayAM chaiva no gantumichChA sa.nvardhate bhRRisham |
smAraNaM cha chikIrShAmo na tu pANDavadarshanam
shlokas.21:
na chAnAryasamAchAraH kashchittatra bhaviShyati |
na cha tatra gamiShyAmo yatra teShAM pratishrayaH
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH shakuninA dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
duryodhanaM sahAmAtyamanujaj~ne na kAmataH
shlokas.23:
anuj~nAtastu gAndhAriH karNena sahitastadA |
niryayau bharatashreShTho balena mahatA vRRitaH
shlokas.24:
duHshAsanena cha tathA saubalena cha devinA |
sa.nvRRito bhrAtRRibhishchAnyaiH strIbhishchApi sahasrashaH
shlokas.25:
taM niryAntaM mahAbAhuM draShTuM dvaitavanaM saraH |
paurAshchAnuyayuH sarve sahadArA vanaM cha tat
shlokas.26:
aShTau rathasahasrANi trINi nAgAyutAni cha |
pattayo bahusAhasrA hayAshcha navatiH shatAH
shlokas.27:
shakaTApaNaveshyAshcha vaNijo bandinastathA |
narAshcha mRRigayAshIlAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.28:
tataH prayANe nRRipateH sumahAnabhavatsvanaH |
prAvRRiShIva mahAvAyoruddhatasya vishAM pate
shlokas.29:
gavyUtimAtre nyavasadrAjA duryodhanastadA |
prayAto vAhanaiH sarvaistato dvaitavanaM saraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha duryodhano rAjA tatra tatra vane vasan |
jagAma ghoShAnabhitastatra chakre niveshanam
shlokas.2:
ramaNIye samAj~nAte sodake samahIruhe |
deshe sarvaguNopete chakrurAvasathaM narAH
shlokas.3:
tathaiva tatsamIpasthAnpRRithagAvasathAnbahUn |
karNasya shakuneshchaiva bhrAtR^INAM chaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
dadarsha sa tadA gAvaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
a~NkairlakShaishcha tAH sarvA lakShayAmAsa pArthivaH
shlokas.5:
a~NkayAmAsa vatsA.nshcha jaj~ne chopasRRitAstvapi |
bAlavatsAshcha yA gAvaH kAlayAmAsa tA api
shlokas.6:
atha sa smAraNaM kRRitvA lakShayitvA trihAyanAn |
vRRito gopAlakaiH prIto vyaharatkurunandanaH
shlokas.7:
sa cha paurajanaH sarvaH sainikAshcha sahasrashaH |
yathopajoShaM chikrIDurvane tasminyathAmarAH
shlokas.8:
tato gopAH pragAtAraH kushalA nRRittavAdite |
dhArtarAShTramupAtiShThankanyAshchaiva svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.9:
sa strIgaNavRRito rAjA prahRRiShTaH pradadau vasu |
tebhyo yathArhamannAni pAnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.10:
tataste sahitAH sarve tarakShUnmahiShAnmRRigAn |
gavayarkShavarAhA.nshcha samantAtparyakAlayan
shlokas.11:
sa tA~nsharairvinirbhindangajAnbadhnanmahAvane |
ramaNIyeShu desheShu grAhayAmAsa vai mRRigAn
shlokas.12:
gorasAnupayu~njAna upabhogA.nshcha bhArata |
pashyansuramaNIyAni puShpitAni vanAni cha
shlokas.13:
mattabhramarajuShTAni barhiNAbhirutAni cha |
agachChadAnupUrvyeNa puNyaM dvaitavanaM saraH
RRiddhyA paramayA yukto mahendra iva vajrabhRRit
shlokas.14:
yadRRichChayA cha tadaho dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
Ije rAjarShiyaj~nena sadyaskena vishAM pate
divyena vidhinA rAjA vanyena kurusattamaH
shlokas.15:
kRRitvA niveshamabhitaH sarasastasya kauravaH |
draupadyA sahito dhImAndharmapatnyA narAdhipaH
shlokas.16:
tato duryodhanaH preShyAnAdidesha sahAnujaH |
AkrIDAvasathAH kShipraM kriyantAmiti bhArata
shlokas.17:
te tathetyeva kauravyamuktvA vachanakAriNaH |
chikIrShantastadAkrIDA~njagmurdvaitavanaM saraH
shlokas.18:
senAgraM dhArtarAShTrasya prAptaM dvaitavanaM saraH |
pravishantaM vanadvAri gandharvAH samavArayan
shlokas.19:
tatra gandharvarAjo vai pUrvameva vishAM pate |
kuberabhavanAdrAjannAjagAma gaNAvRRitaH
shlokas.20:
gaNairapsarasAM chaiva tridashAnAM tathAtmajaiH |
vihArashIlaH krIDArthaM tena tatsa.nvRRitaM saraH
shlokas.21:
tena tatsa.nvRRitaM dRRiShTvA te rAjaparichArakAH |
pratijagmustato rAjanyatra duryodhano nRRipaH
shlokas.22:
sa tu teShAM vachaH shrutvA sainikAnyuddhadurmadAn |
preShayAmAsa kauravya utsArayata tAniti
shlokas.23:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA rAj~naH senAgrayAyinaH |
saro dvaitavanaM gatvA gandharvAnidamabruvan
shlokas.24:
rAjA duryodhano nAma dhRRitarAShTrasuto balI |
vijihIrShurihAyAti tadarthamapasarpata
shlokas.25:
evamuktAstu gandharvAH prahasanto vishAM pate |
pratyabruva.nstAnpuruShAnidaM suparuShaM vachaH
shlokas.26:
na chetayati vo rAjA mandabuddhiH suyodhanaH |
yo.asmAnAj~nApayatyevaM vashyAniva divaukasaH
shlokas.27:
yUyaM mumUrShavashchApi mandapraj~nA na sa.nshayaH |
ye tasya vachanAdevamasmAnbrUta vichetasaH
shlokas.28:
gachChata tvaritAH sarve yatra rAjA sa kauravaH |
dveShyaM mAdyaiva gachChadhvaM dharmarAjaniveshanam
shlokas.29:
evamuktAstu gandharvai rAj~naH senAgrayAyinaH |
samprAdravanyato rAjA dhRRitarAShTrasuto.abhavat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste sahitAH sarve duryodhanamupAgaman |
abruva.nshcha mahArAja yadUchuH kauravaM prati
shlokas.2:
gandharvairvArite sainye dhArtarAShTraH pratApavAn |
amarShapUrNaH sainyAni pratyabhAShata bhArata
shlokas.3:
shAsatainAnadharmaj~nAnmama vipriyakAriNaH |
yadi prakrIDito devaiH sarvaiH saha shatakratuH
shlokas.4:
duryodhanavachaH shrutvA dhArtarAShTrA mahAbalAH |
sarva evAbhisaMnaddhA yodhAshchApi sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
tataH pramathya gandharvA.nstadvanaM vivishurbalAt |
siMhanAdena mahatA pUrayanto disho dasha
shlokas.6:
tato.aparairavAryanta gandharvaiH kurusainikAH |
te vAryamANA gandharvaiH sAmnaiva vasudhAdhipa
tAnanAdRRitya gandharvA.nstadvanaM vivishurmahat
shlokas.7:
yadA vAchA na tiShThanti dhArtarAShTrAH sarAjakAH |
tataste khecharAH sarve chitrasene nyavedayan
shlokas.8:
gandharvarAjastAnsarvAnabravItkauravAnprati |
anAryA~nshAsatetyevaM chitraseno.atyamarShaNaH
shlokas.9:
anuj~nAtAstu gandharvAshchitrasenena bhArata |
pragRRihItAyudhAH sarve dhArtarAShTrAnabhidravan
shlokas.10:
tAndRRiShTvA patataH shIghrAngandharvAnudyatAyudhAn |
sarve te prAdravansa~Nkhye dhArtarAShTrasya pashyataH
shlokas.11:
tAndRRiShTvA dravataH sarvAndhArtarAShTrAnparA~NmukhAn |
vaikartanastadA vIro nAsIttatra parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.12:
ApatantIM tu samprekShya gandharvANAM mahAchamUm |
mahatA sharavarSheNa rAdheyaH pratyavArayat
shlokas.13:
kShuraprairvishikhairbhallairvatsadantaistathAyasaiH |
gandharvA~nshatasho.abhyaghna.NllaghutvAtsUtanandanaH
shlokas.14:
pAtayannuttamA~NgAni gandharvANAM mahArathaH |
kShaNena vyadhamatsarvAM chitrasenasya vAhinIm
shlokas.15:
te vadhyamAnA gandharvAH sUtaputreNa dhImatA |
bhUya evAbhyavartanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
gandharvabhUtA pRRithivI kShaNena samapadyata |
ApatadbhirmahAvegaishchitrasenasya sainikaiH
shlokas.17:
atha duryodhano rAjA shakunishchApi saubalaH |
duHshAsano vikarNashcha ye chAnye dhRRitarAShTrajAH
nyahana.nstattadA sainyaM rathairgaruDanisvanaiH
shlokas.18:
bhUyashcha yodhayAmAsuH kRRitvA karNamathAgrataH |
mahatA rathaghoSheNa hayachAreNa chApyuta
vaikartanaM parIpsanto gandharvAnsamavArayan
shlokas.19:
tataH saMnyapatansarve gandharvAH kauravaiH saha |
tadA sutumulaM yuddhamabhavallomaharShaNam
shlokas.20:
tataste mRRidavo.abhUvangandharvAH sharapIDitAH |
uchchukrushushcha kauravyA gandharvAnprekShya pIDitAn
shlokas.21:
gandharvA.nstrAsitAndRRiShTvA chitraseno.atyamarShaNaH |
utpapAtAsanAtkruddho vadhe teShAM samAhitaH
shlokas.22:
tato mAyAstramAsthAya yuyudhe chitramArgavit |
tayAmuhyanta kauravyAshchitrasenasya mAyayA
shlokas.23:
ekaiko hi tadA yodho dhArtarAShTrasya bhArata |
paryavartata gandharvairdashabhirdashabhiH saha
shlokas.24:
tataH sampIDyamAnAste balena mahatA tadA |
prAdravanta raNe bhItA yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.25:
bhajyamAneShvanIkeShu dhArtarAShTreShu sarvashaH |
karNo vaikartano rAja.nstasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.26:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
gandharvAnyodhayAM chakruH samare bhRRishavikShatAH
shlokas.27:
sarva eva tu gandharvAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
jighA.nsamAnAH sahitAH karNamabhyadravanraNe
shlokas.28:
asibhiH paTTishaiH shUlairgadAbhishcha mahAbalAH |
sUtaputraM jighA.nsantaH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.29:
anye.asya yugamachChindandhvajamanye nyapAtayan |
IShAmanye hayAnanye sUtamanye nyapAtayan
shlokas.30:
anye ChatraM varUthaM cha bandhuraM cha tathApare |
gandharvA bahusAhasrAH khaNDasho.abhyahananratham
shlokas.31:
tato rathAdavaplutya sUtaputro.asicharmabhRRit |
vikarNarathamAsthAya mokShAyAshvAnachodayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gandharvaistu mahArAja bhagne karNe mahArathe |
samprAdravachchamUH sarvA dhArtarAShTrasya pashyataH
shlokas.2:
tAndRRiShTvA dravataH sarvAndhArtarAShTrAnparA~NmukhAn |
duryodhano mahArAja nAsIttatra parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.3:
tAmApatantIM samprekShya gandharvANAM mahAchamUm |
mahatA sharavarSheNa so.abhyavarShadari.ndamaH
shlokas.4:
achintya sharavarShaM tu gandharvAstasya taM ratham |
duryodhanaM jighA.nsantaH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.5:
yugamIShAM varUthaM cha tathaiva dhvajasArathI |
ashvA.nstriveNuM talpaM cha tilasho.abhyahananratham
shlokas.6:
duryodhanaM chitraseno virathaM patitaM bhuvi |
abhidrutya mahAbAhurjIvagrAhamathAgrahIt
shlokas.7:
tasmingRRihIte rAjendra sthitaM duHshAsanaM rathe |
paryagRRihNanta gandharvAH parivArya samantataH
shlokas.8:
vivi.nshatiM chitrasenamAdAyAnye pradudruvuH |
vindAnuvindAvapare rAjadArA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
sainyAstu dhArtarAShTrasya gandharvaiH samabhidrutAH |
pUrvaM prabhagnaiH sahitAH pANDavAnabhyayustadA
shlokas.10:
shakaTApaNaveshyAshcha yAnayugyaM cha sarvashaH |
sharaNaM pANDavA~njagmurhriyamANe mahIpatau
shlokas.11:
priyadarshano mahAbAhurdhArtarAShTro mahAbalaH |
gandharvairhriyate rAjA pArthAstamanudhAvata
shlokas.12:
duHshAsano durviShaho durmukho durjayastathA |
baddhvA hriyante gandharvai rAjadArAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
iti duryodhanAmAtyAH kroshanto rAjagRRiddhinaH |
ArtA dInasvarAH sarve yudhiShThiramupAgaman
shlokas.14:
tA.nstathA vyathitAndInAnbhikShamANAnyudhiShThiram |
vRRiddhAnduryodhanAmAtyAnbhImaseno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.15:
anyathA vartamAnAnAmartho jAto.ayamanyathA |
asmAbhiryadanuShTheyaM gandharvaistadanuShThitam
shlokas.16:
durmantritamidaM tAta rAj~no durdyUtadevinaH |
dveShTAramanye klIbasya pAtayantIti naH shrutam
shlokas.17:
tadidaM kRRitaM naH pratyakShaM gandharvairatimAnuSham |
diShTyA loke pumAnasti kashchidasmatpriye sthitaH
yenAsmAkaM hRRito bhAra AsInAnAM sukhAvahaH
shlokas.18:
shItavAtAtapasahA.nstapasA chaiva karshitAn |
samastho viShamasthAnhi draShTumichChati durmatiH
shlokas.19:
adharmachAriNastasya kauravyasya durAtmanaH |
ye shIlamanuvartante te pashyanti parAbhavam
shlokas.20:
adharmo hi kRRitastena yenaitadupashikShitam |
anRRisha.nsAstu kaunteyAstasyAdhyakShAnbravImi vaH
shlokas.21:
evaM bruvANaM kaunteyaM bhImasenamamarShaNam |
na kAlaH paruShasyAyamiti rAjAbhyabhAShata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asmAnabhigatA.nstAta bhayArtA~nsharaNaiShiNaH |
kauravAnviShamaprAptAnkathaM brUyAstvamIdRRisham
shlokas.2:
bhavanti bhedA j~nAtInAM kalahAshcha vRRikodara |
prasaktAni cha vairANi j~nAtidharmo na nashyati
shlokas.3:
yadA tu kashchijj~nAtInAM bAhyaH prArthayate kulam |
na marShayanti tatsanto bAhyenAbhipramarShaNam
shlokas.4:
jAnAti hyeSha durbuddhirasmAniha chiroShitAn |
sa eSha paribhUyAsmAnakArShIdidamapriyam
shlokas.5:
duryodhanasya grahaNAdgandharveNa balAdraNe |
strINAM bAhyAbhimarshAchcha hataM bhavati naH kulam
shlokas.6:
sharaNaM cha prapannAnAM trANArthaM cha kulasya naH |
uttiShThadhvaM naravyAghrAH sajjIbhavata mAchiram
shlokas.7:
arjunashcha yamau chaiva tvaM cha bhImAparAjitaH |
mokShayadhvaM dhArtarAShTraM hriyamANaM suyodhanam
shlokas.8:
ete rathA naravyAghrAH sarvashastrasamanvitAH |
indrasenAdibhiH sUtaiH sa.nyatAH kanakadhvajAH
shlokas.9:
etAnAsthAya vai tAta gandharvAnyoddhumAhave |
suyodhanasya mokShAya prayatadhvamatandritAH
shlokas.10:
ya eva kashchidrAjanyaH sharaNArthamihAgatam |
paraM shaktyAbhirakSheta kiM punastvaM vRRikodara
shlokas.11:
ka ihAnyo bhavettrANamabhidhAveti choditaH |
prA~njaliM sharaNApannaM dRRiShTvA shatrumapi dhruvam
shlokas.12:
varapradAnaM rAjyaM cha putrajanma cha pANDava |
shatroshcha mokShaNaM kleshAttrINi chaikaM cha tatsamam
shlokas.13:
kiM hyabhyadhikametasmAdyadApannaH suyodhanaH |
tvadbAhubalamAshritya jIvitaM parimArgati
shlokas.14:
svayameva pradhAveyaM yadi na syAdvRRikodara |
vitato.ayaM kraturvIra na hi me.atra vichAraNA
shlokas.15:
sAmnaiva tu yathA bhIma mokShayethAH suyodhanam |
tathA sarvairupAyaistvaM yatethAH kurunandana
shlokas.16:
na sAmnA pratipadyeta yadi gandharvarADasau |
parAkrameNa mRRidunA mokShayethAH suyodhanam
shlokas.17:
athAsau mRRiduyuddhena na mu~nchedbhIma kauravAn |
sarvopAyairvimochyAste nigRRihya paripanthinaH
shlokas.18:
etAvaddhi mayA shakyaM sa.ndeShTuM vai vRRikodara |
vaitAne karmaNi tate vartamAne cha bhArata
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ajAtashatrorvachanaM tachChrutvA tu dhana~njayaH |
pratijaj~ne gurorvAkyaM kauravANAM vimokShaNam
shlokas.20:
arjuna uvAcha||
yadi sAmnA na mokShyanti gandharvA dhRRitarAShTrajAn |
adya gandharvarAjasya bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunasya tu tAM shrutvA pratij~nAM satyavAdinaH |
kauravANAM tadA rAjanpunaH pratyAgataM manaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThiravachaH shrutvA bhImasenapurogamAH |
prahRRiShTavadanAH sarve samuttasthurnararShabhAH
shlokas.2:
abhedyAni tataH sarve samanahyanta bhArata |
jAmbUnadavichitrANi kavachAni mahArathAH
shlokas.3:
te da.nshitA rathaiH sarve dhvajinaH sasharAsanAH |
pANDavAH pratyadRRishyanta jvalitA iva pAvakAH
shlokas.4:
tAnrathAnsAdhu sampannAnsa.nyuktA~njavanairhayaiH |
AsthAya rathashArdUlAH shIghrameva yayustataH
shlokas.5:
tataH kauravasainyAnAM prAdurAsInmahAsvanaH |
prayAtAnsahitAndRRiShTvA pANDuputrAnmahArathAn
shlokas.6:
jitakAshinashcha khacharAstvaritAshcha mahArathAH |
kShaNenaiva vane tasminsamAjagmurabhItavat
shlokas.7:
nyavartanta tataH sarve gandharvA jitakAshinaH |
dRRiShTvA rathagatAnvIrAnpANDavA.nshchaturo raNe
shlokas.8:
tA.nstu vibhrAjato dRRiShTvA lokapAlAnivodyatAn |
vyUDhAnIkA vyatiShThanta gandhamAdanavAsinaH
shlokas.9:
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
krameNa mRRidunA yuddhamupakrAmanta bhArata
shlokas.10:
na tu gandharvarAjasya sainikA mandachetasaH |
shakyante mRRidunA shreyaH pratipAdayituM tadA
shlokas.11:
tatastAnyudhi durdharShaH savyasAchI parantapaH |
sAntvapUrvamidaM vAkyamuvAcha khacharAnraNe
shlokas.12:
naitadgandharvarAjasya yuktaM karma jugupsitam |
paradArAbhimarshashcha mAnuShaishcha samAgamaH
shlokas.13:
utsRRijadhvaM mahAvIryAndhRRitarAShTrasutAnimAn |
dArA.nshchaiShAM vimu~nchadhvaM dharmarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.14:
evamuktAstu gandharvAH pANDavena yashasvinA |
utsmayantastadA pArthamidaM vachanamabruvan
shlokas.15:
ekasyaiva vayaM tAta kuryAma vachanaM bhuvi |
yasya shAsanamAj~nAya charAma vigatajvarAH
shlokas.16:
tenaikena yathAdiShTaM tathA vartAma bhArata |
na shAstA vidyate.asmAkamanyastasmAtsureshvarAt
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu gandharvaiH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
gandharvAnpunarevedaM vachanaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.18:
yadi sAmnA na mokShadhvaM gandharvA dhRRitarAShTrajam |
mokShayiShyAmi vikramya svayameva suyodhanam
shlokas.19:
evamuktvA tataH pArthaH savyasAchI dhana~njayaH |
sasarja nishitAnbANAnkhacharAnkhacharAnprati
shlokas.20:
tathaiva sharavarSheNa gandharvAste balotkaTAH |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta pANDavAshcha divaukasaH
shlokas.21:
tataH sutumulaM yuddhaM gandharvANAM tarasvinAm |
babhUva bhImavegAnAM pANDavAnAM cha bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato divyAstrasampannA gandharvA hemamAlinaH |
visRRijantaH sharAndIptAnsamantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.2:
chatvAraH pANDavA vIrA gandharvAshcha sahasrashaH |
raNe saMnyapatanrAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.3:
yathA karNasya cha ratho dhArtarAShTrasya chobhayoH |
gandharvaiH shatashashChinnau tathA teShAM prachakrire
shlokas.4:
tAnsamApatato rAjangandharvA~nshatasho raNe |
pratyagRRihNannaravyAghrAH sharavarShairanekashaH
shlokas.5:
avakIryamANAH khagamAH sharavarShaiH samantataH |
na shekuH pANDuputrANAM samIpe parivartitum
shlokas.6:
abhikruddhAnabhiprekShya gandharvAnarjunastadA |
lakShayitvAtha divyAni mahAstrANyupachakrame
shlokas.7:
sahasrANAM sahasraM sa prAhiNodyamasAdanam |
AgneyenArjunaH sa~Nkhye gandharvANAM balotkaTaH
shlokas.8:
tathA bhImo maheShvAsaH sa.nyuge balinAM varaH |
gandharvA~nshatasho rAja~njaghAna nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.9:
mAdrIputrAvapi tathA yudhyamAnau balotkaTau |
parigRRihyAgrato rAja~njaghnatuH shatashaH parAn
shlokas.10:
te vadhyamAnA gandharvA divyairastrairmahAtmabhiH |
utpetuH khamupAdAya dhRRitarAShTrasutA.nstataH
shlokas.11:
tAnutpatiShNUnbuddhvA tu kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
mahatA sharajAlena samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.12:
te baddhAH sharajAlena shakuntA iva pa~njare |
vavarShurarjunaM krodhAdgadAshaktyRRiShTivRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.13:
gadAshaktyasivRRiShTIstA nihatya sa mahAstravit |
gAtrANi chAhanadbhallairgandharvANAM dhana~njayaH
shlokas.14:
shirobhiH prapatadbhishcha charaNairbAhubhistathA |
ashmavRRiShTirivAbhAti pareShAmabhavadbhayam
shlokas.15:
te vadhyamAnA gandharvAH pANDavena mahAtmanA |
bhUmiShThamantarikShasthAH sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.16:
teShAM tu sharavarShANi savyasAchI parantapaH |
astraiH sa.nvArya tejasvI gandharvAnpratyavidhyata
shlokas.17:
sthUNAkarNendrajAlaM cha sauraM chApi tathArjunaH |
AgneyaM chApi saumyaM cha sasarja kurunandanaH
shlokas.18:
te dahyamAnA gandharvAH kuntIputrasya sAyakaiH |
daiteyA iva shakreNa viShAdamagamanparam
shlokas.19:
UrdhvamAkramamANAshcha sharajAlena vAritAH |
visarpamANA bhallaishcha vAryante savyasAchinA
shlokas.20:
gandharvA.nstrAsitAndRRiShTvA kuntIputreNa dhImatA |
chitraseno gadAM gRRihya savyasAchinamAdravat
shlokas.21:
tasyAbhipatatastUrNaM gadAhastasya sa.nyuge |
gadAM sarvAyasIM pArthaH sharaishchichCheda saptadhA
shlokas.22:
sa gadAM bahudhA dRRiShTvA kRRittAM bANaistarasvinA |
sa.nvRRitya vidyayAtmAnaM yodhayAmAsa pANDavam
astrANi tasya divyAni yodhayAmAsa khe sthitaH
shlokas.23:
gandharvarAjo balavAnmAyayAntarhitastadA |
antarhitaM samAlakShya praharantamathArjunaH
tADayAmAsa khacharairdivyAstrapratimantritaiH
shlokas.24:
antardhAnavadhaM chAsya chakre kruddho.arjunastadA |
shabdavedhyamupAshritya bahurUpo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.25:
sa vadhyamAnastairastrairarjunena mahAtmanA |
athAsya darshayAmAsa tadAtmAnaM priyaH sakhA
shlokas.26:
chitrasenamathAlakShya sakhAyaM yudhi durbalam |
sa~njahArAstramatha tatprasRRiShTaM pANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.27:
dRRiShTvA tu pANDavAH sarve saMhRRitAstraM dhana~njayam |
sa~njahruH pradrutAnashvA~nsharavegAndhanUMShi cha
shlokas.28:
chitrasenashcha bhImashcha savyasAchI yamAvapi |
pRRiShTvA kaushalamanyonyaM ratheShvevAvatasthire

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.arjunashchitrasenaM prahasannidamabravIt |
madhye gandharvasainyAnAM maheShvAso mahAdyutiH
shlokas.2:
kiM te vyavasitaM vIra kauravANAM vinigrahe |
kimarthaM cha sadAro.ayaM nigRRihItaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.3:
chitrasena uvAcha||
vidito.ayamabhiprAyastatrasthena mahAtmanA |
duryodhanasya pApasya karNasya cha dhana~njaya
shlokas.4:
vanasthAnbhavato j~nAtvA klishyamAnAnanarhavat |
ime.avahasituM prAptA draupadIM cha yashasvinIm
shlokas.5:
j~nAtvA chikIrShitaM chaiShAM mAmuvAcha sureshvaraH |
gachCha duryodhanaM baddhvA sAmAtyaM tvamihAnaya
shlokas.6:
dhana~njayashcha te rakShyaH saha bhrAtRRibhirAhave |
sa hi priyaH sakhA tubhyaM shiShyashcha tava pANDavaH
shlokas.7:
vachanAddevarAjasya tato.asmIhAgato drutam |
ayaM durAtmA baddhashcha gamiShyAmi surAlayam
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
utsRRijyatAM chitrasena bhrAtAsmAkaM suyodhanaH |
dharmarAjasya sa.ndeshAnmama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.9:
chitrasena uvAcha||
pApo.ayaM nityasa.nduShTo na vimokShaNamarhati |
pralabdhA dharmarAjasya kRRiShNAyAshcha dhana~njaya
shlokas.10:
nedaM chikIrShitaM tasya kuntIputro mahAvrataH |
jAnAti dharmarAjo hi shrutvA kuru yathechChasi
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te sarva eva rAjAnamabhijagmuryudhiShThiram |
abhigamya cha tatsarvaM shasha.nsustasya duShkRRitam
shlokas.12:
ajAtashatrustachChrutvA gandharvasya vachastadA |
mokShayAmAsa tAnsarvAngandharvAnprashasha.nsa cha
shlokas.13:
diShTyA bhavadbhirbalibhiH shaktaiH sarvairna hi.nsitaH |
durvRRitto dhArtarAShTro.ayaM sAmAtyaj~nAtibAndhavaH
shlokas.14:
upakAro mahA.nstAta kRRito.ayaM mama khecharAH |
kulaM na paribhUtaM me mokSheNAsya durAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
Aj~nApayadhvamiShTAni prIyAmo darshanena vaH |
prApya sarvAnabhiprAyA.nstato vrajata mAchiram
shlokas.16:
anuj~nAtAstu gandharvAH pANDuputreNa dhImatA |
sahApsarobhiH saMhRRiShTAshchitrasenamukhA yayuH
shlokas.17:
devarADapi gandharvAnmRRitA.nstAnsamajIvayat |
divyenAmRRitavarSheNa ye hatAH kauravairyudhi
shlokas.18:
j~nAtI.nstAnavamuchyAtha rAjadArA.nshcha sarvashaH |
kRRitvA cha duShkaraM karma prItiyuktAshcha pANDavAH
shlokas.19:
sastrIkumAraiH kurubhiH pUjyamAnA mahArathAH |
babhrAjire mahAtmAnaH kurumadhye yathAgnayaH
shlokas.20:
tato duryodhanaM muchya bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaM tadA |
yudhiShThiraH sapraNayamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.21:
mA sma tAta punaH kArShIrIdRRishaM sAhasaM kvachit |
na hi sAhasakartAraH sukhamedhanti bhArata
shlokas.22:
svastimAnsahitaH sarvairbhrAtRRibhiH kurunandana |
gRRihAnvraja yathAkAmaM vaimanasyaM cha mA kRRithAH
shlokas.23:
pANDavenAbhyanuj~nAto rAjA duryodhanastadA |
vidIryamANo vrIDena jagAma nagaraM prati
shlokas.24:
tasmingate kauraveye kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vIraH pUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.25:
tapodhanaishcha taiH sarvairvRRitaH shakra ivAmaraiH |
vane dvaitavane tasminvijahAra mudA yutaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
shatrubhirjitabaddhasya pANDavaishcha mahAtmabhiH |
mokShitasya yudhA pashchAnmAnasthasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
katthanasyAvaliptasya garvitasya cha nityashaH |
sadA cha pauruShaudAryaiH pANDavAnavamanyataH
shlokas.3:
duryodhanasya pApasya nityAha~NkAravAdinaH |
pravesho hAstinapure duShkaraH pratibhAti me
shlokas.4:
tasya lajjAnvitasyaiva shokavyAkulachetasaH |
praveshaM vistareNa tvaM vaishampAyana kIrtaya
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dharmarAjanisRRiShTastu dhArtarAShTraH suyodhanaH |
lajjayAdhomukhaH sIdannupAsarpatsuduHkhitaH
shlokas.6:
svapuraM prayayau rAjA chatura~NgabalAnugaH |
shokopahatayA buddhyA chintayAnaH parAbhavam
shlokas.7:
vimuchya pathi yAnAni deshe suyavasodake |
saMniviShTaH shubhe ramye bhUmibhAge yathepsitam
hastyashvarathapAdAtaM yathAsthAnaM nyaveshayat
shlokas.8:
athopaviShTaM rAjAnaM parya~Nke jvalanaprabhe |
upaplutaM yathA somaM rAhuNA rAtrisa~NkShaye
upagamyAbravItkarNo duryodhanamidaM tadA
shlokas.9:
diShTyA jIvasi gAndhAre diShTyA naH sa~NgamaH punaH |
diShTyA tvayA jitAshchaiva gandharvAH kAmarUpiNaH
shlokas.10:
diShTyA samagrAnpashyAmi bhrAtR^I.nste kurunandana |
vijigIShUnraNAnmuktAnnirjitArInmahArathAn
shlokas.11:
ahaM tvabhidrutaH sarvairgandharvaiH pashyatastava |
nAshaknuvaM sthApayituM dIryamANAM svavAhinIm
shlokas.12:
sharakShatA~Ngashcha bhRRishaM vyapayAto.abhipIDitaH |
idaM tvatyadbhutaM manye yadyuShmAniha bhArata
shlokas.13:
ariShTAnakShatA.nshchApi sadAradhanavAhanAn |
vimuktAnsamprapashyAmi tasmAdyuddhAdamAnuShAt
shlokas.14:
naitasya kartA loke.asminpumAnvidyeta bhArata |
yatkRRitaM te mahArAja saha bhrAtRRibhirAhave
shlokas.15:
evamuktastu karNena rAjA duryodhanastadA |
uvAchAvAkShirA rAjanbAShpagadgadayA girA

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ajAnataste rAdheya nAbhyasUyAmyahaM vachaH |
jAnAsi tvaM jitA~nshatrUngandharvA.nstejasA mayA
shlokas.2:
AyodhitAstu gandharvAH suchiraM sodarairmama |
mayA saha mahAbAho kRRitashchobhayataH kShayaH
shlokas.3:
mAyAdhikAstvayudhyanta yadA shUrA viyadgatAH |
tadA no nasamaM yuddhamabhavatsaha khecharaiH
shlokas.4:
parAjayaM cha prAptAH sma raNe bandhanameva cha |
sabhRRityAmAtyaputrAshcha sadAradhanavAhanAH
uchchairAkAshamArgeNa hriyAmastaiH suduHkhitAH
shlokas.5:
atha naH sainikAH kechidamAtyAshcha mahArathAn |
upagamyAbruvandInAH pANDavA~nsharaNapradAn
shlokas.6:
eSha duryodhano rAjA dhArtarAShTraH sahAnujaH |
sAmAtyadAro hriyate gandharvairdivamAsthitaiH
shlokas.7:
taM mokShayata bhadraM vaH sahadAraM narAdhipam |
parAmarsho mA bhaviShyatkurudAreShu sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
evamukte tu dharmAtmA jyeShThaH pANDusutastadA |
prasAdya sodarAnsarvAnAj~nApayata mokShaNe
shlokas.9:
athAgamya tamuddeshaM pANDavAH puruSharShabhAH |
sAntvapUrvamayAchanta shaktAH santo mahArathAH
shlokas.10:
yadA chAsmAnna mumuchurgandharvAH sAntvitA api |
tato.arjunashcha bhImashcha yamajau cha balotkaTau
mumuchuH sharavarShANi gandharvAnpratyanekashaH
shlokas.11:
atha sarve raNaM muktvA prayAtAH khacharA divam |
asmAnevAbhikarShanto dInAnmuditamAnasAH
shlokas.12:
tataH samantAtpashyAmi sharajAlena veShTitam |
amAnuShANi chAstrANi prayu~njAnaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.13:
samAvRRitA disho dRRiShTvA pANDavena shitaiH sharaiH |
dhana~njayasakhAtmAnaM darshayAmAsa vai tadA
shlokas.14:
chitrasenaH pANDavena samAshliShya parantapaH |
kushalaM paripaprachCha taiH pRRiShTashchApyanAmayam
shlokas.15:
te sametya tathAnyonyaM saMnAhAnvipramuchya cha |
ekIbhUtAstato vIrA gandharvAH saha pANDavaiH
apUjayetAmanyonyaM chitrasenadhana~njayau

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
chitrasenaM samAgamya prahasannarjunastadA |
idaM vachanamaklIbamabravItparavIrahA
shlokas.2:
bhrAtR^Inarhasi no vIra moktuM gandharvasattama |
anarhA dharShaNaM hIme jIvamAneShu pANDuShu
shlokas.3:
evamuktastu gandharvaH pANDavena mahAtmanA |
uvAcha yatkarNa vayaM mantrayanto vinirgatAH
draShTAraH sma sukhAddhInAnsadArAnpANDavAniti
shlokas.4:
tasminnuchchAryamANe tu gandharveNa vachasyatha |
bhUmervivaramanvaichChaM praveShTuM vrIDayAnvitaH
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThiramathAgamya gandharvAH saha pANDavaiH |
asmaddurmantritaM tasmai baddhA.nshchAsmAnnyavedayan
shlokas.6:
strIsamakShamahaM dIno baddhaH shatruvashaM gataH |
yudhiShThirasyopahRRitaH kiM nu duHkhamataH param
shlokas.7:
ye me nirAkRRitA nityaM ripuryeShAmahaM sadA |
tairmokShito.ahaM durbuddhirdattaM tairjIvitaM cha me
shlokas.8:
prAptaH syAM yadyahaM vIra vadhaM tasminmahAraNe |
shreyastadbhavitA mahyamevambhUtaM na jIvitam
shlokas.9:
bhavedyashaH pRRithivyAM me khyAtaM gandharvato vadhAt |
prAptAshcha lokAH puNyAH syurmahendrasadane.akShayAH
shlokas.10:
yattvadya me vyavasitaM tachChRRiNudhvaM nararShabhAH |
iha prAyamupAsiShye yUyaM vrajata vai gRRihAn
bhrAtarashchaiva me sarve prayAntvadya puraM prati
shlokas.11:
karNaprabhRRitayashchaiva suhRRido bAndhavAshcha ye |
duHshAsanaM puraskRRitya prayAntvadya puraM prati
shlokas.12:
na hyahaM pratiyAsyAmi puraM shatrunirAkRRitaH |
shatrumAnApaho bhUtvA suhRRidAM mAnakRRittathA
shlokas.13:
sa suhRRichChokado bhUtvA shatrUNAM harShavardhanaH |
vAraNAhvayamAsAdya kiM vakShyAmi janAdhipam
shlokas.14:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipo drauNirviduraH sa~njayastathA |
bAhlIkaH somadattashcha ye chAnye vRRiddhasaMmatAH
shlokas.15:
brAhmaNAH shreNimukhyAshcha tathodAsInavRRittayaH |
kiM mAM vakShyanti kiM chApi prativakShyAmi tAnaham
shlokas.16:
ripUNAM shirasi sthitvA tathA vikramya chorasi |
AtmadoShAtparibhraShTaH kathaM vakShyAmi tAnaham
shlokas.17:
durvinItAH shriyaM prApya vidyAmaishvaryameva cha |
tiShThanti na chiraM bhadre yathAhaM madagarvitaH
shlokas.18:
aho bata yathedaM me kaShTaM dushcharitaM kRRitam |
svayaM durbuddhinA mohAdyena prApto.asmi sa.nshayam
shlokas.19:
tasmAtprAyamupAsiShye na hi shakShyAmi jIvitum |
chetayAno hi ko jIvetkRRichChrAchChatrubhiruddhRRitaH
shlokas.20:
shatrubhishchAvahasito mAnI pauruShavarjitaH |
pANDavairvikramADhyaishcha sAvamAnamavekShitaH
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM chintAparigato duHshAsanamathAbravIt |
duHshAsana nibodhedaM vachanaM mama bhArata
shlokas.22:
pratIchCha tvaM mayA dattamabhiShekaM nRRipo bhava |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM sphItAM karNasaubalapAlitAm
shlokas.23:
bhrAtR^InpAlaya visrabdhaM maruto vRRitrahA yathA |
bAndhavAstvopajIvantu devA iva shatakratum
shlokas.24:
brAhmaNeShu sadA vRRittiM kurvIthAshchApramAdataH |
bandhUnAM suhRRidAM chaiva bhavethAstvaM gatiH sadA
shlokas.25:
j~nAtI.nshchApyanupashyethA viShNurdevagaNAniva |
guravaH pAlanIyAste gachCha pAlaya medinIm
shlokas.26:
nandayansuhRRidaH sarvA~nshAtravA.nshchAvabhartsayan |
kaNThe chainaM pariShvajya gamyatAmityuvAcha ha
shlokas.27:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA dIno duHshAsano.abravIt |
ashrukaNThaH suduHkhArtaH prA~njaliH praNipatya cha
sagadgadamidaM vAkyaM bhrAtaraM jyeShThamAtmanaH
shlokas.28:
prasIdetyapatadbhUmau dUyamAnena chetasA |
duHkhitaH pAdayostasya netrajaM jalamutsRRijan
shlokas.29:
uktavA.nshcha naravyAghro naitadevaM bhaviShyati |
vidIryetsanagA bhUmirdyaushchApi shakalIbhavet
ravirAtmaprabhAM jahyAtsomaH shItA.nshutAM tyajet
shlokas.30:
vAyuH shaighryamatho jahyAddhimavA.nshcha parivrajet |
shuShyettoyaM samudreShu vahnirapyuShNatAM tyajet
shlokas.31:
na chAhaM tvadRRite rAjanprashAseyaM vasundharAm |
punaH punaH prasIdeti vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
tvameva naH kule rAjA bhaviShyasi shataM samAH
shlokas.32:
evamuktvA sa rAjendra sasvanaM praruroda ha |
pAdau sa~NgRRihya mAnArhau bhrAturjyeShThasya bhArata
shlokas.33:
tathA tau duHkhitau dRRiShTvA duHshAsanasuyodhanau |
abhigamya vyathAviShTaH karNastau pratyabhAShata
shlokas.34:
viShIdathaH kiM kauravyau bAlishyAtprAkRRitAviva |
na shokaH shochamAnasya vinivarteta kasyachit
shlokas.35:
yadA cha shochataH shoko vyasanaM nApakarShati |
sAmarthyaM kiM tvataH shoke shochamAnau prapashyathaH
dhRRitiM gRRihNIta mA shatrU~nshochantau nandayiShyathaH
shlokas.36:
kartavyaM hi kRRitaM rAjanpANDavaistava mokShaNam |
nityameva priyaM kAryaM rAj~no viShayavAsibhiH
pAlyamAnAstvayA te hi nivasanti gatajvarAH
shlokas.37:
nArhasyeva~Ngate manyuM kartuM prAkRRitavadyathA |
viShaNNAstava sodaryAstvayi prAyaM samAsthite
uttiShTha vraja bhadraM te samAshvAsaya sodarAn
shlokas.38:
rAjannadyAvagachChAmi taveha laghusattvatAm |
kimatra chitraM yadvIra mokShitaH pANDavairasi
sadyo vashaM samApannaH shatrUNAM shatrukarshana
shlokas.39:
senAjIvaishcha kauravya tathA viShayavAsibhiH |
aj~nAtairyadi vA j~nAtaiH kartavyaM nRRipateH priyam
shlokas.40:
prAyaH pradhAnAH puruShAH kShobhayantyarivAhinIm |
nigRRihyante cha yuddheShu mokShyante cha svasainikaiH
shlokas.41:
senAjIvAshcha ye rAj~nAM viShaye santi mAnavAH |
taiH sa~Ngamya nRRipArthAya yatitavyaM yathAtatham
shlokas.42:
yadyevaM pANDavai rAjanbhavadviShayavAsibhiH |
yadRRichChayA mokShito.adya tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.43:
na chaitatsAdhu yadrAjanpANDavAstvAM nRRipottama |
svasenayA samprayAntaM nAnuyAnti sma pRRiShThataH
shlokas.44:
shUrAshcha balavantashcha sa.nyugeShvapalAyinaH |
bhavataste sabhAyAM vai preShyatAM pUrvamAgatAH
shlokas.45:
pANDaveyAni ratnAni tvamadyApyupabhu~njase |
sattvasthAnpANDavAnpashya na te prAyamupAvishan
uttiShTha rAjanbhadraM te na chintAM kartumarhasi
shlokas.46:
avashyameva nRRipate rAj~no viShayavAsibhiH |
priyANyAcharitavyAni tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.47:
madvAkyametadrAjendra yadyevaM na kariShyasi |
sthAsyAmIha bhavatpAdau shushrUShannarimardana
shlokas.48:
notsahe jIvitumahaM tvadvihIno nararShabha |
prAyopaviShTastu nRRipa rAj~nAM hAsyo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.49:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu karNena rAjA duryodhanastadA |
naivotthAtuM manashchakre svargAya kRRitanishchayaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prAyopaviShTaM rAjAnaM duryodhanamamarShaNam |
uvAcha sAntvayanrAja~nshakuniH saubalastadA
shlokas.2:
samyaguktaM hi karNena tachChrutaM kaurava tvayA |
mayAhRRitAM shriyaM sphItAM mohAtsamapahAya kim
tvamabuddhyA nRRipavara prANAnutsraShTumichChasi
shlokas.3:
adya chApyavagachChAmi na vRRiddhAH sevitAstvayA |
yaH samutpatitaM harShaM dainyaM vA na niyachChati
sa nashyati shriyaM prApya pAtramAmamivAmbhasi
shlokas.4:
atibhIrumatiklIbaM dIrghasUtraM pramAdinam |
vyasanAdviShayAkrAntaM na bhajanti nRRipaM shriyaH
shlokas.5:
satkRRitasya hi te shoko viparIte kathaM bhavet |
mA kRRitaM shobhanaM pArthaiH shokamAlambya nAshaya
shlokas.6:
yatra harShastvayA kAryaH satkartavyAshcha pANDavAH |
tatra shochasi rAjendra viparItamidaM tava
shlokas.7:
prasIda mA tyajAtmAnaM tuShTashcha sukRRitaM smara |
prayachCha rAjyaM pArthAnAM yasho dharmamavApnuhi
shlokas.8:
kriyAmetAM samAj~nAya kRRitaghno na bhaviShyasi |
saubhrAtraM pANDavaiH kRRitvA samavasthApya chaiva tAn
pitryaM rAjyaM prayachChaiShAM tataH sukhamavApnuhi
shlokas.9:
shakunestu vachaH shrutvA duHshAsanamavekShya cha |
pAdayoH patitaM vIraM viklavaM bhrAtRRisauhRRidAt
shlokas.10:
bAhubhyAM sAdhujAtAbhyAM duHshAsanamari.ndamam |
utthApya sampariShvajya prItyAjighrata mUrdhani
shlokas.11:
karNasaubalayoshchApi sa.nsmRRitya vachanAnyasau |
nirvedaM paramaM gatvA rAjA duryodhanastadA
vrIDayAbhiparItAtmA nairAshyamagamatparam
shlokas.12:
suhRRidAM chaiva tachChrutvA samanyuridamabravIt |
na dharmadhanasaukhyena naishvaryeNa na chAj~nayA
naiva bhogaishcha me kAryaM mA vihanyata gachChata
shlokas.13:
nishchiteyaM mama matiH sthitA prAyopaveshane |
gachChadhvaM nagaraM sarve pUjyAshcha guravo mama
shlokas.14:
ta evamuktAH pratyUchU rAjAnamarimardanam |
yA gatistava rAjendra sAsmAkamapi bhArata
kathaM vA sampravekShyAmastvadvihInAH puraM vayam
shlokas.15:
sa suhRRidbhiramAtyaishcha bhrAtRRibhiH svajanena cha |
bahuprakAramapyukto nishchayAnna vyachAlyata
shlokas.16:
darbhaprastaramAstIrya nishchayAddhRRitarAShTrajaH |
sa.nspRRishyApaH shuchirbhUtvA bhUtalaM samupAshritaH
shlokas.17:
kushachIrAmbaradharaH paraM niyamamAsthitaH |
vAgyato rAjashArdUlaH sa svargagatikA~NkShayA
manasopachitiM kRRitvA nirasya cha bahiShkriyAH
shlokas.18:
atha taM nishchayaM tasya buddhvA daiteyadAnavAH |
pAtAlavAsino raudrAH pUrvaM devairvinirjitAH
shlokas.19:
te svapakShakShayaM taM tu j~nAtvA duryodhanasya vai |
AhvAnAya tadA chakruH karma vaitAnasambhavam
shlokas.20:
bRRihaspatyushanoktaishcha mantrairmantravishAradAH |
atharvavedaproktaishcha yAshchopaniShadi kriyAH
mantrajapyasamAyuktAstAstadA samavartayan
shlokas.21:
juhvatyagnau haviH kShIraM mantravatsusamAhitAH |
brAhmaNA vedavedA~NgapAragAH sudRRiDhavratAH
shlokas.22:
karmasiddhau tadA tatra jRRimbhamANA mahAdbhutA |
kRRityA samutthitA rAjankiM karomIti chAbravIt
shlokas.23:
AhurdaityAshcha tAM tatra suprItenAntarAtmanA |
prAyopaviShTaM rAjAnaM dhArtarAShTramihAnaya
shlokas.24:
tatheti cha pratishrutya sA kRRityA prayayau tadA |
nimeShAdagamachchApi yatra rAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.25:
samAdAya cha rAjAnaM pravivesha rasAtalam |
dAnavAnAM muhUrtAchcha tamAnItaM nyavedayat
shlokas.26:
tamAnItaM nRRipaM dRRiShTvA rAtrau saMhatya dAnavAH |
prahRRiShTamanasaH sarve ki~nchidutphullalochanAH
sAbhimAnamidaM vAkyaM duryodhanamathAbruvan

shlokas.1:
dAnavA UchuH||
bhoH suyodhana rAjendra bharatAnAM kulodvaha |
shUraiH parivRRito nityaM tathaiva cha mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.2:
akArShIH sAhasamidaM kasmAtprAyopaveshanam |
AtmatyAgI hyavAgyAti vAchyatAM chAyashaskarIm
shlokas.3:
na hi kAryaviruddheShu bahvapAyeShu karmasu |
mUlaghAtiShu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhAH
shlokas.4:
niyachChaitAM matiM rAjandharmArthasukhanAshinIm |
yashaHpratApadhairyaghnIM shatrUNAM harShavardhanIm
shlokas.5:
shrUyatAM cha prabho tattvaM divyatAM chAtmano nRRipa |
nirmANaM cha sharIrasya tato dhairyamavApnuhi
shlokas.6:
purA tvaM tapasAsmAbhirlabdho devAnmaheshvarAt |
pUrvakAyashcha sarvaste nirmito vajrasa~nchayaiH
shlokas.7:
astrairabhedyaH shastraishchApyadhaHkAyashcha te.anagha |
kRRitaH puShpamayo devyA rUpataH strImanoharaH
shlokas.8:
evamIshvarasa.nyuktastava deho nRRipottama |
devyA cha rAjashArdUla divyastvaM hi na mAnuShaH
shlokas.9:
kShatriyAshcha mahAvIryA bhagadattapurogamAH |
divyAstraviduShaH shUrAH kShapayiShyanti te ripUn
shlokas.10:
tadalaM te viShAdena bhayaM tava na vidyate |
sAhyArthaM cha hi te vIrAH sambhUtA bhuvi dAnavAH
shlokas.11:
bhIShmadroNakRRipAdI.nshcha pravekShyantyapare.asurAH |
yairAviShTA ghRRiNAM tyaktvA yotsyante tava vairibhiH
shlokas.12:
naiva putrAnna cha bhrAtR^Inna pitR^Inna cha bAndhavAn |
naiva shiShyAnna cha j~nAtInna bAlAnsthavirAnna cha
shlokas.13:
yudhi samprahariShyanto mokShyanti kurusattama |
niHsnehA dAnavAviShTAH samAkrAnte.antarAtmani
shlokas.14:
prahariShyanti bandhubhyaH snehamutsRRijya dUrataH |
