hRRiShTAH puruShashArdUlAH kaluShIkRRitamAnasAH
avij~nAnavimUDhAshcha daivAchcha vidhinirmitAt
shlokas.15:
vyAbhAShamANAshchAnyonyaM na me jIvanvimokShyase |
sarvashastrAstramokSheNa pauruShe samavasthitAH
shlAghamAnAH kurushreShTha kariShyanti janakShayam
shlokas.16:
te.api shaktyA mahAtmAnaH pratiyotsyanti pANDavAH |
vadhaM chaiShAM kariShyanti daivayuktA mahAbalAH
shlokas.17:
daityarakShogaNAshchApi sambhUtAH kShatrayoniShu |
yotsyanti yudhi vikramya shatrubhistava pArthiva
gadAbhirmusalaiH khaDgaiH shastrairuchchAvachaistathA
shlokas.18:
yachcha te.antargataM vIra bhayamarjunasambhavam |
tatrApi vihito.asmAbhirvadhopAyo.arjunasya vai
shlokas.19:
hatasya narakasyAtmA karNamUrtimupAshritaH |
tadvairaM sa.nsmaranvIra yotsyate keshavArjunau
shlokas.20:
sa te vikramashauNDIro raNe pArthaM vijeShyati |
karNaH praharatAM shreShThaH sarvA.nshchArInmahArathaH
shlokas.21:
j~nAtvaitachChadmanA vajrI rakShArthaM savyasAchinaH |
kuNDale kavachaM chaiva karNasyApahariShyati
shlokas.22:
tasmAdasmAbhirapyatra daityAH shatasahasrashaH |
niyuktA rAkShasAshchaiva ye te sa.nshaptakA iti
prakhyAtAste.arjunaM vIraM nihaniShyanti mA shuchaH
shlokas.23:
asapatnA tvayA hIyaM bhoktavyA vasudhA nRRipa |
mA viShAdaM nayasvAsmAnnaitattvayyupapadyate
vinaShTe tvayi chAsmAkaM pakSho hIyeta kaurava
shlokas.24:
gachCha vIra na te buddhiranyA kAryA katha~nchana |
tvamasmAkaM gatirnityaM devatAnAM cha pANDavAH
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA pariShvajya daityAstaM rAjaku~njaram |
samAshvAsya cha durdharShaM putravaddAnavarShabhAH
shlokas.26:
sthirAM kRRitvA buddhimasya priyANyuktvA cha bhArata |
gamyatAmityanuj~nAya jayamApnuhi chetyatha
shlokas.27:
tairvisRRiShTaM mahAbAhuM kRRityA saivAnayatpunaH |
tameva deshaM yatrAsau tadA prAyamupAvishat
shlokas.28:
pratinikShipya taM vIraM kRRityA samabhipUjya cha |
anuj~nAtA cha rAj~nA sA tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.29:
gatAyAmatha tasyAM tu rAjA duryodhanastadA |
svapnabhUtamidaM sarvamachintayata bhArata
vijeShyAmi raNe pANDUniti tasyAbhavanmatiH
shlokas.30:
karNaM sa.nshaptakA.nshchaiva pArthasyAmitraghAtinaH |
amanyata vadhe yuktAnsamarthA.nshcha suyodhanaH
shlokas.31:
evamAshA dRRiDhA tasya dhArtarAShTrasya durmateH |
vinirjaye pANDavAnAmabhavadbharatarShabha
shlokas.32:
karNo.apyAviShTachittAtmA narakasyAntarAtmanA |
arjunasya vadhe krUrAmakarotsa matiM tadA
shlokas.33:
sa.nshaptakAshcha te vIrA rAkShasAviShTachetasaH |
rajastamobhyAmAkrAntAH phalgunasya vadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.34:
bhIShmadroNakRRipAdyAshcha dAnavAkrAntachetasaH |
na tathA pANDuputrANAM snehavanto vishAM pate
na chAchachakShe kasmaichidetadrAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.35:
duryodhanaM nishAnte cha karNo vaikartano.abravIt |
smayannivA~njaliM kRRitvA pArthivaM hetumadvachaH
shlokas.36:
na mRRito jayate shatrU~njIvanbhadrANi pashyati |
mRRitasya bhadrANi kutaH kauraveya kuto jayaH
na kAlo.adya viShAdasya bhayasya maraNasya vA
shlokas.37:
pariShvajyAbravIchchainaM bhujAbhyAM sa mahAbhujaH |
uttiShTha rAjankiM sheShe kasmAchChochasi shatruhan
shatrUnpratApya vIryeNa sa kathaM martumichChasi
shlokas.38:
atha vA te bhayaM jAtaM dRRiShTvArjunaparAkramam |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi vadhiShyAmi raNe.arjunam
shlokas.39:
gate trayodashe varShe satyenAyudhamAlabhe |
AnayiShyAmyahaM pArthAnvashaM tava janAdhipa
shlokas.40:
evamuktastu karNena daityAnAM vachanAttathA |
praNipAtena chAnyeShAmudatiShThatsuyodhanaH
daityAnAM tadvachaH shrutvA hRRidi kRRitvA sthirAM matim
shlokas.41:
tato manujashArdUlo yojayAmAsa vAhinIm |
rathanAgAshvakalilAM padAtijanasa~NkulAm
shlokas.42:
ga~NgaughapratimA rAjanprayAtA sA mahAchamUH |
shvetachChatraiH patAkAbhishchAmaraishcha supANDuraiH
shlokas.43:
rathairnAgaiH padAtaishcha shushubhe.atIva sa~NkulA |
vyapetAbhraghane kAle dyaurivAvyaktashAradI
shlokas.44:
jayAshIrbhirdvijendraistu stUyamAno.adhirAjavat |
gRRihNanna~njalimAlAshcha dhArtarAShTro janAdhipaH
shlokas.45:
suyodhano yayAvagre shriyA paramayA jvalan |
karNena sArdhaM rAjendra saubalena cha devinA
shlokas.46:
duHshAsanAdayashchAsya bhrAtaraH sarva eva te |
bhUrishravAH somadatto mahArAjashcha bAhlikaH
shlokas.47:
rathairnAnAvidhAkArairhayairgajavaraistathA |
prayAntaM nRRipasiMhaM tamanujagmuH kurUdvahAH
kAlenAlpena rAja.nste vivishuH svapuraM tadA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
vasamAneShu pArtheShu vane tasminmahAtmasu |
dhArtarAShTrA maheShvAsAH kimakurvanta sattama
shlokas.2:
karNo vaikartanashchApi shakunishcha mahAbalaH |
bhIShmadroNakRRipAshchaiva tanme sha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM gateShu pArtheShu visRRiShTe cha suyodhane |
Agate hAstinapuraM mokShite pANDunandanaiH
bhIShmo.abravInmahArAja dhArtarAShTramidaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
uktaM tAta mayA pUrvaM gachChataste tapovanam |
gamanaM me na ruchitaM tava tanna kRRitaM cha te
shlokas.5:
tataH prAptaM tvayA vIra grahaNaM shatrubhirbalAt |
mokShitashchAsi dharmaj~naiH pANDavairna cha lajjase
shlokas.6:
pratyakShaM tava gAndhAre sasainyasya vishAM pate |
sUtaputro.apayAdbhIto gandharvANAM tadA raNAt
kroshatastava rAjendra sasainyasya nRRipAtmaja
shlokas.7:
dRRiShTaste vikramashchaiva pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
karNasya cha mahAbAho sUtaputrasya durmateH
shlokas.8:
na chApi pAdabhAkkarNaH pANDavAnAM nRRipottama |
dhanurvede cha shaurye cha dharme vA dharmavatsala
shlokas.9:
tasya te.ahaM kShamaM manye pANDavaistairmahAtmabhiH |
sandhiM sandhividAM shreShTha kulasyAsya vivRRiddhaye
shlokas.10:
evamuktastu bhIShmeNa dhArtarAShTro janeshvaraH |
prahasya sahasA rAjanvipratasthe sasaubalaH
shlokas.11:
taM tu prasthitamAj~nAya karNaduHshAsanAdayaH |
anujagmurmaheShvAsA dhArtarAShTraM mahAbalam
shlokas.12:
tA.nstu samprasthitAndRRiShTvA bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH |
lajjayA vrIDito rAja~njagAma svaM niveshanam
shlokas.13:
gate bhIShme mahArAja dhArtarAShTro janAdhipaH |
punarAgamya taM deshamamantrayata mantribhiH
shlokas.14:
kimasmAkaM bhavechChreyaH kiM kAryamavashiShyate |
kathaM nu sukRRitaM cha syAnmantrayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.15:
karNa uvAcha||
duryodhana nibodhedaM yattvA vakShyAmi kaurava |
shrutvA cha tattathA sarvaM kartumarhasyari.ndama
shlokas.16:
tavAdya pRRithivI vIra niHsapatnA nRRipottama |
tAM pAlaya yathA shakro hatashatrurmahAmanAH
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu karNena karNaM rAjAbravItpunaH |
na ki~nchiddurlabhaM tasya yasya tvaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.18:
sahAyashchAnuraktashcha madarthaM cha samudyataH |
abhiprAyastu me kashchittaM vai shRRiNu yathAtatham
shlokas.19:
rAjasUyaM pANDavasya dRRiShTvA kratuvaraM tadA |
mama spRRihA samutpannA tAM sampAdaya sUtaja
shlokas.20:
evamuktastataH karNo rAjAnamidamabravIt |
tavAdya pRRithivIpAlA vashyAH sarve nRRipottama
shlokas.21:
AhUyantAM dvijavarAH sambhArAshcha yathAvidhi |
sambhriyantAM kurushreShTha yaj~nopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.22:
RRitvijashcha samAhUtA yathoktaM vedapAragAH |
kriyAM kurvantu te rAjanyathAshAstramari.ndama
shlokas.23:
bahvannapAnasa.nyuktaH susamRRiddhaguNAnvitaH |
pravartatAM mahAyaj~nastavApi bharatarShabha
shlokas.24:
evamuktastu karNena dhArtarAShTro vishAM pate |
purohitaM samAnAyya idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThaM samAptavaradakShiNam |
Ahara tvaM mama kRRite yathAnyAyaM yathAkramam
shlokas.26:
sa evamukto nRRipatimuvAcha dvijapu~NgavaH |
na sa shakyaH kratushreShTho jIvamAne yudhiShThire
AhartuM kauravashreShTha kule tava nRRipottama
shlokas.27:
dIrghAyurjIvati cha vai dhRRitarAShTraH pitA tava |
atashchApi viruddhaste kratureSha nRRipottama
shlokas.28:
asti tvanyanmahatsatraM rAjasUyasamaM prabho |
tena tvaM yaja rAjendra shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.29:
ya ime pRRithivIpAlAH karadAstava pArthiva |
te karAnsamprayachChantu suvarNaM cha kRRitAkRRitam
shlokas.30:
tena te kriyatAmadya lA~NgalaM nRRipasattama |
yaj~navATasya te bhUmiH kRRiShyatAM tena bhArata
shlokas.31:
tatra yaj~no nRRipashreShTha prabhUtAnnaH susa.nskRRitaH |
pravartatAM yathAnyAyaM sarvato hyanivAritaH
shlokas.32:
eSha te vaiShNavo nAma yaj~naH satpuruShochitaH |
etena neShTavAnkashchidRRite viShNuM purAtanam
shlokas.33:
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThaM spardhatyeSha mahAkratuH |
asmAkaM rochate chaiva shreyashcha tava bhArata
avighnashcha bhavedeSha saphalA syAtspRRihA tava
shlokas.34:
evamuktastu tairviprairdhArtarAShTro mahIpatiH |
karNaM cha saubalaM chaiva bhrAtR^I.nshchaivedamabravIt
shlokas.35:
rochate me vachaH kRRitsnaM brAhmaNAnAM na sa.nshayaH |
rochate yadi yuShmAkaM tanmA prabrUta mAchiram
shlokas.36:
evamuktAstu te sarve tathetyUchurnarAdhipam |
sa.ndidesha tato rAjA vyApArasthAnyathAkramam
shlokas.37:
halasya karaNe chApi vyAdiShTAH sarvashilpinaH |
yathoktaM cha nRRipashreShTha kRRitaM sarvaM yathAkramam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastu shilpinaH sarve amAtyapravarAshcha ha |
vidurashcha mahAprAj~no dhArtarAShTre nyavedayat
shlokas.2:
sajjaM kratuvaraM rAjankAlaprAptaM cha bhArata |
sauvarNaM cha kRRitaM divyaM lA~NgalaM sumahAdhanam
shlokas.3:
etachChrutvA nRRipashreShTho dhArtarAShTro vishAM pate |
Aj~nApayAmAsa nRRipaH kraturAjapravartanam
shlokas.4:
tataH pravavRRite yaj~naH prabhUtAnnaH susa.nskRRitaH |
dIkShitashchApi gAndhAriryathAshAstraM yathAkramam
shlokas.5:
prahRRiShTo dhRRitarAShTro.abhUdvidurashcha mahAyashAH |
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipaH karNo gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.6:
nimantraNArthaM dUtA.nshcha preShayAmAsa shIghragAn |
pArthivAnAM cha rAjendra brAhmaNAnAM tathaiva cha
te prayAtA yathoddiShTaM dUtAstvaritavAhanAH
shlokas.7:
tatra ka~nchitprayAtaM tu dUtaM duHshAsano.abravIt |
gachCha dvaitavanaM shIghraM pANDavAnpApapUruShAn
nimantraya yathAnyAyaM viprA.nstasminmahAvane
shlokas.8:
sa gatvA pANDavAvAsamuvAchAbhipraNamya tAn |
duryodhano mahArAja yajate nRRipasattamaH
shlokas.9:
svavIryArjitamarthaughamavApya kurunandanaH |
tatra gachChanti rAjAno brAhmaNAshcha tatastataH
shlokas.10:
ahaM tu preShito rAjankauraveNa mahAtmanA |
Amantrayati vo rAjA dhArtarAShTro janeshvaraH
mano.abhilaShitaM rAj~nastaM kratuM draShTumarhatha
shlokas.11:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tachChrutvA dUtabhAShitam |
abravInnRRipashArdUlo diShTyA rAjA suyodhanaH
yajate kratumukhyena pUrveShAM kIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.12:
vayamapyupayAsyAmo na tvidAnIM katha~nchana |
samayaH paripAlyo no yAvadvarShaM trayodasham
shlokas.13:
shrutvaitaddharmarAjasya bhImo vachanamabravIt |
tadA tu nRRipatirgantA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.14:
astrashastrapradIpte.agnau yadA taM pAtayiShyati |
varShAttrayodashAdUrdhvaM raNasatre narAdhipaH
shlokas.15:
yadA krodhahavirmoktA dhArtarAShTreShu pANDavaH |
AgantArastadA smeti vAchyaste sa suyodhanaH
shlokas.16:
sheShAstu pANDavA rAjannaivochuH ki~nchidapriyam |
dUtashchApi yathAvRRittaM dhArtarAShTre nyavedayat
shlokas.17:
athAjagmurnarashreShThA nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
brAhmaNAshcha mahAbhAgA dhArtarAShTrapuraM prati
shlokas.18:
te tvarchitA yathAshAstraM yathAvarNaM yathAkramam |
mudA paramayA yuktAH prItyA chApi nareshvara
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTro.api rAjendra sa.nvRRitaH sarvakauravaiH |
harSheNa mahatA yukto viduraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.20:
yathA sukhI janaH sarvaH kShattaH syAdannasa.nyutaH |
tuShyechcha yaj~nasadane tathA kShipraM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.21:
vidurastvevamAj~naptaH sarvavarNAnari.ndama |
yathApramANato vidvAnpUjayAmAsa dharmavit
shlokas.22:
bhakShyabhojyAnnapAnena mAlyaishchApi sugandhibhiH |
vAsobhirvividhaishchaiva yojayAmAsa hRRiShTavat
shlokas.23:
kRRitvA hyavabhRRithaM vIro yathAshAstraM yathAkramam |
sAntvayitvA cha rAjendro dattvA cha vividhaM vasu
visarjayAmAsa nRRipAnbrAhmaNA.nshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.24:
visarjayitvA sa nRRipAnbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH |
vivesha hAstinapuraM sahitaH karNasaubalaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pravishantaM mahArAja sUtAstuShTuvurachyutam |
janAshchApi maheShvAsaM tuShTuvU rAjasattamam
shlokas.2:
lAjaishchandanachUrNaishchApyavakIrya janAstadA |
UchurdiShTyA nRRipAvighnAtsamApto.ayaM kratustava
shlokas.3:
apare tvabruva.nstatra vAtikAstaM mahIpatim |
yudhiShThirasya yaj~nena na samo hyeSha tu kratuH
naiva tasya kratoreSha kalAmarhati ShoDashIm
shlokas.4:
evaM tatrAbruvankechidvAtikAstaM nareshvaram |
suhRRidastvabruva.nstatra ati sarvAnayaM kratuH
shlokas.5:
yayAtirnahuShashchApi mAndhAtA bharatastathA |
kratumenaM samAhRRitya pUtAH sarve divaM gatAH
shlokas.6:
etA vAchaH shubhAH shRRiNvansuhRRidAM bharatarShabha |
pravivesha puraM hRRiShTaH svaveshma cha narAdhipaH
shlokas.7:
abhivAdya tataH pAdau mAtApitrorvishAM pate |
bhIShmadroNakRRipANAM cha vidurasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.8:
abhivAditaH kanIyobhirbhrAtRRibhirbhrAtRRivatsalaH |
niShasAdAsane mukhye bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.9:
tamutthAya mahArAja sUtaputro.abravIdvachaH |
diShTyA te bharatashreShTha samApto.ayaM mahAkratuH
shlokas.10:
hateShu yudhi pArtheShu rAjasUye tathA tvayA |
AhRRite.ahaM narashreShTha tvAM sabhAjayitA punaH
shlokas.11:
tamabravInmahArAjo dhArtarAShTro mahAyashAH |
satyametattvayA vIra pANDaveShu durAtmasu
shlokas.12:
nihateShu narashreShTha prApte chApi mahAkratau |
rAjasUye punarvIra tvaM mAM sa.nvardhayiShyasi
shlokas.13:
evamuktvA mahAprAj~naH karNamAshliShya bhArata |
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThaM chintayAmAsa kauravaH
shlokas.14:
so.abravItsuhRRidashchApi pArshvasthAnnRRipasattamaH |
kadA tu taM kratuvaraM rAjasUyaM mahAdhanam
nihatya pANDavAnsarvAnAhariShyAmi kauravAH
shlokas.15:
tamabravIttadA karNaH shRRiNu me rAjaku~njara |
pAdau na dhAvaye tAvadyAvanna nihato.arjunaH
shlokas.16:
athotkruShTaM maheShvAsairdhArtarAShTrairmahArathaiH |
pratij~nAte phalgunasya vadhe karNena sa.nyuge
vijitA.nshchApyamanyanta pANDavAndhRRitarAShTrajAH
shlokas.17:
duryodhano.api rAjendra visRRijya narapu~NgavAn |
pravivesha gRRihaM shrImAnyathA chaitrarathaM prabhuH
te.api sarve maheShvAsA jagmurveshmAni bhArata
shlokas.18:
pANDavAshcha maheShvAsA dUtavAkyaprachoditAH |
chintayantastamevArthaM nAlabhanta sukhaM kvachit
shlokas.19:
bhUyashcha chArai rAjendra pravRRittirupapAditA |
pratij~nA sUtaputrasya vijayasya vadhaM prati
shlokas.20:
etachChrutvA dharmasutaH samudvigno narAdhipa |
abhedyakavachaM matvA karNamadbhutavikramam
anusmara.nshcha sa~NkleshAnna shAntimupayAti saH
shlokas.21:
tasya chintAparItasya buddhirjaj~ne mahAtmanaH |
bahuvyAlamRRigAkIrNaM tyaktuM dvaitavanaM vanam
shlokas.22:
dhArtarAShTro.api nRRipatiH prashashAsa vasundharAm |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vIrairbhIShmadroNakRRipaistathA
shlokas.23:
sa~Ngamya sUtaputreNa karNenAhavashobhinA |
duryodhanaH priye nityaM vartamAno mahIpatiH
pUjayAmAsa viprendrAnkratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.24:
bhrAtR^INAM cha priyaM rAjansa chakAra parantapaH |
nishchitya manasA vIro dattabhuktaphalaM dhanam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
duryodhanaM mochayitvA pANDuputrA mahAbalAH |
kimakArShurvane tasmi.nstanmamAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shayAnaM kaunteyaM rAtrau dvaitavane mRRigAH |
svapnAnte darshayAmAsurbAShpakaNThA yudhiShThiram
shlokas.3:
tAnabravItsa rAjendro vepamAnAnkRRitA~njalIn |
brUta yadvaktukAmAH stha ke bhavantaH kimiShyate
shlokas.4:
evamuktAH pANDavena kaunteyena yashasvinA |
pratyabruvanmRRigAstatra hatasheShA yudhiShThiram
shlokas.5:
vayaM mRRigA dvaitavane hatashiShTAH sma bhArata |
notsIdema mahArAja kriyatAM vAsaparyayaH
shlokas.6:
bhavanto bhrAtaraH shUrAH sarva evAstrakovidAH |
kulAnyalpAvashiShTAni kRRitavanto vanaukasAm
shlokas.7:
bIjabhUtA vayaM kechidavashiShTA mahAmate |
vivardhemahi rAjendra prasAdAtte yudhiShThira
shlokas.8:
tAnvepamAnAnvitrastAnbIjamAtrAvasheShitAn |
mRRigAndRRiShTvA suduHkhArto dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.9:
tA.nstathetyabravIdrAjA sarvabhUtahite rataH |
tathyaM bhavanto bruvate kariShyAmi cha tattathA
shlokas.10:
ityevaM pratibuddhaH sa rAtryante rAjasattamaH |
abravItsahitAnbhrAtR^IndayApanno mRRigAnprati
shlokas.11:
ukto rAtrau mRRigairasmi svapnAnte hatasheShitaiH |
tanubhUtAH sma bhadraM te dayA naH kriyatAmiti
shlokas.12:
te satyamAhuH kartavyA dayAsmAbhirvanaukasAm |
sAShTamAsaM hi no varShaM yadenAnupayu~njmahe
shlokas.13:
punarbahumRRigaM ramyaM kAmyakaM kAnanottamam |
marubhUmeH shiraH khyAtaM tRRiNabindusaraH prati
tatremA vasatIH shiShTA viharanto ramemahi
shlokas.14:
tataste pANDavAH shIghraM prayayurdharmakovidAH |
brAhmaNaiH sahitA rAjanye cha tatra sahoShitAH
indrasenAdibhishchaiva preShyairanugatAstadA
shlokas.15:
te yAtvAnusRRitairmArgaiH svannaiH shuchijalAnvitaiH |
dadRRishuH kAmyakaM puNyamAshramaM tApasAyutam
shlokas.16:
vivishuste sma kauravyA vRRitA viprarShabhaistadA |
tadvanaM bharatashreShThAH svargaM sukRRitino yathA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vane nivasatAM teShAM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
varShANyekAdashAtIyuH kRRichChreNa bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
phalamUlAshanAste hi sukhArhA duHkhamuttamam |
prAptakAlamanudhyAntaH sehuruttamapUruShAH
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThirastu rAjarShirAtmakarmAparAdhajam |
chintayansa mahAbAhurbhrAtR^INAM duHkhamuttamam
shlokas.4:
na suShvApa sukhaM rAjA hRRidi shalyairivArpitaiH |
daurAtmyamanupashya.nstatkAle dyUtodbhavasya hi
shlokas.5:
sa.nsmaranparuShA vAchaH sUtaputrasya pANDavaH |
niHshvAsaparamo dIno bibhratkopaviShaM mahat
shlokas.6:
arjuno yamajau chobhau draupadI cha yashasvinI |
sa cha bhImo mahAtejAH sarveShAmuttamo balI
yudhiShThiramudIkShantaH sehurduHkhamanuttamam
shlokas.7:
avashiShTamalpakAlaM manvAnAH puruSharShabhAH |
vapuranyadivAkArShurutsAhAmarShacheShTitaiH
shlokas.8:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH |
AjagAma mahAyogI pANDavAnavalokakaH
shlokas.9:
tamAgatamabhiprekShya kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
pratyudgamya mahAtmAnaM pratyagRRihNAdyathAvidhi
shlokas.10:
tamAsInamupAsInaH shushrUShurniyatendriyaH |
toShayanpraNipAtena vyAsaM pANDavanandanaH
shlokas.11:
tAnavekShya kRRishAnpautrAnvane vanyena jIvataH |
maharShiranukampArthamabravIdbAShpagadgadam
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho shRRiNu dharmabhRRitAM vara |
nAtaptatapasaH putra prApnuvanti mahatsukham
shlokas.13:
sukhaduHkhe hi puruShaH paryAyeNopasevate |
nAtyantamasukhaM kashchitprApnoti puruSharShabha
shlokas.14:
praj~nAvA.nstveva puruShaH sa.nyuktaH parayA dhiyA |
udayAstamayaj~no hi na shochati na hRRiShyati
shlokas.15:
sukhamApatitaM sevedduHkhamApatitaM sahet |
kAlaprAptamupAsIta sasyAnAmiva karShakaH
shlokas.16:
tapaso hi paraM nAsti tapasA vindate mahat |
nAsAdhyaM tapasaH ki~nchiditi budhyasva bhArata
shlokas.17:
satyamArjavamakrodhaH sa.nvibhAgo damaH shamaH |
anasUyAvihi.nsA cha shauchamindriyasa.nyamaH
sAdhanAni mahArAja narANAM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.18:
adharmaruchayo mUDhAstiryaggatiparAyaNAH |
kRRichChrAM yonimanuprApya na sukhaM vindate janAH
shlokas.19:
iha yatkriyate karma tatparatropabhujyate |
tasmAchCharIraM yu~njIta tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.20:
yathAshakti prayachChechcha sampUjyAbhipraNamya cha |
kAle pAtre cha hRRiShTAtmA rAjanvigatamatsaraH
shlokas.21:
satyavAdI labhetAyuranAyAsamathArjavI |
akrodhano.anasUyashcha nirvRRitiM labhate parAm
shlokas.22:
dAntaH shamaparaH shashvatparikleshaM na vindati |
na cha tapyati dAntAtmA dRRiShTvA paragatAM shriyam
shlokas.23:
sa.nvibhaktA cha dAtA cha bhogavAnsukhavAnnaraH |
bhavatyahi.nsakashchaiva paramArogyamashnute
shlokas.24:
mAnyAnmAnayitA janma kule mahati vindati |
vyasanairna tu sa.nyogaM prApnoti vijitendriyaH
shlokas.25:
shubhAnushayabuddhirhi sa.nyuktaH kAladharmaNA |
prAdurbhavati tadyogAtkalyANamatireva saH
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhagavandAnadharmANAM tapaso vA mahAmune |
kiM svidbahuguNaM pretya kiM vA duShkaramuchyate
shlokas.27:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dAnAnna duShkarataraM pRRithivyAmasti ki~nchana |
arthe hi mahatI tRRiShNA sa cha duHkhena labhyate
shlokas.28:
parityajya priyAnprANAndhanArthaM hi mahAhavam |
pravishanti narA vIrAH samudramaTavIM tathA
shlokas.29:
kRRiShigorakShyamityeke pratipadyanti mAnavAH |
puruShAH preShyatAmeke nirgachChanti dhanArthinaH
shlokas.30:
tasya duHkhArjitasyaivaM parityAgaH suduShkaraH |
na duShkarataraM dAnAttasmAddAnaM mataM mama
shlokas.31:
visheShastvatra vij~neyo nyAyenopArjitaM dhanam |
pAtre deshe cha kAle cha sAdhubhyaH pratipAdayet
shlokas.32:
anyAyasamupAttena dAnadharmo dhanena yaH |
kriyate na sa kartAraM trAyate mahato bhayAt
shlokas.33:
pAtre dAnaM svalpamapi kAle dattaM yudhiShThira |
manasA suvishuddhena pretyAnantaphalaM smRRitam
shlokas.34:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vrIhidroNaparityAgAdyatphalaM prApa mudgalaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vrIhidroNaH parityaktaH kathaM tena mahAtmanA |
kasmai dattashcha bhagavanvidhinA kena chAttha me
shlokas.2:
pratyakShadharmA bhagavAnyasya tuShTo hi karmabhiH |
saphalaM tasya janmAhaM manye saddharmachAriNaH
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
shilo~nChavRRittirdharmAtmA mudgalaH sa.nshitavrataH |
AsIdrAjankurukShetre satyavAganasUyakaH
shlokas.4:
atithivratI kriyAvA.nshcha kApotIM vRRittimAsthitaH |
satramiShTIkRRitaM nAma samupAste mahAtapAH
shlokas.5:
saputradAro hi muniH pakShAhAro babhUva saH |
kapotavRRittyA pakSheNa vrIhidroNamupArjayat
shlokas.6:
darshaM cha paurNamAsaM cha kurvanvigatamatsaraH |
devatAtithisheSheNa kurute dehayApanam
shlokas.7:
tasyendraH sahito devaiH sAkShAttribhuvaneshvaraH |
pratyagRRihNAnmahArAja bhAgaM parvaNi parvaNi
shlokas.8:
sa parvakAlaM kRRitvA tu munivRRittyA samanvitaH |
atithibhyo dadAvannaM prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.9:
vrIhidroNasya tadaho dadato.annaM mahAtmanaH |
shiShTaM mAtsaryahInasya vardhatyatithidarshanAt
shlokas.10:
tachChatAnyapi bhu~njanti brAhmaNAnAM manIShiNAm |
munestyAgavishuddhyA tu tadannaM vRRiddhimRRichChati
shlokas.11:
taM tu shushrAva dharmiShThaM mudgalaM sa.nshitavratam |
durvAsA nRRipa digvAsAstamathAbhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.12:
bibhrachchAniyataM veShamunmatta iva pANDava |
vikachaH paruShA vAcho vyAharanvividhA muniH
shlokas.13:
abhigamyAtha taM vipramuvAcha munisattamaH |
annArthinamanuprAptaM viddhi mAM munisattama
shlokas.14:
svAgataM te.astviti muniM mudgalaH pratyabhAShata |
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha prativedyAnnamuttamam
shlokas.15:
prAdAtsa tapasopAttaM kShudhitAyAtithivratI |
unmattAya parAM shraddhAmAsthAya sa dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.16:
tatastadannaM rasavatsa eva kShudhayAnvitaH |
bubhuje kRRitsnamunmattaH prAdAttasmai cha mudgalaH
shlokas.17:
bhuktvA chAnnaM tataH sarvamuchChiShTenAtmanastataH |
athAnulilipe.a~NgAni jagAma cha yathAgatam
shlokas.18:
evaM dvitIye samprApte parvakAle manIShiNaH |
Agamya bubhuje sarvamannamu~nChopajIvinaH
shlokas.19:
nirAhArastu sa muniru~nChamArjayate punaH |
na chainaM vikriyAM netumashakanmudgalaM kShudhA
shlokas.20:
na krodho na cha mAtsaryaM nAvamAno na sambhramaH |
saputradAramu~nChantamAvivesha dvijottamam
shlokas.21:
tathA tamu~nChadharmANaM durvAsA munisattamam |
upatasthe yathAkAlaM ShaTkRRitvaH kRRitanishchayaH
shlokas.22:
na chAsya mAnasaM ki~nchidvikAraM dadRRishe muniH |
shuddhasattvasya shuddhaM sa dadRRishe nirmalaM manaH
shlokas.23:
tamuvAcha tataH prItaH sa munirmudgalaM tadA |
tvatsamo nAsti loke.asmindAtA mAtsaryavarjitaH
shlokas.24:
kShuddharmasa~nj~nAM praNudatyAdatte dhairyameva cha |
viShayAnusAriNI jihvA karShatyeva rasAnprati
shlokas.25:
AhAraprabhavAH prANA mano durnigrahaM chalam |
manasashchendriyANAM chApyaikAgryaM nishchitaM tapaH
shlokas.26:
shrameNopArjitaM tyaktuM duHkhaM shuddhena chetasA |
tatsarvaM bhavatA sAdho yathAvadupapAditam
shlokas.27:
prItAH smo.anugRRihItAshcha sametya bhavatA saha |
indriyAbhijayo dhairyaM sa.nvibhAgo damaH shamaH
shlokas.28:
dayA satyaM cha dharmashcha tvayi sarvaM pratiShThitam |
jitAste karmabhirlokAH prApto.asi paramAM gatim
shlokas.29:
aho dAnaM vighuShTaM te sumahatsvargavAsibhiH |
sasharIro bhavAngantA svargaM sucharitavrata
shlokas.30:
ityevaM vadatastasya tadA durvAsaso muneH |
devadUto vimAnena mudgalaM pratyupasthitaH
shlokas.31:
ha.nsasArasayuktena ki~NkiNIjAlamAlinA |
kAmagena vichitreNa divyagandhavatA tathA
shlokas.32:
uvAcha chainaM viprarShiM vimAnaM karmabhirjitam |
samupAroha sa.nsiddhiM prApto.asi paramAM mune
shlokas.33:
tameva.nvAdinamRRiShirdevadUtamuvAcha ha |
ichChAmi bhavatA proktAnguNAnsvarganivAsinAm
shlokas.34:
ke guNAstatra vasatAM kiM tapaH kashcha nishchayaH |
svarge svargasukhaM kiM cha doSho vA devadUtaka
shlokas.35:
satAM saptapadaM mitramAhuH santaH kulochitAH |
mitratAM cha puraskRRitya pRRichChAmi tvAmahaM vibho
shlokas.36:
yadatra tathyaM pathyaM cha tadbravIhyavichArayan |
shrutvA tathA kariShyAmi vyavasAyaM girA tava

shlokas.1:
devadUta uvAcha||
maharShe.akAryabuddhistvaM yaH svargasukhamuttamam |
samprAptaM bahu mantavyaM vimRRishasyabudho yathA
shlokas.2:
upariShTAdasau loko yo.ayaM svariti sa~nj~nitaH |
UrdhvagaH satpathaH shashvaddevayAnacharo mune
shlokas.3:
nAtaptatapasaH pu.nso nAmahAyaj~nayAjinaH |
nAnRRitA nAstikAshchaiva tatra gachChanti mudgala
shlokas.4:
dharmAtmAno jitAtmAnaH shAntA dAntA vimatsarAH |
dAnadharmaratAH pu.nsaH shUrAshchAhatalakShaNAH
shlokas.5:
tatra gachChanti karmAgryaM kRRitvA shamadamAtmakam |
lokAnpuNyakRRitAM brahmansadbhirAsevitAnnRRibhiH
shlokas.6:
devAH sAdhyAstathA vishve marutashcha maharShibhiH |
yAmA dhAmAshcha maudgalya gandharvApsarasastathA
shlokas.7:
eShAM devanikAyAnAM pRRithakpRRithaganekashaH |
bhAsvantaH kAmasampannA lokAstejomayAH shubhAH
shlokas.8:
trayastri.nshatsahasrANi yojanAnAM hiraNmayaH |
meruH parvatarADyatra devodyAnAni mudgala
shlokas.9:
nandanAdIni puNyAni vihArAH puNyakarmaNAm |
na kShutpipAse na glAnirna shItoShNabhayaM tathA
shlokas.10:
bIbhatsamashubhaM vApi rogA vA tatra kechana |
manoj~nAH sarvato gandhAH sukhasparshAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
shabdAH shrutimanogrAhyAH sarvatastatra vai mune |
na shoko na jarA tatra nAyAsaparidevane
shlokas.12:
IdRRishaH sa mune lokaH svakarmaphalahetukaH |
sukRRitaistatra puruShAH sambhavantyAtmakarmabhiH
shlokas.13:
taijasAni sharIrANi bhavantyatropapadyatAm |
karmajAnyeva maudgalya na mAtRRipitRRijAnyuta
shlokas.14:
na cha svedo na daurgandhyaM purIShaM mUtrameva cha |
teShAM na cha rajo vastraM bAdhate tatra vai mune
shlokas.15:
na mlAyanti srajasteShAM divyagandhA manoramAH |
paryuhyante vimAnaishcha brahmanneva.nvidhAshcha te
shlokas.16:
IrShyAshokaklamApetA mohamAtsaryavarjitAH |
sukhaM svargajitastatra vartayanti mahAmune
shlokas.17:
teShAM tathAvidhAnAM tu lokAnAM munipu~Ngava |
uparyupari shakrasya lokA divyaguNAnvitAH
shlokas.18:
purastAdbrahmaNastatra lokAstejomayAH shubhAH |
yatra yAntyRRiShayo brahmanpUtAH svaiH karmabhiH shubhaiH
shlokas.19:
RRibhavo nAma tatrAnye devAnAmapi devatAH |
teShAM lokAH paratare tAnyajantIha devatAH
shlokas.20:
svayamprabhAste bhAsvanto lokAH kAmadughAH pare |
na teShAM strIkRRitastApo na lokaishvaryamatsaraH
shlokas.21:
na vartayantyAhutibhiste nApyamRRitabhojanAH |
tathA divyasharIrAste na cha vigrahamUrtayaH
shlokas.22:
na sukhe sukhakAmAshcha devadevAH sanAtanAH |
na kalpaparivarteShu parivartanti te tathA
shlokas.23:
jarA mRRityuH kutasteShAM harShaH prItiH sukhaM na cha |
na duHkhaM na sukhaM chApi rAgadveShau kuto mune
shlokas.24:
devAnAmapi maudgalya kA~NkShitA sA gatiH parA |
duShprApA paramA siddhiragamyA kAmagocharaiH
shlokas.25:
trayastri.nshadime lokAH sheShA lokA manIShibhiH |
gamyante niyamaiH shreShThairdAnairvA vidhipUrvakaiH
shlokas.26:
seyaM dAnakRRitA vyuShTiratra prAptA sukhAvahA |
tAM bhu~NkShva sukRRitairlabdhAM tapasA dyotitaprabhaH
shlokas.27:
etatsvargasukhaM vipra lokA nAnAvidhAstathA |
guNAH svargasya proktAste doShAnapi nibodha me
shlokas.28:
kRRitasya karmaNastatra bhujyate yatphalaM divi |
na chAnyatkriyate karma mUlachChedena bhujyate
shlokas.29:
so.atra doSho mama matastasyAnte patanaM cha yat |
sukhavyAptamanaskAnAM patanaM yachcha mudgala
shlokas.30:
asantoShaH parItApo dRRiShTvA dIptatarAH shriyaH |
yadbhavatyavare sthAne sthitAnAM tachcha duShkaram
shlokas.31:
sa~nj~nAmohashcha patatAM rajasA cha pradharShaNam |
pramlAneShu cha mAlyeShu tataH pipatiShorbhayam
shlokas.32:
A brahmabhavanAdete doShA maudgalya dAruNAH |
nAkaloke sukRRitinAM guNAstvayutasho nRRiNAm
shlokas.33:
ayaM tvanyo guNaH shreShThashchyutAnAM svargato mune |
shubhAnushayayogena manuShyeShUpajAyate
shlokas.34:
tatrApi sumahAbhAgaH sukhabhAgabhijAyate |
na chetsambudhyate tatra gachChatyadhamatAM tataH
shlokas.35:
iha yatkriyate karma tatparatropabhujyate |
karmabhUmiriyaM brahmanphalabhUmirasau matA
shlokas.36:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM pRRichChasi mudgala |
tavAnukampayA sAdho sAdhu gachChAma mAchiram
shlokas.37:
vyAsa uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu maudgalyo vAkyaM vimamRRishe dhiyA |
vimRRishya cha munishreShTho devadUtamuvAcha ha
shlokas.38:
devadUta namaste.astu gachCha tAta yathAsukham |
mahAdoSheNa me kAryaM na svargeNa sukhena vA
shlokas.39:
patanaM tanmahadduHkhaM paritApaH sudAruNaH |
svargabhAjashchyavantIha tasmAtsvargaM na kAmaye
shlokas.40:
yatra gatvA na shochanti na vyathanti chalanti vA |
tadahaM sthAnamatyantaM mArgayiShyAmi kevalam
shlokas.41:
ityuktvA sa munirvAkyaM devadUtaM visRRijya tam |
shilo~nChavRRittimutsRRijya shamamAtiShThaduttamam
shlokas.42:
tulyanindAstutirbhUtvA samaloShTAshmakA~nchanaH |
j~nAnayogena shuddhena dhyAnanityo babhUva ha
shlokas.43:
dhyAnayogAdbalaM labdhvA prApya charddhimanuttamAm |
jagAma shAshvatIM siddhiM parAM nirvANalakShaNAm
shlokas.44:
tasmAttvamapi kaunteya na shokaM kartumarhasi |
rAjyAtsphItAtparibhraShTastapasA tadavApsyasi
shlokas.45:
sukhasyAnantaraM duHkhaM duHkhasyAnantaraM sukham |
paryAyeNopavartante naraM nemimarA iva
shlokas.46:
pitRRipaitAmahaM rAjyaM prApsyasyamitavikrama |
varShAttrayodashAdUrdhvaM vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.47:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa bhagavAnvyAsaH pANDavanandanam |
jagAma tapase dhImAnpunarevAshramaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminbahumRRige.araNye ramamANA mahArathAH |
kAmyake bharatashreShThA vijahruste yathAmarAH
shlokas.2:
prekShamANA bahuvidhAnvanoddeshAnsamantataH |
yathartukAlaramyAshcha vanarAjIH supuShpitAH
shlokas.3:
pANDavA mRRigayAshIlAshcharantastanmahAvanam |
vijahrurindrapratimAH ka~nchitkAlamari.ndamAH
shlokas.4:
tataste yaugapadyena yayuH sarve chaturdisham |
mRRigayAM puruShavyAghrA brAhmaNArthe parantapAH
shlokas.5:
draupadImAshrame nyasya tRRiNabindoranuj~nayA |
maharSherdIptatapaso dhaumyasya cha purodhasaH
shlokas.6:
tatastu rAjA sindhUnAM vArddhakShatrirmahAyashAH |
vivAhakAmaH shAlveyAnprayAtaH so.abhavattadA
shlokas.7:
mahatA paribarheNa rAjayogyena sa.nvRRitaH |
rAjabhirbahubhiH sArdhamupAyAtkAmyakaM cha saH
shlokas.8:
tatrApashyatpriyAM bhAryAM pANDavAnAM yashasvinIm |
tiShThantImAshramadvAri draupadIM nirjane vane
shlokas.9:
vibhrAjamAnAM vapuShA bibhratIM rUpamuttamam |
bhrAjayantIM vanoddeshaM nIlAbhramiva vidyutam
shlokas.10:
apsarA devakanyA vA mAyA vA devanirmitA |
iti kRRitvA~njaliM sarve dadRRishustAmaninditAm
shlokas.11:
tataH sa rAjA sindhUnAM vArddhakShatrirjayadrathaH |
vismitastAmanindyA~NgIM dRRiShTvAsIddhRRiShTamAnasaH
shlokas.12:
sa koTikAshyaM rAjAnamabravItkAmamohitaH |
kasya tveShAnavadyA~NgI yadi vApi na mAnuShI
shlokas.13:
vivAhArtho na me kashchidimAM dRRiShTvAtisundarIm |
etAmevAhamAdAya gamiShyAmi svamAlayam
shlokas.14:
gachCha jAnIhi saumyainAM kasya kA cha kuto.api vA |
kimarthamAgatA subhrUridaM kaNTakitaM vanam
shlokas.15:
api nAma varArohA mAmeShA lokasundarI |
bhajedadyAyatApA~NgI sudatI tanumadhyamA
shlokas.16:
apyahaM kRRitakAmaH syAmimAM prApya varastriyam |
gachCha jAnIhi ko nvasyA nAtha ityeva koTika
shlokas.17:
sa koTikAshyastachChrutvA rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI |
upetya paprachCha tadA kroShTA vyAghravadhUmiva

shlokas.1:
koTikAshya uvAcha||
kA tvaM kadambasya vinamya shAkhA;mekAshrame tiShThasi shobhamAnA |
dedIpyamAnAgnishikheva naktaM; dodhUyamAnA pavanena subhrUH
shlokas.2:
atIva rUpeNa samanvitA tvaM; na chApyaraNyeShu bibheShi kiM nu |
devI nu yakShI yadi dAnavI vA; varApsarA daityavarA~NganA vA
shlokas.3:
vapuShmatI voragarAjakanyA; vanecharI vA kShaNadAcharastrI |
yadyeva rAj~no varuNasya patnI; yamasya somasya dhaneshvarasya
shlokas.4:
dhAturvidhAtuH saviturvibhorvA; shakrasya vA tvaM sadanAtprapannA |
na hyeva naH pRRichChasi ye vayaM sma; na chApi jAnIma taveha nAtham
shlokas.5:
vayaM hi mAnaM tava vardhayantaH; pRRichChAma bhadre prabhavaM prabhuM cha |
AchakShva bandhU.nshcha patiM kulaM cha; tattvena yachcheha karoShi kAryam
shlokas.6:
ahaM tu rAj~naH surathasya putro; yaM koTikAshyeti vidurmanuShyAH |
asau tu yastiShThati kA~nchanA~Nge; rathe huto.agnishchayane yathaiva
trigartarAjaH kamalAyatAkShi; kShema~Nkaro nAma sa eSha vIraH
shlokas.7:
asmAtparastveSha mahAdhanuShmA;nputraH kuNindAdhipatervariShThaH |
nirIkShate tvAM vipulAyatA.nsaH; suvismitaH parvatavAsanityaH
shlokas.8:
asau tu yaH puShkariNIsamIpe; shyAmo yuvA tiShThati darshanIyaH |
ikShvAkurAj~naH subalasya putraH; sa eSha hantA dviShatAM sugAtri
shlokas.9:
yasyAnuyAtraM dhvajinaH prayAnti; sauvIrakA dvAdasha rAjaputrAH |
shoNAshvayukteShu ratheShu sarve; makheShu dIptA iva havyavAhAH
shlokas.10:
a~NgArakaH ku~njaraguptakashcha; shatru~njayaH sa~njayasupravRRiddhau |
prabha~Nkaro.atha bhramaro ravishcha; shUraH pratApaH kuharashcha nAma
shlokas.11:
yaM ShaTsahasrA rathino.anuyAnti; nAgA hayAshchaiva padAtinashcha |
jayadratho nAma yadi shrutaste; sauvIrarAjaH subhage sa eShaH
shlokas.12:
tasyApare bhrAtaro.adInasattvA; balAhakAnIkavidAraNAdhyAH |
sauvIravIrAH pravarA yuvAno; rAjAnamete balino.anuyAnti
shlokas.13:
etaiH sahAyairupayAti rAjA; marudgaNairindra ivAbhiguptaH |
ajAnatAM khyApaya naH sukeshi; kasyAsi bhAryA duhitA cha kasya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAbravIddraupadI rAjaputrI; pRRiShTA shibInAM pravareNa tena |
avekShya mandaM pravimuchya shAkhAM; sa~NgRRihNatI kaushikamuttarIyam
shlokas.2:
buddhyAbhijAnAmi narendraputra; na mAdRRishI tvAmabhibhAShTumarhA |
na tveha vaktAsti taveha vAkya;manyo naro vApyatha vApi nArI
shlokas.3:
ekA hyahaM samprati tena vAchaM; dadAni vai bhadra nibodha chedam |
ahaM hyaraNye kathamekamekA; tvAmAlapeyaM niratA svadharme
shlokas.4:
jAnAmi cha tvAM surathasya putraM; yaM koTikAshyeti vidurmanuShyAH |
tasmAdahaM shaibya tathaiva tubhya;mAkhyAmi bandhUnprati tannibodha
shlokas.5:
apatyamasmi drupadasya rAj~naH; kRRiShNeti mAM shaibya vidurmanuShyAH |
sAhaM vRRiNe pa~ncha janAnpatitve; ye khANDavaprasthagatAH shrutAste
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThiro bhImasenArjunau cha; mAdryAshcha putrau puruShapravIrau |
te mAM niveshyeha dishashchatasro; vibhajya pArthA mRRigayAM prayAtAH
shlokas.7:
prAchIM rAjA dakShiNAM bhImaseno; jayaH pratIchIM yamajAvudIchIm |
manye tu teShAM rathasattamAnAM; kAlo.abhitaH prApta ihopayAtum
shlokas.8:
saMmAnitA yAsyatha tairyatheShTaM; vimuchya vAhAnavagAhayadhvam |
priyAtithirdharmasuto mahAtmA; prIto bhaviShyatyabhivIkShya yuShmAn
shlokas.9:
etAvaduktvA drupadAtmajA sA; shaibyAtmajaM chandramukhI pratItA |
vivesha tAM parNakuTIM prashastAM; sa~nchintya teShAmatithisvadharmam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAsIneShu sarveShu teShu rAjasu bhArata |
koTikAshyavachaH shrutvA shaibyaM sauvIrako.abravIt
shlokas.2:
yadA vAchaM vyAharantyAmasyAM me ramate manaH |
sImantinInAM mukhyAyAM vinivRRittaH kathaM bhavAn
shlokas.3:
etAM dRRiShTvA striyo me.anyA yathA shAkhAmRRigastriyaH |
pratibhAnti mahAbAho satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.4:
darshanAdeva hi manastayA me.apahRRitaM bhRRisham |
tAM samAchakShva kalyANIM yadi syAchChaibya mAnuShI
shlokas.5:
koTikAshya uvAcha||
eShA vai draupadI kRRiShNA rAjaputrI yashasvinI |
pa~nchAnAM pANDuputrANAM mahiShI saMmatA bhRRisham
shlokas.6:
sarveShAM chaiva pArthAnAM priyA bahumatA satI |
tayA sametya sauvIra suvIrAnsusukhI vraja
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha pashyAmo draupadImiti |
patiH sauvIrasindhUnAM duShTabhAvo jayadrathaH
shlokas.8:
sa pravishyAshramaM shUnyaM siMhagoShThaM vRRiko yathA |
AtmanA saptamaH kRRiShNAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
kushalaM te varArohe bhartAraste.apyanAmayAH |
yeShAM kushalakAmAsi te.api kachchidanAmayAH
shlokas.10:
draupadyuvAcha||
kauravyaH kushalI rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
ahaM cha bhrAtarashchAsya yA.nshchAnyAnparipRRichChasi
shlokas.11:
pAdyaM pratigRRihANedamAsanaM cha nRRipAtmaja |
mRRigAnpa~nchAshataM chaiva prAtarAshaM dadAni te
shlokas.12:
aiNeyAnpRRiShatAnnya~NkUnhariNA~nsharabhA~nshashAn |
RRishyAnrurU~nshambarA.nshcha gavayA.nshcha mRRigAnbahUn
shlokas.13:
varAhAnmahiShA.nshchaiva yAshchAnyA mRRigajAtayaH |
pradAsyati svayaM tubhyaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.14:
jayadratha uvAcha||
kushalaM prAtarAshasya sarvA me.apachitiH kRRitA |
ehi me rathamAroha sukhamApnuhi kevalam
shlokas.15:
gatashrIkA.nshchyutAnrAjyAtkRRipaNAngatachetasaH |
araNyavAsinaH pArthAnnAnuroddhuM tvamarhasi
shlokas.16:
na vai prAj~nA gatashrIkaM bhartAramupayu~njate |
yu~njAnamanuyu~njIta na shriyaH sa~NkShaye vaset
shlokas.17:
shriyA vihInA rAjyAchcha vinaShTAH shAshvatIH samAH |
alaM te pANDuputrANAM bhaktyA kleshamupAsitum
shlokas.18:
bhAryA me bhava sushroNi tyajainAnsukhamApnuhi |
akhilAnsindhusauvIrAnavApnuhi mayA saha
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktA sindhurAjena vAkyaM hRRidayakampanam |
kRRiShNA tasmAdapAkrAmaddeshAtsabhrukuTImukhI
shlokas.20:
avamatyAsya tadvAkyamAkShipya cha sumadhyamA |
maivamityabravItkRRiShNA lajjasveti cha saindhavam
shlokas.21:
sA kA~NkShamANA bhartR^INAmupayAnamaninditA |
vilobhayAmAsa paraM vAkyairvAkyAni yu~njatI

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
saroSharAgopahatena valgunA; sarAganetreNa natonnatabhruvA |
mukhena visphUrya suvIrarAShTrapaM; tato.abravIttaM drupadAtmajA punaH
shlokas.2:
yashasvinastIkShNaviShAnmahArathA;nadhikShipanmUDha na lajjase katham |
mahendrakalpAnniratAnsvakarmasu; sthitAnsamUheShvapi yakSharakShasAm
shlokas.3:
na ki~nchidIDyaM pravadanti pApaM; vanecharaM vA gRRihamedhinaM vA |
tapasvinaM samparipUrNavidyaM; bhaShanti haivaM shvanarAH suvIra
shlokas.4:
ahaM tu manye tava nAsti kashchi;detAdRRishe kShatriyasaMniveshe |
yastvAdya pAtAlamukhe patantaM; pANau gRRihItvA pratisaMhareta
shlokas.5:
nAgaM prabhinnaM girikUTakalpa;mupatyakAM haimavatIM charantam |
daNDIva yUthAdapasedhase tvaM; yo jetumAsha.nsasi dharmarAjam
shlokas.6:
bAlyAtprasuptasya mahAbalasya; siMhasya pakShmANi mukhAllunAsi |
padA samAhatya palAyamAnaH; kruddhaM yadA drakShyasi bhImasenam
shlokas.7:
mahAbalaM ghorataraM pravRRiddhaM; jAtaM hariM parvatakandareShu |
prasuptamugraM prapadena ha.nsi; yaH kruddhamAsetsyasi jiShNumugram
shlokas.8:
kRRiShNoragau tIkShNaviShau dvijihvau; mattaH padAkrAmasi puchChadeshe |
yaH pANDavAbhyAM puruShottamAbhyAM; jaghanyajAbhyAM prayuyutsase tvam
shlokas.9:
yathA cha veNuH kadalI nalo vA; phalantyabhAvAya na bhUtaye.a.atmanaH |
tathaiva mAM taiH parirakShyamANA;mAdAsyase karkaTakIva garbham
shlokas.10:
jayadratha uvAcha||
jAnAmi kRRiShNe viditaM mamaita;dyathAvidhAste naradevaputrAH |
na tvevametena vibhIShaNena; shakyA vayaM trAsayituM tvayAdya
shlokas.11:
vayaM punaH saptadasheShu kRRiShNe; kuleShu sarve.anavameShu jAtAH |
ShaDbhyo guNebhyo.abhyadhikA vihInA;nmanyAmahe draupadi pANDuputrAn
shlokas.12:
sA kShipramAtiShTha gajaM rathaM vA; na vAkyamAtreNa vayaM hi shakyAH |
Asha.nsa vA tvaM kRRipaNaM vadantI; sauvIrarAjasya punaH prasAdam
shlokas.13:
draupadyuvAcha||
mahAbalA kiM tviha durbaleva; sauvIrarAjasya matAhamasmi |
yAhaM pramAthAdiha sampratItA; sauvIrarAjaM kRRipaNaM vadeyam
shlokas.14:
yasyA hi kRRiShNau padavIM charetAM; samAsthitAvekarathe sahAyau |
indro.api tAM nApaharetkathaM chi;nmanuShyamAtraH kRRipaNaH kuto.anyaH
shlokas.15:
yadA kirITI paravIraghAtI; nighnanrathastho dviShatAM manA.nsi |
madantare tvaddhvajinIM praveShTA; kakShaM dahannagnirivoShNageShu
shlokas.16:
janArdanasyAnugA vRRiShNivIrA; maheShvAsAH kekayAshchApi sarve |
ete hi sarve mama rAjaputrAH; prahRRiShTarUpAH padavIM chareyuH
shlokas.17:
maurvIvisRRiShTAH stanayitnughoShA; gANDIvamuktAstvativegavantaH |
hastaM samAhatya dhana~njayasya; bhImAH shabdaM ghorataraM nadanti
shlokas.18:
gANDIvamuktA.nshcha mahAsharaughA;npata~Ngasa~NghAniva shIghravegAn |
sasha~NkhaghoShaH satalatraghoSho; gANDIvadhanvA muhurudvama.nshcha
yadA sharAnarpayitA tavorasi; tadA manaste kimivAbhaviShyat
shlokas.19:
gadAhastaM bhImamabhidravantaM; mAdrIputrau sampatantau dishashcha |
amarShajaM krodhaviShaM vamantau; dRRiShTvA chiraM tApamupaiShyase.adhama
shlokas.20:
yathA chAhaM nAtichare kathaM chi;tpatInmahArhAnmanasApi jAtu |
tenAdya satyena vashIkRRitaM tvAM; draShTAsmi pArthaiH parikRRiShyamANam
shlokas.21:
na sambhramaM gantumahaM hi shakShye; tvayA nRRisha.nsena vikRRiShyamANA |
samAgatAhaM hi kurupravIraiH; punarvanaM kAmyakamAgatA cha
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tAnanuprekShya vishAlanetrA; jighRRikShamANAnavabhartsayantI |
provAcha mA mA spRRishateti bhItA; dhaumyaM prachukrosha purohitaM sA
shlokas.23:
jagrAha tAmuttaravastradeshe; jayadrathastaM samavAkShipatsA |
tayA samAkShiptatanuH sa pApaH; papAta shAkhIva nikRRittamUlaH
shlokas.24:
pragRRihyamANA tu mahAjavena; muhurviniHshvasya cha rAjaputrI |
sA kRRiShyamANA rathamAruroha; dhaumyasya pAdAvabhivAdya kRRiShNA
shlokas.25:
dhaumya uvAcha||
neyaM shakyA tvayA netumavijitya mahArathAn |
dharmaM kShatrasya paurANamavekShasva jayadratha
shlokas.26:
kShudraM kRRitvA phalaM pApaM prApsyasi tvamasa.nshayam |
AsAdya pANDavAnvIrAndharmarAjapurogamAn
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA hriyamANAM tAM rAjaputrIM yashasvinIm |
anvagachChattadA dhaumyaH padAtigaNamadhyagaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato dishaH sampravihRRitya pArthA; mRRigAnvarAhAnmahiShA.nshcha hatvA |
dhanurdharAH shreShThatamAH pRRithivyAM; pRRithakcharantaH sahitA babhUvuH
shlokas.2:
tato mRRigavyAlagaNAnukIrNaM; mahAvanaM tadvihagopaghuShTam |
bhrAtR^I.nshcha tAnabhyavadadyudhiShThiraH; shrutvA giro vyAharatAM mRRigANAm
shlokas.3:
AdityadIptAM dishamabhyupetya; mRRigadvijAH krUramime vadanti |
AyAsamugraM prativedayanto; mahAhavaM shatrubhirvAvamAnam
shlokas.4:
kShipraM nivartadhvamalaM mRRigairno; mano hi me dUyati dahyate cha |
buddhiM samAchChAdya cha me samanyu;ruddhUyate prANapatiH sharIre
shlokas.5:
saraH suparNena hRRitoragaM yathA; rAShTraM yathArAjakamAttalakShmi |
eva.nvidhaM me pratibhAti kAmyakaM; shauNDairyathA pItarasashcha kumbhaH
shlokas.6:
te saindhavairatyanilaughavegai;rmahAjavairvAjibhiruhyamAnAH |
yuktairbRRihadbhiH surathairnRRivIrA;stadAshramAyAbhimukhA babhUvuH
shlokas.7:
teShAM tu gomAyuranalpaghoSho; nivartatAM vAmamupetya pArshvam |
pravyAharattaM pravimRRishya rAjA; provAcha bhImaM cha dhana~njayaM cha
shlokas.8:
yathA vadatyeSha vihInayoniH; shAlAvRRiko vAmamupetya pArshvam |
suvyaktamasmAnavamanya pApaiH; kRRito.abhimardaH kurubhiH prasahya
shlokas.9:
ityeva te tadvanamAvishanto; mahatyaraNye mRRigayAM charitvA |
bAlAmapashyanta tadA rudantIM; dhAtreyikAM preShyavadhUM priyAyAH
shlokas.10:
tAmindrasenastvarito.abhisRRitya; rathAdavaplutya tato.abhyadhAvat |
provAcha chainAM vachanaM narendra; dhAtreyikAmArtatarastadAnIm
shlokas.11:
kiM rodiShi tvaM patitA dharaNyAM; kiM te mukhaM shuShyati dInavarNam |
kachchinna pApaiH sunRRisha.nsakRRidbhiH; pramAthitA draupadI rAjaputrI
anindyarUpA suvishAlanetrA; sharIratulyA kurupu~NgavAnAm
shlokas.12:
yadyeva devI pRRithivIM praviShTA; divaM prapannApyatha vA samudram |
tasyA gamiShyanti padaM hi pArthA;stathA hi santapyati dharmarAjaH
shlokas.13:
ko hIdRRishAnAmarimardanAnAM; kleshakShamANAmaparAjitAnAm |
prANaiH samAmiShTatamAM jihIrShe;danuttamaM ratnamiva pramUDhaH
na budhyate nAthavatImihAdya; bahishcharaM hRRidayaM pANDavAnAm
shlokas.14:
kasyAdya kAyaM pratibhidya ghorA; mahIM pravekShyanti shitAH sharAgryAH |
mA tvaM shuchastAM prati bhIru viddhi; yathAdya kRRiShNA punareShyatIti
nihatya sarvAndviShataH samagrA;npArthAH sameShyantyatha yAj~nasenyA
shlokas.15:
athAbravIchchArumukhaM pramRRijya; dhAtreyikA sArathimindrasenam |
jayadrathenApahRRitA pramathya; pa~nchendrakalpAnparibhUya kRRiShNA
shlokas.16:
tiShThanti vartmAni navAnyamUni; vRRikShAshcha na mlAnti tathaiva bhagnAH |
AvartayadhvaM hyanuyAta shIghraM; na dUrayAtaiva hi rAjaputrI
shlokas.17:
saMnahyadhvaM sarva evendrakalpA; mahAnti chArUNi cha da.nshanAni |
gRRihNIta chApAni mahAdhanAni; sharA.nshcha shIghraM padavIM vrajadhvam
shlokas.18:
purA hi nirbhartsanadaNDamohitA; pramUDhachittA vadanena shuShyatA |
dadAti kasmaichidanarhate tanuM; varAjyapUrNAmiva bhasmani srucham
shlokas.19:
purA tuShAgnAviva hUyate haviH; purA shmashAne sragivApavidhyate |
purA cha somo.adhvarago.avalihyate; shunA yathA viprajane pramohite
mahatyaraNye mRRigayAM charitvA; purA shRRigAlo nalinIM vigAhate
shlokas.20:
mA vaH priyAyAH sunasaM sulochanaM; chandraprabhAchChaM vadanaM prasannam |
spRRishyAchChubhaM kashchidakRRityakArI; shvA vai puroDAshamivopayu~NkShIt
etAni vartmAnyanuyAta shIghraM; mA vaH kAlaH kShipramihAtyagAdvai
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhadre tUShNImAssva niyachCha vAchaM; mAsmatsakAshe paruShANyavochaH |
rAjAno vA yadi vA rAjaputrA; balena mattA va~nchanAM prApnuvanti
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA prayayurhi shIghraM; tAnyeva vartmAnyanuvartamAnAH |
muhurmuhurvyAlavaduchChvasanto; jyAM vikShipantashcha mahAdhanurbhyaH
shlokas.23:
tato.apashya.nstasya sainyasya reNu;muddhUtaM vai vAjikhurapraNunnam |
padAtInAM madhyagataM cha dhaumyaM; vikroshantaM bhImamabhidraveti
shlokas.24:
te sAntvya dhaumyaM paridInasattvAH; sukhaM bhavAnetviti rAjaputrAH |
shyenA yathaivAmiShasamprayuktA; javena tatsainyamathAbhyadhAvan
shlokas.25:
teShAM mahendropamavikramANAM; sa.nrabdhAnAM dharShaNAdyAj~nasenyAH |
krodhaH prajajvAla jayadrathaM cha; dRRiShTvA priyAM tasya rathe sthitAM cha
shlokas.26:
prachukrushushchApyatha sindhurAjaM; vRRikodarashchaiva dhana~njayashcha |
yamau cha rAjA cha mahAdhanurdharA;stato dishaH saMmumuhuH pareShAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato ghorataraH shabdo vane samabhavattadA |
bhImasenArjunau dRRiShTvA kShatriyANAmamarShiNAm
shlokas.2:
teShAM dhvajAgrANyabhivIkShya rAjA; svayaM durAtmA kurupu~NgavAnAm |
jayadratho yAj~nasenImuvAcha; rathe sthitAM bhAnumatIM hataujAH
shlokas.3:
AyAntIme pa~ncha rathA mahAnto; manye cha kRRiShNe patayastavaite |
sA jAnatI khyApaya naH sukeshi; paraM paraM pANDavAnAM rathastham
shlokas.4:
draupadyuvAcha||
kiM te j~nAtairmUDha mahAdhanurdharai;ranAyuShyaM karma kRRitvAtighoram |
ete vIrAH patayo me sametA; na vaH sheShaH kashchidihAsti yuddhe
shlokas.5:
AkhyAtavyaM tveva sarvaM mumUrSho;rmayA tubhyaM pRRiShTayA dharma eShaH |
na me vyathA vidyate tvadbhayaM vA; sampashyantyAH sAnujaM dharmarAjam
shlokas.6:
yasya dhvajAgre nadato mRRida~Ngau; nandopanandau madhurau yuktarUpau |
etaM svadharmArthavinishchayaj~naM; sadA janAH kRRityavanto.anuyAnti
shlokas.7:
ya eSha jAmbUnadashuddhagauraH; prachaNDaghoNastanurAyatAkShaH |
etaM kurushreShThatamaM vadanti; yudhiShThiraM dharmasutaM patiM me
shlokas.8:
apyeSha shatroH sharaNAgatasya; dadyAtprANAndharmachArI nRRivIraH |
paraihyenaM mUDha javena bhUtaye; tvamAtmanaH prA~njalirnyastashastraH
shlokas.9:
athApyenaM pashyasi yaM rathasthaM; mahAbhujaM shAlamiva pravRRiddham |
sa.ndaShToShThaM bhrukuTIsaMhatabhruvaM; vRRikodaro nAma patirmamaiShaH
shlokas.10:
AjAneyA balinaH sAdhu dAntA; mahAbalAH shUramudAvahanti |
etasya karmANyatimAnuShANi; bhImeti shabdo.asya gataH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.11:
nAsyAparAddhAH sheShamihApnuvanti; nApyasya vairaM vismarate kadAchit |
vairasyAntaM sa.nvidhAyopayAti; pashchAchChAntiM na cha gachChatyatIva
shlokas.12:
mRRidurvadAnyo dhRRitimAnyashasvI; jitendriyo vRRiddhasevI nRRivIraH |
bhrAtA cha shiShyashcha yudhiShThirasya; dhana~njayo nAma patirmamaiShaH
shlokas.13:
yo vai na kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhA;ttyajeddharmaM na nRRisha.nsaM cha kuryAt |
sa eSha vaishvAnaratulyatejAH; kuntIsutaH shatrusahaH pramAthI
shlokas.14:
yaH sarvadharmArthavinishchayaj~no; bhayArtAnAM bhayahartA manIShI |
yasyottamaM rUpamAhuH pRRithivyAM; yaM pANDavAH parirakShanti sarve
shlokas.15:
prANairgarIyA.nsamanuvrataM vai; sa eSha vIro nakulaH patirme |
yaH khaDgayodhI laghuchitrahasto; mahA.nshcha dhImAnsahadevo.advitIyaH
shlokas.16:
yasyAdya karma drakShyase mUDhasattva; shatakratorvA daityasenAsu sa~Nkhye |
shUraH kRRitAstro matimAnmanIShI; priya~Nkaro dharmasutasya rAj~naH
shlokas.17:
ya eSha chandrArkasamAnatejA; jaghanyajaH pANDavAnAM priyashcha |
buddhyA samo yasya naro na vidyate; vaktA tathA satsu vinishchayaj~naH
shlokas.18:
sa eSha shUro nityamamarShaNashcha; dhImAnprAj~naH sahadevaH patirme |
tyajetprANAnpravisheddhavyavAhaM; na tvevaiSha vyAhareddharmabAhyam
sadA manasvI kShatradharme niviShTaH; kuntyAH prANairiShTatamo nRRivIraH
shlokas.19:
vishIryantIM nAvamivArNavAnte; ratnAbhipUrNAM makarasya pRRiShThe |
senAM tavemAM hatasarvayodhAM; vikShobhitAM drakShyasi pANDuputraiH
shlokas.20:
ityete vai kathitAH pANDuputrA; yA.nstvaM mohAdavamanya pravRRittaH |
yadyetaistvaM muchyase.ariShTadehaH; punarjanma prApsyase jIva eva
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pArthAH pa~ncha pa~nchendrakalpA;styaktvA trastAnprA~njalI.nstAnpadAtIn |
rathAnIkaM sharavarShAndhakAraM; chakruH kruddhAH sarvataH saMnigRRihya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
santiShThata praharata tUrNaM viparidhAvata |
iti sma saindhavo rAjA chodayAmAsa tAnnRRipAn
shlokas.2:
tato ghorataraH shabdo raNe samabhavattadA |
bhImArjunayamAndRRiShTvA sainyAnAM sayudhiShThirAn
shlokas.3:
shibisindhutrigartAnAM viShAdashchApyajAyata |
tAndRRiShTvA puruShavyAghrAnvyAghrAniva balotkaTAn
shlokas.4:
hemachitrasamutsedhAM sarvashaikyAyasIM gadAm |
pragRRihyAbhyadravadbhImaH saindhavaM kAlachoditam
shlokas.5:
tadantaramathAvRRitya koTikAshyo.abhyahArayat |
mahatA rathava.nshena parivArya vRRikodaram
shlokas.6:
shaktitomaranArAchairvIrabAhuprachoditaiH |
kIryamANo.api bahubhirna sma bhImo.abhyakampata
shlokas.7:
gajaM tu sagajArohaM padAtI.nshcha chaturdasha |
jaghAna gadayA bhImaH saindhavadhvajinImukhe
shlokas.8:
pArthaH pa~nchashatA~nshUrAnpArvatIyAnmahArathAn |
parIpsamAnaH sauvIraM jaghAna dhvajinImukhe
shlokas.9:
rAjA svayaM suvIrANAM pravarANAM prahAriNAm |
nimeShamAtreNa shataM jaghAna samare tadA
shlokas.10:
dadRRishe nakulastatra rathAtpraskandya khaDgadhRRik |
shirA.nsi pAdarakShANAM bIjavatpravapanmuhuH
shlokas.11:
sahadevastu sa.nyAya rathena gajayodhinaH |
pAtayAmAsa nArAchairdrumebhya iva barhiNaH
shlokas.12:
tatastrigartaH sadhanuravatIrya mahArathAt |
gadayA chaturo vAhAnrAj~nastasya tadAvadhIt
shlokas.13:
tamabhyAshagataM rAjA padAtiM kuntinandanaH |
ardhachandreNa bANena vivyAdhorasi dharmarAT
shlokas.14:
sa bhinnahRRidayo vIro vaktrAchChoNitamudvaman |
papAtAbhimukhaH pArthaM ChinnamUla iva drumaH
shlokas.15:
indrasenadvitIyastu rathAtpraskandya dharmarAT |
hatAshvaH sahadevasya pratipede mahAratham
shlokas.16:
nakulaM tvabhisandhAya kShema~NkaramahAmukhau |
ubhAvubhayatastIkShNaiH sharavarShairavarShatAm
shlokas.17:
tau sharairabhivarShantau jImUtAviva vArShikau |
ekaikena vipAThena jaghne mAdravatIsutaH
shlokas.18:
trigartarAjaH surathastasyAtha rathadhUrgataH |
rathamAkShepayAmAsa gajena gajayAnavit
shlokas.19:
nakulastvapabhIstasmAdrathAchcharmAsipANimAn |
udbhrAntaM sthAnamAsthAya tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.20:
surathastaM gajavaraM vadhAya nakulasya tu |
preShayAmAsa sakrodhamabhyuchChritakaraM tataH
shlokas.21:
nakulastasya nAgasya samIpaparivartinaH |
saviShANaM bhujaM mUle khaDgena nirakRRintata
shlokas.22:
sa vinadya mahAnAdaM gajaH ka~NkaNabhUShaNaH |
patannavAkShirA bhUmau hastyArohAnapothayat
shlokas.23:
sa tatkarma mahatkRRitvA shUro mAdravatIsutaH |
bhImasenarathaM prApya sharma lebhe mahArathaH
shlokas.24:
bhImastvApatato rAj~naH koTikAshyasya sa~Ngare |
sUtasya nudato vAhAnkShureNApAharachChiraH
shlokas.25:
na bubodha hataM sUtaM sa rAjA bAhushAlinA |
tasyAshvA vyadravansa~Nkhye hatasUtAstatastataH
shlokas.26:
vimukhaM hatasUtaM taM bhImaH praharatAM varaH |
jaghAna talayuktena prAsenAbhyetya pANDavaH
shlokas.27:
dvAdashAnAM tu sarveShAM sauvIrANAM dhana~njayaH |
chakarta niShitairbhallairdhanUMShi cha shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.28:
shibInikShvAkumukhyA.nshcha trigartAnsaindhavAnapi |
jaghAnAtirathaH sa~Nkhye bANagocharamAgatAn
shlokas.29:
sAditAH pratyadRRishyanta bahavaH savyasAchinA |
sapatAkAshcha mAta~NgAH sadhvajAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.30:
prachChAdya pRRithivIM tasthuH sarvamAyodhanaM prati |
sharIrANyashiraskAni videhAni shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.31:
shvagRRidhraka~NkakAkolabhAsagomAyuvAyasAH |
atRRipya.nstatra vIrANAM hatAnAM mA.nsashoNitaiH
shlokas.32:
hateShu teShu vIreShu sindhurAjo jayadrathaH |
vimuchya kRRiShNAM santrastaH palAyanaparo.abhavat
shlokas.33:
sa tasminsa~Nkule sainye draupadImavatArya vai |
prANaprepsurupAdhAvadvanaM yena narAdhamaH
shlokas.34:
draupadIM dharmarAjastu dRRiShTvA dhaumyapuraskRRitAm |
mAdrIputreNa vIreNa rathamAropayattadA
shlokas.35:
tatastadvidrutaM sainyamapayAte jayadrathe |
AdishyAdishya nArAchairAjaghAna vRRikodaraH
shlokas.36:
savyasAchI tu taM dRRiShTvA palAyantaM jayadratham |
vArayAmAsa nighnantaM bhImaM saindhavasainikAn
shlokas.37:
arjuna uvAcha||
yasyApachArAtprApto.ayamasmAnklesho durAsadaH |
tamasminsamaroddeshe na pashyAmi jayadratham
shlokas.38:
tamevAnviSha bhadraM te kiM te yodhairnipAtitaiH |
anAmiShamidaM karma kathaM vA manyate bhavAn
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityukto bhImasenastu guDAkeshena dhImatA |
yudhiShThiramabhiprekShya vAgmI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.40:
hatapravIrA ripavo bhUyiShThaM vidrutA dishaH |
gRRihItvA draupadIM rAjannivartatu bhavAnitaH
shlokas.41:
yamAbhyAM saha rAjendra dhaumyena cha mahAtmanA |
prApyAshramapadaM rAjandraupadIM parisAntvaya
shlokas.42:
na hi me mokShyate jIvanmUDhaH saindhavako nRRipaH |
pAtAlatalasa.nstho.api yadi shakro.asya sArathiH
shlokas.43:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na hantavyo mahAbAho durAtmApi sa saindhavaH |
duHshalAmabhisa.nsmRRitya gAndhArIM cha yashasvinIm
shlokas.44:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA draupadI bhImamuvAcha vyAkulendriyA |
kupitA hrImatI prAj~nA patI bhImArjunAvubhau
shlokas.45:
kartavyaM chetpriyaM mahyaM vadhyaH sa puruShAdhamaH |
saindhavApasadaH pApo durmatiH kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.46:
bhAryAbhihartA nirvairo yashcha rAjyaharo ripuH |
yAchamAno.api sa~NgrAme na sa jIvitumarhati
shlokas.47:
ityuktau tau naravyAghrau yayaturyatra saindhavaH |
rAjA nivavRRite kRRiShNAmAdAya sapurohitaH
shlokas.48:
sa pravishyAshramapadaM vyapaviddhabRRisIghaTam |
mArkaNDeyAdibhirviprairanukIrNaM dadarsha ha
shlokas.49:
draupadImanushochadbhirbrAhmaNaistaiH samAgataiH |
samiyAya mahAprAj~naH sabhAryo bhrAtRRimadhyagaH
shlokas.50:
te sma taM muditA dRRiShTvA punarabhyAgataM nRRipam |
jitvA tAnsindhusauvIrAndraupadIM chAhRRitAM punaH
shlokas.51:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA tatraivopavivesha ha |
praviveshAshramaM kRRiShNA yamAbhyAM saha bhAminI
shlokas.52:
bhImArjunAvapi shrutvA kroshamAtragataM ripum |
svayamashvA.nstudantau tau javenaivAbhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.53:
idamatyadbhutaM chAtra chakAra puruSho.arjunaH |
kroshamAtragatAnashvAnsaindhavasya jaghAna yat
shlokas.54:
sa hi divyAstrasampannaH kRRichChrakAle.apyasambhramaH |
akarodduShkaraM karma sharairastrAnumantritaiH
shlokas.55:
tato.abhyadhAvatAM vIrAvubhau bhImadhana~njayau |
hatAshvaM saindhavaM bhItamekaM vyAkulachetasam
shlokas.56:
saindhavastu hatAndRRiShTvA tathAshvAnsvAnsuduHkhitaH |
dRRiShTvA vikramakarmANi kurvANaM cha dhana~njayam
palAyanakRRitotsAhaH prAdravadyena vai vanam
shlokas.57:
saindhavaM tvabhisamprekShya parAkrAntaM palAyane |
anuyAya mahAbAhuH phalguno vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.58:
anena vIryeNa kathaM striyaM prArthayase balAt |
rAjaputra nivartasva na te yuktaM palAyanam
kathaM chAnucharAnhitvA shatrumadhye palAyase
shlokas.59:
ityuchyamAnaH pArthena saindhavo na nyavartata |
tiShTha tiShTheti taM bhImaH sahasAbhyadravadbalI
mA vadhIriti pArthastaM dayAvAnabhyabhAShata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
jayadrathastu samprekShya bhrAtarAvudyatAyudhau |
prAdravattUrNamavyagro jIvitepsuH suduHkhitaH
shlokas.2:
taM bhImaseno dhAvantamavatIrya rathAdbalI |
abhidrutya nijagrAha keshapakShe.atyamarShaNaH
shlokas.3:
samudyamya cha taM roShAnniShpipeSha mahItale |
gale gRRihItvA rAjAnaM tADayAmAsa chaiva ha
shlokas.4:
punaH sa~njIvamAnasya tasyotpatitumichChataH |
padA mUrdhni mahAbAhuH prAharadvilapiShyataH
shlokas.5:
tasya jAnuM dadau bhImo jaghne chainamaratninA |
sa mohamagamadrAjA prahAravarapIDitaH
shlokas.6:
viroShaM bhImasenaM tu vArayAmAsa phalgunaH |
duHshalAyAH kRRite rAjA yattadAheti kaurava
shlokas.7:
bhImasena uvAcha||
nAyaM pApasamAchAro matto jIvitumarhati |
draupadyAstadanarhAyAH parikleShTA narAdhamaH
shlokas.8:
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM yadrAjA satataM ghRRiNI |
tvaM cha bAlishayA buddhyA sadaivAsmAnprabAdhase
shlokas.9:
evamuktvA saTAstasya pa~ncha chakre vRRikodaraH |
ardhachandreNa bANena ki~nchidabruvatastadA
shlokas.10:
vikalpayitvA rAjAnaM tataH prAha vRRikodaraH |
jIvituM chechChase mUDha hetuM me gadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.11:
dAso.asmIti tvayA vAchyaM sa.nsatsu cha sabhAsu cha |
evaM te jIvitaM dadyAmeSha yuddhajito vidhiH
shlokas.12:
evamastviti taM rAjA kRRichChraprANo jayadrathaH |
provAcha puruShavyAghraM bhImamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.13:
tata enaM vicheShTantaM baddhvA pArtho vRRikodaraH |
rathamAropayAmAsa visa~nj~naM pA.nsuguNThitam
shlokas.14:
tatastaM rathamAsthAya bhImaH pArthAnugastadA |
abhyetyAshramamadhyasthamabhyagachChadyudhiShThiram
shlokas.15:
darshayAmAsa bhImastu tadavasthaM jayadratham |
taM rAjA prAhasaddRRiShTvA muchyatAmiti chAbravIt
shlokas.16:
rAjAnaM chAbravIdbhImo draupadyai kathayeti vai |
dAsabhAvaM gato hyeSha pANDUnAM pApachetanaH
shlokas.17:
tamuvAcha tato jyeShTho bhrAtA sapraNayaM vachaH |
mu~nchainamadhamAchAraM pramANaM yadi te vayam
shlokas.18:
draupadI chAbravIdbhImamabhiprekShya yudhiShThiram |
dAso.ayaM muchyatAM rAj~nastvayA pa~nchasaTaH kRRitaH
shlokas.19:
sa mukto.abhyetya rAjAnamabhivAdya yudhiShThiram |
vavande vihvalo rAjA tA.nshcha sarvAnmunI.nstadA
shlokas.20:
tamuvAcha ghRRiNI rAjA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
tathA jayadrathaM dRRiShTvA gRRihItaM savyasAchinA
shlokas.21:
adAso gachCha mukto.asi maivaM kArShIH punaH kvachit |
strIkAmuka dhigastu tvAM kShudraH kShudrasahAyavAn
eva.nvidhaM hi kaH kuryAttvadanyaH puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.22:
gatasattvamiva j~nAtvA kartAramashubhasya tam |
samprekShya bharatashreShThaH kRRipAM chakre narAdhipaH
shlokas.23:
dharme te vardhatAM buddhirmA chAdharme manaH kRRithAH |
sAshvaH sarathapAdAtaH svasti gachCha jayadratha
shlokas.24:
evamuktastu savrIDaM tUShNIM ki~nchidavA~NmukhaH |
jagAma rAjA duHkhArto ga~NgAdvArAya bhArata
shlokas.25:
sa devaM sharaNaM gatvA virUpAkShamumApatim |
tapashchachAra vipulaM tasya prIto vRRiShadhvajaH
shlokas.26:
baliM svayaM pratyagRRihNAtprIyamANastrilochanaH |
varaM chAsmai dadau devaH sa cha jagrAha tachChRRiNu
shlokas.27:
samastAnsarathAnpa~ncha jayeyaM yudhi pANDavAn |
iti rAjAbravIddevaM neti devastamabravIt
shlokas.28:
ajayyA.nshchApyavadhyA.nshcha vArayiShyasi tAnyudhi |
RRite.arjunaM mahAbAhuM devairapi durAsadam
shlokas.29:
yamAhurajitaM devaM sha~NkhachakragadAdharam |
pradhAnaH so.astraviduShAM tena kRRiShNena rakShyate
shlokas.30:
evamuktastu nRRipatiH svameva bhavanaM yayau |
pANDavAshcha vane tasminnyavasankAmyake tadA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM hRRitAyAM kRRiShNAyAM prApya kleshamanuttamam |
ata UrdhvaM naravyAghrAH kimakurvata pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM kRRiShNAM mokShayitvA vinirjitya jayadratham |
AsAM chakre munigaNairdharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.3:
teShAM madhye maharShINAM shRRiNvatAmanushochatAm |
mArkaNDeyamidaM vAkyamabravItpANDunandanaH
shlokas.4:
manye kAlashcha balavAndaivaM cha vidhinirmitam |
bhavitavyaM cha bhUtAnAM yasya nAsti vyatikramaH
shlokas.5:
kathaM hi patnImasmAkaM dharmaj~nAM dharmachAriNIm |
sa.nspRRishedIdRRisho bhAvaH shuchiM stainyamivAnRRitam
shlokas.6:
na hi pApaM kRRitaM ki~nchitkarma vA ninditaM kvachit |
draupadyA brAhmaNeShveva dharmaH sucharito mahAn
shlokas.7:
tAM jahAra balAdrAjA mUDhabuddhirjayadrathaH |
tasyAH saMharaNAtprAptaH shirasaH keshavApanam
parAjayaM cha sa~NgrAme sasahAyaH samAptavAn
shlokas.8:
pratyAhRRitA tathAsmAbhirhatvA tatsaindhavaM balam |
taddAraharaNaM prAptamasmAbhiravitarkitam
shlokas.9:
duHkhashchAyaM vane vAso mRRigayAyAM cha jIvikA |
hi.nsA cha mRRigajAtInAM vanaukobhirvanaukasAm
j~nAtibhirvipravAsashcha mithyA vyavasitairayam
shlokas.10:
asti nUnaM mayA kashchidalpabhAgyataro naraH |
bhavatA dRRiShTapUrvo vA shrutapUrvo.api vA bhavet

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
prAptamapratimaM duHkhaM rAmeNa bharatarShabha |
rakShasA jAnakI tasya hRRitA bhAryA balIyasA
shlokas.2:
AshramAdrAkShasendreNa rAvaNena vihAyasA |
mAyAmAsthAya tarasA hatvA gRRidhraM jaTAyuSham
shlokas.3:
pratyAjahAra tAM rAmaH sugrIvabalamAshritaH |
baddhvA setuM samudrasya dagdhvA la~NkAM shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kasminrAmaH kule jAtaH ki.nvIryaH kimparAkramaH |
rAvaNaH kasya vA putraH kiM vairaM tasya tena ha
shlokas.5:
etanme bhagavansarvaM samyagAkhyAtumarhasi |
shrotumichChAmi charitaM rAmasyAkliShTakarmaNaH
shlokas.6:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ajo nAmAbhavadrAjA mahAnikShvAkuva.nshajaH |
tasya putro dasharathaH shashvatsvAdhyAyavA~nshuchiH
shlokas.7:
abhava.nstasya chatvAraH putrA dharmArthakovidAH |
rAmalakShmaNashatrughnA bharatashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.8:
rAmasya mAtA kausalyA kaikeyI bharatasya tu |
sutau lakShmaNashatrughnau sumitrAyAH parantapau
shlokas.9:
videharAjo janakaH sItA tasyAtmajA vibho |
yAM chakAra svayaM tvaShTA rAmasya mahiShIM priyAm
shlokas.10:
etadrAmasya te janma sItAyAshcha prakIrtitam |
rAvaNasyApi te janma vyAkhyAsyAmi janeshvara
shlokas.11:
pitAmaho rAvaNasya sAkShAddevaH prajApatiH |
svayambhUH sarvalokAnAM prabhuH sraShTA mahAtapAH
shlokas.12:
pulastyo nAma tasyAsInmAnaso dayitaH sutaH |
tasya vaishravaNo nAma gavi putro.abhavatprabhuH
shlokas.13:
pitaraM sa samutsRRijya pitAmahamupasthitaH |
tasya kopAtpitA rAjansasarjAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.14:
sa jaj~ne vishravA nAma tasyAtmArdhena vai dvijaH |
pratIkArAya sakrodhastato vaishravaNasya vai
shlokas.15:
pitAmahastu prItAtmA dadau vaishravaNasya ha |
amaratvaM dhaneshatvaM lokapAlatvameva cha
shlokas.16:
IshAnena tathA sakhyaM putraM cha nalakUbaram |
rAjadhAnIniveshaM cha la~NkAM rakShogaNAnvitAm

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
pulastyasya tu yaH krodhAdardhadeho.abhavanmuniH |
vishravA nAma sakrodhaH sa vaishravaNamaikShata
shlokas.2:
bubudhe taM tu sakrodhaM pitaraM rAkShaseshvaraH |
kuberastatprasAdArthaM yatate sma sadA nRRipa
shlokas.3:
sa rAjarAjo la~NkAyAM nivasannaravAhanaH |
rAkShasIH pradadau tisraH piturvai parichArikAH
shlokas.4:
tAstadA taM mahAtmAnaM santoShayitumudyatAH |
RRiShiM bharatashArdUla nRRittagItavishAradAH
shlokas.5:
puShpotkaTA cha rAkA cha mAlinI cha vishAM pate |
anyonyaspardhayA rAja~nshreyaskAmAH sumadhyamAH
shlokas.6:
tAsAM sa bhagavA.nstuShTo mahAtmA pradadau varAn |
lokapAlopamAnputrAnekaikasyA yathepsitAn
shlokas.7:
puShpotkaTAyAM jaj~nAte dvau putrau rAkShaseshvarau |
kumbhakarNadashagrIvau balenApratimau bhuvi
shlokas.8:
mAlinI janayAmAsa putramekaM vibhIShaNam |
rAkAyAM mithunaM jaj~ne kharaH shUrpaNakhA tathA
shlokas.9:
vibhIShaNastu rUpeNa sarvebhyo.abhyadhiko.abhavat |
sa babhUva mahAbhAgo dharmagoptA kriyAratiH
shlokas.10:
dashagrIvastu sarveShAM jyeShTho rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
mahotsAho mahAvIryo mahAsattvaparAkramaH
shlokas.11:
kumbhakarNo balenAsItsarvebhyo.abhyadhikastadA |
mAyAvI raNashauNDashcha raudrashcha rajanIcharaH
shlokas.12:
kharo dhanuShi vikrAnto brahmadviTpishitAshanaH |
siddhavighnakarI chApi raudrA shUrpaNakhA tathA
shlokas.13:
sarve vedavidaH shUrAH sarve sucharitavratAH |
UShuH pitrA saha ratA gandhamAdanaparvate
shlokas.14:
tato vaishravaNaM tatra dadRRishurnaravAhanam |
pitrA sArdhaM samAsInamRRiddhyA paramayA yutam
shlokas.15:
jAtaspardhAstataste tu tapase dhRRitanishchayAH |
brahmANaM toShayAmAsurghoreNa tapasA tadA
shlokas.16:
atiShThadekapAdena sahasraM parivatsarAn |
vAyubhakSho dashagrIvaH pa~nchAgniH susamAhitaH
shlokas.17:
adhaHshAyI kumbhakarNo yatAhAro yatavrataH |
vibhIShaNaH shIrNaparNamekamabhyavahArayat
shlokas.18:
upavAsaratirdhImAnsadA japyaparAyaNaH |
tameva kAlamAtiShThattIvraM tapa udAradhIH
shlokas.19:
kharaH shUrpaNakhA chaiva teShAM vai tapyatAM tapaH |
paricharyAM cha rakShAM cha chakraturhRRiShTamAnasau
shlokas.20:
pUrNe varShasahasre tu shirashChittvA dashAnanaH |
juhotyagnau durAdharShastenAtuShyajjagatprabhuH
shlokas.21:
tato brahmA svayaM gatvA tapasastAnnyavArayat |
pralobhya varadAnena sarvAneva pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.22:
brahmovAcha||
prIto.asmi vo nivartadhvaM varAnvRRiNuta putrakAH |
yadyadiShTamRRite tvekamamaratvaM tathAstu tat
shlokas.23:
yadyadagnau hutaM sarvaM shiraste mahadIpsayA |
tathaiva tAni te dehe bhaviShyanti yathepsitam
shlokas.24:
vairUpyaM cha na te dehe kAmarUpadharastathA |
bhaviShyasi raNe.arINAM vijetAsi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.25:
rAvaNa uvAcha||
gandharvadevAsurato yakSharAkShasatastathA |
sarpakiMnarabhUtebhyo na me bhUyAtparAbhavaH
shlokas.26:
brahmovAcha||
ya ete kIrtitAH sarve na tebhyo.asti bhayaM tava |
RRite manuShyAdbhadraM te tathA tadvihitaM mayA
shlokas.27:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamukto dashagrIvastuShTaH samabhavattadA |
avamene hi durbuddhirmanuShyAnpuruShAdakaH
shlokas.28:
kumbhakarNamathovAcha tathaiva prapitAmahaH |
sa vavre mahatIM nidrAM tamasA grastachetanaH
shlokas.29:
tathA bhaviShyatItyuktvA vibhIShaNamuvAcha ha |
varaM vRRiNIShva putra tvaM prIto.asmIti punaH punaH
shlokas.30:
vibhIShaNa uvAcha||
paramApadgatasyApi nAdharme me matirbhavet |
ashikShitaM cha bhagavanbrahmAstraM pratibhAtu me
shlokas.31:
brahmovAcha||
yasmAdrAkShasayonau te jAtasyAmitrakarshana |
nAdharme ramate buddhiramaratvaM dadAmi te
shlokas.32:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
rAkShasastu varaM labdhvA dashagrIvo vishAM pate |
la~NkAyAshchyAvayAmAsa yudhi jitvA dhaneshvaram
shlokas.33:
hitvA sa bhagavA.Nlla~NkAmAvishadgandhamAdanam |
gandharvayakShAnugato rakShaHkimpuruShaiH saha
shlokas.34:
vimAnaM puShpakaM tasya jahArAkramya rAvaNaH |
shashApa taM vaishravaNo na tvAmetadvahiShyati
shlokas.35:
yastu tvAM samare hantA tamevaitadvahiShyati |
avamanya guruM mAM cha kShipraM tvaM na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.36:
vibhIShaNastu dharmAtmA satAM dharmamanusmaran |
anvagachChanmahArAja shriyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.37:
tasmai sa bhagavA.nstuShTo bhrAtA bhrAtre dhaneshvaraH |
senApatyaM dadau dhImAnyakSharAkShasasenayoH
shlokas.38:
rAkShasAH puruShAdAshcha pishAchAshcha mahAbalAH |
sarve sametya rAjAnamabhyaShi~nchaddashAnanam
shlokas.39:
dashagrIvastu daityAnAM devAnAM cha balotkaTaH |
Akramya ratnAnyaharatkAmarUpI viha~NgamaH
shlokas.40:
rAvayAmAsa lokAnyattasmAdrAvaNa uchyate |
dashagrIvaH kAmabalo devAnAM bhayamAdadhat

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato brahmarShayaH siddhA devarAjarShayastathA |
havyavAhaM puraskRRitya brahmANaM sharaNaM gatAH
shlokas.2:
agniruvAcha||
yaH sa vishravasaH putro dashagrIvo mahAbalaH |
avadhyo varadAnena kRRito bhagavatA purA
shlokas.3:
sa bAdhate prajAH sarvA viprakArairmahAbalaH |
tato nastrAtu bhagavannAnyastrAtA hi vidyate
shlokas.4:
brahmovAcha||
na sa devAsuraiH shakyo yuddhe jetuM vibhAvaso |
vihitaM tatra yatkAryamabhitastasya nigrahe
shlokas.5:
tadarthamavatIrNo.asau manniyogAchchaturbhujaH |
viShNuH praharatAM shreShThaH sa karmaitatkariShyati
shlokas.6:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
pitAmahastatasteShAM saMnidhau vAkyamabravIt |
sarvairdevagaNaiH sArdhaM sambhavadhvaM mahItale
shlokas.7:
viShNoH sahAyAnRRikShIShu vAnarIShu cha sarvashaH |
janayadhvaM sutAnvIrAnkAmarUpabalAnvitAn
shlokas.8:
tato bhAgAnubhAgena devagandharvadAnavAH |
avatartuM mahIM sarve ra~njayAmAsura~njasA
shlokas.9:
teShAM samakShaM gandharvIM dundubhIM nAma nAmataH |
shashAsa varado devo devakAryArthasiddhaye
shlokas.10:
pitAmahavachaH shrutvA gandharvI dundubhI tataH |
mantharA mAnuShe loke kubjA samabhavattadA
shlokas.11:
shakraprabhRRitayashchaiva sarve te surasattamAH |
vAnararkShavarastrIShu janayAmAsurAtmajAn
te.anvavartanpitR^Insarve yashasA cha balena cha
shlokas.12:
bhettAro girishRRi~NgANAM shAlatAlashilAyudhAH |
vajrasaMhananAH sarve sarve chaughabalAstathA
shlokas.13:
kAmavIryadharAshchaiva sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
nAgAyutasamaprANA vAyuvegasamA jave
yatrechChakanivAsAshcha kechidatra vanaukasaH
shlokas.14:
evaM vidhAya tatsarvaM bhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH |
mantharAM bodhayAmAsa yadyatkAryaM yathA yathA
shlokas.15:
sA tadvachanamAj~nAya tathA chakre manojavA |
itashchetashcha gachChantI vairasandhukShaNe ratA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktaM bhagavatA janma rAmAdInAM pRRithakpRRithak |
prasthAnakAraNaM brahma~nshrotumichChAmi kathyatAm
shlokas.2:
kathaM dAsharathI vIrau bhrAtarau rAmalakShmaNau |
prasthApitau vanaM brahma maithilI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.3:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
jAtaputro dasharathaH prItimAnabhavannRRipaH |
kriyAratirdharmaparaH satataM vRRiddhasevitA
shlokas.4:
krameNa chAsya te putrA vyavardhanta mahaujasaH |
vedeShu sarahasyeShu dhanurvede cha pAragAH
shlokas.5:
charitabrahmacharyAste kRRitadArAshcha pArthiva |
yadA tadA dasharathaH prItimAnabhavatsukhI
shlokas.6:
jyeShTho rAmo.abhavatteShAM ramayAmAsa hi prajAH |
manoharatayA dhImAnpiturhRRidayatoShaNaH
shlokas.7:
tataH sa rAjA matimAnmatvAtmAnaM vayo.adhikam |
mantrayAmAsa sachivairdharmaj~naishcha purohitaiH
shlokas.8:
abhiShekAya rAmasya yauvarAjyena bhArata |
prAptakAlaM cha te sarve menire mantrisattamAH
shlokas.9:
lohitAkShaM mahAbAhuM mattamAta~NgagAminam |
dIrghabAhuM mahoraskaM nIlaku~nchitamUrdhajam
shlokas.10:
dIpyamAnaM shriyA vIraM shakrAdanavamaM bale |
pAragaM sarvadharmANAM bRRihaspatisamaM matau
shlokas.11:
sarvAnuraktaprakRRitiM sarvavidyAvishAradam |
jitendriyamamitrANAmapi dRRiShTimanoharam
shlokas.12:
niyantAramasAdhUnAM goptAraM dharmachAriNAm |
dhRRitimantamanAdhRRiShyaM jetAramaparAjitam
shlokas.13:
putraM rAjA dasharathaH kausalyAnandavardhanam |
sa.ndRRishya paramAM prItimagachChatkurunandana
shlokas.14:
chintaya.nshcha mahAtejA guNAnrAmasya vIryavAn |
abhyabhAShata bhadraM te prIyamANaH purohitam
shlokas.15:
adya puShyo nishi brahmanpuNyaM yogamupaiShyati |
sambhArAH sambhriyantAM me rAmashchopanimantryatAm
shlokas.16:
iti tadrAjavachanaM pratishrutyAtha mantharA |
kaikeyImabhigamyedaM kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
adya kaikeyi daurbhAgyaM rAj~nA te khyApitaM mahat |
AshIviShastvAM sa~NkruddhashchaNDo dashati durbhage
shlokas.18:
subhagA khalu kausalyA yasyAH putro.abhiShekShyate |
kuto hi tava saubhAgyaM yasyAH putro na rAjyabhAk
shlokas.19:
sA tadvachanamAj~nAya sarvAbharaNabhUShitA |
vedIvilagnamadhyeva bibhratI rUpamuttamam
shlokas.20:
vivikte patimAsAdya hasantIva shuchismitA |
praNayaM vya~njayantIva madhuraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.21:
satyapratij~na yanme tvaM kAmamekaM nisRRiShTavAn |
upAkuruShva tadrAja.nstasmAnmuchyasva sa~NkaTAt
shlokas.22:
rAjovAcha||
varaM dadAni te hanta tadgRRihANa yadichChasi |
avadhyo vadhyatAM ko.adya vadhyaH ko.adya vimuchyatAm
shlokas.23:
dhanaM dadAni kasyAdya hriyatAM kasya vA punaH |
brAhmaNasvAdihAnyatra yatki~nchidvittamasti me
shlokas.24:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sA tadvachanamAj~nAya parigRRihya narAdhipam |
Atmano balamAj~nAya tata enamuvAcha ha
shlokas.25:
AbhiShechanikaM yatte rAmArthamupakalpitam |
bharatastadavApnotu vanaM gachChatu rAghavaH
shlokas.26:
sa tadrAjA vachaH shrutvA vipriyaM dAruNodayam |
duHkhArto bharatashreShTha na ki~nchidvyAjahAra ha
shlokas.27:
tatastathoktaM pitaraM rAmo vij~nAya vIryavAn |
vanaM pratasthe dharmAtmA rAjA satyo bhavatviti
shlokas.28:
tamanvagachChallakShmIvAndhanuShmA.NllakShmaNastadA |
sItA cha bhAryA bhadraM te vaidehI janakAtmajA
shlokas.29:
tato vanaM gate rAme rAjA dasharathastadA |
samayujyata dehasya kAlaparyAyadharmaNA
shlokas.30:
rAmaM tu gatamAj~nAya rAjAnaM cha tathAgatam |
AnAyya bharataM devI kaikeyI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.31:
gato dasharathaH svargaM vanasthau rAmalakShmaNau |
gRRihANa rAjyaM vipulaM kShemaM nihatakaNTakam
shlokas.32:
tAmuvAcha sa dharmAtmA nRRisha.nsaM bata te kRRitam |
patiM hatvA kulaM chedamutsAdya dhanalubdhayA
shlokas.33:
ayashaH pAtayitvA me mUrdhni tvaM kulapA.nsane |
sakAmA bhava me mAtarityuktvA praruroda ha
shlokas.34:
sa chAritraM vishodhyAtha sarvaprakRRitisaMnidhau |
anvayAdbhrAtaraM rAmaM vinivartanalAlasaH
shlokas.35:
kausalyAM cha sumitrAM cha kaikeyIM cha suduHkhitaH |
agre prasthApya yAnaiH sa shatrughnasahito yayau
shlokas.36:
vasiShThavAmadevAbhyAM vipraishchAnyaiH sahasrashaH |
paurajAnapadaiH sArdhaM rAmAnayanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.37:
dadarsha chitrakUTasthaM sa rAmaM sahalakShmaNam |
tApasAnAmala~NkAraM dhArayantaM dhanurdharam
shlokas.38:
visarjitaH sa rAmeNa piturvachanakAriNA |
nandigrAme.akarodrAjyaM puraskRRityAsya pAduke
shlokas.39:
rAmastu punarAsha~Nkya paurajAnapadAgamam |
pravivesha mahAraNyaM sharabha~NgAshramaM prati
shlokas.40:
satkRRitya sharabha~NgaM sa daNDakAraNyamAshritaH |
nadIM godAvarIM ramyAmAshritya nyavasattadA
shlokas.41:
vasatastasya rAmasya tataH shUrpaNakhAkRRitam |
khareNAsInmahadvairaM janasthAnanivAsinA
shlokas.42:
rakShArthaM tApasAnAM cha rAghavo dharmavatsalaH |
chaturdasha sahasrANi jaghAna bhuvi rakShasAm
shlokas.43:
dUShaNaM cha kharaM chaiva nihatya sumahAbalau |
chakre kShemaM punardhImAndharmAraNyaM sa rAghavaH
shlokas.44:
hateShu teShu rakShaHsu tataH shUrpaNakhA punaH |
yayau nikRRittanAsoShThI la~NkAM bhrAturniveshanam
shlokas.45:
tato rAvaNamabhyetya rAkShasI duHkhamUrChitA |
papAta pAdayorbhrAtuH sa.nshuShkarudhirAnanA
shlokas.46:
tAM tathA vikRRitAM dRRiShTvA rAvaNaH krodhamUrChitaH |
utpapAtAsanAtkruddho dantairdantAnupaspRRishan
shlokas.47:
svAnamAtyAnvisRRijyAtha vivikte tAmuvAcha saH |
kenAsyevaM kRRitA bhadre mAmachintyAvamanya cha
shlokas.48:
kaH shUlaM tIkShNamAsAdya sarvagAtrairniShevate |
kaH shirasyagnimAdAya vishvastaH svapate sukham
shlokas.49:
AshIviShaM ghorataraM pAdena spRRishatIha kaH |
siMhaM kesariNaM kashcha daMShTrAsu spRRishya tiShThati
shlokas.50:
ityevaM bruvatastasya srotobhyastejaso.archiShaH |
nishcherurdahyato rAtrau vRRikShasyeva svarandhrataH
shlokas.51:
tasya tatsarvamAchakhyau bhaginI rAmavikramam |
kharadUShaNasa.nyuktaM rAkShasAnAM parAbhavam
shlokas.52:
sa nishchitya tataH kRRityaM svasAramupasAntvya cha |
UrdhvamAchakrame rAjA vidhAya nagare vidhim
shlokas.53:
trikUTaM samatikramya kAlaparvatameva cha |
dadarsha makarAvAsaM gambhIrodaM mahodadhim
shlokas.54:
tamatItyAtha gokarNamabhyagachChaddashAnanaH |
dayitaM sthAnamavyagraM shUlapANermahAtmanaH
shlokas.55:
tatrAbhyagachChanmArIchaM pUrvAmAtyaM dashAnanaH |
purA rAmabhayAdeva tApasyaM samupAshritam

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
mArIchastvatha sambhrAnto dRRiShTvA rAvaNamAgatam |
pUjayAmAsa satkAraiH phalamUlAdibhistathA
shlokas.2:
vishrAntaM chainamAsInamanvAsInaH sa rAkShasaH |
uvAcha prashritaM vAkyaM vAkyaj~no vAkyakovidam
shlokas.3:
na te prakRRitimAnvarNaH kachchitkShemaM pure tava |
kachchitprakRRitayaH sarvA bhajante tvAM yathA purA
shlokas.4:
kimihAgamane chApi kAryaM te rAkShaseshvara |
kRRitamityeva tadviddhi yadyapi syAtsuduShkaram
shlokas.5:
shasha.nsa rAvaNastasmai tatsarvaM rAmacheShTitam |
mArIchastvabravIchChrutvA samAsenaiva rAvaNam
shlokas.6:
alaM te rAmamAsAdya vIryaj~no hyasmi tasya vai |
bANavegaM hi kastasya shaktaH soDhuM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
pravrajyAyAM hi me hetuH sa eva puruSharShabhaH |
vinAshamukhametatte kenAkhyAtaM durAtmanA
shlokas.8:
tamuvAchAtha sakrodho rAvaNaH paribhartsayan |
akurvato.asmadvachanaM syAnmRRityurapi te dhruvam
shlokas.9:
mArIchashchintayAmAsa vishiShTAnmaraNaM varam |
avashyaM maraNe prApte kariShyAmyasya yanmatam
shlokas.10:
tatastaM pratyuvAchAtha mArIcho rAkShaseshvaram |
kiM te sAhyaM mayA kAryaM kariShyAmyavasho.api tat
shlokas.11:
tamabravIddashagrIvo gachCha sItAM pralobhaya |
ratnashRRi~Ngo mRRigo bhUtvA ratnachitratanUruhaH
shlokas.12:
dhruvaM sItA samAlakShya tvAM rAmaM chodayiShyati |
apakrAnte cha kAkutsthe sItA vashyA bhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
tAmAdAyApaneShyAmi tataH sa na bhaviShyati |
bhAryAviyogAddurbuddhiretatsAhyaM kuruShva me
shlokas.14:
ityevamukto mArIchaH kRRitvodakamathAtmanaH |
rAvaNaM purato yAntamanvagachChatsuduHkhitaH
shlokas.15:
tatastasyAshramaM gatvA rAmasyAkliShTakarmaNaH |
chakratustattathA sarvamubhau yatpUrvamantritam
shlokas.16:
rAvaNastu yatirbhUtvA muNDaH kuNDI tridaNDadhRRik |
mRRigashcha bhUtvA mArIchastaM deshamupajagmatuH
shlokas.17:
darshayAmAsa vaidehIM mArIcho mRRigarUpadhRRik |
chodayAmAsa tasyArthe sA rAmaM vidhichoditA
shlokas.18:
rAmastasyAH priyaM kurvandhanurAdAya satvaraH |
rakShArthe lakShmaNaM nyasya prayayau mRRigalipsayA
shlokas.19:
sa dhanvI baddhatUNIraH khaDgagodhA~NgulitravAn |
anvadhAvanmRRigaM rAmo rudrastArAmRRigaM yathA
shlokas.20:
so.antarhitaH punastasya darshanaM rAkShaso vrajan |
chakarSha mahadadhvAnaM rAmastaM bubudhe tataH
shlokas.21:
nishAcharaM viditvA taM rAghavaH pratibhAnavAn |
amoghaM sharamAdAya jaghAna mRRigarUpiNam
shlokas.22:
sa rAmabANAbhihataH kRRitvA rAmasvaraM tadA |
hA sIte lakShmaNetyevaM chukroshArtasvareNa ha
shlokas.23:
shushrAva tasya vaidehI tatastAM karuNAM giram |
sA prAdravadyataH shabdastAmuvAchAtha lakShmaNaH
shlokas.24:
alaM te sha~NkayA bhIru ko rAmaM viShahiShyati |
muhUrtAddrakShyase rAmamAgataM taM shuchismite
shlokas.25:
ityuktvA sA prarudatI paryasha~Nkata devaram |
hatA vai strIsvabhAvena shuddhachAritrabhUShaNam
shlokas.26:
sA taM paruShamArabdhA vaktuM sAdhvI pativratA |
naiSha kAlo bhavenmUDha yaM tvaM prArthayase hRRidA
shlokas.27:
apyahaM shastramAdAya hanyAmAtmAnamAtmanA |
pateyaM girishRRi~NgAdvA visheyaM vA hutAshanam
shlokas.28:
rAmaM bhartAramutsRRijya na tvahaM tvAM katha~nchana |
nihInamupatiShTheyaM shArdUlI kroShTukaM yathA
shlokas.29:
etAdRRishaM vachaH shrutvA lakShmaNaH priyarAghavaH |
pidhAya karNau sadvRRittaH prasthito yena rAghavaH
sa rAmasya padaM gRRihya prasasAra dhanurdharaH
shlokas.30:
etasminnantare rakSho rAvaNaH pratyadRRishyata |
abhavyo bhavyarUpeNa bhasmachChanna ivAnalaH
yativeShapratichChanno jihIrShustAmaninditAm
shlokas.31:
sA tamAlakShya samprAptaM dharmaj~nA janakAtmajA |
nimantrayAmAsa tadA phalamUlAshanAdibhiH
shlokas.32:
avamanya sa tatsarvaM svarUpaM pratipadya cha |
sAntvayAmAsa vaidehImiti rAkShasapu~NgavaH
shlokas.33:
sIte rAkShasarAjo.ahaM rAvaNo nAma vishrutaH |
mama la~NkA purI nAmnA ramyA pAre mahodadheH
shlokas.34:
tatra tvaM varanArIShu shobhiShyasi mayA saha |
bhAryA me bhava sushroNi tApasaM tyaja rAghavam
shlokas.35:
evamAdIni vAkyAni shrutvA sItAtha jAnakI |
pidhAya karNau sushroNI maivamityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.36:
prapateddyauH sanakShatrA pRRithivI shakalIbhavet |
shaityamagniriyAnnAhaM tyajeyaM raghunandanam
shlokas.37:
kathaM hi bhinnakaraTaM padminaM vanagocharam |
upasthAya mahAnAgaM kareNuH sUkaraM spRRishet
shlokas.38:
kathaM hi pItvA mAdhvIkaM pItvA cha madhumAdhavIm |
lobhaM sauvIrake kuryAnnArI kAchiditi smare
shlokas.39:
iti sA taM samAbhAShya praviveshAshramaM punaH |
tAmanudrutya sushroNIM rAvaNaH pratyaShedhayat
shlokas.40:
bhartsayitvA tu rUkSheNa svareNa gatachetanAm |
mUrdhajeShu nijagrAha khamupAchakrame tataH
shlokas.41:
tAM dadarsha tadA gRRidhro jaTAyurgirigocharaH |
rudatIM rAma rAmeti hriyamANAM tapasvinIm

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sakhA dasharathasyAsIjjaTAyuraruNAtmajaH |
gRRidhrarAjo mahAvIryaH sampAtiryasya sodaraH
shlokas.2:
sa dadarsha tadA sItAM rAvaNA~NkagatAM snuShAm |
krodhAdabhyadravatpakShI rAvaNaM rAkShaseshvaram
shlokas.3:
athainamabravIdgRRidhro mu~ncha mu~ncheti maithilIm |
dhriyamANe mayi kathaM hariShyasi nishAchara
na hi me mokShyase jIvanyadi notsRRijase vadhUm
shlokas.4:
uktvaivaM rAkShasendraM taM chakarta nakharairbhRRisham |
pakShatuNDaprahAraishcha bahusho jarjarIkRRitaH
chakShAra rudhiraM bhUri giriH prasravaNairiva
shlokas.5:
sa vadhyamAno gRRidhreNa rAmapriyahitaiShiNA |
khaDgamAdAya chichCheda bhujau tasya patatriNaH
shlokas.6:
nihatya gRRidhrarAjaM sa ChinnAbhrashikharopamam |
UrdhvamAchakrame sItAM gRRihItvA~Nkena rAkShasaH
shlokas.7:
yatra yatra tu vaidehI pashyatyAshramamaNDalam |
saro vA saritaM vApi tatra mu~nchati bhUShaNam
shlokas.8:
sA dadarsha giriprasthe pa~ncha vAnarapu~NgavAn |
tatra vAso mahaddivyamutsasarja manasvinI
shlokas.9:
tatteShAM vAnarendrANAM papAta pavanoddhutam |
madhye supItaM pa~nchAnAM vidyunmeghAntare yathA
shlokas.10:
evaM hRRitAyAM vaidehyAM rAmo hatvA mahAmRRigam |
nivRRitto dadRRishe dhImAnbhrAtaraM lakShmaNaM tadA
shlokas.11:
kathamutsRRijya vaidehIM vane rAkShasasevite |
ityevaM bhrAtaraM dRRiShTvA prApto.asIti vyagarhayat
shlokas.12:
mRRigarUpadhareNAtha rakShasA so.apakarShaNam |
bhrAturAgamanaM chaiva chintayanparyatapyata
shlokas.13:
garhayanneva rAmastu tvaritastaM samAsadat |
api jIvati vaidehI neti pashyAmi lakShmaNa
shlokas.14:
tasya tatsarvamAchakhyau sItAyA lakShmaNo vachaH |
yaduktavatyasadRRishaM vaidehI pashchimaM vachaH
shlokas.15:
dahyamAnena tu hRRidA rAmo.abhyapatadAshramam |
sa dadarsha tadA gRRidhraM nihataM parvatopamam
shlokas.16:
rAkShasaM sha~NkamAnastu vikRRiShya balavaddhanuH |
abhyadhAvata kAkutsthastatastaM sahalakShmaNaH
shlokas.17:
sa tAvuvAcha tejasvI sahitau rAmalakShmaNau |
gRRidhrarAjo.asmi bhadraM vAM sakhA dasharathasya ha
shlokas.18:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sa~NgRRihya dhanuShI shubhe |
ko.ayaM pitaramasmAkaM nAmnAhetyUchatushcha tau
shlokas.19:
tato dadRRishatustau taM ChinnapakShadvayaM tathA |
tayoH shasha.nsa gRRidhrastu sItArthe rAvaNAdvadham
shlokas.20:
apRRichChadrAghavo gRRidhraM rAvaNaH kAM dishaM gataH |
tasya gRRidhraH shiraHkampairAchachakShe mamAra cha
shlokas.21:
dakShiNAmiti kAkutstho viditvAsya tadi~Ngitam |
sa.nskAraM lambhayAmAsa sakhAyaM pUjayanpituH
shlokas.22:
