tato dRRiShTvAshramapadaM vyapaviddhabRRisIghaTam |
vidhvastakalashaM shUnyaM gomAyubalasevitam
shlokas.23:
duHkhashokasamAviShTau vaidehIharaNArditau |
jagmaturdaNDakAraNyaM dakShiNena parantapau
shlokas.24:
vane mahati tasmi.nstu rAmaH saumitriNA saha |
dadarsha mRRigayUthAni dravamANAni sarvashaH
shabdaM cha ghoraM sattvAnAM dAvAgneriva vardhataH
shlokas.25:
apashyetAM muhUrtAchcha kabandhaM ghoradarshanam |
meghaparvatasa~NkAshaM shAlaskandhaM mahAbhujam
urogatavishAlAkShaM mahodaramahAmukham
shlokas.26:
yadRRichChayAtha tadrakShaH kare jagrAha lakShmaNam |
viShAdamagamatsadyaH saumitriratha bhArata
shlokas.27:
sa rAmamabhisamprekShya kRRiShyate yena tanmukham |
viShaNNashchAbravIdrAmaM pashyAvasthAmimAM mama
shlokas.28:
haraNaM chaiva vaidehyA mama chAyamupaplavaH |
rAjyabhra.nshashcha bhavatastAtasya maraNaM tathA
shlokas.29:
nAhaM tvAM saha vaidehyA sametaM kosalAgatam |
drakShyAmi pRRithivIrAjye pitRRipaitAmahe sthitam
shlokas.30:
drakShyantyAryasya dhanyA ye kushalAjashamIlavaiH |
abhiShiktasya vadanaM somaM sAbhralavaM yathA
shlokas.31:
evaM bahuvidhaM dhImAnvilalApa sa lakShmaNaH |
tamuvAchAtha kAkutsthaH sambhrameShvapyasambhramaH
shlokas.32:
mA viShIda naravyAghra naiSha kashchinmayi sthite |
Chindhyasya dakShiNaM bAhuM ChinnaH savyo mayA bhujaH
shlokas.33:
ityevaM vadatA tasya bhujo rAmeNa pAtitaH |
khaDgena bhRRishatIkShNena nikRRittastilakANDavat
shlokas.34:
tato.asya dakShiNaM bAhuM khaDgenAjaghnivAnbalI |
saumitrirapi samprekShya bhrAtaraM rAghavaM sthitam
shlokas.35:
punarabhyAhanatpArshve tadrakSho lakShmaNo bhRRisham |
gatAsurapatadbhUmau kabandhaH sumahA.nstataH
shlokas.36:
tasya dehAdviniHsRRitya puruSho divyadarshanaH |
dadRRishe divamAsthAya divi sUrya iva jvalan
shlokas.37:
paprachCha rAmastaM vAgmI kastvaM prabrUhi pRRichChataH |
kAmayA kimidaM chitramAshcharyaM pratibhAti me
shlokas.38:
tasyAchachakShe gandharvo vishvAvasurahaM nRRipa |
prApto brahmAnushApena yoniM rAkShasasevitAm
shlokas.39:
rAvaNena hRRitA sItA rAj~nA la~NkAnivAsinA |
sugrIvamabhigachChasva sa te sAhyaM kariShyati
shlokas.40:
eShA pampA shivajalA ha.nsakAraNDavAyutA |
RRishyamUkasya shailasya saMnikarShe taTAkinI
shlokas.41:
sa.nvasatyatra sugrIvashchaturbhiH sachivaiH saha |
bhrAtA vAnararAjasya vAlino hemamAlinaH
shlokas.42:
etAvachChakyamasmAbhirvaktuM draShTAsi jAnakIm |
dhruvaM vAnararAjasya vidito rAvaNAlayaH
shlokas.43:
ityuktvAntarhito divyaH puruShaH sa mahAprabhaH |
vismayaM jagmatushchobhau tau vIrau rAmalakShmaNau

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato.avidUre nalinIM prabhUtakamalotpalAm |
sItAharaNaduHkhArtaH pampAM rAmaH samAsadat
shlokas.2:
mArutena sushItena sukhenAmRRitagandhinA |
sevyamAno vane tasmi~njagAma manasA priyAm
shlokas.3:
vilalApa sa rAjendrastatra kAntAmanusmaran |
kAmabANAbhisantaptaH saumitristamathAbravIt
shlokas.4:
na tvAmeva.nvidho bhAvaH spraShTumarhati mAnada |
Atmavantamiva vyAdhiH puruShaM vRRiddhashIlinam
shlokas.5:
pravRRittirupalabdhA te vaidehyA rAvaNasya cha |
tAM tvaM puruShakAreNa buddhyA chaivopapAdaya
shlokas.6:
abhigachChAva sugrIvaM shailasthaM haripu~Ngavam |
mayi shiShye cha bhRRitye cha sahAye cha samAshvasa
shlokas.7:
evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairlakShmaNena sa rAghavaH |
uktaH prakRRitimApede kArye chAnantaro.abhavat
shlokas.8:
niShevya vAri pampAyAstarpayitvA pitR^Inapi |
pratasthaturubhau vIrau bhrAtarau rAmalakShmaNau
shlokas.9:
tAvRRishyamUkamabhyetya bahumUlaphalaM girim |
giryagre vAnarAnpa~ncha vIrau dadRRishatustadA
shlokas.10:
sugrIvaH preShayAmAsa sachivaM vAnaraM tayoH |
buddhimantaM hanUmantaM himavantamiva sthitam
shlokas.11:
tena sambhAShya pUrvaM tau sugrIvamabhijagmatuH |
sakhyaM vAnararAjena chakre rAmastato nRRipa
shlokas.12:
tadvAso darshayAmAsustasya kArye nivedite |
vAnarANAM tu yatsItA hriyamANAbhyavAsRRijat
shlokas.13:
tatpratyayakaraM labdhvA sugrIvaM plavagAdhipam |
pRRithivyAM vAnaraishvarye svayaM rAmo.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.14:
pratijaj~ne cha kAkutsthaH samare vAlino vadham |
sugrIvashchApi vaidehyAH punarAnayanaM nRRipa
shlokas.15:
ityuktvA samayaM kRRitvA vishvAsya cha parasparam |
abhyetya sarve kiShkindhAM tasthuryuddhAbhikA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.16:
sugrIvaH prApya kiShkindhAM nanAdaughanibhasvanaH |
nAsya tanmamRRiShe vAlI taM tArA pratyaShedhayat
shlokas.17:
yathA nadati sugrIvo balavAneSha vAnaraH |
manye chAshrayavAnprApto na tvaM nirgantumarhasi
shlokas.18:
hemamAlI tato vAlI tArAM tArAdhipAnanAm |
provAcha vachanaM vAgmI tAM vAnarapatiH patiH
shlokas.19:
sarvabhUtarutaj~nA tvaM pashya buddhyA samanvitA |
kenApAshrayavAnprApto mamaiSha bhrAtRRigandhikaH
shlokas.20:
chintayitvA muhUrtaM tu tArA tArAdhipaprabhA |
patimityabravItprAj~nA shRRiNu sarvaM kapIshvara
shlokas.21:
hRRitadAro mahAsattvo rAmo dasharathAtmajaH |
tulyArimitratAM prAptaH sugrIveNa dhanurdharaH
shlokas.22:
bhrAtA chAsya mahAbAhuH saumitriraparAjitaH |
lakShmaNo nAma medhAvI sthitaH kAryArthasiddhaye
shlokas.23:
maindashcha dvividashchaiva hanUmA.nshchAnilAtmajaH |
jAmbavAnRRikSharAjashcha sugrIvasachivAH sthitAH
shlokas.24:
sarva ete mahAtmAno buddhimanto mahAbalAH |
alaM tava vinAshAya rAmavIryavyapAshrayAt
shlokas.25:
tasyAstadAkShipya vacho hitamuktaM kapIshvaraH |
paryasha~Nkata tAmIrShuH sugrIvagatamAnasAm
shlokas.26:
tArAM paruShamuktvA sa nirjagAma guhAmukhAt |
sthitaM mAlyavato.abhyAshe sugrIvaM so.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.27:
asakRRittvaM mayA mUDha nirjito jIvitapriyaH |
mukto j~nAtiriti j~nAtvA kA tvarA maraNe punaH
shlokas.28:
ityuktaH prAha sugrIvo bhrAtaraM hetumadvachaH |
prAptakAlamamitraghno rAmaM sambodhayanniva
shlokas.29:
hRRitadArasya me rAjanhRRitarAjyasya cha tvayA |
kiM nu jIvitasAmarthyamiti viddhi samAgatam
shlokas.30:
evamuktvA bahuvidhaM tatastau saMnipetatuH |
samare vAlisugrIvau shAlatAlashilAyudhau
shlokas.31:
ubhau jaghnaturanyonyamubhau bhUmau nipetatuH |
ubhau vavalgatushchitraM muShTibhishcha nijaghnatuH
shlokas.32:
ubhau rudhirasa.nsiktau nakhadantaparikShatau |
shushubhAte tadA vIrau puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.33:
na visheShastayoryuddhe tadA kashchana dRRishyate |
sugrIvasya tadA mAlAM hanUmAnkaNTha Asajat
shlokas.34:
sa mAlayA tadA vIraH shushubhe kaNThasaktayA |
shrImAniva mahAshailo malayo meghamAlayA
shlokas.35:
kRRitachihnaM tu sugrIvaM rAmo dRRiShTvA mahAdhanuH |
vichakarSha dhanuHshreShThaM vAlimuddishya lakShyavat
shlokas.36:
visphArastasya dhanuSho yantrasyeva tadA babhau |
vitatrAsa tadA vAlI shareNAbhihato hRRidi
shlokas.37:
sa bhinnamarmAbhihato vaktrAchChoNitamudvaman |
dadarshAvasthitaM rAmamArAtsaumitriNA saha
shlokas.38:
garhayitvA sa kAkutsthaM papAta bhuvi mUrChitaH |
tArA dadarsha taM bhUmau tArApatimiva chyutam
shlokas.39:
hate vAlini sugrIvaH kiShkindhAM pratyapadyata |
tAM cha tArApatimukhIM tArAM nipatiteshvarAm
shlokas.40:
rAmastu chaturo mAsAnpRRiShThe mAlyavataH shubhe |
nivAsamakaroddhImAnsugrIveNAbhyupasthitaH
shlokas.41:
rAvaNo.api purIM gatvA la~NkAM kAmabalAtkRRitaH |
sItAM niveshayAmAsa bhavane nandanopame
ashokavanikAbhyAshe tApasAshramasaMnibhe
shlokas.42:
bhartRRismaraNatanva~NgI tApasIveShadhAriNI |
upavAsatapaHshIlA tatra sA pRRithulekShaNA
uvAsa duHkhavasatIH phalamUlakRRitAshanA
shlokas.43:
didesha rAkShasIstatra rakShaNe rAkShasAdhipaH |
prAsAsishUlaparashumudgarAlAtadhAriNIH
shlokas.44:
dvyakShIM tryakShIM lalATAkShIM dIrghajihvAmajihvikAm |
tristanImekapAdAM cha trijaTAmekalochanAm
shlokas.45:
etAshchAnyAshcha dIptAkShyaH karabhotkaTamUrdhajAH |
parivAryAsate sItAM divArAtramatandritAH
shlokas.46:
tAstu tAmAyatApA~NgIM pishAchyo dAruNasvanAH |
tarjayanti sadA raudrAH paruShavya~njanAkSharAH
shlokas.47:
khAdAma pATayAmainAM tilashaH pravibhajya tAm |
yeyaM bhartAramasmAkamavamanyeha jIvati
shlokas.48:
ityevaM paribhartsantIstrAsyamAnA punaH punaH |
bhartRRishokasamAviShTA niHshvasyedamuvAcha tAH
shlokas.49:
AryAH khAdata mAM shIghraM na me lobho.asti jIvite |
vinA taM puNDarIkAkShaM nIlaku~nchitamUrdhajam
shlokas.50:
apyevAhaM nirAhArA jIvitapriyavarjitA |
shoShayiShyAmi gAtrANi vyAlI tAlagatA yathA
shlokas.51:
na tvanyamabhigachCheyaM pumA.nsaM rAghavAdRRite |
iti jAnIta satyaM me kriyatAM yadanantaram
shlokas.52:
tasyAstadvachanaM shrutvA rAkShasyastAH kharasvanAH |
AkhyAtuM rAkShasendrAya jagmustatsarvamAditaH
shlokas.53:
gatAsu tAsu sarvAsu trijaTA nAma rAkShasI |
sAntvayAmAsa vaidehIM dharmaj~nA priyavAdinI
shlokas.54:
sIte vakShyAmi te ki~nchidvishvAsaM kuru me sakhi |
bhayaM te vyetu vAmoru shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.55:
avindhyo nAma medhAvI vRRiddho rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
sa rAmasya hitAnveShI tvadarthe hi sa mAvadat
shlokas.56:
sItA madvachanAdvAchyA samAshvAsya prasAdya cha |
bhartA te kushalI rAmo lakShmaNAnugato balI
shlokas.57:
sakhyaM vAnararAjena shakrapratimatejasA |
kRRitavAnrAghavaH shrImA.nstvadarthe cha samudyataH
shlokas.58:
mA cha te.astu bhayaM bhIru rAvaNAllokagarhitAt |
nalakUbarashApena rakShitA hyasyanindite
shlokas.59:
shapto hyeSha purA pApo vadhUM rambhAM parAmRRishan |
na shakto vivashAM nArImupaitumajitendriyaH
shlokas.60:
kShiprameShyati te bhartA sugrIveNAbhirakShitaH |
saumitrisahito dhImA.nstvAM cheto mokShayiShyati
shlokas.61:
svapnA hi sumahAghorA dRRiShTA me.aniShTadarshanAH |
vinAshAyAsya durbuddheH paulastyakulaghAtinaH
shlokas.62:
dAruNo hyeSha duShTAtmA kShudrakarmA nishAcharaH |
svabhAvAchChIladoSheNa sarveShAM bhayavardhanaH
shlokas.63:
spardhate sarvadevairyaH kAlopahatachetanaH |
mayA vinAshali~NgAni svapne dRRiShTAni tasya vai
shlokas.64:
tailAbhiShikto vikacho majjanpa~Nke dashAnanaH |
asakRRitkharayukte tu rathe nRRityanniva sthitaH
shlokas.65:
kumbhakarNAdayashcheme nagnAH patitamUrdhajAH |
kRRiShyante dakShiNAmAshAM raktamAlyAnulepanAH
shlokas.66:
shvetAtapatraH soShNIShaH shuklamAlyavibhUShaNaH |
shvetaparvatamArUDha eka eva vibhIShaNaH
shlokas.67:
sachivAshchAsya chatvAraH shuklamAlyAnulepanAH |
shvetaparvatamArUDhA mokShyante.asmAnmahAbhayAt
shlokas.68:
rAmasyAstreNa pRRithivI parikShiptA sasAgarA |
yashasA pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM pUrayiShyati te patiH
shlokas.69:
asthisa~nchayamArUDho bhu~njAno madhupAyasam |
lakShmaNashcha mayA dRRiShTo nirIkShansarvatodishaH
shlokas.70:
rudatI rudhirArdrA~NgI vyAghreNa parirakShitA |
asakRRittvaM mayA dRRiShTA gachChantI dishamuttarAm
shlokas.71:
harShameShyasi vaidehi kShipraM bhartRRisamanvitA |
rAghaveNa saha bhrAtrA sIte tvamachirAdiva
shlokas.72:
iti sA mRRigashAvAkShI tachChrutvA trijaTAvachaH |
babhUvAshAvatI bAlA punarbhartRRisamAgame
shlokas.73:
yAvadabhyAgatA raudrAH pishAchyastAH sudAruNAH |
dadRRishustAM trijaTayA sahAsInAM yathA purA

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tatastAM bhartRRishokArtAM dInAM malinavAsasam |
maNisheShAbhyala~NkArAM rudatIM cha pativratAm
shlokas.2:
rAkShasIbhirupAsyantIM samAsInAM shilAtale |
rAvaNaH kAmabANArto dadarshopasasarpa cha
shlokas.3:
devadAnavagandharvayakShakimpuruShairyudhi |
ajito.ashokavanikAM yayau kandarpamohitaH
shlokas.4:
divyAmbaradharaH shrImAnsumRRiShTamaNikuNDalaH |
vichitramAlyamukuTo vasanta iva mUrtimAn
shlokas.5:
sa kalpavRRikShasadRRisho yatnAdapi vibhUShitaH |
shmashAnachaityadrumavadbhUShito.api bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.6:
sa tasyAstanumadhyAyAH samIpe rajanIcharaH |
dadRRishe rohiNImetya shanaishchara iva grahaH
shlokas.7:
sa tAmAmantrya sushroNIM puShpaketusharAhataH |
idamityabravIdbAlAM trastAM rauhImivAbalAm
shlokas.8:
sIte paryAptametAvatkRRito bharturanugrahaH |
prasAdaM kuru tanva~Ngi kriyatAM parikarma te
shlokas.9:
bhajasva mAM varArohe mahArhAbharaNAmbarA |
bhava me sarvanArINAmuttamA varavarNini
shlokas.10:
santi me devakanyAshcha rAjarShINAM tathA~NganAH |
santi dAnavakanyAshcha daityAnAM chApi yoShitaH
shlokas.11:
chaturdasha pishAchAnAM koTyo me vachane sthitAH |
dvistAvatpuruShAdAnAM rakShasAM bhImakarmaNAm
shlokas.12:
tato me triguNA yakShA ye madvachanakAriNaH |
kechideva dhanAdhyakShaM bhrAtaraM me samAshritAH
shlokas.13:
gandharvApsaraso bhadre mAmApAnagataM sadA |
upatiShThanti vAmoru yathaiva bhrAtaraM mama
shlokas.14:
putro.ahamapi viprarSheH sAkShAdvishravaso muneH |
pa~nchamo lokapAlAnAmiti me prathitaM yashaH
shlokas.15:
divyAni bhakShyabhojyAni pAnAni vividhAni cha |
yathaiva tridasheshasya tathaiva mama bhAmini
shlokas.16:
kShIyatAM duShkRRitaM karma vanavAsakRRitaM tava |
bhAryA me bhava sushroNi yathA mandodarI tathA
shlokas.17:
ityuktA tena vaidehI parivRRitya shubhAnanA |
tRRiNamantarataH kRRitvA tamuvAcha nishAcharam
shlokas.18:
ashivenAtivAmorUrajasraM netravAriNA |
stanAvapatitau bAlA sahitAvabhivarShatI
uvAcha vAkyaM taM kShudraM vaidehI patidevatA
shlokas.19:
asakRRidvadato vAkyamIdRRishaM rAkShaseshvara |
viShAdayuktametatte mayA shrutamabhAgyayA
shlokas.20:
tadbhadrasukha bhadraM te mAnasaM vinivartyatAm |
paradArAsmyalabhyA cha satataM cha pativratA
shlokas.21:
na chaivopayikI bhAryA mAnuShI kRRipaNA tava |
vivashAM dharShayitvA cha kAM tvaM prItimavApsyasi
shlokas.22:
prajApatisamo vipro brahmayoniH pitA tava |
na cha pAlayase dharmaM lokapAlasamaH katham
shlokas.23:
bhrAtaraM rAjarAjAnaM maheshvarasakhaM prabhum |
dhaneshvaraM vyapadishankathaM tviha na lajjase
shlokas.24:
ityuktvA prArudatsItA kampayantI payodharau |
shirodharAM cha tanva~NgI mukhaM prachChAdya vAsasA
shlokas.25:
tasyA rudatyA bhAminyA dIrghA veNI susa.nyatA |
dadRRishe svasitA snigdhA kAlI vyAlIva mUrdhani
shlokas.26:
tachChrutvA rAvaNo vAkyaM sItayoktaM suniShThuram |
pratyAkhyAto.api durmedhAH punarevAbravIdvachaH
shlokas.27:
kAmama~NgAni me sIte dunotu makaradhvajaH |
na tvAmakAmAM sushroNIM sameShye chAruhAsinIm
shlokas.28:
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM yattvamadyApi mAnuSham |
AhArabhUtamasmAkaM rAmamevAnurudhyase
shlokas.29:
ityuktvA tAmanindyA~NgIM sa rAkShasagaNeshvaraH |
tatraivAntarhito bhUtvA jagAmAbhimatAM disham
shlokas.30:
rAkShasIbhiH parivRRitA vaidehI shokakarshitA |
sevyamAnA trijaTayA tatraiva nyavasattadA

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
rAghavastu sasaumitriH sugrIveNAbhipAlitaH |
vasanmAlyavataH pRRiShThe dadarsha vimalaM nabhaH
shlokas.2:
sa dRRiShTvA vimale vyomni nirmalaM shashalakShaNam |
grahanakShatratArAbhiranuyAtamamitrahA
shlokas.3:
kumudotpalapadmAnAM gandhamAdAya vAyunA |
mahIdharasthaH shItena sahasA pratibodhitaH
shlokas.4:
prabhAte lakShmaNaM vIramabhyabhAShata durmanAH |
sItAM sa.nsmRRitya dharmAtmA ruddhAM rAkShasaveshmani
shlokas.5:
gachCha lakShmaNa jAnIhi kiShkindhAyAM kapIshvaram |
pramattaM grAmyadharmeShu kRRitaghnaM svArthapaNDitam
shlokas.6:
yo.asau kulAdhamo mUDho mayA rAjye.abhiShechitaH |
sarvavAnaragopuchChA yamRRikShAshcha bhajanti vai
shlokas.7:
yadarthaM nihato vAlI mayA raghukulodvaha |
tvayA saha mahAbAho kiShkindhopavane tadA
shlokas.8:
kRRitaghnaM tamahaM manye vAnarApasadaM bhuvi |
yo mAmeva~Ngato mUDho na jAnIte.adya lakShmaNa
shlokas.9:
asau manye na jAnIte samayapratipAdanam |
kRRitopakAraM mAM nUnamavamanyAlpayA dhiyA
shlokas.10:
yadi tAvadanudyuktaH shete kAmasukhAtmakaH |
netavyo vAlimArgeNa sarvabhUtagatiM tvayA
shlokas.11:
athApi ghaTate.asmAkamarthe vAnarapu~NgavaH |
tamAdAyaihi kAkutstha tvarAvAnbhava mA chiram
shlokas.12:
ityukto lakShmaNo bhrAtrA guruvAkyahite rataH |
pratasthe ruchiraM gRRihya samArgaNaguNaM dhanuH
kiShkindhAdvAramAsAdya praviveshAnivAritaH
shlokas.13:
sakrodha iti taM matvA rAjA pratyudyayau hariH |
taM sadAro vinItAtmA sugrIvaH plavagAdhipaH
pUjayA pratijagrAha prIyamANastadarhayA
shlokas.14:
tamabravIdrAmavachaH saumitrirakutobhayaH |
sa tatsarvamasheSheNa shrutvA prahvaH kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.15:
sabhRRityadAro rAjendra sugrIvo vAnarAdhipaH |
idamAha vachaH prIto lakShmaNaM naraku~njaram
shlokas.16:
nAsmi lakShmaNa durmedhA na kRRitaghno na nirghRRiNaH |
shrUyatAM yaH prayatno me sItAparyeShaNe kRRitaH
shlokas.17:
dishaH prasthApitAH sarve vinItA harayo mayA |
sarveShAM cha kRRitaH kAlo mAsenAgamanaM punaH
shlokas.18:
yairiyaM savanA sAdriH sapurA sAgarAmbarA |
vichetavyA mahI vIra sagrAmanagarAkarA
shlokas.19:
sa mAsaH pa~ncharAtreNa pUrNo bhavitumarhati |
tataH shroShyasi rAmeNa sahitaH sumahatpriyam
shlokas.20:
ityukto lakShmaNastena vAnarendreNa dhImatA |
tyaktvA roShamadInAtmA sugrIvaM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.21:
sa rAmaM sahasugrIvo mAlyavatpRRiShThamAsthitam |
abhigamyodayaM tasya kAryasya pratyavedayat
shlokas.22:
ityevaM vAnarendrAste samAjagmuH sahasrashaH |
dishastisro vichityAtha na tu ye dakShiNAM gatAH
shlokas.23:
Achakhyuste tu rAmAya mahIM sAgaramekhalAm |
vichitAM na tu vaidehyA darshanaM rAvaNasya vA
shlokas.24:
gatAstu dakShiNAmAshAM ye vai vAnarapu~NgavAH |
AshAvA.nsteShu kAkutsthaH prANAnArto.apyadhArayat
shlokas.25:
dvimAsoparame kAle vyatIte plavagAstataH |
sugrIvamabhigamyedaM tvaritA vAkyamabruvan
shlokas.26:
rakShitaM vAlinA yattatsphItaM madhuvanaM mahat |
tvayA cha plavagashreShTha tadbhu~Nkte pavanAtmajaH
shlokas.27:
vAliputro.a~Ngadashchaiva ye chAnye plavagarShabhAH |
vichetuM dakShiNAmAshAM rAjanprasthApitAstvayA
shlokas.28:
teShAM taM praNayaM shrutvA mene sa kRRitakRRityatAm |
kRRitArthAnAM hi bhRRityAnAmetadbhavati cheShTitam
shlokas.29:
sa tadrAmAya medhAvI shasha.nsa plavagarShabhaH |
rAmashchApyanumAnena mene dRRiShTAM tu maithilIm
shlokas.30:
hanUmatpramukhAshchApi vishrAntAste plava~NgamAH |
abhijagmurharIndraM taM rAmalakShmaNasaMnidhau
shlokas.31:
gatiM cha mukhavarNaM cha dRRiShTvA rAmo hanUmataH |
agamatpratyayaM bhUyo dRRiShTA sIteti bhArata
shlokas.32:
hanUmatpramukhAste tu vAnarAH pUrNamAnasAH |
praNemurvidhivadrAmaM sugrIvaM lakShmaNaM tathA
shlokas.33:
tAnuvAchAgatAnrAmaH pragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH |
api mAM jIvayiShyadhvamapi vaH kRRitakRRityatA
shlokas.34:
api rAjyamayodhyAyAM kArayiShyAmyahaM punaH |
nihatya samare shatrUnAhRRitya janakAtmajAm
shlokas.35:
amokShayitvA vaidehImahatvA cha ripUnraNe |
hRRitadAro.avadhUtashcha nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
shlokas.36:
ityuktavachanaM rAmaM pratyuvAchAnilAtmajaH |
priyamAkhyAmi te rAma dRRiShTA sA jAnakI mayA
shlokas.37:
vichitya dakShiNAmAshAM saparvatavanAkarAm |
shrAntAH kAle vyatIte sma dRRiShTavanto mahAguhAm
shlokas.38:
pravishAmo vayaM tAM tu bahuyojanamAyatAm |
andhakArAM suvipinAM gahanAM kITasevitAm
shlokas.39:
gatvA sumahadadhvAnamAdityasya prabhAM tataH |
dRRiShTavantaH sma tatraiva bhavanaM divyamantarA
shlokas.40:
mayasya kila daityasya tadAsIdveshma rAghava |
tatra prabhAvatI nAma tapo.atapyata tApasI
shlokas.41:
tayA dattAni bhojyAni pAnAni vividhAni cha |
bhuktvA labdhabalAH santastayoktena pathA tataH
shlokas.42:
niryAya tasmAduddeshAtpashyAmo lavaNAmbhasaH |
samIpe sahyamalayau darduraM cha mahAgirim
shlokas.43:
tato malayamAruhya pashyanto varuNAlayam |
viShaNNA vyathitAH khinnA nirAshA jIvite bhRRisham
shlokas.44:
anekashatavistIrNaM yojanAnAM mahodadhim |
timinakrajhaShAvAsaM chintayantaH suduHkhitAH
shlokas.45:
tatrAnashanasa~NkalpaM kRRitvAsInA vayaM tadA |
tataH kathAnte gRRidhrasya jaTAyorabhavatkathA
shlokas.46:
tataH parvatashRRi~NgAbhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAvaham |
pakShiNaM dRRiShTavantaH sma vainateyamivAparam
shlokas.47:
so.asmAnatarkayadbhoktumathAbhyetya vacho.abravIt |
bhoH ka eSha mama bhrAturjaTAyoH kurute kathAm
shlokas.48:
sampAtirnAma tasyAhaM jyeShTho bhrAtA khagAdhipaH |
anyonyaspardhayArUDhAvAvAmAdityasa.nsadam
shlokas.49:
tato dagdhAvimau pakShau na dagdhau tu jaTAyuShaH |
tadA me chiradRRiShTaH sa bhrAtA gRRidhrapatiH priyaH
nirdagdhapakShaH patito hyahamasminmahAgirau
shlokas.50:
tasyaivaM vadato.asmAbhirhato bhrAtA niveditaH |
vyasanaM bhavatashchedaM sa~NkShepAdvai niveditam
shlokas.51:
sa sampAtistadA rAja~nshrutvA sumahadapriyam |
viShaNNachetAH paprachCha punarasmAnari.ndama
shlokas.52:
kaH sa rAmaH kathaM sItA jaTAyushcha kathaM hataH |
ichChAmi sarvamevaitachChrotuM plavagasattamAH
shlokas.53:
tasyAhaM sarvamevaitaM bhavato vyasanAgamam |
prAyopaveshane chaiva hetuM vistarato.abruvam
shlokas.54:
so.asmAnutthApayAmAsa vAkyenAnena pakShirAT |
rAvaNo vidito mahyaM la~NkA chAsya mahApurI
shlokas.55:
dRRiShTA pAre samudrasya trikUTagirikandare |
bhavitrI tatra vaidehI na me.astyatra vichAraNA
shlokas.56:
iti tasya vachaH shrutvA vayamutthAya satvarAH |
sAgaraplavane mantraM mantrayAmaH parantapa
shlokas.57:
nAdhyavasyadyadA kashchitsAgarasya vila~Nghane |
tataH pitaramAvishya pupluve.ahaM mahArNavam
shatayojanavistIrNaM nihatya jalarAkShasIm
shlokas.58:
tatra sItA mayA dRRiShTA rAvaNAntaHpure satI |
upavAsatapaHshIlA bhartRRidarshanalAlasA
jaTilA maladigdhA~NgI kRRishA dInA tapasvinI
shlokas.59:
nimittaistAmahaM sItAmupalabhya pRRithagvidhaiH |
upasRRityAbruvaM chAryAmabhigamya rahogatAm
shlokas.60:
sIte rAmasya dUto.ahaM vAnaro mArutAtmajaH |
tvaddarshanamabhiprepsuriha prApto vihAyasA
shlokas.61:
rAjaputrau kushalinau bhrAtarau rAmalakShmaNau |
sarvashAkhAmRRigendreNa sugrIveNAbhipAlitau
shlokas.62:
kushalaM tvAbravIdrAmaH sIte saumitriNA saha |
sakhibhAvAchcha sugrIvaH kushalaM tvAnupRRichChati
shlokas.63:
kShiprameShyati te bhartA sarvashAkhAmRRigaiH saha |
pratyayaM kuru me devi vAnaro.asmi na rAkShasaH
shlokas.64:
muhUrtamiva cha dhyAtvA sItA mAM pratyuvAcha ha |
avaimi tvAM hanUmantamavindhyavachanAdaham
shlokas.65:
avindhyo hi mahAbAho rAkShaso vRRiddhasaMmataH |
kathitastena sugrIvastvadvidhaiH sachivairvRRitaH
shlokas.66:
gamyatAmiti choktvA mAM sItA prAdAdimaM maNim |
dhAritA yena vaidehI kAlametamaninditA
shlokas.67:
pratyayArthaM kathAM chemAM kathayAmAsa jAnakI |
kShiptAmiShIkAM kAkasya chitrakUTe mahAgirau
bhavatA puruShavyAghra pratyabhij~nAnakAraNAt
shlokas.68:
shrAvayitvA tadAtmAnaM tato dagdhvA cha tAM purIm |
samprApta iti taM rAmaH priyavAdinamarchayat

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tatastatraiva rAmasya samAsInasya taiH saha |
samAjagmuH kapishreShThAH sugrIvavachanAttadA
shlokas.2:
vRRitaH koTisahasreNa vAnarANAM tarasvinAm |
shvashuro vAlinaH shrImAnsuSheNo rAmamabhyayAt
shlokas.3:
koTIshatavRRitau chApi gajo gavaya eva cha |
vAnarendrau mahAvIryau pRRithakpRRithagadRRishyatAm
shlokas.4:
ShaShTikoTisahasrANi prakarShanpratyadRRishyata |
golA~NgUlo mahArAja gavAkSho bhImadarshanaH
shlokas.5:
gandhamAdanavAsI tu prathito gandhamAdanaH |
koTIsahasramugrANAM harINAM samakarShata
shlokas.6:
panaso nAma medhAvI vAnaraH sumahAbalaH |
koTIrdasha dvAdasha cha tri.nshatpa~ncha prakarShati
shlokas.7:
shrImAndadhimukho nAma harivRRiddho.api vIryavAn |
prachakarSha mahatsainyaM harINAM bhImatejasAm
shlokas.8:
kRRiShNAnAM mukhapuNDrANAmRRikShANAM bhImakarmaNAm |
koTIshatasahasreNa jAmbavAnpratyadRRishyata
shlokas.9:
ete chAnye cha bahavo hariyUthapayUthapAH |
asa~NkhyeyA mahArAja samIyU rAmakAraNAt
shlokas.10:
shirIShakusumAbhAnAM siMhAnAmiva nardatAm |
shrUyate tumulaH shabdastatra tatra pradhAvatAm
shlokas.11:
girikUTanibhAH kechitkechinmahiShasaMnibhAH |
sharadabhrapratIkAshAH piShTahi~NgulakAnanAH
shlokas.12:
utpatantaH patantashcha plavamAnAshcha vAnarAH |
uddhunvanto.apare reNUnsamAjagmuH samantataH
shlokas.13:
sa vAnaramahAlokaH pUrNasAgarasaMnibhaH |
niveshamakarottatra sugrIvAnumate tadA
shlokas.14:
tatasteShu harIndreShu samAvRRitteShu sarvashaH |
tithau prashaste nakShatre muhUrte chAbhipUjite
shlokas.15:
tena vyUDhena sainyena lokAnudvartayanniva |
prayayau rAghavaH shrImAnsugrIvasahitastadA
shlokas.16:
mukhamAsIttu sainyasya hanUmAnmArutAtmajaH |
jaghanaM pAlayAmAsa saumitrirakutobhayaH
shlokas.17:
baddhagodhA~NgulitrANau rAghavau tatra rejatuH |
vRRitau harimahAmAtraishchandrasUryau grahairiva
shlokas.18:
prababhau harisainyaM tachChAlatAlashilAyudham |
sumahachChAlibhavanaM yathA sUryodayaM prati
shlokas.19:
nalanIlA~NgadakrAthamaindadvividapAlitA |
yayau sumahatI senA rAghavasyArthasiddhaye
shlokas.20:
vidhivatsuprashasteShu bahumUlaphaleShu cha |
prabhUtamadhumA.nseShu vArimatsu shiveShu cha
shlokas.21:
nivasantI nirAbAdhA tathaiva girisAnuShu |
upAyAddharisenA sA kShArodamatha sAgaram
shlokas.22:
dvitIyasAgaranibhaM tadbalaM bahuladhvajam |
velAvanaM samAsAdya nivAsamakarottadA
shlokas.23:
tato dAsharathiH shrImAnsugrIvaM pratyabhAShata |
madhye vAnaramukhyAnAM prAptakAlamidaM vachaH
shlokas.24:
upAyaH ko nu bhavatAM mataH sAgarala~Nghane |
iyaM cha mahatI senA sAgarashchApi dustaraH
shlokas.25:
tatrAnye vyAharanti sma vAnarAH paTumAninaH |
samarthA la~Nghane sindhorna tu kRRitsnasya vAnarAH
shlokas.26:
kechinnaubhirvyavasyanti kechIchcha vividhaiH plavaiH |
neti rAmashcha tAnsarvAnsAntvayanpratyabhAShata
shlokas.27:
shatayojanavistAraM na shaktAH sarvavAnarAH |
krAntuM toyanidhiM vIrA naiShA vo naiShThikI matiH
shlokas.28:
nAvo na santi senAyA bahvyastArayituM tathA |
vaNijAmupaghAtaM cha kathamasmadvidhashcharet
shlokas.29:
vistIrNaM chaiva naH sainyaM hanyAchChidreShu vai paraH |
plavoDupapratArashcha naivAtra mama rochate
shlokas.30:
ahaM tvimaM jalanidhiM samArapsyAmyupAyataH |
pratisheShyAmyupavasandarshayiShyati mAM tataH
shlokas.31:
na cheddarshayitA mArgaM dhakShyAmyenamahaM tataH |
mahAstrairapratihatairatyagnipavanojjvalaiH
shlokas.32:
ityuktvA sahasaumitrirupaspRRishyAtha rAghavaH |
pratishishye jalanidhiM vidhivatkushasa.nstare
shlokas.33:
sAgarastu tataH svapne darshayAmAsa rAghavam |
devo nadanadIbhartA shrImAnyAdogaNairvRRitaH
shlokas.34:
kausalyAmAtarityevamAbhAShya madhuraM vachaH |
idamityAha ratnAnAmAkaraiH shatasho vRRitaH
shlokas.35:
brUhi kiM te karomyatra sAhAyyaM puruSharShabha |
ikShvAkurasmi te j~nAtiriti rAmastamabravIt
shlokas.36:
mArgamichChAmi sainyasya dattaM nadanadIpate |
yena gatvA dashagrIvaM hanyAM paulastyapA.nsanam
shlokas.37:
yadyevaM yAchato mArgaM na pradAsyati me bhavAn |
sharaistvAM shoShayiShyAmi divyAstrapratimantritaiH
shlokas.38:
ityevaM bruvataH shrutvA rAmasya varuNAlayaH |
uvAcha vyathito vAkyamiti baddhA~njaliH sthitaH
shlokas.39:
nechChAmi pratighAtaM te nAsmi vighnakarastava |
shRRiNu chedaM vacho rAma shrutvA kartavyamAchara
shlokas.40:
yadi dAsyAmi te mArgaM sainyasya vrajato.a.aj~nayA |
anye.apyAj~nApayiShyanti mAmevaM dhanuSho balAt
shlokas.41:
asti tvatra nalo nAma vAnaraH shilpisaMmataH |
tvaShTurdevasya tanayo balavAnvishvakarmaNaH
shlokas.42:
sa yatkAShThaM tRRiNaM vApi shilAM vA kShepsyate mayi |
sarvaM taddhArayiShyAmi sa te seturbhaviShyati
shlokas.43:
ityuktvAntarhite tasminrAmo nalamuvAcha ha |
kuru setuM samudre tvaM shakto hyasi mato mama
shlokas.44:
tenopAyena kAkutsthaH setubandhamakArayat |
dashayojanavistAramAyataM shatayojanam
shlokas.45:
nalaseturiti khyAto yo.adyApi prathito bhuvi |
rAmasyAj~nAM puraskRRitya dhAryate girisaMnibhaH
shlokas.46:
tatrasthaM sa tu dharmAtmA samAgachChadvibhIShaNaH |
bhrAtA vai rAkShasendrasya chaturbhiH sachivaiH saha
shlokas.47:
pratijagrAha rAmastaM svAgatena mahAmanAH |
sugrIvasya tu sha~NkAbhUtpraNidhiH syAditi sma ha
shlokas.48:
rAghavastasya cheShTAbhiH samyakcha charite~NgitaiH |
yadA tattvena tuShTo.abhUttata enamapUjayat
shlokas.49:
sarvarAkShasarAjye chApyabhyaShi~nchadvibhIShaNam |
chakre cha mantrAnucharaM suhRRidaM lakShmaNasya cha
shlokas.50:
vibhIShaNamate chaiva so.atyakrAmanmahArNavam |
sasainyaH setunA tena mAsenaiva narAdhipa
shlokas.51:
tato gatvA samAsAdya la~NkodyAnAnyanekashaH |
bhedayAmAsa kapibhirmahAnti cha bahUni cha
shlokas.52:
tatrAstAM rAvaNAmAtyau rAkShasau shukasAraNau |
chArau vAnararUpeNa tau jagrAha vibhIShaNaH
shlokas.53:
pratipannau yadA rUpaM rAkShasaM tau nishAcharau |
darshayitvA tataH sainyaM rAmaH pashchAdavAsRRijat
shlokas.54:
niveshyopavane sainyaM tachChUraH prAj~navAnaram |
preShayAmAsa dautyena rAvaNasya tato.a~Ngadam

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
prabhUtAnnodake tasminbahumUlaphale vane |
senAM niveshya kAkutstho vidhivatparyarakShata
shlokas.2:
rAvaNashcha vidhiM chakre la~NkAyAM shAstranirmitam |
prakRRityaiva durAdharShA dRRiDhaprAkAratoraNA
shlokas.3:
agAdhatoyAH parikhA mInanakrasamAkulAH |
babhUvuH sapta durdharShAH khAdiraiH sha~NkubhishchitAH
shlokas.4:
karNATTayantradurdharShA babhUvuH sahuDopalAH |
sAshIviShaghaTAyodhAH sasarjarasapA.nsavaH
shlokas.5:
musalAlAtanArAchatomarAsiparashvadhaiH |
anvitAshcha shataghnIbhiH samadhUchChiShTamudgarAH
shlokas.6:
puradvAreShu sarveShu gulmAH sthAvaraja~NgamAH |
babhUvuH pattibahulAH prabhUtagajavAjinaH
shlokas.7:
a~Ngadastvatha la~NkAyA dvAradeshamupAgataH |
vidito rAkShasendrasya pravivesha gatavyathaH
shlokas.8:
madhye rAkShasakoTInAM bahvInAM sumahAbalaH |
shushubhe meghamAlAbhirAditya iva sa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.9:
sa samAsAdya paulastyamamAtyairabhisa.nvRRitam |
rAmasa.ndeshamAmantrya vAgmI vaktuM prachakrame
shlokas.10:
Aha tvAM rAghavo rAjankosalendro mahAyashAH |
prAptakAlamidaM vAkyaM tadAdatsva kuruShva cha
shlokas.11:
akRRitAtmAnamAsAdya rAjAnamanaye ratam |
vinashyantyanayAviShTA deshAshcha nagarANi cha
shlokas.12:
tvayaikenAparAddhaM me sItAmAharatA balAt |
vadhAyAnaparAddhAnAmanyeShAM tadbhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
ye tvayA baladarpAbhyAmAviShTena vanecharAH |
RRiShayo hi.nsitAH pUrvaM devAshchApyavamAnitAH
shlokas.14:
rAjarShayashcha nihatA rudantyashchAhRRitAH striyaH |
tadidaM samanuprAptaM phalaM tasyAnayasya te
shlokas.15:
hantAsmi tvAM sahAmAtyaM yudhyasva puruSho bhava |
pashya me dhanuSho vIryaM mAnuShasya nishAchara
shlokas.16:
muchyatAM jAnakI sItA na me mokShyasi karhichit |
arAkShasamimaM lokaM kartAsmi nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
iti tasya bruvANasya dUtasya paruShaM vachaH |
shrutvA na mamRRiShe rAjA rAvaNaH krodhamUrChitaH
shlokas.18:
i~Ngitaj~nAstato bhartushchatvAro rajanIcharAH |
chaturShva~NgeShu jagRRihuH shArdUlamiva pakShiNaH
shlokas.19:
tA.nstathA~NgeShu sa.nsaktAna~Ngado rajanIcharAn |
AdAyaiva khamutpatya prAsAdatalamAvishat
shlokas.20:
vegenotpatatastasya petuste rajanIcharAH |
bhuvi sambhinnahRRidayAH prahAraparipIDitAH
shlokas.21:
sa mukto harmyashikharAttasmAtpunaravApatat |
la~NghayitvA purIM la~NkAM svabalasya samIpataH
shlokas.22:
kosalendramathAbhyetya sarvamAvedya chA~NgadaH |
vishashrAma sa tejasvI rAghaveNAbhinanditaH
shlokas.23:
tataH sarvAbhisAreNa harINAM vAtaraMhasAm |
bhedayAmAsa la~NkAyAH prAkAraM raghunandanaH
shlokas.24:
vibhIShaNarkShAdhipatI puraskRRityAtha lakShmaNaH |
dakShiNaM nagaradvAramavAmRRidnAddurAsadam
shlokas.25:
karabhAruNagAtrANAM harINAM yuddhashAlinAm |
koTIshatasahasreNa la~NkAmabhyapatattadA
shlokas.26:
utpatadbhiH patadbhishcha nipatadbhishcha vAnaraiH |
nAdRRishyata tadA sUryo rajasA nAshitaprabhaH
shlokas.27:
shAliprasUnasadRRishaiH shirIShakusumaprabhaiH |
taruNAdityasadRRishaiH sharagauraishcha vAnaraiH
shlokas.28:
prAkAraM dadRRishuste tu samantAtkapilIkRRitam |
rAkShasA vismitA rAjansastrIvRRiddhAH samantataH
shlokas.29:
bibhiduste maNistambhAnkarNATTashikharANi cha |
bhagnonmathitavegAni yantrANi cha vichikShipuH
shlokas.30:
parigRRihya shataghnIshcha sachakrAH sahuDopalAH |
chikShipurbhujavegena la~NkAmadhye mahAbalAH
shlokas.31:
prAkArasthAshcha ye kechinnishAcharagaNAstadA |
pradudruvuste shatashaH kapibhiH samabhidrutAH
shlokas.32:
tatastu rAjavachanAdrAkShasAH kAmarUpiNaH |
niryayurvikRRitAkArAH sahasrashatasa~NghashaH
shlokas.33:
shastravarShANi varShanto drAvayanto vanaukasaH |
prAkAraM shodhayantaste paraM vikramamAsthitAH
shlokas.34:
sa mASharAshisadRRishairbabhUva kShaNadAcharaiH |
kRRito nirvAnaro bhUyaH prAkAro bhImadarshanaiH
shlokas.35:
petuH shUlavibhinnA~NgA bahavo vAnararShabhAH |
stambhatoraNabhagnAshcha petustatra nishAcharAH
shlokas.36:
keshAkeshyabhavadyuddhaM rakShasAM vAnaraiH saha |
nakhairdantaishcha vIrANAM khAdatAM vai parasparam
shlokas.37:
niShTananto hyubhayatastatra vAnararAkShasAH |
hatA nipatitA bhUmau na mu~nchanti parasparam
shlokas.38:
rAmastu sharajAlAni vavarSha jalado yathA |
tAni la~NkAM samAsAdya jaghnustAnrajanIcharAn
shlokas.39:
saumitrirapi nArAchairdRRiDhadhanvA jitaklamaH |
AdishyAdishya durgasthAnpAtayAmAsa rAkShasAn
shlokas.40:
tataH pratyavahAro.abhUtsainyAnAM rAghavAj~nayA |
kRRite vimarde la~NkAyAM labdhalakSho jayottaraH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato nivishamAnA.nstAnsainikAnrAvaNAnugAH |
abhijagmurgaNAneke pishAchakShudrarakShasAm
shlokas.2:
parvaNaH pUtano jambhaH kharaH krodhavasho hariH |
prarujashchArujashchaiva praghasashchaivamAdayaH
shlokas.3:
tato.abhipatatAM teShAmadRRishyAnAM durAtmanAm |
antardhAnavadhaM tajj~nashchakAra sa vibhIShaNaH
shlokas.4:
te dRRishyamAnA haribhirbalibhirdUrapAtibhiH |
nihatAH sarvasho rAjanmahIM jagmurgatAsavaH
shlokas.5:
amRRiShyamANaH sabalo rAvaNo niryayAvatha |
vyUhya chaushanasaM vyUhaM harInsarvAnahArayat
shlokas.6:
rAghavastvabhiniryAya vyUDhAnIkaM dashAnanam |
bArhaspatyaM vidhiM kRRitvA pratyavyUhannishAcharam
shlokas.7:
sametya yuyudhe tatra tato rAmeNa rAvaNaH |
yuyudhe lakShmaNashchaiva tathaivendrajitA saha
shlokas.8:
virUpAkSheNa sugrIvastAreNa cha nikharvaTaH |
tuNDena cha nalastatra paTushaH panasena cha
shlokas.9:
viShahyaM yaM hi yo mene sa sa tena sameyivAn |
yuyudhe yuddhavelAyAM svabAhubalamAshritaH
shlokas.10:
sa samprahAro vavRRidhe bhIrUNAM bhayavardhanaH |
lomasaMharShaNo ghoraH purA devAsure yathA
shlokas.11:
rAvaNo rAmamAnarChachChaktishUlAsivRRiShTibhiH |
nishitairAyasaistIkShNai rAvaNaM chApi rAghavaH
shlokas.12:
tathaivendrajitaM yattaM lakShmaNo marmabhedibhiH |
indrajichchApi saumitriM bibheda bahubhiH sharaiH
shlokas.13:
vibhIShaNaH prahastaM cha prahastashcha vibhIShaNam |
khagapatraiH sharaistIkShNairabhyavarShadgatavyathaH
shlokas.14:
teShAM balavatAmAsInmahAstrANAM samAgamaH |
vivyathuH sakalA yena trayo lokAshcharAcharAH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH prahastaH sahasA samabhyetya vibhIShaNam |
gadayA tADayAmAsa vinadya raNakarkashaH
shlokas.2:
sa tayAbhihato dhImAngadayA bhImavegayA |
nAkampata mahAbAhurhimavAniva susthiraH
shlokas.3:
tataH pragRRihya vipulAM shataghaNTAM vibhIShaNaH |
abhimantrya mahAshaktiM chikShepAsya shiraH prati
shlokas.4:
patantyA sa tayA vegAdrAkShaso.ashaninAdayA |
hRRitottamA~Ngo dadRRishe vAtarugNa iva drumaH
shlokas.5:
taM dRRiShTvA nihataM sa~Nkhye prahastaM kShaNadAcharam |
abhidudrAva dhUmrAkSho vegena mahatA kapIn
shlokas.6:
tasya meghopamaM sainyamApatadbhImadarshanam |
dRRiShTvaiva sahasA dIrNA raNe vAnarapu~NgavAH
shlokas.7:
tatastAnsahasA dIrNAndRRiShTvA vAnarapu~NgavAn |
niryAya kapishArdUlo hanUmAnparyavasthitaH
shlokas.8:
taM dRRiShTvAvasthitaM sa~Nkhye harayaH pavanAtmajam |
vegena mahatA rAjansaMnyavartanta sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsIttumulo lomaharShaNaH |
rAmarAvaNasainyAnAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.10:
tasminpravRRitte sa~NgrAme ghore rudhirakardame |
dhUmrAkShaH kapisainyaM taddrAvayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.11:
taM rAkShasamahAmAtramApatantaM sapatnajit |
tarasA pratijagrAha hanUmAnpavanAtmajaH
shlokas.12:
tayoryuddhamabhUdghoraM harirAkShasavIrayoH |
jigIShatoryudhAnyonyamindraprahlAdayoriva
shlokas.13:
gadAbhiH parighaishchaiva rAkShaso jaghnivAnkapim |
kapishcha jaghnivAnrakShaH saskandhaviTapairdrumaiH
shlokas.14:
tatastamatikAyena sAshvaM sarathasArathim |
dhUmrAkShamavadhIddhImAnhanUmAnmArutAtmajaH
shlokas.15:
tatastaM nihataM dRRiShTvA dhUmrAkShaM rAkShasottamam |
harayo jAtavisrambhA jaghnurabhyetya sainikAn
shlokas.16:
te vadhyamAnA balibhirharibhirjitakAshibhiH |
rAkShasA bhagnasa~NkalpA la~NkAmabhyapatanbhayAt
shlokas.17:
te.abhipatya puraM bhagnA hatasheShA nishAcharAH |
sarvaM rAj~ne yathAvRRittaM rAvaNAya nyavedayan
shlokas.18:
shrutvA tu rAvaNastebhyaH prahastaM nihataM yudhi |
dhUmrAkShaM cha maheShvAsaM sasainyaM vAnararShabhaiH
shlokas.19:
sudIrghamiva niHshvasya samutpatya varAsanAt |
uvAcha kumbhakarNasya karmakAlo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.20:
ityevamuktvA vividhairvAditraiH sumahAsvanaiH |
shayAnamatinidrAluM kumbhakarNamabodhayat
shlokas.21:
prabodhya mahatA chainaM yatnenAgatasAdhvasaH |
svasthamAsInamavyagraM vinidraM rAkShasAdhipaH
tato.abravIddashagrIvaH kumbhakarNaM mahAbalam
shlokas.22:
dhanyo.asi yasya te nidrA kumbhakarNeyamIdRRishI |
ya imaM dAruNaM kAlaM na jAnIShe mahAbhayam
shlokas.23:
eSha tIrtvArNavaM rAmaH setunA haribhiH saha |
avamanyeha naH sarvAnkaroti kadanaM mahat
shlokas.24:
mayA hyapahRRitA bhAryA sItA nAmAsya jAnakI |
tAM mokShayiShurAyAto baddhvA setuM mahArNave
shlokas.25:
tena chaiva prahastAdirmahAnnaH svajano hataH |
tasya nAnyo nihantAsti tvadRRite shatrukarshana
shlokas.26:
sa da.nshito.abhiniryAya tvamadya balinAM vara |
rAmAdInsamare sarvA~njahi shatrUnari.ndama
shlokas.27:
dUShaNAvarajau chaiva vajravegapramAthinau |
tau tvAM balena mahatA sahitAvanuyAsyataH
shlokas.28:
ityuktvA rAkShasapatiH kumbhakarNaM tarasvinam |
sa.ndideshetikartavye vajravegapramAthinau
shlokas.29:
tathetyuktvA tu tau vIrau rAvaNaM dUShaNAnujau |
kumbhakarNaM puraskRRitya tUrNaM niryayatuH purAt

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato viniryAya purAtkumbhakarNaH sahAnugaH |
apashyatkapisainyaM tajjitakAshyagrataH sthitam
shlokas.2:
tamabhyetyAshu harayaH parivArya samantataH |
abhyaghna.nshcha mahAkAyairbahubhirjagatIruhaiH
karajairatuda.nshchAnye vihAya bhayamuttamam
shlokas.3:
bahudhA yudhyamAnAste yuddhamArgaiH plava~NgamAH |
nAnApraharaNairbhImaM rAkShasendramatADayan
shlokas.4:
sa tADyamAnaH prahasanbhakShayAmAsa vAnarAn |
panasaM cha gavAkShaM cha vajrabAhuM cha vAnaram
shlokas.5:
taddRRiShTvA vyathanaM karma kumbhakarNasya rakShasaH |
udakroshanparitrastAstAraprabhRRitayastadA
shlokas.6:
taM tAramuchchaiH kroshantamanyA.nshcha hariyUthapAn |
abhidudrAva sugrIvaH kumbhakarNamapetabhIH
shlokas.7:
tato.abhipatya vegena kumbhakarNaM mahAmanAH |
shAlena jaghnivAnmUrdhni balena kapiku~njaraH
shlokas.8:
sa mahAtmA mahAvegaH kumbhakarNasya mUrdhani |
bibheda shAlaM sugrIvo na chaivAvyathayatkapiH
shlokas.9:
tato vinadya prahasa~nshAlasparshavibodhitaH |
dorbhyAmAdAya sugrIvaM kumbhakarNo.aharadbalAt
shlokas.10:
hriyamANaM tu sugrIvaM kumbhakarNena rakShasA |
avekShyAbhyadravadvIraH saumitrirmitranandanaH
shlokas.11:
so.abhipatya mahAvegaM rukmapu~NkhaM mahAsharam |
prAhiNotkumbhakarNAya lakShmaNaH paravIrahA
shlokas.12:
sa tasya dehAvaraNaM bhittvA dehaM cha sAyakaH |
jagAma dArayanbhUmiM rudhireNa samukShitaH
shlokas.13:
tathA sa bhinnahRRidayaH samutsRRijya kapIshvaram |
kumbhakarNo maheShvAsaH pragRRihItashilAyudhaH
abhidudrAva saumitrimudyamya mahatIM shilAm
shlokas.14:
tasyAbhidravatastUrNaM kShurAbhyAmuchChritau karau |
chichCheda nishitAgrAbhyAM sa babhUva chaturbhujaH
shlokas.15:
tAnapyasya bhujAnsarvAnpragRRihItashilAyudhAn |
kShuraishchichCheda laghvastraM saumitriH pratidarshayan
shlokas.16:
sa babhUvAtikAyashcha bahupAdashirobhujaH |
taM brahmAstreNa saumitrirdadAhAdrichayopamam
shlokas.17:
sa papAta mahAvIryo divyAstrAbhihato raNe |
mahAshanivinirdagdhaH pAdapo.a~NkuravAniva
shlokas.18:
taM dRRiShTvA vRRitrasa~NkAshaM kumbhakarNaM tarasvinam |
gatAsuM patitaM bhUmau rAkShasAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.19:
tathA tAndravato yodhAndRRiShTvA tau dUShaNAnujau |
avasthApyAtha saumitriM sa~NkruddhAvabhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.20:
tAvAdravantau sa~Nkruddhau vajravegapramAthinau |
pratijagrAha saumitrirvinadyobhau patatribhiH
shlokas.21:
tataH sutumulaM yuddhamabhavallomaharShaNam |
dUShaNAnujayoH pArtha lakShmaNasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.22:
mahatA sharavarSheNa rAkShasau so.abhyavarShata |
tau chApi vIrau sa~NkruddhAvubhau tau samavarShatAm
shlokas.23:
muhUrtamevamabhavadvajravegapramAthinoH |
saumitreshcha mahAbAhoH samprahAraH sudAruNaH
shlokas.24:
athAdrishRRi~NgamAdAya hanUmAnmArutAtmajaH |
abhidrutyAdade prANAnvajravegasya rakShasaH
shlokas.25:
nIlashcha mahatA grAvNA dUShaNAvarajaM hariH |
pramAthinamabhidrutya pramamAtha mahAbalaH
shlokas.26:
tataH prAvartata punaH sa~NgrAmaH kaTukodayaH |
rAmarAvaNasainyAnAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.27:
shatasho nairRRitAnvanyA jaghnurvanyA.nshcha nairRRitAH |
nairRRitAstatra vadhyante prAyasho na tu vAnarAH

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH shrutvA hataM sa~Nkhye kumbhakarNaM sahAnugam |
prahastaM cha maheShvAsaM dhUmrAkShaM chAtitejasam
shlokas.2:
putramindrajitaM shUraM rAvaNaH pratyabhAShata |
jahi rAmamamitraghna sugrIvaM cha salakShmaNam
shlokas.3:
tvayA hi mama satputra yasho dIptamupArjitam |
jitvA vajradharaM sa~Nkhye sahasrAkShaM shachIpatim
shlokas.4:
antarhitaH prakAsho vA divyairdattavaraiH sharaiH |
jahi shatrUnamitraghna mama shastrabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.5:
rAmalakShmaNasugrIvAH sharasparshaM na te.anagha |
samarthAH pratisa.nsoDhuM kutastadanuyAyinaH
shlokas.6:
akRRitA yA prahastena kumbhakarNena chAnagha |
kharasyApachitiH sa~Nkhye tAM gachChasva mahAbhuja
shlokas.7:
tvamadya nishitairbANairhatvA shatrUnsasainikAn |
pratinandaya mAM putra purA baddhveva vAsavam
shlokas.8:
ityuktaH sa tathetyuktvA rathamAsthAya da.nshitaH |
prayayAvindrajidrAja.nstUrNamAyodhanaM prati
shlokas.9:
tatra vishrAvya vispaShTaM nAma rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
AhvayAmAsa samare lakShmaNaM shubhalakShaNam
shlokas.10:
taM lakShmaNo.apyabhyadhAvatpragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH |
trAsaya.nstalaghoSheNa siMhaH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.11:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM sumahajjayagRRiddhinoH |
divyAstraviduShostIvramanyonyaspardhinostadA
shlokas.12:
rAvaNistu yadA nainaM visheShayati sAyakaiH |
tato gurutaraM yatnamAtiShThadbalinAM varaH
shlokas.13:
tata enaM mahAvegairardayAmAsa tomaraiH |
tAnAgatAnsa chichCheda saumitrirnishitaiH sharaiH
te nikRRittAH sharaistIkShNairnyapatanvasudhAtale
shlokas.14:
tama~Ngado vAlisutaH shrImAnudyamya pAdapam |
abhidrutya mahAvegastADayAmAsa mUrdhani
shlokas.15:
tasyendrajidasambhrAntaH prAsenorasi vIryavAn |
prahartumaichChattaM chAsya prAsaM chichCheda lakShmaNaH
shlokas.16:
tamabhyAshagataM vIrama~NgadaM rAvaNAtmajaH |
gadayAtADayatsavye pArshve vAnarapu~Ngavam
shlokas.17:
tamachintya prahAraM sa balavAnvAlinaH sutaH |
sasarjendrajitaH krodhAchChAlaskandhamamitrajit
shlokas.18:
so.a~Ngadena ruShotsRRiShTo vadhAyendrajitastaruH |
jaghAnendrajitaH pArtha rathaM sAshvaM sasArathim
shlokas.19:
tato hatAshvAtpraskandya rathAtsa hatasArathiH |
tatraivAntardadhe rAjanmAyayA rAvaNAtmajaH
shlokas.20:
antarhitaM viditvA taM bahumAyaM cha rAkShasam |
rAmastaM deshamAgamya tatsainyaM paryarakShata
shlokas.21:
sa rAmamuddishya sharaistato dattavaraistadA |
vivyAdha sarvagAtreShu lakShmaNaM cha mahAratham
shlokas.22:
tamadRRishyaM sharaiH shUrau mAyayAntarhitaM tadA |
yodhayAmAsaturubhau rAvaNiM rAmalakShmaNau
shlokas.23:
sa ruShA sarvagAtreShu tayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
vyasRRijatsAyakAnbhUyaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.24:
tamadRRishyaM vichinvantaH sRRijantamanishaM sharAn |
harayo vivishurvyoma pragRRihya mahatIH shilAH
shlokas.25:
tA.nshcha tau chApyadRRishyaH sa sharairvivyAdha rAkShasaH |
sa bhRRishaM tADayanvIro rAvaNirmAyayAvRRitaH
shlokas.26:
tau sharairAchitau vIrau bhrAtarau rAmalakShmaNau |
petaturgaganAdbhUmiM sUryAchandramasAviva

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tAvubhau patitau dRRiShTvA bhrAtarAvamitaujasau |
babandha rAvaNirbhUyaH sharairdattavaraistadA
shlokas.2:
tau vIrau sharajAlena baddhAvindrajitA raNe |
rejatuH puruShavyAghrau shakuntAviva pa~njare
shlokas.3:
tau dRRiShTvA patitau bhUmau shatashaH sAyakaishchitau |
sugrIvaH kapibhiH sArdhaM parivArya tataH sthitaH
shlokas.4:
suSheNamaindadvividaiH kumudenA~Ngadena cha |
hanUmannIlatAraishcha nalena cha kapIshvaraH
shlokas.5:
tatastaM deshamAgamya kRRitakarmA vibhIShaNaH |
bodhayAmAsa tau vIrau praj~nAstreNa prabodhitau
shlokas.6:
vishalyau chApi sugrIvaH kShaNenobhau chakAra tau |
vishalyayA mahauShadhyA divyamantraprayuktayA
shlokas.7:
tau labdhasa~nj~nau nRRivarau vishalyAvudatiShThatAm |
gatatandrIklamau chAstAM kShaNenobhau mahArathau
shlokas.8:
tato vibhIShaNaH pArtha rAmamikShvAkunandanam |
uvAcha vijvaraM dRRiShTvA kRRitA~njaliridaM vachaH
shlokas.9:
ayamambho gRRihItvA tu rAjarAjasya shAsanAt |
guhyako.abhyAgataH shvetAttvatsakAshamari.ndama
shlokas.10:
idamambhaH kuberaste mahArAjaH prayachChati |
antarhitAnAM bhUtAnAM darshanArthaM parantapa
shlokas.11:
anena spRRiShTanayano bhUtAnyantarhitAnyuta |
bhavAndrakShyati yasmai cha bhavAnetatpradAsyati
shlokas.12:
tatheti rAmastadvAri pratigRRihyAtha satkRRitam |
chakAra netrayoH shauchaM lakShmaNashcha mahAmanAH
shlokas.13:
sugrIvajAmbavantau cha hanUmAna~NgadastathA |
maindadvividanIlAshcha prAyaH plavagasattamAH
shlokas.14:
tathA samabhavachchApi yaduvAcha vibhIShaNaH |
kShaNenAtIndriyANyeShAM chakShUMShyAsanyudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
indrajitkRRitakarmA tu pitre karma tadAtmanaH |
nivedya punarAgachChattvarayAjishiraH prati
shlokas.16:
tamApatantaM sa~NkruddhaM punareva yuyutsayA |
abhidudrAva saumitrirvibhIShaNamate sthitaH
shlokas.17:
akRRitAhnikamevainaM jighA.nsurjitakAshinam |
sharairjaghAna sa~NkruddhaH kRRitasa~nj~no.atha lakShmaNaH
shlokas.18:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM tadAnyonyaM jigIShatoH |
atIva chitramAshcharyaM shakraprahlAdayoriva
shlokas.19:
avidhyadindrajittIkShNaiH saumitriM marmabhedibhiH |
saumitrishchAnalasparshairavidhyadrAvaNiM sharaiH
shlokas.20:
saumitrisharasa.nsparshAdrAvaNiH krodhamUrChitaH |
asRRijallakShmaNAyAShTau sharAnAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.21:
tasyAsUnpAvakasparshaiH saumitriH patribhistribhiH |
yathA niraharadvIrastanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.22:
ekenAsya dhanuShmantaM bAhuM dehAdapAtayat |
dvitIyena sanArAchaM bhujaM bhUmau nyapAtayat
shlokas.23:
tRRitIyena tu bANena pRRithudhAreNa bhAsvatA |
jahAra sunasaM chAru shiro bhrAjiShNukuNDalam
shlokas.24:
vinikRRittabhujaskandhaM kabandhaM bhImadarshanam |
taM hatvA sUtamapyastrairjaghAna balinAM varaH
shlokas.25:
la~NkAM praveshayAmAsurvAjinastaM rathaM tadA |
dadarsha rAvaNastaM cha rathaM putravinAkRRitam
shlokas.26:
sa putraM nihataM dRRiShTvA trAsAtsambhrAntalochanaH |
rAvaNaH shokamohArto vaidehIM hantumudyataH
shlokas.27:
ashokavanikAsthAM tAM rAmadarshanalAlasAm |
khaDgamAdAya duShTAtmA javenAbhipapAta ha
shlokas.28:
taM dRRiShTvA tasya durbuddheravindhyaH pApanishchayam |
shamayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaM shrUyatAM yena hetunA
shlokas.29:
mahArAjye sthito dIpte na striyaM hantumarhasi |
hataivaiShA yadA strI cha bandhanasthA cha te gRRihe
shlokas.30:
na chaiShA dehabhedena hatA syAditi me matiH |
jahi bhartAramevAsyA hate tasminhatA bhavet
shlokas.31:
na hi te vikrame tulyaH sAkShAdapi shatakratuH |
asakRRiddhi tvayA sendrAstrAsitAstridashA yudhi
shlokas.32:
evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairavindhyo rAvaNaM tadA |
kruddhaM sa.nshamayAmAsa jagRRihe cha sa tadvachaH
shlokas.33:
niryANe sa matiM kRRitvA nidhAyAsiM kShapAcharaH |
Aj~nApayAmAsa tadA ratho me kalpyatAmiti

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH kruddho dashagrIvaH priye putre nipAtite |
niryayau rathamAsthAya hemaratnavibhUShitam
shlokas.2:
sa.nvRRito rAkShasairghorairvividhAyudhapANibhiH |
abhidudrAva rAmaM sa pothayanhariyUthapAn
shlokas.3:
tamAdravantaM sa~NkruddhaM maindanIlanalA~NgadAH |
hanUmA~njAmbavA.nshchaiva sasainyAH paryavArayan
shlokas.4:
te dashagrIvasainyaM tadRRikShavAnarayUthapAH |
drumairvidhva.nsayAM chakrurdashagrIvasya pashyataH
shlokas.5:
tataH svasainyamAlokya vadhyamAnamarAtibhiH |
mAyAvI vyadadhAnmAyAM rAvaNo rAkShaseshvaraH
shlokas.6:
tasya dehAdviniShkrAntAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
rAkShasAH pratyadRRishyanta sharashaktyRRiShTipANayaH
shlokas.7:
tAnrAmo jaghnivAnsarvAndivyenAstreNa rAkShasAn |
atha bhUyo.api mAyAM sa vyadadhAdrAkShasAdhipaH
shlokas.8:
kRRitvA rAmasya rUpANi lakShmaNasya cha bhArata |
abhidudrAva rAmaM cha lakShmaNaM cha dashAnanaH
shlokas.9:
tataste rAmamarChanto lakShmaNaM cha kShapAcharAH |
abhipetustadA rAjanpragRRihItochchakArmukAH
shlokas.10:
tAM dRRiShTvA rAkShasendrasya mAyAmikShvAkunandanaH |
uvAcha rAmaM saumitrirasambhrAnto bRRihadvachaH
shlokas.11:
jahImAnrAkShasAnpApAnAtmanaH pratirUpakAn |
jaghAna rAmastA.nshchAnyAnAtmanaH pratirUpakAn
shlokas.12:
tato haryashvayuktena rathenAdityavarchasA |
upatasthe raNe rAmaM mAtaliH shakrasArathiH
shlokas.13:
mAtaliruvAcha||
ayaM haryashvayugjaitro maghonaH syandanottamaH |
anena shakraH kAkutstha samare daityadAnavAn
shatashaH puruShavyAghra rathodAreNa jaghnivAn
shlokas.14:
tadanena naravyAghra mayA yattena sa.nyuge |
syandanena jahi kShipraM rAvaNaM mA chiraM kRRithAH
shlokas.15:
ityukto rAghavastathyaM vacho.asha~Nkata mAtaleH |
mAyeyaM rAkShasasyeti tamuvAcha vibhIShaNaH
shlokas.16:
neyaM mAyA naravyAghra rAvaNasya durAtmanaH |
tadAtiShTha rathaM shIghramimamaindraM mahAdyute
shlokas.17:
tataH prahRRiShTaH kAkutsthastathetyuktvA vibhIShaNam |
rathenAbhipapAtAshu dashagrIvaM ruShAnvitaH
shlokas.18:
hAhAkRRitAni bhUtAni rAvaNe samabhidrute |
siMhanAdAH sapaTahA divi divyAshcha nAnadan
shlokas.19:
sa rAmAya mahAghoraM visasarja nishAcharaH |
shUlamindrAshaniprakhyaM brahmadaNDamivodyatam
shlokas.20:
tachChUlamantarA rAmashchichCheda nishitaiH sharaiH |
taddRRiShTvA duShkaraM karma rAvaNaM bhayamAvishat
shlokas.21:
tataH kruddhaH sasarjAshu dashagrIvaH shitA~nsharAn |
sahasrAyutasho rAme shastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.22:
tato bhushuNDIH shUlA.nshcha musalAni parashvadhAn |
shaktIshcha vividhAkArAH shataghnIshcha shitakShurAH
shlokas.23:
tAM mAyAM vikRRitAM dRRiShTvA dashagrIvasya rakShasaH |
bhayAtpradudruvuH sarve vAnarAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.24:
tataH supatraM sumukhaM hemapu~NkhaM sharottamam |
tUNAdAdAya kAkutstho brahmAstreNa yuyoja ha
shlokas.25:
taM bANavaryaM rAmeNa brahmAstreNAbhimantritam |
jahRRiShurdevagandharvA dRRiShTvA shakrapurogamAH
shlokas.26:
alpAvasheShamAyushcha tato.amanyanta rakShasaH |
brahmAstrodIraNAchChatrordevagandharvakiMnarAH
shlokas.27:
tataH sasarja taM rAmaH sharamapratimaujasam |
rAvaNAntakaraM ghoraM brahmadaNDamivodyatam
shlokas.28:
sa tena rAkShasashreShThaH sarathaH sAshvasArathiH |
prajajvAla mahAjvAlenAgninAbhipariShkRRitaH
shlokas.29:
tataH prahRRiShTAstridashAH sagandharvAH sachAraNAH |
nihataM rAvaNaM dRRiShTvA rAmeNAkliShTakarmaNA
shlokas.30:
tatyajustaM mahAbhAgaM pa~ncha bhUtAni rAvaNam |
bhra.nshitaH sarvalokeShu sa hi brahmAstratejasA
shlokas.31:
sharIradhAtavo hyasya mA.nsaM rudhirameva cha |
neshurbrahmAstranirdagdhA na cha bhasmApyadRRishyata

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sa hatvA rAvaNaM kShudraM rAkShasendraM suradviSham |
babhUva hRRiShTaH sasuhRRidrAmaH saumitriNA saha
shlokas.2:
tato hate dashagrIve devAH sarShipurogamAH |
AshIrbhirjayayuktAbhirAnarchustaM mahAbhujam
shlokas.3:
rAmaM kamalapatrAkShaM tuShTuvuH sarvadevatAH |
gandharvAH puShpavarShaishcha vAgbhishcha tridashAlayAH
shlokas.4:
pUjayitvA yathA rAmaM pratijagmuryathAgatam |
tanmahotsavasa~NkAshamAsIdAkAshamachyuta
shlokas.5:
tato hatvA dashagrIvaM la~NkAM rAmo mahAyashAH |
vibhIShaNAya pradadau prabhuH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.6:
tataH sItAM puraskRRitya vibhIShaNapuraskRRitAm |
avindhyo nAma supraj~no vRRiddhAmAtyo viniryayau
shlokas.7:
uvAcha cha mahAtmAnaM kAkutsthaM dainyamAsthitam |
pratIchCha devIM sadvRRittAM mahAtma~njAnakImiti
shlokas.8:
etachChrutvA vachastasmAdavatIrya rathottamAt |
bAShpeNApihitAM sItAM dadarshekShvAkunandanaH
shlokas.9:
tAM dRRiShTvA chArusarvA~NgIM yAnasthAM shokakarshitAm |
malopachitasarvA~NgIM jaTilAM kRRiShNavAsasam
shlokas.10:
uvAcha rAmo vaidehIM parAmarshavisha~NkitaH |
gachCha vaidehi muktA tvaM yatkAryaM tanmayA kRRitam
shlokas.11:
mAmAsAdya patiM bhadre na tvaM rAkShasaveshmani |
jarAM vrajethA iti me nihato.asau nishAcharaH
shlokas.12:
kathaM hyasmadvidho jAtu jAnandharmavinishchayam |
parahastagatAM nArIM muhUrtamapi dhArayet
shlokas.13:
suvRRittAmasuvRRittAM vApyahaM tvAmadya maithili |
notsahe paribhogAya shvAvalIDhaM haviryathA
shlokas.14:
tataH sA sahasA bAlA tachChrutvA dAruNaM vachaH |
papAta devI vyathitA nikRRittA kadalI yathA
shlokas.15:
yo hyasyA harShasambhUto mukharAgastadAbhavat |
kShaNena sa punarbhraShTo niHshvAsAdiva darpaNe
shlokas.16:
tataste harayaH sarve tachChrutvA rAmabhAShitam |
gatAsukalpA nishcheShTA babhUvuH sahalakShmaNAH
shlokas.17:
tato devo vishuddhAtmA vimAnena chaturmukhaH |
pitAmaho jagatsraShTA darshayAmAsa rAghavam
shlokas.18:
shakrashchAgnishcha vAyushcha yamo varuNa eva cha |
yakShAdhipashcha bhagavA.nstathA saptarShayo.amalAH
shlokas.19:
rAjA dasharathashchaiva divyabhAsvaramUrtimAn |
vimAnena mahArheNa ha.nsayuktena bhAsvatA
shlokas.20:
tato.antarikShaM tatsarvaM devagandharvasa~Nkulam |
shushubhe tArakAchitraM sharadIva nabhastalam
shlokas.21:
tata utthAya vaidehi teShAM madhye yashasvinI |
uvAcha vAkyaM kalyANI rAmaM pRRithulavakShasam
shlokas.22:
rAjaputra na te kopaM karomi viditA hi me |
gatiH strINAM narANAM cha shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.23:
antashcharati bhUtAnAM mAtarishvA sadAgatiH |
sa me vimu~nchatu prANAnyadi pApaM charAmyaham
shlokas.24:
agnirApastathAkAshaM pRRithivI vAyureva cha |
vimu~nchantu mama prANAnyadi pApaM charAmyaham
shlokas.25:
tato.antarikShe vAgAsItsarvA vishrAvayandishaH |
puNyA saMharShaNI teShAM vAnarANAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.26:
vAyuruvAcha||
bho bho rAghava satyaM vai vAyurasmi sadAgatiH |
apApA maithilI rAjansa~NgachCha saha bhAryayA
shlokas.27:
agniruvAcha||
ahamantaHsharIrastho bhUtAnAM raghunandana |
susUkShmamapi kAkutstha maithilI nAparAdhyati
shlokas.28:
varuNa uvAcha||
rasA vai matprasUtA hi bhUtadeheShu rAghava |
ahaM vai tvAM prabravImi maithilI pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.29:
brahmovAcha||
putra naitadihAshcharyaM tvayi rAjarShidharmiNi |
sAdho sadvRRittamArgasthe shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.30:
shatrureSha tvayA vIra devagandharvabhoginAm |
yakShANAM dAnavAnAM cha maharShINAM cha pAtitaH
shlokas.31:
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM matprasAdAtpurAbhavat |
kasmAchchitkAraNAtpApaH ka~nchitkAlamupekShitaH
shlokas.32:
vadhArthamAtmanastena hRRitA sItA durAtmanA |
nalakUbarashApena rakShA chAsyAH kRRitA mayA
shlokas.33:
yadi hyakAmAmAsevetstriyamanyAmapi dhruvam |
shatadhAsya phaleddeha ityuktaH so.abhavatpurA
shlokas.34:
nAtra sha~NkA tvayA kAryA pratIchChemAM mahAdyute |
kRRitaM tvayA mahatkAryaM devAnAmamaraprabha
shlokas.35:
dasharatha uvAcha||
prIto.asmi vatsa bhadraM te pitA dasharatho.asmi te |
anujAnAmi rAjyaM cha prashAdhi puruShottama
shlokas.36:
rAma uvAcha||
abhivAdaye tvAM rAjendra yadi tvaM janako mama |
gamiShyAmi purIM ramyAmayodhyAM shAsanAttava
shlokas.37:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tamuvAcha pitA bhUyaH prahRRiShTo manujAdhipa |
gachChAyodhyAM prashAdhi tvaM rAma raktAntalochana
shlokas.38:
tato devAnnamaskRRitya suhRRidbhirabhinanditaH |
mahendra iva paulomyA bhAryayA sa sameyivAn
shlokas.39:
tato varaM dadau tasmai avindhyAya parantapaH |
trijaTAM chArthamAnAbhyAM yojayAmAsa rAkShasIm
shlokas.40:
tamuvAcha tato brahmA devaiH shakramukhairvRRitaH |
kausalyAmAtariShTA.nste varAnadya dadAni kAn
shlokas.41:
vavre rAmaH sthitiM dharme shatrubhishchAparAjayam |
rAkShasairnihatAnAM cha vAnarANAM samudbhavam
shlokas.42:
tataste brahmaNA prokte tatheti vachane tadA |
samuttasthurmahArAja vAnarA labdhachetasaH
shlokas.43:
sItA chApi mahAbhAgA varaM hanumate dadau |
rAmakIrtyA samaM putra jIvitaM te bhaviShyati
shlokas.44:
divyAstvAmupabhogAshcha matprasAdakRRitAH sadA |
upasthAsyanti hanumanniti sma harilochana
shlokas.45:
tataste prekShamANAnAM teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
antardhAnaM yayurdevAH sarve shakrapurogamAH
shlokas.46:
dRRiShTvA tu rAmaM jAnakyA sametaM shakrasArathiH |
uvAcha paramaprItaH suhRRinmadhya idaM vachaH
shlokas.47:
devagandharvayakShANAM mAnuShAsurabhoginAm |
apanItaM tvayA duHkhamidaM satyaparAkrama
shlokas.48:
sadevAsuragandharvA yakSharAkShasapannagAH |
kathayiShyanti lokAstvAM yAvadbhUmirdhariShyati
shlokas.49:
ityevamuktvAnuj~nApya rAmaM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
sampUjyApAkramattena rathenAdityavarchasA
shlokas.50:
tataH sItAM puraskRRitya rAmaH saumitriNA saha |
sugrIvapramukhaishchaiva sahitaH sarvavAnaraiH
shlokas.51:
vidhAya rakShAM la~NkAyAM vibhIShaNapuraskRRitaH |
santatAra punastena setunA makarAlayam
shlokas.52:
puShpakeNa vimAnena khechareNa virAjatA |
kAmagena yathA mukhyairamAtyaiH sa.nvRRito vashI
shlokas.53:
tatastIre samudrasya yatra shishye sa pArthivaH |
tatraivovAsa dharmAtmA sahitaH sarvavAnaraiH
shlokas.54:
athainAnrAghavaH kAle samAnIyAbhipUjya cha |
visarjayAmAsa tadA ratnaiH santoShya sarvashaH
shlokas.55:
gateShu vAnarendreShu gopuchCharkSheShu teShu cha |
sugrIvasahito rAmaH kiShkindhAM punarAgamat
shlokas.56:
vibhIShaNenAnugataH sugrIvasahitastadA |
puShpakeNa vimAnena vaidehyA darshayanvanam
shlokas.57:
kiShkindhAM tu samAsAdya rAmaH praharatAM varaH |
a~NgadaM kRRitakarmANaM yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.58:
tatastaireva sahito rAmaH saumitriNA saha |
yathAgatena mArgeNa prayayau svapuraM prati
shlokas.59:
ayodhyAM sa samAsAdya purIM rAShTrapatistataH |
bharatAya hanUmantaM dUtaM prasthApayattadA
shlokas.60:
lakShayitve~NgitaM sarvaM priyaM tasmai nivedya cha |
vAyuputre punaH prApte nandigrAmamupAgamat
shlokas.61:
sa tatra maladigdhA~NgaM bharataM chIravAsasam |
agrataH pAduke kRRitvA dadarshAsInamAsane
shlokas.62:
sametya bharatenAtha shatrughnena cha vIryavAn |
rAghavaH sahasaumitrirmumude bharatarShabha
shlokas.63:
tathA bharatashatrughnau sametau guruNA tadA |
vaidehyA darshanenobhau praharShaM samavApatuH
shlokas.64:
tasmai tadbharato rAjyamAgatAyAbhisatkRRitam |
nyAsaM niryAtayAmAsa yuktaH paramayA mudA
shlokas.65:
tatastaM vaiShNave shUraM nakShatre.abhimate.ahani |
vasiShTho vAmadevashcha sahitAvabhyaShi~nchatAm
shlokas.66:
so.abhiShiktaH kapishreShThaM sugrIvaM sasuhRRijjanam |
vibhIShaNaM cha paulastyamanvajAnAdgRRihAnprati
shlokas.67:
abhyarchya vividhai ratnaiH prItiyuktau mudA yutau |
samAdhAyetikartavyaM duHkhena visasarja ha
shlokas.68:
puShpakaM cha vimAnaM tatpUjayitvA sa rAghavaH |
prAdAdvaishravaNAyaiva prItyA sa raghunandanaH
shlokas.69:
tato devarShisahitaH saritaM gomatImanu |
dashAshvamedhAnAjahre jArUthyAnsa nirargalAn

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho rAmeNAmitatejasA |
prAptaM vyasanamatyugraM vanavAsakRRitaM purA
shlokas.2:
mA shuchaH puruShavyAghra kShatriyo.asi parantapa |
bAhuvIryAshraye mArge vartase dIptanirNaye
shlokas.3:
na hi te vRRijinaM ki~nchiddRRishyate paramaNvapi |
asminmArge viShIdeyuH sendrA api surAsurAH
shlokas.4:
saMhatya nihato vRRitro marudbhirvajrapANinA |
namuchishchaiva durdharSho dIrghajihvA cha rAkShasI
shlokas.5:
sahAyavati sarvArthAH santiShThantIha sarvashaH |
kiM nu tasyAjitaM sa~Nkhye bhrAtA yasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.6:
ayaM cha balinAM shreShTho bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
yuvAnau cha maheShvAsau yamau mAdravatIsutau
ebhiH sahAyaiH kasmAttvaM viShIdasi parantapa
shlokas.7:
ya ime vajriNaH senAM jayeyuH samarudgaNAm |
tvamapyebhirmaheShvAsaiH sahAyairdevarUpibhiH
vijeShyasi raNe sarvAnamitrAnbharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
itashcha tvamimAM pashya saindhavena durAtmanA |
balinA vIryamattena hRRitAmebhirmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
AnItAM draupadIM kRRiShNAM kRRitvA karma suduShkaram |
jayadrathaM cha rAjAnaM vijitaM vashamAgatam
shlokas.10:
asahAyena rAmeNa vaidehI punarAhRRitA |
hatvA sa~Nkhye dashagrIvaM rAkShasaM bhImavikramam
shlokas.11:
yasya shAkhAmRRigA mitrA RRikShAH kAlamukhAstathA |
jAtyantaragatA rAjannetadbuddhyAnuchintaya
shlokas.12:
tasmAttvaM kurushArdUla mA shucho bharatarShabha |
tvadvidhA hi mahAtmAno na shochanti parantapa
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAshvAsito rAjA mArkaNDeyena dhImatA |
tyaktvA duHkhamadInAtmA punarevedamabravIt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nAtmAnamanushochAmi nemAnbhrAtR^InmahAmune |
haraNaM chApi rAjyasya yathemAM drupadAtmajAm
shlokas.2:
dyUte durAtmabhiH kliShTAH kRRiShNayA tAritA vayam |
jayadrathena cha punarvanAdapahRRitA balAt
shlokas.3:
asti sImantinI kAchiddRRiShTapUrvAtha vA shrutA |
pativratA mahAbhAgA yatheyaM drupadAtmajA
shlokas.4:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjankulastrINAM mahAbhAgyaM yudhiShThira |
sarvametadyathA prAptaM sAvitryA rAjakanyayA
shlokas.5:
AsInmadreShu dharmAtmA rAjA paramadhArmikaH |
brahmaNyashcha sharaNyashcha satyasandho jitendriyaH
shlokas.6:
yajvA dAnapatirdakShaH paurajAnapadapriyaH |
pArthivo.ashvapatirnAma sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.7:
kShamAvAnanapatyashcha satyavAgvijitendriyaH |
atikrAntena vayasA santApamupajagmivAn
shlokas.8:
apatyotpAdanArthaM sa tIvraM niyamamAsthitaH |
kAle parimitAhAro brahmachArI jitendriyaH
shlokas.9:
hutvA shatasahasraM sa sAvitryA rAjasattama |
ShaShThe ShaShThe tadA kAle babhUva mitabhojanaH
shlokas.10:
etena niyamenAsIdvarShANyaShTAdashaiva tu |
pUrNe tvaShTAdashe varShe sAvitrI tuShTimabhyagAt
svarUpiNI tadA rAjandarshayAmAsa taM nRRipam
shlokas.11:
agnihotrAtsamutthAya harSheNa mahatAnvitA |
uvAcha chainaM varadA vachanaM pArthivaM tadA
shlokas.12:
brahmacharyeNa shuddhena damena niyamena cha |
sarvAtmanA cha madbhaktyA tuShTAsmi tava pArthiva
shlokas.13:
varaM vRRiNIShvAshvapate madrarAja yathepsitam |
na pramAdashcha dharmeShu kartavyaste katha~nchana
shlokas.14:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
apatyArthaH samArambhaH kRRito dharmepsayA mayA |
putrA me bahavo devi bhaveyuH kulabhAvanAH
shlokas.15:
tuShTAsi yadi me devi kAmametaM vRRiNomyaham |
santAnaM hi paro dharma ityAhurmAM dvijAtayaH
shlokas.16:
sAvitryuvAcha||
pUrvameva mayA rAjannabhiprAyamimaM tava |
j~nAtvA putrArthamukto vai tava hetoH pitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
prasAdAchchaiva tasmAtte svayambhuvihitAdbhuvi |
kanyA tejasvinI saumya kShiprameva bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
uttaraM cha na te ki~nchidvyAhartavyaM katha~nchana |
pitAmahanisargeNa tuShTA hyetadbravImi te
shlokas.19:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sa tatheti pratij~nAya sAvitryA vachanaM nRRipaH |
prasAdayAmAsa punaH kShipramevaM bhavediti
shlokas.20:
antarhitAyAM sAvitryAM jagAma svagRRihaM nRRipaH |
svarAjye chAvasatprItaH prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.21:
kasmi.nshchittu gate kAle sa rAjA niyatavrataH |
jyeShThAyAM dharmachAriNyAM mahiShyAM garbhamAdadhe
shlokas.22:
rAjaputryAM tu garbhaH sa mAlavyAM bharatarShabha |
vyavardhata yathA shukle tArApatirivAmbare
shlokas.23:
prApte kAle tu suShuve kanyAM rAjIvalochanAm |
kriyAshcha tasyA muditashchakre sa nRRipatistadA
shlokas.24:
sAvitryA prItayA dattA sAvitryA hutayA hyapi |
sAvitrItyeva nAmAsyAshchakrurviprAstathA pitA
shlokas.25:
sA vigrahavatIva shrIrvyavardhata nRRipAtmajA |
kAlena chApi sA kanyA yauvanasthA babhUva ha
shlokas.26:
tAM sumadhyAM pRRithushroNIM pratimAM kA~nchanImiva |
prApteyaM devakanyeti dRRiShTvA saMmenire janAH
shlokas.27:
tAM tu padmapalAshAkShIM jvalantImiva tejasA |
na kashchidvarayAmAsa tejasA prativAritaH
shlokas.28:
athopoShya shiraHsnAtA daivatAnyabhigamya sA |
hutvAgniM vidhivadviprAnvAchayAmAsa parvaNi
shlokas.29:
tataH sumanasaH sheShAH pratigRRihya mahAtmanaH |
pituH sakAshamagamaddevI shrIriva rUpiNI
shlokas.30:
sAbhivAdya pituH pAdau sheShAH pUrvaM nivedya cha |
kRRitA~njalirvarArohA nRRipateH pArshvataH sthitA
shlokas.31:
yauvanasthAM tu tAM dRRiShTvA svAM sutAM devarUpiNIm |
ayAchyamAnAM cha varairnRRipatirduHkhito.abhavat
shlokas.32:
rAjovAcha||
putri pradAnakAlaste na cha kashchidvRRiNoti mAm |
svayamanvichCha bhartAraM guNaiH sadRRishamAtmanaH
shlokas.33:
prArthitaH puruSho yashcha sa nivedyastvayA mama |
vimRRishyAhaM pradAsyAmi varaya tvaM yathepsitam
shlokas.34:
shrutaM hi dharmashAstre me paThyamAnaM dvijAtibhiH |
tathA tvamapi kalyANi gadato me vachaH shRRiNu
shlokas.35:
apradAtA pitA vAchyo vAchyashchAnupayanpatiH |
mRRite bhartari putrashcha vAchyo mAturarakShitA
shlokas.36:
idaM me vachanaM shrutvA bharturanveShaNe tvara |
devatAnAM yathA vAchyo na bhaveyaM tathA kuru
shlokas.37:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA duhitaraM tathA vRRiddhA.nshcha mantriNaH |
vyAdideshAnuyAtraM cha gamyatAmityachodayat
shlokas.38:
sAbhivAdya pituH pAdau vrIDiteva manasvinI |
piturvachanamAj~nAya nirjagAmAvichAritam
shlokas.39:
sA haimaM rathamAsthAya sthaviraiH sachivairvRRitA |
tapovanAni ramyANi rAjarShINAM jagAmaha
shlokas.40:
mAnyAnAM tatra vRRiddhAnAM kRRitvA pAdAbhivandanam |
vanAni kramashastAta sarvANyevAbhyagachChata
shlokas.41:
evaM sarveShu tIrtheShu dhanotsargaM nRRipAtmajA |
kurvatI dvijamukhyAnAM taM taM deshaM jagAma ha

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atha madrAdhipo rAjA nAradena samAgataH |
upaviShTaH sabhAmadhye kathAyogena bhArata
shlokas.2:
tato.abhigamya tIrthAni sarvANyevAshramA.nstathA |
AjagAma piturveshma sAvitrI saha mantribhiH
shlokas.3:
nAradena sahAsInaM dRRiShTvA sA pitaraM shubhA |
ubhayoreva shirasA chakre pAdAbhivandanam
shlokas.4:
nArada uvAcha||
kva gatAbhUtsuteyaM te kutashchaivAgatA nRRipa |
kimarthaM yuvatIM bhartre na chainAM samprayachChasi
shlokas.5:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
kAryeNa khalvanenaiva preShitAdyaiva chAgatA |
tadasyAH shRRiNu devarShe bhartAraM yo.anayA vRRitaH
shlokas.6:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sA brUhi vistareNeti pitrA sa~nchoditA shubhA |
daivatasyeva vachanaM pratigRRihyedamabravIt
shlokas.7:
AsIchChAlveShu dharmAtmA kShatriyaH pRRithivIpatiH |
dyumatsena iti khyAtaH pashchAdandho babhUva ha
shlokas.8:
vinaShTachakShuShastasya bAlaputrasya dhImataH |
sAmIpyena hRRitaM rAjyaM Chidre.asminpUrvavairiNA
shlokas.9:
sa bAlavatsayA sArdhaM bhAryayA prasthito vanam |
mahAraNyagatashchApi tapastepe mahAvrataH
shlokas.10:
tasya putraH pure jAtaH sa.nvRRiddhashcha tapovane |
satyavAnanurUpo me bharteti manasA vRRitaH
shlokas.11:
nArada uvAcha||
aho bata mahatpApaM sAvitryA nRRipate kRRitam |
ajAnantyA yadanayA guNavAnsatyavAnvRRitaH
shlokas.12:
satyaM vadatyasya pitA satyaM mAtA prabhAShate |
tato.asya brAhmaNAshchakrurnAmaitatsatyavAniti
shlokas.13:
bAlasyAshvAH priyAshchAsya karotyashvA.nshcha mRRinmayAn |
chitre.api cha likhatyashvA.nshchitrAshva iti chochyate
shlokas.14:
rAjovAcha||
apIdAnIM sa tejasvI buddhimAnvA nRRipAtmajaH |
kShamAvAnapi vA shUraH satyavAnpitRRinandanaH
shlokas.15:
nArada uvAcha||
vivasvAniva tejasvI bRRihaspatisamo matau |
mahendra iva shUrashcha vasudheva kShamAnvitaH
shlokas.16:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
api rAjAtmajo dAtA brahmaNyo vApi satyavAn |
rUpavAnapyudAro vApyatha vA priyadarshanaH
shlokas.17:
nArada uvAcha||
sA~NkRRite rantidevasya sa shaktyA dAnataH samaH |
brahmaNyaH satyavAdI cha shibiraushInaro yathA
shlokas.18:
yayAtiriva chodAraH somavatpriyadarshanaH |
rUpeNAnyatamo.ashvibhyAM dyumatsenasuto balI
shlokas.19:
sa dAntaH sa mRRiduH shUraH sa satyaH sa jitendriyaH |
sa maitraH so.anasUyashcha sa hrImAndhRRitimA.nshcha saH
shlokas.20:
nityashashchArjavaM tasminsthitistasyaiva cha dhruvA |
sa~NkShepatastapovRRiddhaiH shIlavRRiddhaishcha kathyate
shlokas.21:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
guNairupetaM sarvaistaM bhagavanprabravIShi me |
doShAnapyasya me brUhi yadi santIha kechana
shlokas.22:
nArada uvAcha||
eko doSho.asya nAnyo.asti so.adya prabhRRiti satyavAn |
sa.nvatsareNa kShINAyurdehanyAsaM kariShyati
shlokas.23:
rAjovAcha||
ehi sAvitri gachCha tvamanyaM varaya shobhane |
tasya doSho mahAneko guNAnAkramya tiShThati
shlokas.24:
yathA me bhagavAnAha nArado devasatkRRitaH |
sa.nvatsareNa so.alpAyurdehanyAsaM kariShyati
shlokas.25:
sAvitryuvAcha||
sakRRida.nsho nipatati sakRRitkanyA pradIyate |
sakRRidAha dadAnIti trINyetAni sakRRitsakRRit
shlokas.26:
dIrghAyuratha vAlpAyuH saguNo nirguNo.api vA |
sakRRidvRRito mayA bhartA na dvitIyaM vRRiNomyaham
shlokas.27:
manasA nishchayaM kRRitvA tato vAchAbhidhIyate |
kriyate karmaNA pashchAtpramANaM me manastataH
shlokas.28:
nArada uvAcha||
sthirA buddhirnarashreShTha sAvitryA duhitustava |
naiShA chAlayituM shakyA dharmAdasmAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.29:
nAnyasminpuruShe santi ye satyavati vai guNAH |
pradAnameva tasmAnme rochate duhitustava
shlokas.30:
rAjovAcha||
avichAryametaduktaM hi tathyaM bhagavatA vachaH |
kariShyAmyetadevaM cha gururhi bhagavAnmama
shlokas.31:
nArada uvAcha||
avighnamastu sAvitryAH pradAne duhitustava |
sAdhayiShyAmahe tAvatsarveShAM bhadramastu vaH
shlokas.32:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA khamutpatya nAradastridivaM gataH |
rAjApi duhituH sarvaM vaivAhikamakArayat

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atha kanyApradAne sa tamevArthaM vichintayan |
samAninye cha tatsarvaM bhANDaM vaivAhikaM nRRipaH
shlokas.2:
tato vRRiddhAndvijAnsarvAnRRitvijaH sapurohitAn |
samAhUya tithau puNye prayayau saha kanyayA
shlokas.3:
medhyAraNyaM sa gatvA cha dyumatsenAshramaM nRRipaH |
padbhyAmeva dvijaiH sArdhaM rAjarShiM tamupAgamat
shlokas.4:
tatrApashyanmahAbhAgaM shAlavRRikShamupAshritam |
kaushyAM bRRisyAM samAsInaM chakShurhInaM nRRipaM tadA
shlokas.5:
sa rAjA tasya rAjarSheH kRRitvA pUjAM yathArhataH |
vAchA suniyato bhUtvA chakArAtmanivedanam
shlokas.6:
tasyArghyamAsanaM chaiva gAM chAvedya sa dharmavit |
kimAgamanamityevaM rAjA rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.7:
tasya sarvamabhiprAyamitikartavyatAM cha tAm |
satyavantaM samuddishya sarvameva nyavedayat
shlokas.8:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
sAvitrI nAma rAjarShe kanyeyaM mama shobhanA |
tAM svadharmeNa dharmaj~na snuShArthe tvaM gRRihANa me
shlokas.9:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
chyutAH sma rAjyAdvanavAsamAshritA;shcharAma dharmaM niyatAstapasvinaH |
kathaM tvanarhA vanavAsamAshrame; sahiShyate kleshamimaM sutA tava
shlokas.10:
ashvapatiruvAcha||
sukhaM cha duHkhaM cha bhavAbhavAtmakaM; yadA vijAnAti sutAhameva cha |
na madvidhe yujyati vAkyamIdRRishaM; vinishchayenAbhigato.asmi te nRRipa
shlokas.11:
AshAM nArhasi me hantuM sauhRRidAdpraNayena cha |
abhitashchAgataM premNA pratyAkhyAtuM na mArhasi
shlokas.12:
anurUpo hi sa.nyoge tvaM mamAhaM tavApi cha |
snuShAM pratIchCha me kanyAM bhAryAM satyavataH sutAm
shlokas.13:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
pUrvamevAbhilaShitaH sambandho me tvayA saha |
bhraShTarAjyastvahamiti tata etadvichAritam
shlokas.14:
abhiprAyastvayaM yo me pUrvamevAbhikA~NkShitaH |
sa nirvartatu me.adyaiva kA~NkShito hyasi me.atithiH
shlokas.15:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH sarvAnsamAnIya dvijAnAshramavAsinaH |
yathAvidhi samudvAhaM kArayAmAsaturnRRipau
shlokas.16:
dattvA tvashvapatiH kanyAM yathArhaM cha parichChadam |
yayau svameva bhavanaM yuktaH paramayA mudA
shlokas.17:
satyavAnapi bhAryAM tAM labdhvA sarvaguNAnvitAm |
mumude sA cha taM labdhvA bhartAraM manasepsitam
shlokas.18:
gate pitari sarvANi saMnyasyAbharaNAni sA |
jagRRihe valkalAnyeva vastraM kAShAyameva cha
shlokas.19:
parichArairguNaishchaiva prashrayeNa damena cha |
sarvakAmakriyAbhishcha sarveShAM tuShTimAvahat
shlokas.20:
shvashrUM sharIrasatkAraiH sarvairAchChAdanAdibhiH |
shvashuraM devakAryaishcha vAchaH sa.nyamanena cha
shlokas.21:
tathaiva priyavAdena naipuNena shamena cha |
rahashchaivopachAreNa bhartAraM paryatoShayat
shlokas.22:
evaM tatrAshrame teShAM tadA nivasatAM satAm |
kAlastapasyatAM kashchidatichakrAma bhArata
shlokas.23:
sAvitryAstu shayAnAyAstiShThantyAshcha divAnisham |
nAradena yaduktaM tadvAkyaM manasi vartate

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tataH kAle bahutithe vyatikrAnte kadAchana |
prAptaH sa kAlo martavyaM yatra satyavatA nRRipa
shlokas.2:
gaNayantyAshcha sAvitryA divase divase gate |
tadvAkyaM nAradenoktaM vartate hRRidi nityashaH
shlokas.3:
chaturthe.ahani martavyamiti sa~nchintya bhAminI |
vrataM trirAtramuddishya divArAtraM sthitAbhavat
shlokas.4:
taM shrutvA niyamaM duHkhaM vadhvA duHkhAnvito nRRipaH |
utthAya vAkyaM sAvitrImabravItparisAntvayan
shlokas.5:
atitIvro.ayamArambhastvayArabdho nRRipAtmaje |
tisRRiNAM vasatInAM hi sthAnaM paramaduShkaram
shlokas.6:
sAvitryuvAcha||
na kAryastAta santApaH pArayiShyAmyahaM vratam |
vyavasAyakRRitaM hIdaM vyavasAyashcha kAraNam
shlokas.7:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
vrataM bhindhIti vaktuM tvAM nAsmi shaktaH katha~nchana |
pArayasveti vachanaM yuktamasmadvidho vadet
shlokas.8:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA dyumatseno virarAma mahAmanAH |
tiShThantI chApi sAvitrI kAShThabhUteva lakShyate
shlokas.9:
shvobhUte bhartRRimaraNe sAvitryA bharatarShabha |
duHkhAnvitAyAstiShThantyAH sA rAtrirvyatyavartata
shlokas.10:
adya taddivasaM cheti hutvA dIptaM hutAshanam |
yugamAtrodite sUrye kRRitvA paurvAhNikIH kriyAH
shlokas.11:
tataH sarvAndvijAnvRRiddhA~nshvashrUM shvashurameva cha |
abhivAdyAnupUrvyeNa prA~njalirniyatA sthitA
shlokas.12:
avaidhavyAshiShaste tu sAvitryarthaM hitAH shubhAH |
UchustapasvinaH sarve tapovananivAsinaH
shlokas.13:
evamastviti sAvitrI dhyAnayogaparAyaNA |
manasA tA giraH sarvAH pratyagRRihNAttapasvinAm
shlokas.14:
taM kAlaM cha muhUrtaM cha pratIkShantI nRRipAtmajA |
yathoktaM nAradavachashchintayantI suduHkhitA
shlokas.15:
tatastu shvashrUshvashurAvUchatustAM nRRipAtmajAm |
ekAntasthamidaM vAkyaM prItyA bharatasattama
shlokas.16:
shvashurAvUchatuH||
vrato yathopadiShTo.ayaM yathAvatpAritastvayA |
AhArakAlaH samprAptaH kriyatAM yadanantaram
shlokas.17:
sAvitryuvAcha||
astaM gate mayAditye bhoktavyaM kRRitakAmayA |
eSha me hRRidi sa~NkalpaH samayashcha kRRito mayA
shlokas.18:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evaM sambhAShamANAyAH sAvitryA bhojanaM prati |
skandhe parashumAdAya satyavAnprasthito vanam
shlokas.19:
sAvitrI tvAha bhartAraM naikastvaM gantumarhasi |
saha tvayAgamiShyAmi na hi tvAM hAtumutsahe
shlokas.20:
satyavAnuvAcha||
vanaM na gatapUrvaM te duHkhaH panthAshcha bhAmini |
vratopavAsakShAmA cha kathaM padbhyAM gamiShyasi
shlokas.21:
sAvitryuvAcha||
upavAsAnna me glAnirnAsti chApi parishramaH |
gamane cha kRRitotsAhAM pratiSheddhuM na mArhasi
shlokas.22:
satyavAnuvAcha||
yadi te gamanotsAhaH kariShyAmi tava priyam |
mama tvAmantraya gurUnna mAM doShaH spRRishedayam
shlokas.23:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sAbhigamyAbravIchChvashrUM shvashuraM cha mahAvratA |
ayaM gachChati me bhartA phalAhAro mahAvanam
shlokas.24:
ichCheyamabhyanuj~nAtumAryayA shvashureNa cha |
anena saha nirgantuM na hi me virahaH kShamaH
shlokas.25:
gurvagnihotrArthakRRite prasthitashcha sutastava |
na nivAryo nivAryaH syAdanyathA prasthito vanam
shlokas.26:
sa.nvatsaraH ki~nchidUno na niShkrAntAhamAshramAt |
vanaM kusumitaM draShTuM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.27:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
yataH prabhRRiti sAvitrI pitrA dattA snuShA mama |
nAnayAbhyarthanAyuktamuktapUrvaM smarAmyaham
shlokas.28:
tadeShA labhatAM kAmaM yathAbhilaShitaM vadhUH |
apramAdashcha kartavyaH putri satyavataH pathi
shlokas.29:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ubhAbhyAmabhyanuj~nAtA sA jagAma yashasvinI |
saha bhartrA hasantIva hRRidayena vidUyatA
shlokas.30:
sA vanAni vichitrANi ramaNIyAni sarvashaH |
mayUraravaghuShTAni dadarsha vipulekShaNA
shlokas.31:
nadIH puNyavahAshchaiva puShpitA.nshcha nagottamAn |
satyavAnAha pashyeti sAvitrIM madhurAkSharam
shlokas.32:
nirIkShamANA bhartAraM sarvAvasthamaninditA |
mRRitameva hi taM mene kAle munivachaH smaran
shlokas.33:
anuvartatI tu bhartAraM jagAma mRRidugAminI |
dvidheva hRRidayaM kRRitvA taM cha kAlamavekShatI

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
atha bhAryAsahAyaH sa phalAnyAdAya vIryavAn |
kaThinaM pUrayAmAsa tataH kAShThAnyapATayat
shlokas.2:
tasya pATayataH kAShThaM svedo vai samajAyata |
vyAyAmena cha tenAsya jaj~ne shirasi vedanA
shlokas.3:
so.abhigamya priyAM bhAryAmuvAcha shramapIDitaH |
vyAyAmena mamAnena jAtA shirasi vedanA
shlokas.4:
a~NgAni chaiva sAvitri hRRidayaM dUyatIva cha |
asvasthamiva chAtmAnaM lakShaye mitabhAShiNi
shlokas.5:
shUlairiva shiro viddhamidaM sa.nlakShayAmyaham |
tatsvaptumichChe kalyANi na sthAtuM shaktirasti me
shlokas.6:
samAsAdyAtha sAvitrI bhartAramupagUhya cha |
utsa~Nge.asya shiraH kRRitvA niShasAda mahItale
shlokas.7:
tataH sA nAradavacho vimRRishantI tapasvinI |
taM muhUrtaM kShaNaM velAM divasaM cha yuyoja ha
shlokas.8:
muhUrtAdiva chApashyatpuruShaM pItavAsasam |
baddhamauliM vapuShmantamAdityasamatejasam
shlokas.9:
shyAmAvadAtaM raktAkShaM pAshahastaM bhayAvaham |
sthitaM satyavataH pArshve nirIkShantaM tameva cha
shlokas.10:
taM dRRiShTvA sahasotthAya bharturnyasya shanaiH shiraH |
kRRitA~njaliruvAchArtA hRRidayena pravepatA
shlokas.11:
daivataM tvAbhijAnAmi vapuretaddhyamAnuSham |
kAmayA brUhi me deva kastvaM kiM cha chikIrShasi
shlokas.12:
yama uvAcha||
pativratAsi sAvitri tathaiva cha taponvitA |
atastvAmabhibhAShAmi viddhi mAM tvaM shubhe yamam
shlokas.13:
ayaM te satyavAnbhartA kShINAyuH pArthivAtmajaH |
neShyAmyenamahaM baddhvA viddhyetanme chikIrShitam
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ityuktvA pitRRirAjastAM bhagavAnsvaM chikIrShitam |
yathAvatsarvamAkhyAtuM tatpriyArthaM prachakrame
shlokas.15:
ayaM hi dharmasa.nyukto rUpavAnguNasAgaraH |
nArho matpuruShairnetumato.asmi svayamAgataH
shlokas.16:
tataH satyavataH kAyAtpAshabaddhaM vashaM gatam |
a~NguShThamAtraM puruShaM nishchakarSha yamo balAt
shlokas.17:
tataH samuddhRRitaprANaM gatashvAsaM hataprabham |
nirvicheShTaM sharIraM tadbabhUvApriyadarshanam
shlokas.18:
yamastu taM tathA baddhvA prayAto dakShiNAmukhaH |
sAvitrI chApi duHkhArtA yamamevAnvagachChata
niyamavratasa.nsiddhA mahAbhAgA pativratA
shlokas.19:
yama uvAcha||
nivarta gachCha sAvitri kuruShvAsyaurdhvadehikam |
kRRitaM bhartustvayAnRRiNyaM yAvadgamyaM gataM tvayA
shlokas.20:
sAvitryuvAcha||
yatra me nIyate bhartA svayaM vA yatra gachChati |
mayApi tatra gantavyameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.21:
tapasA guruvRRittyA cha bhartuH snehAdvratena cha |
tava chaiva prasAdena na me pratihatA gatiH
shlokas.22:
prAhuH saptapadaM mitraM budhAstattvArthadarshinaH |
mitratAM cha puraskRRitya ki~nchidvakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.23:
nAnAtmavantastu vane charanti; dharmaM cha vAsaM cha parishramaM cha |
vij~nAnato dharmamudAharanti; tasmAtsanto dharmamAhuH pradhAnam
shlokas.24:
ekasya dharmeNa satAM matena; sarve sma taM mArgamanuprapannAH |
mA vai dvitIyaM mA tRRitIyaM cha vA~nChe; tasmAtsanto dharmamAhuH pradhAnam
shlokas.25:
yama uvAcha||
nivarta tuShTo.asmi tavAnayA girA; svarAkSharavya~njanahetuyuktayA |
varaM vRRiNIShveha vinAsya jIvitaM; dadAni te sarvamanindite varam
shlokas.26:
sAvitryuvAcha||
chyutaH svarAjyAdvanavAsamAshrito; vinaShTachakShuH shvashuro mamAshrame |
sa labdhachakShurbalavAnbhavennRRipa;stava prasAdAjjvalanArkasaMnibhaH
shlokas.27:
yama uvAcha||
dadAni te sarvamanindite varaM; yathA tvayoktaM bhavitA cha tattathA |
tavAdhvanA glAnimivopalakShaye; nivarta gachChasva na te shramo bhavet
shlokas.28:
sAvitryuvAcha||
kutaH shramo bhartRRisamIpato hi me; yato hi bhartA mama sA gatirdhruvA |
yataH patiM neShyasi tatra me gatiH; suresha bhUyashcha vacho nibodha me
shlokas.29:
satAM sakRRitsa~NgatamIpsitaM paraM; tataH paraM mitramiti prachakShate |
na chAphalaM satpuruSheNa sa~NgataM; tataH satAM saMnivasetsamAgame
shlokas.30:
yama uvAcha||
manonukUlaM budhabuddhivardhanaM; tvayAhamukto vachanaM hitAshrayam |
vinA punaH satyavato.asya jIvitaM; varaM dvitIyaM varayasva bhAmini
shlokas.31:
sAvitryuvAcha||
hRRitaM purA me shvashurasya dhImataH; svameva rAjyaM sa labheta pArthivaH |
jahyAtsvadharmaM na cha me gururyathA; dvitIyametaM varayAmi te varam
shlokas.32:
yama uvAcha||
svameva rAjyaM pratipatsyate.achirA;nna cha svadharmAtparihAsyate nRRipaH |
kRRitena kAmena mayA nRRipAtmaje; nivarta gachChasva na te shramo bhavet
shlokas.33:
sAvitryuvAcha||
prajAstvayemA niyamena sa.nyatA; niyamya chaitA nayase na kAmayA |
ato yamatvaM tava deva vishrutaM; nibodha chemAM giramIritAM mayA
shlokas.34:
adrohaH sarvabhUteShu karmaNA manasA girA |
anugrahashcha dAnaM cha satAM dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.35:
evamprAyashcha loko.ayaM manuShyAH shaktipeshalAH |
santastvevApyamitreShu dayAM prApteShu kurvate
shlokas.36:
yama uvAcha||
pipAsitasyeva yathA bhavetpaya;stathA tvayA vAkyamidaM samIritam |
vinA punaH satyavato.asya jIvitaM; varaM vRRiNIShveha shubhe yadichChasi
shlokas.37:
sAvitryuvAcha||
mamAnapatyaH pRRithivIpatiH pitA; bhavetpituH putrashataM mamaurasam |
kulasya santAnakaraM cha yadbhave;ttRRitIyametaM varayAmi te varam
shlokas.38:
yama uvAcha||
kulasya santAnakaraM suvarchasaM; shataM sutAnAM piturastu te shubhe |
kRRitena kAmena narAdhipAtmaje; nivarta dUraM hi pathastvamAgatA
shlokas.39:
sAvitryuvAcha||
na dUrametanmama bhartRRisaMnidhau; mano hi me dUrataraM pradhAvati |
tathA vrajanneva giraM samudyatAM; mayochyamAnAM shRRiNu bhUya eva cha
shlokas.40:
vivasvatastvaM tanayaH pratApavAM;stato hi vaivasvata uchyase budhaiH |
shamena dharmeNa cha ra~njitAH prajA;statastaveheshvara dharmarAjatA
shlokas.41:
Atmanyapi na vishvAsastAvAnbhavati satsu yaH |
tasmAtsatsu visheSheNa sarvaH praNayamichChati
shlokas.42:
sauhRRidAtsarvabhUtAnAM vishvAso nAma jAyate |
tasmAtsatsu visheSheNa vishvAsaM kurute janaH
shlokas.43:
yama uvAcha||
udAhRRitaM te vachanaM yada~Ngane; shubhe na tAdRRiktvadRRite mayA shrutam |
anena tuShTo.asmi vinAsya jIvitaM; varaM chaturthaM varayasva gachCha cha
shlokas.44:
sAvitryuvAcha||
mamAtmajaM satyavatastathaurasaM; bhavedubhAbhyAmiha yatkulodvaham |
shataM sutAnAM balavIryashAlinA;midaM chaturthaM varayAmi te varam
shlokas.45:
yama uvAcha||
shataM sutAnAM balavIryashAlinAM; bhaviShyati prItikaraM tavAbale |
parishramaste na bhavennRRipAtmaje; nivarta dUraM hi pathastvamAgatA
shlokas.46:
sAvitryuvAcha||
satAM sadA shAshvatI dharmavRRittiH; santo na sIdanti na cha vyathanti |
satAM sadbhirnAphalaH sa~Ngamo.asti; sadbhyo bhayaM nAnuvartanti santaH
shlokas.47:
santo hi satyena nayanti sUryaM; santo bhUmiM tapasA dhArayanti |
santo gatirbhUtabhavyasya rAja;nsatAM madhye nAvasIdanti santaH
shlokas.48:
AryajuShTamidaM vRRittamiti vij~nAya shAshvatam |
santaH parArthaM kurvANA nAvekShante pratikriyAm
shlokas.49:
na cha prasAdaH satpuruSheShu mogho; na chApyartho nashyati nApi mAnaH |
yasmAdetanniyataM satsu nityaM; tasmAtsanto rakShitAro bhavanti
shlokas.50:
yama uvAcha||
yathA yathA bhAShasi dharmasaMhitaM; manonukUlaM supadaM mahArthavat |
tathA tathA me tvayi bhaktiruttamA; varaM vRRiNIShvApratimaM yatavrate
shlokas.51:
sAvitryuvAcha||
na te.apavargaH sukRRitAdvinAkRRita;stathA yathAnyeShu vareShu mAnada |
varaM vRRiNe jIvatu satyavAnayaM; yathA mRRitA hyevamahaM vinA patim
shlokas.52:
na kAmaye bhartRRivinAkRRitA sukhaM; na kAmaye bhartRRivinAkRRitA divam |
na kAmaye bhartRRivinAkRRitA shriyaM; na bhartRRihInA vyavasAmi jIvitum
shlokas.53:
varAtisargaH shataputratA mama; tvayaiva datto hriyate cha me patiH |
varaM vRRiNe jIvatu satyavAnayaM; tavaiva satyaM vachanaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.54:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tu tAnpAshAnmuktvA vaivasvato yamaH |
dharmarAjaH prahRRiShTAtmA sAvitrImidamabravIt
shlokas.55:
eSha bhadre mayA mukto bhartA te kulanandini |
arogastava neyashcha siddhArthashcha bhaviShyati
shlokas.56:
