chaturvarShashataM chAyustvayA sArdhamavApsyati |
iShTvA yaj~naishcha dharmeNa khyAtiM loke gamiShyati
shlokas.57:
tvayi putrashataM chaiva satyavA~njanayiShyati |
te chApi sarve rAjAnaH kShatriyAH putrapautriNaH
khyAtAstvannAmadheyAshcha bhaviShyantIha shAshvatAH
shlokas.58:
pitushcha te putrashataM bhavitA tava mAtari |
mAlavyAM mAlavA nAma shAshvatAH putrapautriNaH
bhrAtaraste bhaviShyanti kShatriyAstridashopamAH
shlokas.59:
evaM tasyai varaM dattvA dharmarAjaH pratApavAn |
nivartayitvA sAvitrIM svameva bhavanaM yayau
shlokas.60:
sAvitryapi yame yAte bhartAraM pratilabhya cha |
jagAma tatra yatrAsyA bhartuH shAvaM kalevaram
shlokas.61:
sA bhUmau prekShya bhartAramupasRRityopagUhya cha |
utsa~Nge shira Aropya bhUmAvupavivesha ha
shlokas.62:
sa~nj~nAM cha satyavA.NllabdhvA sAvitrImabhyabhAShata |
proShyAgata iva premNA punaH punarudIkShya vai
shlokas.63:
satyavAnuvAcha||
suchiraM bata supto.asmi kimarthaM nAvabodhitaH |
kva chAsau puruShaH shyAmo yo.asau mAM sa~nchakarSha ha
shlokas.64:
sAvitryuvAcha||
suchiraM bata supto.asi mamA~Nke puruSharShabha |
gataH sa bhagavAndevaH prajAsa.nyamano yamaH
shlokas.65:
vishrAnto.asi mahAbhAga vinidrashcha nRRipAtmaja |
yadi shakyaM samuttiShTha vigADhAM pashya sharvarIm
shlokas.66:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
upalabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM sukhasupta ivotthitaH |
dishaH sarvA vanAntA.nshcha nirIkShyovAcha satyavAn
shlokas.67:
phalAhAro.asmi niShkrAntastvayA saha sumadhyame |
tataH pATayataH kAShThaM shiraso me rujAbhavat
shlokas.68:
shirobhitApasantaptaH sthAtuM chiramashaknuvan |
tavotsa~Nge prasupto.ahamiti sarvaM smare shubhe
shlokas.69:
tvayopagUDhasya cha me nidrayApahRRitaM manaH |
tato.apashyaM tamo ghoraM puruShaM cha mahaujasam
shlokas.70:
tadyadi tvaM vijAnAsi kiM tadbrUhi sumadhyame |
svapno me yadi vA dRRiShTo yadi vA satyameva tat
shlokas.71:
tamuvAchAtha sAvitrI rajanI vyavagAhate |
shvaste sarvaM yathAvRRittamAkhyAsyAmi nRRipAtmaja
shlokas.72:
uttiShThottiShTha bhadraM te pitarau pashya suvrata |
vigADhA rajanI cheyaM nivRRittashcha divAkaraH
shlokas.73:
nakta~ncharAshcharantyete hRRiShTAH krUrAbhibhAShiNaH |
shrUyante parNashabdAshcha mRRigANAM charatAM vane
shlokas.74:
etAH shivA ghoranAdA dishaM dakShiNapashchimAm |
AsthAya viruvantyugrAH kampayantyo mano mama
shlokas.75:
satyavAnuvAcha||
vanaM pratibhayAkAraM ghanena tamasA vRRitam |
na vij~nAsyasi panthAnaM gantuM chaiva na shakShyasi
shlokas.76:
sAvitryuvAcha||
asminnadya vane dagdhe shuShkavRRikShaH sthito jvalan |
vAyunA dhamyamAno.agnirdRRishyate.atra kvachitkvachit
shlokas.77:
tato.agnimAnayitveha jvAlayiShyAmi sarvataH |
kAShThAnImAni santIha jahi santApamAtmanaH
shlokas.78:
yadi notsahase gantuM sarujaM tvAbhilakShaye |
na cha j~nAsyasi panthAnaM tamasA sa.nvRRite vane
shlokas.79:
shvaH prabhAte vane dRRishye yAsyAvo.anumate tava |
vasAveha kShapAmetAM ruchitaM yadi te.anagha
shlokas.80:
satyavAnuvAcha||
shirorujA nivRRittA me svasthAnya~NgAni lakShaye |
mAtApitRRibhyAmichChAmi sa~NgamaM tvatprasAdajam
shlokas.81:
na kadAchidvikAle hi gatapUrvo mayAshramaH |
anAgatAyAM sandhyAyAM mAtA me praruNaddhi mAm
shlokas.82:
divApi mayi niShkrAnte santapyete gurU mama |
vichinoti cha mAM tAtaH sahaivAshramavAsibhiH
shlokas.83:
mAtrA pitrA cha subhRRishaM duHkhitAbhyAmahaM purA |
upAlabdhaH subahushashchireNAgachChasIti ha
shlokas.84:
kA tvavasthA tayoradya madarthamiti chintaye |
tayoradRRishye mayi cha mahadduHkhaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.85:
purA mAmUchatushchaiva rAtrAvasrAyamANakau |
bhRRishaM suduHkhitau vRRiddhau bahushaH prItisa.nyutau
shlokas.86:
tvayA hInau na jIvAva muhUrtamapi putraka |
yAvaddhariShyase putra tAvannau jIvitaM dhruvam
shlokas.87:
vRRiddhayorandhayoryaShTistvayi va.nshaH pratiShThitaH |
tvayi piNDashcha kIrtishcha santAnaM chAvayoriti
shlokas.88:
mAtA vRRiddhA pitA vRRiddhastayoryaShTirahaM kila |
tau rAtrau mAmapashyantau kAmavasthAM gamiShyataH
shlokas.89:
nidrAyAshchAbhyasUyAmi yasyA hetoH pitA mama |
mAtA cha sa.nshayaM prAptA matkRRite.anapakAriNI
shlokas.90:
ahaM cha sa.nshayaM prAptaH kRRichChrAmApadamAsthitaH |
mAtApitRRibhyAM hi vinA nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
shlokas.91:
vyaktamAkulayA buddhyA praj~nAchakShuH pitA mama |
ekaikamasyAM velAyAM pRRichChatyAshramavAsinam
shlokas.92:
nAtmAnamanushochAmi yathAhaM pitaraM shubhe |
bhartAraM chApyanugatAM mAtaraM paridurbalAm
shlokas.93:
matkRRitena hi tAvadya santApaM parameShyataH |
jIvantAvanujIvAmi bhartavyau tau mayeti ha
tayoH priyaM me kartavyamiti jIvAmi chApyaham
shlokas.94:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA guruvartI gurupriyaH |
uchChritya bAhU duHkhArtaH sasvaraM praruroda ha
shlokas.95:
tato.abravIttathA dRRiShTvA bhartAraM shokakarshitam |
pramRRijyAshrUNi netrAbhyAM sAvitrI dharmachAriNI
shlokas.96:
yadi me.asti tapastaptaM yadi dattaM hutaM yadi |
shvashrUshvashurabhartR^INAM mama puNyAstu sharvarI
shlokas.97:
na smarAmyuktapUrvAM vai svaireShvapyanRRitAM giram |
tena satyena tAvadya dhriyetAM shvashurau mama
shlokas.98:
satyavAnuvAcha||
kAmaye darshanaM pitroryAhi sAvitri mAchiram |
purA mAtuH piturvApi yadi pashyAmi vipriyam
na jIviShye varArohe satyenAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.99:
yadi dharme cha te buddhirmAM chejjIvantamichChasi |
mama priyaM vA kartavyaM gachChasvAshramamantikAt
shlokas.100:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
sAvitrI tata utthAya keshAnsa.nyamya bhAminI |
patimutthApayAmAsa bAhubhyAM parigRRihya vai
shlokas.101:
utthAya satyavA.nshchApi pramRRijyA~NgAni pANinA |
dishaH sarvAH samAlokya kaThine dRRiShTimAdadhe
shlokas.102:
tamuvAchAtha sAvitrI shvaH phalAnIha neShyasi |
yogakShemArthametatte neShyAmi parashuM tvaham
shlokas.103:
kRRitvA kaThinabhAraM sA vRRikShashAkhAvalambinam |
gRRihItvA parashuM bhartuH sakAshaM punarAgamat
shlokas.104:
vAme skandhe tu vAmorUrbharturbAhuM niveshya sA |
dakShiNena pariShvajya jagAma mRRidugAminI
shlokas.105:
satyavAnuvAcha||
abhyAsagamanAdbhIru panthAno viditA mama |
vRRikShAntarAlokitayA jyotsnayA chApi lakShaye
shlokas.106:
Agatau svaH pathA yena phalAnyavachitAni cha |
yathAgataM shubhe gachCha panthAnaM mA vichAraya
shlokas.107:
palAshaShaNDe chaitasminpanthA vyAvartate dvidhA |
tasyottareNa yaH panthAstena gachCha tvarasva cha
svastho.asmi balavAnasmi didRRikShuH pitarAvubhau

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu dyumatseno mahAvane |
labdhachakShuH prasannAtmA dRRiShTyA sarvaM dadarsha ha
shlokas.2:
sa sarvAnAshramAngatvA shaibyayA saha bhAryayA |
putrahetoH parAmArtiM jagAma manujarShabha
shlokas.3:
tAvAshramAnnadIshchaiva vanAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
tA.nstAndeshAnvichinvantau dampatI parijagmatuH
shlokas.4:
shrutvA shabdaM tu yatki~nchidunmukhau sutasha~NkayA |
sAvitrIsahito.abhyeti satyavAnityadhAvatAm
shlokas.5:
bhinnaishcha paruShaiH pAdaiH savraNaiH shoNitokShitaiH |
kushakaNTakaviddhA~NgAvunmattAviva dhAvataH
shlokas.6:
tato.abhisRRitya tairvipraiH sarvairAshramavAsibhiH |
parivArya samAshvAsya samAnItau svamAshramam
shlokas.7:
tatra bhAryAsahAyaH sa vRRito vRRiddhaistapodhanaiH |
AshvAsito vichitrArthaiH pUrvarAj~nAM kathAshrayaiH
shlokas.8:
tatastau punarAshvastau vRRiddhau putradidRRikShayA |
bAlye vRRittAni putrasya smarantau bhRRishaduHkhitau
shlokas.9:
punaruktvA cha karuNAM vAchaM tau shokakarshitau |
hA putra hA sAdhvi vadhUH kvAsi kvAsItyarodatAm
shlokas.10:
suvarchA uvAcha||
yathAsya bhAryA sAvitrI tapasA cha damena cha |
AchAreNa cha sa.nyuktA tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.11:
gautama uvAcha||
vedAH sA~NgA mayAdhItAstapo me sa~nchitaM mahat |
kaumAraM brahmacharyaM me guravo.agnishcha toShitAH
shlokas.12:
samAhitena chIrNAni sarvANyeva vratAni me |
vAyubhakShopavAsashcha kushalAni cha yAni me
shlokas.13:
anena tapasA vedmi sarvaM parichikIrShitam |
satyametannibodha tvaM dhriyate satyavAniti
shlokas.14:
shiShya uvAcha||
upAdhyAyasya me vaktrAdyathA vAkyaM viniHsRRitam |
naitajjAtu bhavenmithyA tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.15:
RRiShaya UchuH||
yathAsya bhAryA sAvitrI sarvaireva sulakShaNaiH |
avaidhavyakarairyuktA tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.16:
bhAradvAja uvAcha||
yathAsya bhAryA sAvitrI tapasA cha damena cha |
AchAreNa cha sa.nyuktA tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.17:
dAlbhya uvAcha||
yathA dRRiShTiH pravRRittA te sAvitryAshcha yathA vratam |
gatAhAramakRRitvA cha tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.18:
mANDavya uvAcha||
yathA vadanti shAntAyAM dishi vai mRRigapakShiNaH |
pArthivI cha pravRRittiste tathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.19:
dhaumya uvAcha||
sarvairguNairupetaste yathA putro janapriyaH |
dIrghAyurlakShaNopetastathA jIvati satyavAn
shlokas.20:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
evamAshvAsitastaistu satyavAgbhistapasvibhiH |
tA.nstAnvigaNayannarthAnavasthita ivAbhavat
shlokas.21:
tato muhUrtAtsAvitrI bhartrA satyavatA saha |
AjagAmAshramaM rAtrau prahRRiShTA pravivesha ha
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
putreNa sa~NgataM tvAdya chakShuShmantaM nirIkShya cha |
sarve vayaM vai pRRichChAmo vRRiddhiM te pRRithivIpate
shlokas.23:
samAgamena putrasya sAvitryA darshanena cha |
chakShuShashchAtmano lAbhAttribhirdiShTyA vivardhase
shlokas.24:
sarvairasmAbhiruktaM yattathA tannAtra sa.nshayaH |
bhUyo bhUyashcha vRRiddhiste kShiprameva bhaviShyati
shlokas.25:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tato.agniM tatra sa~njvAlya dvijAste sarva eva hi |
upAsAM chakrire pArtha dyumatsenaM mahIpatim
shlokas.26:
shaibyA cha satyavA.nshchaiva sAvitrI chaikataH sthitAH |
sarvaistairabhyanuj~nAtA vishokAH samupAvishan
shlokas.27:
tato rAj~nA sahAsInAH sarve te vanavAsinaH |
jAtakautUhalAH pArtha paprachChurnRRipateH sutam
shlokas.28:
prAgeva nAgataM kasmAtsabhAryeNa tvayA vibho |
virAtre chAgataM kasmAtko.anubandhashcha te.abhavat
shlokas.29:
santApitaH pitA mAtA vayaM chaiva nRRipAtmaja |
nAkasmAditi jAnImastatsarvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.30:
satyavAnuvAcha||
pitrAhamabhyanuj~nAtaH sAvitrIsahito gataH |
atha me.abhUchChiroduHkhaM vane kAShThAni bhindataH
shlokas.31:
suptashchAhaM vedanayA chiramityupalakShaye |
tAvatkAlaM cha na mayA suptapUrvaM kadAchana
shlokas.32:
sarveShAmeva bhavatAM santApo mA bhavediti |
ato virAtrAgamanaM nAnyadastIha kAraNam
shlokas.33:
gautama uvAcha||
akasmAchchakShuShaH prAptirdyumatsenasya te pituH |
nAsya tvaM kAraNaM vettha sAvitrI vaktumarhati
shlokas.34:
shrotumichChAmi sAvitri tvaM hi vettha parAvaram |
tvAM hi jAnAmi sAvitri sAvitrImiva tejasA
shlokas.35:
tvamatra hetuM jAnIShe tasmAtsatyaM niruchyatAm |
rahasyaM yadi te nAsti ki~nchidatra vadasva naH
shlokas.36:
sAvitryuvAcha||
evametadyathA vettha sa~Nkalpo nAnyathA hi vaH |
na cha ki~nchidrahasyaM me shrUyatAM tathyamatra yat
shlokas.37:
mRRityurme bharturAkhyAto nAradena mahAtmanA |
sa chAdya divasaH prAptastato nainaM jahAmyaham
shlokas.38:
suptaM chainaM yamaH sAkShAdupAgachChatsaki~NkaraH |
sa enamanayadbaddhvA dishaM pitRRiniShevitAm
shlokas.39:
astauShaM tamahaM devaM satyena vachasA vibhum |
pa~ncha vai tena me dattA varAH shRRiNuta tAnmama
shlokas.40:
chakShuShI cha svarAjyaM cha dvau varau shvashurasya me |
labdhaM pituH putrashataM putrANAmAtmanaH shatam
shlokas.41:
chaturvarShashatAyurme bhartA labdhashcha satyavAn |
bharturhi jIvitArthaM tu mayA chIrNaM sthiraM vratam
shlokas.42:
etatsatyaM mayAkhyAtaM kAraNaM vistareNa vaH |
yathA vRRittaM sukhodarkamidaM duHkhaM mahanmama
shlokas.43:
RRiShaya UchuH||
nimajjamAnaM vyasanairabhidrutaM; kulaM narendrasya tamomaye hrade |
tvayA sushIle dhRRitadharmapuNyayA; samuddhRRitaM sAdhvi punaH kulInayA
shlokas.44:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tathA prashasya hyabhipUjya chaiva te; varastriyaM tAmRRiShayaH samAgatAH |
narendramAmantrya saputrama~njasA; shivena jagmurmuditAH svamAlayam

shlokas.1:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
tasyAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAmudite sUryamaNDale |
kRRitapUrvAhNikAH sarve sameyuste tapodhanAH
shlokas.2:
tadeva sarvaM sAvitryA mahAbhAgyaM maharShayaH |
dyumatsenAya nAtRRipyankathayantaH punaH punaH
shlokas.3:
tataH prakRRitayaH sarvAH shAlvebhyo.abhyAgatA nRRipa |
AchakhyurnihataM chaiva svenAmAtyena taM nRRipam
shlokas.4:
taM mantriNA hataM shrutvA sasahAyaM sabAndhavam |
nyavedayanyathAtattvaM vidrutaM cha dviShadbalam
shlokas.5:
aikamatyaM cha sarvasya janasyAtha nRRipaM prati |
sachakShurvApyachakShurvA sa no rAjA bhavatviti
shlokas.6:
anena nishchayeneha vayaM prasthApitA nRRipa |
prAptAnImAni yAnAni chatura~NgaM cha te balam
shlokas.7:
prayAhi rAjanbhadraM te ghuShTaste nagare jayaH |
adhyAssva chirarAtrAya pitRRipaitAmahaM padam
shlokas.8:
chakShuShmantaM cha taM dRRiShTvA rAjAnaM vapuShAnvitam |
mUrdhabhiH patitAH sarve vismayotphullalochanAH
shlokas.9:
tato.abhivAdya tAnvRRiddhAndvijAnAshramavAsinaH |
taishchAbhipUjitaH sarvaiH prayayau nagaraM prati
shlokas.10:
shaibyA cha saha sAvitryA svAstIrNena suvarchasA |
narayuktena yAnena prayayau senayA vRRitA
shlokas.11:
tato.abhiShiShichuH prItyA dyumatsenaM purohitAH |
putraM chAsya mahAtmAnaM yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayan
shlokas.12:
tataH kAlena mahatA sAvitryAH kIrtivardhanam |
tadvai putrashataM jaj~ne shUrANAmanivartinAm
shlokas.13:
bhrAtR^INAM sodarANAM cha tathaivAsyAbhavachChatam |
madrAdhipasyAshvapatermAlavyAM sumahAbalam
shlokas.14:
evamAtmA pitA mAtA shvashrUH shvashura eva cha |
bhartuH kulaM cha sAvitryA sarvaM kRRichChrAtsamuddhRRitam
shlokas.15:
tathaivaiShApi kalyANI draupadI shIlasaMmatA |
tArayiShyati vaH sarvAnsAvitrIva kulA~NganA
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sa pANDavastena anunIto mahAtmanA |
vishoko vijvaro rAjankAmyake nyavasattadA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yattattadA mahAbrahma.Nllomasho vAkyamabravIt |
indrasya vachanAdetya pANDuputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
yachchApi te bhayaM tIvraM na cha kIrtayase kvachit |
tachchApyapahariShyAmi savyasAchAvihAgate
shlokas.3:
kiM nu tadviduShAM shreShTha karNaM prati mahadbhayam |
AsInna cha sa dharmAtmA kathayAmAsa kasyachit
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ahaM te rAjashArdUla kathayAmi kathAmimAm |
pRRichChate bharatashreShTha shushrUShasva giraM mama
shlokas.5:
dvAdashe samatikrAnte varShe prApte trayodashe |
pANDUnAM hitakRRichChakraH karNaM bhikShitumudyataH
shlokas.6:
abhiprAyamatho j~nAtvA mahendrasya vibhAvasuH |
kuNDalArthe mahArAja sUryaH karNamupAgamat
shlokas.7:
mahArhe shayane vIraM spardhyAstaraNasa.nvRRite |
shayAnamabhivishvastaM brahmaNyaM satyavAdinam
shlokas.8:
svapnAnte nishi rAjendra darshayAmAsa rashmivAn |
kRRipayA parayAviShTaH putrasnehAchcha bhArata
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNo vedavidbhUtvA sUryo yogAddhi rUpavAn |
hitArthamabravItkarNaM sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.10:
karNa madvachanaM tAta shRRiNu satyabhRRitAM vara |
bruvato.adya mahAbAho sauhRRidAtparamaM hitam
shlokas.11:
upAyAsyati shakrastvAM pANDavAnAM hitepsayA |
brAhmaNachChadmanA karNa kuNDalApajihIrShayA
shlokas.12:
viditaM tena shIlaM te sarvasya jagatastathA |
yathA tvaM bhikShitaH sadbhirdadAsyeva na yAchase
shlokas.13:
tvaM hi tAta dadAsyeva brAhmaNebhyaH prayAchitaH |
vittaM yachchAnyadapyAhurna pratyAkhyAsi karhichit
shlokas.14:
taM tvAmeva.nvidhaM j~nAtvA svayaM vai pAkashAsanaH |
AgantA kuNDalArthAya kavachaM chaiva bhikShitum
shlokas.15:
tasmai prayAchamAnAya na deye kuNDale tvayA |
anuneyaH paraM shaktyA shreya etaddhi te param
shlokas.16:
kuNDalArthe bruva.nstAta kAraNairbahubhistvayA |
anyairbahuvidhairvittaiH sa nivAryaH punaH punaH
shlokas.17:
ratnaiH strIbhistathA bhogairdhanairbahuvidhairapi |
nidarshanaishcha bahubhiH kuNDalepsuH pura.ndaraH
shlokas.18:
yadi dAsyasi karNa tvaM sahaje kuNDale shubhe |
AyuShaH prakShayaM gatvA mRRityorvashamupeShyasi
shlokas.19:
kavachena cha sa.nyuktaH kuNDalAbhyAM cha mAnada |
avadhyastvaM raNe.arINAmiti viddhi vacho mama
shlokas.20:
amRRitAdutthitaM hyetadubhayaM ratnasambhavam |
tasmAdrakShyaM tvayA karNa jIvitaM chetpriyaM tava
shlokas.21:
karNa uvAcha||
ko mAmevaM bhavAnprAha darshayansauhRRidaM param |
kAmayA bhagavanbrUhi ko bhavAndvijaveShadhRRik
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ahaM tAta sahasrA.nshuH sauhRRidAttvAM nidarshaye |
kuruShvaitadvacho me tvametachChreyaH paraM hi te
shlokas.23:
karNa uvAcha||
shreya eva mamAtyantaM yasya me gopatiH prabhuH |
pravaktAdya hitAnveShI shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.24:
prasAdaye tvAM varadaM praNayAchcha bravImyaham |
na nivAryo vratAdasmAdahaM yadyasmi te priyaH
shlokas.25:
vrataM vai mama loko.ayaM vetti kRRitsno vibhAvaso |
yathAhaM dvijamukhyebhyo dadyAM prANAnapi dhruvam
shlokas.26:
yadyAgachChati shakro mAM brAhmaNachChadmanAvRRitaH |
hitArthaM pANDuputrANAM khecharottama bhikShitum
shlokas.27:
dAsyAmi vibudhashreShTha kuNDale varma chottamam |
na me kIrtiH praNashyeta triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.28:
madvidhasyAyashasyaM hi na yuktaM prANarakShaNam |
yuktaM hi yashasA yuktaM maraNaM lokasaMmatam
shlokas.29:
so.ahamindrAya dAsyAmi kuNDale saha varmaNA |
yadi mAM balavRRitraghno bhikShArthamupayAsyati
shlokas.30:
hitArthaM pANDuputrANAM kuNDale me prayAchitum |
tanme kIrtikaraM loke tasyAkIrtirbhaviShyati
shlokas.31:
vRRiNomi kIrtiM loke hi jIvitenApi bhAnuman |
kIrtimAnashnute svargaM hInakIrtistu nashyati
shlokas.32:
kIrtirhi puruShaM loke sa~njIvayati mAtRRivat |
akIrtirjIvitaM hanti jIvato.api sharIriNaH
shlokas.33:
ayaM purANaH shloko hi svayaM gIto vibhAvaso |
dhAtrA lokeshvara yathA kIrtirAyurnarasya vai
shlokas.34:
puruShasya pare loke kIrtireva parAyaNam |
iha loke vishuddhA cha kIrtirAyurvivardhanI
shlokas.35:
so.ahaM sharIraje dattvA kIrtiM prApsyAmi shAshvatIm |
dattvA cha vidhivaddAnaM brAhmaNebhyo yathAvidhi
shlokas.36:
hutvA sharIraM sa~NgrAme kRRitvA karma suduShkaram |
vijitya vA parAnAjau yashaH prApsyAmi kevalam
shlokas.37:
bhItAnAmabhayaM dattvA sa~NgrAme jIvitArthinAm |
vRRiddhAnbAlAndvijAtI.nshcha mokShayitvA mahAbhayAt
shlokas.38:
prApsyAmi paramaM loke yashaH svarbhAnusUdana |
jIvitenApi me rakShyA kIrtistadviddhi me vratam
shlokas.39:
so.ahaM dattvA maghavate bhikShAmetAmanuttamAm |
brAhmaNachChadmine deva loke gantA parAM gatim

shlokas.1:
sUrya uvAcha||
mAhitaM karNa kArShIstvamAtmanaH suhRRidAM tathA |
putrANAmatha bhAryANAmatho mAturatho pituH
shlokas.2:
sharIrasyAvirodhena prANinAM prANabhRRidvara |
iShyate yashasaH prAptiH kIrtishcha tridive sthirA
shlokas.3:
yastvaM prANavirodhena kIrtimichChasi shAshvatIm |
sA te prANAnsamAdAya gamiShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
jIvatAM kurute kAryaM pitA mAtA sutAstathA |
ye chAnye bAndhavAH kechilloke.asminpuruSharShabha
rAjAnashcha naravyAghra pauruSheNa nibodha tat
shlokas.5:
kIrtishcha jIvataH sAdhvI puruShasya mahAdyute |
mRRitasya kIrtyA kiM kAryaM bhasmIbhUtasya dehinaH
mRRitaH kIrtiM na jAnAti jIvankIrtiM samashnute
shlokas.6:
mRRitasya kIrtirmartyasya yathA mAlA gatAyuShaH |
ahaM tu tvAM bravImyetadbhakto.asIti hitepsayA
shlokas.7:
bhaktimanto hi me rakShyA ityetenApi hetunA |
bhakto.ayaM parayA bhaktyA mAmityeva mahAbhuja
mamApi bhaktirutpannA sa tvaM kuru vacho mama
shlokas.8:
asti chAtra paraM ki~nchidadhyAtmaM devanirmitam |
atashcha tvAM bravImyetatkriyatAmavisha~NkayA
shlokas.9:
devaguhyaM tvayA j~nAtuM na shakyaM puruSharShabha |
tasmAnnAkhyAmi te guhyaM kAle vetsyati tadbhavAn
shlokas.10:
punaruktaM cha vakShyAmi tvaM rAdheya nibodha tat |
mAsmai te kuNDale dadyA bhikShave vajrapANaye
shlokas.11:
shobhase kuNDalAbhyAM hi ruchirAbhyAM mahAdyute |
vishAkhayormadhyagataH shashIva vimalo divi
shlokas.12:
kIrtishcha jIvataH sAdhvI puruShasyeti viddhi tat |
pratyAkhyeyastvayA tAta kuNDalArthe pura.ndaraH
shlokas.13:
shakyA bahuvidhairvAkyaiH kuNDalepsA tvayAnagha |
vihantuM devarAjasya hetuyuktaiH punaH punaH
shlokas.14:
upapattyupapannArthairmAdhuryakRRitabhUShaNaiH |
pura.ndarasya karNa tvaM buddhimetAmapAnuda
shlokas.15:
tva hi nityaM naravyAghra spardhase savyasAchinA |
savyasAchI tvayA chaiva yudhi shUraH sameShyati
shlokas.16:
na tu tvAmarjunaH shaktaH kuNDalAbhyAM samanvitam |
vijetuM yudhi yadyasya svayamindraH sharo bhavet
shlokas.17:
tasmAnna deye shakrAya tvayaite kuNDale shubhe |
sa~NgrAme yadi nirjetuM karNa kAmayase.arjunam

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
bhagavantamahaM bhakto yathA mAM vettha gopate |
tathA paramatigmA.nsho nAnyaM devaM katha~nchana
shlokas.2:
na me dArA na me putrA na chAtmA suhRRido na cha |
tatheShTA vai sadA bhaktyA yathA tvaM gopate mama
shlokas.3:
iShTAnAM cha mahAtmAno bhaktAnAM cha na sa.nshayaH |
kurvanti bhaktimiShTAM cha jAnIShe tvaM cha bhAskara
shlokas.4:
iShTo bhaktashcha me karNo na chAnyaddaivataM divi |
jAnIta iti vai kRRitvA bhagavAnAha maddhitam
shlokas.5:
bhUyashcha shirasA yAche prasAdya cha punaH punaH |
iti bravImi tigmA.nsho tvaM tu me kShantumarhasi
shlokas.6:
bibhemi na tathA mRRityoryathA bibhye.anRRitAdaham |
visheSheNa dvijAtInAM sarveShAM sarvadA satAm
pradAne jIvitasyApi na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.7:
yachcha mAmAttha deva tvaM pANDavaM phalgunaM prati |
vyetu santApajaM duHkhaM tava bhAskara mAnasam
arjunaM prati mAM chaiva vijeShyAmi raNe.arjunam
shlokas.8:
tavApi viditaM deva mamApyastrabalaM mahat |
jAmadagnyAdupAttaM yattathA droNAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
idaM tvamanujAnIhi surashreShTha vrataM mama |
bhikShate vajriNe dadyAmapi jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
sUrya uvAcha||
yadi tAta dadAsyete vajriNe kuNDale shubhe |
tvamapyenamatho brUyA vijayArthaM mahAbala
shlokas.11:
niyamena pradadyAstvaM kuNDale vai shatakratoH |
avadhyo hyasi bhUtAnAM kuNDalAbhyAM samanvitaH
shlokas.12:
arjunena vinAshaM hi tava dAnavasUdanaH |
prArthayAno raNe vatsa kuNDale te jihIrShati
shlokas.13:
sa tvamapyenamArAdhya sUnRRitAbhiH punaH punaH |
abhyarthayethA deveshamamoghArthaM pura.ndaram
shlokas.14:
amoghAM dehi me shaktimamitravinibarhiNIm |
dAsyAmi te sahasrAkSha kuNDale varma chottamam
shlokas.15:
ityevaM niyamena tvaM dadyAH shakrAya kuNDale |
tayA tvaM karNa sa~NgrAme haniShyasi raNe ripUn
shlokas.16:
nAhatvA hi mahAbAho shatrUneti karaM punaH |
sA shaktirdevarAjasya shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA sahasrA.nshuH sahasAntaradhIyata |
tataH sUryAya japyAnte karNaH svapnaM nyavedayat
shlokas.18:
yathAdRRiShTaM yathAtattvaM yathoktamubhayornishi |
tatsarvamAnupUrvyeNa shasha.nsAsmai vRRiShastadA
shlokas.19:
tachChrutvA bhagavAndevo bhAnuH svarbhAnusUdanaH |
uvAcha taM tathetyeva karNaM sUryaH smayanniva
shlokas.20:
tatastattvamiti j~nAtvA rAdheyaH paravIrahA |
shaktimevAbhikA~NkShanvai vAsavaM pratyapAlayat

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kiM tadguhyaM na chAkhyAtaM karNAyehoShNarashminA |
kIdRRishe kuNDale te cha kavachaM chaiva kIdRRisham
shlokas.2:
kutashcha kavachaM tasya kuNDale chaiva sattama |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tanme brUhi tapodhana
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ayaM rAjanbravImyetadyattadguhyaM vibhAvasoH |
yAdRRishe kuNDale chaiva kavachaM chaiva yAdRRisham
shlokas.4:
kuntibhojaM purA rAjanbrAhmaNaH samupasthitaH |
tigmatejA mahAprA.nshuH shmashrudaNDajaTAdharaH
shlokas.5:
darshanIyo.anavadyA~NgastejasA prajvalanniva |
madhupi~Ngo madhuravAktapaHsvAdhyAyabhUShaNaH
shlokas.6:
sa rAjAnaM kuntibhojamabravItsumahAtapAH |
bhikShAmichChAmyahaM bhoktuM tava gehe vimatsara
shlokas.7:
na me vyalIkaM kartavyaM tvayA vA tava chAnugaiH |
evaM vatsyAmi te gehe yadi te rochate.anagha
shlokas.8:
yathAkAmaM cha gachCheyamAgachCheyaM tathaiva cha |
shayyAsane cha me rAjannAparAdhyeta kashchana
shlokas.9:
tamabravItkuntibhojaH prItiyuktamidaM vachaH |
evamastu paraM cheti punashchainamathAbravIt
shlokas.10:
mama kanyA mahAbrahmanpRRithA nAma yashasvinI |
shIlavRRittAnvitA sAdhvI niyatA na cha mAninI
shlokas.11:
upasthAsyati sA tvAM vai pUjayAnavamanya cha |
tasyAshcha shIlavRRittena tuShTiM samupayAsyasi
shlokas.12:
evamuktvA tu taM vipramabhipUjya yathAvidhi |
uvAcha kanyAmabhyetya pRRithAM pRRithulalochanAm
shlokas.13:
ayaM vatse mahAbhAgo brAhmaNo vastumichChati |
mama gehe mayA chAsya tathetyevaM pratishrutam
shlokas.14:
tvayi vatse parAshvasya brAhmaNasyAbhirAdhanam |
tanme vAkyaM na mithyA tvaM kartumarhasi karhichit
shlokas.15:
ayaM tapasvI bhagavAnsvAdhyAyaniyato dvijaH |
yadyadbrUyAnmahAtejAstattaddeyamamatsarAt
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNA hi paraM tejo brAhmaNA hi paraM tapaH |
brAhmaNAnAM namaskAraiH sUryo divi virAjate
shlokas.17:
amAnayanhi mAnArhAnvAtApishcha mahAsuraH |
nihato brahmadaNDena tAlaja~Nghastathaiva cha
shlokas.18:
so.ayaM vatse mahAbhAra Ahitastvayi sAmpratam |
tvaM sadA niyatA kuryA brAhmaNasyAbhirAdhanam
shlokas.19:
jAnAmi praNidhAnaM te bAlyAtprabhRRiti nandini |
brAhmaNeShviha sarveShu gurubandhuShu chaiva ha
shlokas.20:
tathA preShyeShu sarveShu mitrasambandhimAtRRiShu |
mayi chaiva yathAvattvaM sarvamAdRRitya vartase
shlokas.21:
na hyatuShTo jano.astIha pure chAntaHpure cha te |
samyagvRRittyAnavadyA~Ngi tava bhRRityajaneShvapi
shlokas.22:
sa.ndeShTavyAM tu manye tvAM dvijAtiM kopanaM prati |
pRRithe bAleti kRRitvA vai sutA chAsi mameti cha
shlokas.23:
vRRiShNInAM tvaM kule jAtA shUrasya dayitA sutA |
dattA prItimatA mahyaM pitrA bAlA purA svayam
shlokas.24:
vasudevasya bhaginI sutAnAM pravarA mama |
agryamagre pratij~nAya tenAsi duhitA mama
shlokas.25:
tAdRRishe hi kule jAtA kule chaiva vivardhitA |
sukhAtsukhamanuprAptA hradAddhradamivAgatA
shlokas.26:
dauShkuleyA visheSheNa katha~nchitpragrahaM gatAH |
bAlabhAvAdvikurvanti prAyashaH pramadAH shubhe
shlokas.27:
pRRithe rAjakule janma rUpaM chAdbhutadarshanam |
tena tenAsi sampannA samupetA cha bhAminI
shlokas.28:
sA tvaM darpaM parityajya dambhaM mAnaM cha bhAmini |
ArAdhya varadaM vipraM shreyasA yokShyase pRRithe
shlokas.29:
evaM prApsyasi kalyANi kalyANamanaghe dhruvam |
kopite tu dvijashreShThe kRRitsnaM dahyeta me kulam

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
brAhmaNaM yantritA rAjanupasthAsyAmi pUjayA |
yathApratij~naM rAjendra na cha mithyA bravImyaham
shlokas.2:
eSha chaiva svabhAvo me pUjayeyaM dvijAniti |
tava chaiva priyaM kAryaM shreyashchaitatparaM mama
shlokas.3:
yadyevaiShyati sAyAhne yadi prAtaratho nishi |
yadyardharAtre bhagavAnna me kopaM kariShyati
shlokas.4:
lAbho mamaiSha rAjendra yadvai pUjayatI dvijAn |
Adeshe tava tiShThantI hitaM kuryAM narottama
shlokas.5:
visrabdho bhava rAjendra na vyalIkaM dvijottamaH |
vasanprApsyati te gehe satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.6:
yatpriyaM cha dvijasyAsya hitaM chaiva tavAnagha |
yatiShyAmi tathA rAjanvyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNA hi mahAbhAgAH pUjitAH pRRithivIpate |
tAraNAya samarthAH syurviparIte vadhAya cha
shlokas.8:
sAhametadvijAnantI toShayiShye dvijottamam |
na matkRRite vyathAM rAjanprApsyasi dvijasattamAt
shlokas.9:
aparAdhe hi rAjendra rAj~nAmashreyase dvijAH |
bhavanti chyavano yadvatsukanyAyAH kRRite purA
shlokas.10:
niyamena pareNAhamupasthAsye dvijottamam |
yathA tvayA narendredaM bhAShitaM brAhmaNaM prati
shlokas.11:
rAjovAcha||
evametattvayA bhadre kartavyamavisha~NkayA |
maddhitArthaM kulArthaM cha tathAtmArthaM cha nandini
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu tAM kanyAM kuntibhojo mahAyashAH |
pRRithAM paridadau tasmai dvijAya sutavatsalaH
shlokas.13:
iyaM brahmanmama sutA bAlA sukhavivardhitA |
aparAdhyeta yatki~nchinna tatkAryaM hRRidi tvayA
shlokas.14:
dvijAtayo mahAbhAgA vRRiddhabAlatapasviShu |
bhavantyakrodhanAH prAyo viruddheShvapi nityadA
shlokas.15:
sumahatyaparAdhe.api kShAntiH kAryA dvijAtibhiH |
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM pUjA grAhyA dvijottama
shlokas.16:
tatheti brAhmaNenokte sa rAjA prItamAnasaH |
ha.nsachandrA.nshusa~NkAshaM gRRihamasya nyavedayat
shlokas.17:
tatrAgnisharaNe kL^iptamAsanaM tasya bhAnumat |
AhArAdi cha sarvaM tattathaiva pratyavedayat
shlokas.18:
nikShipya rAjaputrI tu tandrIM mAnaM tathaiva cha |
Atasthe paramaM yatnaM brAhmaNasyAbhirAdhane
shlokas.19:
tatra sA brAhmaNaM gatvA pRRithA shauchaparA satI |
vidhivatparichArArhaM devavatparyatoShayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tu kanyA mahArAja brAhmaNaM sa.nshitavratam |
toShayAmAsa shuddhena manasA sa.nshitavratA
shlokas.2:
prAtarAyAsya ityuktvA kadAchiddvijasattamaH |
tata AyAti rAjendra sAye rAtrAvatho punaH
shlokas.3:
taM cha sarvAsu velAsu bhakShyabhojyapratishrayaiH |
pUjayAmAsa sA kanyA vardhamAnaistu sarvadA
shlokas.4:
annAdisamudAchAraH shayyAsanakRRitastathA |
divase divase tasya vardhate na tu hIyate
shlokas.5:
nirbhartsanApavAdaishcha tathaivApriyayA girA |
brAhmaNasya pRRithA rAjanna chakArApriyaM tadA
shlokas.6:
vyaste kAle punashchaiti na chaiti bahusho dvijaH |
durlabhyamapi chaivAnnaM dIyatAmiti so.abravIt
shlokas.7:
kRRitameva cha tatsarvaM pRRithA tasmai nyavedayat |
shiShyavatputravachchaiva svasRRivachcha susa.nyatA
shlokas.8:
yathopajoShaM rAjendra dvijAtipravarasya sA |
prItimutpAdayAmAsa kanyA yatnairaninditA
shlokas.9:
tasyAstu shIlavRRittena tutoSha dvijasattamaH |
avadhAnena bhUyo.asya paraM yatnamathAkarot
shlokas.10:
tAM prabhAte cha sAye cha pitA paprachCha bhArata |
api tuShyati te putri brAhmaNaH paricharyayA
shlokas.11:
taM sA paramamityeva pratyuvAcha yashasvinI |
tataH prItimavApAgryAM kuntibhojo mahAmanAH
shlokas.12:
tataH sa.nvatsare pUrNe yadAsau japatAM varaH |
nApashyadduShkRRitaM ki~nchitpRRithAyAH sauhRRide rataH
shlokas.13:
tataH prItamanA bhUtvA sa enAM brAhmaNo.abravIt |
prIto.asmi paramaM bhadre parichAreNa te shubhe
shlokas.14:
varAnvRRiNIShva kalyANi durApAnmAnuShairiha |
yaistvaM sImantinIH sarvA yashasAbhibhaviShyasi
shlokas.15:
kuntyuvAcha||
kRRitAni mama sarvANi yasyA me vedavittama |
tvaM prasannaH pitA chaiva kRRitaM vipra varairmama
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yadi nechChasi bhadre tvaM varaM mattaH shuchismite |
imaM mantraM gRRihANa tvamAhvAnAya divaukasAm
shlokas.17:
yaM yaM devaM tvametena mantreNAvAhayiShyasi |
tena tena vashe bhadre sthAtavyaM te bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
akAmo vA sakAmo vA na sa naiShyati te vasham |
vibudho mantrasa.nshAnto vAkye bhRRitya ivAnataH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
na shashAka dvitIyaM sA pratyAkhyAtumaninditA |
taM vai dvijAtipravaraM tadA shApabhayAnnRRipa
shlokas.20:
tatastAmanavadyA~NgIM grAhayAmAsa vai dvijaH |
mantragrAmaM tadA rAjannatharvashirasi shrutam
shlokas.21:
taM pradAya tu rAjendra kuntibhojamuvAcha ha |
uShito.asmi sukhaM rAjankanyayA paritoShitaH
shlokas.22:
tava gehe suvihitaH sadA supratipUjitaH |
sAdhayiShyAmahe tAvadityuktvAntaradhIyata
shlokas.23:
sa tu rAjA dvijaM dRRiShTvA tatraivAntarhitaM tadA |
babhUva vismayAviShTaH pRRithAM cha samapUjayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gate tasmindvijashreShThe kasmi.nshchitkAlaparyaye |
chintayAmAsa sA kanyA mantragrAmabalAbalam
shlokas.2:
ayaM vai kIdRRishastena mama datto mahAtmanA |
mantragrAmo balaM tasya j~nAsye nAtichirAdiva
shlokas.3:
evaM sa~nchintayantI sA dadarshartuM yadRRichChayA |
vrIDitA sAbhavadbAlA kanyAbhAve rajasvalA
shlokas.4:
athodyantaM sahasrA.nshuM pRRithA dIptaM dadarsha ha |
na tatarpa cha rUpeNa bhAnoH sandhyAgatasya sA
shlokas.5:
tasyA dRRiShTirabhUddivyA sApashyaddivyadarshanam |
AmuktakavachaM devaM kuNDalAbhyAM vibhUShitam
shlokas.6:
tasyAH kautUhalaM tvAsInmantraM prati narAdhipa |
AhvAnamakarotsAtha tasya devasya bhAminI
shlokas.7:
prANAnupaspRRishya tadA AjuhAva divAkaram |
AjagAma tato rAja.nstvaramANo divAkaraH
shlokas.8:
madhupi~Ngo mahAbAhuH kambugrIvo hasanniva |
a~NgadI baddhamukuTo dishaH prajvAlayanniva
shlokas.9:
yogAtkRRitvA dvidhAtmAnamAjagAma tatApa cha |
AbabhAShe tataH kuntIM sAmnA paramavalgunA
shlokas.10:
Agato.asmi vashaM bhadre tava mantrabalAtkRRitaH |
kiM karomyavasho rAj~ni brUhi kartA tadasmi te
shlokas.11:
kuntyuvAcha||
gamyatAM bhagava.nstatra yato.asi samupAgataH |
kautUhalAtsamAhUtaH prasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.12:
sUrya uvAcha||
gamiShye.ahaM yathA mAM tvaM bravIShi tanumadhyame |
na tu devaM samAhUya nyAyyaM preShayituM vRRithA
shlokas.13:
tavAbhisandhiH subhage sUryAtputro bhavediti |
vIryeNApratimo loke kavachI kuNDalIti cha
shlokas.14:
sA tvamAtmapradAnaM vai kuruShva gajagAmini |
utpatsyati hi putraste yathAsa~Nkalpama~Ngane
shlokas.15:
atha gachChAmyahaM bhadre tvayAsa~Ngamya susmite |
shapsyAmi tvAmahaM kruddho brAhmaNaM pitaraM cha te
shlokas.16:
tvatkRRite tAnpradhakShyAmi sarvAnapi na sa.nshayaH |
pitaraM chaiva te mUDhaM yo na vetti tavAnayam
shlokas.17:
tasya cha brAhmaNasyAdya yo.asau mantramadAttava |
shIlavRRittamavij~nAya dhAsyAmi vinayaM param
shlokas.18:
ete hi vibudhAH sarve pura.ndaramukhA divi |
tvayA pralabdhaM pashyanti smayanta iva bhAmini
shlokas.19:
pashya chainAnsuragaNAndivyaM chakShuridaM hi te |
pUrvameva mayA dattaM dRRiShTavatyasi yena mAm
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.apashyattridashAnrAjaputrI; sarvAneva sveShu dhiShNyeShu khasthAn |
prabhAsantaM bhAnumantaM mahAntaM; yathAdityaM rochamAnaM tathaiva
shlokas.21:
sA tAndRRiShTvA vrIDamAneva bAlA; sUryaM devI vachanaM prAha bhItA |
gachCha tvaM vai gopate svaM vimAnaM; kanyAbhAvAdduHkha eShopachAraH
shlokas.22:
pitA mAtA guravashchaiva ye.anye; dehasyAsya prabhavanti pradAne |
nAhaM dharmaM lopayiShyAmi loke; strINAM vRRittaM pUjyate deharakShA
shlokas.23:
mayA mantrabalaM j~nAtumAhUtastvaM vibhAvaso |
bAlyAdbAleti kRRitvA tatkShantumarhasi me vibho
shlokas.24:
sUrya uvAcha||
bAleti kRRitvAnunayaM tavAhaM; dadAni nAnyAnunayaM labheta |
AtmapradAnaM kuru kuntikanye; shAntistavaivaM hi bhavechcha bhIru
shlokas.25:
na chApi yuktaM gantuM hi mayA mithyAkRRitena vai |
gamiShyAmyanavadyA~Ngi loke samavahAsyatAm
sarveShAM vibudhAnAM cha vaktavyaH syAmahaM shubhe
shlokas.26:
sA tvaM mayA samAgachCha putraM lapsyasi mAdRRisham |
vishiShTA sarvalokeShu bhaviShyasi cha bhAmini

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tu kanyA bahuvidhaM bruvantI madhuraM vachaH |
anunetuM sahasrA.nshuM na shashAka manasvinI
shlokas.2:
na shashAka yadA bAlA pratyAkhyAtuM tamonudam |
bhItA shApAttato rAjandadhyau dIrghamathAntaram
shlokas.3:
anAgasaH pituH shApo brAhmaNasya tathaiva cha |
mannimittaH kathaM na syAtkruddhAdasmAdvibhAvasoH
shlokas.4:
bAlenApi satA mohAdbhRRishaM sApahnavAnyapi |
nAtyAsAdayitavyAni tejA.nsi cha tapA.nsi cha
shlokas.5:
sAhamadya bhRRishaM bhItA gRRihItA cha kare bhRRisham |
kathaM tvakAryaM kuryAM vai pradAnaM hyAtmanaH svayam
shlokas.6:
saivaM shApaparitrastA bahu chintayatI tadA |
mohenAbhiparItA~NgI smayamAnA punaH punaH
shlokas.7:
taM devamabravIdbhItA bandhUnAM rAjasattama |
vrIDAvihvalayA vAchA shApatrastA vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
kuntyuvAcha||
pitA me dhriyate deva mAtA chAnye cha bAndhavAH |
na teShu dhriyamANeShu vidhilopo bhavedayam
shlokas.9:
tvayA me sa~Ngamo deva yadi syAdvidhivarjitaH |
mannimittaM kulasyAsya loke kIrtirnashettataH
shlokas.10:
atha vA dharmametaM tvaM manyase tapatAM vara |
RRite pradAnAdbandhubhyastava kAmaM karomyaham
shlokas.11:
AtmapradAnaM durdharSha tava kRRitvA satI tvaham |
tvayi dharmo yashashchaiva kIrtirAyushcha dehinAm
shlokas.12:
sUrya uvAcha||
na te pitA na te mAtA guravo vA shuchismite |
prabhavanti varArohe bhadraM te shRRiNu me vachaH
shlokas.13:
sarvAnkAmayate yasmAtkanerdhAtoshcha bhAmini |
tasmAtkanyeha sushroNi svatantrA varavarNini
shlokas.14:
nAdharmashcharitaH kashchittvayA bhavati bhAmini |
adharmaM kuta evAhaM chareyaM lokakAmyayA
shlokas.15:
anAvRRitAH striyaH sarvA narAshcha varavarNini |
svabhAva eSha lokAnAM vikAro.anya iti smRRitaH
shlokas.16:
sA mayA saha sa~Ngamya punaH kanyA bhaviShyasi |
putrashcha te mahAbAhurbhaviShyati mahAyashAH
shlokas.17:
kuntyuvAcha||
yadi putro mama bhavettvattaH sarvatamopaha |
kuNDalI kavachI shUro mahAbAhurmahAbalaH
shlokas.18:
sUrya uvAcha||
bhaviShyati mahAbAhuH kuNDalI divyavarmabhRRit |
ubhayaM chAmRRitamayaM tasya bhadre bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
kuntyuvAcha||
yadyetadamRRitAdasti kuNDale varma chottamam |
mama putrasya yaM vai tvaM matta utpAdayiShyasi
shlokas.20:
astu me sa~Ngamo deva yathoktaM bhagava.nstvayA |
tvadvIryarUpasattvaujA dharmayukto bhavetsa cha
shlokas.21:
sUrya uvAcha||
adityA kuNDale rAj~ni datte me mattakAshini |
te.asya dAsyAmi vai bhIru varma chaivedamuttamam
shlokas.22:
pRRithovAcha||
paramaM bhagavandeva sa~NgamiShye tvayA saha |
yadi putro bhavedevaM yathA vadasi gopate
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tu tAM kuntImAvivesha viha~NgamaH |
svarbhAnushatruryogAtmA nAbhyAM pasparsha chaiva tAm
shlokas.24:
tataH sA vihvalevAsItkanyA sUryasya tejasA |
papAtAtha cha sA devI shayane mUDhachetanA
shlokas.25:
sUrya uvAcha||
sAdhayiShyAmi sushroNi putraM vai janayiShyasi |
sarvashastrabhRRitAM shreShThaM kanyA chaiva bhaviShyasi
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sA vrIDitA bAlA tadA sUryamathAbravIt |
evamastviti rAjendra prasthitaM bhUrivarchasam
shlokas.27:
iti smoktA kuntirAjAtmajA sA; vivasvantaM yAchamAnA salajjA |
tasminpuNye shayanIye papAta; mohAviShTA bhajyamAnA lateva
shlokas.28:
tAM tigmA.nshustejasA mohayitvA; yogenAviShyAtmasa.nsthAM chakAra |
na chaivainAM dUShayAmAsa bhAnuH; sa~nj~nAM lebhe bhUya evAtha bAlA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato garbhaH samabhavatpRRithAyAH pRRithivIpate |
shukle dashottare pakShe tArApatirivAmbare
shlokas.2:
sA bAndhavabhayAdbAlA taM garbhaM vinigUhatI |
dhArayAmAsa sushroNI na chainAM bubudhe janaH
shlokas.3:
na hi tAM veda nAryanyA kAchiddhAtreyikAmRRite |
kanyApuragatAM bAlAM nipuNAM parirakShaNe
shlokas.4:
tataH kAlena sA garbhaM suShuve varavarNinI |
kanyaiva tasya devasya prasAdAdamaraprabham
shlokas.5:
tathaiva baddhakavachaM kanakojjvalakuNDalam |
haryakShaM vRRiShabhaskandhaM yathAsya pitaraM tathA
shlokas.6:
jAtamAtraM cha taM garbhaM dhAtryA saMmantrya bhAminI |
ma~njUShAyAmavadadhe svAstIrNAyAM samantataH
shlokas.7:
madhUchChiShTasthitAyAM sA sukhAyAM rudatI tathA |
shlakShNAyAM supidhAnAyAmashvanadyAmavAsRRijat
shlokas.8:
jAnatI chApyakartavyaM kanyAyA garbhadhAraNam |
putrasnehena rAjendra karuNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.9:
samutsRRijantI ma~njUShAmashvanadyAstadA jale |
uvAcha rudatI kuntI yAni vAkyAni tachChRRiNu
shlokas.10:
svasti te.astvAntarikShebhyaH pArthivebhyashcha putraka |
divyebhyashchaiva bhUtebhyastathA toyacharAshcha ye
shlokas.11:
shivAste santu panthAno mA cha te paripanthinaH |
AgamAshcha tathA putra bhavantvadrohachetasaH
shlokas.12:
pAtu tvAM varuNo rAjA salile salileshvaraH |
antarikShe.antarikShasthaH pavanaH sarvagastathA
shlokas.13:
pitA tvAM pAtu sarvatra tapanastapatAM varaH |
yena datto.asi me putra divyena vidhinA kila
shlokas.14:
AdityA vasavo rudrAH sAdhyA vishve cha devatAH |
marutashcha sahendreNa dishashcha sadigIshvarAH
shlokas.15:
rakShantu tvAM surAH sarve sameShu viShameShu cha |
vetsyAmi tvAM videshe.api kavachenopasUchitam
shlokas.16:
dhanyaste putra janako devo bhAnurvibhAvasuH |
yastvAM drakShyati divyena chakShuShA vAhinIgatam
shlokas.17:
dhanyA sA pramadA yA tvAM putratve kalpayiShyati |
yasyAstvaM tRRiShitaH putra stanaM pAsyasi devaja
shlokas.18:
ko nu svapnastayA dRRiShTo yA tvAmAdityavarchasam |
divyavarmasamAyuktaM divyakuNDalabhUShitam
shlokas.19:
padmAyatavishAlAkShaM padmatAmratalojjvalam |
sulalATaM sukeshAntaM putratve kalpayiShyati
shlokas.20:
dhanyA drakShyanti putra tvAM bhUmau sa.nsarpamANakam |
avyaktakalavAkyAni vadantaM reNuguNThitam
shlokas.21:
dhanyA drakShyanti putra tvAM punaryauvanage mukhe |
himavadvanasambhUtaM siMhaM kesariNaM yathA
shlokas.22:
evaM bahuvidhaM rAjanvilapya karuNaM pRRithA |
avAsRRijata ma~njUShAmashvanadyAstadA jale
shlokas.23:
rudatI putrashokArtA nishIthe kamalekShaNA |
dhAtryA saha pRRithA rAjanputradarshanalAlasA
shlokas.24:
visarjayitvA ma~njUShAM sambodhanabhayAtpituH |
vivesha rAjabhavanaM punaH shokAturA tataH
shlokas.25:
ma~njUShA tvashvanadyAH sA yayau charmaNvatIM nadIm |
charmaNvatyAshcha yamunAM tato ga~NgAM jagAma ha
shlokas.26:
ga~NgAyAH sUtaviShayaM champAmabhyAyayau purIm |
sa ma~njUShAgato garbhastara~NgairuhyamAnakaH
shlokas.27:
amRRitAdutthitaM divyaM tattu varma sakuNDalam |
dhArayAmAsa taM garbhaM daivaM cha vidhinirmitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu dhRRitarAShTrasya vai sakhA |
sUto.adhiratha ityeva sadAro jAhnavIM yayau
shlokas.2:
tasya bhAryAbhavadrAjanrUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi |
rAdhA nAma mahAbhAgA na sA putramavindata
apatyArthe paraM yatnamakarochcha visheShataH
shlokas.3:
sA dadarshAtha ma~njUShAmuhyamAnAM yadRRichChayA |
dattarakShApratisarAmanvAlabhanashobhitAm
UrmItara~NgairjAhnavyAH samAnItAmupahvaram
shlokas.4:
sA tAM kautUhalAtprAptAM grAhayAmAsa bhAminI |
tato nivedayAmAsa sUtasyAdhirathasya vai
shlokas.5:
sa tAmuddhRRitya ma~njUShAmutsArya jalamantikAt |
yantrairudghATayAmAsa so.apashyattatra bAlakam
shlokas.6:
taruNAdityasa~NkAshaM hemavarmadharaM tathA |
mRRiShTakuNDalayuktena vadanena virAjatA
shlokas.7:
sa sUto bhAryayA sArdhaM vismayotphullalochanaH |
a~NkamAropya taM bAlaM bhAryAM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
idamatyadbhutaM bhIru yato jAto.asmi bhAmini |
dRRiShTavAndevagarbho.ayaM manye.asmAnsamupAgataH
shlokas.9:
anapatyasya putro.ayaM devairdatto dhruvaM mama |
ityuktvA taM dadau putraM rAdhAyai sa mahIpate
shlokas.10:
pratijagrAha taM rAdhA vidhivaddivyarUpiNam |
putraM kamalagarbhAbhaM devagarbhaM shriyA vRRitam
shlokas.11:
pupoSha chainaM vidhivadvavRRidhe sa cha vIryavAn |
tataH prabhRRiti chApyanye prAbhavannaurasAH sutAH
shlokas.12:
vasuvarmadharaM dRRiShTvA taM bAlaM hemakuNDalam |
nAmAsya vasuSheNeti tatashchakrurdvijAtayaH
shlokas.13:
evaM sa sUtaputratvaM jagAmAmitavikramaH |
vasuSheNa iti khyAto vRRiSha ityeva cha prabhuH
shlokas.14:
sa jyeShThaputraH sUtasya vavRRidhe.a~NgeShu vIryavAn |
chAreNa viditashchAsItpRRithAyA divyavarmabhRRit
shlokas.15:
sUtastvadhirathaH putraM vivRRiddhaM samaye tataH |
dRRiShTvA prasthApayAmAsa puraM vAraNasAhvayam
shlokas.16:
tatropasadanaM chakre droNasyeShvastrakarmaNi |
sakhyaM duryodhanenaivamagachChatsa cha vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
droNAtkRRipAchcha rAmAchcha so.astragrAmaM chaturvidham |
labdhvA loke.abhavatkhyAtaH parameShvAsatAM gataH
shlokas.18:
sandhAya dhArtarAShTreNa pArthAnAM vipriye sthitaH |
yoddhumAsha.nsate nityaM phalgunena mahAtmanA
shlokas.19:
sadA hi tasya spardhAsIdarjunena vishAM pate |
arjunasya cha karNena yato dRRiShTo babhUva saH
shlokas.20:
taM tu kuNDalinaM dRRiShTvA varmaNA cha samanvitam |
avadhyaM samare matvA paryatapyadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.21:
yadA tu karNo rAjendra bhAnumantaM divAkaram |
stauti madhya.ndine prApte prA~njaliH salile sthitaH
shlokas.22:
tatrainamupatiShThanti brAhmaNA dhanahetavaH |
nAdeyaM tasya tatkAle ki~nchidasti dvijAtiShu
shlokas.23:
tamindro brAhmaNo bhUtvA bhikShAM dehItyupasthitaH |
svAgataM cheti rAdheyastamatha pratyabhAShata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
devarAjamanuprAptaM brAhmaNachChadmanA vRRiShaH |
dRRiShTvA svAgatamityAha na bubodhAsya mAnasam
shlokas.2:
hiraNyakaNThIH pramadA grAmAnvA bahugokulAn |
kiM dadAnIti taM vipramuvAchAdhirathistataH
shlokas.3:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
hiraNyakaNThyaH pramadA yachchAnyatprItivardhanam |
nAhaM dattamihechChAmi tadarthibhyaH pradIyatAm
shlokas.4:
yadetatsahajaM varma kuNDale cha tavAnagha |
etadutkRRitya me dehi yadi satyavrato bhavAn
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmyahaM kShipraM tvayA dattaM parantapa |
eSha me sarvalAbhAnAM lAbhaH paramako mataH
shlokas.6:
karNa uvAcha||
avaniM pramadA gAshcha nirvApaM bahuvArShikam |
tatte vipra pradAsyAmi na tu varma na kuNDale
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairyAchyamAnaH sa tu dvijaH |
karNena bharatashreShTha nAnyaM varamayAchata
shlokas.8:
sAntvitashcha yathAshakti pUjitashcha yathAvidhi |
naivAnyaM sa dvijashreShThaH kAmayAmAsa vai varam
shlokas.9:
yadA nAnyaM pravRRiNute varaM vai dvijasattamaH |
tadainamabravIdbhUyo rAdheyaH prahasanniva
shlokas.10:
sahajaM varma me vipra kuNDale chAmRRitodbhave |
tenAvadhyo.asmi lokeShu tato naitaddadAmyaham
shlokas.11:
vishAlaM pRRithivIrAjyaM kShemaM nihatakaNTakam |
pratigRRihNIShva mattastvaM sAdhu brAhmaNapu~Ngava
shlokas.12:
kuNDalAbhyAM vimukto.ahaM varmaNA sahajena cha |
gamanIyo bhaviShyAmi shatrUNAM dvijasattama
shlokas.13:
yadA nAnyaM varaM vavre bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
tataH prahasya karNastaM punarityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.14:
vidito devadevesha prAgevAsi mama prabho |
na tu nyAyyaM mayA dAtuM tava shakra vRRithA varam
shlokas.15:
tvaM hi deveshvaraH sAkShAttvayA deyo varo mama |
anyeShAM chaiva bhUtAnAmIshvaro hyasi bhUtakRRit
shlokas.16:
yadi dAsyAmi te deva kuNDale kavachaM tathA |
vadhyatAmupayAsyAmi tvaM cha shakrAvahAsyatAm
shlokas.17:
tasmAdvinimayaM kRRitvA kuNDale varma chottamam |
harasva shakra kAmaM me na dadyAmahamanyathA
shlokas.18:
shakra uvAcha||
vidito.ahaM raveH pUrvamAyanneva tavAntikam |
tena te sarvamAkhyAtamevametanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
kAmamastu tathA tAta tava karNa yathechChasi |
varjayitvA tu me vajraM pravRRiNIShva yadichChasi
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH karNaH prahRRiShTastu upasa~Ngamya vAsavam |
amoghAM shaktimabhyetya vavre sampUrNamAnasaH
shlokas.21:
karNa uvAcha||
varmaNA kuNDalAbhyAM cha shaktiM me dehi vAsava |
amoghAM shatrusa~NghAnAM ghAtanIM pRRitanAmukhe
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa~nchintya manasA muhUrtamiva vAsavaH |
shaktyarthaM pRRithivIpAla karNaM vAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.23:
kuNDale me prayachChasva varma chaiva sharIrajam |
gRRihANa karNa shaktiM tvamanena samayena me
shlokas.24:
amoghA hanti shatashaH shatrUnmama karachyutA |
punashcha pANimabhyeti mama daityAnvinighnataH
shlokas.25:
seyaM tava karaM prApya hatvaikaM ripumUrjitam |
garjantaM pratapantaM cha mAmevaiShyati sUtaja
shlokas.26:
karNa uvAcha||
ekamevAhamichChAmi ripuM hantuM mahAhave |
garjantaM pratapantaM cha yato mama bhayaM bhavet
shlokas.27:
indra uvAcha||
ekaM haniShyasi ripuM garjantaM balinaM raNe |
tvaM tu yaM prArthayasyekaM rakShyate sa mahAtmanA
shlokas.28:
yamAhurvedavidvA.nso varAhamajitaM harim |
nArAyaNamachintyaM cha tena kRRiShNena rakShyate
shlokas.29:
karNa uvAcha||
evamapyastu bhagavannekavIravadhe mama |
amoghA pravarA shaktiryena hanyAM pratApinam
shlokas.30:
utkRRitya tu pradAsyAmi kuNDale kavachaM cha te |
nikRRitteShu cha gAtreShu na me bIbhatsatA bhavet
shlokas.31:
indra uvAcha||
na te bIbhatsatA karNa bhaviShyati katha~nchana |
vraNashchApi na gAtreShu yastvaM nAnRRitamichChasi
shlokas.32:
yAdRRishaste piturvarNastejashcha vadatAM vara |
tAdRRishenaiva varNena tvaM karNa bhavitA punaH
shlokas.33:
vidyamAneShu shastreShu yadyamoghAmasa.nshaye |
pramatto mokShyase chApi tvayyevaiShA patiShyati
shlokas.34:
karNa uvAcha||
sa.nshayaM paramaM prApya vimokShye vAsavImimAm |
yathA mAmAttha shakra tvaM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.35:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shaktiM prajvalitAM pratigRRihya vishAM pate |
shastraM gRRihItvA nishitaM sarvagAtrANyakRRintata
shlokas.36:
tato devA mAnavA dAnavAshcha; nikRRintantaM karNamAtmAnamevam |
dRRiShTvA sarve siddhasa~NghAshcha nedu;rna hyasyAsIdduHkhajo vai vikAraH
shlokas.37:
tato divyA dundubhayaH praNeduH; papAtochchaiH puShpavarShaM cha divyam |
dRRiShTvA karNaM shastrasa~NkRRittagAtraM; muhushchApi smayamAnaM nRRivIram
shlokas.38:
tatashChittvA kavachaM divyama~NgA;ttathaivArdraM pradadau vAsavAya |
tathotkRRitya pradadau kuNDale te; vaikartanaH karmaNA tena karNaH
shlokas.39:
tataH shakraH prahasanva~nchayitvA; karNaM loke yashasA yojayitvA |
kRRitaM kAryaM pANDavAnAM hi mene; tataH pashchAddivamevotpapAta
shlokas.40:
shrutvA karNaM muShitaM dhArtarAShTrA; dInAH sarve bhagnadarpA ivAsan |
tAM chAvasthAM gamitaM sUtaputraM; shrutvA pArthA jahRRiShuH kAnanasthAH
shlokas.41:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kvasthA vIrAH pANDavAste babhUvuH; kutashchaitachChrutavantaH priyaM te |
kiM vAkArShurdvAdashe.abde vyatIte; tanme sarvaM bhagavAnvyAkarotu
shlokas.42:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
labdhvA kRRiShNAM saindhavaM drAvayitvA; vipraiH sArdhaM kAmyakAdAshramAtte |
mArkaNDeyAchChrutavantaH purANaM; devarShINAM charitaM vistareNa
shlokas.43:
pratyAjagmuH sarathAH sAnuyAtrAH; sarvaiH sArdhaM sUdapaurogavaishcha |
tataH puNyaM dvaitavanaM nRRivIrA; nistIryograM vanavAsaM samagram

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM hRRitAyAM kRRiShNAyAM prApya kleshamanuttamam |
pratilabhya tataH kRRiShNAM kimakurvata pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM hRRitAyAM kRRiShNAyAM prApya kleshamanuttamam |
vihAya kAmyakaM rAjA saha bhrAtRRibhirachyutaH
shlokas.3:
punardvaitavanaM ramyamAjagAma yudhiShThiraH |
svAdumUlaphalaM ramyaM mArkaNDeyAshramaM prati
shlokas.4:
anuguptaphalAhArAH sarva eva mitAshanAH |
nyavasanpANDavAstatra kRRiShNayA saha bhArata
shlokas.5:
vasandvaitavane rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhImaseno.arjunashchaiva mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNArthe parAkrAntA dharmAtmAno yatavratAH |
kleshamArChanta vipulaM sukhodarkaM parantapAH
shlokas.7:
ajAtashatrumAsInaM bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaM vane |
Agamya brAhmaNastUrNaM santapta idamabravIt
shlokas.8:
araNIsahitaM mahyaM samAsaktaM vanaspatau |
mRRigasya gharShamANasya viShANe samasajjata
shlokas.9:
tadAdAya gato rAja.nstvaramANo mahAmRRigaH |
AshramAttvaritaH shIghraM plavamAno mahAjavaH
shlokas.10:
tasya gatvA padaM shIghramAsAdya cha mahAmRRigam |
agnihotraM na lupyeta tadAnayata pANDavAH
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNasya vachaH shrutvA santapto.atha yudhiShThiraH |
dhanurAdAya kaunteyaH prAdravadbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.12:
sannaddhA dhanvinaH sarve prAdravannarapu~NgavAH |
brAhmaNArthe yatantaste shIghramanvagamanmRRigam
shlokas.13:
karNinAlIkanArAchAnutsRRijanto mahArathAH |
nAvidhyanpANDavAstatra pashyanto mRRigamantikAt
shlokas.14:
teShAM prayatamAnAnAM nAdRRishyata mahAmRRigaH |
apashyanto mRRigaM shrAntA duHkhaM prAptA manasvinaH
shlokas.15:
shItalachChAyamAsAdya nyagrodhaM gahane vane |
kShutpipAsAparItA~NgAH pANDavAH samupAvishan
shlokas.16:
teShAM samupaviShTAnAM nakulo duHkhitastadA |
abravIdbhrAtaraM jyeShThamamarShAtkurusattama
shlokas.17:
nAsminkule jAtu mamajja dharmo; na chAlasyAdarthalopo babhUva |
anuttarAH sarvabhUteShu bhUyaH; samprAptAH smaH sa.nshayaM kena rAjan

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nApadAmasti maryAdA na nimittaM na kAraNam |
dharmastu vibhajatyatra ubhayoH puNyapApayoH
shlokas.2:
bhIma uvAcha||
prAtikAmyanayatkRRiShNAM sabhAyAM preShyavattadA |
na mayA nihatastatra tena prAptAH sma sa.nshayam
shlokas.3:
arjuna uvAcha||
vAchastIkShNAsthibhedinyaH sUtaputreNa bhAShitAH |
atitIkShNA mayA kShAntAstena prAptAH sma sa.nshayam
shlokas.4:
sahadeva uvAcha||
shakunistvAM yadAjaiShIdakShadyUtena bhArata |
sa mayA na hatastatra tena prAptAH sma sa.nshayam
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA nakulaM vAkyamabravIt |
Aruhya vRRikShaM mAdreya nirIkShasva disho dasha
shlokas.6:
pAnIyamantike pashya vRRikShAnvApyudakAshrayAn |
ime hi bhrAtaraH shrAntAstava tAta pipAsitAH
shlokas.7:
nakulastu tathetyuktvA shIghramAruhya pAdapam |
abravIdbhrAtaraM jyeShThamabhivIkShya samantataH
shlokas.8:
pashyAmi bahulAnrAjanvRRikShAnudakasa.nshrayAn |
sArasAnAM cha nirhrAdamatrodakamasa.nshayam
shlokas.9:
tato.abravItsatyadhRRitiH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
gachCha saumya tataH shIghraM tUrNaM pAnIyamAnaya
shlokas.10:
nakulastu tathetyuktvA bhrAturjyeShThasya shAsanAt |
prAdravadyatra pAnIyaM shIghraM chaivAnvapadyata
shlokas.11:
sa dRRiShTvA vimalaM toyaM sArasaiH parivAritam |
pAtukAmastato vAchamantarikShAtsa shushruve
shlokas.12:
mA tAta sAhasaM kArShIrmama pUrvaparigrahaH |
prashnAnuktvA tu mAdreya tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.13:
anAdRRitya tu tadvAkyaM nakulaH supipAsitaH |
apibachChItalaM toyaM pItvA cha nipapAta ha
shlokas.14:
chirAyamANe nakule kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
abravIdbhrAtaraM vIraM sahadevamari.ndamam
shlokas.15:
bhrAtA chirAyate tAta sahadeva tavAgrajaH |
taM chaivAnaya sodaryaM pAnIyaM cha tvamAnaya
shlokas.16:
sahadevastathetyuktvA tAM dishaM pratyapadyata |
dadarsha cha hataM bhUmau bhrAtaraM nakulaM tadA
shlokas.17:
bhrAtRRishokAbhisantaptastRRiShayA cha prapIDitaH |
abhidudrAva pAnIyaM tato vAgabhyabhAShata
shlokas.18:
mA tAta sAhasaM kArShIrmama pUrvaparigrahaH |
prashnAnuktvA yathAkAmaM tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.19:
anAdRRitya tu tadvAkyaM sahadevaH pipAsitaH |
apibachChItalaM toyaM pItvA cha nipapAta ha
shlokas.20:
athAbravItsa vijayaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtarau te chiragatau bIbhatso shatrukarshana
tau chaivAnaya bhadraM te pAnIyaM cha tvamAnaya
shlokas.21:
evamukto guDAkeshaH pragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH |
AmuktakhaDgo medhAvI tatsaraH pratyapadyata
shlokas.22:
yataH puruShashArdUlau pAnIyaharaNe gatau |
tau dadarsha hatau tatra bhrAtarau shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.23:
prasuptAviva tau dRRiShTvA narasiMhaH suduHkhitaH |
dhanurudyamya kaunteyo vyalokayata tadvanam
shlokas.24:
nApashyattatra ki~nchitsa bhUtaM tasminmahAvane |
savyasAchI tataH shrAntaH pAnIyaM so.abhyadhAvata
shlokas.25:
abhidhAva.nstato vAchamantarikShAtsa shushruve |
kimAsIdasi pAnIyaM naitachChakyaM balAttvayA
shlokas.26:
kaunteya yadi vai prashnAnmayoktAnpratipatsyase |
tataH pAsyasi pAnIyaM hariShyasi cha bhArata
shlokas.27:
vAritastvabravItpArtho dRRishyamAno nivAraya |
yAvadbANairvinirbhinnaH punarnaivaM vadiShyasi
shlokas.28:
evamuktvA tataH pArthaH sharairastrAnumantritaiH |
vavarSha tAM dishaM kRRitsnAM shabdavedhaM cha darshayan
shlokas.29:
karNinAlIkanArAchAnutsRRijanbharatarShabha |
anekairiShusa~NghAtairantarikShaM vavarSha ha
shlokas.30:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM vighAtena te pArtha prashnAnuktvA tataH piba |
anuktvA tu tataH prashnAnpItvaiva na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.31:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tvamoghAniShUnmuktvA tRRiShNayAbhiprapIDitaH |
avij~nAyaiva tAnprashnAnpItvaiva nipapAta ha
shlokas.32:
athAbravIdbhImasenaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha bIbhatsushchAparAjitaH
shlokas.33:
chiraM gatAstoyahetorna chAgachChanti bhArata |
tA.nshchaivAnaya bhadraM te pAnIyaM cha tvamAnaya
shlokas.34:
bhImasenastathetyuktvA tAM dishaM pratyapadyata |
yatra te puruShavyAghrA bhrAtaro.asya nipAtitAH
shlokas.35:
tAndRRiShTvA duHkhito bhImastRRiShayA cha prapIDitaH |
amanyata mahAbAhuH karma tadyakSharakShasAm
sa chintayAmAsa tadA yoddhavyaM dhruvamadya me
shlokas.36:
pAsyAmi tAvatpAnIyamiti pArtho vRRikodaraH |
tato.abhyadhAvatpAnIyaM pipAsuH puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.37:
yakSha uvAcha||
mA tAta sAhasaM kArShIrmama pUrvaparigrahaH |
prashnAnuktvA tu kaunteya tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.38:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastato bhImo yakSheNAmitatejasA |
avij~nAyaiva tAnprashnAnpItvaiva nipapAta ha
shlokas.39:
tataH kuntIsuto rAjA vichintya puruSharShabhaH |
samutthAya mahAbAhurdahyamAnena chetasA
shlokas.40:
apetajananirghoShaM pravivesha mahAvanam |
rurubhishcha varAhaishcha pakShibhishcha niShevitam
shlokas.41:
nIlabhAsvaravarNaishcha pAdapairupashobhitam |
bhramarairupagItaM cha pakShibhishcha mahAyashAH
shlokas.42:
sa gachChankAnane tasminhemajAlapariShkRRitam |
dadarsha tatsaraH shrImAnvishvakarmakRRitaM yathA
shlokas.43:
upetaM nalinIjAlaiH sindhuvAraishcha vetasaiH |
ketakaiH karavIraishcha pippalaishchaiva sa.nvRRitam
shramArtastadupAgamya saro dRRiShTvAtha vismitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa dadarsha hatAnbhrAtR^I.NllokapAlAniva chyutAn |
yugAnte samanuprApte shakrapratimagauravAn
shlokas.2:
viprakIrNadhanurbANaM dRRiShTvA nihatamarjunam |
bhImasenaM yamau chobhau nirvicheShTAngatAyuShaH
shlokas.3:
sa dIrghamuShNaM niHshvasya shokabAShpapariplutaH |
buddhyA vichintayAmAsa vIrAH kena nipAtitAH
shlokas.4:
naiShAM shastraprahAro.asti padaM nehAsti kasyachit |
bhUtaM mahadidaM manye bhrAtaro yena me hatAH
ekAgraM chintayiShyAmi pItvA vetsyAmi vA jalam
shlokas.5:
syAttu duryodhanenedamupA.nshuvihitaM kRRitam |
gAndhArarAjarachitaM satataM jihmabuddhinA
shlokas.6:
yasya kAryamakAryaM vA samameva bhavatyuta |
kastasya vishvasedvIro durmaterakRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
atha vA puruShairgUDhaiH prayogo.ayaM durAtmanaH |
bhavediti mahAbAhurbahudhA samachintayat
shlokas.8:
tasyAsInna viSheNedamudakaM dUShitaM yathA |
mukhavarNAH prasannA me bhrAtR^INAmityachintayat
shlokas.9:
ekaikashashchaughabalAnimAnpuruShasattamAn |
ko.anyaH pratisamAseta kAlAntakayamAdRRite
shlokas.10:
etenAdhyavasAyena tattoyamavagADhavAn |
gAhamAnashcha tattoyamantarikShAtsa shushruve
shlokas.11:
yakSha uvAcha||
ahaM bakaH shaivalamatsyabhakSho; mayA nItAH pretavashaM tavAnujAH |
tvaM pa~nchamo bhavitA rAjaputra; na chetprashnAnpRRichChato vyAkaroShi
shlokas.12:
mA tAta sAhasaM kArShIrmama pUrvaparigrahaH |
prashnAnuktvA tu kaunteya tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rudrANAM vA vasUnAM vA marutAM vA pradhAnabhAk |
pRRichChAmi ko bhavAndevo naitachChakuninA kRRitam
shlokas.14:
himavAnpAriyAtrashcha vindhyo malaya eva cha |
chatvAraH parvatAH kena pAtitA bhuvi tejasA
shlokas.15:
atIva te mahatkarma kRRitaM balavatAM vara |
yanna devA na gandharvA nAsurA na cha rAkShasAH
viShaheranmahAyuddhe kRRitaM te tanmahAdbhutam
shlokas.16:
na te jAnAmi yatkAryaM nAbhijAnAmi kA~NkShitam |
kautUhalaM mahajjAtaM sAdhvasaM chAgataM mama
shlokas.17:
yenAsmyudvignahRRidayaH samutpannashirojvaraH |
pRRichChAmi bhagava.nstasmAtko bhavAniha tiShThati
shlokas.18:
yakSha uvAcha||
yakSho.ahamasmi bhadraM te nAsmi pakShI jalecharaH |
mayaite nihatAH sarve bhrAtaraste mahaujasaH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastAmashivAM shrutvA vAchaM sa paruShAkSharAm |
yakShasya bruvato rAjannupakramya tadA sthitaH
shlokas.20:
virUpAkShaM mahAkAyaM yakShaM tAlasamuchChrayam |
jvalanArkapratIkAshamadhRRiShyaM parvatopamam
shlokas.21:
setumAshritya tiShThantaM dadarsha bharatarShabhaH |
meghagambhIrayA vAchA tarjayantaM mahAbalam
shlokas.22:
yakSha uvAcha||
ime te bhrAtaro rAjanvAryamANA mayAsakRRit |
balAttoyaM jihIrShantastato vai sUditA mayA
shlokas.23:
na peyamudakaM rAjanprANAniha parIpsatA |
pArtha mA sAhasaM kArShIrmama pUrvaparigrahaH
prashnAnuktvA tu kaunteya tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
naivAhaM kAmaye yakSha tava pUrvaparigraham |
kAmaM naitatprasha.nsanti santo hi puruShAH sadA
shlokas.25:
yadAtmanA svamAtmAnaM prasha.nsetpuruShaH prabho |
yathApraj~naM tu te prashnAnprativakShyAmi pRRichCha mAm
shlokas.26:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svidAdityamunnayati ke cha tasyAbhitashcharAH |
kashchainamastaM nayati kasmi.nshcha pratitiShThati
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brahmAdityamunnayati devAstasyAbhitashcharAH |
dharmashchAstaM nayati cha satye cha pratitiShThati
shlokas.28:
yakSha uvAcha||
kena svichChrotriyo bhavati kena svidvindate mahat |
kena dvitIyavAnbhavati rAjankena cha buddhimAn
shlokas.29:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutena shrotriyo bhavati tapasA vindate mahat |
dhRRityA dvitIyavAnbhavati buddhimAnvRRiddhasevayA
shlokas.30:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM brAhmaNAnAM devatvaM kashcha dharmaH satAmiva |
kashchaiShAM mAnuSho bhAvaH kimeShAmasatAmiva
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
svAdhyAya eShAM devatvaM tapa eShAM satAmiva |
maraNaM mAnuSho bhAvaH parivAdo.asatAmiva
shlokas.32:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM kShatriyANAM devatvaM kashcha dharmaH satAmiva |
kashchaiShAM mAnuSho bhAvaH kimeShAmasatAmiva
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
iShvastrameShAM devatvaM yaj~na eShAM satAmiva |
bhayaM vai mAnuSho bhAvaH parityAgo.asatAmiva
shlokas.34:
yakSha uvAcha||
kimekaM yaj~niyaM sAma kimekaM yaj~niyaM yajuH |
kA chaikA vRRishchate yaj~naM kAM yaj~no nAtivartate
shlokas.35:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
prANo vai yaj~niyaM sAma mano vai yaj~niyaM yajuH |
vAgekA vRRishchate yaj~naM tAM yaj~no nAtivartate
shlokas.36:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svidApatatAM shreShThaM kiM svinnipatatAM varam |
kiM svitpratiShThamAnAnAM kiM svitpravadatAM varam
shlokas.37:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
varShamApatatAM shreShThaM bIjaM nipatatAM varam |
gAvaH pratiShThamAnAnAM putraH pravadatAM varaH
shlokas.38:
yakSha uvAcha||
indriyArthAnanubhavanbuddhimA.NllokapUjitaH |
saMmataH sarvabhUtAnAmuchChvasanko na jIvati
shlokas.39:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
devatAtithibhRRityAnAM pitR^INAmAtmanashcha yaH |
na nirvapati pa~nchAnAmuchChvasanna sa jIvati
shlokas.40:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svidgurutaraM bhUmeH kiM sviduchchataraM cha khAt |
kiM svichChIghrataraM vAyoH kiM svidbahutaraM nRRiNAm
shlokas.41:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mAtA gurutarA bhUmeH pitA uchchatarashcha khAt |
manaH shIghrataraM vAyoshchintA bahutarI nRRiNAm
shlokas.42:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svitsuptaM na nimiShati kiM svijjAtaM na chopati |
kasya sviddhRRidayaM nAsti kiM svidvegena vardhate
shlokas.43:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
matsyaH supto na nimiShatyaNDaM jAtaM na chopati |
ashmano hRRidayaM nAsti nadI vegena vardhate
shlokas.44:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svitpravasato mitraM kiM svinmitraM gRRihe sataH |
Aturasya cha kiM mitraM kiM svinmitraM mariShyataH
shlokas.45:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sArthaH pravasato mitraM bhAryA mitraM gRRihe sataH |
Aturasya bhiSha~NmitraM dAnaM mitraM mariShyataH
shlokas.46:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svideko vicharati jAtaH ko jAyate punaH |
kiM sviddhimasya bhaiShajyaM kiM svidAvapanaM mahat
shlokas.47:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sUrya eko vicharati chandramA jAyate punaH |
agnirhimasya bhaiShajyaM bhUmirAvapanaM mahat
shlokas.48:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svidekapadaM dharmyaM kiM svidekapadaM yashaH |
kiM svidekapadaM svargyaM kiM svidekapadaM sukham
shlokas.49:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dAkShyamekapadaM dharmyaM dAnamekapadaM yashaH |
satyamekapadaM svargyaM shIlamekapadaM sukham
shlokas.50:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM svidAtmA manuShyasya kiM sviddaivakRRitaH sakhA |
upajIvanaM kiM svidasya kiM svidasya parAyaNam
shlokas.51:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
putra AtmA manuShyasya bhAryA daivakRRitaH sakhA |
upajIvanaM cha parjanyo dAnamasya parAyaNam
shlokas.52:
yakSha uvAcha||
dhanyAnAmuttamaM kiM sviddhanAnAM kiM sviduttamam |
lAbhAnAmuttamaM kiM svitkiM sukhAnAM tathottamam
shlokas.53:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhanyAnAmuttamaM dAkShyaM dhanAnAmuttamaM shrutam |
lAbhAnAM shreShThamArogyaM sukhAnAM tuShTiruttamA
shlokas.54:
yakSha uvAcha||
kashcha dharmaH paro loke kashcha dharmaH sadAphalaH |
kiM niyamya na shochanti kaishcha sandhirna jIryate
shlokas.55:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmastrayIdharmaH sadAphalaH |
mano yamya na shochanti sadbhiH sandhirna jIryate
shlokas.56:
yakSha uvAcha||
kiM nu hitvA priyo bhavati kiM nu hitvA na shochati |
kiM nu hitvArthavAnbhavati kiM nu hitvA sukhI bhavet
shlokas.57:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mAnaM hitvA priyo bhavati krodhaM hitvA na shochati |
kAmaM hitvArthavAnbhavati lobhaM hitvA sukhI bhavet
shlokas.58:
yakSha uvAcha||
mRRitaH kathaM syAtpuruShaH kathaM rAShTraM mRRitaM bhavet |
shrAddhaM mRRitaM kathaM cha syAtkathaM yaj~no mRRito bhavet
shlokas.59:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mRRito daridraH puruSho mRRitaM rAShTramarAjakam |
mRRitamashrotriyaM shrAddhaM mRRito yaj~nastvadakShiNaH
shlokas.60:
yakSha uvAcha||
kA dikkimudakaM proktaM kimannaM pArtha kiM viSham |
shrAddhasya kAlamAkhyAhi tataH piba harasva cha
shlokas.61:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
santo digjalamAkAshaM gaurannaM prArthanA viSham |
shrAddhasya brAhmaNaH kAlaH kathaM vA yakSha manyase
shlokas.62:
yakSha uvAcha||
vyAkhyAtA me tvayA prashnA yAthAtathyaM parantapa |
puruShaM tvidAnImAkhyAhi yashcha sarvadhanI naraH
shlokas.63:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
divaM spRRishati bhUmiM cha shabdaH puNyasya karmaNaH |
yAvatsa shabdo bhavati tAvatpuruSha uchyate
shlokas.64:
tulye priyApriye yasya sukhaduHkhe tathaiva cha |
atItAnAgate chobhe sa vai sarvadhanI naraH
shlokas.65:
yakSha uvAcha||
vyAkhyAtaH puruSho rAjanyashcha sarvadhanI naraH |
tasmAttavaiko bhrAtR^INAM yamichChasi sa jIvatu
shlokas.66:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shyAmo ya eSha raktAkSho bRRihachChAla ivodgataH |
vyUDhorasko mahAbAhurnakulo yakSha jIvatu
shlokas.67:
yakSha uvAcha||
priyaste bhImaseno.ayamarjuno vaH parAyaNam |
sa kasmAnnakulaM rAjansApatnaM jIvamichChasi
shlokas.68:
yasya nAgasahasreNa dashasa~Nkhyena vai balam |
tulyaM taM bhImamutsRRijya nakulaM jIvamichChasi
shlokas.69:
tathainaM manujAH prAhurbhImasenaM priyaM tava |
atha kenAnubhAvena sApatnaM jIvamichChasi
shlokas.70:
yasya bAhubalaM sarve pANDavAH samupAshritAH |
arjunaM tamapAhAya nakulaM jIvamichChasi
shlokas.71:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmaH paramArthAchcha me matam |
AnRRisha.nsyaM chikIrShAmi nakulo yakSha jIvatu
shlokas.72:
dharmashIlaH sadA rAjA iti mAM mAnavA viduH |
svadharmAnna chaliShyAmi nakulo yakSha jIvatu
shlokas.73:
yathA kuntI tathA mAdrI visheSho nAsti me tayoH |
mAtRRibhyAM samamichChAmi nakulo yakSha jIvatu
shlokas.74:
yakSha uvAcha||
yasya te.arthAchcha kAmAchcha AnRRisha.nsyaM paraM matam |
tasmAtte bhrAtaraH sarve jIvantu bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste yakShavachanAdudatiShThanta pANDavAH |
kShutpipAse cha sarveShAM kShaNe tasminvyagachChatAm
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarasyekena pAdena tiShThantamaparAjitam |
pRRichChAmi ko bhavAndevo na me yakSho mato bhavAn
shlokas.3:
vasUnAM vA bhavAneko rudrANAmatha vA bhavAn |
atha vA marutAM shreShTho vajrI vA tridasheshvaraH
shlokas.4:
mama hi bhrAtara ime sahasrashatayodhinaH |
na taM yogaM prapashyAmi yena syurvinipAtitAH
shlokas.5:
sukhaM prativibuddhAnAmindriyANyupalakShaye |
sa bhavAnsuhRRidasmAkamatha vA naH pitA bhavAn
shlokas.6:
yakSha uvAcha||
ahaM te janakastAta dharmo mRRiduparAkrama |
tvAM didRRikShuranuprApto viddhi mAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
yashaH satyaM damaH shauchamArjavaM hrIrachApalam |
dAnaM tapo brahmacharyamityetAstanavo mama
shlokas.8:
ahi.nsA samatA shAntistapaH shauchamamatsaraH |
dvArANyetAni me viddhi priyo hyasi sadA mama
shlokas.9:
diShTyA pa~nchasu rakto.asi diShTyA te ShaTpadI jitA |
dve pUrve madhyame dve cha dve chAnte sAmparAyike
shlokas.10:
dharmo.ahamasmi bhadraM te jij~nAsustvAmihAgataH |
AnRRisha.nsyena tuShTo.asmi varaM dAsyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.11:
varaM vRRiNIShva rAjendra dAtA hyasmi tavAnagha |
ye hi me puruShA bhaktA na teShAmasti durgatiH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
araNIsahitaM yasya mRRiga AdAya gachChati |
tasyAgnayo na lupyeranprathamo.astu varo mama
shlokas.13:
dharma uvAcha||
araNIsahitaM tasya brAhmaNasya hRRitaM mayA |
mRRigaveSheNa kaunteya jij~nAsArthaM tava prabho
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dadAnItyeva bhagavAnuttaraM pratyapadyata |
anyaM varaya bhadraM te varaM tvamamaropama
shlokas.15:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
varShANi dvAdashAraNye trayodashamupasthitam |
tatra no nAbhijAnIyurvasato manujAH kvachit
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dadAnItyeva bhagavAnuttaraM pratyapadyata |
bhUyashchAshvAsayAmAsa kaunteyaM satyavikramam
shlokas.17:
yadyapi svena rUpeNa chariShyatha mahImimAm |
na vo vij~nAsyate kashchittriShu lokeShu bhArata
shlokas.18:
varShaM trayodashaM chedaM matprasAdAtkurUdvahAH |
virATanagare gUDhA avij~nAtAshchariShyatha
shlokas.19:
yadvaH sa~NkalpitaM rUpaM manasA yasya yAdRRisham |
tAdRRishaM tAdRRishaM sarve Chandato dhArayiShyatha
shlokas.20:
araNIsahitaM chedaM brAhmaNAya prayachChata |
jij~nAsArthaM mayA hyetadAhRRitaM mRRigarUpiNA
shlokas.21:
tRRitIyaM gRRihyatAM putra varamapratimaM mahat |
tvaM hi matprabhavo rAjanvidurashcha mamA.nshabhAk
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
devadevo mayA dRRiShTo bhavAnsAkShAtsanAtanaH |
yaM dadAsi varaM tuShTastaM grahIShyAmyahaM pitaH
shlokas.23:
jayeyaM lobhamohau cha krodhaM chAhaM sadA vibho |
dAne tapasi satye cha mano me satataM bhavet
shlokas.24:
dharma uvAcha||
upapanno guNaiH sarvaiH svabhAvenAsi pANDava |
bhavAndharmaH punashchaiva yathoktaM te bhaviShyati
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvAntardadhe dharmo bhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH |
sametAH pANDavAshchaiva sukhasuptA manasvinaH
shlokas.26:
abhyetya chAshramaM vIrAH sarva eva gataklamAH |
AraNeyaM dadustasmai brAhmaNAya tapasvine
shlokas.27:
idaM samutthAnasamAgamaM maha;tpitushcha putrasya cha kIrtivardhanam |
paThannaraH syAdvijitendriyo vashI; saputrapautraH shatavarShabhAgbhavet
shlokas.28:
na chApyadharme na suhRRidvibhedane; parasvahAre paradAramarshane |
kadaryabhAve na ramenmanaH sadA; nRRiNAM sadAkhyAnamidaM vijAnatAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dharmeNa te.abhyanuj~nAtAH pANDavAH satyavikramAH |
aj~nAtavAsaM vatsyantashChannA varShaM trayodasham
upopavishya vidvA.nsaH sahitAH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.2:
ye tadbhaktA vasanti sma vanavAse tapasvinaH |
tAnabruvanmahAtmAnaH shiShTAH prA~njalayastadA
abhyanuj~nApayiShyantastaM nivAsaM dhRRitavratAH
shlokas.3:
viditaM bhavatAM sarvaM dhArtarAShTrairyathA vayam |
ChadmanA hRRitarAjyAshcha niHsvAshcha bahushaH kRRitAH
shlokas.4:
uShitAshcha vane kRRichChraM yatra dvAdasha vatsarAn |
aj~nAtavAsasamayaM sheShaM varShaM trayodasham
tadvatsyAmo vayaM ChannAstadanuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.5:
suyodhanashcha duShTAtmA karNashcha sahasaubalaH |
jAnanto viShamaM kuryurasmAsvatyantavairiNaH
yuktAchArAshcha yuktAshcha paurasya svajanasya cha
shlokas.6:
api nastadbhavedbhUyo yadvayaM brAhmaNaiH saha |
samastAH sveShu rAShTreShu svarAjyasthA bhavemahi
shlokas.7:
ityuktvA duHkhashokArtaH shuchirdharmasutastadA |
saMmUrChito.abhavadrAjA sAshrukaNTho yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.8:
tamathAshvAsayansarve brAhmaNA bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
atha dhaumyo.abravIdvAkyaM mahArthaM nRRipatiM tadA
shlokas.9:
rAjanvidvAnbhavAndAntaH satyasandho jitendriyaH |
naiva.nvidhAH pramuhyanti narAH kasyA~nchidApadi
shlokas.10:
devairapyApadaH prAptAshChannaishcha bahushastathA |
tatra tatra sapatnAnAM nigrahArthaM mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.11:
indreNa niShadhAnprApya giriprasthAshrame tadA |
ChannenoShya kRRitaM karma dviShatAM balanigrahe
shlokas.12:
viShNunAshvashiraH prApya tathAdityAM nivatsyatA |
garbhe vadhArthaM daityAnAmaj~nAtenoShitaM chiram
shlokas.13:
prApya vAmanarUpeNa prachChannaM brahmarUpiNA |
baleryathA hRRitaM rAjyaM vikramaistachcha te shrutam
shlokas.14:
aurveNa vasatA ChannamUrau brahmarShiNA tadA |
yatkRRitaM tAta lokeShu tachcha sarvaM shrutaM tvayA
shlokas.15:
prachChannaM chApi dharmaj~na hariNA vRRitranigrahe |
vajraM pravishya shakrasya yatkRRitaM tachcha te shrutam
shlokas.16:
hutAshanena yachchApaH pravishya ChannamAsatA |
vibudhAnAM kRRitaM karma tachcha sarvaM shrutaM tvayA
shlokas.17:
evaM vivasvatA tAta ChannenottamatejasA |
nirdagdhAH shatravaH sarve vasatA bhuvi sarvashaH
shlokas.18:
viShNunA vasatA chApi gRRihe dasharathasya vai |
dashagrIvo hatashChannaM sa.nyuge bhImakarmaNA
shlokas.19:
evamete mahAtmAnaH prachChannAstatra tatra ha |
ajaya~nshAtravAnyuddhe tathA tvamapi jeShyasi
shlokas.20:
tathA dhaumyena dharmaj~no vAkyaiH samparitoShitaH |
shAstrabuddhyA svabuddhyA cha na chachAla yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.21:
athAbravInmahAbAhurbhImaseno mahAbalaH |
rAjAnaM balinAM shreShTho girA sampariharShayan
shlokas.22:
avekShayA mahArAja tava gANDIvadhanvanA |
dharmAnugatayA buddhyA na ki~nchitsAhasaM kRRitam
shlokas.23:
sahadevo mayA nityaM nakulashcha nivAritau |
shaktau vidhva.nsane teShAM shatrughnau bhImavikramau
shlokas.24:
na vayaM tatprahAsyAmo yasminyokShyati no bhavAn |
bhavAnvidhattAM tatsarvaM kShipraM jeShyAmahe parAn
shlokas.25:
ityukte bhImasenena brAhmaNAH paramAshiShaH |
prayujyApRRichChya bharatAnyathAsvAnsvAnyayurgRRihAn
shlokas.26:
sarve vedavido mukhyA yatayo munayastathA |
AshIruktvA yathAnyAyaM punardarshanakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.27:
saha dhaumyena vidvA.nsastathA te pa~ncha pANDavAH |
utthAya prayayurvIrAH kRRiShNAmAdAya bhArata
shlokas.28:
kroshamAtramatikramya tasmAddeshAnnimittataH |
shvobhUte manujavyAghrAshChannavAsArthamudyatAH
shlokas.29:
pRRithakShAstravidaH sarve sarve mantravishAradAH |
sandhivigrahakAlaj~nA mantrAya samupAvishan
